ARC-001.subject: E1.persistent_predictive_substrate
ARC-001.title: E1 is the persistent predictive substrate.
ARC-001.what_would_answer:
ARC-001 asserts E1 functions as a genuinely PERSISTENT predictive substrate --
carries information across a boundary a non-persistent/reset predictor would
lose it at. Never tested as its own claim (0 genuine_exp entries; sole
evidence is an indirect macaque-V4 literature analogy, not a direct
persistence measurement). Assumed via 23 dependent claims, not measured.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: E1's fast component (LSTM hidden state) is
explicitly and unconditionally cleared at every episode boundary via
reset_hidden_state() (agent.py:3012, :9390) -- so "E1 persists" is NOT
vacuously true of the whole module. The asserted-persistent component is
specifically ContextMemory's 16-slot associative bank, which
reset_hidden_state() never touches and which is separately offline-gated
during sleep (MECH-120/SD-017). A genuine test requires (a) a real
before/after boundary, and (b) a stateless comparator that ALSO zeroes
context_memory.memory at that boundary, so persistence is measured
against a matched non-persistent baseline.

MEASUREMENT: write distinguishable content into context_memory during
episode N, let reset_hidden_state() fire normally, measure retrieval at
the first few post-boundary steps in episode N+1 against a zeroed-memory
ablation at the same boundary. Reuse existing readouts (cosine similarity
already computed in _get_context_memory_code_contributions, or the
MECH-216 schema-salience head) rather than inventing new instrumentation.
Repeat across the sleep/consolidation boundary using the offline-mode
gate as the ablation lever.

ANSWER "persistent" (PASS) if the memory-intact condition shows
above-baseline retrieval in the first few post-boundary steps (>= 0.8 SD
of the seed-to-seed delta), while the zeroed-memory ablation shows none.

ANSWER "not functionally persistent" (FAIL) if there is no measurable
advantage over the zeroed-memory baseline -- would falsify "persistent
predictive substrate" as functionally distinguishing E1 from a stateless
predictor, and would prompt review of the 23 dependent claims.

ARC-002.subject: E2.fast_forward_predictor
ARC-002.title: E2 is the fast forward predictor of affordances.
ARC-002.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the test environment must have genuine
context-dependent action viability -- some actions available/effective only
in some states, not others (e.g. causal_grid_world.py's per-tick
consummatory-act affordance flag, gated on resource-zone entry). Without
this, "E2 predicts affordances" collapses into the untestable claim "E2
predicts world dynamics" -- there is no affordance structure distinct from
raw transition dynamics for E2 to get right or wrong.

CONFIRMING: E2's action-conditioned forward predictions (world_forward /
action_object, ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py) discriminate viable from
non-viable actions at a given state above a naive baseline -- e.g. a
readout over predicted world-effect (reusing the action_object o_t
representation, or the per-action-class viability-index pattern already
built for the narrow escape domain in
ree_core/pfc/e2_escape_affordance_linker.py, generalised beyond
threat/escape) correlates with ground-truth action viability/success at a
state, exceeding a baseline that assumes all actions are equally viable.
A weaker but still confirming form: cand_world_pairwise_dist /
world_forward_contrastive_loss (SD-056) shows predicted-outcome divergence
across actions that tracks true viability differences, not just generic
state drift.

FALSIFYING: E2's action-conditioned predictions show no advantage over a
uniform-viability baseline (predicted outcome/viability uncorrelated with
which actions are actually available/successful at a state) -- i.e. E2
behaves as a generic world-dynamics predictor that happens to be indexed
by action, without encoding "what am I able to do here" as a structure
distinct from "what happens next." This would not falsify E2 as a forward
predictor (ARC-001/E1-adjacent claims are unaffected) -- it would falsify
specifically the "of affordances" qualifier in ARC-002's title, meaning
the affordance-manifold language in e2.md sec 3 should be revised to plain
outcome-prediction language.

ARC-003.subject: E3.trajectory_commitment
ARC-003.title: E3 selects and commits trajectories.
ARC-003.what_would_answer:
ARC-003 is CONJUNCTIVE -- "E3 SELECTS" and "E3 COMMITS" are separate assertions
with OPPOSITE readiness. Digested 2026-07-21 by splitting on testability.

LEG A -- SELECTION (testable now, COMMITMENT-FREE).
ANSWER "E3 selects" if the E3 score gradient over the candidate set is non-flat
and predicts the taken candidate above chance, AND lesioning the E3 contribution
to the score collapses selection toward the candidate-generation prior.
ANSWER "E3 is a pass-through, not a selector" (FAIL) if candidate choice is
statistically indistinguishable from the proposer's prior. MECH-060/061/062 and
the tri-loop gating claims would then lose their premise.
NON-DEGENERACY: the candidate pool must be DIVERGENT (cand_world_pairwise_dist
above floor -- the GAP-A guard). Scoring a pool of near-identical candidates
tests nothing and would manufacture either verdict. Measured at the scoring
level; requires NO sustained execution.

LEG B -- COMMITMENT (BLOCKED; not queueable as of 2026-07-21).
ANSWER "E3 commits" if a selected trajectory persists across >= N steps under a
perturbation that would flip an uncommitted selector, with a measurable
release/switch cost (hysteresis).
This leg requires SUSTAINED MULTI-STEP ACTION COMMITMENT, and the basal-ganglia /
action-commitment layer is under active construction (ARC-107 BG-selector
constitution; MECH-448 demotion lever provisional; MECH-449 substrate_conditional;
commit/release-duration falsifiers 460j/485i/654h pending). A behavioural FAIL run
now would RE-DERIVE THE F-DOMINANCE CONVERSION CEILING ("a navigable landscape
does not convert to committed action because the selector drowns it"), NOT
adjudicate ARC-003 -- a confound, not a verdict.
RELEASE CONDITION: ARC-107 BG-selector constitution landed AND the
commit/release-duration levers (460j / 485i / 654h) returned.

ARC-004.awaiting: serial depth-cascade wiring in LatentStack.encode (z_delta over z_theta history, z_theta over z_beta) -- as-built the three layers are parallel filters sharing alpha_shared=0.3
ARC-004.subject: L_space.latent_stack
ARC-004.title: L-space is a multi-timescale latent stack.
ARC-004.what_would_answer:
ARC-004 asserts that L-space's z_beta/z_theta/z_delta layers are genuinely
stratified by TIMESCALE, not merely by role/information-content within a
single-rate recurrence. This has never been tested as its own claim (absent
from claim_evidence.v1.json) -- it is currently assumed via 36 dependents'
architecture, not measured.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: as-built, LatentStack.encode smooths z_beta,
z_theta, and z_delta with a SINGLE SHARED EMA constant (alpha_shared = 0.3,
hardcoded, ree_core/latent/stack.py) -- there is no differential clock rate
across the three layers. So the claim is NOT vacuously true by construction;
any timescale differentiation must emerge from the recursive top-down
architecture (z_delta reads only z_theta's history, z_theta reads only
z_beta's, so information at each level is progressively more temporally
aggregated) rather than from a built-in rate split. A genuine null (no
differentiation) is possible and must be measurable, not assumed away.
Precedent for taking this seriously: MECH-058 asserted an adjacent
"timescale separation" framing (for the z_self/z_world split) and was
retired (superseded by MECH-069, "incommensurable domains," not timescale).
ARC-004 could suffer the same fate.

[2026-09-01 governance, falsestmt-fix-20260901] CORRECTION -- THE PRECEDENT AS
PREVIOUSLY STATED WAS WRONG IN THREE RESPECTS, and it matters because GFLAG-0055
uses it as the central argument for superseding THIS claim. The original text
read that MECH-058 "was directly tested in V3-EXQ-019 via lag-k autocorrelation
-- it FAILED and the claim was retired". Verified 2026-09-01: (i) THE RETIREMENT
PREDATES THAT RUN -- MECH-058's superseded_at_utc is 2026-03-15, the V3 lag-k run
is 20260317T232028Z, two days LATER; (ii) the retirement basis was a
LEARNING-RATE ABLATION pair (V1 EXQ-002, V2 EXQ-019 terrain_timescale), not lag-k
autocorrelation; (iii) THE LAG-K RUN'S TIMESCALE CRITERIA BOTH PASSED -- that
run's own summary records C1 (dz_world_raw > dz_self) PASS and C2
(autocorr_corr[5] > autocorr_self[5]) PASS; its overall FAIL came from C3, a
reafference/SD-007 criterion, and C4, an underpowered step count (n=969 < 3000).
MECH-058's own note calls both FAILs "consistent with supersession: the test was
ill-posed".
SO THE PRECEDENT'S REAL SHAPE IS: a claim retired on an ILL-POSED TEST and
reframed on conceptual grounds -- which does NOT support "the falsifier fairly
failed", and if anything cuts toward narrowing rather than retiring. Do not quote
the original framing forward; it also propagated into
evidence/planning/e_ladder_realised_timescale_probe_20260820.md.

MEASUREMENT: log z_beta(t), z_theta(t), z_delta(t) trajectories over an
evaluation rollout (no code change needed -- reuse V3-EXQ-019's lag-k
autocorrelation / persistence-half-life methodology per layer instead of
per z_self/z_world). Optionally corroborate with a per-layer decomposition
of MECH-423's inference_convergence readout (currently a single relative-
delta over the concatenated [z_beta,z_theta,z_delta] vector -- would need
unpacking by layer, a small extension since the per-layer tensors already
exist inside LatentStack.encode's settling loop).

[2026-09-01 govapply-20260901] THE MEASUREMENT BELOW IS DEGENERATE AS-BUILT -- do not
run it as written. "No code change needed" is false: the depth cascade is three PARALLEL
first-order filters sharing one time constant, applied to within-tick functions of the
same input, so a per-layer lag-k autocorrelation over the current stack measures three
filters that are identical by construction. A genuine test requires the SERIAL wiring
this claim's precondition assumes (z_delta reading z_theta's history, z_theta reading
z_beta's), which is the substrate this claim now awaits. See evidence_quality_note.

ANSWER "multi-timescale" (PASS) if the layers show a monotonic ordering of
effective persistence -- z_delta autocorrelation half-life > z_theta's >
z_beta's -- by a margin exceeding cross-seed noise (>= 0.8 SD of the
seed-to-seed half-life delta, matching the effect-size convention used
elsewhere in this registry), AND (if measured) MECH-423 per-layer
convergence rates show the same ordering (z_delta settles slowest).

ANSWER "layers differ in content, not timescale" (FAIL) if autocorrelation
half-life is statistically indistinguishable across z_beta/z_theta/z_delta
despite their different informational roles -- i.e. the architecture
nominally stratifies by timescale but in practice all three layers carry
functionally identical temporal persistence. This would not remove the
layers' functional roles but would mean "multi-timescale" is the wrong
description of why they work, structurally analogous to what happened to
MECH-058, and would prompt a supersession review of ARC-004's framing.

ARC-005.subject: control_plane.precision_routing
ARC-005.title: Control plane routes precision and modes.
ARC-005.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: At least one live downstream consumer of operating_mode must be enabled and validated non-degenerate, and in the baseline arm at least two modes must be occupied >= 5% of steps with the precision readout carrying non-zero cross-seed variance. Without a consumer, channel and content arms are re-parameterisations of the same trajectory and neither verdict is earned.
CONFIRMING: Channel settings shift the consumed downstream quantity monotonically and by more than content does, and identical channel settings reproduce the same regime across differing content. Manipulation: Ladder the implemented channels (5-HT rigidity, phasic-surprise-burst gain, SalienceCoordinator mode prior, pcc_stability mu) at >= 4 levels while holding content fixed, and separately vary content with channels pinned. Control: The matched content-varied / channels-fixed cell, plus the canonical OFF arm in experiments/_lib/baselines/exq802_arc005_control_plane.py, on matched seeds and matched RNG. Required event: A trained agent run under a 2x2 of {control-plane channels varied, content fixed} x {content varied, channels fixed}, with the mode output actually consumed by a downstream module. DV: The channel effect on a CONSUMED downstream quantity (dACC bias applied to selection, or hippocampal mode-conditioned retrieval) and on the E3 precision readout, required to exceed the content effect by >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed delta and an absolute floor; per-unit Spearman rho over the ladder for the precision leg.
FALSIFYING: A consumed downstream quantity is predicted as well or better from content features than from channel settings, with a live consumer enabled -- the plane reads out rather than routes, and its dependents need re-derivation. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Partly present. V3-EXQ-846 and 848/848a/848b record per-channel authority and per-unit rho, but the mode-occupancy readout is the SalienceCoordinator's own state; no recorder reads a live consumer of operating_mode, because none is enabled. Consumer / boundary: The control plane's causal authority over a downstream consumer of precision and mode -- selection or retrieval that changes because the plane set a regime -- not the plane's own internal mode vector. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0321, arc005_dacc_adapter_goal_proximity_training, arc_005_control_plane_routing:GAP-A, arc_005_control_plane_routing:GAP-B, EXP-0392.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); operating_mode has no live consumer on any validated config, so the mode leg of the falsifier measures a re-parameterisation. The precision leg is additionally resolution-limited: a 3-level ladder makes Spearman rho too coarse to separate a weak real effect from noise (848a: 7/10 positive-signed, 6 at exactly 0.5). Secondary classes: R2, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's mode-occupancy DV no longer discriminates: GFLAG-0321 (2026-09-17) measured that operating_mode has NO live consumer at any validated config (salience_apply_to_dacc_bias False at config.py:4075, mode_conditioning_enabled False at config.py:2785, no SD-033 write-gate consumer), so a channel-driven shift in the mode vector is a closed-form re-parameterisation of one trajectory rather than routing authority -- channels 1 and 2 moved mode_entropy by exactly 0.000e+00 in V3-EXQ-846 and channel 3 left the trajectory bit-identical to 8 dp. Both plan nodes (GAP-A, GAP-B) are already done, so the WWA also no longer describes owed work. Coordinator: Prerequisite candidate (enable and validate exactly one live consumer of operating_mode) NOT registered as a new node: open GFLAG-0321 already names this item (filed against MECH-019); ARC-005 is recorded as a further claim that item unblocks, for governance to merge when it adjudicates the flag. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-006.subject: entities.binding
ARC-006.title: Entities are sparse, persistent, bindable structures.
ARC-006.what_would_answer:
ARC-006 asserts entities are (i) sparse, (ii) persistent, (iii) bindable
structures. Two of the three properties already have direct
experimental support one hop away: MECH-045's V3-EXQ-658 (2026-06-09,
PASS/supports) exercises ree_core/entities/object_file_buffer.py's
token-continuity association (C1/C5) and occlusion-persistence (C3) and
shows the buffer re-identifies a moved entity across occlusion
(reid_frac INTACT=1.0 vs SHUFFLE=0.3 vs OFF=0.0, feature term
non-degenerate d_cos_min=0.92, 3/3 seeds) -- "persistent" and "bindable
[across motion]" are effectively answered, but the evidence is tagged
only to MECH-045's claim_ids, not to ARC-006. [Note: a prior digestion
memory calling this "V3 pending" was stale as of this pass -- MECH-045
landed 2026-06-09.]

The third property, "sparse," is NOT yet exercised: V3-EXQ-658
deliberately set obf_max_tokens = N_DISTRACTORS + 2 (one slot of
headroom) to guarantee zero capacity evictions, isolating reid/
persistence from competitive contention. The buffer's C4
capacity-eviction machinery (_enforce_capacity(), _n_capacity_evictions,
default max_tokens=5) exists and is wired but has never run
over-capacity.

What would answer this (no new substrate build -- only a new experiment
config over the existing ObjectFileBuffer):
1. Bridge existing evidence: tag/synthesize V3-EXQ-658 onto ARC-006's
   own evidence block so "persistent"/"bindable-across-motion" support
   is visible at the parent-claim level.
2. Run a capacity-contention arm: N entities > max_tokens (e.g. 8
   salient candidates against max_tokens=5), varying per-entity
   salience, and test whether _enforce_capacity's evictions track the
   TRUE salience ranking above a shuffle/random-eviction control (same
   INTACT/SHUFFLE/OFF logic as V3-EXQ-658, applied to eviction choice).
   PASS = eviction selectivity beats shuffle control on >=2/3 seeds;
   FAIL = evictions are salience-independent (effectively FIFO/random),
   falsifying "sparse [attention-gated]" even though the raw capacity
   cap trivially holds.
3. Complementary confirming test (structurally parallel to SD-015's
   z_resource identity-recovery probe): a linear probe recovering
   per-token identity from the buffer's stored feature embedding should
   generalise across nuisance transformations (position, occlusion-gap
   length) well above a token-shuffled control -- operationalising
   "bindable" as identity-stability under transformation.

NON-DEGENERACY GUARD: uninformative if _n_capacity_evictions stays 0
throughout (contention never triggered) or distractor salience values
are near-identical. Add G3 (capacity actually exceeded) to V3-EXQ-658's
existing G0-G2 gates.

ARC-007.subject: hippocampus.path_memory
ARC-007.title: Hippocampal systems store and replay paths through residue-field terrain.
ARC-007.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Four gates, all measured in-run. (a) residue_structure_live: cross-center variance of active residue RBF weights above a floor in A0 and A2 -- permuting a flat field is a no-op that would manufacture a false FAIL. (b) executed_action_diversity: the agent must actually execute enough distinct action classes for a behavioural DV to move -- this is what V3-EXQ-800 breached and it is the binding gate. (c) permutation_effective: the permutation must verifiably alter field state. (d) A base effect must exist on the CORRECTED 114a design (matched episode budget, static no-op control), not on EXQ-114's retired 99.2%.
CONFIRMING: With all four gates met, A2 and A3 degrade toward A1, recovering >= 50% of the A0-to-A1 harm gap at >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed delta. The stored paths depend on residue structure specifically, and leg 2 promotes. Manipulation: The four arms already implemented in experiments/v3_exq_800: A0 intact, A1 hippocampus-ablated, A2 residue weights permuted across active RBF centers (preserving the weight multiset and the spatial map, destroying the residue-to-location correspondence), A3 residue field frozen at initialisation. Control: A1 is the reference ablation establishing the base effect, and A2's permutation is its own matched control by construction -- it preserves the field's marginal distribution exactly, so any A0-to-A2 difference is attributable to correspondence rather than to field magnitude. Required event: Navigation episodes with a live, spatially structured residue field and enough hazard exposure that harm_rate and path efficiency have dynamic range, executed by an agent whose committed actions span more than one class. DV: Behavioural: harm_rate and path efficiency in A2 and A3 relative to the A0-to-A1 gap, expressed as the fraction of that gap recovered, at >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed delta. Explicitly NOT hippo_quality_gap, which is sign-inverted and was reclassified non_contributory in 2026-04-22.
FALSIFYING: With the same gates met, A2 and A3 are statistically indistinguishable from intact A0. Path memory works but not through residue terrain: ARC-007 must be SPLIT, the path-memory leg carried by a corrected 114a-design base effect and the residue-terrain leg demoted, with the 76 dependents that assume residue-shaped terrain re-derived. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The driver is complete: four arms, a dedicated-generator permutation over active RBF centers, and pre-registered PRECONDITION_SPECS covering residue_structure_live, permutation_effective and executed_action_diversity. Its precondition machinery worked -- it is what detected the breach and refused to emit a verdict. Nothing is missing on the recorder side. Consumer / boundary: The hippocampal path store and replay, and specifically whether the stored paths depend on residue STRUCTURE rather than on an ordinary spatial map that residue merely co-varies with -- ARC-007's conjunctive leg 2, which is the whole REE-specific content. Existing ownership: ARC-007, f_dominance_conversion_ceiling, behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-C, V3-EXQ-800, V3-EXQ-114a, EXP-0393.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The falsifier is built, ran, and refused to render a verdict on its own pre-registered gate: executed_action_diversity was FALSE -- the agent did not act diversely enough for the dissociation to be readable. That is the conversion/behavioural-diversity ceiling, not a residue question, and it is owned elsewhere. The base-effect precondition additionally now points at a retired number. Secondary classes: R0. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The registered non-degeneracy precondition (b) is written against a number that has since been retired. It requires 'the A0 -> A1 harm gap must reproduce EXQ-114's magnitude, else there is no base effect to attribute', but the 2026-07-25 governance decision on V3-EXQ-114a (user-confirmed weakens) established EXQ-114's 99.2% headline was a DENOMINATOR ARTEFACT of a constant action stream: with E3-routed selection, a matched episode budget and a static no-op control, the advantage collapses to 11.4% against a 15% requirement, and ARC-007 was demoted active -> provisional on that basis. A precondition keyed to the retired magnitude is unsatisfiable by construction. Separately, the falsifier has now RUN: V3-EXQ-800 breached a precondition the text does not list -- executed_action_diversity -- and self-routed non_contributory / substrate_conditional, so the binding constraint is the conversion ceiling rather than anything about residue. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-009.subject: language.symbolic_mediation
ARC-009.title: Language is a symbolic mediation and coordination layer.
ARC-009.what_would_answer:
Requires two layers of substrate that do not yet exist in ree-v3, neither of which has an implementation and only the first has even a named design target. Layer 1 (shared with ARC-010): a multi-agent environment -- ARC-047's SocialGridWorld is the designated minimal substrate, itself status: candidate, confidence 0.0, gated to implementation_phase v5, and unbuilt. Layer 2 (specific to ARC-009): a discrete symbolic communication channel between agents -- confirmed absent from ree_core/ entirely (no "language", "symbol", "communication", or "message-passing" inter-agent machinery anywhere; the one reference, control_demand.py's LANGUAGE_EXPLICITATION enum label, has no implementation behind it). MECH-014 ("Minimal signalling channel requirements") is the closest existing design artifact for this layer, but it is a prose interface sketch only (inputs: latent-state summaries/residue flags; outputs: discrete-or-continuous signals other agents can condition on) with no substrate, no confidence score, and no queued experiment -- it is not an ARC-047-equivalent scoped build target.
A genuine test becomes possible once both layers land: two (or more) REE agent instances in a shared multi-agent environment (per ARC-010/ARC-047), given access to a shared discrete symbol channel (per MECH-014's sketch, built out as a real interface), on a task with information asymmetry -- one agent observes something the other needs to act correctly on, and coordination/reward requires the information to cross the channel (a standard emergent-communication paradigm, e.g. a referential/signalling game or a coordinated-response variant of ARC-047's predator-avoidance setup). Evidence for the claim would be: (1) agents given the symbol channel achieve significantly better task/coordination performance than a no-communication baseline; (2) the symbols carry recoverable meaning -- e.g. probe accuracy predicting the sender's underlying latent state (z_theta/z_delta slice, residue flag, or intent) from the emitted symbol above chance; and (3) ablating the channel, or shuffling the symbol-to-meaning mapping post-hoc, degrades coordination specifically (not just general task performance), showing the effect is mediated by the symbolic layer rather than some other shared signal (e.g. the scent-channel proxies ARC-047 already specifies). Until both the multi-agent substrate and a real (non-sketch) symbol-passing channel exist, no version of this claim is falsifiable in V3.

ARC-010.subject: social.mirror_modelling
ARC-010.title: Social cognition uses mirror modelling and coupling.
ARC-010.what_would_answer: Requires a multi-agent substrate that does not yet exist in ree-v3 (confirmed: no "social", "mirror", "other_agent", or "otherness" implementation anywhere under ree_core/ beyond two comments acknowledging its absence; ARC-047's SocialGridWorld environment -- the designated minimal substrate for this claim -- is itself unimplemented, status: candidate, confidence 0.0, and gated to implementation_phase v5). A genuine test becomes possible once that substrate lands, and would look like: train a REE agent in a multi-agent environment (e.g. ARC-047 SocialGridWorld, N agent instances sharing a grid) where a second agent's internal state is only observable indirectly (e.g. via the scent-channel proxies ARC-047 specifies: wanting_scent, alarm_scent, harm_stress_field, etc., rather than direct state access). Using the same shared self/other latent stack ARC-010 depends on (ARC-004 L-space, reused with reduced precision gains per the mirror-modelling mechanism), measure whether the agent's inferred other-model -- its OTHER_SELFLIKE-tagged shadow-bundle estimate of the other agent's action-selection (MECH-031) -- converges toward the other agent's actual policy/action distribution at above-chance accuracy across training, and whether coupling strength (signed harm+benefit routing into E3 ranking) predicts downstream cooperative or protective behavior (e.g. MECH-190's predicted defense- coalition sequence: individual defense -> alarm-triggered early coalition -> altruistic defense under no self-threat). Falsified if: even after the substrate exists and training is extended, the other- agent latent estimate does not track the other agent's true policy above chance, OR ablating the shared self-model machinery (forcing an independent from-scratch other-model) produces equal or better mirroring -- which would indicate social cognition does not in fact reuse self-representational machinery as ARC-010 asserts. Currently blocked, not testable: no multi-agent environment and no other-agent latent/inference channel exist in the V3 substrate. The single-agent CausalGridWorld environments used by nearly all current V3 experiments have no second agent to model.

ARC-011.subject: sleep.offline_integration
ARC-011.title: Offline integration (sleep) is required for stability.
ARC-011.what_would_answer:
ARC-011 asserts offline integration (sleep) is REQUIRED FOR STABILITY --
distinct from INV-010 (sleep exists and is required, a bare universal
necessity grounded in cross-species biology, no depends_on) in that
ARC-011 stakes a REE-specific architectural claim: that omitting sleep
causes measurable instability, mediated through ARC-007 (hippocampal
replay) and ARC-005 (control plane). [Digestion note, not resolved
here: INV-010 and ARC-011 are near-duplicate in wording -- worth a
governance pass to make the distinction explicit in one or both
entries, or confirm they should stay separate.] Never tested as its
own claim: 0 genuine_exp entries (claim_evidence.v1.json), sole
evidence one literature citation (zebrafish sleep biology) shared with
INV-010. The extensive sleep experimental corpus in this codebase
(SD-017, MECH-120, MECH-204, MECH-272/273/275/285, Q-055) all attaches
to child mechanism claims, never to ARC-011 or INV-010 directly.

STABILITY OPERATIONALIZED (per docs/architecture/sleep.md's own
"Failure if omitted" list, using DVs already instrumented in the
sleep-cluster experiments):
  (a) Representation drift: slot_cosine_sim among ContextMemory slots
      rising toward ~1.0 (context representations collapsing/
      undifferentiated) -- instrumented since the SD-017/EXQ-436
      family.
  (b) Policy/diversity erosion ("monostrategy convergence"): committed-
      action-class entropy retained at t_k vs t_0, sleep-ON vs
      sleep-OFF -- the DV used by V3-EXQ-691/Q-055.
  (c) Residue-field runaway: unbounded growth/variance in the residue
      field R, or policy entropy collapsing toward frozen -- the
      "residue overgeneralisation" / "brittle or frozen policy
      selection" failure modes named in sleep.md.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the comparison must run long enough / over
enough would-be sleep cycles that instability has a chance to manifest
in EITHER arm. A short run where neither condition destabilizes is
uninformative -- this is not hypothetical caution, it is the observed
failure mode of the two closest existing attempts: EXQ-430 (SLEEP harm
< NO_SLEEP, INV-010) found no differential effect in 0/3 seeds and was
read as substrate-gated/inconclusive rather than falsifying;
V3-EXQ-691 (Q-055) found sleep-OFF was NOT visibly worse than sleep-ON
on diversity erosion at the horizon tested (sleep-OFF was in fact
marginally LESS eroded). Both are consistent with "the run never got
long/stressed enough for the predicted divergence to appear," not with
"sleep doesn't matter." A valid test therefore needs either (i) a
horizon long enough that waking-only operation visibly degrades on
>=1 of the DVs above while the sleep-ON arm does not, or (ii) an
explicit stressor (elevated novelty/harm load, episode count well past
where current sleep-adjacent experiments stop) to force the divergence
within a tractable budget. The sleep-ON arm must run the FULL flag
stack (use_sleep_loop, sws_enabled, rem_enabled,
use_sleep_aggregation_cluster -- landed 2026-05-16 GAP-3), not the
partial/legacy configs used in EXQ-418/436/538a, which repeatedly
produced vacuous or non_contributory results from missing read-paths
rather than a genuine sleep-ON vs sleep-OFF contrast.

CONFIRMING signature: the sleep-OFF arm shows measurable degradation
on >=1 of the three stability DVs over the extended/stressed horizon
(slot_cosine_sim trending toward degenerate; action-class entropy
collapsing toward a frozen/monostrategy floor; residue-field
norm/variance growing without bound), while the sleep-ON arm (full
flag stack) does not show the same degradation, or shows it
significantly less severely, matched for total experience/compute.

FALSIFYING: sleep-OFF sustains the same stability profile as sleep-ON
across all three DVs over the extended/stressed horizon -- no
differential drift, no differential diversity erosion, no differential
residue runaway. This would falsify ARC-011's specific "required FOR
STABILITY, in REE" claim even if INV-010's weaker "sleep exists and is
architecturally motivated" survives on cross-species biological-
analogy grounds alone -- this is the concrete point at which the two
claims can empirically decouple, which is why they should not share
one falsifier.

ARC-012.subject: ethics.no_explicit_cost_term
ARC-012.title: E3 does not require an explicit ethical cost term.
ARC-012.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The harm DV must be off the floor: SD-010/011/012 cut realised harm rates by roughly 100x (the EXQ-227 finding that V3-EXQ-1049 re-registers as its P3 gate), so an environment and episode budget producing a non-trivial baseline contact/harm rate must be witnessed per arm. The residue field must also carry live non-flat structure, otherwise removing M leaves nothing that could substitute for it and the falsifier cannot discriminate 'M unnecessary' from 'nothing works'.
CONFIRMING: With the harm floor cleared, setting lambda_ethical = 0 leaves contact rate and harm exposure statistically indistinguishable from the lambda_ethical = 1 arm on >= 2/3 seeds, and distinguishable from the matched non-ethical-channel ablation -- the explicit term is not required, harm avoidance survives through residue and reality cost. Manipulation: Ablate the explicit ethical cost term on the live scoring path -- lambda_ethical = 0 (E3Config, consumed as lambda_eff in e3_selector.score_trajectory) -- against the shipped lambda_ethical = 1.0, holding f_weight, rho_residue, the harm stream and training budget fixed. Control: A matched arm that removes an equal amount of score magnitude from a NON-ethical channel (f_weight or rho_residue scaled to the same mean contribution recorded by the commensurability estimator), so the comparison is 'ethical term removed' rather than 'score scale changed'. Required event: Trials presenting an approach-gradient conflict: a trajectory that is better on reality cost F and on residue Phi but worse on harm proximity, so the presence or absence of the explicit M term changes which trajectory is committed. DV: Hazard contact rate and cumulative harm exposure per episode in the lambda_ethical = 0 arm relative to the lambda_ethical = 1 arm at matched seeds, with per-channel mean contributions (f_weighted / harm_weighted / residue_weighted) recorded so the counterfactual weighting is auditable.
FALSIFYING: Setting lambda_ethical = 0 produces a significant rise in contact rate or harm exposure, beyond the matched-magnitude control's effect, on >= 2/3 seeds. E3 then does require an explicit ethical cost term, and ARC-012 as an architectural commitment does not hold in the built substrate. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The manipulation and the score decomposition both exist: e3_selector.score_trajectory composes f_weight * F + lambda_eff * M + rho_residue * Phi, with three M evaluation routes (compute_harm_forward_cost, compute_harm_stream_cost, compute_harm_cost_fallback) and _last_commensurability_raw recording each channel's raw magnitude. No experiment in ree-v3 references ARC-012 at all; no run ablates lambda_ethical. Consumer / boundary: The E3 committed-selection score -- whether harm avoidance requires its own priced term there, or is recoverable from the residue and reality channels alone. Not the harm encoder and not the environment's harm generation, both of which stay identical across arms. Existing ownership: ARC-012, EXP-0441, V3-EXQ-1049, INV-001.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Nothing blocks the run: the ablation knob, the three M routes, the per-channel decomposition and the behavioural DVs all exist on the live path. The claim simply has never been tested -- zero experimental entries, zero mentions of ARC-012 anywhere in ree-v3 -- and the standing risk is the post-SD-010/011/012 harm-rate floor making both arms look identical for the wrong reason. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-013.subject: residue.geometry
ARC-013.title: Residue is persistent latent-space curvature; hippocampal paths form a cognitive map.
ARC-013.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The residue field must be able to express spatial contrast and to retain a path. Both fail at production defaults: kernel_bandwidth 1.0 against a measured z_world manifold whose two most distant reachable points are 0.125 apart gives an RBF contrast of 0.9922 (a near-uniform additive offset, which is argmin-invariant), and num_basis_functions 32 with a round-robin overwrite wraps ~28 times in a 720-step run.
CONFIRMING: Residue laid in region R shifts candidate ranking specifically for candidates near R and not for equally harm-loaded candidates near R', and that shift survives a transit through a distinct context. Manipulation: Fork a trained agent into a harm-accruing path in region R versus a harm-free path, with a matched control accruing equal harm mass in a distant region R', holding all non-residue score surfaces bit-identical. Control: The residue-zeroed arm (the V3-EXQ-697 idiom base_i = raw_score_i - residue_weighted_i) plus the equal-harm-elsewhere fork, on matched RNG and matched candidate sets. Required event: An agent that traverses a harm-marked region and later revisits it, or transits between two distinguishable regions, with residue laid down along the first path. DV: Location-specific change in the pre-sampling E3 candidate ranking attributable to residue -- flip rate of the residue-intact versus residue-zeroed argmin conditioned on region -- and survival of region-R centres across a context transition.
FALSIFYING: Residue's effect on ranking is the same for R and R' candidates (a broadcast constant, not a terrain), or the R-specific effect does not survive a context transition -- residue is not persistent latent-space curvature. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Present but mis-scaled. ResidueField / RBFLayer (residue/field.py) and the 697 decomposition record residue's contribution to scoring (flip_intact_vs_zeroed 0.06-0.996 across seeds), but nothing records centre survival across contexts and the kernel cannot resolve region identity at default bandwidth. Consumer / boundary: The residue term inside E3 candidate scoring as a function of WHERE the candidate sits in z_world -- geometry -- not merely whether a residue term is present. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0240, MECH-023, SD-067, infant_substrate:GAP-10, INF-ENV-001.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); At production defaults the residue field is spatially near-uniform (0.8% kernel contrast across the entire reachable manifold), so a geometry falsifier cannot discriminate; and the 32-slot round-robin means injecting fork history RELOCATES the 32 most recent centres rather than extending a path, making any positive result unattributable between geometry and near-field deletion. Secondary classes: R2, R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-014.subject: default_mode.internal_generative
ARC-014.title: Default Mode enables safe imagination without commitment.
ARC-014.what_would_answer:
ARC-014 is CONJUNCTIVE -- "safe imagination" (positive: useful internal
simulation genuinely occurs) and "without commitment" (negative: it
never durably writes to real-experience state) are separate assertions
with DIFFERENT evidentiary status.

LEG A -- SAFE IMAGINATION (that Default Mode / DMN replay genuinely
executes and its content reaches SOME functional consumer). ANSWER by
architectural audit of the live replay/ghost call site, not by
V3-EXQ-880 (which does not exercise it). ree_core/agent.py's
_do_replay() (the production ghost/replay call site) calls
hippocampal.replay()/diverse_replay() -- so the GENERATIVE act of
internal simulation genuinely fires in production -- but per the
V3-EXQ-880 driver's own docstring, its output trajectories are
currently DISCARDED without ever reaching lateral_pfc.update() or
residue_field.accumulate(); MECH-319 names this the "reserved seam"
for the still-pending V3-EXQ-543c replay-driven invocation path.
Separately, INV-011's own audit (this session) traces a DIFFERENT
generative pathway -- E1 internal generation via simulate()/sense()
with hypothesis_tag=True -- through ~30 live agent.py call sites and
concludes DMN/E1 rollout content reaches phi(z)-adjacent read paths
for attenuated affect without producing a belief update. That is
evidence LEG A holds for the E1/simulate() pathway specifically; it is
NOT evidence for the hippocampal _do_replay()/DMN-ghost pathway, whose
output is currently discarded wholesale (not merely write-suppressed)
and is not yet wired to any consumer, safe or not. LEG A therefore
remains PARTIALLY answered: confirmed for E1/simulate(), open
(reserved seam, pending 543c) for the DMN/hippocampal-replay pathway
specifically named in ARC-014's own "Default Mode" title.

LEG B -- WITHOUT COMMITMENT (that simulation-tagged content, IF it
reached a commitment-capable write consumer, would be suppressed while
waking-tagged content commits). ANSWERED by V3-EXQ-880 (2026-08-02,
PASS, 3/3 seeds). Matched-content design: identical captured
(z_delta, z_world) content from a real seeded env rollout applied to
two agents built from the same seed, differing only in
hypothesis_tag/simulation_mode. Two independent channels, both
load-bearing: rule_state/MECH-319 (sim_rule_state_delta <= 1e-7,
measured 0.0 all seeds; wake_rule_state_delta >= 1e-4, measured
0.31-0.43 all seeds); residue/MECH-094 (sim_residue_delta <= 1e-6,
measured 0.0 all seeds; wake_residue_delta >= 1.0, measured ~2.0 all
seeds). IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the experiment constructs the write-gate
seam DIRECTLY via manual tag injection and direct API calls -- it does
NOT drive the real production _do_replay() call site, which (see LEG
A) currently discards its trajectories before they would ever reach
these consumers at all. V3-EXQ-880 therefore confirms the categorical
write-gate ITSELF behaves correctly as a defense-in-depth safeguard,
not that production replay content is currently routed through it.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (LEG B, per V3-EXQ-880's own pre-registered
grid): C0 path-exercised (WAKE arm n_waking_admitted == N_CAPTURE; SIM
arm n_simulation_blocked == N_CAPTURE, n_simulation_admitted == 0)
AND C1/C2/C4/C5 (all load-bearing, combined via plain AND).

FALSIFYING evidence (LEG B): a future experiment driving genuine
replay-tagged content through the real _do_replay() -> consumer path
(once 543c wires it) finds simulation-tagged content reaching
lateral_pfc.update() or residue_field.accumulate() and durably
altering state -- i.e. the gate confirmed here in isolation is
bypassed once wired to the real call site.

CONFIRMING evidence (LEG A residual): a future experiment or audit
showing the DMN/_do_replay() pathway's discarded trajectories are (or
become, post-543c) actually consumed by some functional read path --
would close LEG A for the specific pathway ARC-014's "Default Mode"
title names.

GOVERNANCE FLAG (not resolved here): claim_evidence.v1.json still
shows genuine_exp_count=0, exp_conf=0.0 for ARC-014 despite V3-EXQ-880
(PASS, 2026-08-02) being on file -- the index has not been regenerated
since. Worth a governance index rebuild pass.

ARC-015.subject: agency.self_impact_attribution
ARC-015.title: Self-impact attribution and responsibility flow are required.
ARC-015.what_would_answer:
ARC-015 bundles two testably-separable sub-claims: (1) SELF-IMPACT ATTRIBUTION --
discriminating self-caused from externally-caused state change via an
efference-copy/reafference comparator (operationalised as MECH-095, the TPJ
agency-detection comparator at the z_self/z_world interface); and (2)
RESPONSIBILITY FLOW -- routing that attribution into commit-boundary-gated
learning with pre-commit/post-commit channel separation (MECH-060/061/066/067)
and action/thought-loop completion gates (MECH-057a/057b).

These two halves currently have DIFFERENT evidentiary status and different
substrate requirements. Do not treat ARC-015 as a single testable-now unit.

== HALF 2 (responsibility flow / commit-boundary separation): already has
supporting evidence, testable now ==
MECH-060 (V1, EVB-0043/EXQ-005 PASS) and MECH-061 (channel independence,
|corr|=0.114) already confirm write-locus separation is enforceable and
beneficial. MECH-057a has informative sub-threshold V1/V2 evidence
(FULL < NO_ATTRIBUTION < NO_GATING, correctly ordered) and is now V3-eligible
because V3 supports multi-step committed actions, which V2's atomic single-step
actions could not provide. A clean V3 re-test of MECH-057a on multi-step action
sequences would CONFIRM this half if the completion-gate ablation degrades
responsibility-attribution quality above the pre-registered threshold, and would
FALSIFY it if gating vs. no-gating remains indistinguishable at V3 scale.

== HALF 1 (self-impact attribution / self-vs-world discrimination):
CONFIRMED substrate-blocked on single-agent V3, do not re-test as-is ==

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a genuine test requires an environment containing
BOTH self-caused and externally-caused outcomes that are causally
indistinguishable from surface features alone -- discriminable only via the
agent's own efference copy / action history. CausalGridWorld's native hazards
and resource dynamics do NOT satisfy this: hazard drift and resource respawn
are environment-authored processes with no "intent" for the comparator to
contrast against the agent's own commanded action, so mismatch collapses to
noise regardless of comparator quality.

This was tested directly, not assumed. SD-047 (multi-source environmental
dynamics) was purpose-built to supply a structurally distinct "other" cause.
V3-EXQ-741 (2026-07-12, confirmed failure autopsy, governance-consumed) is the
first VALID test of MECH-095 on the SD-047 substrate: non-degenerate on both
the probe-partition and self/world-balance guards, all 4 intensity arms
exercised as pre-registered. Result: no arm discriminates (best routing
improvement +0.028, below the 0.04 pre-registered floor); the BASELINE already
carries strong contact recall (0.75-0.93) without the comparator. Recorded
interpretation: SD-047's world-caused drift is not a structurally-distinct
OTHER, so a single-agent environment -- however richly instrumented -- cannot
make the comparator load-bearing. This is registered as the 1st valid
substrate_ceiling hit for MECH-095 and empirically confirms
multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-3's standing prediction that this mechanism is
intrinsically relational.

CONFIRMING signature (once MAE-3 / a genuine second agent is available):
on a multi-agent environment where some negative/positive outcomes are caused
by the OTHER agent's actions and some by the focal agent's own actions
(surface-matched, causally distinguishable only via each agent's own action
history), MECH-095's routing improvement on an other-caused-event partition
exceeds the pre-registered 0.04 floor over baseline, with contact_recall_routed
and action-dissociation metrics both clearing their thresholds on >=3 seeds.

FALSIFYING signature: even against a genuine second agent's actions, the
comparator's routed condition fails to discriminate self-caused from
other-caused outcomes -- this would exhaust the mapped substrate ceiling and
force a mechanism-level reconsideration of MECH-095's TPJ-comparator
translation, not merely another substrate enrichment attempt.

Until MAE-3 lands, ARC-015's self-impact-attribution half stays at the same
disposition as ARC-010 (mirror modelling of other agents): substrate-blocked,
pending_retest_after_substrate=true, bound to multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-3.

ARC-016.subject: cognitive_modes.control_plane_regimes
ARC-016.title: Modes are control-plane regimes applied to shared predictive machinery: the precision-to-commitment circuit.
ARC-016.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The eval-time commit threshold must genuinely engage: eval running variance must sit inside the threshold's dynamic range and commit_rate must move strictly between floor and ceiling. At 2 x TRAINING baseline variance the gate never fires in eval (the EXQ-396a/b death), and a trained agent's running variance collapses orders of magnitude below any absolute bar, so the threshold must be re-derived per seed from a noise-free eval calibration window.
CONFIRMING: commit_rate falls monotonically as injected precision noise rises, every seed negatively signed with |rho| above the floor and commit_range above the engagement floor -- the control-plane regime genuinely gates shared predictive machinery at eval time. Manipulation: Inject graded Gaussian noise of pre-registered std directly into the world_forward prediction error that feeds e3.update_running_variance, during eval only, at target running-variance multiples 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.5 / 4.0 / 7.0 of the per-seed eval baseline. Control: A noise-free eval calibration window fixes the per-seed baseline and sets commit_threshold = 2 x eval_baseline; seeds, content and candidate generation held identical across sweep levels, and no behavioural harm DV is attached (that is ARC-029). Required event: A trained agent evaluated while E3-derived prediction-error variance is swept across a graded range, with the BetaGate still wired to action_selection. DV: Per-seed Spearman rho between realised E3 running variance and commit_rate across the sweep levels, together with commit_range within seed as the engagement gate.
FALSIFYING: With the gate demonstrably engaged (commit_range above floor), commit_rate fails to track E3-derived variance -- the first genuine evidence against the precision-to-commitment circuit, forcing the 15 prior FAILs to be re-read as right for the wrong reasons. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_818_arc016_eval_derived_noise_precision_sweep.py driving e3_selector.update_running_variance and the variance-space commit threshold (e3_selector.py:287, :602); the manifest records per-seed rho, all_seeds_negative and commit_range_worst_seed. Consumer / boundary: The E3 variance-to-commit_threshold comparison feeding the BetaGate and action_selection in agent.py (agent.py:7161-7169, :10892), not episode reward and not behavioural harm. Existing ownership: ARC-016, V3-EXQ-818, EXP-0397, GFLAG-0358.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); R0 -- the falsifier is instantiated and has been fired (V3-EXQ-818 PASS). The only live residual is non-degeneracy: the binary commit gate saturates in a trained agent against an absolute threshold, so any successor must re-derive the threshold per seed from an eval window rather than from training variance. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's single named open item -- 'pending recalibration with eval-derived threshold' -- landed and PASSED as V3-EXQ-818 on 2026-07-25 (mean_rho_rv_vs_commit -0.955 against a -0.80 floor, 4/4 seeds negative), and the evidence picture it argues from (exp_conf 0.53, 15 FAILs, aggregation artefact) was superseded by the 2026-07-25 rescore: claim_evidence now reads exp=6, 6 supports, 0 fails, exp_conf 0.847, quadrant confirmed_established. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-017.subject: sensory_stream_tags.minimal_set
ARC-017.title: Minimal stream tags with typed exteroception and explicit reality-coherence lane.
ARC-017.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Some arm must give the representation a reason to carry harm: in both March 2026 runs z_world was detached before the harm_eval probe, so no condition created training pressure and both intact arms returned the identical emergent floor 0.0153. The typed arm must actually route rather than discard a channel.
CONFIRMING: Typed routing yields a larger harm/safe gap than the information-matched merged encoder across seeds, and the gap degrades measurably when imagined/replayed content is allowed to train z_world. Manipulation: Typed separation using the built substrate -- SplitEncoder.lateral_head / HarmEncoder producing a genuine z_harm read by harm_eval_z_harm -- against a merged single-encoder ablation on concatenated world plus harm observations. Control: An INFORMATION-MATCHED merged-encoder arm (never a channel-dropping arm), same capacity, seeds and harm exposure; for the second facet, real-observation training versus replay-contaminated training. Required event: Harm-bearing and world-bearing observations arriving on separable channels during training, with enough harm evaluations to score (n_harm_eval >= 20 per arm). DV: Harm-versus-safe evaluation gap under typed routing minus the same gap under the information-matched merged encoder, with both arms under identical harm-training pressure.
FALSIFYING: The information-matched merged encoder matches or beats typed routing on the harm/safe gap, and reality-contaminated training leaves the gap unchanged -- neither the typed separation nor the reality-coherence lane is architecturally load-bearing. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/latent/stack.py SplitEncoder.lateral_head (MECH-099, line 892) and e3_selector.harm_eval_z_harm (SD-010) exist and are used by roughly 40 experiment scripts, none of which carries claim_ids ARC-017. Consumer / boundary: The encoder boundary -- whether typed stream separation changes what harm evaluation can express -- and, for the second facet, the provenance of the observation that produced a z_world state. Existing ownership: MECH-099, SD-010, EXP-1317, V3-EXQ-129.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The typed-stream substrate ARC-017 asserts was built for other claims and never applied back; the claim's only two experimental entries are March 2026 runs whose TYPED arm discarded harm_obs outright. The reality-coherence facet has no substrate at all -- grep of ree_core finds no provenance / is_imagined / source-tag machinery, only an unrelated resource_tag. Secondary classes: R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-018.subject: hippocampus.rollout_viability_mapping
ARC-018.title: Hippocampus generates explicit rollouts and post-commitment viability mapping.
ARC-018.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: In-run E2 world-forward R^2 against realised next z_world must clear 0.6 (801 measured -66 to -130), rollout scores must carry non-zero cross-candidate variance, fresh E3 selections must actually occur (801 latched 366 of 367 eval ticks), and an exactly-0.0 harm advantage on every seed must be trapped as the unwired-DV signature rather than scored.
CONFIRMING: With E2 fidelity green, harm_advantage_mean rises monotonically with rollout depth and beats both the depth-0 and noise arms at the registered effect size; the mapping leg separately retains its advantage over a static no-op control at matched budget. Manipulation: Rollout depth ablation at matched seeds: depth 0 (no rollout), shallow, full, plus a noise-scored arm, run only after the E2 fidelity floor is measured green in-run, with the P0a z_world warmup stage enabled so the encoder the forward model reads is trained. Control: Depth-0 and noise-scored arms at matched seeds and step budget, plus the static no-op control that V3-EXQ-120a introduced for the mapping leg. Required event: Eval episodes in which the agent runs multi-step hippocampal/CEM rollouts over a forward model of demonstrated fidelity and makes fresh, non-latched selections among candidates with differing rollout scores. DV: harm_advantage_mean at a matched action budget, per arm and per seed, tested for monotonic response to rollout depth at an effect of at least 0.8 SD of the cross-seed contrast on at least 2 of 3 seeds.
FALSIFYING: With E2 fidelity green, verified-live rollouts and non-degenerate rollout score variance, no rollout depth confers any harm advantage over depth-0 -- ARC-018 reduces to its mapping leg; or the mapping leg's advantage does not survive a matched-budget static control, which V3-EXQ-120a already found. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: v3_exq_801 records harm_rate_by_arm, harm_advantage_by_arm, per-seed e2_world_r2, rollout_score_range, fresh_select_yield and residue coverage, and gates every arm on e2_world_r2_adequate before scoring; the instrument is adequate and is what detected the substrate shortfall. Consumer / boundary: Hippocampal/CEM rollout scoring feeding E3 candidate selection, and separately the terrain-prior read that guides navigation -- two distinct loci that the conjunction has been averaging. Existing ownership: V3-EXQ-801, V3-EXQ-120a, sd_zworld_warmup_optimizer_group, SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY, e2-world-forward-sleep-trainer, EXP-0396.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The claim's own rollout test cannot enter its discriminating regime: V3-EXQ-801's four arms all measured e2_world_r2 between -66 and -130 against a 0.6 floor, and fresh_select_yield of 0.0027 means the agent latched almost every tick. The z_world/E2 fidelity work that would lift the floor is registered and ready (sd_zworld_warmup_optimizer_group validated, SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY pending, e2-world-forward-sleep-trainer implemented) but no ARC-018 run has used any of it. ARC-019.subject: developmental.curriculum_stages
ARC-019.title: REE requires staged developmental training with explicit curriculum gates.
ARC-019.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A staged-vs-unstaged comparison is only informative if
the staged arm can actually traverse its stages under the tested budget -- i.e. the
phase-advance gate criteria (as in InfantCurriculumScheduler / infant_substrate_expansion.md
Section 8) must be reachable, and the unstaged control must differ from the staged arm only
in the presence/absence of gating (same total episode budget, same environmental feature set
eventually enabled, same seeds) -- not merely relabeled episode counts. V3-EXQ-591 (2026-05-27)
demonstrated the failure mode this precondition guards against: all arms (staged and flat
alike) plateaued at 1/7 gate criteria because a goal-pipeline prerequisite (z_goal seeding,
goal_pipeline:GAP-4) was not yet substrate-ready, producing a substrate-ceiling non-result
rather than a test of the curriculum question. This precondition must be independently
verified (e.g. staged arm reaches at least Phase 1 in >=80% of seeds) before treating any
outcome below as evidence either way.

CONFIRMING: Given the non-degeneracy precondition holds, the staged/gated curriculum arm
(ARM_2-style, phase-advance gated on the DEV-NEED-008 / infant_substrate_expansion.md
Section 8 criteria) reaches a materially higher fraction of the 7-criterion developmental
gate (>=6/7 in >=4/5 seeds, per V3-EXQ-591's own acceptance design) than an unstaged/ungated
baseline trained on the identical total episode budget and identical eventual feature set
(flat ARM_0/ARM_1-style). Equivalently, on any already-used downstream competence metric in
this registry (e.g. MECH-457 competence-floor measures, or convergence quality/H_pos
trajectory stability), the staged arm should show measurably better or more stable outcomes
than the ungated control at matched total training cost -- and this advantage should
reproduce across at least one additional curriculum-bearing lineage (e.g. scaffolded_sd054
onboarding, or the play-type progression of MECH-197) once each is substrate-ready, not
just the infant-stage instance.

FALSIFYING: Given the non-degeneracy precondition holds (staged arm demonstrably traverses
multiple stages), the staged/gated arm shows no reliable advantage over the unstaged/ungated
baseline at matched total training budget -- e.g. gate-criterion satisfaction, competence-floor
measures, or convergence quality are statistically indistinguishable between staged and flat
arms, or the flat arm matches/exceeds the staged arm at equal or lower cost. This would
indicate the explicit stage/gate structure is not doing useful work beyond what unstructured
training achieves anyway -- the curriculum may still be a convenient scaffold for organizing
training runs and diagnostics, but "staged development with explicit gates" would not be
architecturally load-bearing for outcome quality, only for interpretability/debuggability
(which is a different, weaker claim than ARC-019 currently asserts).

ARC-020.subject: sleep.protected_offline_consolidation_boundary
ARC-020.title: Offline consolidation is protected by typed authority/write boundaries.
ARC-020.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this claim requires a live, reachable typed commit-boundary mechanism gating writes FROM offline/sleep consolidation TO privileged authority stores (POL/ID/CAPS per docs/architecture/sleep.md#arc-020) -- i.e. MECH-067's "machine-checkable phase/store/actor permission matrix" (or equivalent) must actually be wired into the V3 sleep pipeline, with an offline code path CAPABLE of attempting an authority-store write and being intercepted/typed-routed rather than merely never attempting one by construction. THIS PRECONDITION CURRENTLY FAILS: exhaustive grep of ree-v3/ree_core/ for write_locus, permission_matrix, POL/CAPS/ID authority-store analogs, commit_token, and commit_boundary returns zero hits. The sleep pipeline has phase/mode routing (SWS/REM gates, sleep-onset permits) but no privileged-authority-store concept and no typed commit-boundary/ verifier-mediation machinery. MECH-067, the claim this would be implemented through, is provisional on V1 substrate only (ree-v1-minimal EXQ-005/EVB-0043, 2026-02-27) and has never been retested in V3. Do not force a genuine_exp test while this precondition is unmet -- any attempt would be vacuous (no reachable write path to authority stores exists for offline consolidation to violate OR respect). CONFIRMING (once the precondition is met): an experiment in which offline/sleep consolidation generates a candidate authority-affecting change (a commitment-token mint, an external-action dispatch, or a direct write to a POL/ID/CAPS-equivalent store) is rejected or re-routed through the typed commit-boundary/verifier path rather than landing directly -- distinguishable from an ordinary representational/residue/ precision write (which should succeed unimpeded, per the sleep.md "MAY update" list). FALSIFYING: (a) offline/sleep consolidation can mutate a privileged authority-store equivalent directly, with no type check, no verifier mediation, and no distinguishable code path from an ordinary representational write; or (b) a boundary exists but does not discriminate by TYPE (any offline-originated write reaches the store regardless of whether it is representational or authority-affecting); or (c) the only enforcement is a naming/comment-level convention with no machine-checked gate.
SCOPE RULING 2026-09-10 (governance, GFLAG-0128, user decision, option (a)): the permissive MAY-update list this claim inherits from docs/architecture/sleep.md#arc-020 NOW EXPLICITLY INCLUDES ACCESS-ROUTE QUANTITIES -- retrieval-cue mappings, model-to-policy readouts, proposal distributions, and eligibility/competitive-gain mappings -- so an offline BEHAVIOURAL ACCESS REPAIR operation (ARC-137, Q-102) is PERMITTED by ARC-020 rather than, as before, neither permitted nor forbidden by omission. Read it as a widening of what counts as "an ordinary representational/residue/ precision write" in the CONFIRMING clause above, and hence of what the typed boundary must let through unimpeded. The MUST NOT list is untouched: an access-route write that mints a commitment token, dispatches an external action, or reaches a POL/ID/CAPS equivalent is still authority-affecting and must be typed-routed, so the FALSIFYING clauses above stand unchanged. Surfaced by the duplication audit in thought_intake_2026-09-02_sleep_as_deferred_reorganisation_and_behavioural_access_repair.md; the defect was ARC-020's silence, not a rival claim.

ARC-021.subject: basal_ganglia.three_loop_learning_channel_separation
ARC-021.title: Three BG-like cortico-striatal loops require distinct learning channels.
ARC-021.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The three error channels must be separately optimized in the substrate under test (true today: E1, E2 world/harm_s/harm_a and E3 each own an nn.Module, an Adam instance and a loss), the merged arm must actually run to completion, and the control arm must produce a calibration_gap above its own SEPARATED_SIGNAL_FLOOR so the ablation has something to remove.
CONFIRMING: With both arms running in the real agent and the control arm producing signal above its floor, the merged arm shows a materially smaller calibration_gap and lower attribution accuracy than the separated arm at both hazard densities. Manipulation: Collapse E1, E2 and E3 into a shared trunk under a single optimizer and one combined loss (sensory + motor-sensory + harm/goal error), against the separated three-optimizer baseline at matched seeds. Control: SEPARATED arm (three independent optimizers, immediate per-loss backward) at matched seeds and both hazard densities, plus the encoder-frozen reference regime that reproduces a live control signal. Required event: Learning episodes at both dense and sparse hazard density producing near-hazard and safe probe populations, with harm attribution computed from action-conditioned counterfactual rollouts. DV: calibration_gap = mean_causal_sig(near_hazard) - mean_causal_sig(safe) read from the pre-sigmoid harm logit, AND attribution accuracy/AUC -- both of the claim's falsifier DVs, paired across seeds with a confidence interval on the merged-minus-separated mean.
FALSIFYING: The merged arm matches or beats the separated arm on both DVs across densities with the control arm live -- a single shared channel suffices and the three-way split is unnecessary engineering. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: v3_exq_993a and v3_exq_1011 record both DVs with dv_headroom gating; the reproducer experiments/_scratch/arc021_h2_merged_optimizer_runnability_probe.py pins the in-agent merged-arm crash. What is missing is any instrument that can run the merged arm inside ree_core at all. Consumer / boundary: The predictor-level learning channels themselves (E1/E2/E3 parameter updates), not the BG arbitration loops inside E3 that ARC-110 owns. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0229, GFLAG-0264, contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy, V3-EXQ-993a, V3-EXQ-1011, dv-dynamic-range-precondition-class.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); V3 cannot generate the merged condition. e1_deep.py ContextMemory.write mutates the learnable parameter self.memory in place via .data, advancing its autograd version counter and invalidating the retained forward that a single combined loss still holds, so the MERGED arm crashes deterministically on step 2; the parameter is in ree_core and cannot be repaired from a driver. The surrogate routes are also constrained: H1's control-arm readout dies under encoder unfreeze, H3 returns a sub-margin null. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA states the merged-channel ablation 'has never been run' and treats it as the missing test. Three things changed: V3-EXQ-993 ran and was degenerate, V3-EXQ-993a ran the action-conditioned pre-sigmoid readout, cleared every precondition and was ratified mixed (GFLAG-0137 resolved, pending_retest_after_substrate cleared), and V3-EXQ-1011 ran the paired sub-margin CI re-pose. The leg the WWA actually describes -- a merged single-optimizer trunk inside the real agent -- is now known to be BLOCKED: GFLAG-0229 pins a deterministic autograd crash in ContextMemory.write. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-022.subject: architecture.hierarchical_effect_object_pipeline
ARC-022.title: Hierarchical effect-object abstraction pipeline (E1→E2→DMN→Goal/Avoid→Hippocampus) — conflict with ARC-007/ARC-014, pending adjudication.
ARC-022.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: E1 and E2 must be trained to a converged world-forward before any abstraction gradient is read, and the eval sample must contain both harm and non-harm states so the harm-agreement similarity matrix is non-degenerate. Every stage the claim names must be instantiated and actually producing output, otherwise only the E1->E2 leg is exercised and the pipeline ORDER is untested.
CONFIRMING: Each later stage carries typed-object content (harm or goal identity) that the preceding stage does not, in the asserted E1->E2->Goal/Avoid->hippocampus order, sign-consistent across >=3 seeds, and the fitted ordering beats the ARC-007 and ARC-014 rivals on the same data. Manipulation: Lesion or bypass each stage in turn along the asserted order -- identity E2.world_forward, frozen hippocampal proposal stage (module.propose_trajectories), z_goal writer disabled -- so the ORDER of typed-object passing is manipulated rather than only described. Control: The rival ARC-007 and ARC-014 orderings fitted to the same representational data as explicit comparator models, plus a shuffled-stage-label null; V3-EXQ-208's three levels alone give no rival to beat. Required event: A trained agent stepping CausalGridWorldV2 through harm contacts and goal-relevant resource contacts, with the representation at each named pipeline stage captured at the same step index. DV: Typed-object recoverability that is NEW at a later stage: harm/goal identity linearly recoverable at stage k+1 but not at stage k, alongside the drop in raw-observation RSA, both sign-consistent across seeds. Not a monotone RSA decline alone, which any lossy compression produces.
FALSIFYING: Later-stage representations lose raw-observation correlation without gaining any typed content the earlier stage lacked (compression, not abstraction), OR the recovered ordering matches an ARC-007/ARC-014 rival at least as well as ARC-022's, leaving Q-020 unadjudicated in ARC-022's favour. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_208_arc022_hierarchical_pipeline_probe.py records RSA(obs, level) and RSA(harm, level) for z_world, the E1 LSTM hidden state and the E2 world_forward prediction only. There is no recorder for a DMN stage, the Goal/Avoid stage or the hippocampal proposal stage, and grep for dmn/default_mode over ree_core/ returns nothing. Consumer / boundary: The inter-stage representational interface -- what one stage hands the next -- not agent behaviour and not end-of-episode outcome. Existing ownership: ARC-022, V3-EXQ-208, ARC-007, ARC-014, MECH-231.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); V3-EXQ-208 measures decodability (RSA correlation drop) across three levels, not typed-object passing, and is experiment_purpose diagnostic so it cannot weight confidence. Two of the five asserted stages have no recorder and a DMN stage has no module in ree_core at all, so the pipeline ORDER the claim asserts has never been manipulated. Secondary classes: R2, R3.
