ARC-023.subject: basal_ganglia.three_loop_thalamic_heartbeat
ARC-023.title: Three BG-like loops operate at characteristic thalamic heartbeat rates.
ARC-023.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the phase-1 time-multiplexed SD-006 substrate must be active and the three loops must be configured with DISTINCT periods (if E1/E2/E3 are configured at the same period the test is vacuous). SD-006 is status `implemented` and MECH-089 / MECH-090 are `active`, so this precondition is satisfiable in V3 today. Any readout taken from E3 state that is STALE between ticks is inadmissible: EXQ-131's 2026-03-30 diagnosis established that synchronous/time-multiplexed polling produces an "E3 output freeze artifact" (var_harm_eval_on 1.05e-7 vs ablated 0.00276, statistically indistinguishable) regardless of whether the loops are genuinely rate-separated, so var_harm_eval-style discriminative-pair metrics must NOT be used here.
REQUIRED RECORDING (precondition; a run without it is inadmissible): per-step _current_e3_steps and |z_beta|; realized E3 update invocations (the generate_trajectories regeneration, not the clock flag); phase_reset() counts BY TRIGGER (harm, commit-entry, completion, NCL re-assert). Tolerances below are pre-registered here, before any scored run; V3-EXQ-942 is NOT admissible (the falsifier was written with its numbers in view).
CONFIRMING signature (TIGHTENED 2026-09-24, GFLAG-0443 option A): on >= 2 of 3 seeds under ecological load with MECH-093 live, (i) [2026-09-25 governance-20260925; GFLAG-0494/GFLAG-0497] on clock-terminated cycles only, clock_tracking_ratio_clock_terminated_only (the driver's already-instrumented, non-gating contrast) tracks the arousal-set expected count sum_t 1/_current_e3_steps(t) within +/-15% relative, AND (ii) the realized E3 update share (clock-driven plus reset-driven) is below E2's configured share 1/e2_steps_per_tick (1/3 at defaults) by >= 0.08 absolute, AND (iii) the reset-driven share is <= 0.10.
FALSIFYING signature (TIGHTENED): on >= 2 of 3 seeds, the realized E3 update share from clock-driven plus ONSET-GATED reset triggers is >= E2's configured share (1/3) -- E3 is no longer the slowest loop as realized, so "deliberation rate (slowest)" is a configuration label the substrate does not realize. Reset ticks from a trigger with NO onset gate (the MECH-091 harm trigger as of 2026-09-24) are reported separately; an excess attributable only to them is PARTIAL and routes to MECH-091 (onset gate), not a falsification of ARC-023. [2026-09-25 governance-20260925; GFLAG-0494/GFLAG-0497] GOVERNANCE DECISION (rec-20260925-deedce42, option A): under current defaults this design (leg i) discriminates CONFIRMING vs PARTIAL only, not CONFIRMING vs FALSIFYING -- onset-gated reset volume is structurally 17-28x short of the reachable bound needed to reach the FALSIFYING leg. A genuine FALSIFYING test requires a substrate change to raise the reachable clock-driven share; a CONFIRM on this driver is scoped accordingly until then. V3-EXQ-1098 released to queue as-is; EXP-0548's governance gate cleared (see experiment_proposals.v1.json).
PARTIAL: (i) fails with (ii) holding (E3 slowest but not tracking its arousal-set period), or reset-driven share > 0.10.

SCOPE (2026-09-22 split): the LOAD-BEARING half of the original falsifier -- whether rate separation SURVIVES real asynchronous load, or collapses into lockstep under injected latency perturbation -- is NOT tested here. It requires SD-006 phase 2 true asynchronous execution and is registered separately as ARC-148 (implementation_phase v4), which no v3 claim depends on. A confirming result here licenses "the loops run at characteristic rates on the phase-1 clock", NOT "rate separation is robust under asynchronous load".

ARC-024.subject: world.harm_benefit_asymptotic_proxy_structure
ARC-024.title: Harm and benefit signals have asymptotic proxy structure in world latent space.
ARC-024.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both approach classes must be reachable and z_world must be decodable at the tested budget. At default multi-source configs hazard_approach wins every classification tie, so benefit_approach is structurally unreachable unless proximity_approach_magnitude_tiebreak=True; and a positive control must show that SOME world property is decodable from z_world at the same warmup budget.
CONFIRMING: Both harm and benefit readouts show a positive approach-minus-none gap on z_world clearing their pre-registered bars on populated event counts, with the two gradient directions opposed (cosine at or below -0.1). Manipulation: GRADIENT arm (use_proxy_fields=True, hazard_field_view + resource_field_view carried in world_state) against FLAT arm (binary contact harm only, no proximity field), matched seeds and budget, with the magnitude tiebreak enabled so resource proximity can win classification. Control: FLAT arm at identical seeds, budget and network sizes, plus a label-shuffled readout on the same z_world tensors to bound what is decodable from the latent at that training budget. Required event: Episodes on CausalGridWorldV2 (use_proxy_fields=True) that generate pre-contact hazard_approach AND benefit_approach ticks, separable from none and contact ticks, with at least 20 events per class per seed. DV: gap_approach_none, the mean decoded harm (and, separately, benefit) score on approach ticks minus none ticks read off z_world per seed per arm, with harm_eval AUC and cos(harm_dir, benefit_dir) as secondaries; the benefit leg additionally requires n_benefit_approach above its own floor.
FALSIFYING: With both approach classes populated and z_world decodability positively controlled, approach ticks are indistinguishable from none ticks in z_world while remaining separable in the raw observation -- proxy structure in the world but not in the world latent. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: v3_exq_107 and v3_exq_117 compute gap_approach_none, harm_eval AUC and the harm-benefit cosine; the event classifier is causal_grid_world.py's proximity_approach path. Absent: any positive control bounding z_world decodability at the same budget, and any run that enables the magnitude tiebreak. Consumer / boundary: The world LATENT z_world consumed by E3.harm_eval and E2.world_forward, not the raw hazard_field_view observation channel that carries the gradient by construction. Existing ownership: MECH-203, V3-EXQ-117, V3-EXQ-107, ARC-026, EXP-0042.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); V3-EXQ-117's benefit arm returned the -99 sentinel: no benefit_approach events at all. The classifier in causal_grid_world.py gives hazard_approach every tie and the magnitude tiebreak is off by default, so the benefit half cannot enter a discriminating regime. The harm half ran and fell short (0.0030 and 0.0120 against 0.08 and 0.04 bars) but with no positive control on z_world decodability at 200-400 warmup episodes that null cannot separate an absent latent gradient from an untrained encoder. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-025.subject: architecture.three_engine_irreducibility
ARC-025.title: Three-engine (E1/E2/E3) architecture is irreducible; no engine can be collapsed into another.
ARC-025.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The full system must first express BOTH capacities simultaneously in the same run (a non-zero calibration gap and a non-zero attribution gap), and each collapse arm must preserve total parameter budget and training compute so a deficit is attributable to the collapse rather than to capacity loss. Degenerate if the collapsed engine's replacement is simply absent rather than asked to carry the other engine's function.
CONFIRMING: Every collapse direction tried fails to recover both capacities at once: at least one of calibration_gap_approach or attribution_gap stays at or below its ablated level while the full system holds both, sign-consistent across >=3 seeds, for E1-into-E2, E2-into-E3 and E3-into-E2 collapses. Manipulation: COLLAPSE, not ablation: route one engine's function through another (for example have E3 score directly off z_world with E2.world_forward replaced by identity, or have E2 supply the harm evaluation E3 normally computes), holding parameters and training budget matched to the full system. Control: The full three-engine system on matched seeds, plus the existing V3-EXQ-034 pure-ablation arms (e3_ablated, e2_ablated) as the necessity baseline the collapse arms must exceed in informativeness. Required event: A trained agent facing trials that require fast signal revision (E1), long-horizon counterfactual attribution (E2) and committed harm-avoidance under reward pressure (E3) within the same life. DV: Whether the collapsed configuration can recover BOTH the calibration_gap_approach and the attribution_gap that the full system holds simultaneously; a collapse is refuted as reducible if it recovers both to within a pre-registered equivalence bound of the full system.
FALSIFYING: Any single collapse arm recovers both capacities to within the equivalence bound of the full system -- that engine is then reducible and the irreducibility claim is false as a mechanism claim -- or the full system itself fails to hold both gaps simultaneously, which makes the comparison vacuous. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_034_arc025_engine_ablation.py records calibration_gap_approach, calibration_gap_contact and attribution_gap per condition, and already implements the e3-constant and e2-identity hooks; it has no E1 arm and no collapse (function-rehoming) arm. Consumer / boundary: The engine boundary itself -- whether one engine's computation can be carried by another -- not the presence or absence of a module. Existing ownership: ARC-025, V3-EXQ-034, INV-030, MECH-069, ARC-021.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); V3-EXQ-034 tested NECESSITY by ablation on E2 and E3 only; the claim asserts IRREDUCIBILITY (no engine can be collapsed INTO another), which no arm manipulates, and E1 has no arm at all. The notes' four-constraint-redundancy and axiom-violation clauses have no V3 operationalisation and are not falsifiable as written. Secondary classes: R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-026.subject: ethics.love_expands_under_intelligence
ARC-026.title: Love as long-horizon care investment expands under intelligence rather than being crowded out.
ARC-026.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both detectors must have live, non-saturated dynamic range at the measured checkpoint, and the depth/capacity manipulation must change what the agent can actually do rather than only its parameter count. V3-EXQ-507 sweeps world_dim under a RANDOM-ACTION policy, so it varies encoded capacity, not competence; on a competence-floored agent (MECH-457) a null is about the agent, not about care expansion.
CONFIRMING: approach_slope strictly exceeds contact_slope at the peak checkpoint on at least 2 of 3 seeds with approach_gap_at_peak above 0.05, and the capacity sweep shows goal pursuit preserved rather than degraded as capacity rises. Manipulation: Training depth read at the peak checkpoint (V3-EXQ-232) and encoded z_world capacity swept over world_dim {16, 32, 64} with everything else held (V3-EXQ-507). Control: Contact detection is the within-agent comparator for approach detection; the SMALL/MEDIUM capacity arms and the reef-disabled baseline are the between-arm controls; matched seeds across arms. Required event: A training run long enough to reach a peak-performance checkpoint (V3-EXQ-232: 1500 episodes, phased E3 harm supervision from ep100) in which both benefit-approach events at distance and hazard-contact events occur often enough to fit both slopes. DV: approach_slope versus contact_slope at the peak checkpoint and approach_gap_at_peak (v3_exq_232 lines 315-336); goal-pursuit preservation across the capacity sweep, i.e. no behavioural collapse as capacity rises (v3_exq_507).
FALSIFYING: contact_slope at or above approach_slope at peak across seeds (contact detection saturates first on its magnitude advantage), or the capacity sweep showing goal-pursuit degradation as capacity rises, which is the active crowding-out the claim denies. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_232_arc026_approach_contact_resolution.py computes approach_slope, contact_slope and approach_gap_at_peak per seed; v3_exq_507_arc026_capacity_scaling.py records the capacity sweep. No V3 instrument records long-horizon care INVESTMENT (sustained costly commitment to a distal beneficiary or future state) -- only single-agent gradient sensitivity. Consumer / boundary: The encoded z_world and the E3 harm/benefit readout derived from it, upstream of committed behaviour; the claim is about detection sensitivity, not about action. Existing ownership: ARC-024, MECH-071, EXP-0134.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); R0 for the registered prediction: both arms of the falsifier exist as landed drivers and have run (V3-EXQ-232 PASS 4/4 criteria 3/3 seeds; V3-EXQ-507 PASS). The residual is scope, not runnability -- the title's long-horizon care investment is broader than the approach-gradient slope the claim's own notes field defines as its separable content. Secondary classes: R7. Gap disposition: NO GAP -- FALSE POSITIVE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-027.subject: harm_stream.parallel_thalamic_pathway
ARC-027.title: Harm stream runs as a parallel thalamic pathway independent of world latent space.
ARC-027.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The dedicated harm stream must reach E3 trajectory scoring in at least one arm. Verified as built: the production e3.select call (agent.py:9695, kwargs at 9558-9566) passes only z_harm_a, never harm_bridge / harm_forward_model / z_harm_s_current, and affective_harm_scale defaults to 0.0 (config.py:1352) so lambda_eff is the constant lambda_ethical.

DV: Ethical leverage concentrated in the APPROACH gradient rather than at contact -- the harm-avoidance ladder across none/approach/contact regimes -- plus contact-rate reduction tracking the same axis.

Then precedence is not load-bearing, everything testable in ARC-027 is SD-010's, and ARC-027 should be retired into SD-010 with the low-road anatomy moved to SD-010's notes. ARC-028.subject: control_plane.hippocampal_betagate_coupling_wiring
ARC-028.title: HippocampalModule must emit a trajectory completion signal wired to BetaGate to couple the candidacy and propagation gates.
ARC-028.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: beta_gate_bistable True, the gate actually elevating, AND compute_completion_signal reaching the 0.75 release threshold. Because the signal is sigmoid(-best_residue_cost * 0.5), it is below 0.5 for any positive residue cost, so crossing 0.75 needs a best residue cost at or below about -2.2 -- a regime no measured run has entered.
CONFIRMING: In a regime where the completion signal reaches threshold, suppressing the pathway measurably shifts release latency or total release count, and a non-trivial fraction of ON-arm releases occur at ticks no other pathway would have released. Manipulation: Hippocampal-completion pathway live (threshold at its configured value) versus suppressed (threshold pinned above 1.0), with every other BetaGate release pathway -- MECH-091 urgency interrupt, V_s anchor invalidation, SD-034 closure, maintenance release -- held at identical trigger conditions. Control: The matched-seed suppressed-pathway arm, plus the audited alternative release pathways held fixed so attribution is possible at tick level. Required event: A committed episode in which the hippocampal module proposes a trajectory good enough to signal completion while beta is elevated, so the completion pathway has an opportunity to release the gate. DV: Count and latency of beta releases attributable specifically to the completion pathway -- releases firing at ticks where no other pathway's trigger condition is independently met -- and the shift in the release-latency distribution and total release count when the pathway is suppressed.
FALSIFYING: Release timing and rate are statistically indistinguishable between arms once the other pathways are accounted for, or the completion signal never realistically crosses threshold -- the two gates stay functionally decoupled despite the code-level wiring. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: BetaGate.get_state exposes completion_signal and completion_release_threshold; the 944-series trigger_coverage attributes phase_reset requests by MECH-091 event class from agent source and records completion_signal_max per cell. Missing: any config-level lever to vary the release threshold across arms. Consumer / boundary: HippocampalModule.compute_completion_signal to BetaGate.receive_hippocampal_completion to gate release -- the ARC-028 / MECH-105 block in agent.select_action. Existing ownership: MECH-105, MECH-090, EXP-0583, commitment_closure:GAP-4, GFLAG-0395.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The pathway never fires in any measured environment -- completion_signal max 0.0 against a 0.75 threshold across 15 cells -- so an ON/OFF ablation is degenerate by construction. And completion_release_threshold is a BetaGate constructor default the agent never passes from REEConfig, so even the prescribed OFF arm needs a source patch. This is a signal-scale/calibration gap, not the wiring gap the claim's prose assumes. Secondary classes: R4, R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA asserts that existing beta_gate_bistable runs already satisfy the non-degeneracy precondition and that no new substrate work is needed. Measurement says otherwise: V3-EXQ-944/944a/944b record completion_signal max 0.0 against the 0.75 release threshold and ZERO completion-triggered releases summed over 15 cells. Separately, completion_release_threshold is a BetaGate constructor default that agent.py never plumbs from REEConfig, so the OFF arm the WWA prescribes is not reachable through configuration. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-029.subject: cognitive_modes.behavioral_consequence_of_commitment
ARC-029.title: Committed and uncommitted operating modes produce measurably distinct harm outcomes.
ARC-029.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both regimes occupied within a single run -- committed_step_fraction in [0.15, 0.85] with mean committed-run length at least 3 consecutive ticks on at least 4/5 seeds; the mode manipulation must not move precision (paired per-seed current_precision distributions indistinguishable from a static control); and the harm rate must sit an order of magnitude above the measurement floor. On the variance-tracking bar the quantile must be in force (bar_in_force fraction about 1.0) and the commit-gate window must fill.
CONFIRMING: With P1-P3 met and precision invariance clean, committed windows carry lower harm per step than uncommitted windows in the stable env, the gap narrows in the volatile env, and the advantage is strongest at low hazard density. Manipulation: Threshold-side alternation only -- the variance-tracking quantile commitment bar, or a MECH-108 BreathOscillator sweep calibrated to the run's own measured variance distribution. Never a write to running_variance, which is the V3-EXQ-063a confound. Control: A static-threshold arm at matched seeds and identical observation, candidate set and update budget, plus the L0 lineage env rung as the environment negative control. Required event: Within-run alternation between committed and uncommitted operating modes in one agent and seed, in a stable and in a volatile hazard layout. DV: Paired within-agent harm-per-step difference between committed and uncommitted windows in the stable env, exceeding max(0.5 SD of the per-seed paired delta, 0.002 harm/step) with consistent sign on at least 4/5 seeds, AND a narrower gap in the volatile env, AND a hazard-density by mode interaction.
FALSIFYING: Under the same clean preconditions the committed and uncommitted windows show no harm difference or a reversed one in the stable condition -- a genuine falsification, since a threshold-side manipulation cannot be explained away as a precision artifact. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: v3_exq_1066 is the pre-registered evidence driver and records the variance_tracking_commit_bar telemetry; v3_exq_1070a records per-rung occupancy, bar_in_force and joint P1/P3 feasibility; contract test_commit_threshold_variance_tracking pins the bar semantics including the run-length clause. Consumer / boundary: The behavioural consequence of the MECH-090 beta commitment latch on harm, measured within one agent rather than between differently-configured agents. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0346, GFLAG-0354, GFLAG-0371, EXP-1394, MECH-108.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); No licensed operating point yet. V3-EXQ-1070a found 22 jointly P1/P3-feasible cells but failed its own training_tick_budget_equalised precondition (2.28 against a 2.0 ceiling), so it licenses no env verdict; V3-EXQ-1066, the pre-registered evidence run, crashed (ERROR 2026-09-20); GFLAG-0371 refused EXP-1394 at queue-experiment Step 4 on the lineage env, where episodes end in 4-9 steps and the 200-select-call window never fills. Secondary classes: R5, R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: P1's named lever is measured inert on a trained agent: commit_variance collapses to about 1e-6..1.6e-5 against the absolute 0.40 bar, so no MECH-108 sweep_amplitude below about 0.99996 produces an uncommitted window, and the worked amplitudes (a above 0.18 at rv about 0.33) are stale in both directions. The variance-tracking quantile commitment bar built in response landed in ree-v3 on 2026-09-18 and is the lever a rewritten P1 must name (GFLAG-0346, GFLAG-0354). Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22). [2026-09-23 governance cycle governance-pause-20260923-1741 -- RULING on the what_would_answer disjunct; closes GFLAG-0421 + GFLAG-0416 + GFLAG-0354 as ONE decision] ARC-029's what_would_answer permits EITHER "the variance-tracking quantile commitment bar" OR "a MECH-108 BreathOscillator sweep". Governance rules IN FAVOUR OF THE BAR and STRIKES the oscillator disjunct as INERT IN V3 at this lineage's operating point, proven at source rather than argued: Clock.reset() sets _breath_phase_step = 0 (ree-v3 ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py:231, its own comment "MECH-108: reset breath cycle state across episodes"); REEAgent.reset() calls it (agent.py:3718); every driver in this family calls agent.reset() per episode; the sweep is active only while _breath_phase_step >= breath_period - sweep_duration (clock.py:120) and the counter advances once per env step (clock.py:170). At the pre-registered breath_period 25 / sweep_duration 5 the sweep begins at phase step 20, while V3-EXQ-1070a measured mean episode length 7.99-13.97 env steps across its six L1 cells, so the sweep is NEVER REACHED and a run using it would have reported "alternating arm indistinguishable from static" -- a confident null on a manipulation that never happened. This generalises beyond one parameter choice: shrinking sweep_duration far enough to fire converts the sweep into isolated de-committed SELECTIONS rather than the uncommitted WINDOWS ARC-029's text describes. Any ARC-029 successor must therefore name the variance-tracking quantile commitment bar (landed in ree-v3 2026-09-18) as its manipulation; naming the oscillator is a design error, not an option. SECOND RULING (GFLAG-0416): the bar's window is CROSS-EPISODE BY CONSTRUCTION -- _commit_gate_variance_window is a bounded deque built once (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:844 and :881) and nothing in ree_core ever clears it -- so GFLAG-0371's clause that filling the window "would pool rv across ~35 episode boundaries, so it would not be the within-run distribution the estimator is specified against" is WITHDRAWN: there is no within-run specification for pooling to violate. That withdraws ONE clause and nothing else -- failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1070a's withdrawal of its own L0/L1 residual stands on its other two independent reasons, and V3-EXQ-1066 stays unrevived (separately owned, already ERROR). STILL BLOCKED, and this ruling deliberately does NOT unblock it: under bar-alone the natural control is the static ABSOLUTE threshold, which is DEGENERATE at a trained operating point (occupancy 1.0000, the measured V3-EXQ-063a defect). Choosing a non-degenerate control arm is a genuine open design question and is NOT decided here; see evidence/planning/arc029_alternating_arm_occupancy_probe_spec_20260922.md section 9.2. TWO INSTRUMENT FACTS BANKED for whoever writes the successor: e3_score_decomp_enabled defaults False (e3_selector.py:639) and gates the whole last_score_diagnostics block (:4099), so a driver that omits it measures occupancy 0.0 SILENTLY; and commit_threshold_quantile IS read live per bar computation (:985), so one trained agent can serve every quantile. Ruling disposition only; status, confidence and phase unchanged.

ARC-030.subject: architecture.approach_avoidance_symmetry
ARC-030.title: The three BG-like loops require symmetric Go (approach) and NoGo (avoidance) sub-channels; pure NoGo architecture produces behavioral flatness.
ARC-030.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Foraging competence must clear the floor before the Go channel can add anything: FULL-arm resource_visit_rate must exceed the RANDOM baseline by >= 0.05 on >= 2/3 seeds, and avg_goal_norm must clear the 0.4-class floor so the Go channel is demonstrably receiving a live goal signal rather than retesting the pre-514o dead-seeding failure mode.
CONFIRMING: With foraging competence above random and avg_goal_norm above floor, COMBINED beats NOGO_ONLY on benefit_ratio on >= 2/3 seeds independently, harm_ratio stays at or below the ceiling, and the lift is not attributable to a single seed's NOGO_ONLY collapse. Manipulation: COMBINED (benefit_eval_head Go channel plus harm_eval NoGo channel active in E3.score_trajectory) versus NOGO_ONLY (Go channel ablated), matched seeds, on the corrected post-514o seeding wiring -- the EXQ-138a/226 discriminative-pair design re-run. Control: The NOGO_ONLY arm on identical seeds and curriculum, plus the RANDOM reference arm used by the G0 readiness gate, so a COMBINED win driven by one seed's NOGO_ONLY collapse is separable from a general lift. Required event: Hazard-bearing foraging episodes in which the agent must both avoid harm and acquire resources, so the NoGo (harm) and Go (benefit) evaluations of the SAME hippocampal trajectory proposals can compete at the E3 commitment gate. DV: benefit_ratio of COMBINED to NOGO_ONLY resource acquisition (>= 1.2) with harm_ratio held at or below the 1.3 ceiling, scored PER SEED on >= 2/3 seeds independently rather than in aggregate, with avg_goal_norm reported alongside as the live-signal check.
FALSIFYING: With competence and a live goal signal both confirmed, COMBINED does not beat NOGO_ONLY on >= 2/3 seeds -- the symmetric Go channel adds no measurable behavioural lift once it is known to be receiving signal, which the pre-514o FAILs (085m/138a/183/186) could not distinguish from 'no Go signal'. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: e3_selector benefit_eval head and score_trajectory Go-channel subtraction (benefit subtracted from cost), residue/field.py benefit terrain accumulate/evaluate, and the V3-EXQ-899 readiness driver's resource_visit_rate / g0_non_degenerate statistics. All exist; the missing piece is a run that clears the readiness gate. Consumer / boundary: The E3 commitment gate where harm and benefit evaluations of the same trajectory proposals are balanced -- dual evaluation of one candidate set, not two parallel pipelines. Existing ownership: MECH-457, mech457_competence_bootstrap_explorer, MECH-229, SD-106, zworld_adequacy:ZW-1, GFLAG-0303, EXP-0103.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The G0 competence gate has failed four consecutive times (866/866a/866c/899) with the FULL arm foraging below RANDOM and near-zero policy entropy; MECH-307 is ruled out as the fix and the owner mech457_competence_bootstrap_explorer is blocked_pending_dependency on MECH-229. Upstream, SD-106 measures the observation->z_world objective as supplying no gradient toward decision-relevant content, so the Go channel's input carries no resource-proximity variance. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA asserts the non-degeneracy precondition is 'satisfiable, just not on that stretch' (citing 866b as proof the G0 failure is curriculum-specific). V3-EXQ-899 (2026-08-08, two runs) then measured the FULL arm foraging BELOW RANDOM on 866a's exact full onboarding config with G0 0/3 seeds, and its single-variable A/B ruled MECH-307 out as the fix. The claim's own ceiling_routing_note (2026-09-16, user-approved) re-points the operative blocker from curriculum/MECH-307 to MECH-457 competence floor, which is itself blocked on MECH-229; and the upstream encoder locus has since moved to SD-106. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

representation distinct from its existing z_world action-object navigation. As of the

scores z_self trajectories by self-coherence / hypothesis-tag-integrity / self-maintenance cost
-- none of which exists as a scored quantity in e3_selector.py today. ARC-028 (the BG-completion
coupling ARC-031 extends) is itself measured inert: its completion_signal has never crossed the
0.75 release threshold in any run (max observed 0.0), so the "completion fires on cognitive-

V3-NECESSITY PHASE-LEAK RESOLUTION) on the correct grounds that their own mechanisms operate

ARC-032.subject: architecture.theta_frontal_hippocampal_goal
ARC-032.title: The theta-rate packaging of E1 output (MECH-089 ThetaBuffer) is the primary pathway through which E1's goal-context maintenance reaches E3's trajectory scoring -- the computational analog of frontal-hippocampal theta synchronisation.
ARC-032.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: z_goal_norm at or above 0.05 (met, 1.00 frac seeds on the scaffolded_sd054_onboarding curriculum), the ablation confirmed non-inert by arm fingerprints, and the readout restricted to E3-tick steps (e3_tick_ratio about 0.07) so cache-gated steps do not dilute the contrast.

Manipulation: THETA_ZEROED (E1 output bypasses ThetaBuffer.summary via monkeypatch) versus THETA_ACTIVE, crossed with SD-100's phase-weighted von-Mises summary kernel on or off. Control: Matched seeds and identical mechanism elsewhere; the OFF path runs the original flat mean bit-identically, and the uniform-kernel setting reproduces it, isolating the phase structure as the only active ingredient. DV: z_goal persistence across E3 ticks (persist_delta_mean) and goal-proximity-score noise (noise_delta_mean), both measured only on E3-tick steps, with resource-collection lift retained as a downstream secondary.
FALSIFYING: Theta-bypassed and theta-packaged conditions are indistinguishable, or reverse, on a non-saturated readout -- which is what the noise criterion has now shown twice across two structurally independent summary implementations. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

Only the persistence leg is blocked, and by measurement adequacy: persistence_cos sits at about 0.999997 in both arms, so C1 is uninformative in either direction and needs a statistic with headroom. Both are false since 2026-08: V3-EXQ-228b, 228c and 228d each cleared it (goal_norm 1.00 frac seeds), 228c ran the direct persistence/proximity-noise DVs E3-tick-restricted, and 228d retested under the SD-100 phase-weighted ThetaBuffer summary. ARC-033.subject: harm_stream.sensory_discriminative_forward_model
ARC-033.title: SD-003 counterfactual attribution requires a dedicated harm forward model E2_harm_s(z_harm_s, action) -> z_harm_s_next operating within the sensory-discriminative harm stream.
ARC-033.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (a rerun is only informative if all hold --
per the diagnosed EXQ-095/166 confounds):
  - Prediction target must be the harm-DELTA formulation (EXQ-166e), not a
    raw scalar harm_obs_s target -- EXQ-095a/b showed the raw target has
    near-zero action-conditional variance and no training budget fixes that.
  - Phase-1 training budget >= 200 episodes with the delta target (the
    budget that produced EXQ-525's clean result), not the 900-1800 ep
    budgets that were insufficient for the raw-scalar target -- budget and
    target formulation are coupled.
  - P0 (HarmEncoder) convergence must be verified PER SEED, across >=4
    seeds, before trusting any aggregate hf_r2 -- EXQ-166 showed a single
    collapsed-encoder seed (obs_fwd_r2=0.0) can silently sit inside an
    otherwise-strong aggregate and masquerade as architecture failure.
  - n_approach >= 50 per seed so causal_sig comparisons are not
    noise-dominated.
  - The counterfactual/ablation pipeline must be genuinely wired end-to-end
    -- EXQ-195 showed a sound forward model (r2=0.914) can still show a
    negative attribution_gap purely from missing pipeline wiring.

CONFIRMING signature (what V3-EXQ-525 already showed, 2026-05-06,
4 seeds [42,7,123,13], supersedes V3-EXQ-205):
  - hf_r2 = 0.9191 +/- 0.0037, tight and non-bimodal across all 4 seeds
    (resolves EXQ-166's bimodal 0.867/0.0/0.0/0.885 pattern).
  - attribution_gap positive in all 4 seeds (0.102-0.126, mean 0.115),
    >> the 0.002 threshold in every seed (resolves EXQ-195's negative gap).
  - intact_vs_ablated > 0 in 4/4 seeds; null_cf_max = 0.0 in every seed.
  - All 6 pre-registered criteria PASS on every seed tested.
  A rerun under the same non-degeneracy preconditions reproducing this
  pattern (tight multi-seed hf_r2 > 0.85, positive attribution_gap > 0.05
  in >=3/4 seeds, intact>ablated in >=3/4 seeds) would further confirm.

FALSIFYING signature: recurrence of the EXQ-095/166 pattern on a rerun
where the non-degeneracy preconditions above are genuinely controlled for
-- hf_r2 collapses to ~0 in >=2/4 seeds despite verified-adequate P0
encoder convergence, OR attribution_gap <= 0.002 or non-positive in >=2/4
seeds, OR intact_vs_ablated fails to discriminate in >=2/4 seeds despite
n_approach >= 50. Any of these on a controlled rerun would indicate
EXQ-525's clean 4/4 result was seed-fortunate rather than a genuine
resolution, and would require re-opening the architecture question.

SCOPE NOTE: this falsification condition covers only the "a dedicated
harm forward model IS LEARNABLE and causally discriminative" half of the
claim. The "dedicated" (i.e. NOT shared-trunk) half competes with ARC-058,
whose own arbitration test (V3-EXQ-445h) was ruled non-contributory
(floor-locked by the pre-conversion-ceiling F-dominance monostrategy) and
remains blocked on ARC-065 GAP-A / MECH-439 (committed-action diversity).
Confirming or falsifying ARC-033's learnability does not by itself resolve
the independent-vs-shared-trunk arbitration; that requires a rerun of the
ARC-058 three-arm ablation once committed-action diversity is available.

ARC-034.subject: ethics.test_scope_nth_order
ARC-034.title: Ethics testing must span nth-order multiagent trajectory distributions; local pairwise probes are insufficient to characterize emergent ethical properties.
ARC-034.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a multi-agent ecology substrate (n>=2 REE agents interacting causally, with the feedback topology G the claim's own formalization requires) must exist and be exercisable, AND MECH-127 (counterfactual empathic activation) and MECH-129 (relational harm-to-agency representation) must both be implemented and active. None of this exists in V3. Per multi_agent_ecology_v5_plan.md (MAE-1), the substrate itself is status:blocked with owner_exq:null across every node in all six V5 social-tier plan docs -- design-only, no env code, no REEAgent factoring -- gated on MECH-163 (V3-pending) plus V4 object-permanence and self-model-stability prerequisites. MECH-127 is independently design-only (no built substrate, no EXQ/run IDs, gated on MIRROR-1/2 and MECH-163). MECH-129 is held v5 pending the same substrate. Until the substrate and both dependency mechanisms exist, ARC-034 cannot be tested, confirmed, or falsified -- there is no n=k trajectory distribution to test against n=1 probes. CONFIRMING: once the substrate exists, a designed nth-order ethics test (per the claim's own three-part test design -- counterfactual probes, multi-agent stress tests, cascade mapping) finds cases where local-pairwise (n=1) ethical assessment diverges from the nth-order (n=k) emergent assessment. The canonical case is the claim's own motivating example: direct-pathway analysis of a depleted agent predicts reduced helping, but nth-order analysis (accounting for MECH-127's counterfactual empathic activation) predicts and observes increased helping instead. If cascade mapping and attractor-theory/ Lyapunov/transfer-entropy analysis never surface an emergent state that pairwise assessment would have missed or mis-scored, the extra test-scope machinery is unnecessary overhead rather than a genuine requirement, and this claim is false.

ARC-035.subject: vmPFC.affective_normative_state_preparation
ARC-035.title: vmPFC is the substrate that converts stored affective, normative, and residue content -- prior outcome history, social and identity constraints, learned value associations, and safety memories -- into active components of the navigable state used by E3 during trajectory evaluation.
ARC-035.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the SD-033c vmPFC-analog subdivision must be a genuine wired activation substrate, not the claim-graph consolidation currently registered (v3_pending: false / consolidation_status: complete, closed purely by subsuming ARC-035 + MECH-151 + MECH-152 + MECH-235 with no new implementation). The substrate actually performing "stored -> active" conversion is SD-016 (implemented 2026-04-16): E1DeepPredictor.extract_cue_ context(z_world) -> action_bias (E2, MECH-151) / terrain_weight (E3, MECH-152), covering three of the four ARC-035 content classes (residue, safety memory, goal-approach gating). But SD-016's own evidence_quality_note records V3-EXQ-418d/418e FAILs: ContextMemory attention collapses to the uniform-distribution ceiling (entropy ~ln(16)) and slot diversity fails in most seeds -- the pathway is wired and exercised but not demonstrably doing content-selective retrieval. The fourth content class -- social/identity constraints (MECH-132, the EVR/bvFTD case) -- has NO wired substrate: status candidate, unimplemented. A non-degenerate test therefore requires (a) the SD-016 attention-collapse issue resolved or independently verified not to affect the content class under test, and (b) for content-class-2 tests specifically, MECH-132 built and wired as a live tonic constraint gate before an ablation is meaningful.
CONFIRMING SIGNATURE: with the substrate non-degenerate, ablate the vmPFC-analog pathway for one content class while leaving underlying storage intact (content still retrievable via a direct probe of ContextMemory / the residue field). Confirming: the probe shows content is still present and retrievable AND E3 trajectory selection is measurably LESS sensitive to that content with the pathway ablated than intact -- e.g. w_harm no longer scales with hazard-cue proximity (psychopathy/reversal-learning analog); trajectory choice no longer differentiates constraint-violating vs -consistent options (vmPFC-lesion/norm-application analog); safety-context cues no longer shift E3 away from the threat-biased trajectory (PTSD/extinction analog); or goal-directed trajectory frequency drops despite unchanged goal representation (depression/approach-attenuation analog).
FALSIFYING SIGNATURE: ablating the vmPFC-analog pathway produces NO dissociation -- trajectory selection is equally (in)sensitive whether the pathway is intact or ablated, while content remains equally retrievable via direct probe in both conditions. This would mean E3 already gets the content some other way (e.g. directly from ResidueField curvature or hippocampal graph structure), so there is no separable "activation" function distinct from what the residue field / hippocampal machinery already performs -- the stored/active distinction collapses for that content class, and the four-failure-mode taxonomy would need re-grounding elsewhere (e.g. folded back into ARC-007).
CURRENT STATE: zero experimental evidence exists for ARC-035 (13/13 entries literature; exp count = 0). MECH-131/132/133/134 -- the four discriminator mechanisms -- appear nowhere in claim_evidence.v1.json, and no experiment has ever operationalized any of the four failure-mode analogs.

ARC-036.subject: hippocampus.multidimensional_valence_map
ARC-036.title: Hippocampal terrain maps encode separable valence dimensions (wanting, liking, harm-discriminative, surprise); ARC-007 residue-field navigation is the harm-causal special case of this general architecture.
ARC-036.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The valence vector must be written on the real ree_core/residue/field.py RBF centers placed by add_residue at true event locations -- never a standalone re-implementation with fixed random centers -- and all four channels must actually populate (non-zero variance per channel) before any collinearity statistic is read. Any per-pair claim must be reported at a stated incentive-sensitization gain, because the wanting|liking result is gain-conditional.
CONFIRMING: Each of the four dimensions is independently recoverable per node at a stated gain, no pair exceeds the collinearity bar, and surprise-weighted versus harm-weighted replay prioritisation select measurably different node sets. Manipulation: Vary the channel-specific write paths independently -- incentive_sensitization gain for wanting, benefit receipt for liking, hazard exposure for harm_discriminative, PE magnitude for surprise -- and ablate each write path in turn while holding the other three. Control: The matched no-gain / default configuration (887 and 887a) as the comparison against the above-default-gain arm (887b), plus a channel-ablated arm per pair so that a collinearity is attributable to a shared write path rather than to a shared environment. Required event: Waking episodes producing all four valence-relevant events at the same map nodes: drive-scaled approach (wanting), benefit receipt at outcome (liking), harm exposure (harm-discriminative) and prediction-error spikes (surprise), with replay eligible to be prioritised over those nodes. DV: Per-seed |Spearman| (and per-node partial correlation) for each of the six channel pairs against a stated separability bar, plus a replay-prioritisation leg: whether ResidueField.get_valence_priority ranking under a surprise-weighted drive vector differs from ranking under a harm-weighted drive vector at the same nodes.
FALSIFYING: Dimensions collapse onto fewer independent signals at the production defaults -- as harm_discriminative|surprise already does at 0.73-0.85, gain-independently across 9/9 seed-runs -- or replay prioritisation is indistinguishable under surprise-weighted and harm-weighted drive vectors. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/residue/field.py VALENCE_* indices, update_valence / evaluate_valence / get_valence_priority (ResidueConfig.valence_enabled defaults True), with the live consumer at ree_core/hippocampal/module.py which scores replay-buffer entries by get_valence_priority; the existing probe experiments/v3_exq_176_arc036_valence_dimension_probe.py does NOT use any of this. Consumer / boundary: The hippocampal map node's stored valence vector and the replay-prioritisation read over it -- the point where drive state selects which dimension dominates -- not the residue scalar alone. Existing ownership: SD-014, MECH-307, EXP-0461, ARC-007, MECH-030.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); ARC-036's own probe never touched the production substrate (its inline RBFLayer had fixed random, never-updated centers), and the only real-substrate touchpoint is a reanalysis of runs tagged SD-014. No experiment tags ARC-036 and exercises field.py's valence API plus the replay-prioritisation consumer, and the four-dimension claim needs stating per pair. Secondary classes: R7. ARC-037.subject: attribution.causal_routing_circuit
ARC-037.title: REE requires a causal attribution routing circuit (anterior insula equivalent) that classifies prediction errors as agent-caused or environment-caused and gates them into the E3/goal-directed learning channel vs the E1/habit-residue channel respectively.
ARC-037.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (four parts; all four must be reported in the manifest, else `substrate_not_ready`, NOT a verdict).
(P1) The ground-truth agency partition must be PROXIMAL-AVOIDABILITY, not `transition_type`. Confirmed
2026-08-03 (`failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-877_2026-08-03.md`): CausalGridWorldV2's
`agent_caused_hazard`/`env_caused_hazard` labels encode hazard-OBJECT PROVENANCE (diachronic) and are
ANTI-CORRELATED with proximal avoidability for the contamination mechanic, which is exactly the axis a
comparator computes. Every existing `owned=` wiring in `experiments/` uses those labels, so this is the
default failure and must be actively defeated: derive the label by replaying `a_stay` (and, better, the full
action set) from the pre-action state against the environment's own step function, and report the
provenance-vs-avoidability agreement rate. An ARC-037 run scored against `transition_type` is refused as a
verdict. See MECH-071's own `what_would_answer` CAVEAT -- do not re-derive it.
(P2) Both channels must be demonstrably MOVABLE in the OFF arm. E1 side: the residue field must be
non-empty and `world_delta`-sensitive (report `num_harm_events` > 0 and non-zero residue variance across
locations -- note the live default is `world_delta=None`, so a run that leaves the canonical harness
untouched measures nothing). E3 side: `harm_eval(z_world)` must show the graded none < approach < contact
structure with a calibration gap above the EXQ-026 anchor (>0.03) in the OFF arm -- a flat harm_eval means the
E3 channel has no calibration for routing to modulate, which is instrumentation failure, not disconfirmation.
(P3) The classification input must be non-degenerate. Agent-caused and environment-caused hazard events
must both be present at >= the minimum-class count the design pre-registers (V3-EXQ-1001's construction-
balanced RandomPolicy collection reached 6132 minimum-class events and is the existence proof that this is
achievable). This is the SAME gate that blocks SD-029's C2, MECH-257's C2 and SD-031's discriminative arm.
Important scope note: SD-031's 2026-09-04 amend does NOT release ARC-037. That amend clears the gate only
for a comparator-only OFFLINE readout and explicitly keeps the STANDING PROHIBITION on reading from the LIVE
agent loop until `self_attribution:GAP-6` clears. ARC-037 asserts routing INTO LEARNING and is therefore a
live-loop read by construction; the prohibition still binds it.
(P4) The attribution signal driving the gate must be the AGENT'S OWN comparator output, never the
environment oracle. An oracle-driven arm is a legitimate positive control (it upper-bounds the effect) but
is not a test of ARC-037, which asserts a circuit inside the agent.

CONFIRMING. ARC-037's unique content is a DOUBLE DISSOCIATION, not a gate on either channel alone -- the
classifier question belongs to MECH-256/SD-029/SD-031/MECH-095 and the single-channel E1 question to MECH-072;
ARC-037 is confirmed only by evidence no one of those can supply. Under a 2x2 (routing OFF / ON) x (channel
read: E1 residue, E3 harm_eval) design with the same comparator signal driving both gates, ARC-037 is
supported when the SAME signal moves the two channels in OPPOSITE directions and the interaction term -- not
either main effect -- clears threshold:
(C1, E1 leg) env-caused harm events accumulate residue while agent-caused-only gating REDUCES false
attribution: `false_attr_rate(ON) < false_attr_rate(OFF)` (this is MECH-072's own C1, cross-referenced, not
re-derived; V3-EXQ-877 measured 0.753 gated vs 0.506 ungated -- the wrong direction -- under the P1 defect);
(C2, E3 leg) agent-caused prediction errors produce a LARGER `harm_eval` calibration gap under routing-ON than
routing-OFF, delta >= max(0.03, 1.0 x SD of the per-seed delta), the 0.03 floor taken from MECH-071/EXQ-026;
(C3, the dissociation itself, and the only criterion unique to ARC-037) the routing-ON minus routing-OFF
effect has OPPOSITE sign on the two channels, and the interaction exceeds both main effects, on a strict
majority of >= 3 seeds. Threshold for C3: |interaction| >= max(0.04, 1.0 x SD of the per-seed interaction),
the 0.04 absolute floor taken from the MECH-095/SD-047 `recall_improvement` anchor already pre-registered in
`substrate_queue.json` for the sibling comparator test.
Additionally, the two named pathologies must be REPRODUCIBLE BY INVERSION as positive controls: forcing
env-caused errors into E3 must inflate harm attribution on non-avoidable events (the "false guilt /
moral overattribution" arm of the notes), and forcing agent-caused errors into E1 must produce the MECH-136
moral blind spot (harm_eval under-weighting of the agent's own harm). A routing circuit that cannot be broken
in these two directions is not doing the work the claim assigns it.

FALSIFYING. ARC-037 is refuted -- as distinct from its constituents -- if, with P1-P4 all satisfied:
(a) C3 fails while C1 and/or C2 pass, i.e. the entire benefit is captured by a SINGLE-channel gate and adding
the second channel's gate contributes nothing beyond it. That result says there is a *gate* (MECH-072's
claim, or MECH-136's) but no *routing circuit*, and ARC-037 should then be excreted into whichever of those
two survives; or
(b) the two channels move in the SAME direction under the shared signal -- no dissociation, so one common
learning-rate/salience modulation explains the effect and the agent-vs-environment classification is doing no
work; or
(c) the oracle-driven positive control also fails to produce the dissociation, which places the fault in the
channel architecture rather than in the classifier and refutes ARC-037 independently of any comparator
result; or
(d) the effect survives only when the label is `transition_type` provenance and vanishes under the P1
proximal-avoidability label -- ARC-037 would then be a claim about a diachronic self-occupancy trace, not
about a comparator-fed routing circuit, and should be re-registered as such (this is exactly routing
recommendation 2 of the V3-EXQ-877 autopsy, which proposed "a new claim for diachronic/footprint-based
self-caused-harm attribution ... requiring its own (likely memory/trace-based) mechanism").
A run that merely reproduces the classifier's own failure (comparator cannot separate the classes) is
`non_contributory` for ARC-037, NOT falsifying: that is MECH-256/SD-029/SD-031's question and is answered in
their own `what_would_answer` fields.

DISPOSITION AS OF 2026-09-04: `substrate_conditional`, not `substrate_ceiling`. Applying CLAUDE.md's
sharpened discriminator: the E3-side routing consumer does not exist in `ree_core/` (verified by grep -- no
agency conditioning anywhere in `e3_selector.py`); the E1-side hook exists as a dormant parameter
(`update_residue(owned=, world_delta=)`) fed `True`/`None` by the canonical harness and, where varied at all,
by the environment oracle rather than a comparator; the comparator's own boolean output
(`_tpj_last_is_self_caused`) is read by no production code; and `use_tpj_comparator` defaults False. Zero
non-degenerate exercises have been possible, `n_ceiling_hits` reads 0, and no positive evidence is banked
either way -- which is `substrate_conditional` by definition, not the built-and-repeatedly-exercised
signature of `substrate_ceiling`. The blocking substrate is NOT the comparator family (that is upstream and
separately tracked): it is the ABSENT routing/gating module itself, which has no `substrate_queue.json` entry
and no closure node in `self_attribution_plan.md` (GAP-1..6 all own comparators, none owns the consumer). In
work-graph terms the wire is `complicated (buildable)` -- source `owned`/`world_delta` from a comparator
instead of the oracle, add the symmetric E3-side path -- while the *test* of it is `complex (probe-gated)` on
P1 and P3.

(Digested 2026-09-04, thought-digestion campaign `v3-closure`, G16 solo.)

ARC-038.subject: hippocampus.waking_consolidation_mode
ARC-038.title: During waking immobility, hippocampal replay switches between task-focused forward sweeps (planning mode) and local consolidation replay (integration mode) based on task demand; this waking consolidation mode is architecturally necessary for viability map integration during experience.
ARC-038.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A consumer must exist that ingests replayed trajectories into the viability map under the MECH-094 hypothesis-tag constraint, and the write must be routed through a gate target that MECH-261 actually reads -- demonstrated by a per-tick record of non-zero map deltas attributable to replay in the ENABLED arm and exactly zero in the ABLATED arm, before any harm-rate comparison is interpretable.
CONFIRMING: With a replay consumer built and witnessed writing, Phase1-ENABLED harm rate falls meaningfully below Phase1-ABLATED (effect >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed delta) and shows the Phase0 -> Phase1 improvement while ABLATED stays at the Phase0 baseline, with the replay-write witness non-zero only in ENABLED. Manipulation: Three arms as the existing WWA specifies -- Phase0 pre-consolidation baseline, Phase1 with the waking-consolidation write path ENABLED, Phase1 with it ABLATED (replay suppressed or the map write held closed) -- but with the ablation applied at the newly built replay CONSUMER, not at a gate weight nothing reads. Control: Matched seeds (>= 3) across the three arms, with the ABLATED arm serving as the deliberate reproduction of the 355a non-propagation pattern, plus a goal-directed forward-sweep arm so the consolidation mode is dissociated from planning replay rather than merely from no-replay. Required event: Quiescent E3 heartbeat cycles during waking immobility (ticks['e3_quiescent'] is already produced and V3-EXQ-761 PASSed for MECH-092's triggering half), with no active z_goal, followed by later episodes in which the integrated map geometry could be exploited. DV: Phase1 harm rate ENABLED versus ABLATED at matched Phase0 baseline, reported alongside the mandatory mechanism witness: count and magnitude of replay-sourced viability-map writes per arm, so a null can be attributed to the mechanism rather than to an unwired consumer.
FALSIFYING: With the consumer built and the write witness confirming replay-sourced map updates in ENABLED and none in ABLATED, the two Phase1 harm rates remain statistically indistinguishable on >= 2/3 seeds -- the map integrates regardless of whether waking-consolidation-mode gating is engaged, so the task-focused / consolidation replay-mode distinction does no architectural work. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The trigger and the replay generator exist (agent.py _do_replay at :10806, hippocampal/module.py replay at :2975 and diverse_replay at :3193) and V3-EXQ-240/267/355/355a are working drivers. The missing instrument is any recorder of replay-to-map writes, because there is no such write: replay output is discarded and hc_viability has no write_gate reader. Consumer / boundary: The hippocampal viability-map geometry update during waking quiescence, and its propagation to Phase1 online action selection -- the propagation boundary the 2026-04-19 governance note already identified as the failure point. Existing ownership: mech092-replay-consumer-missing, MECH-092, MECH-261, EXP-0584, hippocampal_planning_v4:HPL-7.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); Waking replay has no consumer: _do_replay computes replay_trajs and discards it, and the MECH-261 gate target hc_viability is defined in DEFAULT_GATE_WEIGHTS with no call site. The mode-governance lineage is additionally inert at production defaults, so offline_consolidation mode is never occupied within a life. Secondary classes: R5, R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's own non-degeneracy precondition -- confirm MECH-261's mode-conditioned write gate is LIVE for the viability-map write path -- is provably unsatisfiable in current code, for a reason the text does not name. 'hc_viability' is present in DEFAULT_GATE_WEIGHTS (ree_core/cingulate/salience_coordinator.py:235) but has ZERO salience.write_gate('hc_viability') call sites anywhere in ree_core, and more fundamentally Agent._do_replay assigns replay_trajs from hippocampal.replay()/diverse_replay() and then RETURNS WITHOUT READING IT -- waking replay has no consumer at all. So re-running EXQ-355a's design with MECH-261 landed would reproduce the bit-identical ENABLED=ABLATED result for a mechanical reason, not a new degeneracy signature. Separately the mode-governance lineage is inert at production defaults (use_salience_coordinator=False), so offline_consolidation mode is not entered within life. ARC-039.subject: hippocampus.entorhinal_offline_consolidation
ARC-039.title: Durable long-term storage of the hippocampal viability map requires a hippocampal-entorhinal loop that engages during offline (sleep/DMN-equivalent) consolidation and provides a coordinate-invariant grid representation; this loop does not operate during waking planning or waking immobility consolidation.
ARC-039.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the full hippocampal-entorhinal grid circuit must exist before this claim is testable -- a separate entorhinal grid module, an offline (sleep-equivalent) processing phase distinct from waking micro-quiescence, and a read-back mechanism that seeds waking hippocampal sequences from the grid representation. None of this exists in V3 regardless of the machine-readable implementation_phase tag above (see PHASE-TAG NOTE below); the claim's own notes describe it as V4-scope. The one V3 proxy attempted so far (ResidueField.integrate() every 20 episodes) was shown NOT to be a valid substitute -- EXQ-214 (2026-04-03) found it actively DEGRADES residue-hazard correlation (mean_delta_accuracy=-0.283) rather than consolidating it, so a negative result on that proxy cannot be read as evidence against this claim, and no other V3-buildable proxy is known. CONFIRMING: once the V4 hippocampal-entorhinal circuit exists, viability-map durability over long training runs (e.g. residue-hazard correlation measured across extended episodes) is measurably better with the offline entorhinal-loop consolidation active than with it disabled, AND the grid-coded representation demonstrably generalises across environment layouts (coordinate-invariance) in a way the episodic hippocampal representation alone does not. FALSIFYING: once the V4 circuit exists, offline consolidation via the entorhinal loop shows no durability benefit over an episodic-only baseline, or the grid representation fails to generalise across environments -- meaning the specific mechanism (a hippocampal- entorhinal loop engaging only during offline/immobility periods) is not what durable map storage actually needs, even if some other consolidation approach eventually is. PHASE-TAG NOTE (flagged 2026-08-08, not resolved here): implementation_ phase: v3 above is not a data-entry error -- it is a mechanical reclassification applied by scripts/check_claim_phase_consistency.py, triggered by MECH-261's own depends_on: ARC-039 edge (commented "offline consolidation target"). That edge looks mistyped as a build prerequisite: MECH-261 reached status:stable in V3 (V3-EXQ-446/455/453) while ARC-039's entorhinal circuit never existed, i.e. MECH-261 did not actually need ARC-039 built first -- it reads more like a forward reference to a future write target than a true dependency. ARC-039 also never had phase_locked: true set, which would have routed this to the checker's CONFLICT path (human adjudication) instead of a silent RECLASSIFY. Flagged for whoever owns that checker/validator logic; not fixed in this pass.
RESOLVED 2026-08-10 (chip chip-20260810-phase-consistency-reconciliation): fixed exactly as diagnosed above -- MECH-261.depends_on: ARC-039 deleted, implementation_phase reverted v3 -> v4, phase_locked: true set. See evidence/planning/arc039_phase_reclassification_staged_20260808.md.

ARC-040.subject: hippocampus.dorsal_ventral_functional_segregation
ARC-040.title: The REE hippocampal module requires dorsal-predominant trajectory proposal (value-free spatial navigation) combined with a ventral-analog valence prior sourced from R(x,t) geometry; these are architecturally segregated, not merged.
ARC-040.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A hippocampal module implementing two independently-ablatable
pathways must exist: a dorsal-predominant, value-free trajectory-proposal pathway over
residue-field terrain, and a ventral-analog pathway supplying a valence prior sourced from
R(x,t) geometry (not computed on-the-fly). V3's HippocampalModule (ree_core/hippocampal/
module.py:134) is a single undifferentiated class with no such split -- this claim cannot be
probed until a V4 module implementing the split exists. See MECH-073's what_would_answer (the
CURRENT, undifferentiated map): it already tests whether valence is separable from geometry
at all; do not re-derive that leg here, only cite it as prerequisite groundwork.

CONFIRMING: With both pathways built and independently ablatable, ablating the ventral
valence-prior pathway degrades valence-weighted trajectory ranking (harm avoidance / benefit
seeking) while leaving value-free navigation efficiency statistically unchanged, and ablating
the dorsal pathway degrades navigation efficiency while leaving valence-lookup accuracy
unchanged -- a double dissociation at >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed delta on each leg.

FALSIFYING: Ablating either pathway produces the same degradation pattern (no double
dissociation), or a single undifferentiated module (the current V3 design) performs
indistinguishably from the segregated V4 design on both DVs -- the architectural segregation
does no work beyond what ARC-007's single residue-field path memory already provides.

SUBSTRATE REQUIREMENT: V4 dorsal/ventral hippocampal module split. Does not exist in V3.
Blocking artifact: ree_core/hippocampal/module.py's single HippocampalModule class.

ARC-041.subject: architecture.frontal_cue_weighting_circuit
ARC-041.title: The frontal cue-weighting circuit -- E1 cue-indexed retrieval (MECH-150) feeding dual pathways to E2 action biasing (MECH-151) and E3 terrain precision scaling (MECH-152) -- completes the stored-to-active pathway specified in ARC-035 by providing the retrieval mechanism and dual downstream output architecture.
ARC-041.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both legs must be independently non-degenerate in the SAME run: cue_context must carry differentiated content (selection entropy off the uniform ceiling, sel_context_divergence above floor) AND the E3 terrain leg's input must actually vary with context in the arm being scored. Without the second condition a flat E3 leg is instrument failure, not architecture falsification.
CONFIRMING: Both legs independently track cue-context identity in the same run with the encoder-readiness controls met, supporting the dual-output circuit shape ARC-041 asserts over ARC-035's unspecified pathway. Manipulation: SD-016 production combination (sd016_enabled with the write-path/diversification settings of V3-EXQ-922) versus the cue-retrieval-off control, with selection hardness (hard-Gumbel versus soft) swept as a separate factor rather than confounded with the architecture contrast. Control: Matched-seed retrieval-off arm plus the A0_OFF encoder-readiness control (world_encoder_weights_moved, z_world_spread_lift), and a soft-selection arm to separate selection hardness from mechanism absence. Required event: A production-configured run in which E1 ContextMemory is queried with z_world alone, producing cue_context that is then read at both downstream sites within the same episode. DV: Joint, same-run content-tracking on both legs: action_bias divergence tracked against cue-context identity (E2/MECH-151) and w_harm/w_goal modulation DEPTH -- not only a scale-invariant correlation -- tracked against cue-context identity (E3/MECH-152), each with its own pre-registered target band.
FALSIFYING: With both legs' inputs verified to vary with context and a depth-sensitive E3 DV in place, exactly one pathway tracks retrieval content while the other stays flat -- falsifying the DUAL-pathway architecture while leaving the surviving sub-mechanism claim intact. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

ARC-042.subject: architecture.staged_developmental_phases
ARC-042.title: E3's ethical selection machinery is architecturally present from initialisation but functionally dark until E1 and E2 substrate development is complete; REE requires staged developmental phases before ethical selection can operate on real signal.
ARC-042.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The Phase 1 gate must actually be crossable in the run: ContextMemory representations must separate hazard-proximate from hazard-distal contexts above the noise floor. As of V3-EXQ-972 (2026-09-02) mean separability is 0.028 against a 0.05 floor with intra-cluster cosine 0.98, so every E3 measurement to date sits on the claim's own predicted-null branch and cannot discriminate.
CONFIRMING: E3 discrimination is at chance while separability sits below the noise floor and rises materially once separability clears it, on matched seeds -- the staged-gate signature. Manipulation: Staged versus unstaged training: supervised context labelling applied versus withheld, with E3 held fixed; the claim's content is the ORDER dependency, so the arms differ only in whether the prerequisite phase ran. Control: Matched-seed unsupervised arm (the EXQ-181b/187a baseline at cosine_sim ~1.0) plus an E3-ablated arm, so that any post-gate discrimination is attributable to the input signal rather than to extra training in general. Required event: A training regimen that produces a DIFFERENTIATED ContextMemory (Phase 1 crossed), followed by E2 exposure (Phase 2), then E3 ethical selection measured on the same substrate. DV: E3 ethical-selection discrimination -- e3_harm_eval_diff between hazard-proximate and hazard-distal contexts -- measured BEFORE and AFTER the Phase 1 gate, conditioned on a measured ContextMemory separability above the noise floor.
FALSIFYING: E3 ethical selection discriminates contexts BEFORE the Phase 1 gate is crossed (no staging requirement), or fails to discriminate AFTER a measurably differentiated ContextMemory is achieved -- the latter would relocate the deficit from staging to E3 itself. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

Phase 1 has not been crossed in 6 months: H1 contrastive loss, H2 operating point and H3 task-coupling all FAILed, and H4 (V3-EXQ-972) supports 'representation undifferentiated' upstream.
