ARC-043.subject: architecture.conceptual_stack_ordering
ARC-043.title: The REE ethical architecture is organised as a conceptual stack: Layers 0-4 are the five axioms (epistemic ground, existence, other minds, shared world, love/shared valence); Layer 5 is ethics derived from the axioms; Layer 6 is REE as the decision system implementing ethics under uncertainty; Layers 7-9 close the action-consequence-learning loop.
ARC-043.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A test of ordering requires each named layer to have a separable implementation whose removal can be observed; in V3 the axiom layers (other minds, shared world, language) have no separable substrate, so a layer-ablation design would manipulate nothing distinguishable.
CONFIRMING: Each layer's content is shown to require its asserted prerequisites (removing a prerequisite breaks the derivation) and no higher layer survives its prerequisite's removal, across the audit's enumerated crossings. Manipulation: Remove or degrade one layer (for example the other-minds representation) and re-derive the layers above it, checking whether the higher layer's content still follows; philosophically, attack the is-to-ought crossings the adversarial audit enumerates. Control: Removal of a layer the ordering says is NOT required by the target layer, which should leave the target layer's derivation intact -- the asymmetry is what distinguishes an ordering claim from a list of components. Required event: A derivation audit in which each claimed layer dependency is stated as an entailment and checked against the layer below it, or -- at a much later version -- an agent in which other-minds, shared-world and language layers are separately instantiable. DV: Whether the higher layer's content remains derivable or behaviourally expressible when a lower layer is removed, and whether any ordering violation (a higher layer surviving without its asserted prerequisite) is found.
FALSIFYING: Some layer's content is derivable without its asserted prerequisite, or the ordering can be permuted without loss -- for example ethics derivable without the other-minds axiom -- which would make the stack a presentation convenience rather than a dependency structure. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The existing recorder is documentary, not computational: REE_assembly/docs/architecture/axiom_chain_adversarial_audit.md enumerates each load-bearing step, its strongest objection, and what would defuse it. No V3 module or experiment instruments layer dependency. Consumer / boundary: The logical dependency structure among the axioms, derivations D1/D2, ethics and the decision system -- an architectural documentation boundary, not a runtime consumer. Existing ownership: INV-042, INV-001, EXP-0448, ree_ai_design_critique_plan.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); The claim is a conceptual-ordering commitment whose layers have no separable V3 substrate, and whose stated content (a logical dependency structure, explicitly not a computational pipeline) is not the kind of thing an experiment falsifies. Its live falsification route is the adversarial axiom audit, which no edge connects to the claim. Secondary classes: R8. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: unphased_no_v3_link. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-044.subject: architecture.neuromodulatory_gain_unifier
ARC-044.title: Context-dependent neuromodulatory gain is a single unifying mechanism expressed at multiple levels: ARC-016 (temporal precision from prediction error variance), MECH-152 (contextual terrain weight from cue-indexed retrieval), MECH-026 (arousal-mediated vigilance sensitivity), and MECH-093 (z_beta heartbeat frequency modulation) are all facets of a global arousal/precision signal (LC-NE) modulated by a context-specific gain signal (vmPFC/OFC).
ARC-044.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE STATE (2026-09-02 triage, chip-20260902-arc044-mech152-arc016-no-shared-readout): /queue-experiment attempted to build the MECH-152 x ARC-016 test (drafted as V3-EXQ-990) and was BLOCKED at design review by two independent adversarial passes, both convergent. (a) NO SHARED READOUT: MECH-152's w_harm enters ONLY E3Selector.score_trajectory's harm term (m = m * w_harm, ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py) and ARC-016's running_variance enters ONLY the commit gate (committed = commit_variance < effective_threshold, same file); candidate generation (e2_fast.py:generate_candidates_random) is precision-blind. No code path lets the two mechanisms jointly determine any single measurable quantity today -- a "combined harm-evaluation precision/variability readout" does not exist to be measured, so the CONFIRMING/FALSIFYING pair below is not currently runnable as a single internal-scalar test. (b) SEPARATELY: the harm-cost head used whenever no harm_bridge/harm_forward_model is supplied (E3Selector.harm_eval_head) receives NO gradient from the generic agent.py loss inventory that ordinary experiments use -- it is trained only via the opt-in SD-054 onboarding curriculum (experiments/scaffolded_sd054_onboarding.py, scaffold_train_harm_eval_head=True), which is NOT part of the env setups this claim names for reuse below (V3-EXQ-194/194a, V3-EXQ-818). Reusing those setups directly, as originally specified, inherits an untrained (random-projection) harm_eval_head; any re-test MUST compose the SD-054 curriculum with the 194/818 manipulation rather than assume the harm head is already grounded. Do not re-mint SD-054's training loss as new substrate -- it already exists; the gap is a design-composition step, not a build.
LITERATURE STATE (2026-09-08 targeted review, literature_confidence 0.836, evidence/literature/targeted_review_connectome_arc_044/): three INDEPENDENT lines converge against the claim's headline -- Yu & Dayan 2005 (Neuron, normative Bayesian derivation), Polack et al. 2013 (Nat Neurosci, intracellular pharmacology in mouse V1), and Shine 2019 (Trends Cog Sci, review) / Munn et al. 2021 (Nat Commun, whole-brain human fMRI) -- the latter two share an author and are counted as ONE independent line, not two. All three report the ascending gain layer as AT LEAST TWO dissociable neuromodulatory systems (noradrenergic + cholinergic; locus coeruleus + basal forebrain), not one global signal. ARC-044's ARCHITECTURAL half -- effective precision at an evaluation channel is a composite quantity that ARC-016, MECH-152, MECH-026 and MECH-093 should all write into, rather than each carrying a private threshold -- SURVIVES all three and is the part worth keeping (Munn et al.'s topology-level reorganisation finding, in particular, is the right grain of effect for an architectural control signal). ARC-044's MECHANISTIC half -- "a single... global arousal/ precision signal ... modulated by a context-specific gain" -- is CONTRADICTED by all three and should be restated as a multi-source composite, not a single signal.
FALSIFIER CORRECTION (load-bearing, from Yu & Dayan 2005): the interaction their two uncertainty signals derive to is "part-antagonistic, part-synergistic" -- i.e. SIGN-VARYING across regimes -- a third outcome the claim's original CONFIRMING/FALSIFYING pair (multiplicative vs. additive/null) has no slot for. Any re-test of this claim must admit that third outcome explicitly: a mixed-sign interaction is evidence of genuine (non-independent, non-unified) composition and must not be scored as a null/falsifier by default.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (substrate readiness, unchanged by the above): the two mechanisms must each be independently confirmed live before a null interaction can be read as evidence of independence rather than a wiring gap. ARC-016 (temporal gain): CONFIRMED live -- status stable, gate_green, mean_rho_rv_vs_commit=-0.955 (V3-EXQ-818, 2026-07-25); the substrate already computes volatility_estimate = var(running_variance) over a sliding window (Q-007, ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py). MECH-152 (contextual gain), harm pathway only: CONFIRMED live -- V3-EXQ-194/194a C1 PASS 3/3, r_w_harm=0.70. The GOAL pathway (w_goal) is FAIL (r=-0.007, flat) and stays OUT OF SCOPE. A run in which either running_variance or w_harm shows negligible variance across its manipulated conditions must self-route substrate_not_ready / non_contributory, not be read as a test of ARC-044.
SCOPE NOTE (unchanged): MECH-093's rate-channel is independently confirmed (V3-EXQ-097b/396b/505), but MECH-026 has zero experimental evidence of its own and explicitly defers its mechanism to MECH-161's arousal regulator, which reads as UNBUILT (MECH-161: evidence: [], status: candidate). A full 4-facet unification test is therefore NOT testable now; this what_would_answer stays scoped to the MECH-152 x ARC-016 pair.
CONFIRMING: once (i) the missing shared readout is either built (a substrate design not specified here -- see OPEN questions below) or the design is restated around a downstream BEHAVIOURAL readout common to both pathways (e.g. harm incurred conditional on commit rate, rather than a single required internal scalar), and (ii) harm_eval_head is grounded via the SD-054 curriculum composed with the 194/818 manipulation -- a context x temporal-state interaction that is either cleanly multiplicative OR mixed-sign/regime-dependent (per the Yu & Dayan correction above), on the combined precision/gain readout, exceeding what either main effect alone predicts. Per the gain-control literature already cited in MECH-152's notes (Kanashiro et al. 2017), the confirming signature should also show high w_harm x low running_variance jointly REDUCING harm-evaluation variability (signal-to-noise gain), not merely scaling magnitude.
FALSIFYING: even after (i) and (ii) above, the interaction is additive or genuinely null (NOT merely mixed-sign -- see the falsifier correction above) under non-degenerate preconditions. This falsifies ARC-044's unification for the MECH-152/ARC-016 pair specifically: they stand as REE currently implements them -- two independent gain knobs, not facets of one architecture.
OPEN, NOT RESOLVED HERE: (1) whether precision/gain is even the right shared quantity, or whether an integration/segregation-style state (Shine 2019's candidate -- a property of the whole evaluation-channel set at once, not a per-channel scalar) is a better target for what the four mechanisms jointly modulate; REE has no such state today and the vocabulary should not be imported without a concrete ree_core referent -- this is why no shared-readout substrate design is proposed here rather than deferred. (2) Yu & Dayan's expected-uncertainty (cholinergic) term -- a per-channel cue-reliability prior -- has no counterpart among ARC-016/MECH-152/MECH-026/MECH-093; ARC-016 is closest but estimates from running-variance in the temporal stream, a different quantity (a prior vs. an online estimate). Neither question blocks a corrected MECH-152 x ARC-016 test, but both should inform whatever substrate design eventually implements the shared readout in (i) -- building it before this is resolved risks encoding the wrong architecture and re-blocking the next /queue-experiment pass the same way.

ARC-045.subject: hippocampus.bidirectional_information_flow
ARC-045.title: Bidirectional hippocampus-neocortex information flow is architecturally necessary for attribution mapping convergence: the SWS-direction (hippocampus to cortex) installs context schema structure; waking and REM-direction reactivations fill those structures with causal attribution estimates. Without bidirectional flow, context representations remain globally undifferentiated despite locally coherent online encoding.
ARC-045.what_would_answer:
ARC-045 is falsified if disabling the SWS-direction (hippocampus->cortex) offline consolidation pass produces context-attribution structure of the SAME OR BETTER quality than an agent with it enabled, measured as representational-similarity-matrix (RSM) agreement with ground-truth latent-context structure -- i.e. contexts that are behaviourally/causally related should show correspondingly elevated representational similarity, and contexts that are behaviourally distinct should show correspondingly reduced similarity (per the 2026-08-25 GFLAG-0047 governance resolution, which reframes this claim's decisive DV away from pure differentiation/ maximal-separation and toward relational appropriateness, per MECH-495). ARC-045 is supported if bidirectional (SWS-then-REM) flow measurably improves that RSM-ground-truth agreement over a waking-only (single-pass online) condition.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the underlying write-selection substrate must first demonstrate CONTENT-addressed discrimination (writes route to slots correlated with context identity, not merely fill slots via counter-driven rotation or a structural k+1 floor) -- currently unmet.
Shares this falsification condition with MECH-166 -- do not re-derive independently; the two claims differ only in which variable is manipulated (direction/presence of the hippocampus->cortex pass, vs. temporal separation of formation from filling).
[2026-08-27 thought-digestion]: this claim's pending_retest_after_substrate scoping ('after-WRITE-PATH-ADDRESSING-BUILD') is stale -- the write-path build has gone through THREE generations since that text was written (bias 2026-08-19, refractory 2026-08-19, gumbel_learned 2026-08-26). V3-EXQ-943 (2026-08-20/21) found occupancy achieved but explicitly NOT content- addressed ('occupancy without addressing'). A third mechanism (gumbel_learned, ree-v3 636d0e4fb2, 2026-08-26) is built but its own resolution note says content-discrimination is 'NOT yet shown to actually discriminate content'. An open chip (chip-20260827-queueexp- contextmemory-gumbel-learned-validation) is designing its validation right now but proposes a still-differentiation-shaped DV, not yet reflecting GFLAG-0047's relational-topology mandate. Governance flag raised covering this whole chain.

ARC-046.subject: development.infant_hazard_protection
ARC-046.title: The infant stage requires a hazard protection mechanism that permits sensorially salient harm exposure without catastrophic residue saturation.
ARC-046.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE-BLOCKED as of 2026-08-07. This is a testable-now falsifier design (reusing the V3-EXQ-591 curriculum-vs-flat structure: residue_scale_factor ~0.1 + reduced hazard_magnitude vs full-rate baseline), but it cannot be run validly today because the InfantCurriculumScheduler still fails its own Phase 0 advancement gate under the agent's current action-selection substrate (the precise 591-family failure mode). Two of the three original substrate prerequisites are now CLEARED: (a) MECH-307 default-value recalibration (V3-EXQ-540e/540g), and (b) non-trivial z_goal formation+consumption in default V3 config (V3-EXQ-603n PASS, 2026-06-10). Prerequisite (c), Phase 0->1 advancement, split in two: (c-2) the gate-criterion defect is RESOLVED end-to-end (crossing-count criterion identified V3-EXQ-591f PASS 2026-06-15, wired into InfantCurriculumScheduler 2026-06-19, commit b4dc264, opt-in no-op-default flag phase_0to1_use_crossing_count). (c-1), seed-46 exploration-strength collapse, remains OPEN and is the sole outstanding precondition -- see the corrected ceiling_routing_note above: its gate is now the MECH-457 competence-floor wall, NOT GAP-A (which is resolved and must not be re-cited).
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (must hold before this falsifier is non-vacuous): the InfantCurriculumScheduler must actually advance past Phase 0 in BOTH the protected and full-rate arms (the 2026-05-27 V3-EXQ-591 failure mode -- scheduler stuck in Phase 0 across all 5 seeds, H_pos 0.03-1.08 vs the advancement gate -- must not recur), AND z_goal must develop non-trivially in both arms (must not collapse to ~1e-7 as in 591). Both require (c-1)'s clearance (the MECH-457 competence-floor wall) plus a successful, redesigned V3-EXQ-667a-class exploration-strength retest, ahead of the full curriculum-vs-flat comparison (EXQ-ISEF-005 / GAP-14).
CONFIRMING: once non-degenerate, infant-stage protected agents (residue_scale_factor ~0.1, reduced hazard_magnitude) show normal harm-signal learning -- z_harm_s and z_harm_a fire and train at a rate statistically indistinguishable from full-rate agents -- while residue accumulation over the curriculum stays measurably below full-rate agents, such that protected agents avoid the catastrophic-saturation failure mode (residue field saturating before a behavioral repertoire exists to avoid harm) that would otherwise block childhood-stage training (INV-041).
FALSIFYING: EITHER (i) protected agents show no meaningful reduction in residue accumulation relative to full-rate agents -- the residue_scale_factor / hazard_magnitude scaling does not actually protect the residue field; OR (ii) harm-signal learning is measurably degraded in protected agents relative to full-rate agents -- residue_scale_factor dampens the z_harm_s/z_harm_a LEARNING signal itself, not just downstream accumulation -- so the mechanism cannot decouple educative harm-learning from catastrophic-saturation protection as claimed. A design that needs two independently-tuned levers (one for learning-preservation, one for accumulation-suppression) is itself informative and should be recorded as a qualified falsification rather than folded into either branch.

ARC-047.subject: testing.social_scent_harness
ARC-047.title: Multi-agent gridworld with affective state leakage as gradient scent fields is the minimal substrate for empirically testing ARC-010 mirror modelling, MECH-041 affective expression, and cooperative behavior claims.
ARC-047.what_would_answer:
This is a MINIMALITY claim about test infrastructure, not a behavioral hypothesis -- it asserts that the specific 7-channel gradient-scent SocialGridWorld design (N agents + predator + wanting/seeking/alarm/harm_stress/direction/celebration/defense as diffusing Gaussian fields) is the MINIMAL environment sufficient to generate empirical evidence for ARC-010 (mirror modelling), MECH-041 (affective expression), and cooperative-behavior claims -- not merely A sufficient environment, but the SMALLEST one that works. A minimality claim cannot be answered by building the full design and having it work; that only shows sufficiency. It requires comparing the full design against deliberately simpler alternatives.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- three things must hold before any result here is informative, none currently true (checked 2026-08-08): (1) IMPL-019's self_stability_gate (DEV-NEED-021/026) is confirmed passing -- Stage 1 self-viability, Stage 2 control-plane stabilisation, Stage 3 rollout feasibility, all demonstrated in single-agent CausalGridWorld across seeds; as of this writing this gate is OPEN, no evidence artifact records it passing, and the queue-validation enforcement developmental_metrics.md calls for does not exist in ree-v3/validate_queue.py. (2) SocialGridWorld is actually built -- zero implementation exists anywhere in ree-v3 (no SocialGridWorld class, no scent-channel machinery). (3) A genuine ARC-010/MECH-041 mechanism is live and engaged during the run.
CONFIRMING (minimality is supported): a battery of deliberately SIMPLER substrate variants is run against the same claim set and each demonstrably FAILS to elicit measurable ARC-010/MECH-041/cooperative-behavior signal, while the full 7-channel SocialGridWorld succeeds on the same seeds/budget. Candidate simplifications, in order of removal: no predator, fewer scent channels (e.g. alarm+harm_stress only), discrete presence/absence signaling instead of continuous Gaussian gradient fields, no diffusion (point-source scent instead of a spatial gradient). If each simplified arm fails and only the full design succeeds, minimality is empirically supported -- not asserted, but shown load-bearing.
FALSIFYING (minimality is NOT supported -- ARC-047 as specified is over-built): any materially simpler substrate variant is SUFFICIENT to elicit the same target signal at comparable strength (e.g. binary presence/absence scent suffices for ARC-010 mirror modelling; 2-3 channels suffice for MECH-041; cooperative defense emerges without an autonomous predator). Any of these means ARC-047's specific design commits more implementation cost than the science requires and needs revision to the simpler sufficient design, not confirmation as stated.
A genuinely INDETERMINATE outcome is also possible and should be reported as such rather than forced either way: if simplified arms fail for reasons orthogonal to minimality (insufficient budget, seed variance, an unrelated control-plane instability inherited from an unresolved IMPL-019 gate), the comparison is confounded and does not bear on whether the full design's specific complexity is necessary.

ARC-048.subject: language.externalization_channel
ARC-048.title: Language is a high-bandwidth externalization of pre-existing functional states, not a separate cognitive system; the language bootstrap requires functional states as referents.
ARC-048.what_would_answer:
ARC-048 IS FUSED -- a metaphysical premise plus an operational consequence, with opposite
ownership. Split them; do not test the group as one thing.

LEG A -- THE PREMISE ("language is not a separate cognitive system"). NOT ARC-048's to
answer. Already owned, already digested. This is INV-003's assertion ("language emerges as
functional self-representation, not a bolt-on"), and INV-003 already carries a full
`what_would_answer` specifying the resolution route: a code-path audit (category
`derivational`), not a trained behavioural experiment, run against whatever function turns agent
state into emitted symbols and received symbols into agent-state updates, asking whether that
path reads from and writes to the shared self-representational latent substrate (z_self,
`ree_core/latent/stack.py`, `ree_core/latent/self_recurrence.py`) or is architecturally
isolated. See INV-003's own `what_would_answer` for the precondition, the audit target, and
both verdict conditions. Do not re-derive them here. ARC-048 adds nothing to Leg A and must
not be credited or debited by its outcome.

LEG B -- THE OPERATIONAL CONSEQUENCE (the falsifiable part ARC-048 alone owns). Two
independent, separately-measurable predictions follow from "language is a bandwidth increase
over an existing functional-state channel, and the bootstrap requires functional states to
pre-exist as referents":

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (strictly stronger than INV-003's -- three gates):
(1) A signalling mechanism that both emits and consumes symbols must exist and execute -- the
same gate INV-003 states, confirmed unmet 2026-08-07 and re-confirmed 2026-09-04. The
designated landing site is MECH-014's minimal signalling channel, instantiated at
`language_emergence_bootstrap_v6:LANG-3` (status `blocked`).
(2) A PRE-LINGUISTIC externalisation channel must ALSO exist, because "higher bandwidth than
the existing channel" has no denominator without one and prediction B2 has no baseline
partition. That channel is ARC-047's scent/broadcast fields; see MECH-191's own
`what_would_answer` Leg B RELEASE CONDITION for the exact substrate list -- do not re-derive
it. This gate is what makes ARC-048 harder than INV-003, and it is the reason ARC-048 cannot
ride INV-003's audit.
(3) The functional-state channels used as the referent partition must each show non-degenerate
cross-episode variance -- z_harm_a, z_goal, and z_beta valence must each activate AND go
quiescent within the run (the same variance shape MECH-191 Leg A's precondition specifies). A
referent partition with a channel pinned always-on or always-off is degenerate and the mutual
information in B2 is undefined at the floor; the run self-routes `substrate_not_ready`.

CONFIRMING (B1 -- ORDERING / referent precedence): with the signalling channel open, an
agent whose functional-state channels are ablated or floored fails to stabilise ANY signal,
while a matched agent with intact functional states and no prior signalling history does
stabilise signals -- i.e. the referents are load-bearing for bootstrap, not incidental.
CONFIRMING (B2 -- ISOMORPHISM / bandwidth-monotonicity): the emergent signal repertoire's
discriminative partition is a refinement of the pre-linguistic functional-state partition --
higher resolution over the SAME referents (the yelp -> "my leg hurts when I walk on wet grass"
relation in the claim's own notes) -- not a cross-cut of it. Metric: mutual information between
emitted-signal identity and functional-state identity exceeds MI between signal identity and an
entropy-matched task-arbitrary partition (e.g. tokens keyed to grid coordinates), by a margin
scaled on the SD of the cross-seed delta plus an absolute floor, on at least 2/3 seeds.

FALSIFYING (B1): signals stabilise just as readily over an arbitrary non-functional-state
referent set as over functional states -- language is then a general symbol-learning capacity
and ARC-048's "pre-existing functional-state referents" requirement is doing no work.
FALSIFYING (B2): the emergent partition cross-cuts the functional-state partition (the
signals carve the task, not the state space), or MI with functional states is
indistinguishable from MI with the entropy-matched arbitrary partition -- language is then a
separate channel that merely co-exists with the functional-state channel, not a
bandwidth increase over it, which is precisely the "separate cognitive system" reading ARC-048
denies.

Note on what does NOT falsify ARC-048: expressive breadth or grammaticality of the emergent
signalling. INV-003 already records that fluency is a different question; the same exclusion
applies here, and more sharply, because ARC-048's claim is about the referent architecture, not
the channel's expressive power.

ARC-049.subject: play.context_tag_architecture
ARC-049.title: Play mode boundary requires a co-maintained context tag held by both agent and environment; agent-internal tagging alone is insufficient and unilateral play assertion without mutual signal is manipulation.
ARC-049.what_would_answer:

own notes (persistent L2 flag in LatentState, L1 frame_open/frame_close
events, L3 ambiguity_threshold-triggered repair signals) is UNIMPLEMENTED
in V3 -- confirmed by direct search of ree_core (2026-08): zero occurrences
of play_frame_tag, frame_open, frame_close, or ambiguity_threshold anywhere
in the substrate. No experiment has exercised this mechanism. Everything
below is gated on building it first.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- WHAT IS AND IS NOT TESTABLE IN THE V3
DEGENERATE CASE: per this claim's own notes, V3's environment is
experimenter-complicit by design (the experimenter scripts play-mode
signals rather than a partner agent generating them autonomously). This
means:
  - TESTABLE IN V3 (single-agent, experimenter-scripted signal): whether
    the agent's OWN behavior differentially responds to L1 (frame open/
    close) and L3 (repair) events that the experimenter injects on a
    schedule. This tests whether play_frame_tag is load-bearing for the
    agent's own policy, not whether it is legible to or co-maintained
    with a partner.
  - NOT TESTABLE IN V3, REQUIRES V4/MULTI-AGENT: whether the tag is
    genuinely BILATERAL -- externally legible to and monitored by a
    partner that can independently initiate a frame violation or a
    repair, rather than following an experimenter's script. This is
    specifically the clause "unilateral play assertion without mutual
    signal is manipulation" (INV-059). A scripted experimenter can only
    ever cooperate with the frame; it cannot play the role of a partner
    who is deceived by a unilateral assertion, so the manipulation
    signature cannot be produced or falsified in V3. Sibling questions
    Q-050 and Q-051 already establish this precondition explicitly for
    games-with-rules and cooperative play, and the same reasoning
    applies to ARC-049's own bilateral clause.

CONFIRMING signature (V3-testable slice, once play_frame_tag is built):
following the Q-048/Q-049 pattern, inject an aggression-adjacent action
(bite-shake or equivalent) at an ambiguity juncture, with two arms --
(1) L3 repair signal present immediately after the action, (2) L3 repair
signal withheld. Measure post-juncture behavior (continuation of
play-typical action selection vs escalation/withdrawal consistent with a
real-harm read). ANSWER "genuine frame-tracking" if behavior differs
measurably between arms in the direction predicted by Bekoff 1995's
non-random repair-signal placement, at or above an effect-size floor
across >=2/3 seeds. This also requires L1 (frame open/close) to produce a
detectable behavioral state change on its own, as a baseline check that
the tag is read at all before testing L3's selective effect.

FALSIFYING signature: behavior at ambiguity junctures is statistically
indistinguishable between L3-present and L3-absent arms (and/or L1
open/close events produce no detectable behavioral change) -- the
play_frame_tag is tracked internally but not load-bearing for action
selection, i.e. decorative rather than functional. This would falsify the
V3-testable slice without touching the bilateral/manipulation clause,
which remains open regardless (see below).

SCOPE OF WHAT A PASSING V3 RESULT WOULD AND WOULD NOT ESTABLISH: a PASS
on the confirming signature above would show a co-maintained-style tag CAN
be functionally load-bearing for an agent's own behavior. It would NOT
confirm the full claim as titled -- the bilateral co-maintenance
requirement and the "unilateral assertion is manipulation" clause are
untestable without a partner agent capable of independently violating or
repairing the frame (V4 multi-agent, per INV-059 and Q-050/Q-051). The
full claim stays substrate_conditional/open even if the V3 slice passes.

ARC-051.subject: goal.emergent_hierarchy
ARC-051.title: multi_level_wanting_goal_hierarchy
ARC-051.what_would_answer:

The task suite must vary path-length-versus-schema-radius independently of cue-reliability-versus-gradient-clarity.
CONFIRMING: Degradation is concentrated at each level's claimed operating scale, with near-parity to full hierarchy outside that scale. Manipulation: Three-arm ablation over the independent default-off flags: full hierarchy versus serotonin tonic_5ht_enabled off (MECH-216 removed) versus hippocampal use_backward_credit_sweep off (MECH-217 removed), with the CEM modulatory authority and routing armed identically in every arm. FALSIFYING: Removing a level produces no measurable degradation anywhere, or degradation is uniform across scales (a pooled undifferentiated wanting signal), or the level-to-scale mapping is inverted. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Write-path call counts exist for all three paths; the throughput instrument exists as HippocampalModule.last_candidate_modulatory_bias plus the cem_elite route source, which is what makes an elite-stage bias reach E3.select. The fix is configuration, not a build -- arm the CEM modulatory authority and the cem_elite route. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: V3-EXQ-931 (2026-08-19) measured the hippocampal wanting term's cross-candidate authority at about 0.37 percent of the terrain term and showed that even at wanting_weight 5000, with the elite argmin flipping on 80 percent of refits, mean_resource_proximity stayed bit-identical to ablation because REEAgent.select_action re-scores the pool independently. ARC-052.subject: harm_stream.dynamic_precision
ARC-052.title: harm_precision_weighting
ARC-052.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The two harm streams must be non-redundant (SD-019) and their precision proxies must vary in the run: z_harm_s forward-model accuracy and z_harm_a volatility must each show cross-tick variance above their permutation nulls, as V3-EXQ-977 established (precision_error_corr 0.22-0.41 against a p95 null of ~0.055). A run in which either precision proxy is flat cannot discriminate weighting from no weighting.
CONFIRMING: Each harm stream's precision estimate is context-dependent in the directions the description states AND weighting E3's use of each stream by its own precision changes attribution and commit gating relative to the collapsed-precision baseline. Manipulation: Weight E3's use of each harm stream by that stream's own precision estimate (exp(-log_sigma) from a per-encoder precision head) versus the current fixed/global scheme, and ablate the weighting stream by stream. Control: The unweighted arm using E3's existing single unsigned running-variance precision, matched seeds and environment, plus the z_world positive control V3-EXQ-977 used (R2 >= 0.15, measured 0.27-0.52). Required event: Episodes in which harm-stream reliability varies within a run: periods of good versus poor E2_harm_s forward prediction, and periods of stable versus rapidly changing accumulated threat state. DV: Half (B), already measured: z_harm_s precision_error_corr >= 0.10 and z_harm_a precision_volatility_corr <= -0.10 against permutation nulls. Half (A), unmeasured: the change in attribution weight (SD-003 side) and in commit-gate threshold (z_harm_a side) attributable to each stream's own precision, versus the collapsed single-precision baseline.
FALSIFYING: The precision proxies are flat or move in the wrong direction, or per-stream weighting leaves attribution and commit gating indistinguishable from the single global precision term -- one collapsed precision scalar suffices. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: For half (B), experiments/v3_exq_977_arc052_harm_stream_conditional_precision.py. For half (A) there is no instrument: ree_core/latent/stack.py HarmEncoder and AffectiveHarmEncoder emit a latent only -- no (mu, log_sigma) head -- and ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py carries only the single ARC-016 running-variance precision term, not per-stream weights. Consumer / boundary: E3's weighting of each harm stream -- z_harm_s into attribution, z_harm_a into commit gating -- not the encoders' internal representation. Existing ownership: MECH054-SIGNED-HARM-BENEFIT-PE-PRECISION, SD-063, SD-020, ARC-016, EXP-1290.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); Half (A) has no producer and no consumer: neither harm encoder emits a precision output, and E3's only precision machinery is the single unsigned running-variance term. So the per-stream precision quantity cannot reach the weighting locus the claim asserts, and the one supporting run measured only the empirical antecedent. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. ARC-053.subject: architecture.temporal_coherence_loop
ARC-053.title: Temporal Coherence Loop (TCL): architecture must include a distributed loop responsible for maintaining phase alignment and temporal synchrony necessary for V(t) to be computable.
ARC-053.what_would_answer:
This is an arch_commitment sitting on THREE dependencies, all already
audited this session and all reporting the same result: the
mechanism this claim requires does not exist, and one candidate
implementation explicitly declines to be it.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (this is the blocker, check nothing else
first): a claim about a "loop that maintains phase alignment for
V(t)" is not statable in falsifiable form while V(t) itself has no
phase-alignment term to maintain. Per this session's INV-067 audit,
V(t) is UNBUILT as a literal combined quantity -- content agreement
C_i has a Stage-1 proxy only (MECH-269), phase alignment P_i has NO
implementation and NO functional analog anywhere in the substrate.
Per this session's INV-068 audit, D_V (temporal depth/persistence of
coupling) is equally unbuilt -- no D_V computation exists, and there
is no consumer wiring into E3 even if one did.

Independent spot-check this session (grep of ree_core/ and
experiments/ for phase_align, temporal_coherence, TCL,
phase_reference, phase coupling, synchrony, oscillat): confirms no
TCL-shaped mechanism exists. The only related implementation is
cross_stream_binder.py, whose own module docstring states binding-
by-synchrony is LEARNED, not a fixed phase-coupling field -- the
opposite design choice from what TCL specifies. BreathOscillator
(MECH-108) is a periodic threshold sweep, not phase/timing-window
coupling.

MECH-089 is the sharpest finding, because it is not merely
"unbuilt" -- it is a DELIBERATE ARCHITECTURAL DISCLAIMER. MECH-089
(cross-frequency temporal packaging, the one dependency of ARC-053
that could plausibly implement phase/timing coupling) states
explicitly: "implemented as a rolling aggregation over E1 outputs
before E3 sampling, NOT as oscillatory coupling... the biological
mechanism (theta-gamma CFC) is one implementation of this functional
requirement; it is not required in the ANN substrate." So this is
not one un-built dependency plus two others -- it is three
compounding blockers, one of which is a standing design decision
against the mechanism class ARC-053's title names.

What would need to change before this becomes testable:
  (a) V(t) needs at least a computed phase-alignment term P_i(t) to
      exist (ARC-055 Stage 2, itself status: candidate and unbuilt).
  (b) An actual timing/synchrony-adjustment mechanism, distinct from
      MECH-089's disclaimed rolling-aggregation approach, would need
      to be built -- OR MECH-089's existing scope would need to be
      re-examined as already discharging what ARC-053 requires,
      under a non-anatomical name.

LIVE ARCHITECTURAL QUESTION (flagged, not resolved here): does the
ANN substrate genuinely need literal phase/oscillatory coupling to
make V(t) computable, or does MECH-089's functional-analog rolling
aggregation already satisfy ARC-053's functional requirement --
"ensure ascending and descending signals meet in a comparable
temporal frame before comparison" -- just not implemented as a
distributed phase-alignment loop and not named TCL? If the latter,
ARC-053 as currently titled may be asking for a specific biological
IMPLEMENTATION where only the functional REQUIREMENT is
architecturally necessary -- in which case the claim needs
re-scoping to the requirement level before it can be evaluated at
all. This mirrors MECH-089's own stated position and should be
resolved by whoever next touches ARC-053/MECH-225/MECH-226, not
assumed either way here. This propagates forward: ARC-053 is itself
a load-bearing dependency for ARC-054, ARC-055, MECH-226, MECH-227,
MECH-228.

Re-audit only after (a) above lands, i.e. once V(t) has a real,
non-collapsed phase-alignment term computed and reachable by E3/E1.

that could plausibly implement phase/timing coupling, explicitly disclaims doing so ("NOT as
oscillatory coupling... it is not required in the ANN substrate").

This is the near-exact registry question Q-038 already asks ("Is temporal-depth verisimilitude
D_V explicitly represented as a signal or does it emerge from distributed dynamics without local
representation?") -- ARC-055 is the "yes, explicit" answer Q-038 is testing between. Q-038's
what_would_answer already specifies the TEST DESIGN: a discriminative probe pair on the TCL
substrate (explicit-localised-signal arm vs emergent/distributed arm), lesioning the candidate
local D_V locus and checking whether D_V-graded behaviour selectively degrades (localised-lesion

RESIDUAL beyond Q-038 (specific to ARC-055's own conjuncts, post the 2026-09-14 narrowing):
CONFIRMING (additional, once the above substrate exists): (a) E1 -- high D_V states measurably

rate) than low-D_V states at matched content; (b) E2 -- the forward model's predicted next-state
distribution includes an explicit predicted V(t+1)/D_V(t+1) term whose removal measurably degrades

state); (c) learning -- consolidation/replay priority for a state is a monotonic function of that

FALSIFYING (additional): once built, D_V can be zeroed or scrambled at each of the three

ARC-057.subject: hippocampus.curiosity_approach_emergence
ARC-057.title: Approach behavior toward reward locations emerges from the interaction of DA-mediated representational expansion (MECH-232) and an information-seeking (curiosity) drive operating on the hippocampal map. No explicit approach gradient or wanting field is required in hippocampal terrain.
ARC-057.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (three parts; the run is vacuous without all three).
(1) Live producer, not driver-populated terrain. `residue.benefit_terrain_live_producer=True`
and the driver must NEVER call `ResidueField.accumulate_benefit` outside a declared positive
control. This is the precondition SD-024's own `what_would_answer` states; see it and do not
re-derive. Every prior ARC-057 run (766 / 767 / 767a / 768 / 768a) populated the terrain from the
driver and therefore tested the mechanism, not the agent.
(2) Producer actually fired at a measurable rate. Report `n_benefit_events`,
`n_expansion_events` (cluster_size >= 2) and `mean_cluster_size` per arm. Floor:
`n_expansion_events >= 5` pooled (V3-EXQ-900's own floor, met there at 6). Below that floor the
both-ON arm is not distinguishable from the SD-025-alone arm and the 2x2 is uninterpretable --
this is the group's mutual confound, and it must be a gate, not a post-hoc note.
(3) The selection statistic varies across candidates and across seeds. The load-bearing
statistic is the CONTINUOUS CEM score-margin (768a's re-operationalisation; the binary argmin
gate that saturated at exactly 1.0 with zero cross-seed variance is what made V3-EXQ-768 vacuous
and MUST NOT be reintroduced). Require non-zero cross-seed variance on the both-ON margin and a
non-zero cross-candidate range on the curiosity bonus (V3-EXQ-795's L4a statistic).

CONFIRMING. A 2x2 ablation (both-OFF / DA-ON+curiosity-OFF / DA-OFF+curiosity-ON /
both-ON) run end-to-end through `REEAgent` on a real `CausalGridWorldV2` episode loop with the
live producer, at >= 8 seeds, supports ARC-057 iff all four hold:
- C1 (super-additivity, the claim itself): `margin(both-ON) - margin(DA-only) -
  margin(curiosity-only) + margin(both-OFF)` exceeds `max(3 x SD_seed(that contrast), 1.0)`, where
  `SD_seed` is the cross-seed SD of the interaction contrast. The absolute floor of 1.0 is
  inherited from 768a's C1 (which measured 14.37 in vitro); the SD-scaled term is what makes the
  gate meaningful at the far smaller in-vivo effect sizes measured in 795.
- C2 (neither alone): each single-drive arm's margin is within `1 x SD_seed` of the both-OFF
  arm. In vitro 768a read 0.0 and -0.01; a live run reading materially above zero on a single arm
  is itself informative and must not be waved through.
- C3 (no valence gradient -- ARC-057's negative half): repeat the both-ON arm with all benefit
  WEIGHTS zeroed while leaving centre POSITIONS intact (768a's C4 weight-zeroing control, and 766's
  L2c). The margin must be statistically indistinguishable from the unzeroed both-ON arm. If
  zeroing the value collapses the margin, approach was riding value, not density, and ARC-057's
  central negative claim fails regardless of C1.
- C4 (extinction, ARC-057 notes sub-prediction 3): after a maintained both-ON phase, remove
  the reward contingency (DA modulation ceases; FIFO centre lifecycle overwrites the cluster) and
  show the approach margin decays toward the both-OFF level over a bounded number of episodes.
  This is the arm that discriminates *"there is more map"* from *"a gradient was installed"*: a
  gradient account predicts persistence, the expansion account predicts decay.

FALSIFYING. Any of:
(a) the interaction contrast fails C1 while precondition (2) is met at a healthy expansion
rate -- i.e. the producer demonstrably fired and the conjunction still bought nothing over the
single arms. This is the direct refutation.

ARC-058.subject: harm_stream.shared_forward_trunk
ARC-058.title: Shared forward-model trunk for aversive prediction: a single HarmForwardTrunk substrate encodes a modality-independent unsigned prediction error shared across aversive streams (z_harm_s, z_harm_a, potentially others); stream-specific HarmForwardHeads read out signed per-stream predictions. COMPETES WITH ARC-033, which commits to independent per-stream forward models.
ARC-058.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: One HarmForwardTrunk instance must actually be shared by BOTH harm-stream forward models, and tagged agent-caused harm events must be non-zero in the scored phase; otherwise the ARC-058 and ARC-033 arms are the same module and the comparison is vacuous.
CONFIRMING: With cross-stream sharing genuinely wired and tagged harm events present, the shared-trunk arm matches the independent arm on per-stream forward_r2 within the pre-registered 5 percent degradation band while using fewer parameters, and its unsigned-PE readout drives a measurable dACC-mediated behavioural difference. Manipulation: Construct a single HarmForwardTrunk and pass it to BOTH E2HarmSForward and E2HarmAForward (ARC-058 path, use_shared_harm_trunk=True) versus two independent ResidualHarmForward modules (ARC-033 path). Control: ON_INDEPENDENT arm at matched seeds, training schedule and parameter budget, plus the dACC-OFF arm that fixes the behavioural floor. Required event: Eval-phase steps carrying agent-caused harm on both the sensory (z_harm_s) and affective (z_harm_a) streams, so both forward models have learnable signal and the shared unsigned-PE substrate has something to encode. DV: Per-stream forward accuracy (harm_s_forward_r2 and harm_a_forward_r2) and parameter count in the shared versus independent arm, plus whether the shared unsigned aversive-PE readout produces a signal the MECH-258 dACC bundle converts into a measurable behavioural difference.
FALSIFYING: With the same wiring, the shared-trunk arm degrades per-stream forward_r2 beyond the 5 percent band, or its unsigned-PE readout produces no signal MECH-258 can use even once committed-action diversity is available to express it. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: v3_exq_595 records harm_a_forward_r2, action_class_entropy and n_tagged_harm_p2 per seed and arm. There is no recorder for a z_harm_s forward r2 under a shared trunk, because E2HarmSForward has no shared_trunk constructor path to build. Consumer / boundary: The shared hidden substrate feeding both stream-specific heads, and downstream the dACC (MECH-258) consumer of the unsigned aversive prediction error. Existing ownership: ARC-033, SD-048, MECH-258, V3-EXQ-595, self_attribution:GAP-1.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); E2HarmSForward.__init__ takes only a config -- the shared_trunk kwarg is marked future refactor -- so use_shared_harm_trunk=True gives E2HarmAForward a trunk shared with nobody. Result: 445, 445b and 595 all report bit-identical arm r2 (0.8991467515342368 in both arms, seed 42). 595 also recorded n_tagged_harm_p2 = 0 in every arm and seed. Secondary classes: R4, R2. V3-EXQ-595 DID run post-diversity (three runs 2026-05-20/21, claim_ids [ARC-033, ARC-058]) and PASSED the diversity gate C0 3/3; the measured blocker is different and deeper -- the two arms return bit-identical forward_r2 because E2HarmSForward accepts no shared trunk, so the ARC-058 path shares nothing. ARC-059.subject: developmental.three_stage_ordering
ARC-059.title: REE developmental training proceeds in three ordered stages: (1) self-as-object — action-space discovery via motor experimentation, producing the substrate MECH-256's comparator requires; (2) objects-as-patterns — object-schema formation via experimental action on the world; (3) others-as-special-objects — modelling other agents as objects with their own policies. The ordering is load-bearing: without a self-model the agent cannot distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change; without object-schemas the agent cannot recognise other-agents as a distinguished subclass of objects. Refines the generic ARC-019 curriculum-gates claim.
ARC-059.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Gate (1) must clear: V3 hand-wires the action space (action_dim fixed at 4, ACTIONS a fixed 5-entry literal, no motor-babbling or action-space-discovery code), so a withhold-stage-1 manipulation must ablate the counterfactual-backed self/world attribution mechanism rather than merely truncate an episode count. A stage-2 manipulandum must also exist, which it does not while MECH-278 is phase_locked v4.
CONFIRMING: The stage-2-before-stage-1 arm forms measurably less stable or noisier object-schemas than the matched ordered arm, confirming the ordering is load-bearing rather than a convenient scaffold. Manipulation: Skip-ordering ablation -- stage-2 training before a meaningfully complete stage 1 -- implemented as degradation of the counterfactual-backed self/world attribution mechanism at matched total budget. Control: Properly ordered stage-1-then-stage-2 arm at identical total budget, environment and feature set; the secondary leg additionally contrasts an engineered-z_world arm against an intervention-reconstructed decomposition. Required event: A training curriculum in which stage-1 self/world attribution is either complete or ablated before stage-2 object-schema formation via experimental action is attempted. DV: Stability and noise of formed object-schemas in the mis-ordered versus ordered arm (schema stability, decomposition consistency), and for the secondary leg, agreement between the reconstructed decomposition and the engineered SD-005 split.
FALSIFYING: The mis-ordered arm forms object-schemas statistically indistinguishable in stability and noise from the ordered arm, undercutting the claimed MECH-277 to MECH-278 dependency even if each stage mechanism holds alone. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The stage-2 mechanism is the gap. MECH-276's feedstock readiness is now confirmed by V3-EXQ-703a, but MECH-278 object-schema-via-intervention is phase_locked v4 and explicitly bypassed in V3 by the engineered SD-005 z_world, and no motor-babbling / action-space-discovery code exists (verified against config.py action_dim and causal_grid_world.py's fixed ACTIONS literal). Consumer / boundary: The dependency edge between stage-1 self/world attribution and stage-2 object-schema formation -- whether the ordering is load-bearing, not whether either stage mechanism holds in isolation. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0263, GFLAG-0113, MECH-276, MECH-277, MECH-278, V3-EXQ-703a.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); The primary ablation has no manipulandum: stage 2 (MECH-278) is phase_locked v4 and bypassed in V3 by the engineered z_world, and stage 1's action space is hand-wired with no discovery code to withhold. The gate the claim names as live (MECH-276 feedstock) has in fact been closed since 2026-08-08. Secondary classes: R8. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Its 'Evidence status (2026-08-07)' clause and gate (2) present the MECH-276 feedstock re-queue as not yet run; V3-EXQ-703a ran on 2026-08-08 with outcome PASS (world_forward_r2 0.5569/0.1881/0.6276, cf_margin recalibrated 0.30 to 0.15 with 3/3 seeds straddling) and is marked reviewed, so gate (2) is CLOSED. Separately, MECH-278 is now implementation_phase v4 / phase_locked, so the primary ablation has no stage-2 manipulandum in V3 at all -- a gate the claim's own two-gate framing never named. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. ARC-060.subject: goal.explicit_unresolved_goal_hierarchy
ARC-060.title: A good agent needs both a continuous wanting landscape and a discrete bank of unresolved goal traces: field-level wanting supports smooth local guidance, while ghost-goal traces preserve blocked or deferred goals whose local gradient has collapsed.
ARC-060.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Three gates, two of which V3-EXQ-651a failed to meet. (i) GOAL FORMATION: the superordinate goal must be strongly formed before displacement -- goal_norm after phase A above the 0.4 ecological gate (651a measured 0.302/0.355/0.486, two below it), which now requires the scaffolded_sd054_onboarding warmup that V3-EXQ-603n validated. (ii) ABANDONMENT: the FIELD_ONLY control must genuinely abandon the displaced goal, since the bank has nothing to rescue otherwise. (iii) BEHAVIOURAL READOUT: re-approach must be read behaviourally, not by latent goal_proximity, which saturates near 0.98 in both arms.
CONFIRMING: With a strongly formed goal and a FIELD_ONLY arm that demonstrably abandons, FIELD_PLUS_BANK recovers the displaced goal at a materially higher rate or lower latency on a strict majority of seeds -- the discrete bank buys persistence the field alone does not. Manipulation: FIELD_ONLY (continuous wanting field alone) versus FIELD_PLUS_BANK (field plus the SD-039/MECH-292/MECH-293 discrete ghost-goal anchor bank with its motivational payload), run on the 603n scaffolded onboarding harness rather than the cold Stage-0 nursery. Control: The FIELD_ONLY arm at matched seeds and identical displacement schedule as the negative control, plus a no-displacement reference that establishes the un-blocked approach baseline against which abandonment is defined. Required event: Blockage or displacement of an already-strongly-formed goal so its local wanting gradient collapses, followed by an opportunity window in which the goal becomes reachable again. DV: Behavioural re-approach after the goal becomes reachable again: fraction of episodes in which the agent returns to and reaches the displaced goal, and latency to re-approach, contrasted between arms conditional on the FIELD_ONLY arm having abandoned.
FALSIFYING: With goal formation above the gate and FIELD_ONLY abandonment witnessed, the bank arm recovers no better than the field-only arm -- the discrete unresolved-goal trace adds nothing to the continuous field, and ARC-051's single-field account suffices. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The falsifier script exists and already carries the right gates -- v3_exq_651a_arc060_blocked_goal_recovery.py adds the non-degeneracy gate that FIELD_ONLY must abandon first plus a behavioural readout -- and the bank substrate is landed and child-validated (SD-039 via V3-EXQ-494, MECH-292 via 496). No re-run on the warmed harness exists. Consumer / boundary: Action selection after gradient collapse -- whether a discrete preserved trace can re-enter the candidate/goal pathway and drive re-approach -- not anchor retention or goal-match at the representation level, which 494/496 already established. Existing ownership: ARC-060, SD-039, scaffolded_sd054_onboarding, V3-EXQ-651a, MECH-292, MECH-293.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Not substrate and not test design: both are in place. The one run was executed on an unwarmed harness where the goal barely formed (two of three seeds below the 0.4 gate), so neither arm had anything to recover. The named blocker has since cleared -- scaffolded_sd054_onboarding flipped ready true on 2026-06-11 after V3-EXQ-603n PASS -- and no successor run has been designed or queued. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-061.subject: self_attribution.reafference_comparator_family
ARC-061.title: Self-attribution is implemented via a family of forward-model comparators at motor, interoceptive, and propositional levels — each instantiating the same reafference-cancellation motif (forward model + comparator + authorship tag) at a distinct representational timescale and modality.
ARC-061.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. ARC-061 asserts that three (see the note below on four) comparators are one motif, not three independent mechanisms. Its distinctive content is therefore cross-level, and a test is non-vacuous only if every level it quantifies over is simultaneously live and independently manipulable in the *same* run. Concretely, all four conditions must hold and be reported:
(1) Level 1 live -- for the motor comparator this requires a structurally-distinct OTHER. Do not re-derive this: see MECH-095's own `what_would_answer` NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (HARD), including its two mandatory guards (probe-partition non-degeneracy AND self/world training-label balance, both reported, mirroring V3-EXQ-741) and its explicit refusal of any further single-agent SD-047 letter. As of 2026-09-04 this is bound to `multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-3`, which is `blocked` on MAE-2 on MAE-1; none of the three is built.
(2) Level 2 live -- the ARC-058-vs-ARC-033 arbitration must actually have been run. See ARC-058's own `what_would_answer`, whose "CURRENTLY OUTSTANDING, NOT YET RUN" clause records that *no manifest in the evidence corpus carries `claim_ids` including ARC-058*: the V3-EXQ-445 series tested SD-032b's downstream pipeline and the V3-EXQ-511/512/512a/902 series tested SD-048's own noise-discriminability, neither of which is the shared-trunk-vs-independent comparison. A shared-signature test that reads an unexercised Level 2 is vacuous.
(3) Level 3 live and non-saturated -- see MECH-094's own `what_would_answer`, which carries the standing instruction "DO NOT RE-DERIVE ELSEWHERE. This is the group's shared write-gate condition." Its three sub-conditions (simulation content actually generated and reaching the write sites; the paired waking arm producing non-zero durable writes on the same channels; the call-site set re-derived from the *current* tree at run time) are inherited verbatim.
(4) The shared-signature metric itself must be non-degenerate -- each level must be independently perturbable along its own calibration axis (Level 1: `multi_source_intensity_scale`; Level 2: the SD-048 noise scale; Level 3: the tag's decision threshold or an injected tag-corruption rate) with at least 3 non-extreme points per axis, and each axis must produce a *measurable* change in that level's own attribution error before any cross-level statement is made. A level whose error is flat across its own axis contributes no information to the family claim and must be reported as such, not averaged in.

CONFIRMING. With all four preconditions met, the family claim is supported if the shape of the miscalibration response is shared across levels while the substrate is not:
(a) *Symmetric over/under-attribution* -- at each level independently, shallowing the comparator slope produces BOTH over-attribution (self-credit for other-caused change) and under-attribution (missing own causal footprint) across the S/N range, rather than a unidirectional bias; the sign of the error must reverse across the calibration axis at every level, with the reversal consistent in >= 2/3 seeds per level.
(b) *Non-monotonic noise-dependence* -- each level's attribution accuracy is an inverted U over its own calibration axis, with an interior optimum (peak strictly at a non-endpoint arm), and the peak is >= 2 SD of the per-arm delta above both endpoint arms with an absolute lift floor of 0.04 on that level's own discrimination metric (the same floor V3-EXQ-741 pre-registered for Level 1). Direction-only agreement is not enough -- the interior peak must clear the floor, or the result is "ordering right, magnitude absent" (which is what V3-EXQ-510 actually produced: `ratio_agent_over_env` 1.145/1.159/1.206/1.193 across ARM_0..3, peaking at the pre-registered ARM_2 but never approaching the C1 threshold of 1.5).
(c) *Single substrate pathology -> bidirectional surface consequences* -- a single injected calibration perturbation at one level produces divergent surface failure modes in >= 2 downstream consumers of that level, in opposite directions (the Jardri & Deneve / Nassar signature).
(d) *The distinctively architectural clause* -- the three (four) levels' response shapes are superimposable after per-level rescaling of the calibration axis, i.e. one shape parameter family fits all levels, while the per-level optima sit at different absolute noise magnitudes and different timescales. This is what makes ARC-061 more than the conjunction of its parts.

FALSIFYING. ARC-061 is refuted -- and reduces to "three independent mechanism discoveries that happen to share a metaphor" -- if, with all preconditions met, the shapes dissociate: any level shows a monotonic (not inverted-U) calibration response while another shows an interior optimum; or the error-direction reversal in (a) occurs at one level and is absent at another; or the rescaled response curves in (d) cannot be fit by a common shape family (formally: a per-level-free-shape model beats the shared-shape model on held-out seeds at every candidate rescaling). It is also refuted, in a different and more interesting direction, if a *single* level's miscalibration reliably propagates to another level's attribution error in a run where the levels were manipulated independently -- that would make the levels one coupled mechanism rather than one repeated motif, which is a stronger claim than ARC-061 makes and would require re-registration rather than promotion.

WHAT IS NOT A VERDICT. A conjunction over per-level results is not a test of this claim. As of 2026-09-04, Level 3 is `stable`/confirmed_established, Level 1 has exactly one valid exercise (V3-EXQ-741) and it was a confirmed ceiling hit re-pointed to V5, and Level 2's defining arbitration has never run. "Two of three levels pass" would say nothing about whether they are the same motif. Equally, the twin nulls on the two calibration substrates (SD-047 Level 1; SD-048 Level 2 via V3-EXQ-512a and V3-EXQ-902, both `non_contributory`) do not falsify ARC-061 -- they show the *enabling environment* strategy failed, which is upstream of the shared-signature question and is SD-047's / SD-048's problem, not ARC-061's.

SCOPE CORRECTIONS OWED BEFORE THIS CLAIM IS TESTED (all currency findings, none requiring an experiment). (i) Level 1 is specified here as a two-pass counterfactual gap `E2_harm_s(z, a_actual) - E2_harm_s(z, a_cf)` routed through "the SD-003/SD-029 pipeline"; SD-003 was superseded 2026-04-18 in favour of the single-pass comparator family (MECH-256, concretely SD-029 on z_harm_s and SD-031 on z_world) on the 14-entry Frith/Shergill/Blakemore synthesis. Re-point Level 1 to the single-pass family; see SD-003's own `what_would_answer` for that history, do not re-derive it. (ii) The family omits the encoder-level instantiation, MECH-098 (`z_world_corrected = z_world_raw - ReafferencePredictor(z_world_raw_prev, a_prev)`, live at `ree-v3/ree_core/latent/stack.py:42`), which is the same motif at a per-tick timescale and is the best-evidenced member (18 genuine exp entries). (iii) "SD-047 pending" and "Level 2 ... no calibration SD" are both stale: SD-047 and SD-048 are both implemented (2026-05-03) and SD-048's queue entry names ARC-061 in `unblocks_claims`.

ARC-064.subject: rule_discovery.bottom_up_behavioral_pattern_extraction_pathway
ARC-064.title: bottom_up_behavioral_pattern_extraction_pathway (hippocampal_CLS_bi_pathway + dorsolateral_striatum_chunking + OFC_cognitive_map analog). Architectural commitment: rule discovery from observed-behaviour clustering is logically and architecturally distinct from rule application from instructed/external context (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension). Where ARC-062 receives a context cue and selects a discriminative policy mode, ARC-064 receives an observed-behaviour stream and extracts cross-episode regularities, compressed behavioural patterns, and rule-state abstractions. Both pathways presuppose ARC-065 behavioural diversity generation upstream. Multi-substrate distributed instantiation: hippocampal Complementary Learning Systems bi-pathway (Schapiro et al. 2017), dorsolateral striatum action chunking (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016), OFC cognitive-map state abstraction (Wilson et al. 2014; Schuck et al. 2016).
ARC-064.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) The no-cue substrate must not be solvable without rule discovery: a fixed policy or random control must not already reach near-ceiling. (2) The bottom-up-derived signal must be shown to reach committed action, which on this substrate is the MECH-439 F-dominance washout and is now unfixable by the route of record -- so the primary DV must be moved to the representation/behaviour-stream boundary rather than committed-action learning curves. (3) The ARC-064 children must exist as functional substrate: MECH-317 and MECH-318 partly do via absorption; MECH-316 cross-episode regularity extraction has no substrate at all.
CONFIRMING: On the no-cue substrate ARM_1 shows boundary structure and faster post-shift behavioural re-differentiation than ARM_0, while on the cued-control substrate ARM_1 adds nothing over ARM_0 -- the dissociation, not the main effect, is what establishes bottom-up discovery as a separate architectural function. Manipulation: ARM_0 ARC-062 alone (gated policy heads plus the learned context discriminator) versus ARM_1 ARC-062 plus the ARC-064 children (chunk proposal injection via use_chunk_proposal_injection, the rule_state abstraction path, and a cross-episode regularity extractor that must still be built), each run on BOTH the no-cue and the cued-control substrate. Control: The cued-control substrate is the load-bearing control -- ARM_1 must give no material benefit there -- plus a fixed-policy or random-policy floor on the no-cue task that rules out solvability without discovery. Required event: Episodes on a no-external-cue substrate whose contingency changes without any observable cue -- CausalGridWorldV2's world_rule_shift_enabled action-map re-permutation is the existing primitive, with steps_since_world_rule_shift emitted so re-learning within a stationary window is measurable -- matched by a cued-control variant in which the same regime change is explicitly signalled. DV: Primary: chunk-boundary detectability in the action stream (action-distribution entropy troughs at chunk boundaries in ARM_1 and not in ARM_0) and the rate at which behaviour re-differentiates between hidden regimes after an uncued shift. Secondary and explicitly ceiling-bounded: episodes-to-criterion and terminal reward.
FALSIFYING: ARM_1 does not beat ARM_0 on the no-cue substrate beyond noise even with the children live and the boundary instrument reading, or ARM_0 alone already solves the no-cue task at ARM_1's rate -- the top-down machinery suffices and the bottom-up slot is not load-bearing. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Mixed. The compression mechanism and its counters exist (ree_core/policy/policy_chunking.py: ChunkedPrimitive initiation_set / termination_condition, formation_candidates, mint, ChunkLibrary.register; crystallisation_counter), and the rule-state path exists via SD-033a / candidate_rule_field.py. The claim's own falsifying DV does not: the 2026-09-01 absorption check records that nothing anywhere emits a behavioural chunk-boundary statistic. Consumer / boundary: The bottom-up path from the observed-behaviour stream to a rule-state abstraction that changes behaviour -- architecturally distinct from ARC-062's cue-to-context-discriminator-to-policy-mode path, which is what the dissociation across cued and uncued substrates is designed to separate. Existing ownership: ARC-064, MECH-316, MECH-317, MECH-318, GFLAG-0087, arc_062_rule_apprehension:GAP-I-absorption.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); Three-layered. The claim's own falsifying observable -- chunk boundaries in the action stream -- has no instrument anywhere in the substrate. MECH-316 has zero built substrate, so ARM_1 cannot be assembled in full. And the committed-action learning-curve DV the WWA proposes sits behind the MECH-439 F-dominance washout, whose owning substrate entry is now closed wontfix, so that route will not clear. Secondary classes: R1, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's own 'CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07)' clause -- that MECH-316, MECH-317 and MECH-318 all remain candidate with zero built substrate -- has been overtaken twice. The 2026-09-01 absorption checks found MECH-317 PARTIALLY ABSORBED into the already-built ARC-071/MECH-323 ChunkAccumulator + MECH-324 ChunkLibrary cluster (options triple, compressibility trigger, reusable unit and flag-gated temporally-extended selection all present) and MECH-318 partially absorbed into the built SD-033a/MECH-262 rule_state path. Separately, precondition (2)'s conversion-ceiling gate lost its owner: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling was set wontfix by user decision on 2026-09-16, so 'clear the same bottleneck' is no longer a waitable condition. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued.
