ARC-065.subject: rule_apprehension.behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway
ARC-065.title: behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.
ARC-065.what_would_answer:
Answered by a multi-arm behavioural ablation of the diversity-generation
substrates on an ARMED conversion stack -- not by any run in the
569/687/707/708/714 lineage, all of which were measured against a class-entropy
ceiling they were already at.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (ARMED-CONVERSION; shared with MECH-440 and MECH-441,
which cross-reference this text rather than restating it). Two independently-
defaulting config clamps must BOTH be lifted, and both asserted from MEASURED
per-arm quantities, not from the config:
 (P1) support_preserving_min_first_action_classes = action_dim, with measured
 mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 0.9 * action_dim in every arm. At the
 shipped default of 2 (set literally at 273 driver call sites) the candidate pool
 realises only ~2.16-3.08 distinct first-action classes of 5, so committed-CLASS
 entropy is capped at ln(~3) ~ 1.08 nats IDENTICALLY IN EVERY ARM -- an
 arm-invariant ceiling no diversity lever can move. V3-EXQ-708b measured
 precommit_n_distinct_classes_mean = 2.959 / 2.958 / 2.956 across its three arms
 with precommit_class_entropy at 97.8% of that ceiling in the OFF baseline.
 (P2) use_modulatory_selection_authority = True, with measured
 authority_rel_deviation_mean > 0.05 in every arm bearing a modulatory lever
 (~1e-8 is the OFF signature). With authority OFF, a per-candidate modulatory
 contribution is added at fixed small magnitude to scores whose raw range is
 10-560, and cannot move the argmin by construction.
 Both load-bearing, neither substitutes for the other: V3-EXQ-949 (5 seeds)
 measured yoked committed-action divergence 0.000 with P1 alone, 0.000 with P2
 alone, 0.3675 with both. A null with either clamp in place is VACUOUS and must
 self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue, never weakens.
 A third precondition remains from the original design: ARC-062's gated policy
 heads and learned context discriminator must be ON in every arm, so that a
 monomodal outcome is attributable to absent diversity rather than an absent
 consumer of it.
WHERE MEASURED / WHY NOT ABSORBED: primary DV is committed_class_entropy over the
episode -- the terminal output of E3 selection, downstream of every candidate
scorer, eligibility gate, shortlist and argmin, so nothing remains to absorb it.
Three MANDATORY instruments, whose absence made the prior lineage unreadable:
(i) mean_distinct_first_action_classes per arm as a covariate, so the
combinatorial ceiling ln(distinct) is VISIBLE and the DV is reported as a FRACTION
of it rather than an absolute nat count; (ii) yoked-pair per-tick committed-action
divergence against a matched control arm sharing a private RNG stream (the
V3-EXQ-949 design), which detects authority acquisition even when episode-level
entropy has not yet moved; (iii) authority_rel_deviation_mean per arm, so P2 is
witnessed rather than assumed.
CONFIRMING: on an armed stack, complete ablation of the diversity-generation
pathway (LC-NE tonic floor OFF + structured curiosity OFF + striatal novelty OFF,
ARC-062 gating ON) drives committed-class entropy to monomodal collapse -- a
fraction-of-ceiling at or near its floor -- while at least one single-substrate-ON
arm reaches a strictly higher fraction-of-ceiling on >=2/3 seeds by a margin scaled
on the SD of the paired delta plus an absolute floor. The partial-ON arms then
discriminate load-bearing from contributory among the substrates. ARC-065 is
confirmed as an ARCHITECTURAL SLOT if ANY substrate arm lifts the DV; it does not
require that all four do, and its own text says so.
FALSIFYING: on a fully armed stack (P1 and P2 both witnessed, ARC-062 gating ON,
ceiling headroom demonstrably present -- fraction-of-ceiling in the ALL-OFF arm
materially below 1.0), the ALL-ON arm's committed-class entropy is statistically
indistinguishable from the ALL-OFF arm AND from a matched-magnitude noise control,
on >=2/3 seeds. Then diversity generation is not the missing architectural function
and the collapse must be re-rooted to the representation ceiling (INV-088 z_world
under-differentiation) or to F-dominance (MECH-439). Note the asymmetry
deliberately: a null in the ALL-OFF arm is uninformative (nothing to lift), so the
ceiling-headroom check is a precondition on the FALSIFYING branch specifically.
SCOPE SPLIT OWED ON SUBSTRATE (b): currently lumps striatal novelty (MECH-314a),
frontopolar uncertainty (MECH-314b) and learning-progress curiosity (MECH-314c)
into one "curiosity" slot. MECH-458 splits that slot by POLARITY: density-
attraction curiosity is a reward-conditional EXPLOITATION amplifier contributing
0.00 diversity force at the decision point and 0 directed behaviour on an unshaped
map, while uncertainty- and disagreement-driven curiosity (MECH-314b/c, MECH-441)
carry the opposite, Bellemare polarity. Any curiosity arm must DECLARE which
polarity it instantiates and record a visitation-density covariate.

ARC-066.subject: action.tonic_vigor_coupling
ARC-066.title: tonic_vigor_coupling (capacity-to-action-bias, average-reward-rate / LC-NE tonic / DA effort-vigor analog). Architectural commitment: behaviour-bias toward action scales with capacity (high energy AND low recent prediction error AND low drive -- 'things are going well, deploy'), independent of any specific target. Distinct from existing behavioural-source slots (z_harm threats, z_goal deficit-seeded wants, novelty curiosity) which all fall to zero when the agent is well-fed, safe, and the world is familiar. Without ARC-066 a healthy REE agent has no gradient to act; biology has a positive gradient (felt phenomenology: drive to deploy energy when one has it). First of three slots in the non_deficit_action_drives family; companion ARC-067 (idle aversion / boredom) and ARC-068 (opportunity cost) cover the aversive-of-rest and cost-of-passivity halves of the same architectural commitment. Family principle: behaviour comes from surplus capacity AND from deficits, not deficits alone.
ARC-066.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Two independently witnessed non-degeneracy gates, both violated by V3-EXQ-549. (1) The vigor scalar must be able to go positive: tonic_vigor_baseline_mode must be 'ewma', because at the shipped default 'none' reward_signal = -score makes v_raw a pure negative accumulator so v_t = max(0, v_raw) is identically zero (V3-EXQ-951c measured v_raw max EXACTLY 0.0). (2) The DV must have headroom: the regime must produce a baseline action_density strictly inside (0, 1), whereas 549's ARM_OFF seed 42 sat at 1.0 (6000/6000 non-noop ticks) so no lift was arithmetically possible.
CONFIRMING: With baseline_mode='ewma' witnessed producing a strictly positive v_t on a non-trivial fraction of ticks and a baseline action_density strictly below ceiling, the vigor-ON arm lifts fraction-of-ceiling action_density above the OFF arm by a margin scaled on the SD of the paired cross-seed delta, and the within-arm Pearson r between v_t and action_density clears its pre-registered floor while the matched noise-floor control does not. Manipulation: Three arms at matched seeds: use_tonic_vigor=False; use_tonic_vigor=True with tonic_vigor_form='additive' and tonic_vigor_baseline_mode='ewma' (the R3 primary, now actually able to fire); and the multiplicative-gain arm as the pre-registered falsifiable secondary. Control: The vigor-OFF ablation at identical seeds and identical env, plus a MECH-313 noise-floor-only arm at matched entropy so a lift cannot be attributed to a uniform softmax-temperature rise rather than to a directional action-versus-no-op bias. Required event: Sustained operation in the well-fed-safe-familiar regime where z_harm threats, z_goal deficit wants and novelty curiosity have all decayed toward zero, over enough ticks for the slow score-receipt EWMA to accumulate, in an env where the no-op class is genuinely selectable. DV: action_density (fraction of ticks whose committed first-action class is not tonic_vigor_noop_class) reported as a fraction of its own achievable ceiling, plus the within-arm Pearson r between windowed v_t and windowed action_density, with per-window v_t and gate_product recorded so a null separates a dead scalar from a dead consumer.
FALSIFYING: Under those same witnessed gates the vigor-ON and vigor-OFF arms are indistinguishable in fraction-of-ceiling action_density and the within-arm scaling correlation sits at chance -- capacity-keyed action bias has no behavioural expression, and the ARC-066 slot is either empty or absorbed by the MECH-313 noise term. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/policy/tonic_vigor.py with the 2026-09-17 baseline_mode build, the agent composition site at agent.py:8568 (after MECH-314 curiosity, before MECH-313 noise), and the v3_exq_549 driver which already records action_density, window v_t, Pearson r and gate_product. Nothing new is needed beyond arming baseline_mode and choosing a regime with DV headroom. Consumer / boundary: The additive score bias on the action-versus-no-op axis at E3 trajectory scoring inside select_action, upstream of the softmax -- a directional bias on scores, explicitly not MECH-313's temperature lift. Existing ownership: ARC-066, MECH-320, EXP-0213, V3-EXQ-549, V3-EXQ-951c, ARC-067, ARC-068.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Both sides of V3-EXQ-549's discriminative pair were pinned: v_t = 0.0 on every window because of the sign defect in the default baseline_mode, and action_density = 1.0 in the control so C1 had no headroom. The sign repair landed 2026-09-17 as tonic_vigor_baseline_mode, DEFAULT 'none', and no driver enables it. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-067.subject: action.idle_aversion_boredom
ARC-067.title: idle_aversion_boredom (sustained-low-engagement aversive valence accumulator). Architectural commitment: prolonged low-engagement is itself negatively valenced; the agent acts to escape boredom, even in the absence of specific targets, threats, or novelty pressure. Distinct from the policy-side ARC-066 vigor coupling: ARC-067 instantiates an aversive-side accumulator that recruits the same downstream as actual harm (z_harm-like channel), so engagement-poverty competes for action-selection priority on the same axis as discomfort. Companion to ARC-066 (vigor / capacity-deploy) and ARC-068 (opportunity cost) in the non_deficit_action_drives family.
ARC-067.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The comparator must be genuinely idle-but-capable: full energy, low harm, high familiarity and no active z_goal, with action still available. The engagement-rate estimator must have live variance across the episode (commit transitions, deliberation depth and residue writes must not all be pinned at zero), or low engagement cannot be distinguished from an inert agent.
CONFIRMING: With the accumulator armed, action density rises above the MECH-313 noise floor after a critical low-engagement duration and falls once engagement recovers, with no equivalent rise in the OFF arm. Manipulation: Boredom accumulator ON versus OFF: an aversive that integrates a low engagement rate and is injected on the z_harm_a affective stream, recruiting the same E3 score-bias path as actual harm. Control: Accumulator OFF at matched seeds, with MECH-313 stochastic noise floor as the baseline action source, plus a novelty-rich arm to separate boredom from MECH-314a striatal novelty absence. Required event: A long episode of sustained low engagement in a sated, unthreatened, familiar environment with no specific predicted target. DV: Action density and exploration onset as a function of accumulated low-engagement duration -- specifically whether action pressure rises after a critical idle duration rather than staying at the noise floor.
FALSIFYING: Action density in the armed arm is indistinguishable from the noise-floor OFF arm across the idle window, or the rise tracks novelty rather than engagement rate -- in which case the aversive adds nothing MECH-314 curiosity does not already supply. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Neither the accumulator nor the engagement-rate estimator exists: grep of ree_core for idle_aversion, boredom and engagement_rate returns zero hits. Its three lit-selected inputs (commit transitions per episode, E3 deliberation depth, residue-write rate) are each computed somewhere in the step loop but are not aggregated into a rate readout. Consumer / boundary: The z_harm_a affective stream feeding E3 score bias -- a non-deficit aversive that must not route through SD-012 homeostatic-deficit signalling or SD-037 broadcast override. Existing ownership: ARC-067, ARC-066, ARC-068, EXP-0270.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); ARC-067 is an architectural slot whose implementation shape is explicitly deferred to an unwritten child MECH (acute versus chronic timescale split undecided, three competing accounts unarbitrated), and the engagement-rate estimator that any version needs is unbuilt. It cannot be falsified until narrowed and instrumented. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: NEW NODE REQUIRED. Scope: v3_native. Coordinator: Merged with MECH-330/MECH-331 into ONE registered node (engagement-rate estimator + discharge marker); see prerequisites_registered. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-068.subject: action.opportunity_cost_no_op_penalty
ARC-068.title: opportunity_cost_no_op_penalty (waiting accumulates forgone-reward cost; passive trajectories pay for time consumed). Architectural commitment: trajectories that consume time without progress are not free in E3 scoring; the score function carries an additive cost on no-op / repeated-stationary candidates that scales with the agent's average expected reward rate. Companion to ARC-066 (capacity-to-vigor) and ARC-067 (idle aversion). Existing dACC switch_value (SD-032b / Kolling 2015 foraging) is the closest current substrate but covers a different framing (when to switch FROM the current option to alternatives), not the always-on cost of choosing the null action.
ARC-068.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Two independent non-degeneracy conditions, both currently failing. (1) Baseline no-op frequency must leave headroom -- V3-EXQ-951 self-routed baseline_action_density_saturated_insufficient_headroom with action_density ~0.865 in every arm, so a cost on passivity has almost nothing to act on. (2) The tonic vigor scalar v_t must not be floor-pinned -- V3-EXQ-951c measured vt_floor_driven_by_low_v_raw, i.e. the realised reward rate that scales the penalty is near zero.
CONFIRMING: With headroom restored and v_t off its floor, no-op frequency falls monotonically with v_t in the ON arm and is flat in the OFF arm, active trajectories win on score even at equal or slightly worse predicted benefit, and the effect survives the effort-cost control that holds elapsed time fixed. Manipulation: MECH-320's tonic_vigor_w_passive term ON versus OFF (the ARC-068 implementation per the 2026-05-16 collapse decision), swept against tonic_vigor_bias_scale, with the modulatory-bias selection-authority path enabled so the penalty can actually reach the argmin. Control: The matched vigor-OFF arm on identical seeds, plus an effort-cost arm that varies per-step movement cost while holding elapsed time fixed -- the Salamone-versus-Niv dissociation that separates cost-of-action from cost-of-time, which V3-EXQ-624/624a/624b/624c were built around. Required event: Long-horizon episodes in a well-fed, safe, familiar environment with no active target and no deficit, where standing still is a valid local minimum and the agent has a measurable expected reward rate. DV: No-op and repeated-stationary trajectory frequency at long episode horizons, as a monotone function of the tonic capacity scalar v_t; the discriminating quantity is the ON-minus-OFF difference in no-op frequency conditioned on v_t decile, not overall action density.
FALSIFYING: No-op frequency is unchanged between ON and OFF at every v_t decile with headroom present, or the effect is fully reproduced by the effort-cost manipulation -- the first meaning the opportunity-cost slot buys nothing beyond MECH-320's action-side term, the second meaning ARC-068 is not separable from effort cost and the R4 lit verdict fails in substrate. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: tonic_vigor.py computes passive_term = w_passive * v_t and applies it to no-op candidates with the config knobs in place (tonic_vigor_w_passive, tonic_vigor_bias_scale), and the 624 series records the effort-versus-time dissociation readouts; what has never been recorded is a v_t-conditioned no-op frequency with real headroom in the DV. Consumer / boundary: E3's per-candidate trajectory score -- an additive cost on the null action, always on and task-independent -- as distinct from SD-032b's dACC switch-when-current-option-bad mode-switch framing. Existing ownership: MECH-320, MECH-457, modulatory-bias-selection-authority, ARC-066, SD-032b, EXP-0152.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Two stacked degeneracies. The DV is saturated (baseline action density ~0.865 leaves almost no no-op to penalise) and the scaling scalar is floor-pinned because realised reward rate is near zero. Beneath both, modulatory score-bias selection authority is still validation_pending at severity corrupting, which is why V3-EXQ-624a measured action_density byte-identical between vigor-ON and vigor-OFF. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-069.subject: policy.hierarchy_dynamic_regranularisation
ARC-069.title: policy_hierarchy_dynamic_regranularisation (parent commitment for dynamic policy-primitive granularity in hippocampal rollout). Architectural commitment: the unit-of-policy that the rule-apprehension layer (ARC-062) and the diversity-generation layer (ARC-065) operate on is itself a dynamic representation, not a fixed primitive. The granularity rescales based on simulation outcomes -- decomposed into finer primitives when a chunk fails to ground at execution / prediction resolution (ARC-070), composed into a single primitive when a sequence has been repeatedly grounded with consistent outcomes (ARC-071). Without this commitment, ARC-007 hippocampal proposals are flat action sequences at fixed grain, and the rule layer must apprehend rules at whatever grain the proposer happens to emit, which may be too fine (combinatorial explosion in rollout) or too coarse (chunks fail to map onto the actual state). Cluster parent for ARC-070 (decomposition) + ARC-071 (composition); registers the architectural commitment that primitives are dynamic before any mechanism work.
ARC-069.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS: (a) ARC-071 LEG 2 cleared -- chunks survive E3 re-evaluation (use_e3_reselection_shortcircuit, landed 2026-08-01, not yet measured); (b) ARC-070 mid-execution reachability already confirmed (V3-EXQ-839); (c) a long-horizon repeating task run with both mechanisms live vs. an ARC-069-OFF control. None queued to date.
CONFIRMING: OFF control still flat-grain at episode 1000; ON arm shows BOTH rollout-cost drop on repeatedly-successful sub-sequences (partially corroborated: V3-EXQ-810a/810b) AND re-decomposition + cost recovery under induced prediction failure (partially corroborated: V3-EXQ-844 C2 PASS).
FALSIFYING: preconditions met, but ON arm shows no measurable compression despite the accumulator gate firing, and/or no re-decomposition despite a verified trigger -- the triggers fire individually but don't compose into the claimed cluster-level cost benefit.
EXPLICITLY NOT FALSIFYING: MECH-321's downstream selection-quality failures (V3-EXQ-844 C1, 867 family) -- that's a claim about candidate quality, not about grain-rescaling itself.
CROSS-REFERENCE: this is the cluster-level joint prediction, distinct from either child's own narrower claim -- see ARC-070/ARC-071 for their own what_would_answer.

ARC-070.subject: policy.decomposition_on_prediction_failure
ARC-070.title: policy_decomposition_on_prediction_failure (zoom-in / re-segment imagined chains when chunks fail to ground at execution resolution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: when an imagined chunk's predicted outcome diverges from what its sub-elements would predict (or when MECH-269 V_s on the chunk's region drops), the chunk is broken into finer primitives in the rollout proposal stream. Trigger: simulation-side prediction failure. Direction: zoom in. Phenomenology anchor: 'I planned go-to-the-kitchen; turns out I need to plan the steps.'
ARC-070.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS: use_policy_decomposition + hippocampal.use_event_segmenter both live; the persistent commit handle (SD-084) present so the R4 mid-execution hook is genuinely reachable (confirmed per V3-EXQ-839: decomp_n_evaluated_midexec > 0 in ARM_HANDLE_ON, structural zero in ARM_HANDLE_OFF); a genuine mid-sequence high-MECH-269-V_s-drop region actually induced, not merely configured; each arm (WITH/WITHOUT ARC-070) independently commits at least one multi-action program.

ARC-071.subject: policy.composition_via_repeated_grounding
ARC-071.title: policy_composition_via_repeated_grounding (zoom-out / chunk a sequence of primitives into a single atomic primitive after repeated successful execution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: sequences of policy primitives that have been repeatedly executed together with consistent outcomes are accumulated into a single primitive that the rule-apprehension and diversity-generation layers can treat atomically. Trigger: repetition count + outcome consistency (slow accumulator). Direction: zoom out. Phenomenology anchor: 'making coffee was once seventeen motor acts; after a thousand repetitions it is one unit.' Names the TRANSITION mechanism (planned -> habitual chunk) that MECH-163 dual systems presupposes but does not specify.
ARC-071.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Chunks must form, persist and be selected often enough to measure: n_persistent_present_ticks >= 10 on the worst seed, with any persistence flag (use_persistent_committed_program_handle, use_e3_reselection_shortcircuit) scoped to the PROBE PHASE only -- flipping it across formation perturbs formation itself through RNG-coupled environment dynamics, the 871 defect. The verdict statistic must be tick-rate normalised (n_genuine_commits / n_e3_ticks), never raw mean segment length.
CONFIRMING: With persistence measured above its floor against a real control, an ARC-071-ON arm shows measurably lower rollout deliberation cost and/or behavioural latency on chunked sub-sequences than the OFF arm, with chunk boundaries localisable as entropy troughs in the executed action stream. Manipulation: ARC-071 ON versus OFF (use_policy_chunking plus use_chunk_maintenance and use_chunk_proposal_injection) on the same repeating sub-task and seeds, with a chunk supply under which the persistence DV can exceed its mechanical floor. Control: The chunking-OFF arm on matched seeds and identical environment, plus a real control arm for the persistence leg -- 871b had none, both of its arm_results rows being the same probe-flags-on cell with a by-construction asserted pre-fix baseline. Required event: A repeating sub-task executed enough times that MECH-323 crystallises a chunk, which is then injected into the ARC-007 proposal pool as one atomic candidate and committed and executed as a single move. DV: Rollout deliberation cost and behavioural latency over chunked sub-sequences, ON versus OFF, plus chunk-boundary localisation in the EXECUTED action stream as action-distribution entropy troughs (Smith and Graybiel start-stop bracketing).
FALSIFYING: With chunks reliably forming and persisting, deliberation cost and latency show no measurable drop relative to OFF -- the compression exists mechanically but confers no computational benefit, undercutting the Benefit clause the claim rests on. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: MISSING at the DV that matters. Every ARC-071/MECH-323/MECH-324 readout is a library counter (chunk_acc_n_formed, crystallisation_counter, n_reacquisitions, r_reacq); an exhaustive search of ree_core finds no entropy_trough or chunk_boundary detector, and first_action_entropy (hippocampal/module.py:757) is verified to be proposal-pool diversity at one decision point, not a temporal boundary detector over executions. Consumer / boundary: The executed action stream over time -- where a chunk is either one committed move or N re-deliberated ones -- and the E3 commit latch that must hold across internal ticks for that to be true. Existing ownership: mech317-action-chunk-boundary-instrument, MECH-317, MECH-323, MECH-324, MECH-090, EXP-0259, GFLAG-0083.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); LEG 3 has never been queued and cannot be, because no readout over the executed action stream exists anywhere in the ARC-071/MECH-323/MECH-324 family; the debt is registered as substrate_queue mech317-action-chunk-boundary-instrument, explicitly REGISTRATION ONLY and not a build authorisation. LEG 2's successor also needs a real control arm and a chunk supply that lifts the DV off its floor. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: INSTRUMENT EXISTS BUT WRONG LOCUS/TIMESCALE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: LEG 2 is no longer open on the terms the WWA states. Its 'NO experiment has run to confirm the fix restores cross-tick persistence (the redesigned DV n_genuine_commits/n_e3_ticks has not been measured anywhere)' was overtaken by V3-EXQ-871b, whose confirmed cluster autopsy (2026-09-02) records that the prescribed DV IS measured (0.883 and 0.535) and sits at its mechanical floor, discharges MECH-090's substrate hold, and states in terms that ARC-071's LEG 2 justification is now stale and its substrate_conditional reading is re-grounded on LEG 3's missing chunk-boundary instrument. ARC-072.subject: architecture.developmental_bootstrapping_and_cue_indexed_retrieval_gaps
ARC-072.title: developmental_bootstrapping_and_cue_indexed_retrieval_gaps -- REE lacks (1) a dedicated diversity-bootstrapping epoch that populates the hippocampal trajectory store before reinforcement narrowing; and (2) a differentiable cue-indexed retrieval path from PFC context representation to trajectory generation. EXQ-561 cluster / MECH-269 is diagnostic of gap (1); EXP-0155 zero-gradient cue_action_proj is diagnostic of gap (2). The two gaps are inter-dependent: the severed cue gradient (gap 2) is the mechanism that prevents diverse option population (gap 1).
ARC-072.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: For the Gap-2 leg, the cue gradient must actually reach cue_action_proj on a trained-policy run (cue_action_proj.weight.grad not None), which it currently does not; for the Gap-1 leg, a cross-tick trajectory store must exist to accumulate into, which it does not; and the two legs must be separable so the interdependence clause can fail.
CONFIRMING: The epoch-given agent retains a larger cross-tick diverse library that persists, AND distinguishable context states retrieve distinguishable trajectory subsets with the flag on and the gradient confirmed live, AND Gap 1 does not close while Gap 2 stays severed. Manipulation: Gap 1: a diversity-bootstrapping epoch with an intrinsic diversity objective and a persistent cross-tick store, epoch-given versus no-epoch. Gap 2: use_differentiable_cem ON/OFF WITH the agent-side detaches removed and a loss routed through propose_trajectories, so the flag is not inert in both arms. Control: No-epoch agent given equivalent later exploration (Gap 1); flag-OFF arm with the gradient route verified live in the ON arm only (Gap 2); and a cue-permuted arm to show retrieval differences track the cue rather than the context change itself. Required event: Distinguishable PFC context states arriving across ticks during an early exploration epoch, with trajectories retained across those ticks. DV: Gap 1: size and cross-tick persistence of the diverse option library. Gap 2: retrieval difference between distinguishable context states (different z_goal -> different trajectory subsets), with cue_action_proj gradient magnitude as the readiness gate.
FALSIFYING: No diversity gap opens between epoch-given and no-epoch agents, or the gradient flows but carries no cue-discriminative signal, or either gap closes independently of the other (contradicting the interdependence clause). A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Within-tick entropy diagnostics exist (EXQ-563c/567, tagged ARC-065) and HippocampalModule carries the differentiable-CEM path and rank_ghost_goals, but there is no cross-tick library recorder and no run measures cue-conditioned retrieval divergence with the gradient verified live. Consumer / boundary: PFC goal/context representation -> cue-indexed retrieval -> trajectory generation, and the cross-tick store those retrievals draw on. Existing ownership: SD-055, GFLAG-0301, INV-073, mech151-action-bias-has-no-e3-ranking-channel, MECH-326, EXP-0308.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); Gap 2 is a consumer/reachability failure that survives the SD-055 fix: agent.py detaches z_world before extract_cue_context and detaches action_bias, no live loss backprops through propose_trajectories, and the substrate_queue entry mech151-action-bias-has-no-e3-ranking-channel is marked wontfix. Gap 1 has no cross-tick accumulation code at all. Secondary classes: R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The what_would_answer asserts Gap 2 wiring closed (SD-055, V3-EXQ-568 PASS, grad_max=372) with only the default flip outstanding. GFLAG-0301 (2026-09-16, measured on a live REEAgent with sd016_enabled and use_differentiable_cem both True over 40 act ticks) shows the restored gradient is unreachable from cue_action_proj on any trained-policy run, and current code still detaches gated_for_e1.z_world before extract_cue_context and detaches action_bias immediately after; 568 grad_max was measured on a synthetic requires_grad tensor passed straight to propose_trajectories. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. ARC-073.subject: play.transition_criterion
ARC-073.title: Play-to-real transition is triggered by competence saturation (d(PE)/dt < threshold) or competitive drive pressure, not by scheduled duration; premature transition leaves policy structure undertrained.
ARC-073.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: There must be a play mode to transition out of, and the learning-progress estimate must be shown to move on this substrate (declining then saturating within a play episode) before a saturation threshold can be said to trigger anything; a clock-triggered comparator must otherwise match the LP arm on episode budget.
CONFIRMING: LP-triggered transition yields better post-transition policy structure than clock-triggered transition at matched experience, and the premature-transition arm shows the predicted undertrained deficit. Manipulation: Trigger the play-to-real transition on a rolling learning-progress estimate crossing play_lp_saturation_threshold, versus a fixed-duration clock, versus a homeostatic-drive-pressure criterion; none of these three triggers exists (no play mode, no LP estimator, no such GoalConfig field). Control: Scheduled-duration transition arm matched on total play episodes and total experience, plus a premature-transition arm that cuts play before LP saturation, at matched seeds. Required event: A play episode in which learning progress on the world model first declines and then saturates, followed by a transition back to real-signal operation. DV: Post-transition real-task policy structure: goal-pursuit competence, E3 trajectory-selection diversity and time-to-criterion after transition, compared between LP-triggered, clock-triggered and premature-transition arms.
FALSIFYING: Clock-triggered transition matches or beats LP-triggered transition at matched experience, or premature transition produces no measurable policy-structure deficit -- the criterion is not competence saturation. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Absent on both sides. ree_core has no play mode and no rolling learning-progress estimator; grep for learning_progress and play_lp_saturation_threshold returns zero hits, and GoalConfig carries no such parameter. Consumer / boundary: The episode-close decision that ends play and restores real homeostatic and harm signals -- the transition trigger, not the play content itself. Existing ownership: EXP-0235, MECH-194, MECH-196, ARC-049, play_substrate_design, drives_motivation_v4:DRV-2.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); Both the independent variable and the dependent variable are unconstructible: there is no play mode to leave, no learning-progress estimator to threshold, and no saturation parameter. This is /implement-substrate work, not experiment-design work, exactly as EXP-0235's gating reason records. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-074.subject: development.phase_0_reward_free_exploration_epoch
ARC-074.title: The infant stage requires a reward-free Phase 0 motor babbling epoch, prior to any E3 scoring or reward-weighted learning, in which Hebbian sensorimotor mappings, basic z_self structure, and non-trivial residue gradients are established.
ARC-074.what_would_answer:
CROSS-REFERENCE (mandatory reading before any retest is queued): this claim's mechanism is NOT an independent discovery. It is a candidate fifth locus in the registry's existing conversion-ceiling / monostrategy investigation (MECH-439 F-dominance, INV-088 representation-ceiling, MECH-457 competence-floor/actor-critic). That campaign has run 20+ confirmed experiments against a substrate where E3 is ALREADY ACTIVE and found the diversity-mechanism failure structural and downstream of selection (F-dominance) or attributable to representation under-differentiation in an already-training z_world (INV-088) or to action-learning-machinery failure independent of representation (MECH-457) -- NONE of which manipulate the pre-E3, pre-training period ARC-074 targets. INV-088's own memory record already proposes an untested "differentiate-first" ordering prediction structurally identical in shape to ARC-074's Phase 0, for z_world rather than the residue field specifically. ARC-074 should be read as sharpening/extending that untested ordering prediction to the residue field and to the very start of training, NOT as a rediscovery of the F-dominance or competence-floor findings, and NOT as something those findings already settle.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (must hold before any A/B result is treated as informative): (i) Phase0Config is actually implemented and wired ahead of E3 activation (epoch_steps, hebbian_lr, residue_entropy_min, z_self_loss_max gate criteria; Phase 0 skipped only on warm-start checkpoint load; gate failure within epoch_steps raises a training error) -- not a stub or no-op default. (ii) The gate criteria genuinely discriminate a trained vs. untrained state -- residue_entropy and z_self encoder loss must show real separation between fresh-init and Phase-0-completed agents. (iii) ARC-065's diversity mechanisms (MECH-313/314/320) are genuinely exercised downstream in both arms -- confirm non-zero diversity-channel activation in both arms so a null result cannot be attributed to the diversity stack being silently inert for an unrelated reason. (iv) The environment/task used is confirmed solvable (an oracle/greedy baseline clears the floor).
CONFIRMING (2-arm A/B, WITH-Phase-0 vs WITHOUT, diversity params at existing validated settings): E3 scores measurably differentiate once Phase 0 completes (residue_entropy and per-candidate E3-score variance both rise from step-0 baseline) AND the WITH-Phase-0 arm shows a measurable, non-degenerate diversity-mechanism effect the WITHOUT arm does not, under matched seeds/config.
FALSIFYING: monostrategy/V_s collapse persists in the WITH-Phase-0 arm at statistically indistinguishable levels from WITHOUT, despite the non-degeneracy preconditions holding. This would mean the root cause is NOT cold-start residue-field flatness but lies where the existing MECH-439/INV-088/MECH-457 cluster already localizes it -- in which case ARC-074 should be folded into that cluster's disposition rather than treated as a separate open front, and EXQ-ISEF-006's warm-start gate calibration should not be attempted on this substrate.
A partial result -- Phase 0's own gate met but E3 scores still fail to differentiate once Phase 1 begins -- is itself diagnostic: the ordering fix would be necessary but not sufficient, and should route to the F-dominance/representation-ceiling cluster rather than to a Phase0Config parameter retune.
[2026-08-08 thought-digestion]: Phase0Config confirmed UNBUILT (zero hits across ree-v3/ree_core for Phase0Config/hebbian/phase_0/residue_entropy_min/z_self_loss_max outside an unrelated MECH-094/ARC-108 Hebbian eligibility-trace mechanism). EXQ-ISEF-006 has never been queued or run (absent from experiment_queue.json, evidence/, and git log -S on ree-v3).

ARC-075.subject: development.infant_curriculum_plasticity_magnitude_gating
ARC-075.title: The infant curriculum architecture must implement plasticity magnitude asymmetry across developmental phases, not only temporal phase scheduling: F's effective update weight must be suppressed during the MECH-333 plasticity-open window to allow diversity circuits to reach competitive weight; temporal scheduling alone (as in current GAP-9/GAP-14 implementation) is insufficient.
ARC-075.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Phase transitions must actually fire for the seeds under test (the crossing-count Phase 0->1 gate must admit genuine explorers and reject false advancers), and F must be measurably dominant in the unattenuated arm -- otherwise attenuating it changes nothing and the curriculum-versus-flat comparison is degenerate.
CONFIRMING: The attenuated-F curriculum shows post-closure diversity that the unattenuated curriculum does not, and the difference survives the closure lock (the monocular-deprivation analogue). Manipulation: Phase-gated F attenuation: reduce E3Config.f_weight during Phases 0 and 1 and restore it at closure, as a third factor on the existing crystallize-at-phase3 by curriculum-versus-flat design. Control: Identical curriculum with f_weight held at 1.0 throughout (temporal scheduling alone), plus the flat (no-curriculum) baseline, at matched seeds. Required event: An infant-curriculum run that traverses Phases 0 to 3 with a Phase 2->3 closure that fires crystallize() and the EWC anchor snapshot. DV: Post-closure behavioural diversity that survives F-dominated overwriting -- the V3-EXQ-543h D2 criterion measured after the lock -- and its difference between attenuated and unattenuated curricula.
FALSIFYING: Attenuating F during Phases 0-1 leaves post-closure diversity indistinguishable from the temporally-scheduled-only curriculum -- scheduling alone was sufficient and the magnitude-asymmetry prescription is over-specified. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The levers and the recorder both exist: E3Config.f_weight is read live at scoring time (self.config.f_weight in score_trajectory) so it can be changed mid-run; InfantCurriculumScheduler.config_overrides() already applies per-phase parameter tables; the on_phase3_entry hook fires crystallize() and the residue EWC anchor. The D2 post-closure diversity criterion exists in the 543h falsifier. Consumer / boundary: F's weighted contribution to E3 trajectory scoring during the plasticity-open phases, and the persistence of the diversity distribution after the lock -- not the phase schedule itself. Existing ownership: ARC-075, MECH-333, MECH-334, INV-074, EXP-0478, plasticity_neuromodulation_v4:PLW-4.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Not substrate: the per-phase override table in experiments/infant_curriculum.py gates novelty_bonus_weight, residue_scale_factor and offline_integration_frequency but carries NO f_weight entry, so no arm has ever phase-gated F. The manipulation is an experiment-layer table addition on levers that already exist. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. ARC-076.subject: development.commitment_loop_calibration_window_personality
ARC-076.title: Developmental commitment-loop calibration window with critical-period lock (two-layer): the three BG-like cortico-striatal commitment loops (ARC-021 / MECH-069 / ARC-023) are calibrated during a bounded juvenile/adolescent developmental window and then crystallized (an INV-075 LOCK-arm instance), and this locked calibration IS personality. The architecture is two-layer: (L1) the basic drive-prior set-points of the loops (temperament; the limbic-loop value prior) lock on a largely ENDOGENOUS maturational timer, while (L2) a downstream commitment-policy / characteristic- adaptation layer is calibrated by the juvenile play/peer environment and consolidated at window close. Personality is neither a pure environmental readout nor purely endogenous: the environment writes L2; the timer locks L1.
ARC-076.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: L1 and L2 must be separately manipulable: the endogenous timer must be able to lock set-points without environmental input, and the environmental calibration must be able to vary while the timer is held fixed. If a single lock covers both, the two-layer structure is untestable and the claim degenerates into the existing MECH-334 crystallization result.
CONFIRMING: Juvenile environment variation produces durable post-lock differences in commitment policy (L2) while the set-point layer locks on the timer independently of that environment (L1), with both surviving a post-lock challenge. Manipulation: Two crossed manipulations: juvenile environment enrichment versus impoverishment during the window (writes L2), and endogenous timer lock on versus off at window close (locks L1 set-points). Control: Matched seeds with the window absent (no lock), and a post-lock environment that would have rewritten the calibration had the lock not fired -- the maladaptive-lock arm MECH-336 names. Required event: A bounded juvenile developmental window containing environmentally varied commitment episodes, followed by a window-close lock, followed by a post-lock challenge period. DV: Rank-order stability of the commitment-loop gains across the post-lock period, split by source: variance attributable to the juvenile environment (L2) versus variance that is environment-independent and timer-driven (L1).
FALSIFYING: Post-lock behaviour is fully explained by one layer -- either the environment rewrites everything after the lock (no L1) or nothing the juvenile environment did survives it (no L2) -- collapsing the two-layer structure. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: None of the three exists: no per-loop calibration-gain parameter set, no lock for the commitment loops (crystallize_at_phase3 locks gated-policy diversity heads, not loop gains), and no rank-order stability readout. Grep of ree_core for INV-075, MECH-335, MECH-336 and ARC-076 returns zero hits. Consumer / boundary: The commitment loops' gain parameters and their crystallization at window close -- the ARC-021 / MECH-069 / ARC-023 loop set, not the gated-policy heads MECH-334 already locks. Existing ownership: ARC-076, MECH-335, MECH-336, INV-075, GFLAG-0395, EXP-0481.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); V3 is single-agent with no juvenile play or peer environment, so the input that ARC-076 says writes L2 cannot be generated at all; and the commitment-loop calibration and lock machinery (MECH-335, MECH-336) is unbuilt. The L1 timer-lock leg alone would test only what MECH-334 already covers. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-077.subject: rule_apprehension.socially_scaffolded_rule_population_pathway
ARC-077.title: Socially-scaffolded rule-population pathway: the third rule-source, peer to ARC-062 (top-down gated-policy apprehension) and ARC-064 (bottom-up behavioural-pattern extraction), and upstream-fed by ARC-065 (behavioural diversity generation). Architectural commitment: in biology the candidate-rule hypothesis space is not invented by the agent alone -- caregivers populate it from outside via scaffolded exposure (Vygotsky ZPD; Wood/Bruner/Ross scaffolding; Csibra & Gergely ostensive cueing / natural pedagogy; Tomasello shared intentionality; joint attention / social referencing). This is the most direct architectural answer to MECH-309: a non-Bayesian rule-creator that does not invent its own hypotheses receives candidate regularities, context-bound to the scaffolding episode, from a caregiver. The pathway fills the ARC-063 CandidateRule field (the 'in' face); MECH-337 is the population mechanism; MECH-338 is the cue-driven context-bound retrieval mechanism (the 'select' face). Registered 2026-05-18 as a structural slot only -- hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull and on a caregiver/teacher-agent substrate that does not yet exist in V3.
ARC-077.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE-BLOCKED PRECONDITION: this claim is not yet testable, and the blocker is unchanged since registration (2026-05-18). Re-verified 2026-08-07: (a) the caregiver/teacher-agent substrate implementation_prerequisite (3) remains fully unmet -- grep of ree-v3/ree_core, experiments/, and coordinator/ for "caregiver" and "teacher_agent"/"teacher-agent" returns zero hits; every "scaffold" hit is a false positive (protective avoidance_scaffold_floor, SleepLoopManager Phase-A code scaffolding, InfantCurriculumScheduler -- a single-agent curriculum, not a second agent). V3 remains single-agent: no substrate exists that can deliver scaffolded exposure or ostensive cues from outside the learner. (b) Prerequisite (2), the ARC-063 CandidateRule field, is prototyped and v1-substrate-implemented (candidate_rule_field.py, 2026-06-04) for its CREATE/REPRESENT/GATE/CREDIT faces, but ARC-063's own record is explicit that "only the social in-face (ARC-077/MECH-337) is V4-deferred (needs a caregiver-agent substrate absent in V3)" -- the specific write-path this claim needs remains unbuilt. Prerequisite (1), the GAP-L lit-pull, is discharged (2026-05-18, lit_conf 0.74) and does not on its own promote the claim. Sibling routes ARC-062 (substrate_ceiling, v3_pending) and ARC-064 (hold_pending_v3_substrate) also remain unpromoted, consistent with the cluster as a whole staying pre-V3-tractable for this pathway.
Once the caregiver/teacher-agent substrate exists (a second agent, or an environment mechanism that can deliver ostensive/scaffolded cues independent of the learner's own action stream) and MECH-337 (population) + MECH-338 (cue-driven retrieval) are built on top of it, the discriminating test is the claim's own functional_restatement, made explicit:
DESIGN: hold ARC-065 (behavioural diversity) and the ARC-063 CandidateRule field substrate constant across two arms. ARM_0 = field + diversity, NO socially-scaffolded population channel (MECH-337/338 absent or disabled). ARM_1 = ARM_0 + MECH-337 (caregiver-scaffolded population) + MECH-338 (cue-driven, context-bound retrieval). Measure acquisition of context-bound rules whose discriminative cut is a function of agent/episode history rather than current observation -- i.e. rules that cannot be recovered from ARC-062's top-down context-discriminator route or ARC-064's bottom-up behaviour-clustering route alone, per this claim's peer-pathway framing.
CONFIRMING: ARM_1 acquires and reliably retrieves this class of context-bound, history-dependent rule (rollout-eligibility and behavioural expression track the scaffolding-episode context tag) where ARM_0 fails or acquires it at markedly lower rate/fidelity -- adding the socially-scaffolded channel rescues exactly the acquisition class ARM_0 cannot reach, sharpening ARC-063's falsifiable prediction (a) and validating ARC-077 as a genuinely distinct third rule-source rather than a redundant restatement of ARC-062/ARC-064.
FALSIFYING: ARM_1 shows no measurable acquisition or retrieval advantage over ARM_0 for this rule class -- the agent acquires the same context-bound rules at the same rate/fidelity with or without socially-scaffolded population, or ARM_0 (top-down/bottom-up routes alone) already reaches this class once the substrate exists. Either result means the "third source" framing is not doing independent work: the pathway is redundant with ARC-062/ARC-064's existing routes rather than a peer, and the claim should be reframed as a special case of one of them (or demoted) rather than carried forward as an independent architectural commitment.
This test cannot run, and this claim cannot be promoted or demoted on experimental grounds, until the caregiver/teacher-agent substrate is built. Until then this claim remains a structural slot backed by literature only (lit_conf 0.74), not evidence.

ARC-078.subject: goal.cue_addressed_unresolved_goal_retrieval
ARC-078.title: The unresolved-goal bank is a content-addressed cue-addressed retrieval system: the current goal/context is the retrieval cue, the SD-039 payload is the stored trace, and rank_ghost_goals() is cued recall. A correct bank must satisfy three structural constraints -- outshining-gated composite cue, dissociable-additive channels, and a non-closeable recoverability term with an explicit-divergence abandon path.
ARC-078.what_would_answer:
Adjudicated by an EXQ that flips MECH-339 (use_composite_cue_outshining), MECH-292 (use_mech292_ghost_bank, additive form), and MECH-340 (use_persistence_efficacy_gate) ON SIMULTANEOUSLY on one bank configuration, and contrasts flexible recovery of blocked/deferred goals across three arms: (i) the C1-C3-satisfying bank, (ii) a field-only agent (ARC-060 continuous-field prediction, no discrete bank), and (iii) a bank that violates C1 (no outshining gate / flat additive context term) or substitutes a closeable recoverability cutoff for C3's non-closeable term.
CONFIRMING: (i) recovers blocked/deferred goals more flexibly than both (ii) and (iii) on a shared task battery requiring goal deferral + later recovery under changed context, AND all three of C2's dissociated failure states are separately inducible: wanting-channel-only failure (goal_match suppressed/zeroed, entry still surfaces on drive alone), goal_match-channel-only failure (wanting suppressed/zeroed, entry still surfaces on cue match alone), and independent joint failure (neither channel alone reproduces the other's failure mode).
FALSIFYING: (i) does not outperform (ii) and/or (iii) on flexible recovery, OR fewer than all three of C2's failure states are inducible (e.g. the wanting and goal_match channels covary such that only one dissociated failure mode is reachable), OR the outshining/closeable-cutoff variant (iii) performs indistinguishably from (i).
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: all three flags must be genuinely wired ON together, not tested pairwise or with one held at its no-op default -- a single flag left OFF collapses the arm back toward a form already covered by an existing MECH-level confirmer (e.g. v3_exq_868, C2-only; v3_exq_823/807, C1-on-but-unmanipulated, C3-off) and would falsely read as support for or against the PARENT claim when it only tests a child. The task battery must require goal deferral-then-recovery that a field-only agent is STRUCTURALLY unable to solve (no discrete retrieval target to re-probe), not merely worse at solving.
HARD PRECONDITION shared with Q-053: MECH-340's three control/efficacy failure signatures must be inducible and separable on the substrate before C3 can be meaningfully included in this test; if Q-053's gate signal is still unresolved when this EXQ is designed, use its front-runner (control/efficacy unattainability appraisal) as C3's operationalisation and flag the result as conditional on that choice, not as an independent confirmation of it.

ARC-079.subject: goal.gated_persistence_disengagement_default
ARC-079.title: Persistence of an unresolved goal as an active re-probe target is a GATED control/efficacy-detection operation; disengagement is the ungated default. The trace is preserved (no erase -- this matches biology); 'abandonment' is the persistence gate failing to fire, after which the un-gated trace decays in rank and ceases to be re-probed. This RESOLVES ARC-078's C3 by inverting its 'add an explicit abandon path (deliberate divergence)' framing.
ARC-079.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (partially met): a built, separable gate between MECH-292/293 -- MET (MECH-340, PersistenceAppraisal struct, reads only control/unattainability, not recoverability/staleness/failure tallies). NOT MET: config-gated off, never run in a real experiment (exp_conf=0, no V3-EXQ queued).
CONFIRMING: an agent with (gate ON + default disengagement + preserved SD-039 trace) avoids BOTH rumination/intrusion (gate-stuck-on) AND apathy/learned- helplessness (gate keyed on failure generalising across goals).
FALSIFYING: either failure mode appears. Specific contrast: a bolted-on abandon-trigger control (the original, non-inverted ARC-078 C3 framing) is predicted to reproduce learned helplessness; if it doesn't (behaviourally indistinguishable from the gated design), the inversion's differential causal claim fails.

Does keeping the facets coregistered-but-distinct produce a measurable advantage over a flat/collapsed representation on the diagnostics that motivated OBJ-1 (V3-EXQ-641a coherence-non-reducibility; z_world dim=32 discriminative ceiling)? Does the deferred token-vs-type individuation-strength sub-fork resolve compatibly? As ARC-081/082/083 (and the future Pillar-1 child) get built, do they cleanly instantiate as coordinate facets, or does any one need a mechanism outside the object-file/binding frame?
WHAT WOULD ACTUALLY REVISE THE COORDINATION-PRIMITIVE FRAMING: (a) an OBJ-2 build showing two-or-more facets are not independently necessary; (b) a build showing coregistration yields no advantage over a flat/collapsed representation; or (c) a pillar build needing a mechanism outside the object-file/binding frame entirely.
