ARC-084.subject: cognifold.signed_coupling_edge
ARC-084.title: Typed signed cognifold coupling: the cognifold represents inter-field coupling as a typed, signed edge -- cognifold_edge = {source, target, sign, gain, precision, gate, timescale, write_authority} -- with competition (sign < 0) as a FIRST-CLASS GENERATIVE coupling mode alongside cooperation (sign > 0) and gated-decoupling, not an emergent by-product of selection softmaxes. Three coupling modes: cooperative (binding, coherent trajectory, shared context), competitive (suppress incompatible trajectories, preserve boundaries, prevent runaway resonance, stop one field absorbing all others), gated-decoupling (isolate simulation / offline integration / unsafe candidates from release authority).
ARC-084.what_would_answer:
Restated: once a V4 cognifold signed-edge layer exists, is competition (sign<0) genuinely a FIRST-CLASS GENERATIVE coupling mode -- carrying its own gain, precision, gate, timescale, and write_authority that can be independently manipulated and that does causal work no other mechanism reproduces -- or is it fully reducible to (a redescription of) emergent competition already present in local selection softmaxes (MECH-090 BG winner-take-all, ARC-030 Go/NoGo, MECH-254 top-k)?
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the V4 cognifold_edge layer must exist and be wired with genuinely independent sign/gain/precision/gate/timescale parameters at the FIELD level -- not merely a relabeling or thin wrapper around MECH-090/ARC-030/MECH-254's existing local competition. A test is vacuous unless it can construct a scenario where the "softmax-emergent-competition" hypothesis and the "first-class-edge" hypothesis make DIFFERING predictions -- e.g. by holding local selection softmax temperature/top-k fixed while varying only the cognifold-edge sign/gain between two distant fields with no direct local-selection relationship. This is the same non-degeneracy floor Q-058 sets for the adjacent subsystem-scope question and MECH-363 sets for the stability-outcome question; do not re-derive a weaker substitute here.
CONFIRMING: manipulating the sign/gain of a specific cognifold_edge produces a change in competitive dynamics between the two coupled fields (boundary preservation, suppression of an incompatible trajectory, prevention of runaway resonance) that CANNOT be reproduced by adjusting local selection softmax temperature or top-k alone -- a dissociation between edge-level and softmax-level manipulation, holding the other constant. Q-058's per-subsystem ablation and MECH-363's cooperative-only vs. cooperative+long-range-competitive comparison are the two evidence instruments; either producing a dissociation counts toward CONFIRMING ARC-084's representational claim specifically.
FALSIFYING: across the tested subsystems, all observed inter-field competitive effects are fully accounted for by the existing local mechanisms (MECH-090, ARC-030, MECH-254) with no residual effect attributable to an independent signed-edge property -- Q-058's ablation returns "emergent competition suffices" everywhere it is tried, and MECH-363's stability comparison shows no dissociation between an edge-bearing and an edge-stripped (softmax-only) substrate. If so, the "unifying map" adds no causal power beyond what local softmaxes already provide, and ARC-084 reduces to a redescription rather than a first-class generative mechanism -- it should be demoted, not merely left candidate.
CAUTIONS (carried from this claim's own notes, restated because a test design can easily conflate them): competition != synaptic inhibition; a competitive edge firing is not intrinsically harmful, pathological, or ethically negative; competition != reward subtraction. A test operationalising "competitive effect" as inhibition strength, harm/penalty magnitude, or a reward-subtraction term is testing the wrong thing.
DO NOT design a V3 proxy for this -- per this claim's own instruction, do not build any part of the signed-edge layer in V3 until routed by an explicit version decision.

ARC-085.subject: memory.autobiographical_temporal_event_substrate
ARC-085.title: Unified autobiographical temporal event substrate: retrospective replay (ARC-007) and prospective simulation (ARC-018) draw on ONE self-tagged event-token store rather than two parallel memory machineries. Autobiographical memory is an identity-indexed event field -- personal events bound to perspective, emotion, residue, and self-state -- not neutral storage; future trajectory generation is forward re-composition of the same event tokens, while replay is their backward reinstatement.
ARC-085.what_would_answer:
Non-degeneracy precondition: this claim is untestable until (i) a genuine corruption/ablation manipulation on the shared identity-tagged event-token store is available (not a proxy or a per-module ablation), and (ii) both retrospective replay fidelity (ARC-007) and prospective simulation fidelity (ARC-018) are independently measurable on that same substrate under matched conditions.
Confirming: corrupting/ablating the shared, identity-tagged event-token store degrades BOTH past-recall (replay) fidelity AND future-simulation fidelity together, in proportion to the corruption -- consistent with one substrate serving both directions of address, per the taxonomy decision that ARC-085 is a binding/indexing layer over the existing ARC-007 store rather than a parallel machinery.
Falsifying: corruption degrades one but not the other -- e.g. replay fidelity drops while simulation fidelity is unaffected, or vice versa -- indicating retrospective and prospective access draw on separable stores after all, which would reopen Q-060 toward a distinct first-class autobiographical/prospective type rather than a tag on the episodic token.
This is the same joint-degradation falsifier already specified in full, with its V4 gating and design rationale, at Q-060's own what_would_answer -- refer to that text rather than re-deriving; this entry exists so ARC-085 itself carries a self-contained falsifier rather than only being reachable via its dependent question.
[2026-08-08 thought-digestion]: binding-layer field coverage checked against ree_core -- only self_state/affect/residue have loose existing analogues (as general mechanisms, not as tagged fields on a unified event token); committed_vs_imagined has only an informal precursor (hypothesis_tag); perspective, source_status, and the identity index itself are unbuilt.

ARC-086.subject: failure_modes.transdiagnostic_vulnerability_axis_index
ARC-086.title: REE's failure-mode taxonomy is indexed on TWO axes simultaneously: (1) named failure mode (the existing mechanistically-distinct entries -- psychosis/hypothesis-tag loss, confabulation, derealization, OCD, depressive attractor, catatonia subtypes, etc.) AND (2) a finite, named set of cross-cutting LATENT VULNERABILITY AXES that span the named entries (precision/confidence allocation; commitment-threshold/action-release authority; provenance/source tagging; agency attribution; residue/consequence persistence; goal/salience/incentive coupling; self-other coupling; offline integration/replay; social-contagion/cross-agent coupling; global instability). Named clinical syndromes are emergent clusters -- weighted combinations -- over these axes, not primitive natural kinds; comorbidity is overlapping axis activation and pleiotropy is one mechanism loading multiple axes. The axis layer is an INDEXING layer, never a merging layer: it does not collapse mechanistically-distinct failure modes into one another.
ARC-086.what_would_answer:
LEG 1 (architectural leg, substrate_conditional -- gated on the V4/V5 syndrome-as-weighted-vector substrate; DO NOT queue a V3 experiment): answerable only once the ARC-086 axis vocabulary is instantiated as a substrate that can score a syndrome as a weighted vector over the 10 named axes (the substrate Q-064 asks HOW to build; ARC-086 is the prior claim that such a finite axis set CAN validly index the named failure modes at all). HARD PRECONDITION, shared with Q-064: the axes must first be shown empirically separable (non-degenerate, discriminable loadings) -- if not, no syndrome placement in axis space is meaningful and this leg is untestable, not merely unresolved.
CONFIRMING: build weighted-axis-vector encodings for a panel of named syndromes spanning the existing mechanistically-distinct entries (psychosis, confabulation, derealization, OCD, depressive attractor, catatonia subtypes, ...) plus known comorbid pairs and at least one pleiotropic mechanism. ARC-086 is CONFIRMED if every syndrome in the panel is expressible as a weighted combination over the SAME finite 10-axis set -- comorbidity recovered as overlapping axis activation, pleiotropy as one mechanism loading multiple axes -- WITHOUT requiring a new axis per syndrome or per comorbid pair, AND without the resulting vectors collapsing mechanistically-distinct entries into one another (the axis layer stays an INDEXING layer, never a MERGING layer -- e.g. psychosis and confabulation must remain separably located even though both load the provenance/source-tagging axis).
FALSIFYING: a named syndrome in the panel requires a mechanism that cannot be expressed as ANY weighted combination of the 10 named axes, forcing axis proliferation without a natural stopping point -- the axis set fails to be FINITE and CLOSED, the load-bearing structural commitment of ARC-086. Also falsifying, as a distinct failure mode of the same claim: the vector encoding achieves registry economy only by merging mechanistically-distinct named failure modes into indistinguishable axis-loadings (violating the "indexing layer, never a merging layer" guardrail) -- this falsifies ARC-086 even if Q-064's registry-economy test independently reads as a PASS, because the two claims ask different questions (ARC-086: does the two-axis structure hold at all; Q-064: is the vector representation preferable to the current locus mapping).
LEG 2 (literature-checkable leg, out_of_domain, checkable NOW without V4/V5): three of ARC-086's ten axes carry a biology-first neuromodulator-receptor grounding (precision/terrain <- serotonin 5-HT2A-cortical vs 5-HT1A-hippocampal; goal/salience-coupling + commitment-release <- M4-striatal dopamine-selection damping; commitment-threshold/action-release <- kappa/mu opioid commitment-entropy), predictions PHARM-015..018. This is Q-075's own question, kept here as a SECOND, INDEPENDENT leg on ARC-086's confidence rather than folded into Leg 1, because it bears only on the BIOLOGICAL PLAUSIBILITY of 3 of the 10 axes as distinct receptor-grounded systems -- neither necessary nor sufficient to confirm or falsify the architectural claim itself. A receptor-level collapse of e.g. the commitment-threshold and precision/terrain axes into one affective dimension would weaken the biological grounding note without automatically forcing axis proliferation or merging at the computational level in Leg 1, and conversely a clean double-dissociation would not by itself establish Leg 1's registry economy.
CURRENT STATE OF LEG 2 (2026-07-01 lit-pull, lit_conf=0.708 on Q-075, re-confirmed unmoved as of 2026-08-07): MIXED, not resolved. All three receptor limbs are individually plausible (Carhart-Harris & Nutt 2017 supports the 5-HT2A/5-HT1A precision-terrain split; Bruchas/Land/Chavkin 2009 supports KOR-dysphoria as distinct from mu-reward; Maggio et al. 2014 is mixed on the dopamine-selection limb), but the clean non-crossing double-dissociation Q-075 needs is not yet what the literature hands over: the KOR/commitment-threshold limb carries an explicit CRF-KOR coupling entanglement warning (threatens collapse toward a general threat/stress axis), and the dopamine-selection limb carries a D2-D3 heteromer transactivation warning. Track via future /lit-pull targeting Q-075's own falsification_conditions (PHARM-015..018); do not re-run this leg's literature review from ARC-086 -- it lives on Q-075.
LEG 1 substrate check (2026-08-07): the 2026-07-02 IGW auto-proposal pass independently re-confirmed Q-064 blocked from V3 queueing on this exact ground (no registered vector substrate exists), so the gate is not just unchanged but actively re-affirmed since ARC-086's as_of date.

ARC-087.subject: perception.sense_specific_manifold_adaptor
ARC-087.title: Sense-specific perceptual-manifold adaptor: each sensory modality requires its own adaptor transforming raw stimulus space into a perceptual-manifold (metric) space before shared-world-model entry; senses are not interchangeable raw streams.
ARC-087.what_would_answer:
HARD PRECONDITION (substrate existence): this claim is only testable against a V4+ multimodal-perception substrate that does not yet exist. Confirmed by direct grep of ree-v3/ (ree_core/ and the full tree) for perceptual_manifold, modality_adaptor, perceptual_adaptor, adaptor_depth, sense_specific, manifold_adaptor, cross_modal_negotiation, multimodal_perception -- zero matches as of 2026-08-07. V3 uses gradient-only / smell-like sensing, where a deep perceptual-manifold adaptor is architecturally unnecessary (there is only one shallow modality live), so the claim is vacuously untestable at V3 -- not falsified, not confirmed, simply inapplicable. DO NOT design a V3 proxy for this; the right response once the gate opens is to build the substrate, per Q-065's identical precondition for the same claim cluster.
Once a V4 multimodal-perception substrate exists with at least two live, non-degenerate sense-specific adaptor pathways (the same non-degeneracy floor Q-065 sets for the adjacent negotiability question), ARC-087 has a SPECIFIC, TWO-REGIME structure to test per the PA-1 design-fork resolution (2026-06-14) -- not a generic "senses need some adaptor" claim, which would be nearly unfalsifiable.
CONFIRMING (both parts required, since PA-1 resolved Option C -- one continuum WITH a named regime boundary -- over Option A/uniform and Option B/two-unrelated-kinds): (a) WITHIN the thalamocortical family (vision, audition, somatosensation, vestibular/proprioception), adaptor depth/structure scales continuously with input statistics and hierarchy length rather than being fixed per-modality or absent. Decisive test form (Sur et al. rewiring paradigm): route one modality's raw signal through another thalamocortical modality's adaptor pathway; the receiving pathway should organise toward ITS OWN native topographic structure (e.g. an auditory-pathway adaptor fed visual-statistics input should develop visual-like orientation/retinotopic organisation, not preserve auditory-native organisation), and the resulting structure should track the input statistics rather than a hardcoded per-modality template. AND (b) olfaction/gradient-regime senses integrate into the shared world model via a COARSER valence/orientation/salience channel (riding ARC-005's precision-routing control plane) that is measurably DISTINCT from the within-family precision-weighted, shared-reference-frame co-registration (Ernst & Banks 2002 / Gu 2008 style) used by the thalamocortical family -- e.g. ablating fine metric co-registration degrades thalamocortical fusion but does not degrade olfactory/gradient integration, and vice versa for the coarse channel.
FALSIFYING (either arm alone is sufficient to collapse PA-1's two-regime structure): (i) the thalamocortical family does NOT show continuous depth-scaling with input statistics + hierarchy length -- either the rewiring test produces no native reorganisation at all (adaptor depth is fixed/hardwired per modality regardless of input), which would push the claim toward Option A (uniform, no meaningful depth axis) -- or reorganisation occurs but is independent of input statistics (e.g. depth is set by hierarchy position alone with no statistics-sensitivity), which would falsify the Sur-et-al.-style mechanism specifically while leaving a weaker depth-continuum open; OR (ii) olfaction/gradient senses integrate via the SAME fine, precision-weighted co-registration mechanism as the thalamocortical family, with no measurably distinct coarser channel -- this would collapse the named regime boundary and push the claim toward Option B (two unrelated kinds with no shared underlying continuum) or back toward Option A (no real regime distinction, just noise). A result showing (i) alone (regime boundary holds, within-family continuum does not) or (ii) alone (within-family continuum holds, regime boundary does not) is still informative -- it would motivate a narrower successor claim isolating whichever half of PA-1's structure survives, rather than a flat pass/fail on ARC-087 as currently scoped.
NON-DEGENERACY NOTE: per Q-065's identical precondition for the adjacent negotiability question, a single live modality or adaptors collapsed to a shared raw-feature space makes this claim's test vacuous -- at least two distinguishable, non-degenerate sense-specific adaptor outputs must exist before either the CONFIRMING or FALSIFYING conditions above can be meaningfully evaluated.

ARC-088.subject: affect.anti_collapse_behavioral_diversity_map
ARC-088.title: Emotion-as-anti-collapse architecture: emotion-like systems are a set of GATED, PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT evaluators (is-this-harmful / is-this-safe / did-this-reduce-suffering / am-I-pursuing-something-I-want / did-I-merely-like-the-last-thing / am-I-stuck / am-I-overcommitted / is-this-goal-stale / should-I-explore / should-I-stop / should-I-sleep-and-consolidate / should-I-release-the-policy) whose collective effect is to prevent behaviour from collapsing onto the currently dominant gradient. Affect is therefore the architectural SOURCE of structured behavioural diversity -- not decoration on a rational optimiser and not random exploration noise, but native modulatory control (gates, biases, interrupts, salience shifts, persistence regulators, release conditions, credit-assignment signals) that produces STRUCTURED deviations from naive optimisation. A unifying MAP over REE's already-owned affect machinery, not a new substrate; an optimise-then-bolt-on-safety design fails because these evaluators must be native, not added afterward.
ARC-088.what_would_answer:
A UNIFYING MAP over already-owned claims. Answered by ARCHITECTURAL AUDIT plus one
coherence check, NOT by a new experiment, and it registers no substrate -- its own
notes are explicit that new affect work attaches to the relevant owned child rather
than to this umbrella. Do not invent redundant substrate claims under it.
OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: that emotion-like systems in biology are a set of
partially-independent, natively-integrated control systems rather than a scalar
appraisal bolted onto a rational optimiser is an affective-neuroscience position
with its own literature (Pessoa). REE cannot test it and no REE run bears on it. It
is the FRAMING that motivates the REE leg; per the lit/exp decoupling rule it must
not be counted as evidence for it.
REE LEG: (i) the DISTINCTNESS CONSTRAINT -- the affective streams may converge on
shared CONSUMERS (E3 score bias, commitment gating, residue, offline consolidation)
but their LEARNING TARGETS and GATING CONDITIONS must remain distinct, i.e. they
must NOT be merged into one value scalar; and (ii) the ANTI-COLLAPSE FUNCTION --
that this arrangement measurably prevents behaviour collapsing onto the currently
dominant gradient.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: for (i), the audit must find at least TWO affect
evaluators simultaneously LIVE and CONSEQUENTIAL in the current step loop --
actually computed and actually consumed by a decision -- not merely present as
config fields, default-OFF flags or diagnostic-only counters. An architecture in
which only one affect stream is live trivially satisfies "distinct streams" while
exhibiting none of the structure the claim asserts. This bar is non-trivial here:
SD-086's default_off_scope_note records that both named E3 consumers of z_harm_a
default to 0.0. For (ii), the dominant-gradient channel must be measurably dominant
AND the substrate must be able to express the alternative -- V3-EXQ-785a recorded
z_world participation ratio ~1.06, which leaves "the substrate cannot express it"
live as a rival to "affect does not prevent it."
WHERE MEASURED / WHY NOT ABSORBED: at the CONVERGENCE POINTS, per channel, not at
the aggregate. The claim's own architectural consequence is that streams share
consumers, so the aggregate score bias is exactly where distinct channels become
indistinguishable -- measuring there guarantees absorption by construction. The
audit target is the per-channel decomposition immediately upstream of each shared
consumer, with channel-identity preserved: for E3 score bias, per-channel
cross-candidate range and channel-to-channel COVARIANCE (not the summed bias
tensor, and not reduced scalars -- MECH-463's instrumentation audit records that
agent.py stores per-channel decomposition as REDUCED SCALARS, losing exactly the
covariance this claim needs); for commitment gating, which channel's threshold
movement admits or refuses each commit; for residue and offline consolidation,
which channel's polarity determined each write.
CONFIRMING (i): the audit finds, at each shared convergence point, that the
converging channels have (a) DISTINCT learning targets -- no two trained toward the
same scalar -- and (b) DISTINCT gating conditions -- no two armed and disarmed by
the same predicate -- while sharing the consumer.
FALSIFYING (i): any shared convergence point is found where two or more
nominally-distinct affect streams have been collapsed to a common learning target
or a common gating predicate, such that the architecture is a single value scalar
wearing several names. Finding this ANYWHERE in the live consequential path
falsifies the distinctness constraint, independent of behavioural outcome.
CONFIRMING (ii): with the affect evaluators armed and non-degenerate, the
committed-selection variance share of the dominant channel is strictly LOWER than
with them disarmed, on >=2/3 seeds, by a margin scaled on the SD of the paired
delta plus an absolute floor.
FALSIFYING (ii), AND THE LIVE STATE OF THIS BRANCH: refuted if the dominant
channel's share is flat or RISES when the affect evaluators are armed. THIS BRANCH
CURRENTLY HAS A CONTRADICTING RESULT ON THE RECORD, WHICH ARC-088 DOES NOT CARRY
AND SHOULD. MECH-463 was registered as the sharpened version of exactly this
prediction, and its decisive test V3-EXQ-785a (2026-07-19; urgency set exogenously
over an 8.5x range, gate GREEN, non-degenerate, 1757 independent committed
selections, injection fidelity 5.6e-17, randomisation corr 0.0177,
effective_threshold genuinely moved 0.3761 -> 0.2570) found the incumbent share
moved 0.9375 -> 0.9411 (+0.0036 against a +0.02 threshold) and var_total fold
0.970. The 2026-07-20 autopsy filed does_not_support/standard. The null is TIGHT,
not underpowered: within-level share SE ~0.0044, so the measured gap sits under
1 SE. Reading: the global-scalar affective channels are neither de-concentrating
(ARC-088's prediction) nor amplifying (MECH-463's) but CAUSALLY INERT with respect
to the dominant channel -- and an inert channel prevents no collapse. TWO CAVEATS
MUST TRAVEL WITH THIS: single incumbent regime tested (harm-weighted), so
channel-agnosticism -- half of what is asserted -- is untested; and z_world
participation ratio ~1.06 leaves live the alternative that the substrate cannot
EXPRESS the effect. So this weakens the GLOBAL-SCALAR route to anti-collapse
specifically, and says nothing about the PER-CANDIDATE route (MECH-359, v4) or the
gated-evaluator route the claim's title actually names.

ARC-089.subject: cognifold.substrate_independent_primitives
ARC-089.title: Substrate-independent cognifold primitives: REE specifies its single cognifold (one interacting state-space, not a modular stack) in a hardware-neutral primitive vocabulary -- persistent state, history-dependent deformation, multi-timescale field dynamics, oscillatory propagation, stochastic transition, attractor transitions, residue-as-deformation-of-the-future-action-landscape, commitment as a real boundary between simulated and released action, and offline reintegration -- so that any FUTURE physical substrate is evaluated by whether it can INSTANTIATE these dynamics, not merely execute modular software. The primitives remain software-expressible now while also being legible as future physical-substrate affordances.
ARC-089.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: At least two characterised candidate physical (or physically
plausible) substrates must exist -- one that a domain expert would say clearly instantiates
the listed primitives (persistent state, history-dependent deformation, multi-timescale field
dynamics, oscillatory propagation, stochastic transition, attractor transitions, residue-as-
landscape-deformation, commitment-as-boundary, offline reintegration) and one that clearly
does not (e.g. a stateless combinatorial accelerator). Post-V5; no such characterised
candidate exists yet -- MECH-374 (this batch) is the only candidate on the books and it has
zero evidence entries of its own.

CONFIRMING: Evaluating both candidates against the primitive vocabulary produces the same
verdict a domain expert would give by inspection -- the vocabulary discriminates real
instantiation from mere software-equivalence, and is not satisfied vacuously by any
Turing-complete substrate.

FALSIFYING: The vocabulary is satisfied equally well (or equally poorly) by both the clear
positive and the clear negative candidate -- the primitive list is too loose to do the
evaluative work the claim promises, and the compass needs re-specification before any future
substrate proposal can be assessed against it.

NOTE (definitional character): this wwa is weaker than a normal empirical falsifier -- ARC-089
functions more like a specification/governance commitment (compare SENT-0's REASSESSMENT
TRIGGER template) than a mechanism prediction, even though claim_type is
architectural_commitment. Flagging this mismatch for governance's judgement, not resolving it
here. SUBSTRATE REQUIREMENT: >=2 characterised physical substrate candidates. None exist post-V5.

ARC-090.subject: default_mode.externalised_operation
ARC-090.title: Externalised Default Mode Operation: play instantiates DMN functions (self-reference, autobiographical memory, social imagination, future simulation, counterfactual thought, narrative construction) externally -- pushed outward into objects, roles, movement, spoken narration, and temporary as-if worlds -- as the developmental precursor to the internal DMN, compressing into internal generative modelling over development.
ARC-090.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: ARC-090 requires TWO absent pieces of V3 substrate before any run can be informative. (1) A staged developmental curriculum capable of running a play-type progression (sensorimotor -> constructive -> pretend -> games-with-rules -> cooperative, per INV-060/MECH-197) with the play frame tag mechanism (ARC-049's play_frame_tag/frame_open/ frame_close) actually implemented and independently observable -- confirmed absent by direct search of ree_core (2026-08-07): zero occurrences of play_frame_tag, frame_open, frame_close, or ambiguity_threshold anywhere in the substrate (also reconfirmed by ARC-049's and INV-058's own what_would_answer entries). (2) A self-narration control surface that can externalise the candidate DMN-analog functions (self-reference, future simulation, counterfactual thought, narrative construction) as inspectable, measurable output during play -- the one V3-compatible reduced form is MECH-384's traceable self-narration field set, itself unbuilt: a direct grep of ree_core/ and experiments/ for self_narration, private_speech, and narration_control returns zero hits (checked 2026-08-07). Both pieces are required jointly: without (1) there is no externalised play frame to instrument; without (2) any DMN-function correspondence in play cannot be measured as distinct from ordinary behavior. A run attempted before both exist should self-route substrate_not_ready, not count as a verdict.
NOT WEAKENED BY ARC-014's 2026-08-02 promotion: ARC-014 (the internal-DMN end-state this claim asserts play compresses INTO) gained confirming evidence (V3-EXQ-880 PASS, commitment suppression under simulation mode) since this claim's last review. That strengthens the target state's own standing but does not touch the externalised-precursor mechanism ARC-090 asserts -- the precondition gap is entirely on the play/self-narration side, which is unaffected.
CONFIRMING signature (once both preconditions are built): during pretend-play episodes (MECH-198's hypothesis-tag x play-frame-tag intersection), the agent's externalised behavior -- narrated self-talk, object substitution ("this block is a house"), role assertion ("I am the doctor"), and spoken future/counterfactual statements -- recruits the SAME underlying machinery that ARC-014/MECH-029 later instantiate as internal DMN replay (the same hippocampal-replay- adjacent generative call site and the same E3/reflective evaluation circuitry ARC-014's Leg A and MECH-029 already require), rather than an unrelated behavioral system -- measured as structural correspondence (shared representational content, shared activation of the replay/evaluation call sites) between externalised-play episodes and internal-DMN episodes for matched scenario content. AND a developmental compression signature: across the play-type progression / developmental stages, externalised markers (frequency of spoken self-narration, object substitution, overt role assertion) systematically DECREASE while internal-DMN activity (per ARC-014/MECH-029's own readouts -- replay frequency, E3 evaluation engagement on non-externalised trajectories) systematically INCREASES for functionally equivalent tasks, consistent with a genuine externalise-then-internalise handoff rather than two independently- scaling capacities that happen to co-occur.
FALSIFYING signature: externalised play-phase behavior and later internal-DMN operation show NO structural correspondence -- they recruit distinct, non-overlapping mechanisms (e.g. play narration is driven by a separate motor/language-output pathway with no shared trace to the hippocampal-replay/E3-evaluation circuitry ARC-014/MECH-029 depend on) -- OR there is no compression signature: externalised-play markers and internal-DMN activity co-occur or scale together (both increase, both decrease, or vary independently) across development rather than trading off, indicating externalised play is a parallel capacity unrelated to internal-DMN development rather than its developmental precursor. Either result would mean ARC-090's externalise->internalise bridging claim fails even though the two endpoints (ARC-049/MECH-198 play mechanics; ARC-014/MECH-029 internal DMN) may independently remain sound -- see MECH-381 for the narrower general-compression-ladder claim this would also bear on.

ARC-091.subject: inference.belief_state_affordance_layer
ARC-091.title: Inference / belief-state affordance layer: a named integrative function that constructs latent state hypotheses and inferred affordance fields from partial observation, memory, cue traces, candidate rules, affective gradients, uncertainty, and E2 action-consequence rollouts, so E3 selects trajectories under partial observability without requiring direct perception or oracle-like prior knowledge.
ARC-091.what_would_answer:
Unbuildable in V3 (name+route only) -- this is a V4 experiment, once the belief-state substrate exists. NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the V4 substrate must be built as a genuine integration point, not a rename -- i.e. a first-class interface implementing the design constraints pinned in evidence/planning/inference_belief_state_v4_plan.md (a bounded top-k belief-state hypothesis SET with confidence/precision, not a single collapsed state and not a full posterior, per MECH-385; provenance-tagged inferred/imagined content per INV-078; a corrigible inferred-affordance field per MECH-386) that other claims can depend on as a first-class thing -- and a scenario must exist where partial observability is severe enough that the ingredients need to be JOINTLY reasoned over rather than independently triggered (the V3-EXQ-603k ARM_HARM_ON_MIDLINE family -- danger must be escaped via an inferred route, not merely avoided by direct navigation away from a perceived cue -- is the standing candidate arena; ARM_HARM_ON_NAV, where the threat is directly navigable-away-from, is the pairwise-sufficient control case).
CONFIRMS (ARC-091 is architecturally load-bearing, not purely organisational): built as an integrated layer with a shared belief-state representation, task performance under severe partial observability (e.g. ARM_HARM_ON_MIDLINE-class safety-route inference) measurably EXCEEDS performance obtained by wiring the same ingredients (ARC-004 L-space, ARC-007 completion, ARC-018 rollout, MECH-022 injection, MECH-033 kernel chaining, ARC-062/063 rule field, SD-057 cue recall) independently or pairwise, with no shared belief-state representation and no joint hypothesis-set reasoning across them.
FALSIFIES (ARC-091 is purely a post-hoc label, not architecturally load-bearing): no measurable performance difference between the integrated layer and the same ingredients wired independently/pairwise -- the existing pieces already compose adequately without a named integrative interface. This would not falsify any individual ingredient claim; it would falsify only the claim that NAMING them as one function adds architecture, and the correct response is to demote ARC-091 to a documentation/coherence-map role (matching how ARC-080/ARC-081 are already scoped) rather than to retest it.
Template: adapted from Q-060's ARC-085 joint-degradation falsifier -- same shape (integrated-vs-independent test of whether a named unifying construct is causally load-bearing or descriptive), restated as a composed-capability comparison rather than a lesion comparison, since ARC-091's ingredients are additive capabilities rather than a single store to corrupt. Do not queue an experiment against this in V3.

ARC-092.subject: memory.imagination_learning_constraint_principle
ARC-092.title: Imagination-learning constraint principle: simulated/imagined experience may license only LICIT forms of learning (consistency checking, plan optimisation, schema integration) and is FORBIDDEN from driving durable world-model updates, prediction validation, or novel-fact generation. The provenance gate (MECH-365 committed-vs-imagined field) is the mechanism that enforces this principle; the principle states WHAT learning imagination may and may not produce, independent of any single gate's implementation.
ARC-092.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the substrate must contain at least one code path, tagged simulation/imagined/hypothesis (hypothesis_tag=True today; committed_vs_imagined == "imagined" once MECH-365's field exists), that COULD write into a durable learning target -- world-model or policy weights, prediction-validation statistics/logs, or a fact/schema store. If no such path exists at all, the constraint is vacuously satisfied and this claim cannot yet be meaningfully audited -- that is a reason to leave it substrate_conditional, not a confirmation.
CONFIRMING: an architectural/code audit across every identified write site touching (i) durable world-model or policy parameters, (ii) prediction-validation statistics/logs used to score real predictions, or (iii) a fact/schema store, finds EACH ONE gated to exclude hypothesis_tag=True / committed_vs_imagined="imagined" content -- i.e. MECH-094's call-site hypothesis_tag gate (episodic/residue/valence/EMA writes, live in V3) and, once built, MECH-365's one-way field and MECH-368's durable-model-update admission gate all hold everywhere they should, with no residual unguarded path. LICIT uses (consistency checking, plan optimisation, schema integration) are unaffected.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): discovery of any code path where imagined/simulated content (a) writes into a durable world-model or policy-weight update, (b) is used to validate or score a REAL prediction, or (c) generates a fact/schema-store entry -- in any case without being excluded by a provenance gate. A single confirmed instance falsifies the principle at that site (a confabulation-class bug per MECH-365's own framing) and routes to a targeted MECH-094/365/368 gate fix, not a wholesale rejection of the principle.
PARTIAL AUDIT AVAILABLE TODAY: the V3-only slice is auditable now -- MECH-094's hypothesis_tag gate covers residue accumulation, MEL/prediction-error consumption, EMA/prototype updates, valence updates, and novelty/visitation-buffer writes. FULL confirmation requires MECH-365 (provenance schema on the ARC-085 event-token store) and MECH-368 (durable model/policy-weight admission gate) to exist, since MECH-368's own readiness_gate (Q-062) is the open question of whether an unguarded online E1/E2/policy write channel exists at all -- until MECH-368 is built or explicitly ruled unnecessary, a "no violation found" result on the V3 slice confirms only the episodic/residue arm MECH-094 already covers, not the durable-world-model-update arm.
[2026-08-08 thought-digestion]: MECH-365 confirmed genuinely separate from MECH-094, not a rename -- MECH-094 is live/scattered call-site gating (40+ sites in agent.py); MECH-365 would be a V4 unification into one schema field on the not-yet-built ARC-085 store.

ARC-093.subject: learning.state_conditional_plasticity_gain_commitment
ARC-093.title: State-conditional plasticity gain: cortical encoder learning rates and residue-field write rates are multiplicatively gated by a state-conditional plasticity scalar, separately from the content signals carried by LC-NE / 5-HT / orexin.
ARC-093.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this test is only meaningful once TWO conditions both hold. (1) A V4 plasticity-gain substrate exists (plasticity_neuromodulation_v4 plan, PLW-3/PLW-4, both blocked; PLW-1 decision-to-build gate un-cleared). DO NOT build in V3. (2) The content-signal-only control arm must be genuinely exercisable, not a strawman -- MECH-313/104/203/SD-037 must be live and wired. As of 2026-08-08: MECH-104 is active/PASS; MECH-313 is contested-candidate (demoted 2026-07-09, sub-threshold N=1 signal only); MECH-203 has never had a valid behavioural test (3 consecutive invalid runs, most recently V3-EXQ-843); SD-037 is substrate_ceiling (wired but consumer thresholds not cleared, downstream effect inert). A fair control-arm run may need to accept these as the honest content-only baseline as instantiated, or wait for MECH-313/203/SD-037 to clear their own ceilings first.
CONFIRMING: matched representation-update outcomes (targeted plasticity selectivity; retention-vs-acquisition tradeoff) are NOT achievable by gating on content signals alone -- a separate plasticity-gain channel produces a discriminable improvement, consistent with Bear & Singer 1986's conjunctive ACh x NE gating result.
FALSIFYING: matched outcomes ARE achievable by gating on content signals alone, without any separate plasticity-gain channel -- falsifies the separate-channel commitment; ARC-093 would need demotion or reframing as redundant with the ARC-075 / content-signal machinery it currently depends_on but is kept distinct from.
Falsifier dated 2026-06-17 (targeted_review_plasticity_neuromodulation_v4, Bear & Singer 1986 grounding).

ARC-094.subject: social.no_empathy_scalar_prohibition
ARC-094.title: No empathy module / no empathy scalar: fast empathy must emerge developmentally from existing motivational-affective streams -- the fast affective route scaffolds the slower self -> object -> other mentalizing route, which then differentiates from it -- never as an empathy_enabled flag or empathy_score primitive.
ARC-094.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (1) the V5 social substrate to exist with a working
other-directed-affect mechanism built by routing the agent's own motivational-affective
streams through a stable other-model slot (MECH-405), and (2) at least one candidate design
that introduces a bolted-on empathy_score/empathy_enabled primitive, so the comparison is
"scalar vs. stream-binding," not "scalar vs. nothing."

CONFIRMING: once both exist, an ablation that strips any bolted-on empathy-scalar primitive
from a design leaves other-directed affective/behavioral output statistically indistinguishable
from the pure stream-binding design at matched training budget on >= 2/3 seeds -- the scalar

ARC-099.subject: language.bootstrap_enabling_conditions
ARC-099.title: Language-bootstrap enabling-condition contract: language only bootstraps when a specific pre-linguistic inventory is jointly satisfied -- shared world model, object tokens, action affordances, self-attribution, other-attribution, joint attention, partial observability, coordination pressure, episodic memory, rule apprehension, a low-cost signalling channel, partner variation, and repair.   independently confirmed LIVE and NON-TRIVIAL on a landed V4/V5 node before the contract

  multi-agent substrate (ARC-047 SocialGridWorld) and the symbol channel (MECH-014) that the
  majority of items route through are both unbuilt (see group preamble point 3; do not
  re-derive). The one item with a landed node, joint attention (ARC-150), is itself

  live cannot distinguish "condition insufficient" from "nothing works yet" and is vacuous.
  Per GFLAG-0383 (resolved 2026-09-23): even once "present," an item must be checked at the
  right GRAIN -- e.g. partner variation must vary genuinely in partner COUNT (Raviv et al.
  2019), not merely partner presence, or the item is satisfiable while contributing nothing.
CONFIRMING: With all fourteen conditions independently live and non-trivial, an agent
  reliably achieves MECH-010's own bootstrap DV (compositional, generalizing communication
  per its what_would_answer) when all fourteen are jointly satisfied, AND fails to bootstrap
  (or bootstraps measurably worse) when any single listed condition is withheld while the
  other thirteen remain satisfied -- demonstrating the list is at least individually
  necessary as currently enumerated.
FALSIFYING: Bootstrap occurs at a comparable rate even with one or more listed conditions
  withheld (that item is not actually necessary -- the contract over-specifies), OR bootstrap
  fails to occur even with all fourteen jointly satisfied (the contract under-specifies --
  some condition is missing, the failure mode GFLAG-0383 already found suggestive evidence
  for on role alternation / learning-rate asymmetry, neither of which is currently an
  inventory item). A failure under unmet non-degeneracy preconditions is not evidence against
  the claim.
BLOCKING ARTEFACTS (named, not generic): ARC-047 SocialGridWorld (multi-agent substrate,
  candidate, confidence 0.0, v5-gated, zero implementation) and MECH-014 (minimal signalling
  channel, prose sketch only, no substrate) jointly gate most items; ARC-150 (triadic joint
  attention, candidate, v4, unbuilt, sits on ARC-080 slot machinery) gates the joint-attention

ARC-105.subject: goal.granularity_matched_hierarchy

ARC-106.subject: architecture.biology_grounding_constraint
ARC-106.title: Biology-grounding as a standing construction constraint: build REE the agent so each functional component maps to an identified neural substrate at the level of FUNCTION (not homology), with biology as the reference of first resort for underdetermined design forks. Grounding must be load-bearing (a named neural primitive whose defining constraint is validated on a REE falsifier), not decorative naming; divergences from biology are legitimate but must be explicit and tracked, never silent.
ARC-106.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A ledger row's S4.2 ablation must run in a regime where the pre-registered metric has live cross-arm variance -- enough divergent seeds, an unsaturated DV, and a working positive control. 704b and 708a both recorded non_degenerate:false with degeneracy_reason 'too few divergent seeds / precondition unmet', so their ablations tested nothing about grounding either way.
CONFIRMING: Enough independent ledger rows reach L3 with clean load-bearing verdicts (constraint ablation degrades the pre-registered metric and the non-biological control does not reproduce it) that the aggregate pattern favours grounding, with SD-011 and the BG-4 drive/incentive-salience row as the two existing exemplars. Manipulation: Ablate or gap-blind the biologically-motivated constraint for that row (ARM_DROP_LIMBIC for ARC-110 per-loop segregation, A0_OFF for MECH-440 tonic noise, A1_GLOBAL_WCHAN collapse-to-blend for MECH-451), holding candidate set, seeds and budget fixed. Control: An equally-complex non-biological comparator on the same seeds -- a matched-temperature control for the noise row, the compressed-blend reference for the channel row -- so a lift attributable to added capacity rather than to the biological form is removed. Required event: A per-component falsifier firing on a biologically-motivated construction constraint while everything else is held fixed, on a ledger row whose grounding level is L2 or above. DV: Per row, the pre-registered behavioural metric's delta between the biologically-motivated construction and its ablation, scored against the non-biological control; ACROSS rows, the aggregate tally of L3-confirmed load-bearing verdicts versus confirmed decorative verdicts in the S5 divergence ledger.
FALSIFYING: Across a critical mass of independently-tested rows the ablation control matches or exceeds the biologically-named construction on the pre-registered metric -- a run of confirmed decorative verdicts, not a sequence of non-contributory or precondition-unmet results, which the claim's own S4.4 explicitly treats as data rather than failure. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The S5 ledger in arc_106_biology_grounding_framework.md is a hand-maintained prose table, and no per-row falsifier feeds it: V3-EXQ-704b, 707b, 707c and 708a each declare CLAIM_IDS of their own component only (MECH-451 / ARC-110 / MECH-440), so ARC-106 carries genuine_exp_count 0 and the aggregate DV has no accrual path from the runs that produce it. Consumer / boundary: The construction method itself -- whether biology-grounding, applied at build time across many components, earns its cost -- read off the aggregate ledger, not any single component's behaviour. Existing ownership: MECH-439, MECH-440, MECH-451, ARC-110, biology_grounding_convergence_v4_plan, EXP-0304.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); Per-row verdicts exist but never reach the aggregate locus: every worked-example falsifier is tagged to its own component claim, so ARC-106 has zero experimental entries, and the ledger that is supposed to hold the aggregate is hand-maintained prose no run writes to. Compounding this, four consecutive rows returned precondition-unmet rather than a scorable verdict. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's 'current state of evidence' section names only V3-EXQ-689a/689c as the live front. Since then four further ledger-row load-bearing ablations have run to verdict -- 704b (MECH-451 collapse-to-blend), 708a (MECH-440 noise A0_OFF), 707/707c (ARC-110 ARM_DROP_LIMBIC) -- and every one returned non_contributory under an unmet precondition or weakens, not a scorable load-bearing-vs-decorative result. The WWA assumes the S4.2 test yields a verdict when fired; measurement now says it usually does not. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-107.subject: selection.basal_ganglia_selector_constitution
ARC-107.title: Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. The translation target is functional (a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated BG analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.
ARC-107.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Each BG analogue under test must be individually ablatable while the others stay armed, and the conversion readout must not be analytically entailed by the shipped defaults (937b: converted == envelope >= 2 with zero exceptions). The behavioural substrate must clear foraging readiness -- 654h, 485i and 625e all returned substrate_not_ready_requeue.
CONFIRMING: On a readiness-cleared behavioural substrate, at least one constitution component's ablation reduces committed-class conversion beyond the gap-blind and stochasticity-matched controls by a pre-registered effect-size margin, with no global disinhibition, and the effect is not reproducible by the envelope-size mediator alone. Manipulation: Per-component ablation of the constitution while the rest of the stack is held armed: eligibility mask, MECH-448 demotion envelope, MECH-449 Go/No-Go, the hyperdirect conflict-grade, and the post-commit latch, each toggled independently. Control: The co-armed full-stack arm as reference, a gap-blind control that removes the conflict/gap sensitivity while preserving the bias magnitude, and a stochasticity-matched arm so entropy gained by added noise is excluded. Required event: A committed-action selection on a behavioural substrate where several channels are simultaneously eligible and at least one previously-gated channel could lawfully win, exercised repeatedly enough to measure committed-class entropy. DV: Committed-action-class entropy and the count of previously-gated channels that convert, per ablated component, with safety violations as a hard side constraint; a component whose ablation leaves the pre-registered conversion metric unchanged is decorative by the claim's own rule.
FALSIFYING: Every component's ablation leaves committed-class conversion unchanged once the envelope-size mediator and noise-matched control are applied, which reduces the constitution to a redundant re-parameterisation of the existing scalar argmin and refutes the lawful-access framing for the V3 tract. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: e3_selector.py carries the demotion envelope (:1986), the Go/No-Go gate (:2062) and the hyperdirect conflict-grade (:4138); committed-class entropy readouts exist across the 654/714/851 family. What is missing is a non-entailed conversion readout on a live behavioural substrate -- every fired measurement is either a constructed-bank injection or a substrate_not_ready requeue. Consumer / boundary: The permission-to-commit boundary in E3.select, where eligibility, Go/No-Go and the arbitration interact -- not the per-candidate score and not episode reward. Existing ownership: MECH-448, MECH-449, f_dominance_conversion_ceiling, conversion_ceiling_campaign_plan:FULLSTACK, behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan:GAP-I, GFLAG-0116.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The constitution's fired evidence is analytically entailed (937b, verified over 38,016 banks), and every behavioural conversion retest that would give a non-entailed readout returned substrate_not_ready. Two named components -- the post-commit latch leg and the hyperdirect conflict-hold -- have no per-component ablation of their own, so decorativeness cannot currently be decided for them. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA gates instantiation on V3-EXQ-689a and defines refutation by 689a's outcome. 689a has RUN (rung 1 FAIL / non_contributory, near-tie family exhausted), both constitutional legs were built and validated (MECH-448 689d, MECH-449 689g/926a), and the claim was promoted to provisional. The live question is no longer whether to instantiate but whether the instantiated components are load-bearing rather than decorative, and the 937b autopsy shows the current readouts cannot answer that. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. ARC-108.subject: selection.unified_dopamine_substrate_learned_gating
ARC-108.title: Unified dopamine substrate -- signed dopaminergic-RPE teaching signal feeding LEARNED gating weights on the E3 selector: the cortico-striatal weights that decide which channel wins committed-selection authority should themselves be LEARNED via three-factor plasticity (Hebbian co-activation x signed dopaminergic RPE) with the D1-LTP / D2-LTD asymmetry, consolidating the currently-scattered RPE / vigor / incentive functions into one substrate and supplying the GPi->lateral-habenula negative-RPE drain. The ARC-107 arbitration layer (MECH-447/448/449 + the authority rescale) is today pure arithmetic with NO learned parameters; F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance (MECH-439) precisely because no learned striatal weighting can re-weight channels through experience. The single highest-leverage missing BG piece and the proposed next attack on MECH-439.
ARC-108.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The learned term must carry live cross-arm variance AND the arbitration must sit in a fair regime: w_chan or M_cross must move off init (709 measured 0.116, so learned is not bit-identical to static), the limbic loop must reach parity rather than sub-threshold (709: 1/4 seeds) or saturated monopoly (711: w_eff ratio 10-2274x), and the conversion DV must be accumulated on verified-fresh E3 selections, not on every env step.
CONFIRMING: Under the corrected fresh-select DV and a fair bounded-parity regime, the learned-gating arm converts at least one previously-F-dominated channel into committed-action authority above both the arithmetic-envelope arm and the magnitude-matched null, on >= 2/3 seeds, with No-Go-suppressed classes not learned back in and the signed teaching signal dissociable from the unsigned ablation. Manipulation: use_learned_channel_gating ON versus OFF with learned_channel_rpe_mode signed versus unsigned (the sec-7 C3 ablation isolating divergence B5), composed with MECH-450 settling and, on the cross-loop face, use_learned_cross_loop_arbitration under the bounded parity controller. Control: Matched arithmetic-envelope arm (MECH-448/449 only, no learned parameters), a static cross-loop arbitration arm, and a magnitude-matched same-layer null injected at the eligibility/settling field so any lift attributable to added stochasticity is removed. Required event: Committed-selection ticks on which a modulatory channel that F currently dominates could, through accumulated signed-RPE experience, acquire enough gating weight to win the committed argmin. DV: Committed-action-class entropy accumulated ONLY on verified-fresh E3 selections (the GateDVRecorder statistic), plus the count of previously-F-dominated channels that gain committed-selection authority through experience, with safety-violation count held at zero.
FALSIFYING: With the same corrected instrument and regime, learned gating lifts committed diversity no further than the arithmetic MECH-448/449 envelope, or the entire lift reproduces under the unsigned-RPE ablation -- the three-factor learning rule is then over-specification rather than the conversion route. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: experiments/_lib/gate_dv.py GateDVRecorder (landed ree-v3 c309bc6486, 2026-08-19) is the corrected fresh-select-gated reader of the arbitration gate. It has never been used in a run of this route: 709/711/713 all read gate telemetry on every env step at an E3 cadence of 10, counting a per-selection quantity ~10x and unequally across arms. Consumer / boundary: The cortico-striatal gating weights inside E3's _modulatory_accum composition, strictly within the F-bounded MECH-448/449 eligible set -- authority to win committed selection, not modification of the raw scores. Existing ownership: conversion_ceiling_campaign:P4-learned-gating, behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-K, v4_loop_segregation, GFLAG-0045, GFLAG-0072, MECH-450, ARC-110.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); Every conversion reading on this route was taken with a disqualified hold-weighted DV; the corrected GateDVRecorder exists but has never been run against it, and governance adjudicated the 713x re-letter on 2026-08-21 and REFUSED it, holding the refusal in place. Secondarily the upstream f_dominance_conversion_ceiling is parked behind MECH-457 and INV-088. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA opens 'SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT (the substrate is planned, not present)'. It is built and has been since 2026-06-22: JOB-1 step-1 learned w_chan plus signed-RPE delta_t (e3_selector.py, E3Config.use_learned_channel_gating), JOB-2 rho_t maintenance ramp and habenula de-commit, MECH-450 settling, the learned cross-loop matrix, and the 2026-07-04 bounded parity controller. Six falsifiers have run (700/700a/700b/700d/709/711/713). The live blocker is now the opposite: the one FAIR-parity test used a hold-weighted committed_class_entropy DV that the 2026-07-20 corpus sweep classes disqualifying, so the route was never validly measured. ARC-109.subject: selection.d1_d2_population_split_asymmetric_da_gain
ARC-109.title: D1/D2 striatal population split with asymmetric dopamine gain: the Go (direct/D1) and No-Go (indirect/D2) pathways should be represented as TWO populations with OPPOSITE dopamine sensitivity (DA potentiates D1/Go via LTP, depresses D2/No-Go via LTD), NOT collapsed into one additive scoring scalar. REE today renders Go/No-Go as a scoring SIGN (benefit_eval_head minus harm_eval_head; MECH-449 Go-promote / No-Go-suppress over the eligible set) -- dissociable pathways pre-summed into one cost. The split is REQUIRED to EARN the Parkinson / dyskinesia / Huntington / impulse-control-disorder psychiatric axis per the ARC-106 EARNS criterion.
ARC-109.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Within-loop accumulators must straddle zero on a non-trivial fraction of eligible candidate pairs (loop_assoc_straddle_frac / loop_limbic_straddle_frac > 0) and dopamine da must be non-zero, since at da == 0 the net equals accum bit-identically. Population activity must also carry live cross-arm variance rather than being a re-parameterised single axis.
CONFIRMING: The split arm preserves a conflict-versus-indifference distinction the additive arm collapses, AND a D2-hypofunction lesion produces an akinesia/perseveration signature the matched single-scalar lesion cannot, on a seed majority. Manipulation: use_d1_d2_population_split ON versus OFF at matched seeds, plus a targeted asymmetric lesion sweeping d2_da_gain (D2 hypofunction) against d1_da_gain held fixed, and a single-scalar lesion control that scales the additive accumulator by the same amount. Control: The additive-scalar arm (split OFF, MECH-449 Go-promote/No-Go-suppress sign only) at matched seeds and matched loop segregation, plus a da == 0 shadow arm (loop_d1_d2_reorder_vs_da0) isolating the dopamine dependence. Required event: Loop-segregated selection episodes containing both approach-avoidance conflict candidates (high Go and high No-Go simultaneously) and indifference candidates (low Go and low No-Go), with a non-zero tonic-DA proxy. DV: Leg (i): separation of committed-behaviour statistics between conflict and indifference cells that the additive scalar collapses, read from loop_d1_d2_conflict_signal against committed-class outcomes. Leg (ii): a disorder-analog behavioural signature under D2 hypofunction (perseveration rate / commit-run length / action-initiation rate) that the matched single-scalar lesion does not reproduce, on >= 2/3 seeds.
FALSIFYING: The split yields no behavioural or failure-mode distinction beyond the additive MECH-449 scalar under positive straddle and non-zero da -- decorative, and dropped per the ARC-106 load-bearing-versus-decorative ablation test. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: loop_d1_d2_conflict_signal, loop_*_straddle_frac and loop_d1_d2_reorder_vs_da0 are exposed in e3_selector.last_score_diagnostics and surfaced by experiments/_lib/gate_dv.py; there is NO registered disorder-analog readout (akinesia / perseveration episode statistics) for leg (ii). Consumer / boundary: The within-loop selection layer of E3 -- the two-population representation feeding cross-loop arbitration -- not the learning-update D1-LTP/D2-LTD asymmetry, which already existed. Existing ownership: ARC-109, MECH-464, V3-EXQ-1019, ARC-106, ARC-110, LIT-0503.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The substrate, the lesion knobs and the conflict diagnostic all exist, but every experiment touching the split scores ARC-110/MECH-452/MECH-464, never ARC-109; no run tests conflict-versus-indifference in committed behaviour, and leg (ii) has no disorder-analog behavioural instrument at all. Only LIT-0503 is registered against this claim. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA opens 'SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT', but _d1_d2_split landed 2026-06-27 in ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py behind use_d1_d2_population_split with d1_da_gain/d2_da_gain, and V3-EXQ-1019 (MECH-464) has since measured the split IS order-changing. That run also supplied a sharper non-degeneracy condition the WWA does not carry: at zero straddle the split is a pure positive rescale that _loop_normalize's zscore cancels exactly, so the test is structurally nil, not merely weak. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-110.subject: selection.parallel_segregated_loops
ARC-110.title: Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. HYPOTHESIS (assembly-map A.2 / s.D): the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is partly an ARTEFACT of the single-arena collapse -- F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance because every channel competes in one F-dominated arena; with segregated loops F could dominate only the motor loop and could not drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' computation, which is a different loop with a different value. Translation target is FUNCTIONAL (the Alexander/DeLong/Strick parallel-loop organisation as a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.
ARC-110.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The per-loop channels must carry live cross-loop variance -- a segregated loop pinned to the motor loop's winner is a vacuous split. 707c met this (named-channel routing live, graded limbic competition worst cell 4.28 against a 0.05 floor, a live same-layer null, 4/4 divergent seeds), so the narrow leg's precondition is satisfied and should not be re-derived.
CONFIRMING: For the surviving architectural leg, a per-loop ablation shows a loop-localised conversion the collapsed arena cannot reproduce -- removing the limbic loop costs committed-class diversity that no single-arena parameterisation recovers -- measured on the fresh-select DV above a raised class floor. Manipulation: use_loop_segregation ON (N >= 3 parallel motor/associative/limbic loops, each with its own eligibility mask, Go/No-Go and settling, arbitrated after within-loop competition) versus the single collapsed E3 arena, plus per-loop DROP ablations isolating each loop's contribution. Control: A0_SINGLE_ARENA on matched seeds, plus the magnitude-matched in-layer same-layer null injected at the eligibility/settling field (loop_segregation_noise_on) so a lift attributable to added structure-free variance is removed. Required event: Committed-selection ticks on which the limbic/motivational valuation of a candidate disagrees with the motor loop's F-ranked preference, so within-loop competition and cross-loop arbitration can diverge. DV: Committed-action-class entropy accumulated only on verified-fresh E3 selections, A1_LOOPS strictly above max(A0_SINGLE_ARENA, the live null) plus margin; and for the architectural leg, a loop-localised conversion the collapsed arena provably cannot produce, shown by per-loop ablation.
FALSIFYING: Per-loop ablations leave committed-class behaviour indistinguishable from a matched single-arena parameterisation on the corrected instrument -- segregation is then a re-parameterisation rather than an architectural requirement, and ARC-110 should be narrowed to its already-weakened artefact clause. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: experiments/_lib/gate_dv.py and the 707c fresh-select repair supply the corrected committed-class recorder; the per-loop diagnostics (loop_cross_loop_w_eff, m_range, limbic_ge_motor) exist in e3_selector. What has no instrument is the architectural leg's distinctive prediction -- there is no readout that separates 'loops are load-bearing' from 'loops are a re-parameterisation of one arena'. Consumer / boundary: Committed-action selection: within-loop competition first, cross-loop arbitration after, so F can dominate only the motor loop and cannot drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' value. Existing ownership: v4_loop_segregation, conversion_ceiling_campaign:P4-learned-gating, behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-K, GFLAG-0045, GFLAG-0072, ARC-108, ARC-109, MECH-452.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); The claim bundles an architectural assertion with a narrow artefact sub-hypothesis; only the narrow one was operationalised, and 707c settled it (weakens) on a valid instrument. The surviving assertion has no written falsifier, and the learned-integration rescue it depends on has never been validly measured for conversion (hold-weighted DV; 713x re-letter refused and the refusal holds). Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA reads 'SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT' and frames the claim as a fork awaiting V3-EXQ-700's verdict. The substrate was built 2026-06-27 (use_loop_segregation, _segregated_loop_arbitrate, plus ARC-109 D1/D2 and MECH-452 loop-local traces), the fork resolved toward escalation in 2026-06, and V3-EXQ-707c (2026-07-23, on the repaired fresh-select instrument, all readiness gates passing, 4/4 divergent seeds) FAIRLY tested and WEAKENED the narrow single-arena-artefact sub-hypothesis: the conversion ceiling is INTRINSIC, not a collapse artefact. What remains untested is the broader architectural assertion, for which no falsifier is written. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-111.subject: architecture.context_conditioned_weights_proper
ARC-111.title: Context-conditioned weights PROPER -- learned connection weights as a function of context, distinct from context-conditioned GAIN: REE today has the GAIN form of context-conditioning (ARC-044's unifier -- a context-specific multiplicative scalar: MECH-152 terrain_weight scaling E3 harm/goal scoring, ARC-016 precision, MECH-261 mode-conditioned write-CHANNEL gating) which modulates a FIXED transfer function. It does NOT have the WEIGHT form: a substrate where the learned connection weights THEMSELVES are a function of context (a different effective weight set selected/generated per context -- the transfer function changes, not a gain on it). The valuation/gating parameters are static nn.Modules; context enters only through the INPUT (z_world) and through output GAIN, never through the weights. HYPOTHESIS: genuinely context-dependent BEHAVIOUR (not just context-scaled magnitude) requires context to reach the weights -- the learned per-channel selection weight w_chan conditioned on z_world that ARC-108 introduces is the first instance of this WEIGHT form at the gating layer.
ARC-111.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A context variable must actually index the weights: the substrate must hold more than one effective weight set, selected or generated per context, with measured cross-context variance. A single weight vector shared across contexts is the gain model in disguise and makes the discriminator vacuous.
CONFIRMING: Two contexts produce a committed-channel ordering reproducible by no single fixed weight set under context-varying gain, with the per-context weights carrying live cross-context variance. Manipulation: Context-indexed weights ON versus OFF: a per-context effective weight set at the E3 gating layer versus the shipped single global w_chan, with the ARC-044 gain form (terrain_weight, precision, mode-conditioned write gating) armed identically in both arms. Control: The gain-only arm -- context-varying gain over a fixed weight set -- which is the discriminator: a gain model can rescale a fixed policy but cannot REORDER it. Required event: Repeated committed selections in at least two distinguishable z_world contexts that impose different channel orderings, with enough per-context experience for a local plasticity rule to separate them. DV: Context-dependent REORDERING of committed channels (rank change, not rescaling) on at least 2 of 3 seeds, together with measured cross-context variance of the learned weights.
FALSIFYING: Every observed context effect is reproducible by context-conditioned gain on a fixed weight set -- the ARC-044 gain form suffices and ARC-111 is over-specification. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The readouts exist: lcg_w_chan_range and fcg_w_chan_finer_range/std are emitted per tick, and last_channel_terms gives per-candidate channel biases for a rank readout. What does not exist is any per-context weight object for them to read -- w_chan and w_chan_finer are single global buffers, so cross-context weight variance is structurally zero. Consumer / boundary: The learned connection weights of the E3 channel-gating layer as a function of context -- the transfer function itself, not a multiplicative gain applied to a fixed one. Existing ownership: ARC-111, ARC-108, ARC-044, MECH-451, LIT-0504.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The claim's own named first instance is context-free. ARC-108 w_chan is one global buffer over a fixed channel registry, updated by an RPE-times-eligibility local rule with no context input, so cross-context weight variance is zero by construction and the non-degeneracy precondition can never be met. No other context-conditioned weight substrate is registered anywhere. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The claim names the ARC-108 w_chan as the first instance of the WEIGHT form, and the shipped w_chan is not one: it is a single global register_buffer of length n_channels updated by a context-free three-factor local rule, with no z_world argument anywhere in its allocation or its update. It therefore cannot take different learned values in different contexts, so the falsifier as written -- and its non-degeneracy precondition of live cross-context weight variance -- cannot be instantiated on the named instance. Coordinator: Prerequisite candidate (context-indexed w_chan at the E3 gating layer) NOT registered: it is ARC-111's own asserted mechanism, not a measurement prerequisite, and the audit brief prefers instrument/event items over new cognitive-mechanism builds. The load-bearing correction -- that the shipped ARC-108 w_chan is a single context-free register_buffer, so the claim's 'weight form at no new substrate cost' is false as built -- is carried by the what_would_answer rewrite; the build decision belongs to governance alongside the v4_loop_segregation / ARC-108 owner. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-112.subject: architecture.federation_heterarchy_framing
ARC-112.title: REE is a FEDERATION / heterarchy of asynchronous, partially independent cognitive streams coordinated by shared organisational constraints -- neither a monolith nor a collection of independent modules. Successful integration preserves functionally necessary differences among streams rather than making their dynamics identical.
ARC-112.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The streams compared must be genuinely asynchronous at sampling time, not clock-aliased: REE ticks E1 every step, E2 every 3 and E3 every 10, so a recorder without per-signal freshness flags manufactures shared structure that is a sampler artefact (the Q-081 Outcome B null). At least two of the three children must return interpretable verdicts, since this claim has no measurement of its own.
CONFIRMING: Integration measures rise while stream dynamics remain non-identical (within INV-091 viable similarity band), and event-relative coordination outperforms clock-relative, so the federation frame holds with its anti-collapse qualification intact. Manipulation: None at this level. The manipulations belong to the children: rate separation versus shared organisation (Q-081), event-relative versus clock-relative coordination (MECH-466), and the integration/non-equivalence similarity band (INV-091). Control: The children own their controls; at parent level the control is the collapse pole -- a configuration in which stream dynamics are driven toward identity, which the anti-collapse qualification predicts is a failure rather than a success. Required event: Multi-stream operation over episodes in which stream rates and coupling can differ -- the per-step traces the three child probes collect. DV: The joint verdict pattern across Q-081, MECH-466 and INV-091, read against the anti-collapse qualification: whether integration coexists with protected non-equivalence, or whether integration gains arrive only as stream dynamics converge.
FALSIFYING: Integration benefits appear only as stream dynamics converge toward identity (collapse, not federation), or the streams show no shared organisation beyond configured rate separation, which would make the frame a description of independent modules. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: experiments/_lib/stream_recorder.py records full-width per-step multi-stream traces with per-signal freshness flags (identity / clock / value / event provenance), which is the shared writer the Q-081 telemetry audit found missing; there is no artifact that combines the three child verdicts into a parent disposition. Consumer / boundary: Cross-stream organisation of the whole agent, not any single module boundary. Existing ownership: Q-081, MECH-466, INV-091, EXP-0305.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); The claim has no falsifier of its own by design and none is owed; what is missing is the rollup edge -- no registered rule says which combination of Q-081, MECH-466 and INV-091 verdicts confirms or refutes the parent, and the load-bearing anti-collapse qualification has no operationalisation outside INV-091 similarity band. Secondary classes: none. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-113.subject: reasoning.rule_pipeline_stage_noncollapsibility
ARC-113.title: The rule pipeline is an ORDERED CYCLE of non-collapsible stages: experience -> pattern sensitivity -> candidate regularity apprehension -> representation -> prediction -> counterfactual simulation -> behavioural interaction -> outcome comparison -> regularity refinement -> generalisation -> long-term integration. Each stage has claims; the CYCLE does not, and the stages must not collapse into a single reasoning module.
ARC-113.what_would_answer:
THE MANIPULATION IS COLLAPSE, NOT ABLATION. The property asserted is non-collapsibility, so the test deletes the BOUNDARY between two adjacent stages while holding capacity constant -- it does not delete a stage. An ablation removes capacity, and in this substrate every ablation returns the same flat decrement whether or not the stages are separable; because this claim's guard converts an undifferentiated decrement into a refutation, the ablation design would refute a claim it never tested. Ablation is therefore superseded here as the operative falsifier. External template and existence proof that the manipulation discriminates in both directions: Zhu 2026 (arXiv 2607.11696), whose `Struct-SR` arm -- structured stage representations *without* enforced isolation -- fell below even the unstructured baseline, while on BBEH-Linguini the staged architecture lost to the monolithic one.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (four parts; all required, and none is currently met together).
(1) *Differentiated rule state must be LIVE in the staged (intact) arm.* Metric: `crf_max_pairwise_rule_dist > 0` with at least 2 concurrently-active rules. This is not a formality -- SD-078 established that under raw-`z_world` keying the pool is structurally capped at ONE rule, so `crf_max_pairwise_rule_dist == 0.0` is a tautology (the metric needs two concurrent rules), which is exactly how the V3-EXQ-654b/654d cells were misread as retire-churn. The known-good setting is `crf_cue_centering=True` (SD-078, `candidate_substrate_landed`; measured 9 rules at dist 1.7011 against 1 rule at 0.0000; validated V3-EXQ-806 PASS 2026-07-25).
(2) *Capacity match at the seam.* The collapsed and staged variants must carry equal parameter count and equal information capacity across the manipulated boundary. Without this the comparison measures capacity, not boundary, and reproduces the ablation confound under a new name.
