(3) *The DV must be read UPSTREAM of the conversion ceiling.* Any committed-behaviour readout (`committed_class_entropy_nats` and relatives) is pinned by MECH-439 F-dominance before any stage manipulation can express itself. See ARC-062's own `what_would_answer`, precondition (2) "SHARED DOWNSTREAM CONVERSION CEILING" -- do not re-derive it here. The same precondition is the one MECH-263 and SD-033b both point at. A collapse run scored on committed behaviour is uninterpretable, in either direction.
(4) *The stages being compared must both be INSTANTIATED in the arm.* 7 of the 11 stages are behind default-OFF flags and MECH-316 (generalisation) has no implementation at all, so the "intact baseline" is an all-ON co-armed configuration -- the FULLSTACK arm, which terminally FAILed at readiness (V3-EXQ-714, 2026-07-07, C2 never scored). Until an all-ON arm clears its own readiness, a whole-cycle test has no valid intact baseline. A seam-local arm (two adjacent stages ON, the rest at default) escapes this and is the only currently-designable form.

FALSIFYING. For some adjacent stage pair (i, i+1), the capacity-matched collapsed variant matches the staged variant on that seam's discriminating metric within a pre-registered equivalence bound -- i.e. deleting the boundary costs nothing. Because this is an *equivalence* claim, a failure to reject a difference is NOT sufficient: the bound must be pre-registered as `max(0.5 x SD of the paired-by-seed collapsed-minus-staged delta, absolute floor 0.05 in the metric's normalised units)`, cleared on a majority (>=2/3) of seeds. Collapse-without-loss at ONE seam is a partial refutation, scoped to that seam (and MECH-263's own note that it fuses the `representation` and `prediction` stages makes that seam the pre-registered most-likely-fused candidate). Collapse-without-loss at EVERY testable seam refutes the ordered-cycle reading as a whole.

CONFIRMING. Each collapsed pair costs a measurable amount that exceeds the equivalence bound, AND the cost signatures are seam-SPECIFIC -- different seams degrade different metrics, in the manner Zhu 2026 reports for isolation removal (the system abandons the induced rule and anchors on instance-specific detail) and Capkova 2025 reports across OFC / principal-sulcus / ACC lesions (qualitatively different failures, not a common decrement). A uniform cost of equal size at every seam is NOT confirming: that is capacity loss or the conversion ceiling, and is the same undifferentiated-decrement signature the guard already treats as fatal.

DISCRIMINATOR CONSTRAINT. The discriminator must be FUNCTIONAL -- "does removing this boundary produce this specific failure?" -- never resource-based or module-based. Jia 2011 (the one mixed entry in this claim's literature pull) shows rule identification and extrapolation share a prefrontal-parietal core while recruiting component-specific networks on top; shared machinery is compatible with functional non-collapsibility, so a shared-substrate discriminator would read a working pipeline as collapsed. Correspondingly, partial dissociation is the expected positive result: Capkova 2025 found 2 of 5 lesion groups with no deficit at all, and shared signatures between OFC and ACC.

CURRENT STATE. Not falsified; not tested. 0 experimental entries; `literature_confidence` 0.823 over 5 entries (4 supports + 1 mixed, 2026-09-02). The whole-cycle route is blocked by precondition (4); the behavioural route is blocked by precondition (3). The seam-local representation-plane route is the first non-vacuous test available and is gated only on the corrected gate below, not on GAP-B.

ARC-114.subject: reasoning.language_as_interface_not_substrate
ARC-114.title: Language is an INTERFACE to reasoning, not its substrate: reasoning-like behaviour emerging from language alone (LLMs) does not establish language as the native substrate of reasoning. Language functions as compression, communication, coordination, long-horizon scaffolding, working-memory support and explanation -- and may COMPENSATE for weaknesses in other reasoning systems.
ARC-114.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: no language stream exists in ree_core (confirmed by grep; the one
hit outside claustrum housekeeping is a comment literally listing "social/language/reality-
coherence" among modules that "doesn't exist yet in ree_core"). No weakened-vs-intact
non-linguistic-reasoning-stage manipulation is possible without one. SUBSTRATE-BLOCKED IN V3 --
register-scoped only, per the claim's own notes; do not design or queue against this in V3.

CONFIRMING (reused from the claim's own notes, not re-derived -- the compensation leg is the
testable one): once a language-interface stream exists alongside REE's non-linguistic substrate,
an experiment that WEAKENS the non-linguistic reasoning stage (not merely degrades overall
performance) shows GREATER reliance on / recruitment of the linguistic-scaffolding stream. That
directional prediction is what distinguishes "language compensates" from "language is the
substrate" -- worse performance alone under-determines the two.

FALSIFYING: a weakened non-linguistic reasoning stage shows no increased reliance on linguistic
scaffolding (constant or falling recruitment as the non-linguistic stage degrades), which would
instead support language as substrate rather than interface. A failure under unmet preconditions
(no language stream to test) is not evidence against the claim.

OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: none -- this is fully a REE-substrate claim once a language stream exists, not
a fused claim with a clinical/external leg.

UNBLOCKS WHEN: a language-interface stream is built in ree-v3 (no owning substrate_queue entry
found as of this check -- describe, do not fabricate an id).

LITERATURE STATUS (currency correction to the claim's own notes): the general language-and-
reasoning /lit-pull HAS now run (4 entries banked 2026-09-25, lit_conf=0.832, evidence_quadrant
plausible_unproven, exp_conf=0 as expected pre-substrate) -- do not re-run that query. The
specifically-flagged private-speech / externalised-DMN thought cluster is NOT among those 4
entries and remains genuinely unprocessed; pull that one next, separately.

ARC-115.subject: confidence.externally_induced_agreement_is_separate_channel
ARC-115.title: Confidence readouts are non-collapsible, and externally-induced agreement is a separate channel from internally-derived confidence. A single scalar confidence conflates propositional confidence, attractor stability, cross-subsystem agreement, conflict pressure, action-readiness, and socially-supplied agreement; the last must not enter the same accumulator as the others -- else being told something becomes indistinguishable from having found it.
ARC-115.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The confidence readouts must be live -- non-zero cross-arm and
cross-seed variance on each channel being dissociated (propositional confidence, attractor
stability, cross-subsystem agreement, conflict pressure, action-readiness, and the
socially-supplied-agreement channel), not floor-pinned. Currency check (2026-09-25): ree_core has
no external-assertion / social-agreement input channel at all -- grep of ree_core for
external_assertion, externally_induced, social_agreement and assertion_channel returns nothing. The
nearest live analogue is z_beta leakage (MECH-192, itself v5/substrate_conditional/zero-evidence),
which is affective, not propositional, and cannot substitute. A channel that never moves, or does
not exist to move, cannot be shown separate from another; the run self-routes substrate_not_ready.

CONFIRMING: Stage dissociation, not a performance test. An external assertion should raise the
social-agreement channel and, on its own, must NOT raise commit-readiness the way accumulated
internal evidence does. PASS requires the two paths to be dissociable: an assertion-only
manipulation and an evidence-only manipulation produce distinguishable readout profiles, with a
collapsed control showing them indistinguishable.

FALSIFYING: Performance merely drops without dissociation -- the assertion-only and evidence-only
manipulations produce the same readout profile as the collapsed control -- or the two channels
dissociate only under a post-hoc decomposition rather than an architecturally separate
commit-gating input. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

BLOCKING SUBSTRATE: an external-assertion / social-agreement input channel feeding the confidence
accumulator, wired separately from the internal-evidence path at commit-gating time. No claim id
currently owns building this channel (MECH-192's z_beta leakage is the nearest built analogue but is
explicitly the wrong signal type, per this claim's own notes). UNBLOCKS WHEN: such a channel exists
and is wired into commit-gating.

ARC-116.subject: cognition.generation_readout_reconstruction_noncollapse
ARC-116.title: Generation, metacognitive readout, and linguistic reconstruction are three non-collapsible stages. The confidence readout must not be derived from the verbal reconstruction, and neither may substitute for the generating dynamics. The felt sequence nonverbal-settling -> felt-confidence -> verbal-reconstruction -> external-testing implies three things REE currently treats as two at most.
ARC-116.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The metacognitive readout must be live in the intact baseline --
non-zero cross-arm and cross-seed variance, not floor-pinned. Currency check (2026-09-25): ree_core
has no verbal_reconstruction / linguistic_reconstruction / language_channel implementation of any
kind -- grep of ree_core returns nothing. There is no reconstruction stage to degrade at all, so the
claim is not merely untested but currently unbuildable as an experiment. A readout that never moves,
or a reconstruction stage that does not exist, cannot be shown preserved or degraded; the run
self-routes substrate_not_ready.

CONFIRMING: Dissociation under degradation. Degrade the reconstruction channel; a three-stage
system's confidence readout should be substantially preserved while a collapsed system's degrades
with it. PASS requires the two architectures to be distinguishable on the readout under matched
reconstruction degradation, not merely that performance drops.

FALSIFYING: If a system derives its confidence readout FROM its verbal reconstruction, degrading the
reconstruction corrupts the confidence indistinguishably from the three-stage prediction -- i.e. no
dissociation is found once both architectures are built and testable. A failure under unmet
preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

BLOCKING SUBSTRATE: a linguistic/verbal reconstruction generation stage, plus a metacognitive readout
wired independently of it (neither exists in ree_core). Same non-collapse argument-shape as ARC-025
(engine irreducibility -- has a built instrument, V3-EXQ-034, reuse its COLLAPSE-not-ablation
manipulation pattern rather than re-deriving one) and MECH-069 (error incommensurability). Do not
re-derive the collapse-arm methodology from scratch. UNBLOCKS WHEN: a reconstruction channel exists
and can be independently degraded from the readout.

ARC-117.subject: language.message_selection_minimises_receiver_uncertainty
ARC-117.title: Message selection minimises the receiver's residual uncertainty: an utterance approximates a task-relevant sufficient statistic for the receiver, not a compression of the sender's salience. Predicts WHAT gets said (features that most reduce the receiver's uncertainty about the sender's state) rather than merely that saying happens.
ARC-117.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The receiver's uncertainty must be live -- non-zero cross-arm and
  cross-seed variance in the receiver's posterior entropy over the sender's relevant state. A
  task where the receiver already knows the sender's state (entropy floored at zero) or can
  never know it (entropy pinned at maximum) discriminates nothing; the run self-routes
  substrate_not_ready. The channel budget must also bind -- an unconstrained channel makes
  selection moot. (Ported verbatim from the claim's existing non_degeneracy_precondition
  field -- already house-shaped, not re-derived.)
CONFIRMING: Two signalling policies in a multi-agent coordination task -- features selected by
  predicted uncertainty-reduction in the receiver vs features selected by sender-side salience,
  matched channel budget -- and the receiver-objective arm achieves lower coordination cost by
  a margin scaled on the SD of the delta plus an absolute floor.
FALSIFYING: The two arms are indistinguishable -- the receiver model does no work, and
  language selection can be explained sender-locally.
BLOCKING ARTEFACT (named, sharper than the claim's own notes): no dedicated substrate node
  exists for a receiver-side uncertainty model at all -- confirmed 2026-09-25, zero hits for
  receiver_model / receiver_uncertainty / uncertainty_reduction anywhere under ree_core/. The
  nearest live mechanism, MECH-192's z_beta leakage, is confirmed live (z_beta appears in
  ree_core/agent.py, latent/stack.py, utils/config.py, heartbeat/clock.py,
  regulators/mech295_liking_bridge.py) but is affective/non-propositional leakage, not a
  receiver posterior over sender state, and would not test this claim (matches the claim's
  own notes). Requires: MECH-014's channel built out (sketch only today) PLUS a
  receiver-side uncertainty model that does not exist under any id yet. Per this claim's own
  notes the requirement "should be recorded against ARC-099's enabling-condition contract" --
  checked, that cross-reference has not actually been made (see currency findings above).

ARC-118.subject: language.reference_inherited_via_world_model
ARC-118.title: Worldly reference is inherited through the world model, and the same mechanism covers non-present referents. Language refers reliably to the world because it indexes internal states that model the world; therefore reference to imagined, counterfactual, fictional and abstract states requires no additional mechanism.
ARC-118.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Present-referent reference must first clear a floor with
  non-zero cross-seed variance, AND the model states standing in for non-present referents
  must be independently shown to be reconstructable (a stability measure above floor). If
  either is at floor there is nothing to extend and the run self-routes substrate_not_ready.
  (Ported verbatim from the claim's existing non_degeneracy_precondition field.)
CONFIRMING: A system that refers correctly to present referents extends to non-present ones
  WITHOUT an added pathway, given only that the corresponding model states are stable or
  reconstructable, AND reference quality TRACKS model-state stability rather than referent
  presence -- the discriminating measurement (PASS requires this in addition to the negative
  signature).
FALSIFYING: Non-present reference requires a distinct mechanism, or degrades in a way not
  explained by the stability of the underlying model state; a registry that needed a distinct
  "imagination-reference" pathway would falsify the claim.
BLOCKING ARTEFACT (named): first, the same absent language mechanism INV-003/ARC-009 already
  audit (no version of any language claim is testable in V3 -- do not re-derive). Second, and
  specific to this claim: no dedicated "reconstructability of non-present model states"
  substrate node exists under any id -- checked the claim's own related_claims (ARC-102,
  MECH-416, MECH-419, EXT-005), all confirmed candidate/substrate_conditional/v6/unbuilt as of
  2026-09-25, none of which is itself the reconstructability mechanism this claim needs (they
  are abstraction-level, frame-inventory, compositional-generalisation and causal-attribution
  claims respectively -- adjacent, not identical). The gap is real and currently unowned by any
  registered node; naming it here rather than fabricating an id.

ARC-119.subject: language.input_proposes_candidate_states_never_installs_belief
ARC-119.title: Language-input update policy: an utterance proposes candidate model states which are evaluated before any update; it never installs a belief. Generalises INV-085 from affect to arbitrary content and ARC-104 from the harm stream to all content. Evaluation criteria: context, source reliability, causal compatibility with existing world-model structure, memory, uncertainty, current goals, speaker model.
ARC-119.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a language/propositional INPUT channel with a represented
source-reliability / speaker model -- confirmed ABSENT (see group preamble; no speaker-model
machinery exists in V3 either). In addition, per the claim's own existing non_degeneracy_precondition:
the contradicting-evidence manipulation must move belief in the no-language control (non-zero
cross-arm variance), else the test cannot distinguish "language was correctly refused" from "nothing
moves belief at all" and the run self-routes substrate_not_ready; the source-reliability leg is
untestable if the speaker model is absent.

CONFIRMING (from the claim's existing falsifier, PASS leg): inject an assertion contradicting
available world evidence under a source-reliability manipulation. Resulting belief tracks the
EVIDENCE and the SOURCE RELIABILITY rather than the raw assertion -- a low-reliability contradicting
assertion leaves belief substantially unchanged while a high-reliability one shifts it, and neither
overwrites contradicting direct evidence.

FALSIFYING (from the claim's existing falsifier, FAIL leg): belief tracks the assertion irrespective
of reliability or contradicting evidence -- i.e. the utterance INSTALLS a belief rather than
proposing a candidate state that gets evaluated.

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: requires the V6 language-input channel (ARC-009 Layer 2, still
unbuilt) AND a represented speaker-reliability/source model (no such machinery exists in V3).
Reuses, does not re-derive, INV-085's and ARC-104's channel-absence finding -- see group preamble.

ARC-120.subject: architecture.competence_before_authority_framing
ARC-120.title: Behavioural/write authority in REE is (and should remain) EARNED through demonstrated competence, never granted merely because a computation or mechanism exists: REE's existing authority-gating mechanisms are independently-discovered instances of one general developmental sequence -- existence -> representation -> competence -> authority -> behavioural influence -- rather than unrelated ad hoc gates.
ARC-120.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this is an audit, and an audit over an empty or trivial corpus is the
characteristic vacuity here. The corpus is every mechanism that ACTUALLY GRANTS AUTHORITY -- i.e.
whose effect is to admit a signal to a committed-selection surface, a memory/representation write
path, or a consolidation-rate control -- that was ACCEPTED (registered `active`/`stable`/
`provisional`, code present in `ree_core/`, reachable on a production path, not default-off-and-
never-enabled) since ARC-120's registration on 2026-08-06. At least 5 such mechanisms must be in
the corpus; with 0-2 the correct output is "insufficient corpus", never "confirmed". Each must be
classified gated/ungated by READING ITS ADMISSION PREDICATE IN CODE, not by reading its claim prose
-- a claim whose text promises a gate that the code does not implement counts as UNGATED, and that
asymmetry is the whole point of running the audit against `ree_core/` rather than against
`claims.yaml`.

CONFIRMING: every mechanism in the corpus conditions its authority grant on at least one
competence-like predicate -- per-event eligibility (ARC-107), a learnable rather than fixed store
(SD-032b), operating-mode write gating (MECH-261), real-vs-simulated provenance tagging (MECH-094),
or a demonstrable equivalent. WORKED CONFIRMING INSTANCE, already in the record and usable as the
audit's first row: the ARC-108 JOB-2 habenula de-commit (`ClosureOperator.habenula_tick`, ree-v3,
2026-06-22) grants a genuinely NEW behavioural authority -- abort a live commitment on a
worse-than-expected outcome -- and gates it on `hypothesis_tag is False` (MECH-094, so a replay/DMN
outcome cannot abort a waking commitment) AND `beta_gate.is_elevated` (nothing to de-commit
otherwise). That is a competence-like gate, so ARC-120 survives its most recent test case, and
it survives it in the informative direction: the gate was added for a reason internal to the
mechanism, not to satisfy this claim. On the experimental side, ARC-120's rung is discharged by the
authority-ABSENT findings ARC-130's 2026-08-26 note explicitly assigns to it -- MECH-314/MECH-320
score-bias terms "dominated by the primary harm/goal score term, so they never change argmax"
(`failure_autopsy_604a-624a-630_2026-06-03`), and MECH-341 firing "but leaving committed-class
entropy invariant" (V3-EXQ-614d). These are instances of authority correctly NOT granted to a
mechanism that had not earned it.

FALSIFYING: one accepted, production-reachable mechanism whose authority-admission predicate reads
ONLY on signal presence or magnitude -- no eligibility, mode, learnability or provenance condition --
and whose acceptance was not flagged as a deliberate exception. One clean instance falsifies the
normative half ("should remain"); a second instance PLUS a governance decision declining to add a
gate falsifies the descriptive half ("is"). NEAR-MISS SHAPE TO REJECT, so the audit does not
manufacture a false positive: an ungated INTERNAL scalar that cannot reach a committed surface is
NOT a counterexample here -- it fails at competitive authority or committed throughput, which are
ARC-130's rungs, not this claim's. The discriminator is whether the ungated signal demonstrably
reaches a committed action, a durable write, or a consolidation rate.

PROOF/AUDIT OBLIGATION (the artifact this claim resolves into, in place of an experiment): a dated
table of the post-2026-08-06 authority-granting mechanisms, each with its admission predicate quoted
from `ree_core/` and classified against the four gate types above, re-run at each governance cycle
that accepts a new authority-granting mechanism. ARC-120 closes as resolved-by-derivation when that
table has been maintained across a meaningful corpus with no ungated row; it is refuted the first
time a row is ungated and stays ungated by decision.

ARC-121.subject: architecture.epistemic_state_centrality_framing
ARC-121.title: REE's mechanisms increasingly converge on maintaining and consuming a SHARED epistemic-state object (knowledge / belief / uncertainty / possibility / commitment / action) rather than each existing as an isolated computational function: prediction, replay, harm/ethics evaluation, planning and learning read and update a common epistemic relationship rather than independent local state.
ARC-121.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the census must run over epistemic CONTAINERS -- a class or persistent
agent attribute that holds belief / uncertainty / possibility / commitment state and is instantiated
on a production path in `ree_core/` -- not over every module that mentions a keyword. The sharing
measure for a container is the number of DISTINCT top-level `ree_core/` subpackages that READ it,
excluding (i) its own defining module, (ii) that package's `__init__.py`, and (iii)
`ree_core/utils/config.py`, which carries declarations only and would otherwise make every container
look one-subpackage-shared. A census in which every container scores identically -- all shared or all
private -- is uninformative about CONVERGENCE (which is a claim about a trend, not a state) and must
be reported as uninformative rather than as a verdict; convergence requires at least two containers
at different sharing levels and a defensible ordering by date of addition.

CONFIRMING: newly added epistemic containers are read across >= 3 distinct subpackages -- they JOIN
the existing shared objects rather than adding private ones -- and the shared:private ratio is
non-decreasing across successive substrate additions. MEASURED BASELINE, ree-v3 `ree_core/` as of
2026-09-04, which any future census should be diffed against rather than re-derived:
`hypothesis_tag` (MECH-094) = 24 files / 11 subpackages, spanning amygdala, PFC, sleep, hippocampal,
residue, predictors, governance, latent, cingulate, regulators and policy -- strongly shared, and
exactly the cross-mechanism consumption pattern ARC-121's title asserts (prediction, replay,
harm/ethics evaluation, planning and learning all read it); `rule_state` (SD-033a / SD-034) = 10
files / 7 subpackages -- shared, and read by both the closure operator and E3 selection, i.e.
commitment really is a first-class object several mechanisms consume rather than one module's local
variable. Those two are the claim's genuine confirming core and they are strong.

FALSIFYING: newly added epistemic containers are confined to their own defining module plus the
agent constructor -- private, single-consumer, with no cross-mechanism read path. THIS PATTERN IS
ALREADY PRESENT, and the instance sits inside ARC-121's OWN `depends_on` set. `epistemic_deficit`
(MECH-482, `ree_core/policy/epistemic_deficit.py`, substrate entry SD-102) is referenced in exactly
4 files -- its own module, `policy/__init__.py`, `utils/config.py` (declaration), and `agent.py`,
where it is instantiated only when `curiosity_learning_progress_source == "epistemic_deficit"` and
consumed as a single-purpose curiosity/learning-progress source (agent.py:1815-1920). It is NOT read
by harm/ethics evaluation, replay, planning, or the closure operator -- the precise consumers
ARC-121's title enumerates -- and its substrate was still being actively extended on 2026-08-30
(`sd_epistemic_deficit_multitarget_readiness`, `implemented_pending_validation`) without acquiring a
shared read path. So REE's most actively-developed belief/uncertainty addition is mechanism-private,
which is the falsifying pattern the claim itself specifies. CALIBRATION, so this is not over-read:
ONE private container falsifies the convergence TREND, not the framing -- the correct response is to
amend ARC-121 from "increasingly converge" to "converge on some, not all, epistemic constituents",
or to route `epistemic_deficit` into a shared read path and re-census. ARC-121 is falsified OUTRIGHT
only if a SECOND post-registration epistemic container is added with no shared read path and no
accepted plan to give it one -- at that point private-by-default is the architecture's actual
practice and the framing is describing an aspiration rather than a trend.

ARC-122.subject: architecture.four_phase_developmental_curriculum
ARC-122.title: REE's training curriculum must implement four sequential developmental phases: (1) innate coupling with a competent environment, (2) coupling consolidation with plasticity reduction, (3) play/exploration under a consolidated safety net, (4) language acquisition over a trusted channel. Skipping or reordering phases produces an agent with compromised social and ethical capabilities.
ARC-122.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: see INV-094's what_would_answer for the shared play-mode /
  MECH-014 gates -- do not re-derive the ordering falsifier here. ARC-122's OWN additional
  precondition is a prerequisite DELIVERABLE rather than a run gate: no architecture doc exists
  yet specifying the four phases as concrete, gate-checkable transition criteria (verified --
  docs/architecture/developmental_curriculum.md covers an unrelated, older curriculum register,
  ARC-019/INV-043/etc.). Without that doc, "correctly ordered" has no operational definition to
  hold a training run to, so even once the substrate exists a run cannot be designed against this
  claim id specifically.
CONFIRMING: a curriculum run following the specified four-phase schedule at matched total budget
  produces measurably better social/ethical outcome metrics (as specified once the missing
  architecture doc defines them) than a collapsed or reordered curriculum at the same budget --
  this is INV-094's ordering test integrated across all three phase boundaries at once, plus
  MECH-484's phase-1->2 mechanism actually firing as designed.
FALSIFYING: the reordered/collapsed curriculum matches the four-phase curriculum on those outcome
  metrics at matched budget -- the specific four-phase design adds nothing beyond what INV-094's
  bare ordering constraint (if it holds) already delivers. A failure under an unmet precondition
  (play-mode, coupling-consolidation, language-channel, or the missing architecture doc) is not
  evidence against the claim.
OUT-OF-DOMAIN / UNBUILT PREREQUISITE NOTED IN THE CLAIM'S OWN RECORD: lit-pull on attachment
  sensitive periods (what consolidates, what timescale) and play-as-dependent-on-secure-attachment
  (Bowlby/Ainsworth) are still open per the claim's own notes -- unresolved, not something this
  wwa can gate a run on but worth carrying forward as prerequisite literature work.

ARC-123.subject: language.tom_architecturally_separable
ARC-123.title: Language and theory-of-mind/fast-empathy are implemented as partially-homologous but developmentally SEPARATE specialist systems over a shared self/world/action core -- distinct routing, input histories, representational pressures and gating -- not as one merged social-linguistic system that later differentiates.
ARC-123.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: requires BOTH a live language channel (a code path
that emits symbols from agent state or maps received symbols onto it) and a
live other-model/fast-empathy channel (MECH-405 routing own streams through
a stable other-model slot). Neither exists in V3, so any V3 probe is vacuous
-- a substrate with one system and not the other trivially satisfies
"separable" while exhibiting no separation at all.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: both systems must be independently trained to a
measurable competence, so that a dissociation can be distinguished from one
of them simply being absent or inert.
CONFIRMING signature: a double dissociation under ablation -- lesioning the
language channel leaves other-bound affect and other-model prediction within
tolerance of baseline, AND suppressing the other-model slot leaves language
fidelity within tolerance -- together with measurably distinct input
histories/gating (the two systems are driven by different training signals,
not one reading off the other).
UNSUPPORTED if a single shared representation carries both functions with no
dissociation under ablation, or if one channel is a thin readout of the other
(ablating the "separate" system degrades both), or if the two only separate
when separation is architecturally imposed rather than developmentally
acquired -- the last case would make the claim true by construction and
empty as a developmental commitment.

ARC-124.subject: continuity.branching_successors
ARC-124.title: Copying a running REE creates multiple SUCCESSOR BRANCHES sharing a pre-branch history -- not an authentic original plus a morally negligible replica. After divergence each branch accrues an independent causal and moral history, and no branch may be treated as interchangeable with, or discountable because of, a surviving sibling.
ARC-124.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural AUDIT of the copy/fork code path plus a worked
governance case, not by a trained experiment.
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: a copy or fork operation must exist that produces two
independently-continuing instances. V3 checkpoints exist but nothing forks a
running agent, so there is no branch to reason about.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the two branches must actually diverge -- receive
different observations and accrue different histories. Two branches fed
identical input streams are one trajectory computed twice and raise none of
the questions this claim is about.
CONFIRMING signature: the implementation records both instances as successors
of a common pre-branch entity (neither flagged "original"), each carrying its
own post-branch residue and commitment state, with no code path that resolves
a conflict between them by privileging the older-numbered instance.
VIOLATED if the substrate designates one instance canonical -- or if
terminating a branch is treated as cost-free whenever a sibling survives,
which is the discounting move the claim's second half exists to forbid.

ARC-125.subject: continuity.commitment_inheritance
ARC-125.title: Commitment inheritance must be EXPLICIT across substrate transitions: promises, adopted goals, debts, permissions, relationships and repair obligations require stated transfer semantics at migration, copy and rollback, so that no transition can silently erase an obligation, silently multiply it across branches, or silently bind a successor to obsolete context-dependent state.
ARC-125.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural AUDIT plus a worked transition case.
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: requires commitments that persist beyond a single
episode and are legible as objects (not merely implicit in weights), plus a
transition that could drop or duplicate them. V3 has commitment boundaries
but no persistent inter-episode obligation store and no transition protocol.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least one obligation must be OUTSTANDING at
the moment of transition -- a migration performed with nothing owed cannot
distinguish explicit inheritance from no inheritance at all.
CONFIRMING signature: after a copy, each branch's obligation set is
inspectable and matches a STATED rule (whatever it is), and after a rollback
the restored state's obligations are stated rather than implied; a
deliberately-induced transition with an outstanding repair obligation shows
it neither vanishing nor silently doubling.
VIOLATED if obligation state is carried implicitly in transferred weights
with no inspectable record -- in which case erasure and multiplication are
both possible and neither is detectable, which is precisely the condition
the claim forbids.

ARC-127.subject: environment.conditional_hazard_valence
ARC-127.title: Generalising REE's environmental hazard/valence system from fixed per-object-class danger to conditional, context-dependent danger (time-of-day, a post-feeding window, co-occurring organism state, or combinations of these) is architecturally necessary to force representation of combined sensory evidence, time, memory, and environmental state together, rather than a simple fixed-category lookup.
ARC-127.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a conditional-danger environment variant (e.g. a hazard class dangerous only in a specific time window or organism-state combination) plus a matched fixed-valence control condition using the same objects, and a held-out generalisation test (novel timing/context combinations not seen during training).
CONFIRMING: REE's learned avoidance/approach behaviour becomes conditionally sensitive (differs by time/state/context) in a way a fixed-valence-trained control agent's behaviour does not, and this conditional sensitivity survives the held-out generalisation test.
FALSIFYING: REE fails to learn any conditional sensitivity (treats the object class as uniformly dangerous or safe regardless of context, no better than chance at discriminating safe vs. dangerous instances), OR the existing fixed-valence architecture already achieves equivalent discrimination without requiring any conditional-valence extension (context information is already implicitly available and usable through other existing channels).

ARC-128.subject: control_plane.termination_taxonomy_generality
ARC-128.title: Persistent-process termination is a general architectural requirement, not a rule_state-closure special case: every family of persistent cognitive process REE can initiate (information-seeking, planning, memory retrieval, threat monitoring, goal pursuit, exploration, ethical counterfactual generation) needs its own instance of a shared termination-state taxonomy (completion / satiety / closure / disengagement / suspension / switching / interruption / reopening) that preserves WHY termination occurred, so that suspended/reopenable processes stay distinguishable from completed, satiated, or abandoned ones.
ARC-128.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least two DIFFERENT families of persistent process instrumented, each actually terminating more than once in the measured window under at least two different terminal states.
CONFIRMING: the same taxonomy (completion / satiety / closure / disengagement / suspension / switching / interruption / reopening) classifies terminations in two or more process families without family-specific additions, AND the recorded reason is consequential -- a process terminated as suspension is reopened at a measurably higher rate than one terminated as completion.
FALSIFYING: the taxonomy requires family-specific terminal states (not general); OR the recorded reason has no downstream effect on reopening, resource release or credit (bookkeeping, not architecture).
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional (drafted from the 2026-09-09 convergence family, which bears on the closure/disengagement distinction).

ARC-129.subject: commitment.temporally_displaced_actionable_present
ARC-129.title: The state REE's downstream proposal-generation and action-evaluation machinery consumes as 'the current state' may be more accurately modeled as a short-horizon, affordance-conditioned FORWARD-DISPLACED prediction s_hat(t+tau) rather than the literal current encoded latent, where tau is set by the causal-effect timescale of whichever action REE is presently committed to (or, absent commitment, by the shortest relevant affordance horizon among candidates). Displacement magnitude should scale with commitment quality -- larger when the committed trajectory is well-predicted and low-variance, collapsing toward the immediate encoded state when uncommitted or when prediction quality is poor -- so 'now', for any consumer that reads a single current-state latent, is itself a construction rather than a passthrough of the most recent sensory encoding.
ARC-129.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (1) the forward-displaced current-state substitution
mechanism to exist as a distinct wired path -- a component that takes E2's action-conditioned
forward prediction (world_forward, ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py) along the presently
committed trajectory and substitutes it for the raw encoded z_world/current latent as the
"now" input consumed by proposal-generation (ARC-062 gated-policy heads, candidate minting)
and action-evaluation (E3) machinery, with displacement magnitude tau modulated by ARC-016's
commitment-quality (variance) signal; (2) a task with fast-enough world dynamics that the raw
current latent is measurably stale relative to tau by the time a committed action executes,
so an undisplaced-vs-displaced difference is even in principle detectable; (3) commitment
quality must vary across trials (low-variance well-predicted trajectories vs high-variance /
uncommitted) so displacement magnitude is not pinned at a constant.

CONFIRMING: once built, an arm consuming the displaced estimate s_hat(t+tau) as "now" shows
measurably better downstream proposal/evaluation performance (fewer stale-state action
errors, better anticipation of trajectory-relevant affordance changes) than an arm consuming
the raw encoded latent, with the advantage SCALING with commitment quality (larger under
low-variance well-predicted commitment, collapsing toward parity when uncommitted) -- the
scaling relationship, not just a main effect, is what would confirm the construction is doing
real work rather than being an arbitrary smoothing operator.

FALSIFYING: the displaced-estimate arm shows no advantage (or a disadvantage) over the raw
latent baseline across the commitment-quality range, or the advantage does not scale with
commitment quality (flat or inverted) -- either result means "now" as a literal passthrough
of the most recent encoding is sufficient and the forward-displacement construction is not
load-bearing.

BLOCKING SUBSTRATE: the entire mechanism is unbuilt. Verified 2026-09-25: no
"displaced_present" / "s_hat" / "forward_displaced" symbol anywhere in ree-v3/ree_core; E2's
world_forward is consumed only as a candidate-EVALUATION signal (scoring candidate
trajectories), never substituted for the "current state" input itself -- confirming the
claim's own notes that nothing in ARC-002/ARC-016/MECH-090 currently distinguishes the two.
DO NOT queue a V3 experiment without the explicit version-routing decision the claim's own
notes require.

ARC-130.subject: architecture.mechanism_causal_reach_ladder
ARC-130.title: Organism-level mechanism status is stage-qualified beyond ARC-120's competence-before-authority sequence: a mechanism becomes causally reachable only through an ordered audit projection of existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority (non-zero influence is not necessarily competitive influence against the dominant arbitration term), committed throughput (survives any later selector, latch, commitment boundary, or stale-selection path), ecological consequence (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter in the environment), and retention/generalisation. Authority at one internal selection boundary does not by itself establish that authority reaches committed behaviour -- 'competence should precede authority, but authority must also demonstrate throughput.' The furthest stage actually demonstrated, not a flat implemented/not-implemented judgment, is the correct unit for recording mechanism status.
ARC-130.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: For the ladder to discriminate, at least two ADJACENT rungs must be separately measurable on the SAME mechanism in the SAME run, with the upstream rung demonstrably CLEARED -- otherwise a downstream null is an upstream-failure artifact rather than a stage dissociation. The claim also forbids demanding one-step motor effects from every mechanism, so the ecological rung's currency must be declared per mechanism.
CONFIRMING: A mechanism clearing rung N and failing rung N+1 in the same run, demonstrated at more than one adjacent pair and by more than one mechanism -- already satisfied for authority-versus-throughput (V3-EXQ-931/932 cluster autopsy) and for committed-throughput persistence (the ARC-071 commit-latch and E3-reselection probes, 36.8 pct premature re-selection at chunk_max_size 5). Manipulation: Force the mechanism's competitive authority upward while holding the downstream selector fixed -- the V3-EXQ-931 in-run positive control raised the wanting weight from 0.5 to 5000 -- so authority varies and throughput is read as a separate quantity. Control: The ablation arm on the identical observation and candidate pool, matched seeds, plus the mechanism's own OFF arm as the existence-rung negative; V3-EXQ-932 is the paired PASS that makes 931's null interpretable. Required event: A V3 mechanism that is constructed, enabled, endogenously recruited, locally operating and holds competitive authority at its own selection boundary, in a run that then independently measures committed behaviour, ecological effect and retention. DV: Per-rung pass/fail on one mechanism in one run -- e.g. wanting_authority_ratio and selection_flip_rate for competitive authority against mean_resource_proximity for committed throughput. ARC-130 predicts these dissociate: 931 reached 80.3 pct elite argmin flips at forced authority while mean_resource_proximity stayed bit-identical to ablation (0.6229773644254133).
FALSIFYING: Every rung co-varying: across mechanisms, no case is found in which a mechanism passes rung N and fails rung N+1, so the stages are not separately demonstrable and a flat implemented/not-implemented label loses no information. Equivalently, if each apparent dissociation resolves into an upstream rung that was never really cleared. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/experiments/_lib/capability_contract.py reports interpretation_route ordered by the ladder (ROUTE_PRECEDENCE, line 237) across existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation and competitive authority / committed throughput, with test_capability_contract.py line 225 asserting the non-zero-influence clause. It has NO route for ecological consequence or retention/generalisation, and the per-stage MechanismReachTrace is recorded in claims.yaml as an UNBUILT, explicitly unauthorised instrumentation proposal. Consumer / boundary: The recording boundary for mechanism status -- the failure-autopsy and diagnostic report, GOV-FAILLOC-1's territory. This is an audit projection over a recurrent, distributed, multi-rate organism, not a claim about computational topology. Existing ownership: GOV-FAILLOC-1, GFLAG-0134, GFLAG-0220, ARC-120, EXP-1344.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); Rungs 7 and 8 have no recorder. capability_contract.py's route set stops at committed throughput, and the per-stage reach-trace instrument is deliberately unauthorised -- claims.yaml notes say do not build it without a separate decision, and GFLAG-0134 resolved with user decision (b): close on existing convergent evidence, NO instrumentation authorised. Secondary classes: R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-131.subject: architecture.installability_as_composition_competence
ARC-131.title: Installability is a competence dissociable from isolated component-level validation: a mechanism that passes in isolation can still fail to express itself when composed into the whole organism, because the rest of the organism changes its operating conditions (input state distribution, scale/variance of competing signals, timing and frequency of relevant events, availability of competent upstream representations, downstream action-space and commitment dynamics, post-installation learning gradients, resource/mode occupancy, and the ecology in which it must demonstrate value). A component-level PASS establishes that an operation is possible; it does not establish that the whole agent can enter the states in which the mechanism operates, that the mechanism remains competitive once other mechanisms are enabled, or that later learning will preserve it. This is dissociable from, though related to, competence RETENTION (surviving subsequent learning/time): installability additionally covers SIMULTANEOUS composition, where a competence may never appear in the full-stack agent even absent any later learning event.
ARC-131.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Choose a mechanism with verified isolated competence and identical parameters in composed testing; declare composition interfaces and ensure opportunities for endogenous recruitment and downstream consequence.
CONFIRMING: An isolated PASS coexists with composition failure, localised to a verified interface and rescued by restoring that interface Manipulation: Isolated versus composed configuration, separately from subsequent learning/retention Control: Matched inputs and tasks, sham composition, frozen parameters for the simultaneous-composition leg Required event: Same mechanism exercised in isolation and in full-agent composition DV: Loss of endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive influence, committed throughput or ecological success conditional on preserved isolated capability
FALSIFYING: Across a specified sufficiently varied corpus, isolated capability predicts composed function once input opportunities are matched; one mechanism cannot refute the unrestricted universal framing A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SD-091 request/recruitment records exist; 1038/1038a measure threshold engagement/scale, not the isolated-versus-composed dissociation Consumer / boundary: Component capability -> endogenous whole-agent use; distinguish immediate installability from later forgetting Existing ownership: ARC-131, SD-091, V3-EXQ-1038a.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Current coalition probes do not compare isolation with composition; their guaranteed-fire PASS cannot decide this claim. A bounded corpus/claim scope is required. R7 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

ARC-132.subject: representation.attractor_property_differentiation
ARC-132.title: A learned attractor's carried quantities -- predictive reliability, epistemic confidence, familiarity, affective valence, salience, action urgency, self-relevance, and source confidence -- are separable axes that must remain independently readable rather than collapsing into one undifferentiated strength signal; when collapsed, a strongly valenced and highly precise attractor stops functioning as a hypothesis and becomes the lens through which what is noticed, how ambiguity is resolved, which memories are retrieved, and which replayed material is stored as further evidence are all determined.
ARC-132.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a substrate representation of a learned attractor exposing at least
two of the named axes (predictive reliability, epistemic confidence, familiarity, affective
valence, salience, action urgency, self-relevance, source confidence) as independently-readable
fields on one object -- not scattered unrelated scalars computed by different modules for
different purposes -- must exist, plus an operation that COULD collapse them into one scalar (so
the claim has something to forbid). CURRENTLY UNMET, verified 2026-09-25: the only "attractor"
concept live in ree-v3/ree_core/ is z_goal_latent (ree_core/goal.py), a single slow-decay latent
vector in z_world space with no separable-axis structure -- not even a collapsed scalar of the
named axes, just an unrelated goal-representation object.

CONFIRMING (once built): with the multi-axis object live and exercised across episodes with
genuine variance on >=3 axes, the axes remain separately predictive of distinct downstream effects
(e.g. salience changes what is attended without changing which memories are retrieved; source
confidence changes retrieval weighting without changing valence) under matched-input controls; an
ablation that forces the axes into one scalar reproduces measurable degradation consistent with the
self-reinforcing-loop failure mode the claim names (biased perception/retrieval -> attractor-
consistent derived material -> selective replay -> apparent confirmation).

FALSIFYING: the axes carry redundant information under a genuine multi-axis implementation
(collapsing to one scalar loses no predictive power on held-out behaviour), or a collapsed-scalar
control performs indistinguishably from the multi-axis version on the self-reinforcing-loop DVs. A
failure under the unmet precondition above is not evidence against the claim.

UNBLOCKS WHEN: a structured multi-axis attractor representation is built (V4/V5 scope; no
substrate_queue entry exists for it as of 2026-09-25).

ARC-133.subject: representation.selection_relevant_individuation
ARC-133.title: Selection-relevance is a legitimate object-individuation criterion: an object may be individuated by what it is FOR -- its usefulness relative to goals, harm, and interoceptive/metabolic state -- rather than (only) by the causal coherence of its features under intervention. This is RIVAL to MECH-278 and the two disagree on real cases: causally-identical-but-functionally-distinct items are one object under MECH-278 and two under ARC-133; causally-distinct-but-functionally-identical items (a hazard that bites, a hazard that falls) are two under MECH-278 and one under ARC-133. The sharpest divergence is drive-relative re-individuation -- the same world carves differently when hungry, thirsty or injured -- which a causal criterion cannot deliver and which is precisely what MECH-359 asserts selection requires.
ARC-133.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (three gates, ALL currently unmet -- which is why this is substrate_conditional): (a) AN INDIVIDUATION PATH MUST EXIST. The valuation half is live (IncentiveTokenBank: wanting[k] = base_value[k]*(1+kappa*drive_axis[k]), and CausalGridWorld supplies per-axis drives hunger/thirst/curiosity), but that value is consumed ONLY to select AMONG already-individuated objects (MECH-346). The one place individuation happens -- ObjectFileBuffer's association cost, cost = w_motion*d_pos + w_feat*feat_term -- has NO use/value term, and its docstring states the incumbent: resource_tag is "NEVER used as the association key (the key is continuity, not type)". The substrate HARD-CODES MECH-278. A run not adding a drive-relevance term to that decision cannot adjudicate -> substrate_not_ready_requeue. (b) THE ATTENTION GATE MUST BE NON-VACUOUS. EntityObservation.salience is the only channel by which internal state could reach individuation and has never varied (V3-EXQ-658 hardcodes salience=1.0, precision=1.0; obf_min_birth_salience defaults 0.0, so the C4 birth gate has never rejected an observation). Report the realised salience distribution and a non-zero birth-gate rejection count. (c) ANTI-COLLAPSE CONTROL (MECH-520): report a retained-structure control -- the carving must still recover the causally-coherent grouping under NEUTRAL drive -- else a "win" is the value-only degeneracy MECH-520 predicts, not support. THE DISCRIMINATOR IS NECESSITY, NOT PRESENCE. Wiring drive into the individuation cost and then observing drive-dependent individuation is TAUTOLOGICAL. What discriminates ARC-133 from MECH-278 is whether drive-relative carving resolves a selection problem the causal carving structurally CANNOT. Three arms over ONE recorded observation stream replayed under two internal states (hunger-high/thirst-low vs the converse), world bit-identical by construction: ARM_CAUSAL (w_use = 0, motion+appearance only); ARM_USE (w_use > 0, use_i = normalised wanting[type_i] read live from the bank); ARM_SHUFFLE (w_use > 0 but wanting permuted across types -- LOAD-BEARING, separates drive-RELEVANT structure from "any extra cost term perturbs a greedy assignment"). Two item pairs: PAIR-1 causally-identical / functionally-distinct (matched spawn, benefit amplitude and motion, common perceptual channel, differing only in which drive axis they discharge) -- MECH-278 predicts ONE token, ARC-133 TWO under differential drive. PAIR-2 causally-distinct / functionally-identical (a pursuing hazard vs a static contact hazard, matched harm amplitude) -- MECH-278 predicts TWO always, ARC-133 ONE under harm pressure. CONFIRMING: ARM_USE shows (R2) non-zero drive-locked merge/split events on an unchanged world when the drive state is flipped mid-episode -- MECH-278 predicts ZERO by construction -- AND (R3) a forced-choice discrimination margin on PAIR-1 that ARM_CAUSAL cannot reach (under MECH-278 the two items are ONE token, so the goal pointer is structurally ambiguous and the margin is at chance), with ARM_SHUFFLE at or below ARM_CAUSAL on R3 and the anti-collapse control clean. Ordering ARM_USE > ARM_CAUSAL > ARM_SHUFFLE on R3 per-seed, not arm-mean. FALSIFYING (any one): (i) ARM_USE ~= ARM_SHUFFLE on R3 -- the benefit is from perturbing the assignment, not from drive-relevance (the most likely null, and why ARM_SHUFFLE exists); (ii) ARM_USE <= ARM_CAUSAL on R3 while R2 is large -- the carving IS drive-relative and it HURTS, vindicating MECH-278's criterion and placing `wanting` where it already is, downstream as a CONSUMER of a causally-carved object; (iii) the anti-collapse control fails -- the use-carved representation cannot recover the causal grouping under neutral drive, i.e. degeneracy not individuation; (iv) PAIR-1's margin is recoverable on ARM_CAUSAL by purely perceptual means -- the case was never causally-identical and the divergence was a harness artifact. SCOPE: this adjudicates the CRITERION (what makes one object one object), NOT MECH-278's stage-2 DEVELOPMENTAL assertion, whose own falsifier requires ablating the engineered z_world and is untestable in V3.

ARC-134.subject: representation.perceptual_dynamic_regranularisation
ARC-134.title: The unit of PERCEPT is a dynamic representation, not a fixed primitive: perceptual grain rescales with circumstance, so that the same scene is individuated coarsely or finely depending on demand. This is the perceptual analogue of ARC-069's already-accepted policy-side commitment, and ARC-069's rationale transfers axis-independently -- a fixed grain is either too fine (combinatorial explosion in what must be tracked and bound) or too coarse (units fail to map onto the actual state). REE has made this commitment for policy (ARC-069/070/071) and for context slots offline (MECH-166) but never for online perception, where the unit remains fixed.
ARC-134.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (four; ALL currently unmet). (P0) AN ENDOGENOUS GRAIN OPERATOR MUST EXIST -- it does not. `ree_core/entities/object_file_buffer.py` contains only `_birth`, `_enforce_capacity` and `_evict_stale`: there is NO merge and NO split of tokens anywhere, and matching is strictly 1:1 greedy over a caller-built `List[EntityObservation]` assembled by the harness from grid cells. So `obf_n_active_tokens` measures the ENVIRONMENT's entity count, not the agent's carving, and the perceptual analogue of ARC-070's `decompose_sequence()` is absent. This is the largest disanalogy with the policy axis, where the operator was BUILT (2026-07-24) before the claim was scored. (P1) A PER-PERCEPT TRIGGER -- ARC-070 triggers on region V_s drop or a MECH-288 boundary, both keyed to a TEMPORAL region rather than to a percept. The nearest per-token error signal is computed and then DISCARDED: the association cost's motion term is a zero-order prediction error, never stored on the ObjectFile and absent from `get_diagnostics()`. Exposing per-token match cost / residual / unmatched-observation count is ~10 lines and is the cheapest thing owed. (P2) A DEMAND MANIPULATION AT FIXED SCENE -- the IV must vary required perceptual resolution while holding entity set and trajectory IDENTICAL; no V3 environment varies resolution independently of entity count, and `use_object_file_buffer` is default False with exactly one supporting run (V3-EXQ-658), which deliberately set `obf_max_tokens = N_DISTRACTORS + 2` to guarantee zero capacity evictions. (P3) GROUND-TRUTH SCENE PARTITION for the MECH-126 DV -- overmerge has never been measured anywhere in the corpus. CONFIRMING -- a THREE-RUNG ladder; rung 1 alone is VACUOUS and must never be scored as evidence. L1 VARIABILITY: the maintained unit count varies within a fixed scene. ALREADY TRIVIALLY TRUE -- births, deaths and TTL evictions vary it with no regranularisation whatever, so a falsifier stopping here is satisfied by today's substrate. Record as a readiness check only. L2 CONTINGENCY (load-bearing): with the scene held constant, realised grain moves in the PREDICTED DIRECTION under the P2 demand manipulation -- finer under a within-cluster discrimination demand, coarser under a unit-level demand -- with a selectivity check that the operator FIRES under the demand condition and is SILENT otherwise, against a STRUCTURAL-ZERO OFF arm (`n_regrain_split`/`n_regrain_merge` > 0 ON, exactly 0 OFF). L3 NON-RANDOMNESS (the guard against "fires but worse"): the demand-driven arm must beat a YOKED, RATE-MATCHED RANDOM-REGRAIN control -- same number of merge/split events at the same ticks, targets chosen at random among eligible tokens -- on the MECH-126 DV pair (`overmerge_rate`, `oversplit_rate`). PASS requires a net error reduction versus YOKED, NOT versus OFF: ON-vs-OFF confounds "regrained at all" with "regrained informatively". FALSIFYING (preconditions met, any one): (i) FIXED-GRAIN NULL -- realised partition statistically indistinguishable between fine- and coarse-demand at matched scenes, with the manipulation check confirming the agent registers the demand; (ii) VARIABILITY WITHOUT CONTINGENCY -- L1 holds, L2 fails; (iii) UNINFORMATIVE REGRANULARISATION -- the demand-driven arm is indistinguishable from the yoked control on BOTH MECH-126 DVs. (iii) falsifies "rescales with circumstance" while leaving "grain can vary" intact, and is the specific outcome a naive falsifier would have mis-scored as a PASS. EXPLICITLY NOT FALSIFYING: a downstream TASK-outcome failure (regraining fires without improving reward or reducing harm) -- that is a child mechanism's QUALITY claim, not this architectural commitment, transferring ARC-069's own exclusion; MECH-521's falsifiers, which refute a specific generative story for occupancy rather than this commitment; and any MECH-288 two-scale result in either direction.

ARC-135.subject: architecture.organismal_continuity_decomposition
ARC-135.title: 'Long life' in an artificial organism is not one property but at least four separable continuities -- cognitive/affective/mnemonic state continuity, parameter/plasticity continuity, body/homeostatic continuity, and ecological/world continuity -- which can be held or broken independently of one another. A persistent-organism experiment must therefore declare which of the four it preserves, because duration under a broken continuity is not developmental opportunity: an organism whose cognitive state persists while its body and world regenerate at every boundary is not aging in a world, and an organism observed for many ticks with its parameters frozen is not developing. The decomposition separates four confounds that a scalar 'lifespan' or 'ticks survived' cannot: age from layout luck, learning from reset effects, injury/recovery from death, and memory accumulation from environmental regeneration.
ARC-135.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Within-life change must be measurable at all in the chosen driver: the 906/913 family must show a non-zero early-vs-late competence delta under at least one continuity configuration, otherwise no configuration can differ from any other and the four-way decomposition cannot discriminate. The four continuities must be set independently rather than co-varied by a single boundary policy.
CONFIRMING: Developmental delta at matched tick count differs by continuity configuration -- for example layout-continuous cells show a within-life improvement that layout-re-randomised cells do not, and parameter-frozen cells show none at all -- so lifespan alone does not predict development. Manipulation: Factorially set the four continuities at matched tick count: world/layout continuity via env.reset_to() (913's _continuity_reset) versus env.reset() re-randomisation (906b/906c/911/912); parameter continuity via the sleep/offline-update arms and frozen-parameter eval; body/homeostatic continuity by carrying agent_health across the boundary (reset_to unconditionally restores it to 1.0 at causal_grid_world.py, so the driver must re-write it); cognitive/mnemonic continuity held by construction in this family. Control: The 906b/906c arm (world and body continuity broken at every boundary, cognitive state held) as the reference cell, with tick count, segment count and resource budget matched across cells. Required event: A multi-segment life in which segment boundaries recur many times (V3-EXQ-913 runs 24 segments per seed), so that each continuity has repeated opportunities to be held or broken. DV: Within-life development measured as the early-vs-late segment change in harm rate, benefit rate and mode entropy (913's within_life_development block), compared ACROSS continuity configurations at identical tick counts; the claim requires the same tick count to yield different developmental deltas depending on which continuity was held.
FALSIFYING: Developmental delta is invariant to which continuities were held once tick count is matched, in which case the four-way decomposition buys vocabulary but no interpretive difference and a scalar lifespan readout loses nothing. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: V3-EXQ-913 already records within_life_development, a layout_continuity_confirmed precondition and per-segment done_cause; experiments/_lib/capability_contract.py's nine-mode PLASTICITY_MODES tuple plus PlasticityRequirement.load_bearing record what a run ALLOWED versus DEPENDED on changing. No recorder exists for body/homeostatic continuity because no driver carries agent_health across a boundary. Consumer / boundary: The segment-boundary transition: which substrate of continuity survives it, as against the scalar tick/lifespan readout the claim says cannot separate age from layout luck or learning from reset effects. Existing ownership: ARC-135, GOV-CAPCONTRACT-1, V3-EXQ-913, LIT-0522.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); No experiment sets the four continuities factorially; 913 varies world continuity and sleep only, against 906b/906c as a historical rather than matched control. Body continuity has no driver that carries agent_health, and 913's own within-life deltas were flat-to-negative, so the discriminating regime is not yet demonstrated. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-136.subject: development.play_emergent_information_hunger_frontier_migration
ARC-136.title: Play as emergent developmental information hunger: play-like behaviour emerges WITHOUT a dedicated play module when basic viability is secure, no urgent commitment dominates action selection, spare behavioural capacity is available, reachable states contain learnable (reducible) uncertainty, and exploration is predicted to produce learning progress -- and the FRONTIER of play MIGRATES across affordance spaces (bodily -> object -> compositional/causal -> social -> symbolic/counterfactual -> abstract) as learning progress in earlier spaces saturates, yielding an endogenous developmental curriculum rather than externally imposed stages. Mastery moves curiosity rather than extinguishing it; human neoteny is read as preservation of the developmental exploratory mode with progressively abstract objects. Explicitly NOT the strong equation play = information gain (play also serves bonding, practice, regulation, signalling).
ARC-136.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: an ecology with >=2 affordance spaces carrying measured learnable-uncertainty gradients (plus at least one unlearnable/stochastic trap region as discriminator bait); a reachable safe/satiated/no-urgent-commitment state; an intrinsic drive (learning-progress or epistemic-deficit flavoured) armed and reaching committed action selection. CONFIRMING (two legs): (1) play-without-play -- the safe, satiated, spare- capacity agent selects information-yielding actions above matched-random, preferentially sampling LEARNABLE uncertainty over novel-but-stochastic traps; (2) frontier migration -- as prediction error in space k saturates, exploration mass shifts toward space k+1 WITHOUT stage-specific rewards, yielding an emergent ordering. FALSIFYING: exploration tracks raw novelty/stochastic traps (random-wandering degeneration); no migration despite measured saturation (frozen or uniform allocation); or migration obtainable only with externally imposed stage rewards -- which would instead support ARC-019's explicit-gates reading.

ARC-137.subject: sleep.typed_offline_transformation_taxonomy
ARC-137.title: Offline integration is a protected family of TYPED transformations, not a unitary replay update: retention/interference repair, representational reorganisation, recalibration/attribution repair, and behavioural-access repair are distinct offline OUTCOMES (a partition by what changed, not by which phase ran), and each requires its own declared WRITE TARGET, its own PROVENANCE CLASS for the content it may consume, and its own DISTAL WAKING READOUT. Replay is a transport and sampling operation shared by all four, never a sufficient description of the transformation any of them performs. Consequently a readout appropriate to one operation is not evidence about another: retention is shown by preserved or recovered competence after interference on old and transfer cases; reorganisation by changed relational transfer, equivalence-class behaviour, generalisation or state construction WITH trace/index continuity; recalibration by improved calibration or causal attribution under held-out outcomes, never by narrower uncertainty alone (a sharper but wrong posterior is a failure, and reduced ambivalence from attractor collapse or gate lockout must be separated from reduced ambivalence from evidence integration); and access repair by restored endogenous recruitment, fresh commitment, executed behaviour and ecological consequence while upstream content is held fixed.
ARC-137.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Each of the four typed offline operations must be separately inducible and its own distal waking readout separately measurable, and the interference/damage dose must be non-degenerate. V3-EXQ-994 shows this is not currently met on the one reachable leg: the WITHOUT arm never sustained a measurable interference dose (retention_score 0.9997, non_degenerate false).
CONFIRMING: Each operation moves its own readout and leaves the other three unmoved, with its declared write target and provenance class respected, so a readout appropriate to one operation is demonstrably not evidence about another. Manipulation: Selectively enable one offline operation at a time by restricting its declared write target and provenance class, then read all four distal waking readouts on each arm -- a four-by-four operation-by-readout matrix rather than a single replay-on/off contrast. Control: Replay-matched arms in which transport and sampling are identical across operations, so any readout difference is attributable to the transformation rather than to replay volume; plus a held-fixed-upstream-content arm for the access-repair leg. Required event: An offline bout in which exactly one of the four typed transformations (retention repair, representational reorganisation, recalibration/attribution repair, behavioural-access repair) is allowed to occur, with upstream content held fixed. DV: Readout specificity: each operation's own readout must move while the other three do not. Retention measured as preserved competence after interference on old and transfer cases; reorganisation as changed relational transfer with trace/index continuity; recalibration as improved calibration or causal attribution under held-out outcomes, never narrower uncertainty alone; access repair as restored endogenous recruitment, fresh commitment and executed behaviour.
FALSIFYING: A single readout moves under two or more operations, or one operation's readout moves when only another was enabled -- showing the four are not separable outcomes and replay-plus-one-readout is a sufficient description after all. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Only the retention leg has a harness (the SD-068 consolidation lesion harness and the EXT-007 ablation that produced V3-EXQ-994), and its one run was non-degenerate. No instrument records the provenance CLASS of consumed content or the declared write target per operation, and ARC-020's permissive list does not even name the access-route quantities the fourth operation would write (GFLAG-0128). Consumer / boundary: The offline transformation itself -- write target, provenance class and distal waking readout per operation -- not the replay transport that all four share. Existing ownership: ARC-020, MECH-529, MECH-273, SD-068, GFLAG-0128, V3-EXQ-994.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); Three of the four operations cannot be induced separately in V3 -- reorganisation is blocked on sleep GAP-2 and the unresolved SD-016 ContextMemory discrimination, and access repair has no permitted offline write target -- while the one reachable retention leg's only run returned non_degenerate false. No provenance-class or write-target instrument exists at any of the four. Secondary classes: R5, R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

ARC-138.subject: representation.regulation_first_developmental_organisation
ARC-138.title: Regulation-first representational organisation: the developmental ordering is machine -> regulation -> interaction -> organised experience -> knowledge -- a mature, detached, portable world model is a developmental ACHIEVEMENT reached only through interaction that the organism's own enduring regulatory constraints (continued existence, structural integrity, internal-state regulation, vulnerability, ability to effect change, control, attachment, causal uncertainty) generate and select, so the earliest useful organising axes of z_world are relations between external regularities and those constraints (what changes me / what I can change / what predicts harm or benefit / what is controllable / what persists / what belongs together); non-redundant prediction: agents with matched sensory statistics but different vulnerabilities or affordances develop systematically different latent organisations of the same environment, and if objective scene structure suffices they do not.
ARC-138.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: full resolution needs v4 regulation-first representation substrate,
  which does not exist (design doc only, status candidate). A V3 PROXY leg exists and has already
  been run once (V3-EXQ-1017, 2026-09-09) using the A/B/C matched-auxiliary design named in this
  claim's own notes (arms zworld_p0_generic / zworld_p0_matched_arbitrary / zworld_p0_regulatory_prox
  / zworld_p0_sd070_default against rawfield_ceiling and zworld_untrained controls, per
  INV-104/GOV-MATCHAUX-1). That run failed its own readiness gate (C0_objective_reaches_dv=False --
  the base objective never reached the DV at all, so no arm comparison is interpretable) and
  additionally used a headroom gate certified on the wrong cells (ws250_pca-minus-zworld_untrained
  at 0.1745 rather than the objective-CHOICE contrast the criteria test measures at 0.033) and an
  off-path unrefit sense-path probe (both defects recorded on INV-104's note for the same run). A
  RETEST fixing both defects is owed (pending_retest_after_substrate=true on this claim) but is not
  currently chipped or queued (see currency findings above) -- until it runs, even the PROXY
  question is unanswered, let alone the v4 claim.
CONFIRMING (v3 proxy leg, supportive only -- see caveat below): once C0 passes on a corrected
  retest, the regulatory-anchoring arm (zworld_p0_regulatory_prox) beats the matched-arbitrary
  control (zworld_p0_matched_arbitrary) on held-out agreement by more than the matched control's own
  noise floor (C1/C4-style contrasts in the V3-EXQ-1017 design), i.e. anchoring to regulatory
  constraints organises the probed latent better than an equally-resourced arbitrary anchor.
FALSIFYING (v3 proxy leg): with C0 met, the regulatory-anchoring arm is statistically
  indistinguishable from the matched-arbitrary control (C3_matched_control_flat, already TRUE in
  the defective 2026-09-09 run and needs re-confirming clean) -- compression/supervision alone
  explains the result as well as regulatory relevance does, which is exactly the red-team-5 null
  ("compression alone might explain representation") this claim must beat.
CAVEAT (per governance, 2026-09-09, already the disposition of record -- do not re-litigate): even
  a clean PROXY PASS is evidence for the v4 claim only in a weakened, supportive sense, never a
  resolution, because ARC-138 is probed here only through a v3 substrate that was never built to
  express the v4 regulation-first organisation this claim actually asserts. True resolution requires
  the v4 substrate to exist and be exercised.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: (a) the corrected V3 proxy retest runs and is autopsied (partial, supportive-only
  signal), AND (b) v4 regulation-first representation substrate is built per
  docs/architecture/regulation_first_representation.md (full resolution).

ARC-139.subject: architecture.mutual_legibility_without_representational_convergence
ARC-139.title: Integration does not require representational sameness, it requires selective mutual legibility: specialised cognitive subsystems may preserve distinct high-dimensional PRIVATE internal representations while coordinating through low-dimensional, context-sensitive communication subspaces and low-complexity transformations, so development can raise local specialisation and cross-system legibility AT THE SAME TIME rather than trading one against the other. Non-redundant prediction: a maturing REE shows rising local competence in E1/E2/hippocampus/E3 while GLOBAL representational similarity between them stays flat or falls, and increasing representational similarity between subsystems must therefore NOT be used as the default marker of maturation. This is an explicit ALTERNATIVE framing to ARC-121's shared epistemic-state object, not a refutation of it: one common object, specialised objects with a shared interface format, specialised objects joined by context-specific translation, and a hybrid invariant-core-plus-private-dimensions architecture all remain live, and ARC-121 must not be used to prejudge the question.
ARC-139.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: local competence must actually RISE over the measured developmental window in at least two subsystems (a flat-competence window cannot test 'specialisation and legibility rise together'), and the cross-system similarity measure must have demonstrated range (a measure pinned near zero or one passes vacuously). Source adequacy applies: V3-EXQ-1010 showed the observation -> z_world locus destroys decision-relevant content at encode, so it is not a usable legibility site.
CONFIRMING: over maturation, local competence in E1 / E2 / hippocampus / E3 rises while GLOBAL representational similarity between them stays flat or falls, AND mutual legibility measured as minimum bridge complexity (MECH-538) FALLS over the same window. Both halves required: rising competence with falling similarity and no legibility measure is compatible with fragmentation.
FALSIFYING: legibility improves only when representational similarity also rises (supports ARC-121's shared-object reading instead); OR competence and legibility trade off rather than rising together.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional -- the ML-10..ML-15 instruments and an adequate source are owed first.

ARC-140.subject: architecture.compensatory_realizability_recovery_without_restoration
