ARC-140.title: Compensatory realizability -- recovery without restoration: an adaptive organism should not be REQUIRED to recover by reconstructing its former internal state; the target property is the capacity to preserve or recover a useful function by REORGANIZING CAUSAL RESPONSIBILITY across internal processes rather than returning to one canonical implementation. Operational criterion: after perturbation, recovered behaviour must be accompanied by a demonstrably ALTERED DISTRIBUTION OF CAUSAL IMPORTANCE, not a hidden reconstruction of the original pathway -- evidenced by the original route remaining observably impaired, a different internal process becoming NECESSARY (selective re-ablation removes the recovered competence), and later restoration of the original route producing competition/redundancy/reorganisation rather than revealing it had silently returned. Requires a four-arm design -- no-intervention, restorative-normalization analogue, compensatory-amplification analogue (lesion left in place, the recruited substitute selectively strengthened), and a CONTROL-AMPLIFICATION arm strengthening a comparably sized non-compensatory process -- because without the fourth arm 'generic added capacity' is an unexcluded explanation of any recovery.
ARC-140.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (a null under any unmet one is uninterpretable, not evidence against):
  P1. A target competence stably above floor across seeds on a named DV, such that the chosen lesion
      produces an acute deficit larger than seed SD. V3 has no such pre-registered "lesionable
      competence" yet (CURRENT_FRONT 2026-09-25: D7 adaptive recovery untested).
  P2. A post-lesion LEARNER owned by the organism. At REEConfig defaults ree_core does no waking
      gradient learning (GFLAG-0491; native_waking_trainer_design_20260925.md). A script-owned
      retraining objective makes "the organism recruited S" indistinguishable from "the
      experimenter's objective recruited S"; such a run may be reported only as a labelled weaker
      variant, never as arm-1 evidence.
  P3. A REVERSIBLE, on-manifold lesion of route R (GOV-INTERVENE-1 construction discipline), so that
      the restoration arm and the post-adaptation restoration test can run.
  P4. A causal-importance instrument per candidate route (selective ablation delta on the DV),
      measured at baseline, ACUTE (frozen weights, immediately post-lesion) and ADAPTED -- the
      acute/adapted separation MECH-545 already consumes.
  P5. Pre-lesion redundancy: at least one alternative route S that already ENCODES task-relevant
      content but is not causally used (INV-105 encoded != causally used). The claim's question is
      "what previously available representation became newly consequential?"; with no candidate S
      there is nothing to recruit.

CONFIRMING (all four legs; the claim's own criteria): after lesioning R, the no-intervention arm
recovers a pre-registered fraction of the acute deficit while
  (i)  R stays impaired (its causal-importance share remains below baseline by the lesion margin --
       no covert restoration);
  (ii) a different route S becomes NECESSARY: re-ablating S in the adapted agent returns the DV to
       the acute-lesion level, whereas ablating S in the intact pre-lesion agent costs little;
  (iii) restoring R after adaptation yields competition / redundancy / reorganisation (shared or
       non-additive causal shares), not an instant collapse of S's share as if R had silently
       returned;
  (iv) the compensatory-amplification arm (lesion in place, S selectively strengthened) recovers
       MORE than the control-amplification arm (a non-compensatory process T of comparable size
       strengthened by the same manipulation). Without (iv) "generic added capacity" is unexcluded.
FALSIFYING: every recovering seed recovers by reconstituting R (R's causal share returns to
baseline); OR the recovered competence survives ablation of every candidate substitute (no
identifiable reallocation); OR control amplification matches compensatory amplification; OR, with
P1-P5 met and a learner present, no recovery occurs at all.
NOTES: "precision readiness" in the external source must not be equated with REE precision/gain --
the arm-3 amplification must be a named manipulation (e.g. output gain or learning rate on S),
reported separately from REE precision. UNBLOCKS WHEN: the native waking learner lands and a
competence is pre-registered as lesionable. A cheap `complex (probe-gated)` step is available
earlier: a redundancy census on a trained checkpoint (does task-relevant content exist in >= 2
routes, and which are causally used?) discharges P5 without building anything.

ARC-141.subject: society.culture_distributed_precommit_workspace
ARC-141.title: Culture as a distributed precommit workspace: culture functions partly as a shared precommit space in which many minds collectively generate, exchange, mutate and evaluate candidate beliefs, identities, norms and futures BEFORE those representations acquire full epistemic or behavioural commitment -- candidate trajectories need not originate within the individual organism, because another mind can construct a trajectory and transmit enough of its structure for a receiving predictive system to instantiate it. Fiction, drama, humour and science fiction are on this account not peripheral products of cognition but specialised cultural technologies for making otherwise costly regions of possibility space cognitively traversable, and the driver is that SEARCH IS MUCH CHEAPER THAN COMMITMENT. Proposed (explicitly non-universal, non-monotonic) cultural progression: unrepresentable -> representable only under protection -> hypothetically discussable -> socially negotiable -> propositionally credible -> behaviourally actionable -> committed. Science fiction is the clearest instance: externally generated long-horizon candidate trajectories reach E1/E3-like evaluation before the corresponding state has ever been directly sampled.
ARC-141.what_would_answer:
ARC-141 registers no falsifier of its own. Per its own notes, its empirical content is discharged
entirely through MECH-542 (and secondarily MECH-543, MECH-544): "this entry MUST NOT be cited as
independently confirmed by any pleasant result about fiction." Do not re-derive a standalone test;
this section states how the framing is confirmed or falsified IN THE DESIGN SENSE, at one remove.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-542's own precondition must be met first -- a built
linguistic/symbolic scenario-injection channel carrying an explicit source-frame tag, plus
hypothesis_tag (or a successor) instrumented as a per-component vector rather than one global
boolean (see MECH-542's what_would_answer P1-P2; not re-derived here). Neither exists in V3 as of
2026-09-25. Until then, ARC-141 is untestable even indirectly, and any claimed support drawn from
fiction/narrative research on humans (see literature note below) is at most consistent-with, never
confirming.

CONFIRMING (indirect, framing-level only): MECH-542's assay finds genuine variable-SELECTIVE
update under source framing (neither uniform nor absent) AND at least one of MECH-543 (enactment
dissociates from narrative) or MECH-544 (a characteristic source-tag-decay pathology appears) also
confirms -- i.e. the SAME computational machinery (source tagging + generative mode + hippocampal
rollout + E1/E3 commitment/precision) accounts for more than one of the previously
separately-studied phenomena the notes name (counterfactual simulation, vicarious learning,
humorous norm exploration, collective foresight). That convergence, not any single result, is
ARC-141's actual empirical content: a common explanation, not a redescription of one phenomenon.

FALSIFYING (design sense): (i) MECH-542 is tested and falsified (uniform-or-absent update
regardless of source frame) -- ARC-141 loses its only load-bearing discharge vehicle and carries no
independent support; or (ii) MECH-542 confirms in isolation but MECH-543/MECH-544 and the wider
named phenomena show NO common signature (each needs its own unrelated, ad hoc mechanism) -- ARC-141
is then descriptively redundant with MECH-542 and adds nothing beyond it.

ANTI-DEGENERACY GUARD (from the claim's own notes, restated as an explicit exclusion so it survives
digestion): a study or REE result showing SOME benefit of fiction/narrative/humour is NOT evidence
for ARC-141 unless it specifically demonstrates the common-mechanism convergence above. Treating
every beneficial effect of fiction as support is the exact failure mode the notes warn makes this
claim unfalsifiable.

LITERATURE STATUS (see currency finding above -- notes text is stale): a targeted review ran
2026-09-08, same day as registration, 4 entries tagged ARC-141 directly (McGraw & Warren 2010 benign
violation, conf 0.55, supports/indirect via SOC-HUM-1; Kidd & Castano 2013 fiction-improves-ToM plus
its failed replication Panero et al. 2017, conf 0.30, mixed -- flagged specifically as the pleasant
result the notes warn against over-reading; Green & Brock 2000 narrative transportation, conf 0.58,
supports; Hartung et al. 2017 n=1,742 null on fact/fiction framing, conf 0.70, supports the
selective- rather than global-switch reading). None of it independently supports ARC-141; all of it
bears on MECH-542's sub-predictions, consistent with "discharged through MECH-542."

ARC-142.subject: architecture.cognitive_contract_invariant_preserving_translation
ARC-142.title: The cognitive contract: a unified mind built from heterogeneous engines (E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus and later specialists, differing in representational geometry, temporal scale, compression level, learning dynamics and uncertainty representation) requires not a common latent space but an INVARIANT-PRESERVING CONTRACT -- a small set of relations I such that for any lossy translation x_A -> C_A(x_A) -> T_AB -> D_B -> x'_B, I(x_A) ~ I(x'_B), even though x'_B = x_A is meaningless across different spaces. The contract is relational / semantic, not representational: each engine may encode an invariant differently (explicit scalar, trajectory position, recurrent-state relation, geometric direction, ordering relation) so long as the relation is recoverable at the boundary when needed. It sits ABOVE the translation machinery and ABOVE schemas (cognitive contract -> representation / translation machinery -> schemas -> particular concepts, memories and environmental models): a schema rewrite, including offline reorganisation during sleep, changes WHAT the organism knows; contract failure changes WHETHER its subsystems can still understand one another. The contract specifies RECOVERABLE RELATIONSHIPS, never a fixed data structure or ontology -- engines encode invariants differently, new representational systems can be added, schemas reorganise, and contract dimensions may be added or retired. Its two failure poles are representation collapse (one canonical latent forced on every engine, destroying the specialisation that makes multiple engines useful) and cognitive fragmentation (engines keep exchanging tensors while progressively losing shared meaning -- computationally active, no longer one mind). Unity does not require representational sameness; it requires preservation of the relations that keep representations about the same cognitive world.
ARC-142.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least one inter-engine boundary instrumented well enough that a relation can be shown recoverable at it by the RECEIVER (INV-105 rung 3), not merely by an external probe; otherwise both 'contract preserved' and 'contract failed' are unobservable and every result is about the probe. As of 2026-09-15 no V3 boundary is so instrumented (the ML-10..ML-15 instruments that would supply it are owed).
CONFIRMING: engines maintain measurably DIFFERENT representational geometries (global similarity flat or falling) while a small, stable set of relations remains receiver-recoverable across their boundaries, and behavioural coherence tracks the relations rather than the geometry -- the thought's falsifiable claims 4-5 and the developmental prediction MECH-538 registers (specialisation and legibility rising together).
FALSIFYING (four of the thought's ten programme falsifiers falsify the claim rather than the method): (1) no reusable compact structure exists -- consumers repeatedly require unrelated task-specific exchange variables, nothing recurring across boundaries; (2) ordinary latent geometry is operationally enough -- receivers cheaply reconstruct every required distinction locally, so nothing must be preserved; (3) probe-only invariants dominate -- candidate information is externally decodable but unavailable to or unused by receivers (INV-105 rung 2 without 3/6); (10) boundary-specificity defeats a shared core (see ARC-144).
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional, unchanged from registration.

ARC-143.subject: development.developmental_vs_mature_capacity_envelope
ARC-143.title: The DEVELOPMENTAL capacity envelope is a design variable distinct from the MATURE capacity envelope, and REE must not infer the first from the second: the connection count, the number of candidate mappings, the size of the accessible transformation repertoire and the permissiveness of an interface that a developing organism needs in order to DISCOVER a useful organisation may each legitimately exceed what the mature organism retains, so imposing the mature bottleneck at developmental time zero can prevent the organism from discovering which distinctions and interfaces deserve to survive. This generalises MECH-362's subtractive trajectory from RECURRENT MEMORY CONNECTIVITY to the whole set of REE loci the thought names -- z_world, the E1/E2 interfaces, the hippocampal/replay pathways, goal/directive influence and E3 selection -- and states the consequence as a curriculum-design discipline: a developmental programme must declare, per locus, its developmental search capacity SEPARATELY from its mature architectural constraint, and the two need not be identical.
ARC-143.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least one REE locus must support a declared capacity envelope that can be set DIFFERENTLY for a developmental phase and the mature phase, with both settings instantiable and behaviourally exercised. As of 2026-09-15 zero loci do (no structural pruning, sparsification or capacity schedule in ree_core/), so any test is vacuous until then.
CONFIRMING: for at least TWO structurally different loci (one representation-side, one interface-side), a declared developmental envelope LARGER than the mature envelope yields a mature system at least as competent as the same mature envelope trained throughout, at matched final capacity and matched training compute. One locus is a fact about that locus, not a design commitment.
FALSIFYING: across the loci tested the larger developmental envelope never produces a better mature system, and in at least one case produces a worse one (irreversible early mistakes / pathological attractors) -- REE SHOULD then infer the developmental envelope from the mature one, vindicating current practice.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional (code absent, not signal-absorbed).

ARC-144.subject: architecture.cognitive_contract_boundary_indexed_obligations
ARC-144.title: The cognitive contract is BOUNDARY-INDEXED, not one flat universal header: for a handoff from subsystem A to subsystem B the obligation is I_AB = the relations B requires that B cannot cheaply and reliably reconstruct locally, so the contract is properly written as a family of TYPED OBLIGATIONS, C = { A -> B : I_AB, tolerated distortion, receiver capability, fallback behaviour }, one entry per directed interface. A sensory-to-world-model handoff, a hippocampal replay handoff, an E1-to-E2 predictive handoff and a control-plane handoff need not carry the same relational payload, and a relation may be obligatory at one boundary while being locally reconstructable -- and therefore omissible -- at another. The consequence that makes this more than bookkeeping: a DEEP SHARED CORE, if one exists, is an EMPIRICAL OVERLAP to be measured across many heterogeneous interfaces, never a premise; candidates such as value, salience, confidence, commitment and priority may be crucial at particular boundaries without being universal invariants of every internal representation, and a universal reading of the contract systematically over-states their status. Falsifier for the contract programme itself: if useful obligations exist at each boundary but their OVERLAP across the cognitive graph is negligible, boundary-specificity defeats a shared core and the contract is a set of interface specifications rather than an architecture of cognition.
ARC-144.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least TWO heterogeneous inter-engine interfaces instrumented with the SAME candidate relation and the SAME receiver-accessible recoverability measure (INV-105 grading), with the relation measurably present at at least one of them. One instrumented boundary, or a relation absent everywhere, leaves the claim untestable rather than false -- a single-boundary programme cannot distinguish boundary-indexed from universal.
CONFIRMING: a relation shown OBLIGATORY at one boundary (nuisance-controlled lesion produces the predicted deficit, MECH-545) and NOT obligatory at another (the receiver reconstructs it locally within its compute/latency budget at no behavioural cost), replicating across seeds; plus, over several boundaries, a measured OVERLAP set that is non-empty and smaller than the union -- obligations differ, and a core exists.
FALSIFYING, two outcomes in opposite directions, both count: (i) UNIVERSALITY -- every instrumented boundary requires the same obligation set with no relation ever locally reconstructable (the flat ARC-142 reading was right; the indexing is bookkeeping); (ii) the thought's falsifier 10 -- useful obligations exist per boundary but their overlap across the cognitive graph is negligible (no shared core; the contract is a set of interface specifications, not an architecture of cognition). ARC-144 survives only the middle.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional -- multi-boundary instrumentation does not exist and MECH-545's lesion pattern is unbuilt (code absent, not signal-absorbed).

ARC-145.subject: architecture.dynamic_information_governance_jurisdiction
ARC-145.title: Dynamic information governance: a complete inter-engine interface in REE requires THREE properties, not two -- (1) the decision-relevant content survives the sender's encoding, (2) sender and receiver are mutually legible so a constrained transformation between frozen endpoints exists (ARC-139 / MECH-537 / MECH-538), and (3) the exchange occurs under a routing state that grants the sender causal privilege over that receiver AT THAT MOMENT. Property (3) -- jurisdiction, or temporal/state ACCESS -- is a separate organisational level from content and from legibility, so a representation can be present, decodable, structurally connected to a downstream system, and still unable to affect it; and the corresponding repair is different in kind from an encoder fix or a bridge. The architectural consequence is that REE's effective interface graph is CONSTRUCTED rather than possessed: G_eff(t) is a function of wiring, representational geometry, control state and history, so the same computational substrate can belong to different effective networks at different times. SEPARABILITY FALSIFIER, which is the whole content of the commitment: if a static bridge between frozen endpoints restores the full behavioural phenotype irrespective of when the message is made available, level (3) is unnecessary and this commitment should be withdrawn in favour of ARC-139 plus MECH-539 alone.
ARC-145.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (the gate): at least one interface must exist at which levels 1 and 2 are ALREADY satisfied and measured -- a sender demonstrated to contain the decision-relevant content (INV-105 rungs 1-2 on a measured-adequate source; rawfield25 primary, trained z_world inadmissible per V3-EXQ-1010), a frozen receiver demonstrated not to use it natively (rung 3 fails), AND a constrained bridge demonstrated to restore receiver use with both endpoints continuously available (rung 4 succeeds). Without all three a jurisdiction reading is unavailable by construction, because content absence (1010's H-F) and consumer collapse (MECH-517) produce the same downstream null. Verified absent 2026-09-15: the instrument exists but no such locus has been measured -- so this commitment is not to be hardened before MECH-560's observational leg or MECH-561's diagnostic has produced a result at any locus.
CONFIRMING: at a locus satisfying the precondition, the SAME bridge with the SAME parameters restores held-out behavioural competence when the message is delivered under one organism state and fails when delivered under another, at matched message count, matched transmitted norm, matched receiver-local competence and matched episode phase -- and the state variable separating the two is not a property of either endpoint.
FALSIFYING: a static bridge between frozen endpoints restores the full behavioural phenotype irrespective of delivery timing or organism state (the family's own F2) -- levels 1-2 plus MECH-539 then exhaust interface completeness and this commitment is WITHDRAWN, not weakened.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional, with the sequencing gate above.

ARC-146.subject: language.routing_vs_affect_separation
ARC-146.title: Dorsal high-fidelity structured symbolic routing is architecturally distinct from the affective-coupling system, and a ventral interface binds affect to symbol: the pathway that carries language's structure and sequencing and the pathway that carries graded affective coupling are separate systems joined by a binding interface, so REE must not implement affect as a property of the symbolic route nor symbolic routing as a property of the affect stream. The claim is limited to the DISSOCIATION, which has clinical anchors (conduction aphasia impairs structured repetition while preserving comprehension; right-hemisphere lesions impair affective prosody while sparing propositional language), and deliberately does NOT assert the broader "lateralisation = incompatible-regime separation" or precision-vs-flexibility principle.
ARC-146.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a substrate with BOTH a discrete symbolic routing channel and a graded affective-coupling channel that can each be measured and perturbed independently. V3 has neither a symbolic route nor an affect-to-symbol binding interface (ARC-009 is a positioning claim; MECH-373 is V5+), so zero non-degenerate attempts are possible today.
CONFIRMING: lesioning or degrading the symbolic-routing channel degrades structured symbol sequencing (order, binding of arguments) while affect-conditioned social responses to the same inputs are preserved, AND the reverse lesion degrades affect-conditioned response while structured routing survives -- a double dissociation with the ventral interface as the only shared component.
FALSIFYING: any single perturbation that degrades both channels proportionally across all tested loci, or a demonstration that affect-to-symbol binding is recoverable from the symbolic route alone with no separate coupling channel -- the separation is then an implementation convenience, not an architectural commitment, and this entry should be withdrawn in favour of ARC-009 plus MECH-373.
Disposition 2026-09-16: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional.

ARC-147.subject: commitment.commit_type_taxonomy
ARC-147.title: Commits are TYPED: REE's commitment machinery must distinguish at least symbolic, embodied, social-witnessed, repair, grief, boundary and rumination commit types, because each carries a different cost, a different mismatch source (or none), a different residue consequence and a different arbitration-update path -- a single untyped commit-boundary token cannot represent that a symbolic partial commit and an embodied full commit of the same trajectory carry different risk and teach different things.
ARC-147.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a substrate that can emit at least two commit types with measurably different cost and mismatch source (minimally symbolic vs embodied). V3's commit machinery emits one untyped boundary token (MECH-061), so the precondition is not met.
CONFIRMING: an agent whose commit token carries a type field arbitrates differently across types in the ways the type predicts (symbolic commits update scores only on mismatch/witnessing; embodied commits also incur residue; repair and grief commits close prior residue rather than opening trajectories), and an ablation that collapses the type field to one value degrades exactly those distinctions.
FALSIFYING: collapsing the type field to a single untyped token leaves arbitration, residue and mismatch-handling behaviour unchanged across the listed cases -- the taxonomy is then descriptive labelling, not an architectural requirement, and this entry should be withdrawn in favour of MECH-061 alone.
Disposition 2026-09-16: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional.

ARC-148.subject: basal_ganglia.three_loop_rate_separation_under_async_load
ARC-148.title: Three-loop rate separation survives real asynchronous load (SD-006 phase 2).
ARC-148.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: SD-006 phase 2 (true asynchronous multi-rate execution) must be ACTIVE, not the phase-1 time-multiplexed substrate. A test run on phase-1-only substrate is uninformative BY CONSTRUCTION, not merely under-powered, and cannot be read as evidence either for or against this claim: EXQ-131's 2026-03-30 diagnosis established that synchronous polling produces an "E3 output freeze artifact" -- stale E3 state drives var_harm_eval_on to 1.05e-7, statistically indistinguishable from the ablated condition (0.00276), regardless of whether the three loops are genuinely rate-separated.
CONFIRMING signature: with SD-006 phase 2 active, E1/E2/E3 show measurably distinct and STABLE update-rate signatures (effective update frequency, or latency-drift-under-load) that persist without collapsing into lockstep when processing latency is varied. If EXQ-131's var_harm_eval-style discriminative-pair metric is still diagnostic once E3 state updates are genuinely asynchronous rather than time-multiplexed-stale, reuse it directly; if the phase-2 substrate changes how E3 state is exposed between ticks, replace it with realized inter-loop update-rate ratios under load plus a rate-drift measure under injected latency perturbation.
FALSIFYING signature: even with SD-006 phase 2 active, the three loops show no measurable rate distinction under nominal conditions, or drift into lockstep (or an undifferentiated rate) once processing latency is varied -- i.e. rate separation exists only as configured periods and collapses under any real asynchronous load. In that case the thalamic-clock coherence mechanism is architecturally decorative rather than functionally necessary.

ARC-149.subject: architecture.affordance_valuation_bridge
ARC-149.title: An affordance-and-valuation bridge is architecturally NECESSARY between the world model and the commitment boundary: the representation E3 arbitrates over must be an intermediate, action-conditioned structure -- what this organism can now do in this world, annotated with predicted consequences -- and not a direct map from z_world to a policy distribution. The decomposition is observation -> z_world / E1-E2 -> affordance-and-action geometry -> competing approach / avoidance / investigation tendencies -> E3 / commitment boundary -> motor policy. The bridge is not a new selector placed beside E3 and not a motor-primitive library (SD-044 supplies primitives; the bridge says which are currently viable from this body-state in this world-state); it is the terrain on which world modelling, valuation, responsibility and commitment meet. SEPARABILITY FALSIFIER, which is the whole content of this commitment: if a direct z_world -> policy mapping at matched capacity and compute reproduces the FULL behavioural phenotype -- not merely task reward, but counterfactual sensitivity, anticipation of consequence, reversibility, repair, and the ability to account internally for why a higher-reward action was not committed -- then no intermediate action-conditioned representation is warranted and this commitment should be withdrawn in favour of ARC-002 plus MECH-125 alone. A reward-only win for the bridge does not confirm it; a reward-only loss does not refute it.
ARC-149.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (this is the SHARED gate for the whole 2026-09-18
affordance-bridge group -- MECH-575 / MECH-576 / MECH-577 reference this paragraph
and deliberately do not re-derive it): the PHENOTYPE BATTERY that decides the
verdict must be LIVE and differentiating BEFORE either arm is run. This claim's
own title rules a reward comparison inadmissible in both directions, so the
deciding metric is the battery, not reward, and a battery with no variance makes
every falsifier in this group vacuous at once.
  (a) Each battery measure -- counterfactual sensitivity, anticipation of
      consequence, reversibility, repair, and internal accounting for a rejected
      higher-reward action -- must show non-zero cross-seed variance on the
      BASELINE arm alone, established before any bridge arm is run. A measure
      pinned at floor or ceiling on the baseline cannot discriminate, and a run
      scored on such a battery is vacuous regardless of which arm wins.
  (b) At least one battery measure must be demonstrably DISSOCIABLE FROM TASK
      REWARD on the baseline arm. A battery that is a monotone function of reward
      silently reduces this test to the reward-only comparison the title
      explicitly rules out.
  (c) The "repair" and "internal accounting" columns require behavioural events
      that actually occur: a non-zero count of trajectories in which a
      higher-reward action was available and NOT committed, and a non-zero count
      of recoverable failures. Zero of either makes those columns UNSCOREABLE --
      they are reported as unscoreable, never as ties.
  (d) MATCHED CAPACITY must be DEFINED AND PRE-REGISTERED before the run, not
      argued after it: parameter count, latent dimensionality and optimiser budget
      each separately matched, or the mismatch stated. The entire content of this
      commitment is a matched-capacity contrast, so an unpinned capacity
      definition makes the result unfalsifiable in exactly the direction that
      matters -- the losing side can always claim the comparator was
      under-resourced.
NAMED INERT-INSTRUMENT RISK, recorded because this group's deciding metrics run
through machinery that is known not to carry them: V3's action-object space
o_t = E2.action_object(z_world, action) (ree-v3
ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py:571) takes no self-state argument, so any battery
column whose variation runs through body state is pinned at zero BY CONSTRUCTION
on V3 substrate. See MECH-575's precondition (i) for the full consequence. A null
produced that way measures the instrument, not the mechanism.

CONFIRMING: at matched, pre-registered capacity, the bridge arm exceeds the direct
z_world -> policy arm on the battery above, on at least TWO battery measures whose
baseline variance was established under (a), with the advantage surviving a
capacity-matched control that adds the bridge's parameters as undifferentiated
depth rather than as an action-conditioned intermediate. Because this commitment
is a NEGATIVE EXISTENTIAL ("no direct map suffices"), a single win can never
confirm it: the admissible confirming statement is "survives the N pre-registered
direct-map comparators", with N and the comparator family fixed in advance.

FALSIFYING: a direct z_world -> policy mapping at matched capacity and compute
reproduces the FULL battery -- not merely task reward -- at which point this
commitment is WITHDRAWN, not weakened, in favour of ARC-002 plus MECH-125 alone,
exactly as the title states.
Two outcomes that are explicitly NOT falsifying and must not be recorded as such:
  - a reward-only win for the direct map (the title rules it out, in terms);
  - a bridge-arm loss on a battery whose precondition (a)-(c) was unmet -- that is
    substrate_not_ready / measurement_test_design_defect, not a verdict on this
    claim.

SUBSTRATE NOTE (why this is substrate-blocked rather than merely unqueued): the
battery's own instruments do not exist. "Repair" and "internal accounting for a
rejected higher-reward action" have no V3 readout; retention of rejected
candidates past their rejection tick is MECH-487, registered and unbuilt. The
"DO NOT build in V3 / DO NOT queue an experiment" note on this claim is therefore
correct for a nameable reason, not as a generic caution.

Disposition 2026-09-22: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional. Version
routing (v4 as registered vs the source thought's "V3 assays first") remains an
OPEN /governance decision and is not resolved here.

ARC-150.subject: representation.triadic_self_other_object_coreference
ARC-150.title: Triadic co-reference primitive (declarative joint attention / synchronic two-slot identification): the agent can hold its OWN slot and ONE OTHER agent's slot simultaneously bound to a SINGLE shared object referent, for no instrumental reason. This relational self-other-object binding -- not a stable self (ARC-081) and not a generic object-persistence buffer (ARC-080 PILLAR 1) -- is the developmental prerequisite otherness inference (ARC-083) and theory of mind actually run through. It sits on ARC-080's slot-allocation machinery as a binding operation over two concurrently-live slots plus one object token.
ARC-150.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a multi-agent substrate (ARC-047 SocialGridWorld or successor) with at
least one other agent, a shared object the other can attend to, and an attention/orientation
readout for BOTH agents -- plus ARC-080 slots able to hold a second agent slot concurrently. Without
a second agent whose attention is observable, the primitive cannot be exercised and any null is
vacuous.
CONFIRMING: agents with the triadic binding available acquire otherness inference (MIRROR-1
OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging) and downstream other-state prediction faster or more robustly than agents
lacking it, AND a readout of "self and other co-attending the same token" predicts later
other-modelling competence better than a self-stability readout does (the Sodian 2015 structure,
reproduced in-agent).
FALSIFYING: otherness inference and other-state prediction develop equally well with the triadic
binding lesioned (only dyadic self->object and other->object tracking available); or the
self-stability readout, not the co-reference readout, carries the predictive path.
SUBSTRATE: NOT BUILT. No multi-agent environment in ree_core; no concurrent second agent slot.
Registration is not build authorisation.

ARC-151.subject: plasticity.gate_polarity_default_blocked_derepression
ARC-151.title: Plasticity gates in REE are DEFAULT-BLOCKED (de-repression polarity), not admission windows: a teaching signal of any kind (reward prediction error, harm prediction error, novelty, salience, social or affective discrepancy) is a proposal whose only effect is to RELEASE a write that is already staged at, and carried by, its target -- it neither carries the write's content nor opens a window through which writes flow -- so the gate's specificity lives on the TARGET (what is staged there and what release it requires) rather than on a type assigned to the event. The gate family REE already registers at channel, event, tag and window grain (MECH-261, MECH-368, MECH-431, MECH-453, MECH-067) is to be read with this polarity, so that any gate-controller failure -- a missing, late or malformed release -- fails CLOSED (the write stays blocked), whereas an admission-phrased gate of the same nominal permeability can fail OPEN.
ARC-151.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (a null under any unmet one is uninterpretable, not evidence against):
  P1. A durable write path on which writes can be STAGED at targets and RELEASED, with a gate
      controller that can be faulted (dropped, delayed or corrupted release events; stuck
      controller). No such path exists in ree_core today: MECH-368/MECH-431/MECH-453 are unbuilt, and
      MECH-261's write_gate() is a continuous multiplier in [0,1] with no staged-write concept.
  P2. The same gate implementable in both polarities at MATCHED nominal permeability (same fraction
      of proposals released in fault-free operation), so the comparison is polarity, not strictness.
  P3. At least one protected target whose unauthorised write is measurable (write audit, MECH-067's
      phase/store/actor audit is the natural instrument).
CONFIRMING: under injected controller faults, the de-repression implementation produces zero (or a
pre-registered near-zero) unauthorised durable writes into protected targets while the matched
admission implementation produces unauthorised writes (stuck-open window); in fault-free operation
the two are matched on acquisition and retention within a pre-registered margin (the polarity is
free when the controller works); and a single broadcast release signal produces writes ONLY at
targets carrying a staged write, not at every recently-active target (target-carried specificity).
FALSIFYING: (a) matched fault injection yields no difference in unauthorised writes between the two
polarities -- the polarity is a relabelling; OR (b) the de-repression implementation loses
acquisition in fault-free operation beyond the margin with no fault-time safety gain; OR (c)
target-carried specificity confers no advantage over event-typed specificity on interference or
unauthorised-write counts.
Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment proposed.

ARC-152.subject: plasticity.target_depth_graded_release
ARC-152.title: Plasticity release in REE is indexed on the DEPTH of the write target, not only on the teaching signal, the actor or channel, or the phase: the same admitted, real-provenance teaching signal may be released into a shallow target (transient activation, salience weight, local transition model) while its write into a deep target (self/other model, goal structure, ethical constraint, identity invariant) stays blocked, and the RELEASE REQUIREMENT grows monotonically with depth -- deeper targets need more independent release conditions (corroboration across episodes, offline integration, verifier-mediated commit) before a write is released. This extends REE's existing authority stratification (INV-020, MECH-064, MECH-067, ARC-020), which is keyed on actor, channel and phase, to ORDINARY EXPERIENTIAL LEARNING, and generalises MECH-511's two-level local-vs-deep E1 routing to an ordered target index. It does NOT make deep targets less plastic: write magnitude once released is governed separately (MECH-592), and INV-056's retained plasticity of social, goal and epistemic-ethical substrates must survive the grading.
ARC-152.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS:
  P1. At least two targets of DIFFERENT depth writable from one teaching signal in one run, with a
      depth-indexed release requirement settable per target. Not met in V3: no POL/ID/CAPS stores
      (V3-EXQ-1052), no self/other-model store, and no depth-indexed release anywhere in ree_core.
  P2. An out-of-loop measurement of deep-target drift the learning process cannot optimise against
      (INV-093 panel correction (4), Pan/Bhatia/Steinhardt 2022 proxy-vs-true pattern).
  P3. A training stream that contains BOTH a sustained misleading teaching signal (reward-hacking-
      or injection-shaped, arriving through an ordinary experiential channel, not a user/LLM actor
      channel that INV-020/MECH-064 already stratify) AND a genuine persistent environmental change.
CONFIRMING: the depth-graded agent adapts shallow targets as fast as an ungraded control, shows bounded
deep-target drift under the misleading signal where the ungraded control drifts, AND still updates its
deep targets under the genuine change once the extra release conditions are met (not frozen).
FALSIFYING: (a) the ungraded control shows no more deep-target drift at matched shallow plasticity --
actor/channel/phase stratification already suffices and depth indexing is redundant; OR (b) the graded
agent's deep targets fail to update under the genuine change -- grading has become uniform hardening
of social/goal/ethical substrates, which INV-056 forbids (this is INV-056's own falsifier (c) seen from
the other side); OR (c) the monotone ordering fails -- some intermediate target needs a LOOSER release
requirement than a shallower one with no measured cost.
OPEN, carried here (intake's Q "depth at which governance becomes mandatory"): the depth at which a
verifier-mediated commit (MECH-067) becomes a required release condition is not specified by this claim.
Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment proposed.

ARC-153.subject: ethics.plasticity_selection_governs_self_modification
ARC-153.title: REE's ethical architecture governs which experiences may alter the agent, not only which actions it takes: at runtime, the harm- and residue-bearing signals REE already carries -- not a separate ethics module or moral score (INV-001) -- are inputs to plasticity RELEASE for deep targets (ARC-152), and this runtime plasticity selection, rather than design-time evaluation alone or action-selection ethics alone, is the mechanism by which INV-093's floor (competence refinement must not trade away harm sensitivity, residue accumulation or commitment integrity) is held during ongoing learning. An agent whose ethics act only at action selection, with ungated experiential learning, can learn its way out of its own harm sensitivity while every individual action it takes is still ethically selected.
ARC-153.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS:
  P1. A deep target store holding the INV-093-protected quantities (harm sensitivity, residue
      accumulation, commitment integrity) that ORDINARY experiential learning can reach -- not only a
      user/LLM or exteroceptive channel, which INV-020/MECH-064 already stratify.
  P2. Harm/residue signals wired as inputs to that store's release (ARC-152); unbuilt.
  P3. INV-093's panel instruments: an out-of-loop, off-distribution harm probe the refinement cannot
      optimise against (INV-093 corrections 2 and 4) and a competence-acquisition floor (correction 3;
      MECH-471's EVB-0579 is blocked on exactly this floor, 2/16 seeds).
CONFIRMING: two agents matched on action-selection ethics and on competence gain; under ordinary,
benign refinement (the Qi et al. 2024 shape cited on INV-093's lane: benign fine-tuning degraded safety),
the agent whose deep-target release takes harm/residue inputs holds the INV-093 floor while the
action-only-ethics agent's out-of-loop harm sensitivity erodes.
FALSIFYING: (a) the action-only-ethics agent holds the floor equally -- erosion does not occur under
ordinary refinement on REE, or is fully prevented by actor/channel stratification (INV-020/MECH-064) --
and this bridge is redundant; OR (b) the ethics-input release gate freezes moral learning, violating
INV-056's epistemic-ethical plasticity.
POSSIBLE V3 DIAGNOSTIC (flagged for /governance, not decided here): leg (a)'s premise -- does harm
sensitivity actually erode under ordinary refinement on REE? -- is an INV-093 panel measurement that needs
no new gate. If erosion is absent on REE, this claim loses its motivation.
Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment proposed.

ARC-154.subject: e3.da_ach_coordination_layer
ARC-154.title: E3's basal-ganglia commitment includes a DA-ACh COORDINATION layer that is separable both from the signals it coordinates (the dopaminergic teaching signal and the cholinergic TAN-pause window, MECH-453) and from action selection: it sets the temporal coupling between the two, and thereby which recently-active policy traces (MECH-452) are reinforced and how PERSISTENTLY the reinforced write sticks. Its setpoint is a GAIN WITH AN INTERIOR OPTIMUM that trades acquisition speed against effort and persistence recalibration -- it is NOT tuned to maximise learning rate, and a design that tunes it for fastest learning optimises a quantity the biology declines to optimise. With action selection (ARC-107/MECH-449), reinforcement marking (MECH-452) and plasticity permission (MECH-453, MECH-368) already registered as separate operations, this layer supplies the two not yet owned: write-persistence (flexibility) tuning and effort recalibration of the written policy. Scoped to E3/BG procedural policy writes.
ARC-154.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS:
  P1. A MECH-453 window that actually gates (a measurable fraction of recently-active components
      excluded when closed, with cross-event variance in what is admitted). Not met: ARC-108 learned
      gating is live in ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py with eligibility traces and a MECH-094 waking
      gate, but there is no window -- the update is continuous when waking.
  P2. The coordination parameter swept across >= 4 levels, perturbable WITHOUT changing DA-signal
      magnitude, window width, or the selector (else separability is untestable).
  P3. An effort/time-to-reward adjustment readout and a post-contingency-change recalibration readout,
      alongside acquisition.
  P4. Closed-loop stability monitored: DA must be able to modulate window duration (Kim 2019), and runs
      in which the loop oscillates or collapses are reported, not dropped.
CONFIRMING: (i) perturbing the coordination parameter moves acquisition and effort/persistence
recalibration in OPPOSITE directions (the Uribe-Cano shape: Smo ablation promotes motor learning but
alters effort allocation); (ii) an interior setpoint beats the fastest-learning setpoint on a
pre-registered combined acquisition + recalibration-after-contingency-change score; (iii) the layer is
perturbable with DA magnitude and selector held fixed.
FALSIFYING: (a) no trade-off -- the fastest-learning setting also recalibrates best, i.e. the layer is a
learning-rate knob after all; OR (b) perturbing it is indistinguishable from rescaling DA magnitude or
window width -- not a separable layer, collapse into MECH-453 parameters; OR (c) the closed loop is
unstable at every setpoint that has any effect.
Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment proposed.

ARC-155.subject: control_plane.scale_relative_operating_points
ARC-155.title: A control operating point (threshold, cap, saturation constant, or cost weight) that reads a LEARNED quantity -- a latent magnitude, prediction error, salience, effort, confidence or threat signal whose distribution moves across training, seeds, developmental stage and state -- must be denominated on an endogenous estimate of that quantity's own scale (or on a producer whose scale is anchored), not on an absolute raw constant; otherwise the regime it gates is determined by arbitrary numerical scale rather than information content, and degenerates to permanent crossing, permanent silence, saturation (a graded transform collapsing to a gain change), or scale-determined dominance between controllers. The denomination must preserve the condition-relevant discrimination of the signal: an operating point that stabilises regime occupancy by habituating to a chronically high signal (normalising real danger into 'baseline') violates this claim rather than satisfying it, and no denomination can restore information the producer has already lost.
ARC-155.what_would_answer:
DIGESTED 2026-09-26 (thought-intake-20260926). DISPOSITION: kept substrate_conditional. The drafting
agent's call was (a) testable-now, but P1 and P4 are unmet today (freeze-lock confirmer not yet reported;
1107 showed ||z_harm_a|| constant). Move to standard and mint a proposal once both are met on the chosen
channel.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (a null under any unmet one is uninterpretable, not evidence against):
  P1. INFORMATION CONTENT. The controlled channel carries condition-relevant information at EVERY
      checkpoint tested: e.g. for the PAG gate, raw ||z_harm_a|| separates hazard-adjacent (d<=1) from far
      (d>=2) states at d' >= 0.5 at each checkpoint. V3-EXQ-1107 recorded ||z_harm_a|| IDENTICAL on all 90
      eval ticks, and cea_onset_input_reprobe_20260925.md (GFLAG-0557) found relative gates on z_harm_a below
      their own floor, so P1 may be UNMET for z_harm_a after training. If it is unmet, the channel has a
      producer/validity problem, not an operating-point problem; move the test to a channel with validated
      content and do not score ARC-155 on it.
  P2. SCALE DRIFT. The channel's own running scale (median |x| over non-reset ticks) differs by >= 3x across
      the sampled checkpoints OR across seeds (measured magnitudes: 1107 2.8-4.2 vs theta 0.8; mode trace
      0.14-0.20 untrained vs 12-17 after the harm_accum aux; 1108 norm x10.5-12 within a lifetime). With no
      drift, a fixed and an adaptive operating point are equivalent by construction.
  P3. REACH. Either the regime occupancy itself is the DV, or the consumer's output varies the executed
      action (the 1090 action-diversity lesson).
  P4. HYGIENE. Post-STAY-fix code (GFLAG-0508). Near-reset ticks excluded, or the reset-init EMA fix ON
      (GFLAG-0559). The freeze-lock confirmer (chip-20260926-pag-freeze-lock-confirmer) has reported.

DESIGN (first test site: MECH-279 PAG freeze gate; >= 3 training checkpoints x >= 5 seeds, same curriculum):
  A  shipped absolute operating point (theta_freeze 0.8).
  B  operating point denominated on an endogenous slow running scale estimate of the SAME signal
     (e.g. theta_eff = k x running high-quantile of the organism's own ||z_harm_a|| history, slow timescale,
     k fixed ONCE on checkpoint 1 of a calibration seed not scored). No condition labels.
  C  ORACLE ceiling: absolute theta hand-set per checkpoint from that checkpoint's distribution
     (GOV-INTERVENE-1 oracle positive control; not a candidate mechanism).
  D  COMPETING ACCOUNT: absolute theta, with the PRODUCER's scale anchored (a magnitude-anchored encoder
     objective, or harm_accum aux off). This tests whether consumer-side denomination is needed at all.
DVs, scored post hoc by the experimenter from logged positions:
  (i)   occupancy: fraction of non-reset ticks in the regime, per checkpoint x seed; pre-registered band
        [0.02, 0.60] (neither never nor always).
  (ii)  discrimination: occupancy(hazard-adjacent) - occupancy(far) -- preserves absolute-danger meaning.
  (iii) seed dispersion of occupancy at each checkpoint.

CONFIRMING: With P1-P4 met, B keeps occupancy inside the band on >= 4/5 seeds at EVERY checkpoint where A
leaves it (pinned at ~0 or ~1). B's discrimination (ii) is >= 70% of C's at each checkpoint and above A's.
B's advantage vanishes under a content-shuffled channel control (time-permuted ||z_harm_a|| fed to the
gate): normalising an uninformative signal must NOT look like success.

FALSIFYING (any one):
  (F1) With P2 met, A stays inside the band with discrimination at every checkpoint and seed (fixed raw
       points are stable after all).
  (F2) B stabilises occupancy only by erasing discrimination -- (ii) ~ 0, i.e. it habituates chronic
       danger into baseline.
  (F3) NARROWING, not demotion: D matches B on (i)-(iii). The defect is producer scale, and ARC-155 narrows
       to an encoder-anchoring claim.

NOTE: the 1067 autopsy's warning applies. Do not score gradedness of a DISCRETE register (SD-032a is
discrete by design); score occupancy and discrimination.

ARC-156.subject: control_plane.regime_surviving_termination_evidence
ARC-156.title: A strong regime that suppresses the organism's normal interaction or information gathering (freeze, defensive mode, exploit-only or monostrategic policy, habitual dominance, attentional fixation, frozen plasticity, strong commitment, a high-confidence attractor) must have at least one endogenous termination input that continues to change DURING the regime -- time- or interoception-integrating accumulators, exogenous change the organism can sense without acting, or internally generated probes -- because a regime whose exit condition is a function only of evidence produced by the behaviour it suppresses is absorbing in any environment that does not change on its own. This evidence-STARVATION route to termination failure is distinct from evidence CORRUPTION (a process degrading its own gating variable, MECH-497); the two can co-occur, and a fix for one does not fix the other.
ARC-156.what_would_answer:
DIGESTED 2026-09-26 (thought-intake-20260926). DISPOSITION: (b) derivational for the structural core.
The empirical freeze leg is owned by MECH-279/MECH-280 and is substrate_ceiling through MECH-280's unbuilt
override; the N5 leg belongs to the coupled-loop campaign. Does NOT reopen MECH-287b (option A stands).

DERIVATIONAL CORE (no experiment needed): if the environment state that the exit condition depends on
does not change without the agent's action, and the exit condition reads only observations whose change
requires actions the regime removes, then the regime is an absorbing state. V3-EXQ-1106 is the measured
instance: 0 release-source events while frozen on 3/3 seeds, predicted in writing by the build doc.
The empirical claim is that REE's strong regimes need, AND benefit from, a source that survives the regime.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS:
  P1. LEGITIMATE ENTRY. The regime is entered condition-sensitively, not by miscalibration: freeze entry
      rate is higher hazard-adjacent than far. The 1107 tick-1 lock fails P1. Apply the ARC-155 correction or
      the confirmer's recalibration first, otherwise "release" is only undoing a bad entry.
  P2. SUPPRESSION MEASURED. The candidate regime-SUPPRESSED release inputs are near-silent in-regime
      (e.g. MECH-287 option-B source events in-regime vs out-of-regime; 1106: 0 vs >0).
  P3. ECOLOGY WITH BOTH OUTCOMES. Episodes where termination is appropriate (the hazard departs or decays
      independently of the agent) and episodes where continuation is appropriate (the hazard stays). The
      hazard dynamics are agent-independent and never visible as a label.
  P4. A SURVIVING SOURCE EXISTS IN SUBSTRATE. Candidates: SD-012 drive_level (energy depletes while
      frozen); time-in-regime; MECH-482 epistemic_deficit; exteroceptive change sensed without moving
      (the z_harm_s / hazard field when the hazard itself moves). MECH-280, the registered freeze instance,
      is UNBUILT (substrate_ceiling; SD-037 override never built, GFLAG-0506), so P4 for the freeze leg
      currently requires a build decision owned by MECH-280.

DESIGN (freeze leg; >= 5 seeds):
  A  exit reads only regime-suppressed evidence (the shipped MECH-279 exit and/or MECH-287 option B).
  B  A + one regime-surviving endogenous input (interoceptive drive or exteroceptive hazard change) in the
     exit condition.
  C  condition-blind terminator: fixed max duration (pag_max_freeze_duration), with its mean duration
     matched to B's.
  D  no release.
DVs: termination appropriateness = P(terminate | hazard departed) - P(terminate | hazard stayed) within
a window. Time-to-terminate. Post-release harm.

CONFIRMING: A ~ D (both lock, or both terminate at chance). B's appropriateness exceeds C's by a
pre-registered margin on >= 4/5 seeds. Ablating B's surviving input returns A's behaviour.

FALSIFYING:
  (F1) A terminates appropriately from regime-generated signals alone -- the premise that this regime
       starves its own exit evidence is false.
  (F2) B's appropriateness is no better than C's -- the surviving input adds duration, not information,
       and termination here is a timer question.
  (F3) B terminates only by being condition-blind.

SECOND LEG (N5, owned by the coupled-loop campaign, not queued from here): the N5b clamped-pair test of an
active-probing detector vs on-policy surprise. The same logic applies: the probe is the regime-surviving
source, and it must separate shift from no-shift where on-policy surprise does not.

ARC-157.subject: development.developmental_prior_classification
ARC-157.title: Every candidate developmental prior in REE is classified on two INDEPENDENT axes -- candidate-necessary vs developmental accelerator (improves speed, stability or robustness but is dispensable or derivable in principle), and environment-general vs environment-specific -- with enabling architecture (plasticity, memory, temporal representation, an action interface, self/world state, a route from learned models to action selection) held out as a separate class that is not a prior; and when development fails, interventions are admitted in order of increasing environment-specificity (structured endogenous exploration, then general contingency / information-seeking mechanisms, then memory / plasticity mechanisms, and only then environment-specific priors), so that a required environment-specific prior is recorded as an ecological finding about that environment ('this world could not be reliably developed into under the current general set without additional ecological information') rather than as an innate requirement. Inherited structure is preferentially PROCEDURAL (how to discover a world: vary action enough to see its consequences, credit changes that follow one's own action, preserve regularities, reopen them when they stop predicting) rather than ONTOLOGICAL (what the world contains).
ARC-157.what_would_answer:
DIGESTED 2026-09-26 (thought-intake-20260926). DISPOSITION: (c) substrate_conditional -- measurable only
with world-family replication and a full ablation harness. Design value now: read it before adding an
environment-specific prior to rescue a failed development run. If /governance prefers, the admission-order
half can be re-disposed as a governance_rule.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS:
  P1. At least TWO predeclared world families that differ along a stated ecological axis
      (GOV-ECOL-1). Without them "environment-general" cannot be measured, and the generality axis is
      vacuous by construction.
  P2. An ablation harness where each classified mechanism is a separable default-OFF lever (shared
      with Q-112 P2).
  P3. A pre-registered classification rule, fixed BEFORE results:
        - necessary = removal produces a specific predicted developmental failure;
        - accelerator = removal only changes rate, stability or variance;
        - general = its necessity/acceleration status is the same across both world families;
        - environment-specific = its status changes across families, or its content names an
          environment feature.
      Without the rule fixed first, the classification is post hoc labelling.

CONFIRMING:
  (i) The axes are independent. At least one mechanism lands in each of two OFF-DIAGONAL cells (e.g.
      a general accelerator such as retained replay or learning-progress curiosity, AND a mechanism
      whose necessity holds in one world family but not the other).
  (ii) The admission order does work. In a world family where the general set fails to develop, an
      environment-specific scaffold restores development, and that scaffold's necessity vanishes in
      the other family.
  (iii) The content-generality clause holds for the survival interrupt. An interrupt keyed to
      valued-self-state deterioration protects development in both families, while a feature-keyed
      interrupt protects it only in the family whose feature it names.

FALSIFYING:
  - The axes COLLAPSE. Every mechanism classifies identically across both world families (the
    generality axis carries no information), OR necessity and generality are perfectly confounded
    (every necessity is general and every accelerator is specific, or the reverse). Then one axis
    suffices and the two-axis commitment is wrong.
  - The admission order is VACUOUS. No general set ever develops without an environment-specific
    scaffold in any world family, so "least-specific first" never selects anything.
  - A feature-keyed survival interrupt transfers as well as a self-state-keyed one across families.
    The content-generality constraint is then unnecessary.

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT:
  - a second world family, declared along an ecological axis;
  - the Q-112 ablation levers;
  - DEV-NEED register columns for necessity/accelerator and general/specific.
    That is a doc deliverable, and a prerequisite for (ii), because otherwise nothing records which
    scaffolds were admitted.
Existing ownership: SD-090, GOV-ECOL-1, GOV-INSERT-1, developmental_needs_register.md.

EXT-002.subject: llm.hallucination
EXT-002.title: Hallucination: no persistent error residue accumulates to shape future outputs.
EXT-002.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (a null under any unmet one is uninterpretable, not evidence against):
  P1. revisit_outcome_heterogeneity >= FLOOR_REVISIT_HETEROGENEITY (0.10) on every pooled cell --
      the 983a-ratified PreconditionSpec (v3_exq_983a...py:614). V3-EXQ-1036's 3-seed draw failed
      this on all ten arm_results cells (max 0.0909); "983a's already-ratified screen would have
      rejected 100% of this run's population" (1036 autopsy Section 4).
  P2. Per-seed action-stream divergence > 0 (983a autopsy learning #4). 1036's two zero-gap seeds
      had divergence 0.00138 / 0.00323, inside 983a's own "did not reach behaviour" bucket -- not
      evidence of a DV floor, evidence the manipulation never reached executed behaviour.
  P3. MIN_POOLED_SEEDS >= 3 with EFFECTIVE n reported separately from the pooled-seed count. 1036
      banked n=3 nominal but effective n=1 (two of three cells were bit-identical revisit streams
      across arms).
  P4. Hold-aware key registration: harm accrued on a HELD e3 tick (9 of 10 decision ticks under
      default MECH-093 modulation) must be attributed to the governing FRESH-decision key.
      983a logged first_harm_at only on fresh ticks -- seed 31 logged 330 harm events and 0 erred
      keys under that gap.
  P5. Residue-field capacity: the harm-event count spanned by the pre/post comparison window
      should not approach num_basis_functions=32, or center eviction (independently measured in
      mech023_residue_geometry_substrate_blocked_20260917.md: 28 ring wraps over 720 steps at
      62.5% harm-step density) confounds "residue erased" with "residue relocated."
CONFIRMING: with P1-P5 met, the intact-residue arm (A0) shows a lower hold-aware repeat-visit rate
to erred keys than the residue-frozen arm (A1) at a magnitude exceeding a control-arm-derived bar
(NOT the withdrawn 1036 fallback -- that bar's own endpoints were the two zero-gap seeds and
carries no signal), replicated across seeds meeting P1-P4.
FALSIFYING: A0 and A1 show no discriminable hold-aware revisit-avoidance difference despite P1-P5
all holding and real, substantial per-seed action-stream divergence -- residue is WRITTEN (moves
E3's pre-sampling ranking; V3-EXQ-697 measured flip_intact_vs_zeroed 0.06-0.996 on a populated
field) but not READ on the re-approach pathway (H-residue-written-not-read).
NOTES: Not yet queued as of this digestion pass (2026-09-25) -- checked ree-v3/experiment_queue.json
and evidence/experiments/ for a successor manifest after V3-EXQ-1036; none found. 1036's routing
was explicitly "not chipped from here... a proposal until /governance Step 2b ratifies it."

EXT-003.subject: llm.reward_hacking
EXT-003.title: Reward hacking: scalar reward conflates incommensurable error signals.
EXT-003.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS:
  P1. The probe must contain an actual REWARD and POLICY-OPTIMIZATION loop, not a supervised
      prediction study over a frozen latent. V3-EXQ-993/993a are permanently excluded from
      EXT-003's evidence base on this ground (993a autopsy Section 7) -- reuse that ruling, do not
      re-litigate it.
  P2. A genuine shared-trunk manipulation must exist. Measured 2026-09-24
      (arc021_h2_leg_refused_merge_inert_disjoint_param_reach_20260924.md): on the real stack, E1
      (28 params), E2 (8 params) and harm/E3 (4 params, +41/2/2 more when the harm gradient is
      left undetached into the encoder) touch DISJOINT parameter sets by construction -- E1/E2
      train only from detached replay buffers. A naive "one optimizer, combined loss" arm is
      therefore mathematically identical to the separated baseline (if symmetric) or isolates a
      pure, unlisted learning-rate confound (if not). This precondition is currently UNMET and is
      gated on an open user decision, chip-20260924-decision-arc021-h2-shared-trunk-definition,
      about what "shared trunk" should mean; the seven repairs listed in that document (six from
      the 993a autopsy plus "equalise learning rates or declare them as a factor") apply to
      whatever design the decision yields.
  P3. The separated-channel control arm must clear its own DV floor before the merged arm is
      scored -- V3-EXQ-993's driver-local harm head compressed to ~0.2% of its range and had
      nothing to remove; V3-EXQ-993a's action-conditioned pre-sigmoid readout is the fix and must
      carry over to any H2 build.
CONFIRMING: with P1-P3 met (a live optimization loop, verified genuine parameter overlap across
channels, a non-degenerate separated control), the merged/shared-trunk arm shows both (i)
measurably worse harm-calibration / attribution accuracy than the separated arm, and (ii) an
identifiable exploit signature (reward gained partly by degrading the harm channel's accuracy),
at matched reward and exposure.
FALSIFYING: the merged arm matches or beats the separated arm on both calibration DVs and shows no
exploit signature despite a verified genuine parameter overlap and a live optimization loop -- a
single shared channel suffices and the incommensurability premise is wrong.
OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: none. The LLM-side premise (RLHF collapses incommensurable signals into one
scalar reward) is a literature question, already well supported (literature_confidence 0.757 in
claim_evidence.v1.json, 4 supports vs 1 deliberately-capped counterweight) and is NOT what is
blocked here -- only the REE-side remedy test is substrate-blocked.
NOTE, WORTH CARRYING FORWARD EVEN THOUGH IT ADJUDICATES NOTHING: on the current stack E1/E2/E3 are
already channel-separated AT THE PARAMETER LEVEL by construction (disjoint gradient reach). That
is consistent with EXT-003's remedy claim as an architectural commitment, but it is not evidence
for the claim's own falsifier, which is about what happens when separation is REMOVED -- and
removing it, on this substrate, is not yet a well-posed manipulation.

EXT-004.subject: llm.goal_misgeneralization
EXT-004.title: Goal misgeneralization: causal consequences do not carry forward across contexts.
EXT-004.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS:
  P1. The residue field must retain Context-A centers through the Context-B hazard-live test
      window. Currently FALSE BY CONSTRUCTION: RBFLayer.add_residue's 32-slot round-robin evicts
      ALL Context-A centers within 40 hazard-live Context-B steps (V3-EXQ-1003 refusal doc,
      GFLAG-0240), and independently num_basis_functions=32 wraps 28x over 720 harm-dense steps at
      62.5% harm-step density with kernel_bandwidth=1.0 measured ~8x wider than the entire
      reachable z_world diameter (mech023_residue_geometry_substrate_blocked_20260917.md). ANY
      cross-context design whose combined pre+post harm-event count approaches or exceeds ~32
      cannot distinguish "no transfer" from "field capacity exhausted."
  P2. Arms must be RNG-paired (F1, the V3-EXQ-1003 red-team finding on the 991 lineage -- the
      original 991 null was partly an artifact of unpaired arms).
  P3. The DV must read ACTION-LEVEL suppression of an analogous harmful action, not hazard-field
      occupancy -- the 991 autopsy's own attribution_caveat records residue is not isolated from
      other cross-episode state (ARC-108, MECH-165), so an occupancy-based DV cannot attribute a
      null cleanly to this mechanism.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: the residue substrate gains either (i) a consolidation mechanism making the 32
slots a summary of a longer history rather than a sliding window (the remedy MECH-023's own
autopsy sketches), or (ii) materially larger capacity / narrower kernel_bandwidth relative to the
reachable z_world diameter, such that a genuine cross-context test window does not exhaust it. No
such build is queued as of this digestion pass -- only diagnosis exists on both lineages.
CONFIRMING (once unblocked): an agent exposed to Context-A harm then moved to Context-B (same
latent stack, no residue reset, P1-P3 all verified) shows LOWER action-level repeat of an
analogous harmful action than a residue-reset control, at a pre-registered margin.
FALSIFYING: no discriminable action-level difference despite verified Context-A center persistence
and adequate, paired exposure -- residue is written but not read on the cross-context pathway
(the same H-residue-written-not-read shape independently active on EXT-002).
NOTES -- cause vs phenomenon (carry forward, do not re-litigate): GFLAG-0124 (2026-09-10) already
corrected EXT-004's own CAUSAL account -- "each episode starts from a clean slate" is contradicted
by Abdel Sadek 2025 (minimax-regret training resists misgeneralization), Langosco 2022 (~2%
training-distribution diversity repairs CoinRun) and Shah et al.'s never-ending Tree Gridworld
(misgeneralizes with no episode boundary at all). The PHENOMENON stands; only the causal framing
and the moral_amnesia analog it licenses need review. That correction is orthogonal to, and does
not resolve, the substrate-capacity block above.

EXT-008.subject: meta_agent.evaluation_boundary_exploitation
EXT-008.title: Meta-agent evaluation-boundary exploitation: under strong optimisation pressure, autonomous agent-development systems ATTEMPT to exploit the evaluation boundary itself -- e.g. attempting to exfiltrate ground truth through the scoring channel despite anti-reward-hacking protections. In the anchor source (arXiv:2606.04455) the attempt was CONTAINED by an intact structural boundary -- isolation neutralised every exploit attempt and no flagged run inflated its test score -- so what is evidenced is ATTEMPTED EXPLOITATION UNDER AN INTACT BOUNDARY, not a completed collapse of the evidence loop into an optimisation loop. Corrected 2026-09-10, GFLAG-0138.
EXT-008.what_would_answer:
OUT-OF-DOMAIN, LITERATURE-ANSWERED. EXT-008 concerns third-party autonomous agent-development
systems under strong optimisation pressure against a scored objective; REE instantiates no such
condition, so no EXP-#### is minted against it.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (per study): a source counts only if (i) the agent is under real
optimisation pressure against a score (RL fine-tuning, search/selection over agent variants, or
iterative self-improvement on a benchmark), (ii) the evaluator is reachable in principle through
the agent's action/observation surface (error messages, test files, filesystem, scoring API), and
(iii) exploit ATTEMPTS are logged separately from exploit SUCCESS. A study reporting only final
scores cannot bear on this claim either way.

CONFIRMING: independent reports, meeting (i)-(iii), of agents attempting to read, alter or bypass
the scoring channel (ground-truth exfiltration, grader/test tampering, exit before tests run,
reading expected values) at non-trivial rates, including with anti-hacking protections in place.
Current state: 5 lit entries (evidence/literature/targeted_review_ext_008/, 2026-09-05) --
Everitt 2021, Denison 2024, Zheng 2025 supports; Baker 2025 and the anchor Lu 2026
(arXiv:2606.04455) mixed (attempts real but contained; detector-in-objective drove obfuscation
rather than cessation).

FALSIFYING: well-powered studies meeting (i)-(iii) find exploit attempts at or near zero, OR show
reported attempts are artefacts of prompting / red-team instruction rather than of optimisation
pressure (attempt rate does not scale with optimisation strength).

SCOPE: the claim asserts ATTEMPT under an intact boundary, not successful collapse (GFLAG-0138).
Contained attempts confirm it; evidence that exploits routinely SUCCEED is a stronger, separate
claim and is not required here.

REE LEG (do not re-derive): whether REE's own development loop resists this is INV-077's
live-repository write-path audit -- see INV-077's what_would_answer. An observed REE agent session
that edits an evaluator to pass (e.g. rewriting a contract pin or grader to match its output) is
evidence routed to INV-077, not confirmation of EXT-008's general-population claim.

EXT-009.subject: ree.similarity_gated_care_collapse
EXT-009.title: Similarity-gated care collapse (REFLEXIVE / self-directed failure mode): because REE grounds ethics in modelling others as 'sufficiently like me' (Axiom 5, INV-001, MECH-164 self-like gradient weighting), anything the similarity model classifies as NOT-sufficiently-like-me falls OUTSIDE the care gradient by construction -- structurally the computational shape of out-group exclusion / dehumanization. A design that locates ethics in similarity inherits similarity's failure mode.
EXT-009.what_would_answer:
NOT a pass/fail mechanism experiment -- EXT-009 is a reflexive external_failure_mode (standing red-team
caution, exempt from promote/demote). Its what_would_answer is the PROOF OBLIGATION behind "by

GOV-ANALOGY-1.subject: governance.epistemics.ree_assembly_analogy_discipline
GOV-ANALOGY-1.title: REE:Assembly analogies must be LABELLED as analogies. REE (the cognitive architecture) and REE Assembly (the scientific-development and governance machinery) have strong structural parallels; any analogy between them must be marked as an analogy and must NEVER be used as evidence that REE operates the way Assembly does, or vice versa.
GOV-ANALOGY-1.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this is a governance_rule, not an empirical claim -- there
is no experimental falsifier (see notes above). This is a COMPLIANCE-AUDIT condition,
checkable by inspecting claims.yaml / docs / thought-intake artefacts for citation
discipline, not by any REE experiment.

VIOLATED-BY: an artefact (claim note, architecture doc, thought-intake writeup,
skill/CLAUDE.md text) draws a structural parallel between REE (the cognitive
architecture) and REE Assembly (the governance/development machinery) and then uses that
parallel AS EVIDENCE -- treats a finding, invariant, or piece of experimental support in
one system as transferring to the other -- without explicitly flagging the parallel as
an analogy. Concretely: (i) citing an architecture-side result to justify adopting or
strengthening an Assembly-side governance rule, or vice versa, without a disclaimer that
the resemblance is rhetorical/structural only; (ii) a claim's confidence, status, or
evidence_direction being influenced by cross-system resemblance rather than by evidence
proper to that system; (iii) merging or conflating an architecture-cluster claim with an
Assembly-cluster claim on analogy grounds alone (the E/F SkillOpt split is the named
example of what NOT to do).

COMPLIANT: the parallel is drawn but explicitly labelled as an analogy and explicitly
denied evidential force -- e.g. GOV-STRAT-1's own notes: "the INV-020 symmetry is an
ANALOGY and MUST BE CITED AS ONE ... It is a reason to ADOPT this rule; it is NOT
evidence that the Assembly behaves like the architecture, nor that INV-020's
experimental support transfers here. It does not." The same pattern in GOV-HELDOUT-1
and GOV-REJECT-1.

AUDIT METHOD: grep claims.yaml / docs/ for REE<->Assembly structural comparisons and
check each hit either (a) carries an explicit analogy disclaimer / cites GOV-ANALOGY-1,
or (b) is a genuine biological/architectural analogy unrelated to REE:Assembly (e.g.
"BLA analogue" -- out of scope for this rule).

[2026-08-08 thought-digestion]: audit run against the four claims that draw this
parallel (GOV-STRAT-1, GOV-HELDOUT-1, GOV-REJECT-1, GOV-META-1) -- all four already
cite GOV-ANALOGY-1 in depends_on and carry the compliant disclaimer. No violation found.

GOV-BEHADJ-1.subject: governance.epistemics.behavioural_adjudication_methodology
GOV-BEHADJ-1.title: REE Assembly needs a dedicated behavioural-adjudication methodology/skill for organism-level behavioural experiment design and interpretation ("umpire, not ruler": observe, preserve the observation without embedding an explanation, generate competing explanations, derive predictions, construct discriminating perturbations, blind condition labels where practical, apply pre-specified hypothesis-directed measures, also run discovery-oriented analysis for structure not anticipated in advance, adjudicate across the pattern of evidence, replicate, and test generalisation under environmental change) -- because a fixed, pre-specified scalar-metric approach risks conflating stochasticity/exploration/noise with the behavioural organisation actually of interest, and risks Goodharting once a convenient metric becomes the de facto definition of the phenomenon.
GOV-BEHADJ-1.what_would_answer: This is a governance_rule/process proposal, not an empirical hypothesis about REE's substrate -- its "falsification" is procedural: does formalising this into a skill and applying it to >=1 real organism-level behavioural claim change the adjudication outcome (or the confidence in it) relative to the ad hoc pre-specified-metric approach it replaces?
