GOV-BRIDGE-1.subject: governance.version_transition.bridge_organism_preservation
GOV-BRIDGE-1.title: Bridge-organism preservation: when a version-boundary substrate expansion bundles more than one boundary capacity together, checkpoint and retain intermediate 'bridge' organism states -- each adding one boundary capacity, or one coherent capacity cluster, on top of the prior generation -- as first-class comparison artefacts, not merely as engineering scaffolding discarded once the full expansion lands. Bridge organisms need not become public release numbers; their purpose is causal isolation, so that a downstream behavioural or substrate phenotype observed after a multi-capacity transition can still be attributed to the specific capacity that produced it, the way a knock-in or mutant strain isolates one genetic change in model-organism research.
GOV-BRIDGE-1.what_would_answer:
NOT an empirical pass/fail falsifier -- GOV-BRIDGE-1 is a governance_rule (retention policy), so
this specifies the REASSESSMENT TRIGGER and the evidence that would inform revising it. No EXP-####
should be minted against this claim.

TRIGGER: the GOV-V4CUT-1 cutover review, i.e. BEFORE the first V4 substrate expansion lands --
the claim's own text requires adoption before V3->V4 begins or the first instance has no effect.
Re-applies identically at each later bundled boundary (V4->V5, V5->V6). This same trigger is shared
by GOV-LOWPREP-1 and SENT-15; they cross-reference it here.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the rule only has something to govern once a boundary expansion
actually BUNDLES >= 2 capacities in one landing. If V4 components land one-at-a-time on main,
each landing is already a single-capacity step and the rule is satisfied by ordinary checkpointing;
say so at the review rather than scoring the rule as confirmed.

EVIDENCE RELEVANT AT THAT REASSESSMENT:
  - HISTORY-DEPENDENCE (the load-bearing input): V3 already attributes phenomena by KNOCK-OUT
    (default-off flags ablated on the full organism). Bridges are KNOCK-INS. The two coincide only
    if developmental history does not matter. Q-101 (V5 grain) and MECH-549 (V4 grain) are the
    registered tests. If both resolve FALSIFYING (history irrelevant), knock-out ablation of the
    terminal organism carries most of the causal-isolation value and the rule should shrink to
    "retain only where no knock-out exists"; if either CONFIRMS, bridges are irreplaceable.
  - RE-INSTANTIABILITY: a retained bridge is a comparison artefact only if it can be re-run under
    the code that produced it (pinned code version + config + seed + checkpoint + provenance
    record, per SD-096's field list). Count retained bridges that can still be instantiated one
    boundary later.
  - COST: storage/maintenance per retained preparation versus times a bridge was actually used to
    attribute a post-transition phenomenon.
WHAT WOULD ACTUALLY REVISE: after one full bundled boundary, (a) no post-transition phenomenon
ever needed a bridge for attribution (knock-outs or single-capacity landings sufficed) -> narrow
or retire; or (b) bridges were retained but could not be re-instantiated -> the rule is
aspirational until a pinning standard exists. The rule is SUPPORTED if at least one real
post-transition phenomenon was attributed to one capacity only via a retained bridge.

GOV-CAPCONTRACT-1.subject: governance.epistemics.instantiated_organism_capability_contract
GOV-CAPCONTRACT-1.title: A run is not admissible as negative evidence for a claim unless the organism instantiated for that run was demonstrably able to express -- and, where the claim is learning- or development-dependent, to acquire -- the faculty under test. Each organism-level experiment must therefore DECLARE, and a preflight must machine-verify against the instantiated organism, at minimum: the canonical profile identity and every explicit deviation from it; the mechanisms and capabilities the hypothesis presupposes; whether those mechanisms were constructed, enabled and reached on the production path; whether their decisive readouts engaged often enough for the test to be non-vacuous; whether their output could compete at the relevant arbitration surface at the scale present in the run; which forms of change were permitted (parameters, policy/value, E1/E2 representations, memory state, residue/EMA state, offline updates); and, where online learning is load-bearing, whether gradients were enabled, whether the intended trainable parameters were in an optimizer, and whether a parameter-delta witness confirms an actual update path. A run failing any declared precondition self-routes to a capability-precondition diagnostic status and MUST NOT be recorded as evidence against the claim. 'It did not learn' and 'it could not have learned' are different scientific outcomes.

GOV-CONTRACT-1.subject: governance.epistemics.cognitive_contract_invariant_admissibility
GOV-CONTRACT-1.title: Cognitive-contract invariant admissibility rule: a candidate contract invariant (ARC-142) acquires ARCHITECTURAL standing only by consilience -- independent support from at least two of six evidence domains: (1) cross-linguistic typology (recurrent, obligatorily encoded across unrelated languages), (2) pre-linguistic developmental cognition (present before language or explicit instruction), (3) neuroscience (modality- or subsystem-independent representation, or a known translation mechanism that retains it), (4) comparative cognition (present in species with different sensory / behavioural ecologies), (5) independently trained artificial agents (discovered without being specified; removal produces characteristic failure), and (6) REE-internal necessity (an engine boundary that cannot learn or translate around it). Every candidate must be CLASSIFIED architectural / embodied-ecological / human-linguistic-convention / uncertain, with the alternative explanation (embodiment, culture, task structure) recorded. Cross-linguistic universality ALONE is inadmissible as architectural evidence: shared bodies, sensory systems, ecology and phylogeny explain human universals without cognitive universality. Developmental precedence -- required before substantial learning can occur -- is the strongest single-domain signal. A negative finding (an apparently fundamental invariant shown unnecessary, or translatable-around) is a first-class preserved result, not a discard. The contract must be DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY of REE_assembly's own claims / evidence / provenance / dependency invariant machinery (docs/architecture/invariant_types.md, claim_evidence) -- deriving it from that machinery is circular -- and any structural convergence between the two is logged as an empirical clue under GOV-ANALOGY-1, never assumed. Each candidate carries a twelve-field evidence record (candidate, definition, linguistic, developmental, neural, comparative, artificial-agent, REE evidence, lesion prediction, alternative explanation, classification, confidence); the objective is the smallest defensible set, never the longest list.
GOV-CONTRACT-1.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the ledger has entries whose classification the rule actually determines -- SATISFIED since 2026-09-08 (evidence/planning/cognitive_contract_invariant_ledger.v1.json, 14 records as of 2026-09-15; see the dated correction in notes -- the 'ledger NOT BUILT' sentence there is superseded).
CONFIRMING (evidence of use): the four-way classification and the >= 2-of-6 quorum give a different answer from an unclassified reading on a real candidate, and that answer survives a later independent pull. First live instance: the 2026-09-14 Session-B reconciliation, where CCI-003's linguistic cell was graded 'supports' by one pass and areal/cultural-leaning by the other, and the rule is what forces that disagreement to be recorded per-record rather than silently averaged.
FALSIFYING: (5) cross-domain convergence evaporates -- linguistic, developmental, neural, comparative and artificial-system evidence support mutually incompatible structures, so the quorum aggregates noise; OR the quorum is met by every candidate ever proposed (a bar nothing fails is not a bar). Currently 4 of 14 records are admitted and 0 are not_required -- closer to discriminating than not, but ZERO not_required records after three literature tranches is worth watching, because the negative-finding-preservation clause is the rule's most valuable one and has never fired.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (b) derivational, use-gated promotion; category stays governance_rule.

GOV-CONTRACT-2.subject: governance.epistemics.cognitive_contract_promotion_ladder
GOV-CONTRACT-2.title: Contract-invariant promotion ladder: GOV-CONTRACT-1's >= 2-of-6-domain consilience quorum is STAGE 1 of six, not the whole standard, and clearing it confers a LEDGER STATUS ("admitted") and nothing else -- in particular no claims.yaml entry, no architectural commitment, and no licence to implement. The ladder: Stage 0 named canonical candidate (the relation has a governed ledger record); Stage 1 cross-domain recurrence (the GOV-CONTRACT-1 quorum); Stage 2 transferable RECEIVER-ACCESSIBLE recoverability (the relation is recoverable by a plausible receiver, not merely by a researcher's probe, across held-out content, tasks or remappings -- graded on INV-105's ladder, never on external decodability alone); Stage 3 causal handoff dependence (selective, nuisance-controlled corruption at a relevant interface produces the predicted deficit, MECH-545); Stage 4 irreducibility under constrained reconstruction (a smaller already-supported basis cannot reproduce the function within the receiver's rate, decoder, context, latency and robustness budget -- adjudicated under the reduction-admissibility rule); Stage 5 adaptation-aware characterisation (compensation, alternative-pathway recruitment and rescue understood well enough to separate functional necessity from mechanism uniqueness, ARC-140); Stage 6 boundary scope established (which handoffs require the relation and which can reconstruct or omit it, ARC-144). A candidate becomes CLAIM-SHAPED at Stage 4 and eligible for architectural treatment only after Stage 5; before that its canonical home is its ledger record id. Composite candidates remain candidates however strong their recurrence, and a negative result at any stage is recorded in the ledger, never deleted.
GOV-CONTRACT-2.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least one ledger candidate has reached a stage above 1, so the ladder has discriminated something; until then the rule is a refusal rule only, and 'no candidate registered' is consistent with both the rule working and the programme being stalled.
CONFIRMING (evidence of USE, not of formalisation -- the GOV-PATHVALID-1 / GOV-INTERVENE-1 discipline): the ladder gives a DIFFERENT answer from the prior 'ledger record + lesion prediction' test on a real case, and the different answer proves right in hindsight -- e.g. a candidate that test would have registered is later shown reducible or boundary-local and would have been held at Stage 1-3 by this ladder.
FALSIFYING: the ladder is applied and either every candidate passes all six stages trivially (the stages do not discriminate) or none ever passes Stage 2 over a long programme while candidates are independently shown load-bearing by other routes (the ladder measures instrument availability, not candidate quality). Either says the stages are the wrong cuts.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (b) derivational, use-gated promotion -- a governance rule with no substrate dependency; do not move to provisional until it has been APPLIED in a live /governance pass. Category stays governance_rule.

GOV-CONTRACT-3.subject: governance.epistemics.cognitive_contract_reduction_admissibility
GOV-CONTRACT-3.title: Reduction admissibility for the cognitive contract (the anti-cheating rule the pruning clause lacks): counting primitives is not minimality, and a proposed MERGE, demotion or derivation of one candidate from another counts only if it lowers TOTAL TRANSFERABLE COMPLEXITY rather than relocating it. The quantity to be reduced is minimal sufficient transferable information under CONSTRAINED encoders and receivers -- informally contract cost ~= information rate + encoder/decoder complexity + context or side-channel complexity + reconstruction distortion + computational and latency cost + robustness cost -- not the number of English nouns in the basis. A reduction is therefore INADMISSIBLE when the lost distinctions reappear inside the definition of the surviving relation, a more powerful decoder, hidden context tags, unconstrained numerical precision, recurrent hidden state, task-specific side channels, or expensive reconstruction machinery. Three requirements for any proposed collapse: (1) lower total description or rate cost under fixed assumptions about precision and decoder power; (2) preserve DISCRIMINATING predictions -- the reduced model must still predict distinct failure signatures when different information is corrupted; (3) improve transfer or efficiency relative to an unconstrained equivalent-capacity code. The standard of reducibility is OPERATIONAL, not logical: logical reducibility (a mathematician can derive it) and information-theoretic reducibility (the information exists somewhere) are both inadmissible, and only computational reducibility (the receiver can derive it with plausible resources) and operational reducibility (reliably and quickly enough for the behaviour in question) decide. Corollary that makes the rule bite: rewriting several candidates as one typed relational graph, one latent, or one universal relation is a RENAMING, not a reduction, and is refused unless all three requirements are demonstrated.
GOV-CONTRACT-3.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a concrete merge proposal exists with an explicit before/after basis and cost terms at least coarsely estimable for both; MECH-557 is that proposal -- without one the rule has nothing to score.
CONFIRMING (evidence of use): a merge that looks compelling on relabelling grounds is REFUSED by the relocation checklist -- the lost distinction is found in the decoder, a context tag or a side channel -- and the refusal is later vindicated (the merged basis fails a discriminating-prediction test the unmerged basis passes). One such case establishes the rule catches something the naive noun-count criterion does not.
FALSIFYING: every merge proposal fails the cost test for reasons that turn out to be measurement artefacts (cost terms not estimable at the available precision), so the rule blocks all reduction and the basis grows monotonically (the thought's falsifier 8: total description cost fails to fall); OR the symmetry clause is never exercised -- reductions are policed but no retention is ever argued for -- so the rule is one-sided in practice whatever its text says.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (b) derivational, use-gated promotion (as GOV-CONTRACT-2); category stays governance_rule.

GOV-CRITBAR-1.subject: governance.epistemics.control_denominated_criterion_threshold
GOV-CRITBAR-1.title: A pre-registered threshold criterion is admissible only if its bar is denominated on the CONTROL ARM OF THE RUN THAT WILL BE SCORED AGAINST IT, at that run's own operating point -- not on the same quantity recorded in another run's landed manifest, and not on an absolute value taken from the design's rationale. A bar the run's own control fails, on a majority of its seeds, is measuring baseline variance rather than the manipulation's effect, and a PASS/FAIL returned against it is uninterpretable in BOTH directions: a FAIL is unattributable to the manipulation, and a PASS is a demonstration that the manipulation exceeded a threshold the control could not reach for unrelated reasons. This is a distinct defect from falsifier-runnability (the DV moves fine; the partition is misplaced) and applies with full force to runs carrying `claim_ids: []`, which set their criteria in the driver with no registry review.
GOV-CRITBAR-1.what_would_answer:
NOT an empirical falsifier -- a DESIGN-VALIDITY rule, checkable by inspecting a run's criteria block against its own arm_results, never by any single REE experiment outcome.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the criterion's statistic must be computable on the control arm. A criterion scored only on manipulated arms (a within-arm trajectory property with no control analogue) is OUT OF SCOPE, and must be recorded as out of scope rather than forced.
VIOLATED BY: a scored manifest in which a load-bearing threshold criterion's bar is not cleared by the run's own control arm on a majority of seeds, where no `cannot_determine` was emitted and the resulting PASS or FAIL was carried into an autopsy, a claim-evidence row, or a substrate status flip.
COMPLIANT: the control arm's value on the same statistic is recorded beside the bar; where the control fails its own bar, the criterion returns `cannot_determine` (the negative-instrument category, CLAUDE.md General Rules) rather than a verdict.
CONFIRMING: (i) a prospective case in which recording the control's value against the bar CHANGES a design before it runs -- the bar is moved, or the criterion is withdrawn; (ii) a retrospective case in which a verdict already carried into governance is shown to be unattributable by this test alone.
FALSIFYING: (i) CORPUS SATURATION: a sample of >= 20 landed multi-arm manifests with threshold criteria shows designs already record the control's value against the bar as a matter of course, so the rule names an existing practice and adds nothing (NOT YET RUN; the 0.8% machine-readability figure in the source document measures automatability, not practice, and does not discharge this clause). (ii) SOUND-VERDICT COUNTEREXAMPLES: >= 2 cases in which a design whose control failed its own bar nevertheless produced a verdict later evidence vindicated. (iii) INERT CEREMONY: across >= 3 prospective designs the rule never moves a bar, a criterion or a verdict relative to existing effect-size-margin and non-degeneracy-precondition practice -- demote toward superseded. (iv) SCOPE COLLAPSE: if GOV-UNWRITTEN-1's Step 2.5d trace is extended to cover threshold denomination as well as DV reachability, this claim is absorbed and should be superseded (NOT triggered as of 2026-09-24: REE_Working ed743b5be explicitly scoped threshold denomination out of the 2.5d claim-free extension).
WHAT WOULD ACTUALLY REVISE IT: evidence that the binding constraint is not the bar's denominator but the absence of a pilot at the run's own operating point -- restate as a pilot requirement.
READER NOTE: governance_rule about how the Assembly admits a criterion, not an empirical claim about REE cognition. No EXP-#### is to be minted against it.

GOV-DELETE-1.subject: governance.epistemics.deletion_pressure
GOV-DELETE-1.title: Deletion-pressure rule: construction earns a later obligation to attempt simplification. Once several individually validated local repairs coexist in one organism (representation-preservation objectives, routing bridges, selection-authority boosts, replay repair, provenance tracking, goal-anchor normalisation, compensatory control loops), the mature bundle must periodically be challenged by mechanism removal, low-complexity replacement, consolidation of redundant routes, reduction of bridge capacity, and removal of downstream compensation after an upstream repair -- and competence retained after removal is recorded as a POSITIVE architectural result, not as lost work. Two mechanisms do not both keep conceptual credit when one has become unnecessary; this is the architectural counterpart of not double-counting evidence. A mechanism is not protected from deletion by having once passed its own isolated assay.
GOV-DELETE-1.what_would_answer:
NOT an empirical pass/fail falsifier. GOV-DELETE-1 is a governance_rule (D6 member of GOV-JURIS-1),
so this states the REASSESSMENT TRIGGER and the evidence that would inform revising the rule. Shared
use-gated form with GOV-JURIS-1 / GOV-ECOL-1 / GOV-HOTHER-1: see the G002 preamble; do not re-derive.

TRIGGER: the first governance cycle in which >= 3 mechanisms from the interface campaign
(preservation objective, routing bridge, receiver-conditioned readout, replay maintenance) are
CO-ENABLED AND TRAINED in the recipe that produced the evidence being promoted. OPERATIONALISATION
NOTE: key this on the recipe, not on REEConfig default-ON. The 2026-09-25 gradient-reach census
(gradient_reach_census_20260925.md, GFLAG-0491) shows ree_core does no waking gradient learning at
defaults, so "default-ON" does not identify the exercised bundle. Also reassess the first time an
upstream repair lands on a path carrying a known downstream compensation. The WakingTrainer
(GFLAG-0501) is the likely first such repair.

EVIDENCE RELEVANT AT THAT REASSESSMENT:
(1) Was a deletion arm set actually designed (/queue-experiment) and run under GOV-CONTRACT-3's
    matched-budget test?
(2) Did at least one removal RETAIN competence and get filed as a POSITIVE D6 result that retired or
    merged a mechanism via /claim-synthesis, rather than as lost work?
(3) Held-out case V3-EXQ-223 (commitment architecture removed, loop retained competence): has the
    owed follow-up "which removed mechanism was unnecessary for THIS competence" been asked?
(4) Cheap first candidate: modules the census found read on every tick yet untrained in most
    recipes (e.g. harm_eval_head, 4/5 recipes). Removing them tests the rule at near-zero cost.

WHAT WOULD ACTUALLY REVISE:
(a) Every eligible bundle passes a cycle with no deletion challenge attempted. This is doctrine
    section 14 stop condition 7: the rule is inert and should be demoted or given a scheduled slot.
(b) Challenges are attempted but every removal loses competence under matched budgets across >= 3
    bundles. The obligation then costs runs without information and should be narrowed to
    post-upstream-repair compensation removal only.

GOV-DIAG-1.subject: governance.epistemics.diagnostic_chain_recurrence
GOV-DIAG-1.title: Diagnostic-chain recurrence rule (diagnostic-side analog of the re-derive brake / GOV-CEIL-1): the re-derive brake and GOV-CEIL-1 are BOTH claim-keyed -- they count confirmed failure-autopsy verdicts per claim_id. A pure-diagnostic chain (targets with claim_ids: []) accumulates ZERO on that counter, so a chain of diagnostics circling the same substrate floor never trips the mechanical brake -- it is caught only by a human reading the autopsy stream. This rule adds the missing counter: when N>=3 confirmed pure-diagnostic (claim_ids: []) failure-autopsies that reached NO verdict (recommended_evidence_direction non_contributory / inconclusive) share one bears_on work-stream token, the chain is surfaced with the reading 'the question may be MIS-POSED, not under-powered' -- re-pose the operationalization; do not re-run it harder. Warn-only; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.
GOV-DIAG-1.what_would_answer:
NOT a pass/fail experiment -- governance_rule (diagnostic-side companion to GOV-CEIL-1). The
claim's own DEFINITIONS section already specifies the per-token PASS condition (hit count >= 3 on a
bears_on token, hit-scoped metabolized exclusion); this wwa is for reassessing the RULE, not for
restating that.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: >=1 bears_on-tagged, pure-diagnostic (claim_ids: []), no-verdict
autopsy must exist. MET: a live re-run of check_diagnostic_chain_recurrence.py (2026-09-25) reports
43 work-streams carrying such hits, 0 ACTIONABLE (>=3, unmetabolized), and 36 hits across 10
work-streams correctly excluded via 7 diagnostic_recurrence_metabolized markers on file -- the
detector, the threshold, and the metabolized escape hatch are all live and exercised, not merely

CONFIRMING: a metabolized marker, once applied, correctly stays quiet only for the hits it names,
while a genuinely NEW chain on the same work-stream still re-accumulates toward N=3 (hit-scoped, not
token-scoped, per definition (d)) -- i.e. the marker never permanently deafens a token.

FALSIFYING: (i) a metabolized marker is observed to silence a bears_on token GENERALLY -- a new,
unrelated recurrence on the same token never re-fires -- meaning the hit-scoping promised in
definition (d) has regressed to token-scoping and the exact alarm-fatigue failure mode this rule was
built to avoid (the GOV-FROZEN-1 vector named in its own design notes) has returned; OR (ii) N=3
systematically fails to fire on a chain a human autopsy author independently recognises as circling

TRIGGER: reassess at the next case matching either FALSIFYING branch, or opportunistically whenever

GOV-ECOL-1.subject: governance.epistemics.stochastic_versus_ecological_replication
GOV-ECOL-1.title: Seeds-versus-worlds reporting rule: random-seed replication and ecological (world-family) replication are different evidence and MUST be reported separately -- "stochastic replication: N seeds" and "world-family replication: N environment families / N orthogonal perturbation classes" -- and a result may not be described as general, robust or transferable solely because it survived more seeds. Seeds test robustness within ONE world family; ecological replication tests whether the mechanism survives when the world itself changes along a PREDECLARED axis (map geometry, hazard or resource prevalence and topology, cue-to-consequence mapping, transition dynamics, temporal delays, observation or sensor layout, action costs, affordance structure, partial observability, actor structure). Where such a suite is used as a promotion target it must be FROZEN before use, or it becomes another training distribution. Until a frozen ecological suite exists, world-family replication is a NAMED DEBT on every claim promoted on seeds alone, never an implied property.

GOV-EDGE-1.subject: governance.assembly.claim_graph_edge_types
GOV-EDGE-1.title: Claim-graph edge types are split: `depends_on` is a DIRECTED prerequisite edge (build order / evidential support) and MUST be acyclic; `coupled_with` is an UNDIRECTED reciprocal-coupling edge (co-defining architecture, mutual explanation) and is never a prerequisite. A cycle in depends_on is a registry defect -- it means one edge on the cycle is coupling mislabelled as prerequisite -- and is an ERROR in validate_claims.py, not a tolerated feature of a 'conceptual dependency web'.
GOV-EDGE-1.what_would_answer: TRIGGER: reassess when (a) validate_claims.py --strict blocks a governance run on a depends_on cycle and the session concludes the blocked edge really IS a prerequisite in both directions (which the rule says cannot happen -- a genuine instance falsifies the two-layer model and argues for a third edge type, not for re-tolerating cycles); (b) the 8 cycle-break edges the split script chose heuristically are re-judged by governance and more than a couple are found to be the WRONG edge of their cycle (the mechanical rule is then worse than a human pass and should be replaced by one before any re-run); (c) a consumer is found that needs orientation on coupled_with (none does today: the epistemic overlay treats depends_on and coupled_with as the same weak symmetric potential and its output was byte-identical across the split; the phase-provenance checker ignores coupled_with by design). WHAT WOULD REVISE: the observation that one field carried three meanings (prerequisite, reciprocal coupling, mutual explanation) is measured and stands. What this claim adds is that (1) the prerequisite meaning is the one with an acyclicity invariant worth enforcing and (2) a mechanical mutual-pair + feedback-arc-set demotion is an acceptable first pass at the split. (1) is undercut by a demonstrated need for a cyclic prerequisite edge; (2) by finding the heuristic picked the wrong edge often. Either demotes this claim toward superseded by a sharper edge-type schema, not toward re-merging the layers. READER NOTE: governance_rule about how the Assembly structures its OWN registry, not an empirical mechanism about REE cognition -- no EXP-#### should be minted against it. The brain has reciprocal loops; that is exactly why coupled_with exists. Per GOV-ANALOGY-1 any resemblance between the DAG requirement here and REE's own commitment machinery is an analogy, never evidence.

GOV-EQUIV-1.subject: governance.epistemics.predictive_equivalence_envelope
GOV-EQUIV-1.title: Predictive-equivalence envelope for claim rotation (the checksum GOV-ROTATE-1 lacks): two representations of one canonical claim count as the SAME claim -- and may share one truth state -- only while the experimentally relevant predictions they license remain compatible over an EXPLICITLY DECLARED domain of contexts, interventions, observables, scales and auxiliary assumptions (the equivalence envelope); equivalence is earned by surviving discriminating interventions, never assumed from the wording reading as a paraphrase, and when a discriminating intervention reveals divergence the divergence MUST be classified (scope condition / hidden auxiliary assumption / underspecified parent claim / invalid rotation / genuinely new proposition) BEFORE any evidence is allowed to transfer between the two representations.
GOV-EQUIV-1.what_would_answer:
NOT an empirical pass/fail falsifier -- GOV-EQUIV-1 is a governance_rule about how the Assembly decides whether two representations of one claim may share a truth state. It specifies the REASSESSMENT TRIGGER, the recorded-trial evidence that would inform it, and what would revise it. No EXP-#### is to be minted against it.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least one canonical claim must carry two representations that are BOTH in live use with an explicitly declared equivalence envelope (contexts, interventions, observables, scales, auxiliary assumptions, known divergence points), so that a discriminating intervention inside that envelope is possible. As of registration the only recorded rotation is INV-088 architectural vs transformation (GOV-ROTATE-1 note (v), V3-EXQ-978 -> 1002) and it carries NO declared envelope, so this rule currently has nothing to act on; a "trial" run before any envelope is declared is vacuous and must not be counted either way.
TRIGGER: (a) the next rotation recorded under GOV-ROTATE-1 whose author declares an envelope; (b) any session about to credit a result obtained under one representation to the canonical claim as read through another representation; (c) opportunistically, a retrospective search of claims.yaml for a pair of formulations that DID share a truth state and were later shown not to (this search is the first owed trial and has not been run).
CONFIRMING (the rule does work): a recorded case in which (i) two representations were treated as the same claim, (ii) a discriminating intervention within the declared envelope produced incompatible predictions, and (iii) applying the classification step (scope condition / hidden auxiliary assumption / underspecified parent / invalid rotation / new proposition) CHANGED what evidence was allowed to transfer -- i.e. without the rule a result under R_B would have been credited to C as read under R_A, and with the rule it was withheld or split. The strongest form is retrospective: a historical pair in claims.yaml where evidence was in fact mis-transferred and the rule, applied at the time, would have withheld it. A weaker confirming signal, for the generative corollary: an envelope's named divergence point becoming the next queued experiment.
FALSIFYING / "UNNECESSARY" (source thought section 17): after >=3 rotations with declared envelopes, (i) no divergence ever appears inside a declared envelope (the envelope never withholds anything -- paperwork without decisions), or (ii) every divergence that did appear was already caught by GOV-ROTATE-1's safeguard plus ordinary claim-splitting without the predictive criterion, or (iii) sessions consistently skip declaring envelopes because the per-rotation cost is judged too high (the same "honest counterweight" GOV-HELDOUT-1 records for itself). "MISLEADING": a case where the checksum PASSED -- predictions compatible over the declared envelope -- and the claim was nonetheless laundered, because observational agreement was mistaken for causal equivalence or an undeclared intervention was the one that mattered. One such case does not demote the rule but must be recorded as a scope failure of the envelope concept; two argue for retaining the idea as a reasoning note only, per the source thought's own success criterion ("Does explicitly checking predictive equivalence prevent semantic drift and generate better discriminating experiments without multiplying governance overhead? If not, retain the idea as a reasoning note rather than a formal rule.").
WHAT WOULD ACTUALLY REVISE: the dependency on GOV-ROTATE-1 is load-bearing -- if GOV-ROTATE-1 is demoted under its own criterion (iv), this rule has no object and follows it. Independently, the "unnecessary" branch above demotes the PRACTICE (declare envelopes, classify divergences before transfer) toward a reasoning note without touching the underlying observation that paraphrase is an unreliable test of claim identity, which stands on the 978/1002/1008 lineage regardless.
READER NOTE: do not read the predictive-processing resemblance in the source thought as evidence for this rule (GOV-ANALOGY-1); the 978 -> 1002 -> 1008 lineage is the ILLUSTRATION of what the rule names, run without it, and is not a trial of it.

GOV-FANOUT-1.subject: governance.epistemics.bottleneck_fanout_escalation

Warn-only routing signal; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

GOV-FRONTIER-1.subject: governance.epistemics.frontier_literature_status
GOV-FRONTIER-1.title: Frontier-evidence doctrine: literature is evidence and constraint, never permission. After a documented, scoped, good-faith search, every mechanism claim may carry a literature_status of DIRECT (a sufficiently close mechanism exists and is adapted), ADJACENT (components or analogues constrain the design but no source supplies the required mechanism or coupling), or FRONTIER (no sufficiently close mechanism found; the requirement follows from a REE architectural or ethical question). A scoped search that finds no direct precedent is a SANCTIONED TERMINAL outcome of a literature pull ("no direct mechanism found; adjacent evidence constrains A, B, C; the remainder proceeds experimentally"), not a veto and not evidence against the mechanism -- unless a stated reason shows that the relevant literature should already contain the mechanism if it were viable. Adjacent literature is recorded as constraint, and its literature confidence must not be read as direct support. A frontier mechanism may be built (default-OFF) and promoted on REE experimental evidence alone, but absence of literature RAISES the experimental burden (pre-registered competing candidates, production-path causal reach, negative controls incl. channel-presence and proxy-reward, ablation, world-family replication, a non-compensable adjudication battery) rather than lowering it; frontier status is never itself evidence for a mechanism; and later literature convergence updates literature confidence without rewriting the claim's historical REE-frontier provenance.
GOV-FRONTIER-1.what_would_answer:
NOT an empirical pass/fail falsifier. GOV-FRONTIER-1 is a governance_rule over how literature
support is LABELLED and how a null literature pull TERMINATES; this states the audit condition
under which it is genuinely in force versus merely registered. No EXP-#### should be minted
against this claim. Shared use-gated reassessment form: GOV-CONTRACT-2/3 and the G002 preamble
(CONFIRMING = the rule produced a different call from the old practice and that call was later
vindicated; REVISING = boilerplate or never exercised).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (the rule is currently VACUOUS, not open): it has something to act on
only once EITHER (1) a first FRONTIER declaration is recorded for a mechanism claim, carrying the
search record the rule REQUIRES (queries, databases, vocabularies tried, nearest precedents, and
what each fails to solve); OR (2) the literature_status field is adopted in the claims schema.
Measured 2026-09-25 (REE_assembly 09fa012a89): 0 claims carry literature_status (the only 3
occurrences in claims.yaml are inside this entry); no frontier-declaration or search-record file
exists; the lit-pull skill has no null terminal. SHARED CLAUSE with GOV-INSERT-1: the heightened
burden's first item, a pre-registered competing-candidate family (GOV-FROZEN-1), must exist for the
declared mechanism before any frontier PROMOTION can be audited.

TRIGGER to re-check: (a) any /lit-pull that closes on a claim in the candidate population or on a

CONFIRMING (evidence of USE, not of formalisation):
(1) A documented null pull ends in a FRONTIER declaration, and that declaration discharges a

GOV-FROZEN-1.subject: governance.epistemics.frozen_hypothesis_set
GOV-FROZEN-1.title: Frozen hypothesis-set pre-registration rule (anti-Goodhart contract over the Narrow/Decide dashboard): the reduction ratio surviving/initial is Goodhart-able from the denominator side -- a campaign can improve its apparent narrowing by padding the initial hypothesis set after the discriminating evidence is already in. GOV-INTERVENE-1.subject: governance.epistemics.intervention_diagnostic_taxonomy
GOV-INTERVENE-1.title: Diagnostic interventions used to localise a broken causal edge must be classified along two independent dimensions rather than one flat implemented/not-implemented judgment. (1) EPISTEMIC CONTENT: an ORACLE intervention imports privileged, target-correct information or competence under investigation (establishing achievable ceilings and downstream usability, as a positive control / ceiling test) versus a NON-ORACLE injection that perturbs a suspected causal variable without supplying the task's answer (establishing causal sensitivity/identification). (2) CONSTRUCTION: a SILKY intervention is a minimally disruptive, distribution-preserving perturbation of one suspected variable (diagnostic for threshold, scale, and timing failures) versus an ODDLY COMPOSED intervention that deliberately combines individually-plausible states that rarely co-occur naturally (a stress test for shortcut-dependence, hidden conjunctions, and factorisation, not evidence of ordinary competence). These axes are orthogonal -- a silky nudge can still be oracle-informed, and an oddly composed state can be wholly non-oracular -- and must not be collapsed into one enum. Provenance (which stage/variable/relation was altered, along both axes) must be recorded, and any effect demonstrated only under such an intervention must be attributed to that intervention condition, never silently treated as endogenous REE competence.
GOV-INTERVENE-1.what_would_answer:
NOT an empirical falsifier -- a classification/reporting discipline, checkable by inspecting
whether an experiment's intervention is documented along both axes and whether results are
attributed to the correct axis-combination rather than over-generalised.

VIOLATED BY: a manifest or claim note that reports an intervention result without naming its
epistemic content (oracle/non-oracle) or its construction (silky/oddly-composed/neither), OR
that treats an oracle-established ceiling as evidence of endogenous competence, OR that treats
an oddly-composed stress-test response as evidence of ordinary/ecological competence.

COMPLIANT: intervention provenance is recorded along both axes (at minimum) and every reported
conclusion is scoped to what that specific axis-combination can actually establish (per the
functional_restatement above).

GOV-JURIS-1.subject: governance.epistemics.evidence_domain_jurisdiction
GOV-JURIS-1.title: Evidence-domain jurisdiction rule: evidence receives no broader jurisdiction than the experiment earned. Organism-level validation is a PROFILE over eight orthogonal evidence domains -- D0 instrument validity, D1 local mechanism validity, D2 local causal consequence, D3 closed-loop behavioural consequence, D4 ecological (world-family, not seed) generalisation, D5 developmental validity, D6 integrated compatibility and simplification, D7 adaptive recovery from a materially wrong internal model -- never a scalar ladder and never one "intelligence score". Whenever a result is promoted UPWARD -- into a roadmap or closure-plan node, an architectural recommendation, a milestone or progress summary (CURRENT_FRONT, insights_report, morning digest, a governance cycle's headline), a default-on decision, or any statement that REE itself has become more competent -- the promoting text MUST carry an explicit line of the form "Evidence domain reached: D? / Domains not tested: ..." naming the SPECIFIC untested domains that matter for that claim. A frozen-latent decoder result establishes at most D1; a live selection perturbation at most D2; seven seeds in one world family do not reach D4. Raw manifests and per-run autopsies are exempt; the rule binds the SUMMARY layer, where mechanism validity is most easily narrated as organismal progress.
GOV-JURIS-1.what_would_answer:
NOT an empirical pass/fail falsifier. GOV-JURIS-1 is a governance_rule, the parent D0-D7 profile of
GOV-ECOL-1 (D4), GOV-DELETE-1 (D6) and Q-108 (D7). This states the REASSESSMENT TRIGGER and
revising evidence. Shared use-gated form: see the G002 preamble.

TRIGGER: each time the front moves (governance SKILL Step 7a re-states
evidence/planning/current_front_evidence_domain.json), plus a dedicated review after the first
upward promotion that CLAIMS D3 or above (closed-loop benefit). That is the step the rule exists
to police, and it has not yet occurred.

EVIDENCE RELEVANT AT THAT REASSESSMENT:
(1) Specificity. Does each stamp name the untested domains specifically, or has it decayed into a
    boilerplate "D2-D7"? 2026-09-25 (V3-EXQ-1078, D2): specific. It names z_self-at-E3 as
    "absent by measurement, not untested" and holds V3-EXQ-1010's H-F at D1.

    SD-074 / V3-EXQ-784 (GFLAG-0036, D0 non-destructiveness asserted not measured);
    MECH-537/538 (GFLAG-0282).
(3) Reach. Is the stamp confined to CURRENT_FRONT, or does it also appear in roadmap / closure-plan

GOV-PATHVALID-1.subject: governance.epistemics.positive_control_production_path_traversal
GOV-PATHVALID-1.title: A load-bearing positive control (or any diagnostic injection standing in for a claim's precondition) must traverse the production path it claims to validate. Directly injecting or mocking the state immediately downstream of a suspected causal edge can certify that a downstream consumer works GIVEN that state, but cannot certify that the production organism can reach that state via its own endogenous pathway. A contract test that mocks the source of a load-bearing state establishes consumer competence, not production-path reachability, and must not be reported or treated as evidence that the organism possesses the full pathway.
GOV-PATHVALID-1.what_would_answer:
NOT an empirical falsifier in the usual sense -- this is a DESIGN-VALIDITY / REPORTING rule,
checkable by inspecting an experiment's positive-control construction and its evidence writeup,
not by any single REE experiment outcome.

VIOLATED BY: a manifest, autopsy, or claim note that reports a load-bearing positive-control
PASS as evidence the organism "possesses" or "can reach" a full pathway, when the control's
construction directly injected/mocked a state that only an upstream stage of that SAME pathway
would, in production, ever supply -- without explicitly flagging the untested upstream step.

COMPLIANT: any such control is labelled with which stage was injected/mocked (pre-edge vs.
post-edge, per the functional_restatement above), and claims about pathway reachability are
scoped no further than what was actually demonstrated.

NON-DEGENERACY NOTE: this rule does not forbid mocked/injected positive controls -- they remain
the correct tool for testing a downstream consumer or an upstream producer in isolation (see
GOV-INTERVENE-1's oracle framing). It forbids only the REPORTING move of treating a mocked-
precondition PASS as if it were a demonstrated full-pathway PASS.

GOV-SHARPEN-1.subject: governance.epistemics.predictive_sharpening_vs_split
GOV-SHARPEN-1.title: Predictive sharpening is not a new claim (the over-splitting guard that pairs with GOV-ROTATE-1's smuggling guard): a rotated representation that makes a SHARPER prediction than the canonical claim -- a sign rather than a magnitude, a causal ordering, a conditional dependence, a timescale, a locus, a developmental window, a falsifiable inequality -- remains an inferential refinement of the SAME claim, sharing its truth state, when the sharper prediction follows from the canonical claim plus already-accepted background assumptions (C + B); it becomes a DISTINCT claim (C AND A), which must be split and must NOT inherit C's evidence, exactly when the sharper prediction requires a NEW empirical assumption A introduced during the rotation. The test is which auxiliary assumptions are needed to make the predictions agree, not how different the sentences sound or how much more precise the new one is.
GOV-SHARPEN-1.what_would_answer:
NOT an empirical pass/fail falsifier -- GOV-SHARPEN-1 is a governance_rule (a judgement rule applied when a session drafts a rotated view, a lettered successor, or a child claim that is strictly more precise than its parent). It specifies the reassessment trigger, the recorded-trial evidence, and what would revise it. No EXP-#### is to be minted against it.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a sharpening case must actually arise -- a new formulation that names a sign, ordering, conditional dependence, timescale, locus, developmental window, or inequality the parent did not -- AND the "accepted background B" must be fixable non-circularly at that moment: B = what the registry already holds as stable/provisional or as an ARC commitment the parent depends_on, plus the substrate as built; never the drafting session's own plausibles. If B cannot be fixed without argument, the test is degenerate for that case and must be recorded as such rather than forced.
TRIGGER: (a) the FIRST OWED TRIAL, per this claim's note (iii): a GOV-HELDOUT-1 check against three historical split / no-split decisions the rule was not written from -- the MECH-074 -> MECH-074a-d split (2026-04-21), the z_gamma -> z_self / z_world split, and the 2026-06-11 stance-split hygiene pass -- asking for each whether the C + B vs C + A test reproduces the call the registry actually made, counting only cases where "split" and "keep as refinement" would have given DIFFERENT answers (GOV-HELDOUT-1 non-degeneracy guard); (b) prospectively, any session drafting a sharper formulation under GOV-ROTATE-1 or a lettered successor claim.
CONFIRMING: (i) the held-out check reproduces the registry's actual decision on >=2 of the 3 historical cases AND those decisions were later borne out (no evidence mis-credited, no refinement orphaned from its parent's record); (ii) a prospective case where the rule PREVENTED a fragmentation -- a sharper view kept on the parent's evidence record where the "when in doubt, new letter" default would have minted an evidence-less candidate -- or FORCED a split by surfacing an assumption A that a rotation was carrying unlabelled.
FALSIFYING: (i) the rule gives the WRONG call on >=2 of the 3 held-out cases, where "wrong" means it would have merged something the registry correctly split (or split something correctly kept) and the registry's decision was later vindicated by evidence; (ii) B cannot be fixed non-circularly in practice -- sessions applying the rule to the same case disagree about what counts as accepted background, so the rule reduces to the judgement it was meant to replace; (iii) inert ceremony: across >=3 prospective sharpening cases the rule never changes a decision relative to the existing "when in doubt, new letter" convention (CLAUDE.md, EXQ versioning) -- in which case demote toward rejected/superseded and let that convention stand.
WHAT WOULD ACTUALLY REVISE: this rule refines GOV-ROTATE-1's safeguard in the opposite direction (anti-fragmentation vs anti-laundering); if GOV-ROTATE-1 is demoted, this rule's rotation-facing half falls with it, but its lettered-successor half (a sharper EXQ-047b-style restatement is not a new claim unless it needs A) is independent of rotation and would survive as a note on the EXQ versioning convention. Distinguish from GOV-MATCHAUX-1: that rule says which auxiliary CONTROL a result is admissible against; this one says which auxiliary ASSUMPTION makes a formulation a different claim. Do not conflate.
READER NOTE: governance_rule / process claim about how the Assembly grains its own registry, not an empirical mechanism about REE cognition. The E2 / E3 candidate-future-ordering example in the functional_restatement is illustrative and is NOT a registered prediction of any MECH claim.

GOV-SUBIMG-1.what_would_answer:
Not an empirical falsifier in the usual sense -- a build-and-adopt proposal, checkable by
whether the instrument is built and whether it is actually used under the discipline it
names (candidate observations logged as observations/hypotheses, not findings; at least one

VIOLATED BY: the instrument being built but treated as evidential on its own (a visually

channels left undocumented/not traceable to a recorded variable.
COMPLIANT: every shipped visual channel has a documented variable mapping, and at least one
real candidate-structure-to-quantified-check pipeline instance exists showing the division of
labour actually operating, not merely declared.

GOV-SUBIMG-2.subject: governance.epistemics.longitudinal_substrate_behaviour_causal_methodology
GOV-SUBIMG-2.title: Once REE substrate activity is observable (GOV-SUBIMG-1), Assembly should apply a behaviour-linked substrate-association methodology that aligns internal state to behavioural events (event-related analysis across event types, repeated occurrences, and organisms), extends the alignment window across many temporal offsets from t-1 to t-1000+ steps rather than only the immediate surround, treats distributed multivariate substrate-state patterns -- not single variables -- as the primary unit of analysis (representational-similarity-style comparison across current behaviour, location, goal, recent history, developmental age, and subsequent behaviour), tracks how internal-behavioural signatures change across a long individual REE lifetime (longitudinal artificial-organism analysis), and moves from association to causal claims only via checkpoint branch-and-replay intervention against a matched unperturbed sibling branch -- following the same discovery-then-confirmation discipline GOV-BEHADJ-1 already requires for purely behavioural adjudication.

post-perturbation change as causal without a matched unperturbed sibling replay; COMPLIANT

GOV-UMPIRE-1.subject: governance.canonical.readiness_umpire
GOV-UMPIRE-1.title: Canonical readiness umpire: REE maintains an explicit, inspectable process for recognising when a reproducible organism has become sufficiently coherent and competent that formal reference-organism review is warranted -- while remaining structurally unable to answer that question itself. The detector observes/derives/reports/escalates state transitions (NO_WARRANT / ADMISSION_PASS_WARRANTED / REFERENCE_ORGANISM_REVIEW_WARRANTED / USER_DECISION_REQUIRED / CANONICAL_OBSERVED) over explicit gates (identifiable organism; admission-doctrine candidate substrate; COEXISTENCE of mechanisms in the same animal; whole-organism non-degeneracy; behavioural evidence; reproducibility) -- never a readiness percentage, never self-canonisation. Warrants are withdrawable; profile-admission readiness and reference-organism readiness remain separate thresholds; for developmental REEs the reproducible object may be the developmental recipe and constitution rather than the adult state.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the persistence substrate under audit must actually be exercised by real (non-hypothesis-tagged) committed actions across at least one subsequent reset/decay-eligible boundary -- an episode reset (agent.reset() / env.reset()), a governance rule-closure discharge event (SD-034 ClosureOperator.discharge_domain), or an offline/sleep integration pass. A substrate that is never accumulated into, or never passed through a reset/discharge boundary, trivially and vacuously satisfies "not reset" without testing anything.
CONFIRMING: every mutating call site that can act on a committed trace's representation (weight/magnitude in the RBF field, the total_residue / num_harm_events / harm-history accounting, or an equivalent field in any future persistence mechanism) is either (i) strictly monotone-accumulating, or (ii) where attenuation exists, is bounded multiplicative decay that is provably held away from exact zero/deletion (e.g. SD-034 discharge_domain's factor floor at 1e-6, never 0.0) and does not touch the global accounting fields. Per-episode reset paths (Agent.reset(), env.reset()) explicitly exclude the persistence store from their reset scope. An architectural/code audit across ree_core/residue/field.py, ree_core/agent.py's reset(), and ree_core/governance/closure_operator.py (plus any newly added persistence mechanism) that finds no path violating the above is a CONFIRMING result.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): discovery of any code path -- present or newly introduced -- where a genuinely-committed consequence trace's magnitude, weight, or global accounting field is set to exact zero, deleted/popped from history, or otherwise made indistinguishable from never having been committed. Concrete examples: an episode reset() that clears residue_field.total_residue / _harm_history rather than leaving them untouched across episodes; a discharge/decay factor permitted to reach 0.0 (full erasure) or applied without a documented floor; a sleep/offline consolidation pass that prunes or zeroes residue entries rather than only contextualising them; or a new persistence mechanism (hippocampal/path memory, model-update log) added without an equivalent non-erasure guarantee. apparatus described in precision_scoping.md (MECH-003) is defined but

and reads CONFIRMING -- unlike INV-005 (a structurally similar

AUDIT TARGET: trace the live gain-application path from observation to

Secondary consumer sites where a precision value is read and applied to

INV-009.subject: attention.mechanism
INV-009.title: Attention is precision modulation, not symbolic control.
INV-009.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural audit of the live attention-ALLOCATION
code path specifically -- narrower than INV-008 (which audited
precision-routing infrastructure generally). INV-009 asks whether
ATTENTION (selecting/weighting what gets processed or written) is
realized as a continuous gain/weighting mechanism, or as discrete
symbolic control (an enum-keyed dispatch or if/switch that
categorically picks one mode/stream with no gradation).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the audit must inspect a live,
actually-exercised attention-allocation path -- not a mechanism
merely declared in an enum or present in code that nothing in the
live agent loop calls.

CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass): three live,
actually-exercised attention-relevant mechanisms were traced, all
continuous:
  (1) SD-016 (status: implemented) -- ree_core's E1 frontal cue-
      indexed ContextMemory query path implements attention
      literally as transformer-style query-key-softmax retrieval:
      q = world_query_proj(z_world), k = key_proj(context_memory.
      memory), weights = softmax(q @ k.T / scale). Continuous by
      construction. (Its empirical DIFFERENTIATION has failed in
      some runs -- V3-EXQ-418e/f found attn_entropy pinned at the
      uniform rail ln(16) -- but that is a performance defect in a
      continuous mechanism, not evidence of a discrete one
      underneath.)
  (2) MECH-261 (status: stable, conf 0.891) --
      ree_core/cingulate/salience_coordinator.py's
      SalienceCoordinator. "Operating mode is implemented as a soft
      probability vector ... not a one-hot categorical."
      operating_mode = softmax(logits, temperature); write_gate(
      target) = sum_mode operating_mode[mode] * gate_weights[
      target][mode] -- continuous, read directly by consumers. A
      discrete current_mode label exists (argmax + hysteresis) but
      is diagnostic-only; write_gate() never reads it.
  (3) INV-008's confirmed per-channel precision gains (LatentStack,
      five independent nn.Parameter-backed channels).

THE ONE DISCRETE/SYMBOLIC CANDIDATE FOUND, AND WHY IT DOES NOT
CURRENTLY BEAR ON THIS CLAIM: ree_core/claustrum/{control_demand.py,
coalition_templates.py, coalition_controller.py} (SD-091/MECH-481)
implements a genuinely categorical dispatch -- ControlDemandType is
a 10-member Enum, and request_coalition(demand_type) looks up
COALITION_TEMPLATES[demand_type], a branch on an enum key, not a
gradient. This is exactly the kind of mechanism that WOULD falsify
this claim if it were live. It is not: self.coalition defaults to
None (config flag off by default), and request_coalition() is never
called anywhere in agent.py or any other live ree_core module --
only from the module's own tests and its own falsifier experiment
driver. The module's own docstrings confirm this is deliberately
unwired pending a follow-up pass. write_gate() IS called at 3 live
consumer sites but always against an empty _active list, i.e.
permanent identity no-ops today. This fails the non-degeneracy
precondition and is therefore NOT counted as confirming or
falsifying -- it is a WATCH ITEM: if/when SD-091 steps 4-5 land and
request_coalition() is ever called from a live classifier, this
claim must be re-audited, since that would introduce a genuinely
two-layer structure (discrete classification -> continuous
execution) this audit has not had to resolve.

AUDIT TARGET for re-check: ree_core/cingulate/
salience_coordinator.py (write_gate, operating_mode),
ree_core/predictors/ (SD-016 query/key/softmax path),
ree_core/claustrum/ (re-grep for new request_coalition() callers),
ree_core/latent/stack.py.

FALSIFYING evidence: a live, actually-called attention-allocation
path is found where WHICH stream/mode/target receives processing
resources is determined by a discrete/categorical branch that picks
ONE target categorically with no continuous gradation available, AND
that branch is reachable from the live agent loop.

CONFIRMING evidence: the traced live attention-allocation paths
(SD-016 softmax retrieval, MECH-261 soft-probability write-gating,
INV-008's per-channel precision gains) continue to show continuous,
gradable weighting with no reachable discrete branch determining
allocation outright. This is the CURRENT confirmed state.

INV-010.subject: sleep.necessity
INV-010.title: Offline integration exists and is required.
INV-010.what_would_answer:
INV-010 is the BARE universal-necessity claim: offline integration
exists across cognitive systems and is architecturally required, full
stop -- grounded in cross-species biology (e.g. the zebrafish
sleep-necessity literature already cited in claim_evidence.v1.json),
with no depends_on and no REE-specific mechanism content. This is
DISTINCT from its dependent claim ARC-011 ("offline integration is
required FOR STABILITY [in REE]"), which stakes the REE-specific,
empirically-testable architectural claim (mediated through ARC-007
hippocampal replay and ARC-005 control plane) -- see ARC-011's own
what_would_answer for that empirical falsifier; do not re-run it here.
[Digestion note, flagged not resolved: the two titles read as
near-duplicates in wording despite this real distinction in kind --
worth a governance pass to make the split explicit in one or both
entries.]

Answered by literature/derivational argument, not a REE experiment:
does the biological/computational-cognition literature show ANY
complex, stable cognitive system (biological or artificial) that
sustains long-horizon operation WITHOUT some form of offline
consolidation, or is offline integration a structural universal across
every studied case? FALSIFYING: a credible counterexample -- a
cognitive system (biological species, or an artificial agent
architecture with a comparable operating horizon) demonstrated to
remain stable indefinitely with zero offline/consolidation phase.
CONFIRMING: the cross-species pattern holds without exception across
the literature base already cited for this claim, and no counter-
example architecture is found.

Note: REE's own EXQ-430 (SLEEP harm < NO_SLEEP harm, tagged INV-010)
found no differential effect in 0/3 seeds, but governance's own read
was "not evidence against INV-010; symptom of missing MECH-261
mode-conditioned offline-write gating substrate" -- i.e. inconclusive/
substrate-gated, not falsifying, and in any case this REE-level
empirical question is ARC-011's falsifier, not INV-010's (a universal
invariant is not falsified by one architecture's substrate-readiness
gap).

INV-011.subject: default_mode.safety
INV-011.title: Imagination must be possible without belief update.
INV-011.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural audit of the live simulation/replay
write-gating code path, not by a trained behavioral experiment (this is
a MECHANISM/STRUCTURE question -- WHETHER a real write-blocking gate
exists and is exercised on the belief-update channels -- not a
