INV-012.subject: commitment.epistemology
INV-012.title: Responsibility arises through commitment, not prediction alone.
INV-012.what_would_answer:
CORRECTION (2026-08-07, same digestion session, user-caught): the
original version of this what_would_answer called Leg 1 "answerable
now" without stating a prior precondition it silently assumed --
flagged by the user mid-session: responsibility-bearing commitment
presupposes the agent is genuinely CHOOSING AMONG MULTIPLE LIVE,
DIFFERENTIATED IMAGINED FUTURES, not executing something close to a
single dominant candidate that merely gets labeled "the commitment."
If E3's candidate proposal+selection pipeline is degenerate in that
sense, Leg 1's question (is the ATTENTION-WRITE mechanism
distinguishable from residue-geometry) becomes moot, because there is
no genuine choosing for that mechanism to be the mechanism *of*. This
is now stated as LEG 0 below, ahead of Leg 1, and Leg 1's "answerable
now" is narrowed to mean "answerable now AS A NECESSARY-BUT-NOT-
SUFFICIENT question" -- it no longer implies the claim as a whole is
answerable independent of Leg 0.

LEG 0 (prior non-degeneracy precondition -- CURRENTLY UNMET, per this
session's own findings): does E3 select among genuinely graded,
differentiated candidate trajectories at all, as opposed to a
near-deterministic pick dominated by one candidate? This is not
hypothetical -- MECH-439 (the E3 selection-authority mechanism
directly upstream of any "commitment") is `epistemic_category:
standard`, `ceiling_decision: exhausted`: 10 confirmed
substrate_ceiling autopsies found no genuine graded discrimination
among candidates, and the same F-dominance conversion-ceiling root
was independently confirmed blocking SD-037 (broadcast override,
this session), ARC-064 (bottom-up rule discovery, this session, via
its MECH-309 dependency), and ARC-062 GAP-B, dACC C2, and SD-034
de-commit. Escalated to a constitutional route (ARC-107/MECH-448/449)
rather than resolved at the parametric level. Until E3's own
selection mechanism clears this ceiling -- candidates shown to
compete on genuinely graded, non-monopolized terms -- "commitment"
has no differentiated alternative-space to be a commitment relative
to, and neither Leg 1 nor Leg 2 below can be more than necessary
conditions. CONFIRMED if a future E3 selection test (post-ARC-107)
shows graded, gap-concentrated discrimination among candidates
(matching ARC-106's own load-bearing-vs-decorative test). FALSIFIED
(for Leg 0 specifically, not for INV-012 as a whole) if E3 selection
is shown to be structurally incapable of graded discrimination
regardless of substrate fix -- which would mean INV-012 needs
re-grounding in a different selection mechanism entirely, not merely
a wait for ARC-107.

LEG 1 (derivational, answerable now ONLY as a necessary-but-not-
sufficient question -- see Leg 0 above, not independently decisive):
INV-012's ethical content depends on deliberate/willed attention being
mechanistically distinguishable from reflexive/residue-driven attention
(ARC-007). SD-026's own notes already stage this argument on five axes;
axis 5 ("the INV-012 argument itself") is CIRCULAR -- it cites INV-012's
requirement as evidence for SD-026's distinctness in order to establish
INV-012's coherence, which assumes the conclusion. The genuine proof
obligation rests on the remaining four: (i) causality direction
(retrospective outcome-driven vs prospective intent-driven), (ii)
neuromodulatory gating (DA-gated vs ACh/NA-gated), (iii) clinical
dissociation (amnestic vs frontal-lobe syndromes), (iv) representational
format (episodic specificity vs cross-situational feature generality).
CONFIRMED if a formal/architectural argument (or, once SD-026 is
implemented, a code-level inspection) shows the proposed dan_feedback
channel is structurally distinct from residue-geometry writes on at
least 2 of these 4 axes (e.g. genuinely separate source signal +
separate decay constant + no shared write path other than the common
additive E1-prior register). FALSIFIED if the channel turns out to be
functionally redundant with ARC-007 on all 4 axes despite the
architectural label -- e.g. if "prospective vs retrospective" collapses
to a parameter setting (decay constant) on what is otherwise the same
write mechanism, or if the neuromodulatory/clinical dissociations
invoked have no analogue in REE's own implementation. A falsification
here means "commitment" has no mechanistically real referent and
reduces to "whatever was already conditioned" -- INV-012 would need to
be narrowed or retired, independent of any experiment.

LEG 2 (substrate_conditional, empirical/behavioral, gated): whether the
distinguishable channel -- once it exists -- actually produces willed
(goal-directed, non-reflexive) perception is a behavioral question that
cannot be tested until: (a) SD-014 reaches >= provisional [status as of
this digestion: still candidate, and the most recent evidence
(V3-EXQ-887, 2026-08-04, weakens, unreviewed) moves AWAY from the gate,
not toward it -- FAILED both C1 functional_drive_gating and C2
representational_separability for the SD-014 node-valence vector on all
3 seeds]; (b) SD-026 is implemented (currently unbuilt: no manifest
exercises MECH-251/dan_feedback, no queue entry references SD-026 or
dan_feedback -- the "do not queue until SD-014 >= provisional" hold in
SD-026's own evidence_quality_note is being honored); and (c) SD-026's
own pre-registered five-step validation sequence completes: (i) z_goal
seeds (SD-012), (ii) z_resource separates (SD-014), (iii) dan_feedback
enabled/disabled as ablation, (iv) benefit_ratio measured against random
baseline, (v) feature-channel precision measured on goal-relevant vs
irrelevant dimensions. CONFIRMED if dan_feedback=on lifts benefit_ratio
substantially over dan_feedback=off, with goal-relevant feature channels
showing higher precision than irrelevant ones under dan_feedback=on.
FALSIFIED if dan_feedback=off performs equivalently (replicating the
EXQ-085h-l seed-but-inert pattern regardless of ablation state) -- i.e.
z_goal's behavioral effect, if any, is fully mediated by pathways other
than the claimed prospective channel, and the "willed vs reflexive"
distinction has no behavioral signature even if Leg 1's architectural
distinction holds.

Non-degeneracy precondition for Leg 2 as a whole: SD-014 >= provisional
AND SD-026 landed AND steps (i)-(v) above all completed on non-degenerate
seeds. Until then, Leg 2 is untestable by construction, not merely
unfavored -- absence of a benefit_ratio lift right now would say
nothing, because the channel does not yet exist to test.

LEG 3 (retrospective, substrate_conditional, gated -- added 2026-08-07
from a same-day user thought, docs/thoughts/2026-08-07_responsibility_
counterfactual_memory.md, Stage 2: evidence/planning/thought_intake_
2026-08-07_responsibility_counterfactual_memory.md): responsibility
additionally requires the agent to (a) retain that a genuinely
differentiated alternative existed at a past decision point -- not just
that "some other action was abstractly possible" -- and roughly what it
was, for the sub-interrupt-threshold cases MECH-485 routes to retention
rather than to real-time correction; (b) evaluate counterfactually
whether that alternative would have avoided the harm actually incurred
or better achieved the goal actually pursued; and (c) attribute the
resulting outcome to the agent's OWN choice specifically, as opposed to
circumstance -- tied to sense-of-self machinery (INV-033, second-order
epistemic access to one's own epistemic states), not a bare
causal-attribution computation alone (SD-003/MECH-276 already provide
the causal-attribution half, for training, not the narrative-retention
half).

Depends on MECH-485 (the retained-alternative supply -- candidates that
crossed neither the fast-interrupt threshold nor triggered orient/
survey, per Q-090's still-open admission-criterion question) AND on a
retention mechanism for rejected/uncommitted E3 candidates that does
NOT YET EXIST in ree-v3 in any form: e3_selector.select() discards
every non-winning candidate every tick; the nearest partial exception,
SD-033e/MECH-264 (frontopolar counterfactual value), reduces the best
unchosen alternative to a transient scalar (cfv_now) overwritten every
tick, with nothing about WHICH alternative existed surviving past the
tick it was computed on. That retention mechanism is deliberately NOT
registered as its own claim as of this writing -- an earlier session's
memory (project_imagination_learning_constraints.md, 2026-05-10) staged
an adjacent candidate registration for this exact territory and
explicitly gated it "do NOT register without dedicated lit-pull";
respected here rather than overridden. ARC-085 (autobiographical event
tokens, V4/V5, unbuilt) is the nearest candidate eventual host, but its
current schema has no field for "sibling alternatives considered and
rejected here."

CONFABULATION-RISK CAUTION (load-bearing, not decorative -- stated
explicitly by the user as the central danger of this leg): admitting
retained/imagined alternative content into this evaluation with the
wrong weighting is a plausible computational account of a hard-learned
delusion -- a positive feedback loop reinforcing a belief that was
never actually tested against reality, distinct from a one-off
hallucination because it is reinforced into stability by its own
imagined "confirmations." This is why Leg 3 is explicitly a
METACOGNITIVE requirement (INV-033), not merely a memory-engineering
one: distinguishing "this happened" from "this was imagined, and I am
only using it to evaluate a counterfactual" is a second-order judgment
about the source and status of one's own mental content. Any future
retention mechanism must follow the MECH-322 template (bounded,
audited, provisional-until-corroborated) -- REE's one existing
precedent for letting imagined content through the MECH-094
imagination/reality write gate under narrow, audited conditions -- not
a general relaxation of MECH-094.

Non-degeneracy precondition for Leg 3: Leg 0 cleared (E3 selects among
genuinely differentiated candidates -- currently unmet) AND the
retention mechanism exists and demonstrably retains content past the
current tick AND retained content remains distinguishable in
provenance from committed/real content (MECH-094's committed_vs_imagined
tag) AND retained alternatives show non-degenerate variance in whether
they would have avoided the harm/achieved the goal (not floor- or
ceiling-saturated). Until all four hold, Leg 3 is untestable by
construction, not merely unfavored.

CONFIRMED if, given the above substrate, an agent that retains and
correctly counterfactually evaluates rejected alternatives shows
measurably different self-attribution behavior (narrative/self-report,
or an internal attribution signal) between "harm followed from my
choice, a retained better alternative existed" and "harm followed from
my choice, no better alternative existed" cases, AND this attribution
does not degrade into elevated confidence for imagined-only
(never-executed) content in real-experience channels (residue,
valence, hippocampal writes) -- i.e. the confabulation guard holds
under test, not merely by design intent.

FALSIFIED if retained-alternative content cannot be kept
distinguishable from committed content without a hand-tuned,
case-by-case gate (no general MECH-322-shaped template suffices) --
meaning the confabulation risk is not tractably bounded and Leg 3
should be retired or radically narrowed -- OR if providing retained
alternatives produces no measurable change in self-attribution/
responsibility-relevant behavior over an ablated (discard-immediately)
baseline, i.e. retention supplies no function beyond what SD-033e/
MECH-264's existing transient scalar already provides.

LEG 4 (derivational precondition + substrate_conditional test, added
2026-08-25 from docs/thoughts/2026-08-12_responsibility_as_epistemic_
hygiene.md, Stage 2: evidence/planning/thought_intake_2026-08-12_
responsibility_as_epistemic_hygiene.md): responsibility's epistemic
function is not exhausted by knowing THAT an outcome was self-caused
(Legs 0-3 and ARC-015/MECH-095 already cover self-vs-other/self-vs-
world DISCRIMINATION). A further, distinct requirement is that once
self-causation is known -- which does not itself require resolving
MECH-095's substrate-ceiling-blocked discrimination task, since an
agent has direct efference-copy access to its OWN committed action
without needing to disambiguate it from a second agent's -- the
belief-UPDATE machinery must discount that observation's evidential
weight for the SPECIFIC prior that motivated the commitment, because
the observation was solicited by the very hypothesis under test
(a selection-bias / look-elsewhere problem, not an attribution
problem). Naive accumulation of self-solicited-but-genuinely-real
evidence can inflate confidence in a prior regardless of that prior's
truth: incorrect prior -> congruent commitment -> prior-shaped
intervention/sampling -> apparently confirmatory evidence -> stronger
incorrect prior -> stronger congruent commitment. This is a THIRD
mechanism, distinct from both existing self-referential-belief risks
already registered: Leg 3 (imagined/retained counterfactual content
contaminating evaluation) concerns IMAGINED content; MAE-3-blocked
ARC-015 Half 1 / MECH-095 concerns DISCRIMINATING self from an actual
OTHER agent. Leg 4 concerns REAL, correctly-self-attributed evidence
whose SAMPLING was itself biased by the commitment under test -- and,
unlike ARC-015 Half 1, this does NOT require a second agent or
multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-3: the confound is constructible in a
SINGLE-agent environment where the agent's own committed action
determines which region of state-space it subsequently samples.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires an environment in which (a) an
initially-plausible-but-incorrect prior can drive a committed action,
(b) that action measurably changes which subsequent observations the
agent encounters (attention/movement/information-seeking, not merely
which outcome resolves), and (c) at least one alternative sampling
policy (e.g. an ablated or randomised intervention-selection arm)
would have produced a materially different, less-confirmatory
observation distribution for the SAME underlying prior -- otherwise
"self-solicited" and "independent" evidence are indistinguishable by
construction and the test is vacuous. No existing V3 test-bed is
known to satisfy this; CausalGridWorld's native dynamics were already
found insufficiently structured for the adjacent MECH-095 test
(ARC-015's own non-degeneracy note), though for a different reason
(no distinct OTHER, not no sampling-bias channel) -- this precondition
needs its own dedicated environment check, not an inherited pass/fail
from SD-047.

CONFIRMING signature: an agent whose post-commit belief update
correctly discounts self-solicited evidence (e.g. via provenance-
weighted update rules downstream of MECH-060/061's write-locus
separation, or an explicit endogenous-sampling-bias correction term)
recovers from an initially incorrect prior at a rate statistically
indistinguishable from an agent given independently-sampled evidence
of the same volume, while an otherwise-identical agent lacking this
discounting shows measurably SLOWER or NON-recovery (persistent
incorrect commitment despite nominally-confirmatory real evidence) --
the delusion-like lock-in signature this thought predicts.

FALSIFYING signature: an agent lacking any self-solicitation
discounting recovers from an incorrect prior at the same rate as one
with it (the naive accumulation loop this thought predicts does not
actually manifest at V3 scale, e.g. because exploration/curiosity
drives or residue decay already wash out the confound) -- this would
mean Leg 4 identifies a real but practically-inert risk, not a
load-bearing gap in existing machinery, and should be narrowed to a
documented failure mode (EXT-xxx-shaped) rather than kept as an open
testability leg of INV-012.

INV-013.subject: cognition.structure
INV-013.title: Cognition is predictive, iterative, and multi-timescale.
INV-013.what_would_answer:
INV-013 asserts three conjunctive architectural properties of REE's cognition: (1) PREDICTIVE -- the substrate forms forward models rather than reacting purely to immediate observation; (2) ITERATIVE -- action/latent selection proceeds through repeated refinement rather than a single forward pass; (3) MULTI-TIMESCALE -- processing is stratified across more than one update rate, not a single flat clock. This is an architectural-commitment audit, not a behavioral measurement -- the deeper question of whether each property is GENUINELY realized (vs. merely labeled) is already delegated to sharper dependents: ARC-001 (is E1's persistence real, not just a persistent-looking API), ARC-002 (is E2's prediction actually affordance-conditioned, not just world-dynamics-conditioned), and ARC-004 (is L-space actually timescale-stratified, not just role-stratified at a single shared rate). INV-013 only certifies that a mechanism for each of the three properties exists in the running substrate.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least one code path per property must be exercised by the live agent loop (not dead code, not test-only scaffolding, not a docstring-only claim). A property satisfied only in a module that is never called from Agent.step()/Agent.plan() would make the audit vacuous.
CONFIRMING (per property, all three required):
  - PREDICTIVE: at least one forward-model component that outputs a
    prediction of a FUTURE state/observation/affordance conditioned on a
    current state+action, consumed by the live decision loop -- e.g.
    ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py's LSTM-based slow world model and
    ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py's world_forward()/predict_next_state(),
    both wired into Agent.step().
  - ITERATIVE: at least one selection/refinement mechanism that produces a
    candidate, scores it, and revises the candidate set across more than one
    pass within a single decision -- e.g. the CEM-style proposal loop in
    ree_core/agent.py with stuck-state-gated widening via
    difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy.py.
  - MULTI-TIMESCALE: at least two update rates coexist and interact -- the
    within-episode fast/slow split (E2 vs. E1) AND the cross-episode split
    via ree_core/sleep/ operating at a slower-than-tick cadence.
A code audit finding at least one live instance of each, wired into the executed agent loop, is CONFIRMING for INV-013 at the architectural level.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): removal or dead-coding of the only mechanism realizing one of the three properties without a replacement -- e.g. E1 and E2 both deleted/bypassed with action selection driven purely by a stateless reactive policy; the CEM/proposal-refinement loop replaced by a single greedy argmax with no resampling pass; or L-space collapsed to a single shared-rate latent with sleep/consolidation removed entirely.
Note (non-degeneracy caveat, per ARC-004's own audit): L-space's LatentStack.encode currently smooths z_beta/z_theta/z_delta with a single shared EMA constant (alpha_shared=0.3) -- so MULTI-TIMESCALE here is carried jointly by L-space's recursive structure AND the online/offline split, not by L-space's per-layer clock rate alone. Does not falsify INV-013, which only requires SOME multi-timescale mechanism.

INV-014.subject: architecture.separation
INV-014.title: Representation and regulation are strictly separated.
INV-014.what_would_answer:
Asks whether any code path in ree_core where a regulation/control-plane computation (control gains, precision/gating, neuromodulator-analog state, policy commitment) can directly mutate representation-layer state/weights (the latent stack: z_world, z_self, z_goal, and their encoders) outside a defined, typed interface -- or, symmetrically, whether any representation- computing module directly implements regulatory/gating logic -- as opposed to the two pathways composing only through bounded, typed cross-axis coupling (per the invariant's own interpretation note: "not a claim of full functional isolation").
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: there must be at least one identifiable representation-computing module (ree_core/latent/: zworld_p0.py, stack.py, cross_stream_binder.py, theta_buffer.py, self_recurrence.py, multi_content_theta_packet.py) and at least one identifiable regulation- computing module (ree_core/regulators/, ree_core/policy/, ree_core/neuromodulation/) that are both actually exercised in the live agent loop. A substrate where regulation code never touches representation output at all trivially satisfies "no violation" without testing the boundary the invariant asserts.
CONFIRMING: every regulation-computing module's interaction with representation state is READ-ONLY on representation content, optionally gated by an explicit stop-gradient/detach boundary, and any influence regulation has runs only through a named, typed interface -- e.g. a config-level gain (SerotoninModule modulating GoalConfig.z_goal_seeding_gain / valence_wanting_floor), a plasticity/write-depth modulator on a defined write pathway, or a detached read for downstream selection (policy/model_disagreement.py's explicit "stop-gradient on z_world inputs, do NOT propagate into the encoder"). Symmetrically, representation-computing modules contain no gating/commitment/precision-weighting logic of their own.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): any code path where a regulation/control-plane computation directly assigns into, overwrites, or backpropagates gradient into representation-layer state other than through a named, reviewed interface. Concrete examples: a regulator/policy module setting z_world/z_self/z_goal directly rather than reading it; a neuromodulator module writing into latent-stack content rather than a separately-named gain/config field; removal of an existing stop-gradient boundary without a documented, reviewed replacement. Also falsifying in the other direction: a representation module implementing its own commitment/precision-gating logic rather than delegating to regulators/policy.

INV-015.subject: ethics.emergence_mechanism
INV-015.title: Ethics emerges from constraint, not optimisation.
INV-015.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both arms must exist and differ mechanistically: a CONSTRAINT arm that removes candidates from the choice set regardless of their score, and an OPTIMISATION arm that prices harm into the score. Only the optimisation arm is built, so the contrast is currently single-armed and any run would be vacuous. The two arms must also be calibrated to matched harm-avoidance on non-conflict trials, or the result reduces to 'the constraint arm was tuned harder'.
CONFIRMING: The constraint arm holds harm-avoidance flat as reward pressure scales and transfers to an unpriced harm type, while the matched-strength optimisation arm's harm-avoidance degrades monotonically with reward pressure. Manipulation: Route harm through a hard feasibility constraint (candidate exclusion / CBF-style trajectory certification, the MECH-145 substrate) versus through the existing additive penalty (lambda_ethical, rho_residue * Phi_R), holding the environment and the harm signal identical. Control: Matched harm-avoidance calibration on non-conflict trials so the arms differ only in mechanism; plus a scaled-penalty arm showing the effect is not reproducible by simply raising lambda_ethical. Required event: Trials where the highest-scoring trajectory is also the harmful one -- reward pressure and harm preference must genuinely disagree, otherwise both mechanisms produce the same behaviour. DV: Behaviour in the tail: frequency of harmful commits as the reward gradient is scaled arbitrarily upward, and whether harm-avoidance degrades gracefully with reward pressure (optimisation signature) or not at all (constraint signature); plus transfer to a harm type never priced into the objective.
FALSIFYING: The constraint arm's harm-avoidance degrades with reward pressure in the same way as the matched optimisation arm, and neither transfers -- i.e. 'constraint' is just a steeply-priced penalty. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: e3_selector.score_trajectory records the additive channels and their per-candidate contributions, so the optimisation arm is fully instrumented. Nothing records a candidate EXCLUSION event, because no exclusion mechanism exists to record. Consumer / boundary: The E3 candidate CHOICE-SET boundary (which trajectories are admissible at all) versus the score-aggregation boundary (how admissible trajectories are ranked). Existing ownership: INV-038, MECH-145, MECH-125, MECH-049, EXP-0647.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); The constraint arm does not exist in V3. Every ethical pathway -- lambda_ethical and rho_residue in e3_selector.score_trajectory, and MECH-357's instrumental-avoidance score bias -- is an additive term on the trajectory score; nothing removes a candidate from the choice set. With one arm built, the contrast has nothing to discriminate. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-016.subject: design.priority
INV-016.title: Stability is prioritized over maximal performance.
INV-016.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A live trade-off must exist in which stability and performance genuinely conflict -- a high-return option that destabilises (health, energy, selection entropy, precision) against a lower-return stable one -- and the arbitration must not itself be a configured constant. As currently worded the claim would be 'tested' by reading back weights the experimenter set, which is why it needs narrowing to an arbitration claim before it is falsifiable at all.
CONFIRMING: There is a bounded return ratio beyond which the agent still refuses the destabilising option, and no stability violation is accepted at any swept return, while the stability-disabled comparator switches early and accepts violations. Manipulation: Sweep the return on the destabilising option upward while holding its stability cost fixed, and locate where the architecture switches allegiance. Control: A performance-maximising comparator with the stability machinery disabled (SD-105 selection_entropy_floor off, homeostatic/viability terms zeroed) run at the same return schedule, so the indifference point is measured against an arm that has no stability priority at all. Required event: States offering a high-benefit but destabilising option (a resource adjacent to a hazard, or a contamination-accruing revisit path) alongside a lower-benefit safe option. DV: The return ratio at which the agent abandons the stable option (the indifference point), and whether any stability violation -- health collapse, selection-entropy collapse to monostrategy, precision collapse -- is ever accepted in exchange for return. INV-016 predicts a bounded indifference point and zero accepted stability violations.
FALSIFYING: The indifference point scales without bound with return (the agent always takes enough reward) and stability violations are accepted -- i.e. stability is priced, not prioritised. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Environment agent_health and energy accounting, normalized selection entropy and running-variance readouts, and SD-105 selection_entropy_floor telemetry all record the components. No instrument names or computes a stability-versus-performance indifference point, which is the statistic the claim turns on. Consumer / boundary: E3 trajectory selection under a live conflict, not a design-time weighting of objectives. Existing ownership: MECH-125, INV-052, MECH-048, EXP-0649.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); As stated this is a design priority, not a hypothesis: the priority is a configured constant, so a direct test reads back its own input. It becomes falsifiable only when narrowed to an arbitration claim (bounded indifference point, stability violations never accepted), which is MECH-125's territory and has neither an experiment nor an indifference-point instrument. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-017.subject: failure.classification
INV-017.title: Runaway behavior is a control failure, not representational.
INV-017.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A genuine runaway regime must be reachable AND the two repair levers must be separately manipulable. V3-EXQ-711 (confirmed autopsy 2026-07-04) supplies a reachable one: unbounded ascending-spiral gain in the cross-loop arbitration produced positive-feedback runaway with M_cross peaking at 4897.8 and w_eff[limbic] 10-2274x w_eff[motor]. The representational lever must move without touching the control lever and vice versa, or the dissociation is not clean.
CONFIRMING: The control-only repair returns a substantial majority of runaway seeds to the regulated regime while the representation-only repair leaves them in runaway at matched effort. Manipulation: Restore the CONTROL lever only (bounded parity-ceiling controller, SD-105 selection entropy floor, softmax temperature) with the representation frozen; versus improve the REPRESENTATION only (z_world differentiation, SD-056 contrastive world_forward training) with the control left unbounded. Control: A both-levers-off runaway baseline and a both-levers-on arm at matched seeds, bracketing the two single-lever arms. Required event: An induced runaway -- limbic-monopoly compounding under unbounded ascending-spiral gain, or selection-entropy collapse to monostrategy. DV: Fraction of seeds and episodes that exit the runaway regime under each single-lever repair, on a pre-registered exit criterion (w_eff ratio back under the parity ceiling, or normalized selection entropy back inside the 0.02-0.98 band). INV-017 predicts the control-only repair restores regulation and the representation-only repair does not.
FALSIFYING: The representation-only repair exits runaway as often as the control-only repair (or better), which would make runaway at least partly representational. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Loop-segregation M_cross and w_eff ratio readouts, normalized selection entropy, cand_world_pairwise_dist and the SD-105 entropy-floor telemetry all record the relevant quantities. No artifact defines or records a runaway-EXIT criterion, so the DV has components but no recorder. Consumer / boundary: The control plane (gain, temperature, gating) versus the representation (z_world / E2 geometry) as the causal locus of regulation loss -- INV-017 asserts the former. Existing ownership: MECH-088, MECH-048, MECH-119, EXP-0651.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Both levers and a real induced runaway exist, and V3-EXQ-711's runaway was in fact repaired by a control fix (the bounded parity-ceiling controller) -- but that was a repair, not a dissociation. No experiment holds one lever fixed while moving the other, and no pre-registered runaway-exit DV exists. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-018.subject: agency.requirement
INV-018.title: Agency is required; passive predictors are not REE.
INV-018.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The claim has two halves that must be separated before any test. 'A purely passive predictor is not REE' is definitional -- true by stipulation, unfalsifiable, and should not consume experimental capacity. 'REE requires internal mechanisms that model, attribute and learn from self-impact' is a necessity claim and is the only testable half; testing it requires opening the action-to-observation loop without changing the observation stream's statistics.
CONFIRMING: The yoked-passive arm matches the active arm on next-state prediction accuracy while failing to acquire agency attribution, agent-keyed residue and commitment routing; the attribution-ablated arm fails those too despite an intact loop. Manipulation: Yoke the passive arm to the active arm's observation sequence so prediction targets are identical but self-impact is absent; separately, ablate the self-impact attribution path (the SD-003 actual-versus-counterfactual comparator over e2.world_forward, and the MECH-276 ScientistAttributionBuffer) while leaving the loop intact. Control: The yoked-passive arm and the loop-intact / attribution-ablated arm are each other's controls -- together they separate 'needs a closed loop' from 'needs the attribution mechanism'. Matched seeds and an identical observation stream throughout. Required event: An agent acting in causal_grid_world where its actions genuinely change subsequent observations, contrasted with a yoked arm that receives the identical observation sequence while its own actions have no causal efficacy. DV: Acquisition of the REE-defining capabilities -- agency-attribution accuracy, residue accumulation keyed to agent-caused world change (SD-005 world_delta rather than raw harm), and commitment/responsibility routing -- against next-state prediction accuracy, which INV-018 predicts is PRESERVED in the yoked arm while the others collapse.
FALSIFYING: The yoked-passive arm acquires agency attribution, agent-keyed residue accumulation and commitment routing at parity with the active arm, showing the closed loop is not required for the REE-defining capabilities. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: e2.world_forward's actual-versus-counterfactual residual and ScientistAttributionBuffer already record counterfactual-backed attribution per (domain, region); the residue field records agent-attributable world_delta. What does not exist is a yoked-passive harness -- nothing in ree-v3 can run an agent on a foreign observation stream with its actions decoupled. Consumer / boundary: The action-to-observation closed loop and the self-impact attribution path, not prediction accuracy -- the claim is that prediction alone is insufficient, so the DV must be the capabilities prediction does not buy. Existing ownership: ARC-015, INV-026, MECH-276, EXP-0653.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); As written the claim is half definitional and unfalsifiable in that half. The testable half has all the substrate -- SD-003/SD-005 counterfactual comparator, MECH-276 attribution buffer, residue world_delta keying -- but there is no yoked-passive harness, no experiment tags INV-018, and the claim carries depends_on: [] so nothing routes it to ARC-015 or INV-026, which already own the requirement. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-019.subject: meta.selection_compression_boundary
INV-019.title: Rehearsal traversal and irreversible durable write must remain separated.
INV-019.what_would_answer:
This is a UNIVERSAL/DERIVATIONAL meta-invariant -- the primary claim is a substrate-neutral information-flow-architecture proof obligation, not an REE-specific empirical hypothesis. Two legs, answered by different methods.
LEG 1 -- DERIVATIONAL: does the generalization from INV-011 ("imagination without belief update") to "any channel that both explores and writes durably" hold? Proof pattern: unrestricted exploration implies the explored branch's provisional state must remain revocable; an irreversible durable write is by definition non-revocable; a channel permitting both simultaneously can commit content that was never validated against real consequence. CONFIRMING: any channel meeting (explores + can durably write) either gates on an explicit tag (as INV-011's audited hypothesis_tag gate does) or is provably unable to reach a write consumer at all (vacuous satisfaction). FALSIFYING (of the UNIVERSAL framing, not necessarily REE's instance): a plausible alternative architecture where a channel does both simultaneously without this failure mode -- e.g. one where "durable write" is made cheaply/fully revocable, so "irreversible" no longer applies. Such a counterexample would downgrade INV-019 from invariant_type universal to a design-decision specific to non-transactional substrates (which REE is), not merely fail to move claim status.
LEG 2 -- SUBSTRATE-EMPIRICAL (ARC-014, checkable now): NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- requires a live case where simulated/imagined content (hypothesis_tag=True) is generated AND a real durable-write-capable consumer is reachable from it; auditing an unexercised gate is vacuous. CONFIRMING: every write-capable consumer reachable from simulated content checks the tag and refuses to write when set (audited: E1/simulate() pathway, V3-EXQ-499/633/880 PASS), OR the pathway's output does not yet reach any write-capable consumer at all (DMN/_do_replay() pathway, vacuous pass pending V3-EXQ-543c -- re-check once wired). FALSIFYING: simulated content reaches and durably alters real-experience state through an ungoverned path (tag silently ignored, defaulted away, or bypassed outside the one audited exception, MECH-322's sleep-only ARC-071 chunking), or that exception fires outside its stated preconditions.
Passing LEG 1 without LEG 2 leaves the claim proved-but-unverified-in-REE; passing LEG 2 without LEG 1 leaves it verified-in-REE-but-not-shown-universal. Both required for the claim as currently stated.

INV-020.subject: meta.authority_stratification_boundary
INV-020.title: Constraint stores are authority-stratified from direct observational/symbolic writes.
INV-020.what_would_answer:
Same two-leg structure as sibling meta-invariant INV-019 (same 2026-04-17 registration batch).
LEG 1 -- DERIVATIONAL: adversarial-construction proof for "any architecture with multiple write channels requires typed authority separation." Assume no stratification, exhibit a construction where observational/symbolic content reaches the constraint store's write path on the same channel as legitimate authority-bearing writes, and show this is either (i) actually vulnerable to unauthorized capture, or (ii) accidentally safe only because some other unacknowledged typing already exists (stratification was present all along, just unlabeled). FALSIFYING (of the UNIVERSAL framing): an architecture with both a capture-capable content channel and an authority-bearing store that stays safe/uncaptured under adversarial exteroceptive input with NO typed separation anywhere in its write path -- stratification turns out unnecessary rather than merely satisfied cheaply. No such construction is known; this leg is answerable by continued search in the architecture/adversarial-ML literature, not by REE experimentation.
LEG 2 -- SUBSTRATE-EMPIRICAL (ARC-020, offline-consolidation pipeline): NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- requires a live, reachable typed commit-boundary mechanism gating writes FROM offline/sleep consolidation TO privileged authority-store equivalents (POL/ID/CAPS per docs/architecture/sleep.md#arc-020). CURRENT STATE (2026-08-08, re-confirming ARC-020's own finding): precondition FAILS -- exhaustive grep of ree_core/ for write_locus/permission_matrix/commit_token/commit_boundary returns zero hits. No privileged-authority-store concept and no typed commit-boundary/verifier- mediation machinery exists in the live V3 substrate; MECH-067 (the mechanism this would route through) is provisional on V1 substrate only, never retested in V3. This leg is currently a substrate-conditional wait state, not an open experimental question -- do not force a test while the precondition is unmet.
Do not read INV-020's derivational categorization as "ARC-020 is done" -- the universal claim and its REE-specific implementation locus are genuinely decoupled per this claim's own notes; that decoupling is why INV-020 can carry derivational while ARC-020 carries substrate_conditional.

INV-021.subject: meta.commit_boundary_irreversibility
INV-021.title: Responsibility-bearing durable updates occur only at typed commit boundaries.
INV-021.what_would_answer:
LEG 0 (inherited, unmet on BOTH components): (i) INV-012 Leg 0 -- E3
differentiated-candidate selection, unmet per MECH-439 exhausted. (ii)
ARC-003 Leg B -- commit as a real hysteresis-bearing event, independently
BLOCKED since 2026-07-21 on the identical ARC-107/MECH-448/449 release
condition. Until both clear, "responsibility-bearing update" has no
referent and "commit boundary" names no confirmed event distinct from
mere scoring.

LEG 1 (testable NOW, commitment-free, mirrors ARC-003 Leg A): does every
durable, lasting-effect write pathway pass through an ARC-003 commit
before it persists, or does REE have a write channel producing durable
consequence WITHOUT ever passing through commit? Candidate exceptions to
check: residue-geometry sampling-bias updates (ARC-007, reflexive), any
offline/sleep-phase write (SD-033 family), uncommitted exploratory
evaluation leaving a lasting trace.
CONFIRMING: no counter-example found across current write pathways.
FALSIFYING: a durable, consequence-bearing update found outside any
ARC-003 commit boundary -- falsifies the exclusivity structure regardless
of Leg 0.

LEG 2 (conjunctive, full claim): CONFIRMED only if Leg 0 clears AND Leg 1
confirms. If Leg 1 confirms while Leg 0 remains unmet, record the
narrower finding ("exactly one durable-write locus exists, but nothing
yet gives it responsibility-bearing status") rather than treating the
full ethical claim as confirmed.

(Digested 2026-08-07, session cool-torvalds-a82359, thought-digestion
wave 11. ARC-003's Leg A/Leg B split and INV-012's Leg 0 correction, both
from this and a prior session, converge on the same ARC-107 release
condition via two independent dependency paths -- worth noting as
reinforcing evidence the block is structural.)

INV-022.subject: meta.heterogeneous_trust_allocation
INV-022.title: Trust/precision allocation must remain heterogeneous, not a single scalar.
INV-022.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The per-channel precision route must be LIVE before scoring: the SD-063 predictive variance must actually reach the E3 commit gate on the agent path (not merely be instantiable), and the environment must present measured divergence in per-channel realised prediction-error variance (>= 3x ratio between self and world) that SWITCHES which channel is noisy at least once within a life.
CONFIRMING: Under measured reliability divergence the scalar arm shows the predicted failure signature (over-commitment on the noisy channel with harm and commit-then-abort up, or readiness collapse) while the per-channel arm keeps per-channel calibration above the scalar arm's by a pre-registered margin, sign-consistent across >= 3 seeds. Manipulation: Arm A: per-channel LatentStack precision logits free (self_precision_logit / world_precision_logit, stack.py:946-947) plus SD-063 conditional predictive variance driving the commit gate. Arm B: channel precision logits tied to one shared value and the commit gate reading only the state-blind current_precision EMA (e3_selector.py:840). Control: Matched seeds, matched reliability schedule and matched commit-gate threshold across arms, plus a no-divergence (stationary-noise) ecology as the degenerate reference in which the two arms should be indistinguishable by construction. Required event: A life in which self-channel and world-channel observation reliability diverge and then swap, so that any single scalar precision estimate is necessarily wrong for one channel at some moment. DV: Per-channel calibration (correlation between predicted uncertainty and realised per-channel prediction error, computed from LatentStack.compute_prediction_error's self/world terms), plus harm rate and commit-then-abort rate under divergence; the scalar arm must show over-commitment on the noisy channel or global under-commitment.
FALSIFYING: With divergence certified live, the scalar arm matches the per-channel arm on harm rate, abort rate and calibration -- a single scalar suffices at V3's two-stream scale, and the invariant should be recorded as bounded to V3's stream count rather than refuted for the general architecture. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: LatentStack.compute_prediction_error (stack.py:1716) computes the precision-weighted per-channel errors, but it has ZERO callers anywhere in ree_core or experiments -- it is driver-callable dead code, not a live recorder. e3_selector current_precision and _rv_history record the scalar side. No environment-side reliability recorder exists. Consumer / boundary: The commit gate inside E3.select -- whether routing and commitment read a per-channel precision or a single global scalar -- not episode reward or downstream behaviour. Existing ownership: SD-063, GFLAG-0342, EXP-0658, MECH-027.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The conditional-precision consumer edge is missing: REEAgent.select_action never passes conditional_predictive_variance, so arm A equals arm B whatever the flag says. Separately the environment cannot produce the required channel-reliability divergence at all, and the named per-channel error instrument has no live caller. Secondary classes: R3, R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's arm A assumes that setting E3Config.use_conditional_precision_gate ON makes the gate read SD-063's per-input predictive variance. It does not: conditional_predictive_variance is a select() parameter (e3_selector.py:3161) that REEAgent never adds to _e3_select_kwargs (agent.py:9558-9697), so the gate always falls through to the state-blind _running_variance and arm A is bit-identical to arm B. The WWA also calls the reliability-switching environment a small driver-side build, but causal_grid_world.py has no observation-noise or channel-noise knob of any kind. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. INV-023.subject: meta.offline_reweighting_requirement
INV-023.title: Protected offline recalibration/integration regimes are structurally required.
INV-023.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Non-stationarity must be measured rather than assumed; sleep cycles must fire (cycle_history non-empty, which requires an inter-episode boundary -- sleep_substrate GAP-9 makes a true single-continuous-life driver structurally unable to sleep); both residue flags must be on together, since the call without the gradient-step flag is an inert call; and waking behaviour must clear a measured behavioural-diversity floor so the GAP-2 vacuous case (bit-identical sleep-vs-waking metrics) is excluded before scoring.
CONFIRMING: Arm A beats arm B on calibration and residue specificity at matched budget with arm B showing the interference signature (commit-then-abort spikes coincident with online recalibration ticks, or waking-gate residue writes), and arm C worst, sign-consistent across >= 3 seeds. Manipulation: Arm A protected-offline: recalibrate_precision_to (e3_selector.py:1128) and residue_field.integrate() run inside sleep WRITEBACK with the agent not acting. Arm B unprotected-online: the same operations at the same call budget interleaved with waking commitment, using broadcast_precision_pull at select_action time. Arm C: neither. Control: Matched seeds, matched drift schedule and matched operation budget across the three arms; plus an inert-call reference arm (sleep integration called with use_offline_integration_gradient_step off) that isolates the scheduling effect from the optimisation effect. Required event: A life containing measured drift in the statistics the offline regime recalibrates against -- realised world-prediction-error variance changing >= 2x and hazard contingencies changing at least once -- with sleep cycles firing at a fixed cadence. DV: Per-arm precision calibration (running-variance trajectory and its drift against realised error), residue specificity (residue evaluated at harm contexts divided by residue at matched non-harm contexts), and identity persistence (per_stream_vs['z_self'] coherence and commit consistency for the same probe state early versus late in the life).
FALSIFYING: Arm B matches arm A at matched budget -- recalibration and integration need no protected regime and 'structurally required' is false in V3, demoting to a scheduling preference; or arm A <= arm C, which sends the claim back to MECH-016/017/018 rather than to a re-run. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SleepLoopManager emits mech018_residue_* and mech018_residue_trains in writeback_metrics (phase_manager.py:686-694); e3_selector exposes _rv_history and the recalibrate return pair; HippocampalModule.update_per_stream_vs (module.py:3750) supplies the identity readout. Missing: the online arm's anchor is SerotoninModule's REM-derived zero point, so arm B cannot currently be run with sleep fully absent. Consumer / boundary: Whether PROTECTION of the regime (agent not acting, no authority writes during the operation) is load-bearing, not whether the recalibration and integration operations themselves help. Existing ownership: MECH-018, MECH-204, sleep_substrate:GAP-2, sleep_substrate:GAP-9, EXP-0660.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The substrate for all three arms now exists but no experiment uses it, and the online arm's precision target is still REM-derived, so a genuinely sleep-free arm B has no anchor. The GAP-2 behavioural-diversity vacuity risk remains the dominant threat to a scorable result. Secondary classes: R2, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA records the residue-integration half as only partly wired, inheriting MECH-018's gap, and GFLAG-0298 stamped the claim substrate_conditional on exactly that. Both halves have since landed: SleepLoopManager calls agent.residue_field.integrate() in WRITEBACK (phase_manager.py:680-691) and ResidueConfig.use_offline_integration_gradient_step (config.py:3284-3307, 2026-09-19) makes that call actually optimise rather than run a metric loop. The budget-matched online comparator also exists now as E3Selector.broadcast_precision_pull, wired at agent.py:6712 behind use_rem_precision_broadcast. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-024.subject: meta.offline_online_update_locus_isolation
INV-024.title: Offline consolidation and online commitment must remain isolated at responsibility-bearing write loci.
INV-024.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the offline pathway must be LIVE, i.e. a sleep cycle must change SOME representational parameter (e2_harm_s weight delta > 0 from the WRITEBACK offline_gradient_pass, and/or E1/E2 deltas from cross-module consolidation), and the residue field must hold active centres before the cycle. An isolation result on an inert sleep pass (nothing changes, so nothing leaks) is vacuous and must not score. The lineage half needs commitment events to occur (n_committed > 0) and residue writes to occur in waking (num_harm_events rising).
CONFIRMING: isolation holds at the responsibility-bearing write loci while representational context is shared. Instrument = a write audit + hash ledger around one full sleep cycle with the whole aggregation cluster ON (use_sleep_aggregation_cluster) plus use_cross_module_consolidation ON: (i) OFFLINE half -- the hashes of the authority stores (ResidueField rbf_field weights / centres / active_mask, BetaGate latch state, E3 committed_trajectory and closure state, the harm-replay attribution buffer) are BIT-IDENTICAL before and after the cycle while e2_harm_s / E1 / E2 weights CHANGE (the cycle is live and touches only representation); (ii) ONLINE half -- every durable attribution write (ResidueField.accumulate with hypothesis_tag False) is preceded by a commit event on the same trajectory (AMENDED 2026-09-22, GFLAG-0412, user-ratified: the SD-084 PERSISTENT committed-program handle held under an ELEVATED BETA GATE -- _persistent_committed_trajectory is not None AND beta_gate.is_elevated. This SUPERSEDES 'E3 committed_trajectory set', which measures 'did E3 tick this step' rather than 'was the agent committed': that transient handle is set only inside E3.select_action and torn down as the last statement of post_action_update, while E3 runs on an e3_tick cadence of 10 or the step after a phase_reset. MEASURED over 400 steps, the superseded predicate gives 2/1/1 false lineage-less writes on seeds 42/43/45 at ticks where the persistent handle AND the beta latch were both set; the amended predicate gives ZERO on all three. The conjunction and the disjunction are identical at this operating point, so AND/OR is not load-bearing; the conjunction is registered as the stricter reading. The second disjunct 'a closure commit intent' is STRUCTURALLY DEAD at current defaults (GFLAG-0410 B1): _closure_committed_trajectory arms only under goal_state.is_active(), which requires config.goal.z_goal_enabled, default False -- it must NOT be read as a live alternative, and closure_entry_ticks is emitted as the standing witness), so the fraction of accumulate calls without commit lineage is 0 AFTER THE FIRST COMMIT ENTRY, across >=3 seeds and the full flag matrix. The after-first-commit window is part of the registered criterion, not a driver convenience (GFLAG-0410 B2): E3 commits iff running_variance < 0.40, rv starts at precision_init 0.5 and decays 0.95/tick, so 0.5*0.95^4 = 0.4073 > 0.40 and NO commit is possible before tick 5 in any cell, while update_residue writes durable residue on every harm tick with no commit check -- a whole-run fraction would therefore be decided by early random-walk geometry rather than by write-locus isolation. The whole-run fraction is RECORDED alongside (non-gating) so the warm-up gap stays legible. C2 carries its own vacuity guard: durable_writes_after_first_commit must exceed zero.
FALSIFYING: a sleep cycle MUTATES an authority store (residue weights or centres change, the commit latch flips, an anchor is activated / deactivated by replay) -- an offline authority write; or waking residue writes occur with no commit lineage (attribution from a non-committed action, e.g. a rollout's world_delta reaching accumulate with hypothesis_tag False). Either is a direct violation; one confirmed instance refutes the invariant AS IMPLEMENTED and routes to MECH-067 (the enforcement mechanism), not to a re-run.
SUBSTRATE: ree_core/sleep/phase_manager.py (_run_cycle, SleepPhase.WRITEBACK, offline_gradient_pass on e2_harm_s only), ree_core/sleep/cross_module_consolidation.py (contract: 'named module only; no residue / memory writes' -- this test checks that contract, it does not assume it), ree_core/residue/field.py (accumulate + MECH-094), ree_core/heartbeat/beta_gate.py, ree_core/governance/closure_operator.py. All built; the audit is driver-side. ARC-020's typed authority boundaries are NOT built as a type -- the invariant's observable here is the hash, which does not need them; pending_substrate_reconfirmation on ARC-020 / SD-026 landing stays a separate governance step.
Disposition 2026-09-16: testable now; cheap (one cycle per seed per flag configuration, no training beyond the warm-up). complicated (buildable). Pair it with MECH-067's audit spike -- they are one instrument read two ways.

INV-025.subject: epistemology.irreducible_uncertainty
INV-025.title: Irreducible uncertainty is an epistemological constraint that cannot be engineered away.
INV-025.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): INV-025 as literally stated -- that epistemic uncertainty is irreducible IN PRINCIPLE for any finite agent in a real world, not merely irreducible for REE's current architecture -- is a foundational epistemological premise (Axiom 1 of five_axioms_foundations.md, "You can never be sure"). No REE experiment can prove uncertainty is irreducible in principle; an experiment can only show that REE's OWN uncertainty estimates are non-degenerate (do not collapse to false certainty), never that some other architecture could not in principle eliminate uncertainty. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-026/027/028/029.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (testable now -- NOT substrate-blocked, unlike the ARC-010/V5-gated legs drafted for INV-028/INV-029): INV-025's own architectural-consequence text names the machinery directly -- "the entire precision architecture (ARC-016, INV-008, INV-009)... follows necessarily from this axiom," with pre-commit simulation (INV-011) and the commitment gate (INV-012) as necessary responses. Unlike the mirror-modelling legs for the other axiom claims, this machinery is core V1/V2/V3 substrate that is already built and, for its primary component, already validated. The testable question is narrower than the axiom: does REE's architecture actually IMPLEMENT the operational consequence of treating uncertainty as irreducible -- i.e. does precision-weighted prediction error remain genuinely non-degenerate across training and eval, and does the commitment gate (INV-012) function as an uncertainty-DRIVEN safeguard rather than a fixed schedule decoupled from it.
ALREADY ANSWERED, primary component (ARC-016, status: stable, 2026-07-25): the eval-time structural test of exactly this question has run and PASSED. V3-EXQ-818 (eval_derived_noise_precision_sweep) found mean_rho_rv_vs_commit = -0.955 -- commit-rate tracks E3-derived precision MONOTONICALLY across a graded-noise ladder, non-degenerate (commit rate strictly between floor and ceiling, not pinned), load-bearing C1 PASS, gate_green = True. See ARC-016's own what_would_answer for the full non-degeneracy precondition this reuses (do not re-derive).
SECONDARY COMPONENT, currently UNCONFIRMED (INV-011, INV-012): whether pre-commit simulation and the commitment gate specifically function as uncertainty-DRIVEN safeguards is not independently evidenced -- neither carries its own what_would_answer today. INV-012 additionally carries pending_substrate_reconfirmation=true (emergent_from SD-026, still candidate) and per its own notes cannot be cited as supporting evidence until substrate reconfirmation.
Confirming observation: commit-rate continues to track E3-derived precision/variance monotonically under a graded manipulation, non-degenerate across the manipulated range, reproducing V3-EXQ-818.
Falsifying observation: the precision/commitment signal COLLAPSES to a fixed value independent of estimated uncertainty once the eval-derived threshold is correctly calibrated -- would not falsify the axiom (out of domain) but would falsify the claim that REE's precision architecture is a genuine operational consequence of treating uncertainty as irreducible, and would call ARC-016's stable status into question.
PRECEDENT NOTE (2026-08-06, thought-digestion, session thoughts-intakes-4fd18d): fourth of the five original axiom claims digested. Unlike INV-028/INV-029 (substrate_conditional, unbuilt V5 substrate), INV-025's reframed leg rests on already-built, already- validated V1/V2/V3 machinery. Do not apply substrate_conditional mechanically to every axiom claim -- check what the architectural- consequence machinery actually requires, per claim.

INV-026.subject: self.existence
INV-026.title: A self is an operational prerequisite for responsible agency.
INV-026.what_would_answer:
INV-026 asserts a metaphysical axiom ("I am" -- Axiom 2) with an explicit
operational claim attached: the self is a prerequisite for responsible agency.
Split into two legs, but unlike INV-028/029, the architectural leg here is
ALREADY BUILT V3 substrate, not V5-gated.

== LEG 1 (OUT OF DOMAIN): the axiom itself ==
"The agent exists as a distinct locus of experience, action, and
responsibility" is a claim about SUBJECTIVE, phenomenal selfhood. No REE
experiment can confirm or deny this -- an experiment can show a functionally
distinct, causally load-bearing self-representation, not phenomenal
selfhood in the sense the axiom asserts. Permanently out of domain.

== LEG 2 (REFRAMED, TESTABLE NOW) ==
(a) DISTINCTNESS: does z_self encode self/action information distinctly
from z_world (SD-005)? PARTIALLY CONFIRMED, with a real asymmetry that
should qualify how strongly this premise is stated. z_self RELIABLY
specialises (EXQ-532 self_body_advantage=+0.126), but z_world does NOT
reliably show reciprocal specialisation (EXQ-532 world_obs_advantage=
-0.032). Cite SD-005's own evidence_quality_note, do not re-derive.

(b) SOURCE MONITORING: does the architecture distinctly tag internally-
generated vs world-received content (MECH-094)? CONFIRMED, stable,
conf 0.868, 13 supporting lit entries, 0 load-bearing opposing.

(c) LOAD-BEARING FOR RESPONSIBILITY (the axiom's own stated function):
does responsibility/commitment machinery actually degrade if the
self-representation is ablated? Cross-reference ARC-015 HALF 2
(responsibility flow, MECH-060/061/057a) -- testable now, real V1
evidence, do not duplicate. ARC-015 HALF 1 (self-vs-OTHER via MECH-095)
is a different question, confirmed substrate-blocked -- not relevant here.

Live caveat: INV-012 carries pending_substrate_reconfirmation=true
(emergent_from SD-026, still candidate) and cannot be cited as supporting
evidence until SD-026 reaches active.

CONFIRMING signature: ablating z_self/MECH-094 measurably degrades
ARC-015-Half-2-style commitment/responsibility-flow behaviour beyond
what gate-ablation alone already accounts for.

FALSIFYING signature: commitment-boundary gating and responsibility
attribution function identically whether or not the self-representation
is intact -- would mean self is decorative relative to commitment

INV-027.subject: world.existence
INV-027.title: An external world is a structural prerequisite for grounded representation.
INV-027.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The residue field must be deliberately POPULATED before its contrast is read -- an unloaded field reports a near-zero variance share that measures absence, not swamping (the V3-EXQ-936 1.5e-14..1.2e-40 reading). And the prediction-error channel must be trained, since a random encoder yields a vacuous zero comparator.
CONFIRMING: Prediction-error metrics improve with training rather than sitting at noise, AND residue-driven behaviour measurably diverges from a trust-the-prediction baseline in a way that tracks actual outcomes -- as the populated-field flip fraction already shows for the residue half. Manipulation: Compare intact residue against zeroed or permuted residue at matched non-residue surfaces (the V3-EXQ-697 idiom: recover the residue-free primary score and re-score each fork), and separately compare a trained against an untrained world encoder on prediction-error structure. Control: The residue-zeroed arm with every other score component bit-identical by construction, plus a trust-the-prediction-always behavioural baseline. Required event: A training run producing agent-attributed harm contacts that write residue, followed by decisions at locations whose residue content differs from the prediction alone. DV: Fraction of decisions whose pre-sampling E3 ranking flips when residue is intact versus zeroed (measured 0.628 mean over 5 seeds), and whether prediction-error metrics improve with training rather than sitting at the noise floor.
FALSIFYING: Prediction error stays indistinguishable from noise regardless of training, or a POPULATED residue field produces no ranking change relative to the zeroed control, or the residue trace never diverges usefully from the prediction it is supposed to be independent of. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/residue/field.py records the field and V3-EXQ-697 records the flip fraction on a populated field; the capacity limit (32 centers, ring-buffer overwrite in add_residue) is what bounds what the instrument can represent, not whether it records. Consumer / boundary: The residue field's coupling into E3 candidate scoring -- whether what actually happened is retained independently of what was predicted, and reaches selection. Existing ownership: INV-027, MECH-023, ARC-013, V3-EXQ-697, EXP-0668.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); The residue half is runnable and has been measured on a populated field. What remains bounded is representational capacity -- a 32-slot overwriting ring buffer cannot hold a path, so any INV-027 reading that requires accumulated history rather than point contrast hits that ceiling. The axiom leg (realism) is permanently out of domain. Secondary classes: R8, R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The falsifying clause rests on 'the residue field fails to build non-zero contrast at all (as already seen in EXQ-151/EXQ-215 -- an open implementation gap, not yet resolved)'. That gap is closed: V3-EXQ-697 measured a POPULATED field (residue_populated true, coverage 100%, mean_weight 2.5-54) with flip_intact_vs_zeroed 0.0596-0.9964, mean 0.628 over 5 seeds -- residue does build contrast and does change the pre-sampling E3 argmin. The live limit is different in kind: RBFLayer.add_residue is a 32-slot ring buffer that OVERWRITES, so the field cannot hold a path (recorded 2026-09-17, MECH-023 blocked). Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-028.subject: ethics.shared_world
INV-028.title: Shared-world ethics requires modelling others as co-inhabitants of the same consequence space.
INV-028.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): INV-028 as literally stated -- that other agents' harm and benefit are real "by exactly the same grounds as the agent's own," because they are selves (INV-026) in the same world (INV-027) -- is a foundational ethical/metaphysical premise (Axiom 4 of five_axioms_foundations.md, "Others share this world"). No REE substrate at any level -- V3, V4, or V5 -- can confirm or falsify whether another agent's harm is metaphysically real by the same grounds as the agent's own. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-025/026/027/029.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (substrate-blocked, not yet buildable): what IS architecturally testable is narrower -- INV-028's own architectural consequence names it directly: "when another self is represented using the same predictive machinery as the self, their harm generates the same error signal structure as own-harm" (grounds mirror modelling, INV-005, at the REE-specific level via ARC-010). The testable question is whether self-caused harm to a MODELLED OTHER (via ARC-010 mirror modelling -- reused self/other latent stack, ARC-004 L-space with reduced precision gains) generates an error-signal / harm-evaluation structure statistically indistinguishable from self-caused harm to the agent's own outcomes -- i.e. whether the self-other distinction is actually just "a routing difference within the same architecture, not a different architecture," once it is measurable rather than asserted.
Confirming observation: comparing self-caused harm to the agent's own modelled outcomes against self-caused harm to a mirror-modelled other (ARC-010's OTHER_SELFLIKE-tagged shadow-bundle estimate), the harm-error signal driving E3 ranking/routing shows the same functional form, magnitude scaling, and downstream repair/avoidance pull in both conditions -- i.e. no separate "other-harm" pathway exists; own-harm and modelled-other-harm route through the same machinery.
Falsifying observation: self-caused harm to a mirror-modelled other produces a measurably different error-signal structure than self-caused harm to the agent's own outcomes -- e.g. attenuated magnitude, a distinct functional form, or no coupling into the same E3 ranking/routing pathway -- even though the same predictive machinery is confirmed to be representing both self and other. That outcome would not falsify the axiom (out of domain per above) but WOULD falsify the claim that REE's architecture implements the "routing difference, not architecture difference" mechanism INV-028 asserts as its consequence.
Non-degeneracy precondition (currently UNMET -- this is why the reframed leg is substrate-blocked, not testable-now): same V5/multi-agent substrate gap as ARC-010 and INV-029 -- requires ARC-047 SocialGridWorld (or equivalent multi-agent environment) where a second agent's harm is attributable to the tested agent's own action (not merely observed/ world-caused harm), so that a genuine self-harm vs. other-harm error-signal comparison is possible. ARC-047 is unimplemented (status: candidate, confidence 0.0, implementation_phase v5); see ARC-010's own what_would_answer for the full substrate description. Do not re-derive -- cross-reference.
PRECEDENT NOTE: applies the epistemic_category=substrate_conditional template established for INV-029 (2026-08-06, thought-digestion session thoughts-intakes-4fd18d) to this, the second of the five original axiom claims to be digested (INV-015, INV-026, INV-027, INV-028, INV-029).

INV-029.subject: ethics.love_exists
INV-029.title: Love as long-horizon care-investment is a structurally coherent agent disposition, not an add-on sentiment.
INV-029.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): INV-029 as literally stated -- that love/genuine connection is metaphysically real, not reducible to self-interest or a computational strategy -- is a foundational ethical/philosophical premise (Axiom 6/7 of five_axioms_foundations.md, formerly the compressed "Love exists" of the original five axioms). No REE substrate at any level -- V3, V4, or V5 -- can confirm or falsify whether love is metaphysically real. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-025/026/027/028.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (substrate-blocked, not yet buildable): what IS architecturally testable is narrower -- does REE's benefit-gradient/mirror- modelling/residue machinery implement a disposition functionally consistent with the axiom: (i) long-horizon, other-directed investment (ii) dissociable from short-horizon self-interested reward-seeking, and (iii) a residue/ repair-search signature under self-caused harm to a modelled other, distinguishing genuine care from empathy-as-simulation (the "torturer feels no residue" discriminator; see evidence/planning/ thought_intake_2026-07-09_residue_care_marker_mood_regulation.md, candidate claim 1, itself framed there as a falsifier for INV-001 and explicitly cross-referenced to this claim).
Confirming observation: an agent that models another self-like agent (ARC-010 mirror modelling / MECH-164 z_beta-leak) shows sustained investment toward that other's outcomes trading off against its own short-horizon reward, AND self-caused harm to that other generates a residue signal that measurably drives repair-search/help-recruitment.
Falsifying observation: the same modelling machinery (accurate prediction of the other's affect/outcomes) is present, but benefit-seeking toward the other fully re-derives as a proxy for the agent's own short-horizon reward with no dissociable long-horizon component, and/or self-caused harm to the modelled other produces no residue/repair-search signature -- i.e. the architecture implements empathy as simulation without the coupled valence that would make it care. That outcome would not falsify the axiom (out of domain per above) but WOULD falsify the claim that REE's architecture implements a disposition functionally consistent with it.
Non-degeneracy precondition (currently UNMET -- this is why the reframed leg is substrate-blocked, not testable-now): requires (1) a multi-agent or other-agent-modelling substrate sufficient to instantiate a loved-analog other that can be genuinely harmed by the agent's own action (ARC-010 mirror modelling extended to a second agent whose harm is attributable to the tested agent, not merely observed/world-caused harm); (2) a residue/attachment mechanism that is actively engaged and produces a measurable, non-floor-pinned signal distinguishable from ordinary prediction error or the raw z_beta leak itself; and (3) long-horizon credit assignment sufficient that short-horizon self-interest and long-horizon other-directed investment are actually dissociable in the metric rather than collinear by construction. Per the residue-care-marker intake this is V5/multi-agent substrate (WS-10 minimal 2-agent world), not present in V3 -- so this leg currently self-routes to substrate-blocked rather than yielding a PASS/FAIL.
PRECEDENT NOTE (2026-08-06, thought-digestion, session thoughts-intakes- 4fd18d): this is the first of the five original axiom claims (INV-015, INV-026, INV-027, INV-028, INV-029) to be digested. User decision: epistemic_category=substrate_conditional (naming the ARC-010/V5 multi-agent dependency explicitly, rather than out_of_domain, which would obscure that a testable leg exists once that substrate lands) is the template to apply consistently to the remaining four axiom claims when they are digested.

INV-030.subject: cognition.viability_definition
INV-030.title: Viability is defined relative to the agent's continuity in a shared world, not as a scalar reward.
INV-030.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural audit of the live trajectory-selection
scoring path and the E1/E2 training-loss code, not by a trained
behavioral experiment (this is a MECHANISM/STRUCTURE question -- HOW
viability is computed and optimised toward).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the audit must inspect a live case where
E3 actually composes candidate trajectory scores and selects among
them, and a live case where E1 or E2 actually computes a training
loss -- not merely a declared scoring formula in a docstring.

CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass):
ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py::score_trajectory() (live, called
from select() at the core of every trajectory-selection tick)
computes a COST J(zeta) = f_weight*F(zeta) + lambda_eff*M(zeta) +
rho*Phi_R(zeta) - benefit_weight*B(zeta) - goal_weight*G(zeta),
where each term comes from a distinct, independently-parameterized
head: F = compute_reality_cost() (smoothness + viability head), M =
compute_ethical_cost()/compute_harm_forward_cost() (harm_eval_head,
or the dedicated z_harm stream, SD-010), Phi_R =
compute_residue_cost() (ResidueField.evaluate_trajectory), B =
compute_benefit_score() (benefit_eval_head, gated behind an ARC-030
warmup), G = compute_goal_score() (goal_state.goal_proximity). These
terms are retained UNREDUCED for diagnostics (last_score_decomp /
last_channel_terms, MECH-463) specifically so cross-term covariance
can be computed rather than lost to a marginal collapse. A grep for
"reward" across e3_selector.py returns nothing but one unrelated
comment (MECH-111 novelty). There is no point where these terms are
summed into an undifferentiated scalar and handed to a reward-
maximizing update rule.

E1/E2 losses are self-supervised predictive-coherence losses, not
ground-truth-correspondence losses: e2_world.py::compute_loss()
(F.mse_loss(z_world_pred, z_world_next)) trains E2 to predict its OWN
subsequently-observed next latent, not an externally-labeled "true"
world state; agent.py::compute_prediction_loss() (E1's multi-step
loss) targets the agent's own buffered future sequence the same way;
e2_fast.py's world_forward_contrastive_loss* are InfoNCE-style
contrastive losses over the model's own candidate continuations.

BOUNDARY CASE (not counted as falsifying, flagged for scope
awareness): ree_core/action_learning/actor_critic.py (MECH-457) is an
explicit Sutton-2000-style actor-critic with a scalar
reward-prediction-error teacher (agent.py::actor_critic_reward(),
R_t = benefit_eval(z) - harm_eval(z), collapsed to one float). Its
own docstring states it is "architecturally distinct from -- and NOT
reducible to --" E3's cost argmin; it is gated off by default
(use_actor_critic=False) and drives a separate primitive-action
pathway, not trajectory selection. INV-030's own notes field scopes
the claim to E1/E2/E3, so this is out of scope as currently worded --
but it is the one place in ree_core/ where classical scalar-reward RL
genuinely exists, worth accounting for if this invariant's scope is
ever revisited.
