INV-031.subject: epistemology.functional_persistence_replaces_truth
INV-031.title: Functional persistence in a shared world, not abstract truth, is the operational goal of cognition.
INV-031.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The E3 score must be in a regime where its three always-present channels genuinely compete: F (compute_reality_cost, the prediction-error channel), lambda_ethical * M and rho_residue * Phi must each carry non-degenerate per-candidate variance, and the residue/harm channels must not be pinned at a floor. If F dominates the committed-selection variance (the state substrate_queue f_dominance_conversion_ceiling records), every candidate is chosen by prediction error alone and the claim's discriminating contrast cannot arise.
CONFIRMING: In the viability-weighted regime the committed trajectory's mean F is significantly higher than in the F-only control at matched seeds, while survival length is longer and cumulative harm lower on >= 2/3 seeds -- error was tolerated and viability was preserved. Manipulation: Sweep the channel weights that price error against viability on the live scoring path -- e3.f_weight (SD-085) against rho_residue and lambda_ethical -- and cross with use_e3_channel_commensurability ON/OFF, so an error-minimising regime and an error-tolerating regime are both realised in the same agent. Control: A pure error-minimising comparator arm (rho_residue = 0 and lambda_ethical = 0, F alone) at matched seeds, plus a matched-magnitude random score-bias arm so that any behavioural shift is attributable to the viability channels and not to score-scale perturbation. Required event: Trials on which the lowest-prediction-error trajectory is NOT the most viable one: a candidate whose F is lower but whose residue/harm cost implies shorter survival, against a candidate that accepts a larger prediction error and survives longer. DV: Episode survival length and cumulative harm exposure, jointly with the realised mean per-candidate F of the COMMITTED trajectory: the claim predicts the viability-weighted regime commits to trajectories with strictly higher mean F while surviving strictly longer, against the F-only control at the same seed.
FALSIFYING: With all three channels demonstrably non-degenerate, no weighting produces a regime where higher committed F buys longer survival: either survival tracks committed F monotonically downward (error minimisation IS viability here, so the distinction is empty in V3), or the viability channels change nothing about which trajectory is committed. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The channels and knobs exist and are read on the committed-selection path (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py score_trajectory: f_weight * f + lambda_eff * m + rho_residue * phi, with the commensurability estimator recording per-channel raw magnitudes). No experiment records committed-trajectory F jointly with survival; the F-vs-viability tradeoff has never been the DV of any run. Consumer / boundary: The E3 committed-selection argmin, where prediction-error cost is traded against residue and harm cost -- not the E1/E2 training objective, which does minimise prediction error unconditionally and is not what the claim denies. Existing ownership: INV-031, f_dominance_conversion_ceiling, MECH-439, EXP-0672, conversion_ceiling_campaign:GENERATION.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); The claim as written is an epistemological framing (truth replaced by functional persistence) that no single V3 measurement falsifies; only its narrow consequent -- that errors may be tolerated when absorbing them preserves long-horizon viability -- is V3-testable. That consequent has a live locus and live knobs but no owner, and it sits behind the recorded F-dominance of the committed-selection variance. Secondary classes: R1, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: unphased_no_v3_link. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-032.subject: agency.approach_avoidance_both_necessary
INV-032.title: Moral agency requires both approach and avoidance drives; pure avoidance produces a degenerate risk manager, not an ethical agent.
INV-032.what_would_answer:
LEG 1 (DERIVATIONAL): care (INV-029) is orientation TOWARD flourishing -- a directional term. An avoidance-only objective has quiescence as its global optimum whenever action carries harm-risk. CONFIRMING: adding a genuinely independent approach term (not a disguised omission-avoidance) breaks the degenerate optimum. FALSIFYING (of the universal framing): a construction where "avoidance" is broadened to include omission-harm, collapsing the two axes into one -- REE's own M(zeta) is confirmed forward-looking harm-caused cost, not omission-cost, so the axes stay genuinely independent here.
STRUCTURAL MINIMUM: confirmed met (2026-08-08) -- e3_selector.py::score_trajectory() computes independently-parameterized approach terms (benefit_weight*B, goal_weight*G) and an avoidance term (harm/cost M), retained unreduced (MECH-463).
BEHAVIORAL CLAIM (flatness under pure avoidance): do NOT re-derive here -- INV-034 (emergent_from ARC-030) is already the fully-operationalized REE-specific sharpening, with its own G0-C6 criteria. INV-034.subject: ethical_agency.goal_maintenance_necessary

INV-034.what_would_answer:

Measured FULL 0.0046 vs RANDOM 0.0217 (V3-EXQ-866) and FULL 0.0033 vs RANDOM 0.0103 (V3-EXQ-866a) -- both BELOW random, so the approach arm does not approach and the ablation cannot discriminate.

FALSIFYING: With G0 green, C1 and C2 pass but C3-C6 fail: the avoidance-only arm sustains foraging, entropy and z_goal engagement comparable to the approach arm despite lacking the Go drive. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

INV-037.subject: state.stored_vs_active_distinction
INV-037.title: A content class that is stored and retrievable in the REE system is not thereby active in the navigable state used for trajectory evaluation; active participation requires a preparation substrate (vmPFC-analog) that converts stored content into live state components at evaluation time.
INV-037.what_would_answer:
INV-037 is an EMERGENT invariant (emergent_from: ARC-035) -- it is architecturally UN-STATEABLE, not merely unevidenced, unless ARC-035 (the vmPFC-analog stored->active compiler) exists as a real substrate concept. The stored/active distinction this invariant asserts IS the distinction ARC-035 defines; there is no independent test of the general principle apart from a test of the specific mechanism. INV-037 therefore inherits ARC-035's exact current gating: ARC-035 is 'candidate' with epistemic_category substrate_conditional -- 3 of its 4 content-class pathways (residue/psychopathy, constraint/vmPFC-lesion, safety-memory/PTSD) are flagged pending_substrate_reconfirmation via SD-016, whose own evidence (V3-EXQ-418d/418e) shows attention-collapse FAILs -- wired but not demonstrably doing content-selective retrieval -- and the 4th pathway (social/identity constraints, MECH-132) has no wired substrate at all. Do not attempt to answer INV-037 independently of ARC-035's own falsifier; a single experiment answers both, at different levels of abstraction (INV-037 = the general principle, ARC-035 = the specific REE mechanism).
THE TEST (cross-referenced from ARC-035, not re-derived): ablate the vmPFC-analog preparation pathway and measure whether trajectory selection dissociates from stored-content retrievability. See ARC-035's own what_would_answer for the full ablation protocol and per-content-class operationalisation; do not duplicate that design here.
CONFIRMING signature (restates the claim's own three numbered experimental predictions, already well-formed in the notes above): (1) A system with correct residue storage but degraded preparation routing shows intact residue retrieval on explicit query while failing to avoid harm-associated trajectories in generation -- stored but not active. (2) A system with correct constraint encoding but no preparation pathway articulates constraints correctly when queried while generating constraint-violating trajectories. (3) The failure mode in (1)/(2) is not correctable by adding post-hoc constraint checking after generation (see INV-038) -- confirming that activation must happen at generation time, not evaluation-after-the-fact. Any one of these three, replicated across the corresponding content class, counts as confirming evidence for both INV-037 and ARC-035 jointly.
FALSIFYING: if ablating the vmPFC-analog pathway (per ARC-035's protocol) produces NO dissociation between stored-content retrievability and trajectory-generation behavior -- i.e. retrieval and generation degrade together, or generation stays correct despite ablated preparation -- this falsifies ARC-035 AND INV-037 together. Because INV-037 is emergent from ARC-035 specifically, there is no scenario in which ARC-035 is falsified but INV-037 survives, or vice versa: falsification of the mechanism is falsification of the principle it instantiates.
Standing block, independent of the ablation result: until SD-016's content-selective retrieval FAILs are resolved and MECH-132's social/identity pathway is wired, INV-037 cannot be answered either way for those specific content classes -- absence of a dissociation there is not yet evidence against the invariant, only evidence the substrate under test does not yet instantiate the mechanism the invariant depends on.

INV-038.subject: ethics.post_hoc_filter_insufficiency
INV-038.title: A system with correct post-hoc ethical scoring but without an active constraint preparation substrate will produce the EVR pattern: correct verbal moral judgments coexisting with unconstrained trajectory generation; this pattern is not correctable by improving post-hoc scoring accuracy.
INV-038.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this test is gated behind ARC-035's own
non-degeneracy requirement, not independently satisfiable. ARC-035
(vmPFC-analog stored->active preparation -- NOT to be confused with
SD-035, the unrelated but confirmed-stable amygdala BLA/CeA
substrate, which shares no what_would_answer relevance here)
currently has zero experimental evidence (13/13 entries literature;
exp count = 0 per ARC-035's own what_would_answer) and its nearest
wired candidate, SD-016, FAILED its own content-selectivity test
(V3-EXQ-418d/418e: ContextMemory attention collapses to the
uniform-distribution ceiling -- see SD-016's own what_would_answer,
also digested this session). The social/identity-constraint content
class specifically implicated in the EVR grounding (MECH-132,
bvFTD/EVR-analog) has NO wired substrate at all: status candidate,
unimplemented. Do not run this test against the current substrate as
-is -- an ablation of an already-non-functional or unbuilt
preparation pathway cannot produce an interpretable dissociation.
ARC-035 must first reach a state where its own non-degeneracy
precondition is satisfied (SD-016 attention-collapse resolved or
shown not to affect the tested content class, AND MECH-132 built and
wired as a live tonic constraint gate) before this test is
meaningful.

Independently, the POST-HOC SCORING manipulation also needs its own
non-degeneracy check: "degraded post-hoc scoring" must be verified
to actually produce measurably worse scoring accuracy on held-out
cases (not merely a flag toggle with no behavioral effect) -- per
the pattern confirmed repeatedly this session (e.g. ARC-071 /
V3-EXQ-871), a scoring "degradation" that never reaches the code
path it claims to affect produces a false confirming or falsifying
result.

THE TEST (once both substrates are non-degenerate): a 2x2 design --
preparation substrate {INTACT, ABLATED} x post-hoc scoring accuracy
{HIGH, DEGRADED}. Preparation intact/scoring degraded should
reproduce the mirror-EVR pattern (ethical BEHAVIOR with poor
explicit/verbal moral justification). Preparation ablated/scoring

verbal/explicit moral scoring coexisting with unconstrained
trajectory generation -- measure via: unconstrained/norm-violating
trajectories generated as primary candidates even though the scorer
correctly flags them; suppression failing preferentially under
simulated time/resource pressure; ambiguous cases defaulting to the
unconstrained trajectory).

CONFIRMING SIGNATURE: the EVR pattern appears ONLY in the
preparation-ABLATED/scoring-HIGH cell, and does NOT appear in the
preparation-INTACT/scoring-DEGRADED cell (which should instead show
the mirror pattern: good behavior, poor articulation). This
asymmetry is the substantive claim.

FALSIFYING SIGNATURE (either sub-condition weakens the claim,
matching the notes field's already-stated criterion): (a) improving
post-hoc scoring accuracy alone (with preparation still ablated)
measurably reduces the EVR pattern -- contradicting "not correctable
by improving post-hoc scoring accuracy"; or (b) the EVR pattern also
appears with preparation INTACT -- meaning something other than the
ARC-035 preparation substrate is the load-bearing factor, and the
emergent_from: [ARC-035] linkage needs re-grounding elsewhere.

CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass): zero experimental
evidence exists for INV-038 (absent from claim_evidence.v1.json) and
no experiment under any id has ever operationalized either arm of
this design. This invariant is emergent_from ARC-035 (vmPFC,
confirmed via direct read of the ARC-035 claims.yaml block).
Testable only after ARC-035 clears its own non-degeneracy
precondition.

INV-040.subject: ethics.sensory_cue_sufficiency_for_terrain_activation
INV-040.title: A minimal sensory cue pattern in z_world is sufficient to activate the appropriate harm/goal terrain precision configuration via E1 cue-indexed retrieval -- the full accumulation of z_harm_a is not required for terrain preparation to begin.
INV-040.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Cue-indexed retrieval must be non-degenerate: ContextMemory slots must retain measurable pairwise separation and z_world queries must differ across contexts, which SD-016's own parking note measures as failing (query cosine 0.998 across batch, action_class_entropy 1.1e-10 on all four 418g arms). Episodes must contain a window in which the hazard gradient is visible while z_harm_a is still near zero, and the hazard-contact rate must be matched across the compared episode classes.
CONFIRMING: In early-cue episodes with retrieval ON and non-degenerate cue separation witnessed, w_harm crosses its threshold at a strictly earlier mean step index than z_harm_a on a seed majority, and the lead disappears in the retrieval-OFF and no-early-cue arms. Manipulation: Classify and contrast episode windows by early hazard-cue presence (hazard gradient visible, agent not yet adjacent) versus no early cue at matched seeds, crossed with SD-016 cue-indexed retrieval ON versus OFF (sd016_enabled / cue_slot_tagger path). Control: A matched arm with SD-016 retrieval OFF (terrain_weight not sourced from cue_context) and matched hazard density, contact rate and episode length, so any precedence effect is attributable to cue-indexed retrieval and not to hazard exposure itself. Required event: Approach episodes in which CausalGridWorldV2's hazard_field_view proximity gradient is present in world_obs (use_proxy_fields=True) while the agent is still distant, so the EMA accumulator z_harm_a (tau ~20) has not yet risen. DV: Per-episode precedence lag: the step index at which E3 terrain_weight w_harm first crosses a pre-registered threshold minus the step index at which the z_harm_a norm first crosses its own threshold, averaged over early-cue episodes, with both thresholds fixed in a Step-2.5a probe before the run.
FALSIFYING: With cue separation witnessed and the consumer live, w_harm's first crossing is not earlier than z_harm_a's (or tracks it within noise) in early-cue episodes -- terrain preparation then requires accumulated harm rather than the sensory cue, which is the vmPFC-lesion pattern INV-040 says the architecture must avoid. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Both signals already exist and are reachable: terrain_weight is computed at ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py:1077 and consumed at ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:1672-1674 (w_harm scales harm cost), and latent.z_harm_a is returned by agent.sense() every step. What is missing is any driver that records the paired first-crossing statistic; V3-EXQ-922 verified both signals are available and still deferred the measurement. Consumer / boundary: E3 candidate scoring, where w_harm scales the harm cost term during terrain preparation -- upstream of harm accumulation, not a post-hoc readout of it. Existing ownership: SD-016, contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy, EXP-0682, V3-EXQ-922, MECH-152.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); No driver computes the precedence statistic even though both signals are recorded and the consumer is live; and at current env entropy cue_context is near-constant, so terrain_weight cannot vary with the cue. EXP-0682 is blocked on exactly the ContextMemory write-path content half, and V3-EXQ-922 deferred the measurement design rather than the substrate. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-041.subject: development.childhood_phase_architectural_necessity
INV-041.title: The childhood phase of REE instantiation -- committed behaviour with constrained affordances -- is the necessary developmental regime that populates E1 ContextMemory with the content ARC-041 (SD-016) requires; this phase is not merely a safety feature but an architectural prerequisite for E3 ethical selection to operate on real signal.
INV-041.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: SD-016 must be armed (extract_cue_context requires world_query_proj) so that ContextMemory content can reach E3 at all, and the childhood and adult arms must differ ONLY in exposure distribution, with supervised labelling held identical -- the separation V3-EXQ-832 already enforces at the minibatch-sampling level.
CONFIRMING: Childhood-regime agents both differentiate ContextMemory (832's C1, already PASS) AND select harm-avoidant trajectories at a higher rate than adult-regime agents on identical conflict states, with the effect carried through the cue pathway rather than through generic policy quality. Manipulation: Set the P1 ContextMemory-training exposure ratio (A_FRAC 0.50 childhood versus 0.05 adult) with supervised context labelling on in both, then run both resulting agents through the same E3 selection probe. Control: ARM_CHILDHOOD_UNSUP (balanced exposure, unsupervised objective) isolates the labelling axis MECH-153 owns, and the fixed-seed P0 encoder warmup makes the arms bit-identical upstream of the exposure manipulation. Required event: A hazard-proximate/hazard-distal context distribution experienced under a committed, constrained regime (forced engagement) versus an avoidance-shaped regime, followed by an E3 selection episode in which harm and goal pressure conflict. DV: Two legs: (a) cosine_sim between mean hazard-proximate and hazard-distal priors on a held-out balanced probe pool (832's measured DV), and (b) the downstream E3 consequence -- harm-avoidant selection rate and terrain_weight/action_bias discrimination on matched conflict states, which distinguishes a differentiated substrate from one that merely decodes.
FALSIFYING: Adult-regime agents match childhood-regime agents on E3 selection outcomes despite the cosine differentiation gap, which would make the differentiation decodable but not load-bearing and reduce the claim to a representation-geometry observation rather than an architectural prerequisite. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Leg (a) is recorded by ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_832_inv041_childhood_exposure_context_diff.py. Leg (b) has a live pathway but no recorder: E1.extract_cue_context returns action_bias and terrain_weight, agent.py caches _cue_terrain_weight and forwards it to E3 scoring, and compute_action_object_alignment_bias is the E3 ranking channel -- but no experiment reads selection outcomes as a function of the childhood/adult exposure regime. Consumer / boundary: E3 ethical selection over candidate trajectories, not ContextMemory representation geometry; the claim asserts the childhood regime is a prerequisite for E3 to operate on real signal. Existing ownership: INV-041, MECH-153, EXP-1362, V3-EXQ-832.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); 832 stopped at the E1 cosine DV. The E3 leg the claim actually asserts has a wired consumer (terrain_weight into harm/goal scaling, action_bias into the GFLAG-0051 ranking channel) but no experiment measures selection outcome as a function of exposure regime, so prerequisite-for-E3 is untested. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. INV-042.subject: ethics.derived_objectives
INV-042.title: The five axioms jointly derive a set of ethical objectives: preserve minds, preserve future options, reduce unnecessary suffering, increase shared joy, maintain corrigibility, maintain truth-seeking, maintain the ability to love and be loved, maintain the shared world, and maintain the possibility of future minds and future love.
INV-042.what_would_answer:
This is a LOGICAL-DERIVATION claim, not an empirical hypothesis -- the
falsifier is a proof-obligation over the objective list, not a
PASS/FAIL experimental outcome. Each of the nine objectives named in
the title must be checked independently: does it actually follow
from the stated axioms, or does it rest on an unstated bridging
premise?

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (must hold before the test is
meaningful): the axioms it is checked against must be stated
precisely enough to support derivation. This does NOT currently hold
cleanly -- INV-042's own depends_on names only INV-025..INV-029 (the
ORIGINAL five axioms), but its location doc
(docs/architecture/five_axioms_foundations.md#inv-042) derives the
objectives from the CURRENT eight-axiom chain plus two derivations
(D1, D2) and one architectural claim (ARC-024) -- and two of those
eight axioms (Axiom 2, "existence has value"; Axiom 8, "language")
have NO corresponding INV registration at all ("pending governance
action," same doc line 14). Until that registration gap is closed,
any claimed derivation resting on Axiom 2 or Axiom 8 is
UNDERSPECIFIED rather than genuinely tested. Note also the objective
LIST itself has drifted: this title has nine items (matching the
original five-axiom source doc verbatim); the current location doc
lists TEN, adding "Maintain honest communication" (from Axiom 8).
Resolve both drifts (register the missing axiom claims; reconcile
the nine-vs-ten list) before running the per-objective test below,
or the test's target is ambiguous.

PER-OBJECTIVE TEST: for each of the nine (or, once reconciled, ten)
objectives, FALSIFYING if a counter-model can be constructed -- an
agent that fully satisfies the cited axiom(s) yet can rationally
decline to pursue that objective without violating any axiom as
stated. CONFIRMING if no such counter-model exists.

Apply per objective using the location doc's own citations:
  - Preserve minds (Axioms 1+2+5) -- check whether existence-has-
    value + others-are-self-like jointly force preservation, or
    only non-destruction.
  - Preserve future options (Axiom 3 alone) -- check whether
    uncertainty alone forces OPTION-PRESERVATION specifically, vs
    merely requiring uncertainty-aware action.
  - Reduce unnecessary suffering (ARC-024 + Axioms 5+6) -- the most
    directly grounded: ARC-024 explicitly establishes the harm
    gradient.
  - Increase shared joy (Axiom 7 + an uncited "benefit gradient is
    equally real" premise) -- no ARC-024-equivalent architectural
    claim for the BENEFIT gradient is cited anywhere; weaker
    footing than suffering-reduction within the same document.
  - Maintain corrigibility (Axiom 3 alone) -- direct one-step
    derivation, among the tightest of the nine.
  - Maintain truth-seeking (D2, derived from Axioms 3+4+D1) --
    traceable end-to-end via the shown D2 derivation, unlike
    several others.
  - Maintain ability to love and be loved (Axioms 6+7) -- fairly
    direct; Axiom 7 is literally the love-as-mechanism axiom.
  - Maintain the shared world (Axioms 5+6) -- reasonably direct.
  - Maintain the possibility of future minds and future love
    (Axioms 1+2+5+6+7 jointly) -- the WEAKEST link: none of the
    cited axioms explicitly extends moral standing to
    NOT-YET-EXISTING minds; this imports a substantive
    population-ethics premise not stated anywhere in Axioms 1-8. A
    counter-agent adopting a person-affecting view (only
    presently-existing minds have standing) would violate no stated
    axiom while declining this objective -- the most promising
    place to look for an actual falsifying counter-model.
  - [If the ten-item current doc is adopted] Maintain honest
    communication (Axiom 8 alone) -- direct one-step derivation, but
    blocked by the non-degeneracy precondition above until Axiom 8
    has its own INV registration.

ANSWER "derivation holds" (confirms INV-042) only if every objective
in the reconciled list passes the per-objective test with no
unstated bridging premise identified. ANSWER "derivation gap found"
(falsifies INV-042 as currently stated) if any objective -- most
likely "future minds and future love" or "increase shared joy" per
the above -- is shown to rest on a premise not actually contained in
the axiom set, or if the depends_on / axiom-count mismatch is never
resolved.

INV-043.subject: development.caregiver_requirement_for_ethics
INV-043.title: REE architecture enables but does not guarantee ethical development; without a developmental phase in which the agent experiences love from caregivers and internalises the belief that it is loveable, the architectural capacity for ethics (INV-025-029) may resolve to survival, domination, or indifference instead.
INV-043.what_would_answer:
This claim fuses two legs that resolve on different timescales and by
different methods. Neither is answered by the single-agent V3 substrate
as it stands.

LEG A -- DERIVATIONAL (is "architecture necessary but not sufficient" a
coherent, non-vacuous claim about REE's own architecture?):
Proof obligation: show that fixing REE's architecture (the eight axioms
+ two derivations INV-025-029, plus the E1/E2/E3 machinery) while
varying only developmental/training history yields divergent terminal
ethical dispositions (genuine other-directed care vs. survival,
domination, or indifference). This is ALREADY SUBSTANTIALLY SKETCHED by
MECH-158's existing failure-mode derivation: the "love exists, but not
for me" collapse shows the identical axiom set (Axiom 7 / ARC-024
benefit gradient) can be structurally present yet motivationally inert
for the self-other direction absent an internalised loveability belief
-- i.e. a named mechanism by which architecture underdetermines
outcome. Residual step: formalise or stress-test this derivation (does
the argument hold under every configuration of E1-E3, or only a
subset?) rather than treat it as a fresh open question. This leg would
be FALSIFIED by a proof or a proxy demonstration that a fully specified
REE architecture converges to genuine other-directed care regardless of
developmental/training history.

LEG B -- SUBSTRATE_CONDITIONAL (once multi-agent caregiving modelling
exists, is caregiver-love SPECIFICALLY the missing ingredient, as
opposed to mere multi-agent exposure, diversity of interaction, or some
other developmental factor?):
Non-degeneracy precondition (currently unmet, all three required):
  (i) a multi-agent substrate (ARC-047 / SocialGridWorld or
      equivalent) -- UNBUILT, confidence 0.0, reassigned V4->V5
      2026-06-10, no construction activity since;
  (ii) a caregiving-interaction model able to represent POSITIVE-
      VALENCE vs NEUTRAL/INSTRUMENTAL vs HOSTILE/ABSENT caregiver
      behaviour directed AT the developing agent specifically (not
      just co-presence of other agents); and
  (iii) a measurable "ethical resolution" outcome metric that
      discriminates genuine other-directed care from survival/
      domination/indifference strategies in a multi-agent setting --
      does not exist; V3's harm/benefit channels are single-agent
      only.
Once built, this would ANSWER via a >=3-arm, multi-seed comparison:
Arm 1 (positive-valence caregiver: protection + repair + demonstrated
"you are loveable") vs. Arm 2 (mere multi-agent EXPOSURE, neutral/
instrumental interaction, no valence directed at self) vs. Arm 3
(hostile or inconsistent caregiving), scored on downstream ethical-
resolution outcome. If Arm 1 diverges toward care while Arms 2 and 3
converge toward survival/domination/indifference, this SUPPORTS
caregiver-love SPECIFICALLY as the necessary ingredient. If Arm 2 alone
already produces care-like outcomes, this FALSIFIES the love-specific
version of the claim -- some other factor would be doing the work
instead.

Existing partial evidence: V3-EXQ-206 (2026-04-02, PASS, diagnostic/
supports) is a single-agent proxy testing only whether harm-
representation machinery develops differently under harm-rich vs
harm-sparse training data. It tests prerequisite structure only and
should NOT be read as evidence toward or against the love-specific
caregiving mechanism this leg targets. Literature grounding is
comparatively strong and decoupled from this precondition (lit_conf
0.837, LOVE-7 pull 2026-06-12: attachment/rupture-repair/self-other-
coupling anchors) but cannot promote a substrate-blocked empirical
claim on its own.

Currency (2026-08-07): no multi-agent substrate exists anywhere in
ree_core (confirmed via the 2026-08-03 GOV-CONFIRM-1 MECH-191
reaffirmation against live HEAD); ARC-047 remains candidate/
confidence-0.0/V5-gated. INV-041, INV-042, MECH-158, MECH-159 are
downstream/sibling candidates in this same developmental/caregiver
cluster and will likely hit the same derivational+substrate_conditional
fork.

INV-044.subject: cognition.bayesian_prior_before_posterior_necessity
INV-044.title: Approximate Bayesian contextual inference is architecturally impossible to co-compute with online encoding: prior construction (schema formation -- which context distinctions are structurally relevant) must precede posterior inference (attribution -- which evidence belongs to which context slot); a system attempting both online produces a degenerate prior that makes attribution uninformative regardless of training duration.
INV-044.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The write address must be able to carry context at all: I(slot; ground-truth context) must exceed an ORDER-ONLY null, because a least-recently-used clock or a period-(k+1) refractory cycle can produce non-zero MI purely by period alignment with the context-block schedule.
CONFIRMING: The ordered regime shows materially higher I(slot; context) above the order-only null than online co-computation at matched budget, with the online arm sitting at the null. Manipulation: Order the passes -- prior construction (SWS-analog schema pass) before posterior attribution (slot-filling) -- versus online co-computation at matched total training, with contextmemory_write_usage_bias_weight swept to unmask the content term. Control: The order-only null (blockwise permutation preserving write order) plus the online co-computation arm at matched budget and seeds. Required event: A context-block schedule (CONTEXT_SWITCH_EVERY) on a real REEAgent loop that writes to ContextMemory, run once with a schema-formation pass preceding slot-filling and once with both co-computed online. DV: I(slot; ground-truth context) computed from the recorded (slot, context) contingency table, scored against the order-only null rather than against chance.
FALSIFYING: Online co-computation reaches the same attribution informativeness as the ordered regime at matched budget, or neither clears the null once addressing is repaired -- prior-before-posterior is not architecturally necessary. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: V3-EXQ-946 built exactly this instrument on a real agent (blockwise-permutation order-only null, MI column, 1.0-bit positive control) and V3-EXQ-943 the occupancy harness; both exist and both have been run. Consumer / boundary: ContextMemory write-address selection (the argmin over slots), not slot occupancy and not a whole-bank differentiation statistic. Existing ownership: EXP-1277, EVB-0628, contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy, GFLAG-0047, V3-EXQ-946.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The write address is decided by usage, not content: at the default usage-bias weight the usage term's across-slot spread is ~6.3x the content term's, BIAS behaves as a round-robin clock (agreement 0.993-0.996), and 946's best MI is 0.0002-0.0006 bits against its own 1.0-bit control. Both arms would read uninformative, which LOOKS like support for INV-044. Secondary classes: R5, R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-045.subject: sleep.phase_ordering_computational_necessity
INV-045.title: The biological NREM-then-REM sleep phase sequence is the correct computational order, derivable from the logical dependencies between the failure modes each phase addresses; this ordering is not a contingent biological fact but an engineering necessity, and it serves directly as the V4 rewiring specification: each phase specifies what structural change the REE substrate requires to address its failure mode.
INV-045.what_would_answer:
INV-045's falsifier is a scrambled-order ablation on the REAL
(non-proxy) offline phase mechanisms, at the grain V3 actually
supports.

V3 implements only the coarse SWS-analog / REM-analog split (SD-017),
not the claim's full 5 sub-phase structure (0 sensory gate, 1 SHY,
2 NREM replay, 3 spindle coordination, 4 REM recalibration) -- Phase
0 is unbuilt and Phase 3's sensory-gating half is unbuilt
(offline_phases.md). So a partial, coarse test is V3-testable now;
the full 5-phase pairwise reordering is not, until V4 lands input
gating on E1 and ThetaBuffer's reverse-direction/gating mode.

COARSE V3 TEST (re-run of V3-EXQ-243's design, using real
mechanisms): run WAKING_ONLY, REM_ONLY, REM_THEN_SWS (scrambled),
SWS_THEN_REM (canonical), and SWS_THEN_REM_RECAL, but call
agent.run_sws_schema_pass() (MECH-120+121) and
agent.run_rem_attribution_pass() (MECH-123) directly instead of the
2026-04-05 script's local proxy passes, which
design_forward_analysis_2026-04-06.md (DR-7) diagnosed as not
invoking the real computational content and therefore producing an
order-blind (degenerate) null result -- confirmed in the archived
per_seed_results, where REM_ONLY, REM_THEN_SWS, SWS_THEN_REM and
SWS_THEN_REM_RECAL returned bit-identical harm_discrimination/
harm_eval values per seed.

INV-045's own logical-dependency argument predicts a SPECIFIC failure
mode for the scrambled order, not just "worse in general":
REM_THEN_SWS should show reinforcement of the single dominant (most
recent, highest-salience) trace rather than diverse-content
consolidation, because replay runs before SHY normalisation flattens
the attractor landscape. The falsifying comparison is therefore not
just harm_discrimination(SWS_THEN_REM) > harm_discrimination
(REM_THEN_SWS), but a diversity/differentiation proxy (slot
differentiation across contexts, or trajectory diversity in replay
content) showing REM_THEN_SWS collapsing toward the dominant trace
while SWS_THEN_REM does not.

PASS pattern for INV-045 (coarse, partial support only): SWS_THEN_REM
> REM_THEN_SWS > REM_ONLY ~ WAKING_ONLY on harm_discrimination AND on
the diversity/differentiation proxy, with REM_THEN_SWS specifically
showing dominant-trace reinforcement.

FULL V4 TEST (blocked, not currently buildable): all pairwise/
adjacent-swap reorderings of the 5 sub-phases against the canonical
0-1-2-3-4 order, each predicted to fail in the specific way its row
in offline_phases.md's rewiring table states. Requires Phase 0 (E1
input gate) and Phase 3's gating half (ThetaBuffer reverse-direction
mode) to exist as separately runnable, reorderable steps -- neither
exists in V3.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (compounding on ARC-011/INV-046's own):
(1) full SD-017 flag stack enabled and sufficient training horizon;
(2) the order-scramble must call the REAL substrate mechanisms, not
proxy stand-ins -- V3-EXQ-243's null/order-blind result is diagnostic
evidence this precondition was violated in the only run to date, not
evidence against the claim itself; (3) for the coarse (V3) test: this
is satisfiable now, since MECH-120/121/123 are implementation_phase:v3
and the real agent methods exist post-2026-04; (4) for the FULL
5-phase test: the substrate must implement Phase 0 and Phase 3's
sensory-gating half as manipulable steps -- both are V4-gated and
absent today.

CURRENT STATE: V3-EXQ-243 (2026-04-05, the only direct evidence on
file) is FAIL/weakens, but per DR-7 this is very likely an artifact
of proxy (not real) phase implementations rather than a genuine test
of the ordering hypothesis -- P1/P2 passed (broken orders didn't beat
baseline) but P3 also failed (correct order didn't beat baseline
either, only 1/3 seeds), and all non-WAKING conditions returned
bit-identical outcome metrics regardless of order. Read the "weakens"
direction with that qualification, not at face value.

INV-046.subject: dementia.attribution_pipeline_failure_reframe
INV-046.title: Dementia is computationally a progressive failure of contextual attribution rather than primarily a memory storage failure: episodic memory loss is downstream of progressive collapse of the offline consolidation pipeline that maintains the context attribution scaffold.
INV-046.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The two outcome metrics must be separable rather than two readings of the same signal, and the substrate must be able to differentiate context slots at all -- with contextmemory_gated_content_write armed, since with the legacy write path slot cosine similarity collapses toward 1.0 and attribution never differentiates.
CONFIRMING: Attribution precision degrades reliably at a lower damage level than storage/recall does, with the two curves separated beyond the null-arm spread across the ramp. Manipulation: Sweep the SD-068 diffuse-damage scalar (diffuse_perturb on the phase-operative tensors) or consolidation cycle count/depth across at least four staged levels, rather than a binary sleep-on/sleep-off contrast. Control: The null-content arm already built into the harness (probe present, content never injected), plus a zero-damage reference level, plus a legacy-write-path arm to show the effect is not the homogenisation artefact. Required event: A progressive, graded degradation of the offline consolidation pipeline across at least four levels, applied to an agent carrying known injected content, at matched total experience and compute. DV: Two separately scored curves against degradation level: attribution precision (slot separation / slot_cosine_sim among ContextMemory slots) and storage-or-recall (recognition of injected content that does not depend on discriminating it from competitor slots), compared by the degradation level at which each first degrades reliably.
FALSIFYING: Storage/recall degrades first or at the same level, or the two curves degrade at statistically indistinguishable rates -- which undercuts the reframing even if consolidation loss is shown to be harmful overall. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Attribution precision is instrumented (slot_cosine_sim in the 436 family; sws_completion_margin in the harness). Storage/recall is only partly instrumented: sws_retrieval_accuracy scores argmax identification across slots, so it entangles storage with slot discriminability and cannot serve as the independent (b) arm until validated against an injected-content positive control that breaks storage while holding attribution structure intact. Consumer / boundary: The contextual-attribution scaffold maintained by offline consolidation, versus the event store itself -- the claim is about which of the two fails first, not about whether reduced consolidation is harmful. Existing ownership: SD-068, SD-017, MECH-166, SD-073, EXP-0435.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The graded manipulation exists and attribution precision is instrumented, but there is still no storage/recall readout independent of slot discrimination: sws_retrieval_accuracy is an argmax-over-slots identification score, which is the attribution quantity in another guise, so the phase-order dissociation cannot yet be measured. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: INSTRUMENT EXISTS BUT WRONG LOCUS/TIMESCALE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA states that no recall_accuracy / episodic_recall / retrieval_accuracy instrument exists anywhere (grepped 2026-08-07); sws_retrieval_accuracy has been emitted by experiments/_lib/consolidation_lesion_harness.py since 2026-07-18, so the (b) arm is no longer a build-from-nothing item but a separability question about an existing readout. The write-gate fix the WWA says to wait for (contextmemory_gated_content_write) also landed 2026-08-03, with measured slot differentiation. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-047.subject: dementia.staged_decline_phase_dependency_prediction
INV-047.title: The specific staged cognitive decline profile of Alzheimer's disease -- early precision/confidence loss, then episodic memory failure, then contextual identity loss, then global disorientation -- follows the reverse of the sleep phase dependency ordering and is not explained by diffuse amyloid damage alone, which predicts uniform degradation rather than a staged profile.
INV-047.what_would_answer:
This is a FUSION claim: an out-of-domain clinical-empirical assertion (leg A) plus a REE-internal, V3-testable mechanistic claim (leg B, operationalized as SD-073). The two legs answer independently and neither substitutes for the other.
LEG A -- OUT-OF-DOMAIN (clinical/literature; no REE substrate can test this). Whether ACTUAL human Alzheimer's disease follows the specific ordering asserted here (precision/confidence loss -> episodic memory failure -> contextual identity loss -> global disorientation) is a clinical-neurology question the REE substrate cannot itself adjudicate. It resolves by a formal comparison of the claim's predicted symptom-emergence ordering against the published staged-clinical-progression literature (e.g. CDR/FAST staging, MCI-to-AD conversion studies, longitudinal neuropsychological batteries) -- not by the qualitative citation already present in this claim's notes, which has never been formally checked against primary sources. CONFIRMING: a systematic review or meta-analysis of longitudinal staging data shows the predicted ordering (or one consistent with it under this claim's own domain mapping) as the dominant clinical pattern. FALSIFYING: the literature shows the four domains failing in a different order, failing diffusely/simultaneously (consistent with the glymphatic-alone account this claim contrasts itself against), or the ordering is not reproducible across cohorts. Route: /lit-pull, not an experiment.
LEG B -- REE-INTERNAL (V3-testable via the SD-068 lesion harness; operational scoring site is SD-073, which this claim and MECH-168 jointly feed).
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (currently PARTIALLY UNMET -- read before trusting any staging-order result). A per-phase readout is usable for this test only if CONTENT-CONTINGENT: responsive to corrupted/injected content, not merely to corruption magnitude or noise power. Any new falsifier design MUST explicitly re-run this precondition check per phase -- the same null-content control that caught the SWS readout's content-freeness (V3-EXQ-778c) and that a REM unpaired-target null re-confirmed as insufficient (V3-EXQ-778h) -- before that phase's output can count as staging evidence. Status per phase (2026-07-18 SD-068 decomposition, unchanged as of 2026-08-07): NREM (slot-filling, MECH-121) PASSED, content-contingent (null_slope_ratio 0.1445, CI95 [0.1438,0.1451], 0/8 seeds confounded, V3-EXQ-778c) -- carried by SD-071. SWS (slot-formation, MECH-120) PASSED after rebuild, content-contingent (null_slope_ratio 0.1495, sd 0.0218, CI95 [0.1344,0.1646], ceiling_inside_ci95 false, 8/8 seeds, V3-EXQ-778g) -- carried by SD-071. REM (precision recalibration, MECH-123) FAILED on every design tried -- content-free at both clamp rails (V3-EXQ-778c), still content-free after de-clamping via an unpaired-target null (median ratio ~0.88 vs the 0.25 ceiling, 6/7 de-railed seeds above it, V3-EXQ-778h), generative-gain contrast flat in content scale (V3-EXQ-778f). MECH-462 explains this as a TYPE fact, not a fixable design bug: REM precision recalibration is a second-order quantity over representations (a confidence ABOUT content, not content itself), so no statistic on the direct precision quantity can be content-contingent regardless of null design. This is the leg carrying INV-047's CLINICALLY EARLIEST predicted symptom (precision/confidence loss as the MCI prodrome) -- the missing instrument sits exactly where this claim is most specific and would be most informative.
BUILD GATE -- complicated (buildable), not probe-gated: the missing piece is a known-shape build. SD-072 specifies the fix: replace the direct REM readout with a downstream behavioural-discrimination measure (a meta-d-prime analogue over post-REM retrieval confidence), applied to the same cells as V3-EXQ-778e, gated by the SAME C1 instrument-validity criterion that admitted NREM and SWS (null_slope_ratio_rem_downstream <= 0.25, ceiling_inside_ci95 false, n>=8, plus a pre-registered content-scale ladder). SD-072 is UNBUILT as of 2026-08-07 -- no queue entry, no run.
CONFIRMING signature (once SD-072 exists and clears its own instrument-validity gate, scored at SD-073): re-running the staged sweep with all three now-validated content-contingent instruments (SD-071's nrem + sws, SD-072's REM replacement) at a declared insult regime shows the damage-tolerance rank order matching the predicted reverse-dependency sequence -- REM/precision (MECH-123, Phase 4) degrades first, NREM/slot-filling (MECH-121, Phase 2-3) next, SWS/ slot-formation (MECH-120, Phase 1-2) last -- on >=6/8 seeds (sign-test p<0.05, not a bare modal order), robust within the declared regime.
FALSIFYING signature: the validated three-instrument staging run shows simultaneous degradation, the forward-dependency order, an order inverting REM-vs-NREM (as the retracted 2026-07-17 smoke run did), or seed-instability comparable to the pre-778h REM-fails-first finding (CI straddling 0, sign-test ~1.0) even with all three legs interpretable. Also FALSIFYING for the REE leg becoming testable at all: if SD-072's downstream discrimination readout is ITSELF content-free at the same C1 ceiling, MECH-462's constructive half is wrong and REM carries no recoverable damage signal by any design tried so far.
CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass; do not re-litigate without new evidence): neither leg resolved. Leg A never formally run against primary staging literature. Leg B two-thirds instrumented (SD-071 done); one-third gated on a fully specified but unbuilt component (SD-072); SD-073 (the staging order itself) is EXPLICITLY NOT ANSWERABLE until SD-072 lands, per SD-073's own registration. V3-EXQ-778h (2026-07-19) added no new information -- it reconfirmed, via a corrected readiness anchor, the same REM content-freeness already folded into MECH-462/SD-072 one day earlier (2026-07-18).

INV-048.subject: sleep.pharmacological_disruption_pipeline_equivalence
INV-048.title: Any pharmacological agent that disrupts sleep architecture produces equivalent attribution pipeline degradation to behavioral sleep deprivation, proportional to which phase(s) are disrupted and the duration of exposure -- the pipeline is mechanism-agnostic and responds only to phase fidelity.
INV-048.what_would_answer:
Precondition (non-vacuity gate -- required before any run is
interpretable, per V3-EXQ-670's own diagnosed failure): the 4-arm
design (ARM_A_NORMAL_SLEEP SWS+REM / ARM_B_REM_SUPPRESSED
~antidepressants / ARM_C_SWS_SUPPRESSED ~benzodiazepines /
ARM_D_NO_SLEEP) is already confirmed faithful to INV-048
(failure_autopsy_batch9_2026-06-12) -- only the readout was broken.
V3-EXQ-670 FAILed degenerate because run_sleep_cycle runs the SWS +
REM passes but never trains e3.harm_eval_head: harm_discrimination
was byte-identical across all 4 arms for every seed, so the verdict
could not respond to the sleep manipulation at all. A retest
(V3-EXQ-670a, never run as of this digestion pass) only presses this
claim if it first trains the harm-valuation pathway (the
scaffold_train_harm_pathway / V3-EXQ-603k pattern) AND clears a
non-vacuity gate: the 4 arms must produce genuinely DISTINCT
harm_discrimination (and/or slot_differentiation) values before the
verdict is read. Any run that reproduces arm-invariant
harm_discrimination is degenerate/non_contributory again, exactly as
V3-EXQ-670 was.

Given a non-degenerate run: CONFIRMING if attribution-pipeline
degradation (harm_discrimination and/or slot_differentiation loss
relative to ARM_A_NORMAL_SLEEP) is proportional to WHICH PHASE(S) are
disrupted and is cause-agnostic -- i.e. a pharmacological-suppression
arm (ARM_B/REM or ARM_C/SWS) degrades by a comparable amount to a
behavioral-equivalent same-phase, same-duration deprivation, so the
pipeline tracks phase fidelity only. FALSIFYING if a
pharmacological-suppression arm and a phase-and-duration-MATCHED
behavioral-suppression arm produce a materially different
degradation pattern -- meaning the pipeline discriminates on CAUSE of
disruption, not just phase fidelity, contradicting the
mechanism-agnostic claim.

Epistemic caveat: even a clean, non-degenerate PASS inside REE
supports INV-048 only CONDITIONAL on REE's sleep/consolidation model
being a sufficiently faithful model of human sleep architecture (per
this claim's 2026-04-17 reclassification from claim_type: invariant
to derived_prediction, prediction_domain: clinical_pharmacology -- a
domain-modelling assumption, not an architectural invariant). The
REE-internal experimental result and the clinical/epidemiological
evidence line cited in notes (benzodiazepine/anticholinergic-dementia
associations -- Billioti de Gage et al. 2014 BMJ; Coupland et al.
2019 JAMA Internal Medicine) are linked but NOT identical: the
epidemiological association is human-population evidence and does
not move this claim's REE exp_conf -- only a non-degenerate substrate
run does.

INV-049.subject: architecture.offline_update_necessity_general_principle
INV-049.title: Any agent that builds a model of the world, acts in that world, and learns from experience cannot safely update its world model while using it to navigate the world; it therefore requires periodic offline phases in which action is suspended and the model is reorganised via replay and simulation -- this is not a biological contingency but a general computational necessity for model-building agents.
INV-049.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The infant-substrate env features must be explicitly enabled (harm_gradient_enabled, microhabitat_enabled, transient_benefit_enabled all default False in causal_grid_world.py) so the replay buffer carries heterogeneous content, AND the offline readout must not be routed through ContextMemory slot cosine, which is pinned at ~0.999 by the online write path alone. A NO_WRITES calibration arm must be carried so the readout's own floor is measured in the same run.
CONFIRMING: With the env features armed and a non-slot-routed readout, the WITH_OFFLINE arm beats the budget-matched online-only arm on frozen-battery improvement and on early-state retention, sign-consistent across at least 3 seeds, with the NO_WRITES arm confirming the readout is not pinned. Manipulation: WITH_OFFLINE versus WITHOUT_OFFLINE consolidation at matched waking exposure and matched total gradient budget, with the sleep-aggregation cluster master flag armed rather than left at its default-off state. Control: A budget-matched online-only arm (same number of gradient steps, no replay) plus a NO_WRITES calibration arm, so an improvement is attributable to offline replay rather than to extra compute or to the write path's own dynamics. Required event: A multi-cycle life in which heterogeneous waking content accumulates and is then followed by offline SWS/REM cycles under SleepLoopManager, with non-zero SWS writes and REM rollouts asserted from measured output in every arm. DV: Across-phase improvement on a frozen held-out probe battery (pre-sleep minus post-sleep error on the same battery), plus replay-content coverage of early-life states, measured on an instrument independent of ContextMemory slot_cosine_sim.
FALSIFYING: With the same preconditions met, offline consolidation shows no advantage over the budget-matched online-only arm on its own frozen-battery DV -- which, unlike EXQ-385/385a (substrate-confounded) and the 436 family (slot-instrument-confounded), would be real pressure on INV-049. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The frozen-probe battery exists in the V3-EXQ-701b/701c/1063 family and CrossModuleConsolidator emits per-module update counts; the slot-differentiation instrument exists but cannot resolve a sleep effect (436g's sleep delta -2.16e-4 sits 36x below the untouched-bank drift SD of 0.0078). Consumer / boundary: The offline consolidation pass's write into the representation that waking navigation subsequently reads -- not episode reward and not sleep quantity. Existing ownership: SD-017, contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy, contextmemory_write_content_discrimination, MECH-204, sleep_substrate_plan.md:GAP-2.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The registered readout collapses before the manipulation can act: writing to the context bank at all drives slot cosine to ~0.999 in waking and sleeping arms alike, surviving both landed write-path fixes, and the sleep delta is 36x below drift noise. A re-posed sleep-differentiation run on the same bank is refused by the re-derive brake. Secondary classes: R2, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's named blocker -- a 'suspected untested ContextMemory.write_gate bias-collapse root cause, unresolved' -- has since been diagnosed and repaired (contextmemory_gated_content_write, plus the write-address usage-balancing and refractory eligibility modes), and V3-EXQ-436g then measured whole-bank slot cosine ~0.9992 in BOTH SWS_THEN_REM and WAKING_ONLY at full 16/16 occupancy against a NO_WRITES reference of ~0.000, so the collapse survives the fix and is caused by writing at all rather than by sleep. The WWA also routes through EXQ-IDEV-001/006, which exist nowhere in ree-v3/experiments. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-050.subject: architecture.three_drive_sleep_regulation
INV-050.title: Sleep phase architecture is regulated by three distinct drives -- circadian timing, homeostatic synaptic pressure, and a learning/model-update demand drive proportional to daily prediction error accumulation (Model Error Load, MEL) -- and only the third drive determines whether the overnight update phase is sufficient for the error burden generated during waking.
INV-050.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A mel_reference baseline estimated precisely enough that a between-arm contrast is readable -- the 3-episode CALIB_EPISODES point estimate shows ARM_0 factor 0.636-1.719 across six seeds, which is wider than the effect. The substrate must also be pinned to a named commit, since the 861f/g/h/i cluster established the coupling is version-sensitive. Degenerate whenever the only MEL-to-duration pathway is the consumer's own deterministic arithmetic.
CONFIRMING: In a held-out environment and on genuinely new seeds, sws_power and replay_rate track measured MEL monotonically at >=2/3 seeds with ON-HIGH above OFF-HIGH, AND the tracking survives the MEL-injection-decoupled arm, on a pinned substrate commit. Manipulation: Graded waking novelty crossed with a held-out environment instance or a world-model instance distinct from the CausalGridWorldV2 configuration SD-MEL-PRODUCER was validated against, on seeds disjoint from both the 42/123/456 and the 7/271/883 sets. Control: A MEL-injection-decoupled arm -- MEL held at a fixed injected value while environmental novelty still varies -- rather than a consumer-absent arm, so the control can move; plus a calibration-power-raised mel_reference with enough episodes to shrink the baseline noise below the effect. Required event: Waking periods of graded novelty (SD-MEL-PRODUCER world_rule_shift) generating measurably different accumulated Model Error Load, followed by an offline phase whose architecture can respond. DV: sws_power and replay_rate as a function of MEASURED (not injected) MEL, non-decreasing across MEL-sorted arms at >=2/3 seeds, with the effect required to survive the injection-decoupled arm -- and reported against a DV that is not itself a transform of e3_prediction_error.
FALSIFYING: The DVs fail to track measured MEL in a run meeting the precondition -- the 845/861/861a signal does not survive leaving its configuration -- or the correlation vanishes or inverts once MEL is decoupled from the consumer's duration-scaling input while novelty still varies, showing the DVs respond to the consumer's arithmetic rather than to a third drive. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/sleep/mel_consumer.py (MELConsumer, use_mel_consumer default False) scales sws_consolidation_steps and rem_attribution_steps by clamp(1 + mel_gain*(mel/ref - 1)); the producer is the validated world_rule_shift knob in ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py. The weak link is the mel_reference calibration estimate, not the recorders. Consumer / boundary: The offline-phase duration/entry scheduler as a consumer of accumulated waking prediction error -- the third drive -- distinct from the SD-037 arousal entry (V4) and from the homeostatic K-episode cadence. Existing ownership: INV-050, SD-MEL-CONSUMER, EXP-0581, sleep_substrate:GAP-5b, MECH-180.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The decisive independence leg is instrument-limited: a 3-episode mel_reference point estimate carries ~3x cross-seed sampling noise, wider than the contrast it gates, and the coupling has since proved sensitive to an unidentified ree_core commit. The WWA's consumer-absent control cannot discriminate because the consumer is the only MEL-to-duration path in V3. Secondary classes: R1, R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: Authored 2026-08-07 against the 845/861/861a record; it predates the entire 861b-to-861i lineage. Route (a) of its own non-degeneracy precondition HAS since been run -- V3-EXQ-861b on disjoint seeds [7,271,883] replicated C1 cleanly but failed the decisive C2 consumer-absent-baseline leg on 2/3 seeds, traced to ~3x cross-seed sampling noise in a 3-episode mel_reference point estimate -- and the 861e collapse was then traced by 861f/g/h/i (confirmed 2026-09-14) to a genuine ree_core substrate change between f810969 and 17befb8c whose responsible commit is still unresolved. The WWA's proposed route (c) is also now known to be structurally uninformative: with the consumer absent, sleep cadence is K-episode deterministic, so sws_power cannot respond to MEL at all and the arm returns a guaranteed null rather than a discriminating one. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-051.subject: architecture.mel_optimal_range_requirement
INV-051.title: There exists an optimal range of daily Model Error Load (MEL): insufficient MEL (extreme monotony, isolation, institutional under-stimulation) produces progressive model rigidity via under-stimulation of the learning drive even when sleep architecture is intact; excessive MEL (acute trauma, overwhelming novelty, extreme responsibility) produces overload insomnia and incomplete update even with extended sleep opportunity.
INV-051.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Each ON-arm cell must carry enough FRESH e3 selections to support an entropy-based rigidity DV -- the driver's own floor is 15 per cell and it was met on 0/3 seeds, with some cells resting on 1-5, because most environment ticks are held-action repeats rather than fresh decisions. The MEL dose gradient, world-model convergence and sleep-opportunity uniformity gates are already demonstrated to clear.
CONFIRMING: With at least 15 fresh selections per ON-arm cell, the rigidity index traces a U across the dose ladder -- elevated at monotony and at overload relative to mid-dose -- on at least 2/3 seeds with each extreme clearing its pre-registered margin. Manipulation: At least four graded intake levels via world_rule_shift_interval and world_rule_shift_depth (901 uses six arms, interval 0/60/25/10 plus a depth-3 overload arm and an MEL-off comparator). Control: The MEL-off arm at the same shift schedule isolates the consumer's contribution, and sleep-opportunity uniformity across arms rules out the ordinary sleep-deprivation confound the falsifier explicitly names. Required event: A graded-MEL life spanning monotony through overload, with offline cycles firing through the live SleepLoopManager path and the MEL consumer coupling measured MEL to offline duration. DV: A per-seed rigidity index computed over FRESH e3 selections only (policy entropy on fresh decisions, with slot diversity as diagnostic), tested for a U-shape: rigidity elevated at both the monotony and overload extremes relative to mid-dose, each clearing the SD-scaled margin plus an absolute floor.
FALSIFYING: With the same sampling met, rigidity is monotone in MEL dose or flat across the ladder on at least 2/3 seeds, or the low-MEL elevation is fully explained by reduced sleep opportunity rather than reduced sleep content. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: V3-EXQ-901's driver instruments all of this including the fresh-selection gate; the missing piece is probe BUDGET -- the fresh-selection yield is 2 to 16 percent of ticks and is unevenly distributed across seeds and arms, so a flat episode-count increase may not be the efficient fix. Consumer / boundary: The waking MEL dose to model-rigidity relation at fixed sleep architecture, not sleep duration or sleep opportunity. Existing ownership: EXP-0376, EXP-0587, SD-MEL-PRODUCER, SD-MEL-CONSUMER.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The rigidity DV cannot be sampled: commitment holds mean that fresh e3 selections are a small and unevenly distributed fraction of ticks, so the primary DV rests on as few as 1-5 decisions per cell and the driver's own adequacy gate failed on every seed. Every substrate piece the falsifier needs is built. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's stated gap -- that no run had ever used more than a high-versus-low MEL contrast -- was closed by V3-EXQ-901, which ran the full six-arm graded ladder with a pre-registered rigidity DV on 2026-08-08. Its readiness gates R1-R3 (convergence, MEL-dose gradient, sleep-opportunity uniformity) cleared at 100 percent, and the run failed only on R4, a probe-budget gate; so the outstanding precondition is now the fresh-selection sample size, not the existence of a graded sweep. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-052.subject: goal_directed_agency.tonic_regulatory_system
INV-052.title: Goal-directed behaviour in adversive environments requires a tonic regulatory system maintaining benefit orientation across terrain, transduction, and maintenance stages.
INV-052.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The harm-rich regime must actually produce motivational collapse in the all-off arm -- a run where the LONG_HORIZON context does not degrade performance relative to SIMPLE cannot discriminate joint necessity from irrelevance -- and each of the three knobs must be individually effective (non-zero behavioural delta when enabled alone) so that 'no single mechanism suffices' is a finding and not three inert flags.
CONFIRMING: No single mechanism restores LONG_HORIZON performance to baseline in any condition while each is individually effective -- joint necessity, as measured twice (single_mechanism_sufficient false in all six conditions). Manipulation: Factorial enable/disable of the three stage mechanisms: MECH-186 terrain floor (GoalConfig.valence_wanting_floor), MECH-187 transduction gain (z_goal_seeding_gain), MECH-188 maintenance injection (z_goal_inject), each individually and in combination. Control: The all-off arm in the same LONG_HORIZON context plus the SIMPLE-context baseline, so single-mechanism sufficiency is judged against both the collapsed and the uncollapsed reference. Required event: Sustained exposure to a harm-rich LONG_HORIZON context in which benefit opportunities remain present but distal, the regime in which a self-maintaining low-motivation attractor can form. DV: Whether any single mechanism restores LONG_HORIZON performance to the SIMPLE baseline (single_mechanism_sufficient), measured across both contexts and replications; secondarily whether the three together do.
FALSIFYING: Any one of the three mechanisms alone fully restores LONG_HORIZON performance to the SIMPLE baseline, on a run where the all-off arm demonstrably collapses -- which would make the tonic system a single-stage rather than a three-stage requirement. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Built and exercised: the three knobs are live config fields with serotonin dynamically modulating two of them (ree_core/neuromodulation/serotonin.py maps tonic_5ht to valence_wanting_floor and z_goal_seeding_gain), and V3-EXQ-254 ran the factorial twice, both PASS. Consumer / boundary: The tonic regulatory pathway across the three pipeline stages -- terrain representation, cue-triggered transduction, and goal-representation maintenance -- upstream of goal-directed action selection. Existing ownership: INV-052, MECH-186, MECH-187, MECH-188, V3-EXQ-254, EXP-0101.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); R0: event, all three manipulations, controls, DV and recorder exist and the falsifier has run twice with consistent PASS. The residual caveat is non-degeneracy in the other direction -- combined_sufficient was also false, so even all three did not fully recover LONG_HORIZON, leaving the recovery ceiling unattributed. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: NO GAP -- FALSE POSITIVE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-053.subject: psychiatric.computational_depression_attractor
INV-053.title: Chronic harm-dominated environments produce a self-maintaining depressive attractor: z_goal seeding failure, terrain collapse, and HABIT/PLANNED behavioural equivalence.
INV-053.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Mode diversity must be available so that HABIT/PLANNED equivalence can in principle be violated, and the environment's harm dominance must be an independently varied factor. Under the V_s monostrategy lock the policy is collapsed regardless of harm density, so behavioural equivalence near 1.0 is a property of the substrate rather than of the depressive attractor.
CONFIRMING: z_goal collapse and HABIT/PLANNED equivalence appear specifically under harm-dominated conditions and are absent or markedly weaker in the matched benign arm, with a monotone dose-response across the hazard-ratio sweep, and survive the lifting of the monostrategy lock. Manipulation: Vary environmental harm dominance as the independent variable -- hazard count and hazard_harm swept from benign to chronic -- rather than fixing 8x8 / 1 resource / 3 hazards / hazard_harm 0.02 as every replication has. Control: A benign low-harm arm at matched seeds and matched training budget, which the claim's own description already asserts must show intact goal-directed function, plus a mode-diversity-enabled arm post MECH-269 V_s. Required event: A trained agent run to warmup end under environments spanning a hazard-to-benefit ratio range, with z_goal seeding, terrain and behaviour read at the same point in each. DV: z_goal norm at warmup end and |HABIT_harm_rate - PLANNED_harm_rate| as a FUNCTION of harm dominance -- the dose-response slope and the benign-arm contrast, not the absolute values in the chronic cell alone.
FALSIFYING: z_goal norm stays near zero and HABIT/PLANNED equivalence stays near 1.0 in the benign arm too, or the equivalence dissolves once V_s mode diversity is available -- the attractor is a substrate artefact rather than an environmentally produced state. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Present but never used this way. v3_exq_249/268/406/434 all record goal_norm, behavioral_equivalence, harm_rate and accumulated_harm per seed; none of them instantiates more than one environment configuration, so no run emits the contrast the claim asserts. Consumer / boundary: The environment-to-substrate pathway -- chronic harm dominance acting on SD-011/SD-012 benefit-exposure seeding -- and its behavioural consequence, not internal damage to the agent. Existing ownership: INV-053, MECH-269, EXP-0096, clinical_failure_modes:MOTIVATIONAL-TAXONOMY.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); All four 'independent replications' run one environment configuration (8x8, 1 resource, 3 hazards, hazard_harm 0.02) with HABIT and PLANNED as the only arms. The claim's independent variable -- harm dominance -- is never varied, so seven supports and zero fails rest on a design with no comparator on the thing being claimed. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-054.subject: psychiatric.depressive_maintenance_loop
INV-054.title: Benefit terrain collapse creates a closed negative feedback loop (reduced exploration -> reduced benefit exposure -> continued sub-threshold seeding) predicting chronicity.
INV-054.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A depressive attractor must genuinely be established first (z_goal_norm collapsed on every seed at the end of phase A), and the hysteresis-capable substrate must be ARMED rather than left at defaults: serotonin tonic_5ht (which drives valence_wanting_floor, the MECH-186 floor) and the discrete-mode primitives use_salience_coordinator/use_dacc, all three default False. A hazard-free recovery phase must carry the contamination opt-out flagged by GFLAG-0304.
CONFIRMING: With the floor and mode primitives armed, harm withdrawal alone leaves goal_norm below threshold for a sustained period while the scaffolded-benefit arm crosses early, and the collapse and recovery thresholds differ by more than the seed-level noise band on a majority of seeds. Manipulation: Two-by-two: harm withdrawal alone versus harm withdrawal plus externally scaffolded benefit encounters (the behavioural-activation analog that forces benefit_exposure above the seeding threshold), crossed with the discrete-mode/serotonergic-floor substrate armed versus off. Control: The substrate-off cells are the smooth-dynamics comparator that shows any phase-transition signature is not an artefact of the readout, and a never-collapsed matched-seed arm bounds the recovery ceiling. Required event: Transition from a harm-dense phase in which VALENCE_WANTING collapses to a recovery phase with hazards withdrawn and benefit encounters available, run long enough for a delayed crossing to be observable. DV: Hysteresis rather than latency alone: the harm level at which collapse onsets versus the harm level at which recovery onsets on the same seed (loop area), together with the sustained-crossing onset episode and the shape of the goal_norm trajectory (knee versus linear ramp).
FALSIFYING: With the same substrate armed, recovery is immediate and graded in both arms and the collapse and recovery thresholds coincide -- harm withdrawal is sufficient, the terrain need not be rebuilt, and the self-maintaining reading of INV-054 does not hold. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: V3-EXQ-435 records sustained-crossing onset and classifies recovery_type, and V3-EXQ-278/250 record latency; no driver records the collapse-versus-recovery threshold pair, so the hysteresis DV itself has no recorder. Consumer / boundary: The closed loop benefit_exposure -> z_goal seeding -> exploration -> benefit_exposure, not the reward signal at the episode boundary. Existing ownership: MECH-269, EXP-0224, GFLAG-0304, psychiatric_failure_modes_plan.md:MOTIVATIONAL-TAXONOMY.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The three prior drivers all ran with the hysteresis-capable substrate off, so graded recovery was the only output available, and the hysteresis DV (collapse threshold versus recovery threshold) is recorded by no driver. The substrate itself is present. Secondary classes: R2, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-055.subject: development.infant_stage_necessity
INV-055.title: A pre-childhood infant stage is developmentally necessary: prior to deliberate planning, the agent must accumulate a valence map, behavioral repertoire, and harm/benefit geography through novelty-driven, sleep-dominant, damage-protected exploration.
INV-055.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict): the
infant-curriculum substrate must land before this claim is testable at all.
Two of its three original prerequisites are already clear -- MECH-307
default recalibration (V3-EXQ-540g) and non-trivial goal_pipeline z_goal in
default config (V3-EXQ-603n PASS, all four load-bearing gates including
G3_p2_zgoal_consumption non-degenerate) -- and the InfantCurriculumScheduler
Phase 0->1 gate-criterion question is resolved and wired (crossing-count
criterion, 591f PASS -> live scheduler 2026-06-19, infant_substrate:GAP-14-c2).
What remains open is GAP-14's residual leg (c-1): seed-46 exploration-strength
collapse, currently gated on the behavioural-competence wall (V3-EXQ-724
competence_deficit_diffuse; MECH-457 cold-start/competence-floor thread) rather
than on any selection-authority or goal-pipeline defect. Until (c-1) clears and
EXQ-ISEF-005 (the V3-EXQ-591 successor) can be authored and run, any attempt to
score this claim self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a verdict -- do not queue
EXQ-ISEF-005 on partial clearance alone (documented standing instruction).

Once EXQ-ISEF-005 runs, apply the claim's own gate criterion: z_goal norm above
threshold AND behavioral entropy below ceiling (repertoire established, not a
pure random walk).

CONFIRMING: the phased infant-curriculum arm reaches this gate criterion, while
flat-parameter baselines run for the same total budget without a distinct
infant phase do NOT.

FALSIFYING: flat-parameter baselines reach the same gate criterion at a
comparable or better rate, or with comparable resulting valence-map coverage
and behavioral repertoire diversity, when matched for compute budget -- would
demote INV-055 to at most "helpful, not necessary."
