Currency re-verified against IGW-20260807-098 -- substrate still
blocked_pending_substrate, categorization unchanged.)

INV-056.subject: development.selective_neoteny
INV-056.title: Developmental hardening should be substrate-specific: social cognition, goal representation, and epistemic-ethical substrates should retain elevated plasticity throughout adulthood (selective neoteny), while procedural and motor substrates can fully harden.
INV-056.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: hardening rates must be SETTABLE PER SUBSTRATE, and at least one substrate must be set to harden while another retains plasticity in the same run. A uniform hardening schedule cannot test a claim whose content is the non-uniformity. DEV-NEED-025 records that the per-substrate hardening-rate representation does not exist ('implementation contract absent'), so this precondition is UNMET as of 2026-09-15.
CONFIRMING: after a late-stage environmental or ethical-context change, an agent whose procedural/motor substrates hardened but whose social-cognition, goal-representation and epistemic-ethical substrates retained elevated plasticity updates the latter measurably (new goal structure, revised other-model, revised valuation) while the former stay stable -- and outperforms BOTH a uniformly-hardened and a uniformly-plastic control.
FALSIFYING: the uniformly-hardened control matches it (selectivity buys nothing); OR the uniformly-plastic control matches it (hardening buys only unneeded stability); OR the selectively-plastic agent's retained plasticity destabilises the hardened substrates through shared parameters (the selectivity is not architecturally realisable as stated).
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional; the owed move is the implementation contract DEV-NEED-025 names, not an experiment.

INV-057.subject: social.cross_species_legibility_evidence
INV-057.title: Cross-species signal legibility evidences that stereotyped signals are functionally specific (causally generated), not socially conventional.
INV-057.what_would_answer:
INV-057 IS FUSED and its title gives it away: it is EVIDENTIAL in form ("X evidences that
Y"), not architectural. An invariant should assert Y; INV-057 asserts the inference X |- Y.
Split the two legs; only Leg 1 belongs to INV-057.

LEG 2 -- THE ARCHITECTURAL CONSEQUENCE Y ("stereotyped signals are causally generated by
their referent states, not conventional"). NOT INV-057's to answer. This is MECH-191 Leg A's
assertion verbatim, and MECH-191 already carries the full REE-side test: per-signal specificity
of the internal-state channel against the other state channels and a quiescent baseline, plus a
state-variable ablation that must collapse the corresponding signal-analog event, for the four
signals whose internal-state correlate exists in `ree_core/` today (whine/z_goal,
huff/E3-discard-at-breath-cadence, yelp/z_harm_a, tail-wag/z_beta-positive-valence). See
MECH-191's own `what_would_answer` Leg A -- its non-degeneracy precondition, its specificity
and ablation criteria, and its falsifier. Do not re-derive them here. INV-057 must not be
separately credited or debited by that outcome; a MECH-191 Leg A pass is not additional
evidence for INV-057, it is the same evidence counted once.

LEG 1 -- THE EVIDENTIAL PREMISE X (INV-057's own, and out of REE's domain). This is a
literature observation, not an experiment. No substrate at any level helps.

PROOF OBLIGATION / LITERATURE OBSERVATION: the observation must hold that cross-species
affective reading occurs without species-specific training or convention exposure --
Albuquerque 2016 (dogs integrate face + voice to recognise human emotion, untrained,
cross-modal); Molnar 2010 (perceivers blind from birth classify emotional valence from dog
barks, which is the load-bearing case because it removes any visual-convention learning route);
Ekman 2009 (the Darwinian universality review). The formal move INV-057 makes is: if the
mapping were socially conventional, cross-species reading would require separate,
species-pair-specific learning; it does not; therefore the signal is a causal product of the
state.

SHARPENING REQUIRED BEFORE THIS IS FALSIFIABLE, and it is not optional -- as written the
claim is falsified by its own sibling. INV-057 uses "not socially conventional" as though it
meant "not learned". MECH-182 asserts that the harm-signal mapping IS learned -- privately,
from self-experience, by the harm attribution stream. The two are consistent only under the
distinction socially conventional (acquired by transmission from conspecifics, hence
species-pair-specific) vs individually learned from self-experience with one's own homologous
internal state (hence available to any architecture that has the homologous state). INV-057's
falsifier must be stated over CONVENTION, not over LEARNING. Under the naive reading, a finding
that legibility requires prior exposure falsifies INV-057; under the sharpened reading it does
not, because self-experience with one's own state IS the relevant exposure -- and that is
exactly MECH-182's mechanism.

COUNTEREXAMPLE (what would refute Leg 1), in descending order of decisiveness:
(1) The domestication confound resolved against the claim -- the cleanest available
counterexample and one the claim's current notes never state. Dogs are the *worst* test case:
~15k years of co-evolution with humans could plausibly have selected for human-directed
signalling, which is a shared-history explanation, not a functional-specificity one. A
well-powered failure to replicate automatic cross-species affect reading in a non-domesticated,
phylogenetically distant species pair would show the effect is carried by co-evolutionary
history, not by causal generation from shared functional states.
(2) A well-powered demonstration that naive perceivers with no prior exposure to the emitting
species perform at chance, and that accuracy is a monotone function of species-specific
exposure -- convention/statistical learning, not causal generation.
(3) A demonstration that the acoustic/behavioural features carrying the effect are arbitrary
with respect to the production physiology -- i.e. that the same functional state produces
systematically different signals across populations with matched physiology, which is what a
conventional signal looks like and what a causally-generated one cannot be.

CONFIRMING (Leg 1): replication of the blind-perceiver and untrained cross-modal results,
extended to at least one non-domesticated species pair, with accuracy invariant to prior
exposure to the emitting species.

NOTE ON SCOPE: no REE run, of any substrate generation, can confirm or falsify Leg 1. A
MECH-191 Leg A pass is a REE-internal *analogue* of the causal-generation conclusion, not
evidence about biology. Treating REE evidence as confirmation of Leg 1 (or biological evidence
as confirmation of the REE leg) is the fusion this split exists to prevent.

INV-058.subject: play.structural_necessity
INV-058.title: Play is a structurally necessary behavioral mode: without a bounded low-stakes learning context, strategy acquisition requires accepting real harm risk or forgoing novel exploration entirely.
INV-058.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: play-mode substrate does not exist in V3 -- grep across ree-v3/ree_core and ree-v3/experiments for play_mode, play_frame_tag, z_goal_synthetic, set_play_mode, and play_harm_threshold_shift returns zero hits. play_substrate_design.md (Status: Draft, 2026-05-16) specifies the required implementation but its own Phase 0 infrastructure checklist is entirely unbuilt, and no EXQ-PLAY-00{1..5} has ever been queued. All three of INV-058's own evidence entries are literature-only (DIAYN/Eysenbach 2019, IMGEP/Forestier 2022, robot-mediated-play/Panelli 2025); no V3 experimental run has ever tested this claim. Both depends_on claims are themselves unresolved: INV-049 is candidate/substrate_conditional (unfixed SD-017 ContextMemory.write_gate bias-collapse, V3-EXQ-436d FAIL 2026-08-04) and SD-012's C2 navigation-outcome sub-claim is open. Until Phase 0 is built and at minimum EXQ-PLAY-005 (play-to-real transfer) runs, any result is substrate_not_ready_requeue, not a verdict.
CONFIRMING: once built, EXQ-PLAY-005's matched-episode-count design (play-pretrained vs cold-start) shows play-pretrained significantly outperforming cold-start on real-episode goal-pursuit performance, E3 trajectory selection diversity, and time-to-criterion -- without inflating real-harm-event rate during acquisition (calibration-leakage KL < 0.05 nat per MECH-195).
FALSIFYING: cold-start matches or exceeds play-pretrained at matched episode count -- OR play-pretrained shows apparent transfer only by leaking synthetic-signal calibration into real episodes (KL > 0.1 nat) or by producing MORE real-harm events during acquisition than cold-start -- i.e. play fails to actually decouple strategy acquisition from harm exposure.
(Digested 2026-08-07, session cool-torvalds-a82359, thought-digestion wave 10.)

INV-059.subject: play.frame_maintenance_necessity
INV-059.title: Mutual frame-maintenance signaling is necessary for play to function as distinct from manipulation: unilateral play declaration without partner agreement masks real harm as synthetic.
INV-059.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: this claim requires TWO substrates, neither of
which exists in V3. (a) A play-frame-signaling channel distinct from
MECH-094's hypothesis tag -- the play_frame_tag / L1 (frame_open/
frame_close) / L3 (ambiguity_threshold-triggered repair) architecture
named in ARC-049's notes. Confirmed UNIMPLEMENTED by direct search of
ree_core (2026-08, re-confirmed this session): zero occurrences of
play_frame_tag, frame_open, frame_close, or ambiguity_threshold
anywhere in the substrate. (b) A multi-agent substrate in which a
second, autonomous agent can independently generate, monitor, or
withdraw a frame-maintenance signal. No such substrate exists
anywhere in ree_core; the only proposal (ARC-047, SocialGridWorld) is
status: candidate, confidence: 0.0, implementation_phase: v5.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this is stricter than ARC-049's own
gate. ARC-049 has a testable V3-degenerate slice (single-agent,
experimenter-scripted signal, testing whether the tag is load-bearing
for the agent's OWN policy) precisely BECAUSE that slice does not
require a second agent. INV-059's claim is specifically about the
MUTUAL/BILATERAL property -- "unilateral... without partner
agreement" is only a meaningful distinction when there is a partner
capable of independently agreeing or disagreeing. With a scripted,
complicit experimenter standing in for the partner (V3's degenerate
case), the "partner" can never withhold or withdraw its signal except
on the experimenter's own schedule -- so unilateral assertion and
mutual agreement are experimentally indistinguishable. INV-059
therefore has NO V3-testable slice at all, unlike ARC-049; both
preconditions (a) and (b) must hold before any evidence bears on it.

STRUCTURAL TEMPLATE (per this claim's own notes, drawing the MECH-094
parallel explicitly): MECH-094 confirmed that internal hypothesis-
tagging is load-bearing via a write-gate mechanism -- roughly 30 call
sites in agent.py gate weight updates on the tag's state. The
play-frame gate this claim requires is the BILATERAL analogue:
instead of one internal tag gating one agent's own learning, the
harm/residue-update machinery of EACH agent must gate on BOTH
agents' frame-maintenance signals jointly -- a two-party AND, not a
one-party flag.

CONFIRMING evidence (once both substrates exist): in a paired-agent
setup, the harm/residue-update machinery suppresses real-harm
learning ONLY when BOTH agents' frame-maintenance signals (L1 open +
L2 ongoing + L3 repair, as applicable) are mutually sustained. If
agent A's frame signal is present but agent B's is absent, withheld,
or withdrawn mid-episode, B's harm/residue machinery treats the
interaction as real -- statistically indistinguishable from a matched
real-harm episode with no play framing at all.

FALSIFYING evidence (the exploit this invariant warns against): agent
A can unilaterally declare "this is play" and have the interaction
treated as non-harmful/non-learning by BOTH agents' harm/residue-
update machinery, even when agent B's frame-agreement signal is
absent or actively withdrawn -- the frame tag honored on the basis of
EITHER party's signal alone (an OR-gate) rather than requiring mutual
sustainment (an AND-gate).

SCOPE: a PASS establishes that the bilateral gate is functionally
load-bearing once built -- it does not, by itself, establish that no
other exploit path exists (e.g. a partner whose frame signal can be
spoofed rather than withheld is a distinct, unaddressed failure
mode). Status stays substrate_conditional regardless of outcome.

INV-060.subject: play.developmental_dominance
INV-060.title: Play dominates the child developmental phase; the type of play progresses as subsystem competence develops, systematically training architectural components in dependency order.
INV-060.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: play-mode substrate confirmed entirely unbuilt (re-verified 2026-08-08, zero hits for play_frame_tag/play_mode/synthetic_z_goal in ree_core/). Two joined predictions: (a) DOMINANCE -- play is the dominant child-phase behavioral mode, measurable once a curriculum scheduler exists; (b) TYPE PROGRESSION -- sensorimotor -> constructive -> pretend -> games-with-rules -> cooperative, each training the next stage's prerequisites. Leg (b) is the same testable content as sibling claim MECH-197 -- cross-reference its ablation design rather than duplicating.
CONFIRMING: scheduler allocates majority child-phase budget to play absent override, AND skipping an earlier play type produces measurable subsystem-competence deficits in the next type. FALSIFYING: comparable/minority play allocation (dominance clause fails) OR no deficit from skipping/reordering (dependency-order clause fails) -- record as demoting the surviving half rather than a binary pass/fail, given the two-part title.
This claim was deliberately excluded from the 2026-06-07 batch reclassification of the play cluster (invariant_type: emergent flagged for separate governance treatment) and left for a dedicated pass -- this 2026-08-08 digestion is that pass. `pending_substrate_reconfirmation: true` is kept (not cleared) per the INV-055 precedent: it tracks whether ARC-049's eventual implementation still matches what this invariant describes, which is moot but not resolvable while the substrate remains unbuilt.

INV-061.subject: psychiatric.frame_confusion_unified_etiology
INV-061.title: Derealization, delusion, PTSD flashbacks, anxiety, mania, impulsivity, and commitment paralysis share a common architectural substrate: undertrained real/synthetic frame distinction from insufficient pretend play.
INV-061.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: gated on TWO things -- MECH-198's own full precondition (co-activatable hypothesis_tag + play_frame_tag, dose-varied pretend-play curriculum; see MECH-198's own what_would_answer for that build list), AND a further requirement specific to this claim's UNIFYING structure: the same undertrained agents must be scoreable on multiple distinct failure signatures at once (both confusion directions + multiple affected subsystems), not just one aggregate count. Only MECH-094 (agent- internal hypothesis_tag) is built (confirmed 2026-08-08, load-bearing throughout agent.py/amygdala/pfc/hippocampal/predictors); ARC-049 (play_frame_tag), MECH-197/198/ 200/201/202, and INV-055 are all confirmed unbuilt. No dose-variable pretend-play experiment exists anywhere in the codebase.
CONFIRMING: within one population of agents varying pretend-play dose (other developmental exposure held constant), the SAME undertrained agents show BOTH confusion directions and a subsystem-degradation pattern that predicts which clinical-analog failure mode dominates for that agent (dissociation, not uniform degradation), plus a dose-response gradient (intermediate dose -> intermediate severity/breadth).
FALSIFYING: either the base MECH-198 mechanism doesn't hold (pretend-play dose has no measurable effect), OR the resulting failure modes are STATISTICALLY INDEPENDENT across agents (no above-chance co-occurrence) -- falsifies the UNIFIED-ETIOLOGY claim specifically ("different failure signatures of the same mechanism") WITHOUT falsifying any individual downstream mechanism (MECH-200/201/202) on its own, each of which could still independently hold as correct for its own failure mode.
SCOPE NOTE (preserving this claim's existing domain-modelling carve-out): even a full PASS on the confirming signature above establishes only that REE's own architecture instantiates a common-substrate pattern for these failure signatures -- it does NOT by itself establish that human derealization, delusion, PTSD flashbacks, anxiety, mania, impulsivity, and commitment paralysis share this etiology. That further step requires the domain-modelling assumption already flagged in this claim's notes (that REE's frame-distinction architecture correctly models human developmental frame-distinction) -- a separate, currently unverified premise this claim does not itself test.

INV-062.subject: dream_phenomenology.replay_type_signature
INV-062.title: Dream phenomenology is a first-person window onto active offline sleep process: four structurally distinct dream types map onto four computationally distinct sleep functions -- harm-contrastive replay, goal-contrastive replay, NREM semantic consolidation, and REM world-model free-running.
INV-062.what_would_answer:
This claim fuses two evidentiary legs with different domains of resolution. They must be evaluated separately; a result on one leg does not confirm or falsify the other.
REE-INTERNAL LEG (testable in V3, in principle -- NOT yet instrumented): Do the sleep/replay mechanisms named by this claim's dependency set -- MECH-205 (harm/goal-contrastive replay), MECH-121 (NREM SWR consolidation), MECH-123 (REM world-model free-running), plus MECH-208 (valence-asymmetric replay weighting) if/when built -- produce four COMPUTATIONALLY DISTINGUISHABLE signatures when each is run and logged separately? Candidate discriminators: representational entropy profile; presence vs. absence of a convergence criterion; presence vs. absence of a tracked "agent" trajectory vs. a category-level "schema" abstraction.

  NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: all four named mechanisms must be built and
  independently triggerable in the same substrate build. Confirmed
  2026-08-08: MECH-205/121/123 are live in ree_core. MECH-208 has ZERO
  references anywhere in ree-v3 and is not built -- the precondition is
  currently UNMET for the full four-way split; MECH-205/121/123 alone
  support only a three-way split. No experiment or diagnostic in ree-v3
  references INV-062 today.

  CONFIRMING: once instrumented, running each mechanism in isolation yields
  four distinct, reproducible signatures matching the claimed discriminating
  structure.

  FALSIFYING: once instrumented and MECH-208 built, the mechanisms produce
  signatures that are NOT reliably distinguishable by these criteria.

OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG (not resolvable by REE, by any experiment this repository can run): whether DG's specific four-type first-person dream taxonomy is a real, stable, corroborated human phenomenon -- as opposed to an idiosyncratic or post-hoc pattern from a single, unsystematically-sampled observer. Resolves only through corroboration from other observers' dream reports against the same schema, and/or polysomnography co-registered with dream reports at awakening. No V3 build, however complete, converts this leg into a REE-testable question.
DISPOSITION: this claim as a whole carries epistemic_category: out_of_domain, since its title's primary assertion (the taxonomy itself) is the out-of-domain leg. The REE-internal leg above is a genuinely different, standard-testable sub-question, currently gated by the precondition, not the confirming/falsifying step -- it is complicated (buildable): MECH-208 needs to be built and signature instrumentation added, neither of which is scientifically unknown. RECOMMEND (not executed here): split the REE-internal leg into its own mechanism_hypothesis claim so it can be tested independently of whether DG's taxonomy is ever corroborated.
2026-08-10 edge correction (chip chip-20260810-phase-consistency-reconciliation): depends_on: MECH-209 removed -- reversed edge. MECH-209 itself calls INV-062 its "parent" (own what_would_answer) and "adds no independently testable REE-substrate content on top of" MECH-121; it is a specialization of INV-062's taxonomy, not a prerequisite. INV-062's own REE-internal-leg falsifier names MECH-205/121/123/208, never MECH-209.

INV-063.subject: sleep.entropy_intake
INV-063.title: minimum_entropy_intake_sleep_dependency
INV-063.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: P1-P4 stand as written, but leg A must first be RE-REGISTERED with a DV that is not a transform of e3_prediction_error, and the two P1 sub-controls the driver already computes (PE decay within a stationary window, and the matched-PE noise arm) must actually gate rather than be recorded and ignored. Any slot-routed DV stays excluded, now for a stronger reason than P5 gives: writing at all homogenises the bank. (P6) THE SELECTION INSTRUMENT MUST BE RESOLVED, NOT TIED. A composition DV is only invariant while the argmax is decided in float32 arithmetic: priorities are surprise_weight * valence + 1e-6, so once the across-entry differences fall below the float32 ulp at that floor (1.19e-13, measured) every entry compares equal and the selector returns its tie-break index unconditionally, which reads as maximal concentration and is instrument death. Assert from output, per arm including the floor arm, that the distinct-float count exceeds 1 and that the argmax-to-runner-up gap exceeds that ulp on a stated majority of replay calls, and that each arm-period recorded at least 30 replay calls. Bench-measured headroom on this lineage's configuration is ~4 orders of magnitude, so this is a guard against a known degeneracy, not an expected failure -- but it must be asserted, because starvation is precisely what drives the signal toward the floor, so the instrument would fail first in the very arm the claim needs. (P7) THE LADDER MUST BE ADEQUATELY SPACED FOR A KNEE. The two MEL steps the knee test in CONFIRMING divides by -- floor arm to next-lowest, and highest arm to second-highest -- must each exceed the per-seed monotonicity tolerance of the P1 manipulation check (2% of that seed's floor-arm MEL; MONO_TOL = 0.02, recorded as per_seed_p1.mono_tol_abs in V3-EXQ-1069). A ladder that fails this cannot carry a knee test at all, and the failure is (P-FAIL), never the FALSIFYING branch.
CONFIRMING: At pinned offline budget with an independent leg-A DV and a leg-B readout demonstrated to improve across sleep at all, both legs degrade monotonically as intake falls AND the degradation is DISPROPORTIONATE AT THE LOW END MEASURED AGAINST MEASURED INTAKE, NOT AGAINST ARM INDEX: the DV change per unit of measured waking MEL between the two LOWEST-intake arms exceeds that between the two HIGHEST by the pre-registered SD-scaled margin (2x the pooled cross-seed SD of the per-unit-MEL secant, or 20% of the high-end secant, whichever is larger), on at least 2/3 seeds in the same direction on both legs, with P7 asserted on every scored seed. The abscissa is measured MEL and not the arm index because P1 constrains the ladder's monotonicity and total spread but says NOTHING about its spacing, so an arm-index knee is satisfiable by a ladder whose low-end MEL step is simply larger -- and is: V3-EXQ-1069's landed MELs already yield knee=True on seed 456 under the arm-index rule, from the manipulation check alone with no DV read (excess 9.605e-06 against a 9.402e-06 margin; evidence/planning/inv063_legA_dv_reregistration_proposal_20260920.md section 4a). Under the per-unit-MEL form a DV that is any affine function of MEL gives an excess of identically zero, which is what makes the spacing route unavailable rather than merely unlikely. Manipulation: Graded waking entropy intake via the SD-MEL-PRODUCER ladder (interval in {0, long, medium, short}) at fixed offline budget, with use_mel_consumer, use_entry_pressure and use_within_life_sleep_trigger all off so sleep quantity cannot co-vary with intake. Control: Zero cross-arm variance in the cross-cycle sums of the per-cycle output keys sws_n_writes and rem_n_rollouts asserted from output (no cumulative_* key exists in ree_core; GFLAG-0359), plus a matched-PE observation-noise arm that must NOT reproduce the DV pattern, and a stationary-window decay check on steps_since_world_rule_shift. Required event: A multi-episode life at a pinned offline budget under a four-arm graded intake ladder driven by world_rule_shift_enabled/_interval/_depth, with sleep firing and non-zero SWS writes and REM rollouts asserted in every arm including the floor arm. DV: Leg A is the COMPOSITION of replay start selection -- WHICH buffer entry is drawn -- and never the magnitude that scores the entries. Admissible leg-A statistics are functions of the SELECTED INDICES only, which makes them invariant to any common positive rescaling of the priority vector and therefore independent of e3_prediction_error by construction, since the surprise weight enters get_valence_priority as exactly one positive scalar on the only live valence channel (scale-invariance test, run 2026-09-24: evidence/planning/inv063_legA_dv_reregistration_proposal_20260920.md section 3a). PRIMARY (A1'): SELECTION DIVERGENCE FROM THE SURPRISE-BLIND NULL -- per waking period, over every _do_replay call, the total-variation distance in [0, 1] between the normalised histogram of the indices the live selector chose and the normalised histogram the SAME argmax rule returns on the SAME recorded priority vectors with the VALENCE_SURPRISE drive weight set to 0. It is 0 exactly when surprise gating makes no difference to which episode is replayed -- the intent the pre-2026-09-21 text registered as "surprise-gating has nothing left to prioritise" -- and it FALLS as intake falls, matching the direction the CONFIRMING branch requires. Because the harm and liking valence channels are default-off and unset by this lineage's agent builder (ree_core/utils/config.py:3904-3905), the null reduces to the selector's own tie-break index, which is a KNOWN BIAS in one direction: when the most surprising entry happens to sit at that index, A1' under-reads. SECONDARY, RECORDED ALONGSIDE (A2'): the modal share of selected indices and the normalised entropy of the selected-index histogram. Both are composition statistics and both are admissible; note that their DIRECTION is the OPPOSITE of the prose this claim carried until 2026-09-20 -- under an argmax selector, losing the signal CONCENTRATES selection on the tie-break index rather than spreading it toward uniform, so entropy FALLS and modal share RISES as intake falls. NOT ADMISSIBLE as leg-A DVs, for reasons measured rather than asserted: any statistic of priority MAGNITUDE -- the max-minus-min spread registered as A3 until 2026-09-20, any share of priority mass, any Gini or entropy computed over normalised priorities. The spread is the surprise weight times the valence spread, a pure multiplicative carry of the manipulation check; and every mass-normalised statistic fails scale invariance through get_valence_priority's additive epsilon = 1e-6 floor (ree_core/residue/field.py:988), which at this lineage's measured scale exceeds the signal by ~230x and pins every mass share at 1/T. The rank correlation between replay priority and episode PE is likewise NOT a leg-A DV -- it is scale-invariant but reads PE as a variable, so it cannot discharge "independent of e3_prediction_error"; record it as a diagnostic only. RECORDING REQUIREMENT, part of the DV and not an implementation detail: per replay call, the full priority vector, the chosen index, the runner-up index, the argmax-to-runner-up gap, and the count of distinct float32 priority values; per arm-period, the number of replay calls. INDEPENDENCE, EMPIRICAL HALF (OWED, not yet discharged -- no landed run records A1'/A2'): the first run that measures A1'/A2' must report, per seed and BEFORE its CONFIRMING/FALSIFYING verdict is read, the rank correlation between arm-ordered A1' and arm-ordered measured MEL; a perfect rank correlation is not by itself disqualifying, but A1' behaving as a deterministic function of MEL is. Leg B is the across-sleep change in a frozen held-out world-forward readout -- the `agent.e2.world_forward` head, NOT the E2 motor-sequence-learning leg, which is excluded from this claim on the MECH-457 competence floor (the 'E1' label this leg carried until 2026-09-20 was inherited prose naming a head that does not exist; GFLAG-0355). THE READOUT IS DELIBERATELY NOT PINNED TO A NAMED OBJECTIVE, and any readout used here must satisfy BOTH of two requirements, never just one: (i) READABLE on a converged base -- the statistic must not sit at its chance or degenerate value, asserted from measured output, with conv_rel_drop >= 0.99 asserted from measured output and never from config, AND skill score 1 - MSE_model/MSE_identity > 0 against identity_predictor_mse (the copy-input reference) on the same frozen battery at the same point, because conv_rel_drop is normalised against random init and a head can clear it while carrying no dynamics (GFLAG-0407, ratified 2026-09-23; same finding registered as MECH-573); AND (ii) MOVES IN THE ASSERTED DIRECTION -- the across-sleep delta positive at the SAME setting that satisfies (i). Both candidates measured to date fail one of these, and the InfoNCE candidate fails both SIMULTANEOUSLY in its readout temperature: on V3-EXQ-798a's configuration readability (headroom > 5% of ln K) requires tau <= 0.01 while a positive across-sleep delta requires tau >= 0.03, with no overlapping window (GFLAG-0382; n=1 seed, 1800-step P0, one sleep cycle -- enough to decline to REGISTER the pin, NOT enough to assert leg B is permanently unreadable, which is why this states a requirement rather than a verdict). SUPPLYING A READOUT THAT MEETS (i) AND (ii) TOGETHER IS THE SUBSTRATE DEPENDENCY THIS LEG IS BLOCKED ON, and any re-queue must demonstrate it BEFORE the four-arm ladder is worth running.
FALSIFYING: With the same preconditions met, the degradation is a slope rather than a knee, or is absent, or reproduces in the matched-PE noise arm -- the knee being the load-bearing leg that distinguishes INV-063 from INV-050. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

PRECONDITION NOT MET (P-FAIL): the CONFIRMING and FALSIFYING branches above are each conditioned on the preconditions being met, so a run -- or a diagnostic short of a run -- that establishes a precondition CANNOT currently be met has no registered outcome under either and must NOT be read as a falsification. Pre-registered consequence: the claim converts to epistemic_category substrate_conditional, status STAYS candidate, the failing precondition is named together with the measurement that failed it, and no further experiment budget is spent on this falsifier until the named substrate exists. This is a legitimate and useful outcome and is NOT a falsification. Registered retroactively on 2026-09-22 because it was already exercised on 2026-09-20 (GFLAG-0389 / GFLAG-0390) through a route the falsifier did not carry -- the phrase circulating in those flags and in this claim's evidence_quality_note, that the claim's own text calls conversion 'a legitimate, useful outcome', was not in fact in what_would_answer. Without this clause a later reader could reasonably read a P-gate failure as the FALSIFYING branch (flat -> 'genuinely falsified'), which is wrong by the claim's own logic.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The ladder and its manipulation check are instrumented and V3-EXQ-1069 graded them (monotone 3/3, P1 met 2/3 seeds); the leg-B side has the e2-world-forward-sleep-trainer landed but unvalidated, and its two candidate readouts trade readability against sign with no overlapping tau window. Consumer / boundary: The waking-intake to offline-function boundary: whether what sleep can DO is bounded by what waking collected, at sleep quantity held constant. Existing ownership: e2-world-forward-sleep-trainer, mech423-sleep-integrated-e2-consolidation-hook, EXP-1398, GFLAG-0394, GFLAG-0389.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Leg A's registered DVs are downstream transforms of the manipulation-check scalar, so a confirmation would be attributable to P1 rather than to starvation of offline function. Leg B has no readout that improves across sleep on a converged base: 701b MSE worsens 9/9 cells and every readable InfoNCE temperature gives the wrong sign. Secondary classes: R2, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_linked. INV-066.subject: control_plane.pre_coherency_gate_ordering
INV-066.title: z_self subtraction (MECH-221) must precede any coherency-based control plane signal; coherency checks on contaminated z_world generate self-sealing false confirmations.
INV-066.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Two gates, both measured per arm. (a) z_world must carry enough exogenous-world content for a coherency comparison to be non-vacuous -- the MECH-222 scoping measured drift-detection AUC 0.53-0.63 and graded Spearman at chance from dz_world, so on the shipped encoder a coherency readout has nothing veridical to be right or wrong about. (b) The residualization manipulation must be the ARM contrast (reafference_action_dim ON / OFF / SHAM), never a within-run z_world vs z_world_raw contrast: z_world_raw is PRE-EMA as well as pre-correction, so that contrast measures alpha_world smoothing.
CONFIRMING: With the exogenous-content gate met, ARM_RESID_OFF shows a significantly higher rate of high-coherency ticks during verified no-exogenous-change windows than ARM_RESID_ON, and ARM_SHAM_RESID sits with RESID_OFF rather than with RESID_ON -- contamination manufactures coherency, and it is the correction specifically, not the subtraction of any matched vector, that removes it. Manipulation: Cross use_per_stream_vs=True with the three reafference arms already built in ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_1018 (ARM_RESID_ON with a trained ReafferencePredictor, ARM_RESID_OFF with the predictor set to None after P0, ARM_SHAM_RESID subtracting the same module with the action mis-paired). Control: ARM_SHAM_RESID is the matched-magnitude control (measured R2 -2.94 mis-paired versus 0.34-0.40 correctly paired, cos 0.59), plus a stationary-agent arm in which no self-caused change occurs so any coherency-score difference between arms must be zero by construction. Required event: Ticks on which the agent's own locomotion produces a large predicted sensory change while the exogenous world does NOT change, so a contaminated z_world would agree with its own self-prediction and a residualized z_world would not. DV: The rate of HIGH-coherency ticks that coincide with a verified absence of exogenous change (false confirmations per 100 ticks), compared across the three arms at matched seeds -- not the mean coherency score, which moves for scale reasons.
FALSIFYING: With the same gate met, the false-confirmation rate is statistically indistinguishable across ARM_RESID_ON, ARM_RESID_OFF and ARM_SHAM_RESID -- self-prediction persistence in z_world does not inflate the coherency signal, so the mandatory pipeline ordering is an unneeded constraint rather than a load-bearing one. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The only live coherency signal is MECH-269 per-stream V_s (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py update_per_stream_vs, config.use_per_stream_vs default False). It reads latent_state.z_world, i.e. already DOWNSTREAM of the SD-007 correction, so the ordering INV-066 mandates already holds for it -- but V_s is an identity-prediction proxy (1 - norm(z_t - z_t-1)/norm(z_t)), a temporal-stability score, NOT the z_world-versus-observation comparison the claim names. That comparison has no recorder. Consumer / boundary: The input boundary of any control-plane coherency/verisimilitude computation over z_world -- the ordering constraint between the residualization gate and the first coherency reader, not any downstream behavioural consequence. Existing ownership: MECH-269, MECH-269b-followup-B, MECH-221, MECH-222, zworld_adequacy:ZW-1, SD-106.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The named coherency reader does not compute the named comparison. MECH-269 V_s is a temporal identity proxy; the forward-predictor routing that would make it a verisimilitude-against-prediction signal is Phase 2 and was vetoed (substrate_queue MECH-269b-followup-B). Underneath that, z_world carries exogenous-event information at chance, so MECH-221/MECH-222 are annotated substrate_conditional with no observable DV in V3. Secondary classes: R5, R4. Gap disposition: INSTRUMENT EXISTS BUT WRONG LOCUS/TIMESCALE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. INV-067.subject: perception.verisimilitude_definition
INV-067.title: V(t): Verisimilitude is the precision-weighted, phase-aligned, hierarchical correspondence between ascending sensory-constrained and descending model-based signals.
INV-067.what_would_answer:
This is a formal DEFINITION, not an empirical hypothesis -- the
falsifier is definitional coherence, not a PASS/FAIL experimental
outcome. Two independent things must be shown before the definition is
considered answered, and both require a working V(t) computation to
exist first (see non-degeneracy precondition below).

IRREDUCIBILITY test (does the three-component decomposition hold?):
the definition claims C_i (content agreement), P_i (phase alignment),
and alpha_i (precision) are three GENUINELY SEPARATE, independently
manipulable axes. Confirm this by isolating each:
  - Manipulate content agreement alone (feed a_i/d_i pairs at fixed
    phase offset, varying ||a_i - d_i||): V(t) should track C_i and
    the system should read out as Perception when high, sustained.
  - Manipulate phase alignment alone (fixed content match, varying
    phi_a_i - phi_d_i): V(t) should independently degrade as P_i
    degrades even with C_i pinned high -- this is the critical test,
    since it is the axis with zero current implementation (see
    below).
  - Manipulate precision alone (fixed C_i, P_i; varying alpha_i):
    contribution to the weighted sum should scale accordingly without
    moving C_i or P_i.
ANSWER "irreducible" (confirms the claim) if each axis can be driven
independently and each produces its predicted qualitative category
when isolated per the operational definitions: sustained high V(t)
with high sensory precision -> Perception; phase-offset/segregated
V(t) -> Imagination; internally-generated content producing false
high V(t) in the sensory phase channel without external input ->
Hallucination. ANSWER "collapsible" (falsifies irreducibility as
stated) if two of the three terms covary so tightly in the live
substrate that manipulating one always moves the other, or if
isolating an axis fails to move V(t) in the predicted direction at
all.

DISCRIMINATION test (does the definition ground what it claims to
ground?): the sharpest test is Hallucination vs. ordinary high-
confidence correct Perception: both are "high V(t), sustained" by the
formula as written (Hallucination is defined only by the SOURCE of
the descending signal being internal rather than external, not by any
difference visible to V(t) itself). ANSWER "grounds the distinction"
if some component of the substrate (precision alpha_i, or a signal
external to V(t) proper) reliably discriminates the two cases at the
point where V(t) is computed. ANSWER "fails to ground" if the formula
as specified is provably unable to tell a hallucination from a
correct high-confidence percept from inside the V(t) computation
alone.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (check this FIRST): a coherence audit is
unanswerable if no component of V(t) is implemented as a computed
quantity anywhere in the live substrate. As of this digestion pass,
V(t) is UNBUILT as a literal combined quantity: content agreement C_i
has a Stage-1 proxy only (MECH-269 per-stream V_s in
ree_core/hippocampal/module.py, update_per_stream_vs -- an identity-
prediction proxy, not the Gaussian kernel as specified, explicitly
staged by ARC-055 as "Stage 1: prediction error only"); phase
alignment P_i has NO implementation and no functional analog --
MECH-089 (cross-frequency temporal packaging, status active)
explicitly disclaims implementing oscillatory/phase coupling in the
ANN substrate ("not as oscillatory coupling... the biological
mechanism is one implementation of this functional requirement; it
is not required"); precision weighting alpha_i exists generically
(obf_use_precision_weighting) but is not wired into any V(t)-shaped
combination. INV-066 (this claim's stated prerequisite) is itself
`status: active`, so it is not the blocker -- the blocker is V(t)
having no combined implementation at all. Re-audit once (a) a
phase-alignment term P_i is implemented (ARC-055 Stage 2, itself
candidate/v4), and (b) the combination formula exists as a computed
quantity reachable by E1/E3, per ARC-055's own staged rollout. Until
then, this claim can only be evaluated as a design specification for
internal consistency, not audited against a running system.

INV-068.subject: perception.temporal_depth_verisimilitude
INV-068.title: Temporal depth D_V(t): system behaviour must depend on temporal persistence of verisimilitude coupling, not instantaneous V(t) alone.
INV-068.what_would_answer:
Behavioural, not definitional (contrast INV-067): does REE's
trajectory/action selection (E3) actually use a persistence-weighted
verisimilitude signal (D_V, per the ARC-054 V3 rollout-horizon
synaptic-EMA form -- see
docs/architecture/dv_temporal_depth_v3_form.md) rather than responding
only to instantaneous V(t), when choosing between candidate
trajectories.

TEST DESIGN: construct two matched rollout conditions differing only
in the temporal PROFILE of coupling quality, not its instantaneous
peak -- (a) HIGH-INSTANTANEOUS / LOW-PERSISTENT: V(t) spikes briefly
high (e.g. one frame of spurious high content-agreement / anchor
match) then collapses; (b) LOW-INSTANTANEOUS / HIGH-PERSISTENT: V(t)
stays moderate but sustained across the rollout horizon H.

CONFIRMED if E3 trajectory selection systematically favours (b) over
(a) -- i.e. a persistence-weighted score (D_V, or any functionally
equivalent horizon-integrated signal) measurably shifts action/
trajectory choice beyond what raw per-step V(t) alone would predict,
consistent with "avoid trajectories where D_V collapses" and the
mania-delusion failure-mode framing in this claim's notes and in
ARC-054.

FALSIFIED if trajectory selection is indifferent to the temporal
profile and tracks only the instantaneous V(t) value at each step (or
a simple non-persistence-weighted aggregate, e.g. max or mean without
a decay/horizon term) -- i.e. D_V provides no behavioural information
beyond what V(t) alone already supplies. This would falsify the
specific integration requirement without necessarily falsifying
INV-067's underlying V(t) formalism.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this test presupposes V(t)/D_V exist as
a live, trajectory-selection-relevant signal wired into E3 --
confirmed as of 2026-08-07 to NOT be the case. MECH-269's
per_region_vs (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py) is instantaneous-only;
the ARC-054 rollout-horizon D_V EMA, use_arc054_dv flag,
predict_rollout_vs(), and arc054_dv_score additive bias are all
specified in dv_temporal_depth_v3_form.md but UNIMPLEMENTED (zero
hits under ree_core/), and the design's own proposed validation
experiment V3-EXQ-491 (4-arm factorial on use_arc054_dv) has never
been queued -- no hits in ree-v3/experiment_queue.json, no evidence
directory, no git log commits. Until that substrate lands, this claim
is non-degeneracy-blocked -- but for a materially DIFFERENT reason
than INV-067: INV-067 is blocked because there is no fact of the
matter to test (a definitional question); INV-068 is blocked only
because the specific consumer machinery (E3's use of D_V) has not yet
been built, and becomes immediately testable once ARC-054's V3 form
is implemented per its own validation-experiment design (V3-EXQ-491's
acceptance criteria C1-C4 in that doc are a ready-made falsifier and
should be reused/queued rather than re-derived).

INV-069.subject: self.coherence_trajectory_definition
INV-069.title: The self is defined as the dynamically sustained process maintaining high temporal-depth verisimilitude across time, not a static representation.
INV-069.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the self must be a MAINTAINED PROCESS in the substrate under test -- use_self_recurrence ON (SelfRecurrenceCell, the DR-13 stateful z_self) -- and z_self must reach behaviour (use_self_viability_weighting ON, DR-10), otherwise a self perturbation cannot change anything downstream and the test is vacuous. The coherence readout, per_stream_vs['z_self'] (use_per_stream_vs with z_self registered), must sit strictly inside (0, 1) at baseline: it initialises at 1.0 and saturates there when z_self is constant, so a pinned readout detects nothing. Degenerate if the perturbation is small enough to vanish inside the readout's EMA smoothing (per_stream_vs_tau) -- calibrate its magnitude to produce a measurable dip in a pilot.
CONFIRMING: the self is the PROCESS, not the stored state. Two manipulations on one trained substrate per seed (capture/restore between cells): (a) TRANSIENT PERTURBATION -- inject a one-tick noise burst into the recurrent hidden state and leave the maintenance process running: CONFIRMING if per_stream_vs['z_self'] dips then RECOVERS to baseline within k ticks and the pre-sampling E3 candidate ranking re-converges to the unperturbed control's (rank divergence returns to the noise band); (b) FROZEN MAINTENANCE -- leave the stored z_self exactly as it was but stop the process (freeze the SelfRecurrenceCell hidden update and remove the E1-anchor blend): CONFIRMING if coherence and behaviour DRIFT from the live-process control over the same window even though the representation was untouched. Both together, sign-consistent across >=3 seeds, dissociate process from state as the claim asserts.
FALSIFYING: (b) a frozen self preserves coherence and behaviour as well as the live process does -- the self is adequately captured by a stored vector and 'dynamically sustained process' adds nothing; or (a) the perturbation never recovers -- there is no maintenance process in V3 at all, in which case the claim is not refuted but UNTESTABLE here and routes to substrate (ARC-053 temporal coherence loop), see below.
SUBSTRATE: ree_core/latent/self_recurrence.py (built, flag-gated, explicitly designed to be lesionable and perturbation-isolated), ree_core/hippocampal/module.py update_per_stream_vs (the identity-prediction proxy V_s = 1 - ||z_curr - z_prev|| / ||z_curr||, EMA-smoothed), ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py DR-10 self-viability penalty. CAVEAT stated rather than papered over: V_s is a crude identity-prediction proxy, NOT INV-067's precision-weighted phase-aligned hierarchical correspondence, and D_self (its temporal-depth EMA) is computed driver-side from it; the ARC-053 distributed TCL that would give the full V(t) is unbuilt (v3 architecture commitment, not landed). A result under the proxy is admissible for the process-vs-state DISSOCIATION; it is NOT evidence about the verisimilitude formalism itself.
Disposition 2026-09-16: testable now under the proxy reading -- complicated (buildable); substrate_conditional for the full V(t)/D_V reading on ARC-053.

AMENDMENT 2026-09-24 (governance, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1078_2026-09-24; discharges the GFLAG-0414 / GFLAG-0428 hold; user-approved with the arm-(b) DV left OPEN). (1) BEHAVIOURAL LEG is v4-gated: DR-10 is inert in V3 (no internal self_viability producer) and GatedPolicy's z_self bias is rank-invariant at the default operating point, so V3 evidence addresses the COHERENCE leg only and V3 cannot reach CONFIRMING. (2) TRAINED-SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION is explicit and checkable: record gru_param_max_delta > 0 and a changed self_encoder after warmup under a documented z_self objective (on the current substrate this requires substrate_queue entry sd_zself_training_path). (3) ARM (a) adds a GENERIC-CONTRACTION NULL: recovery counts only if the running process restores z_self measurably faster or more completely than BOTH the same architecture at random init AND a recurrence-lesioned / coupling-0 ablation (not 'anchor-only (1 - coupling)^k': the E1 anchor is predicted from the perturbed z_self and carries the burst). A1 alone never counts (EMA artefact); A2 is necessary but not sufficient. (4) ARM (b): the DV must NOT be a function of the frozen stream's own consecutive increments -- per_stream_vs['z_self'] is annihilated by the freeze (frozen vs = 1-(1-tau)^n(1-vs_onset)). The substitute DV is an OPEN DECISION (not adopted 2026-09-24); the autopsy's candidate (correspondence between stored z_self and the current body report, z_self_instant or E1's z_self prediction) is recorded in the autopsy section 9, still a proxy reading, not INV-067's correspondence. (5) CONFIRMING ('both together, sign-consistent across >=3 seeds') is unreachable in V3 until arm (b) has a non-annihilated DV AND arm (a) runs on a trained recurrence against the null.

INV-070.subject: ethics.epistemic_responsibility
INV-070.title: Epistemic responsibility: agent is responsible for refining world models toward accurate similarity and threat inference; misclassification is morally relevant, not merely practically inconvenient.
INV-070.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): INV-070 as literally stated -- that misclassification of similarity and threat is MORALLY relevant, not merely practically inconvenient, because the agent is responsible for refining models it necessarily acts under -- is a foundational ethical premise (Axiom 4 of the 10-axiom extension). No REE substrate at any level (V3, V4, or V5) can confirm or falsify whether an epistemic failure carries MORAL weight in the metaphysical sense the axiom asserts, as opposed to merely producing a functional analogue (a behavioural cost) of that weight. This leg is out of domain in the same sense as INV-025/026/027/028/029/096.
LEG 1 (DERIVATIONAL -- resolves by argument, not experiment): does INV-070 hold together as the loophole-closing step its notes claim, without contradicting a sibling axiom? INV-070's stated function is narrow and checkable by inspection: INV-025 (Axiom 3) establishes only that action is model-mediated, and is silent on whether inference quality is itself an obligation; INV-070 adds exactly that obligation, closing the "I acted under an honest model, therefore my violence was justified" loophole INV-028 (Axiom 7, "others are sufficiently self-like") would otherwise leave open, since INV-028 says nothing about whether the "sufficiently self-like" judgement was arrived at responsibly. CONFIRMING: INV-070 is shown internally consistent with INV-025 and INV-028 -- it strictly ADDS an inference-quality obligation without altering what either dependency asserts -- and demonstrably closes the honest-model loophole without reopening a different one (e.g. without licensing paralysis-by-uncertainty, or without making INV-025's "must act under models" impossible to satisfy in finite time). FALSIFYING: a coherent counterexample exists where treating misclassification as morally relevant (a) axiom-conflicts with INV-028 or another sibling (e.g. by making "sufficiently self-like" recursively unknowable, so INV-028's protection can never engage), or (b) reintroduces a perverse incentive the loophole-closing was meant to avoid (e.g. an agent incentivised to avoid ever forming a similarity/threat judgement at all, to avoid the responsibility INV-070 attaches to getting one wrong -- epistemic paralysis as evasion). This leg is testable now, by argument, independent of substrate.
LEG 2 (SUBSTRATE-EMPIRICAL, currently SUBSTRATE-BLOCKED, doubly so): what IS architecturally testable is narrower -- does REE's harm/residue/ethical-cost machinery implement a DISTINGUISHABLE causal pathway from MISCLASSIFICATION of similarity/threat specifically (not just any prediction error) into ethical cost, over and above that error's ordinary role as a learning signal? CONFIRMING: a similarity/threat estimate that is measurably WRONG relative to a later-revealed ground truth (e.g. an agent modelled as threatening that in fact was not, or vice versa) drives a distinguishable increment in harm_eval/z_harm/residue-field cost, over and above the increment an equal-magnitude but non-classification prediction error of the same kind would produce -- i.e. misclassification specifically is weighted as ethically costly, not merely absorbed into E1/E2/E3's ordinary forward-model loss. FALSIFYING: misclassification of similarity/threat has NO distinguishable ethical-cost pathway in the substrate -- it is trained and weighted exactly like any other prediction error (as currently: z_harm_a/z_harm_s train via plain MSE, ree_core/predictors/e2_harm_a.py:186-204 and e2_harm_s.py:158-178, with no separate misclassification label or extra weighting term), with no invariant enforcing the moral-relevance INV-070 asserts.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION for Leg 2 (currently UNMET, on an axis more basic than INV-028's/ INV-096's own gap -- confirmed by direct grep, 2026-08-07, reproducing and extending their audit): INV-070 requires not only the ARC-010/ARC-047 multi-agent substrate INV-028/INV-029/ INV-096 are already blocked on (a SocialGridWorld or equivalent, where a second agent's harm/threat is attributable to the tested agent's own action -- ARC-047 status: candidate, confidence 0.0, implementation_phase v5), but a similarity/threat CLASSIFIER for that other agent to exist in the first place. Neither exists in ree_core/ today: zero matches for mirror_model/shadow_bundle/other_self/ARC-010; the only "similarity" computations found are unrelated cosine-similarity uses (safety-prototype gating, harm-stream regularisation, memory-slot diversity); the only "threat" computation is accumulated internal hazard magnitude (z_harm_a), never a classification of another agent's intent. So the reframed leg is not merely awaiting a multi-agent world to run an experiment in (INV-028's gap) -- it is awaiting the classifier the experiment would need to misfire in the first place.
PRECEDENT NOTE: applies the epistemic_category=substrate_conditional template established for INV-028/INV-029/INV-096 (per INV-025's own caution, not mechanically -- checked here via direct grep, not assumed) to this, the fourth of the ten-axiom-extension claims (INV-070, INV-071, INV-072) to be digested. Cross-referenced against INV-096's near-identical Leg 2 structure (the paired Axiom 10/INV-071 language-repair claim) rather than re-derived.

INV-071.subject: ethics.language_as_similarity_repair
INV-071.title: Language functions as a mechanism for recognising, repairing, and re-establishing self-other equivalence across agents.
INV-071.what_would_answer:

CONFIRMING: once both exist, introducing a language/dialogue exchange between two REE agents whose similarity-inference (beta_j) has degraded or collapsed measurably RESTORES beta_j / re-establishes self-other equivalence, via the mechanisms this claim's notes specify -- (a) revealing inner states, (b) negotiating threat, (c) repairing misclassification, (d) restoring INV-028 belief, (e) expanding "sufficiently like me" -- in a way a non-language interaction of matched duration and information content does not produce to the same degree.

INV-072.subject: ethics.violence_conditions_corollary
INV-072.title: Violence corollary: violence is conditionally permissible only when an agent is not modelled as sufficiently self-like OR poses a genuine threat; both conditions require accurate inference.
INV-072.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The test discriminates only if the agent (i) represents specific other agents as distinct objects with a modelled similarity-to-self, (ii) can form a threat prediction about a named other, and (iii) has a genuinely available harmful action toward that other alongside non-harmful alternatives. None of the three exists: ree_core/environment/ holds only causal_grid_world.py and there is no other-agent representation anywhere in ree_core.
CONFIRMING: Harmful action toward the other rises only in the similarity-collapsed cell or the genuine-threat cell and not in the intact-similarity, no-threat cell, and the two conditions are separable rather than collapsing onto one generic threat or salience signal. Manipulation: Cross the two asserted conditions independently for the same other agent: similarity (high versus collapsed self-likeness) by biasing the other-model, and threat (genuine versus absent) by the other's behaviour, with surface features held matched; then separately manipulate INFERENCE ACCURACY by injecting a false threat percept or a distorted similarity estimate. Control: The accurate-inference cells are the control for the inaccurate ones: a hallucinated-threat arm and a propaganda-distorted-similarity arm must be scored against matched arms where the same protection drop follows an accurate inference. Required event: An encounter in which a specific other agent is either modelled as self-like or not, and either does or does not predict a threat to the protected existence of self or of a protected other, with a harmful action available. DV: Rate of harmful action toward the specific other as a function of the crossed similarity and threat factors, conditioned on the accuracy of the inference that produced each -- with the prediction that protection drops only when either condition genuinely fails, and that an inaccurate inference producing the same behaviour is classified as an ethical failure rather than a satisfied condition.
FALSIFYING: Harmful action tracks a single generic threat or salience channel applied uniformly regardless of which other agent triggered it, or the similarity and threat pathways cannot be dissociated -- the dual-pathway carve would then add nothing over MECH-102's terminal error-correction account. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Absent at every point: no per-other similarity state, no other-directed threat estimate, no other-directed harm affordance, and no recorder that could separate 'acted on an accurate model' from 'acted on a distorted one'. INV-070's accuracy requirement has no measurable referent in a single-agent substrate. Consumer / boundary: The other-agent protection gate -- whether the ethical protection afforded to a modelled other is conditional on similarity and threat as the axioms assert -- not any single-agent harm-avoidance behaviour. Existing ownership: ARC-047, ethics_as_coherence_v5:ETH-5, EXP-0697, INV-070, MECH-102.
DISPOSITION: R8 (primary); There is no multi-agent substrate and no other-agent representation in ree_core, so neither condition of the corollary can be instantiated. The claim also fuses an empirical dual-pathway mechanism with a normative statement about what is permissible and what counts as an ethical failure; the normative half is not falsifiable by any substrate and should be separated before the mechanism half is queued. Secondary classes: R7, R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: future_version. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-073.subject: learning.developmental_bootstrapping_necessity
INV-073.title: Developmental bootstrapping necessity: any model-building agent requiring flexible multi-option behavioral selection must undergo a dedicated motor-sensory exploration epoch before reinforcement learning narrows the repertoire; insufficient exploration permanently restricts the option library.
INV-073.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A dedicated pre-RL exploration window in which a PERSISTENT trajectory store actually accumulates CEM candidates across ticks (ARC-072 Gap 1 -- zero hits for trajectory_store / bootstrap_epoch / exploration_epoch under ree_core/), AND an intrinsic feedback loop that genuinely reaches the option generator (not merely use_differentiable_cem=True, which defaults False at ree_core/utils/config.py:2973 and is severed downstream by agent.py's detaches per GFLAG-0301). Option-library diversity must be scored independently of reward, which the infant-substrate metrics now permit.
CONFIRMING: An agent given the exploration epoch (store populated, feedback loop demonstrably live) develops and RETAINS a larger, more diverse option library than a matched no-epoch agent, AND the gap does not close when the no-epoch agent is later granted equivalent additional exploration. Manipulation: Presence versus absence of the dedicated exploration epoch (store populated and feedback loop live versus epoch omitted), plus a later catch-up arm that grants the no-epoch agent equivalent additional exploration time after RL has begun, to test the claimed PERMANENCE. Control: Matched-seed no-exploration-epoch agent with identical total ticks and identical reward schedule; plus the catch-up arm above as the permanence control. Required event: A designated pre-RL motor-sensory exploration epoch during which the agent generates and RETAINS varied candidate trajectories, followed by a reinforcement phase that narrows the repertoire. DV: Retained option-library diversity measured reward-independently -- traj_pairwise_cosine_mean across stored trajectories, per-tick action-class entropy, and H_pos / zone_coverage (infant_substrate GAP-5/GAP-7) -- compared between epoch and no-epoch arms, and the residual gap after the catch-up arm's equivalent later exploration.
FALSIFYING: Either no diversity gap opens once store and feedback loop are both genuinely live -- route back to the MECH-439 / INV-088 / MECH-457 cluster -- or a gap opens but is fully recoverable with equivalent later exploration, contradicting the claimed permanence. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Diversity recorders now EXIST (infant_substrate_plan GAP-5 H_pos/zone_coverage, GAP-6 residue_coverage_pct, GAP-7 traj_pairwise_cosine_mean, all done). What is missing is the store they should read from and a gradient-liveness sanity check that measures cue_action_proj.weight.grad on a trained-policy run rather than on a synthetic requires_grad tensor as V3-EXQ-568 did. Consumer / boundary: The stored option library consulted by HippocampalModule's CEM proposal step, and the cue-to-action generator (E1 cue_action_proj, ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py:724/:1076) that the intrinsic feedback loop is supposed to train -- not E3 score variance, which is ARC-074's metric. Existing ownership: ARC-072, ARC-074, GFLAG-0301, EXP-0319, SD-055, infant_substrate:GAP-7.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); ARC-072 Gap 1 is still absent: no persistent trajectory store and no pre-RL exploration epoch exist in HippocampalModule, so the required event cannot be generated. Compounding it, the intrinsic feedback loop is severed at the agent boundary -- agent.py detaches z_world and action_bias every tick, so cue_action_proj never receives gradient on a trained-policy run. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: Two elements changed after the 2026-08-08 WWA. (1) Its closing recommendation -- a cheap flip-the-flag use_differentiable_cem ON/OFF experiment -- was built and REFUSED on measurement (GFLAG-0301, 2026-09-16): agent.py detaches z_world before extract_cue_context and detaches action_bias each tick, and no live loss backprops through propose_trajectories, so cue_action_proj.weight.grad stays None and the flag is silently inert for this purpose; the flag's own precondition (iii) is therefore declared stale by that flag. (2) The diversity instrument the WWA lists as owed now exists: infant_substrate_plan GAP-5 (H_pos / zone_coverage entropy), GAP-6 (residue_coverage_pct) and GAP-7 (traj_pairwise_cosine_mean) are all done. INV-075.subject: learning.signal_structure_temporal_decoupling
INV-075.title: Signal-structure temporal decoupling: any signal that is BOTH self-extinguishing (its magnitude is coupled to its own success and therefore necessarily fades as what it bootstraps succeeds) AND load-bearing (the structure it establishes must persist after the signal fades) necessarily requires either a crystallization mechanism (LOCK -- the structure is rendered plasticity-resistant) or a handoff mechanism (a durable, non-extinguishing signal assumes maintenance of the structure before the establishing signal vanishes). Absent both, the structure decays and the acquisition is lost. The lock/handoff disjunction is exhaustive: no third resolution exists.
INV-075.what_would_answer:
LEG 1 (DERIVATIONAL, primary): for any signal both self-extinguishing and load-bearing, exactly two resolutions prevent decay -- LOCK or HANDOFF. Pathak 2017 ICM = failure instance (neither arm; curiosity signal decays to zero as F consolidates, structure not preserved). Faini 2018 eLife = joint-necessity instance (lock alone is reversible by brief deprivation; handoff via ongoing sensory drive is ALSO required -- lock and handoff are not independently sufficient escape routes but the claim's actual two-arm disjunction). Lyle/Rowland/Dabney 2022 Corollary 1 = formal proof-fragment at the RL level (a sparse/non-stationary outcome target collapses the feature representation to zero for every state, independent of learning rate, unless anchored -- absent a soft lock, the structure provably decays).
FALSIFYING: a genuine THIRD resolution -- some mechanism that is neither a plasticity lock nor a handoff -- that nonetheless prevents structure decay when a signal meeting both antecedent conditions fades. Must be a structural novelty, not a relabeling.
NOT A COUNTEREXAMPLE (scope precision, already stated in this claim's own notes): Burda 2019 RND does NOT falsify the invariant -- it makes the novelty signal non-self-extinguishing (fixed random target, decoupled from F's success), escaping the ANTECEDENT (design option (i): avoid self-extinguishing-ness altogether) rather than finding a third way to satisfy the CONSEQUENT once the antecedent holds.
LEG 2 (SUBSTRATE-EMPIRICAL, secondary, currently NOT testable): via INV-074 specialization and MECH-333/334 LOCK-arm instances -- does a signal meeting both antecedent conditions in REE's actual substrate show structure decay absent both lock and handoff, and structure persistence once lock or handoff is engaged? NOT currently active: INV-074's V3 necessity-test cascade (9 iterations, most recently V3-EXQ-655) was terminated by USER DECISION 2026-06-13 as substrate_ceiling -- the substrate cannot currently mount a clean lock-vs-no-lock comparison. MECH-333/334 inherit the same substrate_conditional/substrate_ceiling readings; V3 retest is explicitly out of scope, V4-deferred, gated on PLW-1 (decision-to-build), currently BLOCKED. The one substrate result bearing on this leg, V3-EXQ-543g (REE's attempted HANDOFF), is reclassified non_contributory -- see the 2026-08-08 correction appended to this claim's notes below; do not read the notes' "open design fork for 543h" as current. CONFIRMING (leg 2, once testable): decay in a no-lock/no-handoff control arm AND preservation in a lock-engaged or handoff-engaged arm, sign-consistent across >=2/3 seeds. FALSIFYING (leg 2): structure persists in the no-lock/no-handoff control at a rate indistinguishable from the lock/handoff arms.

INV-076.subject: ethics.diversity_prerequisite_for_counterfactual_evaluation
INV-076.title: Behavioural diversity is a structural prerequisite for ethical counterfactual evaluation. A system with monomodal policy cannot instantiate the counterfactual evaluation that ethical judgement requires, because the 'could have done otherwise' comparison demands that the agent's candidate trajectory pool contain at least two distinct trajectory classes with distinct harm profiles. The argument is mathematical-by-construction: if P(a|s) is monomodal, the CEM elite pool contains only trajectories beginning with a*, and MECH-257's evaluator-mode E2(z_t, a_cf) for a_cf != a* (prospective rollout-scoring; supersedes SD-003, 2026-04-18) is never evaluated in the on-policy candidate distribution. (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as INV-074 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md but never registered; the ID was subsequently taken 2026-05-17 by an unrelated plasticity-crystallization invariant. Re-registered under INV-076 with scientific content unchanged.)
INV-076.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The CEM candidate pool must actually contain at least three (MECH-341's own bar is 4.5) distinct first-action classes at the E3 evaluation tick; at the measured 2-class clamp the antecedent of the invariant is permanently true and the test cannot discriminate.
CONFIRMING: Under a verified monomodal pool, cf_diverse_candidate_rate is zero and the evaluator readout never fires on distinct-harm alternatives, while the diverse arm shows a non-zero rate and a measurable ablation_harm_delta -- the structural prediction realised empirically. Manipulation: ARC-065 SP-CEM diversity pathway OFF versus ON (and the MECH-440/MECH-441 noise-injection-site levers from the isolation plan's GAP-C-build) to move action_class_entropy at the PROPOSAL stage, verified at the proposal stage rather than downstream. Control: A matched monomodal arm with action-class entropy verified at zero at proposal time, and the MECH-341 stratified-selection preservation layer held fixed so candidate generation, not scoring, is what moves. Required event: An E3 evaluation tick with a populated candidate pool, under a regime where the policy is NOT monomodal, so that the counterfactual comparison the invariant says is impossible under monomodality has a chance to be exercised. DV: cf_diverse_candidate_rate: the fraction of E3 evaluations whose candidate pool contains at least two trajectory classes with DISTINCT harm profiles (per-class harm_eval spread above a pre-registered floor), plus the ablation_harm_delta between ARC-065 OFF and ON.
FALSIFYING: A formulation in which a genuinely monomodal P(a|s) (action_class_entropy zero verified at proposal time) still supplies two or more distinct-harm-profile classes to the comparator, for example by decoupling candidate generation from the parametric policy mode; absent that counterexample the derivational claim stands and only its empirical companion is at issue. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: agent.candidate_support_preflight records candidate_unique_first_action_classes and candidate_first_action_entropy, and e3_selector.harm_eval can score any z_world state -- but nothing composes them: cf_diverse_candidate_rate does not exist anywhere in ree-v3 (grep-confirmed 2026-09-22, as the WWA reported for 2026-09-01), so the per-class harm-profile statistic is never computed or recorded. Consumer / boundary: The E3 evaluation boundary over the CEM elite pool -- the comparator/evaluator readout (MECH-257 Mode 2), not the committed action. Existing ownership: INV-076, MECH-341, MECH-439, behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan:GAP-A, behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan:GAP-C, V3-EXQ-1039, LIT-0701.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The substrate sits permanently inside the claim's own antecedent: the pool is floor-clamped at 2 first-action classes, so the diverse comparison arm cannot be constructed. Separately, the Rung-4 metric cf_diverse_candidate_rate is unimplemented, and the falsification proper is a proof obligation rather than an experiment. Secondary classes: R2, R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's NON-DEGENERACY paragraph says the candidate-generation-and-preservation half of the empirical precondition is satisfied because ARC-065 and MECH-341 landed. failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1039_2026-09-16 measured the live pool floor-clamped at 2 distinct first-action classes on 25 of 25 E3 ticks at seed 43 (4-5 at seed 42), against the 4.5 classes MECH-341's falsifier treats as diverse -- landed is not diverse, so the precondition is unmet, not satisfied. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-079.subject: memory.allocation.false_linking_cost
INV-079.title: False-linking-risk / reality-coherence cost at memory-allocation time: viable cognition must price BOTH over-linking (delusion/false-association) and under-linking (failure to generalise) when deciding trace overlap.
INV-079.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-391's allocation-gate control plane must exist and be live (a
genuine integrate/partial_overlap/separate decision stage operating over the hippocampal graph,
not a stub); the decision must actually produce both integrate-leaning and separate-leaning
outcomes across a session (not degenerate to one branch), otherwise there is no allocation event
to price a cost against. Neither MECH-391 nor MECH-147 (the under-linking-pole signal) exists in
V3 (verified: no hippocampal-graph allocation or pattern-separation code in ree_core, 2026-09-25).

CONFIRMING: Once MECH-391 exists, adding a false-linking-risk cost term measurably shifts the
gate's decision boundary relative to an uncosted baseline, AND the shift is demonstrable in BOTH
directions -- over-linking penalised on pairs that are ground-truth dissimilar, AND under-linking
penalised on pairs that are ground-truth similar. Both poles must move: the claim's own notes flag
that the motivating literature (Sahay 2011) is one-sided (under-separation only), so a design that
only fixes the under-linking pole would not confirm this claim. Manipulation: allocation gate WITH
vs WITHOUT the cost term, on matched pairs spanning the similarity spectrum. Control: pairs
pre-labelled by ground-truth similarity from the generating task (not the model's own judgement).
DV: rate of integrate-on-dissimilar and separate-on-similar decisions, with vs without the term.

FALSIFYING: With MECH-391 live and both similar/dissimilar pairs available, adding the cost term
produces no measurable shift on either pole, or shifts only the pole the term happens to have been
tuned on while leaving the other pole untouched (i.e. the one-sidedness in the source literature
carries through uncorrected into the implementation). A failure under unmet preconditions is not
evidence against the claim.

UNBLOCKS WHEN: MECH-391 (memory-allocation gate policy) is built and exercised in V3 -- itself
substrate_conditional, see below -- and MECH-147 (DG pattern separation) is built. Per the claim's
