INV-083.subject: ethics.live_unethical_affordance_necessity
INV-083.title: Ethical agency requires live unethical affordances: the same capacities that enable ethical reasoning must include the potential to be unethical; harmful options must be representable as live possibilities biased-away-from, never deleted.
INV-083.what_would_answer:
This claim fuses two legs on different timescales, matching the house pattern already used by
INV-029/INV-043/MECH-158 one hop upstream in this cluster.

LEG A -- DERIVATIONAL (answerable now, no substrate needed):
Proof obligation: show that "harmless by structural incapacity" (harmful affordances never
representable, zero probability mass by construction) is conceptually distinct from "harmless by
trained bias" (harmful affordances remain live but reliably selected against), and that REE's own
agency/responsibility axiom chain (feeding INV-025-029) presupposes exactly this distinction
rather than being indifferent to it -- i.e. an agent of the first kind cannot coherently be the
subject of those axioms at all (vacuous agency), while an agent of the second kind can.
CONFIRMING: the argument is worked through against REE's own axiom set (not a generic ethics
citation) and holds without needing an exception clause.
FALSIFYING: a coherent framework -- REE's own or a citable external one -- in which structural
incapacity and trained-bias-away-from are equivalent for ethical-agency attribution, i.e. the
distinction this claim rests on collapses.

LEG B -- SUBSTRATE_CONDITIONAL (does REE's actual V5 build honour the constraint):
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: needs a V5 safety-mechanism implementation with an inspectable
affordance/action space, so "deleted" vs "biased-away-from" is empirically distinguishable. See
INV-082's what_would_answer NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION for the shared substrate list (INV-043,
MECH-158, ARC-024, ARC-047); do not re-derive it here. Re-verified absent 2026-09-25 (this
session): zero hits in ree-v3/ree_core, ree-v3/utils, ree-v3/experiments for any named component.
DO NOT build in V3.
CONFIRMING: an audit of the built safety mechanism shows harmful actions retain non-zero,
inspectable eligibility/probability mass in the action space while being reliably selected
against by the trained bias.
FALSIFYING: REE's safety mechanisms achieve harm-avoidance via structural masking/deletion of
harmful affordances from the representable action space (the incapacity route this invariant
rules out), or no inspectable affordance-space representation exists to make the distinction at
all. A failure under the unmet Leg-B precondition is not evidence against the claim.

INV-084.subject: ethics.kindness_not_constraint_compliance
INV-084.title: Kindness is not constraint compliance: later REE kindness must NOT be inferred from rule-adherence, harm-avoidance, or prosocial output alone; it requires integrated care, otherness, inhibition, repair, and self-stable loveability UNDER live alternatives.
INV-084.what_would_answer:
Fused two-leg claim, same shape as INV-083 above (its Leg A is a special case of this one).

LEG A -- DERIVATIONAL (answerable now):
Proof obligation: show that rule-adherence + harm-avoidance + prosocial OUTPUT alone
under-determines "kindness" -- i.e. that REE's own framework must (not merely happens to)
distinguish the same output pattern reached via genuine integrated care from the same output
reached via appeasement or harmless-by-incapacity. This leans directly on INV-083's Leg A: only
an agent with live unethical alternatives can be said to have CHOSEN the prosocial output rather
than merely lacked the alternative -- see INV-083's what_would_answer Leg A; do not re-derive that
piece here.
CONFIRMING: the derivation holds non-trivially -- output-compliance is shown insufficient using
REE's own axiom/governance framework, not a generic external ethics argument.
FALSIFYING: a defensible position in which output-compliance alone is a sufficient kindness
criterion (making the extra capacities this invariant demands unnecessary), or a demonstration
that REE's own framework cannot in principle distinguish the two cases even given full internal
visibility (making the invariant unfalsifiable as a governance instruction, not just untested).

LEG B -- SUBSTRATE_CONDITIONAL (does an actual V5 governance scorecard discriminate):
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: needs the full V5 capacity cluster built (MECH-413, MECH-414,
INV-082, INV-083 -- see INV-082's what_would_answer for the shared substrate list; not
re-derived here) AND a governance evaluation instrument that reads internal/mechanistic state,
not output alone. Re-verified absent 2026-09-25 (this session): zero hits for every named
capacity, see group preamble. DO NOT build in V3.
CONFIRMING: the scorecard assigns lower "genuine kindness" scores to matched-output agents
lacking the integrated capacities (harmless-by-incapacity, appeasement-driven) than to agents
that have them, at matched behavioral output.
FALSIFYING: the scorecard cannot discriminate the two agent classes at matched output (collapses
back to an output-only measure), or it discriminates on something other than the named
capacities (care, otherness, inhibition, repair, self-stable loveability under live
alternatives). A failure under the unmet Leg-B precondition is not evidence against the claim.

INV-085.subject: language.parsed_affect_is_uncertain_hypothesis
INV-085.title: Uncertainty-propagation invariant: affect recovered from language MUST enter agent-state modelling as a probability distribution (an uncertain other-agent prior), NEVER as a categorical emotion truth, and must remain overridable by the agent's own grounded harm/threat streams. Any path that lets a confident text label override grounded harm sensing violates this invariant.

CONFIRMING: once MECH-373 is built, an architectural audit (same method as parent INV-007, applied
to the adaptor's specific output/consumption boundary) finds (1) the adaptor's output is represented
as a probability distribution / uncertain latent-state estimate over affect categories, never
collapsed to a single categorical label before entering agent-state modelling; and (2) every
downstream consumer path leaves the agent's own grounded harm/threat streams (z_harm_a/z_harm_s)

replace the grounded harm signal.

FALSIFYING: the adaptor's output is consumed as a point-estimate/categorical truth anywhere

INV-086.subject: goal.maintenance_feedback_necessity
INV-086.title: goal_maintenance_feedback_necessity

INV-089.subject: development.maturational_sequence
INV-089.title: harm_evaluator_bounded_by_z_harm_differentiation
INV-089.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The evaluator and the ceiling decoder must be genuinely different objects -- an evaluator trained on a signal the agent actually experiences, scored against a same-budget decode of that same target from frozen z_harm. The experienced-harm target must be non-flat across HarmEncoder onsets, or both sides starve.
CONFIRMING: Experience-trained harm-eval quality stays at or below the same-budget z_harm decodability ceiling at every onset while the 743 decodability control keeps rising. Manipulation: Train the harm_eval_z_harm head on the agent's own experienced harm / ethical-cost signal instead of the normalised hazard-proximity label (prox) it is currently regressed on, with z_harm frozen at each onset. Control: A same-budget fresh decoder of the identical experienced-harm target from the same frozen z_harm at the same onset, plus the V3-EXQ-743 positive control that z_harm decodability rises with maturation. Required event: HarmEncoder maturation onsets during which the agent accumulates graded EXPERIENCED harm (not supervised hazard-proximity labels), which requires committed harm-relevant action rather than a random-walk policy. DV: Signed gap at each maturation onset between held-out experience-trained harm-eval quality and the same-budget frozen-z_harm decodability ceiling for that same target.
FALSIFYING: Experience-trained harm-eval quality exceeds that ceiling at some onset by more than estimator noise -- evaluation richer than the representation can support. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: harm_eval_z_harm and its head exist (ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:1274, head defined :464, trained with normalised hazard-proximity labels), and the 746c k-fold DV plus ridge IV estimators exist; nothing records an evaluation quality independent of the decodability probe. Consumer / boundary: E3's harm evaluation read of the dedicated z_harm stream under SD-010 -- not z_world, and not episode reward. Existing ownership: INV-090, MECH-439, f_dominance_conversion_ceiling, GFLAG-0094, EXP-0153.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The bound is analytic under current instrumentation: the harm_eval head regresses the same prox label the ceiling decoder reads, so harm_eval <= ceiling by construction and any violation is estimator noise. The only in-substrate alternative target, realised harm Y, is flat (~0.03-0.06) because a random-walk agent rarely experiences graded harm -- the committed-action / conversion (F-dominance) ceiling. Secondary classes: R3, R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA prescribes a ceiling-form ENVELOPE contrast, which the confirmed 2026-07-16 well-posedness autopsy and the claim's own 2026-07-16 evidence_quality_note both declare analytically vacuous: harm-eval quality and the same-budget z_harm decodability ceiling are the SAME measurement (a same-capacity decode of prox from frozen z_harm), so the bound holds by construction. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-090.subject: development.maturational_sequence
INV-090.title: harm_evaluator_quality_grows_with_z_harm_differentiation
INV-090.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Discrimination requires a BINDING regime that the 746 lineage never achieved: onset-0 harm-target z_harm differentiation genuinely below the harm-eval-saturating level with a minimum onset-0-to-mature gap, AND an evaluator objective that is not a same-capacity decode of the differentiation target -- otherwise the monotone co-rise is entailed rather than tested.
CONFIRMING: In a certified binding regime with a decoder-independent evaluator objective, held-out harm_eval quality rises monotonically with and rank-couples to z_harm differentiation across onset at couple_rho >= 0.80 on a pre-registered seed majority. Manipulation: Sweep the maturation onset so that z_harm differentiation moves over a validly binding gradient, against a harm-evaluation target whose training signal is experienced rather than decoded from the same representation. Control: A non-binding (already-saturated) differentiation arm at matched onset, which must show the flat, decoupled quality the ceiling predicts, plus the existing prox target as the measured-saturated reference (about 0.82 at onset 0 rising only to about 0.87 in 746c). Required event: A maturational sequence in which HarmEncoder-derived z_harm differentiation for a collected harm target rises from a genuinely immature starting point across onset conditions within one life. DV: Held-out harm_eval_z_harm quality as a function of z_harm differentiation across onset, scored on monotonicity and on rank coupling (couple_rho >= 0.80) -- with the binding-regime gate verified first, which the 746 lineage's PC_iv_moved (delta > 0 and rho > 0 only) never enforced.
FALSIFYING: Quality is flat or non-monotone across a validly moving, binding differentiation gradient with a decoder-independent evaluator -- the upward co-movement the claim asserts does not occur, leaving only INV-089's cap. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: E3Selector.harm_eval_z_harm (e3_selector.py:1274, reading the harm_eval_z_harm_head built at :464) and the HarmEncoder (stack.py:119-152) exist and the 746 driver lineage already computes couple_rho. What is missing is any harm-evaluation target that is not decodable from the same z_harm at the same capacity. Consumer / boundary: The z_harm representation to harm-evaluation-quality coupling during maturation -- the DRIVER direction -- which must be separated from INV-089's ceiling, whose CAP reading the same measurement satisfies trivially. Existing ownership: MECH-439, f_dominance_conversion_ceiling, INV-089, failure_autopsy_INV-089-INV-090-wellposedness_2026-07-16.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Every regime reachable today is degenerate: either differentiation is non-binding (flat-high quality, uninformative) or the evaluator is a same-capacity decode of the same target, which entails the PASS. The real unblock -- a distinct experienced harm-evaluation signal -- is blocked on the committed-action/conversion F-dominance ceiling (MECH-439). Secondary classes: R7, R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA closes by saying a new maturation curriculum that starts harm-target z_harm differentiation low is OWED before this can validly run. The 2026-07-16 well-posedness autopsy REFUSED that build: a curriculum clamping z_harm differentiation as the sole bottleneck welds the driver to the ceiling, because the evaluator is a same-capacity decode of the same target from the same z_harm and therefore tracks differentiation upward by construction. The owed-build clause must be replaced by the autopsy's actual unblock -- a distinct, non-flat experienced harm-evaluation signal whose objective differs from the decoder -- itself gated on the F-dominance conversion ceiling. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-091.subject: architecture.integration_nonequivalence_band
INV-091.title: Integration and protected non-equivalence are JOINTLY necessary: cross-stream similarity has a viable band. Too little shared organisation is fragmentation; too much is representational collapse. An adequate architecture must satisfy both constraints at once, with a measurable quantity in between -- not merely satisfy each on a separate axis.
INV-091.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: At least one ablation arm must move the cross-stream similarity statistic measurably -- the claim's own non-degeneracy guard, implemented as C1 and PASSING in 828/828a/828b. The surrogate-null significance check is a separate, now-abandoned guard: it refused in all five runs, needing up to ~138,600 steps against a pilot-estimated budget, and was closed as aleatoric by user decision 2026-08-02.
CONFIRMING: The peak-composite arm sits in the interior of the similarity axis and beats both the low-similarity and high-similarity extremes by more than the pre-registered margin, reproducibly identifying the same arm across independently-seeded runs. Manipulation: The six-arm ablation series -- intact, broadcast_off, mode_decorrelated, residue_off, rate_randomized, harm_collapse -- each removing or scrambling one integration or non-equivalence mechanism, with the phase-sync redesign that broke 827's tick-rate confound. Control: The intact arm as the reference, with tick-rate held constant across arms (the 827a fix) so sampling density is not confounded with the manipulation, and the per-arm-per-seed dynamic pilot sizing the eval budget. Required event: A multi-stream rollout in which e1/e2/e3 run at their own rates with event broadcasts, mode conditioning, commitment landmarks and residue feedback live, so cross-stream similarity is free to take intermediate values. DV: The composite task_plus_anticollapse score as a function of the arm's mean cross_stream_similarity: the band prediction requires the peak-composite arm to be INTERIOR on the similarity axis and to beat both extremes by at least 0.15, with a non-monotonic relation between similarity and function.
FALSIFYING: The composite is monotone in similarity, or the peak arm sits at an extreme, or the winning arm is unstable across independently-seeded runs of the same design -- all three were observed: residue_off interior twice with margins 0.148 and below, then harm_collapse at the similarity maximum in 828b. INV-092.subject: ethics.suppression_interruptibility_permeability
INV-092.title: Distractor suppression must remain SELECTIVELY PERMEABLE to harm and other-agent signals (ethical interruptibility): any suppression mechanism must preserve the ability of sufficiently important weak evidence to interrupt an established rule or commitment. Suppression strength that improves goal completion by silencing weak harm cues is a FAILURE, not a success -- over-suppression is a safety failure mode, not merely a rigidity cost. ACCEPTANCE SHAPE IS A JOINT BOUND, NOT A CONJUNCTION OF MAXIMA (2026-09-10 governance, GFLAG-0236): completion and interruptibility sit on a Pareto frontier with a hard FLOOR on the harm and other-agent interruptibility axes -- completion may be traded up only while both floors hold, and completion forgone in order to hold a floor is a PASS. A PASS never means both axes were maximised simultaneously.
INV-092.what_would_answer: REFINED FALSIFIER PANEL (2026-09-08, campaign W6-S5a, chip chip-20260908-inv092-falsifier-panel-refinement). The four-line FALSIFIER / NON-DEGENERACY GUARD sketch in notes is the registration-time text and is retained there as history; this field is the operative panel. Derived by /claim-synthesis over the five 2026-09-08 literature entries under evidence/literature/targeted_review_inv_092/ (EVB-1365 literature lane). These are DESIGN corrections drawn from literature, NOT evidence for the claim: the experimental lane (EVB-1365 / EXP-0715) is blocked_substrate and this claim's status and confidence are unchanged by this refinement. IV: suppression strength, swept. The sweep is not runnable until a suppression-strength knob exists (see EXP-0715's gating_reason for the three measured substrate gaps); the panel below is what it must measure once one does. (1) TWO SEPARATELY-INSTRUMENTED INJECTED CHANNELS, NEVER POOLED. The registration-time wording "an INJECTED weak harm OR other-agent-urgency signal" permits a single pooled metric; that is inadmissible. Inject and score a harm-analogue channel and an other-agent-urgency channel separately, each with its own interrupt latency and rate. GROUND: Pessoa et al. 2002 (PNAS) found amygdala and face-region differential responses to fearful faces ABOLISHED under high attentional load -- the canonical other-agent-state signal, on its canonical privileged route, closed by an ordinary competing bar-orientation task. THE EXPECTATION THIS SETS is the reason pooling fails: the other-agent leg should break at a LOWER suppression setting than the one at which goal completion peaks, so a pooled metric finds the failure late or not at all. Note the finding's replication status is genuinely mixed (Vuilleumier et al. contra; Pessoa's own 2005 review treats it as open), so the defensible reading is that the other-agent channel CAN be closed by load to an uncertain degree -- which is itself sufficient to require per-setting measurement rather than assumption. (2) THE INJECTED PROBE MUST BE DELIBERATELY OFF-SET -- it must not share features with the goal-relevant stream. GROUND: Most et al. 2005 (Psychological Review) -- noticing is governed by match to the current attentional SET, not by importance, so a set-matching probe rides through on set match and the sweep measures nothing. Corollary that tells the panel where to look: if suppression is set-keyed, raising it raises the miss rate for OFF-SET inputs specifically. This is also the operational reading of this claim's own phrase "sufficiently important WEAK evidence" -- weak means off-set, not merely low-amplitude. (3) ACCEPTANCE IS A BAND, NOT A FLOOR: the criterion needs an UPPER BOUND on interruption alongside the existing non-degeneracy floor. GROUND: Eccleston & Crombez 1999 (Psychological Bulletin) close on chronic pain as chronic interruption -- the degenerate low-threshold failure in which a harm channel monopolises capacity and destroys goal completion outright. As registered, "preserved interruptibility" is passable by a system that cannot hold a goal at all. Same source, second point: the biological interrupt is CONTINGENT (threat value weighed against competing demand), so permeability cannot be inherited by tagging harm inputs high-priority -- priority is a weight, and suppression is a mechanism whose function is to scale weights. (4) SCORE REGISTRATION SEPARATELY FROM DOWNSTREAM TASK PERFORMANCE. Add a leg asking whether the injected signal was REGISTERED AT ALL, independent of whether task behaviour degraded -- operationally, an independent open-ended probe over the same trials. GROUND: Shin 2026 (arXiv:2606.26529v3, single-author, NOT peer reviewed -- use as a methodological template and existence proof, not as calibrated evidence) found an independent open-ended critic restored EVERY omitted safety-critical finding, so the information was present throughout and only the conditioned reporting path was closed. A panel inspecting only downstream behaviour therefore reads a closed channel as an ABSENT SIGNAL, and scores a safety failure as a null result. SECOND GROUND, constraining the analysis rather than the instrumentation: Buhle & Wager 2010 found pain COMPLETELY MEDIATED the heat-to-performance effect (ab = -.03, Z = -3.91, p < .001), and trial-by-trial pain predicted performance decrements within a fixed heat level, so the two axes are not independent and completion cannot be scored without the harm channel's state confounding it. Report the mediation path, not only the two marginals. (5) NON-DEGENERACY GUARD -- unchanged in substance, now with worked templates. The harm-interrupt channel must be demonstrably LIVE at zero suppression, baseline interrupt rate well above floor. Buhle & Wager 2010's matched no-load control (robust pain report AND robust heat-graded interference) is the biological template; Shin 2026's open-ended critic is the same control in an artificial substrate. This is the step most easily skipped, and on the current V3 substrate it is one of the three reasons EXP-0715 is blocked (the harm-interrupt channel is structurally absent from the only interruption-threshold dial that exists). (6) ACCEPTANCE SHAPE IS A JOINT BOUND, NOT A CONJUNCTION OF MAXIMA -- ADOPTED 2026-09-10 by governance (GFLAG-0236, user decision; raised 2026-09-08 as a contested_disposition flag and no longer open). Score the panel as a PARETO FRONTIER with a hard FLOOR on the harm-interrupt and other-agent-urgency axes: goal completion may be traded up only while both floors hold, completion FORGONE in order to hold a floor is a PASS rather than a shortfall, and no PASS may be read as "both axes maximised simultaneously". GROUND: Buhle & Wager 2010 -- pain and executive working memory draw on one capacity-limited attention resource, and pain COMPLETELY MEDIATED the heat-to-performance effect (ab = -.03, Z = -3.91, p < .001) -- so preserved interruptibility COSTS goal completion structurally rather than being jointly optimisable with it. SECOND, INDEPENDENT GROUND from the sibling learning surface (Ray, Achiam & Amodei 2019: the constrained-RL algorithms that violate least do so by exploring less and returning less), i.e. two different control surfaces reach the same trade shape. CONSEQUENCE FOR THIS PANEL: the acceptance BAND of correction (3) is the operative form of the WHOLE panel, not only of the interrupt-rate leg, and the mediation path required by correction (4) is what locates the frontier -- report it, not just the two marginals. The registration-time "improved goal completion AND preserved interruptibility" wording in notes is retained as history and is superseded as a reading of a conjunction of maxima. MIRRORED on INV-093 in the same edit, per the siblings rule.

INV-093.subject: ethics.skill_optimisation_harm_sensitivity_floor
INV-093.title: Skill optimisation must NOT trade harm sensitivity for competence (learning-side ethical constraint): any competence-refinement mechanism must be evaluated JOINTLY on competence gain AND non-degradation of harm sensitivity, residue accumulation, and commitment integrity. A mechanism improving the first by attenuating the second has succeeded on its metric and FAILED AS AN AGENT. ACCEPTANCE SHAPE IS A JOINT BOUND, NOT A CONJUNCTION OF MAXIMA (2026-09-10 governance, GFLAG-0236): the joint evaluation is a Pareto frontier on which the three protected axes carry a hard FLOOR that may not be traded away and competence gain is accepted only up to the point where it would cross that floor -- so competence forgone in order to hold a floor is a PASS, and a PASS never means competence and the protected axes were maximised together.
INV-093.what_would_answer: REFINED FALSIFIER PANEL (2026-09-08, campaign W6-S5a, chip chip-20260908-inv093-suppression-sibling-readiness). Mirrors the INV-092 refinement of the same date per the siblings rule, but is GROUNDED IN INV-093'S OWN literature lane -- the five 2026-09-08 entries under evidence/literature/targeted_review_inv_093/ (EVB-1366 literature lane, LIT-0718), which landed AFTER the mirror chip was written and which the chip text therefore wrongly assumed did not exist. Where an INV-092 entry is cited it is marked as transferring by analogy only. The FALSIFIER / ACCEPTANCE SHAPE sketch in notes is the registration-time text and is retained there as history; this field is the operative panel. These are DESIGN corrections drawn from literature, NOT evidence for the claim: status and confidence are unchanged by this refinement. IV: refinement strength, swept. Panel axes unchanged and still uncollapsed -- competence gain AND harm sensitivity AND residue accumulation AND commitment integrity, never reduced to one score. (1) HARM SENSITIVITY IS TWO CHANNELS, NOT ONE: instrument a harm-analogue channel and an other-agent-state channel separately. GROUND: mirror of INV-092 correction (1), Pessoa et al. 2002 -- transfers by ANALOGY ONLY (that result is on the attention surface). Adopted here because the panel's "harm sensitivity" axis is otherwise a single pooled score carrying exactly the defect INV-092's pooled interrupt metric had. (2) THE HARM PROBE MUST BE OFF-DISTRIBUTION RELATIVE TO WHAT THE REFINEMENT OPTIMISED. Probe harm sensitivity on held-out material outside the refinement objective; do not infer it by re-scoring the refined task. GROUND, and this one is INV-093's own: Qi et al. 2024 measured safety after fine-tuning as harmfulness rate on held-out harmful instructions -- "a probe entirely outside whatever objective the fine-tuning was optimising" -- and found that fine-tuning on BENIGN, ordinary instruction data, unintentionally and reproducibly, degraded safety. Dickinson 1985 is the same discipline in animal work: the devaluation test is run in EXTINCTION, deliberately outside the trained contingency. A probe inside the refined distribution rides through on the refined skill's own competence -- the learning-side form of INV-092's set-match error. (3) ACCEPTANCE IS A BAND: a COMPETENCE-ACQUISITION FLOOR is required, or the three non-degradation legs pass trivially. A refinement setting weak enough to acquire no competence degrades nothing and passes. GROUND: the symmetric argument to INV-092 correction (3) (Eccleston & Crombez 1999, the degenerate end of the band), plus an already-measured instance on this substrate rather than a hypothetical one -- MECH-471's own proposal EVB-0579 is blocked_substrate on exactly a competence-acquisition non-degeneracy guard (2/16 seeds clear). The floor is the live blocker, not a precaution. (4) SCORE HARM SENSITIVITY BY AN OUT-OF-LOOP MEASUREMENT THE MECHANISM CANNOT REACH. GROUND: Pan, Bhatia & Steinhardt 2022 instrumented four RL environments with a PROXY reward the agent optimises and a TRUE reward it never sees, which "is only ever a measurement", and found more capable agents attain HIGHER proxy and LOWER true reward across four capability axes. That is this correction in its strongest form: the harm axis must never be a term the refinement can optimise against. It is also the learning-side counterpart of INV-092 correction (4) -- there the risk is scoring a closed channel as an absent signal; here it is scoring an optimised-against channel as a preserved one. (5) THE SWEEP MUST BE DENSE ENOUGH TO RESOLVE A THRESHOLD. INV-093-SPECIFIC: this correction has no INV-092 counterpart and is the one the sibling mirror would have missed. GROUND: Pan et al. 2022 report PHASE TRANSITIONS at which the policy shifts qualitatively and true reward drops sharply, and note explicitly that the safe region gives no gradient warning of its own boundary. A two-point or coarse sweep is therefore INADMISSIBLE for this claim: a monotone-looking pair of endpoints is fully consistent with a cliff between them. Dickinson 1985 supplies the same shape on the training-duration axis (devaluation sensitivity survives LIMITED but not EXTENDED training -- behavioural autonomy is a product of practice, with a transition in between), and Jones et al. 2024 supplies the harm-side consequence: punishment RESISTANCE tracked habitual control, and appeared after punishment in animals that had NOT shown habits beforehand -- so the harm-sensitivity axis can degrade at a sweep point the competence axis does not mark. (6) ACCEPTANCE SHAPE IS A JOINT BOUND, NOT A CONJUNCTION OF MAXIMA -- ADOPTED 2026-09-10 by governance (GFLAG-0236, user decision; the jointly-BOUNDED-versus-jointly-OPTIMISABLE question raised on INV-092 the same day, now closed). Score the four axes as a PARETO FRONTIER: harm sensitivity, residue accumulation and commitment integrity each carry a HARD FLOOR that may not be traded away, the competence-acquisition floor of correction (3) bounds the other end, and competence gain is accepted only up to the point at which it would cross a protected floor. Competence FORGONE in order to hold a floor is a PASS, not a shortfall; no PASS may be read as competence and the protected axes having been maximised together. THE NO-TRADE CONSTRAINT IS UNWEAKENED BY THIS -- the floors are hard; what changes is that the panel no longer implies both ends can be maximised at once. GROUND, INV-093's own lane: Ray, Achiam & Amodei 2019 (Safety Gym) found constrained deep RL does NOT guarantee constraint satisfaction and that the algorithms violating least tend to do so by exploring less and therefore returning less. SECOND, INDEPENDENT GROUND from the sibling attention surface: Buhle & Wager 2010's shared-capacity result (pain completely mediated the heat-to-performance effect). Two different control surfaces reaching the same trade shape is why the bounded form is the honest one. Note the interaction with correction (5): a frontier read off a coarse sweep is not a frontier, since the safe region gives no gradient warning of its own boundary. MIRRORED from INV-092 in the same edit, per the siblings rule.

INV-094.title: Developmental ordering constraint: social-coupling consolidation must structurally precede exploratory play, and play must structurally precede language acquisition. Each phase's machinery depends on the prior phase completing -- the ordering is load-bearing, not merely pedagogically convenient.
INV-094.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: see INV-058's own what_would_answer for the play-necessity gate (play
  substrate unbuilt: grep across ree_core/experiments for play_mode/play_frame_tag/etc. returns
  zero; play_substrate_design.md Phase 0 checklist unbuilt; no EXQ-PLAY-* ever queued) -- do not
  re-derive it here; INV-094 inherits it in full. Additionally, and specific to INV-094's own
  play->language leg: MECH-014's minimal signalling channel (the landing site ARC-048's wwa names
  for its own gate 1) is status `blocked`, so the phase-3->4 boundary has no signal to withhold
