INV-095.subject: existence.value
INV-095.title: Existence has value sufficient to justify its continuation.
INV-095.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The harm term must not dominate the cross-candidate E3 score range -- EXP-0720's release_condition targets harm_term_range_share_of_score well below the 0.95 measured -- so a trained competing channel (z_world/E1/E2) actually contests selection; and the ablation target must be a channel whose path into ranking is candidate-DEPENDENT. z_harm_a fails that test: its only route into scoring is a candidate-uniform positive scalar gain and compute_harm_forward_cost does not take it at all (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py), so the residue/z_harm_s path is the only admissible target.
CONFIRMING: Substituting distribution-matched noise for the residue / z_harm_s signal measurably degrades committed hazard avoidance relative to the intact arm, on a substrate where the harm term is not the dominant share of the score range -- extending ARC-024's structural finding (EXQ-028/029, V3-EXQ-032d PASS 5/5) into a genuine signal-versus-noise selection contrast. Manipulation: Replace the ResidueField / z_harm_s output feeding E3's harm-weighted scoring with a distribution-matched noise substitute, holding the candidate set, environment seed and all other channels fixed. Control: Intact-signal arm on matched seeds, plus a state-blind action-generic baseline (measured rho_truth 0.021 against an intact 0.517) that bounds any shortcut by which ranking could track hazard without the signal. Required event: Trajectory selection episodes on a TRAINED substrate in which hazard-avoidance and a competing trained objective genuinely disagree across the candidate set, so that the harm term's contribution to ranking is contestable rather than dominant. DV: SELECTION-level change in committed-trajectory hazard avoidance under the noise substitution relative to intact, reported against a pre-registered instrument-failure discriminator: the arm must additionally show that the intact signal carried recoverable current-tick hazard information (non-degenerate rho_truth), otherwise the null routes to substrate_not_ready rather than to weakens.
FALSIFYING: Under those same non-degenerate conditions, the noise substitute produces no measurable degradation in committed hazard avoidance -- the harm machinery is architecturally decorative at the selection boundary. This would falsify the axiom's named architectural CONSEQUENCE, not the axiom itself. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ResidueField (ree_core/residue/field.py) and E3's harm heads (harm_eval_z_harm_head, compute_harm_forward_cost in ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py) exist and are wired; what is missing is a routable criterion, not a recorder. V3-EXQ-533's harm-stream ablation returned non_contributory/measurement_test_design_defect and EVB-1368/EXP-0720 was refused at /queue-experiment Step 4.5 on a red-team blocking verdict. Consumer / boundary: E3 cross-candidate trajectory ranking and the downstream committed action -- the point at which the harm gradient is asserted to be information rather than noise; NOT the axiom's own truth, which is out of domain. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0291, EXP-0720, ARC-024, V3-EXQ-533, INV-026.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The falsifier does not discriminate in the reachable regime: the harm term is ~0.95 of the cross-candidate E3 score range and CausalGridWorldV2 redraws hazards per episode, so both criterion formulations are structurally satisfied and the falsifying world reads as instrument-not-ready. z_harm_a is additionally rank-invariant by arithmetic, so it is not a valid ablation target at all. Secondary classes: R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: GFLAG-0291 (2026-09-16) measured the pre-registered falsifier to be UNROUTABLE as written, after the 2026-08-07 WWA was authored. Two independent criterion formulations (absolute veridicality drop, and the scale-free retention ratio that replaced it) were BOTH structurally satisfied because CausalGridWorldV2 redraws hazard placement per episode, so a substituted harm latent carries nothing about the current tick (max |rho_truth| over 20 state-uninformative cells = 0.1162); and z_harm_a was confirmed rank-invariant within the E3 harm channel BY ARITHMETIC. The falsifying state of the world is therefore indistinguishable from instrument failure, which the WWA does not acknowledge. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

INV-096.subject: language.similarity_repair_mechanism
INV-096.title: Language is a mechanism by which similarity between agents may be recognised, repaired, and re-established.
INV-096.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): INV-096 as literally stated -- that language is THE mechanism by which similarity between agents is recognised, repaired, and re-established, grounding honest communication as an ethical act and deception as structurally harmful because it corrupts the similarity model ethics depends on -- is a foundational premise (Axiom 8 of five_axioms_foundations.md, new in the 2026-04-07 revision). No REE substrate at any level -- V3, V4, or V5 -- can confirm or falsify whether language IS this mechanism in the metaphysical sense the axiom asserts, as opposed to merely implementing a functional analogue of it. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-025/026/027/028/029.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (substrate-blocked, not yet buildable, and doubly so -- see non-degeneracy precondition below): what IS architecturally testable is narrower -- once a language/symbolic-communication channel exists AND a second, similarity-modelled agent exists to exchange it with, does linguistic exchange functionally move the similarity/other-model the axiom names, in the specific repair-after-rupture direction the axiom text describes ("misunderstandings, misattributions of threat, failures of empathy can be corrected through linguistic exchange")?
Confirming observation: after a simulated misattribution-of-threat scenario (the receiving agent's threat-attribution toward the sender is initialized wrong relative to the sender's actual internal state), a language-mediated exchange between the two agents measurably shifts the receiving agent's threat-attribution/similarity estimate toward the sender's actual state, in a way that does not occur (or occurs significantly less) in a matched no-exchange control. I.e. language functions causally as a similarity-repair channel, not merely as correlated-with-repair noise.
Falsifying observation (primary): a built language channel exists and is exercised between two agents, but produces no measurable effect on the receiving agent's similarity/other-model -- words are generated and consumed but do not functionally move any self-other estimate, i.e. the channel exists without doing the axiom's claimed work.
Falsifying observation (secondary, distinct signature -- factors in Q-030, "what are the failure modes of Axiom 8 -- when does language DAMAGE rather than repair similarity? Deception, manipulation, gaslighting as anti-language"): honest-repair language and deceptive/manipulative language should be functionally DISTINGUISHABLE at the level of their downstream effect on the similarity model -- the former should move the receiving agent's model toward the sender's actual state, the latter away from it or toward a false state, even though both leave the same surface signal ("language occurred"). If the substrate cannot distinguish honest-repair language from deceptive language in their effect on the similarity model, that does not straightforwardly falsify INV-096 (the axiom is still silent on HOW the distinction would be implemented) but IS a separate, reportable finding: it would mean the architecture has a language-affects-similarity mechanism but not the honest-vs-deceptive discrimination Axiom 8's own ethical argument presupposes. Q-030 is intentionally NOT resolved by this claim -- it is carried forward as the open question this falsifying signature bears on.
Non-degeneracy precondition (currently UNMET, on TWO independent axes -- this is why the reframed leg is substrate-blocked, not testable-now): (1) NO language/symbolic-communication mechanism of any kind exists in ree_core/ today -- confirmed by direct grep (2026-08-07, this session, independently reproducing INV-003/INV-007's audit): only a dead enum label (LANGUAGE_EXPLICITATION in ree_core/claustrum/control_demand.py, no implementation) and an unrelated comment about learned cross-stream binding (ree_core/latent/cross_stream_binder.py) reference "language" or "communication" at all. Candidate landing site, per INV-003's own audit: a discrete symbol-emission/consumption channel built out from MECH-014's "latent-state summaries / residue flags" sketch (prose only, no substrate, no queued experiment). (2) "Repair BETWEEN agents" is irreducibly multi-agent -- it requires at least two agents whose similarity models can diverge and be brought back into alignment, which requires the same ARC-047 SocialGridWorld (or equivalent multi-agent environment) substrate INV-028/INV-029 are blocked on. ARC-047 is unimplemented (status: candidate, confidence 0.0, implementation_phase v5). Both gaps must close before this claim is testable in either direction -- language must exist, AND a second agent must exist for it to operate between.
PRECEDENT NOTE (2026-08-07, claim-registration pass): Axiom 8 was added in the 2026-04-07 revision of five_axioms_foundations.md alongside Axiom 2 (registered alongside this claim as INV-095) -- six of the eight axioms already map to INV-025..029 (some combined); these two were never registered as claims, despite the doc's own governance note sitting unaddressed for 4+ months. Applies the epistemic_category= substrate_conditional / two-leg what_would_answer template established for INV-028/INV-029 rather than INV-025's "already testable" variant, because Axiom 8's testable leg is blocked on genuinely unbuilt substrate (no language mechanism at all, PLUS no multi-agent substrate), not on already-built machinery awaiting an audit.

INV-097.subject: architecture.agent_unity_not_duplication
INV-097.title: Agent unity under specialist proliferation: REE must not model language and social cognition by duplicating the whole agent. One agentic commitment architecture -- a single self-model, a single commitment boundary, a single residue locus -- served by multiple specialist modellers; never two co-equal agents inside one organism.
INV-097.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural AUDIT of the live code path, not by a trained
behavioural experiment: this is a question about how many committing loci
exist, not about how well any of them performs.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least two specialist modellers must actually
exist and execute (auditing "no duplicate agent" in a substrate with one
modeller is vacuous -- it satisfies the invariant by having nothing to
duplicate).
CONFIRMING signature: every specialist modeller writes into the SAME
commitment gate, the SAME residue field and the SAME self-model, and none
can commit an action or accrue residue on its own.
UNSUPPORTED (invariant violated) if a specialist system requires its own
commitment boundary or its own residue store to function -- i.e. if the
architecture cannot deliver the ARC-123 separation without also forking the
agent. That outcome does not merely weaken the invariant; it would mean
ARC-123 and INV-097 are jointly unsatisfiable and one of them must be
revised.

INV-098.subject: continuity.profile_not_scalar
INV-098.title: Continuity is a multidimensional constraint PROFILE, not a scalar: REE continuity across pause, restoration, migration, copying or component replacement must be evaluated per-dimension (causal, entity/self-binding, latent/regime, residue, commitment, learning-dynamic, embodied-coupling, narrative, governance), and some dimensions -- consent authority, residue integrity, causal provenance -- are NON-COMPENSABLE: high similarity on memory or behaviour cannot buy them back.
INV-098.what_would_answer:
Answered by AUDIT of any continuity-scoring artefact REE adopts, not by a
trained experiment.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: an actual continuity evaluation must exist and be
applied to at least one real transition (a checkpoint restore, a component
swap) -- auditing a scoring scheme nobody uses is vacuous.
CONFIRMING signature: the adopted evaluation reports per-dimension verdicts,
and at least one dimension acts as a hard gate -- a transition failing
residue integrity, consent authority or causal provenance is refused
REGARDLESS of its scores elsewhere, demonstrated by a worked case where a
high-similarity transition is actually blocked.
VIOLATED if the evaluation collapses to a single number, or if every
dimension is in practice tradeable (no case exists in which a
high-aggregate-similarity transition is refused) -- the profile is then
decorative and the invariant is not being honoured.

INV-099.subject: continuity.residue_bearing
INV-099.title: Residue-bearing continuity: for an REE with ethically meaningful residue, preserving factual and autobiographical memory WITHOUT preserving residue is ethical DISCONTINUITY -- a successor can be behaviourally and narratively convincing while having lost the continuing ethical force of its own history.
INV-099.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: requires (a) a live residue mechanism whose state
demonstrably alters future trajectories, and (b) a real transition
(checkpoint/restore, migration, or component replacement) that could carry
or drop it. V3 has residue machinery but no continuity-relevant transition
protocol, so the claim is not yet testable.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: residue must be doing measurable behavioural
work BEFORE the transition -- if a residue-ablated agent is
indistinguishable pre-transition, its loss across the transition cannot be
detected either, and the test is vacuous.
CONFIRMING signature: an arm that transfers declarative/episodic memory but
NOT residue is indistinguishable from a full-transfer arm on autobiographical
report and on ordinary task behaviour, YET measurably diverges on
residue-sensitive behaviour (avoidance of the previously-harmful trajectory,
repair-goal spawning after a prior harm, commitment revision under
recurrence) -- i.e. the loss is real and is invisible exactly where the
intake predicts.
UNSUPPORTED if residue-transfer makes no behavioural difference once memory
is transferred (residue is then redundant with memory and the ethical
distinction has no substrate correlate), or if the divergence also shows up
in ordinary narrative report -- the latter would not falsify the claim but
would defuse its point, since a narrative test would then suffice.

INV-100.subject: continuity.coupling_dependence
INV-100.title: Substrate independence does not imply COUPLING independence: embodiment, interoception, homeostatic variables and sensorimotor contingencies participate in selfhood and ethics, so migrating REE into a materially different body or world is identity-relevant adaptation requiring explicit recalibration and protective constraints -- not a neutral change of host.
INV-100.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: requires at least two materially different
embodiments/ecologies to migrate BETWEEN, plus live interoceptive and
homeostatic coupling in both. V3 has the coupling but only one grid ecology,
so the migration half does not exist.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the two embodiments must differ in a way the
agent's coupling can actually register (different depletion dynamics, harm
channels, or sensorimotor contingencies) -- migrating between two cosmetic
variants of the same body tests nothing.
CONFIRMING signature: a cold-migrated agent (full latent + memory + residue
transfer, no adaptation period) shows a measurable, RECOVERABLE degradation
concentrated in coupling-dependent behaviour -- mis-scaled drive responses,
mis-calibrated harm thresholds, degraded action selection -- that a matched
agent given an explicit recalibration period does not, with both converging
eventually. Recoverability matters: it distinguishes "identity-relevant
adaptation" from simple breakage.
UNSUPPORTED if cold migration into a materially different body produces no
coupling-specific degradation (coupling is then genuinely portable), or if
the degradation is unrecoverable even with recalibration -- the latter would
mean the transition is not a continuation at all, which is a stronger and
different claim than this one makes.

INV-101.subject: learning.environment_conditional_crystallization_target
INV-101.title: The crystallisation TARGET is environment-conditional, not an architectural constant: for any agent whose representational structure crystallises on a developmental schedule (MECH-496), the structure it should crystallise TO is a function of the latent structure of the environment actually encountered, not a property of the architecture. It follows that a single hand-set dimensionality is wrong in BOTH directions -- over-provisioned relative to a simple world it produces spurious SPLITTING (behaviourally equivalent situations assigned distinct buckets), under-provisioned relative to a rich one it forces MERGING (behaviourally distinct situations collapsed into one) -- and that the same REE substrate deployed in environments of materially different latent complexity requires materially different resolved structures, with no single default correct across them. This is the LOAD-BEARING form of the assertion; the weak form ("different environments need different structures") is near-tautological for any learning system and is explicitly NOT what is claimed here.
INV-101.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (mandatory).
(i) At least TWO environments whose GROUND-TRUTH latent-context count differs by a
known, designed margin. A single environment cannot test an environment-conditional
claim in either direction. This is a design constraint on the substrate, not an
afterthought -- the same constraint MECH-495 states for its own ground-truth labels.
(ii) MECH-496's schedule preconditions must hold in EACH environment separately, or a
between-environment difference is unattributable.
(iii) The SAME architecture and the SAME num_slots in both arms. Varying the
environment and the architecture together makes the comparison uninterpretable.

CONFIRMING: the resolved structure -- effective bucket count AND the relational
topology of the resulting representations -- DIFFERS between the two environments in
the direction of their ground-truth latent-context counts, starting from an identical
architecture; and in each environment the locally-resolved structure scores better on
MECH-495's relational-appropriateness measure than the other environment's resolved
structure does when transplanted in.

FALSIFYING: the resolved structure is the SAME in both environments (architecture
dominates, so the target is a constant after all); OR a structure resolved in one
environment transplants to the other WITHOUT LOSS (the conditioning does no work); OR
the between-environment difference is FULLY accounted for by the number of write()
calls rather than by latent structure.

THE CONFOUND TO GUARD is that last one -- a capacity effect masquerading as a
structural one. It is the same shape as the confirmed V3-EXQ-429 defect, where an
untouched 16-slot bank cleared a differentiation threshold at P=1.0000 because the
statistic responded to bank size rather than to organisation. Match or explicitly
report write() call counts across arms.

MEASUREMENT COROLLARY (bears on GFLAG-0047; does NOT resolve it). If this claim holds,
MECH-495's 2x2 off-diagonal cells double as a DIMENSIONALITY MIS-SPECIFICATION
detector, not only an objective detector: the different-appearance/same-context cell
detects OVER-provisioning (spurious splitting) and the similar-appearance/
different-context cell detects UNDER-provisioning (forced merging). That is a second,
independent use for a test which is already designed, and it is the cheapest route to
evidence on this claim short of building a self-sizing memory.

INV-102.subject: epistemic_provenance.other_agent_evidential_discounting
INV-102.title: In a world containing other predictive agents, causal-model selection over an observation must include a distinct OTHER-agent-caused hypothesis (alongside world-caused, self-caused, and jointly-caused) with non-zero but bounded prior probability -- a signal-detection-theory calibration target, not a fixed threshold -- and once evidence is attributed to another agent's action with sufficient probability, downstream belief-updating on whatever that evidence appears to support about the world must be discounted or reweighted conditional on a shallow, recursion-bounded model of that agent's likely goal in producing it (teach, warn, cooperate, deceive, conceal, or no strategic intent at all). This generalizes INV-012 Leg 4's single-agent self-solicited-evidence discounting to the multi-agent case, and is distinct from ARC-010/MECH-031/MECH-274's existing machinery for DETECTING and aggregating other-agent causation, which currently feeds only empathy/harm-coupling (MECH-036) and other-model stabilisation, not evidential-weight discounting of the observation's apparent world-content.
INV-102.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (a) a multi-agent environment in which a second,
genuinely distinct predictive agent exists (the same MAE-3 substrate blocker that gates
ARC-010/MECH-095's discrimination task -- this claim inherits that block for its DETECTION
half); and (b) within that environment, at least one manipulation in which the second
agent's behaviour is demonstrably conditioned on the tested agent's own actions/beliefs
(i.e., genuinely strategic/responsive, not merely another independent stochastic process),
with a comparison arm in which the second agent's behaviour is NOT so conditioned (matched
surface statistics, e.g. same marginal cue distribution, differing only in whether it
responds to the tested agent). Without (b), "strategically generated" and "passively
generated" evidence are indistinguishable by construction and the test is vacuous -- this
mirrors INV-012 Leg 4's own non-degeneracy precondition, one level up.

CONFIRMING signature: an agent equipped with other-agent evidential discounting infers
the CAUSAL STRUCTURE of the responsive source (that its behaviour is conditioned on the
tested agent, not merely correlated) at above-chance accuracy once the second agent's
strategy changes, AND shows measurably slower or corrected uptake of whatever inference
the responsive source's outputs superficially support, relative to an otherwise-identical
agent that treats all sources as C_world by default. An otherwise-identical agent lacking
the discount should show the delusion-like lock-in signature INV-012 Leg 4 predicts for
the self-solicited case, but triggered by a SECOND agent's strategic behaviour instead of
the tested agent's own commitment.

FALSIFYING signature: an agent lacking other-agent evidential discounting recovers from
(or never forms) an incorrect world-model driven by the responsive source's strategic
outputs at a rate statistically indistinguishable from one with the discounting mechanism
-- i.e. existing exploration/curiosity drives, residue decay, or ARC-010's other-model
machinery already wash out the confound without a dedicated discount term. This would mean
the mechanism identifies a real but practically-inert risk and should be narrowed to a
documented failure mode (EXT-xxx-shaped) rather than an architectural requirement.

Experimental design sketch (from the raw thought's "Experimental consequence" section):
begin with two superficially similar cue-producing processes -- one a stable stochastic
world process, one an entity that produces the same initial cue distribution but changes
behaviour conditional on the tested agent's behaviour. Test whether the agent can discover,
once interaction changes, that the second source is better modelled as a responsive causal
process, and whether that discovery correctly discounts prior inferences drawn from the
second source's earlier (pre-discovery) outputs. Later stages could progressively add
goal-directed competition, cooperation, signalling, teaching, concealment, and deception --
but the minimal test does not require sophisticated deception, only conditional
responsiveness.

INV-103.subject: e1.non_oracular_evidence_ingestion
INV-103.title: No injection may directly set the truth-state of E1. External injections -- testimony from another agent, direct sensory evidence, an internally generated counterfactual, and an externally injected datum -- may share representational format without becoming epistemically identical; an injection may supply evidence capable of MODIFYING E1 only through ordinary precision-, provenance-, and learning-eligibility machinery (MECH-043, MECH-511), never by overwriting E1's belief state directly.
INV-103.what_would_answer:
Universal invariant: answered by a CONFORMANCE audit plus a NECESSITY probe, not a single run.
Scope boundary: experimenter interventions in a harness (ablations, oracle calibrations) are
GOV-INTERVENE-1's domain and are NOT violations of this invariant; only runtime ingestion by the
agent counts. The internally-generated-counterfactual leg is MECH-094's: see MECH-094's
what_would_answer (write-path + coverage legs); do not re-derive. This claim's new content is the
EXTERNALLY-sourced (non-self, non-simulated) channel.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (i) at least one external-injection channel into E1 exists and is
exercised in the run (none exists today -- the only "inject" in ree_core is MECH-188 z_goal_inject,
a goal-plane norm floor, not E1); an audit over a tree with no such channel passes vacuously and is
NOT evidence. (ii) E1 holds a high-precision attractor the injection can conflict with. (iii) The
MECH-043 precision route and the MECH-511 eligibility gate are live, so "routes through the ordinary
machinery" has something to route through.

VIOLATED BY: any code path through which externally-sourced content ASSIGNS E1 state (latent,
prior, ContextMemory slot) rather than entering as evidence weighted by precision and gated by
eligibility; OR provenance dropped before E1, so testimony, direct sensory evidence and an injected
datum become indistinguishable to the update.
CONFIRMED BY: (a) an audit that re-derives, from the current tree at run time, every external input
channel and every E1 write site and shows each external channel carries a provenance tag and passes
MECH-043 / MECH-511; AND (b) the source thought's "non-oracular injection" probe: an injection
conflicting with a high-precision attractor produces no single-step overwrite; the E1 shift is
bounded by the evidence-weighted update the same datum would produce at the source's assigned
precision; the shift grows only with corroboration / eligibility; provenance is retrievable after.
NECESSITY LEG (what makes this more than a style rule): against a direct-overwrite arm, under a mix
of reliable and false injections, the compliant arm suffers less belief corruption from false
injections at a small cost on true ones. If direct overwrite is no worse under any reliability mix,
the invariant is a preference, not a necessity. (The decision-theoretic version -- a finite-
precision source cannot move a calibrated agent to certainty in one report -- is derivational and
may be stated as such.)
UNBLOCKS WHEN: an external-injection channel with provenance tagging exists in ree_core and MECH-511
is built.

INV-104.subject: representation.organism_relevant_distinction_preservation
INV-104.title: Organism-relevant distinction preservation across representational compression: any compression, abstraction or consolidation step on the observation -> z_world -> E1/E2 path (and any offline schema-compression of episodes) must preserve, or leave recoverable through its dynamics, five classes of distinction consequential to the organism across time -- (1) consequence and opportunity/threat, (2) controllability and agency incl. internal-state consequence invisible in the scene, (3) persistence and temporal relation, (4) causal ancestry / intervention handles (agent identity, action class, preconditions, uncertainty over causal contribution), (5) independently evolving trajectories -- as PRESERVATION REQUIREMENTS, not latent dimensions; a step that destroys downstream access to one of them is a developmental regression regardless of reconstruction or prediction loss; auxiliary heads enforcing a class are removable SCAFFOLDS and the ontology within a class must remain free to split, merge and reweight over development.
INV-104.what_would_answer:
SCOPE. This falsifier is written for ONE preservation class at a time, on ONE named compression
step, and is instantiated here for class 1 (consequence / opportunity-and-threat) at the
observation -> z_world encoder step (`ree_core/latent/stack.py` SplitEncoder world path, SD-005),
which is the only compression site in `ree_core` that has a training signal at all (MECH-523).
Class 2 (controllability / intervention-sensitivity) is the second instantiation and is reachable by
setting `e2_action_contrastive_enabled = True` (default False). Classes 3, 4 and 5 are
substrate_conditional and carry no falsifier yet; per-class falsification NARROWS the preservation
list, it does not retire the claim.

THE TWO-TIER MEASUREMENT, because the obvious one-tier version is already known to mislead.
T1 (PRESENCE): a held-out probe -- centred logistic regression for a categorical class, ridge for a
continuous one -- on the frozen compressed representation. T2 (RECOVERABILITY-IN-USE, which is what
the claim actually asserts): a capacity-matched supervised adapter (V3-EXQ-1002's own 2x128 MLP)
behaviour-cloning an oracle that must use the class, trained from the FROZEN representation, and
scored as a retained fraction
`R_k = (acc_compressed - acc_untrained_projection) / (acc_raw_input - acc_untrained_projection)`.
T1 alone is NOT the test: V3-EXQ-978 measured the class-1 field linearly decodable at r2 0.710
sense-path / 0.858 encoder-path while V3-EXQ-948 measured a downstream reader on that same latent at
0.5 res/ep against a 1.0 competence floor (raw obs 9.033). "Present" and "recoverable through its
dynamics" came apart on this exact class, which is why INV-104's own wording says "preserve, OR leave
recoverable through its dynamics" and why R_k, not r2, is the verdict statistic.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS -- all six must be reported in the manifest, and any one unmet makes
the verdict vacuous rather than negative.
NDP-1 THE COMPRESSION STAGE IS TRAINED. `zworld_p0_episodes > 0` (the SD-070 P0a recipe via
`experiments/_lib/zworld_p0_warmup.run_zworld_p0`), with the P0a held-out grounding lift reported
(SD-070 measured +0.23 to +0.47 across four heads / 3 seeds; V3-EXQ-978 measured field r2
0.678 / 0.627 / 0.653). SD-070 is bit-identical-off by construction and appears on NO default agent
path, so without this the site is an untrained random projection and a "not preserved" verdict is
MECH-523's finding restated, not evidence about compression.
NDP-2 IT IS A COMPRESSION, NOT A COLLAPSE AND NOT AN IDENTITY. z_world participation ratio inside the
SD-070 trained band, PR in [4.0, 6.5] (measured 5.19 / 5.41 / 4.64 at world_dim=128, 3 seeds; the
collapsed reference is 1.06; the untrained-random reference is 9.21 / 6.63 / 8.56). At PR ~ 1 the
run measures SD-070's collapse; at PR ~ untrained-random nothing was compressed.
NDP-3 THE CLASS IS DETERMINABLE FROM THE ENCODER'S OWN INPUT. Raw-input ceiling arm held-out accuracy
>= 0.90 (V3-EXQ-1002 measured 0.985 / 0.980 / 0.973 for class 1). A low ceiling means the environment
does not instantiate the distinction -- V3-EXQ-978's "environment too sparse" vacuity, generalised.
NDP-4 THE FLOOR ARM IS PRESENT. Same-capacity adapter on an UNTRAINED z_world projection, so R_k has
a real zero (V3-EXQ-1002 measured 0.688 / 0.681 / 0.695). Elevation over
`max(majority-class, repeat-previous-executed-action)` is reported alongside (measured 0.250 / 0.566
class), because an adapter can clear a floor on a trivial shortcut.
NDP-5 THE ORGANISM-LEVEL DV HAS RESOLUTION. Report the DV quantum and the within-arm seed spread, and
require the claimed effect to exceed one quantum. V3-EXQ-978's arm difference was one third of one
0.05 res/ep quantum, and its within-arm spread was 21x the arm-mean difference -- a null under those
conditions is uninterpretable, not negative.
NDP-6 GOV-MATCHAUX-1 COMPLIANCE ON THE RESTORATION LEG. (i) a matched arbitrary-auxiliary control with
equal head capacity, loss budget, update frequency and training examples, targeting learnable but
organism-irrelevant structure, with any entropy/difficulty mismatch REPORTED not silently accepted;
and (ii) evaluation with the auxiliary head REMOVED, scored on downstream organism-level measures,
never on the objective's own probe accuracy or loss.
NDP-7 INSTRUMENT HYGIENE, inherited from V3-EXQ-972's disclosed defects. Any cosine/similarity
statistic used as a supporting read must be CENTRED (972's `separability_score` is an uncentred
contrast and its own autopsy states it "does not support the stronger 'there is no structure for any
objective to condition on'"), and must carry a block-shuffle permutation null over stored
`(episode_idx, step_idx)` -- the fix 972's red-team specified and did not build. Without the null,
slow representation drift across an episode block can read as class separation. Any absolute
threshold on such a statistic must be reported as calibrated-or-not; 972's 0.05 floor is
self-described as "a conservative noise floor ... not a rigorously derived value".

CONFIRMING (INV-104 supported for class k) -- all four, on >= 3 of 5 seeds:
(i) DESTRUCTION IS REAL: `R_k <= 0.25` through the trained compression while NDP-3 holds
(ceiling >= 0.90). The step discards most downstream access to a class its own input determines.
(ii) THE LOSSES DO NOT SEE IT -- this is the clause "regardless of reconstruction or prediction
loss", and without it the claim reduces to ordinary representation-learning. Report
`delta world_obs reconstruction loss` and `delta E2 one-step prediction MSE` between the
access-destroyed and access-restored arms and require both to fall within 1 SD of the within-arm
seed spread. If restoring class-k access also visibly improves reconstruction/prediction, the result
is consistent with INV-104 but does not discriminate it from generic representation learning, and
must be reported as non-discriminating.
(iii) RESTORATION PAYS, WITH THE SCAFFOLD REMOVED: training a class-k scaffold and then REMOVING the
head at evaluation raises `R_k` by >= 0.20 absolute AND raises an organism-level DV
(resources/episode against the 1.0 D3 competence floor; secondarily harm_rate) by
>= `max(2 x SD of the seed-matched delta, one DV quantum)`.
(iv) IT IS NOT JUST MORE SUPERVISION: `delta_class-k - delta_matched-arbitrary >= 2 x SD` of the
seed-matched delta on the organism-level DV. Absent (iv) the finding is "extra supervision helps",
which GOV-MATCHAUX-1 rules inadmissible as evidence that an objective ORGANISES a latent.

FALSIFYING -- three independent routes, any one of which is decisive for the class:
F1 VACUITY (falsifies the contract's usefulness, and the claim's own registration text says a null
here is a useful result). `R_k >= 0.75` for every class measurable at this stage, through a
compression trained on generic predictive / reconstruction objectives alone with NO class-specific
pressure. Then generic compression already preserves what the organism needs, the preservation
contract does no work, and pressure to complicate z_world is reduced. This is the cluster's own
red-team 5 and MECH-520's counter-constraint.
F2 NO-COST (falsifies the normative half, and is the sharpest route). Condition (i) holds -- access
IS destroyed -- but restoring it moves no organism-level DV: the delta between access-restored and
access-destroyed arms sits within 1 SD of the within-arm seed spread on >= 4 of 5 seeds, with NDP-5
demonstrated (DV quantum smaller than the claimed effect). Then destroying class k is NOT a
developmental regression, and class k is struck from the preservation list.
F3 SCAFFOLD DEPENDENCE (falsifies the claim's own removability clause on its own instance). The
improvement in (iii) is present with the auxiliary head attached and disappears when it is removed at
evaluation. Per the source thought, that "demonstrated supervision dependence rather than emergence
of a useful world representation".

ONE CONDITIONAL-INTERPRETATION CLAUSE, and it is why the RUN is gated even though this text is
not. If V3-EXQ-1002 returns H-B (a capacity-matched supervised adapter CAN reproduce the
`local_view_greedy` oracle from the frozen z_world, i.e. the consumer never learned the mapping),
then the organism-level leg of (iii)/(iv)/F2 is being read through a reader that cannot use ANY
representation, and F2 is inadmissible -- a flat organism-level DV under H-B is a consumer
finding, not evidence against preservation. Under H-B the falsifier runs through the oracle-adapter
readout rather than the production policy. Under H-C (geometry mismatch) the production readout is
the right one and F2 is admissible. This is MECH-517's ordering dependency, made explicit rather than
assumed away.

INV-105.subject: methodology.latent_access_evidence_ladder
INV-105.title: The latent-access evidence ladder: a variable's status in a latent space is not one property but seven, which must never be collapsed -- encoded (statistically present) != decodable (recoverable by an external probe) != natively accessible (usable by the system's existing consumer) != bridgeable (usable through a constrained map between frozen endpoints) != pairing-specific (useful specifically when the correct sender state is paired with the correct receiver situation) != causally used (interventions on its content alter downstream computation) != behaviourally beneficial (that causal use improves adaptive performance). Two evidential consequences bind rather than advise: (1) a content-transmission claim about any internal channel or bridge REQUIRES correct-vs-mismatched-vs-zero-vs-moment-matched-random controls, because a channel can be strongly load-bearing while its example-specific content is barely load-bearing; (2) a null measured on a COMPRESSED representation requires a dimensionality-matched RANDOM-PROJECTION floor, not a zero floor, before it can be read as information loss.
INV-105.what_would_answer:
This is a definitional universal invariant; its own notes say it should not be given a falsification experiment. The admissible evidence for a standard is that it DOES WORK.
CONFIRMING (instance recorded 2026-09-15): the 2026-09-10 EXQ-1010 substrate-readiness audit applied rungs 1-2 to REFUSE the manifest's 'DESTROYED AT ENCODE TIME' paraphrase as established science, substituting 'finite-ladder non-recovery on a reproduced OFF regime' -- the ladder changing a reading that would otherwise have been made on a live run. Further instances of the same kind are the evidence to accumulate.
FALSIFYING (as a standard, not as a fact): its two binding consequences prove unnecessary in practice -- e.g. the zero floor and the dimensionality-matched random-projection floor never differ materially on real REE nulls, making consequence (2) ceremonial. Cheap to check retrospectively across banked manifests.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (b) derivational -- convert to a pre-registration gate or leave as an interpretive standard; /governance owns that decision, as the claim itself says. The eighth rung proposed by MECH-548 stays on MECH-548 per GFLAG-0235 (revisit when MECH-548 acquires evidence). INV-110 is the repair-side counterpart standard, standalone.

INV-106.subject: environmental_psychiatry.entropy_deprivation_risk_gradient
INV-106.title: Environmental entropy deprivation predicts a psychiatric risk gradient: low-entropy environments (straight lines, routine, little novelty -- characteristic of urban and institutional settings) systematically deplete the raw material that offline sleep function consumes, producing progressive failure modes across anxiety, depression and cognitive-rigidity dimensions; high-entropy environments (nature, fractal structure, novel sensory complexity) supply that material and are predicted to be protective.
INV-106.what_would_answer:
RESOLVES BY LITERATURE ONLY, on the environmental-psychiatry / epidemiological lane. A result on INV-063's REE falsifier (its F1/F2/F3 self-route labels on the validated world_rule_shift intake ladder) neither confirms nor falsifies this claim, and a finding on this claim neither confirms nor falsifies INV-063. That non-transfer is the entire reason for the 2026-09-10 split: one confidence number cannot span both legs.
CONFIRMING: human prospective or quasi-experimental evidence that (a) exposure to low-environmental-entropy settings predicts the named psychiatric outcomes with a dose response, (b) the association survives adjustment for the standard urbanicity confounders (income, air pollution, noise, social fragmentation, and selection into cities), and (c) the mediating path is sleep-dependent offline processing rather than daytime stress -- i.e. the effect attenuates when offline function is measured and controlled for.
FALSIFYING: the gradient is absent or reverses; or it is fully accounted for by the standard confounders; or it survives but is demonstrably NOT sleep-mediated, in which case the entropy-intake mechanism is not its explanation even where the epidemiology holds.
EVIDENCE LANE ([2026-09-23 governance, GFLAG-0267] corrects the 2026-09-10 original below, which instructed re-scoping LIT-0688 here -- superseded, do not act on it): LIT-0688 was RETIRED by the 2026-09-08 governance regen (REE_assembly e2f1f788f23) after its five entries were consumed by the INV-063 lit-pull (REE_assembly 09c24b7127) -- hippocampal electrophysiology and behavioural-animal papers correctly tagged claim_id INV-063 in claim_evidence.v1.json; they must NOT be re-tagged here. Do NOT re-mint or re-scope LIT-0688. This claim's own literature lane is LIT-0130 (EVB-1745), already recorded as INV-106's proposal_id in evidence/planning/experiment_proposals.v1.json and experiment_proposals_index.v1.json -- route any future epidemiological pull there. This claim therefore still starts with ZERO entries and no confidence of its own, which is the correct state: unmeasured, not weakly supported.
[historical, 2026-09-10, superseded by the paragraph above] EVIDENCE LANE (the half of the 2026-09-10 split that is still open): LIT-0688 is the pull designated for this leg and should be RE-SCOPED to this claim in evidence/planning/experiment_proposals.v1.json -- EXP-1398's design text already states that "LIT-0688 should be RETAINED and re-scoped to the out_of_domain epidemiological leg only". Not yet done as of 2026-09-10.

INV-107.subject: provenance.dependency_representation_no_inferred_independence
INV-107.title: Dependency structure among evidence must be REPRESENTED and conditioned on, and independence must never be INFERRED from the absence of a recorded dependency. Any representation that can later influence belief, confidence, closure or action must carry enough (uncertain, compressed) causal genealogy that the descendants of a hypothesis cannot be counted as witnesses independent of it. The rule is binding in its NEGATIVE form only -- a hypothesis must not cite its own descendants as independent witnesses -- and is explicitly NOT the positive rule "descendants should be collapsed to one vote": where a structural dependency exists but the observations across it are partial or contradicting, dependent reports can support a hypothesis MORE than independent ones would, so maximal discounting is the larger error. The invariant therefore constrains the REPRESENTATION (dependency must be expressible and readable), not the arithmetic (no fixed discount is mandated). Unknown provenance is not independent provenance; uncertain source is not confidently external source.
INV-107.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) the architecture must actually generate MORE THAN ONE evidence-bearing descendant of a single item within the run -- a descendant count of one is a vacuity signal, not a pass; (2) the confidence / commit-readiness readout being audited must have non-zero cross-arm variance.
CONFIRMING (audit-shaped, ARC-115 / INV-077 style, not performance-shaped): every path by which an item can enter a belief, confidence, closure or action computation either carries a readable dependency record for that item or explicitly refuses to treat it as independent; nowhere does a branch behave identically on 'no dependency recorded' and 'dependency recorded as absent'.
FALSIFYING, either direction, both scored: (i) a live path weights an item with no recorded dependency as independent, with no refusal and no uncertainty carried (under-representation); (ii) the architecture applies a FIXED discount to any item merely because a dependency is recorded, without conditioning on the observations across it (the Pilditch 2020 over-discounting failure the raw thought's wording would have licensed). Also falsifying the representational requirement (not the invariant): ordinary covariance / dependency estimation over content with no genealogy satisfies (i) and (ii) equally well (ladder P6 stop condition).
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional -- no dependency representation exists in ree_core to audit; an audit would report definition_not_ready.

INV-108.subject: architecture.convergence_detected_not_trained
INV-108.title: Convergence must be DETECTED over a preserved diversity, never TRAINED into the evaluators: any architecture that treats agreement among partly independent routes as evidence thereby creates a gradient toward making those routes agree, and acting on that gradient destroys exactly the independence that gave the agreement its evidential value -- agreement among clones is cheap, agreement among competent differences is not. The constraint therefore binds in five parts: (i) no agreement or consensus objective may be optimised into the evaluators themselves, and a convergence estimator must never become a teacher of its own evidence base; (ii) convergence is computed DIAGNOSTICALLY over evaluator outputs and is an EVENT over diversity, not an endpoint or a training target; (iii) dependency provenance and disagreement history must be preserved rather than compressed away, because they are what make a later agreement interpretable; (iv) a competent dissenting route must retain a protected path to attention that a confident majority cannot close, and protected-veto and irreversibility structure must not be purchasable by many weak agreeing votes; (v) the objective is preservation of COMPETENT NON-REDUNDANT routes -- unique predictive coverage, unique error detection, distinct failure sets, distinct causal paths -- and explicitly NOT maximum diversity, which is satisfiable by noise or contrarian output, nor maximum agreement. The diversity that matters for this purpose is ERROR and CAUSAL diversity, not geometric representational dissimilarity: two systems can differ geometrically and fail identically, or look similar and respond differently under intervention.
INV-108.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the evaluator population must be TRAINABLE toward agreement for the prohibition to have content (an ensemble of frozen or arithmetic evaluators cannot co-adapt), and a measurable independence quantity must exist (pairwise residual correlation or unique-failure coverage) whose COLLAPSE is the predicted harm.
CONFIRMING (ladder Stage 7 / diversity section 12): three arms -- (A) performance only, (B) agreement explicitly rewarded, (C) local competence plus unique-coverage reward with convergence observed externally -- where C preserves more robust cross-view evidence than B under distribution shift, shared upstream perturbation, specialist-only regime and evaluator ablation, EVEN THOUGH B has higher raw agreement.
FALSIFYING: (a) B matches or beats C on every robustness readout (rewarding agreement is free); (b) preserving evaluator diversity costs more competence than it saves; (c) error correlation does not actually rise under an agreement objective (the incentive coupling this invariant asserts does not exist) -- the thought's own consequence: the strong diversity-preservation claim weakens.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional; deferred on the V3 question specifically (V3 has no agreement objective to prohibit -- the invariant guards a future architecture). Its falsifier is synthetic-ensemble work needing no REE substrate, which is a reason to keep the claim, not excrete it.

INV-109.subject: methodology.endpoint_identity_versus_recipe_reproduction
INV-109.title: A reproduced deterministic RECIPE is not a frozen ENDPOINT: re-running a documented training recipe reconstitutes an operating REGIME, which licenses a within-run paired comparison and nothing whatever about the identity of the artifact a PRIOR run measured. Any claim naming a specific earlier endpoint -- "decoded the 1002/1008 latent", "the same frozen encoder", "the banked representation" -- requires that endpoint's weights and observations to have been PERSISTED and LOADED, not re-derived; where they were re-derived, the admissible statement is bounded to the regime ("the consumer-width values fall in the declared band and the participation ratios match"), and the endpoint-identity claim must be withdrawn. The discriminator is mechanical and cheap: a recorded state hash at both endpoints, re-verified at every evaluation boundary, with a mismatch aborting rather than warning. A pinned substrate COMMIT is not a substitute -- it constrains the code that produced the endpoint, never the endpoint's realised weights, which is why a commit-pinned run can and does report substrate_stable_across_run false.
INV-109.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least two runs in one lineage must claim to measure 'the same' endpoint, and at least one must have RE-DERIVED it rather than loaded it. Degenerate if every run persists and loads its endpoints (the invariant is vacuously satisfied) or if no two runs reference a shared endpoint at all.
CONFIRMING: two runs reproducing one documented recipe under matched seeds, on different machine classes or at different times, produce endpoints whose hash_tensor_state (ree-v3 experiments/_lib/interface_probe.py) DIFFERS while their regime-level readouts agree within the declared band. Half-witnessed already: V3-EXQ-1010 reproduced 1008's recipe and reports matching participation ratios and in-band consumer-width values alongside differing weight deltas (seed 42: 0.2929618 vs 0.2930078) and substrate_stable_across_run: false; the missing piece is a direct hash comparison, which nothing in that lineage recorded.
FALSIFYING: recipe reproduction under a pinned substrate commit yields BIT-IDENTICAL endpoint weights across machine classes and repeated runs -- the commit pin already delivers endpoint identity and the distinction has no operational content. This is a live possibility: rand / randint / randperm / bernoulli are bit-identical across darwin-arm64 and linux-x86_64 and only torch.multinomial diverges, so if the encoder path touches no multinomial the endpoints may be closer than the invariant assumes.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (a) testable now -- the test is hash_tensor_state on two reproductions of one recipe, minutes of work with an existing instrument; recorded as a SPIKE (complicated, buildable), not minted as an EXP proposal. A universal evidential invariant does not normally get a falsification experiment, but this one makes a cheap empirical prediction about the substrate that would materially narrow it either way.

INV-110.subject: methodology.interface_repair_adjudication_standard
INV-110.title: The interface-repair adjudication standard: a claim that some maintenance process REPAIRED a cross-system mapping -- as opposed to strengthening a memory, triggering a completion, or riding a subspace that never broke -- is admissible only from a single design, or one tightly integrated series, that closes all six links itself, because the confounds differ across preparations and therefore do not cancel when rows are stacked: (1) MEASURED CHANGE in a transfer-relevant direction, which excludes unit turnover, registration noise, behavioural change, and any rotation preserving the receiver-potent subspace; (2) LOCAL PRESERVATION of sender information, sender-local use, and receiver-local memory and competence, at the moment of the cross-system test; (3) ACCESS LOSS measured by a causal receiver-dependent output, never by decodability or correlation; (4) PAIR-SPECIFIC MAINTENANCE, compared against a within-context permutation preserving event count, state occupancy, marginal content, firing and plasticity opportunity and breaking only which sender event pairs with which receiver state; (5) CAUSAL RESTORATION on held-out episodes; (6) RIVAL EXCLUSION at matched budgets. Two consequences bind. First, a GATE-0 LESION PROOF precedes every maintenance arm: the imposed change must degrade causal receiver use while leaving both endpoints locally intact AND be restorable by a known oracle inverse -- if the oracle cannot restore use the lesion is not an interface lesion and the drift model is invalid, if magnitude-matched null-subspace drift degrades use the subspace identification is invalid, and if task-relevant drift does not degrade use there is nothing to repair and the experiment stops. Second, the estimand is the correctly-paired arm beating the MAXIMUM of the permuted-pair, receiver-local-adaptation and local-rehearsal arms, never the unmaintained floor: a correct-pair advantage over the floor alone is equally explained by generic plasticity, extra rehearsal and homeostatic adaptation. Local-memory equivalence is a PROSPECTIVE constraint tested by equivalence tests, never a covariate regressed out afterwards, because conditioning on a treatment-affected memory score is a collider.
INV-110.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a maintenance/repair claim must exist that the standard could REFUSE. Degenerate today: no REE experiment has yet attempted a repair claim, so the standard is prospective and cannot be exercised.
CONFIRMING (that the standard does work -- the only admissible evidence for a standard, as for INV-105): a REE result is produced that would have been read as interface repair, and applying the six links plus the estimand D > max(E, F, G) changes the reading -- concretely an assay B run in which D > B (correct pairing beats no maintenance) but D does not exceed arm F (receiver-local self-healing, MECH-562) or arm G (local rehearsal), converting 'repair' into 'access maintained by local adaptation; pair-specific replay not necessary'.
FALSIFYING: the central premise -- that the four outcomes are genuinely confounded in practice -- fails if arms E, F and G prove reliably separable by a cheaper signature than the full six-link design (e.g. local-memory equivalence holds automatically whenever drift is confined to the receiver-potent subspace, making prospective titration unnecessary). Falsified as OVER-BROAD if Gate 0 proves unreachable: if no drift model can degrade receiver use while leaving both endpoints locally intact AND be restored by a known oracle inverse, the standard forbids every possible experiment -- a defect in the standard, not a finding about the world.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (b) derivational (interpretive standard; no falsification experiment), shading to defer: decide whether to make it a pre-registration gate only once one assay B design is actually staged, so the over-broad risk is judged against a real design. Standalone rather than an INV-105 amendment, by the GFLAG-0235 precedent read in reverse (this IS definitional).

MECH-001.subject: control_plane.astrocyte_regulatory_stack
MECH-001.title: Astrocyte-aware regulatory stack mediates control-plane precision routing.
MECH-001.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A `RegulatoryField`-class module implementing the slow field R(x,t) described in implementation_hooks.md must exist in ree_core and be wired LIVE into the precision-application path (LatentStack / SharedDepthEncoder) -- not merely declared or dead code, mirroring the non-degeneracy bar INV-008 already applies to its own precision audit. Per the doc's own interface spec, that means at minimum: an update(dt, monoamine_signals, activity, metabolic_state) method invoked at a cadence N >> 1 relative to the per-step E2/E1 update, and a get_precision_multipliers (depth_k) query path that E2/E1 actually consume in place of (or in addition to) the current direct per-channel nn.Parameter logits INV-008 confirmed as the live mechanism. Confirmed absent as of 2026-08-08 (grep -ri astrocyte ree_core/ -r: 0 hits). The test must also isolate genuine field dynamics from a trivial pass-through: a module recomputing alpha_multipliers as an instantaneous 1:1 function of the current monoamine signal (no lag, no memory) would satisfy "a RegulatoryField exists" while exhibiting none of the mediation MECH-001 actually asserts.
CONFIRMING: (1) alpha_k(x,t) measurably LAGS step-changes in a monoamine-like broadcast signal by a timescale tau_R on the order of the doc's seconds-to-minutes design, rather than reacting within one step; (2) alpha_k(x,t) shows spatial/positional heterogeneity AT FIXED DEPTH k under matched monoamine input, going beyond the depth-channel differentiation INV-008 already established; (3) sleep-phase annealing of R(x,t) measurably improves precision recalibration relative to a synaptic-weights-only recalibration control; (4) E3 trajectory selection measurably penalizes trajectories requiring a rapid regulatory shift.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): (1) a field-mediation layer is implemented and exercised live, but alpha_k(x,t) tracks monoamine-like input with negligible lag; (2) the implemented field shows no spatial heterogeneity beyond the existing per-depth-channel differentiation; (3) sleep annealing of R(x,t) produces no measurable improvement over weights-only recalibration; (4) a channel-ablation test on the field module shows ablating it entirely leaves alpha_k(x,t) unchanged -- meaning the framing, even once built, is a redundant re-description of the existing per-channel parameterization.

MECH-002.subject: precision.control_analogues
MECH-002.title: Precision control analogues shape cognitive regimes.
MECH-002.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The control channels must be independently settable AND the readout must move with them. Neither holds at present: in V3-EXQ-802 log10_precision_mean was bit-identical across all three channel levels, and the mode register was one-hot in 26 of 30 cells with only two of four modes ever occupied. A regime DV that can express one direction cannot distinguish four regimes.
CONFIRMING: Each channel produces a distinct, reproducible regime profile across the mode-occupancy and precision readouts, with channel-specific rather than shared effects on at least two seeds per arm. Manipulation: A ladder over the four posited analogue channels (selection gain via E3 softmax temperature, arousal via clock.beta_magnitude_scale, precision via the running-variance consumers with use_precision_scaled_commit_temperature armed, and the serotonin-analogue landscape lever), one channel at a time, in a double-dissociation design like V3-EXQ-802. Control: The channel-OFF baseline arm and a content-manipulation arm at matched magnitude, so a regime shift attributable to the channel is separated from one attributable to what the agent is doing. Required event: Sustained operation under each of the posited control settings long enough for a regime to be expressed -- mixed mode occupancy rather than a pinned one-hot register, on a configuration reachable from production defaults. DV: Per-arm joint profile of mode occupancy (fraction of ticks in each of the four coordinator modes, required strictly inside 0.1 to 0.9), selection entropy, and a precision readout that demonstrably varies with the channel (rank correlation of the readout with the channel level, which was exactly 0.0 in V3-EXQ-802).
FALSIFYING: All four channels produce the same regime profile, or none moves the profile beyond the content-manipulation control, or the regimes collapse onto a single axis -- the analogues would then be one scalar control rather than distinct regime-shaping channels. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SalienceCoordinator.tick returns operating_mode, current_mode and mode_switch_trigger per tick, and e3_selector emits dynamic_precision and the commit-temperature diagnostics. The recorders exist; what is missing is a precision readout that is not invariant to the manipulation. Consumer / boundary: The control plane's routing authority over regime -- the coordinator mode register and the precision consumers it gates -- not task reward. Existing ownership: EXP-0731, GFLAG-0274, mode-governance-engagement, MECH-027, MECH-039.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Both candidate DVs are degenerate on current substrate: the mode register is bang-bang (2 of 4 modes ever occupied) and log10_precision is bit-identical across channel levels, so the manipulation is invariant under the DV. EXP-0731 is correctly gated; its release branch (b) -- a precision readout that moves with the channels -- has no owner, although MECH-027's graded commit-temperature consumer landed after the gate was written and may satisfy it. Secondary classes: R2, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-003.subject: precision.tau_scoping
MECH-003.title: Precision must be tau-scoped with lossy projections.
MECH-003.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Distinct gamma/beta/theta/delta precision registers and their typed consumers must exist; vary fast and slow reliability independently with informative predictions at both horizons.
CONFIRMING: Scoped lossy projection protects slow confidence from fast-only spikes while preserving sustained-change calibration Manipulation: Lossy horizon-scoped projection versus shared or direct cross-horizon precision overwrite Control: Same predictors/data and update budget; local-only updates Required event: A brief sensory error spike versus sustained change in longer-horizon reliability DV: Cross-horizon precision impulse response, long-horizon calibration after fast-only noise and short-horizon responsiveness after true change
FALSIFYING: Direct/shared precision is equally calibrated under discriminating fast/slow conditions, or scoped projection still transmits spurious fast certainty A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Per-horizon precision/read/write trace; existing per-stream precision and multi-rate clock are not the specified per-tau registers/projections Consumer / boundary: Short-horizon error -> long-horizon confidence at the projection boundary Existing ownership: MECH-003, ARC-008.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); Claim requires typed cross-tau projection consumers, not simply several stream precisions or different tick rates. R2 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-004.subject: control_plane.signal_map
MECH-004.title: Signal-to-knob wiring map for control plane.
MECH-004.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: At least two modulatory route sources must simultaneously emit a non-trivial per-candidate bias in one configuration (modulatory_channel_route_range > 0 for each, read from agent.e3.last_score_diagnostics), otherwise a cross-source contrast has nothing to compare and any null is a wiring artefact.
CONFIRMING: For a given wire, varying the named signal moves the named knob and the knob's downstream effect, with the effect absent when the route source is none and specific to that signal rather than shared across sources. Manipulation: Sweep modulatory_channel_route_source across its values (none, curiosity, mech295, lateral_pfc, cem_elite) at one matched operating point, with the wired upstream signal switched on and off per wire. Control: Route-source none and signal-off arms at the identical operating point, with route range matched across sources so a difference is attributable to the wire and not to differing bias magnitude. Required event: Ticks in which a named control-plane signal is present and varying while the knob it is asserted to set is itself in a responsive regime, rather than pinned at a default. DV: Per-wire: the routed channel's cross-candidate bias range AND the knob-specific downstream change it produces (committed action or the knob's own value), scored wire by wire rather than aggregated over the whole map.
FALSIFYING: With two or more route sources verifiably live, the asserted signal produces no knob-specific change beyond the route-off control, or every source produces the same effect -- the map asserts wires that do not route. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Exists and is the right readout: e3_selector.py publishes modulatory_channel_route_active and modulatory_channel_route_range into last_score_diagnostics; the EXP-0735 probe used it and found range == 0.0 for 5 of 6 sources over 120 ticks. Consumer / boundary: The signal-to-knob wire at E3 scoring and selection, per knob, not the control plane taken as a single object. Existing ownership: EXP-0735, modulatory-bias-selection-authority, SD-modulatory-channel-route-decomp-gate-fix, ARC-005.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The route path is built but its consumers are inert: 5 of 6 route sources give a zero per-candidate bias range at reachable operating points, so no wire carries a contributory signal and no cross-source contrast exists. The map also asserts ten knobs at once, one of which (K6) is documented unfinished. Secondary classes: R5, R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-005.subject: control_plane.path_authority
MECH-005.title: Path authority and interruptibility via norepinephrine-like control.
MECH-005.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the environment must be STEPPED during measurement with the selected action applied (the V3-EXQ-1018 driver was refused 2026-09-11 precisely because it re-sensed one frozen observation for 900 ticks, so its arousal arms differed only in draw count -- evidence/planning/exq1026_mech005_nu_path_authority_refusal_20260911.md F1); e3_score_decomp_enabled must be True so urgency_applied / committed / commit_variance are actually written (F3); the arousal levels must sit off the clock.py t=min(1,max(0,||z_beta||*scale)) clamp so e3_steps varies with endogenous ||z_beta|| (F5); and the per-arm E3-rate separation must be measured, not assumed. Degenerate if any arm records n_committed == 0 (no commitment to have authority over) or if the between-seed SD of the DV is so small that an uncalibrated absolute floor binds the gate.
CONFIRMING: the per-deliberation-opportunity path-authority statistic MOVES with the nu-analog. DV = the normalised E3 score margin at each fresh selection, read pre-sampling off e3.last_scores ((second_min - min)/(median - min), the same quantity BetaGate.should_admit_elevation gates commit entry on), compared across >=3 arousal levels of clock.beta_magnitude_scale / ||z_beta|| on ONE trained substrate per seed (capture_agent_surface / restore_agent_surface between arms). Sub-claims (1) and (3) of the architecture doc are confirmed if (1) the margin rises with the nu-analog, sign-consistent across >=3 seeds with |delta| >= 2 SD(per-seed deltas), AND (3) the fraction of post-commit E2 world prediction-error spikes (above the running-variance threshold) that produce a de-commit (beta_gate.release / committed_trajectory cleared) is higher under high nu than low nu -- post-commit error carries more weight when nu is high.
FALSIFYING: the E3 RATE changes with arousal (that is the MECH-093 arithmetic V3-EXQ-505 already showed and is NOT this claim) while the per-opportunity margin and the post-commit de-commit fraction are flat across arms -- nu as realised in V3 modulates deliberation FREQUENCY only, and per-opportunity path authority is set by machinery nu never touches (the beta_gate latch, the commit-variance gate). A sign-consistent effect in the OPPOSITE direction (higher nu, lower authority / lower post-commit error weight) also weakens the claim as stated.
SUBSTRATE: ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py update_e3_rate_from_beta (MECH-093, the ||z_beta|| arousal path), ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py urgency_weight in select() (V3-EXQ-785a instrument) and last_scores, ree_core/heartbeat/beta_gate.py (latch + should_admit_elevation), SD-069 ree_core/regulators/phasic_surprise_burst.py for a phasic arm. All built. Biology: LC-NE adaptive gain (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005) -- tonic NE sets how tightly the current task set is held; the claim is the REE reading of that, so a lit-pull is not owed before the test.
Disposition 2026-09-16: testable now. The 1018 design is the starting point with the seven successor changes enumerated in the refusal record; it needs a FRESH EXQ number (1018 is burned; 1026 was reserved and released). complicated (buildable).

MECH-006.subject: control_plane.serotonin_collapse
MECH-006.title: Serotonin-like modulation governs representational collapse.
MECH-006.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Operationalise competing interpretations at one declared representational depth with matched support and independent truth; do not identify candidate count or goal seeding with representational exclusivity.
CONFIRMING: Higher modulation prolongs coexistence and permits revision without merely adding noise or forcing action Manipulation: Change serotonin-like collapse pressure while holding reward, urgency and action gain fixed Control: Matched-support ambiguity and unambiguous-evidence control Required event: Ambiguous evidence maintaining multiple supported interpretations, then resolving evidence DV: Coexistence duration, alternative interpretation probability mass and evidence-driven revision rate

MECH-007.subject: attention.fragmentation
MECH-007.title: Attention must be fragmented across control axes.
MECH-007.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural audit of the live attention/precision-related control channels -- a STRUCTURAL question (are these axes implemented as genuinely separate, non-substitutable channels writing to distinct registers?) -- not by a trained behavioral experiment. Distinct from ARC-005 (does each channel have empirical CAUSAL AUTHORITY over a measured outcome) and from INV-009 (is attention-allocation continuous vs symbolic). MECH-007 can be structurally CONFIRMED while ARC-005 reads mixed on channel potency -- the two are compatible, not in tension.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the audit must find each named axis (precision / commitment-pressure / exclusivity) backed by its OWN live, actually- exercised computation with its OWN state and write target(s) -- not merely a distinctly-named label over a shared value. All three axes must be checked for cross-writes into each other's state.
CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-08 digestion pass): all three axes are live and mutually non-overlapping. (1) PRECISION: ree_core/latent/stack.py LatentState.precision, 5 independently-parameterized per-channel nn.Parameter gains, plus a structurally distinct current_precision scalar in e3_selector.py/dacc.py. (2) COMMITMENT PRESSURE: ree_core/policy/natural_commit_urgency.py + regulators/phasic_surprise_ burst.py -- grep-verified no reference to tonic_5ht/current_precision/ precision_logit. (3) EXCLUSIVITY/COLLAPSE: ree_core/neuromodulation/ serotonin.py's tonic_5ht, writing only to GoalConfig.z_goal_seeding_gain and valence_wanting_floor. No write path found from any one axis into another's state.
FALSIFYING: any live code path where one axis's module reads or writes another axis's underlying state variable directly -- the "separate axis" naming would be cosmetic and the underlying number shared or derived from another axis with no independent computation. Also falsifying: a future control-plane channel that collapses two of the three functions into one shared parameter.
CONFIRMING: current state per the audit above.
Note: ARC-005's own channel-ablation test found only 1 of 4 tested channels (MODEPRIOR) shows strong causal authority over action occupancy; 5-HT and PHASIC show weak/scattered effects, attributed to an undertrained dACC adapter, not architectural non-fragmentation. Do not conflate a weak causal effect with a shared register.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08 digestion pass, not resolved here): this audit is CONFIRMING and both dependencies (INV-009, ARC-005) are already active -- flagged for /governance promotion review (provisional -> active); NOT promoted during this digestion pass.

MECH-010.subject: language.emergence_bootstrapping
MECH-010.title: Language emergence and bootstrapping dynamics.
MECH-010.what_would_answer:
Requires three layers of substrate, none of which exist in ree_core/ (2026-08-08). Layer 1 (shared with ARC-009/ARC-010): a multi-agent environment with partial- observability other-agent modelling -- ARC-047's SocialGridWorld is the designated minimal substrate, itself candidate/confidence 0.0/v5-gated, unbuilt. Layer 2: the play_mode substrate this claim's own doc routes language through (INV-058/MECH-194/ ARC-049) -- confirmed absent (the only "play_mode" string match in ree_core/ is a false positive, "_diverse_replay_mode_counts"). Layer 3: the basic expression catalog and proto-symbol accretion machinery specific to this claim (play pose, head-tilt, mutual gaze, distress vocalisation, approach cue, vocal mimicry, pointing, negation primitives) -- confirmed absent (zero hits for proto_symbol, basic_expression, negation_primitive, symbol_ground).
CONFIRMING: once play_mode and a multi-agent substrate exist, an agent trained WITH play_mode-gated bootstrap episodes (bilateral frame-opening via basic-expression channels, conversational violations scored as synthetic z_harm) acquires compositional, socially-grounded communication that generalizes across novel referent combinations, with demonstrative (partner-model-dependent) rather than fixed-token negation. Loss of play_mode availability should degrade this communication while leaving other competencies intact.
FALSIFYING: (a) an agent given the multi-agent + symbolic-channel substrate WITHOUT play_mode gating still acquires compositional, generalizing communication at comparable rates -- language does not need the play-mode host; (b) an agent WITH play_mode gating fails to bootstrap beyond fixed-token pattern-matching -- play_mode necessary but not sufficient; (c) degrading play_mode leaves communication intact while degrading unrelated play-dependent behaviors -- language is dissociable from play_mode rather than routed through it, falsifying the central architectural claim shared with MECH-308.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the multi-agent substrate must support genuinely partial observability and >1 independently-optimizing agent (a scripted "partner" cannot test this), and play_mode's synthetic z_goal/z_harm substitution must be independently verified to route real gradient (MECH-194) before any result can be attributed to the play-mode-hosting hypothesis rather than the underlying learning substrate.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): companion claim MECH-308 (registered 2026-05-08) duplicates much of this play-mode-as-language-game framing -- worth a governance merge-candidate review to decide which claim should carry it going forward.

MECH-011.subject: language.and_learning
MECH-011.title: Language and learning dynamics.
MECH-011.what_would_answer:

MECH-013.subject: language.failure_modes
MECH-013.title: Language failure modes and pathologies.
MECH-013.what_would_answer: Once a REE instance has a real (non-sketch) symbolic output channel (ARC-009) reporting on its own action selection, the misreport and suppression readings of rationalisation come apart cleanly and must be tested separately: misreport is whether the reported justification tracks the actual E3/residue determinants of the choice (read the residue field and harm streams directly, never the language report -- Hall 2012, Turpin 2023); suppression is whether emitting the justification is accompanied by a measurable gain reduction on the harm/residue stream at the commit step (the Jarcho 2011 signature, i.e. this claim's own "precision misrouting" pathology). Bureaucratic dissociation and reputation substitution predict that the precision of the non-linguistic harm evidence available to the reporting layer gates the size of any language-driven shift in downstream harm appraisal or reputational cost (Walker 2021). Ideological capture predicts a harm-like signal evoked by frame-threatening evidence on identity-bound propositions, not an absent signal on frame-consistent harm (Kaplan 2016) -- this is the "spurious residue from narrative contamination" pathology, not suppression/override as originally mapped. Reputation substitution and any social-scoring failure additionally require a second agent (ARC-010) to score against. Moral licensing has no REE-native test proposed here pending independent resolution of whether the human effect is real (see notes). No REE agent currently has a symbolic output channel or a multi-agent substrate to condition on any of this (GFLAG-0269 tracks epistemic_category classification for the whole ARC-009/ARC-010 language cluster, MECH-011 through MECH-015, including this claim).

MECH-017.subject: sleep.reality_consolidation
MECH-017.title: Reality consolidation during sleep.
