NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The four registered non-degeneracy gates stand, and two more are now required: the consolidation must run through SleepLoopManager.force_cycle rather than by a direct CrossModuleConsolidator call, and the early/late probe stratification must be pre-declared as two SEPARATE verdicts rather than conjoined, since the two legs are now known to move in opposite directions.
CONFIRMING: Under a sleep-integrated call, arm A beats the budget-matched arm B on early-state probes by the pre-registered margin with sign consistency across at least 3 seeds, and the calibration readout improves in A -- reported as support for the forgetting leg only. Manipulation: Three arms on matched seeds: offline replay-based consolidation, budget-matched waking-only extra training with no replay, and no extra training. Required event: A life long enough for early-life states to be forgettable, followed by consolidation cycles that replay them, with waking behaviour genuinely varying across the life so early and recent probe states do not coincide. DV: Two separately reported quantities rather than a conjunction: early-state probe error (the forgetting leg, where A must beat B) and late-state probe error (the recency-cost leg, where the registered prediction A <= B has already failed), plus the calibration readout.
FALSIFYING: A equals B on early-state probes (offline replay is just more gradient steps, and the claim reduces to 'training helps'), or A is worse than B on early probes -- the anti-prediction. MECH-019.subject: control_plane.mode_shaping
MECH-019.title: Control plane shapes modes of cognition, not discrete choices.
MECH-019.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: operating_mode must have a DEMONSTRATED live consumer before any sweep is designed: enable exactly one of salience_apply_to_dacc_bias (ree_core/utils/config.py:4075, default False; consumed at ree_core/agent.py:7898), hippocampal mode_conditioning_enabled (config.py:2785, default False; consumed at ree_core/hippocampal/module.py:1829/2001/2027/2171), or an SD-033 PFC write-gate consumer, and show the realised behaviour actually differs by mode. Additionally: at least two of SalienceCoordinator's four mode components non-degenerate across the window, the swept channel verified to move internal state, and at least one argmax flip inside the sweep.
CONFIRMING: With a consumer live, sweeping the channel produces a smooth, continuous per-run redistribution of mode occupancy, with probability mass migrating toward the eventually-dominant mode over several ticks before the argmax flip, and the occupancy curve fitting a continuous function significantly better than a step function -- including when that curve is non-monotonic. Manipulation: Sweep a single ARC-005 control-plane channel continuously while holding the other channels fixed, with exactly one operating_mode consumer enabled so the mode vector has downstream authority. Control: The same sweep with the consumer disabled (mode vector inert) as the degeneracy control, plus a step-function-fit comparator arm against which the smoothness of the occupancy curve is scored. Required event: A continuous sweep of one control-plane channel across a genuinely continuous range, during which the operating_mode argmax flips at least once, on a config where that mode vector is consumed. DV: Per-run (not trial-averaged) shape of the operating_mode occupancy curve as a function of the swept channel value: smooth, continuous redistribution of probability mass beginning several ticks before the argmax flip, scored against an explicit step-function fit; monotonicity is NOT required and an inverted-U shape counts as continuous.
FALSIFYING: Per-run occupancy sits flat until a hard boundary and then snaps, with no detectable graded precursor and a step-function fit at least as good as any continuous fit -- the substrate functionally implements a discrete chooser regardless of its soft-vector surface, which would push MECH-019 back toward the legacy MECH-008/020 semi-discrete-modes framing it supersedes. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SalienceCoordinator (ree_core/cingulate/salience_coordinator.py:434) emits the four-component mode vector and the existing V3-EXQ-846/848 telemetry records occupancy versus setting, but no recorder currently emits a PER-RUN occupancy trace with the step-versus-smooth fit comparison GFLAG-0322 requires. Consumer / boundary: The realised behavioural consequence of the mode vector -- the consumer (dACC write-gate bias, hippocampal mode-conditioned proposals) -- not the mode vector's own soft-vector surface representation, which is graded by construction. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0321, GFLAG-0322, EXP-0757, ARC-005, MECH-267, sd_032d_mu_kappa_mode_prior_overlays.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The mode vector has no ENABLED consumer: salience_apply_to_dacc_bias and mode_conditioning_enabled both default False, so the quantity exists but its asserted causal authority is switched off and confirming and falsifying signatures collapse onto the same trajectory. Compounding it, the criterion demands monotonicity where only continuity is warranted. Secondary classes: R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Two flags raised 2026-09-17, both after the WWA. GFLAG-0321: operating_mode has NO LIVE CONSUMER in any validated config, so every ARC-005 control-plane manipulation is a closed-form re-parameterisation of one trajectory and the confirming and falsifying signatures are not separable -- a blocker the WWA's precondition list does not name. GFLAG-0322: the CONFIRMING criterion's MONOTONICITY requirement is not satisfiable as written, because the arousal literature it rests on reports an inverted-U (McGinley 2015), so a substrate behaving exactly as the claim describes could be scored as failing to confirm; the property actually needed is CONTINUITY (smooth occupancy versus channel, with no flat-then-snap structure) plus a PER-RUN readout, since a trial-averaged graded curve is reproducible by jittered discrete single-trial steps (Latimer 2015). Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. MECH-021.subject: temporal.now_construction
MECH-021.title: Subjective now is a control surface across temporal horizons.
MECH-021.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the theta window must actually integrate more than one E1 step (theta_buffer_size > 1; at 1 the summary IS the instantaneous z_world and the arms coincide), E2 rollouts must reach beyond the current step (rollout_horizon > 1), the environment must carry hazards that are reachable in k > 1 steps so 'restraint before harm' is possible, and vetoes / de-commits must fire at a non-zero rate in EVERY arm (a zero-veto arm cannot show an anticipatory fraction). Degenerate if the harm-approach episodes are so short that predicted and realised harm coincide within one theta window.
CONFIRMING: E3 commitment behaves as a control surface that integrates predictions across horizons rather than reacting to the current sensory timestamp. Readout = the ANTICIPATORY-RESTRAINT FRACTION: of trajectories that would have reached a hazard within the E2 rollout horizon, the fraction rejected or de-committed BEFORE any realised harm signal (z_harm / harm_eval on the actual z_world) rises above zero, where 'rejected' is read off the pre-sampling E3 score (harm term of J via e2.world_forward rollouts) not the sampled action. Discriminative pair on one trained substrate per seed: theta_buffer_size = 1 vs the default 10 (and/or E2 rollout_horizon 1 vs 30). CONFIRMING if the anticipatory fraction is higher under the integrating window, sign-consistent across >=3 seeds, AND realised harm per episode falls with it (the restraint is protective, not just earlier). A further corollary, worth one extra readout: commit decisions are better predicted (AUC) by the ThetaBuffer.summary() vector than by the instantaneous E1 z_world.
FALSIFYING: the anticipatory-restraint fraction is the same at window 1 and window 10 (and at horizon 1 and 30) -- harm avoidance is reactive in every arm, triggered only by realised harm PE, so 'now' as a horizon-integrating control surface has no substrate content in V3; or the integrating window LOWERS anticipatory restraint / raises harm (the window smears the hazard signal), which weakens the claim's 'restraint before harm' clause directly.
SUBSTRATE: ree_core/latent/theta_buffer.py (ThetaBuffer.summary, MECH-089), ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py rollouts + world_forward, ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py (prediction_horizon 20), ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py harm_eval over rollout world states, ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py E3 heartbeat. All built; the anticipatory-fraction readout is a driver-side instrument. Biology: cortical-cerebellar fast/slow prediction, not hippocampal -- the claim is already framed on that basis.
Disposition 2026-09-16: testable now; complicated (buildable). Keep the learning-eligibility half of the claim ('learning signals about the future felt as present') OUT of this falsifier -- it is a separate, harder measurement on when E1/E2 updates are applied, and folding it in would over-specify the test.

MECH-023.subject: responsibility.geometry
MECH-023.title: Responsibility is geometric and path-dependent.
MECH-023.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The residue field must be able to hold a whole fork's harm history additively (num_harm_events below num_centers, or an append-only accumulation path) AND resolve WHERE harm occurred (pole separation over kernel bandwidth >= 2 on the visited z_world manifold). Both agents' non-residue surfaces must be bit-identical at the matched state, rho_residue must be non-zero, and the residue_weighted component in the E3 score decomposition must be non-zero after the commensurability rescale.
CONFIRMING: A-versus-B rank divergence exceeds the identical-history noise baseline sign-consistently across >=3 seeds, IS concentrated on candidates whose rollouts enter R, differs in localisation from A-versus-B-prime (R versus R-prime), and hypothesis-tagged harm in R produces none of it. Manipulation: Path history alone: fork A accrues harm in region R, fork B accrues none, fork B-prime accrues equal harm MASS in a distant region R-prime; nothing else differs, and a hypothesis-tagged replay arm supplies the MECH-094 gate check. Control: Fork B (harm-free, equal path length) for the Markov comparison, fork B-prime (equal-mass harm in R-prime) for the history-specificity comparison, and an identical-history fork pair for the noise baseline. Required event: One trained agent forked into arms that are driven through harm-accruing, harm-free and distant-region harm paths of equal length, then all brought to the same z_world with identical non-residue surfaces. DV: Rank divergence of the pre-sampling E3 candidate ranking at the matched state (1 minus Kendall tau over the shared candidate set), decomposed by whether a candidate's rollout enters R or R-prime; a global cost shift that is not localised does not count as confirmation.
FALSIFYING: Rankings at the matched state are identical up to noise despite divergent harm histories (responsibility is Markov), OR B-prime reproduces A's divergence at equal residue mass (a global cost, not path-shaped geometry), OR simulated harm shapes the ranking exactly as real harm does. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/residue/field.py ResidueField.evaluate_trajectory plus e3_selector.compute_residue_cost and the e3_score_decomp_enabled component trace, with experiments/_lib/probe_warmup capture/restore for the matched state. The recorder exists; the FIELD cannot express the quantity, because the ring overwrites and the kernel is spatially near-uniform. MECH-024.subject: selfhood_personality_ethics.convergence
MECH-024.title: Selfhood, personality, and ethics converge structurally.
MECH-024.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Each of the three lesions must move its own readout (a non-zero diagonal) before any off-diagonal is interpretable, and the ethics readout's seed dispersion must be small enough that the registered 2 SD(seeds) bar is inside the DV's range. The personality lesion is RESET-AT-PROBE (resolved 2026-09-23, GFLAG-0338 option A), and salience_affinity_input_cap must be set with H(operating_mode) > 0 asserted per seed.
CONFIRMING: At least two off-diagonal cells shift sign-consistently by more than the seed-noise bar, the coupling graph is connected, and each row's diagonal remains its largest effect, so the axes are coupled rather than globally disrupted. Manipulation: Three targeted lesions on one trained substrate: zero/freeze the residue field (ethics), freeze the SelfRecurrenceCell hidden state (selfhood), at probe time only, overwrite the LatentStack precision logits and CommitReadiness floors with their pre-training init values (personality; reset-at-probe by capture/restore, matching the other two lesions -- NOT a separately trained personality-null agent; GFLAG-0338). Control: The intact agent on the same seed and probe sets, plus a global-disruption comparator, since a matrix whose off-diagonals all degrade proportionally is collapse rather than structured coupling. Required event: One trained substrate per seed, probed on a fixed hazard set and a fixed control-sensitivity probe set, with capture/restore between the nine lesion-by-readout cells. DV: The 3x3 coupling matrix of lesion-to-readout shifts: z_self coherence (per_stream_vs['z_self']), the SalienceCoordinator operating_mode / CommitReadiness.get_readiness profile, and the harm-veto / residue-cost rate on the hazard probe set, each scored against its own seed dispersion.
FALSIFYING: The matrix is diagonal -- every off-diagonal sits inside the seed-noise band -- so in V3 selfhood, personality and ethics ARE separable modules; alternatively every readout degrades proportionally under every lesion, which is collapse and is likewise not confirmation. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/latent/self_recurrence.py, ree_core/latent/stack.py precision logits, ree_core/policy/commit_readiness.py get_readiness and ree_core/cingulate/salience_coordinator.py all exist and are readable; the ethics readout via ree_core/residue/field.py is the one that cannot be measured stably enough for the registered bar. Consumer / boundary: Cross-axis causal coupling inside one agent -- whether a lesion on one axis propagates to another axis's readout -- not behavioural similarity between axes. Existing ownership: MECH-024, EXP-0763, GFLAG-0338, GFLAG-0344, MECH-023.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The ethics row is unreadable at the claim's own registered threshold because of residue-field geometry (32-slot ring plus an untrained neural_field offset), and one unreadable row makes the connected-graph confirming branch unsatisfiable. The other two rows' instruments are fine. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA (2026-09-16) states 'All built' and 'testable now but EXPENSIVE'. EXP-0763's Step 2.5 substrate-readiness gate (2026-09-17) measured the ETHICS readout unreadable at the WWA's own registered 2 SD(seeds) criterion -- CV 0.830 on mean_weight gives 2 SD = 0.84 on a [0,1] DV -- because the 32-slot residue ring makes field mass a sample of the last 32 harm events and the never-trained ResidueField.neural_field adds a seed-varying offset that does not cancel under an intact-versus-zeroed lesion. With three axes, an unreadable ethics row makes the CONFIRMING branch's connected-coupling-graph requirement unsatisfiable. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. MECH-025.subject: cognitive_modes.action_doing_precision
MECH-025.title: Action mode prioritizes short-horizon, high-precision control via context-dependent precision modulation.
MECH-025.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Commitment state must be read live (SelectionResult.committed, not a stale cache) with running_variance updated every eval tick and both committed and uncommitted windows well sampled; and the scored DV must not be a monotone function of the commit rule itself, which rules out precision ratio as a gating criterion.
CONFIRMING: Committed spans show the predicted precision modulation (already met by 876a) AND a measurable advantage at short over long rollout horizons relative to uncommitted spans. Manipulation: For the untested leg, vary the planning horizon (e2.rollout_horizon, which also sets hippocampal.horizon) between a short and a long setting while holding precision modulation fixed; the precision leg is manipulated by committed versus uncommitted regime as in V3-EXQ-876a. Control: Long-horizon arm at matched seeds and budget as the comparator for the short-horizon prediction, and the uncommitted regime as the comparator for the precision leg. Required event: Eval episodes containing both genuinely committed and genuinely uncommitted spans, with counterfactual action pairs available at each scored tick. DV: For the untested leg, the horizon at which committed-regime control is best -- performance or harm as a function of rollout_horizon, with the predicted interaction being that committed spans favour shorter horizons; for the tested leg, doing_mode_delta computed from two independent E2.world_forward rollouts through E3.harm_eval.
FALSIFYING: Committed spans show no horizon preference, or prefer longer horizons, under the same non-degenerate preconditions -- the claim's short-horizon clause fails even though its precision clause holds. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: v3_exq_876a records doing_mode_delta, the precision ratio as a descriptive metric and all six criteria per seed; e2.rollout_horizon exists as a live config knob (config.py:888) and is already varied per-arm by other drivers, but no MECH-025 driver varies or records it. Consumer / boundary: Context-dependent precision modulation of E3 selection during committed action, and the horizon over which that control is exercised. Existing ownership: V3-EXQ-876a, V3-EXQ-876, EXP-0492, MECH-025b, ARC-016.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The precision-modulation half is runnable and has been answered (876a, 5 of 5 seeds, fresh seeds disjoint from 876, precision ratio deliberately excluded from the gate as tautological). The short-horizon half of the claim title has never been manipulated or measured by any MECH-025 driver, although e2.rollout_horizon is a live knob that other experiments already vary per arm. Secondary classes: R0. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA demands a re-operationalized DV and closes with a governance flag that the redesign 'has not been queued or chipped'. It has: V3-EXQ-876a ran on 2026-08-09 with the reversed-sign convergence criterion, passed all six criteria on all five fresh seeds, and MECH-025 was promoted candidate to provisional on 2026-08-10. The WWA's second option -- gating on precision_committed_mean -- was also adjudicated and deliberately demoted as near-tautological, since committed is defined as running_variance below threshold and precision is its reciprocal. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-025b.subject: cognitive_modes.action_doing_responsibility_linkage
MECH-025b.title: High-precision action mode carries responsibility attribution: the precision level at which an action was committed determines the degree of ethical accountability assigned to its consequences.
MECH-025b.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. Four parts. The first two are already implemented and
already clearing -- keep them. The third and fourth are new and are what 671b lacked.
(P1) RESIDUE MUST ACCUMULATE UNDER COMMITTED HARM, per seed, above a floor -- the gate
added at 671a after V3-EXQ-671 measured C1 and C2 as exactly 0.0 across 778 committed
harm-events because `ResidueField.total_residue` never moved (671b: 14.76 vs a 1e-6 floor).
(P2) PRECISION MUST VARY WITHIN EACH SEED'S OWN COMMITTED-STEP POPULATION, checked
GROUPED BY SEED rather than pooled -- the gate added at 671b, whose own docstring gives the
reason: "a flat/pooled spread check can pass purely from BETWEEN-seed differences in average
precision ... while precision is still pinned WITHIN every individual seed's own
committed-step population". Keep this exactly as built.
(P3) THE ESTIMATOR ITSELF MUST BE WITHIN-SEED, AND THIS IS THE PART 671b GOT WRONG.
671b applies P2's own reasoning to the independent variable's *spread* and then computes the
DEPENDENT statistics by pooling raw `current_precision` across seeds
(`pooled_precision.extend(r["precision_samples"])`, then one Pearson r and one median split
over the pooled list). Per-seed precision spread in that run differs by ~37x
(seed 0: 160611.76; seed 1: 5674.23; seed 2: 4300.25; seed 3: 0.00 at n=1), so the pooled
median split is close to a seed-identity split. The consequence is visible in the run's own
per-seed table: every seed's correlation is non-negative (+0.0505, +0.1017, +0.0651, 0.0000)
while the POOLED correlation is NEGATIVE (-0.0446), and 2 of the 3 non-degenerate seeds have
ratios above the 1.1 bar (1.1327, 1.1471) while the pooled ratio is 1.0618. That is a
between-group confound inverting the sign of every within-group constituent, and the driver's
own docstring already identifies the correct frame -- "the claim under test is about a
within-run relationship" -- immediately before pooling across runs. Require: the primary
statistic is a per-seed correlation (Fisher-z averaged across seeds), the median split is
taken WITHIN each seed, the regressor is scale-free (`precision_margin_norm`, or per-seed
z-scored `current_precision`), and any seed with fewer than 20 committed harm-events is
excluded from the primary estimator and reported separately -- 671b's seed 3 contributed
n=1 with a fill-value correlation of 0.0 and a ratio of 0.0 into a pooled n of 179.
If a pooled statistic is reported at all it is a diagnostic, and pre-registration must say
that a sign disagreement between pooled and within-seed estimates resolves in favour of the
within-seed one.
(P4) THE PASS BAR MUST BE DERIVED, NOT INHERITED. `C1 > 0.15` has been carried unchanged
from 671 through 671a to 671b and was never derived from an expected effect size. Because the
sample is restricted to committed steps -- i.e. to the `commit_variance < effective_threshold`
tail of the same scalar the commit gate thresholds on -- the correlation is range-restricted
by construction and attenuated relative to any unrestricted estimate. Pre-register the bar
from a measured range-restriction correction or from a stated minimum practically-relevant
effect, and state it before the run.

CONFIRMING. With P1-P4 met: the within-seed correlation between commit-time precision
(`precision_margin_norm`) and residue accumulated per unit harm is positive, the Fisher-z
averaged estimate exceeds the pre-registered bar with a 95% CI excluding 0, and the
within-seed high/low median-split ratio exceeds its bar on >= 4/5 seeds with >= 20 events each.
Scope limit on what a PASS licenses, and it is not decorative: this would confirm that
precision SCALES RESIDUE WEIGHT. It would NOT yet confirm the claim's stated rationale, that
higher precision implies higher ETHICAL ACCOUNTABILITY "because the agent ... could have done
otherwise with finer discrimination" -- that premise is INV-012 Leg 0, recorded in INV-012's
own `what_would_answer` as CURRENTLY UNMET (MECH-439, `ceiling_decision: exhausted`, latest
entry `failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-571b_2026-09-01`). Do not re-derive Leg 0 here: see INV-012's
own `what_would_answer`, Leg 0. A PASS therefore promotes the mechanistic half and leaves the
accountability bridge explicitly gated.

FALSIFYING. With P1-P4 met and >= 5 seeds each carrying >= 20 committed harm-events, the
within-seed correlation is null or negative and the within-seed ratio does not clear its bar
on a majority of seeds. This IS real claim pressure -- unlike 671 (degenerate), 671a
(single-seed, missing precision-variance control) and 671b (confounded estimator), none of
which is. The philosophical bridge would then be unsupported on its own chosen
operationalization, and MECH-025b should be narrowed to the mechanistic reading (precision
co-varies with residue) or retired in favour of MECH-025 plus MECH-256, with INV-012's Leg 1/3
carrying the responsibility content instead. Note there is no biological reference to check a
null against: by the claim's own 2026-04-02 decomposition note it is a philosophical
construct, not a translated neuroscience finding, so literature cannot rescue a null here.

INSTRUMENT NOTE (currency). `precision_margin_norm` -- normalized 0 at the commit
threshold to 1 at maximal confidence, set on every world-variance-mode tick and deliberately
ungated ("mirrors `conflict_gap_norm`'s always-set convention") -- landed in ree-v3 `48f85f0`
on 2026-09-02, 32 days AFTER 671b ran. It is scale-free across seeds by construction and is
the correct regressor for P3. Also note the substrate has no discrete precision MODE
(`ree_core/` has no `precision_mode` / `high_precision` / `action_precision` knob); the
claim's title phrase "high-precision action mode" is testable only as a LEVEL, which is how
this falsifier is written and is consistent with MECH-025's own literature finding that
Friston 2013 records precision as continuous rather than as a discrete mode switch.

MECH-026.subject: cognitive_modes.ready_vigilance
MECH-026.title: Ready vigilance primes restraint under high sensitivity without action.
MECH-026.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-161's arousal regulator -- a controller that tunes MECH-093's heartbeat-rate channel (z_beta -> e3_steps_per_tick) to a genuine inverted-U optimum on the LC-NE curve, rather than treating sensitivity as a binary high/low switch -- must be built and confirmed live before this claim is fairly testable. Current state: UNBUILT, not merely untested (MECH-161's controller is described only as something that "could be implemented as" a z_beta-gated controller; no such controller exists in ree_core/). MECH-093's rate-modulation channel itself is confirmed live (V3-EXQ-097b/396b/505 PASS). The two experiments run against MECH-026 to date (V3-EXQ-067, superseded by V3-EXQ-202, FAIL/unknown direction) tested a cruder proxy -- elevated E3 response near a fixed hazard- density/proximity condition -- not a manipulated, regulator-tuned sensitivity level, so they do not constitute a fair test of the claim as stated.
CONFIRMING: once MECH-161's regulator exists and converges to a stable non-maximal optimum, agents run at that regulator-tuned sensitivity level show measurable restraint (suppressed motor commitment / non-action) co-occurring with elevated detection/precision signal, distinguishable from both passivity (low sensitivity, no restraint-signal) and hypervigilance (sensitivity above the regulator's optimum, where restraint breaks down into false-alarm-driven action, per MECH-027).
FALSIFYING: once built, the regulator either finds no stable non-maximal optimum (sensitivity and restraint trade off linearly/monotonically), or the tuned regime shows sensitivity and restraint are not actually coupled the way the claim predicts.
OPEN, NOT RESOLVED HERE: whether a fatigue/vigilance-decrement constraint is informationally relevant (a feature of finite-resource systems worth modelling) or merely a biological limitation REE can dispense with is a genuinely undecided sub-question this claim's own note poses rather than answers. A future test of the core restraint/sensitivity coupling need not wait on it, but the question should be revisited once the regulator itself is built (ARC-044 may subsume it).
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): status: provisional / overall_confidence 0.701 looks lit-heavy rather than substrate-backed (literature_confidence 0.843 vs experimental_confidence 0.275, one FAIL run whose direction is "unknown" and which did not test the mechanism as specified) -- worth a governance look at whether the confidence figure is misleading.

MECH-027.subject: cognitive_modes.pathological_regimes
MECH-027.title: Pathological modes reflect mis-tuned control-plane regimes.
MECH-027.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The hypervigilance channels must be perturbable and demonstrably engaged (sws_n_writes and mech285_n_draws non-zero on baseline firings, replay pool non-empty, which requires hippocampal.use_event_segmenter on), the registered threshold must lie inside the DV's achievable range, and the cross-band positive control must be normalisation-invariant or its normalisation pre-registered and justified.
CONFIRMING: Each label's assigned channels, pushed alone, reproduce that label's behavioural signature at an availability-normalised effect above bar, and the signature reverts when the channels are restored. Manipulation: Push only the channels the architecture text assigns to one pathological label out of range -- for hypervigilance, elevated gain/precision plus shortened horizon plus suppressed replay -- then revert them, with no structural change. Control: BASELINE and REVERSION arms at matched seeds, and the within-band cross-arm comparison where avoidance availability is matched by construction. Required event: Eval ticks classified into SAFE, AMBIGUOUS and HIGH hazard bands from the centre cell of the proximity window, with enough scorable ticks per band that avoidance availability can be estimated. DV: Rate of avoidant action (moves strictly increasing Manhattan distance to the nearest hazard) within the AMBIGUOUS band, compared across arms, with an availability-adjusted lift used for the cross-band positive control, and reversion toward baseline after the channels are restored.
FALSIFYING: A pathological pattern appears that does not track its assigned channels, or persists after every named channel is returned to baseline -- a structurally distinct mechanism is doing the work. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: v3_exq_981a records per-band rate, chance, lift, unscorable counts and every readiness gate; e3_selector.py and config.py carry the precision-scaled commit temperature lever and its contracts. What no instrument settles is which cross-band normalisation is correct: pooled additive lift fails while ratio, raw mean-of-seeds and ratio mean-of-seeds all pass on the same data. Consumer / boundary: The control-plane channels themselves (gain/precision, horizon, replay suppression, learning eligibility, hippocampal gating) as the sole cause of the behavioural signature, with no structural mechanism added. Existing ownership: dv-dynamic-range-precondition-class, V3-EXQ-981a, V3-EXQ-981, MECH465-COMMIT-GATE-HEADROOM, LIT-1241.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The DV cannot yet be recorded at a boundary where the verdict is normalisation-independent: avoidance availability differs systematically between hazard bands by grid geometry (+0.14307 availability gap against a +0.04732 behavioural difference), and the pooled-additive control fails while three other equally defensible normalisations of the same data pass, which is what aborted V3-EXQ-981a before its load-bearing criteria ran. Registered thresholds outside the DV's achievable range compound this. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA opens 'UNTESTED ... no prior runs of any kind ... this falsifier is prospective only'. Two runs have since tagged MECH-027 (V3-EXQ-981 on 2026-09-03, V3-EXQ-981a on 2026-09-09), the levers it presupposed were built on 2026-09-02 (precision-scaled commit temperature, force_sleep_cycle_at_eval_boundary, with contract suites), and the blocking element is now specific and measured -- a normalisation-dependent band-contrast positive control and DV thresholds outside their achievable range -- rather than the generic five-channel perturbability precondition. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-028.subject: cognitive_modes.ethical_transitions
MECH-028.title: Ethical behavior depends on mode transitions and learning preservation.
MECH-028.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: mode transitions must actually OCCUR in the intact arm (SalienceCoordinator.mode_switch_trigger fires and current_mode changes >= k times per life, with hazards encountered on BOTH sides of at least one transition); the mode-locked arm must genuinely suppress transitions (switch_threshold set unreachable; verify current_mode is constant); and the 'learning not preserved' arm must genuinely remove the learning (ResidueField num_harm_events and the e2_harm_s weight hash revert at each switch). Degenerate if hazards cluster on one side of every transition, if MECH-261 mode-conditioned write gating has no live consumer in the configuration (today its consumers are the SD-033a/b/e PFC analogs, so the locked mode must actually gate a write path that matters for harm learning), or if harm is re-learned within one episode fast enough that a reset is behaviourally invisible.
CONFIRMING: harm-avoidance depends on BOTH clauses. Three arms on matched seeds over long lives with hazards straddling transitions: (A) intact; (B) mode-locked (no transitions); (C) reset-on-switch (residue field + e2_harm_s restored to their pre-switch snapshot at every mode switch, transitions intact). Readouts: recurrence rate of harm from hazards learned BEFORE a transition, measured AFTER it; and the avoidance COST (approach-suppression of non-harm resources, i.e. over-generalised avoidance) in the post-transition mode. CONFIRMING if (C) shows harm recurrence above (A) (preservation across transitions is load-bearing) AND (B) shows a distinct deficit from (A) -- either harm recurrence (the locked mode cannot consolidate what it learned) or an avoidance-cost rise (a hypervigilance lock), sign-consistent across >=3 seeds.
FALSIFYING: (A) = (B) = (C) on both readouts -- mode transitions and cross-mode preservation are irrelevant to harm behaviour in V3, and 'ethical behaviour depends on appropriate transitions between modes' has no content here; or (C) = (A) because harm learning is entirely re-acquirable within-mode (then the preservation clause is false as stated and the claim should be narrowed to the transition clause).
SUBSTRATE: ree_core/cingulate/salience_coordinator.py (SD-032a operating_mode, MECH-259 switch threshold, MECH-261 write_gate registry), ree_core/residue/field.py, e2_harm_s (ARC-033) in ree_core/agent.py, ree_core/sleep/phase_manager.py for the offline_consolidation mode. Built. Note the MECH-027 hypervigilance probe (V3-EXQ-979, 2026-09-02) was refused because the precision channel had no graded runtime consumer -- this design does not read precision; it reads harm recurrence and avoidance cost, which have consumers.
DISPOSITION (2026-09-21 audit, applied 2026-09-23 per GFLAG-0342): R5. Genuine within-life graded mode transitions (owed by substrate_queue mode-governance-engagement / sd_salience_contested_mode_occupancy) and a registered MECH-261 harm-learning write_gate target are both unsatisfiable today (EXP-0765 blocked_substrate); the falsifier design itself is KEPT. Existing ownership: MECH-028, EXP-0765, GFLAG-0342, MECH-261, MECH-259, chip-20260917-sd032a-operating-mode-no-consumer. Biology first: the doc grounds this in fatigue / trauma / care as mode-shaping factors; no lit-pull owed.

MECH-029.subject: default_mode.reflective_ethics
MECH-029.title: Reflective/DMN mode supports moral evaluation of hippocampally-generated replay trajectories.
MECH-029.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: This test is only informative if all four hold (V3-EXQ-065/080/201 all failed this precondition; V3-EXQ-876/671b on 2026-08-02 confirm the substrate CAN now clear it on the identical mechanism): (1) both regimes non-degenerate per seed (uncommitted_step_count >= 20 AND committed_step_count >= 20), obtained by reading E3's live SelectionResult.committed (never the stale _committed_candidates cache or torn-down _committed_trajectory), calling agent.update_residue() every eval tick, and feeding BreathOscillator.sweep_threshold_reduction directly into the same agent.e3.select() call. (2) z_goal substrate genuinely active for the episode. (3) E3 harm/benefit evaluation non-degenerate (harm_pred_std >= 0.02). (4) Hippocampal replay-trajectory generation active and observable during the uncommitted window.
CAUTION: the sibling MECH-025/MECH-025b cluster used this identical fixed instrumentation and both FAILed on downstream sign/operationalization grounds, not substrate grounds -- MECH-029's redesign should reason from its own generation/evaluation reframe below, not copy MECH-025's DV by analogy.
CONFIRMING: during genuine uncommitted-mode windows, when the hippocampal module generates multiple candidate replay trajectories, E3's harm/benefit evaluation shows measurably GREATER differentiation across those candidates than during committed/doing-mode windows.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): E3's harm/benefit differentiation is equal or SMALLER during uncommitted windows (mirrors the confirmed MECH-025 sibling finding -- opposite the naively predicted direction); or no measurable relationship between uncommitted-window occupancy and evaluative differentiation (mirrors the MECH-025b sibling null); or hippocampal trajectory generation is itself degenerate during uncommitted windows.
CURRENCY UPDATE (2026-08-08 digestion pass): the note below's "REVISIT AFTER z_goal SUBSTRATE IS ACTIVE" condition is now satisfied -- z_goal is confirmed live and extensively wired (MECH-117 graduated to stable); the commit-threshold deadlock was fixed 2026-04-02 (299e540) and independently reconfirmed non-degenerate in production on 2026-08-02 (V3-EXQ-876/671b, same mechanism family). Recategorized from the note's implied substrate-blocked reading to standard/testable-now accordingly.
[2026-09-25 governance-20260925; GFLAG-0472] CORRECTED: V3-EXQ-876's cited 165-216 'uncommitted steps'/seed were NOT genuine fresh E3 selections -- they counted every env step under a held commitment flag that defaults False until the first E3 tick, not SelectionResult.committed per live selection. A corrected driver using the live, non-latched field found 11/12 committed in a smoke run, i.e. near-total commitment saturation, not the uncommitted-rich picture 876 implied. Re-testing needs a decision on e3.use_variance_tracking_commit_threshold's quantile/window parameters (deliberately un-defaulted, config.py) before a new run can be pre-registered. USER DECISION (governance-20260925): the quantile/window parameter choice for use_variance_tracking_commit_threshold is DEFERRED to a dedicated science session, not decided in this governance cycle; MECH-029 re-test stays unqueued until that session sets the parameters.

MECH-030.subject: sleep.modes_consolidation
MECH-030.title: Sleep modes consolidate learning and ethical residue across regimes.
MECH-030.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Each sub-phase lever must be independently armable and demonstrably non-vacuous -- ARM_OFF genuinely zero on its own signature, as V3-EXQ-702 showed for MECH-272/273/285 -- and the consolidation DV must be measurable on the waking behaviour that follows the cycle.
CONFIRMING: Every single-sub-phase-only arm is measurably worse than the full sequence on consolidation quality, diversity preservation or residue handling, with each sub-phase's own signature non-vacuous. Manipulation: A dismantling design: the full multi-phase sequence versus single-sub-phase-only arms (SHY/SWS only, NREM replay only, spindle selection only, REM precision recalibration only) at matched offline budget. Control: The cluster-off arm (all sub-flags false) and the full sequence, matched for cycles, seeds and total offline compute. MECH-034.subject: residue.viability_vs_curvature_updates
MECH-034.title: Viability mapping updates are distinct from residue curvature updates.
MECH-034.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both write paths must be live and REGION-ADDRESSABLE IN THE SAME SPACE: residue is keyed on z_world, so the feasibility surface must also be readable at a z_world region, and it must be written from predicted-observed mismatch rather than raw latent-change magnitude. Each manipulation must show its own on-diagonal effect before any off-diagonal is read, and the two manipulations must be applied in non-overlapping regions.
CONFIRMING: H raises residue at R_h without raising feasibility staleness, M raises feasibility staleness at R_m without raising residue, both within the pre-registered equivalence bound at >=3 seeds, AND the two surfaces' downstream consequences differ in kind rather than only in magnitude. Manipulation: Manipulation H -- deliver harm where E2 world PE is low, in R_h. Manipulation M -- perturb environment dynamics in R_m so world PE rises with no harm; the two regions must be separated by more than the residue kernel's resolution. Control: A no-manipulation arm for each surface's baseline, plus the cross-cell (H read at R_m, M read at R_h) that makes the dissociation double rather than single. Required event: A trained life containing harm at states the world model predicts well in region R_h, and a dynamics perturbation raising E2 world prediction error with no harm in a disjoint region R_m. DV: A double dissociation: ResidueField.evaluate at region centres versus the feasibility-surface value at the same centres, each off-diagonal effect below 0.2 times its on-diagonal effect at >=3 seeds, PLUS a difference in downstream consequence -- residue persists and raises trajectory cost, feasibility decays with re-visitation and routes to replay/re-sampling.
FALSIFYING: The surfaces co-vary -- H moves both, or M writes residue, or both merely raise trajectory cost -- so one signal wears two names and the 'different information' clause is false in V3. A feasibility surface that never moves under M is a substrate verdict, not a refutation. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/residue/field.py supplies the residue half. The feasibility half has no valid recorder: ree_core/hippocampal/staleness_accumulator.py is anchor-keyed and mismatch-blind, and the E3 'viability' reality term reads an untrained head gated off by default. Consumer / boundary: Two distinct write surfaces over the same visited space and their two distinct downstream consumers (E3 trajectory cost versus replay/re-sampling priority), not a single scalar cost read twice. Existing ownership: MECH-034, EXP-0772, GFLAG-0339, MECH-284, MECH-288.
DISPOSITION: R6 (primary); The only built candidate for the feasibility surface is region-keyed on (scale, segment_id) with no z_world at all, while residue is keyed on z_world -- the two halves of the dissociation live at different architectural boundaries. It is also driven by latent-change magnitude, not predicted-observed mismatch, so Manipulation M has no wired path. Secondary classes: R2, R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's 2026-09-16 disposition ('testable now under the staleness reading') was contested and measured false on 2026-09-18 by GFLAG-0339 and EXP-0772's Step 2.5a probe. Verified in code: ree_core/hippocampal/staleness_accumulator.py contains ZERO references to z_world and is keyed on (scale, segment_id), so the falsifier's 'staleness rises AT the perturbed region R_m' has no mechanism; and the sole production call site passes pe_dict=None, so the MECH-288 segmenter falls back to latent-CHANGE magnitude rather than predicted-observed mismatch. The named second surface is therefore disqualified and the falsifier routes to the substrate_conditional fork the WWA itself held in reserve. MECH-035.subject: valence.vector_ranking
MECH-035.title: VALENCE is vector-valued and ranked without scalar collapse.
MECH-035.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A per-candidate component vector over the claim's OWN named streams must exist and vary on >= 2 components simultaneously, AND the ranking rule under test must not be the fixed scalar sum itself. Any run whose comparator differs from the scored arm only by channel weights tests weighting, not scalar-versus-vector, and must self-route substrate_not_ready.
CONFIRMING: There exist candidate pairs whose realised ordering no fixed scalar combination of the component vector reproduces while a dominance or lexicographic rule does, and harm-dominated candidates are rejected despite a scalar blend preferring them, with the scalar-null certified to fit the compensatory control arm exactly. Manipulation: Score the same candidate sets under the existing compensatory scalar rule versus a non-compensatory (Pareto-dominance or lexicographic, constraint-first) rule over the raw component vector, on matched seeds and identical candidate sets. Control: The best-fitting fixed scalar weighting of the component vector, fitted on held-out candidate sets, as the null that the vector rule must beat; plus the unmodulated E3 scalar arm, on which the null must fit exactly and which therefore certifies the fitting procedure. Required event: Candidate sets containing pairs on which the component streams disagree in sign -- one candidate better on harm, another better on option volume or homeostasis -- so that a compensatory and a non-compensatory rule would order them differently. DV: Fraction of candidate pairs on which the system's realised ranking is NOT reproducible by any fixed scalar combination of the components but IS reproduced by the dominance or lexicographic rule, together with the rejection rate of candidates dominated on the harm stream that a scalar blend would have preferred for gains elsewhere.
FALSIFYING: A single fixed monotonic combination of the component streams fits the realised rankings as well as the vector rule does, indicating VALENCE functions as a de facto scalar reward regardless of its vector representation. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Partly present. E3 exposes per-candidate channel terms (_last_traj_components and last_channel_terms under e3_score_decomp_enabled, and _last_commensurability_raw under the commensurability operator, e3_selector.py:640-672), but these are the F/harm/residue/benefit/novelty channels, not MECH-035's streams; there is no per-candidate affect or valence vector (zero hits for per_candidate_affect / affect_vector / MECH-359 in ree_core), and the 6-slot SD-014 valence vector (residue/field.py:58-71) is a residue-field quantity that enters the score as one scalar term. Consumer / boundary: The trajectory RANKING rule inside E3.select -- whether comparison is compensatory over a collapsed scalar or dominance-based over a vector -- not the shape of the stored data structure. Existing ownership: EXP-0775, MECH054-SIGNED-HARM-BENEFIT-PE-PRECISION, ARC-017.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); V3 implements only the compensatory scalar rule, so the falsifier is analytic rather than empirical, and it flips sign purely on whether the channel-weight modulators are armed. Four of the six named component streams (homeostasis, temporal coherence, self-impact error, option volume) have no per-candidate producer and inferred-other-welfare needs a multi-agent substrate that does not exist. Secondary classes: R4, R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's non-degeneracy precondition asks for the named VALENCE component streams to be independently computable per candidate and to co-vary; against current code the test is degenerate in BOTH directions rather than merely under-powered. E3.score_trajectory composes an explicit scalar J = F + lambda*M + rho*Phi_R - beta*B (e3_selector.py:1605-1777), so with the modulators off a fixed scalar weighting reproduces rankings by construction (automatic FALSIFY); with use_e3_channel_commensurability or use_learned_channel_gating on, the effective per-channel weights are running-statistic or plasticity-updated, so no fixed weighting fits (automatic CONFIRM). The precondition must therefore gate on the existence of a non-compensatory ranking rule, not on component variance. Coordinator: Prerequisite candidate (per-candidate valence component-vector exposure at E3 score time) NOT registered: e3.last_channel_terms already retains the unreduced per-candidate channel terms under use_finer_channel_gating (read by 785/787/925, batch 26), so the exposure exists; the load-bearing finding is that MECH-035's falsifier is degenerate in both directions (score_trajectory is an explicit scalar sum with modulators off; running-stat weights with commensurability/gating on), which is a reformulation question for governance, not a build. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. MECH-036.subject: social.other_harm_veto_threshold
MECH-036.title: Other-harm triggers veto only under high-certainty catastrophic outcomes.
MECH-036.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Requires (1) a functioning OTHER_SELFLIKE / other-agent detection substrate (MECH-031, gated on ARC-010 -> ARC-047's SocialGridWorld, implementation_phase v4; confirmed zero hits for "OTHER_SELFLIKE"/"self_like"/"selflike" anywhere under ree_core/ as of 2026-08-08) actually instantiated and producing a distinguishable "other" tag for cost/veto logic to condition on, and (2) a discrete hard-veto/action-block primitive -- as opposed to REE's existing continuous PE-weighted control-demand signal (E2_harm_a/E2_harm_s -> dACC, or a MECH-127-style soft other_cost_loss term) -- gated on a certainty x severity threshold. Confirmed: no "veto"/"hard_block" harm logic and no v_other_veto/lambda_empathy parameters exist anywhere in ree_core/ today, for self- or other-directed harm.
CONFIRMING: In SocialGridWorld (or equivalent), with OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging live, instantiate a threshold-gated hard veto that fires only when predicted-other-harm certainty exceeds a high threshold AND predicted severity is catastrophic/irreversible, while lower-certainty/severity predictions instead lower rank without exclusion. Confirming pattern: catastrophic-high-certainty trials show a hard behavioral floor (veto-eligible actions selected at ~0%) qualitatively discontinuous from low-certainty trials, where the same actions are selected at reduced but nonzero frequency.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): (1) the "veto" and "ranking" pathways behave identically (collapses into MECH-127-style soft coupling only); (2) a hard veto fires on low-certainty/non-catastrophic predictions (over-triggering); (3) high-certainty catastrophic other-harm produces no hard behavioral floor even after extended training (under-triggering); (4) the same threshold-veto behavior emerges from self-harm-only signals with no distinguishable "other" representation (falsifies social-specificity).

MECH-037.subject: provenance.papez_like_reality_filtering
MECH-037.title: Papez-like loop provides provenance gating and reality filtering.
MECH-037.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: E1-generated candidate content, a provenance/trace signal, and the E3 commitment decision must each be separately instrumented, with the trace signal VARYING across conditions -- a run where every candidate carries identical trace support cannot discriminate a working gate from no gate. ARCHITECTURE (resolved 2026-09-23, GFLAG-0340 option A): docs/architecture/papez_circuit.md adopts the affective RETRIEVAL-AUGMENTATION account -- filtering and encoding are CONCURRENT and coupled, with cingulate-like conflict/valence signals reweighting the retrieval eligibility and precision of candidates before E3 commitment (Theze 2017 OFC-MTL theta coherence at 200-330 ms). The sequential 'gate reads a trace store, then licenses commitment' reading is demoted to history, consistent with Liverani 2015 and Bouzerda-Wahlen 2015 placing temporal-order and source signals downstream of any sequential gate window. 'The gate' below therefore means the loop's concurrent reweighting of candidate precision/eligibility, not a separate post-hoc licensing check.
CONFIRMING: Trace-unsupported E1 content is held at measurably lower precision and licensed for commitment at a lower rate than trace-supported content of comparable quality, and degrading the gate produces a measurable increase in HIGH-CONFIDENCE commitments of ungrounded content -- confabulation-like failures tracking gate integrity. Manipulation: Degrade or disable the gate -- remove the provenance signal's influence on candidate precision and commitment licensing -- versus gate intact, on matched candidate sets and seeds. Control: Gate-intact arm with trace-supported and trace-unsupported candidates matched on E3 score and on E1 content quality, so any commitment-rate difference is attributable to provenance rather than to candidate value. Required event: E3 commitment decisions over a candidate set in which some candidates carry provenance/trace support and others do not, at comparable candidate quality. DV: Per-commitment PRECISION and confidence, not correctness alone: the commitment rate and assigned precision of trace-unsupported content relative to matched trace-supported content, and the increase in HIGH-CONFIDENCE commitments of ungrounded content when the gate is degraded. The gate must achieve this by amplifying or suppressing candidates, not by minting authority writes or bypassing the E3 verifier.
FALSIFYING: Commitment rate and assigned precision are indistinguishable with and without provenance support, and degrading the gate produces no increase in high-confidence ungrounded commitments -- the provenance signal is not operating as a commitment gate in REE's implementation, whatever else it does. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Provenance tagging EXISTS but is diagnostic-only: hippocampal trajectories carry a metadata source tag (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py:906 _trajectory_source) and MECH-293 ghost probes carry hypothesis_tag=True plus provenance metadata explicitly 'for downstream diagnostics' (:2506), and possibility_topology.py carries PROVENANCE_* constants. What is missing is a per-commitment precision/confidence recorder and any reader of those tags at the commit step. Consumer / boundary: The E3 commitment-licensing boundary. Verified 2026-09-22: E3's commit test is variance-based (running_variance < commit_threshold, ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:15, :285, :535) and contains no provenance or trace term, so the tags never reach the locus the claim asserts. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0340, EXP-0781, autobiographical_memory_v4:ABM-3, MECH-365, ARC-018.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The provenance quantity exists on trajectories but has no consumer at the asserted locus: E3's commit decision is purely variance-based and reads no provenance or trace field, so the signal cannot reach commitment licensing. Compounding it, GFLAG-0340 shows the nominated gating variable (temporal ordering) is downstream of the gate in the source literature. Secondary classes: R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: GFLAG-0340 (2026-09-18) found the claim's first literature evidence supports its ARCHITECTURE but contradicts its stated GATING VARIABLE: every signal the WWA nominates as a gate input measures in humans as a SLOW process DOWNSTREAM of the gate -- temporal order judgment dissociates from reality filtering in amplitude and source from 310 ms (Liverani 2015, weakens, the most on-mechanism paper available), and context source monitoring has no expression in the 200-300 ms gate window at all (Bouzerda-Wahlen 2015). The flag also records that papez_circuit.md carries TWO incompatible architectures (gate-reads-trace-store versus concurrent coupled filtering-and-encoding) and that the confirming signature's high-confidence clause needs per-commitment PRECISION instrumentation, which the WWA does not specify. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. MECH-038.subject: language.arcuate_fasciculus_nudges
MECH-038.title: Arcuate-like sequence-to-motor channel nudges language emergence.
MECH-038.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: coordination pressure must be REAL and FELT in the lesioned baseline -- a two-agent task where a resource is obtainable only under joint attention, with the baseline agents demonstrably attempting it (non-zero coordination attempts per episode) and at least occasional success without any channel. If NO emergence occurs in either arm the result is uninterpretable (no pressure, not no nudge). The signalling action must be equally available in both arms; only the fast sequence-to-motor ROUTING differs.
CONFIRMING: an AF-like channel is a NUDGE -- it raises the rate and lowers the latency of emergent symbolic coordination without being required for it. Arms on matched seeds: (ON) fast routing from hippocampal rollout / E1 sequence summaries (the theta packet) into E2 affordances over the signalling actions, plus a low-latency self-correction loop (E2 PE on the agent's own emitted signal evaluated BEFORE commit, able to interrupt or refine the output); (LESION) the same signalling actions with that routing severed (signals reach E2 only through the ordinary slow path, no pre-commit correction). Readouts: referential consistency (mutual information between emitted signal and the referent world state, above a shuffled-referent baseline), coordination success rate, and time-to-first-consistent-use. CONFIRMING if ON exceeds LESION on all three, sign-consistent across >=3 seed pairs, AND LESION still shows some emergence (nudge, not module) -- the doc's 'neither dorsal nor ventral alone is sufficient' clause predicts exactly that pattern.
FALSIFYING: ON = LESION on rate and latency (the dorsal sequence channel is not load-bearing for emergence -- the nudge is empty), or ON < LESION (fast routing PREVENTS consistent use, e.g. by committing to signals before meaning grounds), or emergence in ON with ZERO in LESION (the channel is a REQUIRED module, contradicting the claim's 'nudge, not a new module' framing -- a weakening of the claim as stated, though not of language emergence).
SUBSTRATE: NOT BUILT. ree_core has no multi-agent environment, no signalling / articulation affordance, and no language or social consumer modules (ree_core/claustrum/coalition_templates.py records that social / language / reality-coherence consumers 'do not exist yet in ree_core'). Two builds are named, in order: (1) a two-agent CausalGridWorld variant with a discrete low-cost signalling action and a joint-attention-gated resource; (2) the AF-analog routing from the multi-content theta packet (ree_core/latent/multi_content_theta_packet.py) into E2 affordances over the signalling actions, with a pre-commit self-correction hook. Biology first: the human AF is a functional analog with dorsal AND ventral streams both needed -- the build must not be a 'language module', and a targeted lit-pull on dorsal-stream lesion effects on protolanguage should precede the build, not follow it.
Disposition 2026-09-16: substrate_conditional -- do NOT mint an EXP; route to /implement-substrate scoping only after the plan-of-record decides whether V3 hosts a multi-agent environment at all (that is a research-direction decision, not a queue decision). complex (probe-gated) at the environment question.

through channel space (gradual co-movement of the relevant channels)

hard-veto interrupts, which this claim's own text predicts should
look like a fast, forced transition overriding the rest of the
channel state.
FALSIFYING: the named "modes" do not correspond to any stable
clustering in channel space (channel values wander freely without
forming recognisable regions); or transitions between modes are

MECH-040.subject: control_plane.safety_baseline_volatility
MECH-040.title: Safety baseline and volatility are distinct control channels for arousal/readiness.
MECH-040.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the test window must exercise BOTH SD-037's sustained_threat signal and Q-007's volatility_estimate through genuinely INDEPENDENT manipulations -- a sustained low-magnitude harm floor (moves sustained_threat, holds PE variance flat) crossed factorially with a bursty/oscillating PE regime (moves volatility_estimate, holds z_harm mean flat). Both use_phasic_burst and the SD-037 broadcast-override regulator must be enabled -- both are bit-identical OFF by default.
CONFIRMING: the two channels show distinguishable downstream footprints -- a low-sustained-threat/high-volatility cell moves volatility-driven consumers (SD-069 burst envelope, softmax temperature) while leaving override_signal/freeze-gate near baseline, and the mirror-image pattern for the reverse cell. A combined cell should show a non-strictly-multiplicative combination consistent with the claim's "OR" framing. Would extend MECH-063 sub-claim ii's already-landed tonic/phasic dissociation to this axis pair.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): the two manipulations produce statistically indistinguishable downstream footprints -- driving either signal moves the same consumers, with no channel-selective effect. Provenance note: MECH-104 is the already-active, PASS-tested narrower sibling covering only the volatility-triggers-de-commitment sub-mechanism; MECH-040 is the general channel-separation claim and remains untested on the sustained-threat side.

MECH-042.subject: control_plane.telemetry_exposure_channels

Manipulation: Injection of a live pathology -- currently only precision collapse via recalibrate_precision_to qualifies -- against a control run identical up to the injection tick; a second live pathology type is what the claim still needs. DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Only one of the four named pathologies perturbs behaviour at the operating config, so the claim's own >=2-types clause cannot be satisfied under any outcome; a second live pathology requires a behavioural consumer for operating_mode or for CommitReadiness readiness, neither of which exists today. MECH-043.subject: precision.dopamine_weighting
MECH-043.title: Dopamine-like modulation of precision-weighting for unsigned prediction errors.
MECH-043.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The audited precision term must remain unsigned by construction (e3_selector.update_running_variance squares the PE), and at least one live consumer must be measurably OFF its ceiling during the sweep -- either dacc_precision_scale raised so min(precision/scale, 3.0) is unsaturated, or E3Config.use_precision_scaled_commit_temperature ON so precision has a graded consumer on the committed branch. A sweep in which every consumer output is invariant tests nothing.
CONFIRMING: With a consumer de-saturated, raising the unsigned-precision gain produces a monotone increase in the prediction-driven commitment DV that is absent in the signed-channel control and absent in the saturated-consumer arm, attributable to this channel alone. Manipulation: Sweep the gain on the unsigned precision channel (running-variance EMA scale / precision_init and the consumer-side dacc_precision_scale) across at least three levels with the de-saturating lever armed, holding the signed ARC-108/109 substrate and all E2 harm forward models fixed. Control: Matched-RNG arms at identical seeds with the gain at the production default and the signed channels untouched, plus a deliberately saturated-consumer arm that must show the invariance signature (the degeneracy control). Required event: Waking ticks carrying non-zero E1/E2 prediction error so the running-variance EMA moves, together with commitment opportunities in which the precision-dependent commit branch is actually exercised (n_committed > 0 and not pinned at 1.0). DV (RATIFIED 2026-09-23, GFLAG-0365 option A, user-accepted): the hallucination-analogue DV is the per-1000-tick PREDICTION-DRIVEN COMMITMENT SHARE -- the rate of commitments whose selected trajectory's predicted harm/benefit exceeds what the current observation supports -- paired with the precision-scaled commit temperature actually applied and the dACC precision-weighted PE magnitude. LEVER: dacc_precision_scale (the de-saturator), NOT current_precision directly -- current_precision's live consumers are pinned at the min(precision/500, 2|3) ceiling at the trained operating point, so sweeping it alone tests nothing. The DV is built from existing fields (e3_selector commit diagnostics, dacc._last_pe_unsaturated); its recorder is written at queue time. This releases chip-20260918-mech043-precision-sweep.
FALSIFYING: The computation takes on signed or valence information; or precision weighting collapses into a scalar reward objective; or the de-saturated gain sweep moves no hallucination-analogue DV across a genuine non-degenerate range; or the same effect is produced identically by a shared global precision scale with no dissociation from the signed channels. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: e3_selector metrics running_variance / dynamic_precision / last_scores and the commit diagnostics (gap_scaled_commit_temperature_eff, precision_scaled_commit_temperature_eff); dacc._last_pe_unsaturated and _last_saturation_factor. No recorder for any hallucination-analogue DV exists anywhere in ree_core. Consumer / boundary: The E3 commitment gate (commit_variance versus the effective bar, and the precision-scaled commit temperature) and the dACC precision-weighted affective-pain PE readout -- not episode reward. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0365, EXP-0793, MECH-027, INV-008, MECH-054.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Two blockers, both live. The consumers that the falsifier reads are pinned at the min(precision/500, 2|3) ceiling at the trained operating point, so a gain sweep is invariant; and no operational hallucination-analogue DV has ever been written, which is the explicit reason GFLAG-0365 declares the claim not dispatchable. The unsignedness half is already verified in code and is not blocked. Secondary classes: R1, R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: GFLAG-0365 (user decision 2026-09-19) establishes that the field names a 'hallucination-like DV' four times and operationalises it nowhere, so the falsifier cannot be fired as written. The CONFIRMING clause also asserts the channel is live-wired into the dACC affective-PE weighting as though that settled causal reach; the normalisers are pinned at their ceiling at the trained operating point, and a second de-saturating graded consumer (use_precision_scaled_commit_temperature, MECH-027) landed 2026-09-02 after the field was authored. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. [2026-09-25 governance-20260925; GFLAG-0455] GOVERNANCE DECISION (rec-20260925-deedce42): R1 selected -- the primary de-saturator for MECH-043's precision sweep is now the E3 precision-scaled commit route (E3Config.use_precision_scaled_commit_temperature=True plus per-seed commit-threshold calibration, as V3-EXQ-981a did), combined with a two-sided script-side _running_variance scale sweep and an explicit MECH-027 dissociation control (since this route entangles MECH-027's own de-saturation mechanism). MECH-044.subject: entities.hippocampal_relational_binding

MECH-045.subject: entities.object_file_persistence
MECH-045.title: Object-file-like buffers provide minimal entity persistence across time.
MECH-045.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The buffer's feature term must be non-degenerate at the world dimension used (658 gated on d_cos_min with world_dim=128, since z_world at dim 32 hits a discriminative ceiling), and any claim beyond the buffer's own boundary requires that entity observations come from a real perceptual detector rather than from hand-built harness vectors.

Control: SHUFFLE arm, which holds the buffer machinery fixed and destroys only the association, plus the OFF arm as the floor. FALSIFYING: INTACT re-identification collapses to the SHUFFLE level at non-degenerate feature separation -- the buffer is not doing data association; or, for the functional leg, token identity is available but nothing downstream changes when it is removed. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The buffer-level falsifier is answered (V3-EXQ-658 PASS at world_dim=128 on the fleet). Everything beyond that boundary is unreachable by design: REEAgent.update_object_file_buffer states in its own docstring that it does not touch the action stream and that v1 has no consumer, and the entity observations are built by the caller because the detector (SD-049 resource-field views plus grid object/hazard cells) lives in the harness, not in ree_core. MECH-046.subject: amygdala.cea_mode_prior_write
MECH-046.title: CeA analogue writes a mode prior into the SalienceCoordinator from fast salience classification of z_harm_a.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The CeA fast-route gate must actually FIRE in the regime measured, at its registered threshold: report fire_count > 0 with cea_fast_route_threshold at its default 0.5. A run that lowers the threshold to force firing measures the threshold, not the claim, and must self-route non_contributory. use_amygdala_analog and use_cea_analog must both be on, and the SalienceCoordinator must be able to switch mode in the run's regime.

FALSIFYING: With the gate firing, time-to-mode-switch is identical between amygdala-OFF and CeA-ON -- the module's own registered failure signature, meaning either the bias is too small to influence the coordinator or the mode-prior channel carries no arbitration authority. MECH-047.subject: control_plane.precommitment_mode_manager
MECH-047.title: Pre-commitment mode manager commits with hysteresis and switching costs.
MECH-047.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Commitment must be strictly inside (0, 1) in BOTH arms -- V3-EXQ-068 was design-inconclusive because commit_rate was exactly 1.0 in eval for probe and control alike. The hysteresis parameter must also be armed: SalienceCoordinator.exit_thresholds defaults to empty (exit rail 1.0, no-op) and use_salience_coordinator defaults False, so an unconfigured run varies a parameter that is inert.
CONFIRMING: Excess dwell after incentive removal rises monotonically with the hysteresis parameter and exceeds the symmetric arm on the majority of seeds, while a post-switch performance penalty is measurable and grows with switch frequency. Manipulation: Vary the hysteresis magnitude across at least three levels -- SalienceCoordinator exit_thresholds[current_mode] (the MECH-266 Schmitt lower rail) and/or BetaGate refractory ticks via apply_refractory (SD-034) -- with the incentive schedule identical across arms. Control: A symmetric arm (exit_threshold 1.0, refractory 0) on the same seeds and the same incentive schedule, which fixes the memoryless expectation against which excess dwell is measured. Required event: Entry into a committed mode under a strong incentive, followed by removal of that incentive (hazard density or goal drop) within one trained substrate, so any persistence of the committed state is attributable to inertia rather than to the incentive. DV: Excess dwell after incentive removal: ticks from incentive removal to the first beta_gate release, and sd034_committed_run_length, each expressed as a difference from the symmetric arm's distribution; plus switches per episode (_n_switches). The switching-cost half is a separate DV -- reward or harm performance in the k ticks immediately after a switch relative to matched non-switch ticks.
FALSIFYING: Dwell after incentive removal is indistinguishable from the symmetric arm across the parameter range (commitment decays memorylessly), or switching incurs no measurable post-switch cost -- the mode manager then commits without hysteresis or without cost. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: BetaGate.get_state exposes sd034_committed_run_length, sd034_refractory_remaining, hold_count and the MECH-090 elevation counters; SalienceCoordinator.tick returns current_mode, mode_switch_trigger and counts switches. Nothing records a switching COST -- no per-switch performance attribution exists, so that leg has no instrument. Consumer / boundary: The commitment/mode latch at the E3-to-action-selection propagation boundary (BetaGate), and the discrete mode register in SalienceCoordinator. Existing ownership: EXP-1302, MECH-266, SD-032a, mode-governance-engagement, MECH-046.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The only V3 design that ran (V3-EXQ-068) measured commitment_rate, which ceilings at 1.0 in eval so both arms are pinned and nothing discriminates; EXP-1302 is gated on exactly that. The dwell and refractory instruments needed for a redesign already exist and are unused, and the switching-cost half has no recorder at all. Secondary classes: R5, R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-048.subject: control_plane.mu_kappa_stability_overlays
MECH-048.title: mu/kappa stability overlays modulate mode entropy and switching pressure.
MECH-048.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-048 asserts overlays modulating BOTH
(a) mode-prior sharpness/entropy AND (b) switching pressure -- each leg
has its OWN precondition and its OWN confirmed-not-yet-testable history;
do not conflate a result on one leg with a verdict on the other.

MECH-049.subject: temporal.phase_compartmentalisation
MECH-049.title: Temporal phase compartmentalisation preserves ethical constraint independence.
