MECH-054.subject: precision.signed_harm_benefit
MECH-054.title: Signed harm/benefit prediction-error precision channels remain distinct.
MECH-054.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the comparison requires BOTH a harm-side and a benefit-side channel to be actually exercised live, each producing its own precision-weighted signed prediction-error from its own forward model, with each channel's precision/variance state stored and updated independently of the other's.
CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-08 digestion pass): ARCHITECTURALLY ASYMMETRIC -- precondition NOT met. HARM side: E2HarmAForward/E2HarmSForward (MECH-258) are dedicated forward models, consumed by DACCAdaptiveControl as an explicit "precision-weighted affective-pain prediction error." BENEFIT side: E3Selector's benefit_eval_head (ARC-030/MECH-112) is a plain proximity-regression head with no paired forward model and no benefit-specific precision/variance tracker -- no analogue of _running_variance or a benefit-side dACC exists anywhere in ree_core. The learned benefit_eval_head has never converged (EXQ-085m: r2=-8.6; EXQ-183: auc=0.538, near chance); ARC-030's one PASS came from fixed-weight CEM scoring used INSTEAD OF the learned head, and ARC-030 remains candidate/pending_retest_after_substrate. Today's substrate has ONE live signed-precision-weighted PE channel (harm), not two -- MECH-054's comparison cannot yet be run.
CONFIRMING: once a benefit-side channel reaches the same class as the harm-side one -- a benefit forward model whose PE is consumed by its own precision-weighted control-plane readout, verified numerically and causally independent of the harm channel's -- and downstream consumers respond differently to a manipulation that decouples harm-PE from benefit-PE, that is confirming evidence.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): (a) the benefit-side channel, once built, shares its precision/variance state with the harm channel; (b) downstream consumers show statistically indistinguishable sensitivity to harm-PE-only vs. benefit-PE-only manipulations; or (c) the benefit-side channel requires being driven by the harm channel's precision state to train or stabilize at all.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08 digestion pass, not resolved here): the title/wording presupposes parity between harm and benefit channels that doesn't currently exist -- flagged for governance to consider whether MECH-054 should be rescoped (e.g. "benefit- side signed-PE precision channel does not yet exist; harm-side does") rather than "remain distinct". Also flagging a possible cross-claim consistency question against MECH-043's "unsigned PE" framing for the sibling dopamine-like channel -- not resolved here, worth a synthesis pass relating MECH-043/054/002/055's precision-channel taxonomy.

MECH-055.subject: affect.channel_separation
MECH-055.title: Affective channel separation keeps hedonic tone, valence, and signed PE distinct.
MECH-055.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires each of the three named axes independently computable and independently perturbable -- (a) hedonic-stability (mu/kappa overlays), (b) VALENCE vector components with non-zero cross-candidate variance on >=2 components simultaneously, (c) signed PE precision from a genuine forward-model- based precision-weighted PE on BOTH harm and benefit sides. CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-08): (a) PARTIALLY MET -- mu now reaches both mode-prior temperature and threshold (SD-032d, 2026-07-21), V3-EXQ-799 confirmed non-degenerate internal variance (1.105 nats between coupling states); downstream behavioural legibility gap is separate and doesn't block a representational-level test. (b) representationally real (VALENCE_COMPONENTS, ree_core/residue/field.py) but experimentally untested (MECH-035 records no prior run as of 2026-08-06). (c) NOT MET per MECH-054's 2026-08-08 finding -- only the harm-side channel is real/precision-tracked; no benefit-side analogue exists. Consequence: the full three-axis-with-harm/benefit-duality test cannot yet run; a narrower two-axis-plus-harm-only test CAN run now and should self-route substrate_not_ready if attempted as a verdict on the full claim before the benefit-side channel lands.
COLLAPSE-RISK CHECK (new finding, 2026-08-08): before any distinctness test is credited, it must rule out a specific risk -- REE carries TWO harm-related representations downstream of the same z_harm_s/z_harm_a signal: VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE (residue-field tag, axis 2) and the DACC-consumed harm forward-model PE (axis 3). Nothing currently shows these carry independent variance rather than being one collapsed harm scalar wearing two labels -- the same failure class MECH-048 hit before its 2026-07-21 fix (an arithmetic identity mistaken for a measurement). A test showing these merely live in different variables, without showing independent variance under a manipulation that perturbs one without the other, has not established distinctness.
CONFIRMING: under the two-axis-plus-harm-only test, manipulations targeting each axis individually produce measurable, non-degenerate effects on that axis's own documented downstream role WITHOUT matched lockstep effects on the other axes -- no single upstream perturbation moves all measured axes in a fixed, predictable ratio. Separately, VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE and the DACC harm-PE show measurably different variance/timing signatures under a manipulation that decouples their upstream sources, ruling out the collapsed-harm-scalar case above.
FALSIFYING: (i) any two axes move in a fixed, predictable ratio under manipulations designed to perturb only one; (ii) VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE and the harm-side forward-model PE are numerically redundant (correlation ~1) under a decoupling manipulation; (iii) once built, the benefit-side signed-PE channel requires being driven by or sharing state with VALENCE_WANTING/LIKING to train or stabilize, mirroring MECH-054's own falsifier (c).
NAMING NOTE: REE's "hedonic tone" (mu/kappa) is NOT the standard affective- neuroscience hedonic-tone/valence distinction -- it functions as a control-plane stability/inertia regulator (softmax-temperature modulator), not a content-bearing affect quale. The real hedonic-impact-like content (Berridge wanting/liking) lives inside the VALENCE vector (axis 2), not axis 1.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): the MECH-043/054/002/055 precision- channel taxonomy synthesis flagged in MECH-054's digestion is reinforced here -- MECH-035's VALENCE vector also carries harm-adjacent (HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE) and benefit-adjacent (WANTING/LIKING) components that sit conceptually on top of the same signals MECH-054/055 assign to "signed PE precision." A synthesis pass should map MECH-002 -> MECH-043 -> MECH-054 -> MECH-035 -> MECH-055 explicitly and resolve whether VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE is a redundant readout of the DACC harm signal or a genuinely independent channel -- undocumented either way as of this pass.
CATEGORY JUDGMENT CALL: epistemic_category is set to standard for consistency with sibling MECH-054's treatment of the same underlying substrate gap (see MECH-054's own what_would_answer). A stricter reading -- since this claim's own wording requires the harm/benefit duality inside axis 3, and that duality's benefit half is architecturally absent -- could defensibly argue substrate_conditional instead; flagged for governance to revisit if the stricter reading is preferred.

MECH-056.subject: residue.trajectory_first_placement
MECH-056.title: Residue should constrain trajectories before distorting core representations.
MECH-056.what_would_answer:
Asks whether placing residue pressure in trajectory-level gating (hippocampal rollout costs, E3 thresholds) ahead of representational distortion actually reduces enacted harm relative to a residue signal that only reads the terminal/endpoint state -- the same question EVB-0039 (residue_trajectory_placement, ree-v1-minimal 2026-02-26 PASS, ree-v2 revalidation 2026-03-14 PASS) answered on pre-V3 substrate, reprised against V3's live mechanism.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the test environment must produce intermediate (mid-path) harm-relevant world-state changes that are distinct from the terminal state -- i.e. a hazard/harm signal attributable to specific intermediate steps along the executed path, not only encoded in the final state. Without that, TRAJECTORY-WIDE and ENDPOINT-ONLY residue placement are indistinguishable and the test is vacuous (this was true of EVB-0039's CausalGridWorld hazard layout and must hold for its V3 successor too). Trajectories under test must be genuinely committed (non-hypothesis-tagged); MECH-094 blocks residue accumulation from rehearsal/replay content, so a rehearsal-only run cannot exercise this claim.
CONFIRMING: reprise EVB-0039's own operationalization directly on the V3 substrate, comparing (i) TRAJECTORY-WIDE placement, using ResidueField.evaluate_trajectory() over the full step horizon -- already the live default read path for both E3's Phi_R term (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py) and hippocampal rollout terrain scoring (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py) -- against (ii) an ENDPOINT-ONLY ablation, restricting evaluate_trajectory() to the terminal step only, via the same code-swap pattern V3-EXQ-046/397/397c/397d already use to null it out for ARC-007. A CONFIRMING result requires, across a multi-seed sweep at least as large as EVB-0039's (3 seeds / 200 episodes): (a) path-spread criterion -- trajectory-wide intermediate residue mass is non-zero and localised along the executed path, not only at the terminus; (b) harm-avoidance criterion -- last-quarter-episode harm under TRAJECTORY-WIDE placement is no worse than ENDPOINT-ONLY by more than the EVB-0039 harm_tolerance_factor (ratio <= 1.05), ideally recovering a margin closer to the original ree-v1-minimal PASS (0.724 vs 0.8127, ~11%) than the much thinner ree-v2 revalidation margin (1.2493 vs 1.2273, ~1.8%, which only passed inside tolerance); and (c) MECH-056's own rehearsal-lane hooks hold over the same sweep: ledger_edit_detected_count == 0, domination_lock_in_events == 0, and explanation_policy_divergence_rate <= 0.05.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): last-quarter-episode harm under TRAJECTORY-WIDE placement exceeds ENDPOINT-ONLY by more than the harm_tolerance_factor (ratio > 1.05) on the V3 substrate across a properly-powered multi-seed sweep -- i.e. trajectory-level gating measurably fails to reduce enacted harm relative to judging only the terminal state, on an environment materially more complex than the CausalGridWorld toy grid both prior PASSes used. Also falsifying: the path-spread criterion failing (trajectory_wide_mean_intermediate_residue_mass statistically indistinguishable from zero), which would show that evaluate_trajectory()'s full-horizon read is present in code but contributes no real signal beyond what the terminal step alone gives in the live E3/ hippocampal gating path -- i.e. "trajectory-first placement" is wired but inert. Also falsifying: any rehearsal-lane hard-invariant violation (ledger_edit_detected_count > 0 or domination_lock_in_events > 0) during the sweep, indicating rehearsal-only trajectory generation is leaking into committed residue/policy state in violation of MECH-056's DMN-like rehearsal-lane contract.
GOVERNANCE/QUEUE FLAG (2026-08-08 digestion pass, not resolved here): no V3-scale re-test has ever been queued for this claim (confirmed via experiment_queue.json and git log -S). The mechanism is confirmed live and default-wired -- flagged as a clean /queue-experiment candidate reusing the evaluate_trajectory() full-horizon-vs-endpoint-only swap pattern already established by V3-EXQ-786/397-family, scored against MECH-056's own path-spread + harm-avoidance criteria.

MECH-059.subject: precision.confidence_channel_separate_from_prediction_error
MECH-059.title: Confidence channel (uncertainty-derived precision) must remain distinct from residual error.
MECH-059.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both arms must be instantiated AND trained: use_e2_world_uncertainty, its online phased training, and use_conditional_precision_gate are all default False, and an untrained head leaves predictive_variance near-uniform (the 604a / 624a / 614d / 640a vacuous-channel failure class). The two channels must also not be trivially identical, and the correlation target must be re-specified so a state-blind EMA cannot pass by carrying no information.
CONFIRMING: At V3 scale the confidence channel is not a smoothed function of residual error over time, AND the SEPARATED (conditional-gate) condition measurably outperforms the MERGED (EMA) condition on task harm at matched training. Manipulation: SEPARATED versus MERGED: gate commitment on the SD-063 per-transition conditional predictive variance (use_conditional_precision_gate with a trained quantile head) versus on the state-blind running-variance EMA derived from residual error. Control: Matched seeds and matched training budget, with an untrained-head arm as the vacuity control and the SD-031 agency-residual check confirming the head has not absorbed the E2 agency signal. Required event: A trained agent making commit decisions while both a conditional predictive-uncertainty estimate and a residual prediction error are available for the same transition. DV: Two quantities, kept separate: (a) whether the confidence channel is a function of residual error -- correlation of predicted uncertainty with the EMA of realised error ACROSS TIME, which must be low; and (b) operational value -- task harm under SEPARATED versus MERGED at matched training. Per-point precision_error_corr with realised error should be HIGH, not low, and must not be used as the distinctness test.
FALSIFYING: The conditional channel adds nothing beyond a time-lagged transform of residual error, or MERGED performs at least as well as SEPARATED at V3 scale -- the V1-minimal separation result was scale-specific and the separation is not operationally load-bearing. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Substrate present, claim untagged. e2_world_uncertainty.py records the predictive distribution and e3_selector.py:4043 records the EMA path, and tests/contracts/test_sd063_conditional_uncertainty_head.py pins the head -- but V3-EXQ-712 and 716/716a all carry claim_ids = [], so no V3 manifest reaches MECH-059; its sole scored entry is the 2026-03-14 ree-v1-minimal/v2 run. Consumer / boundary: E3's commit gate -- which estimate the commitment decision reads -- not the encoder or the forward model's point prediction. Existing ownership: SD-063, MECH-059, V3-EXQ-712, V3-EXQ-716, SD-031.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); As written the falsifier is non-discriminating: |corr(confidence, PE)| < 0.3 is satisfied trivially by the state-blind EMA (corr ~0.0 by construction) and failed by the informative quantile head (0.379), so the criterion selects the uninformative channel. Compounding this, all three enabling flags are default False and no V3 run carries MECH-059 in claim_ids. Secondary classes: R7, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The V3 realization of the confidence channel landed after the WWA was written and inverts its distinct-signals criterion. SD-063's E2WorldUncertaintyHead (ree_core/predictors/e2_world_uncertainty.py) is named in-source as 'the concrete realization of the MECH-059 confidence channel', and V3-EXQ-712 measured precision_error_corr 0.379 for the winning quantile head against 0.0 for the running-variance EMA -- 'the EMA null', zero BY CONSTRUCTION because it is state-blind. The WWA's confirming signature |corr| < 0.3 therefore passes only the channel that carries no conditional information and fails the one that does. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. MECH-065.subject: control_plane.reality_coherence_conflict_lane
MECH-065.title: Reality-coherence conflict lane modulates loop precision and commitment thresholds before execution lock-in.
MECH-065.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict):
MECH-065 is currently a schematic design claim -- the RC_conflict signal, the
DA_A/DA_M lock-in-pressure dampening, the commitment-threshold (tau/theta_high/
theta_low) hysteresis, and the Pi_rc guarded floor are all still on the
control-plane doc's own TODO list ("formalise control plane state variables",
"specify update equations... for S5 reality-coherence conflict computation").
A test is informative only once: (a) RC_conflict is computed as an explicit,
independently-readable channel (not inferred post-hoc from downstream behaviour),
with live non-zero variance across an authority/provenance-mismatch manipulation
-- a channel that never moves cannot be shown to modulate anything, and any run
against a flat/uncomputed RC_conflict channel self-routes substrate_not_ready,
not FAIL; and (b) commitment threshold and DA_A/DA_M lock-in pressure are
themselves separately measurable at the pre-commit stage, so a shift in them can
be attributed to RC_conflict specifically rather than read off final behavioural
outcome. Two of the six dependencies (ARC-007, ARC-018) are held on the
V3-Pending Gate as of this digestion -- their resolution is upstream of a clean
test here, since MECH-065's provenance/authority framing leans on both.
CONFIRMING signature: under a manipulation that varies authority/provenance
mismatch at matched surface content (e.g. spoofed vs. verified source signal on
an otherwise identical instruction/observation), RC_conflict rises measurably,
DA_A/DA_M lock-in pressure is measurably dampened, and the effective commitment
threshold is measurably raised -- all BEFORE execution lock-in (pre-commit-stage
change, not a downstream behavioural correlate) -- with the system biasing toward
verification/exploration rather than premature commit. Per the claim's own
literature grounding (Sterzer et al. 2016), the effect should track the
PRECISION RATIO of internal-model precision to authority-signal precision, not
authority-signal magnitude alone: an arm that holds absolute authority-signal
strength fixed while varying internal (E1) precision should shift the threshold
the same way as an arm that holds internal precision fixed and varies authority
signal strength, provided the ratio moves equivalently. The response should also
show hysteresis (theta_high > theta_low, bounded recovery via tau_rc_recovery)
rather than a single crisp threshold, and should never suppress reality-conflict
sensitivity below the guarded floor (Pi_rc >= pi_rc_floor) under sustained
exteroceptive pressure.
FALSIFYING signature: if the provenance/authority-mismatch manipulation produces
no measurable pre-commit change in DA_A/DA_M or commitment threshold -- i.e.
RC_conflict, even when computed and live, has no separable causal effect on
lock-in pressure or threshold -- the claim is refuted: reality-coherence
conflict does not constitute a distinct control-plane lane and any observed
downstream effect is better explained by existing signals (S1/S3) alone. Also
falsifying if the threshold shift tracks absolute authority-signal magnitude
independent of internal precision (i.e. the ratio manipulation described above
does NOT dissociate, so magnitude alone predicts the shift as well as the ratio
does) -- this would refute the specific ratio-based account MECH-065 currently
rests on (Sterzer et al.), even if some cruder RC-conflict effect survives. Also
falsifying if the response shows no hysteresis (theta_high == theta_low, or
chronic drift below pi_rc_floor under sustained pressure) -- the design
constraint that reality-conflict must not chronically over-suppress from
transient ambiguity would then be unmet.
EVIDENCE STATUS: no experimental evidence exists for this claim as of this
digestion (2026-08-06) -- only literature grounding (Sterzer et al. 2016, Howes
& Murray 2020, Damiani et al. 2022) supporting the ratio-based reframing of the
threshold, and a clinical-analogue mapping. That literature is supportive of the
general precision-miscalibration framing but does not itself test REE's specific
three-signal (provenance/temporal/identity/policy) carve of RC_conflict -- treat
it as motivating, not confirming.

MECH-066.subject: agency.boundary_conditioned_channel_separation
MECH-066.title: Pre-commit and post-commit channels may share representations, but the components that must stay veridical about the world (REE's E1 world model and the residue field) must stay separated at durable write boundaries: simulated/pre-commit content must not become a durable write to them. Other durable stores (e.g. policy/actor-critic parameters trained on imagined rollouts) are not required to enforce this separation.
MECH-066.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Exercise real and simulated outcomes plus every claimed offline writer; observe the natural sleep cycle, ContextMemory, AnchorSet._active/_all, residue and policy parameters. Positive-control writes must be visible.
SCOPE (narrowed by epistemic role 2026-09-23, GFLAG-0361 option A, user-accepted; IGW-242 lit pull REE_assembly 1e98ae94e8): the protected durable stores are the components that must stay veridical about the world -- E1 and the residue field, plus the attribution records bound to them. Policy/actor-critic parameters durably trained on imagined rollouts are OUT of scope: DreamerV3 (Hafner et al., Nature 2025, PMID 40175544) trains actor and critic durably and purely on imagined rollouts and works, so a blanket every-durable-write reading is contradicted. The lit pull also favours a static write-topology audit over a representation-overlap statistic as the instrument (Kaufman et al. 2014, Nat Neurosci, PMID 24487233).
CONFIRMING: Representations can be reused while intact gates prevent simulated/precommit content from becoming durable attribution; weakening separation permits such writes and corruption. Manipulation: Weaken MECH-094's simulation-write refusal while preserving the represented content. Control: Intact gates; same inputs, seeds, write budgets and real-harm exposure. Required event: Matched hypothetical and committed outcomes, and naturally fired SWS/REM/WRITEBACK cycles. DV: Forbidden durable writes by phase/store/actor, residue mass per actual harm event, and cross-boundary attribution errors.
FALSIFYING: Intact separation leaks into a protected veridical component (E1 or the residue field) under full coverage, or weakening it leaves attribution equally correct despite a manipulation check proving that the formerly blocked writes occur. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: V3-EXQ-1052 call wrappers plus natural-cycle state hashes, requiring the documented anchor-field, ContextMemory-coverage and double-cycle fixes. Consumer / boundary: Durable write boundary, not mere shared representations. Existing ownership: MECH-067, V3-EXQ-1052.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); Existing 1052 recorder hashes nonexistent anchor state, misses the natural sleep cycle and ContextMemory, and leaves required offline flags off. R6; R1 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-067.subject: agency.write_locus_permission_matrix
MECH-067.title: A machine-checkable phase/store/actor permission matrix is required to enforce commit-boundary write rules.
MECH-067.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the write audit must have COVERAGE -- it must observe at least one write in every (phase, store) class it claims to police: waking-commit writes to residue (ResidueField.accumulate), pre-commit simulation / hippocampal rollout content reaching any durable store, sleep-phase writes (SleepLoopManager WRITEBACK offline_gradient_pass on e2_harm_s; cross-module consolidation on E1/E2), and closure-operator discharge (discharge_domain). An audit that sees no sleep-phase or no simulation-phase writes has tested nothing. The comparator arm (matrix-enforced) requires the matrix to exist -- see SUBSTRATE.
CONFIRMING (the 'required' clause): under the CURRENT per-site gates (MECH-094 hypothesis_tag refusal inside accumulate, the sleep pass's 'named module only, no residue / memory writes' contract, the closure operator's bounded attenuation), an instrumented audit over waking + simulation + sleep finds >= 1 write that violates the MECH-060 update-locus table -- e.g. hypothesis-tagged rollout content reaching residue through a path that bypasses accumulate's flag, a sleep-phase write into a durable authority store (residue weights, beta_gate latch, anchor active flags), or a durable attribution write with no commit lineage -- AND that violation measurably corrupts attribution, as V1 EXQ-005 showed for the pre-commit locus (residue mass per real harm event inflated ~46x with no harm reduction). A default-deny (phase, store, actor) matrix that closes the leak and removes the corruption is then confirmed as REQUIRED, not merely tidy.
FALSIFYING: a full-coverage audit across seeds and configurations (use_sleep_aggregation_cluster ON, use_cross_module_consolidation ON, MECH-094 replay ON, closure ON) records ZERO violations under the existing local gates, and deliberately weakening one local gate is caught by another (redundancy) or produces no attribution corruption -- then the local gates are SUFFICIENT and MECH-067's 'machine-checkable matrix is required' is over-strong; demote to implementation guidance (what MECH-060's table originally was) and let INV-024 carry the invariant.
SUBSTRATE: the AUDIT half is buildable now as a driver-side instrument wrapping ResidueField.accumulate / discharge_domain, BetaGate.elevate / release, AnchorSet writes, and the SleepLoopManager._run_cycle parameter deltas (hash before / after), with phase read from SleepPhase and actor from the call site. The MATRIX itself (an explicit (phase, store, actor) default-deny table with typed store classes POL / ID / CAPS / residue / attribution ledger / scratch) is NOT built in ree_core. substrate_conditional for the comparator arm; the audit is the spike that decides whether the build is owed. Do not invent a matrix DV in the meantime.
Disposition 2026-09-16: complex (probe-gated) -> the audit spike first; if it finds violations, /implement-substrate the matrix and re-run as the comparator. The V1 EXQ-005 PASS (2026-02-27) is evidence for the write-locus DISTINCTION (MECH-060), not for the matrix being required; that is why this claim still has no V3 manifests.

MECH-069.subject: latent_stack.three_loop_error_signal_incommensurability
MECH-069.title: Sensory prediction error, motor-sensory error, and harm/goal error are incommensurable and cannot be collapsed.
MECH-069.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The MERGED (collapsed-channel) arm must actually run to completion against the real E1/E2/E3 stack, and the SEPARATED control arm must produce a DV with headroom -- V3-EXQ-993's separated arm measured a largest calibration_gap of 0.00152 against a 0.02 floor (13.1x short), so the ablation had nothing to remove. FALSIFYING: A merged single-channel agent reproduces the separated arm's per-channel scale, covariance and lag structure and matches or beats it on harm calibration at adequate power -- the channels are commensurable and collapsing them costs nothing. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

none < approach < contact pattern from EXQ-029), AND calibration_gap computed
ahead of agent_caused_hazard/hazard_approach transitions exceeds calibration_gap
ahead of env_caused_hazard transitions or locomotion by a margin comparable to
or exceeding the EXQ-026 threshold (>0.03 gap magnitude, or the pre-registered
threshold of the specific test design).
FALSIFYING signature: harm_eval shows no graded/continuous structure with
proximity (jumps only at contact, or is flat), OR calibration_gap does not
differ (or reverses) between the agent_caused_hazard/hazard_approach group and

MECH-072.subject: residue.foreseeable_harm_gating_reduces_false_attribution
MECH-072.title: Foreseeable-harm gating on residue accumulation reduces false attribution without degrading harm avoidance.
MECH-072.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The ground-truth agency partition must be PROXIMAL AVOIDABILITY, derived by replaying the stay action from the pre-action state against the environment's own step function -- not CausalGridWorldV2 transition_type labels, which encode hazard-OBJECT provenance and are anti-correlated with avoidability for the contamination mechanic. Both classes must occur at or above a pre-registered minimum count, the discriminator must clear its null-counterfactual sanity check, and harm-forward quality (harm_fwd_r2) must stay above its floor so a gate failure is not a model failure.
CONFIRMING: With the proximal-avoidability oracle as ground truth, the gated arm's false_attr_rate is materially below the ungated arm's on a strict majority of seeds at matched harm_rate, and the provenance-versus-avoidability agreement rate is reported so the result is not silently re-scored on the old label. Manipulation: Gate residue accumulation on the ARC-033/SD-011 counterfactual discriminator: GATED arm passes owned=True to REEAgent.update_residue only when causal_sig = harm_eval(E2HarmSForward(z_harm_s, a_actual)) - harm_eval(E2HarmSForward(z_harm_s, a_stay)) exceeds the threshold; UNGATED arm accumulates at every harm event. Control: Matched-seed ungated arm on the identical trajectory, plus a null-counterfactual control (a_actual substituted for a_stay, causal_sig must be ~0) and an oracle-gated positive-control arm driven by the replay-derived avoidability label, which upper-bounds the achievable false-attribution reduction. Required event: Harm events of both kinds within one episode stream: harm the agent could have avoided by acting differently this tick, and harm no alternative action this tick would have avoided, with the agent's action sequence long enough to accumulate residue at both classes of location. DV: false_attr_rate = residue accumulated at NON-avoidable harm events divided by total residue, scored against the replayed proximal-avoidability oracle rather than transition_type, paired with harm_rate (harm avoidance must not degrade) on the same seeds.
FALSIFYING: Under the same oracle label and a sound discriminator (null-CF sanity met, harm_fwd_r2 above floor), gating produces no reduction in false attribution or reduces it only at the cost of a measurable rise in harm_rate -- foreseeability gating does not buy cleaner attribution. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Every piece exists and none is combined: the gate hook is REEAgent.update_residue(owned=, world_delta=) into ResidueField.accumulate; the discriminator is exercised by V3-EXQ-877; and the oracle needs only the deepcopy(env) snapshot-and-replay pattern already used by V3-EXQ-817/817a/1006. No experiment computes the avoidability label. Consumer / boundary: The owned= decision at residue accumulation -- which harm events leave a durable trace in the residue field -- not the discriminator's own accuracy, which V3-EXQ-431/525 already validated separately. Existing ownership: V3-EXQ-877, ARC-037, MECH-071, MECH-256.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Not substrate: the gate, the discriminator and the env-replay snapshot idiom all exist. The confirmed V3-EXQ-877 autopsy showed the scored ground truth measures the wrong causal axis, and routed a redesign with a replay-derived avoidability label. That redesign was never written or queued -- no 877a script, no queue entry, and no experiment anywhere computes an avoidability oracle. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-073.subject: hippocampal.intrinsic_map_valence
MECH-073.title: Valence is intrinsic to hippocampal map geometry, not applied downstream (ARC-007 reconciled via Q-020 Resolution A; provisional 2026-06-10).
MECH-073.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Map geometry must be separable from the attached valence lookup, and the field must be non-trivial: at least 4 active RBF centres with non-zero cross-centre weight variance (V3-EXQ-800 measured 4.3e-4 against a 1e-6 floor).
CONFIRMING: Harm-vs-safe stays decodable above chance from geometry alone with valence_vecs withheld, and the valence-trained map's geometry differs measurably from the valence-free map's. Manipulation: Withhold the attached valence channel at readout, or permute valence rows across active centres as V3-EXQ-800's A2_RESIDUE_PERMUTED arm already does, leaving centre placement and z_world position intact. Control: The intact VALENCE_GEOM readout, plus a map trained with valence_enabled=False throughout, to test whether valenced experience reshapes the geometry at all. Required event: Harm and benefit events during training that write valence into RBF centres at the z_world positions the agent visits. DV: Harm-vs-safe AUROC decodable from map GEOMETRY alone (centre placement and z_world position, valence_vecs withheld or permuted), compared with the intact attached-valence AUROC and with the valence-free-trained map's geometry.
FALSIFYING: Geometry-only decoding collapses to chance while attached-valence decoding stays high and the valence-free map's geometry is indistinguishable -- valence is a downstream lookup keyed by position, which is the ARC-007-strict reading. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ResidueField.evaluate_valence (ree-v3/ree_core/residue/field.py:355) and the V3-EXQ-375 probe record AUROC from the attached valence vector only; the permutation and geometry-only readout exist in V3-EXQ-800's code but were never applied to MECH-073. Consumer / boundary: The hippocampal/residue map itself -- whether valence lives in the geometry, or in a position-keyed lookup applied downstream of a value-free map. Existing ownership: ARC-007, V3-EXQ-800, V3-EXQ-375, EXP-0053.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); V3-EXQ-375, the claim's only support, measures the value stored in valence_vecs -- a per-centre attached vector read back by RBF interpolation -- which a value-free map carrying a position-keyed lookup passes just as well. The geometry-versus-lookup discrimination the 'not applied downstream' clause requires has never been run. Secondary classes: R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-074.subject: amygdala.hippocampal_map_readwrite_head
MECH-074.title: Amygdala functions as read/write head for valenced hippocampal map — parent claim split into MECH-074a-d (2026-04-21).
MECH-074.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: reuse V3-EXQ-888's readiness block verbatim; do not re-derive it. All five must be reported green in-run: n_traces >= 8; buffer std of the ground-truth arousal label >= 0.02 (this is the statistic EVERY AOR routes on -- all four AORs are differences of means of gt_arousal, so zero spread forces every AOR to 0 regardless of weighting); buffer/label index alignment == 1.0; memory_strength range across buffer traces >= 0.05 (the strength route cannot move a weighted sample if encoding_gain does not vary); retrieval_bias range across buffer traces >= 0.01 (same for the address route). Plus the instrument control: the fully-OFF arm must be flat, |AOR_z(OFF)| <= 0.02 on every seed (888 measured -0.0006 / -0.0107 / +0.0063). For a run on a NEW consumer, add: the consumer must be shown to actually receive a non-uniform weight vector -- HippocampalModule silently ignores a retrieval_bias whose numel does not equal the buffer length (hippocampal/module.py:2964), so a length mismatch degenerates to uniform sampling with no error.
CONFIRMING: four arms at matched seeds (FULL / TAG_OFF = strength route only / GAIN_FLAT = address route only / OFF). Head authority: AOR_z(FULL) - AOR_z(OFF) >= 0.03 on >= 2/3 seeds. Separability: BOTH single-route arms independently clear the same floor -- AOR_z(TAG_OFF) - AOR_z(OFF) >= 0.03 AND AOR_z(GAIN_FLAT) - AOR_z(OFF) >= 0.03. On a NEW consumer (E3.select proposal reweighting, once wired per SD-035's data-flow spec) the address-route arm must clear 0.06, i.e. 2x the across-seed SD of that arm's delta as measured in 888 (0.0313), because the 0.03 absolute floor sits at exactly 1 SD there and would not distinguish replication from noise; the strength-route arm's observed SD is 0.0740, so its replication floor is 0.15.
FALSIFYING: FULL clears but NEITHER single-route arm does -- authority without separability, i.e. one undifferentiated write channel rather than a read/write head with two routes, which is the parent's specific residual assertion and the only thing it still claims beyond the children. Also falsifying: the OFF arm is not flat (|AOR_z| > 0.02), which voids the instrument rather than the claim; or, on the new consumer, both single-route deltas fall below their replication floors with all preconditions green -- separability would then be a property of the replay-sampling path only, and the parent's scope should be narrowed to that path in text rather than left general.

MECH-074a.subject: amygdala.bla_encoding_gain_on_hippocampal_writes
MECH-074a.title: BLA analogue applies an arousal-dependent multiplicative gain to HippocampalModule write strength.
MECH-074a.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) BLA must actually tick in the live loop -- report `bla_n_ticks > 0`; this is the exact defect that vacated V3-EXQ-474's C2-C5 (an env.step 5-tuple unpacking bug left `bla_n_ticks = 0` and turned the run into synthetic BLAAnalog.tick() unit tests). (2) The gain must VARY: per-episode peak encoding_gain range across the buffer >= 0.05 (888's MS_RANGE_FLOOR), with at least one episode above `bla_arousal_threshold_on = 0.4` and not every threat episode pinned at the inverted-U peak -- a saturated gain is a constant and tests nothing. (3) BOTH DVs must be live: threat-item recall and neutral-item recall each strictly between floor and ceiling in the gain=1 baseline, so that a DECREMENT in neutral recall is measurable at all. (4) The DV must be RECALL ACCURACY on a probe, NOT the arousal-over-representation statistic used by V3-EXQ-659 and V3-EXQ-888. This is the load-bearing precondition: AOR is a share-of-a-fixed-budget measure, so an AOR increase and a neutral-recall decrement are the SAME event expressed twice -- the existing evidence therefore cannot address the second half of this claim's own falsifier even in principle.
CONFIRMING: two arms at matched seeds -- ARM_GAIN (use_amygdala_analog=True, use_bla_analog=True, defaults) vs ARM_GAIN_1 (`override_bla_encoding_gain` pinned to 1.0, everything else bit-identical). Threat-context recall accuracy delta >= max(0.05 absolute, 1 SD of the across-seed delta) on >= 2/3 seeds, AND neutral recall delta > -0.02 on the same seeds. Both halves required -- a threat-recall gain alone is not a PASS of this falsifier as registered.
FALSIFYING: with preconditions green, threat-recall delta below the floor on >= 2/3 seeds -- the encoding-gain arithmetic buys replay-composition bias (659/888) but no recall benefit, and the claim's mapping from write strength to retrievability is mis-specified. SEPARATELY falsifying the arithmetic but not the mechanism: threat gain bought at neutral cost (neutral recall delta <= -0.05), which is the claim's own named second failure mode and routes to `bla_retrieval_bias_compensation` (0.1-0.3, the zero-sum form already implemented and default-off) rather than to abandoning the claim.

MECH-074b.subject: amygdala.bla_retrieval_bias_content_selective
MECH-074b.title: BLA analogue writes a content-selective per-trace arousal tag at encoding and applies a per-trace weight vector (NOT a scalar gain) as sampling priority over the hippocampal replay/reactivation path. Locus narrowed 2026-09-09 from 'on hippocampal readout'; retrieval-time item-level readout enhancement is now an unevidenced residual -- see evidence_quality_note.
MECH-074b.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: see MECH-074's own what_would_answer for the shared readiness block (n_traces, gt_arousal spread, buffer/label alignment, both route-nonuniformity floors, OFF-arm flatness) -- do not re-derive it. Two additions specific to this claim: (a) the arousal tag must be written AT ENCODING (`bla_retrieval_tag_at_encoding=True`); the module exposes False precisely to reproduce the named scalar failure signature, so that setting is the NEGATIVE CONTROL ARM, not a misconfiguration. (b) The environment/harness must expose CENTRAL/GIST vs PERIPHERAL items WITHIN the same episode, each with independently measurable recall. Without (b) the run re-measures 888's between-trace threat-vs-neutral contrast, which is already answered and is NOT the LaBar & Cabeza central/peripheral dissociation this claim is about; a "PASS" obtained that way would be vacuous with respect to the residual.
CONFIRMING: three arms at matched seeds -- ARM_VECTOR (per-trace w_i = 1 + alpha*tag_i, alpha in [0.3, 1.0]), ARM_SCALAR (uniform w = 1 + alpha*mean(tag) across all traces; equivalently `bla_retrieval_tag_at_encoding=False`), ARM_OFF. Confirming requires ALL THREE of: (1) in ARM_VECTOR, central/gist recall advantage over peripheral items of 1.3x-2.0x relative to the neutral baseline (the claim's own registered target magnitude) on >= 2/3 seeds; (2) ARM_SCALAR's dissociation indistinguishable from ARM_OFF's (delta below 0.02) -- the scalar form must NOT reproduce it; (3) ARM_OFF's dissociation flat within |0.02|.
FALSIFYING: ARM_SCALAR reproduces ARM_VECTOR's dissociation within the margin -- the content-selective form is not load-bearing and the claim collapses to a scalar retrieval gain, which is the failure signature the claim was registered to exclude. Independently falsifying: ARM_VECTOR's dissociation misses the floor with all preconditions green -- the per-trace weight then has composition authority over the replay SAMPLE (888) but no authority over item-level READOUT, and the claim should be narrowed to the sampling path rather than retained as a retrieval-weight claim. NOT falsified by, and not testable as, the "BLA contribution grows with trace age" leg: no age term exists in the substrate, so that leg is substrate_conditional on an unbuilt trace-age input and must not be scored in this run. NOT falsified by, and not testable as, ABSOLUTE peripheral suppression (peripheral recall dropping below the ARM_OFF baseline rather than merely trailing the central-item advantage): this claim's target is the RELATIVE central/gist advantage only (see functional_restatement's RELATIVE-VS-ABSOLUTE note, residual R2, 2026-09-14) and the shipped substrate (retrieval_bias_compensation=0.0) cannot structurally produce absolute suppression, so a run showing peripheral recall merely unchanged rather than reduced is not evidence against this claim.

MECH-074c.subject: amygdala.cea_fast_subcortical_priming
MECH-074c.title: CeA analogue emits a fast subcortical priming signal (fast_prime) on low-frequency z_harm_a with an overridable decay window, distinct from MECH-046's cortical mode-prior write.
MECH-074c.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- this is the whole finding, not a formality: the CeA fast gate must actually FIRE in the regime being measured, at its REGISTERED threshold. The only embodied measurement to date (V3-EXQ-895's non-gating SELECTIVITY_PROBE, 4 seeds, 2044 ticks total) recorded embodied_fire_count = 0 on every seed with max ||LowFreq(z_harm_a)||_1/n = 0.216 against cea_fast_route_threshold = 0.5, and fast_prime identically 0.0. Any embodied MECH-074c run must therefore report fire_count > 0 with the threshold at default before any DV is read; a run that LOWERS the threshold to force firing measures the threshold, not the claim, and must be reported non_contributory. Legs 1 (onset latency) and 2 (decay under cortical non-confirmation, plus overridability and boundedness) are ALREADY ANSWERED in the driven regime by V3-EXQ-895 (C1 0 steps <= 2; C2 half-life 4.0 in [3,5]; C3 0.297 <= 0.50; C4 hold 1.0 / separation 0.703; C5 0.8 bound) -- do not re-run them; cite 895.
CONFIRMING (the residual, in-loop leg): with the gate firing at its registered threshold in an embodied run, fast_prime's onset must PRECEDE the AIC/dACC comparator's threshold crossing on the same harm event by >= 3 sim steps on >= 2/3 seeds (the claim's registered 1-2 vs 5-10 step spec, i.e. the ~5:1 fast:slow ratio floored conservatively), while |fast_prime| stays <= cea_mode_prior_log_odds_max so the fast route never dominates cortex, and cortical confirmation arriving inside the override window still holds the pulse (>= 0.90 retained) as it does under driven input.
FALSIFYING: with the gate firing, fast_prime and the AIC crossing are simultaneous, or AIC leads -- the signal is not functionally a PRIME (it arrives too late to prefigure cortical output), which is the module's own registered MECH-074c failure signature. Also falsifying: in-loop, the pulse proves non-overridable (cortical confirmation cannot flip it within the 5-10 step window) -- the override discipline that bounds this claim would then be false in the only regime that matters.
LEG 3 IS NOT A MECH-074c LEG (fused-claim finding, stated here so it stops being re-litigated): "CeA must fire on harm-affective valence, not generic arousal" cannot be tested as a CeA-module manipulation, because CeAAnalog.tick() is a pure function of ||LowFreq(z_harm_a)||_1/n -- a magnitude-matched non-harm drive fires IDENTICALLY by arithmetic (the DV-symmetry artifact class, per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-604c and 895's own interpretation.selectivity_leg). Selectivity is a property of the upstream SD-011 AffectiveHarmEncoder. That leg should be re-registered against SD-011 with 895's already-banked readiness denominator: mean AUROC against the same hazard-proximity label of 0.674 (encoder input), 0.622 (CeA gate statistic), 0.540 (generic activation), reference floor 0.60 -- i.e. the encoder's own harm-discriminativeness is currently only marginally above the floor, which is the real question hiding inside this leg.

MECH-074d.subject: amygdala.bla_pe_remap_with_attribution
MECH-074d.title: BLA analogue emits a remap_signal on harm-PE spike when predictor-attribution flags specific latent codes — partial (~one-third) remap, NOT wholesale replacement.
MECH-074d.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- the attribution head must be given a context-DISCRIMINATING input, and the run must PROVE it in-run before scoring anything. V3-EXQ-894c's decisive reading was that within-context and cross-context Jaccard similarity were IDENTICAL (1.0000 exactly) in 10/15 cells -- the head had converged to a deterministic, context-INVARIANT target set. That is the same signature MECH-153 registered on 2026-03-31 for the E1 ContextMemory store (cosine_sim 0.9999 between hazard-proximate and hazard-distal context vectors, 0/3 seeds), and SD-035's own 2026-08-09 addendum states the legacy write path homogenises the slot bank to off-diagonal cosine 1.0000 within ~24 episodes, "which defeats ANY attribution rule". So a retest is VACUOUS unless it first reports, sustained over the scoring window: off-diagonal ContextMemory slot cosine <= 0.90, AND within-context vs cross-context Jaccard separable at all (not both exactly 1.0). The MECHANICAL half needs no further testing -- 894 and 894a established that candidates compute, the gate fires under `use_e2_harm_a=True`, writes land, and partiality holds, across four PE-sigma thresholds; a fifth run of that is redundant compute.
CONFIRMING: under a store that PASSES the differentiation precondition, and at some operating point, C1 attribution_mass_excess > 0.05 AND C2 context_jaccard_gap > 0.05 on >= 2/3 seeds, with the partiality half still holding (fraction of perturbed codes ~0.33, not wholesale). This is SD-035's open failure_record target verbatim; do not weaken it, and do not substitute C1 alone -- C1 recovered fully under the trained head in 894b (0/3 -> 3/3) while C2, the actual Moita 2004 dissociation this claim is about, stayed at 0/3, so C1 alone is a known false-positive route.
FALSIFYING: with the differentiation precondition demonstrably GREEN, C2 still stays at 0/3 seeds -- the Moita 2004 contextual-vs-auditory dissociation is then not reproducible by an attribution-gated remap in this architecture, and the claim is refuted on its critical half rather than deferred again. Note what would survive that: the partiality half (~one-third remap, not wholesale replacement) held on 2/3 seeds in 894 and could be retained as a narrowed residual claim about remap SHAPE with the attribution-gating half withdrawn. Four routes are already closed by measurement and must not be re-proposed: PE-threshold recalibration/dilution (894a, Spearman -1.0 monotone), trainability alone (894b, doubled budget), entropy_weight/MSE scalar retune (894c, swept [0.02, 0.01, 0.005, 0.001], `passing_arm_ids=[]`, and the predicted C1-vs-C2 tradeoff came out INVERTED at spearman -1.0), and a fifth mechanical-gate readiness run.

MECH-075.subject: basal_ganglia.dopaminergic_attractor_threshold_setting
MECH-075.title: Basal ganglia perform dopaminergic gain/threshold setting on hippocampal attractor dynamics.
MECH-075.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Dorsal: the arousal signal must be LC-sourced and differential at the manipulation (now met), AND the basin-width DV must be shown capable of moving at all under a positive control at decision time -- the untested assumption behind both 905 and 905a. Ventral: the readiness gate (live VTA-RPE signal reaching ventral/motivational terrain with positive grounding correlation) must pass on a seed majority; it has failed twice (1/3 then 2/5).
CONFIRMING: With the manipulation differential and the DV shown movable, basin width widens (dorsal) or narrows (ventral) by the pre-registered floor on >= 2/3 seeds at the asserted decision-time boundary. Manipulation: Dorsal: high versus low LC arousal gain on the CEM proposal distribution (LC_GAIN re-derived against the observed arousal_ema distribution, not inherited from a failed design). Ventral: high versus low VTA-RPE reinforcement gain on ventral/motivational terrain. Control: Matched seeds with the gain lever as the only difference, plus a manipulation check reported BEFORE any downstream metric, and a positive control establishing that the chosen DV can move by the pre-registered floor under a synthetic gain. Required event: Dorsal: episodes on spatial/planning terrain with a differential high-versus-low LC arousal signal present at CEM proposal time. Ventral: episodes in which a live-computed VTA-RPE signal demonstrably reaches valence/motivational terrain. DV: Dorsal: hippocampal attractor basin width / trajectory diversity, required to WIDEN under high arousal by a pre-registered effect-size floor on >= 2/3 seeds. Ventral: basin width required to NARROW under high RPE gain on the same terms.
FALSIFYING: The manipulation is differential, the DV is demonstrably movable under a positive control, and basin width still does not move -- which at the decision-time boundary is now the measured result (905a) and points at the boundary rather than at the mechanism. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: experiments/v3_exq_905a_mech075_dorsal_lc_arousal_probe.py records arousal_ema, the C1 differentiality check and basin_width; 903a records the ventral readiness gate with per-seed grounding correlation. basin_width is a decision-time statistic and showed literally zero movement (2/3 seeds identical to 4+ decimals) even with a 40x gain. Consumer / boundary: Asserted at hippocampal attractor dynamics during CEM proposal generation. The literature registered against this claim in 2026-08-11 places the LC/NE effect at encoding and plasticity timescales instead. Existing ownership: MECH-043, MECH-073, EXP-0002, V3-EXQ-905a, V3-EXQ-903a.
DISPOSITION: R6 (primary); The dorsal DV sits at the wrong boundary. basin_width is a within-decision CEM statistic, while the claim's own registered literature (Wagatsuma 2018, Prince 2021) grounds LC/NE action at encoding and plasticity timescales; McKenzie 2025 is within-session but on a minutes scale. The ventral leg is separately blocked on a readiness gate that has failed on two successive seed budgets. Secondary classes: R5, R1. Gap disposition: INSTRUMENT EXISTS BUT WRONG LOCUS/TIMESCALE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: Three of the WWA's load-bearing statements are now false. (a) signal magnitude and (b) anatomical targeting were both CLEARED -- V3-EXQ-905 passed P0 and C1 cleanly and 905a re-derived LC_GAIN 2.0 -> 80.0 with a clearly differential manipulation on 3/3 seeds. The 'corrected axis-specific retest has never been queued' governance paragraph is obsolete: 903, 903a, 905 and 905a all ran. And the dorsal FALSIFYING clause has now literally occurred, but the 2026-08-10 autopsy read it as a construct-validity gap (the cited LC/NE literature grounds plasticity-timescale, not decision-time, effects), which the WWA does not anticipate. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-076.subject: residue.hippocampal_map_structural_deformation
MECH-076.title: Residue is structural deformation of hippocampal map topology (CA3 retraction, DG neurogenesis, reconsolidation).
MECH-076.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: For the geometry leg, residue-induced basin depth must vary across arms with the behavioural readout off floor and ceiling (V3-EXQ-773 established this). For the three biological legs, V3 must be able to express the mechanism at all -- re-verified today that ree_core contains no neurogenesis, dendritic-retraction, palimpsest or reconsolidation machinery, so no run can be non-degenerate for them.
CONFIRMING: Behavioural avoidance is graded in basin depth and acts at a distance (already established by V3-EXQ-773), and, for the full claim, a structural change in the map (capacity loss, trace overwriting) would have to be shown to be the vehicle rather than a scalar field value. Manipulation: Dose-response over residue basin depth with the terrain as the only differing factor (the V3-EXQ-773 design), and, for the untested legs, a structural manipulation of map capacity or trace overwriting that does not exist in V3. Control: Matched arms at zero and intermediate basin depth with identical candidate pools and identical z_world encoding, so the effect is attributable to terrain geometry alone. Required event: Accumulated harm at specific z_world locations producing graded residue, followed by later trajectory selection passing near and far from those locations. DV: Geometry leg: peak-avoidance monotone in basin depth, and the capture-versus-far share shift showing avoidance acts at a distance rather than as a peak-only lookup. Untested legs would need a capacity or overwrite DV -- for example, whether a later trace partially overwrites an earlier one at the same location (palimpsest) rather than adding to it.
FALSIFYING: Avoidance is threshold-like rather than graded, or is confined to the peak location (a lookup gate rather than geometry), or persists unchanged when the terrain is flattened -- and, for the structural legs, residue influence that survives any manipulation of map structure would falsify the deformation framing. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ResidueField records total_residue, per-location magnitude and the basin geometry the selector scores over; evaluate_trajectory reads the terrain. Nothing records map capacity, unit turnover or trace overwriting, because no such process exists. Consumer / boundary: Trajectory-level selection pressure exerted by the terrain itself, rather than a representational filter layered on perception. Existing ownership: V3-EXQ-773, ARC-013, MECH-056, MECH-073, MECH-077.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); The claim bundles one V3-expressible sub-claim (basin geometry, already passed by V3-EXQ-773) with three biological instantiations -- CA3 retraction, DG neurogenesis, reconsolidation palimpsest -- that ree_core cannot express at all. The claim is credited confirmed_established on one of the five mechanisms it names, so the narrowing is the real action, not a new experiment. Secondary classes: R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-077.subject: hippocampal.therapeutic_remapping
MECH-077.title: Therapeutic change equals hippocampal remapping, with modalities operating at different levels.
MECH-077.what_would_answer:

MECH-081.subject: e1_e2.e2_sufficiency_constraint_reduces_e1_dimensionality
MECH-081.title: E2 sufficiency constraint reduces E1 effective dimensionality target.
MECH-081.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: There must be an actual E2-driven objective term acting on the E1/world encoder that can be armed and severed at matched data and matched E1 self-supervised objective; and the effective-dimensionality metric must have non-zero seed range in both arms rather than saturating at a floor or ceiling.
CONFIRMING: E1 trained with the E2 sufficiency term shows measurably lower effective dimensionality than E1 trained alone at matched data and objective, the retained dimensions are predictive of E2 transition accuracy, and down-weighting the term moves dimensionality back toward the E1-alone baseline on >= 2/3 seeds. Manipulation: Arm the E2 sufficiency term on the encoder versus sever it (detach), holding the sensory distribution, the encoder architecture, the seed and E1's own unsupervised objective fixed; a down-weighting sweep of that term gives the dose-response leg. Control: E1 trained alone under the identical SD-070 self-supervised objective at matched compute and matched seeds, plus a random-init encoder as the untrained dimensionality reference (the 1010 finding that random init can match or beat the trained latent makes this control load-bearing). Required event: Training of the E1 world representation on a fixed sensory data distribution, once with E2's transition-prediction sufficiency constraint acting top-down on the encoder and once without it. DV: Effective dimensionality of the E1 world representation (participation ratio over z_world samples, and/or the minimum decoder capacity needed to hit a fixed prediction bar) under E2-present versus E2-severed, plus the second clause: whether the dimensions retained under E2-present are predictive of E2's transition-prediction accuracy rather than merely fewer.
FALSIFYING: Effective dimensionality is unchanged or increases under the E2 term, or the two conditions are indistinguishable given seed variance -- feature discovery is not offloaded top-down. Lower dimensionality WITHOUT the retained dimensions predicting E2 accuracy is a mixed result (generic regularisation), not a confirm. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The dimensionality readout exists and is validated: _participation_ratio in v3_exq_787 and the trained-versus-untrained PR baselines recorded in zworld_p0.py:8-11 and :75-85 (untrained 9.21 -> trained 5.27 etc.). The manipulation instrument -- an armable E2 sufficiency term on the encoder -- does not exist. Consumer / boundary: The E2-to-E1 training-time constraint edge: whether E2's prediction task pre-specifies what E1 must resolve, measured on E1's representation, not on E2's accuracy. Existing ownership: EXP-0820, SD-027, MECH-033, ARC-002.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); There is no E2-to-E1 gradient or objective path to arm or sever: the encoder optimizer group holds only encoder parameters and E2 trains on detached transitions, so both arms of the required contrast are the same arm. The DV instrument, unusually, is the part that already exists. Secondary classes: R1, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's condition (a) -- a matched pair of E1 training conditions, E2 top-down sufficiency constraint active versus E1 trained alone -- presupposes an E2-to-E1 training-time edge that does not exist in current code. The world encoder is trained solely by the SD-070 self-supervised recipe (grounding CE + VICReg + optional reconstruction; the optimizer group at zworld_p0.py:470 contains only world_encoder parameters), E2's losses train only E2's own heads on detached buffers, and the `topdown` argument in SplitEncoder.encode is the E1-internal delta->theta->beta cascade, not E2. So there is nothing to arm or sever and the manipulation as written is unbuildable rather than merely unqueued. Coordinator: Prerequisite candidate (armable/severable E2-sufficiency training term on the E1/world encoder) NOT registered: it is a mechanism-class build the auditor itself flagged as deserving a harder look and offered 'narrow to a V4 design commitment' as the alternative; the existing owner is MECH-523 (compression sites systematically untrained; no loss reaches the encoders) and the claim itself. Governance decides between narrowing and a build row. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-082.subject: e1_e2.top_down_perceptual_bias_propagation
MECH-082.title: Hippocampal map distortion propagates through E2 to bias E1 attentional sampling without explicit E1 retraining.
MECH-082.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: An E2-to-E1 sampling-control consumer must be live; E1 weights must remain fixed and map distortion must change E2 predictions without changing sensory input.
CONFIRMING: Map distortion changes E1 sampling only when the E2 feedback channel is intact. Manipulation: Distort map-derived E2 predictions; separately cut E2-to-E1 sampling feedback. Control: Undistorted maps and equal-magnitude nonsemantic perturbation, with frozen E1. Required event: Matched sensory evidence under intact versus distorted hippocampal maps. DV: Per-dimension E1 sampling allocation and residue-consistent sampling bias before any E1 retraining.
FALSIFYING: With the feedback consumer demonstrably engaged, distortion does not bias E1 sampling or the bias remains unchanged after feedback ablation. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: No live E2-to-E1 attentional-sampling channel identified; existing E1 prediction metrics do not record sampling allocation. Consumer / boundary: E2 prediction to E1 perceptual sampling, upstream of learning. Existing ownership: MECH-081, MECH-082, GFLAG-0317.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The sampling-control consumer and its allocation DV are absent. R2 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-083.subject: acetylcholine.meta_level_plasticity_gain
MECH-083.title: Acetylcholine as meta-level plasticity gain governing durable-write vs read-through.
MECH-083.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a continuous ACh-analogue plasticity-gain parameter in ree_core, distinct from the binary hypothesis_tag gate, causally read at hippocampal write time (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py, ree_core/residue/field.py) and continuously modulating write/accumulation strength. Currently FAILS: ree_core contains zero occurrences of "acetylcholine"; the only write gate at these sites is the boolean hypothesis_tag (MECH-094). MECH-094's own notes name this exact gap and point to a "candidate implementation" (MECH-249, continuous ACh/NE state variable) that is itself unbuilt and status: candidate. Until a scalar ACh-gain channel exists and is wired to write strength, no non-degenerate experiment can distinguish "continuous gain" from "binary gate."
CONFIRMING: once built, sweeping the ACh-gain parameter across a continuous range during otherwise-identical replay/rehearsal trajectories produces EITHER a monotonic dose-response OR an interior-optimum (peak-then-decline) dose-response in map-update magnitude (residue accumulation, MECH-076 basin-steepness change) -- not a step function -- (cross-reference MECH-592, [2026-09-25 governance-20260925; GFLAG-0541]: Bolognani et al. 2006 HuD/ELAVL4 documents a non-monotonic interior-optimum gain mechanism that would make strict monotonicity the wrong universal prediction) -- and specifically that high-gain retrieval of a stuck/looping rollout produces a measurably deeper attractor basin than low-gain retrieval of the same rollout (the OCD-relevant failure mode this claim's own notes predict).
FALSIFYING: (a) [2026-09-25 governance-20260925; GFLAG-0541] once built, the dose-response is FLAT/NO dose-response, or a shape inconsistent with BOTH the monotonic and the interior-optimum (peak-then-decline) forms admitted above (widened from a strict monotonic-only requirement per GOVERNANCE DECISION rec-20260925-deedce42 option (a), since nothing is built yet and MECH-592's HuD/ELAVL4 mechanism would make strict monotonicity the wrong universal prediction while leaving open that REE's implementation could still legitimately be built either way) -- falsifies the "continuous, not binary" component specifically, even though durable-write/rehearsal separation (INV-019) may still hold. (b) the binary hypothesis_tag gate is found sufficient to explain the separation with no unexplained residual variance -- as INV-019's own wave-15 audit already found for the E1/simulate() pathway (V3-EXQ-499/633/880 PASS via hypothesis_tag alone) -- which would falsify this claim's requirement of a CONTINUOUS ACh mechanism as architecturally necessary, without falsifying ACh's biological plausibility or INV-019's coarser separation claim.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): MECH-083 and MECH-249 look like an unmerged near-duplicate pair -- both propose "ACh as continuous hippocampal-write- gain parameter, replacing a binary switch," registered a month apart (2026-03-15 vs 2026-04-16), never cross-referenced in claims.yaml, both still candidate with no substrate. MECH-249 is the broader claim (adds NE, spans multiple action-modes); MECH-083 is the narrower hippocampal-specific case tied to INV-019/INV-024. Worth a governance pass to either cross-reference them or fold MECH-083 into MECH-249 as the hippocampal-specific sub-case.

MECH-085.subject: serotonin.hippocampal_map_geometry_parameter
MECH-085.title: Serotonin as hippocampal map geometry parameter (rollout depth, distal value weighting) — conflict with MECH-006, pending adjudication.
MECH-085.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: tonic_5ht_enabled must be on (default False) and wanting_weight non-zero, or every arm is bit-identical; and rollout depth must be separately observable from value weighting, since mode_horizon_scale is keyed on operating_mode and carries no serotonin term.
CONFIRMING: A live path in which tonic_5ht (or z_goal_seeding_gain / valence_wanting_floor) is read by the rollout-depth or scoring-window logic or by a discount term, or an experiment in which varying tonic_5ht causally shifts measured effective rollout depth or distal-versus-proximal weighting. Manipulation: Set tonic_5ht high versus low (or clamp it) with serotonin enabled, in a design that separates the wanting-gradient path from any rollout-depth or discount path. Control: A serotonin-disabled arm and a wanting_weight-zero arm at matched seeds, plus a direct mode_horizon_scale manipulation as the positive control that effective rollout depth is measurable at all. Required event: A sustained shift in tonic_5ht during waking, in an episode containing both proximal and distal attractors so a change in temporal weighting could express itself. DV: Measured effective rollout depth (the CEM scoring-window fraction actually applied, recorded as _last_mode_horizon_scale) and the distal-versus-proximal weighting of selected trajectories, each regressed on tonic_5ht rather than on general goal-seeking strength.
FALSIFYING: Varying tonic_5ht leaves effective rollout depth and distal-versus-proximal weighting unchanged once the wanting-gradient path is controlled for -- the map-geometry reading then reduces to general goal-seeking strength. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: HippocampalModule records _last_mode_horizon_scale and _last_operating_mode, so effective depth is recordable; there is no recorder tying a depth or discount parameter to tonic_5ht because no such parameter reads it. Consumer / boundary: The CEM rollout-depth / scoring-window machinery (config.horizon, mode_horizon_scale) or a temporal-discount term -- not the wanting gradient, which is a spatial value bias rather than a temporal-distance weighting. Existing ownership: MECH-267, MECH-006, EXP-0336, SD-032a.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The rollout-depth leg has no consumer: tonic_5ht writes only z_goal_seeding_gain, valence_wanting_floor, benefit/harm salience tags and the replay drive_state, while mode_horizon_scale is keyed on operating_mode from a coordinator with no serotonin term. The distal-weighting leg now has an indirect path via residue VALENCE_WANTING and wanting_weight, which the current WWA does not acknowledge. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's grep finding ('zero references to tonic_5ht in hippocampal/module.py', 'no live write path') is no longer accurate as stated: tonic_5ht feeds VALENCE_WANTING through SerotoninModule.update_benefit_salience into the residue field, and HippocampalModule's CEM terrain score subtracts wanting_weight * mean VALENCE_WANTING along the trajectory, so serotonin DOES reach trajectory value weighting. What remains true, and is what the rewrite must say, is that no path reaches rollout DEPTH or any temporal-discount term. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-086.subject: dopamine.trajectory_selection_gain_plane
MECH-086.title: Dopamine as trajectory selection gain plane operating downstream of landscape, state, and encoding gate.
MECH-086.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The selection stage must be in the regime the gain lever actually reaches. V3-EXQ-775 forced the UNCOMMITTED multinomial branch because the committed branch is a temperature-blind argmin, so a gain sweep run in the committed regime is degenerate unless a graded commit-temperature consumer is armed. Decisiveness must also be measured from real draws, not from the analytic softmax, or the dose-response is an identity.
CONFIRMING: Decisiveness rises monotonically with gain on both landscapes; quality improves with gain only on a clean landscape; low gain yields the indecision pole and high gain over a distorted landscape yields confident selection of a bad trajectory -- all four already passed on 3 of 3 seeds in V3-EXQ-775, and the extension confirms the same non-rescue when the degraded plane is state or encoding, with commitment latency shortening as gain rises. Manipulation: A gain ladder over the E3 softmax temperature crossed with landscape quality (clean versus scrambled), as V3-EXQ-775 ran; the untested extension crosses the same ladder with degradation of the OTHER two upstream planes (state representation and encoding mode) and measures time-to-commit as well as which candidate wins. Control: Matched seeds at baseline gain on each landscape, plus the P0 positive-control readiness check that the uncommitted regime is actually occupied. Required event: Repeated trajectory selections over a candidate pool whose score landscape is independently controllable, in both a clean and a value-decoupled landscape, and -- for the untested half -- selections under commitment with a latency to commit. DV: Realised decisiveness (normalised entropy of actual selector draws), true quality of the selected trajectory read off the clean landscape, and -- for the untested half -- ticks to commitment at each gain level, plus whether raising gain rescues quality when the degraded plane is state representation or encoding rather than landscape.
FALSIFYING: Decisiveness does not track gain; or gain improves quality equally on a distorted landscape (the plane manufactures value it did not receive, contradicting the hierarchical constraint); or high gain over a distorted landscape produces low rather than high confidence; or gain changes which rollout wins but never how quickly. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: V3-EXQ-775's driver records draws, decisiveness and oracle quality through the real e3.select path; BetaGate diagnostics and committed_run_length would carry the commitment-latency DV. No instrument currently records latency-to-commit under a gain sweep, and no arm degrades the state or encoding planes. Consumer / boundary: The E3 trajectory-selection stage as a gain plane operating over whatever landscape it receives -- downstream of landscape, state and encoding, and upstream of action. Existing ownership: V3-EXQ-775, MECH-087, V3-EXQ-674, MECH-085, MECH-043.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The selection-gain dose-response and both pathology poles are already established (V3-EXQ-775, 4 of 4 signatures, 3 of 3 seeds). What no experiment does is the rest of the claim: the 'how quickly' clause has no latency DV, and the cannot-compensate clause was tested only against landscape degradation, not against the state-representation or encoding planes. In the committed branch the gain lever is bypassed entirely. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-087.subject: neuromodulation.four_plane_hierarchical_ordering
MECH-087.title: Hierarchical ordering of four neuromodulatory control planes: ACh → NA → 5-HT → DA.
MECH-087.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Each plane in the pair under test needs its own lesion and augmentation lever that does not act on the same knob as the other plane, plus the four readiness checks V3-EXQ-674 used (discriminative clean landscape, lesion moves the argmin, the gain knob modulates decisiveness). Only the serotonin-landscape by dopamine-temperature pair satisfies this today.
CONFIRMING: For each ordered pair, downstream augmentation fails to rescue an upstream lesion while same-plane repair does, with distinct failure signatures per plane and with intervention order mattering in the predicted direction. Manipulation: Lesion one plane and attempt rescue with the adjacent downstream plane's augmentation, then reverse the roles, for each ordered plane pair in the ACh -> NA -> 5-HT -> DA chain. Control: Same-plane rescue arm (the plane's own knob restores performance) plus the clean, unlesioned landscape, matched seeds and matched effect size across levers. Required event: A forced uncommitted selection regime in which the softmax stage is operative, combined with a lesion applied at one plane's locus. DV: The asymmetry in rescue fraction between the lesioned plane's own knob and the downstream plane's knob, per ordered pair -- downstream augmentation must fail to rescue an upstream lesion while upstream repair succeeds.
FALSIFYING: Downstream augmentation rescues an upstream lesion as effectively as same-plane repair, or the rescue asymmetry reverses, so the planes are orthogonal rather than hierarchically ordered. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The V3-EXQ-674 harness records rescue fractions at the real E3 softmax stage and is reusable; but ree_core has no ACh-analog module at all, and the NA-analog lever (PhasicSurpriseBurst) modulates the same softmax temperature the DA plane is mapped to, so the NA/DA pair has no separable knob to record. Consumer / boundary: The ordered dependency between neuromodulatory planes as expressed at E3 selection -- upstream plane outputs entering the downstream plane's operation. Existing ownership: MECH-083, MECH-084, MECH-161, EXP-1365.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); Three of the six ordered pairs cannot be built: no ACh-analog plane exists in ree_core, so no ACh lesion event can be generated; and the NA analog acts on the softmax temperature already mapped to DA, so an NA-versus-DA dissociation is degenerate by construction. Only the 5-HT by DA pair has been testable, and it passed. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).
