MECH-089.subject: multirate.fast_to_slow_temporal_batching
MECH-089.title: E1 updates are batched into theta-cycle summaries before reaching E3 (cross-frequency temporal packaging).
MECH-089.what_would_answer:
ALREADY-ESTABLISHED (do not re-litigate): uniform static-k theta batching
(k=1, 2, 4) is CONFIRMED HARMFUL for harm attribution (EXQ-066: batched
error 2.28x worse than raw; EXQ-122: harm_auc delta=-0.135 adverse
direction, C1/C2/C3 fail). This is settled; only the context-gated
redesign remains open.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a context-dependent (non-uniform)
theta window implementation to exist and be tested against a fixed
static-k baseline with non-zero cross-condition variance on harm_auc /
prediction-error metrics -- a run using only static-k configurations
cannot reopen this question, it can only reproduce the already-confirmed
weakening.
CONFIRMING signature: a context-gated theta window (batching only during
stable/uncommitted windows, not uniformly) shows harm_auc and
prediction-error metrics AT LEAST at raw (unbatched) levels during
volatile/committed windows, while still providing the batching benefit
(reduced update-rate cost to E3) during stable windows -- i.e. the gating
recovers what static k=2/k=4 lost.
FALSIFYING: a context-gated variant STILL shows the adverse direction
(batched worse than raw) even during stable windows, or no context-gating
scheme recovers the static-k losses -- would indicate E1->E3 temporal
batching is not a viable mechanism at any granularity and the
theta-gamma framing should be retired in favour of raw pass-through.

MECH-090.subject: control_plane.commitment_gated_policy_output
MECH-090.title: BG-level beta oscillations gate E3-to-action-selection propagation, not E3 internal updating.
MECH-090.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Beyond the AT-tick handle check the claim already names, the run must supply CONTINUATION OPPORTUNITIES: chunk_max_size large enough that a non-zero count of E3 ticks arrive with an unexpired, unexhausted arc071-sourced committed program, and a regime in which beta_elevated is not constant across every tick, otherwise the short-circuit predicate and its gate conjunct are both arithmetically pinned.
CONFIRMING: At a chunk supply with a non-zero opportunity count, the short-circuit ON arm holds committed-program object identity across E3 ticks and shows a strictly lower tick-rate-normalised genuine-commit count than the matched OFF arm; hold and release concordance both near 1.0 across trained and fresh agents; and elevation is blocked under the reproduced degenerate low-variance signature while still admitted when readiness clears. Manipulation: Cross use_e3_reselection_shortcircuit ON versus OFF at a matched chunk supply, with use_persistent_committed_program_handle scoped to the probe phase only so formation is not perturbed, and separately drive an E3 internal-model update while the gate is confirmed elevated. Control: A matched OFF arm at identical seeds and identical chunk supply (V3-EXQ-871b had none), plus the fresh high-variance uncommitted agent of the EXQ-049e two-condition design as the release-side comparator. Required event: An E3 heartbeat tick arriving mid-execution of an unexpired ARC-071-sourced committed program, together with completion events and surprise-gated variance spikes that give the gate genuine opportunities to hold and to release. DV: Tick-rate-normalised genuine-commit count n_genuine_commits / n_e3_ticks decomposed into exhausted-chunk, episode-start and opportunity re-commit ticks; hold_concordance and release_concordance; BetaGate hold_count versus propagation_count during elevated windows; and mech090_n_elevation_blocked / _admitted under the reproduced seed-42 degenerate signature.
FALSIFYING: With the fix active, an OFF control present and opportunities non-zero, committed-trajectory identity still fails to persist across E3 ticks, or an E3 internal update is shown to change the selected action during a confirmed-elevated window, or the R-c admission conjunction is arithmetically inert (blocked count zero across a regime including the seed-42 degenerate signature with counters confirmed wired). A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/heartbeat/beta_gate.py exposes propagation_count, hold_count, get_held_state and the mech090_n_elevation_admitted / _blocked / _last_readiness_score_margin diagnostics; v3_exq_871b implements the tick-rate-normalised DV and per-tick beta_elevated records. What is absent is an OFF control arm and a chunk supply that makes the opportunity denominator non-zero. Consumer / boundary: The propagation boundary between E3 internal model state and policy output -- upstream of the committed-selection argmin, so it is not absorbed by the shared conversion path. Existing ownership: MECH-090, ARC-071, GFLAG-0079, V3-EXQ-871b, commitment_closure:GAP-4.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The substrate is built and exercised, but the only post-fix run had no control arm, a constant beta conjunct (959/959 ticks elevated) and zero continuation opportunities, so its prescribed DV was pinned at a mechanical floor. Nothing in the substrate blocks a discriminating run; the chunk supply and an OFF arm are experiment-side. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The registered non-degeneracy precondition has since been met and measured, and the measurement showed the prescribed DV cannot discriminate. V3-EXQ-871b (2026-08-29, autopsied 2026-09-02) recorded n_genuine_commits_identity_based 83 < 104 and 53 < 99, so the 871a defect signature is genuinely absent; but its own decomposition gives 73 exhausted-chunk E3 ticks plus 10 episode starts and zero opportunity re-commits, so the n_genuine_commits / n_e3_ticks ratio sat at a mechanical floor, both cells ran the same arm with no OFF control, and beta_elevated was true on 959/959 ticks so the gate's beta conjunct could not vary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. MECH-092.subject: hippocampal.quiescent_offline_replay
MECH-092.title: Quiescent E3 heartbeat cycles trigger hippocampal SWR-equivalent replay for viability map consolidation.
MECH-092.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Separate trigger selectivity from consolidation benefit. Nonempty theta content and quiescent E3 ticks must occur; the benefit leg additionally needs a durable consumer, identifiable under-sampled regions and novel-path opportunities. Gate on independently observed writes/reads, not on a positive benefit.
CONFIRMING: Selective quiescent triggering plus a replay-specific improvement concentrated in under-sampled and novel trajectories once the durable consumer exists Manipulation: Suppress quiescent replay or its durable update while retaining the same waking exposure Control: Replay enabled with identical model state, exposure, compute budget and isolated replay/policy RNG streams Required event: Quiescent versus salient E3 cycles after matched waking experience, including rarely traversed and never-executed paths DV: Trigger calls per quiescent/salient tick; separately held-out map/model accuracy by recent, under-sampled and never-executed path class
FALSIFYING: Nonselective triggering, or no map/model benefit with verified consumer engagement and independent headroom; a solely recent-path benefit rejects the stronger generative anti-recency clause A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: EXQ-761 and heartbeat/replay call counters can record the trigger. The current _do_replay assigns replay_trajs and discards them. A downstream update/read ledger and held-out map assay are required under existing mech092-replay-consumer-missing; SD-038 owns anti-recency construction. Consumer / boundary: Waking quiescent E3 replay to durable viability/forward-model state; distinct from SleepLoopManager routing/aggregation/writeback, which already has consumers Existing ownership: mech092-replay-consumer-missing, SD-038, GFLAG-0074, GFLAG-0086.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); Triggering is runnable and already supported; the benefit half cannot run because waking replay output has no durable consumer. MECH-093.subject: affective.z_beta_e3_update_rate_modulation
MECH-093.title: z_beta modulates E3 heartbeat frequency, distinct from precision-weighting.
MECH-093.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: z_beta magnitude must span a range wide enough for the rate map to move: the 2026-08-01 arc071 probe measured z_beta norm topping out at 0.78 against a saturation point of 1.0 across 53,063 steps, so beta_rate_min_steps=5 was never reached and the live floor was 8 of a 5-20 range. Harm must also vary between episodes -- EXQ-097 found the pool skewed 16:1, leaving near-zero between-episode variance.
CONFIRMING: Rate tracks |z_beta| step by step (already met), AND under a dosed harm manipulation the high-arousal arm shows greater policy reactivity and the low-arousal arm greater policy stability at matched harm exposure, with the precision-only arm failing to reproduce the effect. Manipulation: z_beta magnitude driven as an independent variable (hazard-density dose or direct injection into update_e3_rate_from_beta) with beta_magnitude_scale swept, against a beta-modulation-OFF arm holding e3_steps_per_tick fixed at the base value. Control: BETA_MOD_OFF arm at matched fixed cadence, plus a precision-weighting arm (MECH-059) manipulated alone so rate modulation is dissociated from update magnitude -- the 2x2 factorial V3-EXQ-505 already instantiates this control at substrate level. Required event: A sustained high-harm-salience stretch followed by a routine low-harm stretch within the same trained agent, with harm exposure varied as an environmental dose rather than sampled opportunistically. DV: Step-level correlation between |z_beta| and instantaneous 1/e3_steps_per_tick (097b measured r=0.964, n=29937) for the channel leg, and for the functional leg the change in policy reactivity -- action-variance ratio between safe and high-harm phases at matched harm exposure, with harm rate held constant by construction rather than observed.
FALSIFYING: With z_beta dosed across its full expressible range, e3_steps_per_tick moves but policy reactivity/stability does not differ from the fixed-cadence control, or the same behavioural effect is fully reproduced by manipulating precision weighting alone -- which would collapse MECH-093 into MECH-059. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: heartbeat/clock.py update_e3_rate_from_beta (:200-221) sets _current_e3_steps from the z_beta norm and is called every step from agent.py:6108; e3_steps_per_tick and the per-step z_beta norm are both recordable, and V3-EXQ-505 drives MultiRateClock directly. No instrument records harm salience independently of the harm exposure that also drives the policy, which is what the state-selection artifact in EXQ-097b's C2 turned on. Consumer / boundary: MultiRateClock's E3 refresh cadence -- how often E3 re-selects -- as distinct from the precision weighting that scales how much each update counts. Existing ownership: MECH-059, MECH-069, ARC-023, GFLAG-0395, EXP-0110, MECH-161.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The rate channel is wired and proven (097b r=0.964, 505 substrate dissociation PASS). The functional half is non-degenerate only in principle: live z_beta occupies a narrow band (max 0.78 of saturation; cadence floor 8 of 5-20) and harm is pervasive, so between-condition contrast is tiny, and harm exposure confounds the DV because high-z_beta phases ARE high-harm phases by construction. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-094.subject: default_mode.simulation_real_distinction_write_profile
MECH-094.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).
MECH-094.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The audited write path must be LIVE, not merely present: hypothesis_tag=True content must actually be generated and reach the write sites during the run (a zero simulation-firing count is a vacuity signal, not a PASS); the paired waking arm must produce non-zero durable writes on the same channels; and the call-site set must be re-derived from the current tree at run time, never from a stored list.
CONFIRMING: Every write-capable consumer of simulated/replayed content, enumerated from the current tree, explicitly checks the tag and refuses to write, with the sole exception of MECH-322 firing inside its three ANDed preconditions, while the matched waking arm writes normally on the same channels. Manipulation: Simulation/replay mode versus matched waking commitment on identical content, with the hypothesis_tag / simulation_mode flag as the manipulated variable, plus a coverage manipulation: re-derive the write-capable-consumer set from the current tree and assert each member's gate. Control: The matched waking arm is the load-bearing control (without it, "no simulation write" is indistinguishable from "no write at all"), and the MECH-322 sleep-only carve-out is the one sanctioned exception that must be shown to fire strictly inside its three conditions. Required event: A run in which simulate() / _do_replay / the DMN rollout genuinely fires, paired with matched waking episodes that commit and write on the same channels, plus a sleep phase in which the MECH-322 carve-out can be observed under and outside its three ANDed preconditions. DV: Two quantities. Behavioural: durable change in real-experience channels (residue / phi(z) accumulation, valence update, hippocampal RBF/MEL write, chunk formation, novelty/visitation state) under simulation versus waking on matched content. Coverage: the count of write-capable consumers in the CURRENT tree that reach a durable channel without consulting hypothesis_tag, simulation_mode or an equivalent replay_origin flag.
FALSIFYING: Tagged content durably alters ANY real-experience channel through an ungoverned path -- tag ignored, defaulted away by a getattr fallback on a newly landed consumer, or bypassed outside MECH-322's stated conditions -- or the MECH-322 carve-out itself fires in waking DMN, outside sleep phase, or without the replay_origin audit flag. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The behavioural side is instrumented -- ResidueField.accumulate / accumulate_benefit / accumulate_safety / update_valence all take and honour hypothesis_tag, and V3-EXQ-499 / 633 / 880 have run. The COVERAGE side has no instrument: no contract test or audit script enumerates write-capable consumers from the current tree and asserts each gates, so the WWA's third precondition cannot presently be discharged. Consumer / boundary: Every durable real-experience belief-update channel -- the residue field primarily, plus the agent.py gating sites for MEL writes, novelty/visitation buffers, EMA advancement, chunking, escape-affordance learning and pACC/cingulate drive updates. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0285, INV-011, MECH-319, MECH-322, V3-EXQ-880.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The behavioural leg is runnable and has run. The coverage-regression leg has no recorder: nothing re-derives the write-capable-consumer set from the current tree and asserts each gate, and the failure mode the claim names is precisely a NEWLY LANDED consumer that never learned about the tag, which a historical PASS cannot discharge. Secondary classes: R0. Gap disposition: NEW NODE REQUIRED. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA freezes a site count that is wrong against the current tree and that its own third precondition forbids relying on: it says "the ~30 getattr(new_latent, \"hypothesis_tag\", False) sites in ree_core/agent.py", and the measured count today is 21 of that exact form (87 mentions of hypothesis_tag in agent.py overall). GFLAG-0285 is open on precisely this. The rewrite should drop the frozen number in favour of the re-derivation instruction the WWA already carries. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-095.subject: tpj.agency_detection_comparator
MECH-095.title: Temporoparietal junction (TPJ) acts as agency-detection comparator distinguishing self-caused from other-caused change.
MECH-095.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (HARD): a test of MECH-095 is informative only on a
substrate that supplies a genuine second agent -- a structurally-distinct OTHER
whose actions are causally attributable separately from ambient world drift. This
is not a design preference; it is an empirically confirmed requirement. V3-EXQ-741
(2026-07-12) ran the SD-047 multi-source-dynamics comparator test-bed VALIDLY for
the first time (probe-partition guard + self/world training-label-balance guard
both passed, non_degenerate=true) and found the comparator does no functional work
in that single-agent environment (best arm recall_improvement +0.028, below the
0.04 pre-registered floor; ROUTED_A gradient-head HURTS recall -0.114; baseline
already carries contact recall 0.75-0.93). This is the FIRST valid substrate_ceiling
hit for MECH-095 (n_ceiling_hits 0->1) and is read as confirming that world-caused
drift is not a structurally-distinct OTHER, so no single-agent env can make the
comparator load-bearing. The retest is bound to multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-3 (as of
2026-08-06 blocked on MAE-2, per IGW-20260806-139) -- a run on any single-agent
substrate, including a further SD-047 letter, is explicitly REFUSED by the
re-derive brake and should self-route substrate_not_ready, not count as a verdict.
Two prior retests must also NOT be read as verdicts: V3-EXQ-047l (probe-partition
saturation -- no-contact negative class was empty, contact_recall pinned at 0.0 in
both arms) and V3-EXQ-047m (training-label saturation -- is_world ~constant 1 at
intensity 1.0) were both instrumentation/measurement degeneracies, not valid tests
of the comparator; only a run whose guards mirror V3-EXQ-741's (probe-partition
non-degeneracy AND self/world training-label balance, both reported) counts.
CONFIRMING signature: on multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-3 (or a later substrate that
supplies a genuine second agent), a query-time READ-OUT comparator (efference-copy-
predicted vs observed z_self change, additive -- not a gradient head reshaping
z_world) shows recall_improvement > 0.04 in at least one informative
intensity/interaction arm, together with the substrate_queue C1+C2+C3 criteria:
other-agent-event selectivity > 0.5, counterfactual gap (agent-caused minus
other-caused) > 0.1, and attributor calibration (within-arm slope) < 0.5. V3-EXQ-741
found the read-out framing (ROUTED_B, neutral-to-positive at +0.003) already
biologically closer to the claim than the gradient-BCE-head framing (ROUTED_A,
which actively hurt recall) -- a confirming test should use the read-out design.
FALSIFYING signature: if, even with a genuine second agent present and the guards
above satisfied, no arm clears recall_improvement > 0.04 / the C1-C3 criteria
across the full pre-registered intensity/interaction sweep -- this is the
Woo/Spelke branch already named in substrate_queue.json: route MECH-095 from
substrate_ceiling to substrate_conditional (the V4/V5 multi-agent dependency is
then exhausted as an explanation, not merely unbuilt) and flip evidence_direction
to weakens rather than non_contributory.
Evidence base to date is genuinely narrow, not contested-and-unresolved: the sole
positive result (EXQ-047k, 4-seed PASS 5/5) came from one thin single-agent
operationalisation and has not been reproduced by any subsequent valid test -- this
is a single positive base flagged per the illusory-conflict-resolution rule, not a
weighing call for this note to make. Strong literature anchor (Blakemore 2002; Gu
et al. 2008; Pitcher & Ungerleider 2021; Rolls et al. 2023) supports the TPJ
mechanism generically but does not substitute for the substrate-specific
architectural test above.

MECH-096.subject: observation_encoder.dual_stream_routing
MECH-096.title: Dual-stream observation routing sends exteroceptive input to both E1 and a dedicated harm detection pathway.
MECH-096.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: two structurally distinct encoder heads must exist with a TESTABLE frame difference. V3 has the z_self/z_world split (SD-005 SplitEncoder) but nothing that makes one head egocentric and the other allocentric, and nothing that measures which frame either occupies (zero egocentric/allocentric/reference_frame matches in ree_core, verified 2026-09-15) -- the frame half of this claim was never built, and the claim is currently untestable in the vacuous sense ARC-087 records for its own substrate gate.
CONFIRMING: with both heads live, a frame-diagnostic probe recovers self-relative coordinates from z_self and agent-position-invariant coordinates from z_world at above-chance separation, AND removing the architectural distinction (a single encoder with a learned routing gate, the alternative this claim rejects) degrades the separation and the downstream split -- the claim's own stated failure mode, the z_self/z_world split degrading back toward z_gamma conflation.
FALSIFYING: a single encoder with a learned routing gate produces the same downstream behaviour and the same stream separation (the two-head requirement is not load-bearing); OR the two heads exist and neither occupies a recoverable frame, in which case the egocentric/allocentric language should be retired to biological motivation rather than architectural content.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional; NOT excreted -- it is the only place REE records a frame commitment and MECH-555 depends on it. Currency: the frame half is asserted and unimplemented.

MECH-097.subject: peripersonal_space.commit_locus
MECH-097.title: Peripersonal space geometry defines the commit locus — the spatial boundary of committed action.
MECH-097.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Commit must be a discriminable event with non-zero rate in the probe window (beta-gate elevations actually occur and vary), and the spatial envelope under test must be manipulable independently of harm exposure -- otherwise a shift in commit location is confounded with a shift in how often the agent is near a hazard.
CONFIRMING: Commit onsets cluster at a characteristic agent-to-object distance, and that distance shifts with the manipulated envelope extent while harm exposure is held matched. Manipulation: Vary the spatial extent of the near-body envelope -- the contact radius at which self-world consequences interact -- and observe whether the commit boundary moves with it; no such parameter exists, since contamination is an on-cell event and ree_core contains no peripersonal-space representation at all. Control: Matched runs with the envelope parameter unchanged, plus a harm-exposure-matched arm so the commit-distance distribution is not driven by approach frequency. Required event: A commit onset (beta-gate elevation / committed-trajectory latch) during an approach to a hazard or resource cell, recorded together with the agent-to-object distance at that tick. DV: The distribution of agent-to-object distance at commit onset versus at non-commit ticks, and specifically whether its mode tracks the manipulated envelope extent -- not harm-prediction accuracy.
FALSIFYING: Commit-onset distance is unrelated to the envelope extent, or commits are distributed indistinguishably from non-commit ticks in distance -- the commit locus is not spatially defined. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Commit onsets are observable through BetaGate and the E3 selector's commit branches, and grid position is available in the driver, so a commit-with-distance recorder is buildable; nothing records it today, and V3-EXQ-137 recorded harm_eval_gap instead. Consumer / boundary: The commit boundary itself -- where beta elevates and a trajectory is latched -- which the claim asserts coincides with the peripersonal envelope. Existing ownership: SD-005, ARC-016, MECH-091, EXP-1319.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); There is no peripersonal-space representation in ree_core and no manipulable contact-envelope parameter, so the required manipulation cannot be generated. The one run on record, V3-EXQ-137, changed the harm_eval_head input and measured harm_eval_gap; it never touched the commit mechanism, so its FAIL does not bear on the commit-locus claim as stated. Secondary classes: R1, R4. Gap disposition: NEW NODE REQUIRED. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-098.subject: encoder.reafference_cancellation
MECH-098.title: Reafference cancellation: z_world subtracts predicted self-caused sensory change to isolate external events.
MECH-098.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Two must hold and neither has: (a) the ReafferencePredictor must reach the pre-registered held-out R2 >= 0.70 on empty-space steps, trained inside the live loop rather than on sense()-only collected data (measured R2 has been -0.027 to 0.40); and (b) z_world must carry any exogenous-event signal at all, which is what the DV reads.
CONFIRMING: With a competent canceller (held-out R2 >= 0.70) and a z_world channel that carries exogenous-event content, the corrected stream shows strictly higher external-vs-self selectivity than both the OFF and sham arms on a majority of seeds. Manipulation: Reafference correction ON vs OFF (LatentStackConfig.reafference_action_dim > 0, applying z_world_corrected = z_world_raw - predicted locomotion delta in LatentStack.encode), with a mis-paired-action sham arm. Control: Correction OFF with the identical trained encoder and the sham (action-shuffled) correction arm, so the contrast isolates the subtraction rather than the extra module. Required event: Locomotion steps producing a purely reafferent egocentric view shift, interleaved with steps carrying a genuine externally-caused world change. DV: Event selectivity in the corrected z_world: the difference in z_world change between externally-caused-event steps and matched self-motion-only steps (event_selectivity_delta), read out of the corrected stream with a held-out probe.
FALSIFYING: With both preconditions met, selectivity in the corrected stream is indistinguishable from OFF and sham -- subtraction removes self-motion content without isolating external events. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: LatentStack.encode exposes z_world_raw as an SD-007 diagnostic and the 069/082/099a/110/529 drivers compute event_selectivity_delta; what is missing is a DV that can register exogenous events, since zworld_p0.py records transition-type decodability at or below chance in the world_obs channel. Consumer / boundary: The encoder boundary before E2_world -- the claim asserts the cancellation belongs at encoder level, so the DV must be read on the corrected z_world that E2/E3 consume. Existing ownership: MECH-221, MECH-222, SD-106, EXP-0015, SD-007.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The DV does not exist: z_world is a static single-frame encoding and carries transition-type information at or below chance (-0.014 3-class, -0.060 6-class held out), reproduced six times in 2026-09. The manipulation is sound (predictor R2 0.34-0.40, action-sensitive) but every one of the 18 runs measured selectivity in a channel with no exogenous-event signal, under an undertrained canceller. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-099.subject: visual_streams.three_pathway_architecture
MECH-099.title: Visual streams use a three-pathway architecture (ventral/dorsal/frontal) for object, action, and executive routing.
MECH-099.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The TWO-stream comparator must not already be at ceiling on the attribution/harm readout: V3-EXQ-098b measured AUC_TWO 0.9989 against AUC_THREE 0.9942, so the auc_delta DV has no headroom in which a third stream could show an advantage. The lateral head must be built (latent.harm_dim > 0; the config default 0 disables it) and its output must reach the E3 harm evaluation.
CONFIRMING: On a non-saturating test-bed where AUC_TWO sits measurably below ceiling, the THREE_STREAM arm raises attribution/harm AUC and avoidance above the TWO_STREAM and capacity-matched controls at matched seeds. Manipulation: THREE_STREAM arm (harm_dim > 0, SplitEncoder.lateral_head built and z_harm routed into E3 harm evaluation) versus TWO_STREAM arm (harm_dim = 0, lateral head absent), matched seeds, matched training budget, run on the SD-047 multi-source dynamics substrate with a non-saturating routing label. Control: The TWO_STREAM arm at identical seeds/budget, plus a parameter-matched control in which the lateral head exists but receives a shuffled or non-motion input, so extra capacity is separated from the claimed dorsal/ventral/lateral routing. Required event: Episodes containing agent-caused versus environment-caused contact events with motion structure, i.e. trials where dorsal (self-motion), ventral (object identity) and lateral (dynamic/agency) information are separately diagnostic of the outcome. DV: Agency-attribution and harm discrimination measured in a regime where the two-stream comparator is demonstrably below ceiling (report AUC_TWO and its distance from 1.0 as a gating statistic), plus avoidance behaviour; the discriminating quantity is the THREE minus TWO delta conditioned on that headroom.
FALSIFYING: With the comparator demonstrably off ceiling and capacity matched, the lateral head adds nothing or degrades the harm channel, as the run-2 adverse direction (auc_delta -0.0384) suggested -- three-stream routing is over-specification at V3 scale. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/latent/stack.py builds lateral_head from hazard+contamination channels and returns z_harm; ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py harm_eval_lateral consumes it; the 098/098b drivers compute auc_delta. What is missing is a headroom gate on the control arm and a driver that runs on the agency_comparator_testbed_sd047 non-saturating label. Consumer / boundary: The encoder-to-E3 harm/agency evaluation path: whether a third anatomically separate stream adds discriminative information that the two-stream encoder cannot carry. Existing ownership: agency_comparator_testbed_sd047, SD-047, EXP-0112, V3-EXQ-098b.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The two-stream comparator saturates (AUC 0.9989), so auc_delta cannot discriminate; both existing runs measured a ceiling, not the mechanism. The agency_comparator_testbed_sd047 entry exists precisely to supply a non-saturating label, but no MECH-099-tagged experiment uses it (V3-EXQ-121 deliberately excludes MECH-099). Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-100.subject: encoder.event_contrastive_supervision
MECH-100.title: z_world encoder requires event-type cross-entropy auxiliary loss during training.
MECH-100.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: z_world must not be collapsed for reasons unrelated to the event-CE term (both arms must run the SD-070 anti-collapse recipe identically), and the event-type label must be decodable in principle from the encoding the probe reads -- transition_type is a property of the TRANSITION while z_world is a static single-frame encoding, and a probe on raw world_obs with no encoder scores at or below chance for that label.
CONFIRMING: Held-out decodability margin is strict-above the OFF arm by a margin clearing the cross-seed SD on a majority of ready seeds, AND the downstream half shows lower E2_world prediction error or better E3 harm calibration in ON than OFF. Manipulation: Add versus omit the event-type cross-entropy auxiliary loss on the z_world encoder, on top of an otherwise bit-identical training recipe (V3-EXQ-897's ARM_EVENT_CE_ON / ARM_EVENT_CE_OFF). Control: Bit-identical OFF arm (same env exposure, rollout policy, buffer, other heads, optimiser, hyperparameters) plus a validated positive-control probe on a label the world channel is known to carry. Required event: Training episodes containing all three transition types (none / env_caused_hazard / agent_caused_hazard) in sufficient numbers for a class-balanced CE term and a held-out probe. DV: Held-out DECODABILITY MARGIN (macro-recall minus chance) for event type from a frozen-encoder independent probe, ON minus OFF; plus, for the claim's downstream half, E2_world forward prediction error and E3 harm-evaluation calibration on the same arms.
FALSIFYING: OFF matches or exceeds ON on held-out decodability under the current recipe with adequate seeds -- the auxiliary loss is not required for z_world to carry event-discriminative information. V3-EXQ-897 measured exactly this direction (OFF >= ON on 3/3 seeds, deltas -0.025/-0.010/-0.005) but at seed counts too small to be more than sign-consistent, and deliberately did not tag MECH-100. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The substrate wiring exists (config.use_event_classifier, SplitEncoder.event_classifier at latent/stack.py:900/1037, REEAgent.compute_event_contrastive_loss at agent.py:11391) but is an ONLINE per-step batch=1 path, which is SD-070's documented fault 3; V3-EXQ-897 therefore trains the head via an experiment-local ZWorldP0TrainerEventCE subclass and records decodability margin, selectivity_margin and event_classification_acc. Consumer / boundary: The z_world encoder's representation, and the gradient it supplies to E2_world and E3 harm evaluation -- not the classifier head's own accuracy. Existing ownership: SD-009, SD-070, V3-EXQ-897, GFLAG-0020.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The decodability ablation has been run once at 3 seeds and read direction=unknown; the substrate's own SD-009 wiring is unusable under the current recipe (online batch=1 re-arms collapse), and the claim's downstream half (stronger gradient for E2_world / E3 to exploit) is measured by nothing. The label/encoding mismatch may also make the CE target ill-posed. Secondary classes: R5, R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-101.subject: encoder.reafference_world_context_required
MECH-101.title: z_world encoding requires reafference context to correctly attribute external vs self-caused change.
MECH-101.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A LOCAL-VIEW environment in which locomotion reveals new cell content (in a global-view env the delta is fully predictable from body state and the contrast is degenerate), the ReafferencePredictor trained only on empty-space steps where transition_type == 'none', and a non-trivial baseline event selectivity in the uncorrected stream so a change is measurable.
CONFIRMING: reafference_r2 is materially higher with z_world_raw_prev than with z_self_prev (EXQ-027 measured 0.027 on the z_self form) and clears the 0.20 floor, AND event_selectivity_delta >= 0.01 with the ON arm attributing change to external events rather than to locomotion. Manipulation: The predictor's INPUT SOURCE: ReafferencePredictor(z_world_raw_prev, a_prev) as built, versus the pre-fix ReafferencePredictor(z_self_prev, a_prev); plus the predictor ON/OFF ablation for the downstream selectivity readout. Control: Matched seeds, identical env config and identical training budget across input-source arms, with the reafference-OFF arm supplying the uncorrected baseline margin. Required event: Paired step types within the same rollout: pure-locomotion steps (transition_type == 'none', self-caused z_world change only) and external-event steps, so self-caused and externally-caused change can be separated. DV: reafference_r2 -- variance of the locomotion-induced delta-z_world explained by the predictor -- under each input source, and event_selectivity_delta = margin(ON) - margin(OFF) where margin is mean ||delta z_world|| on event steps minus mean ||delta z_world|| on locomotion-only steps.
FALSIFYING: reafference_r2 with z_world_raw_prev is no better than with z_self_prev -- the scene-content term is not what carries the locomotion delta, so world context is not required; or the corrected stream shows no selectivity gain (event_selectivity_delta <= 0), which would mean the correction removes external as well as self-caused change. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/latent/stack.py wires the corrected path (correct_z_world at :1531) and records the predictor fit; v3_exq_027b_sd007_reafference_diagnostic.py and v3_exq_069_reafference_selectivity_pair.py record reafference_r2 and event_selectivity_delta with pre-registered thresholds. Consumer / boundary: z_world encoding in LatentStack.encode, where the predicted self-caused perspective shift is subtracted before the EMA -- upstream of every z_world consumer, not at the policy. Existing ownership: MECH-101, SD-007, MECH-098.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); Runnable now and already run: the input-source contrast is built into stack.py, both DVs have pre-registered thresholds and instrumented drivers (027/027b for the r2 contrast, 069 for the selectivity margin), and two supporting entries are banked (027b and 057). No substrate, event, instrument or consumer is missing. Secondary classes: none. Gap disposition: NO GAP -- FALSE POSITIVE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-102.subject: ethics.violence_as_terminal_error_correction
MECH-102.title: Violence is a terminal error-correction mechanism triggered only when all other channels fail.
MECH-102.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: At least two genuinely available low-energy coordination channels (negotiation, withdrawal, cooperation, arbitration) must exist and be selectable, and their availability must be independently manipulable. With a single hazard-contact action class, 'only when all other channels fail' has no other channels to fail and every arm is trivially identical.
CONFIRMING: Escalation to the high-energy action rises sharply and specifically when low-energy pathways are closed, at matched threat level, and does not rise when they remain available even under equal threat. Manipulation: Ablate or progressively narrow the low-energy coordination repertoire (remove negotiation / withdrawal / cooperation actions) while holding the threat level, the forward model and the high-energy action constant. Control: The full-repertoire arm at matched threat level and matched seeds, plus a matched-threat arm in which pathway closure is only predicted rather than actual, to separate the forward-model framing from temporal last resort. Required event: An agent facing a conflict with another agent where low-energy coordination pathways are available in one condition and destroyed or unavailable in another. DV: Rate and latency of the high-energy intervention as a function of low-energy pathway availability, conditioned on identical threat evidence; and whether the agent's own forward model projects no coherent future via low-energy paths at the moment it escalates.
FALSIFYING: The agent escalates at the same rate with the full low-energy repertoire available as with it removed, at matched threat -- violence is not terminal and is not gated on pathway closure. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Absent. There is no multi-agent environment and no coping-channel action set in ree-v3; CausalGridWorldV2 proxies violence as hazard contact with a random or harm-minimising policy, so the escalation-ladder runs record causal_sig by transition type, not repertoire-conditioned escalation. Consumer / boundary: Trajectory selection over a repertoire of differently-priced coordination actions in a multi-agent setting -- the MAE-1/MAE-4 boundary, not the single-agent harm-gradient selection boundary V3 provides. Existing ownership: multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-4, multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-1, MECH-102, EXP-0007.
DISPOSITION: R8 (primary); V3 has no other agents and no alternative coping channels, so the 'only when all other channels fail' clause has no manipulable independent variable. Ownership is already recorded: governance_note_2026_06_18 reclassified this V5-bound with owner multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-4, and states no V3/V4 enrichment can supply the social coping channels. Secondary classes: R3, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: future_version. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-103.subject: e1.multimodal_exteroception_fusion
MECH-103.title: E1 performs multimodal exteroceptive fusion across sensory modalities before feeding E2.
MECH-103.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: "genuine" multi-modal exteroceptive input requires a second modality sourced independently of the visual/spatial world_state pathway -- not a synthetic channel re-derived from the same underlying grid state (as EXQ-128's "auditory" tone and EXQ-134's "somatosensory" contact signal both were, both computed from hazard_field/resource_field/harm_signal). Re-verified 2026-08-08: ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py still exposes exactly one true exteroceptive channel (world_state, vision/spatial), no independent auditory/somatosensory channel exists. Until V3's environment exposes such a channel, this claim is untestable, not merely under-tested -- confirmed twice (EXQ-128, EXQ-134).
CONFIRMING: once genuine multi-modal input exists, E1's shared world latent (z_S/ z_world) shows measurably more accurate/robust representations with both modalities present than either alone at matched training budget, and degrades gracefully rather than catastrophically when one modality is ablated at test time (precision-weighted evidence combination signature).
FALSIFYING: multi-modal input produces no measurable improvement over vision-only baselines at matched budget, or any observed "fusion" is fully explained by naive channel concatenation with no precision-weighting/complementary-structure signature.

MECH-104.subject: control_plane.volatility_interrupt
MECH-104.title: Unexpected harm events spike commitment uncertainty (LC-NE volatility interrupt), enabling de-commitment.
MECH-104.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. See the group's shared COMMIT-GATE DYNAMIC-RANGE PRECONDITION
(G3 preamble (iii)); do not re-derive it. Specific to this run, the CONTROL (gate-ON,
no-injection) arm must report and satisfy: (a) realised `running_variance` range and its distance
to `effective_threshold` (base 0.40, `config.py:1022`); (b) realised committed-fraction strictly
between 0 and 1 -- a run at 1.0 cannot observe a de-commitment; (c) `n_unexpected_harm_events >= 10`
occurring *in committed state* (V3-EXQ-623 C5); (d) the SD-076 floor's binding fraction --
`running_variance` must not sit at `waking_confidence_rv_floor` for more than 10% of ticks, which
is the exact clamp V3-EXQ-794 hit (`rv_final` EXACTLY 0.010000 on all four arms); and (e)
`breath_period = 0` in BOTH arms, because `from_dims` otherwise arms MECH-108's sweep by
default and a sweep-driven uncommitted window would be misread as a surprise-driven one. And,
load-bearing: no line of the driver may write `agent.e3._running_variance` in the ON arm --
the entire question is whether the endogenous impulse suffices.

CONFIRMING. On a matched-seed pair over >= 3 seeds sharing trained weights and episode
sequence -- ENDOGENOUS-ON vs ABLATED (`_ema_alpha = 0.0`, variance frozen; the V3-EXQ-204
ablation) -- the ON arm shows BOTH legs *in the same arm*: (i) SELECTIVITY: endogenous
`delta_var_unexpected` exceeds `delta_var_expected` by more than 3 SD of the per-seed delta AND by
an absolute floor of 1e-4, in >= 2 of 3 seeds; and (ii) SUFFICIENCY: committed -> uncommitted
transitions attributable to those events (V3-EXQ-623's 20-tick POST_SPIKE_WINDOW attribution)
occur at >= 2.0x the ABLATED arm's rate, with the ABLATED rate reported and non-degenerate, in
>= 2 of 3 seeds. Leg (ii) in the absence of any injection is what has never been shown.

FALSIFYING. Leg (i) replicates and leg (ii) does not: the endogenous `delta_var_unexpected` is
real and selective but stays far below the rv-to-threshold gap, so committed -> uncommitted
transition rates are statistically indistinguishable between ON and ABLATED. V3-EXQ-204's own
endogenous magnitude (`harm_spike_rv ~1.6-1.9e-6` against a ~0.39 gap) *predicts exactly this
outcome*, so it must be treated as the live alternative hypothesis, not the surprise. This
refutes the "enabling de-commitment" half of the title while leaving "spikes commitment
uncertainty" standing, and is grounds to demote MECH-104 from `active` and to re-tag it
`substrate_ceiling`. A second, distinct falsifying pattern: the ABLATED arm shows the *same*
transition rate, which means the observed transitions were never surprise-driven at all (most
likely MECH-108's sweep, or the readiness gates) -- which is why precondition (e) is mandatory.

MECH-105.subject: control_plane.hippocampal_bg_coupling_dopaminergic
MECH-105.title: Hippocampal sequence completion drives BG beta release via subiculum-NAc-VTA dopaminergic loop.
MECH-105.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The producer's achievable range must cross the consumer's threshold: compute_completion_signal must be able to exceed _completion_release_threshold on the configured substrate, heartbeat.beta_gate_bistable must be True (it defaults False, so the agent.py wiring never runs at production config), and the threshold must be reachable as a configured value rather than by poking a private attribute.
CONFIRMING: With a producer range that crosses the threshold, releases attributable to this pathway occur at non-trivial rate and ablating the coupling measurably shifts release latency or total release count relative to the intact arm. Manipulation: Ablate the dopamine-analog coupling: completion signal delivered to BetaGate.receive_hippocampal_completion at its configured threshold versus suppressed, holding every other BetaGate release pathway at identical trigger conditions. Control: Matched seeds and config with all other release pathways (natural commit, maintenance-release, habenula abort) held at identical trigger conditions across arms. Required event: A hippocampal trajectory proposal of high quality (low residue cost) while beta is elevated -- the sequence-completion event the subiculum-NAc-VTA loop is supposed to signal. DV: Release latency and total release count attributable to the completion pathway specifically, plus the rate at which completion_signal crosses threshold -- reported with the realised signal distribution so an unreachable threshold is visible.
FALSIFYING: With the range/threshold parity established and the pathway firing, release timing and rate are statistically indistinguishable between arms -- every release would have fired anyway via another pathway, so the loop is architecturally present but functionally redundant. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: HippocampalModule.compute_completion_signal caches _last_completion_signal and BetaGate exposes completion_release_threshold and _last_completion_signal in its state; the 944 family reports that the pathway never fires, but the per-tick signal distribution is not persisted in any manifest. Consumer / boundary: The BetaGate release decision -- the bridge from the hippocampal trajectory candidacy gate to the BG policy propagation gate. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0344, ARC-028, EXP-0827, MECH-290.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The signal can never cross the gate. compute_completion_signal returns sigmoid(-best_score*0.5) on a non-negative residue cost (RBF weights start at zero and accumulate positive magnitude; all three subtractive terms default to zero), giving a range of (0, 0.5] against a 0.75 threshold; the module docstring's stated [0.5, 1.0) range is inverted. beta_gate_bistable also defaults False, so the wiring does not run at production config. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: NEW NODE REQUIRED. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's non-degeneracy precondition checks only that the three wiring changes exist, which they do. The binding blocker found 2026-09-18 (GFLAG-0344) is arithmetic: compute_completion_signal = sigmoid(-best_score*0.5) over a non-negative residue cost, so its achievable range is (0, 0.5] and the 0.75 release threshold is unreachable as an identity -- the specified ON/OFF ablation yields bit-identical arms. The WWA's FALSIFYING branch would therefore record a scaling defect as evidence that the pathway is functionally redundant. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-106.subject: control_plane.commitment_hysteresis_outcome_valence
MECH-106.title: Commitment threshold is asymmetrically modulated by outcome valence: positive outcomes lower it, negative outcomes raise it.
MECH-106.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. See the group's shared COMMIT-GATE DYNAMIC-RANGE PRECONDITION
(G3 preamble (iii)); do not re-derive it -- and note MECH-106 needs it *twice over*, because both
the base threshold and the valence-modulated threshold must sit where `running_variance` can
actually cross them. Specific to this claim: (a) the run must exhibit a differentiated valence
history -- `da_pos - da_neg > 0.20` measured, which is the precise failure that made the original
V3-EXQ-231 a design flaw rather than a claim failure ("PERSISTENT and REACTIVE conditions produced
identical commit values"); (b) latency-to-commit must be finite and unsaturated in BOTH the
positive-history and negative-history conditions -- an episode-length-censored latency in the
negative condition measures the episode budget, not the threshold; (c) the modulation must be
implemented asymmetrically, i.e. with independent gains for the positive and negative
directions (`w_pos != w_neg` as free parameters), because a symmetric linear map makes the
asymmetry criterion an arithmetic consequence of the divergence criterion (see V3-EXQ-231a above)
and therefore vacuous; (d) MECH-104's impulse and SD-011's urgency term must be pinned OFF
(`urgency_weight = 0.0`, no rv injection) -- they move the same inequality (G3 preamble (iv)).

CONFIRMING. With independent positive/negative gains and a matched-seed VALENCE_BIAS vs NO_BIAS
ablation over >= 5 seeds: (i) the direction leg, SIGN-INVERTED 2026-09-10 under GFLAG-0164
option (A) -- the superseded text required latency-to-commit to be LONGER after negative
outcomes; under this claim's own arithmetic a raised threshold is MORE permissive against the
variance gate, so the registered prediction had the wrong sign and any run scored against it was
scored backwards -- mean latency-to-commit is SHORTER after a negative-outcome history than
after a positive one in the VALENCE_BIAS arm, by more than 3 SD of
the per-seed latency delta and by an absolute floor of 5 ticks, in >= 4 of 5 seeds, while the
NO_BIAS arm shows a latency ratio inside [0.5, 2.5] (V3-EXQ-231a's C4, retained as the
no-manipulation control); and (ii) the asymmetry leg, which is the claim's actual content --
the fitted `|w_neg| / |w_pos|` is bounded away from 1.0 (>= 1.5, or <= 0.67) with a
per-seed-bootstrap CI excluding 1.0, in >= 4 of 5 seeds. Leg (ii) must be measured, not assumed:
it is what separates MECH-106 from the weaker claim "outcome valence modulates the commit
threshold at all".

FALSIFYING. Either (i) fails -- valence history does not shift commitment latency once
MECH-104 and SD-011 are pinned off, which would say the EXQ-231a result was carried by the
driver's hand-set `BIAS_WEIGHT` rather than by any property of outcome valence -- or (i) passes
and (ii) fails, i.e. `|w_neg| / |w_pos|` is statistically indistinguishable from 1.0. The second
is the more likely and the more informative: it would refute MECH-106 *as written* (asymmetric)
while supporting a narrower successor ("outcome valence modulates the commit threshold
monotonically"), and would be grounds to demote from `provisional` and re-title. A third pattern:
the seed-42 anomaly recorded in `evidence_quality_note` ("near-zero divergence, no commitments")
recurs on more than 1 of 5 seeds -- that is precondition (a) failing, not a result, and the run
must be re-designed rather than adjudicated.

MECH-107.subject: respiratory.exhalation_trajectory_abandonment
MECH-107.title: Exhalation is the physiological instantiation of E3 trajectory-abandonment — each exhale sweeps pre-commit rollouts for viability and clears the hypothesis tag.
MECH-107.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The commit gate must be in a regime where the threshold can be crossed in both directions -- committed_step_fraction inside roughly [0.15, 0.85] with mean committed-run length at least 3 -- which currently requires use_variance_tracking_commit_threshold armed with a pre-registered quantile and window; and episodes must be longer than breath_period minus sweep_duration or no sweep fires at all.
CONFIRMING: Sweep-window occurrence correlates positively with sweep-locked abandonment rate and negatively with committed-run length, with the effect surviving control for SD-011 urgency and SD-093 velocity. Manipulation: Vary breath_period and breath_sweep_amplitude (HeartbeatClock, wired through agent.py as sweep_threshold_reduction into E3Selector's effective_threshold) across arms, including a breath_period=0 off arm. Control: Breath-off and amplitude-zero arms at the identical operating point, with SD-011 urgency and SD-093 progress-velocity modulators held fixed so the breath term is the only mover of the effective threshold. Required event: Repeated breath cycles during multi-candidate deliberation, each opening a sweep window at the commit gate while a trajectory is already committed. DV: Plan-abandonment rate -- committed-to-uncommitted transitions per deliberation window, and mean uninterrupted committed-run length -- as a function of sweep-window occurrence rate, with the transitions time-locked to sweep windows rather than merely correlated over the run.
FALSIFYING: No reliable or an inverted relationship between sweep occurrence and abandonment once the gate is in a two-sided regime, or an effect fully explained by the other threshold modulators -- in which case the claim reduces to breath being one non-privileged periodic modulator rather than THE instantiation of trajectory abandonment. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: E3Selector applies the reduction at effective_threshold and V3-EXQ-1049/1070a already record committed_step_fraction and per-episode mean committed-run length; the sweep-locked abandonment count and the MECH-094 hypothesis-tag clear are not recorded, and the oscillator is phase-undifferentiated (one window per cycle, no separate inhale-scan phase). Consumer / boundary: The ARC-016 commit decision inside E3Selector.select -- the threshold on the commit gate, not episode reward and not the hypothesis tag, which has no breath coupling in code. Existing ownership: ARC-029, MECH-108, V3-EXQ-1070a, V3-EXQ-1049, GFLAG-0346, EXP-0829.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); At the trained operating point the agent is permanently committed, so the manipulation cannot move the DV; the enabling lever landed only days ago, default-off, and V3-EXQ-1070a (the run that would locate a feasible operating point) FAILed its training-tick-budget precondition and licensed no verdict. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's non-degeneracy precondition is just breath_period > 0. arc029_p1_lever_calibration_finding_20260918.md measured the MECH-108 sweep INERT at the trained operating point: running variance sits at 4e-6 to 1.6e-5 against a 0.40 commit threshold, so committed_step_fraction stays 1.0 at every sweep_amplitude and a reduction would need amplitude > 0.99996. The remedy (ARC-029 D variance-tracking commit bar) landed 2026-09-18 default-off with unset sentinels, so the precondition is now the bar being armed and the operating point admitting uncommitted windows, not merely the oscillator running. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-108.subject: respiratory.breath_rate_plan_sweep_clock
MECH-108.title: Respiratory rhythm (~0.2 Hz) is E3's plan-sweep oscillator — a third control-plane clock governing periodic sweeps of pre-commit hippocampal rollouts and DMN simulations.
MECH-108.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The threshold channel must have real dynamic range: on a trained agent the running variance collapses to ~1e-6..1.6e-5 against an absolute 0.40 bar, so the sweep is inert unless use_variance_tracking_commit_threshold is armed with an explicit quantile and window (workable sweep amplitudes then ~0.02-0.20). Separately, rollout/DMN-simulation initiation must be an enumerable event before any phase-locking can be measured.
CONFIRMING: With a two-phase clock wired to rollout/DMN generation, rollout initiation is phase-locked to the ~0.2 Hz cycle, more rollouts occur in the scan phase and more commitment/abandonment in the execute phase, and the valence channel moves independently of the decision-boundary channel. Manipulation: Vary breath_period and the phase split while holding arousal (MECH-093 e3_steps_per_tick) and theta batching fixed; compare a genuine two-phase sweep against the current single-phase sweep and against an existing threshold modulator (SD-011 urgency, SD-093 velocity) matched for magnitude on the same bar. Control: breath_period = 0 (oscillator off), a phase-shuffled sweep of identical duty cycle, and a magnitude-matched non-respiratory threshold modulator, so any effect is attributable to breath PHASE rather than to threshold modulation as such. Required event: A breath cycle with TWO asymmetric phases (inhalation-scan versus exhalation-execute) during which pre-commit hippocampal rollouts and DMN simulations are initiated, swept for viability, and abandoned or committed. DV: Rate and phase angle of rollout/DMN-simulation INITIATION relative to the breath cycle (phase-locking value), and the scan-versus-execute asymmetry: rollouts generated per phase and commitment/abandonment events per phase, plus a second valence-bias channel measured independently of the decision-boundary channel.
FALSIFYING: Rollout/DMN initiation shows no reliable phase-lock, or the two phases produce no scan-versus-execute asymmetry, or any effect is fully reproduced by a magnitude-matched non-respiratory modulator on the same commit bar -- collapsing MECH-108 into MECH-107's narrower single-phase threshold story. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: MultiRateClock (ree-v3/ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py) exposes only a binary sweep_active derived from _breath_phase_step, and its single consumer is the effective commit threshold in e3_selector.py. There is no phase-resolved readout, no rollout/DMN-simulation initiation counter, and no valence-bias channel; vs_rollout_gate.py gates E1/E2 forward calls but does not enumerate plan rollouts as sweepable objects. Consumer / boundary: Initiation and viability-sweeping of pre-commit rollouts and DMN simulations -- upstream of the commit threshold, which is the only place the current oscillator acts. Existing ownership: MECH-107, GFLAG-0346, GFLAG-0354, MECH-093.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); V3 cannot generate the required event. The clock models one binary sweep state, not two asymmetric phases, and sweep_active reaches only a scalar commit threshold -- never rollout or DMN-simulation initiation, which V3 does not expose as countable objects. On a trained agent even that threshold leg is inert without the 2026-09-18 variance-tracking bar armed. Secondary classes: R4, R5. Gap disposition: NEW NODE REQUIRED. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's precondition states that sweep_active 'forces the uncommitted regime' as an already-exercised single-phase fact. That is now measured false on a trained agent: with the absolute commitment_threshold bar, committed_step_fraction is 1.0000 even at sweep_amplitude 0.999 (GFLAG-0346), and the variance-tracking bar that restores dynamic range landed 2026-09-18 with no science-bearing default (use_variance_tracking_commit_threshold False, q/window unset sentinels that raise). The single-phase baseline the falsifier contrasts against therefore has its own non-degeneracy condition the WWA does not state. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-111.subject: drive.epistemic_value_novelty
MECH-111.title: E1 prediction error surprise at moderate magnitudes generates intrinsic positive valence (curiosity/novelty drive); information-seeking is architecturally grounded.
MECH-111.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict): the novelty/
curiosity signal must be wired into E3 candidate scoring as a PER-CANDIDATE weighting,
not a uniform scalar broadcast added identically to every candidate. A uniform additive
shift is argmin-invariant by construction -- it cannot change which candidate is selected
regardless of magnitude -- and this is not a hypothetical failure mode: it is exactly what
EXQ-141b (2026-05-08) and V3-EXQ-590a (2026-05-25) ran into. V3-EXQ-590a's sweep over
novelty_bonus_weight in {0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0} produced byte-identical mean_coverage,
mean_h_pos, and mean_novelty_ema across all five arms (to 16 sig figs) precisely because
the broadcast term could not have moved selection even in principle. That broadcast branch
was deleted 2026-05-25 as dead-by-construction; `_dc_novelty_w` is now hardcoded to 0.0 and
retained only for schema compatibility (confirmed independently by the 2026-07-19 MECH-463
scoping spike). A run using the old broadcast pathway -- which is most of the evidence
collected on this claim to date -- tests nothing about MECH-111 and must self-route
substrate_not_ready rather than count as PASS or FAIL. Separately, the eval metric used to
detect an effect must not already be saturated (coverage=1.0 ceiling was one of two live,
non-exclusive readings of the 590a null result) -- an unsaturated behavioral DV (e.g.
resource/state coverage below ceiling, positional entropy, or an explicit per-candidate
novelty-conditioned selection margin) is required.
CONFIRMING signature: with a genuinely per-candidate novelty pathway wired to E3 selection
(the MECH-314a per-candidate RBF upgrade path, or equivalent) and an unsaturated DV,
moderate-magnitude E1 surprise at a candidate state produces a directional, seed-stable
INCREASE in that candidate's selection probability/score relative to a matched
ablation/control, while high-magnitude ("alarming") surprise in the same state instead
suppresses selection -- i.e. the approach/avoidance dissociation the claim asserts shows up
as a discriminative, non-degenerate effect, not merely a nonzero novelty_ema.
FALSIFYING signature: even with a correctly per-candidate (non-argmin-invariant) novelty
pathway and an unsaturated DV, moderate-magnitude novelty at a candidate produces no
directional, seed-stable selection advantage over ablation/control. This would mean
curiosity/novelty fails to function as an intrinsic positive-valence drive even when
structurally capable of influencing choice, refuting the claim's core assertion -- as
distinct from merely reconfirming the already-known routing defect above.
NOTE: current evidence is genuinely mixed and NOT reconciled here. claims.yaml's own
evidence_quality_note reads uniformly negative (FAIL/weakens x3), but governance-agenda
tracking (EVB-0029) separately logs this claim at conflict_ratio 0.667 with directional/
source disagreement across 5 considered entries (2 supports, 1 weakens). Reconciling
that discrepancy is a governance call, not resolved by this digestion pass.

MECH-112.subject: drive.goal_state_attractor
MECH-112.title: E3 requires a structured latent goal representation (positive attractor in z_world or z_goal sub-space) distinct from harm avoidance.
MECH-112.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: No non-degeneracy precondition can be stated for MECH-112 as a unit, because the claim conflates two dissociable predicates that its own split separated: a behavioural wanting/liking dissociation (MECH-229) and a structured latent goal representation (MECH-230). Any single test satisfies one and leaves the other untouched.
CONFIRMING: Not well-formed at MECH-112's grain. Confirmation is whatever MECH-229 and MECH-230 individually confirm; a composite pass on MECH-112 has repeatedly meant one leg passing and the other failing. Manipulation: Whichever the child claim specifies -- goal-present versus goal-absent seeding for MECH-230's latent-structure leg, wanting versus liking condition for MECH-229's behavioural leg. MECH-112 itself specifies no single manipulation. Control: The children's own controls: a nogo/random-navigation baseline for the behavioural leg, and a goal-absent or shuffled-seed arm for the latent-structure leg. Required event: Resource-seeking episodes with goal relocation, which the split children already specify: MECH-229 needs a wanting versus liking target divergence, MECH-230 needs a z_goal latent with recoverable structure. DV: Split by leg -- l1_fraction and resource rate under wanting versus liking for MECH-229; goal_resource_r and z_goal structure recoverability for MECH-230. MECH-112's historical composite (benefit_ratio plus dissociation together) is what made its 12 scored runs mutually inconsistent.
FALSIFYING: Equally not well-formed at this grain -- the historical record shows C1 behavioural failures co-occurring with C2/C3/C4 representational passes, which is a symptom of the conflation rather than a verdict. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The substrate is live and instrumented (goal.py GoalState, e3_selector.py benefit_eval head and goal-proximity term, latent/stack.py z_goal and z_resource), so no instrument is missing -- what is missing is a single claim for the instrument to answer. Consumer / boundary: Two distinct loci, which is the problem: the E3 goal-proximity/benefit term for the behavioural leg, and the z_goal latent for the representational leg. Existing ownership: MECH-229, MECH-230, goal_pipeline:GAP-7, sd_blocked_agency_mismatch_floor_calibration.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); MECH-112 is deprecated: claims.yaml carries deprecated true with split_into MECH-229 and MECH-230 since 2026-04-13, yet status is still candidate and the claim still carries 12 scored experiment entries at quadrant confirmed_established. Authoring a falsifier here would duplicate the children's and re-open a conflation already adjudicated closed. Secondary classes: none. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: registry_tooling. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-113.subject: drive.homeostatic_self_coherence
MECH-113.title: The agent requires a self-maintenance error signal monitoring internal latent coherence, independent of external harm signals.
MECH-113.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The self-maintenance loss must be witnessed as a live gradient (non-zero grad norm reaching the z_self-producing encoder parameters) before any arm comparison, and the coherence perturbation must be shown to move D_eff materially in the ABLATED arm -- a post/baseline ratio of 1.0008, as measured, means the perturbation is inert and no Level-1 verdict is available.
CONFIRMING: With the loss witnessed as a live gradient and the perturbation witnessed as moving D_eff, the weight-ON arm holds the post-perturbation D_eff ratio near baseline while the ABLATED arm disperses, the separation holds under harm-absent conditions specifically, and the ON arm shows a measurable self-regulating behavioural difference without degrading E2 motor prediction. Manipulation: Cross self_maintenance_weight (0.0 versus > 0) with the presence or absence of concurrent external harm, with the loss wired so it actually trains the z_self pathway -- i.e. computed from the in-graph latent rather than from agent._current_latent, and optimised over the latent_stack parameter group. Control: A matched-seed ablated arm (weight 0.0) with an identical perturbation schedule, plus a harm-present / coherence-intact arm that isolates whether the error signal is anything other than a relabelled harm signal, and the E2 motor-sensory loss as the orthogonality check EXQ-142 already carried as C4. Required event: A controlled degradation of z_self coherence (injected noise, reafference corruption or encoder perturbation) occurring in a window with NO external harm, so the self-maintenance signal and the harm signal are dissociable in time. DV: The D_eff-derived self-maintenance error and the post-perturbation D_eff recovery ratio, measured under harm-absent conditions and contrasted against the same quantities under harm-present conditions; plus a measurable self-regulating behavioural change attributable to the signal, since a signal with no causal authority is not a homeostatic drive.
FALSIFYING: Under the same witnessed gates the ON and ABLATED arms show no D_eff recovery difference, or the signal tracks external harm so closely that it carries no harm-independent information -- the homeostatic self-coherence channel collapses into ordinary harm avoidance, contradicting 'independent of external harm signals'. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: compute_z_self_d_eff and compute_self_maintenance_loss exist at agent.py:12453 and :12475 and are exercised by v3_exq_075/075d/142/084/084d. What is missing is any live consumer inside ree_core -- an exhaustive grep finds compute_self_maintenance_loss called only from experiment drivers -- and an in-graph z_self source for the loss. Consumer / boundary: The z_self-producing encoder pathway (latent_stack) as trained by an auxiliary coherence objective, and downstream of it any self-regulating behavioural output -- not E3's harm head, which is where EXQ-142 actually routed the gradient. Existing ownership: MECH-113, EXP-1285, Q-022, MECH-118, MECH-119, INV-030.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The MECH-113 signal has no gradient path and no live consumer. _current_latent is detached before compute_self_maintenance_loss reads it, so self_maintenance_weight is inert whatever its value, and the function is never called from ree_core -- only from experiment drivers. EXQ-142's optimizer did include latent_stack, so the optimizer was not the defect. Secondary classes: R1, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA treats EXQ-142's two FAILs as accumulating weakening evidence on Level 1. Code reading shows the manipulation could not have reached the mechanism in either run: agent.py:5585 stores self._current_latent = new_latent.detach(), and compute_self_maintenance_loss (agent.py:12475) builds its loss from that detached z_self, so the returned tensor has no gradient path to any parameter regardless of which optimizer receives it. The two EXQ-142 arms are accordingly bit-identical (mean_d_eff_baseline 22.26944842719783 and mean_e2_loss 6.618085231804359e-06 in BOTH ON and ABLATED), which is a manipulation failure, not a result. The WWA's non-degeneracy precondition about D_eff cross-condition variance also needs strengthening: the perturbation must be shown to move D_eff, and 142's sigma=2.0 z_self noise injection moved the post/baseline ratio by 0.08 percent. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-114.subject: commit_gate.z_self_d_eff_gate
MECH-114.title: D_eff (z_self participation ratio) is a necessary co-condition for commitment, alongside world-side running_variance; both must be in range before irreversible action.
MECH-114.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: d_eff must be structurally READ by E3TrajectorySelector.select()'s commit decision, not merely computed elsewhere. As of 2026-08-08 UNMET: ree_core/agent.py:compute_z_self_d_eff() is called only from experiment scripts (measurement-only); the live commit rule in ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py is exclusively "committed = running_variance < commit_threshold" (and its harm/commit-variance variants) -- no d_eff reference anywhere in that file. The threshold formula this claim proposes (d_eff_threshold = d_eff_baseline * 1.5) is also unvalidated: MECH-113's own EXQ-075/075d run measured a raw D_eff baseline of ~23.85 -- an order of magnitude different from the "~1.5x target" scale the calibration note assumed -- and its perturbation moved D_eff by only ~0.03% (ratio 0.9997), failing to demonstrate D_eff is even a sensitive signal to injected self-model incoherence under this design.
CONFIRMING: once d_eff is wired into E3TrajectorySelector.select() as a second, independent AND-condition alongside running_variance, an experiment that dissociates self-model coherence from world-model confidence (raises D_eff / lowers self- coherence via a perturbation demonstrably stronger than EXQ-075's, while holding running_variance in-range) shows: (a) the combined gate measurably suppresses commitments the running_variance-only gate would have allowed during high-D_eff episodes, and (b) commitments made under the variance-only ablation during those same episodes are measurably more erroneous/lower-quality than commitments made when D_eff is in-range -- i.e. D_eff carries information running_variance does not.
FALSIFYING: either (a) no perturbation protocol can produce a genuine running_ variance/D_eff dissociation (replicating EXQ-075/075d's and MECH-113's own EXQ-142 x2 FAIL pattern at the gating level), or (b) a dissociation is produced but commit- quality is statistically indistinguishable between the D_eff-gated and variance-only conditions -- running_variance alone already explains whatever protective effect exists, and D_eff is a redundant rather than independent signal.

MECH-115.subject: hypothesis_tag.z_self_coherence_dependency
MECH-115.title: Hypothesis tag (MECH-094) reliability degrades with z_self dispersion; high D_eff blurs the simulation/real-action boundary at the self-model level.
MECH-115.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A tag producer must actually read z_self coherence; vary D_eff while matching harm/context content and retaining correct simulation provenance.
CONFIRMING: Self dispersion reduces endogenous tag reliability and increases false durable attribution independently of explicit tag deletion. Manipulation: Disperse z_self with matched norm and inputs, without directly flipping hypothesis_tag. Control: Coherent self state and deliberate tag-loss positive control. Consumer / boundary: Self-state coherence to provenance/tag generation, then residue write. Existing ownership: MECH-115, MECH-094.
