MECH-116.subject: e1.lstm_goal_working_memory
MECH-116.title: E1's LSTM hidden state serves as the working memory substrate for goal representation; when conditioned on z_goal_latent, E1 maintains goal context recurrently across steps without requiring ongoing benefit signals.
MECH-116.what_would_answer:
TEST-DESIGN HISTORY (already established, do not repeat): three prior
attempts (EXQ-076d/e/f) all measured the WRONG thing -- z_goal_norm
decay/persistence directly -- and found zero measurable difference
between goal-conditioned and unconditioned E1 in every variant (076d
budget too small; 076e/f blocked by SD-012 seeding quality producing
near-zero z_goal_norm in BOTH conditions by step 6000, so E1
conditioning had nothing to maintain). The 2026-04-04 user-adjudicated
correction: this claim's own stated mechanism is about E1 PREDICTION
ERROR on goal-directed trajectory segments, NOT z_goal decay rate
(governed by a separate decay_goal parameter independent of E1
conditioning). A test of z_goal_norm persistence does not test this
claim at all -- 076f was correctly classified non_contributory.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (a) z_goal seeding to be
reliable enough that goal-directed trajectory segments are genuinely
identifiable (not the near-zero-by-step-6000 collapse 076e/f
exhibited), and (b) E1 prediction error to be measured SEPARATELY on
goal-approaching vs. non-goal segments, with non-zero cross-condition
variance.
CONFIRMING signature: E1 prediction error on goal-approaching
trajectory segments is measurably LOWER when E1 is goal-conditioned
(receives z_goal_latent) versus unconditioned, while non-goal
segments show NO measurable difference between conditions -- E1
"predicts better because it knows what it is predicting toward,"
specifically on the segments where that knowledge is relevant.
FALSIFYING: goal-conditioned and unconditioned E1 show no measurable
difference in prediction error on goal-approaching segments (once
z_goal seeding is reliable) -- the LSTM hidden state is not
functioning as a goal-conditioned working-memory substrate; or
conditioning affects non-goal segments equally (would suggest a
general regularisation effect rather than goal-specific working
memory). Separately open: whether MECH-116 is a WM subcomponent of
SD-033a or a distinct E1 recurrent-WM substrate (flagged 2026-04-19,
unresolved governance question, not this wwa's job to settle).

MECH-117.subject: wanting.liking_trajectory_dissociation
MECH-117.title: The wanting signal (goal-distance scoring via z_goal_latent) and the liking signal (benefit_eval_head receipt predictor) are functionally dissociable in trajectory scoring.
MECH-117.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both signals must carry the content the claim attributes to them, measured not assumed. The liking head must predict benefit receipt above its own permuted null on held-out data (config.py records benefit_eval_head(z_world) at R2 = -0.004 without resource-proximity supervision, so use_resource_proximity_head must be ON with its r2 reported per seed), and the wanting persistence window must be short relative to the z_goal half-life (~139 steps at decay_goal 0.005) or the persistence DV is entailed by the decay constant rather than measured.
CONFIRMING: With the liking head measurably predictive of receipt, the wanting-intact arm maintains approach toward L1 after relocation over a window short relative to the goal half-life while the liking-intact arm redirects to L2 within a few steps, giving a per-seed L1-fraction separation above the pre-registered margin on a majority of seeds. Manipulation: Ablate each channel independently at matched seeds: goal_weight to zero (wanting off, liking intact) versus benefit_eval_enabled off (liking off, wanting intact) versus both on, with use_resource_proximity_head ON in every arm so z_world carries resource content. Control: The both-on arm and a navigation-matched baseline in which neither channel scores, so the greedy-navigation confound that produced the EXQ-074d/074e C1 failure cannot reappear, plus a relocation-window length chosen well inside the z_goal half-life. Required event: Resource relocation from L1 to L2 mid-episode after the agent has been trained to approach L1, so wanting (goal-distance scoring) and liking (receipt prediction) are placed in direct conflict about where to go next. DV: Post-relocation L1 approach fraction over a window short relative to the z_goal half-life, contrasted between the wanting-intact and liking-intact arms, together with the redirect latency to L2 in each arm and the held-out r2 of the liking head against benefit receipt as a reported covariate.
FALSIFYING: With the same preconditions, the two ablations produce statistically indistinguishable post-relocation approach behaviour, or the separation disappears once the window is shortened relative to the z_goal half-life, or it survives with the liking head at chance-level receipt prediction -- in which case the contrast is a decay-constant artifact rather than a wanting/liking dissociation. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Both channels exist and are separately weighted: ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py computes the goal-distance wanting term under config.goal_weight and hosts benefit_eval_head; ree_core/goal.py applies decay_goal; ree_core/residue/field.py holds the benefit terrain. SD-018's resource-proximity supervision exists (use_resource_proximity_head, compute_resource_proximity_loss) but its own r2 > 0.5 validation was never cleanly recorded and no MECH-117 run enables it. Consumer / boundary: Trajectory scoring in E3 select: whether removing one channel changes the committed approach target while the other is intact, not the downstream resource-acquisition rate. Existing ownership: SD-018, SD-106, zworld_adequacy:ZW-1, SD-049-PHASE-2, MECH-112.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The existing supporting runs are degenerate in two ways: the liking head was read off a z_world measured orthogonal to resource proximity (r2 = -0.004) with resource-proximity supervision default-OFF, and the wanting persistence DV was scored over a 200-step window against a z_goal half-life of about 139 steps, so persistence is largely entailed by decay_goal. No run reports either as a covariate. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-118.subject: self_maintenance.hopfield_familiarity_signal
MECH-118.title: Hopfield-style pattern familiarity of z_self states (stability against stored self-state memories) is a distinct self-maintenance signal from D_eff coherence.
MECH-118.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The two signals must be independently movable on the SAME agent within one run: D_eff must be held near baseline while stored-pattern stability is driven to zero (the coherent-but-unfamiliar Regime 3), and the memory of stored self-states must be frozen during evaluation so stability is scored against a fixed reference. Critically, both arms must tick the substrate the SAME number of times per environment state -- the 2026-05-08 multi_sense audit superseded V3-EXQ-143 precisely because the Hopfield-ON arm called sense() twice per step and the OFF arm once.
CONFIRMING: With equal substrate ticking per step, HOPFIELD_ON recovers stability toward baseline post-perturbation while HOPFIELD_ABLATED does not, the per-seed stability gap clears a pre-registered floor on every seed, the cross-arm D_eff difference stays below its ceiling, and the matched random-pull control does not reproduce the recovery. Manipulation: Matched-seed pair with a single sense() per step in both arms (the StepHarness in experiments/_harness.py is the named repair vehicle): HOPFIELD_ON (D_eff homeostatic loss plus a familiarity pull toward the nearest stored z_self pattern) versus HOPFIELD_ABLATED (identical D_eff loss and weight, familiarity weight zero). Control: The D_eff-only arm at identical seeds, weights, architecture and environment, plus a matched-magnitude random-direction pull arm so a recovery is attributable to familiarity rather than to any additional attractor term. Required event: A trained agent driven into a coherent-but-unfamiliar self-state -- z_self replaced by an orthogonal direction at baseline norm, so D_eff is near baseline while familiarity against stored patterns is near zero -- followed by a recovery window. DV: Post-perturbation stability recovery (max softmax similarity against the frozen stored set) in each arm, together with the cross-arm D_eff difference, which must stay small -- the orthogonality check that makes familiarity NEW information rather than a D_eff substitute.
FALSIFYING: The two arms recover stability equivalently, or the stability gap comes with an equal-and-opposite D_eff difference -- familiarity is then a re-description of D_eff coherence and MECH-118 collapses into MECH-113, which is the registered alternative in the V3-EXQ-084 design. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: D_eff is substrate-side (agent.compute_z_self_d_eff and the self-maintenance auxiliary loss in ree_core/agent.py). The Hopfield familiarity signal is NOT: grep of ree_core finds no Hopfield memory, no stability readout and no consumer; it exists only inside the V3-EXQ-084d/143 drivers, and the canonical implementation still lives in the external epistemic-mapping repo. Consumer / boundary: The self-maintenance control loop -- the loss/consumer that acts on z_self. That loop reads D_eff only, so familiarity has no live downstream consumer at the locus the claim asserts. Existing ownership: MECH-118, MECH-113, MECH-119, Q-022, EXP-0059.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The familiarity signal has no live consumer: no Hopfield memory or stability readout exists in ree_core, so the claim's assertion that it is a distinct SELF-MAINTENANCE signal cannot be tested at the self-maintenance loop -- only as a driver-added auxiliary loss. The only run at the right design, V3-EXQ-143, was superseded 2026-05-08 for the double-sense confound and never re-run. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-119.subject: self_maintenance.coherent_unfamiliar_pathology
MECH-119.title: Low D_eff combined with low Hopfield stability (coherent but unfamiliar self-state) is a distinct pathological regime from high-D_eff dispersion.
MECH-119.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Regime 3 must be REACHED, not constructed. A perturbation or an endogenous route must produce low D_eff together with low familiarity; V3-EXQ-084d's structured-novelty manipulation produced d_eff 22.6, HIGHER than both the noise (20.8) and normal (20.6) conditions, so the regime the claim predicts was not generated by the only non-synthetic manipulation tried.
CONFIRMING: Regime 3 is reachable without direct z_self substitution, occupies a region of (D_eff, familiarity) space distinct from Regime 2 on >= 2/3 seeds, AND joint monitoring detects a pathological episode that D_eff-only monitoring scores as normal, with a measurable downstream cost difference. Manipulation: Three-regime comparison: normal, dispersed (Gaussian perturbation), and coherent-unfamiliar; and, for the consequential half, monitoring by D_eff alone versus joint (D_eff, familiarity) gating of the MECH-113 self-maintenance loss and the MECH-114 commit gate. Control: The dispersed (Regime 2) arm as the low-familiarity comparator that differs only on the D_eff axis, plus a normal (low D_eff, high familiarity) arm; stored-pattern memory held identical across arms. Required event: The agent entering a coherent-but-unfamiliar self-state -- z_self concentrated in few dimensions while resembling no stored self-pattern -- during ordinary operation or under a principled perturbation, rather than by direct substitution of z_self. DV: Joint (D_eff, familiarity) coordinates at matched perturbation magnitude AND a downstream consequence that separates Regime 3 from normal: decision quality, harm exposure or calibration error under D_eff-only monitoring versus joint monitoring.
FALSIFYING: Regime 3 is not reachable except by construction, or when reached it carries no downstream consequence distinguishable from normal operation -- the three-regime taxonomy is a description of an injected state rather than a pathological regime the architecture enters, and the joint gate buys nothing over D_eff alone. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: D_eff exists in-substrate (REEAgent.compute_z_self_d_eff, agent.py:12451, with self_maintenance_d_eff_target in config), but the Hopfield familiarity probe does NOT: it is defined inside v3_exq_144 as an experiment-local class (stability = max cosine similarity to stored patterns); ree_core contains no Hopfield self-pattern memory and no familiarity recorder. Consumer / boundary: The self-maintenance loss (MECH-113) and the commit gate (MECH-114) -- the claim asserts both should incorporate BOTH axes, so the causal boundary is where the monitor gates behaviour, not where the metrics are computed. Existing ownership: Q-022, MECH-118, MECH-113, MECH-114, V3-EXQ-084d.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); The coherent-unfamiliar regime has never been generated except by replacing z_self with a hand-built orthogonal unit vector (V3-EXQ-144), and the familiarity axis has no in-substrate instrument or consumer -- the self-maintenance loss penalises D_eff excess only. Q-022 explicitly gates the combined-gate design on demonstrating the dissociation first. Secondary classes: R4, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. MECH-120.subject: sleep.sws_denoising_attractor_flattening
MECH-120.title: The SWS sub-phase of offline mode performs global attractor flattening and residue field denoising (synaptic homeostasis analog), pruning weak noisy traces and restoring signal-to-noise ratio.
MECH-120.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Committed-action-class diversity must be non-degenerate across arms (established by 691, 2/3 seeds), AND for the denoising leg the sws readout must be sensitive to the manipulation -- the scale-invariant cosine readout cannot register a content-scale ladder while damage is referenced to unscaled content, which is GFLAG-0351's bit-exact finding.
CONFIRMING: SHY-ON restores the strong-to-weak trace mass ratio and post-sleep retrieval fidelity relative to SHY-OFF at matched exposure, and preserves committed-action-class diversity at least as well as sleep-OFF. Manipulation: SHY normalisation ON versus OFF at the SWS phase (config.shy_enabled, shy_decay_rate), with the decay rate swept, and -- for the legs that are not built -- a residue-field global decay and a z_delta recalibration toward a low-information prior at the same phase. Control: Sleep-OFF and SHY-OFF arms at matched seeds and matched waking exposure, plus the staged-damage lesion arms that isolate the sws phase from nrem and rem. Required event: An SWS sub-phase entered after a waking window that has potentiated weak noisy traces alongside strong ones. DV: Signal-to-noise restoration in the structure the phase actually flattens: the ratio of strong-trace to weak-trace weight mass after the phase versus before, and post-sleep retrieval fidelity for strong versus weak traces -- not only the committed-action diversity bound the current WWA reads.
FALSIFYING: SHY-ON leaves the trace mass ratio unchanged or systematically and substantially erodes committed diversity beyond a small bounded margin -- downscaling without working hypothesis-tag protection damages rather than restores signal-to-noise. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: E1DeepPredictor.shy_normalise decays ContextMemory slot weights toward the slot mean (ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py) and experiments/_lib/consolidation_lesion_harness.py maps the sws phase to MECH-120 with a denoising readout; that readout is scale-invariant and its runs are carve-out-forbidden from tagging MECH-120. Consumer / boundary: The SWS phase of the offline cycle, acting on the stores the claim names -- E1 ContextMemory (built), the residue field (not built) and z_delta (not built). Existing ownership: SD-017, SD-071, GFLAG-0351, EXP-0261, MECH-094.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); The claim bundles three SWS operations and only one exists: enter_sws_mode calls e1.shy_normalise on ContextMemory slots and nothing else; there is no residue-field global decay and no z_delta recalibration anywhere in the sleep path. The DV for the built leg has no recorder tagged to this claim -- the sws lesion readout is scale-invariant (GFLAG-0351) and carve-out-forbidden from tagging MECH-120. Secondary classes: R2, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA tests only a downstream proxy (committed-action-class diversity erosion under sleep-ON vs OFF), which V3-EXQ-691 already discharged as protective-or-neutral, and never measures the claim's asserted quantity. It also presumes the SWS operations are implemented: enter_sws_mode performs ONLY E1 ContextMemory SHY flattening -- the residue-field global decay and the z_delta recalibration the claim asserts are absent from the SWS path. Since the WWA was written the SD-068 consolidation-lesion harness landed with a per-phase sws denoising readout, whose validity for MECH-120 is separately contested (GFLAG-0351). Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-121.subject: sleep.nrem_swr_replay_consolidation
MECH-121.title: The NREM sub-phase of offline mode replays recent episodic content via SWR-equivalent sequences, transferring episodic traces from E3/hippocampal buffer to E1/neocortical schematic representation.
MECH-121.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Diverse independently labelled harm and goal episodes, balanced replay scheduling, noncollapsed E1 input content, and an actual episode-to-E1 update path. Independently verify buffer diversity, model updates and held-out target variance; parameter movement alone is insufficient.
CONFIRMING: SWS selectively improves held-out abstract-pattern prediction beyond matched waking replay and no-E1-writeback controls, with the predicted balance dependence Manipulation: Balanced SWS consolidation versus matched waking replay; additionally block E1 writeback while preserving sampling/routing Control: Equal waking exposure, update budget and independently seeded RNG; verbatim-episode and novel-pattern held-out sets kept separate Required event: Repeated true SWS cycles over diverse episodic experience followed by novel instances of the same abstract regularities DV: E1 goal-conditioned held-out prediction error and generalisation to novel combinations before/after sleep, stratified by harm/goal trace balance
FALSIFYING: No improvement with a verified transfer path and nondegenerate content, or only verbatim memorisation without generalisation; balance-insensitivity rejects that additional clause separately A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SWS ContextMemory writes and optional CrossModuleConsolidator updates/counts already exist. They do not provide balanced harm/goal scheduling or a demonstrated abstract-pattern readout. SD-068's instrument lesion readouts are diagnostic plumbing and explicitly cannot promote MECH-121. Consumer / boundary: Episodic buffer to E1 schematic representation across SWS; neither the discarded waking replay output nor E2_harm_s parameter movement alone is this locus Existing ownership: sleep_substrate:GAP-2, mech092-replay-consumer-missing, MECH-423, MECH-439, GFLAG-0086, GFLAG-0319.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); Partial E1 consolidation substrate is built, but the required balanced content-selection-to-E1 chain and discriminative abstraction assay are not established. The old blanket unbuilt-ARC-065 condition is replaced by the actual competence/content gate; no claim hold is lifted. Secondary classes: R5, R2. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. MECH-122.subject: sleep.spindles_packaging_gating
MECH-122.title: Thalamo-cortical spindle-equivalent bursts package E3/hippocampal replay content for z_theta delivery AND gate external sensory input, protecting the consolidation episode from interruption.
MECH-122.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The MEL producer must actually raise MEL above base on every scored seed (861c's producer failed on seed 7), the gate operating point must be verified live rather than dead or saturated, the DV must be non-degenerate per seed (861d's seed 123 was not), and the ContextMemory.write_gate bias-over-content collapse must be ruled out first.
CONFIRMING: With the mel_pe reference and a verified operating point, selection_weight varies with MEL and ContextMemory write differentiation tracks MEL in the predicted direction on a majority of seeds; and, once the gating half is built, external input is measurably suppressed during spindle windows and protected episodes transfer more content than interrupted ones. Manipulation: use_mech122_spindle_content_selection ON versus OFF at mech122_novelty_reference_mode='mel_pe', across a MEL dose ladder produced by varying waking novelty; the sensory-gating half would additionally interleave external observations into the consolidation window. Control: The selection-OFF arm (861c's configuration, plain EMA-blend writes) at matched MEL, plus a write-lock control that isolates the ContextMemory write path from the selection signal. Required event: An SWS schema-installation pass during a real sleep cycle, with waking novelty high enough to raise MEL, so spindle-analog content selection has graded input to act on. DV: Differentiation of ContextMemory writes as a function of MEL -- mean_sws_new_slot_diversity and whole-bank cosine diversity -- with selection_weight reported as the manipulation check; for the gating half, measured suppression of external input during spindle windows and transfer quality of interrupted versus protected consolidation episodes.
FALSIFYING: With the mel_pe reference live, a verified operating point and the write_gate defect cleared, spindle selection_weight still fails to move write differentiation with MEL or moves it in the wrong direction -- upgrading the finding from measurement defect to genuine evidence against content packaging. For gating: protected and interrupted episodes are indistinguishable once gating is built. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/latent/theta_buffer.py supplies set_consolidation_mode/consolidation_summary, agent.py applies the blend in run_sws_schema_pass, and mel_consumer.py supplies the re-sourced novelty channel; V3-EXQ-861d records selection_weight and the diversity DVs. There is ZERO ree_core code for the sensory-gating half. Consumer / boundary: The SWS schema-installation write into ContextMemory, where content selection is applied -- not the ThetaBuffer in isolation, and not the sws_power or replay_rate readouts that do not depend on content selection. Existing ownership: MECH-122, MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION, MECH122-SENSORY-GATING-OFFLINE-PROTECTION, MECH-180, SD-016, V3-EXQ-436c.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The content-selection signal is live and tracks MEL, but it cannot reach the measured DV: the downstream ContextMemory.write_gate defect (V3-EXQ-436c, open) plus a dead-or-saturated gate operating point leave write differentiation unresponsive, and the MEL producer failed on one of three seeds. The sensory-gating half has zero V3 code. Secondary classes: R5, R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA names its precondition as a 'routed-but-not-yet-landed fix' to re-source the novelty reference from a MEL-correlated signal. That fix landed 2026-08-14 (ree-v3 6aa97ca) and mech122_novelty_reference_mode='mel_pe' is now the config DEFAULT; V3-EXQ-861d already ran with the flag ON against it, and the confirmed cluster autopsy found the selection weight live and tracking MEL. The live blocker moved downstream to the open V3-EXQ-436c ContextMemory.write_gate defect plus an unverified/saturated gate operating point. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-123.subject: sleep.rem_precision_recalibration
MECH-123.title: The REM sub-phase of offline mode recalibrates precision priors and tests world model hypotheses via unconstrained generative simulation, with commit gate fully suppressed.
MECH-123.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: requires the full offline-phase architecture
(MECH-030 modes, MECH-092 replay, MECH-094 hypothesis tag, ARC-016
dynamic precision, MECH-093) to be live AND the REM sub-phase's
commit-gate suppression (ARC-016 running_variance threshold effectively
infinite) to be independently confirmed non-degenerate (commitment
genuinely does not fire during REM, not merely rare) -- without this the
mechanism cannot be distinguished from ordinary waking operation.
Registered V4 scope per this claim's own notes; not V3-tractable as
stated (epistemic_category/v3_pending set explicitly 2026-08-06 to match
that prose, mirroring sibling MECH-121).
CONFIRMING signature: during REM, (a) commit-gate suppression is
measurable (zero commitments recorded across the REM window, not merely
reduced); (b) E1 generates world-model trajectories that are coherently
self-consistent for a genuinely-adequate world model and INCOHERENT in
proportion to real model limitations (REM "dream content" tracks actual
model quality, not noise); (c) precision parameters (z_beta, z_delta)
measurably recalibrate toward a low-arousal / low-bias baseline across
the REM window, distinguishable from a matched non-REM control.
FALSIFYING: commit-gate suppression is incomplete or absent during REM
(commitments still fire); REM-generated trajectory coherence is
uncorrelated with independently-measured world-model quality (the
hypothesis-testing framing is not doing real work); or precision
parameters show no measurable REM-specific recalibration relative to a
matched non-REM control (the mechanism collapses to ordinary waking
operation under a different label). CRITICAL FAILURE MODE (already named
in this claim's own notes): if the MECH-094 hypothesis tag fails during
REM, hallucinatory content accumulates in the residue field as real
experience -- this is the psychosis mechanism, and a run showing that
failure mode is evidence AGAINST the tag's reliability, not against
MECH-123 itself.

MECH-124.subject: sleep.consolidation_mediated_option_contraction
MECH-124.title: When harm-trace salience dominates offline replay content, consolidation selectively amplifies harm predictions, progressively contracting option space -- a distinct failure mode from Q-021 behavioral flatness.
MECH-124.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Multiple consolidation cycles must actually fire (SleepLoopManager cycle count > 0 with a non-empty replayed-region set and offline_n_steps > 0), option-space metrics must be non-degenerate in the first cycle (not already at floor), and the harm:goal replay-content ratio must be measurable per cycle rather than assumed from the EXQ-224 baseline.
CONFIRMING: Under harm-dominant replay the option-space metrics contract monotonically across successive cycles while approach drive was present at training, and the contraction is attenuated or absent under the balanced-replay or MECH-094-protected arms. Manipulation: Replay CONTENT composition: harm-dominant consolidation (the current single-module e2_harm_s pass) versus a balanced arm in which goal-directed traces are consolidated proportionally, with MECH-094 tag protection as a third arm. Control: A cycling-held-constant arm that varies only waking training exposure, which separates the MECH-124 consolidation-time dynamic from the Q-021 training-time static-avoidance explanation. Required event: A sequence of >= 4 SD-017 offline sleep cycles interleaved with waking training, each running SelfModelAggregator.offline_gradient_pass over replayed regions, on an agent whose approach drives were present and exercised during training. DV: Cycle-over-cycle trajectory (not pre/post) of action diversity, z_goal representation strength / goal_vs_harm_ratio, and approach-behaviour frequency, tested for progressive monotone contraction rather than a single-step adjustment.
FALSIFYING: Option-space metrics plateau after a single adjustment or do not decline further across cycles; or the contraction is fully reproduced by the cycling-held-constant arm, which would attribute it to Q-021 training-time avoidance rather than to consolidation dynamics. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: goal_vs_harm_ratio is computed by the 085-family and 179/224/298 drivers and z_goal norm is available per tick; SleepCycleState.last_metrics carries per-cycle sleep diagnostics. What is missing is a per-cycle option-space readout attached to the sleep loop and any goal-trace consolidation channel to contrast against. Consumer / boundary: The offline consolidation write into e2_harm_s / the harm prediction path, and its downstream effect on E3 option selection -- not training-time reward shaping. Existing ownership: MECH-121, MECH-092, mech092-replay-consumer-missing, MECH-120.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); The balanced-replay comparator does not exist. SleepReplaySampler prioritises by MECH-284 staleness, not by harm/goal salience, and SelfModelAggregator.offline_gradient_pass updates e2_harm_s parameters only, so there is no goal-trace consolidation channel to hold proportional. Without that arm the harm-dominant condition is the only condition V3 can generate and the mechanism-specificity clause cannot be tested. Secondary classes: R1, R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's premise -- 'this claim cannot be tested in V3 ... V3 has no sleep architecture' -- is refuted by current code: ree_core/sleep/ now carries SleepLoopManager (K-episode multi-cycle SD-017 entry), SleepReplaySampler (MECH-285), RoutingGate (MECH-272) and SelfModelAggregator.offline_gradient_pass (the MECH-121 offline consolidation pass). The residual blocker is narrower and different: replay priority is keyed on staleness and the consolidation pass trains e2_harm_s ALONE, so the harm-dominant arm exists by construction while the balanced-replay control does not. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-125.subject: coherence.multiconstraint_viability
MECH-125.title: E3 trajectory selection is currently COMPENSATORY, not veto-based: candidates are ranked by a single weighted sum over goal, harm/residue, feasibility/resource, coherence and epistemic terms, and commitment is gated by one precision (PE-variance) threshold (ARC-016). No per-candidate, per-space veto exists in the V3 substrate, so a large cost in one space can be outweighed by gains elsewhere. Multi-constraint VETO viability (any one space independently rejecting a trajectory) is the intended biological design, not a description of V3.
MECH-125.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least two evaluation systems LIVE and capable of emitting a veto-level error signal in the measured window, with at least one candidate actually receiving one -- a run in which no veto ever fires tests nothing, and a run with only one live system trivially satisfies 'no major system vetoes'.
CONFIRMING: committed trajectories are those on which no evaluation system exceeds its veto threshold, and this predicts commitment BETTER than the argmin of the aggregate score -- specifically, committed actions exist that are NOT the aggregate-score winner because a higher-scoring candidate carried a veto, at a rate above chance.
FALSIFYING: the committed action is the aggregate-score argmin on essentially every tick -- 'multi-constraint viability' is then an alternative description of scalar maximisation with no separable veto structure, which is what MECH-439's measured 88-89% F-channel variance monopoly currently predicts and why this claim needs its own falsifier rather than inheriting one.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked -- category set from this claim's own live_status reading where present; if governance judges the veto structure built-and-exercised with its signal absorbed by F-dominance, substrate_ceiling is the right variant.
Disposition 2026-09-23 (governance-flags-20260923b, GFLAG-0275, user decision): claim REWRITTEN to the compensatory description the code actually implements; epistemic_category substrate_conditional -> derivational. The FALSIFYING clause above now reads in reverse: an aggregate-score argmin on essentially every tick CONFIRMS the rewritten claim by construction, so no experiment is worth running on it. A behavioural test becomes informative only once a per-space veto is BUILT; that would be a new claim and an /implement-substrate design, not this one.

MECH-126.subject: state_abstraction.failure_modes_psychiatric_analogs
MECH-126.title: Specific modes of REE state abstraction failure -- overmerge, oversplit, temporal context loss, valence mis-tagging, uncertainty collapse, and narrow representational capacity -- produce behavioral signatures that are structurally analogous to empirically described psychiatric conditions, sharing identifiable circuit-level mechanisms.
MECH-126.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: each named failure mode must be independently INDUCIBLE in the substrate -- a taxonomy whose members cannot be produced separately is a vocabulary, not a set of mechanisms -- and the behavioural signature must be measured on a substrate with demonstrated headroom to express the alternative.
CONFIRMING: at least three of the six modes (overmerge, oversplit, temporal context loss, valence mis-tagging, uncertainty collapse, narrow representational capacity) are separately inducible and produce DISSOCIABLE behavioural signatures -- an intervention producing overmerge does not produce the oversplit signature and vice versa.
FALSIFYING: the modes are not separately inducible; OR their behavioural signatures are indistinguishable, collapsing the taxonomy to a single 'abstraction is wrong' axis.
Relevance recorded 2026-09-15: the deferred insight-candidate claim's impostor (1) -- compression that deletes organism-relevant distinctions -- IS overmerge and inherits whatever discriminability this claim can establish.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional.

MECH-127.subject: social.counterfactual_empathic_activation
MECH-127.title: Counterfactual other-cost-aversion activates cooperative behavior as a motivational surrogate when the direct task-reward pathway is degraded.
MECH-127.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-127 is design-only as of this writing -- it has
no built substrate and no experiment has ever attempted to test it (no EXQ/run IDs
exist against this claim). Per mirror_modelling_other_self_v5_plan.md (MIRROR-7),
it is gated on ALL of: pre-encounter OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging (MIRROR-1), a mirror
that runs COUNTERFACTUALLY rather than only on observed other-agent state (MIRROR-2),
the MECH-163 hippocampal multi-step planner (needed to simulate another agent's
future state, not just its present one), and the INV-064 self-model maturational
gate (self_model_v4:SELF-7) establishing self-stability precedes social depth. A run
lacking a verified counterfactual (absent-other) mirror channel, or lacking an
independently-measurable "direct task-motivation pathway degraded" state, tests
nothing and must self-route substrate_not_ready rather than counting as a verdict --
scoring a system that cannot represent an absent other's hypothetical cost is not a
test of bypass-via-counterfactual-projection, it can only be a test of MECH-031-style
modulation by mistake.
CONFIRMING signature (bypass, not modulation): with the direct task-motivation
pathway independently confirmed degraded, cooperative task-engagement rises above
the degraded-pathway-alone baseline specifically when the counterfactual
OTHER_SELFLIKE/mirror channel is active, INCLUDING when the other agent is absent
(the claim is explicit that activation is counterfactual -- "on a model of what
would happen to the other agent if they took on the task, not on their actual
current state"). This must dissociate from MECH-031 (modulation of an intact
pathway): ablating the counterfactual/mirror channel should collapse the rescue
effect, while further degrading the already-degraded direct pathway should NOT
further reduce engagement, since by hypothesis engagement is now being driven
through the alternate (counterfactual empathic) route rather than the direct one.
FALSIFYING signature: cooperative/task engagement under pathway degradation is
statistically indistinguishable with vs without the counterfactual channel (no
rescue); OR the rescue effect requires the other agent to be PRESENT/observable
rather than merely modeled (would falsify the counterfactual/absence claim and
collapse MECH-127 into ordinary MECH-031 modulation); OR ablating OTHER_SELFLIKE
tagging / the counterfactual mirror has no effect on the rescue (would falsify the
proposed mechanism even if some rescue effect is observed via an unidentified
route). Any of these outcomes should be reported as a genuine test result, not
reframed as substrate_not_ready, PROVIDED the non-degeneracy precondition above was
actually met.
Evidence on file: none experimental. This is a first-person-report-motivated
mechanism hypothesis (thought_intake_2026-03-24_empathy_multiagent_ethics.md),
currently un-adjudicated by any run.

MECH-128.subject: e1.goal_context_conditioning
MECH-128.title: E1's LSTM hidden state must be conditioned on z_goal_latent so that predictive trajectories generated by E1 are goal-context-shaped rather than goal-agnostic.
MECH-128.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The conditioning input must carry cross-state variance: z_goal is an EMA attractor pulled toward z_world and sits inside the SD-008 common-mode cone (pairwise cosine 0.9878, ||mean|| / mean||.|| 0.9987 measured on the V3-EXQ-669b nursery), so an un-centered z_goal is effectively a constant and goal_input_proj can only add a constant offset -- which no interaction term can detect. A run must witness a measured cross-tick z_goal spread (common-mode subtracted) and a non-degenerate goal-relevant versus neutral transition labelling.
CONFIRMING: With measured z_goal spread above its floor, the interaction term clears its pre-registered threshold on at least 2 of 3 seeds, err_goal_conditioned is below err_goal_ablated, and the neutral-transition difference stays within the goal-specificity ceiling; the shuffled-z_goal arm does not reproduce it. Manipulation: Matched-seed pair as in V3-EXQ-229 but with the degeneracy repaired: GOAL_CONDITIONED (goal_dim > 0, e1_goal_conditioned True, common-mode-subtracted z_goal) versus GOAL_ABLATED (goal_dim 0, projection absent), with E1 trained under compute_prediction_loss in both arms; plus a third arm that re-injects z_goal at EVERY recurrent rollout step rather than once at the rollout seed. Control: GOAL_ABLATED at identical seeds with z_goal still updated but not passed to E1 (the existing 229 control), plus a shuffled-z_goal arm supplying the same input magnitude with the goal-to-state correspondence broken. Required event: Episodes with an active, varying goal in which transitions can be split into goal-relevant (resource/benefit-proximal) and neutral sets of comparable size, on an agent whose E1 is trained. DV: The interaction term (err_neutral_ablated - err_neutral_conditioned) - (err_goal_ablated - err_goal_conditioned), i.e. a goal-SELECTIVE reduction in E1 prediction error, reported alongside the measured z_goal spread so a null can be attributed to the conditioning or to a degenerate input.
FALSIFYING: With a non-degenerate, common-mode-subtracted z_goal and E1 trained, the interaction term stays at zero -- goal context is represented but does not shape E1 trajectory generation, and the claim's type-match argument fails at the prediction layer rather than at the goal representation. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The conditioning path exists and is live: E1DeepPredictor allocates goal_input_proj when goal_dim > 0 and applies it in forward, and agent.py passes z_goal at the online transition under goal.e1_goal_conditioned (default True) through the VS rollout gate. V3-EXQ-147/147a/229 implement the interaction DV and train E1 (optim.Adam over agent.e1.parameters()). Consumer / boundary: E1's recurrent hidden state as it shapes generated trajectories -- the prediction layer -- distinct from supplying z_goal only at E3 evaluation time. Existing ownership: MECH-128, MECH-112, SD-079, EXP-0113, V3-EXQ-229.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Three consecutive C1 nulls (147, 147a, 229; mean_interaction 3.5e-6 against 5e-3) were run with an un-centered z_goal, which SD-079 later measured to be nearly constant across states -- a constant conditioning input cannot produce a transition-selective interaction, so the regime never discriminated. Secondarily the implementation conditions the rollout SEED once (and generate_prior uses the unconditioned state), not each recurrent step as the claim specifies. Secondary classes: R6, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-129.subject: coherence.relational_harm
MECH-129.title: In a multiagent world, harm must be represented as a relational signal: harm-to-agent (direct cost/physical signal) and harm-to-agency (obstruction of another agent's goal-pursuit) are distinct signal types requiring distinct architectures.
MECH-129.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (1) another agent's goal representation visible in the
tested agent's own latent stack (a second-agent z_goal-equivalent), and (2) a goal-interference
signal computed over trajectory pairs and wired into E3 ranking alongside the existing
SD-010/SD-011 harm-to-agent signal. Neither exists: V3's CausalGridWorld environments are
single-agent (no second agent to interfere with), and no code under ree_core/ computes an
other-agent goal-interference signal (re-verified 2026-09-25, zero hits for "other_agent" /
"goal_interference").

CONFIRMING: once built, trajectories that obstruct another agent's inferred goal (per the wired
interference signal) but carry no direct-contact/proximity harm-to-agent signal are penalized
by E3 above a matched no-interference control -- harm-to-agency scores as a genuinely separate
channel, not recoverable by relabelling the existing SD-010/011 signal.

FALSIFYING: goal-interference trajectories are statistically indistinguishable from matched
non-interference trajectories in E3 ranking once harm-to-agent is held constant -- the claimed
distinct architecture collapses to a relabelling of the existing harm-to-agent channel. A
failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ARC-047-class V5 social substrate, unbuilt (see ARC-094
above; same finding, not restated). MECH-128 (context) already tests goal-conditioning for the
agent's OWN goal in V3 and is live/instrumented, but extending goal-representation to a SECOND
agent -- this claim's actual requirement -- is itself unbuilt. Held by architectural commitment
per three governance decisions (2026-06-06, 2026-06-18, 2026-07-01,
evidence/decisions/decision_log.v1.jsonl), not by missing scope decision -- no further
governance action needed on the hold itself, only the metadata fixes above.

MECH-130.subject: curiosity.agent_novelty_typing
MECH-130.title: Curiosity-driven approach must distinguish world-state novelty from agent-policy novelty; untyped novelty reward creates chronic approach pressure toward partially unpredictable agents regardless of harm risk.
MECH-130.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Requires a multi-agent environment in which other agents are
structurally present and can be varied independently in policy-unpredictability versus
environment-novelty (ARC-047 SocialGridWorld or an equivalent substrate) -- as of 2026-09-25 this is
UNBUILT: ARC-047 carries confidence: 0.0, status candidate, implementation_phase v5, and no path
under ree-v3/ree_core or ree-v3/experiments implements a multi-agent gridworld (confirmed by
directory search; the only social-adjacent script, v3_exq_160_q023_multiagent_convergence_pair.py,
is Q-023's formal-convergence probe, not a novelty-typing environment). Independently, MECH-111's
broadcast novelty signal must reliably reach E3 selection for there to be anything to type: its own
evidence_quality_note records this is NOT currently happening (EXQ-141b, 2026-05-08: novelty_ema
alive at ~1e-4 but does not propagate to E3 selection; V3-EXQ-590a, 2026-05-25: calibration arms
degenerate / byte-identical across novelty_bonus_weight in {0.1...1.0}). A run cannot type novelty
that never reaches selection, and cannot type agent-vs-world novelty without agents to distinguish;
the run self-routes substrate_not_ready on either gap alone.

CONFIRMING: once both are built, an agent exposed to matched-information-gain world-novelty and
agent-policy-novelty events shows (a) approach behaviour toward the two event types diverges --
agent-novelty approach is gated/reduced relative to world-novelty approach at matched
information-gain, especially under concurrent harm risk -- and (b) the three named failure modes do
not occur: no chronic approach-pressure toward the highest-unpredictability agent regardless of harm
risk, no oscillatory approach-avoidance cycling on a single agent, and an adversarially-unpredictable
confederate does not extract more approach than a matched honestly-unpredictable one.

FALSIFYING: with both built and the novelty signal confirmed live at E3 selection, approach behaviour
toward agent-policy-novelty and world-state-novelty is statistically indistinguishable at matched
information-gain -- untyped novelty reward is sufficient and no separate machinery is needed -- or
harm-risk-weighted gating alone already suppresses the three failure modes without any world/agent
novelty distinction. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

BLOCKING SUBSTRATE: ARC-047 (SocialGridWorld, confidence 0.0, unbuilt) for the multi-agent
environment itself; separately, MECH-111's broadcast-to-E3-selection routing must be repaired and
confirmed live (this is the current empirical blocker even at the single-agent level). NOTE ON
DEPENDS_ON: notes cite MECH-128 ("other-agent goal modelling") as a prerequisite; MECH-128 as
registered is single-agent z_goal conditioning, itself unresolved (three C1 nulls) -- plausible as
"the reused mechanism, once mirror-modelled," but not currently a solved building block. See
governance flags above. UNBLOCKS WHEN: ARC-047 or an equivalent multi-agent substrate exists AND
MECH-111's novelty EMA is confirmed to reach E3 selection.

MECH-131.subject: vmPFC.residue_activation
MECH-131.title: A vmPFC-analog substrate must activate stored aversive residue as an anticipatory forward-biasing signal in the navigable state at trajectory evaluation time; residue that is correctly stored but not so activated will fail to suppress harm-associated trajectory re-selection.
MECH-131.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: First establish selected-action entropy >= 0.25445 nats with the recorded estimator, trained terrain-prior avoidance and nonzero residue on distinguishable candidates. This is the user-ratified GFLAG-0363/1061 readiness requirement; do not score a monostrategy.
CONFIRMING: Intact anticipation selectively suppresses harmful proposals and their reselection relative to complete lesion, with preservation of the post-hoc cost path. Manipulation: Lesion both terrain_prior_residue_channel_enabled and score_trajectory_residue_terrain_enabled at evaluation; include CH1-only lesion. Control: Same trained agent, intact CH1+CH2, identical stored residue and post-hoc scorer. Required event: Re-encounter previously harmful trajectories with residue storage and post-hoc E3 costs intact. DV: Proposed-pool residue avoidance, residue-dependent proposal-mass suppression, and committed harmful trajectory reselection; distinguish proposal from committed-action effects.
FALSIFYING: With trained avoidance and diverse policy, complete anticipatory lesion leaves the claimed suppression unchanged, or intact anticipation has no graded relation to stored residue. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: 1061 three-arm lesion instrument and test_mech131_terrain_prior_residue_channel contracts. Consumer / boundary: Residue to pre-selection proposal generation, then E3 committed selection. Existing ownership: V3-EXQ-1061, MECH-131.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); 1061 measured 39-40 of 40 probe states selecting the same action at both exploration floors; more training is an untested caveat, not an established remedy. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-132.subject: vmPFC.constraint_activation
MECH-132.title: A vmPFC-analog substrate must activate social and identity constraints as live trajectory gates in the navigable state; constraints that are stored as semantic knowledge but not so activated will not prevent norm-violating trajectory generation even when post-hoc evaluation correctly identifies the violation.
MECH-132.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Stored social/identity constraints must be independently retrievable and must have a distinct activation-to-trajectory gate. A solitary harm signal is not a social norm.
CONFIRMING: Activation lesion increases violations despite preserved recall, unlike intact activation. Manipulation: Lesion activation while preserving constraint memory and goal representation. Control: Intact activation, erased-memory comparator, and nonsocial matched-cost conflict. Required event: Known social constraint conflicts with an otherwise attractive action. DV: Constraint-violating trajectory eligibility and committed actions conditional on intact constraint recall.
FALSIFYING: With gate engagement and conflict demonstrated, preserved knowledge remains sufficient after activation lesion. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Requires social/identity constraint-store and activation trace; no native V3 social-norm assay. Consumer / boundary: Stored declarative constraint to live navigable-state gate. Existing ownership: ARC-035, MECH-132.
DISPOSITION: R8 (primary); Full social/identity claim belongs to later social substrate; ARC-035 is an existing architectural owner, not a commissioned V3 build. R4 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-133.subject: vmPFC.safety_memory_competition
MECH-133.title: A vmPFC-analog substrate must activate safety memories with sufficient force to compete with threat-attractor states at the level of navigable state construction; an extinction memory that exists in storage but cannot outcompete the threat attractor at state-construction time will produce intrusive return to threat-consistent trajectory generation regardless of contextual safety evidence.
MECH-133.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Conditioned safety memory and competing threat memory must both be learned and distinguishable; gate activation separately from memory retention and downstream freeze suppression.
CONFIRMING: Activation lesion prevents safe-state proposal reinstatement despite intact recall. Manipulation: Disable safety-memory activation into proposal state while retaining the memory. Control: Intact activation, safety-memory erasure, and threat-context return. Required event: Return to extinction/safe context after threat learning. DV: Pre-selection safety-versus-threat proposal occupancy and context-specific committed avoidance, conditional on preserved safety recall.
FALSIFYING: An engaged activation lesion leaves safe-state reinstatement intact, or apparent safety effects occur only through downstream motor inhibition. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ConditionedSafetyStore records cue safety; ilPFC/escape bridge reads are downstream and do not by themselves record navigable-state reinstatement. Consumer / boundary: Safety-memory reactivation before trajectory generation. Existing ownership: ARC-035, MECH-133, SD-051, SD-059.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); Safety storage and downstream avoidance gates exist; the distinct pre-generation state-activation route is not established. R6 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-134.subject: vmPFC.goal_approach_pull_activation
MECH-134.title: A vmPFC-analog substrate must activate goal approach pull as a distinct property from goal representation; a goal that is correctly represented (G component present) but whose approach pull is not activated produces avoidance and anhedonia indistinguishable from absent goals, but is correctable by restoring approach-pull activation without changing goal content.
MECH-134.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Nonzero, discriminative z_goal and reachable alternatives; distinguish proposal attraction from post-hoc E3 goal scoring and show the goal-pull route has authority.
CONFIRMING: Removing pull changes proposal direction and approach while goal identity remains decodable and natively available. Manipulation: Remove pre-generation goal pull while preserving z_goal, wanting and E3 goal scoring. Control: Intact goal pull and shuffled-goal-direction control at matched magnitude. Required event: Goal cue at multiple distances while goal identity remains fixed. DV: Goalward proposal displacement before scoring and realised approach conditional on the same goal representation.
FALSIFYING: The selective lesion leaves approach unchanged with headroom and correct boundary controls. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Goal and hippocampal traces exist; a complete selective pre-generation pull lesion and independent behavioural readout need design. Consumer / boundary: Goal representation to candidate-generation bias, distinct from final ranking. Existing ownership: ARC-035, MECH-134, MECH-236.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); A z_goal norm is not an approach-force DV; current post-hoc score changes do not isolate the asserted boundary. R5 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-135.subject: planning.e1_e2_parallel_rollout
MECH-135.title: During trajectory evaluation, E2 (cerebellar, z_self) must run in parallel with E1 (cortical, z_world) so that z_world co-evolves during the planning rollout; a frozen z_world causes E3 to evaluate goal achievement against a stale world state.
MECH-135.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: E1's rollout output must be action-sensitive: per-action divergence measured at the E1 rollout output must be clearly above zero. The V3-EXQ-954 red-team measured 5.6e-6 at E1 against 2.8e-2 at E2 -- about 5000x attenuation, roughly 675x of it at the LSTM plus output_proj stage -- so co-evolved and frozen z_world currently score alike by construction.
CONFIRMING: With an action-sensitive E1 rollout, co-evolved rollouts select trajectories of higher real goal proximity than frozen ones, and the advantage grows with rollout horizon (longer is better, not worse). Manipulation: Co-evolve z_world by calling E1's single-step action-conditioned transition once per rollout step (action_conditioned_transition on) versus freezing z_world at t=0 for the whole 30-step rollout. Control: The frozen-z_world arm at matched seeds, training budget and trained agent state, plus an action-conditioning OFF arm proving the interface itself is load-bearing rather than decorative. Required event: Multi-step trajectory evaluation in which candidate action sequences genuinely differ and goal-relevant world events (resource contact, harm exposure) occur inside the rollout horizon, so a co-evolving z_world could change E3's goal scoring. DV: Real goal proximity of the best-selected trajectory (co-evolved versus frozen), the per-action divergence of the rollout endpoint, and the horizon-compounding signature -- the advantage growing with rollout length rather than being flat.
FALSIFYING: With per-action divergence demonstrably non-degenerate, co-evolved and frozen rollouts select equally good trajectories at every horizon -- goal-relevant events inside the rollout are irrelevant to E3's scoring and the parallel-rollout requirement is wrong. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: v3_exq_108/108a/108b record per-seed prox_delta and its variance; e1_deep.predict_long_horizon plus the _action_cond_missing_calls counter record whether an ON arm is genuinely ON; the 953/954 probes record the per-action divergence and cr_ratio the precondition needs. Consumer / boundary: E1's single-step z_world transition running inside E2's planning rollout, consumed by E3's trajectory scoring -- not E1's waking perception path. Existing ownership: SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training, INV-088, V3-EXQ-954, V3-EXQ-1000.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); E1's rollout is effectively action-blind. Item 1 (the dedicated LSTM action channel) landed 2026-08-29, but the dominant ~675x per-action divergence crush at LSTM plus output_proj is item 2 and is unbuilt, so a 40-candidate evaluator scores an action-invariant model and the co-evolution contrast cannot discriminate. No MECH-135-tagged retest is queued and EXP-0187 is suppressed. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-136.subject: e3.harm_eval_agency_correction
MECH-136.title: E3 harm evaluation must apply an agency-gain correction to counteract E2's systematic attenuation of agent-caused prediction errors; without this correction the agent structurally underweights its own causal harm.
MECH-136.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Matched agent-caused and external harm must first show systematic attenuation at the exact E3 harm-evaluation input; competent counterfactual attribution and calibrated independent realised-harm target are required.
CONFIRMING: Origin-specific correction removes the self-harm valuation bias better than global gain without inflating external harm. Manipulation: Enable versus remove an origin-conditioned inverse-attenuation correction. Control: Magnitude-matched global gain, wrong-origin gain and unchanged harm prediction. Required event: Equal-magnitude harm from self action versus independent environment transition. DV: Self-minus-external harm underestimation relative to realised harm, and harm-avoidance choices at the same cost.
FALSIFYING: With actual attenuation and correction engagement, the bias persists or a nonspecific gain performs equally. Absence of attenuation fails the premise rather than licensing arbitrary correction. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SD-003 attribution supplies a counterfactual comparison; no verified agency-gain correction at E3 harm evaluation. Consumer / boundary: Causal-origin estimate to E3 harm valuation, not prediction-error magnitude alone. Existing ownership: MECH-136, SD-003, SD-011.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); Neither the claimed attenuation at the consumer nor a selective correction is established by the existence of efference-copy subtraction. R5 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-137.subject: commitment.boundary_token_dual_temporal_registers
MECH-137.title: Commit token must carry two distinct temporal registers: a distal-intent timestamp (when the action was planned) and a proximal-trigger timestamp (when the action was initiated), not a single trigger event.
MECH-137.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Planning and triggering must be independently delayed/cancelled in a live agent; two genuinely different timestamps must reach attribution.
CONFIRMING: Dual registers improve temporal attribution specifically on delayed/cancelled trials. Manipulation: Collapse planned_at and triggered_at into one timestamp while retaining the same plans and execution delays. Control: Dual-register token and delay-free trials where the registers coincide. Required event: Delayed execution after a decision, with a cancellable intervening window. DV: Assignment of outcome credit to the correct intent/trigger interval and erroneous post-cancellation attribution.
FALSIFYING: A single register suffices with independently varied planning/execution timing and a non-degenerate attribution task. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: EXQ-162 implements a driver-local three-phase model, not a live REE commit-token timestamp consumer. Consumer / boundary: Intent/trigger token through actual commit and attribution. Existing ownership: Q-015, MECH-061, MECH-137.
DISPOSITION: R6 (primary); The existing toy phase model does not instantiate the native token boundary. R4 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-138.subject: commitment.boundary_token_cancel_window_flag
MECH-138.title: Commit token must include a cancel-window-open flag supported by a top-down suppressive pathway from dFMC/pre-SMA to premotor cortex that can veto the transition before execution lock-in.
MECH-138.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the cancel window must actually be exercised at a non-trivial rate (cancel_window_utilization > 0.05) under a policy that is not merely entropy-maximizing/random -- e.g. a harm-avoidance-trained policy, per the lesson of EXQ-155's 2026-03-29 supersession (random/undertrained policy converges to max-entropy walk, never meaningfully exercising the commit boundary at all). Without this, C1/C2 passing is uninformative: V3-EXQ-162 (2026-03-29, 9e3b4eaa) already ran this exact THREE_PHASE design under a random action policy and produced n_cancel_events=0 in all four cells (2 conditions x 2 seeds) -- PARTIAL_NO_CANCEL, neither confirming nor falsifying the mechanism.
CONFIRMING: with the precondition satisfied, THREE_PHASE (pre-commit / cancel_window / post-commit, veto-reset advances commit_step by N_CANCEL_WINDOW on harm_signal > CANCEL_THRESH) simultaneously satisfies: (C1) last-quartile harm no worse than the TWO_PHASE atomic-gate baseline (MECH-061) plus a small margin; (C2) pre/ post-commit signal separation is maintained (pre_post_corr < 0.30); (C3) the cancel window is genuinely exercised (cancel_window_utilization > 0.05); and (C4) firing the cancel measurably reduces harm relative to matched non-cancel trajectories (cancel_harm_avoided > 0). All four together => the cancel-window-open flag is a real, harm-reducing veto layered on top of MECH-061's atomic commit boundary.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): under a harm-sensitive (non-random) policy with adequate cancel invocation (C3 satisfied), adding the cancel window measurably DEGRADES policy quality versus the atomic TWO_PHASE baseline (C1 fails); OR cancel fires at a non-trivial rate (C3 satisfied) but produces no harm reduction on the trajectories where it fires (C4 fails) -- the flag exists and is exercised but is functionally inert; OR introducing the cancel/reset logic collapses pre/post-commit signal separation (C2 fails, pre_post_corr >= 0.30). A repeat of the V3-EXQ-162 degenerate outcome under a corrected, harm-sensitive policy and adequate hazard density would indicate the mechanism is genuinely inert at realistic conflict rates, not just undertested.
DATA-HYGIENE FLAG (2026-08-08 digestion pass, not resolved here): `evidence: []` below is misleading. A completed, claim-tagged run already exists -- evidence/experiments/v3_exq_162_mech137_commit_token_structure_9e3b4eaa_v3.json (claim_ids_tested: [MECH-137, MECH-138, MECH-139], outcome: PARTIAL_NO_CANCEL, evidence_direction: mixed) -- but is invisible to claim_evidence.v1.json because the runs/ pack copy the indexer reads is a dead stub (status: UNKNOWN, claim_ids_tested: [], empty metrics) while the flat manifest holds the real result. The run was reviewed once (2026-04-09, commit fc66ce2027) and dismissed as a "stale scaffold" reading only the empty stub. Same problem affects sibling claims MECH-137 and MECH-139. Chip spawned to investigate whether this is a one-off authoring bug or a systemic indexer gap, and to register the orphaned evidence.

MECH-139.subject: commitment.boundary_as_trajectory_endpoint
MECH-139.title: Commitment is a distributed multi-second pre-movement trajectory across motor and prefrontal regions, not a point event; the commit boundary marks the end of this trajectory, not a single moment.
MECH-139.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Separate elapsed pre-movement dynamics from explicit phase labels; an action must have a meaningful preparation interval and cancellation opportunity.
CONFIRMING: Structured preparatory dynamics predict and causally support cancellation beyond the final point gate. Manipulation: Scramble pre-movement state trajectory while preserving the final commit threshold and action. Control: Intact trajectory, equal-duration wait and post-commit perturbation. Required event: A delayed planned movement with intervening stop signals. DV: Time-resolved commitment predictability and cancellation efficacy before movement onset.
FALSIFYING: With a real preparatory interval, a point-gate model predicts and controls the same outcomes without loss. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: EXQ-162's scheduled phases do not measure endogenous multi-second premovement dynamics; V3 atomic grid actions do not supply the claimed biological timescale. Consumer / boundary: Preparation to movement initiation; native elapsed time, not episode training phase. Existing ownership: MECH-057a, MECH-061, Q-015.
DISPOSITION: R6 (primary); Available three-phase proxy and atomic action boundary do not instantiate the full temporal claim. R8 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-140.subject: commitment.tri_loop_soft_competitive_arbitration
MECH-140.title: Tri-loop gate conflict arbitration uses soft-competitive disinhibition (indirect pathway inter-collicular competition) rather than winner-take-all suppression; WTA imposed across loops causes coupling collapse.
MECH-140.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Two gates, both unmet in V3-EXQ-710. The DV must be read once per GENUINE fresh E3 selection rather than hold-weighted across env steps (the instrument-validity defect that withdrew 710's finding on 2026-07-20), and the settling must operate over a field that is not F-collapsed -- on divergent seeds 710's structured settling REDUCED committed-class entropy (-0.169, -0.153 nats), so a lift measured over an F-dominated single arena cannot discriminate soft-competitive from winner-take-all.
CONFIRMING: At the segregated-loop locus with the fresh-selection-gated DV, the structured-kernel arm shows graded (never silenced) down-weighting of losing loops AND a strictly higher committed-class entropy than both OFF and the uniform-kernel null on divergent seeds, with task-switching preserved where a hard winner-take-all comparator collapses it. Manipulation: Matched arms over use_soft_competitive_settling with the parameter-free class-surround kernel intact (A1) versus a uniform rank-preserving kernel (A2) versus OFF (A0), run at the SEGREGATED-loop locus (v4_loop_segregation motor / associative / limbic loops with within-loop competition first), not in the single collapsed arena. Control: A0_OFF at matched seeds plus the A2 uniform-kernel arm as the mechanism-isolating null (710 established A2 reproduces A0 bit-identically, which makes it a clean no-op control rather than a power-bearing one), plus a magnitude-matched random-structure null injected at the eligibility/settling-field layer. Required event: Loop-conflict ticks in which more than one cortico-BG-thalamic loop has an eligible candidate set and the loops disagree -- task-switching or cross-loop arbitration demand, not single-task selection, since the claim's prediction is that ablating the inhibition-on-inhibition edge collapses switching while single-task survives. DV: Fresh-selection-gated committed-class entropy and cross-loop gate readings taken once per genuine non-fallback E3 selection via GateDVRecorder, decomposed by loop, plus a graded-inhibition witness showing losing options are down-weighted but never silenced (all support values strictly positive).
FALSIFYING: With the same instrument and a demonstrably non-F-collapsed field, the structured class-surround kernel gives no advantage over the uniform rank-preserving kernel, or reproduces the 710 pattern of REDUCING committed-class entropy on divergent seeds -- soft-competitive disinhibition does no work that a rank-preserving sharpen does not, and the WTA-causes-coupling-collapse half is unsupported at this locus. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The mechanism is built and contract-tested: ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py _soft_competitive_settle behind config.e3.use_soft_competitive_settling, tests/contracts/test_soft_competitive_settling.py. The corrected DV instrument also now exists -- experiments/_lib/gate_dv.py composed with _lib/fresh_select.py, landed ree-v3 c309bc6 on 2026-08-19 as the 713x re-letter precondition -- and no MECH-140 run has used it. Consumer / boundary: Between-loop competitive disinhibition at the eligibility/settling field, ahead of the committed-selection argmin -- the cross-loop arbitration boundary, which the single F-collapsed arena structurally does not instantiate. Existing ownership: v4_loop_segregation, f_dominance_conversion_ceiling, EXP-1320, MECH-450, MECH-439, ARC-110, conversion_ceiling_campaign:P4-learned-gating, behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-K.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Over the single F-collapsed arena the settling sharpens the F-winner instead of diversifying, so the falsifier cannot discriminate; MECH-140 has zero valid experimental rows since the 710 finding was withdrawn on instrument-validity grounds. The corrected GateDV instrument landed 2026-08-19 and the segregated-loop substrate is built, but governance held the 713x re-letter and nothing has re-run. Secondary classes: R6, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation.
