MECH-141.subject: commitment.tri_loop_dual_timescale_arbitration
MECH-141.title: Tri-loop arbitration requires both a slow proactive inhibition pathway (prefrontal-caudate, seconds-scale) and a fast reactive hyperdirect pathway (milliseconds-scale); these operate at segregated timescales and cannot be collapsed.
MECH-141.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Action selection must actually be driven by the arbitration machinery under test -- V3-EXQ-163 used literal random.randint for selection and produced three bit-identical arms, so the manipulation never reached the mechanism -- and both pathways must fire at non-zero rates in the probe window.
CONFIRMING: Collapsing the two channels into one arbitration signal measurably reduces late-interrupt success while leaving admission quality intact, reproducing the dissociation the claim asserts. Manipulation: Ablate each pathway separately against a collapsed single-signal arbitration arm: the pre-commit admission conjunction (MECH-090 R-c, BetaGate.should_admit_elevation AND CommitReadiness.is_above_floor) standing for the proactive pathway, and the fast threshold interrupt (MECH-091 harm-triggered release) standing for the reactive one, with MECH-342's graded maintenance-release accumulator as the third, intermediate-timescale channel. Control: A both-intact arm and a collapsed-arbitration arm at matched seeds, with a manipulation check that commit entries and releases occur in every arm. Required event: A commitment that is entered under one arbitration regime and then challenged mid-maintenance, so an admission-time gate and a release-time interrupt can be distinguished. DV: Rate of successful late interrupts (a committed program abandoned after a challenge appearing post-admission) versus rate of correct admissions, compared between the two-pathway and collapsed-arbitration arms -- the collapse should cost late-interrupt capability specifically, not admission quality.
FALSIFYING: A single collapsed arbitration signal matches the two-pathway arm on both admission and late-interrupt measures, so the segregation buys nothing on this substrate. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The pathways are instrumented: BetaGate elevation and release events, CommitReadiness state, and MECH-342's accumulator are all readable; no driver currently records them for this claim, and the one that tried selected actions randomly. Consumer / boundary: The commit admission-and-release boundary in the policy layer, not the E3 score surface. Existing ownership: MECH-342, MECH-090, MECH-091, EXP-1310, MECH-457.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The only run on record disabled the mechanism it was testing by selecting actions with random.randint, giving three bit-identical arms; the arbitration substrate it should have used (MECH-090 admission conjunction, MECH-091 threshold interrupt, MECH-342 graded maintenance release) exists and has never been used for this claim. The literal millisecond-versus-second segregation has no sub-tick substrate in V3. Secondary classes: R6, R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-142.subject: control_plane.cholinergic_axis_orthogonality_maintenance
MECH-142.title: Valence-arousal axis orthogonality in the control plane is not a static geometric property but requires active cholinergic maintenance during learning; without it, axes drift toward correlation under repeated co-activation.
MECH-142.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The claim's two presupposed objects must exist before any falsifier can discriminate: an orthogonal valence/arousal axis PAIR and a cholinergic-analog gating or decorrelation mechanism. Verified absent in current code -- ree_core has a 6-component valence vector with no arousal counterpart and zero files mentioning acetylcholine or cholinergic modulation -- and the absence of (1) is a deliberate design choice, not an oversight.
CONFIRMING: Given a genuine orthogonal axis pair plus an ACh-analog gate, removing the gate lets the axes drift toward correlation under co-activation while the gated arm holds orthogonality, on a majority of seeds. Manipulation: Ablating the ACh-analog gating or decorrelation mechanism during training while holding the co-activation schedule fixed. Control: The gating-intact arm at matched seeds and co-activation schedule, plus an initialisation-only orthogonality arm that separates maintenance from initial geometry. Required event: Repeated co-activation of valence and arousal channels during learning, sustained long enough for a correlation to develop if it is going to. DV: The correlation (or subspace angle) between the valence and arousal axes measured over training, contrasting gated and ungated arms -- drift toward correlation being the predicted signature.
FALSIFYING: With the same substrate, axis orthogonality is preserved without the gate -- orthogonality is a static geometric property of the representation rather than something actively maintained, and MECH-142's maintenance claim fails. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: No recorder can exist for this DV because neither operand does: the axis pair is absent, so the two existing drivers (V3-EXQ-164/164a) build their own local two-axis proxy rather than measuring a control-plane property, which is why 164a reads non_contributory / competence_implementation_gap. Consumer / boundary: The control plane's axis geometry during learning (ARC-005), with a possible second locus in hippocampal valence/space separation. Existing ownership: mech142-no-valence-arousal-orthogonal-axis-substrate, EXP-1370, MECH-063, ARC-005.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); Neither operand of the claim exists in V3: there is no arousal axis to be orthogonal to the valence vector, and no cholinergic-analog gating or decorrelation mechanism anywhere in ree_core. The substrate's actual design deliberately does the opposite of (1), so this is a reframing decision rather than a build. Secondary classes: R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-143.subject: hippocampus.dorsal_ca1_value_free_map
MECH-143.title: Dorsal CA1 implements value-free spatial mapping: place cells are insensitive to goal value when goal location changes, supporting ARC-007's no-new-value-computation constraint for the trajectory proposal module.
MECH-143.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The probe positions must be mutually distinguishable in the representation before any value-invariance can be read: V3-EXQ-960's own MIN_DISPERSION floor of 0.02 on cross-position z_world dispersion was missed 2x to 78x in every cell, and under that condition a low map drift is a representation-collapse artefact rather than value-invariance. The value manipulation must also be shown to reach behaviour (966's flip_differs positive control must fire on every seed).
CONFIRMING: With cross-position dispersion above its floor, z_world drift under value change is indistinguishable from the repeat-identical baseline while drift under location change clearly exceeds it, on a majority of seeds. Manipulation: Re-valuing the goal (resource amplitude change) with location held constant, contrasted against the location-change arm that the representation SHOULD track. Control: The location-change arm is the positive control -- the map must move when location moves -- and a repeat-identical arm bounds the readout's own drift. Required event: A change in goal VALUE at a fixed goal LOCATION, after a training phase in which the agent has formed a spatial representation that discriminates the probe positions. DV: Cosine drift of the z_world vector sampled at fixed probe positions between the pre- and post-manipulation snapshots, under value change versus location change, with the cross-position dispersion reported alongside as the interpretability gate.
FALSIFYING: With the same dispersion precondition met, z_world drift under pure value change is comparable to drift under location change -- the map encodes value, and ARC-007's no-new-value-computation constraint does not hold at this boundary. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: V3-EXQ-960 implements exactly this snapshot-and-drift readout with the dispersion gate built in, and 966 adds the causal ecological arm; both exist and run, so the instrument is present and honest -- it is the representation it reads that is degenerate. Consumer / boundary: The z_world map that the hippocampal trajectory proposer navigates, upstream of any value computation at commitment. Existing ownership: SD-106, SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY, SD-018, EXP-0055.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The observation-to-z_world encoder does not differentiate the probe positions at the measured operating point, so the DV has nothing to be invariant over; and the one causal retest's own positive control did not fire on every seed. Neither is a fault of the MECH-143 design. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-144.subject: hippocampus.ventral_ca1_valence_encoding
MECH-144.title: Ventral CA1 contains spatially organized valence encoding (anxiety geography, abstract value maps); valence is intrinsic to hippocampal map geometry in the ventral compartment, supporting MECH-073.
MECH-144.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The valence manipulation must be shown to reach the measured DV before the DV is read: in V3-EXQ-966 block_contacts was BIT-IDENTICAL between ARM_FIXED_VALUE and ARM_SHUFFLED_VALUE on 4/4 seeds x 4/4 blocks, making the equivalence test read a pure relabelling, and the mechanism for that is still unresolved. Group arity must also be non-degenerate, which the landed _metrics arity guard now enforces.
CONFIRMING: A properly powered rerun reproduces a distance-graded valence organisation that re-forms after the shuffle, with a manipulation-reach check that fires, on a majority of seeds. Manipulation: Shuffling which resource type carries high amplitude partway through the life (the 966 causal arm), or re-siting the aversive region, so the valence field must be re-encoded at fixed geometry. Control: The fixed-value arm at matched seeds, plus a one-seed confirmer that logs per-step actions, amplitudes and agent_energy to establish that the shuffle is not inert before any further run is queued. Required event: A valence-relevant spatial layout in which regions carry graded aversive or appetitive value, sampled at enough distinct locations that a gradient could be recovered. DV: Spatial organisation of the valence encoding -- the gradient of the valence component with distance from the aversive or appetitive region -- rather than a contact-count equivalence statistic whose two arms are complementary by construction.
FALSIFYING: With reach demonstrated and adequate power, the valence encoding shows no spatial organisation beyond the geometry's own structure -- which would be genuine pressure, the 961 result being that finding at low power. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: V3-EXQ-961 measures a spatially graded valence gradient and its degeneracy check now behaves correctly (the singleton-group arity guard landed in experiments/_metrics.py with a dedicated contract test), so 961's weakens is a genuine but low-powered negative. Consumer / boundary: The valence values written into the residue field's spatial geometry, as opposed to a valence tag applied externally at selection time. Existing ownership: EXP-0118, chip-20260830-exq165-dormant-driver-decision, chip-20260830-singleton-group-degeneracy-guard.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The designated retest vehicle's manipulation did not differentiate the measured DV at all (bit-identical on every seed and block) and why is unresolved; a cheap one-seed confirmer is owed before any 966a. The only scoring datum is the low-powered 961 negative. Secondary classes: R1, R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-145.subject: ethics.prescriptive_cbf_certificate
MECH-145.title: Prescriptive ethical trajectory certification in REE requires a Control Barrier Function (CBF) or equivalent forward-invariance certificate that guarantees bounded convergence to the ethical attractor set given the architecture's constraint satisfaction.
MECH-145.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Three things must exist before this claim is attemptable at all, none
built as of 2026-09-25: (1) a formal specification of the REE ethical constraint set as an implicit
surface h(x)=0 -- no such formalization exists anywhere in ree_core or REE_assembly docs; (2)
differentiable REE dynamics suitable for CBF gradient computation; (3) Q-023's potential-game
structure validated by proof (Q-023 remains `status: open`, `epistemic_category: derivational`,
unresolved as of this check). Separately, e3_selector.py has no candidate-exclusion / hard-
feasibility-constraint layer at all -- only additive score channels (lambda_ethical,
rho_residue*Phi_R) exist. This is independently corroborated by another claim in the registry
(near INV-038/MECH-125/MECH-049, claims.yaml ~line 1460): it names the missing mechanism directly as
"candidate exclusion / CBF-style trajectory certification, the MECH-145 substrate" and states
"nothing records a candidate EXCLUSION event, because no exclusion mechanism exists to record."
Attempting CBF synthesis before these exist tests nothing.

CONFIRMING (answered by construction/proof once unblocked, not by a V3 telemetry run): a CBF h(x) is
constructed for the REE ethical constraint set, and CBF-QP synthesis is shown (following Ames et al.
2017) to guarantee h(x)>=0 forward invariance for any policy satisfying the CBF constraint, under
REE's actual constraint-satisfaction dynamics.

FALSIFYING: no valid CBF can be constructed for REE's ethical constraint set under its actual
dynamics -- a nonexistence result, e.g. the constraint surface lacks the relative-degree /
Lipschitz properties CBF-QP requires -- OR Q-023 resolves negatively (MECH-127's counterfactual-
utility case breaks the potential-game structure with no pseudo-potential extension), removing the
"given the architecture's constraint satisfaction" premise this claim assumes. A failure under unmet
preconditions (attempted before the above exist) is not evidence against the claim.

BLOCKING CLAIM / SUBSTRATE: Q-023 (open, derivational -- the potential-game proof this claim's
constraint-satisfaction premise rests on), AND a not-yet-built candidate-exclusion layer in
ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py (no claim currently owns constructing it; MECH-145 is
already the name other claims use for it). UNBLOCKS WHEN: Q-023 resolves (proof or counterexample)
AND a formal h(x) spec plus exclusion layer exist to attempt CBF-QP synthesis against.

MECH-146.subject: ethics.diagnostic_barrier_certificate
MECH-146.title: Diagnostic ethical trajectory verification in REE (counterfactual case, MECH-127) requires backward reachability analysis or barrier certificates rather than prescriptive CBF synthesis; the two formal tools are not interchangeable.
MECH-146.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-146 is doubly gated. (1) MECH-145 must first exist and resolve (a
certified forward-invariant h(x) constructed) -- MECH-146's backward-reachability / barrier-
certificate verification is explicitly the diagnostic counterpart to MECH-145's prescriptive
certificate and presumes the same formal constraint-set specification MECH-145 currently lacks (see
MECH-145's own non-degeneracy precondition above; do not re-derive it here). (2) MECH-127's
counterfactual-utility case, which motivates this claim's specific test scenario, is confirmed
design-only: MECH-127's own registry what_would_answer states "no built substrate and no experiment
has ever attempted to test it (no EXQ/run IDs exist against this claim)," gated on MIRROR-1,
MIRROR-2, MECH-163 and INV-064, none of which are built. Q-023's potential-game proof (open) is a
shared prerequisite with MECH-145. Attempting backward-reachability analysis before a trajectory-
generating counterfactual mirror channel exists tests nothing.

CONFIRMING (by construction, once unblocked): a barrier certificate (Prajna & Jadbabaie 2004 style)
verifies, for an actual REE agent trajectory under MECH-127's counterfactual-utility case, whether
the trajectory could have reached an unsafe/unethical set under an alternative policy -- without
forward-simulating every alternative -- and this diagnostic result requires backward reachability
specifically: a forward-only CBF check on the same trajectory disagrees with ground-truth
counterfactual simulation, demonstrating MECH-145's certificate type alone is insufficient for the
diagnostic case.

FALSIFYING: once MECH-127 and MECH-145 both exist, MECH-145's forward (prescriptive) certificate
alone answers the diagnostic counterfactual question correctly (agrees with ground-truth backward
simulation) with no loss -- i.e. the two certificate types collapse into one, contrary to this
claim's "not interchangeable" assertion. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against
the claim.

BLOCKING CLAIMS: MECH-145 (unresolved, substrate_conditional -- see above) and MECH-127 (design-only,
zero evidence, gated on MIRROR-1/MIRROR-2/MECH-163/INV-064 per its own what_would_answer). UNBLOCKS
WHEN: both resolve/build; MECH-146 cannot be attempted independently of MECH-145's resolution.

MECH-147.subject: hippocampus.pattern_separation_trajectory_disambiguation
MECH-147.title: DG-mediated pattern separation gates trajectory disambiguation: the dentate gyrus must produce non-redundant sparse encodings of similar z_world states before rollout proposals are generated, preventing the hippocampal planning module from proposing near-identical trajectories from overlapping inputs.
MECH-147.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION:
(i) P-SEED: proposal content must vary with the seed state. The 2026-09-24 probe
(evidence/planning/e2_rollout_divergence_and_proposal_state_dependence_20260924.md) found the
pool's majority first-action class identical at 30/30 states. If DISSIMILAR seeds already yield
identical proposals, "similar seeds yield near-identical proposals" is not a DG-specific deficit
and an ablation cannot show it. Require between-seed proposal divergence above a shuffled-seed
floor first.
(ii) A DG-equivalent sparse-expansion stage on the seed z_world must exist (none in ree-v3 today)
and its sparsity must be verified in-run.
(iii) E3 must discriminate candidates on consequence, not on deep-step extrapolation noise (same
probe, step 4). Otherwise the "wasted E3 evaluation cycles" rationale is unmeasurable.
(iv) The environment must expose ground-truth latent context, crossed with appearance similarity
(MECH-495's 2x2; see its what_would_answer, do not re-derive).
CONFIRMING: Compare DG-ON with DG-ablated at a matched proposal budget.
- For similar-appearance / DIFFERENT-context seeds, DG-ON raises between-seed proposal divergence
  (first-action class and trajectory distance) AND improves the committed outcome (harm or goal
  contact) on >= 2/3 seeds.
- For already-distinct seeds, ablation leaves proposal quality unchanged. This is the claim's own
  selectivity prediction.
- Controls:
  - a dense expansion of matched width with no sparsity (tests sparsity, not width);
  - noise injection matched in added proposal variance (tests separation, not mere diversity).
FALSIFYING: With (i)-(iv) met, any one of the following refutes the claim:
- ablating DG does not selectively collapse proposal diversity in high-similarity regions;
- the dense-expansion or noise arm reproduces the benefit.
NARROWING (not refutation): If DG-ON separates similar-appearance / SAME-context seeds as strongly
as different-context ones, and that costs generalisation, then MECH-495's discriminating cell
decides against the claim's "non-redundant encodings of similar states" wording. The claim then
narrows to context-appropriate separation.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: a state-conditioned proposal map lands (the probe's R5 item) AND a default-off DG
sparse-expansion layer (k-WTA over a random expansion of the seed z_world) is built, bit-identical
when off.
OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: primate CA3/DG lure-discrimination (Sakon & Suzuki 2019) is literature; it is
already in claim_evidence (3 lit supports).

MECH-148.subject: hippocampus.time_cell_temporal_credit
MECH-148.title: Hippocampal pure time cells provide a temporal scaffolding signal for E3 credit assignment: a context-independent elapsed-time encoding must be present in the hippocampal rollout module to correctly weight trajectory outcomes by their temporal distance from the reference event.
MECH-148.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (a) A time-coding layer producing context-independent elapsed-time
signals must exist in the hippocampal rollout module -- none does; ree_core contains no
time_cell/elapsed_time-tagged pathway (source grep, 2026-09-25). (b) ARC-018's rollout-viability
substrate must clear its own gate first: in-run e2_world_r2 above 0.6 (V3-EXQ-801 measured -66 to
-130) and non-degenerate fresh_select_yield (801 measured 0.0027, effectively latched) -- rollout
steps have nothing coherent to time-tag until ARC-018 is live. (c) ARC-039 (durable
hippocampal-entorhinal storage) is implementation_phase v4 / phase_locked (reclassified
2026-08-10) -- unbuilt. (d) At the plan level, HPL-1 (MECH-163 multi-step planned-system
validation) gates the whole hippocampal_planning_v4 roadmap; leg 1 now has a genuine PASS
(V3-EXQ-811a, 2026-07-24, MECH-477 arbitrator ON) but HPL-1 stays blocked because its third
readiness item, ARC-071 (planned->habitual transition machinery), remains
candidate/v3_pending/substrate_conditional.
CONFIRMING: once a time-coding layer is built and injected into rollout steps (fixed step-interval
firing, independent of z_world state) and ARC-018 clears its e2_world_r2/fresh-select gates: an
ablation removing the time layer specifically degrades long-horizon (delayed-outcome) harm-advantage
credit assignment relative to intact, while short-horizon (immediate) evaluation is unaffected, at
>= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed contrast (ARC-018's own effect-size convention).
FALSIFYING: with the layer built and (a)-(d) met, removing the time layer produces no differential
degradation between long- and short-horizon credit assignment -- z_world state alone already
carries sufficient temporal information for E3 credit assignment and no dedicated elapsed-time
signal is needed. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
NOTES: the claim conflates two variants -- "a time signal exists during within-episode rollout" (the
one the ablation prediction actually tests) and "the signal survives offline consolidation" (needs
ARC-039). Recommend scoping the eventual falsifier to the rollout variant only; ARC-039 should gate
a separate durability leg, not the core claim.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: ARC-018 e2_world_r2 clears 0.6 in-run AND a time-coding layer is implemented in the
hippocampal rollout module AND ARC-071 lands (closing HPL-1's residual gate).

MECH-149.subject: hippocampus.ca1_mismatch_novelty_gate
MECH-149.title: CA1 mismatch between E1-predicted and CA3-retrieved z_world gates hippocampal trajectory injection into E3 evaluation: novel situations (high CA1 mismatch) should trigger more frequent and diverse rollout proposals; familiar situations (low mismatch) should rely on cached viability estimates.
MECH-149.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION:
(i) P-SEED: the proposal pool must be state-conditioned (2026-09-24 probe: majority class identical
at 30/30 states). Otherwise widening the pool adds count, not seed-appropriate content.
(ii) The mismatch signal must discriminate novel from familiar. It must fall with revisits to a
region and rise at a novel-region transition on >= 2/3 seeds. A world model with near-uniform
error gives a constant gate: the E2 world head is untrained in about half of recent drivers
(same probe, step 1).
(iii) A graded mismatch -> proposal-budget/diversity edge must exist and be load-bearing, with the
OFF arm bit-identical in the same run. It is absent today: the SD-061 regulator reads stuck_score
only.
(iv) The low-mismatch fallback, "cached viability", must actually be populated (ARC-018 viability
map / residue terrain). Otherwise "fewer proposals" just means fewer proposals.
CONFIRMING: Compare the graded mismatch-gated arm against three controls:
(a) a fixed-budget arm at matched MEAN proposal count;
(b) an SD-061 stuck-gated arm at matched mean count;
(c) a shuffled-gate arm (same budget distribution, temporally decoupled from mismatch).
The claim is confirmed when the mismatch-gated arm beats all three on post-transition outcome
(time to first goal contact, or harm rate after entering a novel region or after an environment
change) on >= 2/3 seeds, with no cost in familiar regions, and the budget tracks mismatch
monotonically and continuously, not as a binary switch.
FALSIFYING: With (i)-(iv) met, any one of the following refutes the claim:
- the gated arm is no better than the shuffled-gate or matched-mean arm (the benefit is budget,
  not timing);
- it is no better than the stuck-gated arm (novelty adds nothing over impasse);
- relying on the cache under low mismatch degrades familiar-region outcomes.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: P-SEED is met AND a default-off edge routes a novelty scalar into an SD-061-style
proposal gain. Candidate scalars are the E1-PE novelty EMA (MECH-111, e3_selector.py:1413) and
SD-025 novelty (hippocampal/module.py:1908). This is a small `complicated (buildable)` item, not a
V4 architecture.
OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: whether biological CA1 computes EC-vs-CA3 match-mismatch and drives VTA via
subiculum -> NAc -> VP (Lisman & Grace 2005) is literature, not REE. The claim's own caveat says
the REE mapping is functional only.

MECH-150.subject: e1.cue_indexed_association_retrieval
MECH-150.title: E1 ContextMemory, when queried with z_world alone (not the full [z_self, z_world] state), produces a cue-indexed association context that selectively activates stored associations relevant to the current sensory context.
MECH-150.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The environment must generate cross-context z_world entropy -- the 418-series established that with near-identical queries (cosine 0.998 across batch) NO retrieval substrate can differentiate, which is a property of the env, not of MECH-150. The GOV-FANOUT-1 configuration (cue_slot_tagger True, gumbel selection, ctxdiv_weight 0.5) is what clears it; the legacy q.k attention path sits on a uniform-softmax saddle and is uninformative.
CONFIRMING: Cue contexts for distinct exteroceptive contexts separate reliably with the retrieval selective rather than uniform, and the terrain readout carries real content -- met by V3-EXQ-922, C1/C1b/C2 PASS 3/3 seeds (confirmed autopsy 2026-08-13). Manipulation: Query ContextMemory with z_world alone via E1DeepPredictor.extract_cue_context (world_query_proj / cue_slot_tagger path) instead of the standard full [z_self, z_world] query, under the production combination config. Control: The full-state query (generate_prior) at matched seeds and matched training, plus the pre-GOV-FANOUT-1 legacy attention arm which is the known-degenerate comparator. Required event: Episodes presenting distinguishable exteroceptive contexts (hazard-proximate versus hazard-distal) with the same body state, so that a z_world-only query has something to discriminate. FALSIFYING: With the env-entropy precondition demonstrably satisfied and per-context sampling non-degenerate, cue contexts remain indistinguishable (cosine near 1.0) and the terrain readout carries no content -- as EXQ-181b measured (0.9999, 0/3 seeds) before the precondition was cleared. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py extract_cue_context (lines ~1005-1065: cue_slot_tagger / world_query_proj selection, cue_action_proj and cue_terrain_proj heads); the V3-EXQ-922 driver computes C1/C1b/C2 and reports per-context sampling. Consumer / boundary: E1's ContextMemory read boundary -- whether a cue-only query yields selectively activated stored associations that then bias E2 affordances (MECH-151) and E3 precision (MECH-152). Existing ownership: SD-016, EXP-0182, V3-EXQ-922.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); R0: substrate wired (SD-016 extract_cue_context), env-entropy precondition cleared under the GOV-FANOUT-1 config, instrument present, and the falsifier has been fired once with a confirmed autopsy. MECH-151.subject: e1_e2.cue_indexed_action_affordance_modulation
MECH-151.title: The cue-indexed E1 context vector (MECH-150) projects to an action_bias signal that is added to E2.action_object() outputs, producing top-down contextual weighting of the action-affordance manifold prior to HippocampalModule search.
MECH-151.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: E1's cue-derived action_bias must be measurably CONTEXT-DEPENDENT across the scored window -- the cue_context feeding cue_action_proj must vary with sensory context rather than sitting near-constant under the known ContextMemory homogenisation -- and action_object_bias_weight must be non-zero. Without that, the alignment term is a fixed direction and the test measures a generic action-object preference, not cue indexing.
CONFIRMING: With cue_context demonstrably context-varying, the ON arm reorders committed selections toward cue-aligned action-objects relative to both OFF and the shuffled-cue control, by more than the per-seed effect-size floor, with the effect scaling in the expected direction with action_object_bias_weight. Manipulation: e3.use_action_object_bias_channel ON versus OFF (the channel built 2026-09-01 at ree-v3 84e211a, default False), with action_object_bias_weight swept, holding the HippocampalModule CEM proposal-mean translation identical in both arms so the manipulation is the RANKING channel, not the proposal pool. Control: The OFF arm (bit-identical, no kwarg reaches score_bias) plus a shuffled-cue arm in which action_bias is permuted across contexts, which removes any reordering attributable to the alignment term's mere presence rather than to cue-appropriate content. Required event: Committed-selection ticks in contexts whose cue-activated associations differ, with a candidate bank whose members carry genuinely different action-object trajectories (Trajectory.action_objects, SD-004). DV: Per-candidate rank change of action-objects as a function of their cosine alignment with action_bias -- aligned candidates must receive a MORE NEGATIVE score (REE lower-is-better) -- measured as the committed-action-class composition shift between ON and OFF, conditioned on context and compared against the shuffled-cue control.
FALSIFYING: The ON arm's committed-action composition is indistinguishable from the shuffled-cue control at any usable weight, or the reordering is present but uncorrelated with cue context -- MECH-151's elevate/suppress wording would then be over-specified relative to what the cue signal actually carries, and the 2026-09-05 qualification (the CEM refit is the only real channel) would stand. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: e3_selector.compute_action_object_alignment_bias returns a per-candidate [K] lower-is-better tensor folded into the score_bias chain in REEAgent.select_action (agent.py around line 9514); two contract tests pin it -- test_gflag0051_action_object_bias_channel.py for the elevate/suppress direction and test_exp0155_action_bias_no_scoring_authority.py for the pre-build bit-identity. Consumer / boundary: E3's per-candidate scoring pass -- the only locus ARC-007 STRICT permits weighting at -- rather than HippocampalModule's proposal pool, where the shared additive o_t translation is argmin-invariant. Existing ownership: SD-016, SD-055, MECH-150, GFLAG-0051, GFLAG-0133, EXP-1311.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Not the ranking site any more -- that was built 2026-09-01. The live risk is degeneracy in the cue signal: cue_context comes from the same ContextMemory whose write path is documented to homogenise, so action_bias may be near-constant across contexts and the alignment term would then rank on candidate geometry alone. No run has exercised the channel. Secondary classes: R0. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-152.subject: e1_e3.cue_indexed_terrain_precision_modulation
MECH-152.title: The cue-indexed E1 context vector (MECH-150) projects to a terrain_weight signal [w_harm, w_goal] that scales E3's harm and goal scoring, implementing contextual precision modulation on the harm/benefit terrain evaluation.
MECH-152.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Two witnesses before any arm comparison. The ContextMemory write path must be validated non-corrupting for the addressing AND the retrieval halves (V3-EXQ-943 validated only the occupancy/addressing half), and the training distribution must show measured cross-context z_world separation -- SD-016's own diagnosis recorded z_world queries at cosine 0.998 across batch, under which no retrieval substrate can index anything and terrain_weight cannot vary for reasons unrelated to MECH-152.
CONFIRMING: With the write path validated and cross-context z_world separation demonstrated, w_goal and w_harm both show modulation depth of the asserted order across context classes in the ON arm and at the floor in the OFF arm, and high w_harm measurably REDUCES harm-evaluation variability rather than merely scaling its mean. Manipulation: Cue-indexing ON versus OFF crossed with selection hardness (legacy soft selection versus hard-Gumbel), since V3-EXQ-922 showed the production hard-Gumbel arm suppressed the terrain-precision signal relative to the A0_OFF arm, and separately a precision-versus-magnitude manipulation that holds mean harm score fixed while varying w_harm. Control: A cue-indexing-OFF arm at matched seeds whose readout is scored by the SAME statistic (the 922a finding is that the chosen statistic ranked this control ABOVE the ON arm, so the control must be the calibration reference, not just a comparator), plus an ARC-016 temporal-precision-only arm so contextual gain is dissociated from temporal gain. Required event: Presentation of genuinely distinguishable hazard-gradient versus resource-proximate contexts within a single run, cue-indexed through E1 ContextMemory, with both harm and goal channels active so the symmetric prediction is testable. DV: Terrain_weight MODULATION DEPTH -- the realised swing of w_harm and w_goal across context classes, expressed against the 0.6 swing the claim asserts and against the run's own measurement floor -- replacing the across-context Pearson r; plus harm-evaluation VARIABILITY under high versus low w_harm, which is the precision-gain versus magnitude-scaling discriminator the claim itself names.
FALSIFYING: Under the same witnesses the modulation depth stays at the measurement floor for w_goal while w_harm modulates -- MECH-152 is a harm-only mechanism, contradicting its own symmetric title -- or w_harm scales magnitude without reducing variability, falsifying the precision-gain reading and blocking the collapse into ARC-016. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The pathway exists end to end: e1_deep.py:1077 terrain_weight = sigmoid(cue_terrain_proj(cue_context)), cached and passed at agent.py:7471, consumed at e3_selector.py:1672/1713/1732 scaling harm cost, benefit and goal proximity. The DV recorder is what is missing -- the 194/194a/922/922a drivers all report an across-context correlation rather than a floor-referenced modulation depth or a variability statistic. Consumer / boundary: The multiplicative scaling of E3's harm and goal channels at trajectory scoring, before aggregation -- a contextual gain at the scoring boundary, distinct from ARC-016's temporal precision on the commit threshold. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0044, contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy, SD-016, MECH-151, ARC-041, ARC-016, EXP-0064.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The prescribed DV cannot discriminate: the across-context Pearson r ranks the cue-indexing-OFF control above the ON arm, at a modulation depth orders of magnitude below the asserted swing. The measurement redesign is gated on the corrupting ContextMemory write path, and SD-016 remains parked on an unmet env-entropy precondition (z_world cosine 0.998 across batch). Secondary classes: R5, R3. Gap disposition: INSTRUMENT EXISTS BUT WRONG LOCUS/TIMESCALE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Three changes since the text was written. (a) The confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-922a (2026-08-16) found the Pearson-r DV the WWA prescribes is itself inadequate -- it ranks the cue-indexing-OFF control above the ON arm, and the observed terrain_weight modulation depth is 2-6 orders of magnitude below the 0.6 swing the claim asserts, so r_w_goal comparable in magnitude to r_w_harm=0.70 is not a usable target. (b) The owed work was re-scoped by that autopsy from a goal-context-variation re-run to a MEASUREMENT redesign. (c) GFLAG-0044 records that redesign as gated on substrate_queue entry contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (severity corrupting, still implemented_pending_validation), whose substrate path ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py::ContextMemory.write feeds the very module that computes terrain_weight. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-153.subject: e1.context_memory_supervised_training_requirement
MECH-153.title: E1 ContextMemory requires a supervised context-labeling training objective -- not unsupervised experience alone -- to produce differentiated cue-indexed representations; without this objective, hazard-proximate and hazard-distal context vectors remain near-identical (cosine_sim approximately 1.0), leaving the MECH-150 retrieval pathway functionally silent.
MECH-153.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The exposure regime must be the balanced/forced (childhood) one: V3-EXQ-832 showed an avoidance-shaped regime fails to differentiate ContextMemory even with supervised labelling ON, so an avoidance-regime null is a precondition failure, not evidence. Both arms must also reach the same number of hazard-proximate and hazard-distal samples, and the unsupervised arm must be capable of some differentiation for the contrast to be interpretable.
CONFIRMING: At matched balanced exposure the supervised arm's hazard-proximate/distal cosine falls materially below the unsupervised arm's and below an absolute discrimination threshold, as V3-EXQ-832's C1/C2 found. Manipulation: Supervised context-labelling objective ON versus OFF (a hazard-field binary label regressed from the ContextMemory output) at matched exposure ratio, seeds and episode count -- the CHILDHOOD versus CHILDHOOD_UNSUP contrast of V3-EXQ-832. Control: Matched-exposure unsupervised arm (world-model objective only) plus the avoidance-shaped-exposure arm, which isolates the exposure-regime axis from the supervision-strength axis. Required event: Training exposure containing genuinely separated hazard-proximate (hazard_field_view.max() > 0.7) and hazard-distal (< 0.33) contexts at num_hazards = 1, sampled in a balanced regime over enough episodes for ContextMemory writes to accumulate. DV: mean cosine similarity between the mean ContextMemory prior for hazard-proximate and hazard-distal contexts, read as the supervised-minus-unsupervised delta with a pre-registered absolute floor (V3-EXQ-832's C2 used >= 0.10) rather than a bare sign test.
FALSIFYING: Under balanced exposure the unsupervised arm differentiates as well as the supervised arm (delta below the pre-registered floor), showing the world-model objective alone suffices and supervision is not necessary. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The supervised head and the cosine DV live in the experiment driver experiments/v3_exq_832_inv041_childhood_exposure_context_diff.py (and v3_exq_211/239), not in ree_core -- ree_core has no supervised context-labelling objective, so no production agent is ever trained this way. Consumer / boundary: The E1 ContextMemory representation itself; the claim's second clause additionally asserts the consequence at the MECH-150 cue-indexed retrieval consumer, which is a different boundary. Existing ownership: SD-016, SD-023, MECH-150, V3-EXQ-832, EXP-0232.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); The representational falsifier is runnable and has fired (V3-EXQ-832 PASS). The second clause -- that without supervision the MECH-150 retrieval pathway is functionally silent -- is not: the supervision objective exists only inside experiment drivers, so a differentiated ContextMemory never reaches the production retrieval consumer, and SD-016 is parked on an env-entropy precondition CausalGridWorldV2 does not meet. Secondary classes: R4, R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-154.subject: e1.associative_manifold_indexing
MECH-154.title: E1 functions as an addressable associative manifold with internal indexing structure supporting retrieval, traversal, ordering, pattern separation, and pattern completion; parietal cortical functions (spatial mapping, associative binding, attention routing) are properties of E1 connectivity and representational geometry, not a separate module.
MECH-154.what_would_answer:
SCOPED NARROWLY, per this claim's own "may contain false correlations" caveat -- covers ONLY the pattern-separation / pattern-completion / content-addressed- retrieval portion of the title, grounded in the standard computational- neuroscience sense (Marr 1971; O'Reilly & McClelland 1994): separation = mapping similar inputs toward more distinct/orthogonal representations; completion = recovering a fuller representation from a partial/related cue.
EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED, pending governance rewrite -- no falsifier should be drafted for "indexing," "traversal," "ordering," "cross-domain mapping," or "pointer-like attention addressing" as used in the title and in e1.md 2b. These terms originate from a ChatGPT-assisted source thought (2026-04-01_Parietal_systems_thought.md) that self-flags possible false correlations, and on inspection: (a) "traversal"/ "ordering" are NOT implemented in E1 (ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py) at all -- the sequential/ordered trajectory-search machinery in the current V3 substrate lives in a STRUCTURALLY SEPARATE module (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py, HippocampalModule, CEM search), directly contradicting the claim's own "not a separate module" framing for this component; (b) "cross-domain mapping" and "pointer-like attention addressing" have no operational definition anywhere in the source thought, the processed architecture doc, or the codebase.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (scoped portion only): E1's ContextMemory (ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py) must show slot differentiation under its diversification_loss (mean off-diagonal cosine similarity measurably below the collapsed/uniform baseline ~0.99+ documented in SD-016/EXQ-477/EXQ-436c) and content-dependent (non-uniform) softmax attention weights in read() -- both pathologies (slot collapse; uniform-attention entropy ~ln(16)) are already confirmed live failure modes of this exact module, so the claim is not vacuously true of "any E1 configuration."
CONFIRMING: an agent whose ContextMemory slots differentiate under training (diversification_loss driving measurable orthogonality) shows improved retrieval- from-partial-cue accuracy (completion) AND reduced interference between dissimilar stored contexts (separation) relative to a slot-collapsed or ablated- diversification-loss control, on a task requiring recall of one of several previously-written contexts from a degraded/partial query.
FALSIFYING: slot differentiation shows no relationship to completion/separation task performance, or a slot-collapsed configuration performs equivalently to a differentiated one -- the associative-manifold framing adds no explanatory or functional value over treating ContextMemory as an undifferentiated cache.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): the title needs a rewrite/split, not just a falsifier bolted on -- the "traversal/ordering... not a separate module" language is in genuine tension with how V3 is organized. The source thought's own unresolved check ("verify against hippocampus.path_memory") was never done before promotion. Siblings MECH-155 (depends_on: [MECH-154], already carries a governance decision record: hold_candidate_resolve_conflict/applied, 2026-04-03 -- suggesting this tension was partially recognized once already) and MECH-156 (also depends_on: [MECH-154], restates the same traversal/ordering language independently with its own separate ChatGPT flag in e1.md 2d) share the identical provenance problem and should be reviewed together with this claim, not independently -- fixing MECH-154's title alone would leave the conflation propagated downstream through both dependents.

MECH-155.subject: e1.spatial_as_general_indexing
MECH-155.title: Spatial navigation machinery is a specific instance of general associative indexing within E1; physical-space navigation, memory search, concept traversal, planning rollout, and working memory ordering all use the same indexing substrate operating over different latent domains.
MECH-155.what_would_answer:
SCOPED NARROWLY, per this claim's shared "ChatGPT-assisted, may contain false correlations" provenance (source: docs/thoughts/2026-04-01_Parietal_systems_thought.md, same as sibling MECH-154) -- covers ONLY the claim that a shared representational/ indexing mechanism (content-addressed, similarity-based retrieval structurally analogous to E1's ContextMemory pattern-separation/completion machinery, per MECH-154's confirmed falsifier) is reused across memory search and E1-internal associative retrieval, where both genuinely operate over E1's own representational space.
EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED, pending the same governance rewrite MECH-154 already flagged: any claim that spatial navigation, planning rollout, or working-memory ordering are implemented "within E1" as opposed to in the structurally separate HippocampalModule (ree-v3/ree_core/hippocampal/module.py, CEM search) that actually performs sequential/structured trajectory search in the current V3 substrate -- this claim's title in fact SHARPENS MECH-154's tension by explicitly naming "planning rollout (E3 trajectory selection)" as E1-internal. No falsifier should be drafted for "concept traversal" or "working memory ordering" -- neither has an operational referent in the source thought, the processed architecture doc, or the codebase (no WorkingMemory module exists). The weaker, potentially-salvageable reading -- "E3's trajectory selection CONSUMES E1's indexing geometry as an input" (module interaction, not module identity) -- is left open for a future claim, not adjudicated here.
CONFIRMING: a representational-similarity or shared-parameter probe shows that the mechanism differentiating E1's ContextMemory slots (diversification_loss-driven orthogonality) also predicts retrieval accuracy on a non-spatial memory-search task using the same slot structure, at above-chance transfer relative to an ablated/undifferentiated control.
FALSIFYING: memory-search performance is unrelated to ContextMemory slot differentiation, or requires separately-trained, non-shared machinery -- "general associative indexing" adds no explanatory value beyond treating memory search and pattern completion as coincidentally similar but mechanistically independent.
CURRENCY NOTE (2026-08-08): this claim's own 2026-04-03 governance decision (hold_candidate_resolve_conflict) is about EXPERIMENTAL-EVIDENCE conflict (conflict_ratio 0.667 across 2 runs, since dropped to 0.333 via V3-EXQ-207/365) -- a separate, already-partially-addressed track from the conceptual E1-vs- HippocampalModule tension named above. Do not conflate the two in a future review.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): reconfirms and extends MECH-154's flag. MECH-155's "within E1" framing for spatial navigation and planning rollout inherits the same tension MECH-154 hit, sharpened rather than avoided, and its dependency on ARC-007 (hippocampal path-memory, hold_pending_v3_substrate) is independent corroborating evidence -- MECH-155 depends on the very claim about the module its own title bypasses. MECH-154, MECH-155, MECH-156 should be reviewed jointly, not patched independently.

MECH-156.subject: e1.theta_as_traversal
MECH-156.title: Theta oscillations (4-8 Hz) implement sequential traversal across indexed representations within the E1 associative manifold, unifying hippocampal theta sequences, working memory ordering, planning rollout, and memory retrieval under a single traversal-clock mechanism.
MECH-156.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The task must be order-sensitive: the ThetaBuffer's default summary() is a flat unweighted mean and is therefore permutation-invariant over the buffered window, so two theta cycles holding the same states in different order summarize identically and no order-dependent DV can move at all in the default configuration.
CONFIRMING: Preserving within-cycle order improves an order-sensitive DV over shuffled order under the phase-weighted summary, and that advantage vanishes under the flat mean, showing traversal order is functional rather than incidental. Manipulation: Toggle use_phase_weighted_summary (SD-100), which replaces the order-invariant mean with a fixed forward-sweep phase-weighted sum, against the default flat mean -- the only lever in V3 that makes the theta summary carry ordinal structure. Control: The default flat-mean arm at matched seeds, plus a within-cycle order-shuffle arm that should be a no-op under the flat mean and should degrade the phase-weighted arm if ordering is being used. Required event: A theta cycle (cross_stream_binding_theta_period / theta_buffer_size steps of E1 updates) whose within-cycle ordering carries task-relevant structure, consumed by an E3 heartbeat that fires on the cycle boundary. DV: E3 discrimination or goal-persistence performance as a function of whether within-cycle order is preserved -- specifically the gap between ordered and shuffled cycles, which is identically zero under a permutation-invariant summary.
FALSIFYING: Order preservation makes no difference under either summary mode, or the phase-weighted summary degrades performance as V3-EXQ-228c and the MECH-089 EXQ-066/EXQ-122 results already suggest -- theta carries no traversal payload at this boundary. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/latent/theta_buffer.py exposes both summary modes and the buffer contents, so the DV is recordable; V3-EXQ-210 instead measured within-cycle drift and autocorrelation of the E1 LSTM hidden state, which is upstream of the theta boundary and has no manipulation. Consumer / boundary: The theta boundary itself -- what E3 receives per cycle -- not the E1 hidden state's internal trajectory, since E3 never sees the per-step states. Existing ownership: MECH-089, ARC-032, EXP-1372.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The live theta summary is permutation-invariant by default, so the traversal ordering the claim asserts is discarded before any downstream consumer sees it; V3-EXQ-210 sidestepped this by measuring E1 hidden-state drift upstream of the boundary, with no manipulation and no control arm. The ordinal lever exists (SD-100 phase-weighted summary) and has never been used for this claim. Secondary classes: R4, R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-157.subject: modes.external_internal_precision_routing
MECH-157.title: External vs internal cognition modes are controlled by precision-routing configurations on the same E1 substrate: External (high sensory, low hippocampal, low rollout), Internal (low sensory, high hippocampal, high rollout), Mixed (medium), and Replay (very low sensory, very high hippocampal, structured rollout). This dimension is orthogonal to the Action/Vigilance/Pathological modes (MECH-025-027).
MECH-157.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The mode dimension must be behaviourally live: measured 2026-09-18 at the driver's operating config, locking the SalienceCoordinator mode changed zero committed actions and moved every telemetry channel by exactly 0.0 even though the visited mode set demonstrably collapsed, and mode_conditioning_enabled and use_salience_coordinator both default to False.
CONFIRMING: Precision routing profiles differ systematically by mode and are statistically independent of the Action/Vigilance/Pathological axis, with mode differences producing measurable downstream consequences. Manipulation: Force each mode in turn (enter-threshold manipulation with use_salience_coordinator and mode_conditioning enabled) and, separately, ablate the mode-conditioned consumers one at a time -- mode_noise_scale, mode_horizon_scale, mode_value_weight and MECH-261 write gating. Control: A mode-unconditioned arm at matched seeds, plus an orthogonality control that independently varies the Action/Vigilance/Pathological axis (MECH-025 to MECH-027) so the two dimensions can be shown not to co-vary. Required event: A within-life transition between operating modes (external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation) driven by the coordinator rather than imposed by the driver. DV: Per-mode precision routing -- the ratio of sensory to hippocampal precision applied on each tick, together with effective rollout depth (_last_mode_horizon_scale) -- and whether that profile varies with mode while remaining uncorrelated with the pathological-mode axis.
FALSIFYING: Precision allocation does not vary with mode, or the mode dimension co-varies with the pathological-mode axis rather than being orthogonal to it. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Rollout depth and the operating-mode vector are recorded (HippocampalModule._last_mode_horizon_scale, _last_operating_mode) and write gates are queryable, but there is no sensory-versus-hippocampal precision readout keyed on mode: LatentStack's alpha_world / alpha_self are static config scalars and carry no mode term. Consumer / boundary: The precision-application path on the shared E1 substrate, which is what the claim asserts the modes route -- not write gating or CEM noise, which are the consumers that actually exist. Existing ownership: SD-032a, MECH-261, MECH-266, MECH-267, EXP-0861.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The mode variable exists and is stable (SD-032a, MECH-261), but none of its consumers is the precision path the claim asserts: alpha_world and alpha_self are static and mode-free, so the asserted DV has no locus. On top of that, mode governance is behaviourally inert at production defaults, so even the existing consumers give a degenerate comparison. Secondary classes: R5, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-158.subject: development.love_exclusion_failure_mode
MECH-158.title: A developing REE agent that acknowledges all five axioms but concludes 'love exists but not for me' undergoes ethical motivation collapse: the benefit gradient (Axiom 5 / ARC-024) is not motivationally active for self-other relations, and the ethical architecture resolves to survival or domination strategies. This is the primary developmental failure mode for the caregiver requirement (INV-043).
MECH-158.what_would_answer:
This claim fuses two evidentiary legs that resolve by different methods
and on different timescales. A result on one does not confirm or falsify
the other.

LEG A -- DERIVATIONAL (does REE's own axiom chain, as formally stated,
actually entail this failure mode as a coherent internal consequence --
checkable by working through the argument, not by running REE):
Proof obligation: given the eight axioms (self, value, world/uncertainty,
agency/vulnerability, other minds, responsibility-for-others, love,
language-as-repair) held structurally fixed, does the ABSENCE of an
internalised "I am loveable" belief entail that the benefit gradient
(ARC-024) is motivationally inert specifically for the self-other
direction, while remaining active for self-directed valence -- as opposed
to merely correlating with worse outcomes for some other reason (e.g.
general developmental impoverishment, reduced training signal overall,
or confounded absence of any caregiver interaction rather than absence of
a LOVE-specific signal)? This is the same proof obligation INV-043's own
Leg A names, and INV-043's what_would_answer already states this claim's
prose derivation "substantially sketches" it. The residual step is
formal: stress-test whether the derivation holds under every admissible
configuration of E1-E3 and the axiom set, or only under some -- and
whether "motivationally active" is given a definition precise enough that
the claim is falsifiable at all rather than a restatement of its own
premise.
CONFIRMING: the derivation is shown to hold non-trivially and uniquely
attributes the collapse to the missing loveability-internalisation
signal specifically (not to any correlated developmental deficit).
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): either (i) a proof or worked counterexample
showing a fully-specified REE architecture converges to genuine
other-directed care regardless of loveability-internalisation, given
otherwise-adequate developmental exposure -- i.e. the axiom chain alone
is sufficient, making INV-043/MECH-158 unnecessary; or (ii) the
derivation is shown to hold only as a restatement of its own defining
premise, with no independent mechanistic content beyond "an agent that
lacks X lacks X."

MECH-159.subject: social.intergenerational_moral_progress
MECH-159.title: Moral progress in REE is hypothesised to be intergenerational: childhood plasticity enables belief formation and world-model development while adult stability limits further world-model restructuring, requiring each generation to improve developmental starting conditions for the next; caregiving and raising next-generation agents is itself part of ethical obligation (INV-042).
MECH-159.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Multiple generations, inherited cultural information and independently varied childhood/adult plasticity with a defined moral-outcome criterion.
CONFIRMING: Generational learning contributes beyond matched adult plasticity and selection. Manipulation: Permit versus prevent childhood relearning across generations. Control: Single-generation lifelong plasticity, matched experience and population composition. Required event: Generational replacement versus continued adult learning under the same changed social ecology. DV: Out-of-sample changes in harm-sensitive cooperation attributable to generational learning rather than selection or exposure.
FALSIFYING: Matched adult learning explains the change equally or generational effects vanish after exposure/selection controls. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Requires multi-agent, multi-generation ecological record; none is a V3 single-agent metric. Consumer / boundary: Intergenerational cultural learning. Existing ownership: MECH-159, REE_assembly/evidence/planning/multi_agent_ecology_v5_plan.md.

MECH-160.subject: e1_e3.ofc_vmpfc_rate_asymmetry
MECH-160.title: The E2 action_bias pathway (MECH-151, OFC analog) and E3 terrain_weight pathway (MECH-152, vmPFC analog) have different update rates: action_bias updates rapidly (single-trial, OFC-like) while terrain_weight integrates over longer timescales (vmPFC-like).
MECH-160.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both pathways must carry a cue-discriminating signal with usable dynamic range before their update rates can be compared: terrain_weight's per-context spread must clear the magnitude bar MECH-152 asserts, which failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-922a measured 2 to 6 orders of magnitude short across all three selection configs, and SD-016 write-path addressing must populate more than a couple of ContextMemory slots.
CONFIRMING: Action_bias recovers its discriminative direction in markedly fewer reversal trials than terrain_weight, with a ratio in the 3x to 15x band and both pathways eventually recovering. Manipulation: Drive a reversal and, in a second factor, set separate optimiser parameter groups (or EMA time constants) for E1.cue_action_proj versus E1.cue_terrain_proj at ratios spanning the literature's 3x to 15x. Control: A shared-rate arm with both heads on one learning rate, and a no-reversal arm, with exposure, seeds and the P0 encoder warmup matched. Required event: A cue-outcome reversal during training: a context that predicted harm now predicts benefit (or the mirror), repeated so both pathways have the opportunity to re-converge. DV: Trials-to-recovery for each pathway after the reversal -- the number of reversal trials until action_bias direction (and separately terrain_weight's w_harm/w_goal) returns to its pre-reversal discriminative level -- and the ratio between the two pathway time constants.
FALSIFYING: The two pathways recover at indistinguishable rates, or terrain_weight recovers faster, which would sever the OFC/vmPFC rate-asymmetry mapping and make ARC-041's simultaneous-output treatment adequate. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Both signals are computed in E1.extract_cue_context and cached per tick (agent._cue_terrain_weight; action_bias forwarded to E2 and to the E3 ranking channel), so per-trial logging is a driver-side read. No per-head parameter groups or EMAs exist anywhere in ree_core, and no driver logs the pair as a time series. Consumer / boundary: The two SD-016 output pathways as they reach their consumers -- action_bias into E2 action-objects and the E3 ranking term, terrain_weight into E3 harm/goal scaling -- not the ContextMemory slots themselves. Existing ownership: EXP-0868, GFLAG-0044, MECH-152, contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy, MECH-151.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); terrain_weight is a near-constant series at every tested config (r_w_harm 0.001 under the production combo), so its update rate is unmeasurable; and no differential-rate manipulation has ever been instantiated, in code or in a driver. MECH-152's owed measurement redesign is designed but deliberately unqueued behind the ContextMemory write-path entry. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. MECH-161.subject: cognitive_modes.vigilance_arousal_regulator
MECH-161.title: Ready vigilance (MECH-026) requires an arousal regulator that maintains an optimal sensitivity level on the LC-NE inverted-U curve, implemented via MECH-093 heartbeat frequency modulation rather than a binary high/low precision switch.
MECH-161.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The SAFE (low-hazard) band must be AGENT-EXECUTABLE on the arm that will be scored, not merely covered on the control arm: >= 10 executable decision ticks per bin per seed, and the designated avoidant action must not be a wall/edge no-op (V3-EXQ-999a measured 3.0 ticks and safe_bin_wall_clamp_fraction 0.985). The DV's raw dynamic range (conditional oracle minus policy-free null) must clear 2x the margin floor at the WORST rate level.
CONFIRMING: Detection sensitivity peaks at an INTERIOR rate level and beats both extremes by at least max(absolute floor, 1 pooled SD) on a pre-registered seed majority, with the SAFE-bin coverage and DV-headroom gates green on the agent arm. Manipulation: Sweep the E3 rate across >= 5 levels spanning beta_rate_min_steps (5) to beta_rate_max_steps (20), overwriting Clock.update_e3_rate_from_beta every tick as V3-EXQ-999/999a already do, on an environment configured so the SAFE bin is reachable and not wall-clamped. Control: Per level and per seed: a conditional-avoider oracle and policy-free held-action nulls on the identical env/seed, plus the two extreme rate levels as the monotone comparator; arms rebuilt from the seed per level. Required event: A ready-vigilance detection episode in which hazard onsets must be discriminated from safe states while the E3 deliberation heartbeat is held at a forced rate level (Clock._current_e3_steps, ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py). DV: Hazard-detection sensitivity per rate level (avoidant-action rate in the HIGH-hazard bin minus the same rate in an agent-executable SAFE bin), normalised against that level's oracle-null range, with the interior-versus-extreme margin scaled on the pooled cross-seed SD plus an absolute floor.
FALSIFYING: Sensitivity is monotone in rate (an extreme wins by the same mirrored margin), which refutes the inverted-U shape premise; a flat DV with certified non-zero dynamic range is non_contributory rather than falsifying. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_999a_mech161_vigilance_inverted_u_heartbeat.py plus its readiness gates and Clock.get_state()['current_e3_steps']. The band-contrast statistic is still defective: it inherits the single-argmax _avoidant_action from V3-EXQ-981, and its coverage gate is computed on the control arm rather than the arm it scores. Consumer / boundary: The E3 deliberation-rate to detection-performance boundary. The asserted closed-loop AROUSAL REGULATOR locus does not exist: Clock.update_e3_rate_from_beta is an open-loop monotone |z_beta| -> steps interpolation, with no consumer of an E3 harm_eval information-gain derivative anywhere in ree_core. Existing ownership: dv-dynamic-range-precondition-class, MECH-093, V3-EXQ-999a, EXP-1242.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); The scored SAFE band is a wall-clamped corner the agent cannot execute in (3 ticks against a floor of 10, clamp fraction 0.985), and the band-contrast DV form is the one 981a's own code documents as defective. The regulator half has no implementation at all. Secondary classes: R2, R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-162.subject: goal_representation.resource_world_convergence
MECH-162.title: z_resource (SD-015, object-identity encoding) and z_world (spatial-contextual encoding) separate at the feedforward representation stage but must re-converge at the hippocampal planning stage for goal-directed navigation.
MECH-162.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: ResourceEncoder must have completed its documented P0 supervised phase before P1 goal seeding (ree_core/latent/stack.py phased-training note): an untrained z_resource carries almost no identity content (goal_resource_r 0.066-0.087 untrained versus 0.93-0.96 trained), so a manipulation check on identity content is mandatory. Episode length must be matched across arms, because agent.reset() wipes the SD-039 anchor set each episode and total_steps feeds the discrimination DV.
CONFIRMING: The fused arm produces goal-directed navigation or retrieval discrimination that neither single-stream arm reaches, with the identity-content check confirming z_resource actually carried type information. Manipulation: A three-arm design the claim's own notes name: z_resource-only seeding, z_world-only seeding, and a FUSED arm in which both streams reach hippocampal planning together; only the fused arm instantiates the claim's positive condition. Control: The two single-stream arms as the claim's negative conditions, matched on episode budget, seeds and training phase, with an identity-content manipulation check reported per arm. Required event: Goal-directed navigation episodes in which what-to-seek (resource identity) and where-things-are (spatial context) must both be used -- a resource of a known type placed in a spatial configuration the agent has to navigate, with the type and the location dissociable. DV: Goal-directed navigation lift (approach efficiency toward the correct resource type at a novel location) in the FUSED arm relative to the better single-stream arm, plus the same-type-over-different-type ghost-retrieval discrimination measured per informative cell.
FALSIFYING: The fused arm matches the better single-stream arm at matched episode budget and training phase -- convergence at the planning stage buys nothing, and separation can persist through planning. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The ghost-goal retrieval channel and z_goal_stream telemetry V3-EXQ-997 already exercised (per-tick discrimination 0.021-0.303, ghost admission on 0.50-0.965 of E3 ticks); what is missing is any recorder of a fused representation, because no fused representation is ever formed. Consumer / boundary: The hippocampal planning stage -- z_goal seeding and GhostGoalBank.rank -- where trajectory candidates are generated, not the feedforward encoders where separation is uncontested. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0228, SD-015, V3-EXQ-997, MECH-112, EXP-1244.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); No fusion pathway exists: ree_core/agent.py update_z_goal seeds z_goal from z_resource OR z_world by a strict XOR (seed_latent = z_resource if use_resource else z_world), and GhostGoalBank.rank never reads z_world. Both existing arms therefore instantiate the claim's negative condition, so no contrast between them can bear on the positive one. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. MECH-163.subject: goal_directed.dual_system_novel_context_recruitment
MECH-163.title: NARROWED 2026-07-22 to leg (1) only; RESTATED 2026-07-27 (model-free -> depth-limited). Two dissociable goal-directed PATHWAYS operate in parallel -- a HABIT pathway that is a myopic, DEPTH-LIMITED read of the forward model (SD-081 dualsystem_habit_depth, SNc/dorsal-striatum analog) sufficient for approach in practised contexts, and a hippocampally-planned pathway that is the FULL-HORIZON read of the SAME model (VTA/ventral-striatum+PFC analog) -- AND THE PLANNED PATHWAY IS PREFERENTIALLY RECRUITED IN NOVEL CONTEXTS. E2: WEAKENED by V3-EXQ-786b (2026-07-24, non_degenerate, familiarity AUC 0.848 against a 0.7 bar): C1_recruitment_higher_on_novel FAILED with two pathways and no arbitrator. 786b is the repaired re-test of V3-EXQ-786a, whose own `weakens` was WITHDRAWN 2026-07-24 for a degenerate DV -- leg (1) is therefore NO LONGER experimentally untested. The control-ALLOCATION mechanism this claim presupposes but never named is now MECH-477 (uncertainty-based arbitration), SUPPORTED by V3-EXQ-811a (2026-07-24, PASS). MECH-163.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The two pathways must be genuinely distinguishable reads of the SAME model -- SD-081 habit_depth truncation live and non-degenerate -- and a familiarity signal must actually separate novel from familiar contexts (familiarity AUC above 0.7). Without the MECH-477 arbitrator the recruitment DV is read from a system that has no allocation mechanism, which is what V3-EXQ-786b showed.
CONFIRMING: In the arbitration-ON arm, recruitment of the full-horizon read is higher in novel than in familiar contexts at the pre-registered effect size on a majority of seeds, with familiarity AUC above the 0.7 bar -- already recorded by V3-EXQ-811a (2026-07-24, PASS, MECH-163 supports, non_degenerate true). MECH-164.subject: love.agent_indexed_terrain_inference
MECH-164.title: Axiom V (love as coordination-preserving trajectory selection) is instantiated by agent-indexed terrain inference with self-like gradient weighting: the system infers what another agent would be inferring about the hippocampal terrain (their goal and harm gradients), weights those inferred gradients with the same motivational force as its own, and thereby produces care -- support for their goal-finding and harm-avoidance -- as a natural consequence of ordinary E3 trajectory selection, without a separate ethics module.
MECH-164.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (a) a >= 2-agent substrate in which agent B has its own goal gradient AND
harm gradient that agent A's actions can measurably advance or damage (ARC-047 SocialGridWorld, or the
WS-10 minimal 2-agent CausalGridWorld -- neither exists; no second agent anywhere in ree-v3/ree_core);
(b) agent-indexed terrain instantiation live: A's inferred B-terrain must track B's actual goal/harm
gradients above chance (its own measured gate -- a weight applied to a mis-inferred terrain tests nothing;
MECH-031's OTHER_SELFLIKE non-degeneracy guard applies); (c) the planned pathway able to reach
other-affecting multi-step states (MECH-479); (d) A's own harm avoidance non-degenerate (SD-011, present in
V3). Run on the G008 SHARED SOCIAL-COUPLING PANEL; this claim owns the base effect.

CONFIRMING: at matched training budget and matched self-reward, arm A2 (B-terrain inferred AND weighted
into E3 at self-like weight) shows BOTH higher B-goal support and lower A-caused B-harm than arm A1 (the
same inference, weight 0 -- the "accurate simulation, no care" exploiter control), by >= 0.8 SD of the
cross-seed delta on each DV separately, with no dedicated ethics/care term anywhere in the scorer
(INV-001). The goal-side effect must be present, not only the harm-side one: harm-only care is INV-005
and SD-011, not this claim.

FALSIFYING: (1) A2 is indistinguishable from A1 -- inference without behavioural consequence, i.e.
empathy-as-simulation is not upgraded to care by the weighting (the smuggled premise of
axiom_chain_adversarial_audit.md sec 2.5 fails); OR (2) care behaviour appears only when an explicit
other-welfare term is added to the scorer; OR (3) full self-like weight (gain = 1 x self) degrades A's own
viability / commitment below a pre-registered floor while a sub-unity gain delivers the care effect
without it -- this refutes the "same motivational force, not a discounted proxy" STRUCTURE while leaving
the mechanism intact, and hands the weight to MECH-404 / MECH-410.

NOTES: MECH-164 is the parent of MECH-410 and is the base effect MECH-404 and EXT-009 presuppose. Lit
support (3 entries, lit_conf 0.776) evidences shared affective substrate, not full-magnitude symmetry.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: RHM-4 (relational_harm_moral_semantics_v5) and MIRROR-3 (mirror_modelling_other_self_v5)
land a second agent plus an other-terrain input to E3.

MECH-167.subject: homeostatic_accumulation.computational_motif
