FALSIFYING: One channel is not a slow integrator in the tested regime or independent interventions produce unintended cross-channel transfer. Merely matching two coded EMA constants is not evidence. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: HarmSufferingAccumulator plus drive-level and goal-seeding traces; cross-input matched driver is not established. Consumer / boundary: Separate slow accumulators and their distinct downstream gates. Existing ownership: MECH-167, SD-019b, SD-012.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The independent-input and distinct-consumer comparison has not been instantiated. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-168.subject: dementia.consolidation_pipeline_staged_failure
MECH-168.title: Progressive sleep deprivation or neurodegeneration causes staged failure of the offline consolidation pipeline in reverse dependency order: precision recalibration (MECH-123/Phase 4) degrades first, producing early MCI features; slot-filling (MECH-121/Phase 2-3) next, producing the classic early Alzheimer's episodic profile (intact remote, absent new); slot-formation (MECH-120/Phase 1-2) last, producing middle-stage contextual identity loss and schema destabilisation; global context collapse last.
MECH-168.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A per-phase readout that is content-contingent (tracks injected-content fidelity, not corruption magnitude) for the REM leg, at the same C1 bar the NREM and SWS legs cleared (null_slope_ratio <= 0.25, ceiling_inside_ci95 false, n >= 8). A run against the current REM readout self-routes measurement_gap and is not a verdict.
CONFIRMING: With a content-valid readout for each phase, the decline order matches the reverse-dependency sequence (REM precision first, NREM slot-filling next, SWS slot-formation last) on a seed majority by sign test p<0.05. Manipulation: Progressive uniform diffuse damage (diffuse_perturb at increasing sigma), phase readouts taken on independent fresh agents so error compounding is not baked in. Control: Per-phase null-content / unpaired-target control at matched corruption magnitude, which must land below the content-contingency ceiling before that phase's series is admissible. Required event: A uniform diffuse per-phase lesion sweep over the SD-068 harness at n >= 8 seeds, with each phase's functional readout taken at each damage level. DV: Per-phase functional-decline ORDER under uniform damage -- threshold-sigma at 50% normalised degradation per phase -- adjudicated by sign test across seeds, not by a modal order.
FALSIFYING: A content-valid readout shows simultaneous degradation, the forward order, SWS/NREM failing before REM, or the REM-first adjacency remaining seed-unstable (CI straddling 0) even with a valid instrument. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: consolidation_lesion_harness.py carries the validated NREM and SWS legs plus rem_precision_error / rem_generative_fidelity / rem_null_slope_ratio. The REM leg has no content-contingent statistic and MECH-462 argues none is obtainable on the direct precision quantity; SD-072's downstream behavioural-discrimination replacement is unbuilt. Consumer / boundary: Offline consolidation phase function under damage -- the ordering across phases, not any single phase's magnitude. Existing ownership: SD-072, SD-073, MECH-462, SD-071, INV-047.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); One missing instrument: a content-contingent REM readout. MECH-462 explains why no statistic on the DIRECT precision quantity can be content-contingent (it is second-order over representations), and SD-072 specifies the downstream meta-d-prime-analogue replacement -- but SD-072 has no substrate_queue build entry, so nothing owns building it. Secondary classes: none. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA asserts that EVERY readout tried fails content-contingency and that 'the SWS readout is content-free BY CONSTRUCTION (null_slope_ratio sd 2.7e-8, 8/8 confounded)'. That was repaired and revalidated: the rebuilt _sws_pattern_completion reported null_slope_ratio 0.1495 (CI95 [0.1344, 0.1646], 8/8 seeds, V3-EXQ-778g) and NREM 0.1445 (V3-EXQ-778c), both carried by SD-071. Only the REM leg remains uninstrumented, so the blocker is now one-third, not three-thirds, and the named prerequisite ('at least the SWS and REM legs') is half discharged. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-169.subject: dementia.glymphatic_attribution_complementarity
MECH-169.title: The glymphatic clearance hypothesis (amyloid-beta accumulation via insufficient sleep-phase clearance) and the attribution pipeline account (consolidation failure via disrupted offline phases) are mechanistically complementary accounts of sleep-deprivation-induced dementia: the former explains why structural substrate damage accumulates; the latter explains why cognitive symptoms are staged and context-specific rather than diffuse and uniform.
MECH-169.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: An appropriate independent biological/clinical dataset and valid phase/disease measures are prerequisites; REE sleep flags are not measures of pharmacology, clearance or dementia. No intervention is commissioned.
CONFIRMING: Attribution disruption explains staged/context-specific deficits beyond clearance/damage measures Manipulation: Compare clearance impairment and offline-attribution disruption separately and jointly Control: Matched damage burden, baseline cognition and sleep exposure Required event: Sleep disruption with separately measured clearance and attribution dysfunction DV: Staged context-specific attribution decline conditional on measured structural damage
FALSIFYING: Sensitive independent measures show no additional staged/context-specific explanatory contribution A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: No appropriate full-claim V3 instrument. Required future/external recorder: Staged context-specific attribution decline conditional on measured structural damage. Consumer / boundary: Future multi-agent/developmental or external biological boundary specified by the claim; no substitution by a single-agent scalar. Existing ownership: MECH-169, ARC-011.
DISPOSITION: R8 (primary); External-only as written: V3 has neither the biological treatment/source nor the clinical longitudinal DV. Computational sleep analogues belong to separately registered claims. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-170.subject: dementia.sleep_restoration_dissociated_recovery_prediction
MECH-170.title: Sleep architecture restoration in early MCI should produce dissociated cognitive improvement: slot-filling (episodic attribution, MECH-121 analog) should improve before slot-formation (contextual semantic, MECH-120 analog), because the pipeline rebuilds in dependency order. This distinguishes the attribution account from accounts predicting uniform memory improvement with sleep restoration.
MECH-170.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: External clinical study with measured sleep-stage restoration, baseline cognitive capacity and independently measured episodic, semantic and calibration outcomes; computational proxy results do not establish MCI treatment effects.
CONFIRMING: The registered ordered/dissociated recovery appears under valid clinical controls. Manipulation: Measured restoration exposure under an appropriate clinical study design. Control: Matched non-restoration comparison and controls for practice, disease course and nonspecific alertness. Required event: Sleep architecture restoration in the specified clinical population. DV: Order and relative rate of improvement in precision/calibration, episodic attribution and semantic schema formation.
FALSIFYING: Recovery is uniform, reversed or explained by nonspecific improvement with restored sleep verified. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: External sleep/cognitive assessments. SD-068/071 supplies computational lesion/readout analogues only. Consumer / boundary: Clinical sleep-to-cognitive recovery trajectory. Existing ownership: MECH-170, sd068-staged-restoration-mode.
DISPOSITION: R8 (primary); Clinical hypothesis, not a V3 experiment. Its computational staged-restoration analogue is separately blocked and must not be mistaken for the clinical claim. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-171.subject: dementia.sleep_disruption_vicious_cycle
MECH-171.title: Progressive neurodegeneration creates a vicious cycle through sleep disruption: early attribution pipeline failure disrupts sleep architecture, which accelerates consolidation pipeline failure, which accelerates attribution failure. This predicts disproportionate disease-modifying effect of early sleep intervention, because it breaks the cycle before the schema scaffold collapses.
MECH-171.what_would_answer: A clinical-cohort longitudinal study showing (or failing to show) that early sleep intervention in MCI/pre-dementia has a disproportionate disease-modifying effect relative to late intervention.

MECH-172.subject: dementia.habit_system_sparing_architectural_prediction
MECH-172.title: Preservation of habit and procedural memory in early Alzheimer's disease, while episodic and contextual memory fail, is architecturally predicted by the separation of the model-free habit system (MECH-163 D1/D2, SNc) from the contextual attribution system (E3 hippocampal, requiring offline consolidation phases): the habit system does not require offline consolidation to function, so its relative preservation under early consolidation pipeline failure is not incidental but follows from the architectural separation.
MECH-172.what_would_answer: A clinical Alzheimer's cohort showing (or failing to show) that procedural/ habit memory is preserved relative to episodic/contextual memory in the early-to-middle stage, tracking consolidation-pipeline failure.

MECH-173.subject: pharmacology.rem_suppression_phase4_disruption
MECH-173.title: Medications that suppress REM sleep (anticholinergics, MAOIs, most antidepressants at therapeutic doses, benzodiazepines) selectively impair MECH-123 precision recalibration -- the most downstream pipeline phase -- and thereby accelerate the earliest dementia prodrome: overconfident contextual attributions before overt memory loss.
MECH-173.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The agent must be able to express ABSOLUTE overconfidence before REM ablation can remove a correction: with the symmetric precision EMA, running_variance tracks true error by construction and the overconfidence index is pinned near zero, which is what made V3-EXQ-774 a substrate ceiling. So use_waking_confidence_inflation must be armed at a dose that is demonstrably operative and not saturated -- V3-EXQ-794 hit exactly 0.010000 on all four inflation arms, and 794a is the run that established a separable dose.
CONFIRMING: With the drift source armed at 794a's separable dose, REM suppression raises absolute overconfidence relative to full sleep while the accuracy reference is matched, the SWS-suppressed arm does not reproduce it, and the recalibration-off arm reproduces it -- establishing REM-selectivity of the effect. Manipulation: REM suppression via rem_enabled=False with SWS intact (the pharmacological analog), against full sleep, with the recalibration consumer ablated separately. Control: The SWS-suppressed arm is the selectivity control (it must NOT reproduce the effect), plus the recalibration-off arm that isolates the MECH-123/204 consumer from REM presence itself. Required event: Repeated sleep cycles in which REM-phase precision recalibration would otherwise correct a waking confidence drift, in a regime with recalibration headroom that persists across seeds. DV: The overconfidence index (true error reference minus mean running variance, normalised) and the confidence-accuracy dissociation: confidence held high while contextual-attribution accuracy falls, compared across arms at matched true error.
FALSIFYING: With drift demonstrably operative and unsaturated, REM suppression leaves the overconfidence index unchanged relative to full sleep, or the SWS-suppressed arm moves it equally -- the effect is not REM-specific and the claim's mechanistic half fails in the analog. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: V3-EXQ-774's driver already implements all four arms against ree_core's sws_enabled/rem_enabled/recalibration switches; the two pieces it lacked have since landed -- the drift source (use_waking_confidence_inflation, asymmetric EMA in e3_selector) and the Phase 7 broadcast correction (broadcast_precision_pull, read in agent.select_action). Consumer / boundary: The REM-phase write to the precision setpoint that waking commitment thresholds read, not sleep duration or SWS consolidation. Existing ownership: MECH-204, SD-076, EXP-0402, sleep_substrate_plan.md:Phase-7.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Both named prerequisites landed on 2026-07-20 and V3-EXQ-794a established a separable, gate-green dose, but no run since has applied the rem_enabled manipulation with the drift source armed: 794 and 794a deliberately do not tag MECH-173, and the 774 retest was never re-queued. Secondary classes: R8. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-174.subject: pharmacology.sws_suppression_phase12_disruption
MECH-174.title: GABAergic sleep aids (benzodiazepines and Z-drugs: zolpidem, zopiclone, zaleplon) suppress SWS depth and continuity at therapeutic doses, impairing MECH-120 synaptic homeostasis and MECH-121 schema replay, producing context representations that remain globally undifferentiated -- the same failure mode as SD-017 without any SWS-analog.
MECH-174.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (shared with parent claim INV-048, applies to the REE-architecture leg): before any REE-substrate run is interpretable, e3.harm_eval_head must be trained (V3-EXQ-670's own diagnosed failure -- the harm-valuation pathway was byte-identical across all 4 arms because it was never trained). V3-EXQ-670a has never been run as of this digestion pass.
LEG A -- REE-ARCHITECTURE (substrate_conditional; testable in principle, but the specific mechanism this claim asserts is not yet representable by the existing substrate knob). Current state: sws_enabled/sws_consolidation_steps/sws_schema_weight (ree_core/utils/config.py) provide only a BINARY on/off SWS toggle and a duration/weight lever. The one existing pharmacological-analog test (V3-EXQ-670, ARM_C_SWS_SUPPRESSED) sets sws_enabled=False -- full ablation, equivalent to complete SWS deprivation. This tests INV-048's coarse claim but CANNOT test this claim's specific two-pathway mechanism: (1) graded slow-oscillation DEPTH reduction (distinct from full ablation) and (2) SWS CONTINUITY fragmentation (distinct from duration reduction) -- nor the Z-drug/classical-benzo dissociation (partial spindle/MECH-122 preservation under depth-only suppression vs full suppression under both). A GABAergic decay regulator does exist (SD-036, GABAergicDecayRegulator), but it perturbs waking-state cross-stream z_harm decay (the PHARM-004 catatonia mechanism), not the sleep-phase machinery -- not reusable for this claim.
CONFIRMING (once the substrate gap above is closed): degradation in MECH-120 homeostatic reset quality and MECH-121 schema-replay completeness that scales with depth reduction and fragmentation severity, is dissociable from full-ablation degradation, and (for the Z-drug arm) leaves MECH-122 spindle-coordination metrics relatively less impaired than the classical-benzodiazepine arm.
FALSIFYING: graded depth/continuity perturbation producing no dose-response relationship to MECH-120/121 metrics; or no dissociation between the Z-drug and classical-benzodiazepine analogs on MECH-122 spindle metrics despite a depth/ continuity difference.
LEG B -- HUMAN-CLINICAL (out-of-domain to REE's own substrate; answerable now via existing polysomnography and neuropsychological literature, independent of REE substrate status): this claim's own prediction -- long-term BZD/Z-drug users show reduced SWS%, slower context-discrimination/new-schema learning, with relatively preserved remote episodic retrieval (the Phase 1/2-selective signature). CONFIRMING: PSG studies showing reduced SWS%/slow-oscillation power in chronic users, paired with neuropsychological batteries showing selective new-context-learning impairment. FALSIFYING: no SWS-architecture difference vs matched non-users, or a dissociation running the opposite direction.
NOTE (evidence-quality caveat): this claim's existing literature support includes Billioti de Gage et al. 2014 (BZD-dementia association), whose causal-direction interpretation has been substantially challenged by subsequent better-confounded designs (e.g. Gray et al. 2016) addressing reverse causation/protopathic bias (prodromal dementia -> earlier insomnia/anxiety -> BZD prescription). Read this leg's literature confidence with that caveat rather than the Billioti de Gage point estimate.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): V3-EXQ-670a retest (INV-048's own blocker, gating Leg A) still not queued as of this digestion. No graded SWS-depth/ continuity substrate knob exists -- an /implement-substrate gap, not chipped here.

MECH-175.subject: pharmacology.anticholinergic_dual_pathway_dementia_risk
MECH-175.title: Anticholinergic medications confer dementia risk via two independent and potentially additive pathways: (1) REM suppression (ACh is required for REM generation via nucleus basalis and brainstem PGO generators -- muscarinic blockade directly suppresses REM, impairing MECH-123); and (2) cholinergic deficit mimicry (AD is characterised by basal forebrain cholinergic loss; anticholinergic burden creates a pharmacological analog of this deficit during waking hours, independently degrading attention and encoding).
MECH-175.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain: no REE substrate at any level settles this; V3-EXQ-698's
grid-world dual-pathway proxy was confirmed not a fair test (manipulation
checks PASS but outcome DVs at the noise floor). The decisive test is a
prospective clinical-pharmacology cohort with mediation/structural-equation
analysis. Design: enroll older adults free of dementia, score anticholinergic
burden (ACB / ARS / German ACB) at each visit, obtain an annual
polysomnography subset to quantify REM-suppression-years, follow to a
dementia-conversion endpoint, and fit a parallel-mediator SEM with (1)
cumulative REM-suppression-years (Pathway 1) and (2) cumulative diurnal
anticholinergic dose (Pathway 2) as simultaneous mediators of the
ACB->dementia path. CONFIRMS the dual independent additive account if both
mediators carry significant, partially non-overlapping indirect effects whose
sum approximates the total ACB->dementia effect, AND ACB outperforms total
medication count and total sleep-medication count as a predictor. REFUTES if
the ACB->dementia association is fully mediated by a single pathway (e.g.
daytime dose only, with REM-suppression-years adding no independent indirect
effect), or if a non-anticholinergic substitution that removes only the
nocturnal limb (oxybutynin->mirabegron natural experiment) fails to reduce
risk. Note the Grace-Vanstone-Horner 2014 caveat: REM-transition reliability /
REM-theta integrity may be the true nocturnal mediator rather than total REM
amount, so the PSG metric should include transition and spectral measures, not
just REM%.

MECH-176.subject: pharmacology.orexin_antagonist_architecture_preserving
MECH-176.title: Orexin receptor antagonists (suvorexant, lemborexant) are predicted to be architecture-preserving sleep aids: they suppress wake-promoting orexin drive without directly compressing sleep phase machinery, allowing the brain's own homeostatic sleep architecture to unfold, and should therefore preserve or improve SWS/REM ratio relative to GABAergic alternatives at equi-efficacious doses.
MECH-176.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: An appropriate independent biological/clinical dataset and valid phase/disease measures are prerequisites; REE sleep flags are not measures of pharmacology, clearance or dementia. No intervention is commissioned.
CONFIRMING: The predicted relative preservation of phase structure occurs Manipulation: Compare already clinically justified treatment groups or suitable existing controlled data Control: Equivalent sleep efficacy and baseline disorder severity Required event: Sleep after equi-efficacious orexin-antagonist versus GABAergic treatment DV: Polysomnographic SWS/REM phase duration and sequence relative to baseline
FALSIFYING: Equivalent or worse phase disruption occurs under the proposed architecture-preserving treatment A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: No appropriate full-claim V3 instrument. Required future/external recorder: Polysomnographic SWS/REM phase duration and sequence relative to baseline. Consumer / boundary: Future multi-agent/developmental or external biological boundary specified by the claim; no substitution by a single-agent scalar. Existing ownership: MECH-176, ARC-011.
DISPOSITION: R8 (primary); External-only as written: V3 has neither the biological treatment/source nor the clinical longitudinal DV. Computational sleep analogues belong to separately registered claims. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-177.subject: pharmacology.sleep_architecture_restoration_disease_modifying
MECH-177.title: Any pharmacological intervention that durably restores the NREM-to-REM sequence and preserves phase durations in MCI or early Alzheimer's disease is predicted to be disease-modifying via pipeline protection -- upstream of irreversible neurodegeneration, breaking the MECH-171 vicious cycle before schema scaffold collapse, with predicted effect size larger in early MCI than established AD.
MECH-177.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: An appropriate independent biological/clinical dataset and valid phase/disease measures are prerequisites; REE sleep flags are not measures of pharmacology, clearance or dementia. No intervention is commissioned.
CONFIRMING: Sustained restoration predicts durable slowing of decline, larger in early disease Manipulation: Contrast sustained restored phase ordering with matched uncorrected sleep Control: Matched baseline disease and treatment confound control Required event: Longitudinal progression in early MCI versus established disease after sustained sleep restoration DV: Cognitive/functional decline trajectory and phase-restoration persistence by disease stage
FALSIFYING: Sensitive follow-up finds no slowing despite durable restoration, or no predicted stage interaction A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: No appropriate full-claim V3 instrument. Required future/external recorder: Cognitive/functional decline trajectory and phase-restoration persistence by disease stage. Consumer / boundary: Future multi-agent/developmental or external biological boundary specified by the claim; no substitution by a single-agent scalar. Existing ownership: MECH-177, ARC-011.
DISPOSITION: R8 (primary); External-only as written: V3 has neither the biological treatment/source nor the clinical longitudinal DV. Computational sleep analogues belong to separately registered claims. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-178.subject: neurochemistry.noradrenergic_tone_rem_suppression_rigidity
MECH-178.title: Elevated tonic noradrenergic activity (from chronic stress, stimulant exposure, or noradrenaline reuptake inhibitor antidepressants) suppresses REM sleep by maintaining locus coeruleus REM-off firing above the silence threshold required for REM generation, thereby blocking MECH-123 precision recalibration and producing progressive behavioural rigidity equivalent to partial MECH-123 deprivation -- independent of any pharmacological REM suppression.
MECH-178.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A REM-deprivation positive control must first show that removing REM alone moves the rigidity DV on this substrate, and the tonic-tone manipulation must change REM entry while holding total offline time and SWS/NREM work fixed; otherwise REM quality cannot be separated from less sleep.
CONFIRMING: With total offline time matched, raising NA-analog tone reduces REM entries and produces monotone rigidity growth across nights that matches the SWS-only deprivation arm and exceeds the full-sleep control beyond the per-seed spread. Manipulation: Set a settable tonic NA-analog level that raises the REM-entry threshold selectively. No such knob exists: ree_core/neuromodulation holds only serotonin.py, rem_enabled is a binary master switch, and MECH-286's override_signal gates whole-sleep onset rather than REM entry. Control: Three matched arms: full sleep; SWS-only deprivation at matched total offline time (rem_enabled False); and an ACh/pharmacological-analog suppression arm so the NA route is separated from MECH-173's direct cholinergic block. Required event: Repeated sleep opportunities across successive simulated nights under a sustained elevated arousal/noradrenergic-analog tone, with waking learning demand and episode count held constant across arms. DV: Manipulation check: per-night REM entry count and rem_n_rollouts. Outcome: night-over-night growth in behavioural rigidity (policy/strategy-selection diversity and precision-recalibration drift off the captured precision_at_rem_entry reference) in the high-NA arm relative to the full-sleep control, compared against the SWS-only arm.
FALSIFYING: Rigidity under NA-driven REM suppression is indistinguishable from the full-sleep control, or is fully explained by reduced total offline time, or the tone manipulation suppresses sleep as a whole rather than REM selectively. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/sleep/phase_manager.py records REM phase execution and the precision_at_rem_entry zero-point; agent metrics emit sws_n_writes and rem_n_rollouts. Missing: any recorder or setter for a tonic NA level, and any REM-selective (as opposed to whole-sleep) entry threshold. Consumer / boundary: REM entry gating as the permissive condition upstream of MECH-123 / MECH-204 precision recalibration -- not total sleep duration, and not the cholinergic drive MECH-173 blocks. Existing ownership: MECH-084, MECH-173, EXP-0340, MECH-088, sleep_substrate_plan.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); V3 has no noradrenergic plane and no REM-selective entry gate. The only arousal lever, MECH-286 sleep_onset_gate, blocks the whole offline cycle, and rem_enabled is binary, so the claim's distinctive condition -- REM suppressed by tonic tone at matched total sleep -- cannot be generated. The downstream REM-deprivation-to-rigidity leg is separately runnable. Secondary classes: R6, R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-179.subject: sleep.mel_type_phase_specificity
MECH-179.title: Prediction error type determines which sleep phase is demanded for processing: episodic, spatial, and factual errors (incorrect world-state predictions) primarily demand NREM-mediated schema replay (MECH-121) for prior correction; emotional, social, and identity-threatening errors primarily demand REM-mediated simulation and recalibration (MECH-123) for policy and salience update.
MECH-179.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both sleep phases must run with non-zero, INDEPENDENTLY scalable step counts (mel_scale_sws and mel_scale_rem both default True and currently apply the SAME factor), and the two error classes must be separately inducible at matched total magnitude -- otherwise a composition test cannot be distinguished from a total-duration test and the claim is untestable rather than false.
CONFIRMING: With a typed MEL channel, world-model-error blocks demand proportionally more SWS steps and affective/identity-error blocks proportionally more REM steps at matched total MEL, and the corresponding memory classes consolidate selectively when the matching phase is suppressed. Manipulation: Hold accumulated MEL magnitude constant while varying its TYPE composition across waking blocks, then let the sleep scheduler allocate phase resources without further intervention. Control: An untyped-MEL arm at the same total magnitude (the current default behaviour) as the null, plus a fixed-duration arm with the MEL consumer absent, which the code guarantees is bit-identical. Required event: A waking block dominated by world-model prediction error (spatial/episodic misprediction of z_world) versus a magnitude-matched waking block dominated by affective or identity-relevant prediction error, each followed by a sleep cycle. V3 can generate the first kind of error; it has no producer for the second as a distinct error CLASS. DV: The SWS_ANALOG to REM_ANALOG allocation ratio (step counts and per-phase update counts) per unit MEL, by error type -- confirming requires the ratio to move toward SWS after world-model-error blocks and toward REM after affective/social-error blocks, at constant total sleep budget.
FALSIFYING: Phase composition is insensitive to error type at matched total MEL -- only total sleep duration responds -- or suppressing one phase degrades both memory classes equally, which would collapse MECH-179 back into INV-050's magnitude-only account. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: MELConsumer.note_step_pe (sleep/mel_consumer.py:174) accumulates ONE untyped scalar, the E3 z_world prediction error (agent.py:10905-10919), and duration_factor()/scale_steps() scale SWS and REM by the SAME factor (sleep/phase_manager.py:551-572), so phase COMPOSITION is invariant by construction. A word-grep for error_type, pe_type or mel_type over ree_core returns nothing. Consumer / boundary: The sleep scheduler's allocation of offline update resources between SWS_ANALOG and REM_ANALOG (sleep/phase_manager.py:498-521), not the waking prediction-error signal and not downstream task performance. Existing ownership: MECH-179, EXP-0341, SD-MEL-CONSUMER, MECH-180, INV-050.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); No error-TYPE channel exists anywhere in ree_core, and the one MEL input is a single untyped world-model PE scalar that scales both phases by the same factor, so the SWS/REM ratio cannot move for type reasons. The magnitude half of the release condition has an owner (SD-MEL-CONSUMER); the type half has none. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: NEW NODE REQUIRED. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-180.subject: sleep.novelty_adaptive_sleep_upregulation
MECH-180.title: Novel environments and high-MEL learning episodes adaptively upregulate the learning drive component of sleep (INV-050 third drive), producing measurable increases in slow-wave activity power, sleep spindle density, and hippocampal replay rate proportional to the novelty and prediction error load encountered during the preceding wake period.
MECH-180.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The arm-discriminating MEL axis must be live and graded on the CURRENT substrate: world_rule_shift must drive measured waking MEL above reference with a monotone gradient across novelty arms, and the HIGH arm must not collapse toward the reference band. 861e measured exactly that collapse on seed 271, and 861i attributes it to ree_core commit 6293b23 under the full protocol.

MECH-181.subject: dementia.cognitive_reserve_as_update_loop_maintenance
MECH-181.title: Cognitive reserve (produced by education, bilingualism, complex occupation, social engagement, and enriched environments) protects against dementia primarily by maintaining sustained novelty-driven Model Error Load throughout the lifespan, keeping the SD-017 model update system exercised and preserving sleep-architecture responsiveness to learning demands; conversely, understimulating environments accelerate dementia by depriving the update system of the error signal needed to remain adaptive.
MECH-181.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (five gates):
(1) PRODUCER SUPRA-REFERENCE -- the graded-enrichment arms must produce a measured waking MEL
gradient ABOVE the calibrated stable-base reference. The vacuity signature is V3-EXQ-718a's: measured
ecological MEL ~1e-5, noise-level and SCRAMBLED with respect to the novelty label, with
`conv_rel_drop ~0.98`. Grade novelty with SD-MEL-PRODUCER's `world_rule_shift_*` knob (action-map
re-permutation), NEVER with `env_drift_interval` -- V3-EXQ-677 measured a high-vs-low mean-PE
difference of 8.8e-07 against a 0.01 threshold on that knob, because moving hazards adds sampling
noise, not learning load.
(2) THE GRADIENT MUST BE LEARNING LOAD, NOT NOISE -- elevated PE counts only if it DECAYS within a
stationary window; `steps_since_world_rule_shift` is emitted in env `info` for exactly this. A
matched-PE OBSERVATION-NOISE negative-control arm must NOT reproduce the effect (grading observation
noise produces a monotone MEL ladder by construction on any substrate -- the DV-symmetry artifact
class, and the reason V3-EXQ-798a carried this control).
(3) CONSUMER LIVE AND UN-PINNED -- `use_mel_consumer=True`, and cumulative `sws_n_writes` /
`rem_n_rollouts` must VARY across arms. The vacuity signature is V3-EXQ-677's scheduler-pinned
SWS=80.0/80.0, REM=60.0/60.0 with zero cross-arm variance.
(4) HEADROOM -- `mel_duration_factor` is clamped to `[mel_duration_factor_min 0.5,
mel_duration_factor_max 3.0]`. If the top arm saturates at 3.0 the contrast is a cap artefact; report
the per-arm saturation fraction alongside the factor. This is the same shape as MECH-353's
precondition (1) -- see MECH-353's own `what_would_answer`, do not re-derive.
(5) CHANNEL ATTRIBUTION -- an ENRICHED arm with `use_mel_consumer=False` must show the SAME
offline-phase duration as an IMPOVERISHED arm with the consumer off, so any enrichment effect is
attributable to the MEL channel rather than to enrichment changing episode length or boundary count
(note that under the boundary-only trigger, episode count IS sleep count -- `sleep_substrate:GAP-9`).

CONFIRMING (two legs; both are required, and the second is MECH-181's distinctive content over
MECH-180):
(i) MAINTENANCE -- across `>= 3` enrichment levels (impoverished / moderate / enriched) at `>= 5`
seeds, measured above-reference waking MEL is monotone in enrichment level, AND cumulative
offline-phase work (`sws_n_writes + rem_n_rollouts`) is monotone in MEASURED MEL -- not in the
novelty LABEL, the distinction on which V3-EXQ-718's C1 failed 0/3 while its C2 passed 3/3 -- on
`>= 3/5` seeds.
(ii) RESERVE -- after a MATCHED degradation insult applied identically to both histories (a fixed
ablation of ContextMemory slots, or fixed noise injected into the E3 attribution path; identical
magnitude, identical schedule, applied after the enrichment phase), the ENRICHED-history agent
retains more attribution/competence than the IMPOVERISHED-history agent, by
`max(1.5 * SD(per-seed paired delta), an absolute floor derived from the consumer-OFF arm's spread)`,
on `>= 3/5` seeds. This is the only leg that tests "reserve" rather than "responsiveness", and it is
what makes MECH-181 more than a restatement of MECH-180.

FALSIFYING: with (1)-(5) met, ANY of --
(i) offline-phase work is flat or non-monotone in MEASURED MEL (the maintenance chain does not close);
(ii) at matched insult, enriched and impoverished histories show no retention difference (there is no
reserve, only responsiveness);
(iii) DECISIVE -- the retention difference SURVIVES with `use_mel_consumer=False`. MECH-181 asserts
specifically that the protection runs THROUGH the MEL-driven sleep loop; a difference that persists
with the loop disabled is an environment/exposure effect and refutes the claim's mechanism even
though it would leave the epidemiology untouched.

[2026-09-25 governance-20260925; GFLAG-0495] GOVERNANCE DECISION (rec-20260925-deedce42): CORRECTED DV for CONFIRMING leg (i) (MAINTENANCE). The leg (i) text above is an arithmetic identity (cumulative offline-phase WORK VOLUME is monotone in measured MEL by construction of the offline-phase-duration scheduler) and is kept verbatim, not deleted. Leg (i) is now scored on V3-EXQ-1071's B1_infonce_delta / mse_delta (the across-sleep frozen-battery delta) moving monotonically with measured MEL, per the user's standing delegation (chip-20260925-mech181-legi-dv-denomination, done: '(b) then (a); (c) rejected') and this cycle's choice among GFLAG-0495's three candidate readouts -- chosen because V3-EXQ-1071 already has a landed, validated non-zero instrument and needs no new non-degeneracy precondition. chip-20260925-mech181-legii-harness-design is now unblocked to proceed. See evidence/planning/mech181_leg_i_dv_arithmetic_refusal_20260925.md (REE_assembly b006b7642b).

MECH-182.subject: social.vocalization_harm_signal
MECH-182.title: Vocalization timbre as learned cross-modal harm-approach signal, generalizing to other-agent vocalizations.
MECH-182.what_would_answer:
MECH-182 IS CONJUNCTIVE across a LEARNING step and a GENERALISATION step, with very different
readiness -- split it, mirroring MECH-191's Leg A/Leg B pattern. The intake's own seven
structural steps give the cut: steps 1-4 are Leg A, steps 5-7 are Leg B.

LEG A -- SELF-EXPERIENCE CROSS-MODAL LEARNING (intake steps 1-4). Blocked on one small build
plus a knob, not on the social stack. The assertion: an arousal-modulated, self-produced
observable becomes, through experience, a learned predictor of harm-approach, acquired by the
harm attribution stream. This is the leg carrying MECH-182's novelty -- the acoustic substrate
itself is already documented (Andics 2014, Balint 2022); what is novel is that the mapping is
*learned from self-experience*.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (Leg A) -- three gates, all currently unmet:
(1) A self-produced observable must exist: some agent-emitted quantity that (i) is modulated
by arousal (the natural carrier is z_beta, which is live in `ree_core/latent/stack.py` as the
shared affective latent) and (ii) re-enters the agent's own observation stream so that an
association can be learned over it. Confirmed absent 2026-09-04: no vocal/timbre/acoustic
channel anywhere under `ree_core/`, and `BreathOscillator` (`ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py`) is an
internal phase counter that is neither emitted nor re-perceived and therefore does not
satisfy this gate.
(2) The trainable attribution head must be ON and above its competence floor:
`bla_attribution_head` must be set to `"trainable"` -- it defaults to
`"contribution_threshold"` (`ree_core/utils/config.py:6017`), a fixed rule which by its own
module docstring cannot acquire a cue-outcome association at all. A run on the default knob
tests a fixed threshold and can neither confirm nor falsify a LEARNED association; it must
self-route `substrate_not_ready`. Additionally the head's attribution selectivity must clear the
V3-EXQ-894a competence floor on at least 2/3 seeds (autopsy
`failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-894a_2026-08-08`, `competence_implementation_gap`) -- otherwise a null
is attributable to the head, not to the claim.
(3) Joint non-degenerate variance (same shape as MECH-191 Leg A's precondition): the
candidate observable must vary with arousal across the run, AND harm-approach episodes must both
occur and fail to occur. An observable pinned to a constant, or a harm-approach rate at 0 or 1,
tests nothing.

CONFIRMING (Leg A): with gates (1)-(3) satisfied, the agent's harm-approach signal (the
z_harm_a forward model, `ree_core/predictors/e2_harm_a.py`) comes to be driven by the
self-observable at a lead time it did not have at initialisation -- predictive gain from the
observable rises across training and exceeds a shuffled-observable control by a margin
scaled on the SD of the cross-seed delta plus an absolute floor, on at least 2/3 seeds -- AND
ablating the observable channel (not merely decorrelating it) degrades harm-approach lead time
back toward the shuffled control. The association must be shown acquired: a matched agent
trained with the observable held constant must NOT show the gain.

FALSIFYING (Leg A): the predictive gain is already present at initialisation -- the mapping
is architectural, not learned, which falsifies the "learned from self-experience" step that is
MECH-182's entire novelty over the classical acoustic literature; OR, with the head trainable
and the floor cleared, the gain never rises above the shuffled-observable control across
training on at least 2/3 seeds -- which falsifies the cross-modal association itself.

LEG B -- CROSS-AGENT GENERALISATION (intake steps 5-7). BLOCKED, identical gate to MECH-191
Leg B. The assertion: the learned association transfers, so the same feature in ANOTHER
agent's output activates the observer's harm-approach signal via the attributed other-model.
RELEASE CONDITION: see MECH-191's own `what_would_answer` Leg B RELEASE CONDITION -- ARC-047
(broadcast channel) plus ARC-010/MECH-031/MECH-032 (other-agent modelling), both re-confirmed
absent 2026-09-04. Do not re-derive it; MECH-182 implies no build beyond what MECH-183/MECH-191
already require. Do not substitute a scripted-partner or simulated-other-distress proxy:
MECH-183's own `what_would_answer` already evaluated and rejected that (its proxy (a)) as
non-diagnostic -- a PASS would not validate and a FAIL would not invalidate.
CONFIRMING (Leg B, once substrate exists): the same observable carried by an OTHER agent
activates the observer's harm-approach signal, and the transfer is gated by OTHER_SELFLIKE
tagging (present vs absent) rather than by raw feature similarity.
FALSIFYING (Leg B): transfer occurs at statistically indistinguishable magnitude with
OTHER_SELFLIKE off as on -- this falsifies the "via the attributed other-model" step and reduces
MECH-182 to plain stimulus generalisation, which is not a novel claim.

ORDER CONSTRAINT: Leg B is uninterpretable before Leg A passes. If the self-experience
association was never learned, there is nothing to generalise, and a Leg B null measures the
absent Leg A rather than the generalisation step.

MECH-183.subject: social.zbeta_leakage
MECH-183.title: z_beta leakage: attributed other-model affective state activates self z_beta directly, not via inference.
MECH-183.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires V3/V4 social substrate that does
not yet exist in ree_core -- a coupled other-agent model built via an
attribution stream, OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging (MECH-031/MECH-032), and a
multi-agent environment with observable other-agent distress cues.
Confirmed absent by feasibility assessment 2026-06-11 (IGW-200,
exp_0137_mech_183_feasibility_assessment.md): grep of ree_core for
other_model/attribution_stream/OTHER_SELFLIKE/mirror_model/z_beta_leak
returns nothing, and z_beta exists only as a SELF stream. Any run
attempted without this substrate must self-route substrate_not_ready,
not count as a verdict. Two proxy designs were already evaluated and
rejected as non-diagnostic -- do not repeat them: (a) simulated
other-distress cues without an actual other-agent model (tests
pattern-to-z_beta activation, not attributed-other-state activation --
a PASS would not validate the claim and a FAIL would not invalidate
it); (b) cross-modal z_beta activation from a correlated same-agent cue
(tests sensory association learning, i.e. MECH-182, not social
attribution). A test is only informative once the other-model/
attribution/OTHER_SELFLIKE substrate exists and both the
coupling-present and coupling-absent conditions produce non-zero,
non-identical z_beta variance.
CONFIRMING signature: with the coupled other-model substrate present,
the observer's z_beta activates above baseline when its other-model
registers the coupled other-agent's distress, and this activation (1)
scales with OTHER_SELFLIKE coupling strength/confidence rather than
being all-or-nothing, (2) persists when the explicit
inference/prediction pathway toward the other's state is ablated
(i.e. the activation is not merely a byproduct of predicting the
other's behaviour), and (3) is substantially reduced or absent when
OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging is off while the same distress cue is present
-- candidate design per the feasibility assessment: 2x2 factorial,
OTHER_SELFLIKE tag ON/OFF x distress cue present/absent.
FALSIFYING: z_beta in the observer does not activate above baseline
when the other-model registers the coupled other's distress; or the
activation is fully explained by (disappears without) the
inferential/predictive pathway alone, indicating leakage is mediated
by inference rather than direct activation; or the OTHER_SELFLIKE
tag ON vs OFF conditions produce statistically indistinguishable
z_beta activation, indicating the effect is not attribution-gated --
any of these falsifies the "direct activation, not via inference,
gated by attribution coupling" framing that is MECH-183's specific
(as opposed to the well-established PAM base-rate) claim.

MECH-186.subject: serotonin.tonic_benefit_gradient_maintenance
MECH-186.title: Tonic serotonergic signal maintains VALENCE_WANTING floor under chronic harm exposure, preventing benefit terrain collapse.

under chronic harm in the tonic_5ht_enabled=False arm -- z_goal_norm should show real

z_goal_norm from the start in both arms. Both prior direct tests of this claim
(v3_exq_251_mech186_valence_wanting_floor, runs ...1775504875_v3 and ...1775549211_v3,
2026-04-06/07) failed exactly this precondition: mean_z_goal_norm was ~0.01-0.02 in

was wired into the run at all and baseline SD-012 seeding was not functioning.
Governance reclassified both runs non_contributory/substrate_limitation on 2026-04-08
for exactly this reason ("cannot test floor effect without baseline seeding") -- both
the flat manifests and, as of 2026-08-06, the run-pack manifests and the derived
claim_evidence.v1.json index now consistently reflect this (0 genuine experimental
entries either direction; the index previously stayed stale at weakens=2/exp_conf=0.175
because the 2026-04-08 reclassification never propagated to the run-pack copies -- see

that this claim's own evidence_quality_note names as the intended test substrate -- a
future run should use the real flag, not a synthetic clamp, so the result speaks to
the modeled mechanism rather than an arbitrary intervention.

confirmed with tonic_5ht_enabled=False), enabling tonic_5ht_enabled=True measurably
