MECH-187.subject: serotonin.incentive_salience_gain_regulation
MECH-187.title: Serotonin modulates the gain on dopaminergic incentive salience, converting the hard SD-012 threshold into an adaptive graded transduction function.
MECH-187.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The serotonergic driver must be demonstrably moving, not merely enabled: tonic_5ht_enabled True with the realised tonic_5ht trajectory reported per arm and showing a non-trivial range across the harm-rich and benefit-rich conditions, and gain_min / gain_max set so the mapped z_goal_seeding_gain actually spans the band EXQ-252 showed is behaviourally relevant (about 0.6 to 2.0). If the harm-suppression term is the manipulated driver, z_harm_a must be shown non-degenerate (harm_history_len above zero and a trained affective encoder), else only the benefit-rise term is live.
CONFIRMING: Seeding response per unit benefit at matched proximity is graded by serotonergic state in the predicted direction (suppressed 5-HT collapses seeding, elevated 5-HT rescues it) with the serotonin-OFF arm flat, and the effect survives holding global approach vigour constant -- the dissociation the claim's description insists on. Manipulation: Drive the gain SEROTONERGICALLY rather than by config: cross harm exposure and benefit-contact history (which move tonic_5ht through SerotoninSystem.serotonin_step) against a serotonin-disabled arm, letting REEAgent write current_seeding_gain into GoalConfig.z_goal_seeding_gain each step. Control: A serotonin-OFF arm with z_goal_seeding_gain pinned at 1.0 as the bit-identical reference, plus a config-clamped positive control that sets the same gain values directly (the V3-EXQ-252 manipulation), which upper-bounds the effect the serotonergic route can deliver. Required event: Contact with a proximate benefit source while the agent's serotonergic state has been driven apart between conditions -- a harm-rich stretch that suppresses tonic 5-HT versus a benefit-rich stretch that raises it -- so the same cue arrives at different transduction gains. DV: z_goal seeding response per unit of benefit_exposure at matched proximity -- the seeded z_goal norm change on benefit contact -- compared across serotonergic states, with global approach vigour reported separately so cue transduction is not confounded with the Cools-style tonic reduction in approach drive.
FALSIFYING: With tonic_5ht demonstrably ranging and the config-clamped positive control showing the gain band does move seeding, the serotonergically-driven arms produce no graded seeding difference -- the 5-HT-to-gain mapping exists in code but does no work -- or the effect is entirely explained by a change in global approach vigour rather than in cue transduction. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The whole path exists and is readable: GoalConfig.z_goal_seeding_gain multiplies benefit before drive modulation (ree_core/goal.py effective_benefit), SerotoninSystem.current_seeding_gain maps tonic_5ht linearly into it, and REEAgent writes it every step inside the MECH-203 serotonin step. V3-EXQ-252 is the recorder for the gain leg and V3-EXQ-932a already uses the knob as a pre-registered arm. Consumer / boundary: The benefit-to-z_goal transduction point inside GoalState.update, where the gain multiplies benefit_exposure before drive modulation -- not global approach vigour and not terrain maintenance (MECH-186). Existing ownership: MECH-187, MECH-203, MECH-186, SD-012, V3-EXQ-252.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Nothing in the substrate is missing: the gain knob, the tonic_5ht mapping and the live per-step write into GoalConfig all exist. But the only supporting run, V3-EXQ-252, set z_goal_seeding_gain directly as a config value, which tests the graded transduction function and not the claim's subject -- serotonergic control of that gain. No experiment drives the gain through SerotoninSystem. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-188.subject: serotonin.pfc_goal_persistence_under_adversity
MECH-188.title: PFC-mediated goal persistence under adversity, sustained by 5-HT projections from DRN to dlPFC, maintains z_goal through harm spikes after seeding.
MECH-188.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: z_goal must be genuinely seeded and the persistent attractor ACTIVE (goal_state.is_active() true) before any harm spike, and the manipulation must act on that persistent attractor rather than on a per-tick scoring view -- V3-EXQ-536b force-armed z_goal_inject=0.3 with inject_observed_fraction 1.0 at the per-candidate read site and approach_commit_rate still stayed 0.0 on 3/3 seeds, because the injection never touches is_active().
CONFIRMING: With a seeded and active z_goal, enabling tonic_5ht_enabled keeps z_goal_norm above the collapse threshold through harm spikes where the disabled arm collapses at the first event, and the downstream consumer readout tracks that persistence rather than staying pinned. Manipulation: Toggle tonic_5ht_enabled so SerotoninModule.current_seeding_gain drives goal.config.z_goal_seeding_gain dynamically through the live writer at agent.py:12209 (the DRN-to-dlPFC persistence analog the claim names), rather than the MECH-188 z_goal_inject norm floor, which is a read-only per-tick view. Control: A tonic_5ht_enabled=False arm at matched seeds with identical harm-spike scheduling, plus a z_goal_inject arm retained explicitly as the read-site-only comparator so the persistent-attractor versus scoring-view dissociation is measured rather than assumed. Required event: Harm spikes (z_harm_a elevation) or transient benefit-exposure dropouts arriving AFTER a z_goal representation has been seeded and is being pursued, so persistence-through-adversity is distinguishable from failure-to-seed. DV: z_goal_norm trajectory through and after each harm spike (collapse depth and recovery), conditioned on goal_state.is_active() remaining true, together with a downstream consumer readout (approach_commit_rate or MECH-295 bridge engagement) so persistence of the representation is distinguished from persistence of behaviour.
FALSIFYING: With the same seeded baseline, enabling tonic_5ht_enabled gives no reliable difference in z_goal collapse depth or recovery through harm spikes -- there is no PFC-mediated maintenance distinct from seeding, and the cannot-hold-a-plan phenomenology must be attributed elsewhere. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The 5-HT path is live: serotonin.py current_seeding_gain and the writer at agent.py:12209 into goal_state.config, consumed at goal.py:907 in effective_benefit. The MECH-188 handle actually exercised so far, GoalState.with_injection (goal.py:1134), is documented in-source as applying to action selection only and NOT modifying the persistent attractor -- so no instrument currently records persistence at the attractor. Consumer / boundary: The persistent z_goal attractor and its is_active() state through adversity -- the maintenance boundary AFTER seeding -- not the per-tick E3 scoring view that z_goal_inject floors. Existing ownership: SD-018, SD-012, MECH-187, MECH-295, MECH-307, EXP-0100, EXP-0120.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The only manipulation ever run, z_goal_inject, is a read-only scoring view that bypasses the persistent attractor and every consumer gated on is_active(), so the commit chain stayed inert. The modelled manipulation (tonic 5-HT seeding gain) has a live writer but is degenerate without genuine SD-012 seeding, which is gated on SD-018. Secondary classes: R5, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-189.subject: development.super_ordinal_goal_formation
MECH-189.title: During the child phase, high-salience benefit contacts under high contextual complexity are written to persistent ContextMemory as super-ordinal goal anchors that bias adult z_goal seeding across novel episodes.
MECH-189.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: At least two DISTINCT child-phase contexts must form distinct anchors (n_occupied >= 2 with a cue-cosine separation below super_ordinal_merge_similarity), and the adult retrieval contexts must be NOVEL relative to those anchors. Pre-SD-077 this failed by construction (anchor store saturated at 1); V3-EXQ-669c measured max_anchor_count 64 with writes firing, so the ceiling is now lifted.
CONFIRMING: In novel adult contexts, seeding rate and z_goal norm are materially higher for cue-matched than cue-mismatched contexts, with the retrieved slot matching the child context that wrote it on a seed majority, and both collapsing in the frozen-write arm. Manipulation: Cross the write-window (child-phase writes enabled vs frozen throughout) with the adult retrieval context (cue-MATCHED to a stored anchor vs cue-MISMATCHED), holding use_super_ordinal_goal_anchors, salience and complexity thresholds fixed. Control: use_super_ordinal_goal_anchors=False bit-identical OFF arm, plus a within-run mismatched-cue arm that keeps the store populated but presents an adult context no anchor matches -- so a constant seeding bias is separable from a cue-selective one. Required event: A child phase in which high-salience benefit contacts co-occur with high contextual complexity and write anchors, followed by a write_enabled freeze and adult episodes in contexts not seen during the child phase. DV: Adult z_goal seeding attributable to retrieval, split by cue match: the rate of cue_pull seeding events and the resulting z_goal norm in matched vs mismatched novel contexts, and the fraction of seeding events where the retrieved SLOT is the one written in the corresponding child context.
FALSIFYING: Seeding is statistically indistinguishable between cue-matched and cue-mismatched novel contexts (a constant bias, not a cue-indexed hierarchy), or adult seeding is unchanged when child-phase writes are frozen while the store is otherwise identical. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SuperOrdinalGoalMemory.get_state exposes n_occupied, n_writes, n_seeds and last_seed_match; V3-EXQ-588c/588e read adult z_goal norm ON vs OFF. MISSING: the retrieved SLOT index is returned by retrieve() but discarded at agent.py's read site and never recorded, so per-context retrieval selectivity cannot be scored. Consumer / boundary: The adult z_goal seeding path -- GoalState.cue_pull driven from SuperOrdinalGoalMemory.retrieve in REEAgent.update_z_goal, before the within-episode benefit update. Existing ownership: SD-077, V3-EXQ-588e, V3-EXQ-669c, INF-ENV-003, MECH-329.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The write/read substrate is built and non-degenerate post-SD-077, but every run so far scores anchor COUNT, write COUNT and ON-vs-OFF z_goal magnitude. No experiment contrasts cue-matched against cue-mismatched novel adult contexts, and the retrieved slot index is discarded at the agent read site, so context-selectivity has no recorder. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-190.subject: social.defense_coalition_scent
MECH-190.title: Cooperative predator defense emerges without language when defense scent pressure is additive across agents and agents can perceive each other's alarm and harm-stress states.
MECH-190.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Multiple independently acting agents, a predator, additive defence scent, observable alarm/harm and opportunity for cooperative defence without a language channel.
CONFIRMING: Nonlinguistic coordination and defence gains depend on the additive/perceptual routes. Manipulation: Remove additive defence or alarm perception separately. Control: Solitary and nonsignalling groups at matched resources and predator strength. Required event: Predator approach with independently varied group size and signalling availability. DV: Joint defence success and coordination above the sum of isolated-agent responses.
FALSIFYING: No selective coordination gain after preconditions hold, or the same gain survives both route removals. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Multi-agent event/action recorder; absent from the V3 solitary environment. Consumer / boundary: Agent-to-agent alarm perception and combined defence effect. Existing ownership: MECH-038, MECH-190, REE_assembly/evidence/planning/multi_agent_ecology_v5_plan.md.
DISPOSITION: R8 (primary); Multi-agent ecology rather than a V3-native prerequisite. R3 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-191.subject: social.signal_legibility
MECH-191.title: Stereotyped behavioral signals are causal externalizations of specific internal functional states, making them cross-architecturally legible without learned convention.
MECH-191.what_would_answer:
MECH-191 is CONJUNCTIVE -- "causally produced" and "cross-architecturally legible" are
separate assertions with OPPOSITE readiness. Split on testability, mirroring ARC-003's
Leg A/Leg B pattern.

LEG A -- CAUSAL PRODUCTION (testable now, single-agent, RECEIVER-FREE).
Testable today for 4 of the 7 catalogued signals, whose internal-state correlate already
exists in ree_core: whine (z_goal-active-without-satisfaction, ree_core/goal.py
GoalState), huff (E3 trajectory-discard fired at breath cadence, MECH-107/108's
BreathOscillator sweep logic, ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py -- genuinely implemented, not a
stub), yelp (z_harm_a threshold-crossing, ree_core/amygdala/bla.py + cea.py), tail-wag
(z_beta positive-valence threshold-crossing, ree_core/agent.py). The other 3 catalog
entries are each blocked on DIFFERENT missing substrate and are NOT answered by a Leg A
pass on the other four: facial-expression needs OTHER_SELFLIKE model activation (confirmed
absent from ree_core, same grep as MECH-183 below); play-bow needs a mode-manager/play-mode
substrate (confirmed absent -- no PlayMode/mode_manager class anywhere in ree_core);
licks/petting-received is MECH-193's two-agent reward-coupling territory and is not
single-agent by construction.
NON-DEGENERACY: the internal-state channel and the candidate signal-analog event must
both show non-degenerate variance (state activates and stays quiescent across the run;
signal-analog event fires and fails to fire across the run) -- a state pinned always-on
or an event that never/always fires tests nothing.
CONFIRMING: for each of the four substrate-present signals, the internal-state activation
predicts its own signal-analog event with high specificity against the OTHER three states
and against a quiescent baseline -- a decoder trained only on the other internal-state
channels cannot recover which event fired above chance, AND ablating the state variable
itself (not merely a correlated channel) collapses the corresponding event. This is causal,
state-specific production at the level the current substrate can express it -- internal
telemetry standing in for physical externalization, the same substitution MECH-107 already
uses for "exhale."
FALSIFYING: any of the four channels shows low specificity (e.g. z_harm_a
threshold-crossings occur at similar rates during z_goal-unmet or E3-discard episodes as
during genuine harm episodes), OR ablating the state variable does not suppress its
correlated event -- undermines "causal externalization" even before any receiver exists.

LEG B -- CROSS-ARCHITECTURE LEGIBILITY (BLOCKED; not queueable as of 2026-08-08).
Requires (i) an actual externalization/broadcast channel carrying the internal state
outward -- confirmed absent: zero scent/broadcast/social-signal-output implementation
anywhere under ree_core/ (re-confirmed 2026-08-08, same finding as MECH-041's grep); the
only specification is ARC-047's seven scent fields, itself candidate, confidence 0.0,
implementation_phase v5, unbuilt; and (ii) a receiving agent with its own
other-model/attribution-stream/OTHER_SELFLIKE substrate to do the "any observer with a
corresponding internal state can map it" decoding -- confirmed absent, identical to
MECH-183's 2026-06-11 feasibility assessment, independently re-confirmed 2026-08-08.
CONFIRMING (once substrate exists): a receiving agent -- ideally of a different
architecture/training lineage than the emitter -- correctly attributes the emitter's
functional state above chance from the broadcast signal alone, AND this decoding accuracy
drops toward chance when the receiver's own homologous internal-state machinery is
ablated/absent.
FALSIFYING: even once the broadcast + other-model substrate exists, receiver decoding
accuracy is statistically indistinguishable from chance, OR indistinguishable between a
receiver WITH and WITHOUT the corresponding internal-state machinery -- either falsifies
"legible via a corresponding internal state, not learned convention."
[2026-09-10 /governance GFLAG-0175 option A] NECESSITY FRAMING MIGRATED HERE FROM MECH-192, which was
retitled to its narrowed signal-side residual on the same date. Leg B is the manipulation that carries
it: z_beta leakage can only produce functional state-matching if the perceived signal maps onto a
corresponding internal state in the observer, and stereotyped signals meet that requirement because they
are produced by the same functional states they communicate -- which is why fast empathy works
cross-species without shared language (Albuquerque 2016, Silva 2011; lit
targeted_review_social_signal_legibility). Ablating the receiver's homologous internal-state machinery,
i.e. Leg B's CONFIRMING/FALSIFYING clauses above, is what tests that necessity reading; MECH-192 now
retains only the graded signal-side residual (monotone coordination benefit in legibility at fixed
attribution coupling and matched channel information) and does not restate the necessity claim.

RELEASE CONDITION: identical substrate to MECH-183/MECH-041 -- ARC-047 (scent/broadcast
channel) plus ARC-010/MECH-031/MECH-032 (other-agent modelling) landing. No separate build
is implied by MECH-191 beyond what MECH-183/MECH-041 already require.

MECH-192.subject: social.legibility_empathy_prerequisite
MECH-192.title: Coordination benefit from z_beta leakage is monotone in signal legibility, holding attribution coupling and channel information fixed -- the SIGNAL-side ablation (MECH-191 Leg B ablates the RECEIVER; MECH-183 ablates the COUPLING; no other claim ablates the signal). RETITLED 2026-09-10 from the near-analytic 'signal legibility is prerequisite for fast empathy coordination' framing; see notes.
MECH-192.what_would_answer:
AS REGISTERED, MECH-192 IS NEARLY ANALYTIC and therefore not yet falsifiable. "z_beta
leakage can only produce functional state-matching if the perceived signal maps onto a
corresponding internal state in the observer" is a statement about what a mapping *is*, not an
empirical prediction -- there is no world in which an unmapped signal produces state-matching.
Its empirical content appears only when legibility becomes a graded, manipulable variable.
That narrowing is the claim, and it is what the residual below states.

NARROWED RESIDUAL CLAIM: coordination benefit from z_beta leakage is monotone in signal
legibility, holding attribution coupling and channel information fixed. This is the
SIGNAL-side ablation. It is distinct from -- and not tested by -- MECH-191 Leg B (which ablates
the RECEIVER's homologous internal-state machinery) or MECH-183 (which ablates the COUPLING via
OTHER_SELFLIKE ON/OFF). Nobody currently owns it.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- three gates, and the first two are NOT MECH-192's to satisfy:
(1) MECH-191 Leg A must have PASSED. The emitter's signal must first be shown to be a
causal, state-specific product of the internal state; otherwise "legibility" of that signal has
no referent and the manipulation measures channel noise. See MECH-191's own
`what_would_answer` Leg A precondition and criteria; do not re-derive them here.
(2) MECH-183 must be PINNED. The z_beta leakage channel must be demonstrated live and
attribution-gated (its OTHER_SELFLIKE ON/OFF x distress-present/absent 2x2). See MECH-183's
own `what_would_answer`; do not re-derive it. Grading legibility over an unpinned leakage
channel is uninterpretable in both directions: a null cannot distinguish "legibility does
not matter" from "there is no leakage to modulate", and a positive cannot distinguish leakage
from ordinary perceptual inference.
(3) MECH-192's OWN gate, and the one that makes the claim falsifiable at all: legibility
must be manipulable as a graded variable while attribution coupling is held fixed AND channel
information is matched -- i.e. a permuted/scrambled signal carrying identical information
content and identical channel energy but no state-homology, versus the true signal, across at
least three graded levels. Both arms must produce non-zero, non-identical coordination-cost
variance. Without the information-matched scramble the claim is unfalsifiable by
construction (any degradation is attributable to lost information rather than lost
legibility), which is precisely the defect the current registration has.

CONFIRMING: coordination cost (or observer state-matching accuracy) is monotone in signal
legibility across the graded levels, with coupling strength and channel information held
constant, on at least 2/3 seeds; the true-signal vs matched-scramble gap exceeds a margin scaled
on the SD of the cross-seed delta plus an absolute floor; AND the monotone relation survives
ablating the observer's explicit inference/prediction pathway toward the other's state, so the
effect is on the leakage channel rather than on inference (the same dissociation MECH-183's
CONFIRMING clause (2) demands, applied to the signal side).

FALSIFYING: coordination is statistically indistinguishable between the true signal and the
information-matched scramble at fixed coupling -- legibility is doing no work, the benefit is
carried by information availability plus coupling alone, and MECH-192's "prerequisite" framing
is false as an empirical claim; OR coordination tracks coupling strength but is flat in
legibility across the full graded range -- same conclusion, and MECH-192 collapses entirely
into MECH-183 with nothing left over.

RELEASE CONDITION: identical to MECH-191 Leg B -- ARC-047 (broadcast channel) plus
ARC-010/MECH-031/MECH-032 (other-agent modelling). See MECH-191's own text. MECH-192 implies no
build beyond what MECH-183/MECH-191 already require, plus the scramble control, which is an
experiment-design item, not substrate.

MECH-193.subject: social.reward_coupling_reinforcement
MECH-193.title: Social reward signals (affiliative touch, oxytocin-gaze loop) reinforce empathic coupling strength, creating a self-strengthening coordination loop.
MECH-193.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-183's attributed-other-model z_beta-leakage coupling mechanism
  must exist and be live (currently candidate, v5, unbuilt -- the generic z_beta latent stream
  agent.py already carries is NOT this mechanism, it has no attributed-other coupling semantics).
  MECH-192's signal-legibility channel must also exist (candidate, v5, depends_on MECH-183 +
  MECH-191 + ARC-047, itself unbuilt). An affiliative-signal-triggered reward channel distinguishable
  from generic reward must exist to be the thing this claim says reinforces coupling.
CONFIRMING: episodes immediately following an affiliative exchange (as delivered through the
  MECH-183/MECH-192 substrate once built) show measurably increased subsequent coupling/state-
  matching fidelity relative to a matched non-affiliative-exchange control at fixed training
  budget -- and this increase compounds over successive exchanges (the claimed self-reinforcing
  loop), not merely a one-shot bump.
FALSIFYING: coupling fidelity is statistically unaffected by affiliative exchange once matched for
  exposure and budget, or the effect is present but does not compound across exchanges (a one-shot
  bump, not a self-strengthening loop). A failure under any unmet precondition above is not
  evidence against the claim.
NOTES: cross-reference MECH-183 and MECH-192's own future what_would_answer entries once digested
  (neither currently has one) rather than re-deriving their prerequisite structure independently.

MECH-194.subject: play.synthetic_signal_substitution
MECH-194.title: Play mode operates by substituting synthetic z_goal and z_harm signals while permitting full learning flow through E3/E2/E1 as if signals were real.
MECH-194.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: play mode (ARC-049 frame tag + this
substitution mechanism) is UNIMPLEMENTED in V3 (substrate_conditional).
Requires: the play-frame tag (ARC-049) authorizing synthetic z_goal/
z_harm as legitimate training targets for episode duration; z_harm_s/
z_harm_a remaining ACTIVE during play with a RAISED escalation
threshold (not suppressed -- the Panksepp 1998 opioid-mediated
threshold-elevation reading, distinct from simulation's gradient
suppression); and z_goal_synthetic encoding learning-progress
d(PE)/dt (competence-based per Oudeyer 2007), not flat/entropy-based
magnitude.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires play episodes and matched
non-play (real-signal) episodes to produce measurably different
training dynamics -- if E3/E2/E1 update identically regardless of
play-frame status, the substitution mechanism is either absent or
inert.
CONFIRMING signature: during play episodes, E3 trajectory competence,
E2 forward model, and E1 world model all update AS IF the synthetic
signals were real (weight updates proceed normally, not suppressed)
-- distinguishing play from simulation (which suppresses post-commit
learning). Separately, z_harm_s/z_harm_a remain active but with a
measurably RAISED escalation threshold during play relative to
non-play episodes (graduated harm-adjacent exposure, not harm
blindness), and z_goal_synthetic tracks learning-progress rate rather
than a flat or entropy-derived magnitude.
FALSIFYING: play episodes produce IDENTICAL learning dynamics to
simulation (gradients suppressed) -- collapses play into simulation,
contradicting "play is authorized-synthetic learning, not
simulation"; or z_harm during play shows NO threshold elevation
(full suppression or unchanged threshold) -- falsifies the
opioid-mediated-threshold-elevation reading, supporting either harm
blindness (dangerous) or no functional difference from waking harm
processing; or z_goal_synthetic tracks flat/entropy-based magnitude
rather than learning-progress rate -- falsifies the competence-based
framing.

MECH-195.subject: play.strategy_calibration_dissociation
MECH-195.title: Strategy and calibration dissociate at play episode close: policy structure transfers to real episodes; goal/harm magnitude calibration is re-anchored by real homeostatic and harm signals.
MECH-195.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: play mode is UNIMPLEMENTED in V3 (confirmed
2026-08 by direct search of ree_core: zero occurrences of play_mode,
z_goal_synthetic, LP_weighted, play_frame_tag, frame_open, or
frame_close anywhere in the substrate; git history for ree-v3
contains zero commits ever touching "play_mode"). This claim is
gated on all three of its dependencies, none of which is built:
MECH-194 (synthetic signal substitution during play -- itself
unimplemented, per its own what_would_answer), MECH-196 (episode-
close recalibration -- registered, no what_would_answer, no
substrate, no experiments), and SD-012 (provisional, but only on
its REAL-signal seeding sub-claim C1 -- drive-scaled z_goal seeding
in ordinary, non-play episodes; C1's PASS does not build or exercise
any part of play mode's SYNTHETIC seeding path, and SD-012's own
navigation-outcome sub-claim C2 remains open). No experiment has
ever queued or run against this claim (checked claim_evidence.v1.json,
experiment_queue.json, and git log -S "MECH-195" -- registration and
lit-pull housekeeping only).

IMPLEMENTATION-MAPPING CAVEAT: the claim's prose ("goal magnitude
calibration," "harm threshold calibration") does not correspond to
an existing scalar variable in the current E3/goal architecture --
ree_core/goal.py's GoalState.goal_proximity() scores trajectories by
MSE-distance to a z_goal POSITION vector, not by a magnitude scalar.
Once play mode is built, the "magnitude calibration" this claim
describes will need to be identified concretely -- most likely as
(a) the drive-scaled threshold/intensity controlling z_goal SEEDING
(SD-012 territory) and/or (b) z_harm's escalation threshold (per
MECH-194's Panksepp-style raised-threshold reading) -- rather than
assumed to be a property of z_goal's vector geometry itself.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (i) play episodes and matched
real (non-play) episodes sharing a common downstream real-task
evaluation, so that transfer of POLICY STRUCTURE and non-transfer of
MAGNITUDE can be measured as two independent, dissociable outcomes
rather than one degenerate one; and (ii) the episode-close
recalibration event (MECH-196) actually firing and being observable
as a real override.

CONFIRMING signature (both legs required together): (a) TRANSFER: E3
trajectory-selection weights and E2 forward-model weights trained
during play episodes measurably improve real-episode task performance
on goal-pursuit-structure dimensions relative to an agent with no
play exposure; (b) NON-TRANSFER / RE-ANCHORING: post-play real-episode
z_goal seeding intensity and z_harm escalation threshold track REAL
homeostatic drive and harm signals at play-close, not the synthetic
values the agent operated under during play.

FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): (i) NO TRANSFER -- play-trained weights show
no measurable real-episode advantage; (ii) CALIBRATION LEAKAGE --
post-play calibration retains play-episode synthetic values instead of
being overridden by real signals (exactly the "contaminating" failure
mode the dissociation exists to prevent); (iii) INSEPARABILITY --
structure and magnitude prove coupled in a single parameter such that
they cannot be isolated at all.

DISPOSITION NOTE: considered and declined a MECH-158-style
derivational/substrate_conditional fusion split (2026-08-08 digestion
pass). The Schmidhuber 2010 "derivative signals cannot be rescaled
into absolute magnitude by any coefficient" argument in this claim's
notes is dimensional analysis close to definitionally true, with
little independent content to stress-test on its own terms -- the same
vacuity risk MECH-158's Leg A explicitly guards against. The
substantive open question (whether REE's actual mechanics, once built,
keep structure and magnitude separable in a load-bearing way) is
itself substrate-dependent, not resolvable from definitions alone.
Single-leg substrate_conditional is kept as the more accurate
disposition.

MECH-196.subject: play.episode_close_recalibration
MECH-196.title: Play episode termination triggers real-signal recalibration: homeostatic and harm signals override synthetic thresholds; the frame signal drop is the recalibration trigger.
MECH-196.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Scripted play-frame tag and synthetic training path must exist and reach the learner; real harm/homeostatic inputs stay available. Do not use the change in the scientific DV itself as the liveness gate.
CONFIRMING: Exit promptly restores calibration to real signals Manipulation: Restore real signals on frame exit versus delay that restoration Control: No-play and normal-exit episodes with matched real state Required event: Exit from a sustained synthetic play frame while real bodily signals remain informative DV: Frame-exit-aligned latency of harm/homeostatic recalibration and real-action safety
FALSIFYING: Calibration fails to restore despite effective frame exit and available real signals A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Required frame-exit/event and real-versus-synthetic target recorder, linked to actual update/commit paths; current V3 has no play-frame event producer. Consumer / boundary: V3 scripted authorised-synthetic-to-real boundary; independent bilateral maintenance is outside this slice. Existing ownership: MECH-196, ARC-049.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); The V3-compatible scripted play slice is registered in ARC-049/MECH-194 but unbuilt. Real SD-012 seeding and ordinary warmup do not instantiate authorised-synthetic play or its exit transition. Bilateral social maintenance remains future-only. R4 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-197.subject: play.type_progression
MECH-197.title: Play types progress in dependency order (sensorimotor -> constructive -> pretend -> rule-based -> cooperative), each training specific architectural subsystems that the next type requires.
MECH-197.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: This claim cannot be tested by any experiment run
against the current ree-v3 substrate. Verified 2026-06-07 and reconfirmed
2026-07-11 (IGW-20260711-196): a word-boundary grep over ree_core for
play/play_frame/is_play/play_mode/synthetic_z_goal returns empty. LatentState
carries no play_frame_tag, there is no is_play frame flag, no play-type
developmental curriculum, and no synthetic z_goal/z_harm seeding path (the
only z_goal path is the drive-gated GoalState.update()). A queued diagnostic
against this substrate would either fail to instantiate or vacuously re-derive
"V3 has no play-type curriculum" -- that is a substrate_not_ready self-route,
not a for/against verdict on the claim, and must not be logged as a null or
negative result. The release condition is upstream substrate work via
/implement-substrate, not another /queue-experiment iteration: at minimum
ARC-049's play_frame_tag, MECH-194's synthetic z_goal/z_harm substitution, and
a curriculum instantiating the five named, orderable play types (sensorimotor,
constructive, pretend, games-with-rules, cooperative). Only once that substrate
exists does a test become informative.
CONFIRMING signature: once the play-type curriculum exists, an ablation study
that removes or skips an earlier play type (e.g. trains constructive and
pretend play but skips sensorimotor, or skips constructive before pretend)
shows the later type fails to acquire its target subsystem competence --
e.g. a pretend-play-trained agent that skipped constructive play fails to
develop E3 trajectory selection or shows degraded hypothesis-tag/play-frame-tag
co-activation (MECH-198) relative to an agent that received the full ordered
sequence. Each play type's prerequisite subsystem competencies (as named
above: E1/E2 world-motor models for sensorimotor; E2 rollout/E3 trajectory
selection for constructive; MECH-094+ARC-049 intersection for pretend;
structured shared-state monitoring for games-with-rules; full multi-agent
ARC-049 frame maintenance for cooperative) are measurably present only after
the prior type's training, and measurably absent or degraded when that prior
type is ablated.
FALSIFYING signature: skipping or reordering play types produces no
measurable deficit in the "next" type's target subsystem competence --
e.g. an agent trained directly on pretend play (skipping sensorimotor and
constructive) acquires MECH-198's hypothesis-tag/play-frame-tag
co-activation at the same rate and quality as an agent that received the
full ordered curriculum. This would falsify the DEPENDENCY-ORDER claim
specifically (each type requiring the previous type's competencies) without
necessarily falsifying the narrower, already-resolved claim that play-type
CONTENT complexity escalates (that sub-claim, per the 2026-05-16 correction,
is about content complexity of shared-state monitoring, not the
subsystem-training dependency chain, and is not what this test targets).

MECH-198.subject: play.pretend_tag_intersection
MECH-198.title: Pretend play is the developmental point where the hypothesis tag (MECH-094) and play frame tag (ARC-049) first co-operate: the agent maintains counterfactual representations within a play frame, exercising the full commitment architecture in synthetic mode.
MECH-198.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-198 is currently substrate-blocked, not merely
unqueued -- no experiment script or queue entry exists for it anywhere in
ree-v3/, and its three dependencies (MECH-094 hypothesis tag, ARC-049 play
frame tag, MECH-197 play-type progression) are all themselves
candidate/substrate_conditional rather than built-and-proven. A run is
informative only once: (1) the hypothesis_tag and play_frame_tag are both
implemented as independently observable, co-activatable signals (not just
declared in LatentState) so "co-operation" is a measurable event rather than
an assumption; (2) a developmental curriculum harness exists that can run two
curricula differing ONLY in pretend-play inclusion/exclusion, otherwise
identical (same sensorimotor/constructive play exposure, same total training
budget); and (3) "commitment architecture failure" is operationalized into the
two distinct signature classes this claim's own testable_prediction names --
(a) frame-tag confusion (real consequences processed as synthetic, or vice
versa) and (b) commitment-gate miscalibration (fires without E3 evaluation
completing, or never fires) -- as separately logged event types, with
non-zero baseline variance in at least one arm. A run attempted before all
three hold should self-route substrate_not_ready, not count as a verdict.
CONFIRMING signature: the pretend-play-curriculum group shows significantly
fewer total commitment-architecture failures than the pretend-play-skip group
in adult real-consequence operation (otherwise-identical curricula), AND the
skip group's excess failures concentrate specifically in the two predicted
signature classes above (frame confusion in the real->synthetic direction, or
gate firing without/never completing evaluation) rather than presenting as
generic, undifferentiated performance degradation.
FALSIFYING signature: no significant difference in commitment-failure rate
between the two curricula; OR the skip group does show elevated failures but
they do NOT cluster in the predicted signature classes (e.g. failures are
diffuse / equally distributed across unrelated failure types) -- indicating
that even if pretend play matters, it is not doing the specific architectural
job (co-training the hypothesis tag and play frame tag against the commitment
gate) that MECH-198 proposes. Either falsifying outcome would also weaken the
downstream cluster that treats MECH-198 as load-bearing (INV-061, MECH-200,
MECH-201, MECH-202), since their unified-etiology argument presumes this
specific mechanism rather than a generic play-deprivation effect.

MECH-200.subject: psychiatric.frame_confusion_derealization
MECH-200.title: Frame confusion (real->synthetic direction): the agent treats real consequences as synthetic, producing derealization, manic commitment, and dissociative states.
MECH-200.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The frame tag must be INFERRED from ambiguous evidence rather than supplied by the caller, and the ambiguous regime must be entered at a non-zero rate; if the tag is a caller-supplied argument that is always correct by construction, no default-toward-synthetic bias can exist and the falsifier cannot discriminate.
CONFIRMING: The play-deprived agent tags ambiguous real trials synthetic at an elevated rate and commits under real harm at matched z_harm_s magnitude (the manic-commitment and derealization signature), with the effect absent on unambiguous trials. Manipulation: Vary the developmental pretend-play exposure that is supposed to calibrate the real/synthetic decision boundary, then measure the adult default under ambiguity; the crude lesion substitute is to force the synthetic tag on waking ticks. Control: Adequately-play-exercised agent at matched budget under identical ambiguous-frame trials, plus unambiguous real-frame trials in both groups to show the deficit is specific to ambiguity rather than to harm processing generally. Required event: Real-consequence operation under an ambiguous frame signal -- a situation whose frame membership (real or synthetic) is genuinely underdetermined, with real harm present. DV: Proportion of ambiguous real-harm trials tagged synthetic; and conditional on real harm being present, the discount applied to z_harm_s before the commitment gate -- expressed as commitment rate under matched z_harm_s magnitude relative to the control group.
FALSIFYING: No elevated synthetic-tagging under ambiguity, or elevated tagging with no downstream effect on harm discounting and commitment -- the tag error does not propagate to the commitment gate and the claimed failure mode has no architectural realisation. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Absent at the required boundary. simulation_mode is a caller-supplied boolean at every site (ree_core/agent.py, amygdala/bla.py, comparator/suffering_derivative_comparator.py), never inferred, so no tagging DECISION is recorded and no misclassification rate can be computed. MECH-319's counters record admit/block outcomes, not tag-assignment errors. Consumer / boundary: The frame-tag assignment step upstream of the harm gate: whether an ambiguous real episode is admitted into the real-consequence pipeline, not whether harm is represented once admitted. Existing ownership: clinical_failure_modes:FRAME-TAG, INV-061, MECH-198, ARC-049, MECH-094.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); V3 has no ambiguous-frame event and no frame INFERENCE: simulation_mode is passed as an argument, so the tag is correct by construction and the real->synthetic error cannot arise. MECH-319's gate is deliberately idempotent for waking calls (ON, admit_writes, caller_sim=False always returns False), so even the available control cannot inject the real->synthetic mis-tag. Secondary classes: R5, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: unphased_no_v3_link. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-201.subject: psychiatric.frame_confusion_delusion
MECH-201.title: Frame confusion (synthetic->real direction): the agent treats simulation, replay, and imagination as real, producing delusion formation, PTSD flashbacks, and anxiety.
MECH-201.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Replay must actually fire at a non-zero rate and the write sites downstream of it must show non-zero weight change when writes ARE admitted; if the replay-driven path is inert, admitting its writes changes nothing and the lesion cannot discriminate.
CONFIRMING: With the tag dropped, replay-sourced content produces durable arbitration-weight change and elevates z_harm_a and commitment on trials with no waking harm evidence, reproducing the predicted intrusion signature, with the effect scaling with replay rate. Manipulation: Drop the hypothesis tag on internally generated content, i.e. set MECH-319 SimulationModeRuleGate admit_writes=True so replay-driven invocations are admitted at the rule-arbitration sites, and extend the same lesion to the amygdala and comparator sites that currently no-op under simulation_mode=True. Control: Identical run with admit_writes=False (tag intact, simulation writes blocked), and a waking-only arm, with per-site counters confirming the lesion actually changed which calls wrote. Required event: An internally generated episode -- SWR-style replay, a ghost-goal probe, or a pre-commit rollout -- reaching a downstream consumer that normally treats only waking content as real. DV: Durable change attributable to replay-sourced content: n_simulation_admitted per site and the resulting arbitration-weight drift relative to the tag-intact arm; plus z_harm_a magnitude and commitment rate on trials whose only harm evidence came from a simulated rollout.
FALSIFYING: Dropping the tag produces no durable weight change and no harm or commitment elevation from replay-sourced trials -- internally generated content is not on a path that can be mistaken for real, so the synthetic->real confusion has no architectural realisation. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Partly exists. ree-v3/ree_core/regulators/simulation_mode_rule_gate.py records n_calls_total, n_waking_admitted, n_simulation_blocked and n_simulation_admitted per site, which measures write leakage directly. What is not recorded is any behavioural readout distinguishing simulated content PROCESSED as real from simulated content admitted and ignored. Consumer / boundary: The write-admission boundary between internally generated content and the real-consequence pipeline -- the arbitration, amygdala and harm-comparator sites that consult simulation_mode. Existing ownership: MECH-319, MECH-094, MECH-121, clinical_failure_modes:FRAME-TAG, INV-061.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The manipulation, its control and its write-leakage counters all exist and were built explicitly as a falsifier seam, and nothing has ever been run against MECH-201. Remaining gaps: no behavioural readout for processed-as-real versus admitted-and-ignored, and the developmental-etiology leg still needs the unbuilt play curriculum. Secondary classes: R2, R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: unphased_no_v3_link. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-202.subject: psychiatric.commitment_gate_failure
MECH-202.title: Commitment gate developmental failure: undertrained gate from insufficient pretend play produces either impulsivity (gate fires without evaluation) or commitment paralysis (gate never fires).
MECH-202.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The beta gate must have dynamic range at the run's operating point -- baseline committed fraction strictly between 0 and 1 -- and BOTH poles must be reachable by moving the commit threshold, else a pinned gate produces one pole by construction and the two-direction claim is degenerate rather than confirmed.
CONFIRMING: Agents deprived of the low-stakes calibration phase land at one of the two poles -- premature commitment or non-commitment -- while calibrated agents occupy the middle, with the pole determined by which side of the threshold the untrained gate rests on. Manipulation: Include versus omit the pretend-play calibration phase in the developmental curriculum. The only manipulation available today is the downstream surrogate -- sweeping E3 commit threshold and use_variance_tracking_commit_threshold around the INV-055 high infant default. Control: Full-curriculum agent at matched compute, plus a threshold-pinned arm holding the infant default fixed, so that any two-pole signature is attributable to calibration exposure rather than to the sweep itself. Required event: A developmental phase in which low-stakes commitment is repeatedly practised and its outcome fed back (the claim's pretend-play calibration), followed by adult-phase decisions under reward/harm conflict where commitment timing matters. DV: A two-sided signature as a function of calibration exposure -- the rate of commitments issued before E3 evaluation completes (impulsivity pole) and the fraction of episodes with no commitment plus unbounded E3 re-selection (paralysis pole) -- with the calibrated arm sitting strictly between both extremes.
FALSIFYING: Calibration exposure leaves commitment timing indistinguishable from the uncalibrated arm, or the two poles do not appear at any threshold setting, which would make the developmental etiology idle and reduce the claim to a restatement of threshold sensitivity. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The consequence side is instrumented: BetaGate state and committed_run_length (ree_core/heartbeat/beta_gate.py:99-159) and committed_frac in the experiment baselines record both poles. The etiology side has no instrument because no calibration history exists to record -- there is no play phase in ree_core. Consumer / boundary: The calibrated VALUE of the commit threshold at the E3 commit decision (effective_threshold, ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:3974ff), arrived at developmentally rather than set by config. Existing ownership: MECH-197, MECH-198, ARC-049, INV-055, clinical_failure_modes:FRAME-TAG.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); The causal antecedent -- a pretend-play calibration phase -- does not exist in V3, so only the consequence leg (threshold value to behavioural pole) is runnable, and that leg tests MECH-090 gate sensitivity, not this claim's developmental etiology. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-203.subject: serotonin.replay_salience_tagging
MECH-203.title: Tonic serotonergic (5-HT) level during waking tags benefit-relevant experiences for preferential replay during subsequent SWS, complementing harm-salience tagging by the residue field
MECH-203.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Waking exposure must produce nontrivial, discriminable benefit and harm tags at matched contacts. The calibrated harm_salience route is built and does not require HarmEncoder warmup. Preserve experience identity into a real SWS selection boundary and verify that tonic-5HT-derived tags reach that selector.
CONFIRMING: Waking high-5HT benefit tags preferentially influence subsequent SWS selection after contact, opportunity and selection-time drive are controlled Manipulation: Vary waking tonic 5HT during tagging; separately clamp selection-time weights to distinguish stored tagging from current drive bias Control: Yoked contacts, identical replay opportunities and tag-shuffled/control pools; both valence categories independently present Required event: Benefit and harm encounters under different waking tonic 5HT levels, followed by actual SWS replay DV: Benefit-versus-harm replay selection frequency during SWS conditional on waking tag dose, rather than a waking selector score labelled as sleep
FALSIFYING: With admissible tags and verified SWS access, replay allocation is independent of the waking tagging manipulation; current-drive-only effects reject the cross-state tagging clause A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Calibrated update_benefit_salience/update_harm_salience and waking _select_valence_weighted_start exist. SleepReplaySampler currently reads staleness only; the REM replay caller passes drive_state=None. Existing SR-2/admissibility ownership must connect the tags to SWS and record phase-labelled episode/region selections. Consumer / boundary: Waking stored valence to subsequent SWS content selection; separate from current-drive weighting during waking quiescent replay Existing ownership: mech203-valence-pool-admissibility, SR-2, GFLAG-0018, EXP-1266.
DISPOSITION: R6 (primary); The existing falsifier measured a waking quiescent selector as SWS. Pool admissibility remains unresolved, and SWS tag consumption/phase-labelled recording is not supplied by that selector. No new harm encoder is warranted on the scalar route. Secondary classes: R4, R5, R2. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-204.subject: serotonin.rem_gate_zero_point
MECH-204.title: Serotonergic withdrawal during REM actively defines the precision recalibration zero-point by removing the benefit gradient, not merely permitting recalibration
MECH-204.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Demonstrate an active drift source that moves a precision-calibration DV away from independently realised prediction-error calibration with correction OFF, including dose separation beyond float noise. Use at least 16 cycles per arm as established by 541c; verify each correction write and its sign.
CONFIRMING: With operative drift and independent calibration truth, correction returns the DV toward calibration relative to drift-only, with a graded step effect across seeds. Manipulation: Cross SD-076 drift doses with MECH-204 recalibration ON/OFF and predeclared rem_precision_recalibration_step values. Control: Drift-only, correction-only and neither arms; independently realised prediction error as calibration reference. Required event: Waking overconfidence followed by repeated REM/WRITEBACK precision recalibration. DV: Overconfidence relative to realised error and its correction toward the cumulative zero-point reference over at least 16 cycles; dose-response and signed correction versus drift-only.
FALSIFYING: With all admissibility gates met, correctly signed recurrent correction writes leave the drifted DV indistinguishable from drift-only across the defensible step range. A test with absent drift, a self-referential target or an unrelated cluster criterion cannot answer this.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: E3 running_variance and realised prediction-error recorder in 794a; WRITEBACK precision-space correction. An EMA of the corrected variable alone cannot supply an independent calibration target. Consumer / boundary: Precision-space write over repeated sleep cycles, not E3-score divergence or cluster_live_frac. Existing owners: SD-076, sd_waking_confidence_inflation_headroom, GFLAG-0385, V3-EXQ-541d.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); 794a already ran: repaired headroom separates doses, but absolute overconfidence was not established at either dose. The 541d target/guard design adds a self-reference problem. GFLAG-0385 and the existing SD-076 route own the unresolved source question; this audit selects no new mechanism. Secondary classes: R2, R1. Corrected 2026-09-21 against current code and autopsies; previous text preserved verbatim in the audit JSON history. No status/confidence change, build authorisation or experiment queueing.

ADDENDUM 2026-09-25 (governance-20260925-0548; GFLAG-0492): Option A (the 541d-lineage falsifier over a stationary drift source) is CLOSED by user decision. It cannot fire under any stationary drift source, and its C2 reads 0.0 at the SD-076b write-site. A successor test must not re-open Option A; see the 2026-09-25 evidence_quality_note entry.

MECH-205.subject: hippocampal.surprise_gated_generative_replay
MECH-205.title: Hippocampal replay is surprise-gated and generative: episodes with high unexplained prediction error are prioritized, replayed with counterfactual variations via E2, and deprioritized only when forward models can account for the surprise.
MECH-205.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: surprise_gated_replay and valence are enabled; nonzero surprise writes and heterogeneous episode PE are observed. The current default threshold is 1e-5, not the repaired 0.001 trap. Gain/need and episode identity must be independently measured; a global PE EMA or residue scalar is not an episode-specific priority/convergence ledger.
CONFIRMING: Allocation tracks the registered PE-by-need rule, decreases as that episode becomes explained, and structured counterfactual replay selectively corrects its model Manipulation: Independently vary expected revisit need and surprise; block replay for selected high-surprise episodes; compare structured counterfactual composition to rote replay Control: Equal exposure and update budget, episode-yoked suppression, isolated RNG and matched gain with different need Required event: High-PE/high-need, high-PE/low-need and low-PE/high-need experiences with later model correction DV: Episode-specific replay allocation and tapering versus its held-out prediction error; counterfactual recombination/contrast identity; selective correction of replay-blocked episodes
FALSIFYING: With independent PE/need variation and a live consumer, allocation ignores surprise or need, fails to taper with episode-specific correction, or only rote content is generated; score these clauses separately A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Current surprise writes and drive_state-to-valence start scores are observable. _select_valence_weighted_start selects a maximum over recent latent states, while _do_replay discards the output. The built path lacks the required episode-specific need/convergence and causal recombination-to-learning record. Consumer / boundary: Distinguish anchor selection, proposal generation and downstream model update. GFLAG-0076 resolved the alleged current contradiction with MECH-092; SD-038 retains the future three-cell reconciliation requirement. Existing ownership: mech092-replay-consumer-missing, SD-038, GFLAG-0076, GFLAG-0203, ARC-031.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); Threshold liveness is repaired, but the complete priority-to-generative-learning chain is not runnable. A global surprise-weight score does not establish per-episode need or convergence, and the benefit consumer is absent. Secondary classes: R2, R1. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-206.subject: hippocampal.ca1_surprise_buffer_write_mechanism
MECH-206.title: CA1 acts as a PE-proportional comparator that writes episodes to the surprise buffer: mismatch between CA3 prediction and entorhinal actual input produces a graded signal that tags the episode for offline replay and suppresses retrieval of the now-erroneous prediction.
MECH-206.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (three conjuncts, all measured on the run's own data; the run is
unreadable until all three hold).
(1) *Comparator exists and both channels are live.* A CA1-equivalent submodule must receive two
genuinely distinct inputs on the same tick -- a CA3-like pattern-completed anchor
representation and an entorhinal-like actual/variation representation -- and the run must
report non-zero cross-tick variance in BOTH channels separately, plus a channel-decorrelation
floor (|corr(ch_CA3, ch_EC)| < 0.95 over the window). A single-channel residual computed from
one stream is MECH-256's comparator, not this claim's: if only one channel varies, the run
self-routes `substrate_not_ready_requeue` and says nothing about MECH-206.
(2) *The mismatch statistic is PE, not a latent delta.* See MECH-288's own
`what_would_answer` LIVE GRADED-MISMATCH PRECONDITION -- do not re-derive it. The identical
hazard applies here: `agent.py:5448` currently passes `pe_dict=None` to the one comparator-ish
substrate that exists, which silently degrades it to `sum_s ||z_s(t) - z_s(t-1)||`
(`event_segmenter.py:139-142`). Any MECH-206 test must assert its mismatch input is forward
prediction error and record which quantity it used.
(3) *The consumer reads.* Replay output must be consumed by something. As of 2026-09-01
(`substrate_queue.json:mech092-replay-consumer-missing`, verified against source) `_do_replay`
discards `replay_trajs` and no reader exists in `ree_core/`, so every DV below is currently
unmeasurable. The run must report a non-zero count of replayed episodes that reached a
consumer; a zero here is a substrate verdict, never a claim verdict.

CONFIRMING (two legs; leg A is the priority claim, leg B the suppression claim -- the claim
is fully confirmed only by both, and leg A alone is the weaker "PE-tagging" reading).
*Leg A -- graded PE ranks replay, and does so better than the incumbent staleness ranker.*
Three arms at matched seeds and matched replay budget: (i) CA1-comparator PE-magnitude
priority; (ii) MECH-285 staleness priority (`replay_sampler.py`, the built incumbent); (iii)
BINARISED CA1 priority -- the same comparator thresholded to a match/mismatch flag, which is
the claim's own stated null ("a binary flag would not support the priority ordering MECH-205
requires"). CONFIRMED requires BOTH: (a) rank correlation between per-episode CA1 mismatch
magnitude and post-replay forward-model improvement on that episode's content, Spearman
rho >= 0.3 with the 95% CI excluding 0 across >= 6 seeds; AND (b) arm (i) beats arm (iii) on
forward-PE reduction per replay slot by a margin exceeding max(1.0 x SD of the per-seed delta,
an absolute floor of 2% relative), with consistent sign across seeds. Arm (ii) is reported as
the competitive baseline: MECH-206 is confirmed *as the priority signal* only if (i) is not
beaten by (ii); if (ii) wins, MECH-206 survives only as a tagging mechanism and the priority
claim is transferred to MECH-284/MECH-288.
*Leg B -- retrieval suppression (Bein 2020 bidirectional shift).* On high-mismatch ticks the
agent's reliance on the pattern-completed prediction must FALL within the same or the next
tick: the weight/gate on the CA3-like channel into downstream selection drops monotonically
with mismatch magnitude, with a non-zero negative slope whose CI excludes 0, and the effect
must be specific -- no equivalent drop on a matched control channel (the EC-like actual input,
which Bein 2020 predicts should go UP).

FALSIFYING.
With all three preconditions green: (a) mismatch magnitude does not rank-order post-replay
improvement (rho CI includes 0), OR the graded arm is statistically indistinguishable from the
BINARISED arm (iii) -- the latter is the sharpest falsifier available, because it directly
refutes the claim's load-bearing gradedness argument while leaving "CA1 tags surprising
episodes" intact; (b) the CA3-channel reliance does not fall with mismatch, or falls
symmetrically on the control channel (no bidirectional shift -- a generic arousal/gain effect,
not the claimed connectivity dissociation); (c) a CA1-specific lesion impairs forward replay
as much as it impairs buffer population (the claim's Predict-(1) requires the dissociation, not
just the impairment). Any of (a)+(b) together refutes the claim as stated; (a) alone with (b)
holding demotes it to "CA1 tags, something else ranks".

MECH-207.subject: hippocampal.cholinergic_surprise_buffer_gate
MECH-207.title: Acetylcholine acts as a permissive write-gate on the surprise buffer: prediction errors trigger hippocampal representation destabilisation and offline memory updating only when basal forebrain cholinergic activation co-occurs.
MECH-207.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A settable ACh-analog tone/level must exist in
ree_core/neuromodulation with a write-gate consumer on the surprise-buffer/hippocampal write path,
alongside MECH-206's CA1 comparator and MECH-205's episode-level replay allocator each
independently satisfying their OWN what_would_answer preconditions (do not re-derive; see
MECH-205, MECH-206). Currently none of the three exist: ree_core/neuromodulation/ contains only
serotonin.py, with zero acetylcholine/cholinergic hits anywhere in ree_core (verified 2026-09-25).

CONFIRMING: With the ACh-gate substrate live and MECH-205/206's own preconditions met, episodes
encountered under a low-ACh-analog state fail to enter the surprise buffer (no offline
replay/update) despite matched or higher prediction error than episodes encountered under a
high-ACh-analog state, which DO enter and get updated offline. Manipulation: ACh-analog tone
(high vs low) at encoding time, crossed with PE magnitude, on matched episodes. Control: PE
magnitude and novelty held constant across ACh conditions; a waking-arm comparison isolates the
offline-write effect from any online behaviour change. DV: buffer-entry rate and offline update
magnitude for PE-matched episodes, conditioned on ACh-analog level at encoding.

FALSIFYING: With the substrate live and MECH-205/206 preconditions met, buffer entry and offline
updating track PE alone regardless of ACh-analog level at encoding -- i.e. ACh state has no
measurable effect on which PE-tagged episodes get cached for offline correction. A failure under
unmet preconditions (no ACh substrate, or MECH-205/206 preconditions unmet) is not evidence
against the claim.

UNBLOCKS WHEN: an ACh-analog neuromodulatory channel is added to ree_core/neuromodulation (none
exists) AND MECH-205's and MECH-206's own preconditions are separately satisfied.
implementation_phase v4; do not queue a V3 experiment.

MECH-208.subject: hippocampal.valence_asymmetric_replay_approach_avoidance
MECH-208.title: Valence-asymmetric replay causally drives approach/avoidance bias: harm-path replay is weighted relative to reward-path replay by the agent's harm-salience parameter, and chronically elevated harm-weighting produces avoidance bias in safe contexts.
MECH-208.what_would_answer:

MECH-210.subject: sleep.rem_e1_world_model_free_running
MECH-210.title: Type 4 (detailed story, close to reality, super interesting) dreams are the phenomenological signature of REM E1 world-model free-running: with sensory input disconnected and the commit gate suppressed, E1's LSTM generates unconstrained sequential rollouts from its learned prior, producing coherent narrative arcs that are novel-but-plausible and experientially interesting.
MECH-210.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (REE-architecture leg): a genuine joint "REM mode" -- E1's LSTM running forward generatively (predict_long_horizon, prediction_horizon=20, ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py) from an internally-generated starting point with NO live sensory correction, WHILE ARC-016's commit gate is suppressed (commitment_threshold driven low/negative) AND monoaminergic precision is reduced live during the rollout (not only as a post-sleep one-shot adjustment) -- does not currently exist as an assembled, invocable mode in ree_core/. predict_long_horizon is never called from ree_core/sleep/; the existing REM_ANALOG phase scaffolding (agent.py enter_rem_mode/run_rem_attribution_pass, ree_core/sleep/routing_gate.py) does hippocampal REPLAY of stored past trajectories, not E1-generative free-running of novel content -- it implements the Type 1/2/3 mechanism family (MECH-121/205/208/209), not Type 4. Before any confirming/falsifying test is meaningful, a driver must be built that: (a) seeds E1 from an internally-generated, not externally-observed, state; (b) runs predict_long_horizon with commitment_threshold overridden so no commit fires; (c) applies precision reduction concurrently with the rollout, not only afterward; (d) confirms sensory input genuinely does not reach E1 during the window.
CONFIRMING: once built, E1's free-running rollouts show (i) narrative coherence -- later predicted states measurably constrained by earlier ones, above an i.i.d.-shuffle-matched baseline; (ii) novelty-within-learned-prior-support -- rollouts fall outside the specific stored-episode distribution while staying low-error against a held-out plausibility model; (iii) an interestingness/surprise proxy that tracks independently-measured world-model calibration quality (MECH-123's own dependency) -- well-calibrated priors produce a measurably different rollout signature than deliberately miscalibrated ones.
FALSIFYING: rollouts under the jointly-induced conditions are indistinguishable from i.i.d. noise regardless of prior calibration quality; OR the interestingness/surprise signature shows no relationship to independently-measured world-model calibration; OR narrative coherence is present even without the commit-gate/precision manipulations, meaning the REM-specific framing adds nothing beyond ordinary free-running rollout mechanics.
HUMAN-CLINICAL LEG (separate, non-REE-blocking): (1) REM-suppressing-antidepressant prediction -- SSRIs/SNRIs (and other REM-suppressing agents, per MECH-178's NA-tone pathway) reduce/delay REM on PSG; this claim predicts selective loss of Type 4 (detailed-story) dreams under chronic use, with Types 1-3 relatively spared -- testable via dream-diary studies contrasting REM-suppressing vs REM-sparing agents. (2) Dementia-progression prediction -- progressive Type-4 degradation preceding its disappearance, tracked via longitudinal dream diaries in early-stage dementia. Both answerable from clinical/psychiatric literature and cohort studies, independent of REE substrate status.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): this claim's direct mechanistic parent MECH-123 was set to substrate_conditional/v3_pending: true on 2026-08-06 ("mirroring sibling MECH-121") -- this claim is a downstream specialization and its own precondition is unmet a fortiori; consider adding v3_pending: true to match. The REM_ANALOG phase-name collision (see NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION above) could mislead a future reader into thinking this claim is substrate-supported because a similarly-named phase exists -- worth a short cross-reference note in docs/architecture/sleep/offline_phases.md.

MECH-212.title: e2_motor_sequence_sleep_consolidation
MECH-212.what_would_answer:

MECH-213.subject: sleep.rem.joint_calibration
MECH-213.title: e1_e2_joint_rem_calibration

CONFIRMING: The joint-rollout arm reduces E1-E2 calibration divergence relative to the E1-only and no-REM arms, with the reduction concentrated on state-action pairs whose waking experience was sparse. Manipulation: REM joint-rollout ON versus OFF (and an E1-only rollout arm) between matched waking blocks, holding SWS replay, MECH-204 precision recalibration and total offline compute fixed. MECH-216.subject: goal.e1_schema_wanting

depletion-RATE estimator (E2 projecting z_self forward to derive drive_level_rate, distinct from
current drive_level) -- this has ZERO substrate: grep of ree_core/goal.py finds only the reactive
SD-012 drive_floor/drive_weight mechanism, no rate/trend/anticipatory computation anywhere; (3) a
wiring path from that rate estimate into GoalConfig.drive_weight modulation / VALENCE_WANTING
seeding, which also does not exist. Recommend adding MECH-215 to depends_on (see left).

CONFIRMING: with recurrence enabled and a depletion-rate estimator wired into VALENCE_WANTING
seeding, an agent with rapidly-falling energy at a high absolute baseline shows anticipatory
approach/seeking behaviour BEFORE the absolute drive_level threshold is crossed, while an agent
with a depleted-but-STABLE energy level (same absolute level, zero rate) does NOT show this
early-seeking behaviour -- the dissociation the claim's own notes already specify.

FALSYING: with the rate estimator wired and both arms run at matched absolute drive_level,
early-seeking behaviour is statistically indistinguishable between the falling-rate and
stable-rate conditions -- the "anticipatory" signal collapses into ordinary reactive SD-012
wanting keyed off current level alone. A failure under unmet preconditions (rate estimator or
recurrence absent/off) is not evidence against the claim.

UNBLOCKS WHEN: (1) `use_self_recurrence` is exercised (on or measured-live) rather than left at
its off default; (2) a depletion-rate estimator is built on top of it and wired into
GoalConfig.drive_weight / VALENCE_WANTING seeding -- named blocking artifact: no such estimator
or wiring exists in ree-v3/ree_core/goal.py as of this check.

MECH-219.subject: harm_stream.hysteretic_affective_load
MECH-219.title: affective_harm_hysteretic_integration
MECH-219.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the run must actually exercise the accumulator
substrate, not merely have it present-but-inert. use_harm_suffering_accumulator=True
(master flag, default OFF/bit-identical) AND use_harm_un=True (loud precondition
per the 2026-06-10 implementation_note) must both be set, and the relevant
consumer redirect flag(s) for whichever downstream signature is being tested
(e.g. the mode-switch consumer for prediction 4) must be enabled -- most
default OFF except the v1 urgency/PAG/MECH-091-interrupt wiring. z_harm_un
itself must show real dynamic range within the run (nonzero variance across
onset/offset events) -- a flat or near-constant z_harm_un gives the
integrator nothing to demonstrate hysteresis over. A run failing any of these
self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a verdict on the mechanism. The 11/11
unit contracts already on file (test_mech_219_harm_suffering_accumulator.py)
establish only that the arithmetic (drive computation, alpha_rise/alpha_fall,
gate math) matches spec -- they are NOT evidence for this claim's behavioral/
representational content and should not be cited as validation.
Scope note: this falsifier covers the TEMPORAL/HYSTERETIC content of MECH-219
(its own predictions 1, 2, 4 below). The controllability-gating question
(originally this claim's prediction 3) was narrowed out to MECH-305
(2026-05-04), which is a separate, currently lit-only claim depending on
MECH-219. Do not treat a controllability-only demonstration as confirming
MECH-219, and do not fold a MECH-219 temporal-signature test into a
MECH-305 controllability test -- keep the two experiments and their
verdicts separate.
CONFIRMING signature (all should hold, on a substrate meeting the
precondition above):
(1) Asymmetric decay: after harm offset, z_harm_un falls rapidly while
    z_harm_a remains elevated and decays measurably slower (e.g.
    alpha_fall << alpha_rise reflected in fitted onset vs recovery time
    constants, not just eyeballed trajectories).
(2) Non-linear summation: repeated brief harm exposures produce a higher
    z_harm_a than a single continuous exposure of equal cumulative
    duration x intensity -- i.e. the signal is not just a rescaled EMA of
    total dose, but genuinely path-dependent.
(3, formalizing prediction 4) Separable behavioral signature: z_harm_a
    (not z_harm_un) is the variable that predicts mode-switch rate
    (MECH-259), while z_harm_un drives immediate avoidance amplitude --
    an ablation or regression showing the two channels dissociate, not
    that either alone explains both behaviors.
(4) Nonredundancy: z_harm_a is NOT reconstructible from z_harm_un by a
    simple monotonic or time-shifted transform (low r2 / low cosine-sq
    overlap, consistent with the SD-019 nonredundancy metric this claim
    depends on) -- i.e. the explicit "pure delay" null model
    (z_harm_a(t) = z_harm_s(t-k)) that this claim's own notes reject is
    actually tested and rejected, not assumed.
FALSIFYING signature: decay is symmetric or z_harm_a collapses as fast as
z_harm_un after offset (no genuine hysteresis); repeated-brief and
single-continuous exposures of matched cumulative dose produce
statistically indistinguishable z_harm_a (no summation advantage, i.e.
it behaves as a simple EMA on raw exposure); z_harm_a is reconstructible
from z_harm_un with high r2/cosine-sq (fails nonredundancy, reduces to
the rejected pure-delay model); or z_harm_a and z_harm_un predict
mode-switch and avoidance interchangeably with no separable signature.
Any of these would mean the hysteretic-integrator design adds no
functional content beyond a delayed copy of the sensory stream, and the
claim should be revisited rather than simply re-run with different
hyperparameters.

MECH-220.subject: harm_stream.cross_stream_hub
MECH-220.title: harm_stream_hub_coordination
MECH-220.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The two harm streams must be separately non-degenerate in the run (z_harm_s and z_harm_a both non-None and both varying), and the coordination path must be exercised at an operating point where it is not inert: AICAnalog's harm_s_gain only departs from 1.0 when beta_gate is elevated AND p_external_task is non-zero AND drive_level is below the protect ceiling.
CONFIRMING: Coordinated arms show both a higher z_harm_s forward R^2 and better z_harm_a urgency calibration than the ablated arm at matched seeds, with a behavioural harm_rate difference beyond seed noise. Manipulation: Ablate the live cross-stream coordination in the shipped substrate: use_aic_analog True vs False (and harm_descending_mod_enabled off) for the affective-to-sensory gain direction, and the SD-020 precision-weighted PE target on/off for the sensory-to-affective direction -- not a bespoke experiment-local HarmHub. Control: Matched-seed arms with the coordination path off but both encoders present and trained identically; plus the legacy raw beta_gate descending path as a coordination-free comparator that changes the same multiplier for a different reason. Required event: Trials where sensory harm prediction error and accumulated affective load disagree -- a phasic hazard onset under low chronic load, and sustained chronic load under low phasic surprise -- with committed and uncommitted episodes both represented. DV: E2 forward-model R^2 on z_harm_s and urgency calibration of z_harm_a (agreement between z_harm_a level and realised harm within the next k steps), plus harm_rate as the behavioural readout, each compared coordinated vs ablated at matched seeds.
FALSIFYING: Ablating the live coordination leaves forward R^2, urgency calibration and harm_rate unchanged (the 395 signature, harm_rate_delta 0.0 in every seed), or improves only one of the two directions, which would falsify the bidirectional-hub form and leave at most a single directed gate. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/cingulate/aic_analog.py (urgency, harm_s_gain) and its application at the agent.sense() descending-attenuation site; z_harm_a via ree_core/latent/stack.py AffectiveHarmEncoder and the SD-020 harm PE tracker in agent.py. No recorder currently emits a paired forward-R^2 and urgency-calibration pair per arm. Consumer / boundary: The live sense()/E3-commit path -- harm_s_gain multiplying z_harm before it reaches E3 and E2_harm_s, and z_harm_a feeding commit gating -- not a bespoke greedy harm-score selector inside an experiment. Existing ownership: SD-032c, SD-020, SD-021, EXP-1294, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-395-cluster_2026-09-02.
