DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); No cross-stream hub exists in ree_core; the 395/262 drivers built an inline HarmHub and scored it with a bespoke greedy harm-score selector, so the manipulation never reached the live commit/policy path (harm_rate delta 0.0). The shipped partial coordination -- AICAnalog harm_s_gain and the SD-020 PE target -- was never ablated and is not linked to this claim. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-221.awaiting: z_world exogenous-world-event channel (chip-20260910-zworld-exogenous-event-channel, /implement-substrate, PARKED behind evidence/planning/zworld_adequacy_plan.md SD-106 by user decision 2026-09-16, no substrate_queue entry)
MECH-221.subject: latent_stack.continuous_self_residualization
MECH-221.title: z_world must be continuously residualized against z_self predictions; efference-copy subtraction is not limited to SD-003 query time.
MECH-221.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A trained action-sensitive reafference predictor, observable independent exogenous-event labels and a downstream z_world event DV above chance with headroom; matched EMA and action sequences.
CONFIRMING: Continuous correction improves exogenous-event discrimination over OFF and sham when event information is available. Manipulation: Disable continuous ReafferencePredictor correction after training. Control: Correction on and action-mispaired sham subtraction, matched magnitude and smoothing. Required event: Self motion crossed with independently timed exogenous world transitions. DV: Held-out exogenous-event detectability and false self-attribution from downstream z_world deltas, followed separately by native-consumer consequences.
FALSIFYING: With a usable event DV and effective correction, OFF or sham performs equally or better. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: LatentStack.encode corrects every eligible sense tick; 1018's event AUC recorder exists but measured absent/chance event information. z_world_raw minus z_world also includes EMA and is not a valid correction DV. Consumer / boundary: Post-correction, post-EMA z_world as read by downstream consumers. Existing ownership: SD-007, chip-20260910-zworld-exogenous-event-channel, GFLAG-0320.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Residualisation is already implemented; the exogenous-event signal required by the proposed DV is unready. R2 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-222.awaiting: z_world exogenous-world-event channel (chip-20260910-zworld-exogenous-event-channel, /implement-substrate, PARKED behind evidence/planning/zworld_adequacy_plan.md SD-106 by user decision 2026-09-16, no substrate_queue entry)
MECH-222.subject: pathology.self_attribution_overflow_psychosis
MECH-222.title: Failure of continuous z_self residualization produces self-attribution contamination psychosis: referential delusion and thought broadcasting substrate.
MECH-222.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: An exogenous world event must be decodable from the downstream z_world stream ABOVE CHANCE in the un-contaminated condition, or there is no visibility for contamination to destroy. Six measurements put that probe at 0.53-0.63 AUC and the stationary positive control at 0.488 / 0.550 / 0.570, so the precondition is currently unmet and any verdict would be vacuous.
CONFIRMING: With an above-chance exogenous-event channel established, the residualization-OFF arm shows a materially lower exogenous-event probe AUC than ON, and the drop is not reproduced by the magnitude-matched SHAM arm. Manipulation: Ablate continuous reafference residualization via config.latent.reafference_action_dim (0 disables the predictor, action_dim enables it), against a sham arm that subtracts a vector of the same distribution and magnitude with the action mis-paired. Control: ARM_SHAM is the load-bearing control: any change common to the ON and SHAM arms is attributable to subtracting a vector of that size rather than to correct residualization; actions are drawn uniformly at random so the env trajectory is identical across arms at a given seed. Required event: A world-state transition not caused by the agent -- a hazard actually changing cell on a step -- occurring while the agent is also self-moving, so a self footprint and an exogenous event are simultaneously present in the z_world delta. DV: Held-out AUC of a linear probe detecting a ground-truth exogenous hazard transition from the downstream z_world delta alone, contrasted ACROSS arms; self_footprint_frac is recorded as a manipulation check and is explicitly not load-bearing.
FALSIFYING: With the channel established and the manipulation verified, the OFF and ON arms give indistinguishable exogenous-event AUC, or SHAM reproduces the drop -- retained self footprint then does not mask exogenous events and the contamination substrate has no purchase in V3. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The manipulation, the arms and the probe all exist in experiments/v3_exq_1018_mech222_self_attribution_contamination.py, and ReafferencePredictor is applied on every encode tick in ree_core/latent/stack.py. What does not exist is the signal: there is no channel by which a z_world consumer perceives an exogenous event, and the staged measurement record shows SD-070 alone will not create one because it targets static single-frame properties, not transitions. Consumer / boundary: The downstream z_world stream a coherency consumer reads -- whether an exogenous world event remains distinguishable from the agent's own prediction footprint at that boundary. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0300, chip-20260910-zworld-exogenous-event, MECH-221, EXP-0893.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The claim's consequent has no observable: z_world carries exogenous world-event information at chance across six measurements, so the DV cannot lose what it never had. Underneath that is a reachability question the claim presupposes and nobody has answered -- if the body delta is routed to z_self by SD-005, by what pathway does a z_world consumer ever perceive an exogenous event. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Coordinator: Prerequisite candidate (exogenous-world-event channel at the z_world consumer boundary) NOT registered as a new substrate_queue row: the requirement is already held by chip-20260910-zworld-exogenous-event-channel (PARKED by user decision 2026-09-16) and open GFLAG-0300; a queue row would sidestep that parking decision. Recorded in prerequisites_rejected with the four claims it would unblock (MECH-221, MECH-222, INV-066, MECH-098) so governance can un-park it as one item. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-223.subject: attribution.animated_agency_overweighting_bias
MECH-223.title: Animated agency attribution overweighting: systematic bias toward attributing intentional causation to animated/moving entities requires active calibration in the attribution pathway.
MECH-223.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Moving non-agentive objects and genuine agents must be matched for kinematics, with independent causal-intent labels and a learnable calibration signal.
CONFIRMING: Calibration selectively reduces animation-driven false agency attribution. Manipulation: Remove agency-prior calibration while holding sensory motion and causal exposure fixed. Control: Intact calibration, static objects and matched non-agentive motion. Required event: Ambiguous biological/animated motion with different actual causal sources. DV: False intentional-agency attribution conditional on matched motion evidence.
FALSIFYING: No animation-specific overattribution or no selective calibration effect with informative conditions. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: No V3 animate-agent versus moving-nonagent attribution instrument; hazard drift alone supplies no intention ground truth. Consumer / boundary: Motion-based prior to agent attribution. Existing ownership: MECH-223, REE_assembly/evidence/planning/mirror_modelling_other_self_v5_plan.md.
DISPOSITION: R8 (primary); Requires later agent-modelling ecology; no valid V3 intentional-agency label. R3 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-224.subject: harm_representation.piecewise_gradient
MECH-224.title: harm_eval.piecewise_gradient_structure: E3 harm_eval learns both continuous intensity and discrete mode-transition thresholds.
MECH-224.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: harm_eval's own calibration gradient must be reproduced LIVE in the
same run as the shape test (calibration_gap clearing the EXQ-026 bar of 0.03), using proxy hazard
fields (CausalGridWorldV2, use_proxy_fields=True) with >= 20 events per class per seed for
none/approach/contact, exactly as ARC-024/MECH-071's own instrumentation requires. Scope the V3
leg to the HARM-ONLY three classes -- do NOT include benefit_approach, which ARC-024's own R5
finding shows is structurally unreachable at default event-classification tie-breaking
(hazard_approach wins every tie unless proximity_approach_magnitude_tiebreak=True, which is off
by default); including it would inherit ARC-024's degeneracy rather than test MECH-224's own
question.

CONFIRMING: with the calibration gradient live and >=20 events/class/seed, a multimodality test
on the pooled harm_eval score distribution (e.g. Hartigan's dip statistic, or BIC comparison of a
1-component vs 2/3-component Gaussian mixture) rejects the unimodal null in favour of >=2
components, with inter-cluster gaps exceeding within-cluster spread on >= 2/3 seeds -- i.e. the
none/approach/contact classes cluster with gaps, not smoothly.

FALSIFYING: with the same live calibration gradient and event floors met, the pooled distribution
is statistically indistinguishable from a single smooth unimodal fit (dip test / BIC do not
prefer >=2 components) -- response FORM does not transition discretely even though response
MAGNITUDE (the calibration gradient itself) is graded. A failure under unmet preconditions
(calibration gradient not reproduced live, or event floors unmet) is not evidence against the
claim.

OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG / V4 RESIDUAL: the behavioural half of the claim (agent learns qualitatively
distinct defensive strategies -- routing modification, freezing, emergency escape -- at discrete
harm-gradient thresholds) has no V3 substrate: the action space has no such class distinctions.
This stays substrate_conditional/v4; UNBLOCKS WHEN a V4 action space distinguishes these strategy
classes. Governance should consider whether MECH-224 needs splitting into a v3-scoped output-shape
claim and a v4-scoped behavioural-strategy claim rather than carrying one `implementation_phase`
for both, given the two legs now have genuinely different testability status.

MECH-225.subject: perception.oscillatory_multiplexing
MECH-225.title: Oscillatory coupling multiplexing: cross-frequency oscillatory dynamics (gamma/theta/beta/delta) implement phase-based separation of perception, simulation, and action preparation streams.
MECH-225.what_would_answer:
MECH-225 fuses two claims that resolve in different domains. Following the precedent already established by its own dependency MECH-089 (functional_ restatement: the biological mechanism is one implementation of a functional requirement, not required in the ANN substrate), split explicitly.
LEG 1 (REE mechanism, substrate_conditional -- testable once V4 substrate exists): does REE's E1/E2/E3-hippocampus system implement some functional analog of channel-banded routing letting shared representational capacity simultaneously carry (a) sensory-constrained perception, (b) counterfactual/imagined rollout, and (c) committed action-trajectory content, disambiguated without separate circuits -- and does collapse of that separation produce a measurable confusion signature between imagined and perceived content (this claim's own hallucination-analog prediction)? "Gamma/theta/beta/delta" should be read as a functional-separation requirement, not a commitment to literal continuous-time oscillatory dynamics.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires V4 substrate that concurrently encodes at least perception + imagination (or perception + action-commitment) over shared representational capacity with an explicit disambiguation/routing mechanism -- verified absent in V3 as of this date: ThetaBuffer (MECH-108), BetaGate (MECH-090), and cross_stream_binder.py each implement at most a two-way separation, none disambiguate three concurrent streams over shared capacity.
CONFIRMING signature: once V4 substrate exists, ablating/collapsing the channel-separation mechanism measurably increases confusion between imagined-rollout content and perceived content, beyond what ablating either channel alone accounts for.
FALSIFYING signature: perception, imagination, and action-commitment streams remain functionally distinct and non-confusable under shared representational capacity even with no explicit disambiguation mechanism -- meaning the "multiplexing" framing is unnecessary machinery relative to what plain capacity-separation already achieves.
LEG 2 (biological substrate, out of REE's test domain): whether biological gamma/theta/beta/delta oscillations specifically implement local binding / hippocampal sequencing / commitment-bias / global-mode respectively, in actual cortex and hippocampus, is a human/animal electrophysiology question no REE experiment can adjudicate -- resolved by literature, not REE experiment. Per PubMed: McLelland & VanRullen 2016 reconcile "communication-through-coherence" (Fries) and the "theta-gamma neural code" accounts of oscillatory multiplexing in a single spiking-network model (PLoS Comput Biol 12(10):e1005162, DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1005162); Hyafil et al. 2015 show theta-gamma coupling functioning as a de-multiplexing mechanism for speech in human auditory cortex (eLife 4:e06213, DOI 10.7554/eLife.06213). This literature supports that cross-frequency multiplexing is an actively-studied biological mechanism, NOT that the specific gamma=binding/theta=sequencing/beta=commitment/delta=global-mode assignment in this claim's notes is settled consensus.

MECH-226.subject: architecture.tcl_biophysical_substrate
MECH-226.title: TCL substrate: Temporal Coherence Loop is implemented as a distributed system involving the inferior olive, cerebellum, thalamus, and cortical networks.
MECH-226.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: TCL (ARC-053) must first exist as a genuine multi-region
distributed mechanism, not a functional-analog rolling aggregation. Per ARC-053's own
what_would_answer (audited this session): V(t)'s phase-alignment term P_i(t) has no
implementation anywhere in ree_core/, and ARC-053's own LIVE ARCHITECTURAL QUESTION --
whether TCL needs literal anatomical decomposition, or whether MECH-089's explicitly
disclaimed functional-analog rolling-aggregation already discharges the functional
requirement under a non-anatomical name -- is flagged unresolved, not assumed either way.
MECH-226 cannot be stated in testable form until that question resolves toward "literal
multi-region decomposition is architecturally necessary": until then there is no substrate
to assign the four proposed anatomical roles to. MECH-225 (the oscillatory-multiplexing
mechanism MECH-226's cortical/E1 leg depends on) is independently substrate_conditional
and itself unbuilt in V3 (verified absent: ThetaBuffer/BetaGate/cross_stream_binder.py
each implement at most a two-way separation).

CONFIRMING: once a V4 TCL exists as a genuine multi-region system, perturbing/ablating each
of the four proposed components in isolation produces the DISTINCT failure signature
specific to that component's proposed role -- e.g. ablating the inferior-olive-analog
specifically degrades phase-reference generation without degrading predictive alignment;
ablating the cerebellum-analog specifically degrades predictive alignment without
degrading phase reference; and so on for thalamus (global gating) and cortex (phase-coded
representation). I.e. the four roles are functionally separable, not one mechanism wearing
four anatomical labels.

FALSIFYING: a single undifferentiated timing/synchrony mechanism suffices for V(t)
computability, OR ablating any one of the four components produces the same generic
degradation as ablating any other (no role-specific signature). The anatomical mapping
would then be biologically evocative labelling over one mechanism, not four separable
functions -- MECH-226 should demote to an explanatory note on ARC-053/MECH-225 rather than
stand as its own mechanism_hypothesis. A failure under the unmet precondition above (TCL
still unbuilt) is not evidence against the claim.

OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: the "Clinical: cerebellar findings in schizophrenia, timing
abnormalities in psychosis, sleep-phase disruptions" tail is a biological/clinical
plausibility argument, not a REE-testable claim -- answerable by literature, not by an REE
experiment. Keep separate from the architecture leg above: literature support for the
clinical correlates must not substitute for evidence that the four-way REE-internal
functional split is real.

MECH-227.subject: pathology.anaesthesia_consciousness
MECH-227.title: Anaesthesia as D_V collapse: general anaesthesia abolishes consciousness by disrupting phase alignment, degrading V(t) globally, and collapsing D_V to zero.
MECH-227.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Conscious-state outcome measured independently of the proposed V(t)/D_V index; actual anaesthetic exposure and physiological coupling measurements.
CONFIRMING: The predicted integration loss tracks and explains state transitions beyond arousal controls. Manipulation: Change anaesthetic state while separately assessing phase alignment and effective connectivity. Control: Matched sedation/arousal changes without loss of the independent consciousness measure. Required event: Anaesthesia induction and recovery. DV: Temporal relation and dissociation between consciousness assessment and D_V/coupling changes.
FALSIFYING: Reliable preserved consciousness with collapsed proposed integration, or loss without the predicted disruption, under valid measures. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: External physiological assessment; ARC-053 TCL is future-scoped and V3 proxy V_s is not consciousness. Consumer / boundary: Distributed temporal integration across induction/recovery. Existing ownership: ARC-053, INV-068, MECH-227.
DISPOSITION: R8 (primary); External consciousness/anaesthesia claim; zeroing a V3 scalar is not a test. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-228.subject: architecture.ephaptic_coupling_coherence
MECH-228.title: Field-level coherence support (ephaptic coupling): extracellular electric field interactions stabilise phase relationships across neural populations, supporting temporal coherence.
MECH-228.what_would_answer:
This claim fuses a biological assertion with an REE functional requirement. Split, following the
MECH-225 precedent.
LEG 1 (biological, out of REE's test domain; the claim's core):
CONFIRMING: at physiological amplitudes, field-only manipulations (applying, cancelling or
clamping the endogenous field while synaptic and gap-junction transmission are held fixed or
blocked) change inter-population phase locking or synchrony.
FALSIFYING: once synaptic and gap-junction contributions are controlled, cancelling or clamping
the endogenous field leaves phase locking unchanged. Field effects on spike timing may exist, but
too weakly to stabilise phase.
Answered by literature. Owning pipeline: LIT-0905 (proposed), which must include a disconfirming
or mixed source. Starting points: Anastassiou et al. 2011; Frohlich & McCormick 2010;
Anastassiou & Koch 2015. The anaesthesia corollary belongs to MECH-227 (already out_of_domain)
and is not duplicated here.
LEG 2 (REE functional requirement, V4, substrate_conditional):
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a per-population oscillatory phase variable and the ARC-053/MECH-225
coherence scaffold must exist. None exists in V3. cross_stream_binder is a binding factor, not a
phase-stabilisation term, so V3-EXQ-720/725/725a are not evidence here (EXP-0904 already draws
this line).
CONFIRMING: a synchrony-dependent mean-field coupling term reduces phase drift and improves the
ARC-053 coherence DV beyond a pairwise learned/synaptic coupling arm matched in gain.
FALSIFYING: the matched pairwise coupling arm equals it. The field term is then decoration for
REE, whatever Leg 1 finds.

MECH-229.subject: drive.wanting_liking_behavioral_dissociation
MECH-229.title: E3 produces reliably distinct wanting and liking behavioral signals: wanting drives persistent approach toward goal-encoded locations (incentive salience); liking produces only consummatory response at resource contact.
MECH-229.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Foraging contact must occur (repeated substrate_not_ready_requeue outcomes across 514l/m/n/p/q), AND the load-bearing criterion must be one a drive-uniform negative control does NOT clear. The 514p autopsy measured raw C_WL at 0.717 on the drive-uniform control against a 0.6 bar, so with n_resource_types=3 the raw fraction is dominated by the ~(N-1)/N categorical baseline.
CONFIRMING: Approach persistence toward the incentive-bound identity exceeds the identity-shuffled control by a pre-registered effect-size margin while the consummatory response stays confined to contact, AND the drive-uniform negative control does not clear the same bar. Manipulation: Object identity and incentive state varied via the SD-057 incentive token bank, comparing persistent approach toward the wanted identity against consummatory response at contact, with the drive axis manipulated as a within-eval contrast. Control: An identity-shuffled arm that breaks the object-incentive binding while preserving contact rate, plus the drive-uniform arm as an explicit negative control that MUST fail the criterion for the criterion to be isolating. Required event: A trial in which the agent's most-wanted object and last-consumed object can diverge: an object-bound incentive state exists at a distance, and consumption is available at another identity. DV: Approach persistence toward the incentive-bound object identity relative to the identity-shuffled control (the wanting leg), contrasted against consummatory response confined to contact events (the liking leg); the raw most-wanted != last-consumed fraction is a non-vacuity check only, never the load-bearing quantity.
FALSIFYING: Approach persistence toward the wanted identity is indistinguishable from the identity-shuffled control on a contact-clearing substrate, or the negative control clears the bar as readily as the treatment arm -- which would mean the recorded dissociation is a categorical-baseline artifact rather than incentive salience. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The SD-057 IncentiveTokenBank in ree_core/goal.py (use_incentive_token_bank, incentive_decay, incentive_value_alpha, incentive_drive_kappa_weight) supplies per-object incentive state, and 514o/514p/514q record wanting_liking_dissoc_fraction plus wl_drive_minus_nodrive. The object-bound instrument exists; the isolating contrast is the part the drivers do not currently make load-bearing. Consumer / boundary: Behavioural dissociation at the action level -- prospective approach versus contact-time consummation -- not the z_goal latent structure (that is MECH-230) and not the drive-coupling leg (split out as MECH-436). Existing ownership: MECH-436, SD-049-PHASE-2, SD-057, EXP-0237, scaffolded_sd054_onboarding, GFLAG-0100.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The established leg-(a) support rests on a criterion its own drive-uniform negative control clears (0.717 vs a 0.6 bar), so the DV does not isolate incentive-salience content; and every corrected retest on the object-bound substrate has hit substrate_not_ready on foraging contact. The bank exists; the experiments do not score against it discriminatively. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-230.subject: drive.goal_state_latent_structure
MECH-230.title: E3 maintains a structured latent goal representation (positive attractor in z_goal sub-space, measurable as z_goal_norm > 0) distinct from harm avoidance, enabling hippocampal terrain navigation toward goal states.
MECH-230.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Foraging competence must deliver enough resource contacts per seed for z_goal to seed at all -- the recorded blocker is 2 of 3 seeds making zero contact on the pre-scaffold substrate -- and the ablated arm must hold z_goal_norm at zero, which V3-EXQ-328b's C3 did not (benefit_threshold=0.6 failed to suppress seeding in the ablated condition on 2 of 3 seeds).
CONFIRMING: On the scaffolded substrate, the intact arm shows z_goal_norm above the seeding floor with identity-probe accuracy and per-axis drive separation well clear of chance while the ablated arm stays at zero, AND steps-to-resource is materially lower in the intact arm on at least two of three seeds with a pre-registered margin. Manipulation: Ablate the goal-seeding path (drive/benefit seeding off, GoalState.update suppressed) against the intact arm, holding curriculum, seeds and harm exposure fixed; a second axis lesions the harm stream to test distinctness. Control: Goal-ablated arm (z_goal_norm expected 0.0, measured 0.0 in V3-EXQ-632's negative control 3/3) and a harm-only arm with no resource identity, on matched seeds. Required event: Homeostatically driven resource contact on the scaffolded_sd054_onboarding curriculum, with SD-012 drive active, producing a z_goal seed that persists past the contact tick. DV: Two legs. Leg one: z_goal_norm and its persistence to end-of-episode, the identity-recovery probe accuracy over resource type, and the per-axis drive ANOVA F, with decoding cross-talk against z_harm as the distinctness measure. Leg two: goal-conditioned navigation lift -- steps-to-resource and goal_resource_r under structured z_goal versus the ablated arm.
FALSIFYING: z_goal is structured and distinct from harm yet goal-conditioned navigation shows no lift over the ablated arm on a substrate where contacts are non-degenerate -- the 'enabling hippocampal terrain navigation' clause then fails and the claim narrows to a representational assertion only. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/goal.py GoalState.update supplies z_goal and z_goal_norm; V3-EXQ-514m records the identity probe (acc 0.926, n=3455), the per-axis ANOVA (F_max 1096) and goal_resource_r 0.953. The VALENCE_WANTING residue seeding path exists in agent.py, but no run on the scaffolded substrate records a navigation-lift DV against an ablated-goal arm. Consumer / boundary: E3's z_goal sub-space as written by GoalState.update, read downstream at the hippocampal VALENCE_WANTING residue seeding and the goal-conditioned navigation policy. Existing ownership: MECH-230, SD-049-PHASE-2, scaffolded_sd054_onboarding, V3-EXQ-514m, V3-EXQ-632, goal_pipeline:GAP-7.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The structured-attractor and distinct-from-harm legs are runnable and were measured by V3-EXQ-514m. The navigation-enabling clause has never been measured on the scaffolded substrate: EXQ-326's C3 navigation FAIL predates it, and the 085x series' C2 failures were a goal-to-action-selection wiring bug, not a navigation result. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-231.subject: latent_stack.e2_short_horizon_efference_copy
MECH-231.title: E2 operates as a short-horizon efference-copy forward model on z_self; its prediction accuracy degrades faster than E1's across multi-step horizons, consistent with a cerebellar 1-step transition predictor.
MECH-231.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: both E1 and E2 must be adequately trained (not degenerate/undertrained) before a horizon-degradation comparison is meaningful -- EXQ-407's dry run (3 warmup/eval episodes) was explicitly flagged as preliminary for this reason; the full run (100 warmup episodes, 30 eval episodes, 3 seeds, 7196 total windows) resolves that caveat and is the evidentiary basis below.
CONFIRMING: this is what EXQ-407's full run actually found, confirming the claim: E2's R2 degrades far faster than E1's across horizons h=1,2,3,5,7,10,15 (slope_e2=-4094.58 vs slope_e1=-25.03, a ~164x steeper degradation), while E2 is more accurate than E1 at h=1 (r2_e2_h1=-19.35 vs r2_e1_h1=-44.74) and catastrophically worse than E1 by h=10 (r2_e2_h10=-19063.65 vs r2_e1_h10=-377.15). All 4 acceptance criteria passed, consistently across all 3 seeds (42, 7, 123) -- exactly the short-horizon-cerebellar-predictor signature the claim asserts, and directly the inverse of what MECH-070 (this claim's superseded predecessor) had predicted.
FALSIFYING: The claim would have been falsified by slope_e2 >= slope_e1 (E2 not degrading faster than E1 across horizons) or by e2_r2_h1 failing to exceed e2_r2_h10 by a significant margin -- i.e. any outcome where E2 sustained comparable or better multi-step accuracy than E1. Concretely, this is MECH-070's original (now-refuted) pass criteria almost exactly inverted: MECH-070's own C2 FAIL is direct evidence of what a MECH-231 falsification would look like, since MECH-231 is the corrected inverse of that exact prediction. EXQ-132 FAIL and EXQ-212 FAIL 2/4 are the prior (pre-correction) instances of partial falsification that motivated MECH-070's retirement and MECH-231's reformulation.

MECH-232.subject: hippocampus.da_representational_expansion
MECH-232.title: Dopaminergic modulation of hippocampal place coding at reward-associated locations produces representational expansion (higher information density, finer spatial resolution, more stable place fields), and this expansion -- not an explicit positive valence gradient -- is the mechanism by which approach valence enters hippocampal terrain.
MECH-232.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The DA allocation must be non-degenerate in vivo and the density signal must reach action selection. Both are unmet at defaults: use_da_modulated_rbf_density is False (config.py:3368), and V3-EXQ-900's live run produced only 6 expansion events (cluster_size >= 2) in 57 benefit encounters, with drive_level rather than benefit magnitude supplying essentially all of the dopamine range.
CONFIRMING: With benefit weights zeroed, the LIVE agent still approaches the DA-expanded reward region above the DA-OFF arm while a value-driven comparator falls to chance, and local density is elevated at reward locations without an explicit positive gradient. Manipulation: Enable DA-modulated multi-centre allocation on the benefit terrain (use_da_modulated_rbf_density with da_allocation_scale and da_bandwidth_narrowing) versus the single-centre OFF arm, and independently zero the benefit WEIGHTS so only structural density remains. Control: The DA-OFF arm at equal centre capacity, plus the value-follower comparator that must fall to chance when weights are zeroed -- the crux discriminator against a valence-tag account. Required event: A trained agent encountering reward at a location, with dopamine released at that encounter, then later approaching that region during live action selection. DV: Live approach rate to the reward region under weights-zeroed conditions, read from the REEAgent's own selected actions, contrasted against the DA-OFF arm; with local structural density (compute_local_density, weight-independent) as the mediating measure.
FALSIFYING: With weights zeroed the live agent's approach falls to chance alongside the value-follower, or DA elevates density without any approach consequence -- approach valence does not enter hippocampal terrain via representational expansion. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Substrate instrumented, live locus not. residue/field.py compute_local_density and hippocampal/module.py:3481 record weight-independent density, and tests/contracts/test_sd024_da_modulated_rbf_density.py pins the discriminator -- but the two runs tagged MECH-232 (V3-EXQ-766a, 893) build a standalone ResidueField with synthetic z_reward vectors and a hand-written hill-climbing walker; neither constructs a REEAgent or a CausalGridWorldV2. Consumer / boundary: The live agent's action selection reading the hippocampal benefit terrain -- approach produced by representational quality rather than by a valence gradient -- not a bench walker over an isolated RBF field. Existing ownership: SD-024, GFLAG-0196, V3-EXQ-900, V3-EXQ-795, MECH-232.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); Both MECH-232-tagged confirmers are synthetic benches over an isolated ResidueField with a bespoke walker instrument; the live-path runs that do construct a REEAgent (V3-EXQ-795, 900) carry claim_ids of SD-024 only. The density signal therefore has no demonstrated live consumer in action selection, and the flag is default-off. Secondary classes: R1, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-233.subject: hippocampus.valence_encoding_asymmetry
MECH-233.title: Threat and approach valence enter hippocampal terrain through mechanistically asymmetric pathways: BLA writes explicit negative valence via dedicated anxiety/avoidance cells (Jimenez 2018); VTA-DA enhances representational fidelity via LTP modulation and place field sharpening (Retailleau & Morris 2018). The behavioural outputs (avoidance, approach) appear similar but the encoding mechanisms are distinct.
MECH-233.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both explicit harm writes and DA-sensitive benefit representation must be live, with non-degenerate approach and avoidance measured separately.
CONFIRMING: DA resolution lesion selectively impairs approach and negative-valence lesion selectively impairs avoidance. Manipulation: Ablate explicit negative-valence writes and DA-dependent benefit resolution separately in a crossed design. Control: Intact pathways, matched total field strength and location/payload shuffles. Required event: Harm-associated and benefit-associated locations under matched accessibility. DV: Double dissociation in held-out approach versus avoidance, accompanied by benefit-field resolution and explicit harm-tag readouts.
FALSIFYING: With both manipulations active and behaviours non-degenerate, effects are symmetric or the opposite pathway accounts for them. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ResidueField benefit per-center bandwidth/allocation and harm writes exist; 766/893/900 measure the DA half, not the full double dissociation. Consumer / boundary: Distinct hippocampal terrain writes through proposals to choice. Existing ownership: SD-024, SD-035, MECH-233.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The full paired dissociation is not instantiated; a representational density effect is not a behavioural asymmetry result. R5 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-234.subject: control_plane.habitual_deliberate_effector_domain_parallelism
MECH-234.title: DMS (goal-directed) and DLS (habitual) corticostriatal circuits can produce simultaneous parallel motor outputs only when targeting anatomically distinct motor effector pools; within the same effector pool, habitual and goal-directed outputs compete via winner-takes-all basal ganglia selection, not independent parallel expression.
MECH-234.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. The test requires an environment with >= 2 anatomically
distinct effector pools -- two independently-commandable action channels whose commands are not
mutually exclusive within a step. `ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py` has exactly one
(`action_dim` 5-6, a single discrete choice, `causal_grid_world.py:1529, 2341-2344`), so on the
current substrate the same-effector leg is TRUE BY CONSTRUCTION and the cross-effector leg is
UNTESTABLE -- there is no non-degenerate run available and any "confirmation" would be vacuous.
Additionally: a habitual channel distinct from the E3 deliberative channel must be separately
observable (E1-direct or a policy-chunking output per `ree_core/policy/policy_chunking.py`,
ARC-071), so that "both computed" can be distinguished from "one was expressed".

CONFIRMING (conditional on a multi-effector substrate landing). With two channels A and B, and
a committed E3 trajectory addressing channel A: (i) CROSS-DOMAIN -- the habitual output on channel
B is expressed at a rate statistically indistinguishable from its uncommitted baseline (a
ratio within [0.85, 1.15] with a bootstrap CI excluding 0.5), i.e. commitment does not suppress the
other pool; AND (ii) SAME-DOMAIN -- the habitual output on channel A is suppressed relative to its
uncommitted baseline by more than 3 SD of the per-seed suppression delta and by an absolute floor
of 50% expression loss, in >= 2 of 3 seeds. The claim's content is the CONJUNCTION and the
DISSOCIATION between (i) and (ii); either alone is a weaker claim.

FALSIFYING. Either (i) fails -- commitment suppresses the *other* effector pool too, which
would mean REE's commitment is a global gate rather than a per-effector one and would invalidate
the "Layer 3 applies in multi-effector environments" half of the ruling -- or (ii) fails, i.e. the
habitual channel is expressed on the committed effector concurrently with the deliberative one,
which would refute the winner-takes-all model MECH-090's BetaGate encodes and reopen the Layer 3
design question the claim closed. For the out-of-domain leg, a counterexample looks like: a
peer-reviewed report of *simultaneous, independently-expressed* DMS- and DLS-driven motor output
within a single effector pool in an intact animal (i.e. not sequential alternation and not
cross-pool), which would contradict Balleine & O'Doherty (2010)'s qualification and require the
title's "only when" to be weakened.

MECH-235.subject: control_plane.vmpfc_arbitration_commitment_urgency
MECH-235.title: vmPFC arbitration continuously weights model-based (E3/deliberative) vs. model-free (E1/habitual) contributions to action selection on a spectrum, not a binary switch. Commitment (beta-elevated E3) shifts weighting toward model-based without silencing the habitual channel; unexpected threat (urgency signal) shifts weighting toward model-free. The MECH-091 urgency interrupt is the substrate implementation of this arbitration shift, not a bypass of the beta gate.
MECH-235.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a graded arbitration WEIGHT between a deliberative and
a habitual action channel must exist and be readable per-tick.

[2026-09-01 governance, falsestmt-fix-20260901] CORRECTION -- THIS PRECONDITION
WAS RECORDED AS UNMET AND THAT IS FALSE. The original text read "IT DOES NOT, as
of 2026-08-28." A graded, per-tick-readable arbitration weight DOES exist and
predates that sentence by five weeks: SD-081 / MECH-477's _arbitrate_dual_system
(ree-v3 ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:1390, invoked at :2834 inside
select(), gated by E3Config.use_dualsystem_arbitration, default False) computes
w = sigmoid(gain*(u_habit_n - u_planned_n) + bias) and exposes it per tick via
self.last_arbitration. It landed ree-v3 4472811 on 2026-07-22 and was validated
by V3-EXQ-811a (PASS, 2026-07-24, supports MECH-477 + MECH-163: 1137/1137
non-degenerate ticks, w_mean 0.3645, w_sd 0.2266, w_range 0.9153,
rho_w_vs_relative_uncertainty 1.0).
WHAT ACTUALLY SURVIVES, and it is real but much narrower than the original
sentence: SD-081 arbitrates DEPTH under UNCERTAINTY -- its "habit" leg is the
same model-based E3 scorer truncated to dualsystem_habit_depth=2, not a cached
model-free policy -- whereas THIS claim asserts arbitration on URGENCY and
commitment, keyed to z_harm_a. Different independent variables, different
biology (Daw/Niv/Dayan 2005 vs Dolan & Dayan 2013). So the dose-response content
below remains unmeasured; the precondition is NOT unmet. [2026-09-10 /governance GFLAG-0239 RULED -- OPTION A;
THE 'CHEAPEST DISCRIMINATOR' SENTENCE IS STRUCK.] It read: "Cheapest discriminator, per the
2026-09-01 decision brief: re-run V3-EXQ-811a's design with z_harm_a logged per tick alongside w --
driver-only, shipped substrate, no build." That run is decided BY CONSTRUCTION and was REFUSED at
design on 2026-09-09. w = sigmoid(gain*(u_habit_n - u_planned_n) + bias)
(e3_selector.py:1775) is a deterministic function of exactly two inputs: u_habit = 1 - familiarity
(supplied from agent.py:9371-9379) and u_planned = the E3 z_world one-step PE-MSE EMA
(e3_selector.py:4410-4416). z_harm_a IS forwarded by select() (e3_selector.py:3122-3134) but is
consumed only by score_trajectory (:1727-1736), producing the habit score vector blended at :1778 --
it never reaches w. The partial correlation of w with z_harm_a given (u_habit_n, u_planned_n) is
therefore identically zero and the re-run would return a guaranteed null. Record:
evidence/planning/gflag0080_mech235_harm_arbitration_design_refusal_20260909.md (origin/master
bb8f987842); substrate citations independently re-verified against ree-v3 HEAD.
LEG-SCOPED MARKER: MECH-235's HARM/URGENCY arbitration leg is SUBSTRATE_CONDITIONAL on the (a) or (b)
build named below -- concretely a harm-PE input to the arbitrator, two shapes recorded in the refusal
record, about one line of substrate plus a config knob and a bit-identity contract. It is not testable
on shipped substrate at all. status stays CANDIDATE; the uncertainty/depth leg (SD-081/MECH-477) is
unaffected and is separately validated. DO NOT let a later audit read this parked state as evidence
AGAINST the claim: the harm leg is currently implemented only as a hard binary threshold, which is
precisely what MECH-235 says the arbitration is NOT. Two items OWED and NOT done by this edit: a
substrate_queue entry for the harm-PE arbitrator input, and the closure of GFLAG-0080 -- which must be
closed as MISDIAGNOSED, not as satisfied, since its assertion that the graded weight was never built is
false (it landed ree-v3 4472811 on 2026-07-22). NOTE the paragraph below is also stale on
line numbers: urgency_interrupt_threshold is config.py:1037 (not 964) applied at
agent.py:6507 (not 6048); the binary-interrupt substance is unaffected.
module contract states it "is READ-ONLY with respect to z_self and z_world" -- it is
an associative prior, not a habitual ACTION pathway, so the claim's named model-free
leg has no substrate referent. The only implemented arbitration is
E3Config.urgency_interrupt_threshold (config.py:964, default 0.8, applied
agent.py:6048): a HARD BINARY interrupt, which is precisely the "binary switch" this
claim asserts the arbitration is NOT. Any experiment run on the current substrate
can only vary the binary threshold, which tests MECH-091's interrupt calibration,
NOT MECH-235's spectrum assertion. Building the precondition means either (a) a
continuous arbitration weight modulating channel contribution in proportion to
z_harm_a magnitude rather than crossing a threshold -- explicitly named as future
work in the claim's own notes -- or (b) re-anchoring the habitual leg onto ARC-071
policy chunking, which IS a real planned->habitual transfer mechanism, but which
feeds the PROPOSAL layer (hippocampal.set_chunk_source, agent.py:1536) rather than
competing at selection. Route (b) CHANGES THE CLAIM and needs an explicit decision,
not a silent substitution.
CONFIRMING (once a graded weight exists): (1) arbitration weight varies CONTINUOUSLY
with z_harm_a magnitude across a dose range, rather than stepping at a threshold --
measured on the weight itself, at the arbitration site, upstream of the
committed-selection argmin and therefore not absorbed. (2) Commitment (beta-elevated
E3) shifts the weight toward model-based WITHOUT silencing the habitual channel --
the habitual contribution is downweighted, not zeroed, which is the claim's specific
and falsifiable content against a binary switch. (3) Urgency shifts the weight toward
model-free PROPORTIONALLY, not to a pure model-free reset. (4) The clinical-prediction
axis the claim names: agents with a low arbitration setpoint abandon goal-directed
plans under mild threat; agents with a high setpoint maintain them under significant
threat -- a dose-response curve, not two regimes. If any behavioural DV is added
downstream of selection, apply SHARED-CONVERSION-PRECONDITION (G4): a graded weight
entering as a score bias into an argmin where F holds 88-89% of the variance
(MECH-439) will be absorbed exactly as MECH-314 / SD-032b / ARC-062 were.
FALSIFYING: (1) a graded weight is built and the arbitration is shown to behave as a
threshold anyway -- contribution is step-shaped in z_harm_a with no intermediate
regime, i.e. the binary implementation was not a simplification but the correct
model. (2) Commitment SILENCES the habitual channel rather than downweighting it
(habitual contribution goes to zero, not to a reduced nonzero share) -- falsifies the
"without silencing" clause directly. (3) Urgency resets to pure model-free regardless
of z_harm_a magnitude -- falsifies the proportionality clause and makes MECH-091's
interrupt a genuine bypass rather than the arbitration shift this claim says it is.
OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG (stated, not dropped): "Does vmPFC continuously weight model-based
and model-free contributions on a spectrum rather than switching between discrete
states in biological brains?" is a human neuroimaging / computational-psychiatry
question, tested outside REE and substantially answered there (Dolan & Dayan 2013,
Neuron). Not REE's to test and no REE experiment bears on it. Its role here is to
license the REE leg's DESIGN, not to be re-litigated. Also note the architectural
boundary already recorded and still binding: this arbitration sits at the BG/vmPFC
level and does NOT apply below it (spinal withdrawal reflexes, MECH-234 note, remain
active independently of it).

MECH-236.subject: hippocampus.e3_goal_conditioning
MECH-236.title: Hippocampal trajectory proposals must be conditioned on a goal signal (z_goal) injected from E3 via a dedicated input channel; without this conditioning, the hippocampal module generates only position-based trajectories and cannot produce goal-directed navigation toward target states.
MECH-236.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The downstream selector must be able to act on goal-tagged candidates before the ablation can discriminate: wanting_weight > 0, a populated residue field (agent.update_residue actually called, so VALENCE_WANTING is not identically zero) and either benefit_terrain or hazards present. With wanting_weight=0.0, benefit_terrain off and no residue accumulation, the CEM elite stage is goal-blind and the null is structurally guaranteed regardless of the claim's truth.
CONFIRMING: Ablating the goal input degrades goal-terrain navigation toward chance while MECH-230's z_goal structure is unchanged, and restoring it recovers navigation in proportion to z_goal_norm, with the wanting term demonstrably able to move the elite argmin in the ON arm. Manipulation: Ablate the E3 -> hippocampal goal input (the current_z_goal injection / ghost-probe channel) while leaving E3's goal encoding intact, then restore it; run with use_cem_modulatory_authority enabled so the wanting term can actually move the elite argsort. Control: The goal-encoding-intact / channel-ablated arm versus the channel-restored arm at matched seeds, plus a NOGOAL calibration arm confirming bit-identical trajectories when no goal is set. Required event: Goal-directed navigation episodes in which the hippocampal CEM proposes trajectories while a structured z_goal attractor is maintained in E3 (MECH-230 intact) and ghost-probe seeding is active. DV: Goal-terrain navigation score and the fraction of elite trajectories whose first-action class is goal-directed, as a function of z_goal_norm; recovery proportional to z_goal_norm on restoration is the claim's own stated prediction.
FALSIFYING: Navigation is unchanged by ablation under a selector that demonstrably can consume goal information -- the hippocampal proposals are goal-directed without the injection, so the dedicated channel is not required. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/hippocampal/module.py _score_trajectory with the return_components path plus the elite-selection diagnostics, and the wanting/curiosity/mode_value modulatory terms rescaled by cem_modulatory_authority_gain; V3-EXQ-914/914a recorded the channel's own P1/P2 preconditions but not a selector able to consume it. Consumer / boundary: The hippocampal trajectory-proposal and CEM elite-selection stage -- the consumer of z_goal -- not E3's maintenance of z_goal, which MECH-230 already covers. Existing ownership: EXP-1296, GFLAG-0033, GFLAG-0222, V3-EXQ-931, MECH-293.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The only runs tagged to this claim zeroed the very lever that lets a goal signal reach selection: wanting_weight=0.0, benefit_terrain never enabled, NUM_HAZARDS=0, and (GFLAG-0033) no update_residue call at all, so VALENCE_WANTING was identically zero. The CEM modulatory-authority build that fixes the ~0.37 percent authority ratio landed 2026-08-19/20 and no run has used it here. Secondary classes: R5, R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-237.subject: drive.goal_attractor_global_reachability
MECH-237.title: The z_goal attractor must be globally reachable across the z_goal sub-space — accessible from arbitrary latent starting states — not merely locally stable at a narrow basin; a locally-only-stable attractor fails to seed goal-directed hippocampal navigation from states far from the goal, producing approach behavior only when already near the goal.
MECH-237.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Define a bounded admissible starting-state distribution and verify an existing stable goal attractor plus reachable physical routes; arbitrary latent vectors outside the trained manifold are not ecological starts.
CONFIRMING: Reachability generalises across the registered admissible distribution with a lower-bound success/latency criterion defined before a run. Manipulation: Vary starting state while holding goal, drive and learned weights fixed. Control: Near-goal basin positive control, no-drive control and matched reachable versus unreachable physical routes. Required event: Goal activation from near and far admissible latent/environment states. DV: Probability and latency of converging to the goal attractor, plus physical goal arrival; z_goal norm alone is not reachability.
FALSIFYING: A reproducible admissible starting region fails despite intact drive and a reachable goal; finite sampling cannot prove universal reachability. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Goal-state/trajectory traces exist; no complete basin-coverage instrument or global proof. GhostGoalBank ranking is not a basin-of-attraction test. Consumer / boundary: Starting state to goal attraction through planning. Existing ownership: MECH-237, MECH-230, SD-012.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); The unrestricted global-necessity wording needs a defined domain; the old elevated-norm proxy does not distinguish accessibility. R1 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-238.subject: hippocampus.distance_metric_encoding
MECH-238.title: The hippocampal module encodes pairwise distance relations between states in the z_world latent manifold — not only positional tags — providing a metric structure that enables distance-based navigation toward goal states across the residue-field terrain.
MECH-238.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the HippocampalModule already exists and performs trajectory search over ACTION-OBJECT space O (E2.action_object(z_world, a) -> o_t, per SD-004), not raw z_world directly -- this claim's title should be read as "distance relations over the hippocampal map's indexing space." No distance-preservation, contrastive, or metric-supervision training objective exists anywhere in ree_core as of this date. The only distance computation touching z_world today is a raw MSE used by goal-tracking machinery, not a learned hippocampal encoding -- i.e. the substrate currently looks exactly like the categorical/lookup alternative this claim needs to rule out. The claim is untestable as stated until a distance-preservation objective is added to HippocampalModule (or its action-object embedding) training.
CONFIRMING: once a distance-preservation/contrastive loss is added, a representational-distance probe shows pairwise distances in the learned representation correlate with true manifold distances at a level above what an undifferentiated/categorical-only control achieves; AND trajectory proposals succeed at "navigate toward goal" tasks that specifically require distance comparison between non-adjacent candidate states (not just membership/retrieval of a previously-visited state), with performance degrading when the metric-supervision loss is ablated.
FALSIFYING: representational-distance probes show no reliable correlation between the hippocampal module's internal similarity structure and true manifold distances, even after adding the metric-supervision objective -- the representation remains categorical/positional rather than metric regardless of training pressure; OR trajectory-proposal performance on distance-requiring navigation tasks is statistically indistinguishable from a lookup/nearest-neighbor-tag baseline that has no access to distance information, while performance on pure membership/retrieval tasks is unaffected -- showing the metric structure adds no functional value beyond what a position tag already provides.

MECH-239.subject: hippocampus.temporal_indexing_time_cells
MECH-239.title: The hippocampal indexing substrate includes a temporal dimension implemented via time cells that tile elapsed time using the same phase-precession and theta-sequence machinery as place cells, enabling correct ordering of states within multi-step planning rollouts and working-memory sequences.
MECH-239.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Elapsed-time code must generalise across content/location and feed sequence retrieval; elapsed ticks stored as metadata do not establish time-cell tiling.
CONFIRMING: Temporal-index removal selectively breaks temporal ordering beyond content/spatial effects. Manipulation: Ablate temporal-index input while preserving spatial/content associations. Control: Intact temporal code, shuffled time labels and spatial-index lesion. Required event: Same states/actions encountered in different temporal orders and delays. DV: Held-out sequence-order and interval discrimination, and temporal-order errors in proposed trajectories.
FALSIFYING: A verified temporal code/consumer can be removed without loss of temporal ordering, with the task requiring temporal discrimination. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ThetaBuffer and Anchor timestamps exist; explicit time-cell tiling/phase-precession retrieval consumer is not demonstrated. Consumer / boundary: Temporal index to hippocampal sequence generation. Existing ownership: MECH-148, MECH-239, REE_assembly/evidence/planning/hippocampal_planning_v4_plan.md.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); Existing timestamps and rollout positions are not the specified temporal-cell substrate; MECH-148 and V4 hippocampal planning already own the broader requirement. R8 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-240.subject: drive.goal_attractor_basin_scaling
MECH-240.title: SD-012 homeostatic drive_level dynamically scales z_goal attractor basin width — high drive widens the basin so the goal attractor is globally accessible, low drive narrows it to local stability only — enabling motivational-state-dependent modulation of goal-directedness without permanently widening the basin.
MECH-240.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: two preconditions, both currently unmet.
(1) MECH-237 (global reachability of the z_goal attractor) must itself pass first -- this
claim's own notes state this explicitly ("implementing MECH-240 before MECH-237 risks
conflating the two failure modes"), and MECH-237's own what_would_answer records
DISPOSITION R7 with no experiment queued as of the 2026-09-21 falsifier-runnability audit.
(2) No basin-WIDTH representation exists for drive_level to scale. ree-v3/ree_core/goal.py's
z_goal is a single EMA-updated point (GoalState._z_goal, goal.py ~801-908); drive_weight /
drive_floor / drive_ema currently scale only the scalar `effective_benefit` multiplier
feeding action selection (goal.py:41-82, 890-908) -- exactly as this claim's own
IMPLEMENTATION NOTE says. There is no width/variance/tolerance dimension on z_goal for
drive_level to act on; this is a representational change still to be built, not a wiring gap.

CONFIRMING: once (1) and (2) are cleared, an ON arm in which drive_level scales a defined
basin-width parameter (distinct from the existing action-selection multiplier) reaches goal
states from a measurably wider range of starting latent states, at a pre-registered
reachability-margin floor, than a drive-fixed-width control -- with the width parameter
itself shown to move under the drive manipulation (manipulation check) before any
downstream reachability metric is read.

FALSIFYING: with the width parameter shown to move and MECH-237's reachability precondition
independently satisfied, reachability from far starting states does not differ between
drive-scaled and fixed-width arms -- the drive signal already accomplishes its
motivational-flexibility purpose through the existing action-selection weighting
(effective_benefit) alone, and no separate representational change to z_goal geometry is
warranted. A failure under either unmet precondition above is not evidence against the claim.

INSTRUMENT-RISK NOTE (from MECH-075, not a merge -- different mechanism): a
differently-scoped `basin_width` driver statistic already exists at
experiments/v3_exq_905a_mech075_dorsal_lc_arousal_probe.py, measuring hippocampal CEM
candidate-trajectory diversity under arousal (LC-gain) modulation, and was found INERT
under a 40x manipulation gain (V3-EXQ-905a: "basin_width... showed literally zero movement
... even with a 40x gain", DISPOSITION R6, construct-validity gap at the CEM-proposal
locus). MECH-075's DV measures CEM proposal spread, not z_goal attractor geometry, so it is
not directly reusable here -- but any future MECH-240 driver should include a positive-
control check that its own width DV can move at all before reading a drive-scaling result,
on pain of repeating MECH-075's construct-validity failure at a different locus.

MECH-241.subject: hippocampus.goal_state_representational_compression
MECH-241.title: During active goal pursuit, hippocampal and OFC-analogue representations of goal-proximal states undergo compression -- goal locations cluster more tightly in neural state space -- improving signal-to-noise for goal-directed trajectory selection; the degree of compression predicts planning efficiency across episodes.
MECH-241.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (a) ARC-040 (dorsal/ventral segregation) must be built -- V3's
HippocampalModule is undifferentiated (one module, no separate value-free dorsal proposer / ventral
valence-prior), and ARC-040 is itself blocked on HPL-1's residual gate (ARC-071, see MECH-148
above). (b) The base metric-space goal encoding this claim would sharpen must itself be live and
non-degenerate: MECH-236 is disposition R1 -- the CEM-modulatory-authority build that lets the
wanting term move trajectory selection landed 2026-08-19/20 but no run has exercised it -- and
MECH-238 (distance-metric encoding) is candidate/substrate_conditional. A compression measurement
taken before either is confirmed live would be measuring noise, not a metric-space sharpening. (c)
No representational-compression mechanism exists in ree_core/hippocampal/module.py (source grep
found only an unrelated docstring use of "compressed"). (d) A multi-distractor / long-path
environment (richer than the sparse-hazard grids most V3 hippocampal experiments use) is needed to
give convergence efficiency dynamic range to move in.
CONFIRMING: once (a)-(d) are met, goal-proximal z_world states measurably cluster more tightly
(lower within-cluster variance / higher local density) during active goal pursuit than during a
non-pursuit baseline, AND the degree of compression correlates with trajectory-convergence
efficiency (steps-to-goal) across episodes and seeds, replicating the Muhle-Karbe et al. (2023)
correlational pattern in this substrate.
FALSIFYING: with (a)-(d) met, goal-proximal state density does not differ between active-pursuit and
baseline, or does not correlate with convergence efficiency -- the efficiency-gain mechanism does
not hold here and MECH-238's static metric structure is sufficient on its own. A failure under
unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
NOTES: the claim's own text flags an unresolved causal-vs-consequence question the Muhle-Karbe
literature (correlational) cannot settle. A pure observational replication (measure compression,
measure efficiency, correlate) tests only co-occurrence. Once (a)-(d) are met, prefer an
INTERVENTION design -- an auxiliary loss that manufactures goal-proximal compression independent
of pursuit outcome, then measures whether convergence improves as a result -- over the passive
correlational form; do not spend the diagnostic on the weaker design.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: ARC-040 lands (needs ARC-071) AND MECH-236 has been re-run with the
CEM-modulatory-authority fix live AND a multi-distractor environment variant exists.

MECH-242.subject: hippocampus.dual_mode_trajectory_construction
MECH-242.title: Hippocampal trajectory construction operates via two dissociable mechanisms: (1) pattern completion for familiar trajectories (hippocampus-proper), and (2) vector-based construction for novel trajectories assembled from relational components (parahippocampal/parietal-analogue); pattern completion alone is sufficient for navigation within a learned residue field, but vector-based construction is required for generalisation to novel environments not represented in the existing map.
MECH-242.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (a) The parahippocampal/parietal-analogue vector-construction module
this claim requires does not exist -- ree_core has one hippocampal module
(ree_core/hippocampal/module.py, CEM generator) with no dissociable second circuit (source grep for
vector_based/pattern_completion/dual_mode: zero hits). (b) A zero-shot-transfer or
compositional-planning harness (goals/environments outside the training map) is required to give
mechanism (2) something to do -- current V3 hippocampal experiments run within a learned residue
field by design (ARC-007's terrain-navigation setup), so mechanism (1) alone is sufficient by
construction and the dissociation cannot even be attempted. (c) MECH-238 (distance-metric encoding),
the shared representational substrate both mechanisms would operate on, is itself
candidate/substrate_conditional. (d) ARC-021's three-loop architecture, which this claim's V4
implication tracks, has not itself assigned loops to construction mechanisms.
CONFIRMING: once (a)-(c) are met, pattern completion alone reproduces navigation performance within
the learned residue field (no advantage from adding vector-based construction there), AND on the
zero-shot/compositional harness, vector-based construction succeeds at novel-trajectory generation
where pattern completion alone fails or degrades sharply -- a clean double dissociation by task
type.
FALSIFYING: pattern completion alone generalises to the zero-shot/compositional harness as well as
the two-mechanism system, OR vector-based construction fails to outperform pattern completion
specifically in the novel-environment condition -- the dual-mode dissociation does not hold here
and a single retrieval mechanism suffices. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence
against the claim.
RELATED: see MECH-325 below -- its cue-indexed store is a finer-grained specification of this
claim's mechanism (1); do not re-derive a second pattern-completion falsifier once MECH-325's is
drafted, cross-reference instead.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: ARC-040 dorsal/ventral segregation lands (giving mechanisms (1) and (2) separate
circuits to dissociate) AND a zero-shot-transfer/compositional-planning harness exists.

MECH-243.subject: hippocampus.approach_bias_output_pathway
MECH-243.title: A dedicated hippocampal output pathway (analogous to vCA1 to nucleus accumbens shell) specifically encodes approach bias during motivational conflict -- separately from harm avoidance -- cleanly dissociating the approach signal at the action-selection interface; inhibition of this pathway defaults action selection to avoidance without disrupting harm representation.
MECH-243.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (a) Approach and avoidance must be independent, simultaneously
measurable output dimensions -- the current CausalGridWorld substrate has a single action channel
(move), so approach (toward) and avoidance (away) are structurally the same axis and cannot be
dissociated at the output stage; this is the claim's own stated blocker and remains true (no
approach_bias/vCA1/nucleus_accumbens-named pathway exists in ree_core -- the codebase's
"approach_bias" hits are the unrelated compute_approach_bias functions in
ree_core/pfc/escape_affordance_bridge.py and siblings). (b) MECH-230's navigation-enabling leg
(whether structured z_goal actually improves goal-conditioned navigation over an ablated arm) has
never been measured on the scaffolded substrate (disposition R1) -- without it there is no
confirmed approach signal to dissociate from harm-avoidance in the first place. (c) MECH-069's
merged-channel comparison arm (needed to establish approach/avoidance ARE currently commingled
before testing a dedicated separation pathway) cannot run at all: ContextMemory.write's in-place
.data mutation (e1_deep.py:169-179) invalidates the retained autograd graph a single merged
optimizer needs (disposition R3).
CONFIRMING: once (a)-(c) are met -- a richer substrate with independent approach/avoidance output
dimensions, a confirmed z_goal navigation benefit, and a runnable merged-vs-separated comparison --
inhibiting the dedicated approach-output pathway defaults action selection to avoidance during
simultaneous motivational-conflict trials, WITHOUT degrading pure-avoidance behaviour or harm
representation measured independently (the Patterson et al. 2025 pathway-selectivity signature).
FALSIFYING: with (a)-(c) met, inhibiting the candidate pathway degrades both approach AND
avoidance/harm representation together (no clean dissociation), or produces no behavioural change --
the approach signal is not carried by a separable output channel in this substrate. A failure under
unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: a multi-action-dimension substrate exists (approach/avoidance as independent
outputs) AND MECH-230's navigation-enabling leg is measured AND MECH-069's runnability blocker
(ContextMemory.write in-place mutation) is fixed. All three are independent gates that can be
worked in parallel.

MECH-244.subject: psychiatric.psychosis_precision_weighting_failure
MECH-244.title: Psychosis is a precision-weighting failure where prior beliefs persistently dominate sensory evidence; the generative model becomes self-sealing and sensory update is suppressed.
MECH-244.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the two readiness gates the V3-EXQ-826a evidence_quality_note names must both clear before any arm is interpretable -- phase-A convergence ratio at or above its 0.25 floor (measured 0.152) and regime-change disconfirmation at or above 1.15 (measured 0.966); pe_precision_manipulation_took passed (2.06 vs 1.5 floor), so E1 trains and the outstanding gates are convergence and disconfirmation, not gradient flow.
CONFIRMING: down-weighting sensory prediction-error precision relative to prior precision produces beliefs that persist against incoming percepts, with a dose-response on the precision ratio, and the persistence is NOT reproduced by the two registered alternative pathways at matched input (MECH-246 signal degradation, MECH-247 pathological priors).
FALSIFYING: belief persistence tracks input noise or prior structure rather than the precision ratio; OR the self-sealing signature appears at every precision setting including the intact one (the precision ratio is not load-bearing).
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional on its own readiness gates (two non_contributory runs, 826/826a), and separately (c2) out-of-domain for its clinical content, which resolves by literature. The 2026-09-15 provenance ingestion deliberately did NOT register a fourth (provenance-error) pathway beside this claim.

MECH-245.subject: psychiatric.hallucination_generative_dominance
MECH-245.title: Hallucination is a generative-model dominance failure where top-down predictions produce percepts without corresponding bottom-up sensory grounding.
MECH-245.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The generative pathway must be the agent's own trained E1/E2 world model at a measured operating point, and the agent must enter the window from a genuinely grounded confidence state. The substituted percept must be the model's own prediction, not a designer-set constant, or the arm only re-states its own construction.
CONFIRMING: In the live loop, substituting the model's own prediction for the missing bottom-up estimate sustains or raises commit-eligible confidence while ground-truth drift grows, and the ungrounded percept reaches durable consequences (committed actions and residue writes) that the frozen-observation arm does not produce. Manipulation: Substitute the agent's own predicted z_world for the encoder's observed z_world at the perception boundary (generative-dominance arm) instead of freezing the last genuinely grounded estimate (intact arm). Control: Frozen-last-observation arm over the same window, same seed and same trained model, plus a grounded arm in which observation continues, so drift from the true state is measured rather than assumed. Required event: A deafferentation window in the live agent loop: real sensory observation stops arriving while the agent keeps selecting and committing actions. DV: E3 running_variance / current_precision and commit fraction across the window, AND whether the ungrounded percept produces durable downstream consequences -- committed actions taken on it and ResidueField.accumulate calls with hypothesis_tag False -- scored against ground-truth drift of the hallucinated state.
FALSIFYING: The substitution leaves precision, commit fraction and downstream durable writes indistinguishable from the frozen-observation arm, or confidence collapses identically in both arms -- the bottom-up mismatch check is not bypassable by feeding predictions forward. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: E3TrajectorySelector.post_action_update and its precision/commit diagnostics exist and were driven directly by V3-EXQ-825, but in a synthetic GRU harness; agent.py feeds post_action_update from self._current_latent.z_world with no lever that substitutes a prediction, so nothing records this at the live perception boundary. Consumer / boundary: The encoder -> z_world -> E2/E3 consumption boundary in the live agent, and the durable write path (residue accumulation and committed action), not a module-level precision statistic. Existing ownership: MECH-245, EXP-1346, V3-EXQ-825.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The only test to date drove the real E3 with a synthetic GRU stand-in for E1/E2 and stopped at a precision statistic. The agent has no observation-substitution lever, so the asserted percept-without-grounding never reaches behaviour or durable memory, and the ablation arm's zero prediction error is definitional rather than measured. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: NEW NODE REQUIRED. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-246.subject: psychiatric.pareidolia_signal_degradation_pathway
MECH-246.title: Psychotic-like symptoms can arise from signal-degradation pareidolia: sufficiently noisy or ambiguous bottom-up perceptual signals allow correct Bayesian inference to produce false percepts, without requiring formal precision-weighting failure.
MECH-246.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Independent structure-presence labels, calibrated uncertainty and a native perceptual inference consumer; errors must not be defined by a trained decoder's own predictions.
CONFIRMING: Signal degradation alone induces reversible false structure reports despite intact calibration. Manipulation: Degrade sensory evidence while leaving prior and precision calibration intact. Control: Clean input and precision/prior-lesion arms matched for error rate. Required event: Noisy/sparse observations of structure-present and structure-absent scenes, followed by restoration of input quality. DV: False-positive structure perception and its reversibility when clean evidence returns.
FALSIFYING: With ambiguous evidence and native inference verified, false positives do not increase or persist after input restoration in contradiction to the proposed mechanism. Clinical psychosis is not inferred. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: 826 lineage concerns precision weighting; no independent native structure-detection DV validated for this distinct pathway. Consumer / boundary: Bottom-up quality through inference to perceptual commitment. Existing ownership: MECH-246, MECH-244, REE_assembly/evidence/planning/inference_belief_state_v4_plan.md.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); A native structure-perception outcome must be operationalised separately from clinical symptoms and external decodability. R2; R4 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-247.subject: psychiatric.trauma_prior_psychosis_pathway
MECH-247.title: Trauma-shaped hypervigilant priors can generate psychotic-like symptoms by structuring top-down predictions to respond strongly to minimal threat-relevant signals, producing perceptual errors and false beliefs without primary precision-weighting dysregulation.
MECH-247.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A learned threat prior must reach native perceptual inference with independently verified, graded precision use and ambiguous threat/no-threat labels.
CONFIRMING: Prior content, independently of precision failure, produces selective false threat commitments. Manipulation: Change learned prior content while holding current observation and precision policy fixed. Control: Neutral prior, precision-only perturbation and non-threat ambiguity. Required event: Weak threat-like cues after matched threatening versus neutral histories. DV: Threat-themed false perceptual commitments, corrected by prior change versus precision change.
FALSIFYING: A live prior manipulation fails to produce selective false threat commitments or precision alone explains the complete effect. No clinical inference from the proxy. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Residue/history fields exist; a native graded prior/precision inference DV is not established by their presence. Consumer / boundary: Past-threat prior to current perceptual commitment. Existing ownership: MECH-247, MECH-244, MECH-027, REE_assembly/evidence/planning/inference_belief_state_v4_plan.md.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); Stored residue is not a verified native perceptual-prior consumer; the clinical mapping remains separate. R7 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-248.subject: default_mode.source_monitoring_frontoparietal_implementation
