MECH-248.title: Source monitoring (frontoparietal network; Johnson-Raye tradition) is a candidate biological implementation of the simulation/real distinction required by MECH-094 -- distinguishing internally generated from externally received content at the level of memory encoding and attribution.
MECH-248.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a source-monitoring readout DISTINCT from the write gate must exist -- the architecture must be able to report P(external | representation) separately from whether the item was allowed to write. In the current tree it cannot: hypothesis_tag (ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py) is the same bit for both.
CONFIRMING: a distinct attribution stage, operating at RETRIEVAL rather than at encoding, reproduces the functional separation MECH-094 asserts, and its ablation degrades attribution while leaving the encoding-side neuromodulatory mode-setting (MECH-249) intact.
FALSIFYING: encoding-side mode-setting alone (MECH-249) reproduces the whole of MECH-094's functional separation with no retrieval-side attribution stage needed -- MECH-248 then earns no keep over MECH-249.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional. Bears directly on Q-105: the source readout Q-105 needs is this claim's readout, and neither exists.

MECH-249.subject: default_mode.neuromodulatory_encoding_mode_profile
MECH-249.title: Acetylcholine/noradrenaline balance implements action-mode-specific hippocampal write profiles as a continuous neuromodulatory state variable, providing the biological substrate of mode-dependent memory encoding differences across deliberate action, habit, simulation, SWS, and REM states.
MECH-249.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Independent continuous ACh and NA inputs must be live at hippocampal write boundaries; mode identity must be measured independently rather than assigned from the same two inputs.
CONFIRMING: Distinct continuous profiles preserve provenance and predict writes beyond a categorical mode label. Manipulation: Cross ACh and NA levels continuously while keeping content/provenance fixed. Control: Discrete-tag baseline and equal overall write-rate control. Required event: Waking, habitual, simulated and offline content under crossed neuromodulatory conditions. DV: Mode- and provenance-specific durable-write probability and protection against simulated-content attribution.
FALSIFYING: With both modulators reaching writers, profiles collapse to a scalar rate or fail provenance protection. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Current Boolean hypothesis tags and scalar NA controls do not instantiate continuous ACh/NA write profiles. Consumer / boundary: Neuromodulatory state to hippocampal write permission and strength. Existing ownership: MECH-249, REE_assembly/evidence/planning/plasticity_neuromodulation_v4_plan.md.
DISPOSITION: R8 (primary); Continuous cholinergic plasticity belongs to the existing V4 plasticity plan. R4 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-250.subject: control_plane.respiratory_phase_gate_release
MECH-250.title: The end of exhalation (expiration phase) provides a hard, periodic release signal for committed motor programs via respiratory-motor coupling -- a breath-timed gate-release mechanism distinct from hippocampal completion (ARC-028) and urgency interrupt (MECH-091).
MECH-250.what_would_answer:
question is *hard release at a boundary*, not *periodic uncommitted windows*, which is MECH-108's):

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. See the group's shared COMMIT-GATE DYNAMIC-RANGE PRECONDITION
(G3 preamble (iii)); do not re-derive it. Specific to this claim, and decisive: the run must
establish that MECH-108's existing threshold softening is INERT at the run's own operating
point -- report `effective_threshold` under sweep (`0.40 x (1 - sweep_amplitude)`) against the
realised `running_variance` distribution, and confirm the softened threshold is not crossed. If
the sweep alone *does* produce uncommitted steps in this configuration, MECH-250's residual is not
separable from MECH-108 in that run and the run cannot adjudicate it -- re-derive the operating
point first. Additionally: (a) the committed-fraction in the release-OFF control arm must be
strictly between 0 and 1, and specifically high (> 0.8) -- a hard release is only observable
against a background of sustained commitment; (b) the breath cycle must be running
(`breath_period > 0`) and the exhale-end boundary must be counted, with `n_boundaries >= 20` per
episode-block; (c) MECH-104's surprise impulse must be pinned off (no rv injection,
`_ema_alpha` at its default) so that de-commitments cannot be attributed to two mechanisms at
once (G3 preamble (iv)).

CONFIRMING. With a `receive_respiratory_phase(EXHALE_END) -> beta_gate.release()` build, on a
matched-seed RELEASE-ON vs RELEASE-OFF pair (both with `breath_period = 50`, so MECH-108's sweep is
identical in both arms and cancels): (i) PHASE-LOCKING -- committed -> uncommitted transitions
in the ON arm cluster at the exhale-end boundary, with a circular-phase concentration over the
breath cycle whose Rayleigh test rejects uniformity at p < 0.01 in >= 2 of 3 seeds; and
(ii) CAUSAL CONTRIBUTION -- the ON arm's transition rate exceeds the OFF arm's by more than
3 SD of the per-seed rate delta and by an absolute floor of 1 transition per 5 breath cycles.
Leg (i) is what distinguishes MECH-250 from any generic periodic de-commitment, and (ii) is what
distinguishes it from MECH-108's already-present sweep.

FALSIFYING. (ii) holds but (i) fails: transitions increase but are uniformly distributed over
the breath cycle, meaning the mechanism is a periodic release *rate* rather than a
*phase-locked boundary* event -- that refutes MECH-250 as written and collapses the residual back
into MECH-108's window model, i.e. it makes the full absorption correct after all. Alternatively,
(i) and (ii) both hold but the OFF arm shows the same transition rate once `breath_period = 0` is
also tested as a third arm -- meaning the transitions were produced by the sweep, not the release.
A third pattern, and the cheapest to hit: the OFF arm's committed-fraction is already < 0.8 in
the control, so there was never sustained commitment for a release to break -- that is the
precondition failing, and is a re-design signal, not a result.

MECH-251.subject: attention.dan_feedback_precision_write
MECH-251.title: z_goal projects to a precision template vector that is additively written to the E1 prior via the dan_feedback channel with fast exponential decay, separable in dynamics and source from residue-geometry bias.
MECH-251.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: SD-026's own gating condition still holds: without a crisp z_resource separation, a DAN template ablation confounds template quality with target quality, so the ablation cannot attribute a benefit change to the channel. A separability test also requires the residue-geometry bias to exist as a distinct precision contributor, which it currently does not.
CONFIRMING: With the channel built and z_resource separation adequate, benefit_ratio lift requires dan_feedback ON, and the template contribution decays on a fast constant following z_goal update while the residue contribution holds its episode-scale constant -- separable in both dynamics and source. Manipulation: Toggle sd026_enabled (dan_feedback ON versus OFF) at matched z_goal seeding, and separately vary the decay constant tau on alpha_dan so the template channel's dynamics are identifiable. Control: The residue-only arm (alpha_dan = 0) at matched z_goal seeding is the falsifying comparator the claim itself names -- if benefit_ratio lift survives with dan_feedback off, residue alone suffices and SD-026 is wrong. Required event: Episodes in which z_goal updates at a definite tick and then behaviour continues for long enough that a fast exponentially decaying template contribution and a slow episode-scale residue contribution are distinguishable in time. DV: benefit_ratio lift attributable to the template channel, plus a source-separation statistic: the time constant of the precision contribution following a z_goal update (seconds-scale in env steps) against the residue bias's episode-scale constant.
FALSIFYING: Benefit_ratio lift is unchanged with dan_feedback OFF once z_goal seeds, or the two contributions cannot be separated in dynamics -- residue alone then suffices and SD-026's prospective channel is not necessary. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Absent at every element. grep across ree_core returns zero hits for sd026_enabled, dan_feedback, template_proj, alpha_dan, alpha_residue, residue_bias, precision_prior and prior_precision; E1 has no precision prior for either channel to write to, so neither the manipulation nor the separability DV has a recorder. Consumer / boundary: The E1 prior's precision weights, where the claim asserts an additive prospective write from z_goal that is separable in dynamics and source from residue-geometry bias. Existing ownership: SD-026, SD-014, EXP-0934, INV-009, biology_grounding_convergence_v4:BG-6.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); There is no path from z_goal to any E1 precision prior, because E1 has no precision prior at all. z_goal does reach E1, but as an INPUT concatenation through goal_input_proj (MECH-116 conditioning) -- a different architectural boundary from the additive prior write with fast decay the claim asserts, and one with no decay dynamics and no residue comparator to be separable from. Secondary classes: R6. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-252.subject: sleep.sws_stored_goal_consolidation

MECH-256.subject: self_attribution.forward_model_comparator_general
MECH-256.title: Self-attribution is implemented by a forward-model comparator: for any reafferent latent stream z_x with an efference-copy-driven forward model E2_x, the residual (z_x_observed - E2_x(z_x_{t-1}, a_actual)) is the agency signal on that stream.
MECH-256.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The forward model must be well fit on the stream under test (forward_r2 above 0.9), AND the eval stream must contain enough of BOTH event classes for an event-conditioned contrast: agent-caused and externally-caused events at roughly balanced counts. Every 433-lineage run failed the second condition (0 agent_caused trials in 4/4 seeds; later 15/7/20/3 against a target of 20).
CONFIRMING: On a stream with forward_r2 above 0.9 and a balanced event distribution, single-pass residuals separate self-caused from externally-caused events on a majority of seeds, and a two-pass counterfactual does not strictly outperform them on the same stream. Manipulation: Compare single-pass comparator residuals conditioned on event class, on a stream with a well-fit efference-copy forward model; the discriminating contrast is self-caused versus externally-caused, not gate-on versus gate-off. Control: A two-pass counterfactual comparator (a second E2 call on a counterfactual action) on the same stream and seeds -- the converse test the claim names -- plus an untrained-forward-model arm establishing that the dissociation is not present without the model fit. Required event: A balanced mixture within one eval stream of self-caused events (the agent walks into a hazard / acts on the world) and externally-caused events (a hazard appears or moves independently of the agent's action). DV: Event-conditioned separation of the residual norm: mean ||z_x_observed - E2_x(z_x_prev, a_actual)|| on externally-caused events minus the same quantity on self-caused events, with per-class event counts reported, evaluated on at least two streams (z_harm_s via ARC-033/SD-029, z_world via SD-031).
FALSIFYING: With a well-fit forward model and adequate counts of both event classes, single-pass residuals do not distinguish self-caused from externally-caused events on any reafferent stream; or a two-pass counterfactual strictly outperforms single-pass on the same stream, which weakens the no-counterfactual commitment specifically. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e2_harm_s.py (E2HarmSForward) with agent.py::_update_scientist_attribution computing attribution = ||z_harm_s_obs - E2_harm_s(z_prev, a)||, and ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e2_world.py comparator_residual() for the z_world instantiation. The comparator instruments exist on two streams; the event-class counter is what runs out. Consumer / boundary: The single-pass residual on a reafferent latent stream -- one forward pass on the actually-taken action, no counterfactual -- as the agency signal, stream-agnostic in computation but stream-specific in substrate. Existing ownership: SD-029, SD-031, MECH-269, self_attribution:GAP-2, self_attribution:GAP-6.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The policy never produces the balanced agent-versus-environment event distribution the event-conditioned contrast requires: 0 agent_caused_hazard trials in 4/4 seeds (433d), 15/7/20/3 against a target of 20 (433f), under the V_s monostrategy lock -- and SD-050 reef enrichment did not break it. The z_world arm is additionally gated on world_dim >= 128 plus ARC-065 behavioural diversity. Secondary classes: R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-257.subject: forward_model.dual_function_gated_readout
MECH-257.title: E2_x is a dual-function substrate: one forward model read in two modes, retrospective comparator (attribution) and prospective rollout-scoring (evaluation), arbitrated by a controller gating signal.
MECH-257.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both read modes must be evaluable on the SAME weights in one run: C1 comparator validity (counterfactual separation above 0.05 on a strict majority of seeds) AND a genuinely harm-differentiated trajectory set for C2, which the live monostrategy policy does not produce and which must therefore be supplied by construction-balanced collection rather than assumed. The mode-split baselines (separately trained comparator-only and evaluator-only heads) must be run at matched parameter budget, since the claim is about dual-function capacity, not about absolute performance.
CONFIRMING: On a harm-differentiated evaluation set, the same weights that pass C1 also reach pe_harm_surprise_corr above 0.15, and neither mode degrades materially against its own mode-split baseline at matched parameter count -- one substrate genuinely serves both reads. Manipulation: Three arms at matched parameter budget: shared-weight dual-function E2_x trained for both modes; comparator-only split baseline; evaluator-only split baseline -- the 3-arm ablation self_attribution:GAP-3 names. Mode arbitration in the dual arm is the MECH-094 hypothesis-tag / commitment-boundary controller signal. Control: The two mode-split baselines are the controls, plus a null-counterfactual sanity check on the comparator residual and a matched-parameter-count check so a dual-function deficit is not read off a smaller effective capacity. Required event: Post-action reafferent residuals for the comparator mode and pre-action candidate rollouts for the evaluator mode, over a trajectory set containing genuinely different harm outcomes -- which on the current substrate must come from a balanced collection rather than from the agent's own committed-action distribution. DV: Paired per-mode performance on shared versus split weights: C1 counterfactual_separation for the comparator mode and C2 pe_harm_surprise_corr (above 0.15) for the evaluator mode, with the degradation of each mode under joint training relative to its own split baseline as the discriminating quantity.
FALSIFYING: With the class-balance precondition met, joint training degrades one mode measurably relative to its split baseline (or C2 still fails while C1 passes on a properly differentiated set) -- the architecture must split into E2_x_comparator and E2_x_evaluator, doubling the parameter count. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The dual read exists in ree_core/predictors/e2_world.py (comparator_residual for the retrospective read, the bulk rollout path for the evaluator read) and V3-EXQ-452/452a are complete recorders of both criteria. What no run supplies is a harm-differentiated evaluation distribution; both 452 and 452a scored C2 on the live monostrategy policy and reproduced the same C2 failure. Consumer / boundary: The shared E2_x weights read in two modes, arbitrated by the commitment-boundary/hypothesis-tag signal -- the question is capacity interference between modes, not the accuracy of either read alone. Existing ownership: self_attribution:GAP-3, MECH-256, SD-031, GFLAG-0293, f_dominance_conversion_ceiling, V3-EXQ-1001.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The DV is not measurable on the live agent: under monostrategy / F-dominance both reads operate over one locked policy, so no harm-differentiated trajectory classes exist for C2 to correlate against -- the same gap that blocks SD-029's C2 and SD-031's discriminative arm. The WWA gates on a conversion-ceiling fix that is now closed wontfix, while the offline construction-balanced route V3-EXQ-1001 demonstrated is unused. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's operative gate is a STANDING PROHIBITION -- do not re-queue before conversion_ceiling_campaign:FULLSTACK lands -- and that condition is no longer reachable: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling was set implementation_status wontfix by user decision on 2026-09-16 (GFLAG-0293) with the note that the conversion route of record is exhausted and no new build is owed. A prohibition waiting on a closed node is a permanent block stated as a delay. Separately, V3-EXQ-1001 demonstrated a construction-balanced collection reaching 6132 minimum-class events, and SD-031's 2026-09-04 amend cleared the class-balance gate for comparator-only OFFLINE readouts, so an offline route around the live-policy monostrategy now exists and the WWA does not mention it. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-258.subject: cingulate.precision_weighted_pain_PE
MECH-258.title: z_harm_a enters action selection as a precision-weighted prediction error (harm_surprise_PE, SD-020) against an internal pain forward model (E2_harm_a), not as a raw magnitude. Upgrades SD-020 from provisional to prerequisite for SD-032b (dACC-analog).
MECH-258.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Four conjuncts, of which the first two are the live ones. (P1) z_harm_a must be live and non-saturated -- within-episode cov_z_harm_a above the 0.05 floor with correct mode ordering; the P0-H stage is the candidate repair and is still default-OFF and unvalidated by any queued experiment. (P2) model_pe and raw_norm must be separable: |corr(model_pe, raw_norm)| <= 0.8 per seed, answerable by reanalysis of the already-recorded V3-EXQ-597b series. (P3) the scored DV must admit a pe-driven variance share above a pre-registered floor. (P4) committed-action diversity must exist and bias_clip_saturation_frac must be below 0.1.
CONFIRMING: With P1-P4 satisfied, ARM_PE's adjustment magnitude tracks the precision-weighted PE and is decoupled from raw magnitude, and shows a larger adjustment in the high-precision (unexpected/uncontrollable) condition than the low-precision one for matched nociceptive input, on >= 2/3 seeds after the forward-r2 gate, while ARM_RAW tracks raw magnitude with no such split. Manipulation: ARM_PE (use_e2_harm_a=True, dACC consumes pe = ||z_harm_a - E2_harm_a(z_harm_a_prev, a_taken)|| precision-weighted) versus ARM_RAW (use_e2_harm_a=False, dACC falls back to ||z_harm_a||), within seed, everything else fixed, with dacc_bias_max_abs raised from 2.0 to 20.0 before anything is scored on the dACC bias. Control: The raw-magnitude ablation arm is the control, matched within seed; plus the per-seed C1 gate excluding any seed whose harm_a_forward_r2 < 0.3 from the win-count denominator, and bias_clip_saturation_frac < 0.1 asserted per seed as a scoring PRECONDITION rather than a post-hoc check. Required event: Nociceptive input arriving under varying predictability and controllability, so the same raw harm magnitude occurs once as an expected, controllable event and once as an unexpected, uncontrollable one. DV: Behavioural-adjustment magnitude on a payoff-NORMALISED readout, contrasted between arms: in ARM_PE it must scale with the precision-weighted PE and be materially decoupled from raw z_harm_a magnitude, and must show the high-precision versus low-precision split for a matched nociceptive input, with no such split in ARM_RAW.
FALSIFYING: With the same preconditions met, a raw-magnitude consumer reproduces ARM_PE's behavioural pattern, including the precision split -- precision weighting is then unnecessary overhead, which is the claim's own stated falsifier. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: dacc.py computes pe and pe_weighted = pe * (1 + precision_norm) and exposes bundle['pe']; e2_harm_a.py supplies the forward model with its phased-training path. The trap is named: bundle['control_required'] and bundle['effort_term'] are deterministic linear functions of pe, so corr(control_required, model_pe) = 1 by construction -- component isolation is an identity, never a measurement. The escape is arm contrast on a normalised behavioural DV. Consumer / boundary: The dACC-analog's consumption of harm -- whether the control-demand signal entering action selection is a precision-weighted prediction error against E2_harm_a or a raw magnitude -- and thence the E3 bias it produces. Existing ownership: sd_zharm_a_warmup_optimizer_group, SD-086, SD-087, SD-020, SD-032b, self_attribution:GAP-1, GFLAG-0211.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The representations are not separable on this substrate: harm_obs_a carries exact rank 2 and ||z_harm_a|| correlates 0.9885 with the hazard EMA at the frozen projection, while a near-constant z_harm_a makes E2_harm_a trivially accurate, so PE collapses toward a constant and 'PE' and 'raw magnitude' are close to the same variable. Independently, pe's maximum attainable variance share of the dACC bias is at or below 1e-6 at default gains. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Precondition P1's named cause has a landed repair the WWA predates. z_harm_a was a frozen random projection because the P0/P1 warmup had no optimizer group covering latent_stack.affective_harm_encoder; substrate_queue sd_zharm_a_warmup_optimizer_group records the P0-H stage BUILT 2026-09-18 and, on the 2026-09-19 user decision, p0_precision_norm_floor adopted as the stage default at 0.1 with the default path clearing 3/3 seeds at mean lift +0.930. The same measurement pass also sharpens P2 in a way the WWA does not carry: harm_obs_a has EXACT RANK 2 and corr(||z_harm_a||, hazard_EMA) = 0.9885 at the frozen projection, so no amount of encoder training adds degrees of freedom the observation does not contain. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-259.subject: cingulate.switch_threshold
MECH-259.title: Salience-network switch threshold: when the precision-weighted salience of any input to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) exceeds a threshold, the coordinator fires a whole-system mode switch rather than producing an incremental policy update.
MECH-259.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: At least two SalienceCoordinator modes must be genuinely occupied (>= 5 percent of steps each) so a switch is not an episode-length artefact, and salience_aggregate must genuinely vary in situ. The discrete leg is only testable where a whole-system consumer reads current_mode rather than the graded operating_mode vector.
CONFIRMING: At matched salience_aggregate the discrete arm produces whole-system reconfiguration (step changes in gate-mediated substrate behaviour and in mode dwell distribution) that the graded arm does not reproduce, on >= 2/3 seeds, with n_switches > 0 and >= 2 modes occupied. Manipulation: Discrete arm (Schmitt-trigger mode_switch_trigger latching current_mode, as built) versus a graded comparator arm in which downstream consumers read only the continuous operating_mode mixture and no discrete latch is held, with salience inputs and thresholds matched. Control: Matched-salience graded arm plus a coordinator-OFF arm; salience_aggregate trajectory and effective_threshold recorded per arm so the two arms differ only in discreteness, not in salience magnitude. Required event: A precision-weighted salience input (dacc_pe and/or aic_salience) rising above effective_threshold while argmax(operating_mode) differs from the discretely held current_mode, in a live episode rather than a synthetic injection. DV: Whole-system behavioural and gating divergence attributable to the discrete latch: change in write_gate-mediated substrate behaviour, mode dwell-time distribution and committed-action-class composition at matched salience_aggregate, contrasted between discrete and graded arms.
FALSIFYING: The graded arm reproduces the discrete arm's gating and behavioural profile within noise at matched salience_aggregate, i.e. the coordinator's effects are carried entirely by the continuous operating_mode mixture -- MECH-259 is over-specification and the coordinator should be redesigned as a graded-modulation layer. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: salience_coordinator.tick() returns mode_switch_trigger, salience_aggregate and effective_threshold, and get_state/diagnostics report n_switches/n_ticks. There is NO recorder of a whole-system consequence of the discrete latch, because mode_switch_trigger has no consumer in agent.py and current_mode has exactly one (ClosureOperator mode-gating, default OFF). Consumer / boundary: The coordinator-to-substrate boundary: whether the discrete switch, rather than the graded operating_mode mixture, is what reconfigures downstream substrates (MECH-261 write gates, E3 policy gate, hippocampal proposal gating). MECH-260.subject: cingulate.dacc_bias_suppression
MECH-260.title: dACC-analog bias suppression against recency / monostrategy: the dACC module writes a counter-bias that resists repeating the last-rewarded trajectory when long-term value information demands exploration. Candidate explanation of the monostrategy failure observed in fishtank_viz and earlier queue-diversity results.
MECH-260.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-260's suppression must be measurably non-zero AND varying across arms at whichever boundary the test reads. At the score_bias boundary this is not met (bias_fraction 0.000, V3-EXQ-571) and a run reproducing it corroborates rather than falsifies. At the Go/No-Go eligibility boundary it IS met (per-candidate recency-share varying across candidates on a live dACC). The FIFO must also be fed: act_with_split_obs bypasses select_action where dacc.record_action is called, which left the buffer permanently empty in the 603 chain.
CONFIRMING: With the suppression channel demonstrably engaged, the ON arm measurably reduces the monostrategy failure relative to SD-032b alone -- the bias-suppression channel does causal work on committed behaviour. Manipulation: use_dacc and dacc_suppression_weight ON versus OFF against the SD-032b-alone comparator, with gng_perseveration_floor armed so the recency-share also reaches the No-Go eligibility gate rather than only the score bias. Control: SD-032b implemented WITHOUT the MECH-260 suppression channel -- the claim's own stated comparator -- plus a FIFO-warmup gate (FIFO_WARMUP_STEPS, the Kennerley/SD-054 temporal-horizon gate) so a zero-suppression arm is distinguishable from an unfilled buffer. Required event: Repeated action selection long enough for the dACC FIFO (dacc_suppression_memory, default 8) to fill and for a recently-rewarded trajectory to become repeatable, in an environment offering an alternative worth exploring. DV: Behavioural: reduction in monostrategy -- route/action-class entropy and repeat-of-last-rewarded-trajectory rate -- in the ON arm relative to SD-032b alone, conditioned on a demonstrably non-zero suppression signal at the boundary being read.
FALSIFYING: SD-032b WITHOUT MECH-260 already resolves the monostrategy failure, making the channel unnecessary; OR SD-032b plus MECH-260 still produces monostrategy with the channel genuinely engaged and non-zero, locating the fix in exploration noise / entropy regularisation (MECH-313) instead. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/cingulate/dacc.py: record_action at line 332, _suppression_penalty at 320, the per-candidate suppression vector emitted at 449-479 and applied as score_bias at 573-574; the eligibility-gate consumer is ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py lines 2076-2087; contract tests/contracts/test_sd032_wiring_contracts.py line 65 pins that select_action calls record_action. Consumer / boundary: The claim asserts a counter-bias on TRAJECTORY SELECTION that shapes behavioural diversity, i.e. the committed action, not merely the score vector. The live consumer sits at the eligibility-access boundary, one step upstream of that. Existing ownership: MECH-449, ARC-106, MECH-439, f_dominance_conversion_ceiling, Q-045, SD-034.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); At the boundary the claim asserts (E3 score bias on trajectory selection) the channel is drowned -- bias_fraction 0.000 -- and the live consumer that does read it sits at a different boundary (the MECH-449 eligibility gate), where V3-EXQ-926/926a and 937 deliberately do NOT tag MECH-260 because its own falsifier is behavioural. The behavioural DV remains blocked by the shared MECH-439 conversion ceiling. Secondary classes: R6. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The proposed consumer has changed. The WWA's non-degeneracy precondition is pinned to the score_bias route, where V3-EXQ-571 measured bias_fraction 0.000. Since then the MECH-449 Go/No-Go constitution landed and its perseveration axis CONSUMES MECH-260's per-candidate suppression vector as an eligibility-access gate (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py lines 2076-2087), explicitly 'generalising MECH-260 from a drowned score-bias'; V3-EXQ-926/926a/937 read a LIVE dACC suppression varying across candidates. The channel is therefore no longer inert everywhere -- it is drowned at the asserted locus and live at a different one. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. MECH-261.subject: cingulate.mode_conditioned_write_gating
MECH-261.title: Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Generalises MECH-094 hypothesis tag to a mode-conditioned family of write gates. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.
MECH-261.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A quiescence window in which internal_replay actually carries content and the mode vector is not pinned to external_task: internal_replay weight must be materially above zero over the replay window and the replayed trajectory content must be recorded, otherwise the post-quiescence bias DV has nothing to correlate against and a null is vacuous.
CONFIRMING: Arm A shows a post-quiescence bias toward replayed trajectories that arms B and C do not reproduce (A strictly greater than B and approximately equal to C at chance), with segregated write bleed present only in A -- the shared coordinator overlay is doing real work rather than decorating locally-emergent gating. Manipulation: The EXP-0148 three-arm design: (A) intact coordinator emitting the full soft operating_mode vector; (B) coordinator output clamped to a constant external_task one-hot while per-substrate gates keep their local logic; (C) gates replaced by permanently-open local heuristics with no operating_mode dependence. Control: Arm C is the no-mode-gating null and arm B the coordinator lesion; both matched on seeds, replay content and quiescence schedule, with 5 seeds per arm and a pairwise Cohen's d >= 0.8 acceptance on the primary metric. Required event: A scheduled micro-quiescence window (MECH-092 SWR-analog) carrying specific replayed trajectories, followed by external_task action selection on the same environment within the forward-propagation horizon. DV: Post-quiescence action-selection bias toward recently replayed trajectories -- cosine similarity between replay content and the next committed trajectory embedding -- plus cross-mode write bleed (writes into the viability map originating from replay content during external_task commitment).
FALSIFYING: Arm C reproduces arm A's forward-propagation bias (mode gating unnecessary) or arm B reproduces it (the coordinator overlay is over-specification and coordination is local), on matched seeds with the quiescence precondition met. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: MISSING. The write gates are consumed (agent.py write_gate call sites for autonomic, e3_policy, sd_033a, sd_033b) and the soft vector is exposed, but nothing records replay-content-to-next-trajectory correspondence, and SalienceCoordinator exposes no API to clamp operating_mode to a fixed vector for arm B. Consumer / boundary: Cross-mode forward propagation: replayed content routed through the mode-conditioned write gates into SD-033a/SD-033b and thence into subsequent external_task action selection -- not the within-tick gate arithmetic already validated by V3-EXQ-446/453. Existing ownership: EXP-0148, EXP-0149, SD-033a, SD-033b, MECH-092.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); Neither half of the causal test can be instantiated: there is no recorder for the post-quiescence replay-to-action bias metric, and no fixed-operating-mode clamp for the coordinator-lesion arm. Compounding, no run has demonstrated non-trivial internal_replay occupancy -- all measured coordinator occupancy in this lineage is external_task-side and saturated. Secondary classes: R1, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The precondition defers the EXP-0148 ablation 'until SD-033 substrates land', and they have: SD-033a (ree_core/pfc/lateral_pfc_analog.py) and SD-033b (ree_core/pfc/ofc_analog.py) are implemented and genuinely consume write_gate('sd_033a') and write_gate('sd_033b') at live agent call sites, alongside the autonomic and e3_policy gates. The paired implementation_note assertion that substrate-side application is not yet implemented is therefore false. What blocks the test now is the absent forward-propagation-bias recorder and the absent fixed-mode clamp, not an unbuilt consumer. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-262.subject: pfc.lateral_pfc_rule_selective_persistence
MECH-262.title: Rule-selective persistence in lateral-PFC-analog: stimulus-abstracted rule representations in SD-033a persist across simulated time steps without external drive, remain selective through distractor events, and emerge through training rather than being innate.
MECH-262.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: rule_state must be differentiated across rule contexts with use_candidate_rule_source=True -- the inversion of 598b's C3 trainable_not_monomodal collapse -- and this must be demonstrated in-run before persistence is scored. A monomodal rule_state makes any distractor-resistance reading vacuous, since an undifferentiated vector cannot be shown to survive a distractor selectively.
CONFIRMING: With rule_state differentiated, same-rule novel-stimulus cosine stays high relative to cross-rule cosine, rule_state drift across forced internal_replay stays low at BOTH read sites, and selectivity increases with task exposures rather than being present at initialisation. Manipulation: use_candidate_rule_source ON versus OFF (differentiated CandidateRuleField source versus the legacy delta_proj/world_proj source), crossed with forced internal_replay injected during the maintenance window, and for signature (1) a transfer block presenting novel stimuli under an already-trained rule. Control: The legacy-source arm reproducing the measured monomodal collapse as a negative control, a no-distractor arm to establish the undisturbed persistence baseline, and a different-rule transfer block so generalisation is distinguished from stimulus memorisation. Required event: Intervening events during a maintained rule episode -- simulated distractor stimuli, forced internal_replay, and MECH-092 micro-quiescence cycles -- occurring between rule establishment and rule-dependent action. DV: Three separable quantities: (1) cosine between rule_state under a trained stimulus and under a novel stimulus of the SAME rule, compared against the cross-rule cosine; (2) rule_state drift across the distractor window, read BOTH at the storage site and on the selection path, since 874b showed they dissociate; (3) rule-selectivity as a function of task exposures, to test training-dependent emergence.
FALSIFYING: rule_state is stimulus-bound (same-rule novel-stimulus cosine no higher than cross-rule), or it collapses across the internal_replay window at the storage site, or it is already selective before training -- any of which means the SD-033a substrate does not meet its functional spec. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: LateralPFCAnalog holds the rule_state buffer and 598c supplies a working cosine probe, but that probe reads the storage site only and its own docstring disclaims MECH-262; no experiment combines the GAP-B source, forced internal_replay and a novel-stimulus transfer block, and no recorder pairs the storage-site read with a selection-path operative-rule read in the same run. Consumer / boundary: The lateral-PFC-analog rule representation itself -- its abstraction, its survival through intervening events, and its emergence with training -- read at BOTH the storage site and the selection path, since a storage-site read alone is now known not to track the operative rule. Existing ownership: SD-033a, ARC-062, ARC-063, MECH-309, MECH-467, arc_062_rule_apprehension_plan.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The substrate the WWA waits on has landed, but no experiment exercises it for this claim: 598c probes the storage site without forced internal_replay and explicitly disclaims MECH-262, 874/874b own the distractor battery under MECH-467, and nothing tests stimulus-abstraction transfer at all. The 874b storage-versus-selection dissociation means a single-site read cannot settle signature (ii). Secondary classes: R6, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Two changes. (1) The WWA gates the retest on 'GAP-B's rule-creator substrate landing differentiated rule states'; that substrate has landed -- ree_core/policy/candidate_rule_field.py plus LateralPFCAnalogConfig.use_candidate_rule_source, the literal ARC-063 GAP-B wiring that makes crf_source THE EMA source. (2) It prescribes a V3-EXQ-598c-style direct probe, but 598c's own docstring states it deliberately does NOT tag MECH-262 because it lacks the forced internal_replay the signature requires, and the 2026-08-18 V3-EXQ-874b finding recorded on this claim shows storage-site rule drift dissociates from selection-path operative-rule fidelity in 6 of 9 cells. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-263.subject: pfc.ofc_state_space_specific_outcome

MECH-264.subject: pfc.frontopolar_counterfactual_value_tracking
MECH-264.title: Frontopolar counterfactual-value tracking: SD-033e maintains, in parallel with SD-033c's chosen-option value signal, a running estimate of the value of unchosen alternatives. A switch-to-alternative decision is signalled when the counterfactual estimate exceeds the chosen estimate by a threshold-sensitive margin.
MECH-264.what_would_answer:
TWO DISTINCT THINGS ARE BEING TESTED HERE, and they must not be conflated.
(i) V3-NARROW GEOMETRIC SLICE (BUILT, 2026-07-09; use_frontopolar_decommit / frontopolar_gain, ree_core/pfc/frontopolar_analog.py compute_counterfactual_value). A parameter-free, SINGLE-TICK goal-proximity advantage of the best unchosen candidate over the committed endpoint (||z_chosen-z_goal|| - ||z_alt-z_goal||), wired only as an entry-relative de-commit PRESSURE on the natural-commit latch (NaturalCommitUrgencyRelease). This is NOT a maintained parallel value channel and is NOT what this claim asserts -- it is a deliberately degenerate stand-in, built to serve a different substrate goal (the MECH-439 F-dominance duration-face de-commit lever), that happens to instantiate MECH-264's switch logic in its simplest possible form.
(ii) V4-FULL SUBSTRATE (UNBUILT). The mechanism this claim actually asserts: a RUNNING, MULTI-STEP counterfactual-value ESTIMATE maintained in parallel with SD-033c's chosen-option value signal (not recomputed fresh each tick), with a switch fired when it exceeds the chosen estimate by a threshold-sensitive margin. Structurally blocked on MECH-163 (hippocampal multi-step trajectory planning, unmet) -- without multi-step plans a counterfactual value is necessarily 1-step and collapses to MECH-257 (dACC immediate-reward comparator), which is a different mechanism entirely.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (must hold before any result is interpretable): - For (i): the isolated-GAP-A substrate must sustain a genuine natural-commit
  latch to de-commit FROM -- i.e. competent committed foraging must exist at
  all. V3-EXQ-726 (the slice's own validation script, arms ARM_FP_CONTRAST vs
  ARM_FP_ON) is written and gate-hygiene-fixed but explicitly HELD, NOT QUEUED:
  its resume condition is "a substrate that sustains competent committed
  foraging," which is the SAME substrate gap the MECH-457 competence-floor
  campaign (V3-EXQ-724 lineage, GOV-FANOUT-1) is diagnosing. That campaign
  remains open (candidate/v3_pending) as of the latest confirmed evidence
  (V3-EXQ-821, 2026-07-25). Running 726 before MECH-457 clears would
  self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue on a precondition already known to
  be unmet.
- For (ii): requires MECH-163 multi-step planning landed, plus a non-degenerate
  3+-alternative decision task (this claim's own functional_restatement names
  "simulated three-alternative decision tasks").

CONFIRMING observation: - (i), once MECH-457 clears and V3-EXQ-726 runs: ARM_FP_ON's median committed-
  latch occupancy (ncur_last_occupancy_at_release) drops >= 0.40 vs
  ARM_FP_CONTRAST on >= 2/3 strong-F seeds, WITH frontopolar_release_count > 0
  on the ON arm (proving the release is attributable to the counterfactual
  term firing when cfv_now > cfv_at_entry, not to flat-timeout or F noise).
  This would confirm the geometric switch signal behaves as a genuine
  counterfactual-value comparator even in its degenerate 1-step form --
  supportive but NOT sufficient to promote MECH-264 itself, since (i) is
  explicitly not the claim's mechanism.
- (ii), in a V4 implementation: lateral-FPC-analog activity tracks the value
  of the best UNCHOSEN alternative (dissociable from SD-033c's chosen-option
  value stream) during simulated three-alternative decision tasks, and
  individual variation in the counterfactual signal's magnitude predicts
  switch propensity (per Boorman et al. 2009).

FALSIFYING observation (this claim's own primary falsifier, verbatim from functional_restatement): if lateral-FPC-analog activity in a V4 implementation tracks CHOSEN-option value rather than counterfactual-option value during simulated three-alternative decision tasks, MECH-264 fails at source and SD-033e collapses functionally into SD-033c -- in that case the OFC/vmPFC/FPC value architecture is over-specified at REE's level of description and the frontopolar subdivision should be folded into the vmPFC-analog. A secondary falsifier applies to (i) alone: if V3-EXQ-726 runs post-clearance and ARM_FP_ON shows no attributable occupancy drop (frontopolar_release_count == 0, or the drop is indistinguishable from the flat-urgency contrast), the geometric slice fails to behave as a counterfactual comparator even in its minimal form -- this would NOT itself falsify MECH-264 (the slice is not the claim), but would remove the one piece of experimental purchase currently available on any instantiation of the mechanism.
Until MECH-457 clears, MECH-264 has zero experimental evidence (genuine_exp_count: 0 in claim_evidence.v1.json; all current evidence entries are literature) and cannot be tested even in its narrow V3 form.

MECH-266.subject: salience.asymmetric_mode_hysteresis
MECH-266.title: Asymmetric mode hysteresis in SalienceCoordinator: entering an operating mode uses a different threshold on the aggregate salience vector than exiting it, and the asymmetry is mode-specific. Schmitt-trigger extension of the existing SD-032a enter-threshold logic (currently enter-only / symmetric).
MECH-266.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A contested mode must be genuinely occupiable at an intermediate level: at least one accessible cap/regime must produce fractional external_task occupancy rather than the 0.0/1.0 step function 934/935/935a found, and the bounding operator must not itself shift the external_task logit (GFLAG-0370's measured squash-vs-clamp confound, -0.96 to -1.50 at the cap).
CONFIRMING: At some accessible cap or under a margin-normalised rule, occupancy varies continuously with the hysteresis parameter (a genuine mixed regime, reproducible across seeds under the new gate), and varying exit_threshold within that regime reproduces a graded under-binding/over-binding continuum. Manipulation: Per-mode exit_threshold swept via set_hysteresis_ratio across r in [0.10, 2.00] with enter_thresholds held fixed, on a bounding operator whose cap behaviour is matched across arms rather than swapped between clamp and squash. Control: The symmetric-threshold baseline (empty enter/exit dicts, legacy MECH-259 behaviour), plus a matched-occupancy arm at the same mean dwell so the dose-response cannot be read off occupancy level alone. Required event: A mode-switching episode in which salience pressure crosses the enter rail into a mode and then decays toward the exit rail, so the Schmitt asymmetry can bind or release. DV: Mode dwell time and switch count as a continuous function of the exit/enter ratio within an accessible regime, plus the under-binding/over-binding behavioural continuum; the discriminating quantity is whether occupancy varies continuously with the hysteresis parameter or only as a step.
FALSIFYING: Under the corrected gate, no cap value or regime-conditioning yields anything but a step function -- occupancy ~1.0 below some r and ~0.0 above it with n_switches invariant -- which falsifies the GRADED framing (H2) while leaving the Schmitt trigger's existence intact. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: cingulate/salience_coordinator.py implements the two-rail trigger (enter_thresholds / exit_thresholds, setters at :504-520) and returns enter_threshold, exit_threshold and current_mode_prob per tick; experiments/_lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py now supplies the regime-conditioned non-vacuity gate that the old min-across-arms statistic corrupted. Consumer / boundary: The SalienceCoordinator mode register -- the enter/exit rails on the aggregate salience vector, not the E3 candidate score. Existing ownership: mode-governance-engagement, sd_salience_contested_mode_occupancy, SD-032a, GFLAG-0370, MECH-259, EXP-0163.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); H2 (structurally bang-bang) is not eliminated and is the live alternative: 19 of 21 arm/ratio cells sat at exactly 0.0 or 1.0, and no single cap graded on more than 1 of 3 seeds. The bounding-operator build that would widen the crossing is implemented_pending_validation, and its validation run was refused at red-team over a confound (GFLAG-0370). Secondary classes: R1. MECH-269.subject: hippocampal_proposer.regional_verisimilitude_anchor_selection
MECH-269.title: Hippocampal proposer anchor selection AND anchor-reset: (a) trajectory proposals issued between committed actions anchor on the subset of current latent streams whose regional verisimilitude (per-stream prediction/realization alignment) exceeds threshold; misaligned streams hold their last-verified snapshot (anchor carryover) rather than contaminate the rollout. (b) Active anchors are continuously re-evaluated against an effective verisimilitude V_s_anchor(a, t) = V_s(r, t) - staleness[r] (MECH-284 read-out); if V_s_anchor falls below theta_reset(r) for k consecutive steps the anchor is marked inactive (NOT erased -- dual-trace preservation per Bouton 2004) and a new anchor is sought from the current latent slice. A minority probe channel deliberately inverts the gate for low-verisimilitude / high-PE regions, carrying a strengthened MECH-094 hypothesis tag, and does not update the ARC-018 viability map until realized-experience validation.
MECH-269.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A real theta_anchor eligibility gate must exist so the proposer's start-state composition VARIES across ticks, and per-stream V_s must have usable dynamic range. Neither holds: stream_mixture is tuple(sorted(self.per_stream_vs.keys())) at module.py:4150 -- all tracked streams, unconditionally -- so leg 1 has exactly zero variance.
CONFIRMING: Anchored-eligible-only rollouts show a smaller prediction-vs-outcome gap than indiscriminate composition; probe-tagged rollouts preferentially seed high-PE regions and do not populate the viability map until realized validation; anchor invalidation fires within ~2-3 PAG releases rather than a 1000/1000 freeze. Manipulation: Anchor-eligible-only start-state composition (misaligned streams held at their last-verified snapshot) versus indiscriminate composition from the full current latent slice, at matched proposal budget. Control: A no-anchor-selection baseline composing the start state from all streams, plus a shuffled-eligibility control that gates the same number of streams at random so the gate's CONTENT, not the act of gating, is what is tested. Required event: Inter-commit trajectory proposals issued while streams genuinely differ in prediction/realisation alignment, plus sustained invalidation of an active anchor across k consecutive ticks. DV: Prediction-vs-outcome gap of the resulting rollouts, conditioned on anchor label; fraction of probe-tagged rollouts entering the ARC-018 viability map before realized validation; and mark_inactive events per PAG release.
FALSIFYING: With a real eligibility gate live and V_s carrying dynamic range, anchored-eligible-only rollouts perform no better than indiscriminate anchoring, probe rollouts contaminate the viability map before validation, or re-presented extinction cues trigger from-scratch relearning rather than return-of-avoidance. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: per_stream_vs and the AnchorSet hysteresis/dual-trace counters are recorded (module.py:3750, 4118; ree_core/hippocampal/staleness_accumulator.py). MISSING: an eligibility label per stream at proposal time, and a prediction-vs-realisation alignment score -- the live V_s is a temporal-stability proxy V_s = 1 - ||z_t - z_t-1|| / ||z_t||, not align(z_hat_s, z_s). Consumer / boundary: HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories' rollout start state, which currently takes a single z_world tensor (module.py:2037-2150) and never consults per_stream_vs or the anchor set. Existing ownership: MECH-284, MECH-287, MECH-288, EXP-0579, behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-D.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The anchor quantity exists but has no consumer at the asserted locus: propose_trajectories takes a single z_world and never reads per_stream_vs or the anchor set, and stream_mixture is the unconditional key list rather than the above-threshold subset. Separately the recorded V_s is a step-stability identity proxy, not a prediction/realisation alignment, so it has no dynamic range to gate on. Secondary classes: R2, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's blocker -- 'live per-stream V_s telemetry and anchor/probe labels confirmed ABSENT, the read-side hook missing' -- is no longer the operative defect. update_per_stream_vs (module.py:3750) now emits per-stream V_s and tick_anchor_set (module.py:4118) runs hysteresis with the MECH-284 staleness lookup; MECH-284/287/288 are all substrate_queue implemented/ready. The 2026-08-04 GOV-CONFIRM-1 adjudication (EXP-0579) re-localised the blocker to two different, more specific defects that the WWA does not name. MECH-269b.subject: cortical_world_model.regional_verisimilitude_rollout_gating
MECH-269b.title: Regional verisimilitude V_s gates not only hippocampal proposer anchor selection but also which streams ground forward predictions in cortical world models (E1 sensory predictor, E2 transition model). Without symmetric V_s gating on E1/E2 rollouts, downstream consumers receive stale-but-confident-looking prediction errors -- the wired-but-inert failure mode.
MECH-269b.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The V_s gate must actually hold the stream the DV reads (z_harm_a), which requires per-stream thresholds calibrated to that stream's own near-ceiling V_s band (0.989-1.000) rather than a global 0.85 borrowed from another stream; and the quantity read must have a non-trivial variance share of the downstream signal it is correlated against.
CONFIRMING: With the gate demonstrably holding the target stream in the ON arm, disabling cortical-side V_s gating reproduces the wired-but-inert signature (override mean elevated, PAG releases up, approach_commit near zero) while enabling it restores behavioural sensitivity to prediction error, on a majority of seeds. Manipulation: Factorial on use_vs_rollout_gating OFF versus ON under the 475a-conditions substrate (GABAergic decay + PAG freeze + dACC ON), with e1_threshold_per_stream / e2_threshold_per_stream calibrated per stream so the manipulation genuinely crosses for the stream the DV reads. Control: The gating-OFF arm at matched seed and matched substrate, with a demonstrated non-zero held count on the target stream in the ON arm so the two arms are not functionally identical (862a's failure: bit-identical pe series between arms). Required event: Cortical forward prediction (E1 sensory step, E2 transition step) on a stream whose alignment to perception has decayed, so the gate substitutes a held snapshot for the current latent value. DV: A quantity on which V_s gating has non-negligible authority -- the corrective revision actually produced downstream, e.g. the change in committed action or E3 candidate ranking attributable to the held-versus-current stream value, or the dACC control_required term expressed as a share of the total E3 payoff. NOT the raw Spearman of pe against total dACC bias magnitude, which is capped at rho about 0.001.
FALSIFYING: With the gate demonstrably crossing on the target stream and a DV that carries real variance share, the ON and OFF arms are indistinguishable on the behavioural signature -- symmetric cortical V_s gating buys nothing over the hippocampal-proposer gating alone, and the symmetric-application commitment fails. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/regulators/vs_rollout_gate.py records per-stream held/refresh counts; dacc.py:205-225 computes pe and the bias; the 862 lineage drivers record pe_series and bias_magnitude_series per seed. The instrument records real quantities; it reads them at a boundary where pe contributes at most 1e-6 of the variance. Consumer / boundary: The corrective revision that downstream consumers (dACC adaptive control, E3 commit gate, MECH-269 proposer scoring) actually make on the basis of forward prediction errors -- the wired-but-inert signature is about behavioural consequence, not about correlation at the dACC bias output. Existing ownership: Q-040, modulatory-bias-selection-authority, MECH-269b-followup-B, behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-D, goal_pipeline:GAP-6.

MECH-270.subject: hippocampus.ephaptic_verisimilitude_readout

Streams whose predictions align with realized values produce coherent pyramidal ensembles whose extracellular fields constructively reinforce; misaligned streams produce incoherent fields. 'Anchor-eligible' reduces to 'field-coherent at read time.'
MECH-270.what_would_answer:
This claim fuses a biological substrate claim with an in-silico sufficiency check. The claim's
own notes put its weight on the biology. Split.
LEG 1 (biological, out of REE's test domain; the claim's core):
CONFIRMING: in CA1/CA3 pyramidal layers, local field coherence covaries with the verisimilitude
of the content being carried, beyond firing rate and synchrony magnitude. Examples of that
content: sequence content congruent with the realised trajectory, or ripple-initiation locus
aligned with cortical expectancy (the claim's own test). Field-only perturbation, with synaptic
drive held, shifts which content is anchored or replayed.
FALSIFYING: once rate and synchrony magnitude are controlled, field coherence does not covary with
content verisimilitude; or field-only perturbation leaves anchored or replayed content unchanged.
Current support is 4 lit entries that establish field effects exist (Anastassiou 2011 et al.).
None of them tests the coherence-to-verisimilitude mapping. That mapping is the open gap for a
lit-pull.
LEG 2 (REE in-silico sufficiency) SPLIT OUT 2026-09-25 (GFLAG-0518) to MECH-270a: the
in-silico V_s-computation content MECH-456 actually reads is no longer tested under this
claim. See MECH-270a's own what_would_answer for that leg.

MECH-271.subject: hippocampus.hypothesis_tag_routing
MECH-271.title: MECH-094's hypothesis tag is realized as differential downstream routing of hippocampal replay, not as a source-side boolean. Tag loss presents as probe content reaching consolidation destinations it should not reach -- an auditable confabulatory-planning signature distinct from psychosis or hallucination.
MECH-271.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this claim presupposes the MECH-271 V3 routing substrate exists as live, wired machinery -- confirmed as of 2026-08-08 to NOT be the case. The routing-table form specified in docs/architecture/mech_271_routing_v3_substrate_plan.md (RoutingTable module, ReplayEvent.replay_kind/routing_weights extension, the destination dispatcher in REEAgent.consume_replay, the mech271_tag_loss_count audit hook, and the use_mech271_routing master flag) is UNIMPLEMENTED -- zero hits for use_mech271_routing / mech271_tag_loss_count / e1_consolidation / lateral_pfc_viability_map / bla_affective_tagging / nac_curiosity_scaffolding anywhere under ree_core/, and no ree_core/hippocampal/replay_routing.py exists. The plan's own stated release condition -- landing after the implement- mech269b lock on ree_core/hippocampal/module.py clears -- has itself not resolved: MECH-269b remains candidate/v3_pending as of 2026-07-11, with only a diagnostic-probe PASS (V3-EXQ-601, scoring_excluded) and its non-diagnostic behavioural-sufficiency retest (Q-040b) still outstanding. The claim's own proposed validation experiment, V3-EXQ-492, has never been queued.
CONFIRMING (primary, once substrate lands -- V3-EXQ-492 or successor, 4-arm {A0_off, A1_routing_only, A2_forced_leak, A3_high_leak} per the design doc): (C1) master-flag-ON with clean substrate (force_tag_loss_rate=0.0) reduces consolidation writes sourced from probe replays by >=70% relative to the OFF baseline; (C2) the audit counter (mech271_tag_loss_count) tracks the deliberate leak-injection rate within +/-10% across ablation levels; (C3) full forced tag loss (rate=1.0) reproduces a confabulation behavioural signature -- >=2x increase in E1-prediction-divergence on held-out probe content relative to the clean-substrate arm; (C4) the OFF arm is bit-identical to the pre-flag baseline (within 1e-9 on all run metrics).
CONFIRMING (secondary): BLA engagement (SD-035 substrate, V3-EXQ-473/474) should correlate with probe replay and not with anchored replay once routing is wired -- consistent with the strong literature cluster already registered (lit_conf=0.881) but not yet linked to a REE V3 run.
FALSIFYING: (F1) with the master flag ON and a clean substrate, probe-replay content continues to reach consolidation destinations at rates indistinguishable from the OFF baseline (C1 fails) -- would falsify the routing-differentiation framing and support the original MECH-094 source-side boolean-gate framing instead. (F2) the audit counter does not track the injection rate (C2 fails) -- instrumentation failure, not evidence against the mechanism per se. (F3) forced full tag loss produces no measurable increase in E1-prediction-divergence on probe content (C3 fails) -- would falsify the specific clinical claim that routing-side tag loss produces an auditable confabulatory-planning signature, even if C1/C2 pass.

One names the MECH-269b lock (matches this claim's own depends_on). V4 adds the continuous phase-channel coordinate per MECH-228"). Looks like a conflation of the V3 minimum-viable form with the V4 full realization. Net effect on testability is the same either way, but the two documented gating rationales disagree and should be reconciled.
Falsifiable (secondary): the BLA analog landing under SD-035 is the natural probe-destination consumer. V3-EXQ-474 (BLA encoding + remap) + a follow-up probe-routing experiment should show BLA engagement correlates with probe replay, not with anchored replay.

MECH-272.subject: hippocampus.state_gated_routing
MECH-272.title: MECH-271 routing is state-gated. In waking, the anchor channel dominates the hippocampal fan-out: replay preferentially reaches consolidation and viability-map consumers to support decision-making. In sleep, the probe channel dominates: replay preferentially seeds Bayesian schema restructuring -- testing which action-outcome attributions held up across episodes, creating new buckets for non-fitting experiences, revising causal graphs. The informational needs of sleep (schema revision) and waking (decision support) are distinct, and the routing bias reflects that.
MECH-272.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Actual SWS/REM phases, nonempty replay draws and nonzero schema writes; read the phase at each consumer. A configured channel weight is not proof of dominance at the consumer.
