MECH-293.subject: hippocampal.awake_ghost_goal_probe_search
MECH-293.title: Waking hippocampal search allocates a minority probe budget to top ghost-goal entries, seeding proposals around unresolved but still-wanted anchors instead of relying on pure current-anchor CEM or random probe noise.
MECH-293.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The full prerequisite stack must be armed (use_anchor_sets, use_sd039_anchor_payload, use_mech292_ghost_bank, use_mech293_ghost_probes) with an ACTIVE goal, so the ghost branch actually fires and admits candidates; and the blocked-goal episode must last long enough for a recovery difference to be expressible, within a continuous stream because AnchorSet.reset() clears the dual-trace pool at every episode boundary.
CONFIRMING: Versus a budget-matched random-probe control, ghost-goal probes yield faster recovery from blocked-goal conditions and lower revisitation of fully incoherent stale regions, with the ghost branch demonstrably firing (n_ghost_admitted > 0) in the ON arm. Manipulation: Toggle use_mech293_ghost_probes (and the ghost fraction) against a random-probe control that spends the same candidate budget on non-ghost noise, so the comparison isolates ghost SEEDING rather than the extra budget. Control: A matched random-probe arm consuming the identical minority candidate budget, plus the master-OFF arm that V3-EXQ-497 UC2 already shows is bit-identical to pre-MECH-293. Required event: A goal whose approach path is blocked or whose reward is relocated mid-stream, leaving inactive anchors on the formerly valid path, followed by continued waking search in which recovery can be measured. DV: Time-to-recovery of the blocked goal (steps to re-approach or to re-instate an equivalent goal) in the ghost arm versus the random-probe arm, plus the revisitation rate of fully incoherent stale regions -- both behavioural, not representational.
FALSIFYING: With the ghost branch demonstrably firing, recovery time and stale-region revisitation are indistinguishable from the budget-matched random-probe control -- ghost seeding produces distinguishable proposal CONTENT (already shown by V3-EXQ-881) with no behavioural consequence. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories with get_last_propose_diagnostics records mech293_n_ghost_proposed / n_ghost_admitted / max_ghost_priority / mean_goal_match_at_seed; V3-EXQ-881 supplies the endpoint effect_size instrument. NO instrument records time-to-recovery against a random-probe control, and there is no recorder for revisitation of incoherent stale regions -- the nearest available proxy is the hippocampal curiosity familiarity density. Consumer / boundary: Waking proposal generation inside propose_trajectories and its behavioural consequence at commitment -- the claim is about which proposals the agent generates and whether that changes recovery, not about the bank's ranking. Existing ownership: V3-EXQ-495, ARC-060, MECH-292, SD-039, MECH-163.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The behavioural half of the registered falsifier has never been run under this claim's own claim_ids. V3-EXQ-881 measured representational divergence, not recovery; V3-EXQ-651/651a are tagged ARC-060 only and both returned FAIL/non_contributory; V3-EXQ-495, the drafted behavioural gate, carries a DO-NOT-QUEUE banner from before MECH-292/293 landed and was never requeued. No revisitation recorder exists. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

value -- the SAME-STATISTIC safeguard against the V3-EXQ-661 rescale-invisible scalar null),
`routed_range_bounded` (< 1e6, the 643a explosion ceiling),
`adequate_committed_window_sample` (worst-cell `n_p1_ticks_past_window` >= 200 -- the precondition
V3-EXQ-840 actually failed, per the corrected diagnosis in
`substrate_queue.json::mech294_coherence_magnitude_strengthening.diagnosis_correction`).
(3) De-duplication, mandatory and explicit: committed-action counts must be accumulated on the
fresh-select denominator via `experiments/_lib/fresh_select.py` (diagnostics cleared before
every `select_action`, so a latched/held tick contributes no row), with
`adequate_fresh_selection_sample` >= `nominal_window_ticks / beta_rate_max_steps(20)` on the
`MIN_SEEDS_FOR_PASS`-th largest per-seed value, and `n_latched` / `replication_factor` reported
per cell. Raw per-tick accumulation is ~9x pseudo-replicated and voids the readout
([memory] `reference-hold-weighted-e3-readout-form2`).
(4) An instrument positive control on the DV itself, which 840b lacked. A yoked
same-arm-vs-same-arm control must diverge on 0 ticks (V3-EXQ-949's
`paired_control_is_bit_identical`), AND at least one arm contrast in the design must be shown
capable of exceeding `cross_seed_baseline_tv` -- otherwise the pre-registered pass rule
(`mean_tv > baseline_tv`, driver line 968) is unsatisfiable by construction and a FAIL is a
`measurement_test_design_defect`, not a claim verdict. In 840b `cross_seed_baseline_tv = 0.7669`
and the largest observed contrast was 0.1928, so no arm cleared it.
SD-105 (selection-entropy headroom floor) must be OFF, or matched-constant across all arms with
its realised log-temperature recorded per arm -- an entropy controller acting on the E3 softmax
directly manufactures this DV.

CONFIRMING. On a pool with `mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 4.5` and routed coherence
supra-floor and mode-distinct (JOINT > ALT > SHUF ~ 0), the committed-action-class distribution
under JOINT differs from ALTERNATION by mean paired TV > max(0.1, cross_seed_baseline_tv) on
>= 7/10 seeds (C1), AND JOINT differs from SHUFFLED on the same bar (C2). Both must hold: C1
alone with C2 failing is `multi_content_present_joint_not_isolated` -> `mixed`, and does NOT
promote the joint clause. Effect-size gate scaled per [memory]
`feedback_effect_size_pass_gate_margin`: the absolute floor 0.1 is retained as a floor, and the
`cross_seed_baseline_tv` conjunct supplies the SD-of-the-delta half -- do NOT drop the baseline
conjunct to make the test pass.

FALSIFYING. With every precondition above met -- including P1 at >= 4.5 classes and a
demonstrated capacity for some contrast to exceed the baseline -- JOINT remains
indistinguishable from ALTERNATION on the committed-action distribution (C1 fail). That is the
Kay-2020 parsimonious outcome: the joint-packet clause is over-specified at the
behavioural-committed-action level this substrate can measure. It weakens the *joint* clause only;
it does not touch MECH-089's theta-gamma multiplexing substrate, on which MECH-294 depends and
which is separately lit-anchored (Lisman & Jensen 2013, Colgin 2009, Igarashi 2014).
A second independent falsifying route, if the committed readout stays resolution-limited:
per the claim's own "Falsifiable (secondary)", manipulate V_s anchor-eligibility so packet
components differ in temporal vintage, and show that downstream consumers (E3 commit gate, dACC
adaptive control) respond no differently to the component-typed packet than to a
homogeneous-latent null on a readout upstream of the committed argmax (e.g. the routed
cross-candidate range distribution, or the rank-order of the eligible set) -- a readout not
subject to the class-count ceiling.

MECH-295.subject: drive_to_approach.liking_stream_bridge
MECH-295.title: The drive -> liking-stream -> approach-cue gain pathway is one of several drive->approach pathways in the REE substrate. It biases approach action scoring via a liking-specific per-candidate score_bias contribution, but is NOT the sole or necessary pathway by which drive amplification reaches approach action selection (narrowed 2026-05-31 from necessity to modulation per V3-EXQ-490j autopsy; original necessity title preserved in functional_restatement history). Parallel architecturally first-class drive->approach pathways operate in the same substrate: MECH-216 schema-readout wanting, MECH-290 backward credit sweep, MECH-307 anticipatory liking, and serotonin tonic_5ht benefit_salience.
MECH-295.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: mech295_bias_range_mean > 0 -- the per-candidate MECH-295 score_bias must vary across candidates before an argmin that never flips can be read as evidence about MECH-295's causal weight. Because the bias is bias = -gain * d * candidate_proximities, this reduces exactly to: the candidate first-step world summaries must differ in goal proximity.
CONFIRMING: With bias_range non-degenerate, the per-candidate MECH-295 score_bias changes the committed argmin at a pre-registered rate on >= 2/3 seeds, supporting the narrowed modulatory-sufficiency reading. Manipulation: Bridge cue side ON versus severed (mech295_liking_to_approach_cue_gain = 0.0) at matched drive, with a sensitivity arm holding the other VALENCE_WANTING writers (MECH-216, MECH-290, MECH-307, tonic_5ht) off in both arms. Control: The severed-bridge arm is the within-run control; the counterfactual no-MECH-295 score vector on the same tick and candidate set is the argmin-flip comparator, so the control is matched tick-for-tick rather than run-for-run. Required event: Commit ticks with an active GoalState, non-zero effective drive above mech295_min_drive_to_fire, and a candidate pool whose first-step world states genuinely differ in proximity to the goal latent. DV: Fraction of commit ticks on which subtracting the MECH-295 per-candidate bias changes the E3 argmin (argmin_flip_ticks / mech295_fired_ticks), reported only under a pre-registered mech295_bias_range_mean > 0 guard.
FALSIFYING: With bias_range confirmed non-degenerate, argmin_flip_ticks stays at or near zero -- the bias exists and varies but is never large enough against the other additively composed channels to change which candidate wins, narrowing the claim to contributes-but-never-decisive. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The bridge records fires and bias range (ree_core/regulators/mech295_liking_bridge.py get_diagnostics; agent.py select_action block at 8346-8412). The recorder is adequate; what it records is structurally constant whenever the candidate summaries are. Consumer / boundary: The E3 committed argmin in e3_selector.py, where the negated MECH-295 bias is composed additively with the dACC / lateral PFC / OFC score_bias -- not episode-level approach_commit. Existing ownership: behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-A, modulatory-bias-selection-authority, scaffolded_sd054_onboarding, GFLAG-0007, MECH-307.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); agent.py:8368-8378 falls back to self._current_latent.z_world for every candidate whose world_states is None, producing an IDENTICAL summary per candidate, hence a constant proximity vector and a bias range of exactly 0.0. The V3-EXQ-812a repair (candidate_summary_source e2_world_forward) only partially engaged -- 2 of 3 seeds still measured exact-zero proximity range. Secondary classes: R2, R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Both blockers the WWA names have been superseded. The scaffolded-curriculum-hazard-rebalance entry it gates on was found unwarranted and closed 2026-08-08 (GFLAG-0007), and the 'separate, unconditional degeneracy at the downstream bias-computation stage' that V3-EXQ-812a reported is refuted by reading the function: compute_approach_cue_score_bias is a pure negative scalar multiple of candidate_proximities and cannot degenerate independently of it. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-296.subject: hippocampal.prototype_readout_via_type_keyed_attention
MECH-296.title: Prototype-readout operator computes a softmax-attention match between the current LatentState and the type-keyed anchor pool, returning a small set of best-matched type-keys plus their confidences. Runs both during waking (moment-to-moment type recognition) and during sleep (consolidation refinement of the type-anchor pool).
MECH-296.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Requires SD-040's type-keyed AnchorSet entries to exist. Confirmed
  unbuilt: zero hits for "type_encoder", "type_key", or "prototype_readout" anywhere in
  ree-v3/ree_core/ (AnchorSet itself, MECH-269's substrate, does exist at
  ree_core/hippocampal/anchor_set.py, but carries no type-key field). SD-040 is itself
  candidate/substrate_conditional -- see its what_would_answer; do not re-derive. Also requires
  MECH-285's sleep refinement pass (the offline consolidation leg) to be wired to a consumer:
  MECH-285's SleepReplaySampler is currently Phase B, a diagnostics-only no-op consumer (confirmed,
  ree_core/sleep/replay_sampler.py docstring), so even if type-keys existed, the sleep-refinement
  half of this claim (MECH-285-driven pool update) has no substrate to run against yet.
CONFIRMING: once SD-040 lands and the readout operator is implemented, surface-different stimuli
  sharing a structural type-signature activate overlapping type-key sets in the readout (measured
  as top-k type-key overlap above a permutation-null baseline across distinct instances of the same
  type, in an environment with genuine multi-instance-per-type variability -- V3's gridworld does
  not have this by design, a test-bed limitation flagged in SD-040's own wwa).
FALSIFYING: with the substrate live and a multi-instance test-bed available, same-type stimuli
  produce no above-chance type-key overlap (readout is effectively instance-specific, not type-
  specific), or the sleep-refinement pass shows no measurable change in match precision/pruning of

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: AnchorSet exists (ree_core/hippocampal/anchor_set.py) but has no

DISPOSITION: substrate_conditional (primary). Mechanism never exercised; zero evidence either way.

MECH-297.subject: hippocampal.type_vs_anchor_gating_extension_mech_269
MECH-297.title: Type-V_s gating extends MECH-269's per-stream / per-region V_s with a per-type V_s dimension keyed on the matched type-key from MECH-296. Allows the proposer / E3 to gate stream contributions by category-V_s as well as by per-stream V_s, downweighting type-confident-but-stream-degraded inputs and vice versa.
MECH-297.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Requires (1) MECH-296's matched type-keys to exist (MECH-296 is itself
  substrate_conditional on SD-040 -- see MECH-296's what_would_answer above, do not re-derive), AND
  (2) MECH-269's per-stream V_s to actually reach a consumer at proposal time, which per MECH-269's
  own what_would_answer here it currently does not: propose_trajectories (module.py:2037-2150) takes
  a single z_world and never reads per_stream_vs or the anchor set; stream_mixture is the
  unconditional full key list, not an eligibility-gated subset. A per-type V_s gate bolted onto a
  per-stream V_s signal that itself has no consumer is doubly inert.
CONFIRMING: once both substrates exist and are wired to the proposer/E3, novel instances of a known
  type produce low per-type V_s (matched type-key but poor prototype fit) and trigger the probe
  channel in MECH-269 (low-V_s anchors with strengthened MECH-094 hypothesis tag), at a rate above a
  matched-staleness / shuffled-type-label control.
FALSIFYING: with both substrates live and wired, novel instances of a known type are treated
  identically to familiar instances (no differential probe-channel firing attributable to per-type

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: MECH-269's AnchorSet/staleness-accumulator substrate exists

  time (confirmed by MECH-269's own audited wwa here). MECH-296's type-key readout does not exist

  dimension to -- currently absent for BOTH the per-stream and the (not-yet-existing) per-type
