NOT A MERGE CANDIDATE: this claim's own notes float folding it into MECH-269 as "Phase 4" rather
  than a sibling claim. Recommend AGAINST merging -- the registry's own precedent for structurally
  identical cases (MECH-273/MECH-274/MECH-275, self- vs other- vs general-aggregation kept as
  separate coupled claims rather than folded into one) favours keeping a distinct falsifiable unit
  per gating dimension, since MECH-297's probe-channel/novel-instance criterion is a genuinely
  separate DV from MECH-269's own anchor-eligibility criterion, not a restatement of it.
DISPOSITION: substrate_conditional (primary, doubled: both the type-key input and the per-stream V_s
  consumer path it extends are unwired). Zero evidence either way.

MECH-298.subject: pfc.event_gated_frontal_write_at_goal_instantiation
MECH-298.title: Event-gated frontal write at goal-instantiation moments: when GoalState transitions from inactive to active, or when z_goal changes substantially, perform a high-bandwidth one-shot transfer of LatentStack content into SD-033a rule_state and SD-033b state_code, replacing the slow-EMA update for that tick. Mirrors Spellman et al. 2015 encoding-direction HPC->PFC dependence at goal-cue encoding.
MECH-298.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the event-gated one-shot write hook itself must be built -- it does
not exist. LateralPFCAnalog.update() (ree-v3/ree_core/pfc/lateral_pfc_analog.py:298-386)
implements only gate-modulated EMA (rule_state <- (1-eff_eta)*rule_state + eff_eta*source); there
is no branch that performs a one-shot full-replace of rule_state/state_code from LatentStack
content at a GoalState inactive->active transition or a MECH-288 slow-scale boundary. Both
prerequisite substrates the hook would sit between ARE wired in V3: MECH-288's EventSegmenter
(ree_core/hippocampal/event_segmenter.py) emits slow-scale BOCPD boundaries every tick, and
SD-033a/SD-033b already expose the rule_state/state_code buffers the hook would write into. This
is a scoped implementation gap (one hook, not a new substrate class) -- MECH-466's 2026-08-10
dependency edit independently confirms MECH-298 has never been built ("an explicitly optional
future pull ... ever being built").
CONFIRMING: once built, GoalState inactive->active transitions and MECH-288 slow-scale boundary
events show a measurable step change in rule_state/state_code cosine distance from their
pre-event value, distinctly larger than the step size an ordinary EMA tick produces at the same
gate value; ticks without a boundary event continue to show smooth EMA-scale drift only.
FALSIFYING: with the hook active, rule_state/state_code trajectories at goal-onset events are
statistically indistinguishable in step size from ordinary EMA ticks (no encoding-specific
HPC->PFC coupling signature); or the one-shot replace DEGRADES the SD-033a rule-discrimination
margin already validated by V3-EXQ-598c (0.308 against a 0.15 floor) -- i.e. the fast write
overwrites differentiated rule content with noisier raw LatentStack content.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: the hook itself (unbuilt); MECH-288 EventSegmenter's
current_segment_id()/boundary events as the trigger source; SD-033a's existing update() gate
parameter as the natural extension point.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: the hook is implemented in lateral_pfc_analog.py (and the SD-033b analogue) and
wired to GoalState-transition / MECH-288-boundary events. Per the claim's own notes this is one of
the lighter build items in the cluster -- a reasonable /implement-substrate candidate once
governance wants to pull it forward, but nothing currently forces that.

MECH-299.subject: hippocampal.theta_cycle_content_scales_with_substrate_vocabulary
MECH-299.title: Theta-cycle content scales with the agent's current substrate abstraction vocabulary: the unit packaged into a single theta cycle is the smallest reusable item available in the active substrate stack -- atomic actions when only those exist, action chunks when SD-045 lands, type-instance matches when SD-040/MECH-296 land, option invocations when SD-042 lands. Refinement of MECH-089 (theta-gamma nesting) on the content-of-packet axis.
MECH-299.what_would_answer:
Extracted from the claim's own functional_restatement Falsifiable clause and put in house form.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least one substrate above atomic-actions-plus-z_world must exist and
be non-degenerately populated -- SD-045 (action-chunk cache), SD-040 + MECH-296 (type-instance
matching), or SD-042 (option library). None does: grep of ree-v3/ree_core/ (2026-09-25) for
option_library/OptionLibrary/type_encoder/TypeEncoder/action_chunk/ActionChunk/chunk_cache returns
zero hits. V3's substrate vocabulary is fixed at z_world + atomic actions, so there is currently no
second granularity for theta-cycle content to scale into -- a V3 run cannot be non-degenerate for
this claim regardless of design.

CONFIRMING: longitudinal measurement of theta-sequence content (via the MECH-089 ThetaBuffer /
MECH-294 multi-content packet machinery, both already live) before and after the agent acquires a
chunked/typed/option-level skill shows content granularity shifts from atomic units to the new
unit (chunk-units, type-instance matches, or option invocations) while gamma-count per theta cycle
stays roughly constant (packaging machinery fixed; granularity scales, not packet rate).

FALSIFYING: after the new substrate vocabulary lands and is exercised, theta-cycle content stays
atomic-unit-only (gamma-count-per-cycle packaging does not pick up the new unit), or granularity
scales but gamma-count-per-cycle also scales with it (contradicting the "packaging machinery is
fixed" architectural prediction). A run under the unmet precondition above is not evidence either
way.

BLOCKING ARTEFACT (named): SD-045, or SD-040+MECH-296, or SD-042 -- whichever lands first. Currently
none exists in ree_core/. This is a genuine V4-vs-V3 substrate gap, not a stale note: MECH-089 and
MECH-294 (the theta-packaging machinery MECH-299 refines) are both live/implemented, so the packaging
mechanism side is ready; only the "second unit to package" side is missing.

MECH-300.subject: hippocampal.cognitive_map_traversal_at_active_abstraction_level
MECH-300.title: Cognitive map traversal via theta sequences operates at the agent's active abstraction level. Theta sequences do not have a fixed semantic content -- they simulate trajectories through whatever cognitive map the substrate vocabulary currently defines, whether spatial, conceptual, type-graph, or option-graph. Sister claim to MECH-299, on the map-being-traversed axis.
MECH-300.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this claim is untestable until the substrate vocabulary actually contains a granularity level ABOVE the atomic action. V3's vocabulary is fixed at z_world + atomic actions, so a run against V3 alone cannot address MECH-300 -- theta content would trivially reduce to atomic-action traversal because no other map exists to traverse, and that should self-route substrate_not_ready rather than count as a null/negative result. A valid test additionally requires: (1) MECH-089 / MECH-294 theta-gamma packaging confirmed live, (2) MECH-269 anchor pool live (defines the cognitive-map nodes MECH-300 traverses), and (3) at least one of the reusable-unit substrates landed -- SD-045 (action chunks), SD-040 / MECH-296 (type-instance prototypes), or SD-042 (option library) -- so there is a second, non-atomic map for theta to be traversing. Per the plan-of-record (object_reasoning_abstraction_v4_plan.md OBJ-ABS-6), this claim is explicitly the capstone validation node and cannot be the first thing built; it validates that the lower pillars re-grain the theta packet rather than existing as separate substrates.
CONFIRMING signature (per the claim's own functional_restatement): in a hierarchical-task paradigm where the agent has learned BOTH atomic-action sequences AND a higher-level unit (option-level subroutines, action chunks, or type-graph transitions), decoded theta-cycle content during execution of the higher-level unit should transition between nodes of THAT graph (option-to-option, chunk-to-chunk, or type-to-type) rather than between atomic action-steps -- i.e. the same theta-sequence machinery re-grains to whichever vocabulary is currently active. This is the substrate-level analogue of the Frank-lab hierarchical-task replay literature (the closest biological anchor named in the claim).
FALSIFYING signature: if, even once a higher-level substrate (chunks / types / options) is built and demonstrably drives behaviour, decoded theta-sequence content during higher-level execution continues to reflect ONLY atomic-action-to-atomic-action transitions -- i.e. theta stays pinned to the lowest-granularity map regardless of which vocabulary level is behaviourally active -- that falsifies MECH-300's "no fixed semantic content" claim and would instead support a fixed theta-content model (theta always encodes atomic spatial/action trajectories, irrespective of higher-level structure).
Note the sister-claim coupling: MECH-299 (content/unit) and MECH-300 (map/graph) are intended to be tested together against the same hierarchical-task substrate. A result confirming one while falsifying the other is itself informative and should be reported as such rather than resolved -- it would indicate the packaging and traversal axes are dissociable rather than co-scaling as currently assumed.

MECH-301.subject: hippocampal.waking_quiescent_replay_via_mech285_priority_sampling
MECH-301.title: Priority-weighted anchor replay (MECH-285) runs not only during sleep but also during brief waking quiescent pauses, surfacing remote / non-current stored content for goal-directed retrieval. The architectural gating is contextual (quiescent vs active behaviour, sensory input vs absence) rather than state-categorical (waking vs sleep). Refinement / generalisation of MECH-285.
MECH-301.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Requires MECH-285's SleepReplaySampler to be wired to a real downstream
  consumer (routing / aggregation / writeback) in at least one state, sleep or waking -- currently
  neither: confirmed by ree_core/sleep/replay_sampler.py's own docstring, "Phase B is a NO-OP
  CONSUMER... no downstream consumer... sees them yet. Phases C / D / E will pipe the draws into
  MECH-272 routing, MECH-275 aggregation, and MECH-273 self-model writeback." Lifting the
  sleep-only invocation gate to include waking quiescence (this claim's proposed change) is
  therefore not yet a testable manipulation on its own -- there is nothing downstream to observe a
  difference in. SEPARATELY, and independent of MECH-285's own wiring: an already-built, unrelated
  mechanism (MECH-293, ree_core/hippocampal/module.py:2504-2520, use_mech293_ghost_probes) already
  performs waking ghost-goal-bank-seeded retrieval on every trajectory-generation tick, gated on
  nothing but the MECH-292 bank being non-empty -- NOT on quiescence, NOT on MECH-285. Any
  behavioural DV drawn from MECH-292/MECH-293 output (as this claim's own falsifiability paragraph
  proposes) must be measured in a MECH-293-OFF arm, or it is not testing MECH-301 at all.
CONFIRMING: with MECH-285 wired to a real consumer AND run only through the newly-lifted
  waking-quiescent gate (MECH-293 disabled, isolating MECH-285's own staleness-priority sampler as
  the sole retrieval path), waking-quiescent-gated agents surface remote/non-current anchors at a
  rate and staleness-bias pattern matching the existing sleep-only arm, at above-chance rates
  relative to a shuffled-eligibility control, in a goal-relocation task with no opportunity to sleep
  before retest.
FALSIFYING: with the same wiring and the MECH-293 confound controlled out, waking-quiescent-gated
  agents show no above-chance remote-anchor surfacing during inter-trial intervals, or the
  staleness-priority pattern present in the sleep arm is absent in the waking arm (suggesting the
  routing gate, not merely state, differentiates the two contexts in a way this claim's
  "architectural gating is contextual, not state-categorical" premise denies).
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SleepReplaySampler exists but Phase B only (diagnostics, no
  consumer). MECH-092 (agent.py:11541, _do_replay) already demonstrates waking-quiescent replay is
  architecturally live in V3 via a DIFFERENT (recency/valence) selection signal -- relevant prior
  art for plausibility, not itself a substitute test. MECH-292/MECH-293 (ghost_goal_bank.py,
  module.py) are fully built and MECH-292's own falsifier already PASSed (V3-EXQ-868) but must be
  held OFF or controlled for when isolating MECH-301's own contribution.
DISPOSITION: substrate_conditional (primary). MECH-285's own downstream wiring (Phase C+) is the
  actual blocking artefact, not the sleep/waking gate the claim's notes name; until that lands there
  is no manipulation to run.

MECH-302.subject: relief.completion_event_reuses_goal_achievement_pipeline
MECH-302.title: Relief-completion event reuses goal-achievement / reward-circuit completion machinery. When a comparator on a suffering-stream derivative crosses a downward threshold (sustained suffering-reduction below baseline), the resulting event fires the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement: MECH-057a (commitment-release / beta-gate-drop), MECH-091 (salient-event phase-reset), and MECH-094 (categorical hypothesis-tag write gate). The polarity of the reinforcement is set at the input -- what counts as the completion is the suffering-derivative crossing, not a reward-onset event -- but the consolidation pipeline is shared. 'Things that just reduced suffering' are tagged in the same approach-attractor structure as 'things liked'.
MECH-302.what_would_answer:
OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG (affective neuroscience; already answered, no REE run bears on
it): that pain relief recruits the same value-coding VTA-DA / NAc-shell machinery
as appetitive reward -- Navratilova 2012 PNAS (relief activates VTA-DA + NAc-shell
DA, DA-antagonist-blockable, produces CPP; supports 0.84), Andreatta 2012
(relief->striatum / fear->amygdala cross-species double dissociation; 0.86,
LOAD-BEARING), Ramirez 2015 (active avoidance requires BA->NAc-shell; 0.78),
Tanimoto 2004 (Drosophila opponent-timing relief-as-reinforcer; 0.78), with
DA-heterogeneity qualifiers Bromberg-Martin 2010 / Brischoux 2009 (mixed ~0.80)
that motivate the comparator-not-pooled-DA trigger.
REE LEG (the testable claim): MECH-302 asserts the CONSOLIDATION PIPELINE is
SHARED, with polarity set at the input -- a relief-completion event writes into the
SAME approach-attractor tag store as goal-attainment, such that relief-paired
stimuli acquire conditioned approach with the SAME temporal-discounting profile and
the SAME downstream tag-write signature as goal-paired stimuli.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (D1) the comparator must FIRE non-vacuously in BOTH
the relief and the goal condition, at rates in the same order of magnitude. Met and
exceeded on the scheduled-curriculum substrate -- V3-EXQ-517d recorded 686.7 events
and 686.7 writes per seed in ARM_A against 0.0/0.0 in ARM_B, 3/3 seeds.
(D2) THE RELIEF EVENTS MUST BE ACTION-CONTINGENT, NOT ENVIRONMENT-SCHEDULED. This
is the precondition the whole 517 lineage evades by design. V3-EXQ-517/517a/517b
FAILed at 0-0.33 events/seed precisely because a trained avoidance policy filters
out the damage->heal trajectories the comparator needs; the SD-022 scheduled-limb-
damage curriculum rescued the run by injecting damage INDEPENDENT OF AGENT ACTION.
That fix is legitimate for testing the DETECTOR (SD-050) but makes the relief
non-contingent, and a non-contingent relief event cannot produce conditioned
approach to anything the agent DID -- there is nothing to credit. A run using
scheduled_limb_damage_* as its sole relief source is a valid SD-050 test and a
VACUOUS MECH-302 test, and must self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue on the
approach DV. Additionally inherited: SD-050's readout precondition.
WHERE MEASURED / WHY NOT ABSORBED: the DV is conditioned APPROACH to a
relief-paired cue measured in a subsequent extinction-style probe phase with the
comparator, the curriculum and the hazard all OFF -- at the behavioural output,
after consolidation, with every generating mechanism removed. Nothing downstream
can absorb it because nothing downstream is running. Two paired instruments make
the "same pipeline" assertion falsifiable rather than merely plausible: (i) the
temporal-discounting profile of approach to the relief-paired cue versus the
goal-paired cue, fitted per seed, since the claim is SAME-profile not merely
non-zero; (ii) the MECH-094 tag-write signature (tag valence, weight, residue write
address) for the two event types, compared for identity of STRUCTURE rather than of
magnitude. Recording event counts and write counts alone -- what the entire 517
lineage does -- cannot discriminate a shared pipeline from two parallel ones
producing similar counts.
CONFIRMING: in the OFF-probe phase, approach to the action-contingently-relief-
paired cue exceeds approach to a matched unpaired control cue on >=2/3 seeds by a
margin scaled on the SD of the paired delta plus an absolute floor; AND the fitted
discounting profile for the relief-paired cue lies within the seed-noise band of
the goal-paired cue's profile; AND the MECH-094 write signatures for the two event
types are structurally identical, differing only in the input-polarity field the
claim says is the ONLY licensed difference.
FALSIFYING: either (a) relief events fire action-contingently and tags are written,
but the probe phase shows no conditioned approach above the unpaired control -- the
tag store does not feed the approach attractor, so the "shared" pipeline is shared
in name only; or (b) approach IS produced but its discounting profile is separable
from goal-attainment's beyond the seed-noise band, or the write signatures differ
structurally -- which supports PARALLEL circuitry with a common output rather than
the shared-pipeline-with-input-polarity architecture the claim asserts. (b) is the
more informative refutation and the claim should be read as predicting against it.
WHAT 517c/517d DID AND DID NOT ESTABLISH: they established the PLUMBING
(comparator fires, beta-gate releases, VALENCE_LIKING write lands, none of it with
the comparator OFF -- 686.7/686.7 vs 0.0/0.0, 3/3 seeds). They did NOT establish
the CLAIM, because relief was environment-scheduled rather than action-contingent
and no approach DV was recorded. The v3_pending clearance those runs bought should
be read as scoped to the plumbing.

MECH-303.subject: safety_prediction.contextual_passive_substrate
MECH-303.title: Context-bound passive safety representation: the agent encodes 'this environment predicts absence of suffering' through sustained non-occurrence of harm, without requiring a discrete teaching event. Substrate is prefrontal-hippocampal (IL for expression gating; vHipp-to-PL-equivalent for contextual store). Update rule is diffuse and slow -- accumulated context exposure without harm drives the store. Output lowers background vigilance threshold: reduces the general avoidance commitment level when the agent is in an environment the store predicts as safe. Parallel to the 'things liked' goal-cue store but tracking suffering-absence rather than reward-presence. Sister claim to MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition pathway).
MECH-303.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The contextual-safety gate must be able to discriminate safe from unsafe contexts in the regime under test: with contextual_safety_gate_source at its z_harm_a default under SD-022 damage sourcing it cannot (measured AUC <= 0.52 at all 18 swept thresholds), so the dedicated proximity signal must be selected and its threshold set reachably. For the dissociation leg, MECH-304's store must be ON and demonstrably trained, otherwise ablating MECH-303 removes the only release path and the contrast is vacuous.
CONFIRMING: With MECH-304 intact and trained, ablating MECH-303 abolishes the safe-context background release while leaving cue-present release intact, and the intact arm shows release rates clearly above the hazardous-context arm -- the dissociation runs in both directions. Manipulation: use_contextual_safety_terrain ON versus OFF (the MECH-303 ablation) crossed with use_conditioned_safety_store ON, so contextual safety is removed while cue-specific safety is intact -- the reciprocal of the dissociation V3-EXQ-763 already ran. Control: Forced-closed and forced-open gate arms as in V3-EXQ-939a, plus a hazardous-context arm at matched seeds, and a cue-present versus cue-absent split so contextual and cue-driven release are separable within the same run. Required event: Repeated exposure to a spatial context in which harm does not occur, long enough for the safety terrain to accumulate, followed by a vigilance test in that context and in a matched hazardous context, with a cue-specific safety signal separately available. DV: Avoidance-commitment release rate in the safe context with the cue absent -- the background-vigilance readout -- contrasted between the MECH-303-ablated arm and the intact arm, with MECH-304-driven cue-present release measured in both arms as the sparing check.
FALSIFYING: With the gate demonstrably able to discriminate safe from unsafe, ablating MECH-303 leaves background release in safe contexts unchanged because the cue-specific store alone reproduces it, or the intact arm fails to separate safe from hazardous contexts -- the contextual store is not carrying a distinct signal. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ResidueField.accumulate_safety / evaluate_safety (ree_core/residue/field.py) and the release path in agent.select_action exist and are exercised; v3_exq_939a_mech303 implements the four-arm release-rate DV with a proximity-sourced gate. ConditionedSafetyStore (ree_core/safety/conditioned_safety_store.py) supplies the MECH-304 side. No driver crosses the two ablations in the MECH-303-ablated direction. Consumer / boundary: The beta-gate release threshold under contextual safety -- a diffuse lowering of background avoidance commitment, distinct from the cue-triggered release MECH-304 owns. Existing ownership: MECH-303, MECH-304, SD-052, SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING, V3-EXQ-763.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The claim's extinction-asymmetry prediction cannot discriminate: accumulate_safety calls add_residue with no decay at all, so the contextual safety terrain never extinguishes, while ConditionedSafetyStore has its own decay_rate -- the asymmetry is trivially infinite by construction rather than an emergent property. The reciprocal ablation leg is runnable but unrun. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: NEW NODE REQUIRED. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-304.subject: safety_prediction.cue_specific_conditioned_inhibition_substrate
MECH-304.title: Cue-specific conditioned safety prediction: a discrete predictive structure encodes 'this stimulus actively predicts that suffering will be omitted', updated by explicit MECH-302 relief-completion events as its teaching signal. Encoding substrate is cortico-striatal (dorsal striatum + dlPFC). Expression/output pathway is IL-to-CeA. This is the conditioned-inhibition mechanism: when a specific cue co-occurs with relief, a separate learned prediction forms that can gate avoidance commitment release when the cue is later present. Sister claim to MECH-303 (contextual passive safety representation).
MECH-304.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-302 relief-completion events must actually fire so the store has a teaching signal, the cue channel must be controllable and the store prototype populated (V3-EXQ-759's positive-control AUC 0.997 and populated-prototype gates), and the arm-A positive-control release rate must clear its floor so the avoidance-commitment DV has dynamic range in the absence of any safety signal.
CONFIRMING: With the cue present concurrently with a threat cue, avoidance-commitment release is higher than in the store-OFF arm and higher than with an untrained cue, while contextual release is spared under store ablation -- the classical conditioned-inhibition signature with its dissociation control. Manipulation: use_conditioned_safety_store ON versus OFF (store necessity) crossed with cue-present versus a non-trained cue at test (cue specificity), with use_contextual_safety_terrain held ON as the MECH-303 sparing arm. Control: The store-OFF arm is the necessity control and the untrained-cue arm the specificity control; the MECH-303-intact arm is the dissociation control, and an orthogonal-class positive control anchors the isolation-level readout. Required event: A specific cue co-occurring with a MECH-302 relief-completion event during teaching, followed at test by that cue presented CONCURRENTLY with a threat cue while an avoidance commitment is active. DV: Avoidance-commitment release rate with the safety cue present concurrently with a threat cue, against store-OFF and against the untrained cue (the store-necessity and cue-specificity gaps), plus contextual release rate in the same run as the MECH-303 sparing readout.
FALSIFYING: Under the same preconditions, the trained safety cue fails to lower avoidance commitment relative to store-OFF or to an untrained cue, or store ablation also abolishes contextual release (no dissociation) -- the cue-specific pathway is not a separate system from the contextual one. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/safety/conditioned_safety_store.py (ConditionedSafetyStore, EMA prototype, decay, cosine threshold) with its release path gating beta_gate; v3_exq_763 implements both load-bearing DVs and the dissociation arm; v3_exq_759 supplies the frozen-agent predict() discriminability readout. SD-065 (controllable cue channel) and SD-066 (centered readout) landed 2026-07-15. Consumer / boundary: The IL-to-CeA-analog expression route: the cue-conditional lowering of the avoidance-commitment release threshold, distinct from the diffuse contextual tone MECH-303 owns. Existing ownership: MECH-304, SD-051, SD-065, SD-066, MECH-302.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); Nothing blocks the V3 falsifier: both pre-registered gates were executed and passed (V3-EXQ-759 isolation, 6/6 seeds above chance; V3-EXQ-763 behavioural, both DVs including the MECH-303 sparing arm), on a landed substrate with its cue channel and centered readout. Only the enrichment axes are not runnable. Secondary classes: R8. Gap disposition: NO GAP -- FALSE POSITIVE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-305.subject: harm_stream.controllability_weighted_affective_load
MECH-305.title: z_harm_a requires a controllability-modulated weighting term beyond MECH-219 temporal hysteresis: perceived uncontrollability or inescapability amplifies the affective load integrator, while perceived controllability suppresses it. Biological locus is dorsal ACC, which integrates noxious stimulus input with controllability context and projects to the medial suffering pathway (ACC/insula, overlapping with salience network).
MECH-305.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The controllability signal must be ENDOGENOUS -- derived from the agent's own avoidance action-outcome history -- or the test measures a scripted schedule rather than perceived controllability; both existing drivers use the external mode. The gated state must also reach a consumer: V3-EXQ-957's red-team found the accumulator's output is a dead-end register with every harm_suffering_redirect_ flag off.
CONFIRMING: At matched harm dose with an endogenous efficacy signal witnessed to diverge between arms, affective load and avoidance urgency are higher under persistent avoidance failure than under reliable avoidance, and the difference vanishes in the gate-ablated arm. Manipulation: Set harm_suffering_escapability_mode to avoidance_efficacy so the gate g = 1 - escapability is driven by the SD-058 InstrumentalAvoidanceGate's eligibility-trace efficacy estimate, with use_instrumental_avoidance and use_harm_suffering_accumulator both ON, against a MECH-305-ablated arm at escapability held constant. Control: The ablated arm is pure temporal integration (escapability constant, gate inert) at matched harm dose and matched avoidance attempt counts, so a load difference cannot be attributed to differing harm exposure or differing action budgets. Required event: Sustained harm exposure under two contingency regimes at matched harm dose: avoidance actions that reliably reduce harm (escapable) versus avoidance actions that persistently fail (inescapable). DV: The affective load magnitude and its downstream avoidance urgency under inescapable versus escapable contingency at matched harm dose -- for this claim as written, the gain on z_harm_a itself, which is NOT the quantity the built gate modulates.
FALSIFYING: With the same contingency divergence witnessed, load is equal in both regimes -- pure temporal integration accounts for it and no controllability weighting is required beyond MECH-219 hysteresis. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: A controllability-gated integrator exists but one stage downstream: ree_core/affect/harm_suffering_accumulator.py accumulates z_harm_suffering from z_harm_un with g = 1 - escapability, and harm_suffering_escapability_mode already offers the endogenous avoidance_efficacy source. z_harm_a itself carries no controllability gain term; it enters only optionally via harm_suffering_body_damage_weight, default 0.0. Consumer / boundary: The claim asserts the gain on the z_harm_a affective-load integrator; the substrate applies controllability at the derived z_harm_suffering state, and that state currently has no live consumer. Existing ownership: MECH-219, SD-019b, SD-058, V3-EXQ-957, V3-EXQ-962, EXP-0959.
DISPOSITION: R6 (primary); The controllability gate exists at the wrong locus: it modulates the derived z_harm_suffering accumulator, not z_harm_a's own gain, and that accumulator's output is a dead-end register with all redirect consumers off. Both existing drivers script escapability externally rather than sourcing it from the built avoidance-efficacy estimate, and at defaults the whole path is inert (escapability constant 1.0 gives g = 0). Secondary classes: R4, R5. Gap disposition: INSTRUMENT EXISTS BUT WRONG LOCUS/TIMESCALE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-306.subject: goal_seeding.sustained_drive_trace
MECH-306.title: z_goal seeding under SD-012 requires sustained drive at contact, not instantaneous homeostatic drive alone: when the agent is well-fed, drive_level collapses at consumption and anti-correlates with benefit_exposure, so effective_benefit cannot cross the seeding threshold unless drive is floored or slow-traced.
MECH-306.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Contacts must occur inside the measurement window -- V3-EXQ-582's post_warmup_cut=100 arm recorded zero contacts and therefore tested nothing -- and the drive input must be non-degenerate at contact. The EMA lever alone cannot lift a consistently near-zero input (drive_trace_at_contact 0.0002 to 0.005 at every alpha including 0.01), so a floor arm is required for the comparison to discriminate at all.
CONFIRMING: The floored arm's mean effective benefit at contact clears benefit_threshold with a non-zero seeding count on all seeds while the unfloored arm seeds zero times, replicated on an evidence-purpose run -- V3-EXQ-627 PASS, exp_conf 0.773, evidence_direction supports. Manipulation: GoalConfig.drive_floor set to 0.9 (sustained arm) versus 0.0 (OFF arm), with drive_ema_alpha held at 1.0 -- the V3-EXQ-627 two-arm ablation; the predecessor V3-EXQ-582/582a swept alpha and floor monotonically. Control: The OFF arm (drive_floor=0.0, drive_ema_alpha=1.0), which is bit-identical to the pre-amendment instantaneous-drive path and must seed zero times; matched seeds across arms. Required event: A resource-contact and consumption step at which agent_energy resets and instantaneous drive_level = 1 - agent_energy collapses toward zero, immediately followed by the z_goal seeding test in GoalState.update(). DV: Mean effective_benefit at contact measured against benefit_threshold (0.1), the count of z_goal seedings per seed, and z_goal_active_fraction -- 582a operating point: 0.115 versus the 0.08 gate, 3/3 seeds seeding, active fraction 0.081, OFF arm zero seedings.
FALSIFYING: The floored arm seeds no more often than the unfloored arm (drive is not the binding term at contact), or seeding fires in the unfloored arm as well (the anti-correlation diagnosis was wrong), or a pre-registered combined floor-plus-EMA arm shows the floor's effect is an artifact of the trace rather than of the floor. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: GoalState.update() in ree-v3/ree_core/goal.py -- drive_level_floored = max(drive_level, self.config.drive_floor) at line 893 and the EMA at line 899; contracts test_drive_floor_gap3_opt2.py and test_sustained_drive_ema_gap3.py; scoring driver v3_exq_627_mech306_sustained_drive_trace_validation.py (experiment_purpose=evidence, claim_ids [MECH-306]). Consumer / boundary: The SD-012 drive-multiplier site inside GoalState.update, upstream of z_goal seeding -- explicitly NOT behaviour, and explicitly not a promotion of SD-012 or MECH-295. Existing ownership: SD-012, MECH-216, goal_pipeline:GAP-3, goal_pipeline:GAP-4.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); R0: the substrate, the flags, the contracts and an evidence-purpose two-arm ablation all exist and the falsifier has run and passed. The only residual is breadth -- a single genuine experiment with lit_conf on the biology side only -- which is a confidence matter, not a runnability gap. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: NO GAP -- FALSE POSITIVE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-307.subject: affect.anticipatory_conjunction_architecture
MECH-307.title: Anticipatory positive affect (excitement) and anticipatory negative affect (dread) emerge as derived states from the conjunction of (a) signed VALENCE_SURPRISE, (b) MECH-216 schema readout coupled to z_beta arousal, (c) anticipatory VALENCE_LIKING write at predicted-imminent-positive-event locations, and (d) MECH-216 writes at predicted rather than current location. Four-gap substrate amendment to MECH-216 + MECH-205 + the residue valence buffer, NOT a new VALENCE channel.
MECH-307.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The agent must forage above the competence floor: resource contact and approach must occur often enough that the anticipatory conjunction (wanting + anticipatory liking + positive surprise + z_beta arousal at the predicted location) forms at all. V3-EXQ-899 measured the opposite on the full onboarding config -- G0 foraging readiness 0/3 seeds with MECH-307 ON and OFF alike.
CONFIRMING: With foraging competence cleared, conjunction-state locations receive at least 1.5x the replay frequency of the uniform-priority baseline and elevated ghost priority relative to a staleness-only baseline, with anticipation writes spatially offset from contact writes. Manipulation: use_mech307_conjunction ON/OFF (master resolver flipping split-surprise, schema multichannel and predicted-location write), with the Path B consumer read held ON in every arm so the manipulation is the conjunction write, not the reader. Control: MECH-307-OFF arm on the identical substrate and seeds, plus a location-shuffled control in which the conjunction is written at a random z_world rather than at e1_prior, which removes any effect attributable to extra write volume. Required event: A predicted-imminent positive event: the agent occupies an approach state from which E1's forward pass predicts a resource location, before contact occurs. DV: Replay frequency at conjunction-state locations relative to a uniform-priority baseline (the claim's own >= 1.5x Adcock prediction), and the spatial offset between anticipation writes (predicted location) and outcome writes (contact location).
FALSIFYING: Conjunction-state locations receive replay and ghost priority indistinguishable from the location-shuffled control, or the anticipation writes are not spatially separable from consummatory writes, which would mean the four-gap fix produces no detectable derived state and the SD-014 six-channel fallback is the better architecture. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: residue/field.py carries VALENCE_POSITIVE_SURPRISE / VALENCE_NEGATIVE_SURPRISE at VALENCE_DIM=6 and mech295_liking_bridge.compute_conjunction_score_bias reads the conjunction, but replay priority does NOT: test_do_replay_drive_state_width pins the MECH-307 split channels at ZERO replay-drive weight in both flag states, so the sleep-replay DV has no recorder. Consumer / boundary: The write side of the residue valence field at the E1-predicted z_world, and the downstream consumers that read the conjunction -- MECH-205 replay priority, MECH-292 ghost priority and the MECH-295 approach cue. Existing ownership: MECH-229, MECH-457, mech457_competence_bootstrap_explorer, GFLAG-0100, goal_pipeline_plan:GAP-1, MECH-205.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The behavioural regime never arrives: G0 foraging readiness failed 4 times (866/866a/866c/899) and 899's single-variable A/B showed MECH-307 ON and OFF fail identically, so the conjunction rarely fires. Independently, the split-surprise channels carry zero replay-drive weight by deliberate pin, so the claim's headline replay-priority DV has no live consumer. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-308.subject: language.acquisition_tracks_play_mode
MECH-308.title: Language acquisition tracks play_mode maturation: socially-grounded compositional language emerges as a specialised game type instantiated within play_mode (INV-058 / MECH-194 / ARC-049), not via a parallel language-acquisition substrate. The basic expression catalog (play pose, head tilt, laughter, mutual gaze, distress vocalisation, approach cue, vocal mimicry, pointing) acts as the bilateral frame-opening signal; conversational violations function as synthetic z_harm; utterance-as-goal acts as synthetic z_goal; proto-symbols accrete as conditional modifiers attached to basic-expression channels. Predicts that systems trained without play_mode-like episodes fail to acquire socially-grounded compositional language even when pattern-matching imitation succeeds.
MECH-308.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Future social/developmental substrate must instantiate the named frame or distinct other-agent state endogenously; a manually supplied scalar or training warmup is not that event.
CONFIRMING: Play maturation precedes and selectively supports compositional transfer Manipulation: Vary play maturation while holding language exposure constant Control: Matched exposure without play and noncompositional signalling Required event: Progression through socially grounded play and compositional communication DV: Held-out compositional communication success and its temporal relation to play maturation
FALSIFYING: Compositional competence develops independently of play maturation under adequate social/exposure controls A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: No appropriate full-claim V3 instrument. Required future/external recorder: Held-out compositional communication success and its temporal relation to play maturation. Consumer / boundary: Future multi-agent/developmental or external biological boundary specified by the claim; no substitution by a single-agent scalar. Existing ownership: MECH-308, ARC-049.
DISPOSITION: R8 (primary); Current V3 single-agent environment lacks the social/play event and its independent ground truth. Existing social/play architecture owns the requirement; no pull-forward or build authorised. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-309.subject: policy.monomodal_collapse_as_equilibrium_without_rule_apprehender
MECH-309.title: Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.
MECH-309.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The agent must be competent enough for two regimes to be distinguishable at all -- above the resources-per-episode floor and surviving the hazard stage -- and the committed-class DV must have headroom above the F-dominance conversion ceiling. 719a measured competence below floor on 3/3 seeds, so an ARM_1-equals-ARM_0 result is uninformative.
CONFIRMING: Under a competence-cleared, ceiling-lifted condition, ARM_1 clears the committed-class diversity criterion where ARM_0 does not, on the same SD-054 substrate. Manipulation: Gated-policy heads with a learned context discriminator (use_gated_policy, ree_core/policy/gated_policy.py), optionally with the ARC-063 CandidateRuleField, against a single-head baseline at identical training budget. Control: ARM_0 single-head baseline at matched budget and seeds, plus the EXQ-522 hand-coded reef-aware heuristic as the substrate-ceiling positive control establishing that the substrate itself carries ~50/50 occupancy and ~49 zone transitions. Required event: Trained episodes on the SD-054 reef substrate in which both regimes are individually viable: a hazard-proximate reef-flee regime and a hazard-distant forage regime, each reachable and each paying off. DV: reef_visit_fraction in [0.3, 0.7] and zone_transitions_per_episode at least 5x ARM_0, with the SD-029 C0 trials-sufficient gate passing on 3/4 seeds -- and competence (resources per episode) reported as a gate, not assumed.
FALSIFYING: Under that same post-ceiling-lift, competence-cleared condition, a gated-policy ARM_1 still fails to produce diverse committed-class behaviour relative to ARM_0 -- i.e. the missing capacity is not rule apprehension at the policy layer. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: gated_policy.py and candidate_rule_field.py emit head-selection and rule-match telemetry, and the 654 lineage drivers record reef_visit_fraction and zone transitions; the missing reading is a per-run competence gate upstream of them. Consumer / boundary: Policy-head selection feeding E3 candidate scoring -- the rule-apprehension slot -- not the E3 committed argmin, which the F-dominance ceiling already saturates. Existing ownership: arc_062_rule_apprehension:GAP-B, ARC-062, f_dominance_conversion_ceiling, MECH-457, GFLAG-0271.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The falsifier has been run six times and never reached a discriminating regime. C1 readiness clears, C2 committed-class entropy fails, and 719a localised the root as competence, not selection: a thin 90-episode bias-head-only REINFORCE on a frozen encoder leaves the agent below the foraging floor, so ARM_1 equals ARM_0 for reasons that have nothing to do with rule apprehension. Secondary classes: R1, R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's prescribed next action -- implement-substrate on the GAP-A gain/contrast amend or the ARC-108/MECH-450 settling line -- was superseded by the confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-719a_2026-07-08, which made the first direct competence measurement (0.065/0.0/0.455 resources per episode, below the 1.0 floor) and relocated the dominant diagnosis from a further selection lever to a behavioural-competence / training-regime ceiling. Both named routes are now parked behind MECH-457 + INV-088 (conversion_ceiling_campaign:P4-learned-gating, :GENERATION). Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-312.subject: policy.rule_arbitration_multi_variable_multi_channel_dynamic_within_session
MECH-312.title: rule_arbitration_multi_variable_multi_channel_dynamic_within_session. Parent claim for the multi-variable, multi-channel, dynamic-within-session arbitration that selects between competing rules / policy modes / action sources at the policy layer. Arbitration is governed by at least four distinct sub-mechanisms (MECH-312a/b/c/d), each falsifiable independently, with a candidate fifth (controllability/agency) deferred pending V3 substrate availability. Recommended combination rule: multiplicative gate (per-channel softmax of reliability * cost * agency * V_s * practice_maturity products) per Pull 3 R4 verdict; falsified against additive-logit baseline in V3-EXQ-543b/c. Reframed 2026-05-10 from earlier dual-channel-arbitration sketch following Pull 3 SYNTHESIS R5 SUB-MECH SPLIT recommendation (conf 0.78).
MECH-312.what_would_answer:
MECH-312 is the PARENT claim for the arbitration COMBINATION RULE across
the four registered sub-mechanisms (MECH-312a uncertainty/reliability,
MECH-312b practice/maturity, MECH-312c affective-stream modulation,
MECH-312d V_s freshness) plus the deferred candidate fifth (MECH-312e
agency, not yet registered). Each sub-mech carries its own independent
falsifier (see MECH-312a/b/c/d functional_restatement); THIS claim's own
scientific content is narrower and sits one level up -- whether the
architectural-default MULTIPLICATIVE GATE (per-channel softmax of
reliability * cost * agency * V_s * practice_maturity) outperforms the
falsifying ADDITIVE-LOGIT baseline, per the Pull 3 R4 verdict (conf 0.74).
Do not conflate a sub-mech-level result with a verdict on this parent --
a sub-mech confirming its own weighting channel says nothing about which
combination rule integrates the channels.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (currently UNMET; a run that fails this must
self-route substrate_not_ready, not count as a verdict):
  (1) MECH-312 and all four registered sub-mechs are v3_pending --
      implementation_phase v3 names an active DESIGN target, not
      something buildable on the substrate as it stands
      (rule_apprehension_layer.md).
  (2) The live gated-policy substrate (ree_core/policy/gated_policy.py)
      is the ARC-062 Phase-1 single-scalar two-head gate
      (w*h0 + (1-w)*h1) -- it has no multi-channel multiplicative-gate
      implementation to test AGAINST an additive-logit alternative.
  (3) This claim's own cited falsification vehicle is a MIS-CITATION:
      V3-EXQ-543b/c are tagged ARC-062/MECH-309/SD-029 (both FAIL) and
      never tested the arbitration combination rule. Do not treat a
      future re-read of 543b/c as evidence either way; requeue a
      purpose-built combination-rule probe instead.
  (4) The proximate substrate blocker is arc_062_rule_apprehension:GAP-B
      (the ARC-063 rule-creator/discriminator that would populate
      DIFFERENTIATED competing rule states). GAP-B remains in-progress
      as of the most recent plan update (2026-08-01, failure-autopsy of
      V3-EXQ-851): without differentiated rule states to arbitrate
      between, a combination-rule probe is VACUOUS (trivial-prediction
      hazard) regardless of outcome. GAP-B additionally names the
      separate MECH-439 F-dominance conversion-ceiling issue as a second
      precondition once differentiated rule states exist -- a run that
      reaches committed action without the arbitration weights actually
      moving the committed argmax is re-deriving that ceiling, not
      adjudicating MECH-312.
  (5) MECH-312 has zero entries in claim_evidence.v1.json -- there is no
      prior partial evidence to weigh against a new run; this is a
      from-scratch test once the substrate exists.
CONFIRMING signature (once non-degeneracy is met): on a substrate with
>= 2 differentiated, arbitrable rule states and a wired multi-channel
gate, action-selection under the multiplicative-gate arm diverges from
the additive-logit arm specifically at low-confidence single-factor
regimes -- i.e. when one channel (e.g. low reliability) is weak, the
multiplicative arm suppresses overall arbitration trust for that rule
(logical-AND behaviour) while the additive arm still lets another
strong channel dominate (logical-OR behaviour). This divergence should
be attributable to the gate's functional FORM, not to which individual
sub-mech channel happens to be strongest that trial.
FALSIFYING signature: the multiplicative and additive arms produce
statistically indistinguishable action-selection signatures across the
low-confidence-single-factor regime, OR the additive-logit arm matches
or outperforms multiplicative on the architecture's own selection
criteria -- either would falsify the Pull 3 R4 multiplicative-gate
recommendation as architectural default and reopen the combination-rule
question.

MECH-312a.subject: policy.arbitration.uncertainty_reliability_weighting
MECH-312a.title: uncertainty_reliability_weighting (Daw_2005_Lee_2014_dual_systems_arbitration_analog). Arbitration weight tracks the inverse-uncertainty / reliability of each candidate rule or policy mode; high-reliability sources receive higher arbitration weight. Biological substrate: model-based / model-free dual-systems arbitration (Daw et al. 2005 Nat Neurosci; Lee et al. 2014 Neuron). LOW divergence from existing literature; direct mapping. Sub-claim of MECH-312.
MECH-312a.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Two candidate sources must carry INDEPENDENT reliability estimates and the arbitration weight must not be an analytic function of their difference. SD-081 fails this second half by construction -- w is a deterministic sigmoid of (u_habit_n - u_planned_n), so rho(w, relative uncertainty) = 1.0 is a tautology, not a measurement. A real test needs reliability manipulated at the SOURCE (a rule whose recent exception rate is driven experimentally) and weight read downstream.
CONFIRMING: Arbitration weight ratio tracks the independently-measured reliability ratio monotonically when reliability is manipulated at source, and the uniform-weighting arm shows a flat ratio under the same manipulation. Manipulation: Drive the recent exception rate of one candidate up while holding the other's fixed, and separately toggle the arbitration channel (use_dualsystem_arbitration ON/OFF at the policy-mode locus; uniform-weighting comparator at the rule locus). Control: Uniform-weighting arm (arbitration OFF), plus a reliability-matched arm in which both candidates carry the same exception rate, so a weight difference cannot arise from the candidates' identity. Required event: Trials in which two candidate rules or policy modes are simultaneously eligible and their reliabilities have been driven apart -- one recently failing, one consistently succeeding -- under otherwise matched context. DV: Ratio of arbitration weight assigned to the high-reliability versus low-reliability candidate, regressed on the measured reliability ratio; slope must be positive and monotonic, with the OFF arm flat.
FALSIFYING: Arbitration weight is invariant to source-manipulated reliability, or tracks it non-monotonically, on a substrate where reliability is decoupled from practice-maturity. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: e3_selector.last_arbitration records w_planned, u_habit_raw/norm, u_planned_raw/norm and a degeneracy flag per tick, so the policy-mode readout exists. At the rule locus CandidateRule carries only a single scalar `availability` (support net of exceptions) plus eligibility/minted_step -- no separate reliability channel and no per-rule arbitration-weight readout. Consumer / boundary: The arbitration weight applied between simultaneously eligible candidates -- CandidateRuleField.gate_and_select / active_rule_state for rules, and the habit-versus-planned blend in E3 for policy modes. Existing ownership: MECH-312, MECH-477, SD-081, arc_062_rule_apprehension:GAP-B, LIT-0963.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); Two distinct blocks. At the rule locus CandidateRule holds one conflated availability scalar, so reliability cannot be separated from MECH-312b maturity. At the policy-mode locus SD-081 exists but its weight is an analytic sigmoid of the uncertainty difference, so tracking is true by construction and does not discriminate. Secondary classes: R5, R4. Gap disposition: INSTRUMENT EXISTS BUT WRONG LOCUS/TIMESCALE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's blocker -- 'no second, independent uncertainty channel exists, so 312a and 312b cannot be discriminated' -- has landed at the policy-mode locus the claim's own title includes. SD-081/MECH-477's _arbitrate_dual_system (e3_selector.py, ree-v3 4472811, 2026-07-22) computes w = sigmoid(gain*(u_habit_n - u_planned_n) + bias) from two independent uncertainty channels and exposes it per tick via last_arbitration, validated by V3-EXQ-811a (PASS). The 2026-08-27 digestion pass that last touched this WWA post-dates that landing by five weeks and missed it. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-312b.subject: policy.arbitration.practice_maturity_weighting
MECH-312b.title: practice_maturity_weighting (Smith_Graybiel_habit_takeover_analog). Arbitration weight tracks practice-maturity / habit-strength of each candidate rule or policy mode; well-practiced behaviour receives higher arbitration weight via a habit-takeover dynamic. Biological substrate: dorsolateral striatum habit consolidation (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016); successor-representation maturation (Stachenfeld et al. 2017). LOW-MEDIUM divergence; partial mapping (the maturity dimension is well-anchored; the integration into a multi-channel arbitration layer is more REE-specific). Sub-claim of MECH-312.
MECH-312b.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Practice-maturity and reliability must be experimentally decoupled -- a high-practice candidate that is currently failing and a low-practice candidate that is currently succeeding must both exist and both be eligible. Without that decoupling any weight-tracks-practice result is confounded with MECH-312a reliability.
CONFIRMING: Proposal weight rises monotonically with accumulated practice count at fixed reliability, and the uniform-weighting comparator shows a flat relationship under the same manipulation. Manipulation: Vary the number of corroborating real executions a candidate has accumulated (crystallisation_counter / R_min) while holding its outcome-consistency fixed, and toggle practice-weighting against uniform weighting. Control: Uniform-weighting arm, plus a practice-matched arm where both candidates carry the same execution count, so any weight difference must come from something other than practice. Required event: Selection ticks on which a high-practice candidate (many corroborated real executions) and a low-practice candidate are simultaneously eligible in the same context bucket. DV: Arbitration / proposal weight assigned to each candidate regressed on its accumulated practice count, at fixed reliability; the claim predicts a positive monotonic slope across the practice range, not a single threshold step.
FALSIFYING: Proposal weight is invariant to practice count, tracks it non-monotonically, or is fully explained by the binary crystallisation threshold with no graded component, on a substrate where practice and reliability are decoupled. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ChunkedPrimitive exposes crystallisation_counter, formation_timestamp, state, selection_weight, n_reacquisitions and reacquisition_repetitions, and ChunkLibrary sorts the pool by selection_weight -- so practice IS recorded and IS consumed. But selection_weight is set to 0.0 or 1.0 by lifecycle transition, so the graded practice-to-weight function the claim asserts cannot be read off it. CandidateRule carries no practice count at all. Consumer / boundary: The proposal-pool weight on a candidate at selection time -- ChunkLibrary selection_weight for crystallised chunks, and CandidateRuleField availability gating for rules. Existing ownership: MECH-312, MECH-323, MECH-324, GFLAG-0110, arc_062_rule_apprehension:GAP-B, LIT-0964.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The maturity signal exists and is consumed, but only through a binary lifecycle gate: selection_weight is 0.0 or 1.0 (policy_chunking.py:1279, 1540, 1553, 1579) so monotonic tracking has no dynamic range to be measured in. CandidateRule itself carries no practice channel, and no experiment manipulates practice at fixed reliability. Secondary classes: R5, R1. Gap disposition: INSTRUMENT EXISTS BUT WRONG LOCUS/TIMESCALE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Two named items resolved. (1) The 'pending the MECH-317/ARC-071 merge review' clause is closed -- GFLAG-0110 was adjudicated 2026-09-01 (MOVE) and depends_on now reads MECH-312/MECH-323/MECH-324. (2) The WWA proposes sourcing maturity from the chunk-crystallisation count as a future fix, but that accumulator already exists and is already live in the candidate pool: ChunkedPrimitive.crystallisation_counter is maintained by ChunkAccumulator and crystallised chunks are spliced into the proposal pool (hippocampal/module.py:1300, 2565). The residual block is narrower and different -- selection_weight is a STEP function of lifecycle state (0 -> 1.0 at crystallisation, linear decay while DISSOLVING), not a graded function of practice count. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-312c.subject: policy.arbitration.affective_stream_modulation_ree_novel
MECH-312c.title: affective_stream_modulation_of_arbitration_REE_novel. Arbitration weight is modulated by affective stream load: when the SD-010 / SD-011 affective stream produces high load (high salience harm or affect), the arbitration layer routes more weight to rules associated with affect-laden context, suppressing arbitration weight on neutral-context rules. The REE-novel claim is the FUNCTIONAL CONSEQUENCE: dual-stream architecture (SD-010/SD-011) is well-anchored in Murray-Rudebeck 2018 and Pessoa-Adolphs 2010, but the modulation of rule-arbitration weights by affective-stream load is REE-specific (MEDIUM-HIGH divergence). Sub-claim of MECH-312.
MECH-312c.what_would_answer:
On a substrate where affective load varies (SD-054 extended with affect-cue conditions), arbitration weight should show interaction effects with affect load: rules previously deployed under high-affect conditions should receive higher weight when affect re-elevates. MECH-312c-OFF agents should show flat arbitration across affect conditions.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (verified current): the dual-stream structural substrate (SD-010/SD-011) is landed and stable -- this part is NOT blocking. Two things are: (1) SD-054 has no affect-variable condition yet; (2) CandidateRuleField carries no affect-weighted channel or context-tag- by-affect distinction -- context_tag is a generic cosine-matched cue vector with no explicit affect dimension. Both must be built before this claim is testable, in addition to the shared GAP-B rule_state-differentiation precondition (met) and the downstream conversion-ceiling clearance (unmet).
Clinical corollary (mood-congruent decision-bias prediction) flagged for V4/clinical-substrate work, not currently V3-testable even once the above lands.
[2026-08-27 thought-digestion]: same stale ARC-063 note as MECH-312a/b. No other staleness found -- the 'EXQ design deferred' framing is still accurate.

MECH-312d.subject: policy.arbitration.v_s_freshness_modulation_per_region_ree_novel
MECH-312d.title: V_s_freshness_modulation_per_region_REE_novel. Arbitration weight is modulated per-region by V_s freshness (the per-region staleness scalar from MECH-269 / MECH-284 / MECH-287); rules associated with stale regions receive lower arbitration trust, regardless of their reliability or practice. HIGH divergence (REE-novel per-region scope + rule-trust function): Behrens 2007 ACC volatility and Bouton 2004 contextual renewal are nearest cousins, but per-region continuous scalar + arbitration-trust routing are REE-specific. Sub-claim of MECH-312.
MECH-312d.what_would_answer:
On a substrate with region-specific staleness induction (SD-054 extended with reef-config rotation that ages V_s on previously-active reef regions), arbitration weight on rules previously deployed in those regions should drop monotonically with V_s freshness. MECH-312d-OFF agents should show invariant arbitration weight despite V_s drift.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (verified current, materially UPDATED from this claim's own note): MECH-269/284/287 are further along than the evidence_ quality_note suggests -- MECH-284 and MECH-287 were promoted to provisional on 2026-07-14 (after this claim's as_of: 2026-07-11 live_status stamp), so the upstream V_s-freshness substrate is now more mature, not still purely candidate. What remains missing: (1) any consumption path routing a per-region freshness scalar into CandidateRuleField arbitration weight (no such wiring found in candidate_rule_field.py), and (2) the region- staleness-induction substrate itself (multi-reef-configuration rotation), still absent.
FALSIFYING signature (post-substrate, post-conversion-ceiling-clearance): arbitration weight on stale-region-derived rules matches fresh-region rules despite measured V_s divergence.
[2026-08-27 thought-digestion]: same stale ARC-063 note as the rest of the family; PLUS a positive update the claim doesn't yet reflect -- MECH-284/ 287's 2026-07-14 promotion to provisional, the strongest upstream-readiness improvement found anywhere in this group.

MECH-313.subject: policy.stochastic_noise_floor_lc_ne_tonic_analog
MECH-313.title: stochastic_noise_floor (max_entropy_policy_regularisation_LC_NE_tonic_analog). A floor-level stochastic action-selection noise that prevents complete deterministic collapse of the policy. Biological substrate: locus coeruleus tonic firing producing baseline action-selection variability (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 adaptive-gain model). Computational analog: max-entropy policy regularisation / SAC entropy bonus (Haarnoja et al. 2018). Distinct from MECH-260 dACC anti-recency: MECH-313 is a state-independent noise floor, while MECH-260 is a state-dependent recency penalty. Both can contribute to anti-monostrategy pressure but operate via different mechanisms; whether they collapse into a single substrate or are mutually load-bearing is open (Q-045).
MECH-313.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires the MECH-457 competence-floor
substrate to clear first -- V3-EXQ-687a (2026-07-30) already found all
4 arms of the Q-045 design failing committed_sufficiency at the
absolute floor, which is a readiness failure shared with the whole
committed-behaviour campaign (MECH-260/Q-045 co-tagged), NOT a
discrimination result; this claim is not independently re-queueable
until MECH-457 clears. Also requires the 4-arm design (both-OFF /
313-only / 260-only / both-ON) to reach adequate N once readiness is
met -- the N=1-per-cell cross-substrate signals already on file
(603/603a/603b/605, all same-direction, all sub-threshold) are
suggestive but explicitly not sufficient per this claim's own notes.
CONFIRMING signature (this claim's own stated FALSIFIER, restated):
on the SD-054 reef substrate with ARC-062 gated-policy enabled,
behaviour diversity (action-distribution entropy at probe states;
reef/forage occupancy CoV across seeds) ranks both-ON > {313-only,
260-only} > both-OFF at adequate N -- the two mechanisms (MECH-313
state-independent noise floor, MECH-260 state-dependent recency
penalty) are mutually load-bearing. If 313-only alone matches
both-ON, MECH-260 is contributory-not-necessary; if 260-only alone
matches both-ON, MECH-313 is contributory-not-necessary (this is
Q-045's question, answered by the same design).
FALSIFYING: both-OFF does NOT collapse to monomodal behaviour (some
OTHER anti-monostrategy mechanism is doing the work, independent of
both); or 313-only produces no measurable entropy lift over both-OFF
at adequate N -- would corroborate the co-equal NULL reading carried
since the 2026-07-09 GOV-CEIL-1 demotion ("the LC-NE noise floor is
inert / does no work").
CURRENT STATUS: CONTESTED candidate since 2026-07-09 (7 confirmed
substrate_ceiling autopsies: 573/603c/603d/603e/610f/655/687) -- the
competing null reading is carried CO-EQUALLY.

MECH-314.subject: policy.structured_curiosity_bonus_parent
MECH-314.title: structured_curiosity_bonus (frontopolar_uncertainty_driven_exploration_expected_free_energy_analog). A reward bonus on action-selection that rewards information-gain or uncertainty-reduction, distinct from a state-independent noise floor (MECH-313). Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature) operating jointly with striatal novelty (Wittmann et al. 2008 Neuron). Three sub-flavours (MECH-314a/b/c) that the lit-pull recommended NOT to collapse prematurely: striatal novelty (Wittmann anchor), frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity (Daw anchor), learning-progress / intrinsic-motivation curiosity (Schmidhuber/Pathak tradition). Active-inference (Friston 2010/2015 expected free energy) provides the formal-level unification. Q-044 captures the open question of whether the three sub-flavours are distinct substrates or three readings of one mechanism with different upstream inputs.
MECH-314.what_would_answer:
MECH-314 is falsified in the direction of 'the structured-curiosity-bonus mechanism does not exist / is not load-bearing' if, on a substrate where the single-arena F-dominance conversion ceiling has genuinely lifted, a parametric sweep of the MECH-314 weight against the MECH-313 noise-floor weight FAILS to produce a Pareto frontier on behavioural-diversity-vs-task- reward (Q-043's DV), and/or a three-arm sub-flavour ablation (314a-OFF / 314b-OFF / 314c-OFF vs. all-on) fails to produce THREE DISTINCT failure signatures once each sub-flavour is genuinely per-candidate.
Until the shared single-arena ceiling lifts, a null result on ANY such retest is NOT informative about MECH-314 itself (the standing brake-lock finding from the 705b/706b autopsy cluster) -- it only becomes a genuine test once the readiness gates (GAP-A pool divergence, curiosity-bias non- degeneracy, and selection-authority genuinely moving the argmin) are simultaneously met. Cross-references MECH-314a/b/c's own falsifiers rather than re-deriving them; Q-044 is the standing open question this retest resolves.
[2026-08-27 thought-digestion]: this claim's ceiling_retest_binding_ substrate note (2026-07-01) calls the MECH-448/449/ARC-107 substrate 'unbuilt' -- it was actually built+validated+promoted (provisional) by 2026-06-22, nine days before the note was written. The cross-loop arbitration-REWEIGHTING route specifically (V3-EXQ-709/711/713) was tried and found EXHAUSTED 2026-07-05, routing to MECH-448's fixed selection-face lever as the campaign's route of record. A corrected measurement instrument (GateDVRecorder, ree-v3 c309bc6486, 2026-08-19) has since landed but sits governance_held (2026-08-21). None of this newer activity has produced a lift; disposition unchanged. Governance flag raised separately for the stale binding-substrate note.

MECH-314a.subject: policy.curiosity.novelty_bonus_striatal_analog
MECH-314a.title: novelty_bonus_striatal_analog. A reward bonus that tracks recency-of-encounter; new or rarely-encountered states/actions receive a positive bonus independent of reward prediction error. Biological substrate: ventral striatum response to stimulus novelty (Wittmann et al. 2008 Neuron). Sub-flavour of MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus.
MECH-314a.what_would_answer:
MECH-314a is falsified if a state-novelty-bonus ablation (314a-OFF vs. all-on) does NOT show a distinct failure signature from the 314b-OFF and 314c-OFF conditions -- specifically, if 314a-OFF agents do not show a reduced return-rate to rarely-visited states, OR if the effect is indistinguishable in direction/magnitude from what 314b-OFF or 314c-OFF produce (the Q-044 collapse hypothesis).
Standing evidence (V3-EXQ-590b, reclassified non_contributory 2026-06-12) already shows the AUTHORITY-moves-argmin leg is operative (H_pos moves 0.283 across gains) but did not show gain=0 was reliably beaten (best gain 1/3 seeds lifted) -- routed to /claim-synthesis as granularity debt ('novelty buys exploration' under-names authority-moves-argmin != signal- is-adaptive) rather than treated as a weakens. A future confirmatory run would need to close that specific gap: does novelty's Goldilocks calibration actually improve on off, not merely move the argmin. Not currently blocking -- this is optional hardening, not a required retest.

MECH-314b.subject: policy.curiosity.uncertainty_driven_frontopolar_analog
MECH-314b.title: uncertainty_driven_curiosity_frontopolar_analog. A reward bonus that tracks epistemic value -- how much the agent would learn from sampling a state or action. Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature). Sub-flavour of MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus. Active-inference framing: bonus equals epistemic value term in expected free energy decomposition (Friston 2010/2015).
MECH-314b.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A state partition that is genuinely familiar-but-uncertain must exist and be occupied often enough to score, the per-candidate epistemic signal must be non-degenerate across candidates, and the modulatory authority rescale must be ON -- at the production default the channel's contribution is roughly seven orders of magnitude below the E3 raw score range and clamped by curiosity_bias_scale.
CONFIRMING: With authority on and a genuine per-candidate signal, 314b-ON commits to the higher-predictive-variance candidate at familiar-but-uncertain states materially more often than 314b-OFF on matched seeds, and those visits reduce that state's predictive variance more than control visits. Manipulation: Ablate use_curiosity_uncertainty ON/OFF holding MECH-314a and MECH-314c fixed, crossed with use_modulatory_selection_authority ON/OFF, with the per-candidate uncertainty source supplied by the SD-063 head rather than the broadcast scalar. Control: The 314b-OFF arm at matched authority, the authority-alone arm with no genuine per-candidate signal (949's C3 negative control, which correctly read 0.0), and a 314a-only arm so novelty cannot explain the effect. Required event: Episodes containing states the agent has visited many times (low novelty) where E2's predictive uncertainty over the next z_world remains high, so epistemic value and recency dissociate. DV: Rate of uncertainty-resolution rollouts -- committed trajectories whose first action targets the high-predictive-variance candidate -- measured specifically at familiar-but-uncertain states, together with the realised post-visit drop in that state's predictive variance.
FALSIFYING: 314b-ON and 314b-OFF are indistinguishable in uncertainty-resolution rollout rate at familiar-but-uncertain states even with the authority rescale on and a demonstrably non-degenerate per-candidate signal -- the epistemic bonus then does not steer sampling toward epistemic value. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/policy/structured_curiosity.py compute_score_bias accepts per_candidate_uncertainty and ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e2_world_uncertainty.py supplies it; agent.py caches the per-candidate vector. V3-EXQ-949 records committed-action movement only. Nothing partitions states by familiarity x uncertainty or labels a rollout as uncertainty-resolving. Consumer / boundary: E3 candidate selection -- which candidate the argmin commits to -- and the subsequent visit, not the score bias in isolation. Existing ownership: MECH-314b, ARC-065, modulatory-bias-selection-authority, SD-063, V3-EXQ-949, GFLAG-0065.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Substrate is complete: SD-063 head, per-candidate slot, authority rescale, all validated. The gap is the experiment -- 949 measured selection authority rather than epistemic behaviour, and no instrument partitions familiar-but-uncertain states or scores uncertainty resolution. At the production default (authority OFF) the channel cannot move the argmin at all. Secondary classes: R2, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The appended 2026-08-27 note asserts the falsifier has already been run via V3-EXQ-949. It has not: 949's C1/C2/C3 all measure whether the authority rescale lets the per-candidate channel move the committed action, which is only the SECOND conjunct of the registered falsifier. The epistemic conjunct -- reduced uncertainty-resolution rollouts at familiar-but-uncertain states -- has no state partition, no rollout-purpose recorder, and was never measured. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-314c.subject: policy.curiosity.learning_progress_intrinsic_motivation_analog
MECH-314c.title: learning_progress_curiosity_intrinsic_motivation_analog. A reward bonus that tracks the rate-of-improvement of the agent's predictive model (or any internal-state quantity); actions that produce a steepening learning curve receive a positive bonus. Most computationally instantiated in ML literature (Schmidhuber 1991, Pathak et al. 2017); least biologically anchored of the three MECH-314 sub-flavours -- no clean cellular or regional analog. Distinguishes from MECH-314a (recency-based) and MECH-314b (uncertainty-based) by tracking second-order signal (improvement rate) rather than first-order (count or uncertainty).
MECH-314c.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The per-candidate learning-progress vector must be differentiated across candidates (the readiness gate sd_epistemic_deficit_multitarget_readiness exists precisely for this), the modulatory authority rescale must be on so the bonus can move selection at all, and the task family must separate LEARNABLE from IRREDUCIBLE uncertainty or the noisy-TV failure mode confounds the DV.
CONFIRMING: 314c-ON shows greater learning-curve curvature than 314c-OFF in the learnable regime on a majority of seeds, with no corresponding advantage in the irreducible-noise regime, and the committed-action share targeting still-improving regions is higher. Manipulation: Ablate use_curiosity_learning_progress ON/OFF with curiosity_learning_progress_source set to epistemic_deficit, holding MECH-314a and MECH-314b constant, crossed with the learnable/unlearnable regime. Control: 314c-OFF with 314a+314b held at their ON values, plus the irreducible-noise regime as the discriminating cell where a learning-progress bonus should NOT persist while a raw prediction-error bonus would. Required event: Episodes on a task family where the model-improvement rate genuinely varies with policy -- some regions still learnable, others irreducibly stochastic (SD-047 weather AR(1) or SD-048 interoceptive noise supply the unlearnable arm, both OFF by default). DV: Curvature of the per-seed learning curve (rate of change of model improvement) in the learnable regime, integrated over training, for 314c-ON versus 314c-OFF; plus the fraction of committed actions targeting still-improving regions rather than irreducibly noisy ones.
FALSIFYING: With a genuine per-candidate learning-progress source and live authority, 314c-ON and 314c-OFF show indistinguishable learning-curve curvature on tasks where improvement rate varies with policy -- which, per the registration's own framing, retires 314c cleanly as redundant given 314a plus 314b. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/policy/structured_curiosity.py consumes per_candidate_learning_progress and ree-v3/ree_core/policy/epistemic_deficit.py supplies it. No experiment records learning-curve curvature: the only 314c readouts on file are selected_action_class_entropy from the 604 series, which is a pure function of the argmax sequence and was an arithmetic identity under the Phase-1 broadcast scalar. Consumer / boundary: E3 candidate selection biased by a second-order improvement-rate signal, evaluated against the trajectory of model quality rather than against instantaneous prediction error. Existing ownership: MECH-314c, MECH-482, ARC-065, modulatory-bias-selection-authority, sd_epistemic_deficit_multitarget_readiness, orienting_epistemic_deficit_v3:ORNT-2.
