MECH-316.subject: rule_discovery.cross_episode_regularity_extraction
MECH-316.title: cross_episode_regularity_extraction (episodic_RL_successor_representation_CLS_monosynaptic_analog). A mechanism for extracting cross-episode statistical regularities from observed behaviour streams, producing a representation that supports prediction of future state-occupancy distributions. Biological substrate: hippocampal monosynaptic CA1 path (Schapiro et al. 2017 CLS bi-pathway); statistical learning in hippocampus (Davachi 2015). Computational analog: successor representation (Stachenfeld et al. 2017 Nat Neurosci). Sub-claim of ARC-064 bottom-up rule discovery.
MECH-316.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The environment must present >= 2 transition regimes that are separable in the recorded stream and persist long enough to be learned between shifts (world_rule_shift_interval large enough that steps_since_world_rule_shift spans a learnable window), and the OFF arm must be genuinely successor-representation-ablated rather than merely untrained.
CONFIRMING: With the regime event live, the ON arm's regime-conditioned occupancy predictions separate by more than the OFF arm's by a pre-registered margin scaled on the cross-seed SD of the paired delta, and the separation grows with the number of distinct regimes. Manipulation: MECH-316-ON versus MECH-316-OFF (successor-representation / cross-episode-statistics module armed versus ablated), with regime count (1-regime versus >= 2-regime variant) as the crossed factor. Control: The 1-regime variant of the same ecology at matched seeds and matched shift schedule, plus a schedule-only depth-0 shift arm (already legal in the env) that fires the schedule without changing the rule. Required event: A cross-episode regime change in the transition structure -- an action-map re-permutation fired by CausalGridWorld._maybe_shift_world_rule, which is persistent across episode resets and emits world_rule_shift_count / steps_since_world_rule_shift. DV: Divergence between the two regimes of the learned state-occupancy prediction (discounted future-occupancy distribution per state), measured per seed as the distance between regime-conditioned occupancy predictions, against the ON/OFF and 1-regime/multi-regime contrasts.
FALSIFYING: The ON arm's regime-conditioned occupancy predictions are indistinguishable from the OFF arm's, or do not scale with regime count, on a seed majority with the event and coverage preconditions green. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: MISSING. No successor-representation, state-occupancy or cross-episode-statistics readout exists in ree_core (direct grep for successor_representation / successor_rep / state_occupancy / occupancy_prediction returns zero hits). The event side IS instrumented by the env info dict. Consumer / boundary: The bottom-up rule-discovery layer (ARC-064): a representation in which cross-episode regularity is an explicit feature available to downstream rule-state abstraction (MECH-318), not merely decodable from episode traces. Existing ownership: MECH-316, ARC-064, SD-MEL-PRODUCER, mech318-within-episode-rule-switch-instrument, EXP-0294.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The asserted mechanism has no implementation, so there is nothing to arm and nothing to read: no module produces a state-occupancy prediction the DV could be computed from. The regime EVENT is no longer the blocker. Secondary classes: R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's non-degeneracy precondition asserts that the multi-rule-context substrate (>= 2 distinguishable transition regimes) does not exist. SD-MEL-PRODUCER landed 2026-07-21 (world_rule_shift_enabled/_interval/_depth in CausalGridWorld, validated 2026-07-30 on V3-EXQ-798a) and generates exactly that, with switch-relative telemetry; the 2026-09-21 audit already corrected the sibling MECH-318 entry on this point. The successor-representation half of the absence claim still holds. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. MECH-318.subject: rule_discovery.rule_state_abstraction_substrate
MECH-318.title: rule_state_abstraction_substrate (meta_RL_recurrent_task_state_representation). A mechanism for abstracting the higher-level rule-state itself as a latent variable in the agent's representation, supporting policy adaptation that depends on inferred rule-context rather than only observable cue. Biological substrate: OFC cognitive map (Wilson, Takahashi, Schoenbaum & Niv 2014; Schuck et al. 2016 OFC encodes task state). Computational analog: meta-RL recurrent task-state representation (Wang et al. 2018 prefrontal-as-meta-RL; Duan et al. 2016 RL^2; Botvinick et al. 2019 review). Sub-claim of ARC-064 bottom-up rule discovery. ABSORPTION CHECK 2026-05-10: VERDICT (B) PARTIALLY ABSORBED. Within-V3 functional weight is borne by SD-033a LateralPFCAnalog rule_state buffer (W1 EMA recurrence + W3 substrate-readiness + W4 downstream bias) plus ARC-062 Phase 1 gated_policy multi-stream context discriminator (W3 per-tick rule-context discrimination + W4 score-aggregation training pressure), with ARC-062 Phase 3 GAP-C wiring now DONE (2026-09-16, V3-EXQ-1039, non_contributory/standard) closing that loop -- the cluster's empirical verdict remains separately gated on GAP-B (in-progress), an independent competence gate this correction does not clear. [2026-09-23 governance, GFLAG-0397] Two residual gaps remain: W2 (multi-task training distribution -- blocked on multi-rule-context substrate, SD-054 single-context insufficient) and W5 (cross-episode hidden-state continuity -- likely V4-scope; SD-033a per-episode reset is architecturally load-bearing for the rest of the agent state machine). Empirical retire-vs-promote verdict deferred to V3-EXQ-543c-successor on multi-rule-context substrate. See REE_assembly/docs/architecture/mech_318_absorption_check.md.
MECH-318.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Demonstrate competent action under both rules, differentiated rule_state and effective SD-082 propagation to committed actions. A switch must change the effective action map during one continuous episode without agent reset, leave enough post-switch opportunities to measure recovery, and not give the agent a privileged rule label. A scheduled event with depth=0 or cancelling transpositions does not meet this gate.
CONFIRMING: Under met gates, the existing cluster adapts within the episode faster than the recurrent-state-ablated arm. This supports absorption of MECH-318's W1/W3/W4 portion into the cluster. Manipulation: Intact SD-033a/ARC-062 recurrent adaptation versus selective recurrent-state ablation at the switch, with slow parameter learning held matched or frozen. Control: No-switch and schedule-only depth=0 controls, matched event opportunities and pre-switch competence. Required event: Within-episode change of the action-to-displacement rule; SD-MEL-PRODUCER is an existing candidate provider. A reef-context switch would require separate equivalence/design justification. DV: Switch-aligned number of executed actions until sustained recovery to the preregistered new-rule competence criterion, with censoring for episode termination; intact-minus-ablated latency. Rule_state change alone is insufficient.
FALSIFYING: With effective switches, baseline competence and verified lesion reach, the cluster lacks a selective within-episode adaptation advantage. This rejects the cluster-sufficiency/absorption reading; it does not by itself validate a dedicated meta-RL mechanism. W2 multi-task training and W5 cross-episode continuity remain separately scoped.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: CausalGridWorld.step already emits world_rule_shift_occurred/count and steps_since_world_rule_shift. The registered mech318-within-episode-rule-switch-instrument owns the missing behavioural latency recorder and continuous-episode assay. EXQ-606b resets across episodes and cannot supply this DV. Consumer / boundary: Recurrent adaptation through SD-082 to fresh commitment and executed behaviour within the same episode. Existing owners: SD-MEL-PRODUCER, mech318-within-episode-rule-switch-instrument, arc_062_rule_apprehension:GAP-B, SD-082.

MECH-319.subject: policy.arbitration.simulation_mode_write_gating_substrate_ree_novel_function
MECH-319.title: simulation_mode_rule_write_gating_categorical_replay_tag (SWR_machinery_substrate_REE_novel_function). The substrate-level instantiation of MECH-094's hypothesis-tag write gate at the rule-arbitration layer: a categorical write-gate keyed to a simulation-mode tag that suppresses arbitration-weight updates during ghost / replay / DMN passes, allowing rule-arbitration to be exercised without overwriting the active rule weights from non-realized data. Substrate-availability premise is well-anchored: SWR machinery (Joo & Frank 2018 review) + reverse-replay discriminable signature (Foster & Wilson 2006). The specific REE function (categorical write-gate keyed to a simulation tag suppressing arbitration-weight updates) is plausible biologically but unverified at cellular / synaptic level.
MECH-319.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: three conditions, all of which V3-EXQ-628 and
V3-EXQ-668 already carried and any successor must too. (1) The replay-driven
invocation path must actually be constructed -- REEAgent.select_action never calls
the gate with caller_sim=True, so a run relying on the ordinary step loop
exercises only the waking identity-passthrough branch and is structurally vacuous
(this is why 628 had to build effective_simulation_mode(simulation_mode=True,
site=lateral_pfc) + a conditional LateralPFCAnalog.update by hand). Assert a
NON-ZERO simulation-firing count. (2) The waking path must be bit-identical across
BLOCK and ADMIT arms with zero simulation firings -- the load-bearing C4
falsifier; without it, an observed arm divergence could come from the waking path
rather than the gate. (3) The readout must reach rule_state (and, for the drift
form, compute_bias) -- a truth-table or wiring-only check never touches the
consumer and is diagnostic, not evidence (V3-EXQ-546 was exactly this and scored
non_contributory). Construction guard: the substrate raises ValueError on
admit_writes=True without master ON (loud, not silent), so a mis-configured
falsifier arm fails loudly rather than reading as a green BLOCK.
CONFIRMING (V3 -- ALREADY MET, twice, do not re-queue these slices): with
admit_writes=False (MECH-319 normal), a simulation-tagged caller produces ~zero
rule_state delta while the ADMIT arm replaying the SAME captured latent produces a
measurable one, the arms diverge, and the waking path stays bit-identical --
V3-EXQ-628 (3/3 seeds, mean replay delta ~0.31). And, over a SUSTAINED replay
regime, BLOCK produces no accumulated drift while ADMIT accumulates beyond a
single step and the drift reaches the compute_bias arbitration output --
V3-EXQ-668 (3/3 seeds, all criteria green, bias_readout_non_degenerate). Two
contributory entries, genuine_exp_count=2, exp_conf 0.825, conflict_ratio 0,
quadrant novel_discovery; promoted candidate_substrate_landed -> provisional,
v3_pending: false, 2026-06-11.
CONFIRMING (V3 -- the RESIDUAL that is still open): the gate's declared scope is
"MECH-312 sub-mechanisms" generally, but it is wired at exactly TWO call sites
(GatedPolicy.forward and LateralPFCAnalog.update). Confirming: an enumeration of
arbitration-weight write sites re-derived from the CURRENT tree shows every one
either gate-consulted or explicitly out of scope.
FALSIFYING (V3): an arbitration-weight write site is reachable from a
simulation-tagged caller WITHOUT consulting effective_simulation_mode -- the
coverage gap, which is the live drift risk now that the two behavioural paths have
passed. Or: BLOCK and ADMIT arms produce indistinguishable rule_state trajectories
under a genuinely-exercised replay regime (would contradict 628 and 668). Or: the
waking path differs across arms, which invalidates the instrument rather than the
claim.
OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG (stated plainly, NOT dropped, and NOT gating the V3 verdict):
the claim's functional_restatement carries a second, V4-bound,
pharmacology-dependent falsifier REE cannot run: pharmacological or optogenetic
SWR suppression during a rule-arbitration training task should NOT change
steady-state rule-arbitration weights, whereas suppression during ACTIVE-policy-
deployment phases SHOULD produce different effects -- the training-vs-deployment
dissociation is the diagnostic. Substrate availability is well-anchored (Joo &
Frank 2018; Foster & Wilson 2006); the specific REE commitment -- that SWR events
suppress rule-arbitration-weight updates in cortical-striatal arbitration loops --
is biologically unverified at cellular/synaptic level and the literature does not
confirm it. THIS LEG DOES NOT BLOCK A V3 PROVISIONAL and must not be cited as an
outstanding V3 gate.
CROSS-REFERENCES: the write-gate principle is MECH-094's; MECH-319 is its
substrate-level instantiation at the arbitration layer, and the two are NOT
redundant (Pull 3 R1 + Pull 4 R3 KEEP-AS-IS, 2026-05-10). MECH-261 is the
complementary CONTINUOUS gate; the two compose and neither subsumes the other.

MECH-320.subject: action.tonic_vigor_coupling_score_bias
MECH-320.title: tonic_vigor_coupling_score_bias (capacity-keyed E3 score-side action drive / mesolimbic-DA-vigor-analog / average-reward-rate opportunity-cost regulator). Child mechanism for ARC-066 (tonic_vigor_coupling) AND ARC-068 (opportunity_cost_no_op_penalty -- collapse into MECH-320 per ARC-068 lit-pull R3 verdict 2026-05-16; MECH-320's w_passive term IS the ARC-068 implementation). Adds a tonic vigor scalar v_t to E3 trajectory scoring as an additive bias toward action-trajectories and an additive cost on no-op / repeated-stationary trajectories, where v_t is a slow EWMA over the realised E3-score-receipt stream. Target-free: bias applies regardless of whether any z_goal is currently active. Distinct from MECH-313 (LC-NE noise floor -- noise on choice, orthogonal axis), MECH-216 (target-conditioned wanting), SD-012 (deficit-keyed drive, opposite coupling), and MECH-330 (ARC-067 boredom -- valence-side z_harm_a write, different architectural layer).
MECH-320.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Selection authority on (use_modulatory_selection_authority), AND the vigor scalar demonstrably alive on the run: tonic_vigor_baseline_mode='ewma' (or a positive tonic_vigor_v_t_floor) with measured v_t > 0 and a non-zero action-vs-no-op bias recorded per arm. A DV-headroom check that action density can move between the noise floor and ceiling is also required.
CONFIRMING: With v_t certified live, action density rises monotonically with v_t in the well-fed-safe-familiar regime in ARM_1/ARM_2 relative to ARM_0, on a majority of ready seeds, with the additive/multiplicative contrast resolving the sub-hypothesis. Manipulation: Three arms: ARM_0 baseline (MECH-313 ON, MECH-320 OFF), ARM_1 MECH-320 additive, ARM_2 MECH-320 multiplicative, all with baseline_mode='ewma' so v_t is live, plus a parametric sweep of v_t against a pre-existing action preference. Control: ARM_0 with MECH-313 ON only, predicted inert at the noise floor; plus a dead-scalar control arm (baseline_mode='none') to show the previously measured null reproduces and is attributable to the dead scalar. Required event: Well-fed, safe, familiar operation -- full energy, no z_goal active, familiar environment, no harm signal -- sustained long enough for the slow EWMA to accumulate a positive advantage. DV: Action density (fraction of committed ticks that are non-no-op) as a function of v_t, ON versus ARM_0; and, for the additive-versus-multiplicative sub-hypothesis, whether the action-vs-no-op score gap scales linearly with v_t independent of pre-existing preference or differentially under strong preference.
FALSIFYING: With v_t certified live (positive scalar, non-zero bias) and selection authority on, action density shows no monotonic rise with v_t relative to the inert ARM_0 baseline -- the tonic-vigor coupling does not exist or is not load-bearing at E3. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/policy/tonic_vigor.py computes and exposes v_t and the per-candidate bias, control-vector logging carries the v_t scalar, and tonic_vigor_baseline_mode / tonic_vigor_baseline_half_life / tonic_vigor_v_t_floor are the live levers. No experiment in the corpus sets baseline_mode, and nothing is queued. Consumer / boundary: E3 committed selection on the action-versus-no-op axis -- vigor must change what is committed, not merely what is scored. Existing ownership: modulatory-bias-selection-authority, dv-dynamic-range-precondition-class, ARC-066, ARC-068.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); MECH-320's own scalar was identically zero at the shipped default, so every prior null was measured on a dead treatment. The repair lever (tonic_vigor_baseline_mode='ewma', landed 2026-09-17) is default-OFF and is set by no experiment in the corpus; without it the discriminative pair cannot discriminate. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA and its 2026-08-27 'ready to queue' addendum assume v_t is a live scalar once selection authority is on. V3-EXQ-951c measured v_raw max EXACTLY 0.0 (means -14.26 / -22.97): because reward_signal was -score and REE scores are positive costs, max(0, v_raw) was identically zero and v_t was pinned at the floor, so MECH-320's bias was dead at the shipped default. The 2026-09-17 tonic_vigor_baseline_mode lever fixes this but defaults to 'none'. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-321.subject: policy.decomposition_via_event_segmenter
MECH-321.title: policy_decomposition_via_event_segmenter (rollout-side consumer of MECH-288 boundary pulses; re-segments the rollout proposal stream at finer grain when a chunk's region shows low V_s / boundary fires on the imagined trajectory). First child mechanism for ARC-070. Bidirectional extension of MECH-288 substrate (R2 lit-pull verdict 2026-05-10): MECH-288 already detects boundaries on whatever latent + PE streams it consumes; MECH-321 wires the rollout / imagination input stream into MECH-288 and consumes the resulting boundary pulses at the policy-primitive layer to decompose chunked primitives into finer-grain sub-elements. PE-driven primary trigger (V_s drop on chunk's region per Zacks 2007 / Schapiro 2017); bottleneck-state framing is a separate consolidation-phase mechanism, not the primary trigger. Recursive multi-level decomposition; depth cap 3 is an ENGINEERING choice, not a literature-derived constant (provenance corrected 2026-07-27 -- see evidence_quality_note). The MULTI-LEVEL commitment is ARC-070's R3 verdict (Badre & D'Esposito 2009) and STANDS; that source never supported a level COUNT, and Badre & Nee 2018 (Badre's own re-appraisal) finds the evidence supports neither a unitary model of lateral frontal function nor a unidimensional abstraction gradient, so there is no single ordered axis along which to cap. The cap rests instead on tractability + operator symmetry (mirrors ARC-071's chunk_max_depth so the inverse operations stay symmetric; open Q-claim on hard-vs-soft). Magnitude prior only, with an explicit grain caveat: Koechlin 2003 resolves a 3-level lateral-PFC cascade (4 with Koechlin & Summerfield 2007 frontopolar branching), but at ANATOMICAL grain -- heterogeneous, anatomically fixed control levels, NOT homogeneous recursion depth of one operator re-applying to its own output. Both pre-commit and mid-execution phases supported via the same mechanism, with downstream effects gated by MECH-094 hypothesis_tag (rollout fires under hypothesis_tag=True write nothing; observation / execution fires under hypothesis_tag=False enable the existing observation-side consumer chain unchanged).
MECH-321.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Two, and the second is now the binding one. (a) The manipulation must engage: decomp_n_harm_bias_nonzero > 0 on the ON arm, met since 867a/867b. (b) The TRIGGER READOUT must be able to locate the loci at all -- 938's proximal statistic secondary_fwd_pe_delta_yoked_minus_pe = -2.6e-05 is the signature of a readout too coarse to register the environment's actual uncertainty, and a within-run rank normalisation does not repair a readout of that kind.
CONFIRMING: With a PE/V_s readout demonstrated to discriminate high- from low-reliability regions (a positive control on the readout itself, not on the decomposition count), ARM_PE shows lower realised task harm than the rate-matched yoked arm by more than the run's own MDE, with a consistent direction across paired seeds. Manipulation: use_policy_decomposition ON versus OFF with decomposition_trigger_mode 'vs_boundary' (R1 V_s/boundary) versus 'bottleneck' (R5 diverse-density accumulator), at matched decomposition RATE across arms so a difference cannot be produced by firing more often. Control: The rate-matched yoked arm 938 introduced (ARM_YOKED fires the same number of decompositions at PE-independent loci) plus an ARC-070 OFF baseline, with the arm-invariant abort rate held fixed. Required event: Rollout proposal ticks on which a chunked primitive spans a region the predictive engine cannot reliably forward-simulate, so a V_s drop or a MECH-288 boundary pulse on the rollout stream should re-segment it before commitment. DV: Realised task harm and forward prediction error on the decomposed sub-sequences, ARM_PE minus ARM_YOKED at matched decomposition rate over >= 40 paired seeds, with the effect required to exceed the run's own 80%-power MDE rather than merely the direction being right.
FALSIFYING: With the readout's discriminative power demonstrated and the rate match held, PE-targeted decomposition still delivers no advantage over yoked decomposition at matched rate -- prediction-failure SELECTIVITY is then false, as distinct from 938's current null, which cannot separate that from an uninformative readout. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: policy_decomposition.py evaluate() and the 938 driver record decomposition counts, boundary fires, rate-match and abort-rate controls adequately. The inadequate instrument is the TRIGGER's own input: the V_s / forward-PE readout that is supposed to identify unreliable regions, whose measured delta between PE-targeted and yoked loci is -2.6e-05. Consumer / boundary: The rollout proposal stream before commitment, where a chunked primitive is either kept whole or replaced by recursively tiled leaf candidates -- and the mid-execution abort hook on the remaining chunk content. Existing ownership: ARC-070, MECH-288, MECH-269, SD-hazard-aware-policy-decomposition, policy_decomposition_discrimination, mech321_harm_aware_selection_task_effect, GFLAG-0258.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); 938's null is uninterpretable as a claim verdict because the same run's proximal readout shows the PE signal barely differentiates the loci it targets from yoked ones (-2.6e-05), so 'selectivity is false' and 'the PE readout cannot locate the loci' are not separable. No positive control on the readout itself has been built. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. MECH-323.subject: policy.composition.chunk_accumulator_formation
MECH-323.title: policy_composition_chunk_accumulator -- striatum/DLS-analog formation operator that builds chunk candidates from sequences of policy primitives repeatedly executed together with consistent outcomes. First child mechanism for ARC-071 (the maintenance operator MECH-324 is registered separately). Encodes the lit-pull R1 verdict (repetition + outcome consistency as primary trigger, evaluative-gate upstream, V_s-positive secondary) + R2 verdict partial (striatum-analog formation substrate; vmPFC/IL maintenance substrate handled by MECH-324) + R4 verdict (chunked primitive carries initiation-set + termination-condition fields per Sutton 1999 options structure) + R5 verdict (gradual hysteresis with F_low formation < F_high dissolution -- the RELATION is literature-grounded as of 2026-07-27 (Barnes 2005; Bouton 2012), the VALUES F_low=0.15 / F_high=0.45 are uncalibrated engineering defaults with NO literature support, awaiting child-MECH calibration; INITIAL chunk-size budget 2-5 elements per level, licensed by Sakai 2003 at MOTOR grain only and NOT a stable architectural constant -- Ramkumar 2016 shows chunk length grows with practice under a compute/efficiency trade-off, Bo & Seidler 2009 shows it tracks visuospatial working-memory capacity and declines with age, so the ceiling should be exposed as growable and ideally DERIVED from the agent's deliberation/rollout budget rather than configured independently; see the 2026-07-27 provenance correction in evidence_quality_note). Dissolution is SUPPRESSION WITH RETENTION, not erasure (2026-07-27 structural correction, registered on MECH-324): a previously-dissolved sequence re-forms at the REDUCED bar R_reacq = R_min * f_reacq rather than at R_min from scratch, so the MECH-323 trigger is state-dependent on the chunk library; and the initiation_set field becomes load-bearing for the renewal falsifier, which is expressible only if dissolution is scoped to the same context granularity formation uses. Two write paths: default MECH-094 strict (hypothesis_tag=False real executions only); sleep-replay carve-out under MECH-322 conditions (replay_origin=True audit flag with accelerated dissolution if not corroborated by real waking execution).
MECH-323.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (four; any one unmet makes the run vacuous):
 (1) CHUNKS MUST ACTUALLY FORM, checked from PER-SEED rows. Pre-check
 chunk_acc_n_formed against a pre-registered worst-seed floor BEFORE any
 downstream statistic is trusted. V3-EXQ-810a's own bar is the calibrated
 precedent (load-bearing criterion cleared 7/8 seeds vs a 0.75 pre-registered
 fraction; worst-seed margins 2.4x-7.0x); do not invent a new one. V3-EXQ-834 is
 the counter-example that makes this a per-seed check rather than a gate reading:
 it returned precondition_unmet on chunks_formed while 4/5 seeds had in fact
 formed 8-44 chunks each -- a driver gate-strictness defect, not a substrate
 ceiling.
 (2) THE OUTCOME SPAN MUST BE PRE-REGISTERED, AND >= 2.0. F_low and F_high are
 SCALE-RELATIVE: the substrate applies no normalisation anywhere
 (policy_chunking._variance is plain population variance over the raw, unbounded,
 caller-supplied E3-score-receipt scalar). Population variance on a span-S range
 is at most S^2/4, so at F_high = 0.45 dissolution needs S > 1.342 and S >= 2.0 is
 the recommended floor for headroom. Span moves BOTH gates at once -- a wider span
 makes F_low HARDER to satisfy -- so it is an IV, never an unstated constant.
 (3) THE RETENTION STATE MUST BE DECLARED. With use_chunk_dissolution_retention
 ON, this claim's repetition bar is not R_min but ceil(R_min * f_reacq) for any
 sequence carrying a dormant chunk -- the trigger is state-dependent on the
 MECH-324 library. The cheap control is the flag: retention OFF makes the bar
 unconditionally R_min.
 (4) PERSISTENCE FLAGS SCOPED TO THE PROBE PHASE ONLY. V3-EXQ-871 showed that
 flipping a persistence flag across the WHOLE cell perturbs formation itself via
 RNG-coupled environment dynamics -- same seeds 101/505 formed 1/0 chunks vs 2/2
 under V3-EXQ-841 -- producing an artefact indistinguishable from a substrate
 finding.
CONFIRMING: target the RELATIONS, never the registered constants. R_min = 20,
W = 100, F_low = 0.15, evaluative margin 0.05, chunk size 2-5, f_reacq = 0.25 and
chunk_ceiling_returns_threshold = 0.10 are UNCALIBRATED ENGINEERING DEFAULTS with
no literature support; only the orderings are grounded (Barnes 2005; Bouton 2012;
Ramkumar 2016; Bo, Borza & Seidler 2009). A result turning on a specific value
scores nothing.
 (C1) FORMATION READINESS -- ALREADY ANSWERED; DO NOT RE-DERIVE. V3-EXQ-810a and
 810b confirm the accumulator forms chunks under non-degenerate conditions with
 2.4x-7.0x margins and C7 credit-rule separation 5x. This leg is closed; it is a
 PRECONDITION above, not a target.
 (C2) REDUCED-BAR ORDERING -- the sharpest open formation-side item. On the
 829a-corrected substrate (use_reacquisition_window_isolation ON), re-formation of
 a dormant chunk under an identical consistent above-baseline regime completes in
 STRICTLY FEWER repetitions than first acquisition of the same sequence, with
 r_acq MEASURED on the same run, not assumed: r_reacq < r_acq. AND r_reacq is
 monotonic-decreasing in f_reacq across at least three levels -- a rank ordering,
 not a value match.
 (C3) CEILING-DERIVATION ORDERING (never measured; V3-EXQ-834 attempted and failed
 on a driver defect, so this is open, not answered). With use_growable_chunk_ceiling
 ON, all three must hold: (i) an agent with a LARGER deliberation/rollout horizon
 settles at a LARGER mean chunk size than one with a smaller horizon, same task,
 same seeds -- the ordering, not the number; (ii) growth PLATEAUS strictly below
 the derived maximum when marginal returns go flat, rather than running to the cap;
 (iii) settled size is INVARIANT to chunk_min_repetitions at fixed horizon (the Bo
 et al. size-vs-rate dissociation). (i) alone is consistent with a monotonic
 practice-driven accumulator, which Ramkumar's macaques rule out -- so partial
 satisfaction is not confirmation.
FALSIFYING:
 (F1) r_reacq >= r_acq on the corrected substrate, under a declared span and a
 declared retention state, with the formation precondition met. PRIOR RESULT IS
 VOID FOR THIS PURPOSE: V3-EXQ-829 measured exactly this shape (median r_reacq 90
 vs measured median r_acq 20 = R_min exactly) but its DV was rate-limited by the
 contaminated whole-lifetime variance window -- r_reacq/W = 0.908 +/- 0.029,
 tracking W and not R_min or f_reacq -- a MECH-323/MECH-324 SHARED-WINDOW confound
 since closed by use_reacquisition_window_isolation (V3-EXQ-829a, supports). Any
 re-run MUST have that flag ON and MUST report r_reacq/W.
 (F2) r_reacq FLAT across f_reacq with r_reacq/W no longer tracking W. The genuine
 structural falsification that 829's result was mistaken for.
 (F3) Settled chunk size fails to order with the deliberation horizon, OR grows
 monotonically to the cap regardless of realised marginal return, OR moves with
 chunk_min_repetitions at fixed horizon.
 (F4) NOT FALSIFIABLE AS REGISTERED -- CONTEXT-CONDITIONED FORMATION. This claim's
 title and its initiation_set inference rule assert formation is context-
 conditioned. The substrate does not implement it: ChunkedPrimitive.initiation_set
 defaults to frozenset() (policy_chunking.py:513), neither mint() call site
 populates it (:1352 replay, :1926 formation), zero reads outside the module.
 VERIFIED UNCHANGED 2026-08-28. No experiment can confirm or falsify this
 component. Building it is UPSTREAM of MECH-324's renewal falsifier and is gated on
 a prior MEASUREMENT, not a design choice: over the chunking regime's own context
 stream, how many distinct centered-z_world buckets occur, and does one chunk's
 real executions span more than one? The nearest existing implementation
 (candidate_rule_field._context_bucket) COLLAPSES TO ONE BUCKET on real z_world
 (~0.98-cosine common-mode cone, SD-008 under-differentiation); SD-078
 cue_centering is the measured fix (1 -> 20 buckets) but is
 candidate_substrate_landed and DEFAULT OFF. If the answer is 1,
 context-conditioning is inexpressible whatever the gate does. Classification:
 puzzle (known rules). Do NOT inherit the 20-bucket nursery number.
SHARED EXPERIMENT: C2/F1/F2 are scored by the SAME single chunking-lifecycle run
that scores MECH-324's F1. Do not mint a second experiment; cross-reference
MECH-324. LEG-3-style behavioural signatures belong to ARC-071's own
what_would_answer LEG 3 and have never been queued -- do not smuggle them in here.

MECH-324.subject: policy.composition.chunk_maintenance_dissolution
MECH-324.title: policy_composition_chunk_maintenance -- IL/vmPFC-analog maintenance operator that gates chunk crystallisation, persistence under continued corroboration, and dissolution under outcome inconsistency. Dissolution is SUPPRESSION WITH RETENTION, not erasure: a dissolved chunk persists DORMANT (unselectable but retained) and re-forms at a reduced repetition bar R_reacq = R_min * f_reacq, per the 2026-07-27 structural correction (Barnes 2005 striatal ensemble re-emergence; Bouton 2012 renewal/resurgence/rapid-reacquisition) -- f_reacq is an uncalibrated engineering default on the same footing as F_high. Yields three relapse falsifiers (rapid reacquisition, testable now; renewal and resurgence, each substrate-blocked on an open Q-claim). Second child mechanism for ARC-071 (paired with MECH-323 formation operator). Causally required for chunk crystallisation per Smith & Graybiel 2013 selective optogenetic disruption of infralimbic cortex during overtraining (which PREVENTS habit formation despite intact striatal accumulator activity). Encodes the lit-pull R2 verdict (IL/vmPFC-analog substrate component of the phase-dependent multi-substrate chunking machinery) + R5 verdict (asymmetric hysteresis with F_high dissolution threshold > F_low formation threshold and slower dissolution timescale than formation timescale -- the RELATION and the timescale asymmetry are literature-grounded as of 2026-07-27 (Barnes 2005; Bouton 2012), but the VALUE F_high=0.45, and the ratio 0.45/0.15, have NO literature support and remain uncalibrated engineering defaults awaiting child-MECH calibration; see the 2026-07-27 provenance correction in evidence_quality_note) + MECH-322 verdict (accelerated dissolution for replay-origin chunks not corroborated by real waking execution within N episodes).
MECH-324.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (four): (1) A CHUNK MUST ACTUALLY REACH DISSOLVED --
(i) MECH-323's formation precondition met upstream; (ii) use_chunk_maintenance ON
(with it OFF, chunks form and NEVER crystallise BY CONSTRUCTION, contract
test_c7_formation_only_arm_never_crystallises, so every maintenance DV is
identically null and the run measures the flag); (iii) outcome span S >
2*sqrt(F_high) = 1.342, S >= 2.0 recommended. AT THE REGISTERED F_high = 0.45 ON A
0-1 SCALE THE CRYSTALLISED -> DISSOLVING TRANSITION IS ARITHMETICALLY IMPOSSIBLE
(max population variance on span S is S^2/4 = 0.25), which takes DISSOLVED, and
with it ALL THREE RELAPSE FALSIFIERS, out of reach at the registered defaults.
Emit the reachability arithmetic as an explicit per-cell precondition.
(2) THE REVIVAL GATE MUST READ THE ISOLATED WINDOW
(use_reacquisition_window_isolation ON). With it OFF the revival gate reads
accumulator._tally[key] -- the whole-lifetime sliding window, BY CONSTRUCTION
saturated with the contaminating high-variance stream at the moment dissolution
completes. Report r_reacq/W per cell as the standing degeneracy check.
(3) OPERATOR-LEVEL, NOT AGENT-LEVEL -- AND SAY SO IN THE MANIFEST. V3-EXQ-810
measured the MECH-323 accumulator SILENT under agent control, so an agent-level run
measures that readiness gap rather than MECH-324. Evidence from a driver-level run
attaches to the OPERATOR and licenses nothing about chunk-driven behaviour; it must
not be read as evidence for ARC-071's LEG 3, which has never been queued.
(4) PERSISTENCE FLAGS SCOPED TO THE PROBE PHASE ONLY -- the V3-EXQ-871 guard.
CONFIRMING: target the ORDERINGS. F_high = 0.45, the ratio 0.45/0.15, C_min = 5,
W_maint = 100, T_dissolve = 50, N = 75 and f_reacq = 0.25 are UNCALIBRATED
ENGINEERING DEFAULTS. Barnes 2005 and Bouton 2012 establish the DIRECTION and
NEITHER quantifies any of them. A calibrated threshold quoted WITHOUT the outcome
span it was calibrated at is not interpretable.
 (C1) DUAL-OPERATOR DISSOCIATION -- the load-bearing prediction, structurally
 mirroring Smith & Graybiel 2013 IL optogenetic disruption. ARM_1 (MECH-323 on,
 MECH-324 off) vs ARM_2 (both on): chunks form at COMPARABLE RATES in both arms,
 but only ARM_2 yields crystallised, selectable chunks with the accompanying
 rollout-cost / latency signature. The formation-rate equivalence is part of the
 confirmation, not background.
 (C2) RETENTION, NOT ERASURE -- PARTIALLY ANSWERED, supports. V3-EXQ-829's C3
 discriminator held cleanly: with the dormant-state flag OFF, 12/12 dissolved cells
 stayed dead; ON, they revived. Confirms the STRUCTURE, says nothing about the RATE.
 (C3) HYSTERESIS ORDERING, measured as crossings rather than read off the config.
 Dissolution requires a strictly larger outcome-variance excursion than formation
 tolerated (F_high > F_low as MEASURED crossing points), AND takes strictly more
 trials than formation took on the same sequence in the same run. The timescale
 half is better-grounded -- Barnes 2005 is a timescale/retrievability result, not a
 variance-threshold measurement, so F_high > F_low as a variance gate is supported
 only by analogy across two constructs.
 (C4) RECOVERABILITY FROM DISSOLVING (V3-EXQ-829's C5 mild-dissolution robustness
 held).
 (C5) REPLAY-ORIGIN ASYMMETRY (MECH-322 sub-mechanism C). A replay_origin=True
 chunk uncorroborated by real waking execution retires DIRECTLY to DISSOLVED and is
 NEVER revived at the reduced bar, while an otherwise identical
 replay_origin=False chunk IS. Both halves in one run: the second half is the
 MECH-094 posture the carve-out exists to preserve.
FALSIFYING:
 (F1) RAPID REACQUISITION -- TESTABLE NOW, and the claim's own prediction has NOT
 yet been tested on the corrected substrate. FALSIFIED IF re-formation of a dormant
 chunk takes >= r_acq measured on the same run, OR if r_reacq does not order with
 f_reacq, with use_reacquisition_window_isolation ON and r_reacq/W reported.
 V3-EXQ-829 returned exactly this shape but is VOID as a verdict (DV tracked W).
 V3-EXQ-829a confirms the FIX works; it is a bug-fix confirmation, NOT a falsifier
 run. The claim's pending_retest_after_substrate flag points here.
 (F2) DUAL-OPERATOR DISSOCIATION FAILS: ARM_1 and ARM_2 yield the same
 selectable-chunk behaviour and the same rollout-cost / latency profile, OR ARM_1
 crystallises without maintenance.
 (F3) HYSTERESIS INVERTED OR ABSENT.
 (F4) RENEWAL -- NOT TESTABLE; STRUCTURALLY BLOCKED, AND THE BLOCKER IS UPSTREAM OF
 THIS CLAIM. Not expressible, and NOT for the registered reason. The registration
 locates the asymmetry as "formation is context-conditioned, dissolution is
 context-blind"; the substrate has NO asymmetry -- BOTH halves are context-blind,
 because initiation_set is declared-but-never-populated. Two traps make "just scope
 dissolution to initiation_set" a refusal rather than a deferral: Layer 1 -- scoping
 to a universally-empty set is a SILENT NO-OP that READS as renewal-capable; Layer
 2, load-bearing -- populating it from raw z_world does NOT fix it (one bucket,
 ~0.98-cosine common-mode cone). A renewal run on that substrate HAS NO CONTEXT B,
 would return FALSIFIED BY CONSTRUCTION OF THE INSTRUMENT, and that verdict would
 land against Bouton 2012's biology rather than against REE's context
 representation. Classification: puzzle (known rules).
 (F5) RESURGENCE -- NOT TESTABLE; a STRUCTURAL GAP, not a prediction this operator
 makes. Requires dissolution state SHARED ACROSS COMPETING library candidates;
 MECH-324's gate is per-chunk on its own variance, and nothing in policy_chunking.py
 implements a competition term (VERIFIED 2026-08-28). Classification: complicated
 (buildable), zero evidence either way.
TRANSFER LIMIT ON F1 / F4 / F5 -- load-bearing, not boilerplate. The sources are
rodent T-maze procedural learning (Barnes 2005) and single-response operant
contingencies (Bouton 2012). In both, the extinguished object is a SINGLE RESPONSE;
a chunk is BY CONSTRUCTION multi-element, and REE's outcome dimension is an
E3-score-receipt over policy primitives rather than a food reward. Whether a
SEQUENCE extinguishes with the same asymmetry -- and whether context-dependence of
extinction survives COMPOSITION at all -- is EXTRAPOLATION, NOT EVIDENCE.
SHARED EXPERIMENT: F1 and C2/C3/C4 are scored by the SAME chunking-lifecycle run
that scores MECH-323's C2/F1/F2. C1/F2 (the ARM_1-vs-ARM_2 dissociation) is a
SEPARATE, agent-level design and inherits the LEG-3 readiness gap -- do not bundle
it into the lifecycle run.

MECH-325.subject: hippocampus.cue_indexed_trajectory_library

exists (ree_core/utils/config.py:3267, hippocampal/module.py:2428) but agent.py detaches z_world
before extract_cue_context and detaches action_bias, so no live loss backprops through
propose_trajectories to cue_action_proj -- confirmed still the case (ARC-072 as_of 2026-09-17; the
SD-055 fix left the detaches in place). Without a live gradient, "PFC cues pattern-complete against
the store" has no learning signal to shape the store by. (b) Gap 1 (persistent store): no cross-tick
trajectory-accumulation code exists anywhere in ree_core -- the V3 HippocampalModule (ARC-007
STRICT CEM) generates K candidates fresh every tick and stores nothing across ticks. (c) MECH-292/

builds beyond, must remain distinguishable in any test -- a test that cannot tell arbitrary-cue
retrieval apart from spatial-proximity retrieval is not testing this claim.
CONFIRMING: once (a)-(c) are met -- first the claim's own V3 staging diagnostic (cue_action_proj
gradient confirmed live) then the full store -- distinguishable PFC context/goal states retrieve
distinguishable trajectory-template subsets from a store that persists across ticks (not merely
across one CEM refit), at retrieval accuracy above a cue-permuted control (showing retrieval tracks
the cue, not incidental context change).
FALSIFYING: with the gradient live and a persistent store built, retrieval does not differentiate
by PFC context cue (a cue-permuted control performs equivalently to the true-cue condition), or the
store's benefit is fully explained by spatial proximity alone (no advantage over MECH-292/293's
spatially-indexed bank) -- the arbitrary-cue-indexing clause fails and the claim narrows to

UNBLOCKS WHEN: SD-055's detach points (agent.py z_world/action_bias before extract_cue_context) are
removed so the gradient reaches cue_action_proj (Gap 2), AND a cross-tick trajectory-recorder is
built (Gap 1). Per ARC-072's own disposition these are independent and can be worked in parallel;
the claim's own V3 staging diagnostic needs only Gap 2 closed.

MECH-326.subject: pfc.context_bias_hippocampal_retrieval_gate
MECH-326.title: pfc_context_bias_as_hippocampal_retrieval_gate -- PFC active goal/task representations send top-down bias signals that steer which hippocampal trajectory templates are retrieved or replayed; different PFC context states should produce different hippocampal retrieval subsets, enabling context-appropriate behavioral option selection; without this routing, the trajectory library is queried uniformly regardless of goal state.

The differentiable-CEM path must also be ON, since with use_differentiable_cem False no gradient reaches cue_action_proj at all.
CONFIRMING: With retrieval separation witnessed, different active contexts produce measurably different proposed candidate sets at matched state, and the divergence collapses in the context-shuffled and channel-OFF arms. Manipulation: Cross use_differentiable_cem ON versus OFF with E3Config.use_action_object_bias_channel ON versus OFF, and contrast candidate sets proposed under different active goal or cue contexts at matched state. Control: A context-shuffled arm in which the cue is mis-paired with the state at matched entropy, so any retrieval divergence is attributable to the context signal rather than to state differences or to proposal noise. Required event: Two or more distinct active goal or cue contexts within a run on a goal-rich environment, each followed by hippocampal candidate proposal, so the retrieved candidate sets can be compared context against context. DV: Cue-conditioned divergence of the proposed candidate set and of the committed action across contexts -- distributional distance between per-context candidate distributions -- not a gradient-flow statistic, which V3-EXQ-568 already established.
FALSIFYING: Under witnessed non-degenerate retrieval, the proposed candidate distribution is statistically indistinguishable across contexts -- the trajectory store is queried uniformly regardless of goal state, which is the failure mode the claim names. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The V3 staging path is built and validated: SD-055's softmax-weighted CEM mean restores gradient to cue_action_proj (use_differentiable_cem in hippocampal/module.py:2428, V3-EXQ-568 PASS), and a per-candidate E3 ranking channel for the cue action bias landed 2026-09-01 (compute_action_object_alignment_bias, e3_selector.py:297, called at agent.py:9353). The MECH-325 trajectory library it would retrieve from returns zero hits anywhere in ree_core. Consumer / boundary: The hippocampal retrieval / proposal step, keyed by an active context -- the claim asserts z_goal as the key, whereas the built cue path keys on z_world through extract_cue_context. Existing ownership: SD-055, SD-016, MECH-325, ARC-072, EXP-0968.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The claim's key is z_goal, but the built retrieval path is keyed on z_world through extract_cue_context, so the asserted PFC-goal bias has no route to the retrieval operation. Above that, MECH-325's trajectory library does not exist in ree_core, and the behavioural cue-divergence run SD-055 deferred has still never been queued. Secondary classes: R5, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. MECH-327.subject: play.pe_locus_probe_action_selection
MECH-327.title: During sensorimotor play, E1 prediction-error locus upweights probe-action selection: actions targeting high-PE regions of z_world are preferentially selected, implementing curiosity-driven exploration within the play frame.
MECH-327.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Two things must be non-degenerate. The PE terrain over z_world must vary across regions, and the curiosity bias must have live dynamic range at selection (the recorded model_disagreement_bonus_range must be non-zero) so the bias is not swamped inside the E3 argmin. A play frame that can be switched on and off is the third, missing, requirement.
CONFIRMING: High-PE-targeting action selection rises inside the play frame relative to a matched non-play episode with the same PE terrain, and the rise disappears when the curiosity bonus is ablated. Manipulation: Play frame ON versus OFF at matched PE terrain, with the PE-driven curiosity bonus enabled in both arms -- the claim's content is the frame-conditional UPWEIGHT, not the existence of a PE bias. Control: A curiosity-bonus-OFF arm (use_model_disagreement_curiosity and use_structured_curiosity both false) and a non-play episode with identical PE terrain and identical candidate sets. Required event: A sensorimotor play episode in which some regions of z_world carry measurably higher prediction error than others, and probe-type actions toward those regions are available. DV: The fraction of selected actions targeting the top-PE quantile of z_world, inside versus outside the play frame at matched terrain -- confirming requires the in-frame fraction to exceed the out-of-frame fraction, over and above the frame-free bonus effect.
FALSIFYING: The high-PE-targeting fraction is the same inside and outside the play frame at matched terrain, which would make MECH-327 a restatement of the already-built frame-free curiosity bonus rather than a play-specific mechanism. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The bias side is instrumented -- e3_selector records last_score_diagnostics["model_disagreement_bonus_range"] (:3905) and StructuredCuriosity exposes compute_score_bias (ree_core/policy/structured_curiosity.py:356). The conditional cannot be formed because no play-frame tag exists anywhere in ree_core. Consumer / boundary: E3 action-object candidate scoring before CEM evaluation, conditioned on the frame tag -- not goal representation, which is MECH-328's territory. Existing ownership: ARC-049, MECH-194, GFLAG-0118, MECH-441, MECH-314.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); The PE-weighted exploration bonus is BUILT and reaches E3 scoring; what is missing is the play frame that makes this claim distinct from MECH-441 and MECH-314. Without a frame tag the claim cannot be stated as a conditional, so it is both unrunnable and, as written, indistinguishable from the shipped mechanism. Secondary classes: R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-328.what_would_answer:

Manipulation: Use shared versus disjoint synthetic/real goal embeddings with an explicit alignment control. FALSIFYING: Comparable transfer survives a verified disjoint mapping without an alignment route, or shared representation is insufficient after play competence holds. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

MECH-329.subject: development.wanting_before_liking_goal_seeding_sequence
MECH-329.title: The wanting system (mesolimbic dopamine / approach motivation) seeds z_goal anchors via accidental benefit contacts before the liking system (hedonic evaluation) is calibrated -- producing a first wave of super-ordinal goals shaped by approach drive rather than calibrated preference.
MECH-329.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The write path must fire at all (both_delayed positive control forming anchors and writes), the wanting-schedule manipulation must take, and the anchor store must not saturate at one slot. All three were MET in V3-EXQ-669c (19 anchors and 550 writes in the control, max_anchor_count 64 across arms), so the SD-077 context-diversity ceiling that made this claim unmeasurable is lifted.
CONFIRMING: Anchors laid down in the wanting-first window are predominantly approach-triggered and survive the write freeze, and removing Phase 0 contacts (transient benefit patches off) leaves the adult store structurally empty relative to the wanting-first arm. Manipulation: Schedule contrast on the ORDER of system onset -- wanting_first (z_goal seeding active in the child window, benefit_eval delayed) versus liking_first (the reverse) versus both_delayed as the write-path positive control. Control: both_delayed forced-feed arm establishing that writes fire when the substrate is fed, and a matched-seed liking_first arm so anchor formation under calibrated preference is the comparator rather than an empty store. Required event: A phase-gated developmental run in which approach drive (z_goal seeding) is active before hedonic evaluation is calibrated, and accidental benefit contacts occur during that window. DV: Not anchor COUNT alone. The distinguishing quantity is the CONTENT of the first wave: the fraction of child-phase anchors whose write was triggered by approach-drive proximity rather than by a calibrated benefit evaluation, and the downstream adult consequence (goal-hierarchy occupancy and adult seeding rate) when Phase 0 contacts are removed.
FALSIFYING: Anchor composition is indistinguishable between wanting-first and liking-first once counts are matched, or the adult hierarchy is unaffected by removing the Phase 0 accidental-contact window -- the ordering carries no consequence for what the hierarchy contains. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SuperOrdinalGoalMemory.get_state exposes only aggregates -- n_writes, n_reinforce, n_allocate, n_occupied, last_salience, last_complexity. There is no per-anchor provenance record of WHICH drive triggered each write, so the 669 line can only score counts and a complexity percentile, which is what it does. Consumer / boundary: The child-phase write gate in REEAgent.update_z_goal (the MECH-189 salience-and-complexity conjunction), and the resulting composition of the adult goal hierarchy. Existing ownership: MECH-189, SD-077, INF-ENV-003, EXP-0081, SD-049-PHASE-2.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The substrate is built and now demonstrably non-degenerate, but the only experiment line scores anchor COUNT and a p01 complexity percentile. Neither addresses the claim's actual content -- that the FIRST WAVE is shaped by approach drive rather than calibrated preference -- and the anchor store records no per-write provenance, so composition cannot be scored without new telemetry. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-330.subject: action.idle_aversion_acute_restlessness_accumulator
MECH-330.title: idle_aversion_acute_restlessness_accumulator (engagement-rate-keyed aversive accumulator on z_harm_a / affective stream at the acute timescale ~minutes/tens-of-episodes. First child mechanism for ARC-067. Routes boredom-aversive through SD-011 affective harm stream / AIC analog per Danckert 2018 AIC-deactivation under boredom and Wilson 2014 Science self-shock exchangeability with physical pain. Three-input executive-engagement-rate estimator: commit transitions per episode, E3 deliberation depth, residue-write rate; novel-observation count dropped as primary input (van Tilburg 2017 meaning-seeking not stimulation-seeking). MAC meaning-component adds a parallel secondary channel via existing z_goal substrate (SD-012 / MECH-308). Cross-talk to MECH-331: sustained MECH-330 activation without discharge seeds the chronic frontostriatal effort-allocation substrate.)
MECH-330.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The environment must be able to hold the agent in a genuinely low-engagement state -- well fed, safe, familiar, no active z_goal -- for long enough to integrate over H_acute, while leaving action available; and the always-on action-pressure sources (MECH-313 noise floor, MECH-320 tonic vigor, structured curiosity) must be held fixed across arms so any action-density change is attributable to the boredom channel.
CONFIRMING: Action density rises at the boredom_t threshold crossing in the MECH-330-ON arm only, decays after discharge, and exceeds the yoked-constant control -- showing the aversive is engagement-keyed rather than a generic z_harm_a offset. Manipulation: ARC-067 OFF versus MECH-330 ON (the engagement-rate-keyed accumulator writing w_boredom * boredom_t into z_harm_a), with e_threshold and H_acute pre-registered. Control: The ARC-067-OFF arm at the MECH-313 noise floor, plus a yoked arm in which an equal-magnitude constant is written to z_harm_a irrespective of engagement rate, which separates the aversive write from its engagement keying. Required event: A sustained idle period in which the engagement-rate estimate (commit transitions, E3 deliberation depth, residue-write rate) falls below threshold, followed by a discharge event (a commit transition or residue-write spike). DV: Action density time-locked to the boredom_t threshold crossing -- rising specifically after crossing and not before -- together with the decay of action density after a discharge event, both measured against the yoked-constant control.
FALSIFYING: Action density in the ON arm is indistinguishable from the noise floor, or matches the yoked-constant arm, which would mean the engagement-rate keying carries no behavioural content and boredom is better treated as one more generic action-pressure term. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Absent end to end. There is no boredom, idle_aversion or engagement_rate symbol anywhere in ree_core; the three named inputs are not composed into a windowed rate estimator, and no recorder emits boredom_t. The sibling pure-arithmetic modules that fix the build pattern do exist (policy/noise_floor.py for MECH-313, policy/tonic_vigor.py for MECH-320), as does the z_harm_a affective stream and its E3 consumption path. Consumer / boundary: The z_harm_a affective-harm stream write, feeding E3 scoring through the same channel physical harm uses -- deliberately not the SD-037 broadcast override and not the score-side vigor or noise layers. Existing ownership: ARC-067, EXP-0973, MECH-331.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); The mechanism is unbuilt and unowned: no accumulator, no engagement-rate estimator, no boredom_t recorder, and no substrate_queue entry for ARC-067 at all (the queue holds ARC-066 tonic vigor only). Neither the ON arm nor the DV can be produced. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: NEW NODE REQUIRED. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-331.subject: action.idle_aversion_chronic_anhedonic_flatness
MECH-331.title: idle_aversion_chronic_anhedonic_flatness_substrate (slow-integrating frontostriatal effort-allocation substrate at the chronic timescale ~sessions/episode-blocks. Second child mechanism for ARC-067. Seeded by sustained MECH-330 acute-restlessness activation without discharge. Implements the apathy archetype (Husain-Roiser 2018 frontostriatal effort-allocation failure) as a slow-integrating complement to MECH-330's acute restlessness pole. Preserved hedonic experience (MECH-295 liking-channel intact); impaired effort-to-act mobilisation. HPA-axis substrate context (Ulrich-Lai & Herman 2009 chronic understimulation / loss-of-control signature). Ablation predicts reduced action-density in long-horizon episodes even when MECH-330 acute restlessness is firing -- the chronic substrate damps the effort-mobilisation pathway below what the acute channel alone can drive.)
MECH-331.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-330 must be firing and measurable first -- the chronic substrate is defined as a function of sustained undischarged boredom -- and the run must span enough episodes for H_chronic to integrate, with the acute channel held identical across the acute-only and chronic arms so the attenuation is attributable to the chronic gain and not to a different boredom level.
CONFIRMING: At equivalent episodes and equivalent boredom_t, the chronic arm shows lower action density than the acute-only arm while E3 scoring and the liking channel are unchanged, and recovery after sustained discharge is slow at H_chronic. Manipulation: Three arms: ARC-067 OFF; MECH-330 ON only; MECH-330 plus MECH-331 ON, where fatigue_t scales down the z_harm_a write gain with a configurable gain_floor. Control: The MECH-330-ON-only arm at equivalent episode index is the load-bearing comparator, plus an E3-intact check confirming attenuation is specific to the z_harm_a write gain rather than to trajectory scoring. Required event: Sustained boredom above b_chronic_threshold across N episodes without a discharge event, producing the seed signal, followed by long-horizon episodes in which action is still available. DV: Action density in the chronic arm relative to the acute-only arm at matched episode index and matched boredom_t, together with an E3-side specificity readout showing candidate scoring is unchanged -- preserved capacity with impaired mobilisation.
FALSIFYING: The chronic arm's action density matches the acute-only arm, or the attenuation also appears in E3 scoring or the liking channel -- which would make this hedonic or scoring failure rather than the apathy signature the claim asserts. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Absent: neither pole exists in ree_core, so fatigue_t, the seed signal and the write-gain are all unrecorded. The one piece of prior art is the cross-episode persistence pattern -- MECH-295's liking bridge keeps counters across episodes while its per-tick cache resets -- which is the shape the session-level fatigue buffer would need. Consumer / boundary: The z_harm_a write amplitude from the acute channel (the effort-mobilisation gain), explicitly not E3.select trajectory scoring and explicitly not the MECH-295 liking channel. Existing ownership: ARC-067, MECH-330, EXP-0975.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); Both poles are unbuilt with no substrate owner, and the chronic pole additionally needs across-episode agent state that only MECH-295-style counters currently demonstrate. Its seed signal is defined in terms of MECH-330, which does not exist, so the arm ordering itself is unbuildable today. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: NEW NODE REQUIRED. Scope: v3_native. Coordinator: Merged with MECH-330 and ARC-067 into ONE registered node (engagement-rate estimator + discharge marker); see prerequisites_registered. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-332.subject: harm_stream.nociceptive_attenuation_dual_substrate_dissociation
MECH-332.title: Nociceptive attenuation on z_harm_s is implemented by two mechanistically dissociable parallel pathways: (1) per-step efference-copy comparator (MECH-256/SD-029, spinal/cortical substrate, triggered by a_actual) and (2) commitment-gated PAG/RVM precision suppression (SD-021, PAG/RVM substrate, triggered by committed-trajectory state). Their substrates and triggers are independent; their attenuation effects are additive.
MECH-332.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (four gates; all four must be recorded in the manifest as MEASURED values, and the first is the one both prior runs silently failed).

(P0) REALISED-CONFIG PROOF, not declared flags. V3-EXQ-878 and 878a both recorded `harm_descending_mod_enabled: true` per arm while the live config held `False`, because `REEConfig.from_dims()` silently drops undeclared kwargs and whole sub-config objects. Any run scored against this claim MUST (i) set both Pathway-2 knobs by attribute assignment on the returned config (`config.harm_descending_mod_enabled = True`, `config.heartbeat.beta_gate_bistable = True`) -- the idiom `v3_exq_325a_sd021_descending_pain_modulation.py:130-133` already uses -- and (ii) read the values back off the constructed config and emit those read-back values, not the intended flags dict. Additionally: `ARM_BOTH` and `ARM_E2_ONLY` must differ on at least one Pathway-2-sensitive quantity (e.g. `z_harm_s_mean_uncommitted`). A bit-identical ARM_BOTH/ARM_E2_ONLY pair is not a null result -- it is proof the A factor is inert, and it self-routes `substrate_not_ready`.

(P1) COMMITMENT LIVE (inherited -- see MECH-090's own `what_would_answer` for the persistent-handle / object-identity precondition; do not re-derive). `n_committed_steps >= 8` in every A=ON arm on at least 2 of 3 seeds, AND `z_harm_s_mean_committed > 0`. In V3-EXQ-878 the reported `z_harm_s_ratio = 1.0` in every arm was a fabricated 0/0 (`z_harm_s_mean_committed = 0.0`, `n_committed_steps = 0`), not a measured null.

(P2) EVENT BALANCE, ENFORCED AS A GATE (inherited -- this is SD-029's C0/C2 precondition; see SD-029's own `what_would_answer` for why it has been the binding constraint for 13+ runs, and do not re-derive it). Per seed, per E=ON arm: `n_agent_caused_trials >= 6` AND `n_env_caused_trials >= 6`, AND `residual_agent_caused_mean > 1e-3`. This must gate `d2_pass`, not merely be recorded beside it: V3-EXQ-878 seed 13 had `n_agent_caused_trials = 0`, whose `self_other_discrimination_ratio = residual_env / max(1e-6, residual_agent)` evaluated to 1.8e5 and trivially cleared the 1.15 floor, scoring `d2_pass: true` vacuously.

(P3) HARM CHANNEL LIVE AND NON-SATURATED (the precondition shared across the z_harm_s / z_harm_a family; see MECH-219's `what_would_answer` for the dynamic-range wording and SD-011's for the regime-declaration requirement). The run must declare `harm_history_len`, `use_gabaergic_decay`, and `limb_damage_enabled`, and z_harm_s must show nonzero variance across both the committed/uncommitted partition and the agent-caused/env-caused partition. A flat or saturated z_harm_s makes both `z_harm_s_ratio` and `self_other_discrimination_ratio` fabricated quantities regardless of how the flags landed.

CONFIRMING (thresholds pre-registered in V3-EXQ-878; PASS on >= 2 of 3 seeds). Four-arm 2x2 on Factor E (`use_e2_harm_s_forward`) x Factor A (`use_aic_analog` + `harm_descending_mod_enabled`), arms ARM_BOTH / ARM_E2_ONLY / ARM_AIC_ONLY / ARM_NEITHER, identical arena and curriculum across arms:
- D1 (Pathway 2 works without Pathway 1): `|z_harm_s_ratio[AIC_ONLY] - z_harm_s_ratio[BOTH]| <= 0.20` AND both `<= z_harm_s_ratio[NEITHER] - 0.03`. That is: commitment-gated attenuation of z_harm_s appears whether or not the efference-copy forward model is trained, and is near-equal in magnitude with and without it.
- D2 (Pathway 1 works without Pathway 2): `|self_other[E2_ONLY] - self_other[BOTH]| <= 0.60` AND both `>= 1.15`. That is: the residual `z_harm_s_observed - E2_harm_s(z_harm_s_{t-1}, a_actual)` is measurably smaller on agent-caused than on externally-caused hazard transitions, with the descending pathway entirely absent -- and the Shergill-2003 partial, graded pattern, not binary abolition (this is the same discriminator SD-029's CONFIRMING clause states; a near-total attenuation falsifies there and here).
- D3 (independence / non-interference, NOT literal additivity): `z_harm_s_ratio[BOTH] <= z_harm_s_ratio[AIC_ONLY] + 0.15` AND `self_other[BOTH] >= self_other[E2_ONLY] - 0.15`. That is: each pathway's own signature metric survives undegraded when the other is co-active. No summed-gain number is claimed or measured, because Pathway 1 is not a gain on z_harm_s at all -- it is a prediction residual consumed by the MECH-276 attribution buffer, while only Pathway 2 multiplies z_harm in `agent.sense()`.
- SELECTIVITY (from SD-021's already-drafted falsifier, cross-referenced not re-derived): z_harm_a must remain unattenuated in every A=ON arm. Attenuating both streams is the Hofbauer-2001 violation SD-021 already names.

FALSIFYING (any one, with P0-P3 all met -- otherwise the run is non_contributory, not a refutation):
- D1 fails: with Pathway 1 ablated, z_harm_s attenuation during committed traversal collapses to the ARM_NEITHER level (`z_harm_s_ratio[AIC_ONLY] > z_harm_s_ratio[NEITHER] - 0.03`). Pathway 2 is then not independent -- it requires the forward model, and there is one pathway with two triggers, not two pathways.
- D2 fails: with Pathway 2 ablated, `self_other[E2_ONLY] < 1.15` on a seed whose event counts clear P2. Self/other discrimination on z_harm_s then depends on descending modulation, again collapsing the two pathways into one.
- D3 fails: either signature metric degrades by more than 0.15 when the other pathway is co-active -- one pathway crowds out or overwrites the other, refuting independence directly (this is the falsification most likely to be informative, since it is the only one of the three that cannot be produced by a mis-wired ablation).
- SELECTIVITY fails: z_harm_a is also attenuated in A=ON arms.

NOT falsifying, and this is the load-bearing exclusion: a bit-identical or near-identical pair of arms that differ only in flags proven un-landed at P0. Both existing MECH-332 runs (V3-EXQ-878 2026-08-03, V3-EXQ-878a 2026-08-08) fail P0 on measurement and are `non_contributory` for that reason, over and above the `n_committed_steps = 0` reason their autopsies recorded.

MECH-333.subject: learning.developmental_critical_period_open_phase
MECH-333.title: Critical period open phase: the dominant scoring pathway's effective update magnitude must be suppressed (or diversity circuit signal weight amplified to competitive parity) during a time-bounded plasticity-open window, preventing winner-take-all capture before diversity circuits achieve viable weight; REE analog of E/I balance shift and GABA maturation that opens biological critical periods.
MECH-333.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: only option (E) plasticity injection (the
post-window closure/plastic-channel half) is implemented
(GatedPolicy.crystallize(), 2026-05-17). The pre-window
F-ATTENUATION half (suppressing F's gradient contribution during the
open phase -- ARC-075 requirement 1) is NOT yet implemented; this is
the actual mechanism under test and it does not exist yet.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (already established by 5 consecutive
non_contributory harness failures -- 610a/b/c/d/e, all
measurement_test_design_defect or substrate_ceiling): requires (a) a
genuinely trained gated policy (610c/610d's harness never actually
trained it -- crystallize() froze never-trained heads, ewc_penalty
never entered the loss) and (b) a true negative control with noise
floor / E3 diversity / entropy bonus OFF in the D2 arm (610e's
control was confounded by MECH-313/MECH-341/entropy-bonus always-on
in BOTH arms, so D2 never showed the collapse a valid negative
control requires). A run reproducing any of these five defects is
NOT a fresh test of the mechanism.
CONFIRMING signature: once the pre-window F-attenuation is built and
a genuinely-trained policy is tested with a valid (collapsing) D2
negative control under Phase-3 destabilising pressure (SD-047/SD-048
multi-source dynamics + accelerated env_drift, already implemented
2026-06-01 IGW-20260601-023): the D2 control arm (no
crystallization/no open-phase gating) shows entropy COLLAPSE (delta
>= +0.10) under post-Phase-3 pressure, while the D1 arm (MECH-333
open-phase gating + MECH-334 closure) PRESERVES Phase-2 diversity.
FALSIFYING: even with a genuine training regime, a valid collapsing
negative control, and the pre-window F-attenuation actually built,
D1 (open-phase-gated) shows the SAME entropy collapse as D2
(ungated) under Phase-3 pressure -- the open-phase mechanism buys
nothing over ordinary training, falsifying the "temporary inversion
of the normal operating ratio" framing. The implementation-option
question (Q-052: which of learning-rate scheduling / magnitude
rescaling / gradient blocking / PV-analog penalty / plasticity
injection is the right computational form) is a SEPARATE open
question this wwa does not resolve.

MECH-334.title: Critical period closure / crystallization: once diversity circuits establish competitive weight during the MECH-333 open window, a complementary closure mechanism reduces plasticity for the crystallized diversity distribution while restoring full dominant-pathway update scale; without closure, diversity representations remain equally vulnerable to gradient-driven overwriting throughout all subsequent training.
