MECH-335.subject: basal_ganglia.staggered_commitment_loop_calibration_windows
MECH-335.title: Staggered ventral->dorsal commitment-loop calibration windows: the three commitment loops do not share a single critical period. Their calibration windows are staggered ventral->dorsal -- the limbic/value loop (ventral striatum / OFC) opens earliest and is the most environmentally sensitive, the associative loop next, the sensorimotor loop last -- with region-specific consolidation latencies (a calibration can be induced during a window but only expressed after it closes).
MECH-335.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The three commitment loops must be behaviourally dissociable before their calibration windows can be staggered: V3-EXQ-993a merged the three learning channels and found no degradation, and governance recorded that verdict as mixed because the merge acted on experiment-local surrogate heads over a frozen latent rather than the E1/E2/E3 modules ARC-021 names. Each loop must also have a per-loop expression readout, or a latently-consolidated calibration cannot be detected after window close.
CONFIRMING: Final calibration depends on window ORDER, with the ventral-first schedule outperforming reversed and shared schedules at equal total plasticity, and at least one loop showing a calibration that is measurable only after its window closes. Manipulation: Per-loop plasticity windows: freeze and unfreeze each learning channel's parameters (and apply the MECH-334 EWC anchor per channel) on a staggered schedule -- value/E3 channel first, then associative, then sensorimotor -- versus a single shared window, which is what crystallize_at_phase3 currently implements. Control: The single-shared-window arm (current infant_curriculum phase-3 crystallization) and a reversed-order arm, with total plasticity budget per channel equalised across arms. Required event: A staged developmental run in which each loop's plasticity window opens and closes at a different phase, followed by a post-window probe. DV: Per-loop calibration quality measured AFTER each window closes -- the post-critical-period expression test -- so an induced-but-unexpressed calibration is detectable; plus the order-dependence of final calibration across the forward, reversed and shared schedules.
FALSIFYING: Calibration outcome is invariant to window order and to staggering versus sharing, which would make ARC-076's single-window treatment sufficient and reduce this claim to a biological description with no REE consequence. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Partially present: MECH-334's EWC anchor and ewc_penalty plus crystallize_at_phase3 give a global window, and experiments/infant_curriculum.py provides the phase structure. Missing: per-channel window control and any post-window per-loop expression readout, so latent consolidation cannot currently be separated from no calibration. Consumer / boundary: The plasticity schedule over the three learning channels, not the within-episode commitment decision; the claim's content is the ORDER of the windows and the lag between induction and expression. Existing ownership: ARC-076, ARC-021, MECH-334, V3-EXQ-993a, EXP-0977.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); No experiment stages per-loop windows even though drivers own their optimisers and could freeze channels independently, and the ventral-to-dorsal ordering has no registered mapping onto V3's three learning channels -- which of E1/E2/E3 is the limbic, associative or sensorimotor loop is nowhere stated, so the ordering prediction is not yet well-formed. Secondary classes: R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-336.subject: development.maladaptive_commitment_lock_failure_mode
MECH-336.title: Maladaptive-lock failure mode (personality-pathology analog): adequate environmental input does NOT determine the locked calibration value. A stable subset of agents locks a maladaptive commitment-loop configuration despite sufficient input (lock-onto-bad-calibration), and failure to lock at all yields an unstable / diffuse commitment policy. These are the REE substrate of personality-disorder-analog failure modes: lock-too-early / lock-onto-bad-value (rigid maladaptive personality) and failure-to-lock (identity diffusion).
MECH-336.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The lock must have a measurable behavioural consequence before lock QUALITY can vary: across six iterations (V3-EXQ-610a through 610f) the stripped no-crystallization control never collapsed (entropy deltas -0.010 to -0.012 with no entropy floor load-bearing), so locked and unlocked agents were behaviourally indistinguishable and a maladaptive-lock subpopulation could not be defined. Input adequacy must also be certified equal across agents, or an outcome spread is attributable to exposure rather than to under-determination.
CONFIRMING: At matched adequate input, post-lock outcomes are multi-modal with a stable maladaptive mode of non-trivial size, and a separate set of agents fails to lock at all and shows an unstable commitment policy -- both modes reproducible across seed batches. Manipulation: Crystallization ON (crystallize_at_phase3 with EWC anchor) versus OFF, across a seed population large enough to resolve a subpopulation, with the phase-3 task distribution conflicting with phases 0 to 2 as the V3-EXQ-656 redesign specifies. Control: The no-crystallization arm and an input-adequacy positive control demonstrating that the same curriculum can produce an adaptive lock, so failure-to-lock is distinguishable from failure-to-learn. Required event: A developmental window closing on many independently-seeded agents that received the same adequate curriculum, followed by a post-lock task-distribution shift that a well-calibrated policy should absorb. DV: The DISTRIBUTION across seeds of post-lock policy quality under the shifted task -- specifically whether it is multi-modal with a stable low-performing mode (lock-onto-bad-calibration) at matched input, and separately the dispersion of commitment policy within an agent over time (identity-diffusion arm: high variance, no stable configuration).
FALSIFYING: Post-lock outcomes are unimodal and tightly concentrated at matched input, which would restore the adequate-input-determines-calibration position and remove the REE handle on personality pathology. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Cross-seed distributions are recordable from existing arm_results, and the 610/655 drivers already log per-seed phase-2 and phase-3 action entropy plus EWC penalty magnitude. Missing: any lock-detection statistic (did this agent crystallize a stable configuration at all) and any pre-registered bimodality or subpopulation test; the existing criteria are arm-mean deltas that cannot see a subpopulation. Consumer / boundary: The post-window crystallized configuration itself -- which value got locked -- rather than the average effect of locking, which is what the INV-074 necessity line measures. Existing ownership: ARC-076, INV-074, MECH-334, V3-EXQ-656, EXP-0979.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The lock regime has never been instantiated: six necessity iterations plus V3-EXQ-655 failed to make the unlocked control collapse, so locking currently has no measurable consequence and a maladaptive lock cannot be distinguished from any other. The redesigned task-shift successor V3-EXQ-656 exists as a script with no manifest. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-337.subject: rule_apprehension.caregiver_scaffolded_rule_population
MECH-337.title: Caregiver-scaffolded rule-population mechanism (the 'in' face of the ARC-063 CandidateRule field). A caregiver / teacher agent structures the agent's exposure (Vygotsky ZPD; Wood/Bruner/Ross scaffolding) and marks regularities ostensively (Csibra & Gergely natural pedagogy); the marked regularity is written into the ARC-063 CandidateRule field as a candidate the agent could not have invented alone, tagged with the scaffolding context. Population is context-bound by construction -- this is the concrete mechanism behind 'context-bound rule population'. Child of ARC-077. Structural slot only; hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull and a caregiver-agent substrate that does not exist in V3.
MECH-337.what_would_answer:
Freshly derived (no existing Falsifiable clause; built from this claim's own functional_restatement + MECH-338's test shape). Once a caregiver/ teacher-agent substrate exists (multi-agent extension to the current single-agent V3 loop) and can write into the live ARC-063 CandidateRule field: MECH-337 would be SUPPORTED if, when a caregiver agent ostensively marks a regularity during exposure structured within the learner's zone-of- proximal-development, the marked regularity is instantiated as a CandidateRule (status=latent) carrying context tags from the scaffolding episode -- and this happens for regularities the learner's own unsupervised exploration does NOT independently discover within a matched budget.
FALSIFIED if candidate rules populated via the caregiver channel are indistinguishable in content and context-binding from candidates the agent's own bottom-up extraction (ARC-064) would produce anyway on a no-caregiver control -- i.e. the caregiver channel adds no candidate the agent couldn't have generated itself. Non-degeneracy precondition: the no-caregiver control must itself fail to populate the target regularity within the matched budget (otherwise the comparison is vacuous).
[2026-08-27 thought-digestion]: verified live -- grep for caregiver/teacher_agent/TeacherAgent across ree-v3/ree_core/ returns zero hits; the substrate genuinely does not exist. Two of the three prerequisites this claim's own implementation_prerequisites text names are now discharged (GAP-L lit-pull complete 2026-05-18; the ARC-063 CandidateRule field is now confirmed BUILT, landed 2026-06-04). The sole remaining blocker is the caregiver/teacher-agent multi-agent substrate.

MECH-338.subject: rule_apprehension.cue_driven_context_bound_rule_retrieval
MECH-338.title: Cue-driven context-bound rule retrieval (the 'cue pipeline' / 'select' face of the ARC-063 CandidateRule field). Environmental or internal cues are matched against CandidateRule context tags to gate rollout-eligibility: a rule populated in a context becomes available again when that context, or a cue associated with it, recurs (context-dependent / cued recall; Tulving & Thomson encoding-specificity; Godden & Baddeley context-dependent memory). This is the retrieval pay-off of context-bound population (MECH-337) and the access gate that decides which CandidateRules enter hippocampal rollout. Child of ARC-077. Structural slot only; hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull.
MECH-338.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The field must hold at least two rules with genuinely differentiated context_tags and clear the tolerance gate: V3-EXQ-654d showed that when tags cluster within the match threshold, 7 to 8 rules co-match per tick and theta rises to roughly 1.65, gating every matched rule out. So mature_context_match_threshold (or an equivalent tag-spread control) must be set so n_matched falls to about 2 to 3 before the matched-versus-mismatched contrast means anything.
CONFIRMING: Rollout-eligibility for the target rule is reliably higher under the tag-overlapping cue than under the matched non-overlapping cue, and the advantage disappears in the scrambled-tag control. Manipulation: Present cue A, which overlaps the tags of a rule minted in context A, versus a matched cue B that does not, on the identical rule field -- a within-pool cue swap, not a population manipulation. Control: The same rules under a scrambled-tag arm (tags permuted across rules, preserving tag geometry but destroying the population-time association), which separates retrieval-relevant tag content from tag-vector statistics. Required event: A tick at which the current context either overlaps a stored rule's context_tag or is matched-but-non-overlapping, with the same candidate pool present in both conditions. DV: Rollout-eligibility of the target rule -- whether it is selected active by gate_and_select and enters the rule_state handed to SD-033a -- under matched versus mismatched cue, on the same pool and at matched n_matched.
FALSIFYING: Eligibility is statistically indistinguishable between matched and mismatched cues at matched n_matched, meaning the context tags written at population time carry no retrieval-relevant information and the in/select coupling asserted in the title fails. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Present: CandidateRuleField.gate_and_select sets rule.active (available AND context-matched) and exposes active_rule_state; the agent records the CRF source at its step site. Missing: no experiment runs the matched-versus-mismatched cue contrast -- the 654 lineage tests ARC-062/ARC-063 rule-state differentiation and churn, not cued retrieval. Consumer / boundary: The retrieval/availability gate inside the CandidateRule field, upstream of the ARC-063 Tolerance-Principle eligibility decision it feeds -- not the population path MECH-337 owns. Existing ownership: MECH-338, ARC-063, arc_062_rule_apprehension:GAP-B, EXP-0372, MECH-337.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The retrieval mechanism is built and live but no experiment fires the cue-match contrast, and the field's own tag-crowding regime can gate every matched rule out unless the mature threshold levers are set. The claim's registered sequencing behind the absent caregiver substrate is the other, non-mechanical, blocker. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA says the falsifier is inherently sequenced behind MECH-337's caregiver-agent substrate, verified absent. The SELECT face has since landed independently: ree_core/policy/candidate_rule_field.py implements cue-driven retrieval as cosine(context, rule.context_tag) against context_match_threshold, with gate_and_select feeding the tolerance gate, and the agent ticks it live under use_candidate_rule_field. Retrieval by context tag does not depend on WHO wrote the tag, so the caregiver gate is not load-bearing for this claim's own falsifier. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-339.subject: hippocampal.composite_retrieval_cue_outshining_gate
MECH-339.title: Composite retrieval cue: the ghost-bank cue is z_goal plus a context channel composed from the already-preserved-but-match-unused SD-039 payload fields (arousal_tag, last_vs, cause), combined by an outshining gate so a strong direct z_goal match suppresses the context channel. Context-cue retrieval is the conditional fallback regime, not an always-on additive term.
MECH-339.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both inputs to the gated term must have live range on the SAME anchor pool: (a) AnchorSetConfig.goal_cue_centering must be True, because on a raw cue z_goal pairwise cosine sits at 0.988 in the SD-008 common-mode cone, goal_match exceeds outshine_pivot for every anchor and the gate is identically 0.0 -- the context channel is unconditionally dead (pinned by test_sd_079_centered_goal_anchor_match.py C3); and (b) AnchorGoalPayload.arousal_tag must be non-zero with cross-anchor spread, which requires the BLA analog writing tags at encoding, since the field defaults to 0.0 and context_salience is then exactly 0.
CONFIRMING: In the strong-direct-match stratum the GATED arm's top-1 entry matches OFF on essentially every cue while FIXED_ADDITIVE changes it on a non-trivial fraction; in the weak-match stratum the GATED arm changes the top-1 entry relative to OFF at a rate well above the OFF-versus-OFF reshuffle floor, on at least 2 of 3 seeds. Manipulation: Three ranking arms over the identical anchor pool and identical cues: OFF (use_composite_cue_outshining False, the shipped default), GATED (composite on, context_weight > 0, outshine_pivot 0.5 -- the MECH-339 form), and FIXED_ADDITIVE (context term added with the gate forced to 1.0, i.e. no outshining). Control: The OFF arm at identical seeds and identical stored anchors is the bit-identical baseline; FIXED_ADDITIVE is the discriminating comparator that isolates the gate rather than the context channel. Required event: A populated ghost-goal bank ranked on a live agent across two retrieval regimes within one run: cues with a strong direct centered goal_match above outshine_pivot, and cues whose direct match is weak or absent, with arousal-tagged and untagged anchors present in both. DV: Top-1 bank entry identity, measured separately in the strong-direct-match and weak-direct-match strata: the rate at which the top-ranked anchor changes between OFF and each composite arm, plus the realised gate value and context_term distribution per stratum.
FALSIFYING: With centering on and arousal spread measured, either the GATED arm changes the top-1 entry as often as FIXED_ADDITIVE does in the strong-match stratum (the outshining gate is not load-bearing and the composite collapses to a fixed-weight additive term), or it changes nothing in the weak-match stratum (the context channel carries no retrieval signal at all). A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: GhostGoalBank.rank emits per-entry components including the context term, and _outshine_gate / _context_salience_for_anchor are directly readable (ree_core/hippocampal/ghost_goal_bank.py); V3-EXQ-594 exercises the four predictions on synthetic anchors. No driver fires the channel on a centered cue with real arousal tags -- v3_exq_807 and v3_exq_823 measure the SD-079 centering itself and record the gate as pinned. Consumer / boundary: The retrieval-cue composition step upstream of ghost_priority ranking, i.e. which stored anchor is returned, not the downstream consumer of the returned anchor. Existing ownership: MECH-339, SD-079, MECH-292, EXP-1348, V3-EXQ-594.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); At shipped defaults the mechanism cannot enter its discriminating regime: goal_cue_centering is False, so the gate is identically 0.0 on every anchor (measured and contract-pinned), and arousal_tag defaults to 0.0, so context_salience is 0 even if the gate opened. V3-EXQ-594 validated the arithmetic on synthetic anchors; no run fires the channel on a real centered bank. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-340.subject: hippocampal.persistence_efficacy_gate
MECH-340.title: The persistence/efficacy gate: a control/efficacy-detection signal that maintains an unresolved-goal bank entry as an active MECH-293 re-probe target. Its ABSENCE is the default (the entry stops being re-probed and decays in MECH-292 rank; the SD-039 trace is NOT erased). It is gated ON by an unattainability-negative / control-positive appraisal, NOT by accumulated failure, repeated suppression, bare effort-cost, or staleness.
MECH-340.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The gate must be armed and able to vary: use_persistence_efficacy_gate defaults False and persistence_default_when_appraisal_missing is 1.0, so with no appraisal supplied the license is identically 1 and no anchor is ever excluded. The agent must also hold bank entries that WOULD otherwise be re-probed, so exclusion has something to act on, and the appraisal must span both sides of persistence_floor (0.05).
CONFIRMING: Gate-ON with a licit appraisal keeps entries eligible while control is appraised as present and lets them decay out of re-probe when it is not, with no dependence on accumulated failure, effort-cost or staleness, and the behavioural arms reproduce the predicted give-up / persistence asymmetry. Manipulation: Three arms: gate OFF (pure disengagement default); gate ON with the licit appraisal (control_efficacy x (1 - goal_unattainability)); and a mis-keyed arm in which the gate is driven by accumulated failure, repeated suppression or MECH-292 staleness -- the hard negatives the claim forbids. Control: The gate-ON arm with appraisal held constant (license fixed above the floor) so that rank decay attributable to MECH-292 is separated from exclusion attributable to the gate, plus a gate-stuck-ON arm for the rumination leg. Required event: An unresolved goal held in the ghost-goal bank while the agent's control/efficacy appraisal changes -- i.e. a goal that becomes appraised as unattainable or out of control without being achieved. DV: Re-probe behaviour over time: the rate at which excluded entries are proposed as MECH-293 awake re-probe targets and the decay of their MECH-292 rank, plus the behavioural signatures the claim names -- premature abandonment under the OFF arm, perseverative re-probing under stuck-ON, and cross-goal generalisation of passivity under the failure-keyed arm.
FALSIFYING: Exclusion tracks accumulated failure, suppression count, effort-cost or staleness rather than the appraisal; or gate-OFF and gate-ON produce indistinguishable re-probe behaviour and downstream persistence; or the gate erases rather than merely de-prioritises the trace. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/hippocampal/ghost_goal_bank.py _persistence_license and the rank() exclusion, ree-v3/ree_core/hippocampal/persistence_appraisal_compute.py, and the contracts in tests/contracts/test_mech340_persistence_efficacy_gate.py record the mechanism-level DV. V3-EXQ-607 exercised only that layer (PASS, experiment_purpose diagnostic). No recorder exists for the apathy / rumination / generalised-passivity phenotypes. Consumer / boundary: Ghost-goal bank re-probe eligibility -- an entry stops being proposed to MECH-293 while its SD-039 trace is preserved; the claim asserts the gate reads ONLY the appraisal struct, never failure tallies or staleness. Existing ownership: EXP-1349, Q-053, MECH-293, MECH-292, ARC-079.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The only run is V3-EXQ-607, a diagnostic that verified the license arithmetic and exclusion, not a discriminative test of the three falsifying legs; there is no behavioural recorder for premature give-up, rumination or generalised passivity, and the licit gate signal is deliberately left open as Q-053, so the failure-keyed leg cannot yet be adjudicated. Secondary classes: R2, R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-341.subject: ethics_engine_3.scoring_trajectory_class_diversity_preservation
MECH-341.title: e3_scoring_preserves_trajectory_class_diversity. E3 score aggregation over CEM-supplied candidates must preserve trajectory-class diversity rather than collapse a diverse candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. Without explicit diversity preservation at the scoring step, downstream action selection becomes deterministic regardless of proposal-layer diversity (ARC-065 SP-CEM child), making the whole distributed diversity pathway rate-limited by Layer B. Mechanism options (not yet committed): (1) entropy bonus over candidate first-action classes added to E3 score; (2) class- stratified argmax with within-class proportional sampling; (3) jittered tie-breaking when top-K E3 scores are within epsilon. Final design pending diagnostic data on whether E3 collapse is near-tie or large-gap (see behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan.md Phase P2).
MECH-341.what_would_answer:
SCOPE, ratified 2026-06-14 and load-bearing for reading this falsifier. MECH-341 asserts
scoring-layer PRESERVATION -- that E3 score aggregation does not collapse an upstream-diverse
candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. It does NOT assert that the preserved
diversity reaches the COMMITTED action; that conversion is the shared E3 selection-authority
ceiling tracked on `behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-A` / MECH-439 F-dominance, and is MECH-442's
territory, not this claim's. A flat committed-action-class entropy is therefore not evidence
against MECH-341 (614e and 660 both showed byte-identical committed-class entropy while MECH-341
passed). Two falsifier shapes are additionally RETIRED and must not be resurrected:
(a) graded-in-K dose-response -- retired by confirmed `failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-660b_2026-06-11`
because a graded response over-specifies a binary preserve-or-collapse claim (three convergent
iterations 660 / 660a / 660b; no 660c); (b) in-isolation clearance via the
`entropy_bias_scale` lever -- V3-EXQ-616 proved mathematically that a uniform additive bias
cannot move a single-class CEM proposer output (bit-identical across scales 1/2/4/8), so the
B_only arm's structural bound sits at the *proposer* layer (SP-CEM presence), not the score-layer
knob. MECH-341 is a preserver, never an in-isolation generator.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION.
(1) There must be something to preserve, and this is the condition every run to date missed.
Measured `mean_distinct_first_action_classes` in the PRE-scoring candidate pool must be
`>= 0.9 * action_dim` (>= 4.5 of 5), i.e. `support_preserving_min_first_action_classes` raised to
`action_dim` -- see ARC-065's own `what_would_answer` (P1) for the full statement and the
V3-EXQ-949 evidence; do not re-derive it here. At the shipped default of 2 the pool realises
~2-3 classes and `min_classes_for_stratification = 2` is only just satisfied, so a "preservation"
verdict is measured at the mechanism's degenerate boundary.
(2) The substrate must be OPERATIVE and measured as such, not assumed from config
(`use_e3_score_diversity` and both sub-flags default `False`): `n_stratified_fired > 0` on every
ON arm and every seed (the V3-EXQ-611 C1 criterion -- 611's ARM_2 recorded
`n_stratified_fired = 0` across all seeds and that FAIL was a wiring artefact, not a claim result),
and `entropy_bonus_max_abs` non-trivial relative to the observed `mean_top2_class_gap` (the 611c
C2 lesson: `lambda = 0.05` produced a 0.045 bonus against gaps of 0.27-1.96 and was inert; the
defaults are now `lambda = 0.5`, `bias_scale = 1.0`).
(3) De-duplication: the pre/post class counts and the within-class representative entropy must
be accumulated on the fresh-select denominator (`experiments/_lib/fresh_select.py` -- select
diagnostics cleared before every `select_action`, latched ticks contribute no row), with
`n_fresh_select`, `n_latched` and `replication_factor` reported per cell. A held/latched E3 decision
re-counted per tick inflates every class count by the hold factor (~9x) and is the standing
hold-weighted readout hazard.
(4) SD-105 (selection-entropy headroom floor) OFF or matched-constant with realised log-temperature
recorded per arm.

CONFIRMING. On a pool with measured `mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 4.5`: the number of
distinct first-action classes SURVIVING the E3 scoring step (post-score, pre-commit) is
strict-above the same quantity with `use_e3_score_diversity = False`, on >= 2/3 seeds; and the
established within-class-representative readout `H(rep_signature | committed_class)` (the 660
corrected readout mandated by the 614e autopsy's Learning #2 -- not committed-class entropy)
remains strict-above legacy-argmin by a margin exceeding both an absolute floor and the
cross-seed SD of the delta. The already-established instance at the clamped pool is 660:
4.862 vs 4.781 nats, +0.081 against a 0.05 threshold -- note this margin is thin and its
SD-scaled robustness was never established, which is part of what the raised-P1 arm would test.

FALSIFYING. Two distinct routes, either sufficient.
(i) Collapse at a genuinely diverse pool: with `mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 4.5`
upstream and the substrate measured operative, the post-scoring distinct-class count does NOT
exceed the `use_e3_score_diversity = False` control (the diverse pool is collapsed by scoring
regardless of the preserver) -- MECH-341's preservation assertion fails exactly where it should
bite hardest. (ii) Boundary artefact: the 660 within-class-representative lift does not
replicate at the raised pool -- at ~4.9 classes the niches are small (often singletons, where
`stratified_select`'s own code short-circuits to argmin: `len(class_idxs) < 2`), so a +0.08 nats
effect that vanishes when niches shrink would indicate the ratified result was an artefact of the
2-class clamp rather than a property of the preserver. Either outcome is a genuine weakening and
would put the 2026-06-14 ratification back in front of governance.

MECH-342.subject: control_plane.commit_maintenance_release
MECH-342.title: control_plane.commit_maintenance_release. The R-c readiness signals that gate commitment ENTRY (MECH-090: score_margin decisiveness + nav_competence) must ALSO be able to RELEASE an already-elevated beta latch when execution readiness degrades mid-commitment. The release is a graded, bounded-accumulation drift-to-a-release-bound (conflict-scaled by the deficit magnitude), NOT a one-shot threshold flag; targeted to the active committed motor program (not a global brake); and hysteretic with a reengagement path that guards the premature-abort pole. This closes the V3-EXQ-592f reach gap (the MECH-090 R-c conjunction is admission-only by design; no existing release pathway covers degraded-readiness-mid- commitment).
MECH-342.what_would_answer:
The substrate's internal correctness is ALREADY CONFIRMED and is not what this
falsifier tests. V3-EXQ-592g (forced state-machine diagnostic) passed all six
acceptance criteria -- including C4, the conjunction criterion 592f could only
pass VACUOUSLY, now strictly positive (max_drop 0.6) -- so "does the pressure
accumulator/release-bound machinery fire as coded" is closed. What remains open
is whether the mechanism, once ecologically triggered, produces adaptive
behaviour -- promotion to provisional/active requires exactly that: an
ecological, evidence-grade experiment, not another diagnostic probe.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready_requeue /
measurement_test_design_defect, NOT a verdict): a run only tests MECH-342 if it
first establishes GENUINE sustained commitment (beta latch elevated on real
nav-competence/foraging engagement, not a forced state) in >= 2/3 seeds, AND the
readiness-degradation manipulation (score_margin and/or nav_competence actually
crossing their release-triggering floors mid-commitment) is verified non-vacuous.
Two prior ecological attempts failed this precondition, not the mechanism:
V3-EXQ-629b (2026-06-12) cleared genuine commitment + degradation on only 1/3
seeds (foraging contact-guard held on seed 43 only); V3-EXQ-629c (autopsied
2026-07-24) failed it entirely (contact_rate 0, 3 gates false) and was
categorised measurement_test_design_defect, explicitly NOT a substrate_ceiling
hit, precisely because the ecological scenario never materialised. A future
retest must confirm >= 2/3 seeds clear the same nav-competence/contact floor
629b used before treating any release/non-release result as informative. Note
also the adjacent, still-open frozen_z_goal_scaffold_family finding
(2026-07-27): the 629b/629c test harness (ScaffoldedSD054OnboardingScheduler)
belongs to a scaffold family with a documented frozen-z_goal measurement-phase
issue; that audit confirmed 629b/629c's own non-scoring status stands (nothing
to reopen), but a retest inheriting the same harness should re-verify the goal
state is live/unfrozen as intended for the arm being measured, not assume it.
CONFIRMING signature: once the precondition above is cleared, commit_maintenance
_release fires (mech342_fires > 0) at the point score_margin and/or
nav_competence cross their release floors; the release is TARGETED (only the
degraded committed program is released -- unrelated ongoing behaviour is
unaffected, mirroring 592g's C5 no-false-abort criterion but measured
ecologically); and agent behaviour measurably improves relative to a matched
ON/OFF ablation over the same degradation episodes (e.g. reduced
wasted/hazardous persistence in a now-unwinnable commitment) without an increase
in premature aborts on a matched no-degradation/recovery control arm.
FALSIFYING signature: in a run that clears the non-degeneracy precondition
(real commitment established, real degradation occurs, adequately powered),
the coupling either (a) fails to fire when the deficit crosses its floor -- a
true miss, not a precondition failure; (b) fires but produces no measurable
behavioural benefit over the OFF ablation -- correct substrate, ecologically
inert; or (c) causes harm the OFF arm does not show -- premature abort of a
still-viable commitment, non-targeted release bleeding into unrelated ongoing
programs, or oscillatory re-commit/release churn. Any of these, replicated on a
properly-powered ecological run (i.e. not a repeat of the 629b/629c
precondition-failure mode), falsifies the ecological-benefit claim without
reopening the already-closed diagnostic-correctness question from 592g.

MECH-343.subject: control_plane.difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy
MECH-343.title: difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy (controlled proposal-entropy widening under goal blockage). When goal progress stalls -- repeated failure to improve goal progress, high inter-candidate conflict, low E3 score margin, low committed-action diversity, plateau/stuck-state signal -- WITH goal salience preserved, the agent should transiently INCREASE proposal-generation entropy UPSTREAM of action selection (wider hippocampal/world-model rollout candidate set + higher within-class sampling temperature) while preserving goal/harm/constraint scoring and DELAYING commitment until one candidate clears the E3 score-margin / commitment threshold; entropy then NARROWS once a workable candidate is found -> committed action -> entropy decay. Asserted distinction (preserve this): a hard problem must trigger WIDER INTERNAL PROPOSALS -> more candidate diversity -> longer arbitration -> selective committed action (controlled entropy), NOT 'hard problem -> random behaviour' (noise). WORKING HYPOTHESIS -- no experimental evidence yet; not an established mechanism.
MECH-343.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Beyond the shared conversion precondition the text already names: the temperature half must be armed and witnessed (dgpe_enable_differentiable_cem True with sd061_temperature_half_inert False in the regulator's get_state), the declared axis set must be stated and every declared axis wired, and the stuck detector must show a duty cycle strictly inside (0.05, 0.80) on a resume-capable ecology with detector_peak exceeding threshold and THEN decaying on >= 2/3 seeds.
CONFIRMING: On a resume-capable ecology with both halves armed, the stuck-gated arm strictly beats BOTH the OFF arm and the always-high arm: proposal-layer diversity and arbitration cycles rise under stuck and DECAY after progress resumes, with no harm increase and no action-churn increase, and commitment latency rising in the hard phase then falling after solution discovery. Manipulation: The registered Q-056 four-arm design -- entropy-gating OFF, stuck-gated ON, entropy ALWAYS high, and entropy high with goal/harm constraints ablated as a diagnostic -- run with BOTH regulator halves live (candidate-count widening and the coupled CEM temperature) and the declared axis set stated per run. Control: The always-high arm is the load-bearing control (it is what the difficulty-GATING must beat), with the OFF arm as the rigidity reference, matched seeds throughout, and the SD-032b dACC choice_difficulty contribution to stuck_score reported separately since that input is itself substrate_ceiling. Required event: Naturally arising goal blockage in an ecological regime followed by genuine resumption of goal progress -- not the induced, never-ending impasse of V3-EXQ-694's scheduled_action_block, which cancels moves with no way through so the stall never ends. DV: Proposal-layer candidate-set diversity under stuck (per GFLAG-0357, an action-object-space diversity measure rather than first-action-class entropy), the number of arbitration cycles before commitment, and the decay of both after goal progress resumes -- with goal progress, harm rate and action churn as the committed-behaviour leg.
FALSIFYING: The always-high arm matches or beats the stuck-gated arm with no harm or churn penalty -- difficulty-gating buys nothing over constant high temperature; or proposal diversity rises and NEVER narrows after progress resumes, falsifying the closed-loop decay half. Entropy-up-with-flat-committed-behaviour is NOT falsifying and routes to the conversion-ceiling line. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The regulator is built and contract-green: ree_core/cingulate/stuck_state_detector.py and ree_core/policy/difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy.py with agent wiring and no-op-default flags, plus the sd061_temperature_half_inert self-report. V3-EXQ-694 is a working driver. The missing instrument is the re-scoped proposal-diversity DV, and the missing regime is a resume-capable ecology. Consumer / boundary: The PROPOSAL layer upstream of action selection -- ARC-018/CEM candidate-set width and within-class sampling temperature -- explicitly not the E3 select() softmax that SD-069 and MECH-313 act on; the WWA's own warning that conflating the two makes a result unattributable stands. Existing ownership: SD-061, sd061-resume-progress-ecology, GFLAG-0352, GFLAG-0357, EXP-0176, Q-056, MECH-342, MECH-527.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Two live blockers. The declared temperature lever had no consumer until 2026-09-18 and its coupling flag is default-off and unused, so the regulator's realised manipulation is candidate-count widening only. And with _progress_deficit saturated at 1.0 the stuck duty cycle sits at a pole and goal progress never resumes, so the decay leg cannot be measured; that ecology is commissioned, not built. Secondary classes: R4, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Two of the WWA's own load-bearing statements were falsified after it was written. (a) GFLAG-0352 (open, 2026-09-18) measured that SD-061's declared temperature lever has NO live consumer -- differentiable_cem_temperature is read at exactly one site inside SD-055's 'if use_differentiable_cem' (default False), so the WWA's premise that the regulator 'lifts differentiable_cem_temperature on the ARC-018/CEM PROPOSAL layer' is false and V3-EXQ-694's C2 certified the candidate-COUNT half alone; the coupling flag dgpe_enable_differentiable_cem landed 2026-09-18 default False and no run sets it. (b) The declared-axis measurements of 2026-09-18/19 show _progress_deficit saturating at 1.0 so the is_stuck duty cycle sits at a pole, and substrate_queue entry sd061-resume-progress-ecology records that no environment yet lets goal progress RESUME -- so leg (c) decay is not measurable at all. GFLAG-0357 additionally proposes re-scoping leg (a)'s DV to action-object-space diversity. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-344.subject: incentive.benefit_object_identity_binding
MECH-344.title: Benefit-to-object-identity binding (L2): at resource contact the benefit pulse is bound to the contacted object's identity (the SD-049 per-type tag) via an associative object->benefit node, rather than written as a raw scalar gate against the current world/resource latent. The amygdala/BLA-analog identity-binding node the legacy substrate lacked (cue_features was a V3 no-op stub).
MECH-344.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The bank must hold at least two distinct type tags with materially different base_values, and the per-type devaluation must demonstrably change only the targeted type's drive axis (SD-049 tag k uses per-axis drive k-1); a run where only one type is ever contacted cannot discriminate identity binding from a scalar write.
CONFIRMING: Devaluing type A drops wanting and most_wanted selection for A while leaving B essentially unchanged, and the bank-OFF arm shows no such per-type separation. Manipulation: Selective per-type devaluation after binding, with use_incentive_token_bank ON; the comparator arm disables the bank so the benefit pulse writes the legacy single-attractor z_goal at the current latent instead of binding to the contacted type tag. Control: Bank-OFF legacy-seeding arm (the 636 C3/C4 controls) plus a devalue-the-other-type arm at matched seeds, so any drop in wanting for A must be shown to be identity-specific rather than a global decay of the whole goal signal. Required event: Contact with resource type A followed by selective devaluation of A (per-axis drive or benefit set to zero for A only) while type B is left intact, then a later recall/selection episode with both types available. DV: Identity specificity of the wanting drop: change in IncentiveTokenBank.wanting()[A] and in most_wanted() selection frequency for A versus B after devaluing A only, and the corresponding change in z_goal seeding target, compared against the bank-OFF arm where no per-type separation is possible.
FALSIFYING: Devaluing A moves wanting for A and B together (non-specific), or the bank-ON arm's selection behaviour is indistinguishable from the legacy single-attractor arm -- the benefit pulse would then be functioning as a scalar gate against the current latent, which is exactly what the claim denies. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/goal.py IncentiveTokenBank (base_value and z_object per tag, wanting(), most_wanted()) with the agent-side seeding consumer in agent.update_z_goal; the 636 driver already records types_bound, per-contact liking_target and wanting_target. Consumer / boundary: The benefit-pulse-to-z_goal write path: whether the pulse updates a per-identity token that survives and revalues, or a raw scalar attractor pulled toward the current z_world/z_resource. Existing ownership: SD-057, MECH-345, MECH-346, EXP-0982, goal_pipeline_plan.md:GAP-7.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The substrate exists and has a live consumer, but the only validating run (V3-EXQ-636) carries claim_ids empty and experiment_purpose diagnostic, and its C1 criterion is a bank-key count ('binds >= 2 distinct identities') rather than an identity-specific revaluation test. No experiment applies a selective per-type devaluation against a scalar-write comparator. Secondary classes: none. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-345.subject: incentive.per_object_wanting_token
MECH-345.title: Per-object incentive-salience token (L3): each resource identity accrues a slowly-decaying, revaluable base incentive value plus a stored identity embedding; wanting amplitude at recall = base_value * (1 + kappa * drive), with the drive multiplier relocated from the seeding gate onto the stored per-object value and computed per-axis so wanting is drive-specific / identity-matched (specific PIT).
MECH-345.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The per-axis drive spread at the moment wanting is read must be large enough to compete with the base_value gaps it multiplies: the V3-EXQ-514r autopsy measured an in-run spread of ~0.006 against object base_value gaps above 0.5, so at the shipped defaults (incentive_drive_kappa_scale 1.0, per_axis_restoration_fraction 1.0, equalised per_axis_drive_decay) no drive state can flip most_wanted and the identity-matching leg cannot discriminate.
CONFIRMING: With the bank ON and a realised per-axis spread witnessed in the manifest, the identity of the most-wanted object tracks the depleted axis (food under hunger, water under thirst) at a rate strictly above the scalar-drive control, while base_value tracks received benefit with the expected slow decay between contacts. Manipulation: Cross use_incentive_token_bank ON versus OFF with a standing per-axis differential: per_axis_restoration_fraction < 1.0 plus a divergent per_axis_drive_decay tuple, and incentive_drive_kappa_scale raised so kappa times the realised drive spread is comparable to the base_value gap. Control: An arm with incentive_use_per_axis_drive=False (scalar drive applied uniformly) at matched contacts and matched base_value history, which isolates the identity-matching claim from the plain revaluation claim; plus the bank-OFF legacy seeding arm. Required event: Multi-type foraging episodes in which at least two resource types have been contacted and cached, and the agent's per-axis deficits then diverge (one axis standing depleted while another is restored) before the next goal seeding. DV: The rate at which the per-axis drive state changes which resource type is most_wanted at seeding (argmax flips of wanting[k] under matched base_value), and the base_value trajectory's tracking of received benefit versus its decay between contacts.
FALSIFYING: With the same spread witnessed and kappa scaled, most_wanted is determined by base_value alone and never flips with the drive axis, or base_value fails to revalue toward received benefit -- either would falsify the relocated drive-multiplier form wanting = base_value * (1 + kappa * drive_axis). A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Fully present and read-only inspectable: IncentiveTokenBank in ree_core/goal.py:659-780 holds base_value, z_object, decay(), update() EMA revaluation and wanting()/most_wanted(); state_dict exposes the per-type values; the consumer redirect is at agent.py:12009-12034 where seed_latent is replaced by the most-wanted object's embedding. No experiment script references MECH-345 at all. Consumer / boundary: The z_goal seeding decision -- which stored object embedding becomes the attractor -- not a downstream behavioural readout. Existing ownership: SD-057, MECH-436, SD-049, goal_pipeline:GAP-7, EXP-0984.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Nothing is missing from the substrate; the shipped defaults make the load-bearing half degenerate. Every lever needed to fix that exists (incentive_drive_kappa_scale, per_axis_restoration_fraction, divergent per_axis_drive_decay), and no queued or completed experiment arms any of them for this claim. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-346.subject: incentive.z_goal_from_token_pointer
MECH-346.title: z_goal written from the incentive-token pointer (L4; amends MECH-230): z_goal is seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored identity embedding (argmax over per-object wanting) rather than from the raw last-contacted z_resource. z_goal keeps its role as E1 conditioning vector and E3 goal_proximity target; only the seed SOURCE changes, making the attractor object-bound and the wanting target dissociable from the liking (last-contacted) target.
MECH-346.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The per-object wanting landscape must actually diverge from the last-contacted target by more than the (N-1)/N categorical baseline. V3-EXQ-514q measured the drive-attributable residual and it FAILED its effect-size bar, so a most-wanted-versus-last-consumed mismatch rate alone is not evidence -- the drive-uniform control must be subtracted.
CONFIRMING: The bank-ON arm's drive-attributable dissociation residual clears its effect-size bar, so the wanting target is structurally separable from the liking target and z_goal tracks the most-wanted object identity. Manipulation: use_incentive_token_bank ON (z_goal seeded from IncentiveTokenBank.most_wanted) versus OFF (z_goal seeded from the raw last-contacted z_resource), at matched seeds, matched drive schedule and an unchanged GoalState firing gate. Control: The drive-uniform arm, which subtracts the categorical mismatch a random pointer would produce, plus the bank-OFF raw-seed arm; both at matched consumption schedules. Required event: Multi-resource-type episodes with per-axis drive favouring a type other than the one most recently consumed, so that argmax over per-object wanting and the raw last-contacted z_resource point at different objects. DV: The drive-attributable dissociation residual: mean(WL_drive - WL_nodrive), where WL is the fraction of scored consumption events on which the MECH-346 most-wanted type differs from the last-consumed type, scored against an SD-of-delta plus absolute-floor bar rather than a bare mismatch count; plus cosine(z_goal, most_wanted z_object) versus cosine(z_goal, last z_resource).
FALSIFYING: With the drive-uniform control subtracted the bank-ON arm's residual is indistinguishable from zero, i.e. the token-pointer seed produces no z_goal difference the raw last-contacted seed does not, and the wanting/liking dissociation is not expressible. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: agent.update_z_goal and ree_core/goal.py implement the pointer; the dissociation readout exists in experiments/v3_exq_514n-q and v3_exq_693/693a, which already read most_wanted and compare it to the just-consumed type. Consumer / boundary: The z_goal seed source inside update_z_goal, and its consequence at z_goal's two consumers -- E1 conditioning and the E3 goal_proximity target. Existing ownership: MECH-346, SD-057, MECH-229, V3-EXQ-514q, modulatory-bias-selection-authority, EXP-1327.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The pointer substrate exists and is wired, but V3-EXQ-514q returned non_contributory with the drive-coupled dissociation criterion FAILED (drive delta below effect size, off-arm overshoot) -- the mechanism does not enter a regime where the most-wanted argmax diverges from the last-contacted target by a drive-attributable margin. Downstream, z_goal's own selection authority is the documented modulatory-bias ceiling. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-347.subject: incentive.cue_triggered_wanting
MECH-347.title: Cue-triggered wanting / cue-recall (L6): a PERCEIVED cue/object type (with no benefit pulse) retrieves its SD-057 incentive token and nudges z_goal toward that object's stored identity embedding BEFORE consumption -- identity-matched (pulls toward the perceived cue's object) and drive-specific (amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive)). The downstream E3 goal_proximity + MECH-295 approach bridge then raise pre-consummatory approach toward the cued object. Distinct from the benefit-driven seed: no benefit pulse, no token revaluation, weaker (cue_recall_gain) pull.
MECH-347.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The cue_pull must actually move the mediator: V3-EXQ-652 measured mean_cue_zgoal_pull_norm of only 0.003-0.005 at cue_recall_gain 0.2-5.0, so a run whose z_goal displacement is at that scale cannot produce a detectable approach change and should self-route substrate_not_ready rather than emit a verdict. Perceived-cue and consumption events must also be separable in time (a post-cue window with no benefit pulse).
CONFIRMING: With cue recall ON the post-cue approach rate toward the cued type exceeds the matched background rate by more than the pre-registered effect-size floor on a seed majority, and the lift scales with cue_recall_gain and per-axis drive. Manipulation: use_cue_recall ON versus OFF (GoalState.cue_pull via agent.cue_recall_wanting), swept over cue_recall_gain and incentive_drive_kappa_weight, with use_incentive_token_bank held ON in both arms. Control: The cue-off arm at matched seeds and matched cue schedule, plus the within-run background approach rate on non-cue steps, which is the comparator V3-EXQ-652 already computes. Required event: A perceived object cue with NO benefit pulse and no token revaluation, occurring while the corresponding per-axis drive is elevated and the cued object is not the one most recently consumed. DV: Post-cue approach-rate lift over the matched background rate toward the CUED object type specifically, scored against an effect-size floor scaled on the SD of the per-seed delta -- not a 2-of-3 sign count -- with mean_cue_zgoal_pull_norm reported as the mediator-strength precondition.
FALSIFYING: Post-cue approach lift toward the cued type is within noise of the background rate across the gain/kappa sweep despite a measurable z_goal pull, i.e. cue-triggered wanting reaches z_goal but not pre-consummatory approach. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/goal.py cue_pull + agent.cue_recall_wanting, the _harness.py automatic cue-recall perception hook, and experiments/_lib/z_goal_stream.py, which counts both z_goal writers; the approach-lift DV is recorded by v3_exq_640b/652 but without an effect-size floor. Consumer / boundary: z_goal, and through it the E3 goal_proximity term and the MECH-295 approach bridge -- a serial chain in which cue recall is only the first link. Existing ownership: MECH-347, SD-057, MECH-295, V3-EXQ-652, modulatory-bias-selection-authority, EXP-1330.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The substrate is built and wired, but the only counted run passes on a 2-of-3 sign count whose primary cell has per-seed lifts +0.0005, +0.0038, -0.0123 (mean negative) and whose z_goal pull norm is ~0.004. The mediator barely moves and the acceptance rule has no effect-size floor, so the falsifier as fired cannot discriminate. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-348.subject: incentive.dacc_object_discriminative_readout
MECH-348.title: dACC object-discriminative goal readout (L7): the dACC adaptive-control consumer reads per-candidate goal_proximity to the (SD-057 object-bound) z_goal, so its effort/value computation becomes object-discriminative -- approach_commit is goal-conditioned rather than z_goal-blind. Resolves the 2026-06-04 L7 audit finding that only E3 goal_proximity read z_goal consequentially and dACC was blind.
MECH-348.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The per-candidate goal_proximity vector reaching the dACC bundle must be measurably DISCRIMINATIVE across candidates within a tick -- non-zero cross-candidate spread recorded per selection -- because V3-EXQ-637's own design note records that in a forced harness the per-type z_object embeddings are near-identical, which would make an object-discriminative readout a constant offset that the E3 argmin cancels. The agent must also reach resources at above-random rate, the goal_pipeline:GAP-2 condition, so approach_commit has object-bound content to be conditioned on.
CONFIRMING: With measured per-candidate proximity spread, the goal-readout-ON arm commits to the most-wanted object type at a rate exceeding both the OFF arm and the shuffled-proximity control by a margin scaled on the SD of the paired per-seed delta plus an absolute floor, on at least 2 of 3 seeds. Manipulation: Matched-seed ablation of dacc_goal_readout_weight (0.0 versus a non-zero weight) with use_mech_consume True in both arms and use_dacc held constant, so only the goal-readout bias term into DACCtoE3Adapter changes. Control: The dacc_goal_readout_weight = 0.0 arm (bit-identical legacy adapter, verified by the skip branch in cingulate/dacc.py) at identical seeds, plus a shuffled-goal_proximity arm that supplies the same magnitude with the candidate ordering permuted, to separate object discrimination from a uniform bias. Required event: Waking action selection in a foraging episode where two resource types with different current drive weights are both reachable, so a goal-conditioned consumer and a goal-blind one would commit to different objects. DV: Fraction of committed approach actions directed at the currently most-wanted object type, and the per-tick change in committed candidate identity between the two arms, conditioned on ticks where the per-candidate goal_proximity spread is non-zero.
FALSIFYING: With the spread precondition met, the ON arm's object choice is indistinguishable from OFF and from the shuffled control -- the readout reaches the bundle but exerts no selection authority, which routes to the modulatory-bias-drowning class rather than to a z_goal representation fault. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The wiring exists and is validated: DACCAdaptiveControl.forward takes candidate_goal_proximity into the goal_readout bundle, DACCtoE3Adapter subtracts dacc_goal_readout_weight * goal_readout after the dacc_bias clamp, agent.select_action passes the per-candidate proximity, and V3-EXQ-637 confirmed the readout reaches the bundle. No instrument records the object-identity of the committed action against current drive. Consumer / boundary: The dACC-to-E3 bias applied to per-candidate scores at commit time -- the effort/value computation, not the z_goal representation itself. Existing ownership: MECH-348, SD-057, EXP-0986, goal_pipeline:GAP-7, V3-EXQ-637.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The only run, V3-EXQ-637, carries claim_ids empty and tests wiring only (C3 asserts the bundle field is non-None, finite and length K); it explicitly defers the ecological approach consequence as GAP-2-gated. No experiment manipulates dacc_goal_readout_weight and measures committed object identity. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued.
