MECH-349.subject: policy.candidate_rule_field.mint
MECH-349.title: CandidateRule mint (ARC-063 CREATE face): a non-gradient structural event mints a distinct CandidateRule slot when a (context-bucket -> action-object) regularity recurs above threshold and no existing rule's context_tag already covers it. The literal MECH-309 answer -- the creator that 'invents' rules so that credit only 'weights' them. Bottom-up (ARC-064 regularity detection) primary; optional top-down ARC-062 discriminator seed.
MECH-349.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Mint must fire and be non-vacuous in the SAME run: crf_n_minted >= 2 and crf_live_rules_final >= 2 on >= 2/3 seeds; churn scored PER REGIME CLASS rather than against the ecology-fixed 0.25 global ratio; late mints engineered by staggered regime onsets; and the ARC-062 seed leg declared untested unless the gating-weight distribution at mint events is reported.
CONFIRMING: Mint count falls monotonically as the recurrence threshold rises while surviving mints stay distinct, AND live-rule count in the 3-regime variant exceeds the 1-regime variant by >= max(2 rules, 2 SD of the within-variant per-seed count) on >= 2/3 seeds. Manipulation: Sweep crf_mint_recurrence_threshold over >= 4x (3 -> 12) and cross it with regime count (1-regime versus 3-regime variant of the same ecology), plus a mature_mint_block_threshold contrast (0.8 -> 0.5) on a key where the block can fire on something other than the regime itself. Control: Matched-seed 1-regime variant, the raised-threshold arm, and V3-EXQ-1025's single-axis crf_maintenance_decay positive control at 0.35 that reproduces the 666c treadmill in full. Required event: A keyed (context-bucket -> action-object) regularity recurring above threshold in an ecology presenting >= 3 separable regularities, with regime onsets staggered so mints remain possible in the final third of the window. DV: Mint COUNT and live-rule count as functions of (a) the recurrence threshold and (b) the number of distinct regularities presented, plus the per-regime-class retired/minted ratio and the persistent re-mint count -- not the pinned-direction distance, which is a lookup.
FALSIFYING: Mint count is insensitive to a >= 4x recurrence-threshold sweep, or insensitive to regime count, with the preconditions green -- the creator is a timer or a slot-filler rather than a triggered structural event. The 666c treadmill signature was tested by V3-EXQ-1025 and NOT falsified. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/policy/candidate_rule_field.py telemetry (crf_n_minted, crf_n_retired_total, crf_live_rules_final, crf_max_pairwise_rule_dist) and experiments/v3_exq_1025_mech349_crf_churn_retirement.py, which already fired the churn leg. No instrument records the recurrence count AT the mint event on a key where the block is not self-blocking. Consumer / boundary: The non-gradient structural mint event inside CandidateRuleField._maybe_mint -- slot creation, not any downstream behavioural conversion. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0265, GFLAG-0266, GFLAG-0268, EXP-1393, ARC-063.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); Two of the claim's own clauses are unfalsifiable as written against this substrate (a fixed-seed arithmetic identity; a mint block that only ever fires on a regime re-presenting itself), and GFLAG-0268 contests whether the CREATE face predicts anything the implementation could fail to do. The churn leg is the one that was made reachable and run. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Three of the four criteria were measured NOT SATISFIABLE against the substrate they name (GFLAG-0265/0266, both open): precondition (b)'s crf_max_pairwise_rule_dist >= 1.5 is an arithmetic identity off the fixed pinned_seed under the mature-pool stack, the (ii) novelty clause's mint block fired 190/190 times at cosine exactly 1.000 (a regime blocking itself), and GFLAG-0270 measured the (c) remedy inert. V3-EXQ-1025 then supplied the scope corrections the text still lacks (per-regime-class churn ratio, staggered-onset late mints). Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

[2026-09-24 governance-20260924 -- SUPERSEDING AMENDMENT, adjudicates GFLAG-0265/0266/0268/0271; the text above is retained as history]: (1) WITHDRAWN: CONFIRMING's regime-count conjunct ('live-rule count in the 3-regime variant exceeds the 1-regime variant by >= max(2 rules, 2 SD ...)') and FALSIFYING's 'or insensitive to regime count' -- measured NOT SATISFIABLE on the SD-078 centered key (GFLAG-0265(3): a 1-regime ecology is annihilated by the common-mode baseline and mints MORE; mint count is non-monotonic in regime count, 26.6/15.8/18.2/25.0 live rules at 4/8/16/24 regimes). (2) 'surviving mints stay distinct' is structural (pinned directions; MECH-350, GFLAG-0265(1)) and is not scored. (3) The 0.8 -> 0.5 mature_mint_block_threshold contrast is recorded as parameter sensitivity ONLY and is NOT evidence for clause (ii): on separated regimes the cross-regime blocks it produces are false blocks (GFLAG-0266), and on an overlapping-cluster ecology the natural criterion is algebraically the non-degeneracy precondition (GFLAG-0268(2)). (4) Clauses (i) 'recurs >= threshold' and (ii) 'not already covered' are IMPLEMENTATION-DEFINED trigger conditions of CandidateRuleField._maybe_mint (increment-then-compare; block fires only on self re-presentation at 0.8); their validation is a contract pin, not an experiment. (5) EMPIRICAL CONTENT OF THIS CLAIM, exhaustively: (E1) threshold sensitivity -- first-mint latency and mint count within a fixed pre-saturation window rise/fall with a >= 4x crf_mint_recurrence_threshold sweep (3 -> 12) with the non-degeneracy precondition green; DV must NOT be final live-rule count, which the mint-block/slot bound (not the counter) sets (GFLAG-0265 mechanism note), so a threshold-insensitive FINAL count is not a falsification; (E2) selective churn -- tested V3-EXQ-1025, not falsified. (6) The downstream consequence (a minted field yields a regime-differentiated rule_state a shared-gradient head cannot reach -- GFLAG-0268 option (b)) is owned by MECH-350's 2026-09-22 what_would_answer and is not duplicated here. Behavioural/committed-action DVs remain out of scope (MECH-439; GFLAG-0271).

MECH-350.subject: policy.candidate_rule_field.subspace_partitioned_representation
MECH-350.title: CandidateRule field representation (ARC-063 REPRESENT face): the field holds K candidate rules as a population of distinct pinned subspace directions, so distinct minted rules occupy distinct directions and the rule_state handed to SD-033a is differentiated by construction. The architectural answer to why two shared-gradient scalar heads collapse (598b) but a minted field does not -- separability is structural, not an equilibrium gradient must find.
MECH-350.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: At least two rules must be live and minted from DIFFERENT context regimes in the same run, and the read must be taken on the rule_state actually handed to SD-033a rather than on the pinned-direction matrix -- crf_max_pairwise_rule_dist off a fixed pinned_seed is a deterministic lookup on live-rule count (GFLAG-0265) and cannot discriminate.
CONFIRMING: Between-regime rule_state separation in the CRF-ON arm exceeds the gradient-head baseline by a margin scaled on the SD of the paired per-seed delta, with within-regime separation flat, on a seed majority. Manipulation: CandidateRuleField rule source ON versus OFF at the consumer: lateral_pfc_analog use_candidate_rule_source True (crf_source replaces the legacy delta_proj/world_proj EMA source) versus the 598b shared-gradient scalar-head baseline, at matched seeds. Control: The 598b trainable-head arm (the collapse case this claim is the architectural answer to) and a CRF-ON-but-single-regime arm in which no differentiation is available to express. Required event: Presentation of >= 2 separable context regimes within one run, each driving a mint, so that the active-rule stack handed downstream differs by regime. DV: Separability of the rule_state vector handed to SD-033a ACROSS CONTEXT REGIMES -- mean between-regime distance of rule_state versus within-regime distance -- contrasted against the gradient-head baseline; secondarily the per-candidate bias spread (prop_delta) the readout produces.
FALSIFYING: rule_state handed to SD-033a is no more regime-separable under the minted field than under the shared-gradient heads, or collapses over the run despite distinct mints -- separability is not preserved by construction across the handoff. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: PARTIAL. lateral_pfc_analog.get_state() exposes only rule_state_norm, a scalar magnitude that cannot distinguish regimes; no regime-conditioned rule_state readout exists. The CRF side exposes the pinned-direction statistic, which GFLAG-0265 showed is an identity. Consumer / boundary: The CandidateRuleField to LateralPFCAnalog.update() rule_state handoff and its onward SD-033a/SD-082 bias readout -- the consumer boundary, not the pinned-direction matrix inside the field. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0265, GFLAG-0271, ARC-063, SD-033a, EXP-0990.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); As written the claim is a structural identity (slots are seeded distinct, so distinctness is true by construction and its headline statistic is a lookup). The falsifiable content sits one boundary downstream, and the only rule_state readout there is a scalar norm. Secondary classes: R2, R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-351.subject: policy.candidate_rule_field.tolerance_gated_availability
MECH-351.title: CandidateRule tolerance gate (ARC-063 GATE face): a candidate rule becomes AVAILABLE (eligible to enter the active rule_state) only when its availability clears a threshold that RISES with the number of competing context-matched rules. The conflict-graded 'hold your horses' dynamic threshold; availability (which rules enter the active set) is distinct from selection (which action E3 picks among available rules' biases).
MECH-351.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The field must be live (use_candidate_rule_field=True) AND run the 2026-06-17 gate-calibration levers under crf_mature_pool_dynamics, because at legacy defaults theta = 0.3 + 1.0*(n_matched-1) >= 1.3 exceeds the 1.0 availability ceiling, so every tick with >= 2 co-matched rules gates out ALL of them and the conflict grading is arithmetically all-or-nothing. V3-EXQ-654f measured crf_frac_active 0.828-0.968 once those levers were set, so the discriminating regime is reachable.
CONFIRMING: The graded arm holds under-supported rules out on high-conflict ticks and admits them after credit raises availability, and that admission difference changes the committed action distribution relative to the count-matched fixed-threshold arm. Manipulation: Sweep crf_tolerance_conflict_gain (graded, 0.25) against a FIXED-threshold arm (gain 0.0 at a tolerance_floor chosen to admit the same mean number of rules), and move crf_mean_n_matched with crf_mature_context_match_threshold. Control: Fixed-threshold arm matched on admitted-rule count and on mint/retire budget, plus ARM_OFF (use_candidate_rule_field=False), all bit-identical otherwise across >= 3 seeds. Required event: Ticks on which at least two context-matched candidate rules with differing availability compete for admission to the active rule set, followed by outcome-driven credit that raises a held-out rule above threshold. DV: Composition of the admitted set as a function of n_matched at matched availability (crf_n_active_last, crf_frac_active, crf_last_theta, crf_n_matched_last), and the committed-class entropy / action difference the resulting rule_state produces downstream.
FALSIFYING: Admitted-set composition is indistinguishable between graded and fixed threshold at matched admitted count, or the admitted set differs while the committed-action distribution does not move. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: CandidateRuleField.get_state() exposes crf_last_theta, crf_n_matched_last, crf_n_active_last, crf_frac_active and crf_maintained_pairwise_dist, and the 639/654/666 readiness scripts already report them; there is no per-rule availability vector, and no diagnostic attributes a committed-action change to an admission event. Consumer / boundary: Availability gate -> active rule_state handed to SD-033a LateralPFCAnalog -> per-candidate action bias -> E3 committed action. Existing ownership: SD-082, crf-availability-maintenance, f_dominance_conversion_ceiling, ARC-063, V3-EXQ-639, EXP-0992.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The gate fires and is fully instrumented, but its output has no live behavioural consumer: rule_state -> action-bias propagation measured exactly 0.0 (V3-EXQ-822, 822a, SD-082 amend), and V3-EXQ-654g lifted committed-class entropy by +0.011 nats on 0/3 seeds under the MECH-439 F-dominance ceiling. No run manipulates the conflict gain itself. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-352.subject: policy.candidate_rule_field.eligibility_trace_credit
MECH-352.title: CandidateRule eligibility-trace credit (ARC-063 CREDIT face): each rule active when an action was taken leaves a decaying eligibility trace; the subsequent outcome/PE updates the rule's availability (raise on success, lower on exception), recency-weighted, with slow availability decay and retire-below-floor. The 'weight' half of mint-then-weight -- credit refines an existing rule's availability, it does not create rules.
MECH-352.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The outcome proxy must actually change SIGN across ticks, because CandidateRuleField.credit() uses only sign(outcome_signal) to choose the EMA target (1.0 success / 0.0 exception) and never its magnitude. Agent.py feeds outcome_signal = -||z_harm_a||, which is non-positive by construction, so the success branch is reachable only at an exact zero harm norm.
CONFIRMING: Availability rises after success and falls after exception in proportion to the eligibility trace at outcome time, with the shuffled-credit control showing no such dependence, and retirement concentrating on consistently-exception-paired rules. Manipulation: Replace the harm-norm proxy with a genuinely signed outcome (benefit_exposure minus harm, or the SD-012 drive-reduction delta), ON vs OFF, and sweep crf_eligibility_window to vary the recency weighting. Control: Shuffled credit assignment (the same outcome stream applied to rules that were NOT active on that tick) at matched update count and matched mint/retire budget, plus the current harm-norm proxy as the legacy arm. Required event: A rule active when an action was taken (eligibility > 0), followed within the eligibility window by outcomes of BOTH signs, so raise-on-success and lower-on-exception are separately exercised. DV: Per-rule availability trajectory conditioned on outcome sign and on eligibility at credit time (the recency-weighted increment), and the retirement rate that follows from it.
FALSIFYING: Availability change is independent of eligibility (flat across the window sweep) or indistinguishable from the shuffled-credit control, or the signed-proxy arm is indistinguishable from the legacy one-signed proxy. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: credit() applies the update, but get_state() exposes only aggregates -- crf_n_minted_total, crf_n_retired_total, crf_n_active_last, crf_frac_maintained -- and no per-rule availability or eligibility vector, so the eligibility weighting that is the claim's content cannot be read off a manifest. Consumer / boundary: Rule availability -> tolerance gate admission (MECH-351) -> differentiated rule_state for SD-033a. Existing ownership: ARC-063, MECH-351, crf-availability-maintenance, V3-EXQ-639, EXP-0994.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The live outcome proxy -||z_harm_a|| is non-positive, and credit() branches on its sign alone, so the raise-on-success half of the claim is effectively never exercised and the falsifier cannot discriminate. Compounding it, no per-rule availability or eligibility is exposed in get_state(), so the recency weighting has no recorder. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-353.subject: affect.blocked_agency_control_failure_stream
MECH-353.title: Blocked-agency / control-failure affect stream (z_block): an integrated readout on the SD-029 agency comparator applied to the action-outcome channel. z_block rises when an intended action repeatedly fails to produce its forward-model-predicted outcome (MECH-112 z_goal supplies the expectation), the mismatch is attributed to an EXTERNAL constraint (not own motor error), AND goal/capacity-belief is RETAINED. It is a distinct affect stream from harm (SD-011: no noxious input required), from suffering (SD-019b/Q-036: OPPOSITE controllability pole -- capacity-retained drives ASSERT, capacity-collapsed drives WITHDRAW), from residue (MECH-056: action-prevented, not action-taken-at-cost), and from licit commitment-hold (MECH-090: externally-imposed block, not self-imposed gate).
MECH-353.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The attribution clause must be exercisable -- some manipulation must push motor_agency below the 0.5 attribution floor -- and z_harm_a must actually populate so the dissociation criterion is not algebraically reduced to the z_block criterion. Also: action_dim must be 5 with blocked_agency_noop_class 4, or the withdraw pole has no action to express itself in and the assert/withdraw contrast is unrepresentable.
CONFIRMING: On at least 3 of 5 readiness-cleared seeds, z_block_mean separates BLOCK from CONTROL by at least 0.20 with BLOCK at least 0.20; z_harm_a does not separate comparably; the BLOCK arm shows effort escalation or alternative-action search; and the use_blocked_agency=False arm does NOT reproduce that behavioural signature. Manipulation: Four-way: external block versus free, crossed with use_blocked_agency ON versus OFF (the necessity arm the lineage has never run), with capacity-belief manipulated across a matched controllability sweep to test the hand-off to the SD-019b withdraw pole. Control: The free/no-block arm at matched seed and the use_blocked_agency=False arm with everything else identical; the CONTROL arm's z_block_mean must sit well below z_block_cap (1.5) for the headroom statistic to be valid. Required event: Repeated external cancellation of an intended, predicted-to-succeed action (CausalGridWorldV2 scheduled_action_block_*) with harm and goal-value held constant, contrasted against a SELF-attributable cancellation in which the agent's own motor execution fails. DV: z_block_mean (never z_block_peak, which saturates at the 1.5 cap in both arms) separating BLOCK from CONTROL by at least 0.20; stated POSITIVELY alongside z_harm_a showing no separation of comparable magnitude against its own margin; plus the behavioural assert signature (effort escalation / alternative-action search) and, under collapsed capacity, a flip to the withdraw signature.
FALSIFYING: With the preconditions met, either z_block fails to separate on a headroom statistic under a genuine external block, or z_harm_a separates comparably (the signal is harm re-labelled), or -- decisively, and never yet run -- the use_blocked_agency=False arm reproduces the blocked-action behaviour using only the existing harm, suffering and decommit machinery. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/affect/blocked_agency.py computes the comparator, the external-attribution gate and the capacity gate; LatentState.z_block carries the readout; CausalGridWorldV2 supplies the scheduled_action_block curriculum. What is missing is any instrument that can drive motor_agency below the attribution floor, and a populated z_harm_a in this harness. Consumer / boundary: A distinct affect stream at the action-outcome comparator -- distinct from harm (no noxious input), from suffering (opposite controllability pole), from residue (action-prevented, not action-taken-at-cost) and from licit commitment-hold. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0230, SD-029, SD-030, sd_blocked_agency_mismatch_floor_calibration, EXP-1379, SD-019b.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); Two of the six repairs the 642c autopsy marks mandatory cannot be instantiated. z_self does not encode the executed action strongly enough for an execution failure to register (0.0107 separation against a 0.6487 norm, roughly 100x short of the motor_mismatch > 1.0 the floor needs), so the attribution clause is untestable by any design; and z_harm_a stays None on 400/400 ticks, so the dissociation criterion is algebraically inert. Secondary classes: R5, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA predates V3-EXQ-642c and GFLAG-0230. Its confirming clause (i) has since been RUN and PASSED (642c, 2026-09-04: BLOCK-minus-CONTROL z_block_mean 0.6805/0.5904/0.7709 on 3/3 against a 0.30 bar), while clauses (ii) and (iii) were measured UNRUNNABLE on 2026-09-08: motor_agency stayed 0.72-0.98 with frac below 0.5 equal to 0.000 in every arm of five configurations, because z_self separates executed move from executed no-op by only 1.7 percent against a floor needing about 100x that, so the external-attribution clause is not testable by any design; and z_harm_a was None on 400/400 ticks even with use_affective_harm_stream set, pinning the dissociation criterion at zero. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-354.subject: affect.fatigue_stop_recover_homeostatic_accumulator
MECH-354.title: Effort/fatigue stop-recover homeostatic accumulator: a two-bound (hysteretic) leaky cost-evidence accumulator on the SD-012 homeostatic-drive side (substrate-hosted by the SD-048 interoceptive channel). F accumulates with effort / time-on-task and dissipates with rest; at the upper bound it emits STOP / disengage, recovering to a lower bound before re-engaging. Two time-constants: a fast within-task accumulator and a slow sleep-pressure (Process-S) variant whose recover phase is offline (SD-017 sleep). The in-task STOP feeds the MECH-342 release actuator as a new deficit input and the ARC-078 goal-disengagement consumer via a cost/benefit (non-aversive) channel; the recover / re-accumulation half lives on the SD-012 / SD-017 side. Distinct from suffering / learned-helplessness (SD-011 side): fatigue is controllability-independent, incentive-reversible, and -- decisively -- recovers with rest, which helplessness does not.
MECH-354.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (five gates; gate (0) is currently UNMET and every gate below it is
conditional on the build):
(0) EXISTENCE -- an F accumulator with TWO bounds must exist and be reachable from the agent loop.
It does not today: `ree_core/` contains no effort-driven accumulator, `ARC-078` appears nowhere, and
the only two things named "fatigue" are an environment observation-noise AR(1) term and a PCC
stability subtrahend reading SD-012 `drive_level`. Until (0) is satisfied this claim is untestable in
principle, not merely unqueued.
[2026-09-10, GFLAG-0142 -- GATE (0) IS NOW SPLIT BY LEG.] It continues to bind IN FULL on the
FAST within-task accumulator, which remains unbuilt and unqueued (part i, owed). For the SLOW
Process-S leg it is SATISFIED IN FORM: SD-SLEEP-ENTRY-PRESSURE (EntryPressureAccumulator,
ree-v3 ree_core/sleep/mel_consumer.py, 2026-08-26) is a hysteretic sleep-pressure accumulator
that exists and is reachable, so the slow leg's open question is narrowed to its INTEGRAND --
effort versus waking prediction error -- plus one-bound-versus-two-bound, not to whether an
accumulator exists at all. Gates (1)-(4) below are unaffected and still apply to both legs.
(1) TWO-BOUND LIVENESS AND HEADROOM -- BOTH bounds must be reached and neither pinned: each seed must
show F crossing the UPPER bound at least once AND recovering to the LOWER bound at least once, with
the fraction of steps spent at each bound reported. An F pinned at either bound reproduces the exact
V3-EXQ-642a/642b degeneracy -- see MECH-353's own `what_would_answer` precondition (1) for the full
statement of why a bounded-accumulator DV must have headroom; do not re-derive it here.
(2) DISCONFOUNDING FROM z_block (MECH-353) -- the run MUST set `use_blocked_agency=False`, or pin
`z_block` to a constant. MECH-353's ARC-016-gated DECOMMIT fires on the SAME observable
(disengagement) from the OPPOSITE antecedent (external block with capacity retained). With both live,
a stop/disengage DV cannot attribute, and a null on MECH-354 would be uninterpretable.
(3) HARM AND CONTROLLABILITY PINNED -- `z_harm_a` and the SD-019b/Q-036 escapability gate held
constant across the time-on-task axis. If they drift, the disengage is the suffering pole, which is
precisely the DEV-NEED-002 conflation this claim exists to cure.
(4) THE EFFORT AXIS MUST BE REAL AND DECOUPLED FROM HARM -- use `CausalGridWorldV2`'s
`effort_harm_coupling_enabled=False` setting so effort cost is not a harm proxy, and run the Q-080.b
`effort_benefit_asymmetry > 0` positive control to prove the effort machinery is non-vacuous before
reading any negative result.

CONFIRMING (three legs, matching the claim's own (a)/(b)/(c); all three are required, since (a) alone
is shared with the suffering pole):
(a) TIME-ON-TASK -- disengagement hazard rises monotonically with time-on-task at FIXED harm and FIXED
controllability, on `>= 3/5` seeds, effect `>= max(1.5 * SD(per-seed delta), an absolute floor derived
from the F-OFF arm's spread)`.
(b) INCENTIVE-REVERSIBILITY -- raising incentive at a FIXED accumulated F measurably delays or cancels
the STOP. This is the leg that discriminates the Boksem-Tops cost/benefit recalibration account from a
pure-depletion account, which predicts no incentive effect at fixed F.
(c) REST-RECOVERY, THE DECISIVE DISSOCIATOR -- after a rest / offline phase, re-engagement latency and
disengagement hazard return toward baseline, AND a matched suffering/learned-helplessness arm
(uncontrollable aversion, SD-011/SD-019b) run on the SAME DV shows NO rest-recovery. Without the
matched comparison arm this leg is not a dissociation, only a description.

FALSIFYING: with the accumulator built and (1)-(4) met, ANY of --
(i) (a) holds but (b) and (c) do not -- the stop is neither incentive-reversible nor rest-recoverable,
so on its OWN decisive dissociator the signal is indistinguishable from the SD-011 suffering pole and
MECH-354's claim to be a separate stream on the SD-012 side is refuted;
(ii) (c) holds but the matched helplessness arm ALSO recovers with rest -- rest-recovery is then not
the dissociator the claim rests on;
(iii) PARSIMONY -- feeding the EXISTING SD-012 `drive_level` (which MECH-342 and the PCC already read)
directly into MECH-342 as a deficit input reproduces (a), (b) and (c) without any two-bound hysteretic
accumulator. MECH-354 asserts the "smallest computational form" is Meyniel's two-bound accumulator; if
a one-bound leaky drive suffices, the claim is over-specified and should be narrowed rather than
confirmed.

MECH-355.subject: affect.soothing_comfort_autonomic_state_gain_modulator
MECH-355.title: Soothing/comfort autonomic state-gain modulator: a present-tense down-regulation of the ONGOING aversive/stress state (lowers the gain or speeds the recovery of the active trajectory), canonically socially gated (conspecific buffering; oxytocinergic + parasympathetic/HPA + prefrontal regulation). Proposed home is a modulator on MECH-219 (suffering accumulator) decay + SD-012 (drive) + SD-032e (pACC autonomic coupling). Distinct from relief (MECH-302: past-offset phasic reinforcer), from safety (MECH-303/304: future inhibitory predictor), and from wanting (MECH-112: appetite): soothing acts on the present stress trajectory via autonomic state-gain, not reinforcement, prediction, or appetite. V4-social (the canonical trigger is an other-agent, which V3 cannot represent); an optional V3-minimal non-social autonomic-recovery hook is noted but not built.
MECH-355.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a V4/V5 other-agent (conspecific) representation must exist and be
capable of being the trigger for a down-regulation event -- V3 has none (verified 2026-09-25: no
oxytocin, soothing, PV-analog, or BDNF-analog code anywhere in ree-v3/ree_core; the
fast_empathy_v5_plan.md roadmap nodes for stream-binding, EMP-3 onward, remain unbuilt). DO NOT
build in V3. The proposed effector substrate (MECH-219 suffering-accumulator decay/gain, SD-012
drive, SD-032e pACC autonomic write-back) IS live in V3, but a live effector is not a live trigger
-- driver availability is not substrate readiness (same caution MECH-398's own wwa states for its
analogous case).

CONFIRMING (once the V4/V5 other-agent substrate exists): in the presence of a conspecific during
an ongoing aversive/stress trajectory, a soothing input measurably LOWERS the gain or SPEEDS the
recovery of the active z_harm_a / drive_bias trajectory beyond what the matched no-conspecific
condition shows, with onset/peak of the ORIGINAL stressor unaffected (soothing acts on the
present trajectory, not on the triggering event) and with the effect scaling with, and disappearing
without, conspecific presence (the social-gating signature, per Hostinar 2014 / Heinrichs 2003).

FALSIFYING: a conspecific-present arm shows no measurable difference from the no-conspecific arm
in recovery kinetics of the same state variables, under the same preconditions -- soothing is
inert relative to the endogenous mechanism and should fold into (or be subsumed by) MECH-356
rather than surviving as a separate socially-gated claim.

CROSS-REFERENCE, do not re-derive: the V3-tractable sibling of this mechanism (endogenous,
no-conspecific offset-triggered autonomic recovery, same MECH-219/SD-032e effector machinery) is
already registered as MECH-356 and already carries a full what_would_answer with its own
non-degeneracy preconditions (use_harm_suffering_accumulator / use_suffering_derivative_comparator
both REEConfig-default False) and an explicit no-conspecific control arm built in specifically to
separate it from MECH-355. MECH-355's own eventual test, once the social substrate exists, should
reuse MECH-356's control-arm design (matched onset/peak, matched episode schedule) and add the
conspecific-present manipulation on top, rather than designing the recovery-kinetics DV from
scratch.

OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: the biological grounding (Hostinar, Sullivan & Gunnar 2014 Psychol Bull;
Heinrichs et al. 2003 Biol Psychiatry) is a human/animal oxytocin-HPA finding, settled in its own
domain independent of REE; a REE PASS/FAIL can neither confirm nor refute the biology, only
whether REE's analogical mapping (drive_bias / z_harm_a as HPA/cortisol proxies) reproduces the
qualitative social-buffering signature.

MECH-356.subject: affect.endogenous_parasympathetic_recovery_autonomic_rebound
MECH-356.title: Endogenous parasympathetic recovery / autonomic rebound: an active, offset-triggered, transient acceleration of return-to-baseline for the affective/autonomic stress state, fired by the agent's OWN stressor offset (the z_harm_a derivative going negative -- the MECH-302 SufferingDerivativeComparator signal) with NO conspecific and NO prediction. Shares the effector/update rule of MECH-355 soothing (decay-acceleration on the recovery side: a transient state-scaled multiplier on the MECH-219 z_harm_a recovery_rate + the SD-032e drive_bias leak) but differs by TRIGGER (endogenous offset vs conspecific). The V3-tractable sibling of MECH-355 that closes REE's sympathetic-rich / parasympathetic-poor asymmetry (dense escalation: MECH-219 onset, SD-032e accumulation, SD-037 override, MECH-091 urgency, MECH-279 freeze; thin recovery: only passive recovery_rate + offline-only drive_bias decay). Distinct from passive MECH-219 recovery (active overshoot, not decay), from MECH-302 relief (shared offset trigger, different output -- relief writes a reinforcer, rebound boosts recovery rate), from MECH-303/304 safety (no prediction), and from MECH-355 soothing (endogenous trigger, not social).
MECH-356.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The three named substrates must all be enabled and non-inert: use_harm_suffering_accumulator and use_suffering_derivative_comparator are REEConfig-default False, and the MECH-219 accumulator is additionally inert under escapability_mode=constant=1.0 (g=0 -> s->0). Because the rule is multiplicative on accumulated state, a supra-threshold episode must leave non-zero s_t and non-zero drive_bias at offset, or rebound-ON and rebound-OFF are bit-identical.
CONFIRMING: With rebound ON, s_t and drive_bias return to baseline measurably faster than the matched OFF arm after the same offset, with onset slope and peak unchanged, with no measurable effect in the never-stressed arm, and with the acceleration tied to comparator fires rather than to elapsed time. Manipulation: Rebound ON vs OFF: an offset-triggered transient R(t) that multiplies the MECH-219 recovery-side rate (recovery_rate_eff = alpha_fall * (1 + nu_R * R)) and applies a waking per-tick leak drive_bias *= (1 - leakR * R), fired by the MECH-302 SufferingDerivativeComparator descent event. Control: Rebound-OFF arm at matched onset drive, matched escapability and matched episode schedule; a never-stressed arm for load-proportionality (rebound must be a no-op on a calm agent); and a no-conspecific condition throughout, which separates this from MECH-355 soothing. Required event: An agent-owned aversive episode that drives z_harm_a / the MECH-219 suffering accumulator above threshold and is then genuinely released (damage removal or healing), on the waking stream, with no conspecific present and no predictive safety cue. DV: Post-offset return-to-baseline kinetics of s_t and of PACCAnalog drive_bias -- half-life or ticks-to-baseline after the comparator fires -- with ONSET slope and PEAK magnitude required to be unchanged between arms (so the effect is recovery acceleration, not gain reduction). Secondary: MECH-091 urgency-interrupt rate over the post-offset window.
FALSIFYING: Recovery kinetics are unchanged between ON and OFF at matched onset and peak; or the ON arm also lowers onset/peak (a gain change, not an active rebound); or the ON arm changes the never-stressed control (sedation rather than load-proportional recovery). A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: HarmSufferingAccumulator.update outputs and PACCAnalog drive_bias diagnostics expose both state variables per tick, and the comparator already emits its fire event; but no driver records a post-offset recovery half-life, and no R(t) state or nu_R/leakR knob exists anywhere in ree_core. Consumer / boundary: The recovery side of the MECH-219 z_harm_a/suffering integrator and the SD-032e drive_bias accumulator, on the WAKING stream only (MECH-094: an offset detected during replay must not fire). Existing ownership: MECH-302, MECH-219, SD-032e, EXP-1001, LIT-1002.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Trigger and both effectors exist separately -- SufferingDerivativeComparator fires on offset, the MECH-219 accumulator has an explicit alpha_fall recovery side, and PACCAnalog carries an offline_decay hook documented as reserved for a future claim -- but nothing connects them. There is no R(t) transient, no waking drive_bias leak (offline_decay applies only at note_offline_entry and defaults to 0.0), hence no ON/OFF arm to run. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-357.subject: prefrontal.infralimbic_freeze_suppression_avoidance_gate
MECH-357.title: Infralimbic-PFC-analog freeze-suppression + instrumental-avoidance gate: the mechanism instantiating SD-058. A pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/infralimbic_avoidance_gate.py, sibling to SD-035 CeA/BLA, MECH-279 PAG, MECH-313/MECH-320 policy regulators) with three coordinated pieces, all behind use_instrumental_avoidance (no-op default): (a) an instrumental-avoidance ACTION pathway -- a per-candidate E3 score-bias that under threat penalises the no-op/freeze class proportional to effective avoidance-efficacy, RELEASING the instrumental action (it does not pick the escape direction; E3's harm gradient does -- ARC-007-strict-compatible); (b) an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate that, when effective_efficacy*threat_scale >= threshold, overrides the MECH-279 freeze no-op so the agent acts instead of freezing; (c) an eligibility-trace avoidance-efficacy learner credited when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (Debiec & Sullivan 2017 gradual acquisition), bootstrapped by a protective-scaffold floor that anneals across Stage-H (Turchetta 2020).
MECH-357.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The LESION arm must actually fail to survive, or the discrimination criterion has no headroom. 603h met this (median survival 27.5/16.5/19.0); 603r did not -- under byte-identical hazard config the lesion arm reached 200/103/200, i.e. the ceiling, so G_H_INTACT > G_H_LESION cannot fire for reasons unrelated to the gate.
CONFIRMING: Suppression onset tracks the learned avoidance_efficacy trace rather than instantaneous arousal, and the INTACT arm shows shorter freeze duration and faster directed-escape latency under threat than the lesion arm, on >= 2/3 seeds. Manipulation: use_instrumental_avoidance ON (ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression plus instrumental-avoidance action bias) versus the ilPFC-lesion arm with the gate OFF, both carrying the harm-pathway training and the escape-affordance bridge so the gate is the sole variable. Control: The gate-OFF lesion arm at matched seeds and hazard config; plus an arousal-yoked control in which suppression is driven by instantaneous z_harm_a/threat scale rather than the learned avoidance_efficacy trace, which is the SD-037/MECH-281 confound the claim's distinctness rests on. Required event: Sustained threat episodes in an isolated hazard-avoidance stage where freezing is genuinely lethal and a directed escape is available -- a freeze-incompatible pressure regime. DV: A GRADED per-tick escape DV rather than the binary Stage-H survival fraction: freeze duration under threat, latency to first directed action after threat onset, and the correlation of suppression onset with the learned avoidance_efficacy trace rather than with instantaneous threat magnitude.
FALSIFYING: With readiness met (gate engaging and suppressing at 1.0, freeze committing on the lesion arm), the INTACT arm shows no graded advantage in freeze duration or escape latency -- or suppression onset tracks instantaneous z_harm_a spikes rather than the learned trace, which would collapse the SD-037/MECH-281 distinction the claim's distinctness depends on. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The gate records efficacy, engagement and suppression per tick (ree_core/pfc/infralimbic_avoidance_gate.py; agent.py caches whether the last emitted action was directed), and the escape-affordance bridge records per-class credit. The binary G_H survival fraction is what the falsifier currently scores. Consumer / boundary: The per-tick freeze-suppression override of the MECH-279 PAG no-op inside select_action -- not episode survival, which is a many-step aggregate both arms can reach by other routes. Existing ownership: mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism, mech357-avoidance-efficacy-eligibility-trace-imbalance, escape-affordance-bridge, mech357_avoidance_efficacy:BUILD, SD-058.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The discrimination DV is ceiling-bounded: once the harm-pathway fix is applied, the ungated lesion arm also survives, so the binary survival fraction cannot separate the arms. All four designs intended to restore headroom by making freezing lethal (static field, mobile drift, scheduled adjacency, agent-directed pursuit) are exhausted and recorded validated_negative, with a standing instruction not to open a fifth. Secondary classes: R6, R1. Gap disposition: INSTRUMENT EXISTS BUT WRONG LOCUS/TIMESCALE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA states 'No experiment currently in the queue tags MECH-357' and names a chip to queue the combined retest. That retest RAN as V3-EXQ-603r on 2026-08-09, and four further runs followed (603s, 603t, 603u, 603v). The combined retest produced a new and decisive finding the WWA predates: ARM_LESION (no gate at all) also reached the survival ceiling once the harm-pathway fix was applied, so the discrimination DV has no headroom. substrate_queue mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism is now status validated_negative with all four pressure designs exhausted. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-358.subject: prefrontal.relief_safety_escape_affordance_bridge
MECH-358.title: Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge mechanism (instantiates SD-059): a pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/escape_affordance_bridge.py, sibling to the SD-058/MECH-357 gate) extending the MECH-357 scalar avoidance_efficacy into a per-first-action-class credit table. RELIEF half: a directed action under threat that drops z_harm_a (delta = prev - now > floor) credits relief_affordance[class] (EMA toward 1; MECH-302-consistent). SAFETY half: a directed action after which threat is absent (threat_scale <= 0) credits safety_affordance[class] (MECH-303/304-consistent response-produced safety). Approach bonus: under future threat, a per-candidate NEGATIVE (favoured) E3 score-bias toward credited classes = -clamp(approach_gain * threat_scale * combined_affordance[class], 0, bias_scale); the no-op/freeze class never gets a bonus. Three guards: bias_scale clamp, threat-context gate (zero when safe), per-tick leak.
MECH-358.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Stage-H must be survivable-but-not-ceilinged (the binary G_H gate saturated in 603l and made the discrimination criterion structurally unsatisfiable), the harm pathway must be trained so PAG freeze and the ilPFC gate engage on the base arm, and each enabled bridge half must increment its credit table before any survival statistic is scored.
CONFIRMING: With preconditions met, both_bridge and best_bridge mean Stage-H survival exceed ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY by at least 10 percent -- fired by V3-EXQ-603q (base 37.7 to safety 46.6, supports), substrate reproduction reconfirmed by V3-EXQ-866b. Manipulation: Enable the relief half, the safety half, or both (use_escape_affordance_bridge with its per-half flags) so credited first-action classes receive a threat-gated negative approach bias at E3. Control: ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY -- the SD-058/MECH-357 ilPFC freeze-suppression gate alone, bridge OFF -- on matched seeds, plus a nav-competence positive control so a flat outcome across bridge arms can be attributed to a navigation ceiling rather than to the bridge. Required event: A directed action under threat that either drops z_harm_a (relief) or is followed by threat absence (safety), followed later by a future-threat episode in which a credited action class is available. DV: Mean Stage-H survival (continuous episode length, not the binary G_H gate) of the best and both bridge arms relative to ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY, with a >= 10 percent lift bar, plus P1 survival transfer without over-avoidance or starvation.
FALSIFYING: With each enabled half firing non-vacuously and the nav-competence positive control PASSING, no bridge arm lifts continuous Stage-H survival over ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY -- affordance-indexed relief/safety credit adds nothing beyond scalar freeze suppression. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/pfc/escape_affordance_bridge.py with HazardAvoidanceResult.escape_bridge_state surfacing per-half credit tables; V3-EXQ-603q records per-arm continuous survival and all four preconditions. Both exist and fired. Consumer / boundary: The E3 score-bias chain at select_action (agent.py L8790), where the per-first-action-class approach bonus is composed after the MECH-357 scalar action bias -- the directed-escape channel MECH-357 cannot supply. Existing ownership: SD-059, MECH-357, scaffolded_sd054_onboarding, V3-EXQ-603q, GFLAG-0215.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); R0: the credit tables, the threat-gated per-class approach bias, the E3 consumer, the Stage-H regime, the continuous survival DV and the nav-competence control all exist, and the falsifier ran to a PASS. What is owed is replication (n=1 genuine run) and the v3_pending gate, not runnability. Secondary classes: none. Gap disposition: NO GAP -- FALSE POSITIVE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-359.subject: affect.candidate_differentiated_gradient
MECH-359.title: Candidate-differentiated affect vector: for proto-affect to carve behaviour it must carry per-candidate (cross-candidate) range, not merely per-tick magnitude. Each E3 candidate trajectory carries a multi-channel affect vector (curiosity / safety / harm-sensory / harm-affective / effort / relief / blocked-agency) so the same world-state can support different candidate rankings (approach / inspect / retreat / persist / retry / rest / reorient) under different internal pressures. A scalar added equally to all K candidates cannot change an argmax; only a per-candidate-differentiated contribution can.
MECH-359.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (hard gate -- do not attempt to read this
claim without it): the V4 per-candidate multi-channel affect substrate
(a real, separately-tracked affect vector -- curiosity / safety /
harm-sensory / harm-affective / effort / relief / blocked-agency -- per
E3 candidate trajectory) must actually be BUILT first; it does not exist
in V3 and this claim is explicitly DO-NOT-BUILD-IN-V3. Do not queue an
experiment against this claim until that substrate exists. Once built,
a run is only informative if each affect channel shows genuine
cross-candidate RANGE (variance across the K candidates at a given
tick), not merely per-tick magnitude -- apply the same
range/non-vacuity readiness discipline already established for the
V3-narrow instance of this principle by V3-EXQ-643a (which fixed
V3-EXQ-643's float32-cancellation-masked zero-range failure). A run
whose channels are magnitude-only / flat across candidates (e.g.
cand_world_pairwise_dist collapsed to floor, mirroring the historical
behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-A collapse) must self-route
substrate_not_ready -- it is not a verdict on this claim, only a
precondition failure. Per this claim's own notes, do not treat this
claim as testable until a downstream per-candidate-affective-variance
readiness result exists on the GAP-A-ready substrate (the MECH-341
within-class-representative-diversity retest plus GAP-A bias channels
demonstrating that per-candidate range actually bites at behavioural
runtime).
CONFIRMING signature: with the multi-channel substrate built and
non-vacuity established, the SAME world-state, under DIFFERENT
internal-pressure profiles (different relative weighting/activation
across the affect channels), yields DIFFERENT candidate rankings /
argmax selections (approach / inspect / retreat / persist / retry /
rest / reorient) -- i.e. the affect vector is shown to be doing real
selection work, not just riding along with a world-state-determined
ranking. This is the claim's own core prediction: "only a
per-candidate-differentiated contribution can [change an argmax]."
FALSIFYING signature: even after the substrate is built and each
channel independently demonstrates non-vacuous cross-candidate range,
the selected action / argmax remains invariant to variation in the
affect vector for a fixed world-state -- i.e. candidate ranking is
fully explained by world-state features alone and the differentiated
affect channels carry no additional selection authority. This would
refute the mechanism even though the range precondition was met, and
would need to be distinguished from a precondition failure (see above)
before being read as a genuine falsification.
NOTE: this claim is the V4/V5 GENERALISATION only. Do not conflate a
result here with the already-closed V3-narrow question (whether the
existing single-channel modulatory/curiosity contribution needed a
range-not-magnitude gate) -- that is resolved and owned by
V3-EXQ-643/643a, MECH-341, behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-A/B, and
SD-056, not by this claim.

MECH-360.subject: expression.action_geometry_emergent_readout
MECH-360.title: Affective expression begins as emergent action geometry: because candidate-differentiated affect (MECH-359) selects trajectories, it also shapes the visible STYLE of behaviour -- hesitation, latency, approach angle, retreat, repeated retry, stopping, resumption, oscillation between candidates, avoidance margin, decommitment, repair-seeking. Expression is therefore initially an emergent readout of candidate-level affective arbitration, not a separately-engineered output channel; a later social agent can infer internal state from HOW an action occurred, not only what action occurred.
MECH-360.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: depends on MECH-359 and MECH-041, both confirmed still
unbuilt/current as of 2026-09-25. MECH-359 is explicitly phase_locked V4 ("the right response is
to wait for the upstream substrate, NOT more experiments"; distinct from the V3-narrow
modulatory-authority numerical fact already tested by V3-EXQ-643/643a, which is NOT this claim).
MECH-041 is confirmed blocked on a social/other-agent-modelling substrate and the ARC-047
scent-channel implementation (candidate, confidence 0.0, v5, unbuilt, as_of 2026-09-17). Neither
gate has moved since registration.

CONFIRMING (once MECH-359's substrate lands): the visible geometric STYLE of a committed action
(hesitation, latency, approach angle, retreat, repeated retry, avoidance margin, decommitment)
covaries measurably and predictably with the per-candidate affect vector that determined WHICH
candidate was selected, even holding the selected action CLASS constant -- i.e. two episodes that
commit to the "same" action class via differently-shaped affect vectors produce measurably
different action geometry.

FALSIFYING: with the multi-channel per-candidate affect substrate live and non-degenerate
(genuine cross-candidate range per channel, per the discipline V3-EXQ-643a already established
for the narrower V3 instance), action geometry shows no differentiation attributable to the
affect vector beyond what the selected action CLASS alone predicts -- style is not an emergent
readout of affective arbitration, and this claim collapses into MECH-041 (a
separately-engineered broadcast channel) or into nothing.

NOTES: explicitly complementary to, not competing with, MECH-041 per this claim's own notes --
MECH-041 tests the deliberate-broadcast reading, this claim tests the emergent-residue reading. A
joint experiment design should keep both arms once MECH-359 lands, rather than treating this as a
single falsifier against MECH-041.

MECH-361.subject: memory.candidate_gradient_episode_schema
MECH-361.title: Candidate-gradient hippocampal episode schema: enrich the event trace from state -> action -> outcome to state -> candidates-considered -> affective gradients over candidates -> selected action -> outcome -> residue (relief / harm / blocked-agency / safety update), and use the affective gradient as a memory WRITE-WEIGHT and RETRIEVAL-QUERY variable -- high-gradient episodes are preferentially written, and later similar-gradient states retrieve prior action-affect-outcome arcs rather than undifferentiated state-action-outcome tuples.
MECH-361.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the V4 per-candidate multi-channel affect substrate (MECH-359) must
be BUILT first -- confirmed absent from ree_core 2026-09-25 (no candidate_differentiated /
affect_vector hits). Do not queue an experiment against this claim before MECH-359's own
substrate lands and clears MECH-359's non-vacuity gate (genuine cross-candidate range per
channel, not magnitude-only). Additionally, MECH-261's replay-to-action bias recorder and
SalienceCoordinator operating_mode clamp API are also unbuilt (MECH-261's own
SUBSTRATE/INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: MISSING) -- this claim's retrieval-query leg needs that
recorder too, so both gaps must close before a run is informative.

CONFIRMING: with MECH-359 and the MECH-261 recorder built, episodes with higher per-candidate
affective-gradient magnitude at commit time show higher write/retention probability than
lower-gradient episodes, after controlling for MECH-074's BLA arousal-modulated write depth
(already built and evidenced, V3-EXQ-1080 PASS) -- i.e. gradient adds explanatory power beyond
generic arousal, not merely riding along with it. AND: retrieval cued by a probe state carrying a
given affective-gradient profile preferentially returns prior action-affect-outcome arcs whose
gradient profile matches, at a rate above a state-only nearest-neighbour baseline.

FALSIFYING: write/retention probability is fully explained by MECH-074 arousal once gradient is
added as a covariate (gradient's incremental coefficient is null), OR retrieval match rate is
indistinguishable from the state-only baseline (the gradient query adds nothing). A failure under
an unmet MECH-359/MECH-261 precondition is not evidence against the claim.

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: MECH-359 (blocking, unbuilt), MECH-261 recorder (blocking,
unbuilt), MECH-074 (built, evidenced -- usable as the covariate control), MECH-094 provenance
gating (built, live, audited -- simulated candidates already excluded from indexing per MECH-094's
own confirmed audit).

MECH-362.subject: development.subtractive_sparsification
MECH-362.title: Subtractive developmental sparsification: mature sparse/structured memory connectivity emerges by pruning / down-weighting an initially over-connected, dense, near-random ('tabula plena') substrate, not by additively growing connections onto a sparse skeleton; correspondingly, mature recall requires convergent summation of several weak inputs rather than a single strong cue.
MECH-362.what_would_answer:
Currency check 2026-09-15: the stated blocker (a developmental pruning/sparsification substrate not yet built) is STILL TRUE -- verified against ree_core/ and substrate_queue.json (no matching sd_id); no run has appeared.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: both regimes must be instantiable -- an over-connected / near-random early substrate AND a sparse/structured mature one -- with the TRAJECTORY between them actually traversed by the system, not configured at two fixed settings. MECH-363.subject: cognifold.long_range_competition_stability

An all-cooperative (all-positive) routed-field cognifold is unstable: every salient stream reinforces every other, producing runaway resonance / over-synchronisation / loss of modular segregation. Competition is the constructive ingredient that buys stabilisation, segregation, hierarchy, synergy, and subject-specificity.
MECH-363.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: ARC-084's V4 cognifold signed-edge layer (cognifold_edge =
{source, target, sign, gain, precision, gate, timescale, write_authority}) must exist with at
least one field pair wired sign<0 (diffuse, long-range, opposite-profile) alongside the
existing sign>0 edges. V3 has no such layer -- confirmed, no `cognifold_edge` or equivalent
typed signed-coupling object anywhere in ree_core/; V3's competition is local only (BG
winner-take-all, MECH-090 commitment latch, ARC-030 Go/NoGo, MECH-254 top-k). Probing the
CURRENT local-softmax competition is not a test of this claim and would be vacuous.

CONFIRMING: A cooperative-only field-coupling configuration shows runaway resonance /
over-synchronisation (loss of modular segregation, measured as cross-field activity
correlation approaching 1 and/or collapse of distinguishable regime occupancy), and adding the
diffuse long-range sign<0 edges (fields with opposite profiles) restores segregation,
stabilises the dynamics, and raises measured synergy/hierarchy -- at >= 0.8 SD of the
cross-seed delta, replicating Luppi et al. 2026's whole-brain finding inside REE's cognifold.

FALSIFYING: The cooperative-only and cooperative+long-range-competitive configurations are
statistically indistinguishable on stability/segregation/synergy once the layer exists, or
local competition (already built) already achieves the same stabilisation the diffuse
long-range edges are supposed to add uniquely.

DISTINGUISH (own notes, retained): this claim's failure axis is runaway POSITIVE coupling /
hypersync (MECH-076-adjacent); do NOT conflate with MONOSTRATEGY / regime-collapse (MECH-309,
owned by ARC-062/063), which is the opposite pole (too little structure, not too much
coupling).

invent a synthetic tag oscillation as its own DV).

accumulates across ticks -- NOT SD-032b's per-tick z_conflict and NOT E3 _running_variance, which is

switch mechanism active (SD-032a's modes have no threat-vigilant vs exploratory pair and the

safe-confirmation events scored independently of the load readout; (iv) a benign-reframe episode
design in which a threat cue is repeatedly disconfirmed.

per-tag clears (the regime-level increment is the claim), crossing a load threshold precedes and
predicts the switch into the exploratory regime (exploration up, commitment rigidity down), and
ablating the load discharge while leaving per-tag clears intact prevents the regime re-opening after
a benign reframe -- producing the predicted lock-in / persistence (MECH-076, MECH-027 routes).
FALSIFYING: the regime transition happens at the same rate and latency with load discharge ablated;
OR the load drop equals the per-tag-clear sum with no regime consequence (MECH-364 reduces to

MECH-365.subject: memory.provenance_bearing_event_token
MECH-365.title: Provenance-bearing one-way commit-status gate (V3 half of the 2026-09-24 split): imagined / simulated event representations carry an explicit committed_vs_imagined provenance label, and a ONE-WAY gate ensures they can be used for planning without ever acquiring committed-history status -- the reality-status signature MECH-545's contract-lesion assay targets. Scope: the label and gate on the event representations V3 already carries; the full unified-store event-token schema is MECH-365a (v4, on ARC-085).
MECH-365.what_would_answer:
SCOPE: the V3 half after the 2026-09-24 split. V3's committed_vs_imagined label is
hypothesis_tag, carried on the representation object (Trajectory.hypothesis_tag /
.metadata, LatentState.hypothesis_tag), not only passed as a per-call mode argument. The V3
analogue of "committed history" is the ResidueField valence/residue terrain that later reads
as experienced value. The full event-token schema on the ARC-085 store is MECH-365a (v4) and
is not tested here. The safety property itself (simulation content must not accumulate as
experience) is owned by MECH-094 / INV-011 / MECH-037, and their audits stand. This claim adds
three testable specifics: (i) the label TRAVELS on the imagined representation to the
consolidation boundary; (ii) the gate is SELECTIVE, blocking committed-status writes while
imagined content is still presented and read (a gate, not a discard); (iii) it is ONE-WAY,
stripping the label only on REALIZATION (observed states), never on commitment of predicted
states.
BIOLOGY: reality monitoring / source monitoring. Confabulation after ventromedial-orbitofrontal
and basal-forebrain damage is a failure to filter currently-irrelevant or internally generated
memory traces from what is taken as present reality (Schnider 2003 reality/temporal-context
filtering, cited under MECH-094; Papez-loop provenance gating, MECH-037, Theze 2017). Source
is multidimensional (Johnson, Hashtroudi & Lindsay 1993, cited under MECH-430). This claim
tests only the single reality-status bit; per-dimension provenance is MECH-430.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (P1) a real replay -> consolidation writer must be LIVE in the
unlesioned arm: the MECH-217 REM wanting-spread (use_offline_wanting_spread, rem_enabled,
sleep cycles firing) must make non-zero accepted writes from reverse (real) replay, as it did
in V3-EXQ-842. (P2) Imagined content must actually be generated AND presented to that same
writer. Today it is not (REM forward replay is scored read-only; waking _do_replay discards
its output), so a routing flag is required, and without it every lesion is vacuous by
construction. (P3) The imagined trajectories presented must carry non-zero source wanting at
their start state (world_states[0]); otherwise spread_reverse_replay_wanting returns before
reaching the gate and "no contamination" means "no write attempted". (P4) The contamination
DV must have demonstrated range: a CANARY arm with the label suppressed at SOURCE must show
imagined-sourced accepted writes > 0, or the instrument cannot detect a gate failure. (P5)
The valence clamp must not be saturated (fraction of active centers at clamp_abs < 0.5 in the
intact arm), or contamination is absorbed and under-read.
CONFIRMING (all, >= 3 seeds, every seed): (C1) with the gate intact and imagined replay routed
to the writer, imagined-sourced accepted write mass == 0 and the end-of-run VALENCE_WANTING
map matches the unrouted reference arm to within 1e-6 relative L1. (C2) Dropping the label at
the consolidation boundary (the sender's Trajectory keeps its label; only the translation into
update_valence drops it) makes imagined-sourced mass > 0 and a relative-L1 wanting-map
divergence from the intact arm D > theta, theta = max(3 * SD_seeds(D_sham), 0.05). (C3) A sham
lesion that runs the same override code path on real (already-untagged) trajectories gives
D_sham <= 0.01. (C4) SELECTIVITY: in the intact arm the imagined replay is still generated and
read. Forward-replay scored count > 0 and equal to the reference arm, mean forward terrain score
equal to within 1e-6, and forward trajectories reach the writer and are refused there (refused
waypoint count > 0), not dropped upstream.
ONE-WAY LEG (audit, separate from the lesion): re-derive from the CURRENT tree at run time every
site that yields an untagged Trajectory / LatentState from a tagged source. CONFIRMING only if
every such site strips on realization, i.e. it stores OBSERVED z_world, not a proposal's predicted
states.
FALSIFYING (any one): (F1) the label does not travel. The intact-gate arm accepts
imagined-sourced writes (C1 fails with the P4 canary valid): the gate is not one-way at the
only V3 consolidation boundary. (F2) The gate is not selective: making the label honoured also
suppresses the read/scoring path (C4 fails), so the mechanism is a blackout, not a
status gate, and the "usable for planning" leg fails. (F3) The label is not load-bearing:
with P1-P5 met, the boundary lesion produces D <= theta in a majority of seeds. Imagined
content then reaches committed history in no material amount, and the provenance label has no
keep at this boundary. A sham with D_sham > 0.01 invalidates the run: instrument
nondeterminism, no verdict.
SUBSTRATE (verified 2026-09-24 at ree-v3 44ddbfd): ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py Trajectory
(hypothesis_tag default False, metadata); ree_core/latent/stack.py LatentState.hypothesis_tag;
ree_core/hippocampal/module.py replay() (2975; DEFECT: output is not tagged despite its
docstring), diverse_replay() (3193, forward/random steps delegate to replay()),
reverse_replay() (3110), spread_reverse_replay_wanting() (3668; the sole ree_core reader of
Trajectory.hypothesis_tag, at 3738), record_committed_trajectory() (3534; the sole
tagged->untagged site), backward_credit_sweep() (3574); ree_core/residue/field.py
update_valence() (847, the hypothesis_tag refusal); ree_core/agent.py _do_replay() (10968,
output discarded), run_rem_attribution_pass() (13184, forward replay scored read-only, reverse
replay spread). Harness precedent: experiments/v3_exq_842_mech217_offline_wanting_spread_readiness.py
(PASS 2026-07-30, MECH-217 writer demonstrably live).
CAVEATS, stated plainly: (a) The lesion leg is AUDIT-STRENGTH, like INV-011's. Once the label
is stamped and honoured, C1 and C3 are structurally determined, and C2 is near-guaranteed
given P3. The informative content is F1 (does the label travel: on the as-built tree it does

It is not behavioural evidence that contamination changes later action. A behavioural follow-up
(post-sleep wanting-gradient approach to imagined-only content) is owed before any promotion
beyond candidate. (b) The one-way leg is currently VIOLATED latently at MECH-290

realization); it does not refute the claim. (c) Evidence from this falsifier tags MECH-365

Disposition (draft): testable in V3 now for the carried-label + selectivity + boundary-lesion

MECH-375.subject: relief.trainable_relief_critic
MECH-375.title: Trainable relief critic Q_relief(state, action, threat_context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head that predicts expected harm/suffering reduction following an action under threat -- negative-reinforcement credit assignment, distinct from generic reward / wanting. It is the trainable successor to the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA credit table of the MECH-358 relief half, and is downstream of (NOT a duplicate of) the non-trainable MECH-302 / SD-050 relief-completion comparator that merely DETECTS relief on the current state. Q_relief is a function approximator generalising relief-credit across continuous state x action x threat-context, trained on action-contingent drops in z_harm_a: positive target when a directed action under threat is followed by a temporally-close, action-contingent z_harm_a drop not explained by passive environmental drift; negative / extinction target when the expected relief action fails to reduce harm. Feeds E3 as a bounded, threat-gated, extinguishable score-bias toward actions predicted to reduce harm -- never global reward, never fires when safe, never credits no-op / freeze unless explicitly modelling passive safety. MECH-094-safe: simulated relief in hypothesis mode must not train the waking critic unless authorised as play / training.
MECH-375.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The relief head must have headroom and be non-vacuous: threat must be present on some ticks and absent on others, directed non-noop actions must occur under threat, and action-contingent z_harm_a drops must be separable from passive environmental drift. A run where every relief target is zero, or where harm falls without any action, cannot discriminate a learned critic from the fixed EMA table.
CONFIRMING: The trainable critic predicts relief on held-out state x action x threat combinations better than the fixed EMA table at matched exposure, while staying bounded, firing only under threat, and extinguishing when relief predictions fail. Manipulation: use_trainable_escape_affordance_learner ON with use_relief_critic=True, against the fixed-arithmetic SD-059 EscapeAffordanceBridge EMA table, at matched threat exposure and matched bias_scale. Control: The MECH-358 fixed per-first-action-class EMA table arm (current default), plus a novel-state generalisation probe -- state-action-threat combinations held out of training -- which is where a parametric critic must beat a lookup table if trainability is the claim's content. Required event: A directed, non-noop action taken while threat_scale > 0, followed by a temporally-close drop in z_harm_a not explained by passive drift -- and, for the extinction half, an expected relief action that fails to reduce harm. DV: Generalisation of relief credit to unseen state x action x threat-context combinations: predicted relief on held-out combinations versus the fixed table's, plus extinction rate when a previously-crediting action stops reducing harm, plus the resulting bounded E3 score-bias magnitude.
FALSIFYING: The learned head matches the fixed per-action-class table on held-out combinations -- no generalisation gain -- or its bias fires when safe, or fails to extinguish, in which case the trainable form buys nothing over MECH-358. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: TrainableEscapeAffordanceLearner exposes relief_values, best_escape_class, diagnostics() and a per-update TrainableEscapeAffordanceLearnerOutput carrying relief_target, relief_value, relief_loss, bias_max_abs, updated, optimizer_step and simulation_skipped -- the DV is fully recordable. What does not exist is any experiment that turns the flag on. Consumer / boundary: The bounded, threat-gated, extinguishable score-bias entering E3 via compute_approach_bias (agent.py:8837-8861), trained from the realized transition at agent.py:5146-5154 -- never a global approach signal. Existing ownership: MECH-358, SD-059, MECH-302, SD-050, Q-067, LIT-1009.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Not a build gap. The head is built and fully wired (construction agent.py:2305-2327; update :5146; bias :8861; reset :3874) with a master switch use_trainable_escape_affordance_learner default False, and contract tests exist -- but zero experiments set that flag, so the manipulation has never been applied. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-376.subject: safety_prediction.trainable_safety_predictor
MECH-376.title: Trainable prospective safety predictor P_safety(state, cue, action, context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head predicting threat-ABSENCE / response-produced safety / conditioned inhibition, licensing commitment-release, approach to safety affordances, and recovery after threat. Distinct from z_goal (it predicts the ABSENCE of threat, not the PRESENCE of a goal) and from relief (it is a PROSPECTIVE threat-absence prediction, not an aversive-offset event). It is the trainable + contrastive successor that makes the MECH-303 (contextual passive safety) + MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition) substrate learnable, replacing the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA safety table of the MECH-358 safety half: positive target when a cue / context / action predicts threat absence or response-produced safety; negative target when 'safe' cues are followed by threat recurrence; CONTRASTIVE target to stop safety overgeneralising to stable background features that merely co-occurred with relief. Output supports commitment release, permits approach to safety affordances, stabilises recovery, and prevents persistent defensive mode when threat is genuinely absent.
MECH-376.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Threat must both offset and RECUR within a run, with cues that co-vary with threat absence separable from stable background features. If every low-harm state is also a safe-cue state, safety and 'low harm' are the same variable and the claim's own distinguishing failure mode cannot be tested.
CONFIRMING: The learned predictor generalises threat-absence prediction to held-out cue/context/action combinations better than the fixed table, extinguishes on threat recurrence, and does NOT attach safety to the background feature that merely co-varied with relief. Manipulation: use_trainable_escape_affordance_learner ON with use_safety_predictor=True against the fixed MECH-358 safety EMA table; and, for the contrastive leg, a background feature deliberately confounded with relief so that an undisciplined predictor will over-generalise to it. Control: The fixed per-action-class safety EMA arm, plus a z_goal-presence arm confirming the predictor is tracking threat ABSENCE and not goal presence, plus a confound-free arm where no background feature co-varies with relief. Required event: A cue/context/action followed by threat absence (threat_scale falls to zero) licensing commitment release, and separately a 'safe'-predicted cue followed by threat recurrence, which must drive the negative target. DV: Predicted safety on held-out cue x context x action combinations versus the fixed table; the rate at which safety predictions attach to the confounded background feature (the over-generalisation DV); and commitment-release / re-approach latency after threat offset.
FALSIFYING: Safety predictions are indistinguishable from the fixed table on held-out combinations, or track 'low harm' / 'recent relief' rather than prospective threat absence, or fail to extinguish on threat recurrence. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The learner records safety_target, safety_value, safety_loss and per-class safety_values, and get_state()/diagnostics() expose the positive, negative and noop-skipped counts -- so the prospective-safety DV is recordable. The over-generalisation DV is NOT: no contrastive term exists anywhere in the module (grep for 'contrast' returns zero hits), and the positive target is literally threat_scale <= 0.0 -> 1.0. Consumer / boundary: The bounded, threat-context-gated safety bias entering E3 through compute_approach_bias, and the commitment-release decision it is meant to license -- not the harm stream and not z_goal. Existing ownership: MECH-358, SD-059, MECH-303, MECH-304, MECH-375, LIT-1010.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Two layers. The trainable predictor is built and wired but no experiment enables it (flag default False, zero experiment hits). And the claim's distinguishing CONTRASTIVE discipline is genuinely absent from the implementation -- the safety target is set by threat_scale <= 0.0, which is precisely the 'safety == absence of threat' shortcut the claim warns against, so the over-generalisation leg has no instrument. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-380.subject: cognitive_control.private_speech_externalised_scaffold
MECH-380.title: Private speech is the external phase of a cognitive-control system: overt self-narration regulates attention, action, affect, and task sequence as an inspectable control surface, and the Vygotskian internalisation ladder (other-regulation -> overt self-regulation -> inner speech -> compressed control) is the developmental route by which that external control surface becomes internal.
