actually emitted during waking operation and (b) capable of being read back INTO arbitration
(not merely an inspection trace). Neither exists in V3: MECH-384, the registered V3-compatible
reduced form (fourteen-field trace scaffold: state_label, goal_label, candidate_action,
commitment_threshold, simulation_or_commitment, etc.), is status=candidate,
epistemic_category=substrate_coherence, and its own SUBSTRATE/INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT records
"grep of ree_core finds no self_narration, narration_trace or MECH-384 reference at all."
MECH-384 is explicitly a READ-ONLY observability surface by design (its DISPOSITION: "explicitly
NOT a control input, since compressing it into internal control is the later V4
developmental-ladder step, not this claim") -- so even once MECH-384 lands, MECH-380 additionally
needs a second, not-yet-designed piece: a route by which the emitted trace can be FED BACK into
E3/arbitration as a control signal. A run attempted before both exist should self-route
substrate_not_ready, not report a verdict.

CONFIRMING (once both pieces exist): an agent whose self-narration trace is exposed to
arbitration shows measurably different regulation of attention/action/affect/sequencing (e.g.
altered commit-threshold behaviour, altered task-sequencing under conflict) relative to a
matched agent with the trace collected but withheld from arbitration (trace-collected-but-inert
control) -- isolating the CONTROL-SURFACE function from mere logging.

FALSIFYING: the trace can be exposed to arbitration with no measurable behavioural difference
from the withheld-trace control across matched conditions -- private speech content carries no
control function distinguishable from post-hoc narration. A failure under unmet preconditions
(MECH-384 unbuilt, no feedback route) is not evidence against the claim.

OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: none -- this is a REE-internal mechanism claim throughout.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: MECH-384 lands (even as an inert trace) AND a feedback/control-input route from
that trace into E3 or an equivalent arbitration site is designed and built. Until then this is
substrate_conditional, not substrate_ceiling -- the mechanism has never been exercised, not
exercised-and-absorbed.

MECH-381.subject: development.externalise_internalise_compression_ladder
MECH-381.title: Developmental compression ladder: sensorimotor exploration -> play/simulation -> self-narration -> compressed internal control -> mature arbitration. External cognitive scaffolds (play, private speech) compress into internal control over development; the externalise-then-internalise compression is the developmental mechanism, distinct from the progression of play types.
MECH-381.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: see MECH-380's what_would_answer for rung 3 (private
speech/self-narration) -- do not re-derive; MECH-384 is unbuilt there and blocks here identically.
Additionally, rungs 1-2 (sensorimotor exploration -> play) require the play-frame-tagging
mechanism ARC-090 already names as its own blocker: ARC-049's play_frame_tag/frame_open/
frame_close, confirmed absent from ree_core by direct search (zero hits, re-confirmed this pass,
matching ARC-090's 2026-08-07 finding). This claim needs BOTH rung-2 and rung-3 instrumentation
live simultaneously to measure a COMPRESSION signature (the same external content becoming
internally represented over development), which is a strictly harder joint requirement than
either sibling claim alone.

CONFIRMING: across a developmental run, behaviour that initially requires the externalised
scaffold (an observable play-frame episode, or an observable self-narration trace, per the above)
to be produced comes to be produced WITHOUT that externalisation later in the same
developmental trajectory, while performance on the underlying task is preserved or improves --
the compression signature. This must be shown to be the ladder's ORTHOGONAL compression axis, not
a restatement of INV-060/MECH-197's within-play-type progression (sensorimotor->constructive->
pretend->rule-based->cooperative): the discriminating test is that compression should be
observable WITHIN a single play type (e.g. pretend play becoming silent/internal while still
pretend), not only across play-type transitions.

FALSIFYING: externalisation persists at constant rate across the developmental trajectory with no

OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: none.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: MECH-384 lands AND ARC-049's play-frame-tag mechanism lands AND a developmental

MECH-382.subject: arbitration.self_distancing_reframe_operator
MECH-382.title: Distancing operator: reframing a sticky, high-conflict, self-referential state from first-person ('I am failing') into a model-like system-state or third-person frame ('REE is encountering unresolved prediction-error pressure under current constraints') reduces self-referential collapse and increases model-based inspection during arbitration.

CONFIRMING: with a writable self-narration surface and a live ARC-005 consumer both present, inducing
  a sticky, high-conflict, self-referential state and then applying the third-person/system-state
  reframe (vs. a first-person-framing control matched for length/content) produces LESS self-

FALSIFYING: with both preconditions met, the third-person reframe produces no measurable difference

UNBLOCKS WHEN: MECH-384 is extended from a read-only trace to a writable control surface AND ARC-005

MECH-383.subject: perception.label_as_topdown_control_signal
MECH-383.title: Labels as active top-down perceptual-control signals: a self-directed label ('food-gradient', 'danger-gradient', 'novelty-gradient', 'blocked-goal', 'return-to-baseline') is not merely a post-perceptual report but a top-down tuning signal that biases perceptual search and detection -- a perceptual-control intervention, not a description.

first. (1) A label-generation surface (self-directed label emission) coupled into perceptual search:

MECH-384.subject: observability.self_narration_trace_scaffold
MECH-384.title: Lightweight self-narration trace/debug scaffold: an optional traceable field set (state_label, goal_label, sensed_gradient, active_prediction, uncertainty_level, candidate_action, candidate_action_reason, expected_consequence, affective_pressure, conflict_flag, commitment_threshold, stop_condition, simulation_or_commitment, self_reference_frame) that surfaces REE's working state for inspection -- the V3-compatible reduced form of an externalised 'private speech' surface, before it is compressed into internal control.
MECH-384.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Acceptance here is coverage, not an outcome: each of the fourteen fields must be shown to be recoverable from live state at a single waking tick without new machinery, and any field that is not (candidate_action_reason, self_reference_frame) must be declared as new substrate rather than re-exposure, or the claim silently becomes a build.
CONFIRMING: The fourteen fields are assembled at one tick from existing state, the trace-on arm is bit-identical to trace-off, and the trace makes a real inspection question answerable that was previously answerable only by reading code. Manipulation: Emit the assembled trace versus not. This is a read-only observability surface, so the only manipulation is whether the fields are collected and written out; no control signal changes. Control: The trace-off arm, which must be bit-identical in action sequence and in every scored metric -- an observability scaffold that changes behaviour has stopped being an observability scaffold. Required event: One waking decision tick at which a candidate action is proposed, scored and either committed or withheld -- the tick at which all fourteen fields are simultaneously defined. DV: Field-coverage count (how many of the fourteen are recoverable from existing state without new computation) plus bit-identity of the action stream and of the scored metrics between trace-on and trace-off.
FALSIFYING: Several fields turn out not to be recoverable without new machinery (so this is a build, not a surface), or assembling the trace perturbs selection, or the surface answers no inspection question that existing per-module diagnostics do not already answer. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Nothing emits the field set: grep of ree_core finds no self_narration, narration_trace or MECH-384 reference at all. Components exist scattered (hypothesis_tag for simulation_or_commitment, E3 commit_threshold and running_variance, precision for uncertainty_level) but no assembled trace object and no writer. Consumer / boundary: A read-only inspection surface over the waking decision path -- explicitly NOT a control input, since compressing it into internal control is the later V4 developmental-ladder step, not this claim. Existing ownership: MECH-384, EXP-1011, LIT-1012, developmental_dmn_v4:DMN-1.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); Registered as claim_type design_decision with epistemic_category substrate_coherence precisely so it is suppressed from the proposal lane and from promote/demote gating; there is no experiment that could falsify it and nothing is built. The two auto-minted proposals EXP-1011 and LIT-1012 contradict that suppression and are the live defect here. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-385.subject: inference.belief_state_hypothesis_set
MECH-385.title: Belief-state hypothesis set: when observations are ambiguous or incomplete, REE maintains a bounded set of competing latent-state hypotheses, each carrying confidence/precision, predicted transitions, goal/antigoal relations, and uncertainty; E3 evaluates candidate trajectories over the hypothesis set rather than over a single collapsed state.
MECH-385.what_would_answer:
PRECONDITION (not yet met): the V3 single-hypothesis path -- MECH-022 hypothesis injection + ARC-007 hippocampal completion -- must first be exercised and instrumented to a clean PASS. As of 2026-08-06, ARC-007/ARC-018/MECH-033 (completion, rollout, kernel-chaining) are confirmed_established (exp_conf 0.64-0.72, 6-8 genuine experiments each), but MECH-022 itself carries only one genuine instrumented experiment with a MIXED result (exp_conf 0.28) -- not the clean confirmation evidence/planning/inference_belief_state_v4_plan.md's own 2026-06-16 readiness note requires before the belief-SET extension can open. AND the V4 bounded-competing-hypothesis-set substrate must be built (confirmed absent; explicitly gated DO NOT BUILD IN V3).
Once both preconditions are met, this resolves empirically as:
CONFIRMING: under genuine observational ambiguity, E3 trajectory evaluation over the multi-hypothesis set produces measurably different and better-calibrated decisions than evaluation over a single collapsed state -- e.g. the agent maintains appropriate uncertainty (avoids premature commitment to a wrong hypothesis when evidence is genuinely ambiguous) and its expressed/behavioral confidence tracks the TRUE ambiguity of the situation more closely than the single-hypothesis (MECH-022/ARC-007 only) baseline.
FALSIFYING: multi-hypothesis evaluation produces no measurable behavioral or calibration difference from the single-hypothesis baseline under the same ambiguous scenarios -- i.e. collapsing to one hypothesis loses no decision-relevant information REE actually uses, so the bounded competing-set representation is architecturally inert relative to the simpler single-hypothesis generator it would replace.

MECH-388.subject: inference.epistemic_action_pressure
MECH-388.title: Epistemic action pressure: when goal success or harm avoidance depends on hidden state, REE can assign action pressure to information-gathering transitions that reduce uncertainty, even when those actions are not immediately reward-maximising or harm-minimising; generalises Q-044 curiosity into a survival-relevant viability function under partial observability.
MECH-388.what_would_answer:

above). (2) Q-044 (curiosity sub-flavour independence) remains genuinely OPEN and current as of

MECH-389.subject: goal.interrupted_task_resumption_parked_slot
MECH-389.title: Interrupted-task resumption: a parked-goal persistence + capacity-keyed re-prioritisation mechanism that closes the event-arc interrupt->reorient->resume span. When a task is interrupted (hazard, capacity loss, higher-priority goal), its goal slot is PARKED (z_goal + progress context retained, not invalidated) rather than discarded; the parked slot carries a persistence/urgency signal (Zeigarnik-analog) that re-elevates its relative importance in the SD-033e/MECH-265 arbitrator when capacity returns, triggering reorient-and-resume rather than restart-from-scratch.
MECH-389.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the V4 goal-deliberation substrate must exist and be exercised --
SD-046 multi-slot GoalState (>=2 live slots) plus the MECH-265 relative-importance arbitrator it
re-enters through -- neither built in ree-v3 today (verified: GoalState is a v3 singleton,
ree-v3/ree_core/goal.py; no SD-046 or MECH-265 code exists anywhere in ree_core). Additionally,
per this claim's own 2026-08-08 reconciliation note, Q-053 sub-question (c)'s residual tension
must be resolved before any result here is interpretable as a test of PARKED-SLOT resumption
specifically: the persistence/urgency signal that re-elevates a parked slot's ranking on capacity
return must NOT reduce to a bare time-since-interruption accumulator, because that is structurally
the MECH-292 staleness signal Q-053 already rules out (Jasinska 2014 incubation sign-inversion). A
MECH-389 implementation that uses an unconditional/unbounded urgency accumulator would confound
any CONFIRMING result with that already-ruled-out mechanism rather than demonstrating parked-slot
persistence.

CONFIRMING: on capacity return, a PARKED slot (z_goal + progress context retained at interruption)
reorients-and-resumes at measurably lower cost (fewer replanning steps to re-approach, or faster
time-to-recontact) than a RESTART-FROM-SCRATCH control that discarded the slot at interruption,
across a majority of seeds -- AND the arbitrator's re-elevation of the parked slot is driven by the
persistence/urgency signal specifically, separable from bank staleness (Q-053(c)'s licit-signal
test, reused here rather than re-derived).

FALSIFYING: reorient-and-resume shows no advantage over restart-from-scratch at capacity return
(the parked representation carries no behaviourally load-bearing content and MECH-389 is
unnecessary machinery over MECH-292/293's existing bank), OR the urgency signal reproduces the
ruled-out staleness/incubation-sign-inversion pathology.

NOTES: this claim's own text already disposes of the ARC-079/MECH-340/Q-053 apparent contradiction
(three-axis reconciliation: substrate/plane, trigger axis, lifecycle stage) and folds the residual
tension into Q-053(c) rather than minting a new Q-claim -- do not re-litigate that reconciliation
when this wwa is applied; treat Q-053(c)'s resolution as an upstream precondition only.

MECH-390.subject: affect.developmental_sparsification_of_affect_vector

FALSIFYING: mature affect-driven selection remains dominated by a single strongest channel
throughout the curriculum (no convergent-weak-channel handoff occurs) even though MECH-362's

MECH-391.subject: memory.allocation.gate_policy
MECH-391.title: Contextual memory-allocation gate policy: a control-plane decision stage (context_similarity x temporal_distance interaction, schema_fit, salience, PE, uncertainty, goal_relevance) selecting integrate / partial_overlap / separate over the hippocampal graph.
MECH-391.what_would_answer:

temporal_distance measured as an INTERACTION term (not additive, per the claim's own Verdict G3)
and schema_fit, salience, PE, uncertainty and goal_relevance each independently varying across
trials. None of this exists in V3 (verified 2026-09-25: no hippocampal-graph allocation control
plane in ree_core; SD-016, the nearest built neighbour, performs stored->active retrieval for
E2/E3, not an allocation decision over a hippocampal graph).

CONFIRMING: Once the allocation-gate control plane exists, decisions track the registered
interaction term -- e.g. high context_similarity with SHORT temporal_distance drives integrate,
high context_similarity with LONG temporal_distance drives separate/partial_overlap (the
interaction, not either factor alone, predicts the outcome) -- and the decision is measurably
distinct from MECH-261's mode-gate output (which only answers "can this substrate write in this
mode", not "how should this specific episode be allocated"; see overlap note below).
Manipulation: cross context_similarity x temporal_distance independently while holding the other
five inputs fixed, then vary each of those five independently with the interaction term fixed.
Control: an additive-only gate policy (sum of terms, no interaction) as the comparison arm, to
test Verdict G3's interaction claim specifically. DV: allocation outcome as a function of the
interaction term vs the additive control.

FALSIFYING: With the substrate live, an additive combination of the same inputs predicts
allocation outcome as well as the interaction term (Verdict G3 earns no keep), or allocation
outcome is indistinguishable from MECH-261's mode-gate output (the claim would then have no novel

UNBLOCKS WHEN: the V4 memory-lifecycle hippocampal-graph store is built (currently absent --
evidence/planning/memory_lifecycle_v4_plan.md is a design doc, not a built substrate). Per the

reconfirmed 2026-09-25): MECH-261 (stable, v3) gates WHICH SUBSTRATES CAN WRITE per operating
mode (channel-grain); this claim decides HOW a specific episode is allocated within the

MECH-392.subject: memory.consolidation.provenance_required
MECH-392.title: Consolidation provenance + contradiction-flag + rollback: every consolidated summary carries transformation_history + contradiction_flags; a summary conflicting with its source is flagged not silently authoritative; retired schemas leave source episodes intact.
MECH-392.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a V4 memory-lifecycle store implementing the planned 6-state model (retained/indexed/summarised/consolidated/contested/ retired -- memory_lifecycle_v4_plan.md MEM-5) must exist and must be the thing consolidation transforms actually write through -- i.e. every consolidation operator (MECH-068 selectivity, MECH-124 schema/abstraction, MECH-273 sleep-half aggregation) must populate a transformation_history field on its output as a normal part of running, not as instrumentation bolted on for a single probe. As of 2026-08-08 the store does not exist in V3; the operators this claim generalises over are individually more V3-mature than at this claim's 2026-06-10 registration (MECH-068 candidate w/ V3-EXQ-835 support, MECH-273 v3_pending cleared 2026-06-23), but none of them supplies the store itself. DO NOT build in V3. CONFIRMING: once the store exists, (1) every consolidated summary carries a populated transformation_history (source episode pointers + transforms applied); (2) a summary that conflicts with its source episodes is marked with a contradiction_flag and treated as flagged/degraded downstream, not silently authoritative; (3) retiring a schema leaves the source episodes it was built from unmutated and independently retrievable (per INV-080). FALSIFYING: (1) the store is built but transformation_history is absent, unpopulated, or not actually consulted by anything downstream (a decorative field); (2) a summary that measurably conflicts with its source is nonetheless treated as equally authoritative in action selection or retrieval as an unflagged one; (3) retiring a schema deletes, mutates, or makes unreachable the source episodes it summarised, violating INV-080. A test of the consolidation operators run WITHOUT the 6-state store in place counts as neither confirming nor falsifying (non-degeneracy precondition unmet).

MECH-393.subject: memory.retrieval.scope_vs_authority
MECH-393.title: Retrieval-scope vs action-authority split: retrieval for reflection is distinct from retrieval that confers action authority; a consolidated abstraction lacking source-episode grounding may inform reflection but not unilaterally drive committed action.

CONFIRMING: once the V4 store exists with a genuine authority field, a trace whose
authority field is unset (a consolidated abstraction lacking source-episode grounding)

authority-field state -- i.e. anything active in the navigable state (ARC-035's gate) is
equally able to drive commitment -- and the authority axis this claim proposes collapses
into ARC-035's stored-vs-active distinction rather than being a separable gate. A failure
under the unmet precondition above (no V4 store) is not evidence against the claim.

CROSS-REFERENCE (already done, not re-derived here): this claim's distinct_from links to
MECH-257 (gates READ-MODE) and ARC-035 (gates stored-vs-active) were already made
bidirectional by the 2026-07-14 MEM-6 plan reconcile (see MECH-257's and ARC-035's own

MECH-394.subject: drive.multidrive_arbitration
MECH-394.title: Multidrive arbitration policy: when several drive axes are simultaneously active, behaviour is selected by a soft-competitive orchestration over context, per-axis satiation, inter-drive competition, and developmental phase -- not a fixed priority or single-axis winner.

winner absent competition from the others.

selection accuracy / behavioural coherence at matched conditions, OR the MECH-435 currency term
alone (context/satiation/dev-phase terms all ablated) suffices to reproduce it -- either result
means "soft-competitive orchestration, not fixed priority or single-axis winner" is not doing
independent work. A failure under an unmet precondition above is not evidence against the claim.

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SD-060 (multidrive register) is unbuilt -- confirmed via
`grep -rniE "multidrive|non_terminal_drive|drive_register|drive_axis"` under ree-v3/ree_core/,

MECH-395.subject: drive.pre_approach_orienting_mode
MECH-395.title: Pre-approach orienting/surveying mode: a cue-triggered, need-gated active-sensing control state entered when a cue/need is present but directional/affordance confidence is too low for reliable approach; it samples gradients (turn/scan, exploratory arcs) until a directional vector stabilises, then exits to approach.
MECH-395.what_would_answer:
Falsifiable (co-authored from the owning plan doc's own instrumentation, orienting_epistemic_deficit_v3_plan.md's ORNT-1 node -- this claim's own text carries no functional_restatement or falsifier clause to extract): once a cue reliably reaches action selection (i.e. the shared E3 selection-authority / cue-authority ceiling this claim currently sits behind is cleared -- see precondition below), resume the snail-race diagnostic: measure orient_mode_entries_after_cue, survey_steps, heading_entropy, and gradient_information_gain in a paradigm where a cue/need is present but directional/affordance confidence is deliberately kept low (e.g. an ambiguous or multi-candidate resource layout). FALSIFYING: (a) no distinct orienting-mode entry is detectable above the cue-independent background rate (the mechanism does not exist as a separate control state -- MECH-111/curiosity or bare cue-response fully explains the behaviour), or (b) an orienting-mode entry occurs but gradient_information_gain does not decline over the mode's duration (agent is not actually using the surveying period to resolve a vector).
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (must be met before this is a real test): candidate_proximity_evaluable must be measurably above zero -- V3-EXQ-812 (2026-07-24) FAILED on exactly this precondition (measured 0.0), the same candidate-pool-collapse confound documented for the GAP-A cluster. MECH-398.subject: learning.ach_analog_plasticity_gain_gate
MECH-398.title: ACh-analog basal-forebrain plasticity-gain gate: a state-conditional scalar in [0,1] multiplying cortical encoder learning rates and residue write magnitudes, driven by novelty/attention/arousal, distinct from LC-NE/5-HT/orexin content signals.
MECH-398.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: two conditions, and NEITHER is currently met.
 (1) A V4 plasticity-gain substrate must exist. VERIFIED 2026-08-28: no
 state-conditional plasticity-gain scalar exists anywhere in ree-v3/ree_core. The
 only plasticity_gain-named knobs are loop_segregation_ascending_plasticity_gain
 and loop_segregation_parity_plasticity_gain (config.py:1335, 1365) -- FIXED
 config constants in the E3 selector's loop-segregation spiral-maturation path,
 unrelated to a novelty/attention/arousal-driven gate. The gate's own plan
 (plasticity_neuromodulation_v4_plan.md) has PLW-3/PLW-4 blocked and the PLW-1
 decision-to-build gate un-cleared. DO NOT BUILD IN V3 -- the claim carries
 implementation_phase: v4, version_relevance: v4_v5, and this instruction
 explicitly in its own notes.
 (2) The content-signal-only control arm must be genuinely exercisable, not a
 strawman. The comparison rests on gain-channel vs content-signal-only, so
 MECH-313 / MECH-104 / MECH-203 / SD-037 must be live and wired. As of 2026-08-08:
 MECH-104 active/PASS; MECH-313 a CONTESTED candidate (demoted 2026-07-09,
 sub-threshold N=1 signal only); MECH-203 has NEVER had a valid behavioural test
 (3 consecutive invalid runs, most recently V3-EXQ-843); SD-037 is
 substrate_ceiling (wired, but consumer thresholds uncleared and the downstream
 effect inert). A fair control arm must either accept these as the honest
 content-only baseline AS INSTANTIATED and say so, or wait for them to clear their
 own ceilings -- running against an inert content-only arm manufactures a
 difference that is the control's defect, not the gate's contribution. Its DRIVERS
 all live in V3 today (MECH-205 surprise EMA, SD-032a salience mode, drive_level);
 DRIVER AVAILABILITY IS NOT SUBSTRATE READINESS and must not be mistaken for it.
CONFIRMING (REE leg, once built): a state-conditional gain scalar in [0,1] driven
by novelty/attention/arousal, multiplying cortical encoder learning rates and
residue write magnitudes, produces a DISCRIMINABLE improvement in
TARGETED-PLASTICITY SELECTIVITY -- it changes WHICH inputs are incorporated into
durable representation -- over the V3-conservative form (a scheduler-driven
open/closed flag toggle) and over an ungated uniform rate, on a task where the
toggle is demonstrably insufficient. Consistent with Bear & Singer 1986's
conjunctive ACh x NE gating result. The improvement must be in SELECTIVITY (and
the acquisition-vs-retention tradeoff), not merely in aggregate learning speed --
a faster uniform rate is not this claim.
FALSIFYING (REE leg): the gate is OTIOSE -- matched targeted-plasticity-selectivity
outcomes ARE achievable by gating on content signals alone, or by a
scheduler-driven flag toggle, with no separate plasticity-gain channel. Gating the
learning rate by state does not change WHICH inputs are incorporated versus an
ungated/uniform rate. This falsifies the separate-channel commitment and would
route MECH-398 to demotion, or to reframing as redundant with the MECH-313 /
ARC-075 content-signal machinery it currently depends on but is kept distinct from.
OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG -- biological, tested outside REE, stated plainly and NOT
silently dropped. The grounding is neurophysiological and already settled in its
own domain independently of anything REE does: Kilgard & Merzenich 1998 (nucleus
basalis activity NECESSARY for adult cortical remapping); Froemke 2007 (transient
cholinergic disinhibition window gates receptive-field plasticity); Bear & Singer
1986 (paired ACh + NE gates whether cortex incorporates inputs into long-term
representations). Indexer state: 3 literature entries, lit_conf 0.826,
plausible_unproven, 0 experimental entries. A REE run can neither confirm nor
refute this leg, and a PASS on the REE leg is not evidence for it. What the REE leg
genuinely inherits is only the ARCHITECTURAL COMMITMENT that a plasticity-GAIN
channel is distinct from the LC-NE / 5-HT / orexin CONTENT channels (MECH-313) --
the REE-side proposition, and the only one this claim's falsifier can decide.
CROSS-REFERENCES: this is the OPENING-side analog of MECH-333's open phase, made
state-conditional rather than scheduler-driven; MECH-333's own what_would_answer
carries the pre-window F-attenuation precondition and the D1/D2 valid-negative-
control requirement, and MECH-398's control arm should reuse that design. ARC-093
is the state-conditional-gain commitment this realises and carries the same
two-condition precondition. MECH-205 is a DRIVER here, not a dependency to be
tested.

never been exercised). DO NOT build in V3. Reuse MECH-398's own two-condition non-degeneracy
precondition in full once MECH-398 exists; do not re-derive it here.

CONFIRMING (once MECH-398 exists): a continuous time-since-onset accumulator that monotonically
lowers the plasticity-gain CEILING produces a measurable improvement on the retention-vs-plasticity
tradeoff over the existing binary MECH-334 phase transition (on_phase3_entry crystallize) -- i.e.
there exists a regime where graded closure outperforms the flag flip, consistent with Hensch 2005's
finding that biological closure is a continuous, area-specific inhibitory-maturation process, not a
binary switch.

FALSIFYING: the continuous accumulator yields no measurable benefit over the binary MECH-334
transition on that tradeoff in any regime tested -- the continuous clock is redundant and MECH-399
is falsified (this is the claim's own pre-registered 2026-06-17 falsifier, carried forward

CROSS-REFERENCE: this is the plan's PLW-5 pillar, built on PLW-3 (MECH-398); MECH-398's own

this).

OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: Hensch 2005 (PV-interneuron maturation sets critical-period timing) and Deidda

REE analog outperforms the current binary flag, not on the biological grounding itself.

MECH-400.subject: learning.bdnf_analog_window_duration_knob

must exist and be validated first -- neither does (see MECH-399's own currency finding above,
carried forward: MECH-398 gated on PLW-1 decision gate + MECH-333 core, both unbuilt; MECH-399
gated on MECH-398). This claim is explicitly the LOWEST-priority pillar in the source design

CONFIRMING (once MECH-398 and MECH-399 both exist and are validated): varying a window-duration
multiplier on top of the existing gain gate and closure clock produces a change in the
acquisition-vs-retention outcome that is NOT already captured by the gain and closure knobs alone
-- i.e. duration is an independent control dimension, consistent with Huang 1999 (BDNF precociously
opens AND closes the critical period) and with Sale 2007's reopening result (enrichment lowers
GABA / raises BDNF / reduces PNNs and reopens an adult window).

FALSIFYING: varying the duration multiplier produces no change beyond what the gain and closure
knobs already produce on their own -- the duration knob adds no independent control and MECH-400
is falsified (this is the claim's own pre-registered 2026-06-17 falsifier, carried forward
verbatim; still current).

CROSS-REFERENCE: do not test this before MECH-399 (PLW-5) and MECH-398 (PLW-3) have themselves

three pillars together.

MECH-404.subject: social.mirror_coupling_gain_homeostasis
MECH-404.title: Mirror-coupling gain must be homeostatically regulated inside an operating window; the three social pathologies are its boundaries (low gain = psychopathy/callousness, high gain = empathic overwhelm/paralysis, miscalibrated = burnout/moral injury).
MECH-404.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (a) the G008 SHARED SOCIAL-COUPLING PANEL substrate (>= 2 agents; none exists);
(b) a single scalar coupling gain (ARC-010 signed coupling / MECH-031 lambda_empathy) that can be swept
and demonstrably changes the weight of B's inferred gradients in A's E3 ranking (a sweep that does not move
the weight is vacuous); (c) other-terrain inference above chance (MECH-164 precondition (b)); (d) WELFARE
GATE: the high-gain and burnout cells are distress-like regimes -- MIRROR-5 is welfare_relevance:
hard_review under SENT-2 / SENT-9 / SENT-13 with forbidden combination
suffering_like_accumulator_without_boundedness; the sweep may not enter them without that review and a
boundedness guarantee.

CONFIRMING (two legs, both required):
 LEG 1 -- WINDOW: sweeping the gain alone, holding everything else fixed, reaches (i) a LOW-gain regime
 where A-caused B-harm rises toward the A1 (weight-0) level while A's own performance is intact
 (callousness), and (ii) a HIGH-gain regime where A's own viability, commitment rate or decision latency
 degrades (overwhelm / paralysis) while B-outcomes do not improve further, with an interior window where
 B-support is high and A's own floor holds. The window should be compatible with DEV-NEED-022's
 provisional band (empathy_coupling_gain in [0.05, 0.65], GovernanceOnly) or explicitly revise it.
 LEG 2 -- HOMEOSTASIS: under a perturbation that pushes effective gain out of the window (sustained
 high-distress B, or a load step), a REGULATED gain returns into the window and preserves both DVs, while
 an identical agent with the gain frozen at the same starting value does not. The third ("miscalibrated
 = burnout / moral injury") regime must appear as a DYNAMIC failure of this leg (e.g. sustained high load
 -> gain overshoot then collapse below the low edge), since a single static scalar has only two edges.

FALSIFYING: the pathologies are NOT reachable on the one gain axis (e.g. overwhelm requires a second
parameter such as veto threshold or precision, so the window is not one-dimensional); OR no interior
window exists (B-support rises monotonically with gain with no A-side cost -- then MECH-164's full
symmetry stands and there is nothing to regulate); OR a frozen gain inside the window performs as well as
the regulated one under perturbation (Leg 2 fails: a window exists but homeostasis is not needed).

NOTES: ARC-010 owns the coupling primitive; this claim adds only the window + regulator. DV set is the
panel's, never pooled into one "empathy score".

MECH-408.subject: social.other_bound_stream_developmental_order
MECH-408.title: Developmental ordering of other-bound streams: other-bound suffering/threat (protective) come online BEFORE other-bound liking/wanting (appetitive), because early positive other-reward is destabilising and exploitable -- a safety-relevant maturational ordering on the ARC-059 social spine.
MECH-408.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Requires (i) MECH-405's stream-binding mechanism live for AT LEAST TWO
other-bound streams (suffering/threat AND liking/wanting) so an ordering is manipulable at all --
EMP-3 status: blocked; (ii) self_model_v4:SELF-7's maturational-sequence-honesty gate satisfied (not INV-064's own
content, see GFLAG-0550) (the self-stage
must genuinely precede the social stage, not merely be labelled so); (iii) a maturational training
regime in which per-stream onset timing is independently controllable. None of these exist in
ree_core today (same substrate gap as MECH-405, verified 2026-09-25).

CONFIRMING: in a curriculum where onset timing of other-bound suffering/threat versus other-bound
liking/wanting is independently controllable, an agent whose protective stream binds BEFORE its
appetitive stream shows measurably lower exploitability (rate of being led into self-damaging
cooperation by a scripted exploiting partner) than an agent with the reverse order or simultaneous
onset, at matched final competence on both streams.

FALSIFYING: exploitability is statistically indistinguishable across onset orderings
(protective-first, appetitive-first, simultaneous) once both streams reach matched final competence
-- the safety-relevant ordering would then not be load-bearing, and the developmental sequencing
could be arbitrary rather than safety-motivated. A failure while the substrate is absent (streams not
yet bindable at all) is not evidence against the claim.

UNBLOCKS WHEN: MECH-405's binding mechanism is live for >=2 streams (EMP-3) AND a maturational
curriculum with independently-controllable per-stream onset exists. DO NOT queue a V3 experiment.

NOTES: distinguish from MECH-410 (G008 batch, sibling session): MECH-410 schedules the MAGNITUDE of
an already-bound coupling over development; this claim orders WHICH streams bind FIRST -- different
axis, not a merge candidate (G008's own draft independently reaches the same disambiguation).
Distinguish from MECH-505's TIMESCALE axis: this claim orders stream ONSET across development;
MECH-505 distinguishes brief-vs-sustained transfer WITHIN a single interaction (MECH-505's own
notes state this explicitly) -- do not conflate the two.

MECH-410.subject: love.self_like_weight_calibration
MECH-410.title: Self-like gradient weighting (MECH-164) requires a developmental calibration schedule: other-terrain coupling must tighten over development scaled by inferred-terrain confidence, between the failure poles of empathic collapse (too-strong, too-early) and callousness (too-weak), and never weight a badly-inferred terrain self-like.
MECH-410.what_would_answer:
READING RATIFIED 2026-09-25 (governance-20260925, GFLAG-0520): "inferred-terrain confidence" means precision of the
inferred CONTENT of B's terrain (what B wants / fears), NOT confidence that B is a mind at all. The latter
is EXT-009's care criterion, which must stay liberal (MECH-032). Under the other reading this claim would
implement the dehumanization channel EXT-009 red-teams.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (a) MECH-164's base effect established on the G008 SHARED SOCIAL-COUPLING
PANEL (A2 > A1 on both B-goal support and B-harm avoidance) -- without it there is no weight to schedule;
(b) MECH-404's window located (both failure edges reachable), so "too-strong" and "too-weak" are measured
edges, not labels; (c) a per-target content-confidence signal that varies across targets / over training
above a permutation null; (d) the confidence-scaling leg is already in MECH-031's what_would_answer
("empathy coupling ... should correctly scale with OTHER_SELFLIKE probability") -- reuse it, do not
re-derive. This claim's RESIDUAL is the developmental SCHEDULE.

CONFIRMING: at matched total training and matched FINAL gain, a schedule that starts low and tightens as
content-confidence rises (arm A3) ends with (i) fewer overwhelm/collapse episodes during development and
(ii) B-support and B-harm avoidance at least as high as a fixed-gain agent run at the final gain from step
0, AND at least as high as a fixed-low-gain agent at end of training (no residual callousness). Mis-inferred
terrain (content-confidence low) receives less CONTENT-specific weight, but A's protective weight toward
that B stays above the A1 (weight-0) level -- a floor.

FALSIFYING: (1) the fixed-final-gain agent matches the scheduled one on every DV (no schedule needed --
MECH-404 regulation or MECH-164 alone suffices); OR (2) the schedule's benefit is fully explained by
confidence scaling alone with no time-dependence (the residual collapses into MECH-031); OR (3) the
confidence-scaled weighting drives protective weight toward a low-confidence but genuinely minded B to the
A1 level -- that is EXT-009's failure mode, and the claim as worded is then unsafe, not merely false.

NOTES: DEV-NEED-022 (developmental_needs_register.md) is the developmental-side statement of the same
gap; its open question "how should coupling tighten over development after the high-recall
OTHER_SELFLIKE bias?" is this claim's question. Sibling MECH-408 (developmental ordering of other-bound
streams) is a different axis (which streams come online first), not this schedule.

v4, v3_pending: false (relabeled 2026-09-01, GFLAG-0105) and explicitly BYPASSED in V3

related string anywhere in ree-v3/ree_core/ (confirmed by grep) -- there is no V6

outcome triples an inspection of the raw CandidateRule field would give, INCLUDING

MECH-419.subject: reasoning.compositional_generalisation_over_named_symbols
MECH-419.title: Compositional generalisation over named symbols: the agent systematically recombines grounded, named primitives (object/action/property/relation symbols) into novel combinations never directly experienced, via the symbol/grammar layer rather than the substrate. Compositionality is mined from grounded substrate, not imported as transformer attention.
MECH-419.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: both tiers this claim forks from must exist. Tier 1 (substrate): SD-040
(type-encoder, the named primitives recombined) plus MECH-299/MECH-300 (the substrate the primitives
ground over). Tier 2 (symbol layer): ARC-009's symbolic mediation machinery (a real symbol/grammar
layer, not the LANGUAGE_EXPLICITATION enum label with no implementation behind it -- confirmed absent
2026-08-07, re-confirmed here). Neither exists in ree_core/ today (grep 2026-09-25). Per INV-003 (the
anti-bolt-on invariant this claim's recombination operator must satisfy), checking for "no bolt-on
LLM call" in a substrate with NO language mechanism at all is vacuous -- it trivially looks compliant
while equally failing to exhibit the positive capacity. So a V3/early-V4 run here would be
uninterpretable in either direction, not merely weak evidence.

CONFIRMING: once both tiers exist, an agent systematically produces and correctly interprets NOVEL
combinations of grounded named primitives (object/action/property/relation symbols) it was never
directly trained on, at above-chance compositional-generalisation accuracy on a held-out combination
set, via the symbol/grammar layer (not by memorising each combination, and not via an imported
attention-based compositionality mechanism -- per the ARC-100 anti-import discipline this claim cites).

FALSIFYING: with both tiers live and exercised, the agent's performance on novel combinations
collapses to near-chance (or to whatever a frequency/co-occurrence baseline over TRAINED combinations
predicts), showing the symbol layer memorises rather than recombines -- or the only combinations that
generalise are ones directly reducible to substrate-level (MECH-300) traversal with no symbolic
recombination step, which would instead support ARC-102's falsifying direction above.

BLOCKING ARTEFACTS (named): SD-040 (type-encoder, unbuilt) AND ARC-009's symbol/grammar layer (gated
on ARC-047 SocialGridWorld, unbuilt/v5, plus a real MECH-014 channel, currently sketch-only). See
ARC-102's what_would_answer above for the shared Tier-2 detail; not re-derived here.

MECH-420.title: Relational/propositional inference over named relations: transitive inference, role-binding (giver vs receiver), and proposition chaining are realised as theta-sequence traversal (MECH-300) of a SYMBOLIC/type-graph cognitive map whose nodes are named symbols. The V6 realisation of MECH-300's cognitive-map-traversal primitive over a named symbolic map.
MECH-420.what_would_answer:
Shares G030's Tier-1/Tier-2 framing (ARC-102/MECH-299/MECH-419/MECH-421/SD-042 digestion, same plan
doc) -- reused, not re-derived; only the MECH-420-specific detail is drafted here.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) Tier 1 -- a NAMED symbolic/type-graph cognitive map for MECH-300's
theta-sequence traversal to walk (per MECH-300's own text: "with types (SD-040/MECH-296), theta
traverses type-graphs"). SD-040 (type-encoder) confirmed absent from ree_core/ (2026-09-25 grep, same
result as G030). (2) Tier 2 -- ARC-009's symbolic mediation/naming layer, confirmed absent (no
language/symbol/communication machinery in ree_core/, 2026-09-25). ARC-063 (the context->action-
object->outcome rule shape relations chain over, per MECH-420's own notes) is the ONE dependency that
IS satisfied: ree_core/policy/candidate_rule_field.py is built and live, evidenced by
failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-654g (non_contributory/substrate_ceiling on its own persistence tuning, not on
absence) -- so the rule-shape grounding is ready; only the map-traversal-over-named-symbols side is
missing.

CONFIRMING: once both tiers land, theta-cycle content during a transitive-inference or role-binding
task (e.g. A gives to B, B gives to C -> who ultimately holds it) traverses NAMED type-graph nodes
(per MECH-300) built from ARC-063 CandidateRule structures, and correctly resolves multi-step

memorisation of trained chains.

FALSIFYING: with both tiers live and exercised, performance on held-out relational chains does not

BLOCKING ARTEFACTS (named): SD-040 (type-encoder, unbuilt) AND ARC-009's symbol/grammar layer (gated
on ARC-047 SocialGridWorld [unbuilt, v5, confidence 0.0] + a real MECH-014 channel [sketch only]) --
identical Tier-2 gate to ARC-102/MECH-419/MECH-421, not re-derived (see G030's ARC-102
what_would_answer). ARC-063 is NOT a blocking artefact -- it is already built; cited here only as the
grounding rule-shape MECH-420 chains relations over.

MECH-421.subject: reasoning.analogy_structure_mapping_across_domains

The capstone symbolic capacity; first tested as emergent from the compositional + relational stack before any dedicated analogy module is built.

See Q-074's what_would_answer for the full build-vs-emerge TEST DESIGN (source-target pairs over

operator vs emergent from MECH-300 traversal); MECH-421 is the mechanism assertion that grounded

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (shared with Q-074): the shared symbolic/relational cognitive map must
exist and be non-degenerate -- MECH-300 (cognitive-map traversal, V4, unbuilt) traversable at a
conceptual/type-graph level, reachable through ARC-009's symbolic layer (V6, unbuilt: no multi-agent
substrate per ARC-047, no real symbol channel per MECH-014, confirmed absent 2026-09-25). Until the
map exists there is nothing to traverse and no entry points to test "same map, different entry
points" against.

CONFIRMING: once the stack exists (regardless of which Q-074 horn wins), the agent correctly transfers
relational structure across surface-dissimilar grounded domains (e.g. spatial containment -> social
inclusion) at a rate distinguishable from surface-feature/object-similarity mapping, on held-out
domain pairs never explicitly trained. Literature evidence already logged (claim_evidence.v1.json)

surface-feature/object-similarity-mapping baseline on held-out domain pairs -- i.e. no genuine

The already-logged Lewis 2025 LLM-fragility evidence (weakens, current artificial-system analogy

BLOCKING ARTEFACTS (named): MECH-300 (V4 cognitive-map traversal, unbuilt) AND ARC-009's symbol layer
(gated on ARC-047 SocialGridWorld + MECH-014, both unbuilt) -- same Tier-2 gap as ARC-102/MECH-419,
not re-derived. The build-vs-emerge design decision itself is Q-074's, not this claim's.

MECH-422.subject: language.event_arc_grammatical_realisation
MECH-422.title: Event-arc grammatical realisation: grammatical tense/aspect/connectives (because, but, unless, done, again, stop, resume) are the symbolic rendering of the pre-linguistic ActionEventArc (initiate/persist/interrupt/reorient/resume/close). 'unless' = ARC-063 exception gate; 'because' = causal link; 'again/done' = aspect over closure. The action arc must EXIST (V3..V5) before grammar can name it.
MECH-422.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: shares MECH-417's ActionEventArc precondition verbatim --
see MECH-417's what_would_answer; do not re-derive it here. Confirmed unmet by the same
grep (zero hits for ActionEventArc / EventArc anywhere in ree_core/).

Additional precondition specific to this claim: ARC-009's symbolic mediation layer
(the layer tense/connectives would render IN) is itself unbuilt -- Layer 1 (multi-agent
substrate, ARC-047, unbuilt v5) and Layer 2 (discrete symbol channel, confirmed absent
from ree_core/) per ARC-009's own what_would_answer. Note: MECH-422's connectives
(because, but, unless, done, again, stop, resume) do not obviously require the
MULTI-AGENT half of ARC-009 (they can in principle be single-agent self-narration over
the arc) -- flagging this as a possible OVER-STRICT precondition inheritance for
governance to weigh: MECH-422 may only need a discrete symbolic rendering channel
(ARC-009 Layer 2 alone), not the full two-agent Layer 1+2 test ARC-009's own wwa
describes. Recorded here rather than silently narrowed.

CONFIRMING (once ActionEventArc + a symbolic rendering channel exist): each connective
correctly discriminates its named arc operation from the others when tested against
matched arc-state pairs -- "unless" fires specifically at ARC-063 tolerance-gate
exception events (not general negation), "because" fires at causal-link edges in the
arc's history (not mere temporal sequence), "again"/"done" fire at closure events
specifically (matching MECH-417's aspect facet), each above a permutation-shuffled
connective-to-event-type baseline.

FALSIFYING: connectives are usable only as a fixed post-hoc template keyed on
superficial arc features (duration, reward sign) rather than the structured
distinctions claimed (exception-gate vs causal-link vs closure) -- connective choice
does not track the underlying arc-state distinctions above a shuffled-label control.

OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: none.
NOTES: possible_overlap_with MECH-417 is confirmed genuine (both name the same
ActionEventArc) but does NOT warrant a merge -- the two facets (aspect/closure vs
tense/connective) have distinct CONFIRMING/FALSIFYING content once the shared
precondition clears, and the claim authors already registered them as siblings, not
duplicates. See Group preamble.

MECH-423.subject: integration.cross_model_super_additivity
MECH-423.title: Cross-model super-additivity: integrating predictive models over a shared latent yields capability gains that EXCEED the sum of the isolated models, because shared features let each model's prediction-error corrections propagate to the others. Integrated (E1 world-model + E2 affordance-model [+ object spine]) beats a param/compute-matched bag of isolated modules -- the 'cross-pollination turbo-charges development' claim, made falsifiable.
MECH-423.what_would_answer: V3 ablation. ARM INTEGRATED: E1 world-model + E2 affordance-model (and, in a third arm, the object spine) trained over a SHARED L-space latent with cross-module gradient flow. ARM ISOLATED: parameter- and compute-matched modules trained with NO shared features (gradient stop between streams). PASS = joint world-model R2 + affordance accuracy of the integrated arm EXCEEDS the additive baseline (sum of each isolated module's marginal gain) by a pre-registered margin. FAIL = integrated arm at-or-below the additive baseline. READINESS PRECONDITION (the discriminating non-degeneracy gate, per Daniel 2026-06-12): the integration machinery must demonstrably be doing cross-module work before the test means anything -- (i) the shared latent must carry NON-ZERO cross-module gradient (measured), (ii) the inference loop must be running to convergence, and (iii) offline/consolidation transfer (DMN-analogue + sleep replay, MECH-121) must be active and moving traces across modules. Below any of these the integrated and isolated arms are indistinguishable by construction and the run self-routes substrate_not_ready (check_degeneracy non_degenerate=false), NOT a FAIL. The concrete readiness metric/threshold is to be set by a pending literature pull on which integration prerequisites are necessary for super-additive gain.

MECH-424.subject: language.prediction_as_corrective_instantiating_stream
MECH-424.title: Language prediction as a corrective / instantiating predictive stream: when language is modelled as an externalisation of internal cognition, predicting language inside the integrated substrate can INSTANTIATE cognitive structures not gained sensorimotorically, and can CORRECT or DEGRADE existing structures as a function of the language's quality. The bidirectional clause (good language repairs structure; bad language corrupts it) is the discriminating edge over language-as-scaffold.
MECH-424.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL -- requires a linguistic input channel REE-v3 does not have (the V6 language interface: ARC-009 realisation / MECH-373 / MECH-422). Once that channel exists: an agent with a language-prediction head trained over a corpus encoding CORRECT task structure acquires or repairs a behaviourally-measured cognitive structure that a matched no-language control does NOT (instantiate / correct leg = PASS); AND an agent trained over a corpus encoding WRONG structure has that structure DEGRADED relative to the no-language control (worsen leg = PASS). Both legs required: the bidirectional dependence on language quality is the discriminating prediction. UNMET PRECONDITION: no linguistic channel in V3, so the claim self-routes substrate_not_ready until the V6 language layer is built; the non-degeneracy gate additionally requires the measured structure to be live (non-floor) in the no-language control so 'correct' and 'worsen' are both reachable directions.

MECH-425.subject: memory.retrieval_time_accessibility_gating
MECH-425.title: Retrieval-time accessibility gating: which stored traces become reinstatable at a given moment is set by two composable READ-side policy layers, not by storage alone. Line A -- a global, slowly-fluctuating, arousal-coupled reinstatement GAIN (content-blind; sets the threshold on whether ANY stored trace crosses into accessibility; stochastic-resonance flavour). Line B -- a content-selective competitive SUPPRESSION that, given what the global gate admits, inhibits specific competitors to keep retrieval clean. The READ-side sibling of MECH-261's mode-conditioned WRITE-gate family: REE owns the gates but not this retrieval-time gating POLICY.
MECH-425.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL -- REE-v3 has no explicit retrieval-readiness gain knob and no content-selective retrieval-suppression operator over episodic / ContextMemory read-out (the gates exist for WRITE, MECH-261; the read-time POLICY does not). Once a retrieval substrate exposes (i) a global scalar gain on trace reinstatement and (ii) a competitor-suppression operator: DISSOCIATION test -- lesioning Line A (clamp gain low) reduces reinstatement of ALL traces uniformly (apparent forgetting, content-blind), while lesioning Line B (disable competitive suppression) leaves gain intact but RAISES competitor intrusions / wrong-trace reinstatement (interference, content-selective). PASS = the two lesions produce mechanistically distinct, doubly-dissociable read-out signatures (uniform-suppression vs selective-intrusion); FAIL = a single knob reproduces both, i.e. the two layers are not separable on this substrate. NON-DEGENERACY GATE: the reinstatement-accuracy metric must be live (non-floor, non-ceiling cross-trace variance) and at least two competing traces must be co-encoded and individually scorable in the no-lesion control, else neither 'uniform forgetting' nor 'selective intrusion' is reachable and the run self-routes substrate_not_ready (check_degeneracy non_degenerate=false), NOT a verdict.

MECH-426.subject: goal.progress_velocity_maintenance
MECH-426.title: progress_velocity_maintenance
MECH-426.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: TWO preconditions, not one. (a) The agent must forage measurably above random on this env family, so completion rate and commitment persistence have dynamic range to lose -- currently unmet. (b) The velocity signal must have non-zero cross-condition range (not magnitude-only), and the SPARSE OFF arm must retain less z_goal than the DENSE OFF arm, or the run self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue.
CONFIRMING: Ablating velocity degrades long-horizon maintenance specifically in the SPARSE arm, with the effect absent in DENSE, on a seed majority and above an effect-size floor. Manipulation: goal.use_progress_velocity_effort_modulation ON versus OFF -- ablating the velocity READOUT alone, with compute_goal_score() and goal_proximity() verified byte-identical across arms -- crossed with SPARSE (num_resources=2) versus DENSE (num_resources=8) confirmation density. Control: The DENSE arm is the informational control (velocity adds nothing where confirmations are frequent), giving an interaction rather than a main effect; plus the canonical OFF-path baseline in experiments/_lib/baselines/exq885_mech426_velocity_baseline.py. Required event: Long-horizon episodes in which terminal confirmations (resource consumptions clearing benefit_threshold) are sparse relative to the z_goal decay constant, so an unrefreshed attractor decays substantially between confirmations. DV: The velocity-by-density INTERACTION on long-horizon maintenance -- commit-run length, z_goal retention between confirmations and completion rate -- read in the Carver and Scheier effort-regulation direction (positive velocity lowers the effective commit threshold), never as same-goal reinforcement.
FALSIFYING: With foraging competence established, the velocity-by-density interaction is absent -- ablation costs the same in SPARSE and DENSE, or nothing anywhere -- so the velocity derivative adds no maintenance beyond the proximity signal itself. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/goal.py record_progress()/progress_velocity/progress_velocity_effort_modulation and the E3 effective_threshold multiplier in e3_selector.py; the 2x2 driver experiments/v3_exq_885_mech426_progress_velocity_maintenance.py is authored, smoke-tested and retained UNQUEUED behind a BLOCKED banner. Consumer / boundary: E3's effective commit threshold at selection time -- an effort/persistence modulator -- not goal VALUE, which the build deliberately leaves untouched. Existing ownership: EXP-0384, EXP-1045, V3-EXQ-866a, V3-EXQ-978, SD-093.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Substrate SD-093 is complete with 18 contracts and the driver is written; the block is behavioural. No agent on this env family forages above random, so the maintenance DV sits at its floor. Both release conditions failed: V3-EXQ-866a FAIL/non_contributory and V3-EXQ-978 FAIL on the 1.0 competence floor, leaving EXP-0384 and EXP-1045 blocked_substrate with no live owner. Secondary classes: R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's only non-degeneracy clause is about the velocity signal's own cross-condition RANGE, but the binding degeneracy found since is upstream of that: the 2026-08-03 /queue-experiment pass refused to queue the authored driver because no agent forages above random on this env family, and both named release conditions have now returned negative (V3-EXQ-866a FAIL/non_contributory 2026-08-03; V3-EXQ-978 FAIL, did not clear the 1.0 competence floor, 2026-09-03). A completion-rate DV read at the competence floor cannot degrade. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-427.subject: goal.cross_level_subgoal_credit
MECH-427.title: cross_level_subgoal_credit
MECH-427.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Three gates. (i) ATTAINMENT: subgoal events must fire at a non-zero rate FROM THE AGENT'S OWN POLICY, not a scripted walk, which needs subgoal_mode with SD-094 arrival-position checking and the waypoint proximity field observable. (ii) SEEDING: the child-level z_goal must actually seed (benefit_exposure above the seeding gate), else the credited representation is a zero vector. (iii) CONSUMPTION: a live reader of _z_goal_parent must exist, otherwise the parent attractor cannot change any behaviour and the restore arm is DV-invariant by construction.
CONFIRMING: With autonomous attainment, a seeded child goal and a live parent consumer, the ON arm sustains superordinate-goal-directed behaviour measurably longer or completes the superordinate goal more often than the matched no-attainment control on a strict majority of seeds, and the effect survives the credited-representation cross. Manipulation: GoalConfig.use_hierarchical_goal_credit OFF versus ON, with REEAgent.notify_subgoal_attainment routing the env transition_type into GoalState.credit_subgoal_attainment at the attainment tick; a second factor crosses the credited representation (env waypoint z_world versus the settled child-level z_goal). Control: A matched no-attainment arm on the same seed and episode budget in which the agent forages the same number of steps without reaching a waypoint, plus the flag-OFF bit-identical arm, so parent decay and step count are held while only the attainment event differs. Required event: Autonomous attainment of a waypoint or sequence_complete transition in CausalGridWorldV2 subgoal_mode while a superordinate goal is already seeded and decaying, so there is an existing parent commitment for the credit pulse to maintain. DV: Persistence of superordinate-goal-directed behaviour after attainment -- superordinate completion rate and time-to-abandonment of the parent goal, with parent_goal_norm and n_subgoal_credits reported as substrate telemetry rather than as the acceptance criterion.
FALSIFYING: With the same three gates met, attainment produces no parent-commitment persistence advantage over the matched no-attainment control -- credit propagates up the hierarchy in representation but does not maintain the superordinate goal, which is what the claim asserts. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The write path and its telemetry exist and are contract-tested (GoalState.credit_subgoal_attainment, parent_goal_norm, REEAgent.notify_subgoal_attainment, test_sd092_notify_subgoal_attainment.py). The missing instrument is any reader: no module outside goal.py consumes _z_goal_parent, so no behavioural DV can register the credit -- chip-20260902-zgoal-parent-e3-consumer names exactly this. Consumer / boundary: The E3 scoring boundary at which parent-goal commitment should bias committed action, which is where 'reinforcing maintenance of the parent goal' has to bite -- not the GoalState internal attractor whose norm is the write's own footprint. Existing ownership: SD-092, chip-20260902-zgoal-parent-e3-consumer, INV-086, waypoint-proximity-field-observable, V3-EXQ-1004, V3-EXQ-1030.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); _z_goal_parent has no consumer anywhere in ree_core, so any restore or ON arm is DV-invariant by construction at the behavioural boundary; and V3-EXQ-883, the only run, used a scripted walk with the child z_goal deliberately never seeded, so its PASS measures the credit call rather than goal maintenance. V3-EXQ-1030 additionally found the waypoint direction may not survive observation-to-z_world compression. Secondary classes: R1, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Two measured changes. (a) The norm leg was satisfied by V3-EXQ-883 under a SCRIPTED deterministic walk with benefit_exposure pinned at 0, so the parent attractor rose from exactly zero purely because credit_subgoal_attainment was called -- the lift is implied by the manipulation rather than measured. (b) A code check shows _z_goal_parent has no downstream reader anywhere in ree_core (only goal.py writes and decays it), which the confirmed V3-EXQ-1004 autopsy states independently, so the 'commitment / persistence' half of the DV has no behavioural boundary to be read at. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-428.subject: goal.subgoal_bootstrapped_seeding
MECH-428.title: subgoal_bootstrapped_goal_seeding
MECH-428.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Subgoals must be attained at a non-zero rate, a 626b-style forced-seed positive control must show a structured goal attractor in the same harness, AND the parent-level statistic must have an achievable range that separates from a null that re-runs parent construction (parent_goal_alpha / event rate swept as the independent variable, not held at defaults).
CONFIRMING: Under swept parent_goal_alpha / event rate, the correctly-nulled parent statistic separates from its own re-constructed null on a majority of seeds with non-zero attainment and a working forced-seed control, and a live consumer of the parent attractor yields goal-directed behaviour above the no-subgoal arm. Manipulation: Enable use_hierarchical_goal_credit so REEAgent.notify_subgoal_attainment routes attainment events into GoalState.credit_subgoal_attainment, against a no-subgoal arm and a forced-seed positive control; sweep parent_goal_alpha and inter-event rate as the independent variable. Control: NO-SUBGOAL arm (credit path off), a credited-partition-scored random-credit null (the CREDIT_RANDOM_TICKS control scored against its OWN credited partition, not the attainment partition), and the 626b forced-seed positive control. Required event: Repeated attained subgoal events (waypoint / sequence_complete transitions in causal_grid_world subgoal_mode) in a regime where direct superordinate seeding is sparse. DV: A parent-attractor statistic whose null re-runs parent construction (not a fixed-parent permutation), plus a downstream behavioural readout that some live consumer of the bootstrapped attractor produces -- goal-directed action rate that the no-subgoal control does not produce.
FALSIFYING: With attainment non-zero and the forced-seed control structured, no sweep point yields parent-statistic separation from a null that re-runs parent building, i.e. subgoal credit builds no content the parent did not already contain. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: credit_subgoal_attainment returns n_subgoal_credits / parent_goal_norm / credit_applied and parent_goal_norm()/z_goal_parent expose state (ree-v3/ree_core/goal.py); the 884c driver plus four probes measure cosine statistics. No instrument records a parent-attractor effect on behaviour, because nothing reads _z_goal_parent. Consumer / boundary: GoalState._z_goal_parent, the superordinate attractor. The claim asserts this bootstrapped attractor then drives goal-directed behaviour, which requires a consumer at E1/E2/E3 or the policy; there is none. Existing ownership: SD-092, GFLAG-0294, GFLAG-0227, EXP-0390, MECH-427.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Two blockers. Two of the three parent-statistic forms are degenerate at registered defaults (norm criterion analytically guaranteed; content statistic artifact-biased). The correctly-nulled form separates from its re-constructed null on 4/5 seeds at the default operating point once controls are K-averaged and time-local and the null is a circular time-shift (V3-EXQ-1093), so 884c's at-chance reading was mainly an instrument limitation. Separation is still ordered by the EMA effective sample size: the crossover is ESS ~15-24 and strongly seed-dependent, so the default (ESS ~24) is marginal. MECH-434.subject: inference.epistemic_commitment_timing
MECH-434.title: Epistemic commitment timing: the inference layer's decision of WHEN to stop gathering evidence and commit a trajectory is a governed control parameter (an urgency/threshold over the belief-state set), balancing pragmatic value (act now) against epistemic value (sample more). This axis is NOT reducible to the MECH-126 state-abstraction failure taxonomy; it lives at the seam between the belief-state hypothesis set (MECH-385) / epistemic action pressure (MECH-388) and the commitment gate (MECH-061 / MECH-090), and has an inverted-U optimum rather than a monotone.
MECH-434.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the commitment threshold must be reachable in BOTH directions within the measured range -- both the epistemic-freezing pole and the premature-commit pole producible by the available parameter sweep -- or the asserted inverted-U cannot be distinguished from a monotone.
CONFIRMING: performance as a function of the urgency/threshold parameter is non-monotone with an interior optimum; the two failure poles are behaviourally DISSOCIABLE (freezing: sampling without commitment; panic: commitment at measurably lower evidence); and the collapse of the epistemic term under threat is demonstrated rather than assumed.
FALSIFYING: performance is monotone in the parameter (no inverted-U); OR the two poles cannot be dissociated; OR the axis reduces to MECH-126's uncertainty-collapse failure mode, which this claim explicitly denies.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional.

MECH-436.subject: drive.wanting_drive_state_modulation

MECH-439.subject: selection.primary_score_variance_monopoly

MECH-440.subject: policy.state_conditioned_self_annealing_noise_floor
MECH-440.title: state_conditioned_self_annealing_noise_floor (NoisyNet learned-parametric-weight-noise analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-313's tonic exploration noise floor. MECH-313 is registered as a STATE-INDEPENDENT floor (a post-softmax max-entropy/temperature analog); V3-EXQ-687 found that floor NON-PROPAGATING -- the temperature was invisible to the argmax/committed action (selected_action_entropy=0.0, the r1a_entropy_only_artefact the degeneracy gate caught). MECH-440 asserts the LC-NE tonic floor must instead be injected as LEARNED PER-PARAMETER (factorised-Gaussian) WEIGHT NOISE in the E3 selection pathway, so it (i) PROPAGATES into the committed action (it changes which action is argmax, not just a discarded pre-commit temperature), (ii) is STATE-CONDITIONED by construction (weight noise x state-dependent activations perturbs different states differently, with no hand-set per-state schedule), and (iii) SELF-ANNEALS (a gradient-trained per-parameter sigma falls where the policy is confident and stays up where exploration pays, so the floor does not wash out committed-action diversity uniformly). External analog: NoisyNet (Fortunato et al. 2018).
MECH-440.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: P1 support_preserving_min_first_action_classes raised to action_dim (the ln(~3) class-entropy ceiling otherwise makes every committed-class-entropy null degenerate), P2 modulatory selection authority armed, noise injection WITNESSED (supra-floor bias range as a non-trivial fraction of the raw score range), and for legs (ii)/(iii) a decisiveness stratifier that is a real confidence criterion rather than a per-seed median split, plus a manipulation-engagement gate on sigma_scale.
CONFIRMING: Leg (i) committed-class entropy fraction strictly above the matched temperature control on a majority of seeds (met by 955), AND per-state noise magnitude covarying with state plus sigma annealing where confidence is high, on at least 4/6 seeds with the strata defined by a real decisiveness criterion. Manipulation: use_noisy_selection_head ON (factorised-Gaussian selection-head weight noise injected into _modulatory_accum before the committed within-eligible argmin) with noisy_selection_anneal ON versus OFF, against the matched-pre-commit-variance post-softmax temperature arm. Control: The TEMPERATURE arm sharing a private yoked RNG stream (the V3-EXQ-687 non-propagating control) plus the bit-identical self-yoke, which is what makes the injection SITE the axis under test. Required event: Fresh E3 select() calls on a warmed agent with candidate diversity and ceiling headroom present, across states that genuinely differ in decision decisiveness. DV: Committed (argmax) selected-action-class entropy as a fraction of ln(mean_distinct_first_action_classes) and yoked per-tick committed-action divergence for leg (i); for legs (ii)/(iii), per-state noise magnitude covariance with state and per-parameter sigma falling where the policy is confident, computed from stratum-level divergence rates and raw-score-range means.
FALSIFYING: Weight noise washes out at the argmax identically to the temperature floor once ceiling headroom is confirmed, or it raises pre-commit entropy without raising committed diversity, or committed diversity rises while the noise is measurably state-independent and non-annealing (supporting a plain stochastic floor and refuting only the state-conditioning refinement). A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/policy/noisy_selection_head.py plus the 955/959 drivers record sigma_scale_mean, yoked_divergence_frac and the committed-class entropy fraction; leg (ii)/(iii) inputs (median_rsr, n_decisive, n_near_tie, divergence_rate_decisive/near_tie) are COMPUTED at 959 L1284-1315 and written to no manifest. Consumer / boundary: The committed within-eligible argmin in E3 -- the injection site is the whole content of the claim, so a pre-commit entropy DV cannot distinguish it from MECH-313's post-softmax temperature. Existing ownership: V3-EXQ-959, GFLAG-0072, EXP-0114, ARC-065, behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-C.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); Leg (i) is settled. Legs (ii)/(iii) failed on an instrument, not on the mechanism: the driver computes the direct inputs to both load-bearing criteria and persists none of them, so which seeds passed is unrecoverable without 22 hours of recompute; the decisive/near-tie strata are a 50/50 median split with nothing asserting the upper half is genuinely confident; and there is no manipulation-engagement gate, so a 3.9 percent anneal counted as ON. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: INSTRUMENT EXISTS BUT WRONG LOCUS/TIMESCALE. Scope: v3_native. MECH-441.subject: curiosity.model_disagreement_directed_signal
MECH-441.title: model_disagreement_directed_curiosity (RND / Plan2Explore analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-314's structured_curiosity_bonus: a PER-CANDIDATE, SELF-ANNEALING intrinsic curiosity signal derived from E2 FORWARD-MODEL DISAGREEMENT (an ensemble / dropout-variance proxy over E2 forward predictions) -- high where the forward model is uncertain, collapsing toward zero as a region is learned -- fed into E3 selection so it PROPAGATES per-candidate to the committed action, unlike the broadcast-novelty EMA channel found non-propagating in V3-EXQ-590a / EXQ-141b. The self-annealing-on-learning-progress property is the non-degeneracy guard against a cross-candidate-flat (degenerate) bonus. External analog: RND (Burda et al. 2018) predictor-error novelty; Plan2Explore (Sekar et al. 2020) ensemble model-disagreement. Maps to MECH-314c learning-progress / MECH-314b uncertainty-driven curiosity.
MECH-441.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Three, none currently met in any run: (P1/P2) the armed-conversion precondition inherited from ARC-065 -- modulatory authority at the _modulatory_accum injection site plus a raised first-action-class floor, since support_preserving_min_first_action_classes is 2 at the shipped default and caps committed-class entropy arm-invariantly at ln(~3) (GFLAG-0072); (P3) the disagreement signal must be built (n_disagreement_heads >= 2; default 0), carry cross-candidate RANGE above an absolute floor, and be shown to FALL with repeated visitation.
CONFIRMING: With P1-P3 witnessed, the disagreement arm raises yoked divergence and fraction-of-ceiling committed-class entropy above the constant-bonus control on at least 2 of 3 seeds, the bonus is uncorrelated or anti-correlated with visitation density, and the divergence rate declines as disagreement anneals. Manipulation: Arm the MECH-441 ensemble (use_model_disagreement_curiosity True, model_disagreement_weight > 0, n_disagreement_heads >= 2) so per-candidate cross-head variance is injected into scores and _modulatory_accum before the within-eligible argmin. Control: A matched-magnitude CONSTANT-BONUS arm sharing a private RNG stream (the V3-EXQ-949 yoked design) -- not a noise control -- which has the same magnitude and no direction, plus the MECH-441-OFF arm. Required event: Committed action selection in regions the E2 forward model has and has not learned, with enough repeated visitation for annealing to be observable within the run. DV: Yoked per-tick committed-action divergence against the constant-bonus control, and committed_class_entropy reported as a FRACTION of ln(mean_distinct_first_action_classes) so the combinatorial ceiling is visible; plus per-candidate disagreement bonus regressed on visitation density (the anti-conflation covariate) and its decline over training.
FALSIFYING: Either the disagreement signal is cross-candidate flat; or it carries range but does not reach the committed action; or it moves the committed action without raising fraction-of-ceiling class entropy above the constant-bonus control; or the bonus is POSITIVELY correlated with visitation density, in which case MECH-441 has re-derived the MECH-458 exploitation amplifier under a new name. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/policy/model_disagreement.py (ModelDisagreementEnsemble, per-candidate cross-head variance) and the injection site at ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py ~3818 that adds the term to scores and _modulatory_accum. MECH-442.subject: selection.behavioral_descriptor_committed_selection_archive
MECH-442.title: Committed-action diversity survives the selection/commit step via a behavioral-descriptor eligible-set ARCHIVE (Quality-Diversity / MAP-Elites analog) -- NARROWED 2026-09-10 (GFLAG-0186, partial absorption ADOPTED; option A) to the two residuals that are genuinely unbuilt: (i) a behavioral descriptor OTHER than first-action class -- the e2.world_forward strategy signature or the realised committed-action class -- and (ii) niche partitioning placed at the ELIGIBLE-SET RESTRICTION stage of E3TrajectorySelector.select, composed with MECH-448 f_demotion, rather than at MECH-341's score-composition stage. The rest of the mechanism as originally registered is BUILT under other ids and is NOT re-claimed here: MECH-341::stratified_select is already a descriptor-indexed per-niche-elite archive with a coverage-aware commit rule for descriptor = first-action class; MECH-448 f_demotion is already an eligible-set restriction upstream of the argmax, with precedence over top_k; MECH-449 Go/No-Go is the validated partner (V3-EXQ-689g PASS). What the residual still predicts: on a descriptor the built route does not partition, a behaviorally-distinct action stays selectable at a moderate primary-score (F) gap, bounded by the per-niche-elite safety envelope, rather than collapsing to the single global optimum of F. The F-dominated committed argmax itself (MECH-439) is biologically faithful and is NOT changed -- only the eligible-set structure feeding it. Nothing is retired and no id is superseded by this narrowing.

upstream of the argmax with F removed from the within-eligible arbitration -- and it takes

(c) `MECH-449` Go/No-Go constitution is the validated partner (V3-EXQ-689g PASS).
The comparator in this claim's registered FALSIFIER ("BEYOND the descriptor-free top-k shortlist,
V3-EXQ-569i") is therefore superseded: the baseline arm must be the MECH-448 demotion +

residual is exactly two things: (i) a descriptor OTHER than first-action class -- specifically
