(composed with `f_demotion`), rather than at MECH-341's score-composition stage.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. See ARC-065's own `what_would_answer` ARMED-CONVERSION block
(P1 + P2 + the ARC-062 gated-policy leg) -- MECH-440 and MECH-441 already cross-reference that
text and this claim does the same; do not re-derive it. Two additions specific to this claim:
(3) The descriptor must be non-degenerate independently of the class ceiling. The realised

MECH-443.subject: policy.arbitration.priority_weighted_replay_write_selection
MECH-443.title: priority_weighted_replay_write_selection (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze + hippocampal prioritized-replay analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-319's simulation-mode rule-write gate. MECH-319 is a BINARY categorical gate: during a ghost/replay/DMN pass it either blocks arbitration-weight writes (normal) or admits them (the V3-EXQ-543c/628 falsifier flag) -- all-or-nothing, no ordering among the replayed transitions it admits. MECH-443 asserts that WHEN the replay write channel is open, the transitions admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should not be written uniformly but in GRADED priority order, weighted by an update-utility signal (a surprise / value-prediction-error / coverage proxy), so a high-utility replayed transition writes more strongly and a low-utility one writes weakly or not at all. The external analog is EfficientZero/MuZero prioritized experience replay (priority ~ value-prediction error); the biology is hippocampal SWR replay, which is demonstrably prioritized rather than uniform. CRITICAL REFINEMENT FROM BIOLOGY: the priority is the value of the UPDATE (Mattar & Daw gain x need), NOT raw reward magnitude or current action-value -- Carey et al. 2019 shows replay can be biased AWAY from the currently-most-valuable outcome. MECH-443 is the WHICH/HOW-STRONGLY complement to MECH-319's WHETHER gate; it does not change the binary gate, it grades the admitted writes.
MECH-443.what_would_answer: SUPPORTS if arming a per-transition update-utility (surprise / value-prediction-error / coverage) priority weight on the admitted replay writes lifts rule-arbitration retention/selectivity -- measured AT rule_state (upstream of the F-dominated E3 commit, in the GAP-K write-gating locus, NOT at committed action) -- STRICTLY above a matched-TOTAL-write-mass uniform-admit control (MECH-319 admit_writes=True with equal write mass) on >=2/3 seeds. FALSIFIES if priority-weighting is inert versus the matched-mass uniform admit, OR if any lift is explained solely by greater total write mass (the matched-mass guard isolates this degenerate confound), OR if priority is operationalized as reward magnitude / committed-policy value rather than value-of-the-update (Carey et al. 2019: hippocampal replay biases AWAY from the currently-preferred outcome, so a reward-keyed priority is biologically falsified). Pre-gate: the readout must be non-degenerate -- if admitted replay barely moves rule_state on the current substrate so the metric is pinned across seeds, the falsifier is vacuous and MECH-443 re-routes to a replay-write-magnitude substrate enrichment (NOT to MECH-439). Any COMMITTED/behavioural variant of this test is MECH-439-conversion-ceiling-gated (V3-EXQ-654g: the rule_state channel cannot move the argmax today and the 569i top-k bypass does not reach it) and is sequenced behind the 689a F-rebalance.

MECH-444.subject: policy.arbitration.staleness_gated_target_refresh_on_replay_write
MECH-444.title: staleness_gated_target_refresh_on_replay_write (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze analog). The second, more speculative leg of the CDQ-005 reanalyze import, complementary to MECH-443. Asserts that a replayed transition admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should NOT write its stored (ghost-derived, possibly stale) target verbatim; the target should first be RECOMPUTED against the current model/policy before it updates the rule layer, and the write should be down-weighted or skipped when the recomputed target has not drifted from the stored one (low staleness => low update value). This is the MuZero reanalyze trick (re-run the model on stored trajectories to produce fresh targets) plus EfficientZero off-policy/staleness correction. It guards against the failure MECH-319 was built to prevent (overcommitment to ghost-derived arbitration weights) from re-entering THROUGH the admitted-write channel that MECH-443 opens: prioritized writing of STALE targets would re-introduce drift, so the priority signal (MECH-443) and the freshness signal (MECH-444) must operate together.
MECH-444.what_would_answer: SUPPORTS if recomputing each admitted replay-write target against the CURRENT model before it updates the rule layer (and down-weighting / skipping low-drift writes) ATTENUATES rule-arbitration drift / overcommitment relative to writing the stored ghost-derived (stale) target -- on the MECH-319 admit_writes=True drift-inducing substrate (the V3-EXQ-628 block-vs-admit divergence), on >=2/3 seeds -- i.e. the 628 divergence shrinks under refreshed-target admit versus stale-target admit. FALSIFIES if the refresh does not attenuate drift versus stale-target writing (the staleness gate is inert), OR if it earns nothing independent of MECH-443's priority weighting (the pair is non-separable). MECH-446.subject: governance.closure_decommit_magnitude
MECH-446.title: De-commit-authority magnitude: the closure-coupled de-commit lowers post-closure latch occupancy with authority magnitude sufficient to overcome the natural-commit occupancy it competes against -- the committed-run-scaled refractory drives a within-arm around-closure occupancy drop (pre-closure vs post-closure window on the ON arm), scaling with committed-run length so a long committed run triggers a proportionally long de-commit. Child B of the SD-034 de-commit-pipeline decomposition (S4).
MECH-446.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: On the ON arm the SD-034 closure fire must co-locate with a sustained latch-armed beta occupancy on at least 2/3 seeds, and the coupling gate must be refractory-independent so the magnitude lever cannot zero its own certifier.
CONFIRMING: On a substrate where closure fires co-locate with sustained latch occupancy, the committed-run-scaled refractory drives a within-arm post-closure occupancy drop that scales with committed-run length, on at least 2/3 coupling-certified seeds. MECH-447.subject: selection.conflict_graded_near_tie_sufficiency
MECH-447.title: Conflict-graded near-tie lever sufficiency: a hyperdirect-STN-like conflict-graded shortlist / commit-temperature lever (k = f(top-F gap); T = f(top-F gap)) is SUFFICIENT to lift committed-action-class entropy strict-above both collapsed-proposer and gap-blind controls -- gap-CONCENTRATED (the lift correlates with per-tick top-F gap) -- WITHOUT reducing F's E3 variance share. MECH-448.subject: selection.rank_preserving_f_to_eligibility_demotion
MECH-448.title: Residual conversion ceiling requiring rank-preserving F->eligibility demotion: near-tie levers (conflict-graded shortlist / commit-T, MECH-447) CAP committed-action-class entropy BELOW the proposer ceiling because they act only at near-ties while F still decides every non-tie; only REMOVING F from the final committed argmin -- demoting it to a graded ELIGIBILITY envelope (rank-preserving renormalisation against the competing field; divisive-normalisation analog) so a modulatory/diversity channel arbitrates within the F-eligible set -- lifts committed diversity to the proposer ceiling without disinhibiting harmful classes.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The F-eligibility envelope must actually EXCLUDE -- bounded, not all-admit -- on a candidate pool with genuine divergence, and the committed-class DV must be read once per fresh E3 selection rather than once per env step. 689d met the first (mean excluded_count 0.152 > 0, demotion active on 1.0 of P1 ticks); the corrected recorder for the second now exists.

MECH-449.subject: selection.go_nogo_eligibility_constitution
MECH-449.title: Go/No-Go eligibility constitution for committed-action conversion: committed-action diversity is recovered not by any single louder channel but by an explicit eligibility CONSTITUTION -- bounded Go pressure (promote a channel when evidence/value/drive/rule/safety make it eligible) AND bounded No-Go pressure (suppress unsafe / stale / perseverative / irrelevant / low-viability channels) governing which candidates may compete for the pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate -- so that lawful, channel-specific access (not scalar dominance) decides the committed action. The full Go/No-Go eligibility-set governance is what converts when the minimal near-tie lever (MECH-447) does not and isolated F->eligibility demotion (MECH-448) is insufficient alone.
MECH-449.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Go and No-Go pressures must carry live cross-arm variance that is NOT analytically entailed by the shipped defaults. The 937b autopsy measured the opposite: with PERSEVERATION_FLOOR=0.5 making soft_nogo a singleton and gng_protect_min_eligible=1, converted == (pre_nogo_envelope_size >= 2) with zero exceptions over 12,672 ARM_CONSTITUTION banks, so C1's only reachable value is 1.0 against a 0.4 bar.
CONFIRMING: With natively-produced axes and the envelope-size mediator controlled, ARM_CONSTITUTION converts at least one previously-gated channel above the shuffled-signal control by more than max(1 SD of the per-seed delta, an absolute floor), with zero safety violations and the fail-open guard never overridden. Manipulation: Toggle use_go_nogo_constitution ON/OFF with the per-candidate Go/No-Go axes produced by the agent itself rather than injected via set_injected_go_nogo_signals, and vary gng_protect_min_eligible and the axis floors off the values that force the outcome. Control: Matched ARM_OFF (bit-identical default), plus a shuffled-signal arm in which the No-Go vector is permuted across candidates so any conversion attributable to firing rate alone is removed, and an envelope-size-matched stratum so envelope width is not the mediator. Required event: A committed-selection tick in the LIVE waking loop where an F-eligible candidate is unsafe, stale, perseverative or low-viability on an axis orthogonal to F-rank, so No-Go must drop it and bounded Go must re-admit a lawfully-eligible F-demoted competitor. DV: Committed-action-class conversion rate of a previously-gated channel, measured per bank CONDITIONAL on pre_nogo_envelope_size, plus the safety-violation count; the discriminating quantity is conversion residual after the envelope-size mediator is partialled out, not raw conversion.
FALSIFYING: Conversion is fully explained by pre_nogo_envelope_size (residual indistinguishable from the shuffled control once the mediator is partialled out), or the constitution converts nothing beyond what the MECH-448 demotion envelope already achieves, which makes the Go/No-Go layer over-specification rather than the conversion route. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: e3_selector._go_nogo_eligibility_gate diagnostics (go_nogo_n_soft_applied_mean and the per-bank envelope columns used by V3-EXQ-937b) record the gate's own activity; no recorder exists for natively-produced safety/staleness/viability/go axes, because agent.py:9592-9613 wires only the MECH-260 dACC suppression vector as perseveration and leaves the other four experiment-supplied. Consumer / boundary: The eligibility set feeding _modulatory_accum arbitration inside E3.select -- the permission-to-commit boundary, not episode reward. Existing ownership: ARC-107, MECH-260, MECH-448, f_dominance_conversion_ceiling, conversion_ceiling_campaign_plan:FULLSTACK, V3-EXQ-937b.

In the live loop only the MECH-260 perseveration axis has a native producer; safety, staleness, viability and Go have none, so the constitution as claimed cannot be exercised end-to-end. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. The gate has been discharged: the constitution was BUILT 2026-06-21 (_go_nogo_eligibility_gate, e3_selector.py:2062, invoked at :4247 under use_go_nogo_constitution), 689g and 926a RAN PASS, and the claim was promoted to provisional. MECH-450.subject: selection.minimal_recurrent_settling_step
MECH-450.title: Minimal recurrent settling step over the eligible set: replace the one-shot feed-forward argmin/softmax committed-selection readout with a few rounds of mutual-inhibition (surround-inhibition) updates on the within-eligible _modulatory_accum field BEFORE commit, so the committed action emerges from a bounded recurrent SETTLING competition rather than a single global comparison. A hard argmin over an F-dominated score always returns the F-winner (the conversion ceiling); a settling competition with lateral inhibition can FLIP the selected attractor when a modulatory channel is strong enough, and turns the additive _modulatory_accum BLEND into a competitive winner-take-most. The V3-bounded version of the BG's recurrent settling dynamics; the full learned thalamo-cortico-basal loop is the V4 bet.
MECH-450.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The settling must move the field across rounds (scs_mean_round_delta greater than zero; measured 5-8) with the uniform-kernel ablation reproducing OFF bit-identically, and a magnitude-matched null injected at the settling-field layer must be able to verify-lift committed-class entropy, which the 700-lineage policy-temperature null could not.
CONFIRMING: In a segregated-loop arena with a valid same-layer null, the settling step lifts committed-action-class entropy above the MECH-448/449 pre-filters and flips the committed attractor away from the F-winner when a modulatory channel is strong enough, with no harmful-class disinhibition, on at least 2/3 seeds. Manipulation: Run bounded mutual-inhibition settling rounds over the within-eligible _modulatory_accum field before commit (parameter-free kernel and/or learned W_lat), against the one-shot argmin readout, and across segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops rather than one arena. Control: Settling OFF (byte-identical), a uniform-kernel ablation arm isolating the structured class-surround, and a magnitude-matched same-layer random-structure null as the noise-as-diversity guard. Required event: Committed-selection steps where several first-action classes are eligible and a modulatory channel disagrees with the F-winner, so an attractor flip is possible in principle. DV: Committed-action-class entropy lift over the one-shot argmin readout, and the rate of committed-attractor flips away from the F-winner, with no harmful-class disinhibition.
FALSIFYING: With the same substrate and a scoring null, settling converges to the same argmin winner and adds no entropy over the pre-filters -- the recurrence is unnecessary in V3. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: e3_selector._soft_competitive_settle emits per-round diagnostics (scs_mean_round_delta) and the corrected non-hold-weighted GateDV instrument landed at experiments/_lib/gate_dv.py; the older 700-lineage null perturbed policy temperature and was decoupled from the committed-class DV. Consumer / boundary: The within-eligible modulatory field immediately before commit, inside segregated loops whose cross-loop arbitration happens after within-loop competition -- not the single shared foraging selector. Existing ownership: ARC-110, v4_loop_segregation, GFLAG-0069, V3-EXQ-713, conversion_ceiling_campaign:P4-learned-gating.
DISPOSITION: R6 (primary); Built and live, but at the wrong locus: over the single F-collapsed within-eligible field, settling reduced committed-class entropy on 2/3 divergent seeds (710). The segregated-loop substrate (ARC-110 / v4_loop_segregation) is built no-op-default and the corrected GateDV instrument landed (ree-v3 c309bc6486), yet the queue entry still reads ready:false and the 713x re-letter has been held by governance since 2026-08-21. Secondary classes: R5, R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA is headed SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT. Both halves were built: the learned lateral-inhibition settling (use_learned_settling_step, W_lat, 2026-06-22) and the parameter-free soft-competitive settling (use_soft_competitive_settling, _soft_competitive_settle, 2026-07-02), both contract-validated. V3-EXQ-710 then ran it live (round_delta 5-8) and found it SHARPENS the F-winner in the single arena. The live question is locus and null validity, not whether it is built. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. MECH-451.subject: selection.intermediate_channel_granularity
MECH-451.title: Intermediate channel-granularity falsifier -- before the full segregated-loop build (ARC-110), expose the compressed E3 score_bias modulatory channel as SEVERAL separately-learnable finer channels (OFC-devaluation / dACC-conflict / lateral-PFC rule-evidence / vigour / liking) to the learned-gating layer (ARC-108 w_chan), so the learner can discover SEPARATELY that different control functions matter in different states. The current single global w_chan learns one weight over a pre-compressed blend; this tests whether the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is REPRESENTATIONAL COMPRESSION (finer channels convert non-motor influence to committed action) rather than a requirement for full per-loop competition (finer channels do NOT convert, and only ARC-110 segregated loops do). The cheap intermediate rung BETWEEN ARC-108's one global weight vector and ARC-110's full segregated loops -- a V3-tractable falsifier that can pre-empt the V4 loop build.
MECH-451.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The finer channels must move and dissociate (learned range above floor, achieved in 704b: 0.0087 > 0.005), noise must be magnitude-matched to the finer-channel perturbation (achieved: ratio 1.0), AND the magnitude-matched same-layer null must itself LIFT committed-class entropy above the A0 baseline -- the verify-lift leg that failed 0/2 divergent seeds.

Manipulation: use_finer_channel_gating ON (score_bias exposed as >= 3 separately-learnable channels each with its own signed-RPE-trained w_chan_finer entry) versus the single global ARC-108 w_chan. Required event: Waking E3 selection episodes in which non-motor control functions (OFC devaluation, dACC conflict, lateral-PFC rule evidence, vigour, liking) contribute score bias while F dominates the committed argmin. DV: Committed-action-class entropy and conversion of at least one previously F-dominated non-motor channel to committed authority, measured at the committed argmin rather than pre-commit.
FALSIFYING: With a verified-lifting null, finer channels move their weights but produce no committed-conversion lift beyond the single global weight -- compression is not the binding constraint and the route is ARC-110 segregated loops. SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: e3_selector.py's finer-channel registry and w_chan_finer diagnostics plus the 704/704b drivers record per-channel learned ranges, delta_t variance and committed-class entropy; the missing instrument is a valid same-layer null on that DV. Existing ownership: v4_loop_segregation, ARC-110, EXP-0391, MECH-439, conversion_ceiling_campaign:P4-learned-gating.

The valid null needs the eligibility/settling layer that only the ARC-110 segregated-loop build provides, and that build's own validation (707) failed substrate_not_ready. Secondary classes: R6. It was built 2026-06-24 (E3Config.use_finer_channel_gating, the _FCG_CHANNEL_INDEX registry and the parallel w_chan_finer buffer in e3_selector.py, contract-tested), and ran as V3-EXQ-704/704b. 704b then moved the blocker from build-absence to substrate_ceiling: a correctly magnitude-matched same-layer null does not lift committed-class entropy in the single arena, so the conversion test's control cannot be validly constructed there. MECH-452.subject: selection.loop_local_eligibility_traces
MECH-452.title: Loop-local eligibility traces under a globally-broadcast dopamine signal: even with a SINGLE shared dopaminergic teaching signal (ARC-108 delta_t), the credit traces that decide WHICH synapses/channels the signal updates must remain LOCAL and loop-specific -- effective update = shared delta_t x separate local eligibility trace x loop-specific active synapses -- rather than the current single globally-broadcast credit that updates every recently-active selector component. A too-broad or temporally-smeared eligibility trace would make learned gating appear ineffective (no committed conversion) even when the underlying dopamine learning rule is exactly correct, because the right teaching signal is delivered to the wrong synapses.
MECH-452.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Loop segregation ON with measured live cross-loop variance (707c's loops_carry_live_cross_loop_variance gate, min flip/disagree fraction above floor), the ARC-108 learned-channel-gating eligibility path engaged so there are credit terms to localise, and the loop-vote diagnostic loop_local_credited_channels strictly between zero and the full channel count -- if every loop always votes, the local and global traces are the same trace under two names.
CONFIRMING: With loops live and disagreeing and under the delayed-outcome regime named in Required event, the loop-local arm produces measurably better GROUND-TRUTH credit attribution than the collapsed-global arm at matched teaching signal and matched trace duration, on a strict majority of seeds, with the collapse-to-global ablation reproducing the global arm's profile -- and attribution is two-sided in trace duration: degraded at the long decay (credit smeared onto channels that were not responsible; locality rescues this) and degraded at the short decay once the outcome lags the action by k>=1 ticks (the flag has gone before the third factor arrives; locality does NOT rescue this). Manipulation: A 3x2 independent-arm design -- learned_channel_gating_elig_decay in {short (trace half-life below the delayed-outcome lag, e.g. 0.3 at k>=3), 0.9 (the default), long (e.g. 0.99)} crossed with use_loop_local_eligibility_traces OFF versus ON, with use_loop_segregation held ON in ALL cells and use_learned_cross_loop_arbitration held OFF in ALL cells (the same decay constant also decays the ARC-110 M_cross co-activation trace, e3_selector.py ~2967, so a decay sweep with cross-loop learning ON would confound trace duration with cross-loop arbitration learning; if it is ever varied it must be a named factor). Trace locality and trace duration are the ONLY swept factors, and no existing run varies either: 707/707a/707b/707c/708a all bind the trace flag to the same loop_seg switch that arms segregation itself, and every experiment script that sets the decay pins LCG_ELIG_DECAY = 0.9. Control: The collapse-to-global ablation the claim itself demands (loops present, one shared trace), plus the ARM_NOISE in-layer null already built in the 707 lineage, so a lift cannot be attributed to loop segregation or to added stochasticity; the voting-loop credit fraction / loop_local_credited_channels is carried as a MANIPULATION CHECK only (it confirms the locality mask engaged, it is not an outcome). Required event: Committed action selections under a shared signed-RPE teaching signal in which the within-loop winners of the motor, associative and limbic loops disagree with each other and with the committed action on a non-trivial fraction of ticks, AND a DELAYED-OUTCOME event: the outcome that ground-truths the credit (e.g. a resource or harm contact) lands k>=1 ticks after the responsible action and credit is scored to the action/channel k ticks before contact, or an equivalent sparse/delayed teaching-signal regime. Under the current teaching signal delta_t is formed at the very next post_action_update from a DENSE per-tick R_t (benefit_eval_head - harm_eval_head at the resulting z_world, e3_selector.py ~4744-4759) and the trace is not reset after use, so the action-to-third-factor lag is 0 ticks and the too-short pole is structurally unobservable -- a short-decay null without the delayed-outcome event is guaranteed by construction and says nothing. DV: GROUND-TRUTH-referenced credit-assignment correctness per decay x locality cell: the share of eligibility credit and of the resulting w_chan movement landing on the channel(s) that are CAUSALLY outcome-predictive in an environment where that is known by construction (or, equivalently, held-out selection accuracy after learning), with committed-class conversion reported as a corroborating and explicitly ceiling-bounded secondary. NOT the DV: the fraction of credit landing on channels whose loop voted for the realised action (or w_chan movement 'attributed to the voting loop') -- with loop-local ON only voting-loop channels are admitted to the trace (e3_selector.py ~4626-4634), so that fraction is 1.0 by construction at decay 0 and near 1.0 at any decay; locality cannot lose on it.
FALSIFYING: Trace locality yields no ground-truth credit-attribution advantage over the single global broadcast under live, disagreeing loops at ANY swept trace duration -- the locality is decorative by the ARC-106 load-bearing-versus-decorative test and should be dropped. A locality null at a SINGLE decay value is NOT a falsification: at too short a decay both arms fail together (the flag is gone before the third factor arrives, Gerstner 2018) and at the default the smear may be too small to separate them, so the locality contrast is interpretable only across the duration sweep. Separately, if ground-truth attribution is flat across the whole duration sweep under the delayed-outcome regime, the trace-DURATION axis is decorative and the too-narrow pole of psychiatric_failure_mode loses its substrate reading. A conversion null alone does not falsify: conversion is pinned by MECH-439 F-dominance independently of trace locality. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The recorder exists in e3_selector.py -- last_score_diagnostics['loop_local_credited_channels'] plus the _loop_of_channel / _loop_voted bookkeeping and the _lcg_elig_trace / _fcg_elig_trace buffers -- and the 707 lineage already carries the readiness gates. What does not exist is a driver that varies the trace flag or the trace decay independently of loop segregation, a delayed-outcome event, or a ground-truth-referenced credit readout. Premise corrections (2026-09-24 pre-flight): P1 -- there is no separate 'global' versus 'loop-local' buffer; loop-local mode is a MASK on the per-tick contribution into the SAME _lcg_elig_trace (e3_selector.py ~4626-4642), and the two buffers the decay constant hits are _lcg_elig_trace (ARC-108) and _fcg_elig_trace (MECH-451 finer path); the config.py docstring's 'PARTITIONED into one trace per loop' overstates this (per-channel masking is equivalent in effect). Trace duration is ONE constant, config.e3.learned_channel_gating_elig_decay (default 0.9), shared by both buffers. P2 -- that same constant ALSO decays the ARC-110 cross-loop M_cross co-activation trace when use_learned_cross_loop_arbitration is on (e3_selector.py ~2967), hence the hold-OFF in Manipulation. Consumer / boundary: The eligibility-recording site that decides WHICH gating channels the shared delta_t updates, upstream of the weight update -- not the teaching signal itself and not the cross-loop arbitration policy. Existing ownership: ARC-110, ARC-108, MECH-450, MECH-439, behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-K, conversion_ceiling_campaign:P4-learned-gating.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The substrate is built, flag-gated and diagnosable, and the loops demonstrably disagree -- but every experiment that touches it (707, 707a, 707b, 707c, 708a, 709, 711, 713, 1019) sets use_loop_local_eligibility_traces from the same loop_seg switch, so trace locality has never been an independent arm. The claim's own DV, committed conversion, is additionally ceiling-pinned and cannot carry the contrast. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The text opens 'SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT (requires the ARC-110 loops plus per-loop/per-channel trace machinery; neither is present in V3)'. Both landed 2026-06-27: e3_selector.py credits a channel only when its loop voted for the committed action behind config.e3.use_loop_local_eligibility_traces, and ARC-110 loop segregation is live and measured to carry cross-loop variance (707c min flip/disagree fraction 0.41). Separately, the WWA's proposed DV -- committed conversion -- is now known to be ceiling-pinned: 707c weakened the arena-collapse route and 709/711/713 all self-routed substrate_ceiling. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-453.subject: selection.tan_plasticity_window_credit_gating
MECH-453.title: Cholinergic TAN-pause plasticity-window gating of selector credit: dopamine should NOT continuously update every recently-active selector component; a striatal cholinergic tonically-active-neuron (TAN) pause should open a NARROW plasticity window around behaviourally-relevant events, so the three-factor learned-gating updates (ARC-108) are admitted only WITHIN the window. Without a window, continuous credit smears across irrelevant recently-active components and degrades the learned gating the conversion attack depends on. The OPENING-side neuromodulatory complement to REE's existing CLOSURE-side plasticity control (MECH-094 waking-gate; INV-074/MECH-333/MECH-334 consolidation/EWC) -- REE today has machinery to stop/consolidate learning but not a phasic gate to OPEN a precise learning window.
MECH-453.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT (no event-locked plasticity-window gate exists on the selector; the learned gating updates continuously when waking). A future experiment SUPPORTS this if gating the ARC-108 three-factor update behind a narrow event-locked (TAN-pause-like) window lifts committed conversion or credit precision over the continuously-updating learner, AND a window-ablation (open the window permanently) reproduces the smeared-credit no-lift, on >=2/3 seeds. WEAKENED if windowing the update yields no advantage over continuous updating (the window is then decorative -- dropped per the ARC-106 load-bearing-vs-decorative ablation test). NON-DEGENERACY: the window must actually GATE updates (a measurable fraction of recently-active components excluded when the window is closed, with live cross-event variance in what is admitted) -- a window that admits everything is the continuous learner re-labelled, route substrate_not_ready_requeue.
REFINEMENT 2026-09-25 (from the 2026-09-19 pull, design correction only -- status and confidence unchanged): add a GRADED-CONTRAST arm alongside the categorical-admission arm (outside-window updates attenuated, not zeroed); the categorical reading is supported only if it beats the graded arm, since Cragg 2006 grounds contrast, not admission. Let DA modulate window duration in at least one arm (Kim 2019); a fixed-width-only design tests a mechanism the biology does not use. Do not score the window on learning speed alone -- a window that maximises learning rate is not the biological target (Uribe-Cano & Kottmann 2026).

MECH-454.subject: ethics_engine_3.self_option_value_reversibility_cost
MECH-454.title: Foreclosing the SELF's own future reachable-option space carries a decision cost in E3 trajectory scoring, GATED BY FORECAST UNCERTAINTY -- the non-harm, self-directed analog of INV-026 (which scopes foreclosure-of-reachable-state-space as a harm to OTHERS). E3 today scores harm + benefit + goal + residue + the modulatory stack; nothing represents the option-value / reversibility of an action for the agent's OWN reachable futures. REE's irreversibility-awareness is HARM-scoped (residue cannot be erased; No-Go gates; INV-026 foreclosure-of-others); there is no INFORMATION/RESOURCE-scoped analog (don't cheaply foreclose your own options). The claim: an uncertainty-gated reachable-option-preservation cost should change committed action -- preferring the reversible/option-preserving branch MORE when the forecast that justifies foreclosure is UNCERTAIN, and not at all when it is confident (a generalization of DR-12's PE-conditioned E3 confidence from object-rollouts to a foreclosure cost).
MECH-454.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT. Blocked on two substrates that do not exist: (1) a reachable-option-DISSOCIATING env extension on CausalGridWorld -- a cheap-REVERSIBLE branch vs a costly-IRREVERSIBLE branch (a one-way door / a region-collapsing consumable) so that an action measurably changes the agent's reachable-future-option count; (2) the E3 option-value cost term itself (a penalty on the post-action drop in reachable distinct future states/goals, scaled by forecast PE). A future ablation SUPPORTS this if, with the term ON vs OFF under MANIPULATED outcome uncertainty, the ON arm prefers the option-preserving action MORE than OFF specifically when forecast uncertainty is HIGH and converges to OFF when it is LOW (uncertainty- GATED), on a strict majority of seeds. WEAKENED if ON==OFF (the term never moves committed action -> decorative, dropped per the ARC-106 ablation test) OR ON avoids the irreversible branch REGARDLESS of uncertainty (un-gated risk-aversion, not the claimed mechanism). NON-DEGENERACY (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a verdict): the two branches must measurably differ in reachable-future-option count (post-action reachable distinct states/goals spread > floor) AND forecast uncertainty (E2 forward-PE or E3 running_variance) must VARY across the manipulated conditions (range > floor) -- if reachable-option count is identical across branches or PE is pinned, the term has nothing to act on and the test is vacuous.

MECH-455.subject: goal_pipeline.competence_based_intrinsic_motivation_wanting
MECH-455.title: competence_based_intrinsic_motivation / goal_achievement_progress_wanting. A wanting bonus indexed to the agent's RATE-OF-IMPROVEMENT in ACHIEVING its own active goals: per active goal, an EMA of the derivative of goal-achievement competence (success-rate, or 1 - proximity-at-termination) injected as intrinsic wanting alongside MECH-229 VALENCE_WANTING, biasing the agent toward goals it is currently getting BETTER at reaching. This is the SECOND intrinsic-motivation family in Mirolli & Baldassarre (2013) -- COMPETENCE-based IM (reward = progress in achieving a self-generated goal, i.e. improving the agent's SKILLS) -- which REE's registered IM stack (MECH-314 info-gain / MECH-314a novelty / MECH-314c learning-progress, all KNOWLEDGE-based: reward = improving the WORLD MODEL) entirely lacks. Same derivative-not-level discipline as MECH-314c, but the operand is BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCE, not predictive error.
MECH-455.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Two things must hold or the test is vacuous. (P1) Goal-achievement competence must be ABOVE the floor and moving, since a derivative of a flat 0.065-0.455 resources/episode competence is zero for reasons unrelated to the claim. (P2) The wanting channel must have measurable authority over the committed action: V3-EXQ-931 measured the wanting term cross-candidate spread at ~0.37% of the terrain term, first flipping the elite argmin at wanting_weight ~50 and 5/5 seeds at ~500.
CONFIRMING: The competence-progress arm shifts goal selection toward improving goals relative to BOTH the yoked-permutation and OFF arms, and foraging competence rises toward the 1.0/episode floor with grounding and harm behaviour unchanged. Manipulation: A per-goal EMA of the derivative of achievement competence injected as an additive wanting bonus alongside MECH-229, ON vs OFF, routed to the committed action via use_cem_modulatory_throughput plus modulatory_channel_route_source=cem_elite so the bonus can actually reach the argmin. Control: A yoked bonus of identical magnitude and arity permuted across goals (competence ORDERING destroyed), plus OFF, plus a level-not-derivative arm to pin the derivative discipline. Required event: Repeated attempts at the same active goal whose success rate is changing, so a rate-of-improvement in achievement exists to be read. DV: Share of goal selections directed at the goals whose achievement competence is currently improving, and foraging competence per episode against the 1.0/episode WS-1 floor.
FALSIFYING: Selection share and competence are indistinguishable from the yoked control at matched bonus magnitude, or the effect survives permuting competence across goals (so it is bonus magnitude, not competence progress). A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Nothing records achievement-competence derivative. The nearest existing recorder is GoalState.record_progress / _progress_velocity (SD-093, MECH-426), which is a within-episode goal-PROXIMITY velocity over a 5-tick window consumed by effort modulation and default OFF; mech457_retention_trajectory_probe samples unshaped foraging_competence but not per-goal success rate. Consumer / boundary: Wanting term -> goal selection / trajectory scoring -> committed action. Existing ownership: MECH-426, SD-093, mech457_retention_trajectory_probe, modulatory-bias-selection-authority, MECH-457, EXP-1058.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); No competence-progress quantity exists anywhere in ree_core, and the channel the claim proposes to inject into is itself a measured non-consumer: the wanting term needs ~100x scaling to move the elite argmin, and elite flips do not imply throughput (at wanting_weight 5000 the elite argmin flipped on 80.3% of refits while mean_resource_proximity stayed bit-identical). Secondary classes: R2, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-456.subject: entities.rebinding_under_perturbation
MECH-456.title: Entity binding is continuously re-evaluated, not fixed: an established self-anchor <-> world-configuration binding is re-bound to a competing configuration when that competitor overtakes the currently-bound one under perturbation of the shared anchor. Rebinding is the ENTITY-LAYER analogue of MECH-269(b) anchor-reset -- it operates over self<->world-config bindings rather than proposer stream-anchors. The rebinding trigger is prediction-error / competitor-overtake driven (object-file updating; serial-dependence hysteresis; PE-driven perceptual switching), NOT a coherence-specific selection factor C(tau) (that coherence-SPECIFICITY question is settled NO-CLAIM by V3-EXQ-725a and is explicitly excluded from this claim).
MECH-456.what_would_answer: A V3 experiment on the converged learned cross_stream_binder in which the environment presents a genuine competing-configuration overtake (the world-config that best matches the agent's realized situation changes mid-episode) must show BOTH: (1) the binder re-binds to the newly-correct configuration -- rebinding tracks the TRUE competitor, not arbitrary anchor noise, measured by rebinding-alignment-with-ground-truth above a shuffle control; AND (2) a behavioural / competence consequence -- rebinding-ON produces a downstream outcome difference (e.g. faster re-acquisition, fewer stale-binding errors) vs a rebinding-frozen arm, using a GRADED, non-saturating metric (per the V3-EXQ-725a frac_state_div saturation note). Unsupported if rebinding events fire but are bit-identical OFF=ON on the behavioural DV (the MECH-269(b) V3-EXQ-478 inert-reset signature), OR if rebinding does not track the true competitor above the shuffle control (arbitrary anchor-sensitivity, not functional rebinding).

MECH-457.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.actor_critic_action_learning_substrate
MECH-457.title: action_learning_as_first_class_actor_critic_substrate / rpe_driven_policy_learning. Competent action learning in REE requires a DEDICATED RPE-driven actor-critic policy-learning substrate (a dorsal-striatal analog: a parameterized actor trained on a reward-error teaching signal, with a value-baseline critic), architecturally distinct from -- and NOT reducible to -- the current thin bias_head REINFORCE readout over the prediction-trained (SD-056 e2 world-forward contrastive) encoder. The V3-EXQ-724 competence autopsy localized REE's foraging wall (integrated all-ON agent forages ~0 resources/episode vs a 1.0 floor) to exactly this un-varied invariant: action is learned only as a bias on a representation trained for SENSORY PREDICTION, never as a first-class policy object trained on RETURN. 'Prediction-rich, action-poor': REE trains a substantial world model but has no dedicated action-learning system -- in brains, action learning IS a substantial learning system (O'Doherty 2004 dorsal-striatum-as-actor; Schultz 1997 dopaminergic RPE teacher), not a bias term on a prediction model.
MECH-457.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The DV must have headroom and the environment must be solvable from the agent's own view before any arm is scored -- V3-EXQ-765's readiness leg established the 5x5 view supports local_view_greedy 48.05 and an oracle 57.2 against a 1.0 floor, so the env is not the limit. The actor must also NOT ride a frozen z_world: V3-EXQ-737 measured a trainable actor-plus-critic on the frozen latent scoring below random, and V3-EXQ-737a found 0 of 4 world_encoder and 0 of 61 latent_stack tensors changed after 200 P0 episodes. And on D3_hazard_free the return does not rank the foraging DV at all (random_walk mean_episode_reward -1.006, greedy oracle surviving 20.4 steps versus vanilla PPO's 175).
CONFIRMING: The dedicated actor-critic arm crosses the 1.0/episode unshaped foraging floor where the bias-head-over-prediction arm does not, on an instrument where the return ranks the foraging DV, with the trajectory showing install and retention rather than install and decay. Manipulation: use_actor_critic ON versus the incumbent thin bias_head REINFORCE readout, with actor_critic_cotrain_encoder as the representation co-shaping lever and actor_critic_use_sf_critic as the successor-feature variant. Control: Two controls, and both are load-bearing: a privileged oracle / local-view-greedy arm establishing the achievable ceiling, and a non-REE vanilla learner on the IDENTICAL observation -- if that also fails, the target is the observation encoding (H2), not the policy (H1). Required event: A foraging episode sequence in which the agent must repeatedly locate and consume resources, long enough for an RPE-driven actor-critic update loop to install and then retain competence. DV: Unshaped foraging competence per episode against the 1.0/episode floor, sampled as a TRAJECTORY on a fixed post-install schedule during RL refinement (not terminal-only), so that installed-then-decayed is distinguishable from never-installed.
FALSIFYING: The actor-critic arm fails the floor WHILE a vanilla non-REE learner on the identical observation also fails -- the bottleneck is the observation encoding, not the policy substrate (H2), which weakens this claim. V3-EXQ-742 already weakened the sufficiency reading, and 770/771/772 eliminated drive-schedule, reward-coupling and credit-horizon as the axis. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/action_learning/actor_critic.py (ActorCriticPolicy: dorsal-striatal actor, value_head at lines 142-145, optional successor-feature critic) behind use_actor_critic and the co-shaping knobs; the retention trajectory probe and the schedulable bc_aux_coef, distributional critic and KL-anchor levers are all recorded implemented in substrate_queue.json; drivers in experiments/_lib/mech457_bootstrap_explorer.py and mech457_explorer_classes.py. Consumer / boundary: The action-learning system itself -- a separately parameterised policy taught by a reward-prediction-error signal -- as distinct from a bias term on a prediction-trained encoder. The claim is about necessity at that boundary, explicitly NOT sufficiency. Existing ownership: zworld_adequacy:ZW-1, SD-106, SD-018, conversion_ceiling_root, dv-dynamic-range-precondition-class, MECH-475, MECH-476.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The installability half is unresolved: every arm sits at or near the floor while the oracle clears it, so the discriminating DV has no headroom in the arms that matter. The competence_floor question is DECIDED for RETENTION only (value estimator and update constraint each independently set the decay half-life); the representation explanandum -- whether prediction-trained z_world confers any advantage -- is the live frontier, carried by zworld_adequacy and conversion_ceiling_root's H-observation-interface. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-458.subject: hippocampal_module.curiosity_drive.exploitation_polarity
MECH-458.title: Curiosity is a reward-conditional EXPLOITATION amplifier, not a diversity generator: the SD-025 hippocampal curiosity / density-attraction drive pulls only toward representational structure that reward (SD-024/MECH-232 DA-expansion) has ALREADY sculpted -- a rich-get-richer loop with zero PROACTIVE pull toward unshaped / novel / under-represented regions. Its only diversity affordance is a weak, lagging, REACTIVE familiarity-discount brake (~half the strength of the exploitation force it opposes, and zero at the decision point). COROLLARY: proactive strategy-diversity GENERATION requires a SEPARATE rarity-seeking drive (Bellemare-2016 polarity: attraction to LOW-count / under-represented strategy classes, independent of prior reward-shaping), NOT a novelty-magnitude increase on the existing drive; and any such drive is ORDERING-GATED on INV-088 z_world differentiation (a rarity term over an under-differentiated map has nothing to range over).
MECH-458.what_would_answer: ONCE INV-088 z_world differentiation is cleared (the ordering gate), build a proactive rarity-seeking generation drive on ARC-065/MECH-314 (Bellemare polarity: attraction to low-count / under-represented strategy classes or z_world regions, independent of reward-shaping) and run a discriminative arm against (a) OFF and (b) a pure novelty-MAGNITUDE sweep of the existing SD-025 drive (the infant_substrate:GAP-13 lever). PRIMARY DV = per-candidate / committed-class strategy diversity on an UNSHAPED (flat / not-yet-reward-sculpted) map. SUPPORTS the claim iff the rarity-seeking arm supplies diversity pull comparable to the ~39-unit exploitation force AT THE DECISION POINT (where SD-025 supplies 0) AND the novelty-magnitude sweep does NOT (768a predicts the flat-map arm reads ~0 regardless of weight). WEAKENS iff a magnitude sweep of the existing density-attraction drive alone lifts flat-map diversity (would refute the polarity/category claim). Not runnable before INV-088 (a rarity term over an AUC-0.83 under-differentiated map chases the sparse corner, not diverse strategies) -- so this is a build-gated prediction, not a queued falsifier.

MECH-459.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.return_pathway_stabilisation
MECH-459.title: return_scale_invariance_blocks_actor_bootstrap / one_sided_return_normalisation. REE's MECH-457 actor-critic update stacks TWO two-sided normalisers -- a Welford RUNNING reward std (r / running_std) followed by a per-episode advantage standardisation ((adv - mean) / (std + 1e-8)) -- which together form a SCALE-INVARIANCE OPERATOR: after it the policy gradient depends only on the SHAPE of the within-episode advantage vector and is exactly invariant to any multiplicative rescaling. This is sufficient to produce converter invariance to every MAGNITUDE lever by construction (the reward-coupling and drive-schedule axes eliminated by V3-EXQ-771 and 770), and it converts a zero-forage episode -- whose reward stream is harm_signal + novelty_bonus only, so whose advantage vector is pure critic error plus exploration jitter -- into a FULL-MAGNITUDE unit-variance noise gradient. DreamerV3 (Hafner 2023) names this exact failure ('amplification of near-zero returns', Appendix E) and prescribes the corrective: a STATIONARY magnitude compressor (symlog, explicitly against running-statistics normalisation, which injects non-stationarity because the target moves when the normaliser moves), a ONE-SIDED percentile normaliser adv / max(1, Per95 - Per5) that scales large returns down and never scales small returns up, and a DISTRIBUTIONAL twohot/cross-entropy critic in place of a scalar MSE head (which under a bimodal sparse-return distribution converges to the never-observed MEAN of the two modes, and whose gradient is linear in the error rather than bounded).
MECH-459.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The knock-out must run in a regime where the existing readiness anchors hold (local_view_greedy ~48-55 and greedy_oracle ~57-61 foraging competence at D3, both far above the 1.0 floor, as 782 measured) and must report the critic-calibration state, because 782's flat-uninformed critic means a null could reflect absent value signal rather than an exonerated normaliser -- the two accounts must be separated on the same run.
CONFIRMING: With readiness anchors met, swapping to the one-sided percentile denominator moves foraging competence off the ~0-1 floor relative to the byte-identical two-sided arm, and the advantage composition shows forage mass no longer rescaled to parity with novelty/harm mass in the gradient. Manipulation: Replace ONLY the per-episode standardisation adv_t = (adv_t - adv_t.mean()) / (adv_t.std() + 1e-8) at experiments/_lib/mech457_fanout.py::train_rawview_ac_rl with the one-sided adv / max(1, Per95(adv) - Per5(adv)), everything else byte-identical; optionally a second arm that also removes the Welford running reward-std divide. Control: The unmodified two-sided pathway at matched seeds and identical budget, plus the behavioural-cloning reference (32.72, which clears the floor by bypassing the return pathway entirely) as the achievability anchor, and the local_view_greedy / greedy_oracle readiness controls. Required event: MECH-457 actor-critic training episodes in the near-zero-forage regime where the reward stream is harm_signal plus novelty_bonus only, so the advantage vector is pure critic error plus exploration jitter -- the regime in which the claim says the two-sided operator manufactures a full-magnitude unit-variance noise gradient. DV: Foraging competence after the knock-out relative to the unmodified arm, reported with the advantage-composition split (forage-contact versus novelty/harm |adv| mass, pre and post normalisation) and the critic separation between pre-reward and post-reward states on BC-visited states, so an unmoved floor is attributable.
FALSIFYING: The floor does not move under the shape-preserving knock-out while the readiness anchors hold -- the two-sided normaliser is exonerated, the weaker noise-re-amplification form falls with it, and the four eliminated axes (769/770/771/772) regain their face value as constraints on the mechanisms they tested. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Both normalisers are present exactly as the claim asserts and both sit in a driver library fully under experiment control: experiments/_lib/mech457_fanout.py lines 240/296 (Welford running reward std) and 305/584 (per-episode standardisation). The probe-R readouts already exist as experiments/_lib/mech459_probe_r.py and were exercised by V3-EXQ-782. Consumer / boundary: The advantage pathway between the reward stream and the policy gradient in the MECH-457 actor-critic update -- the measuring instrument of the four-axis elimination campaign, not the environment or the credit horizon. Existing ownership: mech457_competence_bootstrap_explorer, MECH-457, MECH-460, MECH-461, EXP-0077, V3-EXQ-782, SD-056.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); Nothing in the substrate blocks it: the change is a one-line swap in a driver library and the probe-R instrumentation exists. The gate is governance -- the claim explicitly licenses no build, mech457_competence_bootstrap_explorer is blocked_pending_discrimination under GOV-FANOUT-1 (V3-EXQ-780 versus 781), and whether competence_floor gains a third ALIVE leg is a /governance decision. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA presents its two supporting readouts as cheap additions still to be taken; both have since RUN and both came out against the claim's stated predictions. V3-EXQ-782 (2026-07-18, weakens, confirmed autopsy 2026-07-20) carries the interpretation label forage_mass_already_concentrated__critic_flat_uninformed: readout (a) found the forage |adv| mass already concentrated PRE-standardisation, contradicting the claim's prediction that it is tiny and rescaled to parity, and readout (b) found the critic flat and uninformed, which the WWA itself assigns to the signal-absence account rather than to bimodal-collapse. The same run refuted the STRONG form (Finding V2). Only the shape-preserving knock-out remains, and the prior against it has moved. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-460.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.behavioral_prior_seed_transience
MECH-460.title: transient_behavioral_prior_bootstrap / bc_seed_then_rl_without_permanent_demonstrator. What a behavioural-cloning prior supplies to a floored converter is PRIMARILY TRACTABLE EXPLORATION / STATE-VISITATION, not merely a competent action distribution: VPT (Baker 2022) reports RL from random initialisation in the same action space obtains essentially no reward and never reliably reaches the first link in the item chain, while BC-initialised RL reaches the diamond pickaxe -- a PRESENCE/ABSENCE result, not a speed-up. Three further functions are separable: the action distribution (the vehicle), VALUE-SIDE GROUNDING (DQfD's large-margin loss, which plain BC does NOT supply and whose ablation costs most of the benefit), and STRATEGIC-DIVERSITY PRESERVATION against collapse (AlphaStar). Because REE already owns deterministic in-substrate demonstrators (LocalViewGreedyPolicy 48-55 and OraclePolicy 57-61, instantiated in experiments/_lib/mech457_fanout.py::run_anchor_cell), NO PERMANENT EXTERNAL DEMONSTRATOR IS REQUIRED -- REE's transience question is not how to stop paying for demonstrations but whether the seed leaves a RESIDUE in the converter after the guide leaves the action path. The only strong transience construct in the literature is JSRL's ROLLOUT HANDOFF (a guide acts for the first h steps, the learner for H-h, with h decreasing to 0 as the learner clears a threshold), NOT a decaying loss weight: none of VPT, AlphaStar or DQfD ever anneals its prior term to zero.
MECH-460.what_would_answer: Three readouts, in decreasing order of decisiveness. (a) RESIDUE AFTER PRIOR REMOVAL -- the JSRL h=0 endpoint: does foraging competence survive when the prior is fully out of the action path? SUPPORTED if competence persists post-removal above the 780 ctrl; FALSIFIED (as a SEED reading) if it collapses to the 0-1 floor the instant the auxiliary/guide is removed, which would make the prior a permanent crutch rather than a bootstrap. (b) GUIDE-QUALITY GRADIENT -- seeding from greedy_oracle (57-61) should dominate local_view_greedy (48-55), and both should dominate random_walk; a FLAT response across guide quality is surprising under this claim and points at the converter rather than the seed. (c) VALUE-SIDE SEED CONTRAST -- policy-only seeding vs policy+value seeding at matched actor warm-start budget, read out as critic calibration on demonstrator-visited states.

MECH-461.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.innate_approach_primitive_bootstrap
MECH-461.title: innate_action_primitive_basis_plus_reward_independent_engagement_drive. Biological competence bootstrap without a demonstrator rests on TWO components, not one. (i) The action basis is INNATE AND REFINED, never constructed: the two neonatal motoneuron primitives are RETAINED into adulthood and augmented, with matching primitives across rat/cat/macaque/guineafowl (Dominici 2011, 10.1126/science.1210617) -- so 'a learner with no action prior fails' is the biological DEFAULT, not an anomaly; and the innate seed is demonstrator-free but NOT experience-free, since deprived of proprioceptive feedback from its OWN self-generated activity the CPG fails to mature (Zeng 2021). (ii) A REWARD-INDEPENDENT ENGAGEMENT DRIVE is necessary: an identified ZIm circuit converts stimulus presence into investigation independent of learned reward value (Ahmadlou 2021, 10.1126/science.abe9681), and dopamine-deficient mice with INTACT perception, INTACT motor apparatus and INTACT hedonics starve in front of food (Szczypka 2001) -- the closest biological analog of REE's 'readiness met on every leg, foraging at floor'. COROLLARY for REE: an approach primitive is underspecified unless one also names WHAT THE DRIVE'S OUTPUT TRAINS (the Zeng closed loop), because an innate generator alone does not mature.
MECH-461.what_would_answer: The V3-EXQ-781 pre-registered readout is the direct test on the drive half: a sustained, non-extinguishing, demonstrator-free approach drive (constant-coefficient intrinsic reward on resource proximity) that leaves the actor at the passive-survival floor on BOTH representations -- with mean_approach_reward_recent confirming the drive actually fired, so a null is informative rather than a plumbing bug -- FALSIFIES the drive half. The PRIMITIVE-BASIS half is NOT tested by 781 and is the claim's distinctive, currently-untested content: it would be answered by contrasting a converter given a pre-specified action-primitive basis (a small set of composable multi-step motor primitives) against one that must construct its repertoire from single-step actions, at matched drive. A drive-only arm clearing the floor would show the primitive basis is unnecessary; a primitive-basis-only arm clearing it would show the drive is.

MECH-462.subject: sleep.consolidation_readout_order
MECH-462.title: Consolidation-phase damage is content-scorable only where the phase's output is a FIRST-ORDER content-bearing quantity (NREM inter-store transfer; SWS retrieval margin). A phase whose output is a SECOND-ORDER quantity over representations -- REM precision / confidence recalibration -- is content-free BY TYPE, and its damage is readable only through a downstream behavioural discrimination consequence, never through a statistic computed on the precision quantity itself.
MECH-462.what_would_answer: Build the meta-d-prime-analogue downstream readout for the REM phase (does the agent's post-REM confidence separate its own correct from incorrect retrievals) and run it on the SAME CELLS as V3-EXQ-778e. SUPPORTED if the downstream readout is content-contingent (null_slope_ratio <= 0.25, ceiling_inside_ci95 false, >=6/8 seeds) WHILE the direct precision readout on those same cells remains above 0.25 -- the same-cells contrast is what makes this a test of the type fact rather than of the build. REFUTED two ways, and both matter: (i) if the downstream readout is ALSO content-free, the phase carries no recoverable damage signal at all and the type story is wrong about recoverability; or (ii) if a DIRECT precision-quantity readout can be made content-contingent, the type-fact is simply false and all three results were construction defect after all.

MECH-463.subject: selection.global_arousal_variance_amplification
MECH-463.title: Global-scalar arousal channels are a VARIANCE AMPLIFIER of the already-dominant selection channel, not a source of behavioural differentiation: the three affective routes that modulate commitment globally (D1/D2 dopamine gain, harm-urgency threshold shrinkage, LC-NE/phasic-surprise temperature) apply one scalar uniformly across all K candidates and therefore cannot change an argmax, but DO change whether commitment fires and how sharply -- selecting for whichever channel already carries the most per-candidate score variance. Under F-dominance (MECH-439) this makes affective engagement ENTRENCH F rather than convert diversity, predicting that F's share of committed-selection variance RISES with arousal and FALLS under low urgency.
MECH-463.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The V3-EXQ-643 non-vacuity gate must hold: modulatory authority active fraction above zero, cross-candidate range above floor, and urgency_applied non-constant across the run. Without it the probe returns a spurious flat F-share from float32 catastrophic cancellation (643's E3 scores ~1e32 put the modulatory range below ULP) and FALSELY refutes.
CONFIRMING: Incumbent share rises monotonically with urgency decile and the bottom-versus-top gap exceeds the pre-registered effect-size floor, with total variance rising too -- affect amplifying the incumbent rather than converting diversity. Manipulation: Set urgency EXOGENOUSLY, i.i.d. uniform over a pre-registered grid on e3.config.urgency_weight, which breaks the endogeneity confound by construction rather than adjusting it away; 785b extends this to a second incumbent identity to test channel-agnosticism. Control: The endogenous-urgency arm as the confounded reference, plus V3-EXQ-787's exogenous hazard-proximity arm which independently eliminated the near-hazard candidate-geometry rival that produced 785's original 14.1x profile. Required event: Committed selections spanning a wide range of harm-urgency levels, with the commit threshold genuinely moving (785a measured effective_threshold 0.3761 -> 0.2570 over an 8.5x exogenous urgency range, 1757 independent committed selections). DV: Incumbent channel's share of committed-selection score variance as a function of urgency decile, and total committed-selection variance fold across that range; the discriminating statistic is the bottom-versus-top-decile share gap against a +0.02 threshold and rho against +0.6.
FALSIFYING: Incumbent share is flat across urgency deciles with the gate green -- measured: share 0.9375 -> 0.9411, gap +0.0036 against +0.02, rho +0.31 against +0.6, var_total fold 0.970 -- which means the harm-urgency route is causally inert with respect to score geometry and F-dominance is structural, leaving MECH-439 untouched. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Built for this claim and present in code: e3_selector.py retains the per-candidate [K] channel terms UNREDUCED (line 642 and 3915) and surfaces urgency_applied, effective_threshold and commit_variance into last_score_diagnostics (line 4092), all gated on e3_score_decomp_enabled and bit-identical when off. Consumer / boundary: The score geometry at E3's commit gate -- which channel's per-candidate separation the threshold shrinkage selects for -- not behavioural conversion, so the probe does not require a competent agent. Existing ownership: MECH-464, MECH-465, MECH-087, MECH-439, GFLAG-0081, EXP-0119.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); R0: the instrumentation was built, the gate passed green, and the narrowed falsifier fired twice with a replicated null and an independently eliminated rival. The residual is interpretive, not runnability -- under an under-differentiated z_world (participation ratio ~1.06) the per-candidate channels have little to range over, so the null must be read against that rather than unconditionally. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA specifies conditioning 'secondarily on tonic temperature and the D1/D2 da scalar', but the 2026-07-20 user-approved claim-synthesis WITHDREW the blanket three-route premise: D1/D2 reorders candidates in code (_d1_d2_split gains relu(-accum) and relu(+accum) asymmetrically) and now belongs to MECH-464, softmax temperature belongs to MECH-087, and the commit-gate half moved to MECH-465. The claim is narrowed to the harm-urgency threshold route only, and on that scope the decomposition was RUN and returned a tight, replicated null (785a, 785b, rival eliminated by 787). Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-464.subject: selection.d1_d2_opponent_gain_is_order_changing
MECH-464.title: D1/D2 opponent dopamine gain is ORDER-CHANGING, not a uniform scalar: because it gains the promote and suppress populations asymmetrically about zero, a non-zero da can reorder any candidate pair whose loop accumulators straddle zero -- so this route is capable of the behavioural differentiation MECH-463 asserts no global-scalar route can produce.
MECH-464.what_would_answer:
Sweep da EXOGENOUSLY (as V3-EXQ-785a swept urgency) with d1_da_gain / d2_da_gain at their configured values, recording per-candidate loop accumulators and the committed argmin per tick. SUPPORTS if the committed-candidate identity changes with da at a rate exceeding the da == 0 baseline, and if the reordering rate scales with the fraction of candidate pairs whose accumulators straddle zero. REFUTES if the committed identity is invariant to da across the sweep, which would mean the straddle fraction is ~0 in practice and the asymmetry, though real in code, is behaviourally inert. MANDATORY NON-VACUITY GATE: report the straddle fraction. If it is ~0 the run is vacuous and MUST be scored precondition_unmet, not as a null -- without this gate the probe returns a spurious "inert" for a purely structural reason.
[2026-09-24 governance, GFLAG-0450 -- AS-RUN FORM] There is no exogenous da knob (da = tanh(_lcg_value_baseline)), so the executable form is: fix da at a non-zero value by injecting _lcg_value_baseline (precondition |da| >= 0.01) and sweep d1_da_gain / d2_da_gain, which spans the same 1 +/- g*da surface with the two gains moved independently; DV is the within-tick reorder vs the da=0 shadow argmin; exclude d2_gain saturation to 0 (loop silencing, not reordering) as a confound. V3-EXQ-1019 ran this form.

MECH-465.subject: selection.commit_gate_arousal_effect_requires_boundary_regime
MECH-465.title: Arousal's effect on WHETHER commitment fires is expressible only near the commit-gate boundary: in every run to date the gated quantity sits 25-48x below the threshold and commit rate is pinned at 0.99-1.00, so MECH-463's commit-gate prediction is UNTESTED rather than falsified.
MECH-465.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Conjunct (1) headroom -- median gate margin within [0.5, 2.0] on >= 50% of post-warmup fresh-select ticks and per-level commit rate inside [0.05, 0.95] -- and conjunct (2) a PER-SEED dispersion floor set from within-seed data. The pooled 785a figure 0.51 is forbidden as a per-seed bar and must not be reinstated; warmup is excluded by pre-registration.
CONFIRMING: With conjuncts 1-2 green, the residual is signed and above its pre-registered floor on the seed majority -- arousal changes whether commitment fires by a route beyond sliding the bound against a fixed distribution. Manipulation: Graded arousal (SD-011 urgency) across levels, run in a boundary regime obtained either by z_world warmup plus per-cell recalibration (V3-EXQ-1015) or by arming use_variance_tracking_commit_threshold with q, window, precision_ema_alpha and the E3 cadence pre-registered. Control: The urgency-off arm supplies the empirical running-variance CDF from which the counterfactual commit rate at each level's shifted threshold is computed; that counterfactual IS the control, not a second live arm. Required event: Post-warmup fresh-select ticks in a regime where the commit gate is near its boundary, so that commitment can both fire and fail to fire within the same run. DV: The RESIDUAL commit rate -- observed minus the rate predicted by evaluating the OFF arm's empirical rv CDF at each level's shifted threshold -- signed and scored against a pre-registered floor, per seed.
FALSIFYING: With conjuncts 1-2 green, the residual is indistinguishable from zero: arousal slid the bound and nothing else happened, which makes the commit-gate half of MECH-463 empty beyond arithmetic. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: experiments/_lib/baselines/mech465_zworld_warmup_dispersion.py already pins the conjunct-1 bands (P1_BAND 0.05-0.95, GATE_MARGIN_BAND 0.5-2.0) and V3-EXQ-1015 records per-cell commit rates; the counterfactual-CDF residual computation has never been implemented in a driver. Consumer / boundary: Whether commitment fires at all (the E3 commit gate crossing), not the identity of the winning candidate and not the sharpness of the committed distribution. Existing ownership: MECH465-COMMIT-GATE-HEADROOM, EXP-0590, ARC-029, MECH-463.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); No build gates the residual-DV run, but EXP-0590 is still gated, the per-seed dispersion floor is unregistered, and the multiplicative urgency route re-saturates under the new quantile bar (occupancy 0.974 at urgency_applied ~0.2), so the manipulation may need the deliberately-unbuilt quantile-shift form. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Two load-bearing statements have been overtaken. (1) REACHABILITY -- OPEN, AND MEASURED NEGATIVE: the confirmed V3-EXQ-1015 autopsy (2026-09-09) found conjunct (1)'s commit-rate band reached in 6 of 15 cells on 2 of 3 seeds, set pending_retest_after_substrate false and recorded that NO BUILD gates the conjunct-3 experiment. (2) ARC-029's variance-tracking commit bar landed 2026-09-18 and makes commit occupancy a settable quantile rather than a saturated absolute bar, which is precisely the headroom the substrate entry was minted for. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-466.subject: architecture.event_relative_temporal_grammar
MECH-466.title: Event-relative coordination exceeds clock-relative coordination: cross-stream alignment measured around event boundaries, commitment onset, interruption, completion and offline transitions is stronger than alignment by wall-clock timestep. If so, the boundary stream is the coordination substrate for the whole federation, not merely a detector with a consumer.
MECH-466.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Boundary pulses must be non-degenerate -- boundary rate neither floor- nor ceiling-pinned -- and per-signal freshness must be respected: E3-derived streams are held stale on 9 of every 10 env ticks, so a clock-locked comparison run over duplicated samples finds sampler-artefact structure (Q-081 Outcome B) rather than coordination.
CONFIRMING: Event-locked alignment exceeds clock-locked by more than max(absolute floor, the scaled SD of the paired delta), with the boundary-rate non-degeneracy guard green. Manipulation: Alignment reference only: the SAME recorded traces are re-analysed event-locked versus clock-locked, plus the q081 landmark-removal arm that ablates the landmark stream while keeping the agent able to act. Control: Clock-locked alignment on the identical traces at identical seeds, and the landmark-removal arm from experiments/_lib/q081_landmark_removal.py as the confound check. Required event: Landmark events in a running episode -- MECH-288 event-segmenter boundary pulses, beta commitment onset, interruption and completion, mode transitions, and (the untested class) sleep-phase transitions with use_sleep_loop True. DV: Cross-stream alignment (event-triggered-average style statistic over full-width latent streams) computed event-locked minus clock-locked, with the margin scaled on the SD of the paired DELTA plus an absolute floor.
FALSIFYING: Event-locked alignment does not exceed clock-locked by that margin with the guard green -- which is what V3-EXQ-831 measured for the WAKING-ONLY scope (delta -0.091 against a 0.171 floor, 3/3 valid seeds). A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: BUILT: experiments/_lib/stream_recorder.py records every stream at full width with per-signal freshness flags, q081_pair_reach_check.py and q081_landmark_removal.py supply the guards, and V3-EXQ-831 already computed both alignments on one set of traces. Consumer / boundary: The federation-wide coordination substrate -- whether the boundary stream, rather than the wall clock, is what aligns processes running at different characteristic timescales. Existing ownership: MECH-466, MECH-288, Q-081, EXP-0082.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); Nothing blocks it. Every landmark and the recorder exist, the waking-only leg has already been fired and returned a clean weakens, and the sleep-phase-transition landmark class only needs a lettered follow-up with use_sleep_loop True. Secondary classes: none. Gap disposition: NO GAP -- FALSE POSITIVE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-467.subject: attention.distractor_failure_mode_dissociation
MECH-467.title: Distractor resistance has THREE dissociable failure modes -- sensory capture (distractor enters/dominates the active representation), rule corruption (distractor overwrites or destabilises the active goal/rule/task context), and behavioural capture (rule survives intact but the distractor still controls action selection). REE's distractor evidence covers rule corruption ONLY; a system can pass rule-corruption tests while failing behavioural capture.
MECH-467.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Distractors must be encoded, rule-state discriminability must be verified, and enough actual target-choice events must occur in every cell. Use realised eligible-tick denominators and instrument stepping clones, not their warmup parents.
CONFIRMING: At least one condition elevates wrong-target selection while rule drift stays at floor, with sensory capture and target opportunity verified. Manipulation: Separately stress sensory capture, rule maintenance and rule-to-action selection. Control: No distractor and matched distractor salience with the correct rule independently verified. Required event: Distractor exposure during held-out target selection. DV: Sensory-capture rate, rule-state drift and wrong-target selection conditional on intact rule, each with its own denominator.
FALSIFYING: Adequately powered, non-degenerate perturbations fail to dissociate the three stages; all-floor or no-target-event runs are uninformative. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: 874b/940/941 battery exists; confirmed autopsies identify deficient exposure/event denominators and a parent-versus-clone writer false positive. Consumer / boundary: Sensory registration -> rule state -> committed target choice; all three separately. Existing ownership: mech467_legc_event_denominator_cause, MECH-439.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Target-event denominator/realised exposure remains the binding gate; policy/cadence hypotheses are owned elsewhere and cannot justify another same-design run. R2 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-468.subject: hippocampus.anchor_topology_functional_information
MECH-468.title: Hippocampal anchor TOPOLOGY carries functional information not present in local anchor payloads. REE's typed relations (spatial, temporal, action-transition, event, goal, valence, social, schema, staleness, scale) are each realised as a payload field, a gate, or a scoring term -- a property of an anchor or proposal -- and none is exposed as an EDGE TYPE over the anchor set. Nothing tests whether the topology carries information beyond local anchor features.
MECH-468.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Recoverable anchor identities, nontrivial edge densities per relation, payloads and independent held-out functional labels; no empty/full adjacency and no labels constructed from the tested edges.
CONFIRMING: Payload+topology beats payload alone and shuffled-topology controls on held-out labels. Manipulation: Add typed topology to a payload-only predictor. Control: Payloads alone; randomise topology preserving payloads; preserve topology while shuffling payloads. Required event: Logged anchor creation, transitions, shared events and outcomes over multiple contexts. DV: Held-out functional-label prediction delta from topology beyond payloads, with an independently preregistered absolute floor and cross-seed delta-SD margin.
FALSIFYING: With recoverable nontrivial relations and valid labels, topology adds no predictive information or its advantage vanishes under leakage controls. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: AnchorSet stores payloads and timestamps, not an explicit typed-edge trace. The registered edge-type inventory must establish which relations are recoverable from logs before a test. Consumer / boundary: Retrospective functional readout only; this does not establish native graph representation or action access. Existing ownership: MECH-468, REE_assembly/evidence/planning/thought_intake_2026-07-19_multiple_relational_graph_organisations_hippocampal.md.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); Typed projection/recoverability instrument is not delivered by the existence of AnchorSet; the scoping spike is already registered in the intake. R1 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-469.subject: hippocampus.relation_type_noncollapsibility
MECH-469.title: Relation types are NOT collapsible to one adjacency structure: collapsing all edge types into a single adjacency, or removing event / goal-motivational edges, or removing action-transition directionality, degrades functional-label recovery.
