The same non-collapsibility argument as MECH-069 (error incommensurability), one level down.
MECH-469.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-468's nontrivial recoverable typed relations and independent labels; demonstrate predictor sensitivity using a positive control, not by requiring the scientific ablation itself to succeed.
CONFIRMING: Type-specific ablations lose useful prediction beyond capacity and payload controls. Manipulation: Collapse all edge types; remove event/goal edges; remove action-transition directionality. Control: Full typed topology, topology-randomised/payload-fixed and topology-fixed/payload-shuffled arms. Required event: Same held-out functional tasks over the same anchor traces. DV: Loss of held-out functional prediction under type collapse relative to full topology at matched model capacity.
FALSIFYING: Collapsed adjacency performs equivalently under an instrument shown sensitive by an independent positive control; do not classify that intended null as unmet preconditions. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Shares the uncompleted typed-edge recovery inventory and projection recorder with MECH-468. Consumer / boundary: Retrospective typed-relation readout, not hippocampal biological storage format. Existing ownership: MECH-468, MECH-469.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The typed projection recorder is missing; the old requirement that an ablation must move the metric risks excluding the falsifying result. R1 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-470.subject: hippocampus.topological_ghost_goal_reactivation_ranking
MECH-470.title: Topological position improves ghost-goal reactivation ranking: MECH-292/293 rank inactive anchors by preserved-goal-payload match; adding a topological term (relational distance to the current anchor along typed paths) improves reactivation precision. An anchor's functional role -- gateway, bottleneck, recurrent trap, interruption point, repair opportunity -- may be inferable from its POSITION even when its local payload is incomplete.
MECH-470.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The ghost bank must be non-empty and the payload-only baseline ranking non-degenerate (not all ties) in both arms, and the topology must have actually accumulated edges -- edges are written only on observed anchor-family remap succession, so a run with few remaps yields an empty relation store and a bit-identical ON arm.
CONFIRMING: With the bank non-empty and the baseline non-degenerate, the payload-plus-topology arm ranks the task-designated anchors higher than the payload-only arm at matched seeds, and the improvement survives restriction to entries admitted through a relation rather than on their own goal_match. Manipulation: use_possibility_topology ON versus OFF: with it ON, GhostGoalBank.rank admits the enables successors of floor-clearing anchors with the goal_match_floor waived and scores them with a relation channel (relation_weight * edge.weight * parent_goal_match), changing which regions _propose_ghost_seeded probes. Control: The payload-only arm (topology OFF), which the build guarantees is bit-identical to the pre-SD-097 four-term ranking, at matched seeds, config and anchor pool. Required event: Goal pursuit after reward relocation or path blockage, with payload-bearing inactive anchors in the SD-039 pool and recorded anchor-remap successions available as enables edges. DV: Reactivation precision -- the fraction of the top-k ranked anchors that are the ones the task says should be reactivated (for example anchors on the formerly valid approach path after relocation) -- plus the ghost-probe hit rate downstream; not the raw ghost_priority, whose magnitude is explicitly uncalibrated.
FALSIFYING: Ranking precision is unchanged or worse with the topology on; or the relational admissions are all low-value successors that displace better direct matches from the top-k; or the two arms are indistinguishable because no enables edges were written. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: GhostGoalBank.get_diagnostics, the per-entry component breakdown and relation_provenance all record the ranking and its relational admissions. What is absent is a ground-truth should-be-reactivated label from causal_grid_world, so ranking precision currently has no referent to be scored against. Consumer / boundary: HippocampalModule._propose_ghost_seeded -- which anchors' z_world seed the CEM probes, i.e. where the agent actually looks, not an internal score. Existing ownership: SD-097, MECH-292, MECH-293, EXP-1074.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The topological term is built, wired and default-OFF (SD-097, ree-v3 a902639 on origin/main; config field use_possibility_topology; module.py constructs and attaches it), so the manipulation exists. The missing element is measurement: no environment emits a ground-truth reactivation-correctness label, so a ranking-precision DV cannot be computed today. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-471.subject: learning.competence_update_bounded_provenance_rollback
MECH-471.title: Behavioural-competence updates require the same BOUNDED / PROVENANCED / ROLLBACK-CAPABLE discipline already registered for consolidation. MECH-392, INV-080 and MECH-401 give the memory-consolidation path bounded, attributable, provenance-carrying, rollback-capable, over-rewrite-gated editing; NOTHING EQUIVALENT is registered for behavioural competence -- policy / affordance / action-object learning has no rollback, no provenance record, and no gate against a single successful rollout propagating widely.
MECH-471.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The 'unrelated' competences must be DEMONSTRABLY ACQUIRED in the baseline -- above-floor performance with live cross-seed variance. This is currently unmet: acquisition clear-rate is a reproducible ~12.5% (2 of 16 seeds in V3-EXQ-875a, corroborated on overlapping seeds by MECH-472's V3-EXQ-882a). Interference measured against competences the agent never had is vacuous and self-routes substrate_not_ready.
CONFIRMING: On seeds with demonstrably acquired unrelated competences, a targeted local update measurably degrades those unrelated competences across a perturbation range -- which SUPPORTS MECH-471 and motivates building the discipline. Manipulation: Train a targeted competence improvement (a local update to one competence) with a perturbation range, holding the training budget and zworld_p0 warmup fixed at V3-EXQ-728's validated recipe. Control: The same agent and seeds without the targeted update, plus a matched-magnitude update applied to an unrelated parameter set, so degradation is attributable to the local update rather than to continued training. Required event: An agent that has reliably acquired at least two separable competences, then receives a targeted local update to one of them. DV: Change in performance on the UNRELATED previously-acquired competences after the targeted update, measured against each seed's own pre-update level, with the acquisition-clear-rate reported per seed so a floor-bound seed cannot contribute a spurious null.
FALSIFYING: With acquisition demonstrated, unrelated competence does not degrade across the perturbation range -- the competence path does not need bounded/provenanced/rollback discipline, and the consolidation-path analogy does not generalise. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The interference drivers exist (ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_875a_mech471_competence_provenance.py; the acquisition characterisation is v3_exq_890_mech471_acquisition_reliability_probe.py) and the zworld_p0 warmup lint contract guards the V3-EXQ-875 defect; the missing instrument is a per-seed acquisition gate that admits only seeds above the competence floor. Consumer / boundary: The behavioural-competence learning path -- policy, affordance and action-object updates -- as contrasted with the consolidation path, which already has bounded/provenanced/rollback discipline. Existing ownership: EXP-0068, EXP-0399, MECH-457, mech471_competence_acquisition_reliability, orienting_epistemic_deficit_v3:ORNT-4.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The non-degeneracy precondition is unmet: only ~12.5% of seeds acquire the survival competence the falsifier must interfere WITH, so an interference null cannot be distinguished from never having had the competence. EXP-0068 is held blocked_substrate on exactly this release condition, and the V3-EXQ-890 autopsy refuses an /implement-substrate build ahead of the MECH-457 synthesis. Secondary classes: R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-472.subject: learning.heldout_context_acquisition_vs_memorisation
MECH-472.title: HELD-OUT CONTEXT distinguishes skill acquisition from task memorisation: a competence update should be promoted to durable only on evidence from contexts that did not generate it.
MECH-472.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The ACQUISITION FLOOR is the non-degeneracy guard and it is the binding one: held-out contexts must be genuinely reachable by the trained policy (non-zero baseline completion) on a majority of seeds. V3-EXQ-882a cleared it on 2 of 8 seeds at the lowest exposure, with the other 6 not approaching it even at 10x budget, so a measured gap would be a floor artefact.
CONFIRMING: With the acquisition floor cleared on the pre-registered seed majority, the held-out gap opens with exposure beyond its threshold while staying near zero at low exposure: the gate discriminates memorisation from acquisition. Manipulation: Paired in-context versus held-out-context evaluation of the SAME competence across an exposure sweep, with zworld_p0_episodes=60 supplied to the acquisition call (the V3-EXQ-728/875a validated operating point) so z_world is not a frozen random projection. Control: The in-context arm at matched exposure and seeds is the paired control; the exposure sweep itself supplies the second control (a memorisation gap should open with exposure, a difficulty gap should not). Required event: A learned competence reaching criterion in its training contexts, then being evaluated unchanged in contexts that did not generate it. DV: The paired in-context minus held-out completion gap per seed as a function of exposure, scored against a pre-registered threshold and required to be seed-majority consistent rather than pooled.
FALSIFYING: With the floor cleared, the gap stays flat across the whole exposure sweep -- the held-out contrast carries no information about memorisation and the proposed promotion gate would not be usable. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: BUILT: experiments/v3_exq_882a_mech472_context_memorization_generalization.py carries the paired evaluation, the acquisition-floor gate and the exposure sweep; both confirmed defects of the first run (frozen z_world, worst-of-3-seed veto) were fixed and verified applied. Consumer / boundary: The competence-update promotion decision -- whether an update earns durable status -- not episode reward and not any single evaluation score. Existing ownership: MECH-471, MECH-457, EXP-0400, mech471_competence_acquisition_reliability.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The agent does not reliably acquire the competence at all: 6 of 8 seeds never reach the acquisition floor even at 10x exposure, so the decisive in-context/held-out comparison has never been reachable. The blocker is MECH-471 acquisition reliability, not this claim's instrument. Secondary classes: none. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-473.subject: learning.rejected_adaptation_memory
MECH-473.title: REJECTED-ADAPTATION MEMORY improves later recovery and transfer: retaining failed behavioural revisions together with their failure conditions improves adaptation when conditions later change. A failed adaptation should remain available as evidence about what was tried, why it failed, and under what conditions it might later become useful.
MECH-473.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION:
(P1) A competence-revision unit exists: a structure that, when a behavioural revision is attempted
  and then REJECTED (reverted / not retained as the live policy), records that revision's content
  together with the conditions under which it failed, addressable later. V3 has no such structure --
  residue (INV-004/INV-006) retains the consequences of COMMITTED actions only; MECH-392's
  contradiction-flagging applies to consolidated summaries, not to in-flight rejected revisions; a
  2026-09-25 grep of ree_core/ for competence-revision / rejected-adaptation vocabulary returns zero
  hits. This is a new structure, not a re-description of an existing one -- confirmed, not merely
  asserted by the claim's own notes.
(P2) A CONDITION-REVERSAL task exists: an environment where a previously-adaptive behaviour becomes
  maladaptive, is abandoned under the new conditions, and the OLD conditions later recur (same or a
  transfer episode) -- so the shelved, rejected revision is exactly the one that would help again.
(P3) The competence(s) under test are reliably ACQUIRED above floor before rejection/reversal is
  measured. This is currently the harder gate: MECH-471's own R5 disposition (acquisition clear-rate
  ~12.5% of seeds, V3-EXQ-875a/890) means even the acquisition precondition this task design would
  need is itself unmet on V3 today, compounding the block beyond the missing store.
A null under any unmet precondition is uninterpretable, not evidence against.

CONFIRMING: at matched training budget and matched competence-acquisition rate, an arm WITH the
rejected-adaptation store re-adapts faster (fewer episodes/updates to recover the old behaviour) than
a matched arm without the store, when the old conditions recur.

FALSIFYING: with P1-P3 met, the store confers no recovery advantage, or a recovery DISADVANTAGE (the
retained rejected-adaptation content actively slows re-adaptation, i.e. dead weight) -- this is
CARRIED CO-EQUALLY per the claim's own text, an informative negative rather than an ambiguous one.

BLOCKING: V4-scoped by registration; competence-revision unit does not exist in V3 (confirmed
2026-09-25). DO NOT build or queue against this in V3, consistent with the claim's own notes.
ASSEMBLY-SIDE ANALOGUE (per the claim's notes, GOV-REJECT-1) is an analogy only, never evidence, and
is not used above.

MECH-474.subject: learning.regime_meta_selection_narrow
MECH-474.title: LEARNING-MECHANISM META-SELECTION (narrow form): the control plane selects among the learning regimes REE actually has -- online practice, exploration, counterfactual simulation, offline consolidation -- rather than applying one learning rule universally, and this selection is state- and mode-dependent.
MECH-474.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (three parts, all mandatory, checked BEFORE any verdict is read).
(P1) Every fixed arm must be a real learning path. Each regime named in the registered menu must, when pinned, actually change parameters. This is currently FALSE for "counterfactual simulation": `REEAgent._do_replay` (`ree_core/agent.py:10501`) discards its replay trajectories (dead assignment, no update), MECH-319's `simulation_mode_rule_gate` suppresses arbitration-weight writes during ghost/replay/DMN passes, `GhostGoalBank` carries no trainable parameters, and the only replay that drives updates lives inside `run_rem_attribution_pass` -- which IS regime 4 (offline consolidation), not regime 3. A pinned regime-3 arm is therefore a structurally inert no-learning arm and `experiments/_lib/precondition_gate.assert_no_structurally_unsatisfiable_gate` must refuse the run. Until the registered menu is adjudicated (narrowed to three, or MECH-094 revisited), this precondition cannot be met and NO verdict on MECH-474 is admissible.
(P2) The task mix must actually dissociate the regimes. In the FIXED-ARM baseline, run first and read before the selecting arm ever runs, at least two distinct regimes must each win on a DIFFERENT sub-task, each win exceeding a margin scaled on the SD of the per-sub-task delta across seeds plus an absolute floor. If one regime dominates every sub-task there is nothing to select between: report `substrate_not_ready_requeue`, not a verdict. Prior evidence says do not assume this: the offline-consolidation regime, on the only substrate that instruments it (SD-083, `experiments/_lib/mech457_offline_consolidation.py`), produced `weakens` on both V3-EXQ-836d and V3-EXQ-836e.
(P3) The selector must be observed to switch. Log the realised regime-choice distribution per seed and per sub-task. A selector whose distribution is degenerate (one regime above a pre-registered occupancy ceiling, e.g. >0.9 of decision points, or entropy below a pre-registered floor) is a fixed arm wearing a different label; its result is not evidence about selection and must be reported as degenerate, not as PASS or FAIL.

CONFIRMING (MECH-474 supported). With P1-P3 met, the selecting arm's per-sub-task and aggregate performance beats EVERY fixed-regime arm, not merely their mean, by a margin scaled on the SD of the DELTA (paired across shared seeds) plus an absolute floor. The every-regime bar is load-bearing and is not negotiable: beating the mean is satisfied by a selector that always picks the single best fixed regime, which demonstrates no selection at all. Additionally, the selector's realised choice must covary with the state/mode variable the claim names -- i.e. the regime chosen on sub-task X differs systematically from the regime chosen on sub-task Y, in the direction the fixed-arm baseline (P2) says each sub-task rewards. A selector that beats every fixed arm while choosing at random or choosing invariantly with state supports "an ensemble helps", not "the control plane selects".

FALSIFYING (one universal learning rule suffices). With P1-P3 met, the selecting arm fails to beat the best fixed regime -- i.e. its aggregate falls within, or below, the margin band around the best single fixed arm -- on a mix the baseline has DEMONSTRABLY shown to dissociate the regimes. This is a clean, decision-relevant negative: regime meta-selection buys nothing at this granularity, and REE should keep applying one learning rule with the mode-conditioned write gating it already has (MECH-261). A second, weaker falsifying pattern: the selector beats every fixed arm but P3's choice distribution shows it collapsed onto the single best regime -- that falsifies *selection* while leaving the ensemble result intact, and must be reported as such rather than as support.

MECH-475.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.baseline_informativeness
MECH-475.title: uninformative_value_baseline_makes_optimisation_iatrogenic. In REE's MECH-457 actor-critic pathway the value baseline is UNINFORMATIVE on the policy's own state distribution, so the advantage carries variance rather than signal and ADDED OPTIMISATION PRESSURE IS IATROGENIC: policy capacity, training budget, an earned intrinsic approach drive, environmental reward-coupling and post-installation RL refinement each drive competence BELOW THEIR OWN CONTROLS rather than plateauing beneath a ceiling, and the magnitude of the loss tracks baseline uninformativeness rather than the identity of the intervention. Measured mechanism: V3-EXQ-782 R-(b) reads the shared CTRL critic at std(V)/std(G) = 0.041 against a 0.25 collapse threshold and a pre-reward-vs-far separation ratio of 0.016 against a 0.25 floor -- an unbaselined high-variance advantage. A ceiling plateaus; this does not.
MECH-475.what_would_answer: Two readouts, in decreasing order of decisiveness. (a) REVERSAL -- the decisive test. Re-run the three destructive ACQUISITION-side treatments (V3-EXQ-769 capacity/budget, V3-EXQ-781 approach drive, V3-EXQ-771 metabolic coupling) with the V3-EXQ-788 DISTRIBUTIONAL CRITIC in place, everything else byte-identical to the original arm, on the non-regressed reference build (128-wide / 3x budget / z_world detached / credit-replay 3 / topk 32). SUPPORTED if the treatment-below-control inversion REVERSES OR FLATTENS in at least 2 of 3. WEAKENED if treatments still land below their own controls with an informative baseline -- the destructiveness is then not the baseline's doing and this claim is WITHDRAWN (it does not degrade into a weaker version; the whole content is the causal attribution). (b) DOSE -- the cheap standing readout. Record std(V)/std(G) and the pre-reward-vs-far separation ratio as DECLARED COVARIATES on every arm of every future MECH-457-family run, and test whether the control->treatment competence DELTA is predicted by baseline informativeness across instances. SUPPORTED if the correlation holds and is signed as predicted; a null here is weak evidence only (n is small and the five existing instances differ on many axes at once). MANDATORY on both: TRAJECTORY, not terminal competence. This signature is invisible to terminal-only measurement, which is precisely what hid it across nineteen autopsy targets -- every one of which recorded the numbers that show it. NON-DEGENERACY GUARD: an arm whose control did not itself clear the readiness anchors cannot exhibit a treatment-below-control inversion and must self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a reversal verdict.

MECH-476.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.acquisition_retention_dissociation
MECH-476.title: competence_retention_dissociable_from_acquisition. ACQUIRING competence and RETAINING it are dissociable capabilities with separate substrate requirements: REE has the first and lacks the second. Behavioural cloning installs foraging competence at 20.933 on raw_view (3/3 seeds took) and 32.72 on z_world, and unconstrained RL refinement then ERODES it to 11.667 -- while a distributional critic (V3-EXQ-788, retains 1.839) and a KL anchor to the installed snapshot (V3-EXQ-792, retains 0.778 vs 0.525 unconstrained, still plastic) each preserve it. Retention is supplied by properties of the VALUE ESTIMATOR and the UPDATE CONSTRAINT, NOT by continued demonstration (V3-EXQ-789 eliminates the imitation-auxiliary schedule axis at every setting). COROLLARY, and the claim's distinctive testable content: consolidation is properly defined as RESISTANCE TO RETROGRADE INTERFERENCE (Krakauer 2005), hence dependent on install DOSE and elapsed offline INTERVAL -- neither of which REE has ever varied.
MECH-476.what_would_answer: An A -> B -> A RETROGRADE-INTERFERENCE design, the standard consolidation assay (Krakauer 2005). A = BC-install competence; B = an interfering unconstrained-RL phase; then re-measure A. Vary the TWO factors REE has never varied: INSTALL DOSE (BC episodes) and A->B INTERVAL (offline steps before refinement begins). DV: retained-fraction TRAJECTORY, never terminal competence. SUPPORTED if resistance to interference GROWS with install dose and/or with the A->B interval -- retention is then a dose/time-dependent consolidation PROCESS, and the build target is a consolidation window rather than a larger constraint coefficient. WEAKENED if retained fraction is INVARIANT to both and tracks only the concurrent constraint coefficient -- there is then no consolidation process and this claim is withdrawn into MECH-459/460. THIRD ARM, from the behavioural-tagging literature (Moncada & Viola 2007) and cheap because REE already owns the signal: pair the install with a NOVELTY episode (the landed RND drive) inside the consolidation window. Behavioural tagging predicts a WEAK install that would not otherwise persist becomes durable when a novelty exposure falls close in time. SUPPORTED if a sub-threshold BC dose consolidates only in the novelty-paired condition. This arm is the sharpest available discrimination between "consolidation process" and "regulariser", because a regulariser has no reason to care about an unrelated novelty exposure. PREREQUISITE, inherited from the retention portfolio and NON-NEGOTIABLE: an install that did not take is UNINFORMATIVE about retention and must self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a retention verdict. Bands: floor 1.0, RND plateau 5.22, lift target 13.05, BC-expert 32.72, local_view_greedy 48.05, greedy_oracle 57.2, random_walk 0.933.

MECH-477.subject: goal_directed.uncertainty_based_control_arbitration
MECH-477.title: dual_system_uncertainty_arbitration. Differential recruitment between the habit and the hippocampally-planned goal-directed pathways is produced by an explicit ARBITRATION element that reads the two pathways' relative uncertainty/reliability and reallocates control accordingly -- NOT by the mere presence of two pathways. Two pathways WITHOUT an arbitrator produce a FLAT recruitment response regardless of context novelty. Registered 2026-07-22 as the control-allocation mechanism MECH-163 presupposed but never named; MECH-163 conflated ARCHITECTURE (two pathways exist) with DYNAMICS (control shifts between them with novelty, uncertainty and practice).
MECH-477.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Familiarity discriminability must clear the pre-registered AUC bar (0.7; 786a measured 0.848) so novel and familiar contexts really differ; the habit read must be taken at HABIT_DEPTH 2 with its own range and distinct-value-fraction gates, defeating the 786a constant-vector degeneracy; and the mandatory manipulation check must show the arbitration weight VARYING with measured uncertainty, otherwise the run is a readiness failure that scores nothing.
CONFIRMING: The novel-minus-familiar recruitment delta is strictly greater with the arbitrator ON than OFF on a strict majority of divergent seeds with the ON-arm delta clearing its robustness margin -- which V3-EXQ-811a measured (6 of 7 divergent seeds, Cohen d 0.999 ON versus -0.158 OFF, lower bound 0.097 against margin 0.02). Manipulation: SD-081 dual-system uncertainty arbitration OFF versus ON (e3.dualsystem_uncertainty_arbitration, default OFF and bit-identical when OFF), holding the familiarity manipulation, habit depth and every other config constant across arms. Control: The bit-identical arbitrator-OFF arm at matched seeds -- freshly run rather than inherited from 786a -- plus the per-cell readiness controls on the habit vector's own range and distinct-value fraction that the 811 aggregation bug spuriously tripped. Required event: Trials that differ in context novelty, so the hippocampally-planned pathway and the habit pathway differ in their relative predictive reliability and there is something for an arbitrator to reallocate over. DV: The novel-minus-familiar differential recruitment delta between the two pathways, compared ON versus OFF, with the paired (uncertainty, weight) series from E3Selector.last_arbitration as the manipulation check that the arbitrator is live.
FALSIFYING: With the arbitrator demonstrably live on the manipulation check and the AUC bar met, the ON arm reproduces the OFF arm's flat response (delta within noise of zero, d below 0.1) -- two pathways plus an explicit uncertainty-reading arbitrator still produce no differential recruitment, so the arbitration element is not what allocates control. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Built and exercised: SD-081 in ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py with last_arbitration exposing the uncertainty-weight pairs, the canonical cell experiments/_lib/baselines/mech477_dualsystem_arbitration.py, the pinned manipulation-check contract in tests/contracts/test_sd081_dualsystem_arbitration.py, and the two-arm driver V3-EXQ-811a which produced a scored PASS. Consumer / boundary: The arbitration weight over the habit-pathway and planned-pathway contributions to E3 selection -- the allocation boundary, distinct from ARC-071's slow planned-to-habitual transfer. Existing ownership: SD-081, V3-EXQ-811a, MECH-163, GFLAG-0106, GFLAG-0109.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); Nothing blocks it. Substrate, manipulation check, canonical cell, contract and both arms all exist, and V3-EXQ-811a already returned a scored PASS. The only live defects are bookkeeping: the WWA still instructs reuse of the degenerate 786a OFF arm, and the claim carries candidate status while a first genuine supporting run is on file. Secondary classes: none. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's closing clause -- 'NOTE the OFF arm is already measured: V3-EXQ-786a IS that arm' -- was falsified by measurement: the confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-786a_2026-07-24_dv_degeneracy showed 786a's recruitment DV was a constant first-step vector across all 32 candidates, so it measured tie-break noise and returns a flat between-condition delta whether or not an arbitrator exists. Both arms had to be re-run fresh at HABIT_DEPTH 2, which V3-EXQ-811/811a did; the OFF-arm reuse instruction must be withdrawn rather than left standing for the next lineage. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-478.subject: goal_directed.long_horizon_benefit_accumulation
MECH-478.title: long_horizon_benefit_requires_model_based_rollout. Sustained benefit accumulation is a TRAJECTORY property, not a single-contact event, and is therefore reachable only by goal-seeded multi-step rollout; a 1-step greedy or value-flat-proposal policy cannot navigate toward it. Split out of MECH-163 leg (2) on 2026-07-22 because it carries a blocker of its own -- ARC-007 STRICT value-flat proposals -- entirely unrelated to the blockers on MECH-163 legs (1) and (3), and was inheriting MECH-163's V3-EXQ-786a weakens without ever having been tested.
MECH-478.what_would_answer: GATED on an ARC-007 relaxation supplying goal-seeded proposal generation (the MECH-292 / MECH-293 ghost-goal path is the registered candidate route). Then: an environment in which the cumulative-benefit optimum DIVERGES from the greedy-contact optimum, with the divergence verified as a property of the environment by a manipulation check on the environment itself, not on the agent. SUPPORTED if the goal-seeded arm accumulates strictly higher INTEGRATED benefit than the value-flat arm on >= 2/3 seeds WHILE MATCHED ON CONTACT COUNT -- the matching is load-bearing, since an unmatched advantage is consistent with the planned arm simply foraging more. REFUTED if integrated benefit is equal or lower with goal-seeded rollout demonstrably live and the two optima demonstrably divergent.

MECH-479.subject: goal_directed.prosocial_trajectory_planning
MECH-479.title: prosocial_planning_requires_planned_system. Planning trajectories that affect ANOTHER agent's z_harm_a accumulation and benefit_exposure over time is structurally inaccessible to a 1-step greedy policy and requires the hippocampally-planned pathway. Split out of MECH-163 leg (3) on 2026-07-22 and REFILED implementation_phase v3 -> v4: there is no V3 substrate for it whatsoever -- no second agent exists, hence no other-agent z_harm_a to plan over. Arguably the clearest single piece of granularity debt in MECH-163, since the leg had been carrying a V3 implementation_phase it could not possibly satisfy since 2026-04-02.
MECH-479.what_would_answer: GATED on the V4 multi-agent substrate. SUPPORTED if a planned-arm agent reduces a SECOND agent's integrated z_harm_a relative to a greedy-arm agent on >= 2/3 seeds, WITH ITS OWN RESOURCE ACQUISITION MATCHED -- the matching is load-bearing, otherwise the effect is confounded by the planned agent simply being better at everything. REFUTED if planned and greedy arms are indistinguishable on the other agent's integrated harm, with both arms demonstrably able to PERCEIVE the other agent (mandatory manipulation check; without it a null is a perception failure, not a planning failure).

MECH-480.subject: cingulate.lofc_execution_gain_dissociation
MECH-480.title: LOFC-analog execution-gain channel is dissociable from dACC-analog (SD-032b) strategy authority: how strongly a persisting policy is expressed should be modeled as a control channel distinct from whether the policy retains behavioural-adjustment authority.
MECH-480.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Every seed-by-arm cell must survive past the contingency switch by a pre-registered minimum number of post-switch steps, with execution_strength non-NaN in every cell, AND the OFF-ablation logit margin must show non-zero cross-arm/cross-seed variance. A cell failing either is substrate_not_ready, not a verdict.
CONFIRMING: Outcome-sensitivity degrades under ablation while execution strength is statistically unchanged at matched effect size, in every cell that clears the post-switch survival floor -- the two channels vary independently. Manipulation: Ablate SD-032b's dACC-analog adjustment-magnitude output by setting dacc_weight=0 versus dacc_weight>0, leaving action selection and E3 scoring otherwise intact. Control: The dacc_weight>0 arm at matched seeds, episode budget and switch step, with post_switch_toward_new_frac and the logit margin read over an identical post-switch window in both arms. Required event: A reward-contingency change mid-episode (resource geometry mirrored at the switch step) while a policy is already persisting, so that outcome-sensitivity and execution strength can be read on the same post-switch window. DV: (i) outcome-sensitivity: post-switch fraction of realized displacement toward the newly-favoured region, ON minus OFF; (ii) execution strength: logit margin / softmax confidence of the committed action, deliberately not requiring committed-action diversity.
FALSIFYING: Both degrade together at matched effect size under every ablation tried, in cells that clear the survival floor -- the execution-gain channel is not separably implemented and the claim folds back into SD-032b. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: experiments/v3_exq_870a_mech480_dacc_execution_gain_dissociation.py computes both DVs (post_switch_toward_new_frac, execution_strength) over [SWITCH_STEP, STEPS_PER_EP); ree_core/cingulate/dacc.py applies dacc_weight to the E3 score bias, so the manipulation reaches the intended module. Consumer / boundary: The dACC-analog score-bias contribution to E3 action selection -- the boundary between whether the policy retains adjustment authority and how strongly it is expressed -- not episode reward. Existing ownership: EXP-0413, EXP-1375, SD-032b, MECH-260, MECH-258.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The routed redesign was never queued: no V3-EXQ-870b script, queue entry or manifest exists. The one landed run is non-contributory because half its cells ended before the switch, so the execution-strength DV was NaN exactly where it needed to be read. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: V3-EXQ-870a showed the stated non-degeneracy clause (cross-arm variance in the OFF-ablation logit margin) silently passes on cells where the episode ends before the contingency switch: in 3 of 6 seed-by-arm cells episodes terminated at a mean of 8-20 of 80 steps against a switch at step 40, leaving execution_strength NaN and near-zero post-switch data. The precondition must add a minimum-post-switch-steps floor per cell, and the design must guarantee scorable post-switch data (earlier switch or longer budget), or the DV cannot exist. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-481.subject: control_plane.typed_coalition_instantiation
MECH-481.title: Selective cognitive coalition instantiation: the control plane converts typed control demands (e.g. PROVENANCE_CHECK, COUNTERFACTUAL_EXPANSION, SOCIAL_MODEL_CHECK) into temporary functional interaction graphs over E1/E2/hippocampal/reality-coherence/social/language/affective/E3 systems, recruiting only the subsystems relevant to the discrepancy type.
MECH-481.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Three gates witnessed per run, not assumed. (i) TYPE SEPARATION: ARM1 baseline percept_volatility / model_pe must separate perceptual from provenance trials above a pre-registered cluster-separation floor (886 measured 13.29 vs 0.14). (ii) HEADROOM: each doubt type must degrade ARM1_CLEAN performance by more than DEGRADE_FLOOR -- 886 measured the perceptual deficit at ~0, so that arm is inert. (iii) RECOVERABILITY: the agent must be able to repair the deficit within the trial, i.e. carry goal-directed competence above the capability_eval foraging floor and an online-adapting policy, since recruiting a frozen E2 cannot repair a corrupted percept.
CONFIRMING: With competence, headroom and type separation all witnessed, ARM4 recovery exceeds both CTRL_MISMATCH and ARM3 by the pre-registered selectivity margin on the matched problem class AND exceeds ARM2, while ARM4 coalition cost stays below ARM3 -- typing does discriminative work beyond raw recruitment and beyond parametric modulation. Manipulation: Four coalition policies injected at the discrepancy onset through CoalitionController.request_coalition: ARM1 none (monitoring only), ARM2 parametric only (channel_gain on e3_candidate_count, empty recruit/suppress sets), ARM3 untyped (the union of both templates regardless of doubt type), ARM4 typed (SENSORY_RESAMPLE on perceptual trials, PROVENANCE_CHECK on provenance trials). Control: ARM1_CLEAN (no perturbation) as the no-doubt performance reference, plus CTRL_MISMATCH -- the deliberately wrong template per doubt type -- which isolates type SELECTIVITY from any-coalition-helps; identical seeds, env construction, step counts and per-step agent.act/update calls across every arm. Required event: Scripted onset of a persistent, typed epistemic discrepancy mid-episode on a competent agent -- additive Gaussian noise on obs_world (perceptual doubt) or a transposition of the environment action-to-movement map (provenance doubt) -- with the perturbation held to episode end and the pre-onset settle window establishing baseline competence. DV: Post-onset cumulative env reward recovery relative to ARM1 for the MATCHED versus MISMATCHED versus UNTYPED versus PARAMETRIC policy, per doubt type, plus the coalition cost DV (size of the recruited-union-suppressed set plus excess channel gain) for the ARM3-versus-ARM4 over-recruitment contrast.
FALSIFYING: Under the same witnessed preconditions, ARM4 is statistically indistinguishable from ARM3 (typing does no discriminative work) or from ARM2 (parametric modulation suffices and the graph-valued G_t is superfluous), on a strict majority of seeds; a null with the competence or headroom gate unmet is substrate_not_ready, never a verdict. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: V3-EXQ-886 is a complete, strict-validated, smoke-passing recorder: per-cell arm_fingerprint, P1-P4 readiness gates, cost and discrepancy series, and a self-route to substrate_not_ready_requeue. What is missing is the harness it runs on -- a competence baseline (experiments/_lib/capability_eval.py, mech457_bootstrap_explorer.py) and a perturbation whose deficit online engagement can actually repair. Consumer / boundary: The write_gate() and channel_gain() attenuation applied at the eight contract-tested consumer sites (hippocampal_write_consolidation, hippocampal_anchor_set, e3_commitment_monitor, motor_commitment and the rest), i.e. the per-tick processing configuration -- not representational content, reward, or the E3 trajectory choice itself. Existing ownership: SD-091, V3-EXQ-886, GFLAG-0311, GFLAG-0332, MECH-457, f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The falsifier instrument, the substrate and the wiring all exist; the REGIME does not. On the untrained CausalGridWorldV2 harness the perceptual deficit is ~0 and the provenance deficit is unrepairable without within-trial adaptation, so the type-selective recovery DV has nothing to move. Building competence is the MECH-457 conversion-ceiling wall, whose substrate entry is closed wontfix. Secondary classes: R3, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The 4-arm design survives but its single non-degeneracy clause (typed discrepancy signals must vary across trial types) was satisfied ~95x in the V3-EXQ-886 Step-2.5a premise probe while the run stayed uninterpretable for a different reason the WWA never names: the perceptual deficit measured ~0 even at obs-noise sigma 4.0, and the matched PROVENANCE_CHECK coalition made the provenance deficit WORSE, because the agent carries near-zero goal-directed competence and no online within-trial adaptation. A competence-and-recoverability precondition plus the mismatched-template selectivity control must be added. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-482.subject: drive.epistemic_deficit_accumulator
MECH-482.title: epistemic_deficit: a persistent, target-bound accumulator representing unresolved, consequential, potentially-resolvable model inadequacy -- distinct from raw novelty (MECH-314a), raw uncertainty (MECH-314b), transient prediction error, and learning-progress (MECH-314c). Rises with unresolved importance x uncertainty x expected_resolvability x persistence; falls with verified resolution, established irrelevance, or accepted irreducibility.
MECH-482.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a substrate where target-bound
uncertainty can be tracked per-candidate/per-region (MECH-314b is currently
a global scalar per the existing curiosity intake -- not yet built in V3)
AND where cross-seed/cross-condition variance in the accumulator is
non-zero (not floor-pinned at zero or ceiling-saturated) -- below that the
run self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a verdict. CONFIRMING signature
(once built): an unresolved, consequential uncertainty accumulates across
time steps even as raw novelty and instantaneous prediction error fall to
baseline, AND providing diagnostic/resolving evidence specifically quenches
the accumulator (satiation) rather than only reducing raw uncertainty.
FALSIFYING signature: no persistent deficit state is needed to explain
information-seeking behaviour -- raw novelty (MECH-314a) or raw uncertainty
(MECH-314b) alone predict exploration equally well, OR the accumulator
remains elevated after verified resolution (no satiation), OR the system
preferentially engages irreducible noise over learnable uncertainty (would
falsify the expected_resolvability term).

MECH-483.subject: policy.orient_survey_regime
MECH-483.title: orient/survey: a third primitive behavioural regime (alongside approach and avoid) -- a temporary, diffuse reduction in commitment during which the agent widens behavioural sampling and gathers situational information before committing to approach/avoidance, driven by accumulated epistemic_deficit (MECH-482) rather than a specific cue. Distinct from MECH-395 (cue-triggered, need-gated orienting that resolves a SPECIFIC directional/affordance vector for an already-identified cue): orient/survey is diffuse and precedes cue identification, MECH-395 is narrow and follows it.
MECH-483.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires trajectories to be classifiable as
orient-mode vs random-exploration vs directed-approach on some structural
measure (state-coverage, trajectory structure, observation-before-commitment)
with non-zero variance across conditions -- a run where all three regimes
are behaviourally indistinguishable self-routes substrate_not_ready.
CONFIRMING signature: a structured orient/survey condition improves LATER
action-selection quality (not just entropy/state-coverage) relative to
matched stochastic-exploration-only and no-orienting baselines, and
terminates (commitment resumes) once uncertainty measurably falls.
FALSIFYING signature: orient/survey behaviour is indistinguishable from
random wandering with no benefit to later competence, OR orienting
persists despite already-adequate information (no termination condition),
OR the same benefit is fully explained by existing MECH-313/314/320/ARC-065
substrates with no need for a distinct regime.

MECH-484.subject: development.sensitive_period_coupling_plasticity_narrowing
MECH-484.title: Sensitive-period plasticity narrowing follows social-coupling consolidation: consolidation of the initial coupling pattern is obligate (occurs regardless of coupling quality, adaptive or maladaptive) and is followed by a plasticity-reduction window that closes around whichever pattern existed at consolidation, rather than continuing to update on subsequent coupling quality.
MECH-484.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) a coupling-consolidation mechanism must exist -- something that
  fixes/freezes a representation of the initial coupling pattern at the end of phase 1 -- which
  does not exist in ree_core today (verified). (2) The claim's own carried-forward open question
  must be resolved into a specific DV before a confirm/falsify contrast can even be posed: does the
  post-consolidation plasticity reduction narrow the SIGNAL REPERTOIRE (which affiliative cues the
  agent can still respond to), the TRUST CALIBRATION (how strongly a given cue updates coupling
  strength), or both -- currently only a directional hypothesis, per the claim's own notes, and
  needing a dedicated architecture note first.
CONFIRMING: an agent whose initial coupling pattern is (deliberately, for the manipulation) poor
  or maladaptive nonetheless shows the SAME degree of plasticity reduction post-window as an agent
  with a good initial pattern (consolidation is obligate, not quality-gated), AND both agents fail
  to proportionally update their coupling behaviour when subsequently exposed to a changed partner
  after the window closes, relative to a pre-window control that DOES update -- confirming a
  genuine sensitive-period closure rather than continuous online updating.
FALSIFYING: post-window coupling behaviour updates at a rate statistically indistinguishable from
  pre-window behaviour (no narrowing occurred), OR the degree of plasticity reduction scales with
  initial-pattern quality (consolidation is not obligate, contradicting the claim's own "regardless
  of coupling quality" text). A failure under either unmet precondition above is not evidence
  against the claim.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: a coupling-consolidation mechanism is built AND the signal-repertoire-vs-trust-
  calibration architecture note (already flagged as owed in the claim's own notes) exists to define
  the DV.

MECH-485.subject: commitment.predicted_harm_confidence_threshold_gated_triage
MECH-485.title: A single predicted-harm/success magnitude with an associated confidence (epistemic_deficit) term, computed from E2/E3 forward rollouts, is threshold-gated into three distinct consumers rather than producing one uniform response: real-time interrupt/reroute of a committed trajectory or a newly branched choice (via the MECH-090/MECH-141/MECH-138 hyperdirect and cancel-window pathways) when confidence is high and magnitude crosses the interrupt threshold; information-seeking orient/survey (MECH-482/MECH-483) when confidence is too low to trust the magnitude; and retention of the alternative for later counterfactual evaluation and responsibility attribution when magnitude is sub-threshold but non-trivial.
MECH-485.what_would_answer:
Answered by ABLATING THE FAN-OUT, once the substrate exists: does routing
one magnitude+confidence signal to three regime-specific consumers do
anything a single graded response would not?

Two separable assertions, which can fail independently:
(A) SHARED SOURCE -- the three legs are driven by the SAME predicted
magnitude + confidence pair, not by three independently-computed triggers
that merely co-vary. This is Addendum 5's synthesis; Addendum 2's own
earlier reading (three "functionally distinct consumers" of shared
representational substrate) is the competing hypothesis, not a strawman.
(B) DIFFERENTIATED RESPONSE -- the fan-out is genuinely regime-gated, not
one uniform response whose intensity happens to scale with magnitude.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (five parts; as of 2026-09-04 ONE is partially
met and FOUR are unmet -- this claim is untestable by construction, not
merely unfavored):
(1) Leg 0 cleared -- E3 must select among genuinely graded, differentiated
candidates, or there is nothing for a magnitude to be computed OVER. See
INV-012's own what_would_answer LEG 0 for the full statement and the
MECH-439 `ceiling_decision: exhausted` evidence; do NOT re-derive it here.
Re-verified 2026-09-04: MECH-439 is still `exhausted`, `live_status`
re-stamped 2026-09-01. UNMET.
(2) The magnitude half must exist AND be consumed AS A MAGNITUDE.
`predicted_harm_delta` (ree_core/pfc/e2_escape_affordance_linker.py:111,
assigned :665) is the nearest existing forward-rollout predicted-harm
quantity, and a grep over ree_core/, tests/ and experiments/ still finds
ZERO readers of that field (re-verified 2026-09-04; unchanged since
2026-08-07). [updated 2026-09-04] The underlying `harm_delta` HEAD is not
dead -- it is trained (:594-598) and read at :448-449 -- but only inside
`clamp01((harm_delta + threat_termination) / 2)`, so the one path by which
a predicted-harm prediction reaches any consumer destroys its identity by
averaging it with an unrelated head and clamping it to [0,1]. A signal
that is only ever consumed pre-averaged cannot gate three regimes at two
cut-points, and a magnitude nothing consumes cannot gate anything at all.
UNMET -- and note the remedy is now narrower than "wire it up": the field
needs a consumer that sees it UNAVERAGED.
(3) The confidence half must exist. [updated 2026-09-04 -- this is the one
precondition that has MOVED since the original draft.] It now does:
MECH-482's EpistemicDeficitAccumulator is BUILT and wired
(ree_core/policy/epistemic_deficit.py, SD-102, ree-v3 b69a1b8 2026-08-29;
multi-target readiness rebuild bd58ab6 2026-09-01), with 23 contracts. But
it is NOT USABLE for this claim yet, for two independent reasons that must
both be discharged before any MECH-485 run is scored: (a) it is DEFAULT-OFF
-- `curiosity_learning_progress_source` defaults to `"broadcast"`, which is
documented bit-identical, so an experiment that does not explicitly arm
`"epistemic_deficit"` is testing nothing; (b) its own validation is OWED
and its first attempt was structurally void -- V3-EXQ-964 (2026-08-29) is
FAIL / non_contributory because the per-episode reset kept `n_targets == 1`
and the per-candidate readout was a CONSTANT vector that cannot move an
argmax, and the 2026-09-01 readiness build found four causes of that
collapse (two of them not named by the autopsy) and explicitly recorded
that a new-letter successor is required and was not queued. So the
confidence term exists as code and does NOT yet exist as a discriminating
quantity. Any MECH-485 run must gate on the readiness statistics that build
exposed -- `n_targets >= 2`, `last_readout_deficit_range > 0`,
`last_lp_dev_range > 0` -- BEFORE reading a verdict, or it will silently
reproduce 964's vacuity one level up. PARTIALLY MET.
(4) The leg-1 target pathways must accept a predicted-harm input.
BetaGate (ree_core/heartbeat/beta_gate.py) exists but takes no harm or
predicted-harm term in any method signature or body (re-verified against
its full `def` inventory, 2026-09-04); MECH-138's cancel-window has no
substrate presence at all (`cancel_window`/`veto_window`/`cancel_open`:
zero hits in ree_core/). So leg 1 is still a claim about a wire that does
not exist, between an endpoint that exists and one that does not. UNMET.
(5) Leg 3's retention mechanism must exist. [updated 2026-09-04] It is now
REGISTERED -- MECH-487, the bounded provenance-tagged retention buffer for
rejected/uncommitted E3 candidates, riding on the MECH-094 imagination/
reality write gate under the MECH-322 audited-exception template -- and is
already in this claim's depends_on. It is NOT BUILT: no retention or
persistence of losing E3 candidates exists in ree_core/ (five distinct
name-shapes checked, zero hits each; MECH-487 appears in no substrate,
experiment or test file). Cross-reference MECH-487's own what_would_answer
and INV-012's LEG 3 for what the mechanism must do and for the
confabulation bound it must respect; do NOT re-derive either here. UNMET.
NOTE for whoever next edits this claim's `notes`: the "LOAD-BEARING
UNREGISTERED DEPENDENCY" paragraph there is now stale -- it says the
retention mechanism is deliberately unregistered pending a lit-pull, which
that same lit-pull discharged on 2026-08-07 by registering MECH-487.

PLUS one non-degeneracy guard specific to THIS claim rather than
inherited: (6) MAGNITUDE AND CONFIDENCE MUST BE MEASURABLY DISSOCIABLE in
the test distribution. The claim asserts a two-dimensional gate
(magnitude x confidence) fanning into three regimes. If confidence is in
practice a monotone function of magnitude -- confidently-predicted harms
are also large ones -- the gate collapses to one dimension, only two
regimes are ever occupied, and leg 2 (orient/survey) is never entered.
A run under those conditions would report "no three-way structure" for a
reason that has nothing to do with whether the claim is true. Require a
reported joint distribution over (magnitude, confidence) with populated
off-diagonal cells -- specifically high-magnitude/low-confidence, which
is the ONLY cell that distinguishes leg 2 from leg 1 -- before any
verdict is read. [updated 2026-09-04] This guard is now the DIRECT
generalisation of V3-EXQ-964's confirmed failure, not a hypothetical: 964
was void precisely because the confidence-side readout was constant across
candidates. A constant confidence term populates exactly one column of this
joint distribution, so precondition (6) and precondition (3b) are the same
failure at two scales and must be reported together.

CONFIRMING signature (all three, not any one):
(i) FAN-OUT IS LOAD-BEARING -- collapsing the three consumers into a
single graded response (interrupt probability scaled by magnitude, no
orient/survey regime, no retention) degrades performance on at least two
of the three legs' own outcome metrics relative to the intact pipeline.
Scale the PASS gate on the SD of the paired per-seed delta (>= 2 SD) with
an absolute floor, not on a raw difference.
(ii) DOUBLE DISSOCIATION OF CUT-POINTS -- sweeping the interrupt
threshold moves the leg-1/leg-3 boundary WITHOUT moving the leg-2
boundary, and sweeping the epistemic_deficit threshold moves the leg-2
boundary WITHOUT moving the leg-1/leg-3 boundary. This is what separates
"one signal, independently-placed cut-points" from "three signals": three
independent triggers would not show each sweep confined to its own
boundary.
(iii) SHARED SOURCE IS SUFFICIENT -- substituting a leg-specific,
independently-computed trigger for the shared signal in any single leg
yields no improvement over the shared signal on that leg's own metric.

FALSIFYING, in three distinct ways with three distinct remedies:
-- THREE-SIGNAL reading: the shared signal underperforms a leg-specific
trigger in at least one leg by a margin that survives the other legs
being held intact. Then the legs need different COMPUTATIONS, not
different thresholds on one, and Addendum 2's pre-synthesis reading was
right. Remedy: demote MECH-485 from a unity claim to "three mechanisms
sharing E2/E3 forward-prediction substrate" and keep each leg. NOTE this
is a partial falsification -- MECH-485 can fail AS A UNITY CLAIM while
every individual leg survives, and that outcome must not be recorded as
refuting the legs.
-- DECORATIVE FAN-OUT: a single graded response reproduces the intact
pipeline's benefit on all three legs' metrics. Then threshold-gating is
a description of the response curve, not a mechanism, and (B) is false
even if (A) holds. Remedy: retire the three-consumer structure, keep the
shared-signal claim.
-- OVER-CONSTRAINED SCALE: no placement of the two cut-points leaves all
three legs simultaneously non-degenerate -- every setting at which leg 1
fires usefully starves leg 3 of retainable candidates, or vice versa.
This is Q-090's independent-criterion reading generalized to the whole
pipeline, and it falsifies the "one scale partitioned at two cut-points"
architecture specifically. Remedy: give the legs independent admission
criteria, which is exactly what Q-090 asks about for leg 3 -- see Q-090's
own what_would_answer, which is already written and which inherits this
precondition block rather than restating it.

ORDER OF ATTACK, if this is ever built. [updated 2026-09-04 -- the
ordering has CHANGED, because precondition (3) moved.] Precondition (2) is
still the cheapest and is still independently useful: giving
`predicted_harm_delta` a consumer that reads it UNAVERAGED is a smaller
step than anything else here, and its result is informative regardless of
MECH-485's fate. Precondition (3) is now second rather than blocked --
what it needs is not a build but the OWED V3-EXQ-964 successor (new
letter, readiness config armed on both arms, gated on n_targets >= 2 and a
non-constant per-candidate readout before C2 is scored), which the
2026-09-01 readiness build recorded as required and did not queue.
Preconditions (4) and (5) remain the expensive ones and are unchanged. Do
not treat the whole pipeline as one indivisible build.

MECH-486.subject: language.tom_representational_interference
MECH-486.title: Representational interference between language and fast empathy: discrete/reportable/sequential language representations and graded/affective/resonant empathy representations exert conflicting representational pressures, so forcing them into one shared workspace too early measurably degrades BOTH relative to separated systems at matched capacity.
MECH-486.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: requires both a language channel and a fast-empathy
channel (MECH-405), neither of which exists in V3.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: each system must reach a measurable competence
when trained ALONE, so that a shared-workspace deficit is attributable to
interference rather than to one of them never having worked.
CONFIRMING signature: a shared-workspace arm degrades on BOTH a
language-fidelity metric and an other-bound-affect metric relative to a
separated-workspace arm, at MATCHED total capacity and compute, with the
degradation growing as the two training signals are made more simultaneous
(the "too early" clause -- interference should be worse under early merging
than under merging after each system has consolidated separately).
UNSUPPORTED if the shared-workspace arm matches or beats the separated arm at
matched capacity, or if the deficit disappears once capacity is equalised --
that result says the limiting factor was capacity, not conflicting
representational pressure, and ARC-123 would then rest on the developmental
evidence alone with no mechanistic support.

MECH-487.subject: memory.uncommitted_candidate_retention_provenance_tagged
MECH-487.title: A bounded, provenance-tagged retention buffer for rejected/uncommitted E3 candidate trajectories: it persists WHICH differentiated alternative was considered (identity plus a trajectory/value sketch, not merely a transient scalar) past the tick it was rejected on, so a later stage can counterfactually evaluate it and attribute responsibility -- admitted and typed under the MECH-322 template (audited replay_origin-style flag, fail-closed admission, accelerated dissolution if not corroborated by real waking execution), riding ON the MECH-094 imagination/reality write gate rather than relaxing it.
MECH-487.what_would_answer:
Registered 2026-08-07 from the dedicated lit-pull commissioned by MECH-485 /
INV-012 leg 3 and by memory project_imagination_learning_constraints.md
(2026-05-10), which gated this exact registration "do NOT register without
dedicated lit-pull". Literature: evidence/literature/
targeted_review_uncommitted_candidate_retention/ (5 entries).

MECHANISM SHAPE the lit-pull grounds -- TWO disciplines, both required:
(1) a TYPING discipline (Schnider 2013 orbitofrontal reality filtering,
10.3389/fnbeh.2013.00067; Bouzerda-Wahlen 2015 reality-filter / source-
monitoring dissociation, 10.1162/jocn_a_00686): retained content must carry a
fast, standalone provenance/reality tag -- separable from the "which
alternative" content -- that keeps it typed considered-but-not-real and off
the residue/valence/hippocampal write paths committed action gets; the failure
mode of an untyped store is confabulation. This is REE's MECH-094
committed_vs_imagined bit, made load-bearing.
(2) a BOUNDING discipline (Janner 2019 MBPO, arXiv:1906.08253): imagined /
non-executed content may feed evaluation/learning only within a bounded,
uncertainty-gated, corroboration-limited regime -- MBPO's short model-trust
horizon is the algorithmic form of MECH-322's fail-closed admission plus
accelerated dissolution of any chunk not corroborated by real waking
execution; the trust bound should scale with model uncertainty (REE
epistemic_deficit / MECH-482), tying retention to the same confidence term
that routes MECH-485's orient/survey leg.

LICITNESS (the other half of the lit-pull's question): Boorman 2011
(10.1371/journal.pbio.1001093) shows a dedicated frontopolar network tracks
the BEST counterfactual (unchosen) option and carries a counterfactual
prediction error for learning from hypothetical feedback -- so retaining and
learning from rejected options is a normal adaptive function, not confabulation
by construction, PROVIDED it stays a prior for future testing (memory LICIT
category #4) under the bounding discipline above. Its selectivity (the BEST
option, not all) bears on Q-090's admission criterion.

WHAT IS ALREADY BUILT vs MISSING: Boorman 2009 (10.1016/j.neuron.2009.05.014)
is the biological anchor for REE's SD-033e/MECH-264 frontopolar counterfactual
value, but the signal is an ONLINE relative-advantage magnitude -- exactly
MECH-264's cfv_now transient scalar overwritten every tick. So the substrate
for representing a rejected alternative's VALUE exists; what does NOT exist in
ree-v3 in any form is persistence of WHICH alternative existed, past the tick,
in a store usable for retrospective evaluation. That identity + persistence is
MECH-487's novel content.

CONFIRMED if a built retention buffer (a) persists a rejected E3 candidate's
identity / trajectory-sketch past the tick it was rejected on, (b) keeps it
provenance-distinguishable from committed/real content under test (no elevated
confidence for imagined-only content leaking into residue/valence/hippocampal
channels -- the confabulation guard holds behaviourally, not just by design),
and (c) supplies a function -- measurably different counterfactual evaluation
or self-attribution behaviour -- BEYOND what MECH-264's existing transient
scalar already provides, over a discard-immediately ablation baseline.

FALSIFIED if retained-alternative content cannot be kept distinguishable from
committed content without a hand-tuned, case-by-case gate (no general
MECH-322-shaped template suffices) -- i.e. the confabulation risk is not
tractably bounded, and the mechanism should be retired or radically narrowed --
OR if a bounded, provenance-tagged retention buffer produces no measurable
change in counterfactual-evaluation / responsibility-relevant behaviour over
the discard-immediately (MECH-264-only) baseline, i.e. persistence-of-identity
adds no function beyond the existing transient scalar.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (shared with MECH-485 / INV-012 leg 3): MECH-439's
E3 selection conversion ceiling must clear first (ceiling_decision: exhausted
as of registration) -- with no genuinely differentiated candidates to select
among, there is nothing to retain, so no retention test is meaningful. Do NOT
build ahead of that clearing, or ahead of Q-090's admission-criterion
resolution (same-scale vs independent goal-match). Architectural synthesis
grounded in the cited literature; not yet verified against a built ree-v3
retention buffer, which does not exist.

MECH-488.subject: control_plane.selection_conflict_brake
MECH-488.title: A selection-conflict signal (E3's per-candidate decision-gap, gap_norm) should feed the control plane as a distinct S6 class, driving K5 control-allocation escalation and K10 hard-veto threshold as a fast, conflict-triggered brake -- an STN-hyperdirect-style mechanism, complementary to (not a substitute for) the existing tonic Go/No-Go + lateral-inhibition selection machinery (MECH-449/MECH-450).
MECH-488.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (hard gate -- do not attempt to build or test this
claim without it): MECH-439's F-dominance / candidate-pool-collapse conversion
ceiling must first clear (candidate diversity demonstrated to reach committed
action, per the standing MECH-439 falsifier ladder), such that BOTH of the
following hold on the cleared substrate: (a) gap_norm regains genuine
cross-seed spread (gap_spread_seeds >= 2, mirroring V3-EXQ-689's own
non-vacuity gate), and (b) the PAG freeze-gate shows non-zero engagement
under the same substrate (pag_release_count_end > 0 in >=2/3 seeds, mirroring
SD-037 axis Phase-3's acceptance gate). Do not queue an experiment against
this claim until both (a) and (b) are independently confirmed -- a run on a
substrate where either is still pinned at zero self-routes
substrate_not_ready_requeue, it is not a verdict on this claim.

Once both preconditions hold: build the S6 signal path (propagate gap_norm
out of _gap_scaled_commit_pick as a control-plane-visible quantity; wire it
as an additional, independent input alongside the existing z_harm_a-based
trigger into K10's freeze-commit condition and/or K5's control-allocation
escalation). Run a 2-arm comparison (gap_norm-informed brake vs. harm-only
brake, matched substrate, matched seeds).

CONFIRMING: the informed arm fires >=1 additional non-degenerate
freeze/escalation event per seed on >=2/3 seeds that is attributable to
selection conflict (high gap_norm at a tick where z_harm_a alone would not
have triggered), AND existing harm-triggered freeze behaviour is unchanged
(no regression on the harm-only trigger pathway).

FALSIFYING: the informed arm shows no additional discriminable events beyond
seed noise, OR wiring the signal delays/degrades harm-triggered freeze
commitment (the new input interferes with the existing, validated MECH-279
commit law).

MECH-489.subject: pag.defensive_orienting_response
MECH-489.title: Defensive-orienting response: a phasic freeze-arrest -> orient/identify -> epistemic-sufficiency-override -> valence-gated approach/withdraw/resume behavioural chain triggered by a sudden, UNIDENTIFIED onset (positive-derivative spike in unsigned prediction-error surprise and/or sensory-discriminative harm), distinct from MECH-279 (chronic, accumulated-suffering freeze) and from MECH-482/MECH-483 (persistent target-bound epistemic_deficit accumulator and the diffuse orient/survey regime it drives -- the opposite end of the timescale from this PHASIC, transient trigger, which MECH-482 explicitly excludes by definition).
MECH-489.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: For the surviving valence-gating leg: enough override ticks to score (V3-EXQ-910b pooled 21 against a floor of 10), unclassified == 0, and the two channels z-scored against their own running distributions so a non-negative harm norm is not compared with a near-zero benefit value. For any future trigger test the onset channel must carry hazard-type variance, which this ecology's residue_surprise does not.
CONFIRMING: With a channel that carries hazard-type onset variance, the ON arm's surprise-onset-to-freeze and post-identification dread-to-withdraw / excite-to-approach couplings move well past the incidental baselines toward a sharp signature, and the decision split tracks event valence. Manipulation: DefensiveOrientingGate ON versus OFF at matched seeds against the same ground-truth injected-event schedule as observational_review_V3-EXQ-906b, with the SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE z-scoring in force in the ON arm. Control: The gate-OFF arm's incidental behaviour-coupling baselines from Section 12b (P(moved at t+1 | spike) 24.0 percent; P(mode-change at t+1 | spike) 11.1 percent), matched seeds and matched event schedule. Required event: A sudden UNIDENTIFIED onset -- a positive-derivative spike in unsigned prediction-error surprise or in sensory-discriminative harm norm exceeding its rolling baseline by the onset delta -- followed by identification-confidence rising to the sufficiency threshold and an override decision. DV: For the valence-gating leg: the approach/withdraw/resume decision split conditioned on event valence, counted ONCE PER OVERRIDE TICK (not per env step), together with n_latched_ticks, and verified against the legacy per-env-step readout by a discriminating agreement test rather than the trivially-true sum identity.
FALSIFYING: The ON arm's behaviour-coupling numbers are statistically indistinguishable from the OFF arm's incidental baseline (a gate but not a coupling), OR identification confidence resolves on a fixed schedule regardless of whether the triggering elevation decayed (a disguised timer). A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/pag/defensive_orienting.py (DefensiveOrientingGate.tick, trigger_channel, identification_confidence) and the agent.py Component 4/5 override block; the override-tick readout landed 2026-08-20 and V3-EXQ-910b validated decision_counts, but its C1 check (21 == 21) is true by construction of the tap. Consumer / boundary: The PAG-analog phasic gate at motor arrest and the override decision tick inside select_action -- an E3-tick boundary, which the legacy readout sampled at env-step granularity and inflated by about e3_steps_per_tick (206/42 = 4.90). Existing ownership: SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE, EXP-0057, MECH-489, orienting_epistemic_deficit_v3:ORNT-6.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The valence-gating leg's instrument still lacks a discriminating correctness check: the two readouts diverge 5.95x/32.57x in the same run and the reported sum identity cannot detect disagreement, which is why V3-EXQ-910b reads MIXED. The trigger leg is worse than uninstrumented -- the residue_surprise channel in this ecology does not carry the hazard-type events the falsifier needs. Secondary classes: R3. Gap disposition: INSTRUMENT EXISTS BUT WRONG LOCUS/TIMESCALE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's confirming clause (a) -- the trigger fires reliably on limb_damage_injected / external_hazard_injected / world_rule_shift_occurred -- has already been answered NO and adjudicated: V3-EXQ-910 measured 2.6/1.5/0.0 percent alignment and V3-EXQ-910a reconfirmed 0/0/0, and both confirmed autopsies record the trigger-alignment sub-claim as fairly falsified and explicitly NOT to be re-tested. The refinement is also new: this ecology's residue_surprise channel is dominated by reef-boundary crossings and resource events, so a correctly built onset detector on that channel will under-fire on hazard-type events regardless of calibration. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-490.subject: sleep.action_sequence_coherence_via_commitment_gate_persistence
MECH-490.title: Sleep-associated action-sequence coherence via E3 commitment-gate persistence: if sleep increases post-sleep action-run coherence (fewer local re-decisions / reversals, longer directionally-persistent action runs) in the Fishtank substrate, the most mechanistically plausible route is increased persistence of E3Selector's commitment gate (lower commit_variance -> longer open-loop execution of an already-committed action sequence, reducing per-tick CEM/softmax re-scoring) -- NOT a global reduction in stochasticity (structurally excluded: sleep never touches the noise floor/temperature), NOT preferential consolidation of specifically successful trajectories (replay sampling is confirmed outcome-agnostic, staleness- or uniform-weighted), and NOT policy-chunking macro-execution (use_chunk_proposal_injection is confirmed off in every Fishtank driver, bit-identical to chunking being absent).
MECH-490.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (a) spawn position matched across WITH_SLEEP/NO_SLEEP
arms at each compared segment index (CONFIRMED UNMATCHED in the only existing data,
V3-EXQ-913 -- a run with this precondition unmet self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a
verdict), and (b) E3Selector commit-variance/commit-gate-engagement logged per matched
window, so the behavioural signature can be tied to the mechanism rather than left as an
unexplained correlation.
CONFIRMING signature: with spawn position matched and commit-variance instrumented, WITH_SLEEP
windows show BOTH (i) a directionally consistent lift in action-run coherence (mean run
length, turning-entropy/tortuosity reduction) across >=5 seeds at a sign-test or permutation
p<0.05, AND (ii) that lift covaries with commit-gate engagement rate/lower commit-variance in
the same windows -- behaviour and proposed mechanism must move together, not just the
behaviour alone.
FALSIFYING signature: the coherence lift (if real) shows NO relationship to commit-gate
engagement (mechanism wrong even if behaviour is real); OR a matched "long wake interval, no
sleep firing" control shows the SAME coherence gain given equivalent elapsed time/experience
(relocates the cause to time/experience accumulation, not sleep); OR the effect does not
survive the transfer test to a structurally different ecology (route memorisation, not
reorganisation).

MECH-491.subject: memory.external_scent_trace_internal_memory_interaction
MECH-491.title: REE emitting a slowly-decaying self-scent trail into the environment, later re-encountered as an external sensory signal, produces measurable interaction with internal spatial/episodic memory (confirmation, conflict, or substitution effects) that is distinct from -- and detectable independently of -- internal memory operating alone.
MECH-491.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a self-scent-deposit-and-decay mechanism in the environment substrate (does not exist in v3 fish-world) and REE's internal episodic/spatial memory state readable at the point of comparison.
CONFIRMING: REE's behaviour or internal-memory readout differs measurably between (a) revisiting a location with its own fresh scent present, (b) revisiting after the scent has decayed, and (c) revisiting a location never visited but carrying another organism's overlapping scent -- in a pattern consistent with the scent functioning as an external memory cue (e.g. faster reorientation, altered precision/confidence signals, or measurable belief updating), not merely being ignored.
FALSIFYING: behaviour/internal state is statistically indistinguishable across conditions (a)-(c), or the self-scent signal is used identically to any other undifferentiated sensory-novelty cue -- i.e. REE shows no differential treatment of "this is my own trace" versus "this is unfamiliar."

MECH-492.subject: sleep.mech286_threat_term_sourcing
MECH-492.title: MECH-286's sleep-permission threat conjunct is an UNCALIBRATED, UNDECLARED-SOURCE consumer of the same shared z_harm_a.norm() expression whose place-safety informativeness V3-EXQ-917 showed is set by unrelated driver config: the gate's third term is `z_harm_a.norm() < mech286_threat_tonic_threshold` (default 0.4), the identical expression MECH-303's contextual-safety gate reads, which measures at chance (AUC <= 0.52 across 18 swept thresholds) under damage_sourced and at AUC 0.84-0.97 under the proximity_ema_sourced default. MECH-286 declares no sourcing mode of its own and inherits whichever the driver happens to set, and its 0.4 threshold has never been calibrated against any measurement of that signal. Therefore, with use_mech286_sleep_onset_gate enabled, threat_ok does not reliably gate on place safety; being ANDed into a three-way conjunction, a near-constant term silently degrades the gate to an effective always-permit (or, above threshold, always-refuse) rather than a safety gate.
MECH-492.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the falsifier must drive the agent through REAL world positions with known ground-truth hazard and read the gate's own emitted diagnostics there. It must NOT set z_harm_a by hand -- see the V3-EXQ-891 correction in notes below, which is exactly the degenerate form.
NO NEW SUBSTRATE INSTRUMENTATION IS NEEDED: evaluate_sleep_onset_permit already emits mech286_threat_ok, mech286_z_harm_a_norm, and mech286_threat_tonic_threshold in its diagnostics dict. A new DRIVER is needed (891 cannot be reused as-is); no ree_core change is.
The falsifier must be run under BOTH sourcing modes (limb_damage_enabled True and False), because the whole point of the claim is that MECH-286 declares neither and inherits whichever the driver sets.
CONFIRMING (claim SUPPORTED): mech286_threat_ok fails to discriminate hazardous from non-hazardous locations above chance under the sourcing mode(s) tested, OR is invariant across the ground-truth hazard gradient (near-constant 0 or 1 across all locations), OR discriminates under one sourcing mode and not the other -- the last being the specific "informativeness inherited from unrelated driver config" leg, and the one that would confirm the claim in its exact registered form.
FALSIFYING (claim REFUTED): mech286_threat_ok discriminates hazardous from non-hazardous locations above chance under BOTH sourcing modes at the default threshold of 0.4, i.e. the term does gate on place safety regardless of driver configuration and the sourcing is adequate as built.
