ALSO FALSIFYING (weaker, partial): the term is shown to be near-constant but the conjunction's behaviour is nonetheless unaffected because another conjunct is always the binding one -- in which case the wiring is still undeclared but the "silently degrades the gate" consequence does not hold, and this claim should be narrowed rather than supported.

MECH-493.subject: context.inference_as_hysteresis_bearing_arbitration
MECH-493.title: Context inference is an active, persistent control process rather than passive nearest-match retrieval: selecting which latent situation is currently active is itself a COMMITMENT-BEARING act that requires hysteresis (a switch threshold and switch cost preventing small fluctuations from continuously reinterpreting the situation) and a protected EXPLOITATION WINDOW (a period after selection during which the organism acts on the interpretation rather than immediately reopening inference). Without both, a sufficiently uncertainty-sensitive agent becomes PERMANENTLY EPISTEMIC -- continuously checking, rarely acting. REE already has a developed commitment-hysteresis account (MECH-106 dwell/switch-cost, MECH-047 asymmetric de-commitment) but applies it only to the ACTION/mode variable; this claim asserts the same machinery is required one level up, on the CONTEXT variable, where no dwell, switch cost, or protected window currently exists (ARC-062's learned context discriminator is a soft per-step gate with none of these). The loop spans existing modules (ContextMemory, epistemic_deficit, orient/survey, event segmenter, commitment) and does NOT require a new executive module.
MECH-493.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (mandatory -- without it the run is vacuous):
(i) the context variable must be observably live -- context assignment must vary
across episodes and be recoverable from the substrate, NOT collapsed to a single
value (cf. V3-EXQ-436f, where 3/5 seeds occupied exactly 1 of 16 ContextMemory
slots despite thousands of write() calls); (ii) the agent must not have collapsed
to monostrategy (MECH-309) -- either run on the ARC-062 gated-policy substrate or
pre-register MECH-309 collapse as an alternative explanation, because a
monostrategy agent has no context-conditional behaviour for context arbitration
to affect and will produce a null for reasons unrelated to this claim;
(iii) MECH-153's undifferentiated-ContextMemory finding (cosine_sim ~= 1.0 without
a supervised context objective) must be excluded or the retrieval path is silent.

CONFIRMING: in an environment family containing perceptually similar states
requiring OPPOSING policies, an agent with hysteresis + exploitation window
(a) maintains the active context under minor/transient ambiguity, (b) switches
when evidence genuinely and persistently favours another context, and (c) achieves
higher task competence than a matched no-hysteresis ablation BECAUSE it sustains
an interpretation long enough to act on it -- with the competence gain traceable
to increased mean dwell in a correct context, not merely to fewer switches.

FALSIFYING, two distinct routes, BOTH of which count against this claim:
(1) SUFFICIENCY OF THE SIMPLE ACCOUNT -- context switching in these environments is
fully explained by similarity retrieval alone or by unsigned prediction error
alone, with no residual variance for hysteresis/orienting to explain; the larger
mechanism is then unnecessary.
(2) OVERBUILD / PATHOLOGY -- adding uncertainty-sensitivity, orienting and
hysteresis fails to improve hidden-context discrimination, OR produces pathological
indecision (the permanently-epistemic failure: orienting occupancy rises without a
corresponding competence gain). Note route (2) is a REAL predicted risk of this
claim's own mechanism, not merely a null -- an agent with orienting but without a
protected exploitation window should be predicted to get WORSE, and observing that
specific pattern supports the necessity of the window while falsifying any account
that treats orienting alone as sufficient.

MECH-494.subject: context.switch_criterion_structured_explanatory_failure
MECH-494.title: The criterion for abandoning an inferred context is PERSISTENT, STRUCTURED evidence that the currently inferred latent situation no longer explains observations OR THEIR ACTION CONSEQUENCES -- not unsigned prediction-error magnitude. A startling transient, sensor noise, gradual environmental drift, and a genuine latent-state transition can all produce large prediction error, and should NOT produce the same response: transient surprise should not switch context, gradual drift may warrant update-in-place rather than switch, and only genuine latent transition should switch. The ACTION-CONSEQUENCE term is the part with no existing REE analogue: MECH-288's slow-scale BOCPD change-point already supplies a persistence-based (rather than threshold-based) boundary signal over z_goal, but it is computed over observations and is consumed as a region KEY by downstream substrates (MECH-269 anchor sets, per-region V_s, MECH-284 staleness, MECH-287 broadcast) -- nothing consumes it to arbitrate retain-vs-switch-vs-create over stored contexts.
MECH-494.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the four conditions must be genuinely dissociable in
the substrate -- transient surprise, sensor noise, gradual drift, and abrupt latent
transition must each be independently inducible and must produce COMPARABLE
unsigned prediction-error magnitude at the moment of onset. If the abrupt-transition
condition simply produces larger PE than the others, the design cannot distinguish
this claim from a PE-magnitude threshold and the run is vacuous. Verify by
measuring the PE distributions per condition BEFORE scoring any switch behaviour.

CONFIRMING: context-switch rate is predicted by persistent structured explanatory
failure and NOT by instantaneous PE magnitude, specifically -- switches are rare
under transient surprise and under noise (high PE, no sustained explanatory
failure), rare-or-update-in-place under gradual drift, and reliable under abrupt
latent transition. Additionally, and this is the discriminating half: a condition in
which OBSERVATIONS remain well-explained but ACTION CONSEQUENCES do not (the same
scene now rewards the opposite policy) triggers switching, which an
observation-only criterion such as MECH-288's slow-scale BOCPD cannot detect.

FALSIFYING: switch behaviour is fully predicted by an unsigned-PE threshold or by
MECH-288's existing observation-side change-point alone, with the action-consequence
term adding no independent predictive power; OR the four conditions cannot be
behaviourally dissociated at all, which would indicate the criterion is not
implemented (distinct from being wrong -- report as non_contributory, not as a
claim-layer falsification).

MECH-495.subject: memory.relational_topology_objective
MECH-495.title: The objective for hippocampal/episodic memory organisation is RELATIONAL APPROPRIATENESS, not maximal pattern separation: related experiences should overlap appropriately (overlap is what supports generalisation and memory linking) while behaviourally distinct latent situations should separate appropriately. It follows that "more diverse slots", greater slot occupancy, and lower representational overlap are NOT objectives in themselves, and that a metric which is monotonically improved by increasing differentiation is scoring the wrong quantity regardless of whether it is computed correctly. This is a claim about the TARGET, and is therefore distinct from -- and not answered by -- the already-established finding that REE's slot_cosine_sim family was computed incorrectly (whole-bank, no occupancy mask; 2026-08-07 governance reversal at V3-EXQ-436d) or the finding that the ContextMemory write path could not produce differentiation at all (scores.mean(0).argmin() single-slot fixed point; V3-EXQ-436f).
MECH-495.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (mandatory): (i) the memory store must actually be
recruiting multiple slots -- V3-EXQ-436f found 3/5 seeds occupying exactly 1 of 16
slots despite 2,837-4,903 write() calls each, and a single-slot store has NO
topology to evaluate, making any relational statistic undefined rather than merely
null; verify occupancy BEFORE computing any topology statistic. (ii) The environment
must expose GROUND-TRUTH latent-context labels, since the statistic is an agreement
measure against that structure -- this is a design constraint on the substrate, not
an afterthought. (iii) All four cells of the 2x2 must be populated at adequate n.

TEST DESIGN: vary perceptual similarity and latent-context identity INDEPENDENTLY --
(similar appearance, same context), (similar appearance, DIFFERENT context),
(different appearance, SAME context), (different appearance, different context).
The diagonal cells are what any similarity-driven store gets right for free. The two
OFF-DIAGONAL cells are the entire test: similar-appearance/different-context is
where a nearest-match store fails by MERGING; different-appearance/same-context is
where a maximal-separation store fails by SPLITTING.

CONFIRMING: representational similarity structure tracks LATENT-CONTEXT structure
rather than perceptual similarity -- specifically, representations in the
different-appearance/same-context cell overlap MORE than those in the
similar-appearance/different-context cell, and this ordering predicts downstream
generalisation and discrimination performance. Critically, a differentiation-
maximising objective scores the similar-appearance/different-context cell correctly
and the different-appearance/same-context cell BACKWARDS, so the two objectives make
OPPOSITE predictions in that cell -- that cell is the discriminator between this
claim and the incumbent objective, and a design that omits it cannot decide between
them.

FALSIFYING: a maximal-separation objective predicts downstream generalisation and
discrimination at least as well as the relational-topology objective across all four
cells (i.e. appropriate overlap confers no measurable benefit and separating
everything is not merely harmless but optimal); OR the relational statistic cannot be
computed at adequate power because latent-context ground truth is not recoverable
from the substrate (report non_contributory, not falsified).

NOT ANSWERED BY: any re-run of the SD-017/ARC-045/MECH-166 lineage scored on a
differentiation DV, however correctly that DV is computed. Six generations
(V3-EXQ-436a..436f) have established measurement and substrate facts about
differentiation; none of them tested whether differentiation is the right target.

(iv) DEVELOPMENTAL TIMING (added 2026-08-23 per MECH-496 / INV-101): the topology
statistic must be read either AFTER representational structure has stopped changing,
or as a trajectory ACROSS the change. A system whose bucket structure is still
plastic will read as poor relational agreement on any static snapshot, and that
reading is an artifact of TIMING, not evidence against the objective -- so a run that
omits this precondition can produce a false FALSIFYING result. If no crystallisation
schedule exists in the substrate (TRUE AT REGISTRATION: ContextMemory(num_slots=16) is
a fixed nn.Module buffer with no growth or allocation policy), record the structure at
a declared, fixed training point and state that point explicitly, so the snapshot is
at least comparable across arms. See MECH-496's own what_would_answer precondition
(iii) -- do not re-derive it.

MECH-496.subject: memory.representational_dimensionality_crystallization
MECH-496.title: Representational dimensionality is an OUTCOME of a developmental plasticity schedule, not an a-priori architectural constant: the number and granularity of memory buckets (ContextMemory slots, and any analogous discrete representational partition) must itself be plastic during an open window and reduce in plasticity as the encountered environment's latent structure is resolved. The INV-074 / MECH-333 / MECH-334 critical-period shape -- open window, competitive establishment, closure / crystallisation -- is currently specified ONLY over the SCORING / POLICY plane (behavioural diversity vs winner-take-all capture); this claim asserts the same schedule is required over REPRESENTATIONAL STRUCTURE. Corollary bearing on measurement: a differentiation-family objective is not merely mis-targeted (MECH-495) but ILL-DEFINED under variable dimensionality, since separation can always be increased by adding buckets, so the objective degenerates into "use more slots"; and any fixed-N spread statistic (sws_slot_diversity over 16 slots, emitted by 29 experiment drivers) presupposes the very structure that should be the outcome. Substrate state at registration: ContextMemory(num_slots=16) at ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py:36 is a fixed nn.Module buffer with no growth, no allocation policy and no environment conditioning.
MECH-496.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (mandatory).
(i) The store must be recruiting more than one slot before ANY dimensionality
statistic is computed -- V3-EXQ-436f found 3/5 seeds occupying exactly 1 of 16 slots
despite 2,837-4,903 write() calls each. A single-slot store has no dimensionality to
measure. This INHERITS MECH-495's precondition (i); do not re-derive it.
(ii) num_slots must actually be VARIED. The claim is about dimensionality as an
OUTCOME, so a single fixed-N run cannot address it in either direction.
(iii) The schedule must be OBSERVABLE: whether the effective number of distinct
buckets in use CHANGES over training must be recorded per-episode, not only at the
end. A single end-of-training snapshot cannot distinguish "crystallised at N" from
"was always N", and the distinction is the claim.

CONFIRMING: with num_slots varied across a range spanning under- and
over-provisioning relative to the environment's ground-truth latent-context count --
(a) the effective bucket count in use converges toward the GROUND-TRUTH count rather
than toward num_slots; (b) that convergence is non-monotone in plasticity -- high
early, reducing -- rather than flat; and (c) downstream generalisation /
discrimination is FLAT with respect to num_slots over the range where (a) holds.
(c) is the LOAD-BEARING leg: it is the claim that the architecture is insensitive to
a constant which is currently hand-set.

FALSIFYING: effective bucket count tracks num_slots rather than the environment (the
store simply fills what it is given); OR downstream performance is MONOTONE in
num_slots (more is just better, so dimensionality is a capacity parameter and not a
structure to be resolved); OR the effective count is FLAT across training (no
schedule, so crystallisation is doing no work even if the final count happens to be
right).

CHEAPEST FIRST STEP -- A PROBE, NOT A BUILD. Treat num_slots as a declared
experimental variable rather than a constant and re-run the V3-EXQ-436 lineage across
a small sweep. If the 436-lineage results are STABLE across num_slots, the
dimensionality question is not currently load-bearing and this claim can wait; if they
MOVE, it is. This is `complex (probe-gated)` work resolving to `puzzle (known rules)`,
NOT the `complicated (buildable)` self-sizing-memory build, and must not be routed as
the latter. Registered as a proposal at intake; see manual_proposals.v1.json.

NOT ANSWERED BY: any run at a single fixed num_slots, however well designed --
including MECH-495's own 2x2, unless that 2x2 is itself swept over num_slots.

MECH-497.subject: control_plane.self_referential_stopping_failure
MECH-497.title: A persistent cognitive process can degrade the very confidence/evidence variable that gates its own termination condition, producing a positive-feedback failure to stop: repeated verification/checking reduces subjective recollective confidence while leaving objective accuracy largely intact, so the stopping condition ('sufficiently confident') becomes progressively harder to satisfy the more it is checked. This self-referential-measurement failure is mechanistically distinct from MECH-080's attractor-lock-in account of OCD (deep locked rollout basin via BG/ACh gate dynamics); the two may co-occur but a substrate fix for one does not by itself fix the other.
MECH-497.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A persistent process must exist whose termination decision is gated
by re-reading an internal confidence/evidence variable (not a fixed-budget or externally-timed
stop), AND that gate variable's read operation must itself have a modelled cost on the variable
(checking degrades the checked signal). Neither exists in ree_core today: SD-034's closure token
(the one built "done"-token instance) treats its gating condition as exogenously satisfied and
read, never endogenously corrupted by the act of evaluating it; grep for
recollective_confidence / checking_reduces / repeated_check / verification_loop under
ree-v3/ree_core/ returns zero hits.

CONFIRMING: instrumenting a stopping-gated process so each re-check both reads AND (parameter
epsilon > 0) degrades the gating confidence variable, holding objective accuracy constant,
produces a measurable increase in check count / time-to-stop / non-termination rate relative to a
matched process whose re-check reads but does not degrade the variable (epsilon = 0 control) --
i.e. the positive-feedback failure-to-stop reproduces mechanically from the self-referential-
measurement design, not merely from generic confidence noise.

FALSIFYING: the epsilon > 0 and epsilon = 0 arms are statistically indistinguishable on check
count / non-termination rate at matched objective accuracy -- the self-referential-measurement
mechanism carries no independent explanatory weight beyond generic confidence noise. A failure
under the unmet precondition above is not evidence against the claim.

OUT-OF-DOMAIN / LITERATURE LEG: the named anchor (van den Hout & Kindt checking-reduces-memory-
confidence paradigm) is flagged in the claim's own notes as NOT YET independently verified against
a specific citation -- a dedicated lit-pull is a precondition for treating this as
literature-grounded rather than provisional, independent of the substrate gate above.

DISTINCT FROM MECH-080 / coupled_with MECH-434: MECH-080 explains OCD via BG/ACh attractor-lock-in
(gating/selection-dynamics account); MECH-434 (see its own existing what_would_answer -- do not
re-derive) explains the same Hauser 2017 over-gathering phenotype via an epistemic-freezing pole
on its inverted-U commitment-timing axis. MECH-497 proposes a THIRD, mechanistically distinct
route (the act of measuring corrupts the measured signal). All three may co-occur; a substrate fix
for one does not fix the others. Do not conflate MECH-497's falsifier with MECH-434's.

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: no stopping-condition-with-self-corrupting-gate mechanism
exists in ree_core (confirmed 2026-09-25). ARC-128's general termination taxonomy (itself
substrate_conditional -- see ARC-128 context) is the natural architectural home for instrumenting
this, but ARC-128 is not built either. DO NOT build or queue a V3 experiment without an explicit
version-routing decision AND the named lit-pull (both currently unmet, confirmed current).

MECH-498.subject: control_plane.progress_gated_disengagement
MECH-498.title: Continuation of a persistent process should be gated jointly on marginal expected return relative to available alternatives (Marginal Value Theorem framing) AND on the observed RATE of progress -- whether uncertainty, goal-distance, or informational yield is actually decreasing under continued investment, not only its current absolute level -- so that a process whose marginal progress has collapsed increasingly loses justification for further resource allocation even while absolute uncertainty/value remains high. This is the disengagement-direction complement to MECH-343/SD-061's difficulty-gated proposal-entropy WIDENING response to stall: it covers the case where widening the search ALSO fails to restore progress.
MECH-498.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: RATE of progress and ABSOLUTE level of uncertainty / goal-distance must be DECORRELATED in the measured window -- the claim's content is that rate adds something level does not, so a regime where they covary tests nothing.
CONFIRMING: disengagement gated jointly on marginal expected return and observed progress RATE outperforms a level-only gate specifically in the cell where absolute value remains high while marginal progress has collapsed; and it is dissociable from MECH-343's difficulty-gated widening response -- cases exist where widening also fails and only disengagement recovers.
FALSIFYING: a level-only gate matches it everywhere; OR the rate term's apparent benefit disappears once the level term is correctly scaled.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional.

MECH-499.subject: hippocampus.ephaptic_actionable_now_aggregation
MECH-499.title: Ephaptic/oscillatory field-level coherence functions as a fast, non-synaptic CONTENT-AGGREGATION mechanism -- not merely the confidence/eligibility readout MECH-270 already covers -- synthesising distributed oscillatory information (amplitude, phase, relative phase, frequency, synchrony, cross-frequency relationships) into the temporally-coherent 'actionable now' state that seeds hippocampal proposal generation. The field need not 'understand' anything; its attraction as a mechanism is that the physical substrate may perform part of the aggregation automatically, fast enough that proposal generation is not stale by the time candidate futures are produced.
MECH-499.what_would_answer:
DERIVATIONAL PRECONDITION, owed first and cheapest (parallel to MECH-500's derivational leg; see
MECH-500's what_would_answer, do not re-derive):
State one prediction on which field aggregation of the "actionable now" state DISSOCIATES from
both of these alternatives:
(a) learned synaptic multi-stream fusion (the converged cross_stream_binder conjunction, or a
learned encoder over z_self/z_world/z_harm);
(b) MECH-270's scalar V_s gating.
The claim's distinguishing features are SPEED ("not stale") and multi-dimensional relational
content (relative phase, cross-frequency).
- In V3's synchronous tick, every aggregator finishes within the tick, so the speed axis does not
  exist unless latency is modelled explicitly.
- The relational-content axis needs per-stream phase/amplitude variables, which V3 lacks.
If no dissociating prediction can be written, the claim reduces to "seed proposals from a fused
multi-stream state", a design choice with no ephaptic content, and should be narrowed.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (empirical):
- The MECH-228/MECH-270 substrate must have landed: per-stream oscillatory variables plus a
  field-coupling term.
- The proposer must read a composed multi-stream seed. Today propose_trajectories takes a single
  z_world.
- P-SEED: the proposal must be state-conditioned (2026-09-24 probe: 30/30 states, one class).
CONFIRMING (V4): compare the field-aggregated seed against two controls:
(a) a learned synaptic-fusion seed matched in parameters and training;
(b) the same aggregate computed k ticks stale (sequential polling).
The claim is confirmed when:
- field-seeded proposals are better targeted than both controls (proposal-outcome alignment, goal
  contact, harm) on >= 2/3 seeds;
- the advantage grows with the rate of environmental change;
- a static average-field-magnitude control does not reproduce it (the architecture doc's
  "not reducible to a static average field magnitude").
FALSIFYING: any one of the following refutes the claim:
- synaptic fusion matches it at equal latency;
- the advantage vanishes once latency is equalised (then the effect is freshness, not field
  aggregation);
- the static-magnitude control reproduces it.
OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: perturbing endogenous field structure while minimally altering synaptic drive
alters the timing/coherence of prospective hippocampal representations more than it alters simple
sensory representation (docs/architecture/ephaptic_hippocampal_now_construction.md). Literature to
date: 2 supports and 1 mixed. None of it bears directly on content aggregation, and Biel et al.
2021 add a caution that multi-template capacity is limited (targeted_review_connectome_mech_499).

MECH-500.subject: control_plane.field_coherence_commitment_readiness
MECH-500.title: Content authority (which candidate future should win commitment -- already REE's existing architecture via MECH-090/MECH-341/ARC-003) and temporal/readiness authority (whether a candidate future has become sufficiently coherent, in the cross-system field-coherence sense, for commitment to be permitted to land AT ALL) are distinct constitutional questions that may require different mechanisms. Fast cross-system field coherence (extending MECH-499's content-aggregation function) is a candidate mechanism for the readiness axis specifically -- locating the moving frontier at which a previously branching predicted future becomes sufficiently well-predicted for commitment to land -- distinct from MECH-434's evidence/posterior-driven epistemic commitment timing at the inference layer, and distinct from MECH-090's beta-gated propagation of an already-decided commit.
MECH-500.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (V4; do NOT queue a V3 experiment against this without
an explicit version-routing decision, per the claim's own notes): none of MECH-228 /
MECH-270 / MECH-499 is V3-landed, so no ephaptic/field-coherence substrate exists to
measure a coherence signal on. Any run purporting to test this claim before that
substrate lands is measuring something else. Independently, the claim's DISTINCTNESS
premise must survive an argument before any substrate spend is justified -- see the
derivational leg below, which is the load-bearing open question right now.
DERIVATIONAL LEG (answerable by argument, and it must be answered FIRST): the claim
asserts that temporal/readiness authority requires a mechanism distinct from (a)
MECH-434's evidence/posterior-driven epistemic commitment timing at the inference
layer and (b) MECH-090's commit-entry gate. Leg (b) currently rests on a STALE
reading: MECH-500's own distinct_from block describes MECH-090 as gating
"propagation of an ALREADY-DECIDED commit via margin/competence", which was true of
MECH-090's base claim but NOT after its R-c amendment (2026-05-28 within-tick
score-margin + 2026-05-29 across-tick nav-competence), which made MECH-090 an
entry-ADMISSION readiness conjunction -- structurally the same shape MECH-500
proposes, and already two-axis. Correct that text, then state what field coherence
adds that a margin-and-competence conjunction does not. Leg (a) faces a parsimony
challenge already sitting in this claim's own evidence at direction=weakens:
Schurger, Sitt & Dehaene 2012 explains the readiness potential -- the closest
biological analogue to "is this the moment commitment should be permitted to land"
-- with an ordinary leaky stochastic accumulator crossing a fixed threshold, no
cross-population synchrony term required. CONFIRMING the derivational leg: a stated
prediction on which a field-coherence readiness signal and an accumulator-threshold
readiness signal DISSOCIATE. FALSIFYING it: no such prediction can be constructed,
in which case MECH-500 reduces to MECH-434 (or to MECH-090's R-c conjunction) and
should be absorbed rather than built.
CONFIRMING (empirical, V4, conditional on the ephaptic substrate landing): (1) a
cross-system field-coherence readout over the MECH-499 aggregation substrate rises
as a previously-branching predicted future converges, and commitment admitted only
above a coherence floor produces better-timed commitment than commitment admitted on
MECH-434's evidence-sufficiency criterion alone -- with the two signals shown to
DISSOCIATE in at least some cells (otherwise this is MECH-434 under a new name).
(2) The two AND-compose rather than one subsuming the other -- the pattern
MECH-090's own R-c precedent set, and which this claim's notes flag as unresolved.
Measured at the ADMISSION boundary (elevation admitted vs blocked), upstream of the
committed-selection argmin and therefore not absorbed; if any downstream behavioural
DV is added, apply SHARED-CONVERSION-PRECONDITION (G4).
FALSIFYING: (1) the field-coherence readout and MECH-434's posterior-sufficiency
signal are shown to be monotone transforms of each other across the tested regime --
MECH-500 has no independent content and MECH-434 subsumes it. (2) A leaky-accumulator
readiness signal with no coherence term matches or beats the coherence-gated one on
commitment timing -- the Schurger parsimony result carried into REE. (3) The
coherence readout does not track the branching-to-converged transition it is posited
to locate.

MECH-501.subject: commitment.interrupt_triggered_now_reconstruction
MECH-501.title: Interruption of a committed trajectory by a sufficiently consequential prediction violation should trigger an explicit BACKWARD RECONSTRUCTION of the current-state estimate proposed by ARC-129 -- a measurable discontinuity in which the forward-displaced predicted-now s_hat(t+tau) is replaced by a less-displaced, evidence-corrected estimate closer to s_hat(t) -- distinct from, and downstream of, gate re-opening (MECH-090) and decommitment (MECH-342), which govern behavioral/ACTION authority but say nothing about what happens to the STATE REPRESENTATION consumed as 'now' at the moment of interrupt. Expected corollary: unexpected interruption of a highly predictable action-linked sequence should produce stronger state-estimate reconstruction than an expected within-trajectory correction of the same magnitude.
MECH-501.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires ARC-129's displaced-present substitution built and live
(see ARC-129's what_would_answer -- do not re-derive), PLUS separate instrumentation of the
STATE ESTIMATE itself at the moment of interrupt (a value distinct from MECH-090's gate state
and MECH-342's decommit signal) so a discontinuity in the state representation, not merely in
gate/decommit signals, is independently measurable. Requires trials spanning graded
prediction-error magnitude sufficient to cross whatever "sufficiently consequential"
threshold triggers reconstruction, and both expected (within-trajectory) and unexpected
(interrupt) corrections of matched magnitude, so the claim's own corollary (unexpected >
expected) is discriminable.

CONFIRMING: at a sufficiently large prediction-error interrupt, the consumed state estimate
shows a measurable discontinuity -- a jump from the displaced estimate s_hat(t+tau) toward
the less-displaced s_hat(t) -- that persists as a distinct effect after conditioning on
MECH-090's gate-state and MECH-342's decommit-state (i.e. not explained by either alone), and
unexpected interrupts produce a reliably LARGER discontinuity than expected within-trajectory
corrections of matched prediction-error magnitude.

FALSIFYING: no measurable state-estimate discontinuity at interrupt beyond what MECH-090's
gate state and MECH-342's decommit already explain, or unexpected and expected corrections of
matched magnitude produce statistically indistinguishable discontinuities -- either result
falsifies interrupt-triggered reconstruction as a mechanism DISTINCT from existing
gate/decommit machinery (does not falsify ARC-129 itself, only this corollary).

BLOCKING SUBSTRATE: doubly blocked -- ARC-129's substitution mechanism does not exist (see
there), and even were it built, no interrupt-triggered state-reconstruction operator or
instrumentation exists in ree_core/heartbeat/beta_gate.py or ree_core/agent.py (verified
2026-09-25: MECH-090's existing what_would_answer covers gate hold/release and BetaGate
propagation_count/hold_count only, nothing about the downstream-consumed state estimate).

NOTES: the postdictive/backward-referral literature analogy the claim names (intentional
binding, chronostasis, saccadic predictive remapping) is explicitly flagged in the claim's
own notes as owed and not yet pulled. This is a citation debt on the framing, not a fused
out-of-domain leg -- the falsifier above is fully REE-internal and does not require the
literature to resolve; do not route this to (c2).

MECH-502.subject: commitment.nested_multiscale_displacement_horizons
MECH-502.title: Because REE can hold multiple simultaneously-active commitments at different behavioural scales (e.g., a fine-grained motor/action-level commitment nested within a longer path/sequence-level commitment, itself nested within a longer goal-level commitment), the displaced-present construction proposed by ARC-129 should not be modeled as one global scalar displacement but as potentially several concurrently-active, differently-scoped forward-displacement horizons -- with local interrupt/correction at a fine-grained level (e.g., a single-step prediction-error correction) plausibly not requiring re-opening of a coarser-grained commitment, and vice versa. This is a nesting-of-DISPLACEMENT-HORIZONS claim, distinct from ARC-070/MECH-321's nesting of POLICY-DECOMPOSITION depth (which recursively re-segments candidate action primitives, not the temporal position of the consumed current-state estimate).
MECH-502.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires ARC-129's single-horizon substitution built and live
(see ARC-129's what_would_answer), PLUS a task with genuinely nested commitments at >=2
distinct behavioural timescales operating concurrently (e.g. a fine motor/action-level
commitment inside a longer path/sequence-level commitment), so a single global displacement
scalar and multiple per-scale displacement scalars make DIFFERENT predictions -- without
concurrent nesting the two models are indistinguishable and any run is vacuous.

CONFIRMING: a local (fine-grained) interrupt/correction at one commitment scale occurs
without propagating a discontinuity to a coarser-grained commitment's displacement horizon
(and, symmetrically, a genuinely coarse-scale interrupt does not force a fine-scale
discontinuity) -- measured as a within-scale discontinuity (per MECH-501's instrument, once
that exists) at the perturbed scale with no corresponding discontinuity at the unperturbed
scale(s).

FALSIFYING: a fine-grained, single-step correction always propagates a matched discontinuity
to the coarser commitment's displacement horizon (or vice versa) -- i.e. a single global
displacement scalar already accounts for the data and no per-scale structure is needed. This
would not falsify ARC-129 (single-horizon displacement could still hold) but would falsify
the NESTING extension specifically, meaning ARC-016/MECH-090's existing single
commit/uncommitted state per tick is sufficient and need not be generalized per-scale.

BLOCKING SUBSTRATE: triply blocked -- ARC-129's substitution mechanism does not exist; REE's
commitment substrate (ARC-016/MECH-090) is presently modeled as ONE commit/uncommitted state
per agent-tick, not per-scale (confirmed by the claim's own notes and by the single BetaGate
instance in ree_core/heartbeat/beta_gate.py); and no nested multi-scale commitment substrate
exists to host multiple concurrently-active horizons.

NOTES: ARC-070's built policy-decomposition substrate (ree_core/policy/
policy_decomposition.py, landed 2026-07-24, default OFF) is a superficially similar
multi-level structure but decomposes control PRIMITIVES (action-segmentation depth), not
temporal displacement horizons -- confirmed this is genuinely a different axis per the
claim's own cross-reference to ARC-070/MECH-321, so it does not partially satisfy this
claim's substrate requirement and should not be read as a head start.

MECH-503.subject: control_plane.motif_selection_and_content_binding
MECH-503.title: Motif selection and content binding: given a typed control demand or task requirement, the control plane should select a reusable computational motif (an operation such as maintain, compare, accumulate, sequence, retrieve, or estimate-uncertainty) from a repertoire and dynamically bind task-relevant content to it, as a step distinct from and inserted before/ alongside coalition/topology instantiation (MECH-481). Content binding and coalition/topology selection are proposed as separable causal axes: correct-coalition/wrong-binding and wrong-coalition/correct-binding should produce dissociable failure signatures if the axes are genuinely distinct.
MECH-503.what_would_answer: Primary falsifier -- COALITION x BINDING FACTORIAL (source thought Test D): a 2x2 diagnostic crossing {correct coalition, wrong coalition} x {correct content binding, wrong content binding}. CONFIRMING: the two manipulations produce DISSOCIABLE failure signatures (e.g. wrong-coalition/correct-binding degrades WHICH subsystems interact while the bound content remains usable to whichever subsystems do engage; correct-coalition/wrong-binding degrades what the correctly-recruited subsystems operate ON while their interaction structure stays intact) -- this would show topology control and binding control are genuinely separable causal axes, not one axis dressed as two. FAILING: the two manipulations produce the SAME failure signature, or wrong-coalition/correct-binding and correct-coalition/wrong-binding are behaviourally indistinguishable -- binding does no discriminative work beyond what coalition/topology control (SD-091/MECH-481) already provides, and this claim should be retired or folded into MECH-481 rather than treated as a separate axis. Secondary/corroborating -- RECOMBINATION TEST (Test C): two motifs developed/trained in separate contexts are recombined for a novel task never directly experienced; compare recombination (no structural learning) vs. de novo mechanism learning vs. a control with one required motif unavailable. A clean positive result is rapid, motif-recombination-specific transfer. NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (learned from the analogous MECH-481 4-arm design and the general REE non-degeneracy discipline): before trusting Test D's dissociation, confirm the "correct" coalition and "correct" binding conditions are each independently sufficient to solve the task at above-chance performance in isolation -- otherwise a null dissociation is uninformative (substrate_not_ready), not a verdict against separability.

MECH-504.subject: developmental.other_agent_discovery_via_responsive_intervention
MECH-504.title: Developmental specialisation of the scientist-agent principle (MECH-276) for other-agent / responsive-entity discovery: parallel to MECH-278's stage-2 object-schema formation via experimental intervention on passive world-features, an agent discovers candidate other- minds by performing actions and testing which environmental entities' subsequent behaviour covaries with those actions (I-move to entity-responds; I-stop to entity-changes-behaviour; I-approach to entity-withdraws; I-pursue to entity-evades; I-signal to entity-changes-state), producing the RESPONSIVE-entity discrimination that a purely passive-world-focused curriculum (static hazards and resources only) cannot supply. This is the "V4 social-intervention mechanism (parallel to MECH-278 for other-agents)" MECH-276's own notes already name as a known specialisation but do not register.
MECH-504.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires an environment offering at least two superficially
similar cue-producing sources at curriculum-entry: one exogenous/passive (stable stochastic
rule, uncorrelated with the agent's behaviour) and one RESPONSIVE (behaviour measurably
covaries with the agent's own prior actions -- approach/withdrawal, pursuit/evasion,
signal/state-change, or simpler). Without a genuinely responsive counterpart, "discovering
agency via intervention" cannot be distinguished from ordinary world-model learning, and the
claim is untestable by construction. No existing V3 CausalGridWorld variant is confirmed to
supply this (ARC-047's SocialGridWorld is the designated candidate substrate but is itself
unimplemented, status candidate, confidence 0.0, gated v5 per ARC-010's own testability
note) -- this precondition needs its own dedicated environment check, not an inherited
pass/fail from an adjacent claim.

CONFIRMING signature: an agent using only the existing self/world scientist-agent
experimentation machinery (MECH-276/277/278's shared mechanism, applied here to entities
rather than passive features) discovers, through its own actions and without a dedicated
social-cognition module, which entities' behaviour is conditioned on its own actions --
i.e. the responsive/non-responsive discrimination emerges from the SAME experimental-
intervention logic MECH-278 already uses for object-schema formation, requiring no
additional architecture beyond redirecting the intervention target from world-features to
candidate-entity behaviour. This discrimination should then measurably improve MECH-031's
AGENCY/OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging accuracy relative to a version trained only on static
hazards/resources (no responsive entities in the curriculum).

FALSIFYING signature: the responsive/non-responsive discrimination requires a dedicated
social-cognition detector that cannot be reduced to the existing scientist-agent
experimentation logic reused from MECH-278 -- i.e. redirecting the SAME mechanism to
entity-behaviour targets fails to produce above-chance discrimination even with adequate
intervention density, meaning other-agent discovery is not, in fact, a specialisation of
the general scientist-agent principle and needs its own architecture, contrary to what
MECH-276's notes already anticipate.

MECH-505.subject: social.fast_empathy_gated_transfer_requirement
MECH-505.title: Fast-empathy other-harm transfer into REE's own valuation/action-selection must be a GATED channel, regulated along (at minimum) six axes -- mapping fidelity, self/other identity preservation, gain control (regulatable transfer magnitude), context gating (familiarity, attachment, kinship, threat, competition, role), timescale differentiation (brief resonance vs. sustained caregiving), and graded action-selection authority (able to suppress self-serving action or trigger costly protection when warranted) -- with interaction history able to update future transfer, rather than an undifferentiated scalar leak from other-harm to self-harm.
MECH-505.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (claim's own words, restructured): requires MECH-031/ARC-010
other-agent detection (ARC-047 SocialGridWorld, v5-gated, confidence 0.0, unimplemented) AND the
fast_empathy_v5 binding substrate (MECH-183/405) to exist first. Verified 2026-09-25: neither exists
in ree_core (no social/mirror/other_agent/OTHER_SELFLIKE/lambda_empathy/v_other_veto hits anywhere).
Also requires MECH-506's functional otherhood threshold to be operational -- an entity must first be
classified as a "vulnerable goal-directed other" before there is anything to gate transfer TO.

CONFIRMING: once the gated channel exists, transfer magnitude (other-harm's influence on self
action-selection) varies independently along the six named axes rather than moving as one
undifferentiated scalar: (i) MAPPING FIDELITY -- transfer tracks self/other harm-mapping accuracy
(degraded mapping -> proportionally degraded, not binary, transfer); (ii) IDENTITY PRESERVATION --
self and other harm remain separately legible post-transfer, action-selection is not wholesale
overwritten; (iii) GAIN CONTROL -- transfer magnitude is tunable independently of mapping accuracy
and context; (iv) CONTEXT GATING -- transfer strength varies with familiarity/attachment/kinship/
threat/competition/role at matched mapping and gain; (v) TIMESCALE -- brief-resonance and
sustained-caregiving transfer dissociate WITHIN one interaction; (vi) ACTION-SELECTION AUTHORITY --
transfer can suppress self-serving action or trigger costly protection only GRADEDLY, under
conditions the gate specifies, and interaction history updates future transfer (MECH-407's narrower
repair case is one instance).

FALSIFYING: transfer behaves as a single undifferentiated scalar -- manipulating any one axis while
holding the other five fixed fails to move transfer independently -- OR action-selection authority is
all-or-nothing (fully suppresses self-serving action or never does, no graded middle). Either result
supports the "raw leak" account this claim explicitly rejects and folds it back into ungated MECH-183
leakage.

OUT-OF-DOMAIN NOTE: the biological literature the source thought flags (mirror-neuron systems for
mapping; oxytocin/AVP for context-gating; prolactin for timescale/sustained-caregiving; endogenous
opioids and PAG/hypothalamus/amygdala/ACC/insula/NAcc for gain and action-selection-authority) is
GROUNDING/precedent literature for the six-axis design, explicitly "NOT verified in this pass" per
the claim's own notes -- it informs which REE-internal mechanism to build, not a claim that REE
itself models neuromodulator physiology. This lit-pull debt is not yet owned by any EMP-* node
(EMP-7's scope is MECH-405/408 only); recommend a new node or an EMP-7 scope extension when MECH-505
nears build.

UNBLOCKS WHEN: MECH-506 operational AND MECH-183/405 binding substrate exists AND MECH-031/ARC-010
other-agent detection exists (ARC-047). DO NOT queue a V3 experiment.

MECH-506.subject: social.operational_otherhood_functional_threshold
MECH-506.title: An entity crosses an operational "vulnerable goal-directed other" threshold when convergent evidence shows (a) diverse behaviour compactly predicted by persistent latent goals and (b) systematic, adaptive alteration of subsequent behaviour in response to harm, threat, goal-frustration, damage, or restoration -- a functional/behavioural criterion sufficient for protective treatment while explicitly preserving uncertainty about subjective experience, and distinct from both MECH-031's self-model-possession criterion and EXT-009/INV-072's similarity-based ethical-inclusion criterion.
MECH-506.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (claim's own words, restructured): requires a substrate where an
entity's behaviour can be observed responding systematically to harm/goal-frustration across
MULTIPLE episodes (multi-agent or scripted-partner substrate). Verified 2026-09-25: not present in
ree_core today. Also requires INV-102's C_other causal-attribution-to-an-other-agent-hypothesis
machinery to fire first (upstream prerequisite per this claim's own depends_on note) -- itself
substrate_conditional / MAE-3-blocked.

CONFIRMING: an REE agent exposed to a target entity across multiple episodes classifies that target
as crossing the operational otherhood threshold when (a) the target's diverse behaviour is compactly
predicted by a persistent latent-goal representation (a low-dimensional goal estimate outperforms a
no-persistent-goal baseline on held-out behaviour prediction) AND (b) the target's subsequent
behaviour changes systematically and adaptively following harm/threat/goal-frustration/damage/
restoration events (a direction-consistent shift, not noise) -- AND this classification is
DISSOCIABLE from both MECH-031's self-model-possession criterion (a scripted target satisfying (a)+
(b) but with no self/world loop should still cross this threshold while failing MECH-031's) and
EXT-009/INV-072's similarity criterion (a low-similarity but goal-directed/harm-responsive target
should still cross this threshold).

FALSIFYING: the functional criterion collapses onto one of the two criteria it claims to be distinct
from -- classification tracks self-model-possession (MECH-031) or similarity-to-self (EXT-009/
INV-072) with no independent variance -- in which case MECH-506 adds nothing over existing machinery
and should be folded back into whichever criterion it collapsed onto.

UNBLOCKS WHEN: a multi-agent or scripted-partner substrate exists (ARC-047 or equivalent) AND
INV-102's other-agent causal attribution is live. DO NOT queue a V3 experiment.

NOTES: consistent with sibling batch G008's EXT-009 draft (this session), which independently cites
MECH-506 as the candidate NON-similarity care route that would, if it binds independently of
similarity, dissolve EXT-009's structural-dehumanization failure mode. Both drafts now agree:
functional/behavioural criterion, explicitly NOT similarity-based, explicitly NOT a sentience claim.

MECH-507.subject: e1.compression_decompression_bridge
MECH-507.title: E1's persistent context should be reframed as an explicit RECIPROCAL compression/decompression bridge, not merely a latent representation with compression left implicit inside ordinary representation learning: high-dimensional experience, autobiographical history, and body state compress into a lower-dimensional organising state z_t, and z_t decompresses into higher- dimensional predictions and candidate sensorimotor futures. Compression is what makes different high-dimensional situations become functionally equivalent when they imply sufficiently similar action-relevant consequences; decompression is what turns that summary back into usable prospective content for downstream planning.
MECH-507.what_would_answer:
SHARED INSTRUMENT -- EQUIVALENCE-CLASS MAP (ECM), defined here and cited by MECH-508/509/511:
  For held-out situation pairs (s_i, s_j), measure four distances: d_obs (raw observation
  distance), d_z (distance between the compressed states), d_dec (distance between the decompressed
  prospective outputs: predicted futures or proposal distributions), and d_cons (ground-truth
  consequence distance under matched action sequences, from counterfactual rollout on a
  copy.deepcopy(env) snapshot, the idiom used by V3-EXQ-981a and V3-EXQ-1006). The ECM is the
  partition that thresholding d_z induces. The ACTION-RELEVANCE score is the partial rank
  correlation rho(d_z, d_cons | d_obs). Include pairs that look the same but have different
  consequences, and pairs that look different but have the same consequences.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) the E1/ContextMemory site has a TRAINED decompression stage, i.e.
  a generative head from the compressed context state to predicted futures or candidate proposals
  (absent today: ContextMemory, e1_deep.py:67, is an attention lookup, and the only downstream
  proposal map, hippocampal.terrain_prior, is untrained). (2) The env yields both kinds of
  informative pair above, with enough of each per seed to estimate the partial correlation
  (report the per-class counts). (3) The compressed state is not collapsed: d_z variance is above
  a shuffled floor.
CONFIRMING: with the bridge trained, (a) rho(d_z, d_cons | d_obs) > 0 and above both an
  untrained-bridge arm and a no-compression arm (identity or full-state), at >= 0.8 SD of the
  seed-to-seed delta; (b) d_dec predicts d_cons; and (c) freezing or zeroing the decompression half
  at matched seeds removes the downstream planning benefit while leaving (a) intact. That shows
  the two halves do separable jobs.
FALSIFYING: with (1)-(3) met, the compressed state's partition tracks appearance (d_obs), not
  consequence; OR the decompression half adds nothing over reading the compressed state directly;
  OR a non-reciprocal arm (compression only, with the decompression head replaced by a plain
  readout) does equally well.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: MECH-532 lands a confirmed trained-decompression pairing at either site (z_world
  via SD-056+SD-070, or O via SD-080). The E1/ContextMemory head is then the next build.
READINESS PROBE (runnable now; NOT a test of this claim): the ECM action-relevance score on the
  existing MECH-150 cue_context path (V3-EXQ-922 config) gives the compression-half baseline this
  claim's arm (a) would be compared against.

MECH-508.subject: attractor.compressed_generative_disposition
MECH-508.title: An REE attractor is best formalised as a compressed, history-conditioned GENERATIVE DISPOSITION defining a family and probability distribution over possible sensorimotor trajectories -- not a stored proposition (e.g. "this is threat") and not a fixed memory object -- whose precision controls how strongly it constrains interpretation and future generation, and into which incoming precision-weighted evidence may select, modify, or (if sufficiently consequential) remodel or displace. Its pathology separates into two independent failure axes that can co-occur but must not be conflated: EXCESSIVE PRECISION (the attractor is treated as extremely certain, strongly constraining interpretation/retrieval/generation -- the "perceptual lens" failure, where material the attractor itself generates or biases gets counted as independent confirming evidence) and EXCESSIVE COMPRESSION (too many distinct situations are collapsed into one action-relevant equivalence class, independent of how confident the system is in that collapsed class).
MECH-508.what_would_answer:
DERIVATIONAL LEG (the "best formalised as" half): adopting the generative-disposition form over a
  stored-proposition form is justified only if it predicts something the proposition form does not.
  The discriminating prediction: attractor influence on proposals and interpretation is GRADED and
  DISTRIBUTIONAL (it shifts the proposal distribution's mass and spread in proportion to
  precision), not a categorical relabel. If every observed attractor effect is reproduced by a
  binary tag, the formalisation adds nothing.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) compression depth is an independently settable variable (MECH-512;
  absent, no knob at any timescale in e1_deep.py). (2) Generative precision is an independently
  settable ENDOGENOUS quantity (MECH-510's precondition (1)). (3) The ECM instrument (MECH-507's wwa;
  do not re-derive) is live at the attractor's site. Hand-set hyperparameters (e.g. CEM ao_std,
  mode_noise_scale) do NOT satisfy (1) or (2): two different knobs having different effects is
  trivially true and tests nothing.
SHARED 2x2 DISSOCIATION (anchor; MECH-510 cites it): cross compression depth {matched, excessive}
  with generative precision {matched, excessive} at matched seeds and training. Two DVs:
  CAPTURE, the fraction of evidence-contradicting episodes in which the attractor's
  proposal/interpretation distribution fails to shift toward the evidence (the "perceptual lens"
  signature, including self-generated material counted as confirmation); and OVERGENERALISATION,
  the ECM merge error (pairs with large d_cons placed in one class).
CONFIRMING: the axes dissociate. Excessive precision raises CAPTURE with the ECM merge error
  unchanged. Excessive compression raises the merge error with CAPTURE unchanged at matched
  precision. The double-excess cell shows both, and main effects exceed 0.8 SD of the seed-to-seed
  delta.
FALSIFYING: with (1)-(3) met, the two manipulations produce the same signature (one failure axis,
  not two); OR one axis produces no effect on either DV across a non-degenerate range. A failure
  under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

MECH-509.subject: hippocampal.pre_rollout_possibility_field
MECH-509.title: A cheap, E1-context-conditioned decompression stage should generate a structured POSSIBILITY FIELD -- a proposal distribution over plausible sensorimotor futures, P(possible futures | z_t, current context) -- from which a SMALLER NUMBER of candidate trajectories are sampled for expensive hippocampal/E2 rollout, rather than rollout sampling from an unconstrained space. The possibility field is a computational claim about staging (cheap generative field BEFORE expensive trajectory simulation), not a claim that an explicit long-horizon rollout mechanism has been biologically identified.
MECH-509.what_would_answer:
Uses MECH-507's ECM instrument and d_cons (do not re-derive).
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) the E1-conditioned proposal stage is TRAINED. Today that stage is
  hippocampal.terrain_prior (module.py:169, :562-610), fed a live e1_prior (agent.py:6956) and
  trained by no ree_core loss, so it is a frozen random projection of E1 context. (2) The
  action-object space O is trained (SD-080). Otherwise candidate diversity is measured in a
  meaningless coordinate system. (3) The comparison is at a matched rollout budget (the number of
  E2 rollouts) and reports the per-arm candidate counts.
ARMS: (A) trained E1-conditioned field; (B) the current untrained terrain_prior; (C) unconditioned
  (e1_prior zeroed); (D) arm A with the residue channel ablated
  (terrain_prior_residue_channel_enabled=False). Arm D checks that any gain is E1-derived, not
  terrain-derived.
CONFIRMING: at matched or smaller rollout budget, arm A reaches equal or better selection outcome
  AND higher coverage of consequence-distinct futures (the fraction of d_cons-distinct outcome
  classes hit by the sampled candidates) than arms B and C. The advantage survives arm D.
FALSIFYING: with (1)-(3) met, arm A shows no efficiency or coverage gain over C; OR its gain
  vanishes under the residue ablation (the field is terrain, not E1 context); OR it narrows
  candidates into recency or attractor capture (the SD-038 failure mode: coverage falls while the
  outcome holds only on the training distribution).
NOTE: the staging claim does not require the field to be biologically identified (per title).

MECH-510.subject: precision.generative_vs_error_routing
MECH-510.title: Prediction precision -- how strongly a generative attractor constrains interpretation and proposal generation -- and prediction-error precision/salience -- how much a discrepancy is trusted to drive correction or learning -- are separable control-plane quantities that need not move together and should be routable independently. An overprecise prediction combined with underweighted error produces capture (the attractor dominates regardless of contrary evidence); noisy but highly salient errors can produce instability (the system is destabilised by unreliable discrepancies). REE already treats precision as heterogeneous rather than scalar (MECH-043, MECH-054); this claim proposes GENERATIVE/interpretive precision as a further, independently-routable axis distinct from both the unsigned-error channel MECH-043 names and the signed harm/benefit valence split MECH-054 names.
MECH-510.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) an ENDOGENOUS prediction-precision estimate (the SD-PP-2
  WorldForwardEpistemicPrecision pi_epi is the candidate; landed 2026-09-22, default OFF) has a
  GENERATIVE consumer where it sets how strongly the prediction constrains proposals or
  interpretation, e.g. scaling CEM proposal concentration or the E1-prior weight. Absent today:
  pi_epi's only consumer is the SD-PP-4 sleep write gain. (2) An error-trust channel is live and
  off its ceiling. Use MECH-043's de-saturated dacc_precision_scale lever and its non-degeneracy
  clause (do not re-derive), or SD-PP-1 evidence precision. (3) The two estimates are not the same
  statistic: their correlation across ticks is below 1 and each moves under its own manipulation.
  Sweeping hand-set hyperparameters does not satisfy (1).
CONFIRMING: (a) the two quantities co-vary imperfectly in normal operation. (b) Perturbing each
  alone yields dissociable signatures. The CAPTURE leg (high prediction precision + low error
  trust) raises MECH-508's CAPTURE DV (cite MECH-508's 2x2; do not re-derive). The INSTABILITY leg
  (noisy but high-trust errors) raises the variance of proposal/interpretation updates and
  commitment reversals without raising CAPTURE.
FALSIFYING: with (1)-(3) met, the two estimates are interchangeable (perturbing either yields the
  same signature, or one is a deterministic function of the other); OR routing them separately
  adds nothing over a single shared precision scalar at matched budget. That would collapse this
  axis into MECH-043's channel.
NOTE: the SD-PP-4 K_i = ev/(ev + pi_cur) routing already shows the two quantities are separately
  computable on the update-authority side. That is a precedent for the separation, not evidence
  for the generative-side claim.

MECH-511.subject: learning.deep_update_eligibility_function
MECH-511.title: Durable ("deep") revision of E1 or a deep attractor should be gated by a LEARNING ELIGIBILITY function of (error, error precision, predicted future/control relevance, organism-or-other consequence, evidence provenance, current mode) -- not by raw error magnitude alone. Candidate routing: low-consequence mismatch -> local correction; significant mismatch -> retained as pending integration material; high-confidence/high-consequence mismatch -> waking adaptation and active information-seeking; contradiction of a deep attractor -> preserve and contest rather than immediately rewrite; accumulated or structurally important contradiction -> counterfactual reprocessing and possible offline revision. Whether a deep update actually occurred should be measured by whether the EQUIVALENCE CLASSES an attractor uses to generate future possibilities changed, not merely by whether stored content changed -- a corollary measurement criterion, since content can change without the generative structure changing.
MECH-511.what_would_answer:
MEASUREMENT CRITERION (the claim's corollary; uses MECH-507's ECM, do not re-derive): a DEEP update
  occurred iff the attractor's ECM partition changed. Score it with the adjusted Rand index between
  pre- and post-update partitions over a fixed held-out situation set: ARI clearly below 1 counts,
  against a same-seed no-update drift floor. A CONTENT-only update changes stored values or slots
  but leaves ARI at the floor.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) an eligibility gate reads at least the three inputs the claim adds
  beyond SD-PP-4: predicted future/control relevance, organism/other consequence, and mode (absent
  in ree_core; SD-PP-4 covers error, error precision and provenance, sleep only, default OFF).
  (2) The ECM instrument is live at a site with trained decompression (MECH-507 precondition 1).
  (3) The stimulus set spans all five routing rows: low-consequence mismatch, significant mismatch,
  high-confidence/high-consequence mismatch, a deep-attractor contradiction, and accumulated
  contradiction.
CONFIRMING: at matched raw error magnitude, the routing follows the table. Low-consequence mismatch
  gives content change with ARI at the floor. High-consequence, high-confidence mismatch gives
  waking adaptation plus information-seeking. A single deep-attractor contradiction is preserved
  (ARI at the floor during waking) while accumulated contradiction produces an ECM change after
  offline revision. That timing reading is also how the claim is compatible with SD-PP-4's
  anti-self-sealing reopen factor, which acts offline. A raw-error-magnitude gate arm fails to
  reproduce this pattern.
FALSIFYING: with (1)-(3) met, deep (ECM-changing) updates are predicted as well by raw error
  magnitude alone as by the eligibility function; OR ECM change never separates from content change
  (the criterion is not measurable); OR single deep-attractor contradictions are rewritten at once
  in waking with no preserve-and-contest phase.

MECH-512.subject: representation.momentary_compression_depth
MECH-512.title: The level of abstraction / compression depth selected when compressing experience into an attractor or context representation is a MOMENTARY, functionally consequential control variable -- too much compression overgeneralises (distinct contexts collapsed into one action-relevant class); too little compression prevents useful generalisation and leaves the system overly concrete or uncertain. This momentary compression-depth axis is separable both from prediction confidence/precision (MECH-510) and from total representational CAPACITY -- distinguished explicitly from MECH-496/INV-101's slower DEVELOPMENTAL crystallisation of bucket COUNT: MECH-496/INV-101 concern how many buckets an architecture resolves to over a training-scale critical-period schedule; this claim concerns how much a GIVEN instance of compression discards versus retains at inference time, which could vary moment to moment even under a fixed bucket count.
MECH-512.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (i) a compression operator whose depth is a PER-INSTANCE variable
(varies within an episode). None exists in ree_core; SD-016's learnable attention temperature does
not qualify (one global scalar, on retrieval sharpness, precision-like). (ii) ContextMemory occupies
>= 2 slots -- inherits MECH-496 precondition (i) (V3-EXQ-436f: 3/5 seeds at 1 of 16 slots); do not
re-derive. (iii) An environment with ground-truth context structure in which some distinct contexts
require DIFFERENT actions and some superficially different contexts share ONE optimal action, so both
over- and under-compression carry a measurable cost. (iv) Precision/confidence (MECH-510) and
capacity (slot count) recorded per decision, so both can be held fixed or conditioned out.
CONFIRMING: at fixed slot count and matched precision, compression depth shows an inverted U:
over-compression collapses action-distinct contexts (cross-context action error), under-compression
fails to transfer to novel members of an equivalent class (within-class generalisation error);
per-instance depth predicts per-decision error beyond slot count and precision; and per-instance
depth selection beats the BEST FIXED depth (the "momentary control variable" leg). Double
dissociation: manipulating precision at fixed depth does not reproduce the over/under-generalisation
error pattern.
FALSIFYING: depth effects are fully explained by precision or capacity once conditioned; OR
performance is monotone in depth (it is a capacity parameter, not a control variable); OR the best
fixed depth matches per-instance selection (the claim reduces to MECH-496's developmental axis).
NOTES: supplies the control variable for MECH-508's "excessive compression" failure mode; MECH-508's
wwa, when drafted, should cross-reference this one. UNBLOCKS WHEN: MECH-496's num_slots probe
(manual_proposals.v1.json, proposed, not run) shows slot count is load-bearing and an allocation
policy lands, and a compression operator with a per-instance depth exists.

MECH-513.subject: memory.representation_version_reindexing
MECH-513.title: Representation-version reindexing for episodic memory: when the representational primitives used to index memory change -- a bucket splits, several buckets merge, ContextMemory's effective dimensionality crystallises to a different count (MECH-496), or the underlying encoder is otherwise updated -- previously stored episodes must be explicitly reinstated and reindexed under the new scheme via an ADDITIVE, versioned relationship rather than an overwrite: the episode, its source, and its original indexing remain independently recoverable, the new indexing is created as a distinct version with provenance back to the change that produced it, and the episode should remain interpretable under both the historical and the current representational scheme.
MECH-513.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (a) a representation-version / addressing-scheme concept must exist in
ree_core distinguishing "which indexing scheme currently applies to a stored episode" from the
episode's content -- verified 2026-09-25 by grep, zero hits for any reindex/representation-version
concept anywhere in the codebase; (b) the change driver itself, MECH-496 (dimensionality
crystallization), must actually fire a change -- MECH-496 is unbuilt as a full mechanism
(ContextMemory is a fixed 16-slot buffer with no growth or allocation policy, per MECH-496's own
registration note), though it has a cheap num_slots-sweep PROBE that could run without the full
mechanism; that probe has not been run as of 2026-09-25 (no matching entry in
experiment_queue.json or claim_evidence.v1.json).

CONFIRMING (once both exist): when a bucket split/merge/dimensionality change occurs, every episode
indexed under the prior scheme remains recoverable under BOTH its original indexing and a new
versioned indexing with provenance back to the triggering change, verified by round-tripping a
sample of pre-change episodes through both index versions and confirming stable content identity
plus correct new-scheme placement.

FALSIFYING: episodes indexed under a prior scheme become silently inaccessible or misattributed
after a representational change, with no versioned record of the prior scheme surviving. A failure
under the unmet preconditions above is not evidence against the claim.

NOTE: not a duplicate of MECH-392/INV-080 -- those cover content-abstraction provenance; this
covers addressing-scheme provenance (see this claim's own notes for the full distinction; do not
re-derive). MECH-551 (out-of-group) already cross-references this claim rather than duplicating it
("item (3) of the offline list is already owned here").

UNBLOCKS WHEN: MECH-496 substrate lands (or at minimum its num_slots-sweep probe runs and shows the
effective bucket count is non-degenerate) AND a representation-version concept is designed into the
memory store (V4 scope; no substrate_queue entry yet).

MECH-514.subject: hippocampal.counterfactual_replay_model_comparison
MECH-514.title: Counterfactual replay for attractor testing: an offline-preferred process that (1) separates preserved, externally-grounded evidence from a dominant model's interpretation of it, (2) temporarily reduces that dominant attractor's influence over retrieval and interpretation, (3) constructs a small set of bounded alternative explanatory models, (4) replays the SAME anchored evidence through the dominant and alternative models to generate predictions that would distinguish them, and (5) compares the models against held-out or subsequent waking evidence before any resulting reindexing is granted full action or memory authority. Every replay-derived item carries provenance to its originating evidence and generating model so that repeated simulations from one episode cannot be counted as multiple independent confirmatory samples, and the process selecting what gets replayed must have some independence from the attractor under test.
MECH-514.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a multi-model explanatory-comparison substrate must exist -- the
ability to hold >=2 bounded alternative models of the same anchored evidence and replay it through
each to generate discriminating predictions -- distinct from MECH-269's single-anchor reset/probe
(which compares one model's rollout against a threshold, not several models against each other).
CURRENTLY UNMET, verified 2026-09-25: no multi-model comparison code exists in ree_core, and
MECH-269 (the nearest live substrate this would extend) is still candidate/v3_pending on its own
single-anchor behavioural-sufficiency test -- the most recent falsifier-completion audit
(2026-09-21, resumed 2026-09-22) re-confirms propose_trajectories never consults per_stream_vs or
the anchor set, so even the single-model ingredient this claim would compose is not yet
functioning, let alone a multi-model extension of it.

CONFIRMING (once built): the dominant model and >=1 alternative model, replayed against the SAME
anchored evidence, generate predictions that discriminate against subsequent/held-out waking
evidence; the alternative model's predictions win on a pre-registered accuracy metric in a
meaningful fraction of cases where the dominant attractor was undifferentiated (the ARC-132
precondition), AND provenance tagging confirms no episode's replay-derived predictions are
double-counted as independent samples (the anti-pseudo-replication requirement the claim treats as
load-bearing).

FALSIFYING: replayed alternative models never outperform the dominant model even when it is
demonstrably miscalibrated against held-out evidence, or repeated replay from one episode is
indistinguishable (by the system's own bookkeeping) from independent confirmatory samples --
reproducing the model-collapse failure mode the claim is designed to prevent (Shumailov et al.
2024, cited as general-principle corroboration, not a direct test of this mechanism). A failure
under the unmet precondition above is not evidence against the claim.

UNBLOCKS WHEN: MECH-269 clears v3_pending (goal_pipeline:GAP-4 / V3-EXQ-490g Tier-1 retest cohort)
AND a multi-model comparison layer is designed on top of it (V4/V5 scope).

MECH-515.subject: control_plane.multiagent_strategic_delay_cost
MECH-515.title: In multi-agent settings, the cost of continued deliberation is not only an opportunity cost against a passive, unchanging world (the internal expected-value-of-information trade MECH-434 already governs) but a STRATEGIC cost that another goal-directed agent can actively impose: a competing mind can occupy a contested resource, block a route, infer REE's objective from its information-seeking behaviour, conceal or manufacture evidence, or prepare an attack while REE continues gathering evidence. A commitment-timing mechanism that weighs only pragmatic-vs-epistemic value against a static environment will systematically over-deliberate whenever another agent is present and can act on REE's delay; the commitment threshold/urgency term must therefore also be sensitive to detected other-agent presence and behaviour, not internal information value alone.
MECH-515.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A multi-agent substrate with a working other-agent-state estimate
must exist (ARC-047 SocialGridWorld, confirmed UNIMPLEMENTED: grep -rniE
"socialgridworld|social_grid|other_agent|mirror_model" under ree-v3/ree_core/ and
ree-v3/experiments/ returns zero hits; registry confirms confidence: 0.0, status: candidate,
implementation_phase: v5) AND MECH-434's single-agent commitment-timing mechanism must itself be
live (MECH-434 is substrate_conditional on the V4 belief-state substrate -- see MECH-434's
existing what_would_answer; do not re-derive) AND ARC-010's other-agent policy-inference channel
must be producing an above-chance estimate of the other agent's behaviour (see ARC-010's existing
what_would_answer, itself gated on the same ARC-047 substrate).

CONFIRMING: at matched pragmatic/epistemic value (MECH-434's own inverted-U terms held constant),
commitment occurs measurably EARLIER when a detected other agent is present and behaviourally
positioned to exploit REE's delay (occupying a contested resource, moving to block, or producing
behaviour consistent with inferring REE's goal) than in a matched single-agent or
agent-present-but-behaviourally-inert control, AND the earlier commitment tracks a distinct
other-agent-derived cost term rather than merely a reduction in MECH-434's own epistemic-value
estimate.

FALSIFYING: commitment timing is statistically indistinguishable between other-agent-present and
other-agent-absent/inert conditions once MECH-434's internal EVOI terms are matched, OR the entire
effect is fully explained by INV-102's evidential-discounting term alone (the other agent's
presence only changes how much REE trusts evidence it already has, never how urgently it stops
gathering more) -- either result means no independent strategic-delay-cost term is needed beyond
existing single-agent and evidential-discounting machinery. A failure under an unmet precondition
above is not evidence against the claim.

DISTINCT FROM MECH-498 and INV-102 (per the claim's own notes, both confirmed still accurate):
MECH-498's disengagement is progress-gated (the process stops making headway); MECH-515 is
threat/competition-gated (a rival's action erodes outcome value independent of REE's own
progress). INV-102 discounts the evidential WEIGHT of an observation attributed to another agent;
MECH-515 raises the COST of further deliberation given another agent's mere presence, independent
of any new evidence being gathered at all.

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ARC-047 (SocialGridWorld, unbuilt), ARC-010 (mirror modelling
/ other-agent policy inference, unbuilt, coupled_with ARC-047), and MECH-434 (V4 belief-state
commitment-timing substrate, unbuilt). All three must land before this claim's manipulation is
constructible. DO NOT build a substrate or queue a V3 experiment without an explicit
version-routing decision, per the claim's own notes (confirmed current).

MECH-516.subject: selection.graded_value_categorical_interface
MECH-516.title: Argmax collapse at the incentive-to-goal interface: the per-object drive-conditioned value structure wanting[k] is computed over ALL stored objects and then reduced by most_wanted()'s ARGMAX to a single winner before it reaches selection, so z_goal is seeded from one object embedding and every candidate trajectory is scored against that one target. The comparative structure that would let candidates differ from one another for a value-relevant reason is destroyed upstream of the selector, not absent from it -- predicting that a downstream readout is FLAT in upstream wanting range except at rank flips, and becomes sloped when the argmax is replaced by a norm-matched graded read.
MECH-516.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (P1) LIVE SITE -- use_incentive_token_bank=True (DEFAULT-OFF, so a default-config run is vacuous for reasons unrelated to this claim); require bank_populated_frac == 1.0 and >= 3 distinct tokens each with a stored z_object. (P2) UPSTREAM RANGE IS REAL -- wanting_rel_range = (max_k w[k] - min_k w[k]) / (mean_k |w[k]| + 1e-9), median over scored ticks >= 0.10; if the wanting vector is near-flat there is no range to destroy. (P3) SEEDS ARE SEPARABLE -- z_object_min_pairwise_cos_dist >= 0.05, else argmax and mixture emit the same seed and the contrast is arithmetically empty. (P4) CONSUMER CAN MOVE -- e3_goal_score_cross_candidate_range > 1e-6 on >= 90% of scored ticks, and report f_variance_share (V3-EXQ-571 basis); > 0.95 forbids scoring any behavioural readout. ARMS (bit-identical otherwise, >= 3 seeds): ARM_ARGMAX (control) seed_latent = z_object[argmax_k w[k]], the current code; ARM_GRADED (treatment) seed_latent = sum_k softmax(w/T)[k] * z_object[k] RENORMED to ||z_object[k*]|| -- matched seed mass, so no result can be a seed-magnitude effect; ARM_SHUFFLE (negative control) the same mixture with w permuted across k -- identical arity and norm, value ORDERING destroyed, separating "graded value matters" from "mixing embeddings at all matters". Dose-sweep incentive_drive_kappa_scale over >= 5 levels spanning >= 1 order of magnitude in wanting_rel_range; record argmax_flip_rate. CONFIRMING (both legs required): (C1) under ARM_ARGMAX the downstream metric e3_goal_score_cross_candidate_range is FLAT in wanting_rel_range except at rank flips -- R^2(downstream ~ argmax_flip_rate) > R^2(downstream ~ wanting_rel_range) on >= 2/3 seeds; AND (C2) ARM_GRADED shows a monotone non-zero slope of the SAME metric on wanting_rel_range at matched seed norm, with mean(GRADED - SHUFFLE) >= max(1.0 * pstdev(per-seed delta), 0.05) on >= 2/3 seeds. FALSIFYING (any one): (F1) ARM_GRADED not separable from ARM_ARGMAX on any interface metric at matched seed norm with P1-P4 passing -- the argmax is not the binding constraint (the likely outcome, and the one that cleanly kills the claim); (F2) ARM_GRADED ~= ARM_SHUFFLE -- any lift is seed geometry, not graded VALUE; (F3) ARM_ARGMAX's downstream metric already tracks wanting_rel_range continuously (argmax_flip_rate high enough that the interface is effectively graded in practice) -- no destruction occurs.
