PRIOR EVIDENCE, PARTIAL AND CONSISTENT: V3-EXQ-514u (2026-06-20, PASS/supports MECH-436, 5 seeds) already ran flip-gated vs continuous readouts on this substrate -- flip-gated mean_wl_drive_delta -0.133 (sd 0.119), sign-unstable, FAILED its 0.15 margin; the sub-flip continuous mean_cont_amplitude_shift +0.164 (sd 0.022) cleared 5/5 against a hard 0.0 OFF floor. That is this claim confirmed AT THE INTERFACE, not behaviourally.

MECH-517.subject: methodology.interface_before_representation_ordering
MECH-517.title: Interface before representation: a representation improvement is undetectable through a collapsing interface, so representation-side experiments run before the consumer interface is fixed return nulls that cannot be interpreted. This is RIVAL to the standing differentiate-first ordering (differentiate z_world per INV-088, THEN apply diversity pressure). The two give opposite readings of the same result: V3-EXQ-817a verifiably improved O's consequence structure and produced no behavioural change, which differentiate-first reads as consequence structure does not help, and this claim reads as the measurement could not have detected help.
MECH-517.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both halves must be certified in the same run: the grounding manipulation must TAKE (ARM_1 median ao_M5_r2_explained_by_action_alone <= 0.90 with the shuffled control >= 0.99, reproducing 817a), and the interface arm must be demonstrably non-collapsing -- the CEM search width must not be set by the constant floor (ao_std_max > 1.10 x floor on a majority of scored iterations, or a matched support_preserving_ao_std_floor=0.0 arm).
CONFIRMING: The grounded-minus-frozen behavioural delta is positive and above a pre-registered, power-justified floor in the non-collapsing cell while remaining null in the collapsing cell -- 817a's null was a measurement property of the interface. Manipulation: A 2x2: O frozen versus consequence-grounded (the V3-EXQ-817a ARM_0/ARM_1 contrast, driver already written) crossed with collapsing versus non-collapsing interface (support_preserving_ao_std_floor at its 0.2 default versus 0.0, and/or the SD-082 centred candidate-summary readout). Control: 817a's ARM_2 shuffled-target content control, plus the frozen-O-with-non-collapsing-interface cell, which is what separates an interface effect from a representation effect. Required event: Action selection through the hippocampal CEM proposal interface while O carries either frozen or consequence-grounded structure, in an ecology where a behavioural benefit is in principle expressible. DV: The ORDERING contrast: the grounded-minus-frozen behavioural delta measured through the non-collapsing interface versus through the collapsing one. Interface-first predicts a benefit that appears only in the non-collapsing cell; differentiate-first predicts a null in both.
FALSIFYING: The grounded-minus-frozen delta is null in BOTH interface cells with the grounding certified to have taken and the interface certified non-collapsing -- the differentiate-first ordering survives and 817a's null bites on the representation. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Partially built. The propose-side diagnostics exist (cem_iteration_diagnostics ao_std_mean/ao_std_max, pre_refit_first_action_entropy, action_object_roundtrip_recovery) and the 817a driver arms exist, but no non-collapsing-interface arm has ever been defined or run, and 817a's behavioural DV has no power: ARM_0 harm_rate spans 0.021-0.702 across 5 seeds. Consumer / boundary: The representation-to-consumer interface (O to the CEM search coordinates and onward to the executed action), which is where this claim says a representation improvement is lost, not the representation itself. Existing ownership: MECH-518, SD-080, SD-082, INV-088, MECH-458, EXP-1114.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The claim never names what makes an interface non-collapsing, so its central manipulation is undefined; and the behavioural DV it needs is the one 817a showed is swamped by seed variance, so the contrast has no power as currently posed. Secondary classes: R5, R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-518.subject: hippocampal.action_object_dual_role_variance_contention
MECH-518.title: One tensor, two masters: E2.action_object_head's output O is simultaneously the semantic compression (what o_t means) and the search coordinate system the hippocampal CEM samples in (ao_mean + ao_std*noise, decoded to actions), so an objective that improves the first can degrade the second by reallocating a shared fixed budget -- O's variance. Measured in V3-EXQ-817a: ao_M5_r2_explained_by_action_alone fell from ~0.995 to ~0.721, moving roughly 28 percent of O's variance out of action-coding, while the consequence-ordering metric M6 remained weak and sign-unstable (mean ~+0.12, negative on 2 of 5 seeds). O stopped being a clean action code without becoming a reliable consequence code.
MECH-518.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (all four, in BOTH arms, or the read is vacuous): (P1) THE SEARCH BUDGET MUST NOT BE FLOOR-SET. HippocampalConfig defaults are use_support_preserving_cem=True with support_preserving_ao_std_floor=0.2, and the elite refit is clamped to that floor. Measured live on default config: CEM iteration 0 ao_std_mean 1.000 (constant init, not O); iteration 1 mean 0.206 (partly clamped); iteration 2 mean 0.2000003, min 0.200, max 0.200 (FULLY clamped) -- against ARM_0's own O carrying mean_per_dim_action_std 0.0296, an order of magnitude BELOW the floor. At defaults the CEM's search WIDTH is set by a constant rather than by O's variance, so the channel this claim is about cannot express itself. REQUIRE ao_std_max > 1.10 * floor on >= 50% of scored iterations in both arms, OR run a matched support_preserving_ao_std_floor=0.0 control arm and read the test there. (The floor value and the clamp measurement are sourced; the 1.10x / 50% trigger is a judgement call.) (P2) ARM_0 MUST HAVE DIVERSITY TO LOSE -- action_object_roundtrip_recovery.true_unique_classes >= 2 and pre_refit_first_action_entropy > 0.10 nats on >= 4/5 seeds. A candidate set already collapsed to one first-action class has no diversity for grounding to degrade, and a drop measured from zero is not a drop. (P3) FLOAT32 GUARD (V3-EXQ-643) -- mean pairwise L2 between the K candidates' get_action_object_sequence()[:,0,:] in ARM_0 > 1e-3. At ARM_0's magnitudes a difference-of-means in float32 is only ~4 decades above eps, and the V3-EXQ-604a rule ("scaling a zero range is still zero", quoted verbatim in module.py) applies to a floored ao_std the same way. (P4) THE GROUNDING MANIPULATION MUST REPRODUCE -- ARM_1 median ao_M5_r2_explained_by_action_alone <= 0.90, median paired (ARM_0 - ARM_1) M5 >= 0.10, ARM_2 (shuffled target) staying >= 0.99. All three sourced from V3-EXQ-817a's own measured 0.721 / 0.271 / ~0.995. CONFIRMING: with P1-P4 met, ARM_1 (grounded) shows a paired within-seed DROP versus ARM_0 (frozen) in BOTH (a) the search budget -- mean over CEM iterations of cem_iteration_diagnostics[i].ao_std_mean, restricted to iterations above the floor -- AND (b) proposal diversity -- pre_refit_first_action_entropy and pre_refit_unique_first_action_classes at the same iterations -- with the paired drop in (b) >= 0.10 nats AND >= 1.0 SD of the paired per-seed delta, on >= 4/5 seeds. Direction and per-seed consistency are what matter, not absolute level. A confirming read means V3-EXQ-817a's behavioural null is a MEASUREMENT ARTEFACT of the shared budget rather than evidence against consequence-grounding, and the remedy is to split the roles (ground a consequence READOUT of O while leaving the CEM's search coordinates action-conditioned). FALSIFYING: with P1-P4 met, ARM_1's search budget and proposal diversity are statistically indistinguishable from ARM_0's -- paired per-seed delta in pre_refit_first_action_entropy within +/- 0.05 nats and below 0.5 SD of the paired delta on >= 4/5 seeds, with no drop in above-floor ao_std_mean. Then O's variance reallocation does not propagate into the search geometry, the two masters do not contend, and 817a's null bites directly against SD-004's efficiency rationale and against ARC-133. RESIDUAL that any FALSIFYING write-up must state: ao_std is floored but ao_mean is NOT, so a null on the variance channel accompanied by movement in ao_mean's candidate geometry falsifies the "shared fixed budget = O's VARIANCE" formulation specifically, not the weaker claim that O's geometry is shared.

MECH-519.subject: drive.epistemic_value_carrier
MECH-519.title: SD-057's object-bound incentive tokens and SD-049's per-axis drive CANNOT carry epistemic value: the object-side carrier is written by a contact benefit-pulse, and the only epistemic pulse the environment supplies is a visit-count novelty proxy, which is disqualified by the gain x need constraint (Mattar and Daw 2018; Carey 2019 -- replay can be biased AWAY from the currently-most-valuable outcome). This is the NEGATIVE half only, and is the non-redundant content: the positive half (the quantity IS gain x need on transitions) is MECH-443's premise, inherited rather than added. Logically independent of MECH-443, whose subject is the replay write channel rather than the drive/goal pathway.

MECH-520.subject: representation.predictive_obligation_anticollapse
MECH-520.title: Predictive obligation is the anti-collapse constraint on a value-carved representation: a representation compressed toward selection-relevance ALONE degenerates, because value is a near-scalar projection and a pure value-carving objective admits solutions that discard everything not currently useful. Requiring the higher-order latents to remain PREDICTIVE across the ARC-004 temporal spread supplies a constraint the value objective lacks -- cross-horizon prediction demands retained state structure that value alone does not -- so the combination holds perception open where value-carving alone would collapse it.

MECH-521.subject: entities.settling_derived_slot_occupancy
MECH-521.title: Perceptual slot OCCUPANCY is an emergent order parameter of a coupling-versus-lateral-inhibition settling competition, bounded above by an independently-set CAPACITY -- so capacity and occupancy are two distinct regulators rather than one. Occupancy is not read off coherence by counting related coherencies, which is circular (the relatedness criterion IS the grain decision) and ill-posed (coherence nests rather than partitions). Mechanism-agnostic about what sets the coupling constant.
MECH-521.what_would_answer: DERIVATIONAL PRECONDITION, OWED FIRST AND CHEAPEST: the discriminating signature ("graceful degradation then whole-domain loss") is ASSERTED, NOT DERIVED. Pattern formation gives domain COUNT and domain SIZE as functions of the control parameter; the mapping from domain size to per-item representational FIDELITY is unargued. This is checkable in a ~20-line 1-D lateral-inhibition settling toy -- sweep coupling, plot count and mean-domain-coherence -- with NO REE substrate at all, and it can kill or confirm the signature before any substrate work is justified. Nothing in the record names this probe. NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (three gates, ALL currently FALSE in V3): (P0) THE UNIT COUNT MUST BE ENDOGENOUS -- ObjectFileBuffer.update() consumes a caller-built List[EntityObservation] assembled from grid cells, so occupancy today measures the ENVIRONMENT, not the agent. (P1) THE RESOURCE HORN MUST BE EXPRESSIBLE -- per-item fidelity must degrade continuously with load, i.e. something must be shared across items; today tok.precision depends only on that observation's own precision (no cross-token normalisation) and capacity is a hard truncation cap = max(1, max_tokens) (default 5), so a load sweep returns a step function BY CONSTRUCTION, which is a vacuous PASS for the slot horn rather than evidence for it. (P2) CAPACITY AND OCCUPANCY MUST BE INDEPENDENTLY MANIPULABLE -- capacity must be a DERIVED quantity (a carrier/nesting ratio) rather than a config constant, else the two-regulator assertion is untestable in principle. Any run not meeting P0-P2 self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a verdict. DESIGN: escalating load, N = 1..K simultaneously-presented distinguishable elements, scoring per-item fidelity f(N) and retained-item count R(N), as a pre-registered 2x2 (carrier ratio high/low x coupling constant high/low) with an interaction test -- NOT two one-way sweeps. CONFIRMING (all three, in order): (1) f(N) degrades SMOOTHLY and monotonically over the sub-critical range (resource-like, no plateau-then-cliff in fidelity alone); (2) R(N) drops DISCRETELY -- a whole unit lost, not all units degraded -- at a critical coupling/inhibition ratio; (3) THE DISSOCIATION, which is the load-bearing part: manipulating the CARRIER ratio moves the discrete drop point while leaving the sub-critical f(N) slope unchanged, and manipulating the COUPLING constant moves occupancy WITHIN the bound while leaving the drop point where the carrier puts it. FALSIFYING (any one): R(N) is a pure step with f(N) flat below it under a load-only manipulation (the discrete-slot horn -- this claim's dissolution adds nothing); f(N) degrades smoothly with R(N) = N and no whole-unit loss at any supported coupling value (the pure-resource horn, likewise); THE DISSOCIATION FAILS -- carrier and coupling move the same thing, or occupancy tracks the capacity constant one-for-one -- which refutes the two-regulator leg SPECIFICALLY and reduces the claim to a re-description of the existing max_tokens truncation; or occupancy is reproduced by a magnitude-matched RANDOM coupling constant (shuffle control, mandatory per the 725a precedent), making coupling a generic perturbation rather than a control parameter. BINDING INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT, inherited from the V3-EXQ-725a autopsy: the fidelity DV must be GRADED and NON-SATURATING. A raw occupancy COUNT is discrete and ceiling-saturates at the capacity bound -- the exact failure that left 2 of 6 seeds uninterpretable in 725a (frac_state_div 1.000 on BOTH real and shuffle). Score fidelity per item on a continuous scale and report the count alongside it, never as the sole DV.

MECH-522.subject: entities.ephaptic_coupling_constant_for_grain
MECH-522.title: Ephaptic field strength is the COUPLING CONSTANT of the perceptual settling competition that sets slot occupancy (MECH-521), not a quantity that is measured and counted. A physical field does not enumerate domains; it sets the interaction strength from which the domain count emerges -- and because coherence is a property of each population separately, a field-derived setter is natively HETEROGENEOUS (different streams settling into different domain counts simultaneously) rather than imposing the single ordered abstraction axis that Badre and Nee 2018 reports the evidence does not support. This is a THIRD ephaptic function, distinct from MECH-499 (what the actionable now CONTAINS) and MECH-500 (WHEN a branching future is coherent enough to commit): at what GRAIN the now is carved.
MECH-522.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-521's own P0-P2 must already be met AND MECH-521's CONFIRMING signature must already have been demonstrated under at least ONE NON-ephaptic coupling constant (a learned scalar, a prediction-error-derived scalar, or a global neuromodulatory scalar). Until then there is no dynamic for a field to be the coupling constant OF, and any test here is uninterpretable. This ordering is the whole point of the split and must not be relaxed. CONFIRMING: a field-coherence-derived coupling constant produces MECH-521's core signature AND outperforms matched non-ephaptic setters specifically on HETEROGENEITY -- occupancy tracking LOCAL, PER-POPULATION coherence, with different streams settling into different domain counts simultaneously, which scalar setters cannot produce by construction. That heterogeneity is the only thing this claim buys over MECH-521 and is therefore the correct DV; a magnitude or drop-point win alone does not confirm it. FALSIFYING: a field-derived coupling constant is indistinguishable from (a) a magnitude-matched RANDOM scalar or (b) any of the cheap non-ephaptic setters, on BOTH occupancy and the per-population heterogeneity DV -- the ephaptic framing is decoration, MECH-521 survives, this claim does not. BINDING INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT inherited from the V3-EXQ-725a autopsy: the DV must be GRADED and NON-SATURATING; a discrete count ceiling-saturates at the capacity bound, which is the exact failure that left 2 of 6 seeds uninterpretable there.

MECH-523.subject: representation.untrained_compression_sites
MECH-523.title: REE's designated compression sites are systematically UNTRAINED, so representational-ceiling results measured at them are uninterpretable as capacity findings. Verified 2026-08-26 at three independent sites: (a) E2.action_object_head, SD-004's action-object bottleneck that the hippocampal CEM searches inside, receives zero gradient from every REE training path and is a frozen random projection with ~99.5% of its variance explained by the action label (SD-080); (b) the ARC-004 higher-order latent stack -- beta_encoder, theta_encoder and delta_encoder appear ZERO times in agent.py, have no loss, no optimiser and no predictive head at any horizon, and are an untrained random-projection cascade smoothed by one hardcoded shared EMA (alpha_shared = 0.3); (c) no value-shaped objective reaches any encoder at all -- compute_benefit_eval_loss reads z_world.detach() and trains only E3.benefit_eval_head. The corollary is methodological: a null measured at an untrained compression site is evidence about the absence of a training signal, not about the representation's capacity or about the sufficiency of the architecture.
MECH-523.what_would_answer: This claim is VERIFIABLE BY INSPECTION rather than by experiment, and that is the point -- it is a statement about the substrate's training graph, not about behaviour. CONFIRMING (all three, each a direct source check on a named ref): (a) `grep action_object_head` across `ree_core/` returns only construction and the forward call, with no loss, optimiser or backward reference; corroborated behaviourally by V3-EXQ-809 (re-drawn heads reach the CEM proposals but behaviour is invariant to their content) and by the spike measurement that the head's parameters are bit-identical after 40 warmup episodes. (b) `grep -c beta_encoder|theta_encoder|delta_encoder` in `agent.py` returns 0 for each, and no optimiser anywhere in `ree_core/` holds their parameters. (c) every value-shaped loss either detaches its latent input or terminates in a head, so no gradient path exists from a value target to any encoder. FALSIFYING (any one): a training signal is found that reaches one of the three sites on the named ref -- e.g. an optimiser group holding `action_object_head` or the depth encoders, or a non-detached value loss reaching `world_encoder`. Since this is an inspection claim, a falsification is a code citation, not a run. THE METHODOLOGICAL COROLLARY, which is the part that needs testing rather than inspecting: for each site, a representational-ceiling result measured there should MOVE once a training signal is supplied. SD-070 is the one worked instance and it went the claim's way -- z_world was measured collapsing to participation ratio ~1.06 at world_dim=128, an anti-collapse training recipe was built, and V3-EXQ-783 then measured trained PR 5.261 vs untrained 9.121 (retained_fraction 0.577 against a 0.50 floor). If a comparable training signal is supplied at site (a) or (b) and the ceiling does NOT move, the corollary is refuted for that site and the ceiling is a genuine capacity finding after all.

MECH-524.subject: hippocampal.capacity_triggered_resumption_reseeding
MECH-524.title: Capacity-triggered resumption reseeding: at the moment a task is interrupted, REE captures an interruption_snapshot (z_world + z_self + z_goal + CEM planning stage + rule-arbitration weights + what-was-attempted) that is richer than, and distinct from, SD-039's existing dual-trace anchor goal-snapshot payload. When a spare-compute signal (low SD-037 broadcast-override + low z_harm_a + low dACC choice_difficulty) or sleep entry indicates freed processing capacity, the interruption_snapshot is re-seeded into MECH-293's awake ghost-goal probes and MECH-285's sleep-replay sampler, so that resumption is a reorient-from-snapshot rather than a restart-from-scratch. This is the backward-direction complement to REE's existing forward direction, in which world-change invalidates stale model content (MECH-269 anchor V_s + MECH-284 staleness -> MECH-287 broadcast -> anchors inactive): the forward direction discards stale content when the world moves on without the agent; MECH-524 is what lets the agent pick its own paused work back up once capacity to attend to it returns.
MECH-524.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Recently-interrupted entries must be separable from merely-stale ones on the MECH-292 bank at the moment of test, and the spare-compute trigger must not degenerate into a bare time-since-interruption accumulator or key on the entry's own devalued worth (the MECH-340 / Q-053 hard negative constraints). Interruptions must also be frequent enough that both trigger poles are exercised.
CONFIRMING: With both snapshot and trigger present, recently-interrupted entries show BOTH elevated re-engagement AND reduced resumption cost relative to merely-stale entries; with trigger but no snapshot, attempts rise while cost does not fall; with snapshot but no trigger, no Ovsiankina differential appears. Manipulation: 2x2 of {interruption_snapshot captured versus not} x {capacity/sleep trigger active versus passive persistence only}, with the snapshot re-seeded into MECH-293 awake ghost-goal probes or the MECH-285 sleep-replay sampler when the trigger fires. Control: Merely-stale MECH-292 bank entries reached by the ordinary re-probe cadence, at matched eligibility under MECH-340, plus a bare re-probe/replay boost arm with no cue content (which should raise attempts without lowering cost). Required event: A committed, in-progress task aborted mid-execution, followed later by a genuine return of capacity (low SD-037 broadcast override, low z_harm_a, low dACC choice_difficulty) or by sleep entry. DV: Two separable quantities per entry class: re-engagement rate (Ovsiankina-shaped differential of recently-interrupted over merely-stale) and resumption COST -- Salvucci-style reconstruction lag from re-seeding to task-state recovery. Both must be reported; attempts alone is the degenerate reading.
FALSIFYING: Recently-interrupted entries resume no faster and no more often than merely-stale entries once trigger and snapshot are both live, or the whole differential is reproduced by a bare time-since-interruption accumulator, which the claim's own constraints rule out as the mechanism. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The stores and triggers-in-parts exist (AnchorGoalPayload, GhostGoalBankEntry ranking, sleep/replay_sampler.py, dACC choice_difficulty, use_broadcast_override) but the payload carries only z_goal_snapshot, wanting_strength, arousal_tag, last_vs, staleness_at_write and payload_written_step -- no z_world/z_self, no CEM planning stage, no rule-arbitration weights, no what-was-attempted. There is no interruption_snapshot anywhere in ree_core and no resumption-cost recorder. Consumer / boundary: The MECH-292/SD-039 bank-entry store and its re-seeding into MECH-293 awake probes / MECH-285 sleep replay -- explicitly NOT MECH-389's V4 goal-slot arbitrator, which is a different store with different consumers. Existing ownership: MECH-524, SD-039, MECH-292, MECH-293, MECH-285, MECH-389.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); The capture payload and the composite trigger are unbuilt: AnchorGoalPayload is motivational-only, no interruption_snapshot exists, and the spare-compute conjunction is not assembled from its three live parts. Resumption COST has no recorder at all, so even a built trigger would leave the falsifier's discriminating half unmeasured. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-525.subject: memory.schema_integration_waking_primitives_only
MECH-525.title: Schema integration during offline/imagination-adjacent consolidation (MECH-272 probe-channel routing, MECH-273 sleep-half self-model aggregation) is constrained to recombining waking-derived trace primitives: the material a schema-integration pass restructures must trace back to real, committed (hypothesis_tag=False) waking experience, and a schema update computed from one imagination/consolidation cycle's output must not itself become input material for a later cycle's schema integration without an intervening waking-encoded checkpoint. Without this constraint, successive offline cycles could compound self-amplification of imagined content into schema structure -- confabulation by accretion rather than by single-event failure.
MECH-525.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires MECH-272/MECH-273's schema-integration pass to run over
more than one offline (sleep or equivalent) cycle without an intervening waking-encoding
checkpoint; a substrate that only ever runs a single consolidation pass before returning to
waking cannot exhibit the compounding failure mode this claim is about.

CONFIRMING: an audit of MECH-272/273's actual input stream at each successive offline cycle
shows that every item entering schema integration traces back to a hypothesis_tag=False
(waking, committed) episode -- never to the SCHEMA OUTPUT of a prior offline cycle re-injected
as if it were fresh waking material. Cai et al. 2009's dissociation (REM restructures
associative links among waking-encoded primed words, without gaining new item-level content)
is the empirical LICIT-side shape this claim requires REE's own consolidation pass to match.

FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): discovery that a schema update produced by one offline cycle is fed
back into a LATER offline cycle's schema-integration input without having first been
represented in, or corrected against, a subsequent waking (hypothesis_tag=False) episode --
i.e. the substrate lets imagination bootstrap off its own prior imagination, cycle over cycle,
with no waking-reality checkpoint between them. This is the accretion-confabulation failure
mode distinct from MECH-094's single-event failure mode (Schnider 2003): each individual write
might pass MECH-094's per-event gate while the SEQUENCE of writes still compounds unchecked
imagined content into schema structure.

PARTIAL AUDIT AVAILABLE TODAY: MECH-272/273 already exist in V3 (status: provisional /
stable-adjacent); a code audit of their input construction is possible now, before MECH-365
or ARC-085 exist, since the question is about what feeds today's offline consolidation pass,
not about a not-yet-built provenance schema.

MECH-526.subject: memory.counterfactual_exploration_output_is_prior_not_knowledge
MECH-526.title: Outputs of counterfactual exploration (imagined/simulated candidate rollouts scored during E3 selection or equivalent planning) are LICIT only as priors for future waking testing -- i.e. as inputs to policy/value preference (which action to prefer, which hypothesis to test next) -- and are FORBIDDEN from being treated as knowledge: they must not be written into the world-model's own predictive parameters, used to validate or score a REAL prediction's accuracy, or logged as an established fact. This is REE's architectural analogue of expected-free-energy policy scoring (Friston et al. 2015): imagining a candidate's likely outcome to choose among candidates is a distinct operation from updating the model that did the imagining, and the two must not be allowed to collapse into one write path.
MECH-526.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires at least one code path where an E3 (or equivalent)
candidate's imagined-outcome evaluation could plausibly feed back into a durable store --
world-model parameters, a prediction-validation log, or a fact/schema entry -- rather than only
ever informing the immediate action-selection decision. If no such path exists, this claim is
vacuously satisfied and not yet meaningfully auditable (same caveat as ARC-092's own
non-degeneracy precondition).

CONFIRMING: for every identified candidate-scoring site, the imagined outcome used to compute a
candidate's score is consumed ONLY by the selection/preference decision (which candidate wins,
what prior it sets for a future waking test) and never appears as an input to a REAL prediction's
validation, a world-model parameter update, or a new fact/schema-store write -- matching the
formal separation Friston et al. 2015 derive between expected-free-energy policy evaluation and
generative-model updating.

FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): a code path where an imagined candidate's score, or the imagined
outcome itself, is consumed by (a) a world-model or policy-parameter update, (b) scoring/
validating a real prediction's accuracy, or (c) a fact/schema-store write -- without an
intervening real, enacted observation. A single confirmed instance is a targeted MECH-094/E3
gate fix, not a rejection of the principle (mirrors ARC-092's own falsification handling).

MECH-527.subject: policy.stuckness_triggered_attractor_escape
MECH-527.title: Stuckness-triggered attractor-escape exploration: a triggered, organism-level annealing analogue in which persistent CONFIDENCE-WITHOUT-RESOLUTION (settled attractor, repeated failure to reduce the active need/goal error -- natural trigger substrate: MECH-482's epistemic_deficit accumulator) transiently injects variation ABOVE the immediate-action level -- perturbing candidate trajectories, strategy proposals, retrieved attractors, goal decompositions, and the precision/authority of the currently dominant attractor, with escalating breadth under continued stuckness -- to escape a false bottom (a locally stable but persistently inadequate basin), then decays after successful resolution. Distinct from tonic or near-tie action noise: the trigger is unresolvedness, not uncertainty; two well-understood, similarly-good actions warrant NO exploration, while a high-confidence failing strategy warrants it strongly.
MECH-527.what_would_answer:
SCOPE NOTE. This claim's trajectory-proposal-widening leg is MECH-343/SD-061's question, already
built (`ree_core/policy/difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy.py`) and already partially measured
(V3-EXQ-694). See MECH-343's own `what_would_answer` -- in particular its
SHARED-CONVERSION-PRECONDITION (G4) reference, its "DECLARE WHICH TEMPERATURE the entropy DV
reads" clause (SD-061's CEM proposal-layer knob vs the SD-069/MECH-313 E3 select() softmax --
different knobs; a run that conflates them cannot attribute its result), and its "PRIOR TO
CARRY IN" record that V3-EXQ-694's ON arm entropy FELL on 3/3 seeds. Do not re-derive any of
it. What follows tests only what is left after that: escalation ACROSS channels, and the
trigger's selectivity.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. Apply TRIGGERED-STRUCTURAL-EVENT PRECONDITION (G9) in full, plus
three requirements specific to this claim, all of which must be reported before any verdict:
(a) *A genuine false bottom must be demonstrated to EXIST in the ecology, by a control that has
nothing to do with this claim.* Show that a competent-by-other-means agent (an oracle, a shaped-
reward arm, or a hand-coded policy) attains materially better basin quality than the no-
perturbation arm converges to, and that the no-perturbation arm's policy is STABLE (low
committed-class turnover) and CONFIDENT (high score margin) while it sits there. Without that
control, a null on escape is indistinguishable from "there was nothing to escape to". The
MECH-457 / V3-EXQ-769 D3_hazard_free passive-survival optimum is a documented instance and the
`MetabolicForageWrapper` in `experiments/_lib/mech457_probe_envs.py` is the dissolving control.
(b) *The trigger must be selective, and the near-tie axes must be shown NOT to be carrying it.*
This claim's load-bearing distinction is that unresolvedness triggers and uncertainty does not.
SD-061's `StuckStateDetector` combines four axes, of which two (E3 score margin, dACC choice
difficulty) are near-tie/ambiguity axes that this claim asserts should trigger NOTHING. Report
each axis's separate contribution to `stuck_score` at every firing. CONFIRMING requires that
the stall and committed-diversity axes carry the firing in the false-bottom condition; if the
two near-tie axes carry it, the run has tested MECH-440's trigger, not this one, and must
self-route rather than report a verdict.
(c) *The trigger must fire from naturally-arising blockage, and must also NOT fire.* Detector
peak must exceed threshold and then decay on >= 2/3 seeds from ecological stuckness, not from
an experimenter-induced impasse (V3-EXQ-694 induced its impasse; that route is already spent).
Report the duty cycle: with `ema_alpha_rise` 0.3 vs `ema_alpha_fall` 0.05, a pinned-high score
is the expected failure and turns every arm contrast into a dose contrast. Duty cycle must lie
strictly inside (0.05, 0.80).
(d) *If MECH-482's `epistemic_deficit` is used as the trigger, the persistent-PE channel must
be isolated.* Per the 2026-09-01 synthesis, the uncertainty and disagreement inputs are
suppressed exactly in the confident-but-failing case, so an unmodified `epistemic_deficit` that
fails to rise is a substrate artifact, not evidence against the claim. Either consume the
persistent-PE channel only, or use the SD-061 stall + committed-diversity axes, and say which.

CONFIRMING (the claim's own registered design, preserved). A >= 3-arm run in a demonstrated
false-bottom ecology -- (1) no perturbation; (2) low-level ACTION noise (MECH-313/MECH-440
class); (3) stuckness-triggered perturbation ABOVE the action level -- on organism-level DVs:
arm 3 strictly beats BOTH arm 1 and arm 2 on escape probability and discovery latency, with
basin quality after escape strictly better than the false bottom's, AND perturbation magnitude
decays after resolution, AND the no-unnecessary-exploration negative control holds (a matched
near-tie condition with two well-understood, similarly-good options produces NO perturbation
above arm 1's baseline). Effect-size gate: the arm-3-minus-arm-1 escape-probability delta must
exceed max(2 x SD of the per-seed delta, an absolute floor of 0.20 escape probability), on
>= 2/3 seeds.
ESCALATION LEG (separately gated, and currently the claim's weakest commitment). Under CONTINUED
stuckness the perturbation must broaden across channels, not merely intensify within one: at
least one channel beyond candidate trajectories must be shown to engage, later than channel 1,
and only after channel 1 has failed to resolve. Recorded as a KNOWN GAP rather than an
asserted property: the 2026-09-01 synthesis found no biological support for graded escalation
(Karlsson 2012 gives the destabilise-then-decay, nothing gives the ladder), and the only
precedent is algorithmic. Do not gate the claim's verdict on this leg until it has grounding.

FALSIFYING.
(1) With the preconditions met, arm 3 does not beat arm 2 -- low-level action noise escapes the
false bottom as often and as fast as above-action-level perturbation. This is the claim's own
load-bearing distinction from MECH-440/MECH-313 and its failure is the cleanest refutation.
(2) The no-unnecessary-exploration control fails: arm 3 perturbs in the matched near-tie
condition as much as in the false-bottom condition. The trigger is uncertainty after all, and
the claim collapses into the operationalisation V3-EXQ-959 already weakened.
(3) Perturbation rises under stuckness and never decays after resolution -- falsifies the
annealing/triggered half, leaving a tonic floor (which MECH-313 already owns and V3-EXQ-687
found non-propagating).
(4) Variation rises but the policy does not RELOCATE: the dominant response stays dominant with

MECH-529.subject: e1.replay_driven_rebucketing_decision_relevance_pressure
MECH-529.title: Replay-driven rebucketing: accumulated consequential-divergence evidence -- typed insufficiency signals from decision outcomes (prediction/consequence mismatch, harm or goal error, repeated veto/conflict, divergent outcomes following apparently equivalent E1 states), never category labels -- drives split / merge / feature-reweighting / relation-discovery / event-boundary-revision / abstraction-change over E1's equivalence classes, via REPLAY of non-contiguous episodes under a common evaluative frame (retrospective representation learning: later experience revises how earlier experiences are bucketed). Candidate rebucketings are COUNTERFACTUALLY tested before adoption (does representing the distinction improve predictions under relevant alternative actions and contexts?), and consequential revisions preferentially complete in a decoupled/sleep phase whose job includes RE-INDEXING episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives the representational change -- sleep as safe maintenance of the representational coordinate system itself. E3 must not become E1's teacher: downstream selection changes the learning conditions and evidence pressure on E1, never its truth content directly (non-oracular).
MECH-529.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a corrigible representational grain (ARC-134 P0 merge/split operator landed and exercised -- without it the categories are environment-authored and the question cannot be posed); provenance-preserving episodic indices; replay of NON-CONTIGUOUS episodes reachable on the production path. CONFIRMING (the source thought's 8-point necessity test, minimum decisive subset): object CORRECTION (two initially-equivalent entities become distinct after accumulated divergent consequences) AND object GENERALISATION (two initially-distinct entities functionally merge under equivalent consequence structure), achieved NON-ORACULARLY (no downstream signal supplies the category label), with a replay- ablation showing the reorganisation depends on non-contiguous-episode replay (online-only arm fails or is materially slower), measurable downstream decision-relevance improvement, and INDEX CONTINUITY (episodic traces remain addressable post-rebucketing). FALSIFYING: rebucketing achievable only with oracular labels; replay arm no better than online-only; rebucketing necessarily breaks episodic addressability; or reorganisation yields no decision-relevance improvement.

MECH-531.subject: entities.corrigible_grain_operator_p0
MECH-531.title: A merge/split operator over the existing EntityObservation boundary must exist and be corrigible by consequence evidence, at FIXED capacity -- no dynamic per-population regulation, no settling competition. This is the minimal P0 substrate floor ARC-134 and MECH-529 both name as currently absent: `ree_core/entities/object_file_buffer.py` has no merge or split of tokens anywhere, and matching is strict 1:1 greedy over a caller-built List[EntityObservation]. EXPLICITLY NOT ASSERTING (MECH-521/522's scope, deferred v4/v5, unchanged by this claim): occupancy as an emergent order parameter of a coupling-vs-lateral-inhibition settling competition; dynamic/derived capacity; ephaptic coupling-constant specialisation. MECH-521's own notes ("DO NOT build in V3. DO NOT queue an experiment.") continue to apply to that scope exactly as registered.

MECH-533.subject: development.offline_frequency_competence_comaturation
MECH-533.title: Developmental co-maturation of offline scheduling and offline competence: the benefit of frequent early offline phases is CONDITIONAL on the maturity of the offline machinery itself, so offline FREQUENCY and offline COMPETENCE develop together and cannot be substituted for one another. Early agents may need frequent protected windows precisely because traces are fragile and representations change rapidly, while their replay selection, sequence fidelity, cross-episode aggregation, and re-indexing competence are still immature -- so adding sleep cycles to an agent whose replay content, sequencing, or write-address discrimination is degenerate produces cycles without transformation. A developmental test must therefore CROSS frequency with competence and hold apart at least seven things that are routinely conflated: sleep-cycle frequency; amount and diversity of waking content; replay coverage and sequence fidelity; ContextMemory content discrimination; transformation competence; behavioural access after waking; and a stage-appropriate ecology in which the result can be expressed. Firing many empty or degenerate cycles is not developmental consolidation, and longer observation under no_grad() is not development if no relevant learning update occurs.

arm and the step-ceiling BACKSTOP landed 2026-08-14 (SleepLoopManager.notify_waking_step(),

(2026-08-09, H1 context-divergence loss + H3 gumbel hard selection, "breaks_saddle" on both), but
MECH-151's resulting action_bias signal has NO CONSUMER on the E3 ranking path
(e3_selector.py contains zero occurrences of action_object/action_bias per SD-016's own current
DISPOSITION). Replay sequence fidelity (a second named competence component) still has no
manipulable knob at all -- unchanged from this claim's own notes. Do not build in V3; do not
queue an experiment. A frequency-only sweep run before the competence axis is wired to a consumer
is precisely the degenerate "cycles without transformation" design this claim itself names.

CONFIRMING: once both axes are independently manipulable, the offline-integration benefit
(post-sleep retention/behavioural-access improvement) shows a genuine INTERACTION -- high
frequency with low competence (machinery immature: selection uncalibrated, no ranking consumer,
degenerate sequencing) produces LESS benefit than moderate frequency with high competence, and
frequency alone (holding competence fixed at whatever floor exists) does not linearly predict
benefit.

FALSIFYING: frequency alone predicts post-sleep benefit regardless of the seven named competence
components (replay selection, sequence fidelity, cross-episode aggregation, re-indexing,
ContextMemory content discrimination, behavioural access after waking, stage-appropriate ecology)
-- i.e. "more sleep cycles" is sufficient on its own, no interaction. A failure under unmet
preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

Buzsaki 2005, Noguchi et al. 2023, Pochinok et al. 2024 for the competence/ripple-maturation half)

VERIFIED IN THIS PASS" -- that verification (promoting the first three to evidence/literature/
EVB entries, adding Pochinok 2024, which is not yet in the repo at all) is a precondition for
hardening the claim's biological grounding and is independent of, but should precede, any future
substrate work.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: MECH-151's action_bias gets a ranking-path consumer (SD-016 Leg B closes) AND a
replay-fidelity manipulation knob is built. This is the SHALLOWEST blocker in this batch -- Leg A
of its main dependency is already fixed; only the consumer wiring (a described, scoped fix per

MECH-534.subject: l_space.authority_field_dynamic_causal_geometry
MECH-534.title: Authority field: the moment-to-moment functional conformation of L-space -- the effective directed distance / permeability / gain between representational regions, its asymmetry, persistence and decay, the compatibility of simultaneously active routes, and a local coalition's capacity to recruit wider participation -- is a STATE VARIABLE in its own right: continuous, graded, state-dependent, endogenously recruited from the organism's own prediction error, goal progress, residue and learned relevance, with its own competition and dynamics, and not identical to stored content, to the slow regulatory/neuromodulatory field, or to the final policy; falsifiable consequence: two runs with materially similar content state but different field state differ systematically in retrieval, commitment and distractor recovery, and an equally-parameterised static scalar or global gate cannot reproduce the same context-sensitive behaviour across matched tasks and seeds.

Neither is MECH-534, but a reduction check that misses them is incomplete.
CONFIRMING: two runs with materially similar content state but different field state differ systematically in retrieval, commitment and distractor recovery, and an equally-parameterised static scalar or global gate cannot reproduce the same context-sensitivity across matched tasks and seeds.
FALSIFYING (from this claim's own notes, unchanged): a static scalar control plane matches or beats the field; the field improves internal separability with no causal downstream effect; the gain comes only from extra parameters under matched capacity and exposure; field state is exogenously injected rather than recruited (Q-106 supplies the matched open-loop control that instruction never specified); the system becomes brittle or oscillatory without improving ecological tasks.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional -- code absent, never exercised. MECH-535.subject: psychiatric.catatonia_direction_blind_reactive_ambitendency
MECH-535.title: Direction-blind reactive ambitendency (catatonia route III): a memoryless reactive actor reading a state representation that carries goal PROXIMITY MAGNITUDE but not goal DIRECTION produces, from one frozen policy and selected only by initial condition, either a two-cell approach/withdraw limit cycle (ambitendency: one step toward the goal, one step away, repeated) or a boundary-press fixed point (stupor); the catatonic phenotype therefore has a REPRESENTATIONAL generative route that requires no commitment gate to malfunction and no harm-stream lock, distinct from MECH-202B (gate frozen at maximum threshold) and SD-036 subtype II (harm-stream lock-in upstream of an intact gate).
MECH-535.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Independently verify direction-poor/proximity-carrying representation and competent directional anchor. Replicate on fresh seeds; distinguish phase-space orbit from wall press and contamination death, without defining direction blindness by the observed phenotype.
CONFIRMING: Direction-poor state produces the predicted two classes of attractor within a frozen policy, while directional information removes them Manipulation: Compare the same reader under directional versus direction-poor representations, with initial conditions varied independently Control: Raw-field directional greedy anchor and matched random walk; contamination-off sensitivity arm Required event: Frozen memoryless reader encounters reachable goals from varied initial conditions DV: Initial-condition-dependent incidence and periods of bounded orbits versus boundary fixed points, plus goal-directed efficiency at matched exposure
FALSIFYING: An adequate, independently verified direction-poor representation yields neither phenotype across informative initial conditions, or adding direction leaves the attractors unchanged under matched action capability A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: 1007 position traces/detectors exist; its read-across repeats the 978 exemplar and its latch leg is degenerate. Blocked 1007a does not establish a repaired instrument. Consumer / boundary: Representation -> reactive chosen action -> executed position trajectory Existing ownership: MECH-535, MECH-536, V3-EXQ-1007a, GFLAG-0233.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Fresh-seed independent representation discrimination is missing; 1007 read-across is not replication and a period-2-only detector cannot certify absence of longer orbits. R2 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

MECH-536.title: Basal-ganglia-like action persistence (a post-commit latch / commitment hysteresis) is PROTECTIVE against representational degradation rather than NECESSARY for competence: with an adequate directional representation a memoryless greedy actor forages competently with no latch at all (V3-EXQ-978 local_view_greedy anchor, 45.75 res/ep), whereas with a direction-blind representation (MECH-535) a latch abolishes the ambitendency limit cycle but yields perseveration (straight runs into the boundary) with no rise in competence. No substrate build is implied. R2; R5 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. MECH-537.subject: representation.communication_subspace_routing_exposure
MECH-537.title: Communication-subspace routing failure -- encoded but not exposed: a task variable can be strongly encoded in the FULL sender latent while being weakly represented in the CONSUMER-FACING subspace, producing the phenotype `external probe succeeds -> native behaviour fails` with no information having been destroyed. This is a third failure category strictly between 'information absent from the sender' and 'information used by the receiver', and it is distinct from MECH-517 (the decoder collapses) and MECH-532 (the compression site has no trained decompression stage): routing failure requires neither a collapse nor a missing readout, because the consumer can be reading a perfectly healthy low-rank subspace that simply does not carry the distinction. Operationalised by cross-validated Reduced Rank Regression from sender activity to the ACTUAL consumer input tensor, comparing task decodability in the full sender, inside the estimated communication subspace, and in its orthogonal complement; the diagnostic signature is `target decodable from X` but `poorly decodable from P_comm X`.
MECH-537.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A source that passes adequacy first (V3-EXQ-1010's H-F verdict rules out the primary observation -> z_world locus), a receiver_input tensor that is the tensor the LIVE consumer reads rather than a neighbour (interface_probe.CaptureRecord cannot enforce this), and the C5 single-subspace premise holding across frame and receiver-state strata, otherwise the question belongs to MECH-547/MECH-555.
CONFIRMING: On an adequacy-passing source with the single-subspace premise held, the target is decodable from X but its decodability inside P_comm X falls below the same-rank random-subspace ensemble at a pre-registered percentile, the orthogonal complement carries the decodability, and the live consumer is demonstrably insensitive to the complement. Manipulation: Compare task decodability from three representations of the same captured sender activity: the full sender X, its projection into the cross-validated communication subspace P_comm X, and the orthogonal complement -- with a MULTI-DRAW random same-rank subspace ensemble as the orientation reference, not a single random-rank arm and not a row permutation. Control: Two distinct controls that 1043/1043a conflated: (i) the permutation refit, which establishes the sender-to-receiver map is real, and (ii) the new same-rank random-subspace ENSEMBLE, which establishes that the communication subspace's ORIENTATION, not its rank, is what loses the target. Required event: Paired sender-activity and actual consumer-input captures on a live agent over enough held-out blocks that a cross-validated reduced-rank regression can be fitted at the parsimonious rank and a distribution of same-rank random subspaces can be drawn against it. DV: Held-out decodability gap of the task target between the full sender and P_comm X, expressed as a percentile against the same-rank random-subspace ensemble rather than against a single absolute floor, together with the complement's decodability and a measured consumer-insensitivity readout on the complement.
FALSIFYING: The decodability inside P_comm X is indistinguishable from the same-rank random-subspace ensemble (the loss is a rank effect, not a routing effect -- route to F3 consumer insensitivity or F1 target absent), or the subspace estimate is unstable across frame or receiver-state strata, which fails the single-subspace premise and hands the question to MECH-547/MECH-555. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: experiments/_lib/interface_probe.py supplies communication_subspace (cross-validated RRR), principal_angles and _random_orthonormal, and v3_exq_1043 / v3_exq_1043a implement the capture-and-contrast harness. The missing instrument is the multi-draw random same-rank ensemble and its percentile statistic; _random_orthonormal is called once per seed. Consumer / boundary: The sender-to-consumer interface -- the directions actually exposed to the live receiver input tensor -- not the sender latent as a whole and not the receiver's decoder. Existing ownership: MECH-537, EXP-1403, GFLAG-0310, GFLAG-0282, V3-EXQ-1043a.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The orientation null does not exist. The shipped randrank arm is one draw per seed and the permutation clause tests a different proposition, so the discriminating contrast between routing failure and generic rank-k loss cannot currently be computed; the measured effect (mean 0.050, CI [0.005, 0.095]) sits on its own floor, so the run is underpowered rather than adverse. Secondary classes: R5, R1. Gap disposition: INSTRUMENT EXISTS BUT WRONG LOCUS/TIMESCALE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Two runs since the 2026-09-15 disposition changed what the falsifier must contain. V3-EXQ-1043a (confirmed autopsy 2026-09-20) recorded that the permutation clause it used as the orientation null is the wrong null -- all 200 shuffled refits decode worse than the real subspace (p = 1.0 on 6/6), which shows the sender-to-receiver map is real but never tests orientation against a RANDOM SAME-RANK subspace, because that reference (many draws; the shipped randrank arm is ONE draw per seed) was never built. The orientation contrast came in positive on 5/6 seeds, mean 0.050, CI [0.005, 0.095], which straddles the declared floor, so the registered CONFIRMING clause as written cannot separate routing failure from generic rank-k loss. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

MECH-538.subject: development.minimum_bridge_complexity_legibility_measure
MECH-538.title: Minimum bridge complexity as the measure of mutual legibility: for systems A and B and a family of constrained mappings of increasing expressiveness (native readout -> orthogonal/Procrustes -> affine -> low-rank affine -> constrained nonlinear -> high-capacity upper bound), define L(A -> B) = the minimum bridge complexity achieving a predeclared HELD-OUT functional criterion between FROZEN endpoints; lower L means greater mutual legibility, and the simpler the bridge that works the stronger the evidence that the sender already held an appropriately structured representation -- a high-capacity bridge that succeeds may be performing new cognition and is therefore evidence about the bridge, not about the endpoints. L must never be read alone: two systems that became identical because one LOST its specialisation would show falling L with worsening cognition, so development is tracked on two axes (local specialisation/competence, and cross-system legibility). Non-redundant developmental prediction: sender and receiver each improve local competence WHILE global representational similarity stays flat or falls, task information concentrates in the consumer-facing subspace, and minimum bridge rank falls -- coordination without homogenisation.
MECH-538.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (includes this claim's own sequencing gate): the bridge ladder must be able to SEPARATE its rungs on the endpoints measured -- if the native readout already clears the criterion, or nothing up to the high-capacity upper bound clears it, L is not measurable and the developmental trajectory cannot be tracked. The V3-EXQ-1002/1008/1010 lineage at observation -> z_world is in the second state (H-F confirmed 2026-09-11: content destroyed at encode time), which is informative about that locus and DISQUALIFYING as the instrument-validation site. Per this claim's registration, the developmental sweep runs only after ML-20 has shown L's range and stability at one waking locus; earlier runs measure the instrument.
CONFIRMING: across developmental checkpoints at a locus where L is measurable, minimum bridge rank FALLS while both endpoints' local competence RISES and global representational similarity stays flat or falls -- coordination without homogenisation, on both axes at once.
FALSIFYING: L stays flat or rises while competence rises (the overcapacity crutch); OR L falls together with rising cross-system similarity and falling local specialisation -- the degenerate homogenisation case the two-axis requirement exists to catch, reported as a failure, never as one-axis confirmation.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional; sequencing gate stated above. Stale-note flag on the 1002 rotation-corroborator obligation raised as GFLAG-0282.

MECH-539.subject: representation.dynamic_interface_transition_compatibility
MECH-539.title: Dynamic interface compatibility: between PREDICTIVE systems, pointwise state correspondence across an interface is insufficient -- a mapping must additionally satisfy that receiver_transition(T(x_t), a_t) is compatible with T(x_(t+1)) under the relevant action/context, because a bridge can succeed pointwise while destroying transition geometry. The registered diagnostic separation is: map ONLY the initial state and let the receiver evolve natively, versus repeatedly mapping sender rollout states -- this distinguishes a bridge that supplies a compatible starting condition from one that must continually correct incompatible dynamics. Failure signature `good static + bad dynamic` routes to transition-geometry work rather than to representation work; `good one-step + degrading long-horizon` indicates compounding dynamics mismatch; `good dynamic but poor behaviour` routes downstream to valuation/selection.
MECH-539.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (the reference-frame thought's addition): sender and receiver transitions must be compared in the SAME action and horizon frame before any 'good static + bad dynamic' reading is taken -- a transition-geometry null measured across a frame mismatch (one indexed at observation time, one at predicted action time) is uninterpretable and would be scored F4 when it is RF-F. Plus the same source-adequacy gate as MECH-555 (1010: the primary locus has none).
CONFIRMING: map-initial-only (receiver evolves natively) preserves one-step and multi-step compatibility while repeated re-mapping of sender rollout states does not -- or the reverse, each routing differently -- with the frame correspondence asserted rather than assumed and horizons matched to those used to judge predictive competence (MECH-548's requirement).
FALSIFYING: pointwise and transition compatibility move together across every bridge rung (transition geometry adds no separable failure mode); OR the good-static-bad-dynamic signature disappears once the action/time frame correspondence is fixed (reassign to MECH-555).
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional -- interface_probe.dynamic_compatibility now supplies the primitive, so the block is the source-adequacy gate, not the instrument.

MECH-540.subject: sleep.selective_interface_maintenance
MECH-540.title: Sleep as selective interface maintenance -- the third offline job: MECH-529 gives offline consolidation two functions, revising the representation (split/merge/reweight over equivalence classes) and re-indexing episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives that revision. This claim adds a THIRD: adjusting or stabilising the INTERFACE -- the subspace through which another subsystem reads the revised representation. The prediction is explicitly NOT global alignment but a PLASTICITY/STABILITY DIVISION OF LABOUR across interfaces: some reconfigure because recent learning demands it, others remain stable because downstream continuity matters more, so the strongest test compares at least TWO interfaces with different predicted plasticity rather than asking whether all systems become more similar after sleep. Four distinguishable post-sleep signatures: S1 representational retuning (interface metrics move only because the sender moved), S2 interface recalibration (local competence stable, communication subspace or bridge complexity improves), S3 stable scaffold (representations move, mapping holds), S4 maladaptive homogenisation (similarity rises while local competence or task-specific differentiation worsens).
MECH-540.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (includes this claim's own sequencing gate): at least TWO interfaces with DIFFERENT predicted plasticity must be measurable pre- and post-sleep, at least one predicted stable -- the content is a plasticity/stability division of labour, so a single-interface measurement cannot confirm it however it comes out. A waking interface metric must have shown range and stability at one locus first; force_sleep_cycle_at_eval_boundary makes a within-run pre/post measurement cheap, and that cheapness is the trap named at registration.
CONFIRMING: S2 or S3 at the predicted-plastic interface (communication subspace or bridge complexity improves with local competence stable; or representations move while the mapping holds) WITH the predicted-stable interface not moving in the same direction over the same sleep episode.
FALSIFYING: S4 -- cross-system similarity rises while local competence or task-specific differentiation falls (maladaptive homogenisation); OR all measured interfaces move together (global alignment, which this claim predicts against); OR S1 alone at every interface (metrics move only because the senders moved -- sleep is doing representation work, not interface work).
Proposed signature additions routed to governance, not applied here: S5 (static probe improves while the next waking trajectory destabilises; from MECH-548) and access-correspondence maintenance / capacity reduction as further offline jobs (GFLAG-0280; MECH-551).
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional; sequencing gate stated above.

MECH-541.subject: psychiatric.maladaptive_compensation_over_stabilisation
MECH-541.title: Maladaptive over-stabilized compensation as a distinct pathology mechanism: pathology may arise not only because an original mechanism is damaged, but because an ADAPTATION TO that damage becomes over-stabilized -- a workaround that was initially adaptive becomes over-strengthened, over-generalized or too persistent, trapping the organism in a distorted solution after the original problem has changed or resolved. Predicted routes: the compensatory pathway acquires excessive precision or gain, dominates ambiguous perception, becomes resistant to counterfactual correction, persists after the initiating lesion resolves, recruits memory and sleep processes that progressively stabilise the workaround, or reduces flexibility by making one emergency solution the default policy. REGISTERED DETECTION SIGNATURE: improved LOCAL performance accompanied by POORER generalization, flexibility, calibration or counterfactual revision -- a compensation that improves everything is not this failure mode. Diagnostic is hysteresis: the compensatory solution persisting even after the original route is restored.
MECH-541.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: ARC-140's CONFIRMING result must already hold in the same setup -- a
recruited substitute S shown necessary by selective re-ablation, with R still impaired. See
ARC-140's what_would_answer; do not re-derive (its P1-P5 are inherited). In addition: (i) an
EXPLICIT COST MODEL under which "adaptive" is defined -- persistence alone is not pathology, since
much clinical learned non-use is optimal effort conservation (Faity 2026, targeted review
compensatory_realizability); (ii) separate LOCAL and GLOBAL measures: local = the recovered DV;
global = held-out generalisation, flexibility after a contingency change, calibration, and
counterfactual revision.
CONFIRMING: an amplification sweep on S (same named manipulation as ARC-140 arm 3) shows a boundary
a*: below it local and global both improve; above it local holds or improves while at least one
global measure degrades beyond seed noise (the registered signature). Hysteresis: after R is
restored and amplification withdrawn, S's causal share stays elevated AND the agent underperforms a
matched restoration-arm agent on tasks where R is the better route under the cost model (reverting
would pay but does not happen). The same sweep on control process T (ARC-140 arm 4) does NOT show the
local-up / global-down dissociation at matched gain. Optional sleep leg: with MECH-529 replay on,
hysteresis is larger than with it off.
FALSIFYING: across the whole sweep local and global move together (compensation that improves or
degrades everything is not this failure mode); OR the persisting compensation is optimal under the
cost model; OR S's causal share reverts once R is restored (no hysteresis); OR T shows the same
pattern (generic over-gain, not compensation-specific).
DISCRIMINANT (vs MECH-364 / MECH-027): the persistence must be LOCALISED to S's causal share. A
whole-policy rigidity with no elevation of S's share is regime persistence from undischarged load,
not over-stabilised compensation.

MECH-542.subject: default_mode.source_sensitive_selective_permeability
MECH-542.title: Source-sensitive selective permeability -- INV-011 decomposed: `imagination without belief update` must NOT be implemented as `hypothetical -> learning OFF`, because 'belief update' is too unitary a category applied literally across every representational layer. A hypothetical/fictional source should PROTECT one set of variables -- autobiographical occurrence (this happened to me), historical occurrence (this event actually occurred), source truth (the narrator's proposition describes reality), responsibility attribution (I performed this action), and responsibility-bearing residue -- while PERMITTING update of another: possibility estimates, causal expectations, representations of other agents and their possible motivations, policy repertoire, harm/benefit expectations, social contingencies, counterfactual vocabulary, and the range of trajectories available for later simulation. Three otherwise-conflated properties must be free to dissociate: REPRESENTABILITY (can this state enter the generative system at all), EPISTEMIC COMMITMENT (does the system treat it as describing the actual world), and BEHAVIOURAL COMMITMENT (has an action been selected and owned on its basis). REGISTERED FALSIFIER -- the prediction is explicitly NOT 'fiction causes no update' but 'epistemic framing determines WHICH components are authorised to update': inject semantically identical event content under different source frames (direct observation / testimony / fiction / counterfactual / prediction / joke / memory / committed experience) and measure DIFFERENTIAL change across world-state belief, source confidence, E1 expectations, E2 predictions, other-agent models, harm-benefit expectations, policy availability, hippocampal trajectory repertoire, E3 evaluation, precision allocation, residue and subsequent behaviour. WRONG IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: if REE learns equally from fiction and observation across EVERY component the architecture is wrong, and if REE learns NOTHING transferable from fiction or counterfactual trajectories it is also wrong.
MECH-542.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION:
(P1) A linguistic/symbolic scenario-injection channel exists: REE can receive semantically
  equivalent event content explicitly tagged with a SOURCE FRAME (direct observation / testimony /
  fiction / counterfactual / prediction / joke / memory / committed experience) as a controllable
  input dimension. Confirmed absent in V3 (2026-09-25 grep of ree_core/: no source_frame / narrative
  / fiction vocabulary).
(P2) hypothesis_tag (or a successor) is a VECTOR / multi-channel gate, not the single global boolean
  it is today (ree_core/agent.py, ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py) -- instrumentation must read
  differential update across world-state belief, source confidence, E1 expectations, E2 predictions,
  other-agent models, harm-benefit expectations, policy availability, hippocampal trajectory
  repertoire, E3 evaluation, precision allocation and residue SEPARATELY, not as one pooled
  write/no-write decision. THIS IS THE SAME GAP already registered by MECH-248 ("a source-monitoring
  readout DISTINCT from the write gate must exist... hypothesis_tag is the same bit for both") and
  MECH-430 ("provenance is a SOURCE VECTOR... not a single committed_vs_imagined bit") -- see
  depends_on additions above.
(P3) At least two source frames are semantically matched on content (same event, different frame),
  so a measured difference is attributable to framing, not content.
Degenerate if P1-P3 unmet; a null under those conditions is uninterpretable, not evidence against.

CONFIRMING: differential update appears -- some components move with source frame (source
confidence, autobiographical/historical-occurrence-linked fields, responsibility attribution) while
others move roughly UNIFORMLY regardless of frame (possibility estimates, causal expectations,
other-agent models, policy repertoire, hippocampal trajectory availability) -- the protected/
permitted split the claim predicts, not a uniform split across every component.

FALSIFYING (explicitly two-sided per the claim's own wording): (i) REE updates EQUALLY from fiction
and direct observation across EVERY component -- no protection anywhere; or (ii) REE updates from
NEITHER fiction NOR counterfactual trajectories on ANY component -- no permeability anywhere, no
transfer from imagined material at all.

GOVERNANCE DECISION OWED (per the claim's own notes, not resolved here): whether this decomposition
folds into INV-011's wording/wwa/audit scope, or the two stand as separate claims, is explicitly
left to /governance.

LITERATURE (targeted review ran 2026-09-08, same day as registration -- notes text calling this
"owed" is stale, see currency finding): net picture is genuinely mixed and consistent with the
claim's own careful selective-permeability (not mode-switching) wording. Hartung et al. 2017
(n=1,742, conf 0.70, PMID 28983269) found NO broad fact/fiction difference in reading experience --
evidence AGAINST a global mode-switch, therefore consistent with selective permeability specifically.
Altmann et al. 2014 (conf 0.48, mixed, PMID 22956671) found a fact/fiction processing difference in
neuroimaging that the much larger Hartung behavioural study did not reproduce -- the assay must
measure internal update directly, not rely on behavioural proxies alone, or it will reproduce
Hartung's null and wrongly read as refuting. Green & Brock 2000 (conf 0.58) found belief change from
narrative REGARDLESS of fact/fiction label -- a caution that general belief-consistent evaluation may
show little source-differentiation in humans even where the claim predicts protection; reduced
false-note detection under high transportation there is a critical-evaluation effect, distinct from
source-tag decay (relevant to MECH-544, not this claim's falsifier). Garry et al. 1996 imagination
inflation (conf 0.65) is direct human evidence that the PROTECTED column (autobiographical occurrence)
is imperfectly protected even in humans under nothing more than repeated imagining -- a ceiling on how
impermeable a faithful REE implementation should even aim to be; do not treat perfect protection as
the confirming target.

MECH-543.subject: social.drama_enactment_vs_narrative_simulation
MECH-543.title: Drama runs OWN generative machinery under another agent's boundary conditions, where fiction only simulates another's trajectory: reading about an agent primarily requires modelling its trajectory, whereas ENACTING a role may temporarily recruit parts of one's own action and social machinery under the constraints of another identity or situation. Non-redundant prediction: enacted role-play should produce partially overlapping but DISTINGUISHABLE update fingerprints from semantically equivalent descriptive narrative -- specifically on other-model formation, policy availability, and affective prediction -- and role enactment should therefore be a more powerful route to exploring what another person could experience, without permanently confusing self and other.
MECH-543.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-542's P1-P3 apply unchanged (scenario-injection channel,
per-component instrumented hypothesis_tag vector, content-matched source frames) -- see MECH-542's
what_would_answer; not re-derived here. ADDITIONALLY:
(P4) REE has an ENACTMENT/role-taking input modality distinct from narrative description -- some
  channel by which "run one's own generative/action machinery under another agent's imported
  boundary conditions" differs mechanically from "simulate another's trajectory as a described
  narrative." Confirmed absent in V3 (2026-09-25 grep of ree_core/: no role_enact / drama
  vocabulary) -- REE currently has only the one route (trajectory simulation), not two.
Degenerate if MECH-542's P1-P3 or this P4 is unmet.

CONFIRMING: at matched semantic content, an ENACTED condition produces a measurably DIFFERENT
update fingerprint (via MECH-542's per-component instrumentation) than a DESCRIPTIVE-NARRATIVE
condition on at least other-model formation, policy availability and affective prediction, while
both stay within MECH-542's protected-column limits (no spurious autobiographical/occurrence update
from either route -- self/other confusion must not appear as a side effect).

FALSIFYING: enacted and descriptive conditions produce statistically indistinguishable update
fingerprints on all three named components at matched content and matched exposure -- enactment is
then a stronger dose of the same route, not a distinct one, and MECH-543 earns no keep over MECH-542
alone.

LITERATURE (2026-09-08 pull; claim registered at Tier 3, "speculative but experimentally tractable,"
and the evidence supports no higher): Tien et al. 2025 (conf 0.35, mixed, PMID 41245769) is the only
study found directly contrasting imagining a role against enacting it in the same participants (60
medical students); role-play reflections showed higher engagement than imagination, particularly in
the caregiver role -- directionally consistent, but weak: imagination always preceded enactment
(confounded with order/practice), and the DV is linguistic engagement in written reflection, not the
update-fingerprint components this claim specifies. Any REE test must counterbalance route order,
which this human study did not.

MECH-544.subject: default_mode.permeability_pathology_source_tag_decay
MECH-544.title: Permeability pathology and source-fidelity loss: the same selective permeability that enables cultural learning (MECH-542) necessarily creates its failure modes, and this is NOT an accidental weakness but plausibly the unavoidable price of a system that can learn from counterfactual experience -- a fully impermeable hypothetical system learns nothing from imagination, a fully permeable one cannot distinguish imagination from reality, and the useful system lies between. Predicted routes: repeated fictional trajectories distorting perceived likelihood; emotionally powerful narratives acquiring inappropriate precision; propaganda altering other-agent models without adequate evidence; humour gradually reducing the effective cost of previously prohibited representations; imagined threats modifying expectations of groups never directly encountered; cultural availability mistaken for environmental frequency. REGISTERED SIGNATURE -- SOURCE-FIDELITY LOSS: source information becomes less reliable while narrative structure is retained, producing characteristic errors in which retained narrative becomes progressively harder to distinguish from experienced or testified information; the underlying mechanism (stored-tag decay vs reconstructed-at-retrieval misattribution, per Johnson, Hashtroudi and Lindsay 1993) is left open pending the D6 discriminating test. The architectural requirement is therefore NOT to prevent hypothetical material from influencing cognition, but to keep the KIND and MAGNITUDE of update appropriate to the epistemic status of the representation.
MECH-544.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-542's P1-P3 apply unchanged (the permeability whose failure mode
this is) -- see MECH-542's what_would_answer; not re-derived here. ADDITIONALLY:
(P4) REPEATED / longitudinal exposure to source-framed content across multiple episodes or an
  offline/sleep consolidation boundary is available to test -- source-tag decay is a decay-OVER-TIME
  signature, not a single-exposure readout; MECH-542's base single-shot injection assay cannot by
  itself exhibit decay.
(P5) A source-confidence/source-tag quantity that can in principle decay INDEPENDENTLY of
  narrative-content retention is instrumented and readable (the same vector-vs-boolean gap as
  MECH-542's P2).
Degenerate if MECH-542's P1-P3 or P4/P5 here is unmet.

CONFIRMING: source information (confidence that content was fiction/hypothetical vs. experienced)
degrades with repeated exposure or elapsed consolidation cycles WHILE narrative/content structure is
retained at a slower rate -- the registered signature (retained content becomes progressively harder
to distinguish from experienced/testified content) -- on at least one of the claim's named routes
(likelihood distortion from repeated fictional trajectories; inappropriate precision on emotionally
powerful narrative; other-agent-model drift toward groups never directly encountered).

FALSIFYING: with P1-P5 met, selective permeability (once MECH-542 is built) produces NO characteristic
pathology at ANY permeability setting tested -- source and content decay at statistically
indistinguishable rates across the tested range. Per the claim's own notes this would be "a welcome
result and a genuine surprise," not a routine null, since the claim asserts the pathology is intrinsic
to a useful permeable system rather than incidental -- report it as a positive design finding, not
merely absence of evidence.

LITERATURE (2026-09-08 pull -- "the part with the clearest external grounding" per the claim's own
notes, confirmed): Johnson, Hashtroudi & Lindsay 1993 (conf 0.72, PMID 8346328, the founding
source-monitoring-framework review) directly supports that content and source-attribution dissociate
