in humans -- BUT proposes source is RECONSTRUCTED at retrieval from qualitative cues, not stored on a
tag that decays, which is architecturally DIFFERENT from the decaying-source-tag mechanism this claim
posits; flag as an unreconciled design choice, not yet resolved by this digestion pass. Garry et al.
1996 imagination inflation (conf 0.65) is direct support of the pathology itself (imagining alone
raises occurrence confidence) via a familiarity-misattribution route the source literature treats as
possibly distinct from source-tag decay proper -- a REE assay attributing all such errors to
source-tag decay would conflate two mechanisms the human literature keeps separate; measure both.

CROSS-REFERENCE OWED: architecture/language/language_failure_modes.md already names "spurious
residue from narrative contamination" as a REE failure mode, owned by MECH-013 (itself
substrate-blocked behind ARC-009/ARC-010, GFLAG-0269). MECH-544's notes say this claim "supplies the
mechanism that would generate that family," but the two claims are not cross-referenced -- see
depends_on addition above.

MECH-545.subject: architecture.cognitive_contract_lesion_assays
MECH-545.title: Contract-lesion assays: the decisive test of a candidate cognitive-contract invariant (ARC-142) is not its presence in successful cognition but a BOUNDARY LESION -- a translation between two engines that preserves content but deletes one relation -- producing a predicted, invariant-specific fragmentation signature. Five pre-registered signatures: IDENTITY lesion (two representations cannot determine whether they concern the same entity) -> broken persistence, duplicated selves / objects, incoherent credit assignment, unstable memory integration; TEMPORAL lesion (content without temporal relation) -> cause / effect inversion, present-state vs anticipated-state confusion, confused planning, memory / prediction contamination; REALITY-STATUS lesion (observed, remembered, simulated and counterfactual states indistinct across the boundary) -> confabulation-like behaviour, false commitment to imagined states, impaired counterfactual learning, psychosis-like representational error; AGENCY lesion (events representable, controllability and actor relation lost) -> poor action learning, internal / external attribution errors, impaired responsibility assignment, failure of intentional planning; CONFIDENCE lesion (content translates, uncertainty does not) -> overcommitment, under-reaction to reliable predictions, inappropriate belief updating, failure of precision-sensitive integration. Predictions: each lesion applied at ONE inter-engine boundary yields a signature distinct from the other four and from generic information loss (scored against a dimensionality-matched random-projection floor, INV-105), and an invariant whose boundary lesion produces NO reproducible deficit is struck from the contract, with the negative result preserved (GOV-CONTRACT-1).
MECH-545.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a within-boundary CONTENT-PRESERVING control exists and works -- the lesion must be shown to delete the relation while leaving content intact, distinguished from MECH-537's encoded-but-not-exposed phenotype (INV-105 rung 3 loss vs rung 2). Without it every lesion result is generic information loss. Off-manifold construction and compensation must be excluded per GOV-INTERVENE-1 and ARC-140 before either verdict.
CONFIRMING: each of the five lesions, applied at ONE inter-engine boundary, produces a signature distinct from the other four AND from a dimensionality-matched random-projection floor, replicating across seeds, with acute (frozen-weights) and adapted phases separated per ARC-140.
FALSIFYING: (4) lesion specificity disappears -- controlled corruption produces only generic information loss, no five-way dissociation. Two asymmetric failure routes must be excluded first: an OFF-MANIFOLD lesion damaging unrelated computations (false positive: the candidate looks necessary) and COMPENSATION through an alternative pathway (false negative: the mechanism looks unnecessary if only post-adaptation behaviour is examined).
CURRENCY CORRECTION 2026-09-15 on the 'cheapest V3 cousin': the reality-status lesion described as 'force-dropping committed_vs_imagined at the replay -> consolidation boundary, a small edit' -- grep for committed_vs_imagined / source_status over ree_core and experiments returns 0 hits; the MECH-365 token is unbuilt, and what exists is hypothesis_tag as a boolean WRITE GATE (ree_core/sleep/mel_consumer.py, phase_manager.py). Forcing that gate open is still cheap but perturbs a gate, not a status carried across the boundary -- a weaker instance of the assay pattern; whoever routes it must say which is meant.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional; depends_on gains ARC-140 and GOV-INTERVENE-1 (edges, not a merge), which between them own the section-12 causal standard.

MECH-546.subject: language.grammar_inherits_cognitive_contract
MECH-546.title: Grammar inherits the cognitive contract: some grammar-like relational structure -- agency / role marking, tense and aspect, modality and evidentiality, negation, reference and number, causation and conditionals -- emerges in a communication channel because external transmission between minds inherits the same relations that internal translation between engines must already preserve (ARC-142). Chain: cognitive invariants -> internal representational contracts -> repeated compression / translation pressure -> proto-grammatical relational structure -> external language. Two-directional test: (a) invariants derived from cognition or REE-internal necessity should be over-represented among recurrently grammaticalised distinctions; (b) recurrently grammaticalised distinctions lacking developmental, comparative or computational support should classify as embodied or cultural, not contract. Prediction: agents required to transmit invariant-rich cognitive states efficiently over a low-cost channel develop grammar-like structure for exactly the contract relations and not for schema content; agreement across (a) and (b) is the evidence, either direction alone is not.
MECH-546.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the two directions must be able to disagree -- the candidate set must have been FROZEN before the typological comparison, else direction (a) is guaranteed and the test is circular (the contamination GOV-CONTRACT-1 and the prereg's language firewall exist to prevent).
CONFIRMING: agreement across both directions -- contract-derived invariants over-represented among recurrently grammaticalised distinctions, AND recurrently grammaticalised distinctions lacking developmental/comparative/computational support classifying as embodied or cultural; plus the emergent-communication prediction: agents transmitting invariant-rich states over a low-cost channel develop grammar-like structure for contract relations and not for schema content.
FALSIFYING: either direction alone (the claim says agreement is the evidence) -- the grammaticalised set and the contract set statistically independent; or agents develop grammar-like structure for schema content as readily as for relations. CONTRARY EVIDENCE ALREADY FILED: evidence/literature/targeted_review_cognitive_contract_invariants/entries/2026-09-08_mech_546_compositionality_not_required_for_generalization_chaabouni2020 (compositionality not required for generalisation in emergent communication) weakens the channel-converges-on-relational-structure half; read it before attaching any confirming citation.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional -- v6 per ARC-100's language phase; nothing in V3 or V4 exercises it, and the owed work is a typology /lit-pull, not an experiment.

MECH-547.subject: representation.receiver_conditioned_context_indexed_translation
MECH-547.title: Receiver-conditioned translation: what a sender should expose to a consumer is a function of the receiver's current state, not of the sender alone -- translated content = T(sender state, receiver state, receiver position / context) -- so the communication subspace (MECH-537) is CONTEXT-INDEXED rather than one globally fixed cross-system alignment. The sender may support several potential read surfaces, and which one is active may depend on receiver mode, current goal or task-loop context, uncertainty, the action or candidate under evaluation, retrieved episodic context, temporal phase and the receiver's current predicted state. CONSTRAINT that keeps this from becoming a hidden cognitive module: receiver-conditioning determines WHICH PART of already-present sender information is exposed and HOW it is expressed; it must not let the bridge solve the task independently. Confirming signature: T(A,B) > T(A) on held-out data at MATCHED capacity AND receiver-state permutation destroys the gain; if permutation barely matters, the gain is extra capacity, not conditioning, and the result is evidence about the bridge (MECH-538). Candidate REE loci: z_world -> E1 versus z_world -> E2 (different read surfaces of one sender), E1 <-> E2 conditioned on the candidate action / horizon under evaluation, hippocampal retrieval -> consumer conditioned on the consumer's present query state, ContextMemory -> downstream reader expressed relative to current context rather than injected as a fixed latent message, and waking versus offline interfaces using different receiver-conditioned geometry.
MECH-547.what_would_answer:
Extracted 2026-09-15 from this claim's own registration (assay arms on docs/architecture/receiver_conditioned_translation.md) plus the reference-frame thought's separation note.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: frozen endpoints (INV-109), matched capacity with the conditioning channel's added capacity REPORTED, and a source that passes adequacy (V3-EXQ-1010: the observation -> z_world locus does not). The receiver-conditioned bridge T(A,B) must have an instrument: as of 2026-09-15 interface_probe.py fits X->Y unconditionally, so this precondition is unmet (chip-20260915-interface-probe-receiver-conditioned-rung).
CONFIRMING: T(A,B) beats BOTH the sender-only matched-capacity baseline T(A) AND its own receiver-state PERMUTATION control (same bridge, receiver states shuffled across episodes/positions at matched capacity) on held-out consumer use, with correct-vs-mismatched sender specificity (INV-105) preserved and the off-manifold and recurrence checks (MECH-548) passing -- the exposed read surface is genuinely a function of the receiver's state.
FALSIFYING: the receiver-state permutation matches the intact conditioned bridge (the conditioning is not doing the work); OR the T(A,B) gain over T(A) reduces to the added capacity of the conditioning channel; OR both fixed and conditioned bridges fail while richer source information succeeds (upstream representation deficiency, not receiver conditioning).
SEPARATION NOTE (2026-09-15): the temporal-phase item in this claim's conditioner list is NOT tested by the receiver-state permutation, because permuting receiver state within a phase stratum leaves phase intact. A T(A,B) gain attributed to temporal phase is a MECH-556 result, not a MECH-547 result; score the two separately (run the receiver-state permutation and the phase permutation together -- if only the receiver permutation destroys the gain, this claim owns the result).
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional (no T(A,B) rung exists).

MECH-548.subject: representation.recurrent_interface_stability_closed_loop
MECH-548.title: Recurrent interface stability: an interface can be statically useful yet recurrently unstable -- a bridge with one-step utility > 0 can fail repeated closed-loop application, and REE traverses most interfaces repeatedly over trajectories, episodes and recurrent prediction loops. Two mechanisms, to be distinguished experimentally: (a) OFF-MANIFOLD COMPOUNDING -- a bridge trained on native receiver states emits a slightly off-distribution receiver state, the next application treats it as ordinary input, and B_0 -> T(A_0,B_0) = B_1' -> T(A_1,B_1') = B_2' accumulates displacement into a regime the bridge never saw; (b) SEMANTIC DOUBLE-COUNTING -- content already injected is not recognised as present and is re-amplified, escalating gain. Design corollary: CUMULATIVE translation (each step operates on the previously translated receiver state) versus CLEAN-BASE translation (each step computed against an unmodified native receiver state, the residual held as a temporary gated overlay) -- translated information should first be tested as an overlay or gated read surface, never as an irreversible rewrite of the receiver's core latent state. Adds an EIGHTH rung to INV-105's ladder, RECURRENTLY STABLE: repeated use preserves receiver-state validity, information calibration and functional behaviour over the timescale the system actually uses the interface -- assessed BEFORE behavioural usefulness is read as architecturally meaningful in a dynamical system. Sleep corollary for MECH-540: offline interface recalibration must improve or preserve closed-loop stability when waking dynamics resume; a sleep-induced change that improves a static probe but destabilises the next waking trajectory is a failure, not consolidation. Signatures: one-step rescue + cumulative collapse + clean-base stability = recurrent interface instability; cumulative stability + correct-pair specificity = a functionally coherent recurrent bridge; both fixed and conditioned bridges failing while richer source information succeeds = upstream representation deficiency remains more likely.
MECH-548.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the interface must be traversed REPEATEDLY over a horizon the system actually uses, and the one-step result must be positive -- there is nothing to destabilise otherwise (degenerate if one-step utility is at or below floor). Frozen endpoints per INV-109; adequate source per V3-EXQ-1010 (trained z_world inadmissible).
CONFIRMING (registered signature): ONE-STEP RESCUE + CUMULATIVE COLLAPSE + CLEAN-BASE STABILITY -- recomputing each step against the unmodified native receiver state restores stability while cumulative application degrades. This is simultaneously the separating arm against MECH-539: MECH-539's failure persists under clean-base and MECH-548's does not. Assay spec section 1.8 fixes the readout: N=20 consecutive closed-loop consumer steps, agreement at step 1 and step N, fitted decay slope, first-crossing index, with 'one-step-only, never a rescue' as a named reporting category.
FALSIFYING: cumulative and clean-base application are indistinguishable over the horizons the system uses (the bridge's own output re-entering as input costs nothing); OR the degradation is fully explained by native-dynamics incompatibility (MECH-539) and clean-base does not rescue it.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional -- PARTIAL instrument: manifold_guard covers the off-manifold half (mechanism a); the cumulative re-application half is NOT built (dynamic_compatibility measures compounding across ONE rollout, not N re-applications of T; no cumulative_drift / repeated_use / recurrent_interface symbol exists in ree-v3) -- complicated (buildable). The eighth-rung proposal stays here rather than amending INV-105 (GFLAG-0235); live trigger: revisit when this claim acquires evidence.

MECH-549.subject: development.history_irreducibility_at_matched_final_capacity
MECH-549.title: Developmental-history irreducibility at matched final capacity: some mature cognitive organisations may be historically inaccessible from their own final architecture -- a system that develops through a transiently larger capacity envelope and is progressively reduced to a target architecture can outperform an identical target architecture trained from initialisation under the identical curriculum, so developmental history contributes something the final architecture alone does not reproduce. The claim is stated with its own discriminating control and is confirmable ONLY by that control: a four-arm design of (A) mature size throughout, (B) overcapacity progressively reduced to the mature size, (C) overcapacity retained, and (D) arm B's final architecture, sparsity mask and interface structure REINITIALISED and trained from the start under the same curriculum. B > A alone is consistent with the rival "pruning found a better small architecture"; only B > D at architecture(B) ~= architecture(D) and final capacity(B) = final capacity(D) establishes the claim. Corollary: premature representational or interface compression should selectively impair distinctions whose relevance is revealed only later in the curriculum, even where the same compressed form works well after maturation.
MECH-549.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (two legs, both UNMET 2026-09-15): (1) a capacity-reduction mechanism that takes an over-capacity locus to an exactly specified final architecture, so arm B has a defined endpoint; (2) arm D constructible -- the sparsity mask / interface structure arm B produced must be EXPORTABLE and re-instantiable at initialisation. Arms A/B/C alone cannot separate this claim from architecture search.
CONFIRMING: with final capacity(B) = final capacity(D), architecture(B) ~= architecture(D), identical curriculum and seeds, matched compute: competence(B) > competence(D) by a margin scaled on the seed-level SD of the B-D difference plus an absolute floor, AND the advantage persists out of the training distribution (held-out layouts, changed action semantics, delayed-consequence distinctions, cue reassignment).
FALSIFYING (primary): competence(B) ~= competence(D) at matched final capacity -- the final architecture reproduces the whole effect. FALSIFYING (secondary, distinct signature): B > A and B > D but the advantage disappears at matched compute, or is fully reproduced by teacher-student distillation from arm C at matched compute. BOUNDARY (not refutation): arm C strong while every reduced arm collapses -- the mature bottleneck is too narrow; the claim is untested.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional (the arm-D export path is unspecified, not merely unbuilt).

MECH-550.subject: development.functional_persistence_retention_criterion
MECH-550.title: Functional persistence, not weight magnitude, is the retention criterion for developmental capacity reduction: which relationships, mappings or routes survive a developmental reduction should be determined by repeated demonstrated usefulness under prediction, action, regulation and replay -- predictive contribution, reduction of persistent prediction error, harm/benefit relevance, controllability discrimination, counterfactual usefulness, action-selection contribution, replay recurrence, transfer across contexts, stability across developmental stages, utility to more than one downstream consumer, and maintenance of uncertainty where premature collapse would be dangerous. The prediction is comparative and has a named rival that must be run as a control rather than assumed away: relevance-guided reduction should outperform indiscriminate magnitude pruning at matched final capacity; if it does not, functional selection is not what the developmental reduction is doing and the effect reduces to capacity annealing.
MECH-550.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the magnitude-pruning control arm must REACH the same final capacity without collapsing, and the two criteria must actually select DIFFERENT retained sets (report the overlap). Identical retained sets make the comparison vacuous whatever the outcome -- the criterion was never manipulated (the V3-EXQ-610a-e lesson: a control that does not degrade makes the treatment arm uninformative).
CONFIRMING: at matched final capacity and matched update count, a retention criterion built from the functional-persistence list (predictive contribution, persistent-PE reduction, harm/benefit relevance, controllability discrimination, counterfactual usefulness, action-selection contribution, replay recurrence, cross-context transfer, cross-stage stability, multi-consumer utility, uncertainty maintenance) produces better downstream competence AND better transfer than magnitude pruning, with a non-trivial retained-set difference; diagnostically, surviving routes correspond to stable regulatory distinctions, task-relevant communication subspaces or repeated transformation motifs rather than to large parameter magnitude.
FALSIFYING: magnitude pruning matches or beats the relevance-guided criterion at matched capacity and updates (the benefit, if any, is capacity annealing). SECOND FAILURE SIGNATURE: the relevance-guided criterion wins on aggregate competence but selectively destroys INV-104-protected distinctions whose relevance had not yet been revealed -- a failure of this claim as stated, not a partial success.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional (nothing in ree_core/ scores any route for retention).

MECH-551.subject: sleep.replay_coupled_capacity_reduction_coordination
MECH-551.title: Capacity reduction concurrent with representational change is a COORDINATION problem, and offline replay is the proposed coordination site: while a representation is still being revised, a route can appear unnecessary only because its consumer has not yet adapted to the new representation, and an apparently useful route can be preserving an obsolete coding convention -- so the retention decision read online during representational change is systematically unreliable in both directions. The proposal is that offline/replay periods provide the safer setting for it, because they permit testing which old episodes remain reconstructable, comparing alternative candidate mappings without immediate behavioural cost, re-indexing memories after representational change, stabilising newly useful communication subspaces, weakening redundant routes, and checking that a reduction has not destroyed counterfactual or regulatory distinctions. Falsifiable prediction with its matched control stated: at equal aggressiveness of reduction AND matched update count, replay-coupled reduction should preserve more transfer and causal structure than online-only reduction; the strong form is that replay permits GREATER compression at equal or better transfer.
MECH-551.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (three legs): (1) a capacity-reduction mechanism exists; (2) the representation is actually CHANGING during the reduction window (a frozen representation removes the coordination hazard and degenerates the test into 'does replay help pruning'); (3) update count is matched between arms, not wall-clock or episode count.
CONFIRMING: at equal reduction aggressiveness and matched update count, replay-coupled reduction preserves more transfer and more causal structure (held-out layouts, counterfactual discrimination, delayed-consequence distinctions) than online-only reduction. Strong form, worth pre-registering: replay permits GREATER compression at equal or better transfer.
FALSIFYING: online-only reduction matches replay-coupled reduction at matched updates -- the reduction decision is reliable enough online. SECOND FAILURE SIGNATURE (inherited from MECH-540 S4 and MECH-548's sleep corollary): the replay-coupled arm improves a static retention/reconstruction probe while the next waking trajectory is measurably worse -- a failure, not consolidation, and it must be measured.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional (nothing to reduce); merge into MECH-540 as a further offline job is proposed to governance (GFLAG-0280) -- if merged, MECH-540 survives and ARC-143 / MECH-550 reverse-deps re-point.

MECH-552.subject: provenance.false_evidence_multiplication_cardinality
MECH-552.title: False evidence multiplication: a provenance error can change the apparent CARDINALITY of evidence and not only its source label. One internally generated hypothesis H produces descendants through prediction, hippocampal replay, counterfactual simulation, retrieved memory and ambiguous perceptual interpretation; if shared ancestry is lost, those descendants are counted as several mutually corroborating observations and confidence in H rises with no corresponding increase in world evidence. Two consequences are asserted to be separable and must not be collapsed: a phenomenological branch (self-generated content losing evidence of self-generation acquires external/perceptual status) and an epistemic branch (descendants losing shared ancestry inflate posterior confidence and shorten information-seeking). LOCUS CORRECTION, carried in the claim rather than deferred: the operative variable is the READOUT'S DEFAULT FOR UNKNOWN ANCESTRY, not the corruption event itself -- an architecture that treats unrecorded dependency as independence will inflate whether or not any genealogy was ever corrupted.
MECH-552.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (all four, from ladder P1 and supplement P1-R1/R4): (1) informational content and the external evidence set are IDENTICAL across provenance conditions, asserted not intended; (2) descendants are GENERATED by the architecture's own processes and the ancestry record is corrupted INSIDE it, not handed to a reader as a fixed evidence graph; (3) a genuinely-independent-new-observation arm raises both count and confidence with calibration preserved (the count readout has range in the right direction); (4) the effective-source-count instrument reports its own calibration and confidence is measured separately, never derived from the count.
CONFIRMING: with content and world evidence fixed, the corrupted / absent-ancestry condition raises the effective independent-source count AND degrades calibration against world truth AND reduces further information-seeking, while a matched legitimate-computation arm (further computation on a fixed observation set that demonstrably improves the estimate) shows calibration IMPROVING at UNCHANGED effective source count. The separation of the two signatures is the confirmation; either alone is not.
FALSIFYING: content-matched provenance corruption changes source attribution and association strength but leaves effective source count and calibration intact (H0 source-label-only, still the most likely single result); OR inflation appears only when ancestry is PRESENTED as split and never when corrupted internally; OR contradictory external evidence is handled normally despite corruption; OR the effect requires an explicit provenance-error-to-confidence bonus; OR the legitimate-computation control cannot be distinguished from the false-independence signature under the chosen instruments (untestable as posed; rebuild instruments before reporting).
CURRENCY carried in the claim: provenance_p1_result.md (2026-09-10, synthetic) located the effect in the READOUT DEFAULT for unknown ancestry (absent_policy independent 1.117 -> 4.869; soft -> 5.000; dependent -> 1.000 at identical corruption) and provenance_p1r5 found the dependent fix also fails its crossing criterion; synthetic-harness results, NOT claim evidence.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional -- the veridical comparator arm cannot be built (no genealogy in ree_core; ancestry reference deleted at commit, hippocampal/module.py:3450-3453).

MECH-553.subject: provenance.compressed_causal_genealogy_graph
MECH-553.title: Compressed causal genealogy as the representation that discharges the dependency-representation invariant: provenance is a GRAPH over representations, not a vector of attributes on each one. The proposed structure is bounded rather than a full history -- shared-ancestor probability between any two evidence-bearing items, an externally-anchored-observation flag with its own confidence, a hypothetical / replay lineage marker, an already-counted-evidence-family marker recording whether an item has already contributed to the current belief update, and a context-conditioned dependency estimate -- and each genealogy edge carries its own confidence so that ancestry can be uncertain without being absent. This extends the per-token provenance source vector from attributes of one token to relations between tokens, which is the level at which evidence cardinality is defined.
MECH-553.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: comparison at MATCHED INFORMATION with the genealogy actually exercised -- at least one pair of items in the run genuinely shares an ancestor and at least one pair genuinely does not, both reaching a belief update; the structure must be genuinely BOUNDED (a full-history implementation is a different, weaker claim and must be reported as such).
CONFIRMING: explicit compressed genealogy beats both lineage-free inference and no genealogy on calibration and duplicate-evidence resistance at matched information, AND the already-counted-family marker demonstrably prevents a re-presented item contributing twice to one belief update, AND edge confidence is load-bearing (an uncertain edge yields an intermediate weighting, not present-or-absent collapse).
FALSIFYING: lineage-free dependency estimation -- residual/error covariance, shared latent provenance, temporal co-reactivation, common prediction ancestry, ablation/dropout response, or a context-conditioned dependency estimate (Rule and O'Leary 2022, PMID 35145024, the named competitor) -- matches explicit genealogy on calibration and duplicate resistance at matched information; OR MECH-430's per-token source vector alone, with no relational edges, suffices (this claim then earns no keep over MECH-430).
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional; merge into MECH-552 as its substrate half remains a live governance option -- it stands separately only because MECH-430's own falsifier passes unchanged in an architecture that counts one lineage four times.

MECH-554.subject: provenance.replay_amplification_of_false_independence
MECH-554.title: Recursive replay amplification of false independence: when genealogy is corrupted or absent, repeated replay / reinstatement of internally stored content converts remembered or simulated material into apparent new evidence, so confidence in a hypothesis rises monotonically with replay count while external evidence is held fixed, and the belief becomes self-maintaining. The dangerous signature is specifically an ancestry-by-replay-count INTERACTION, not a replay-count main effect: healthy replay must be able to improve retrieval fidelity and representation quality with the effective independent-source count staying flat. Admissible only under two controls -- replay stratified by kind (single-episode content rehearsal, cross-episode relational linking, prediction-generated descendants), and retrieval quality matched across ancestry conditions, since a corrupted-ancestry arm that also retrieves better yields a retrieval effect wearing a provenance label.
MECH-554.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (supplement P3-R1/R2/R3): (1) external evidence genuinely FIXED after the replay phase begins, asserted not assumed; (2) replay STRATIFIED by kind -- single-episode content rehearsal, cross-episode relational linking, prediction-generated descendants -- a pooled replay-count main effect is not a result; (3) retrieval quality MATCHED across ancestry conditions, or the interaction is a retrieval effect wearing a provenance label; (4) the healthy-replay arm must be REACHABLE (replay improving retrieval fidelity at flat effective source count) -- if every replay arm inflates the count the instrument measures replay exposure and the run reports instrument failure.
CONFIRMING: a significant ancestry-by-replay-count INTERACTION at fixed external evidence and matched retrieval quality -- confidence rising monotonically with replay count under corrupted / absent ancestry and not under veridical ancestry, with the healthy-replay arm simultaneously showing fidelity improvement at flat source count.
FALSIFYING: no ancestry-by-replay-count interaction survives matched retrieval quality; OR replay improves representation without any change in the independence estimate under every ancestry condition; OR the interaction appears only under an explicitly programmed confidence bonus.
CURRENCY: provenance_p3_r2_spike_result.md (2026-09-10) found the healthy-replay arm UNREACHABLE as first built (fidelity rise exactly 0) until a harness capability was added; routes complex (probe-gated) -> puzzle (known rules) -> complicated (buildable); confirmatory grid not run.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional in REE. Named, deliberately UNQUEUED V3 observation point: ree_core/sleep/bayesian_aggregator.py adds likelihood precision per routed replay event with no dependency term and replay_sampler.py draws with replacement while tracking draw_region_counts, so precision-vs-draw-count at fixed waking evidence is instrumentable with no code change -- but a positive relation is the code's own arithmetic and the veridical comparator does not exist, so it is not a test.

MECH-555.subject: representation.reference_frame_mediated_interface_legibility
MECH-555.title: Reference-frame mediation as a separable interface factor: two systems can each contain a task distinction, expose it through a healthy communication subspace (MECH-537), and still fail to communicate because they index that distinction against INCOMPATIBLE RELATIONAL COORDINATES -- egocentric versus allocentric, current-position-relative versus trajectory-origin-relative, observation-time versus predicted-action-time, absolute location versus action-conditioned displacement, episode-identity versus elapsed-tick. The interface decomposition is therefore content x communication subspace x REFERENCE FRAME x receiver context x temporal gate, and the frame is a THIRD selection variable alongside which directions are exposed (MECH-537) and which read surface the receiver's state selects (MECH-547). Registered failure class RF-F (an eighth entry in the location doc's F1-F7 routing table): an external probe succeeds on sender AND receiver, the information is not missing and the subspace is not collapsed, yet native cross-system use fails -- routing to a relational re-indexing rather than to more sender capacity or a higher bridge rung. The DISCRIMINATOR that makes this more than a redescription is a frame permutation that preserves content: permute the frame labels or anchors between episodes or positions while holding sender-state distribution, marginal difficulty and content statistics fixed (intact >> frame-permuted, while the target stays decodable in both, is the confirming signature; intact ~= frame-permuted says the frame is incidental at that interface). Two non-redundant predictions: frame alignment should LOWER the minimum bridge rung L(A -> B) (MECH-538) without requiring a higher-capacity bridge, and a frame permutation may disrupt only ONE downstream consumer, in which case reference frames are consumer-specific rather than globally shared -- which forbids inferring one global workspace or one canonical coordinate system from several consumers sharing an indexing relation.
MECH-555.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (three conditions, all failing 2026-09-15; this is the gate): (1) an ADEQUATE SOURCE at the tested interface -- V3-EXQ-1010 confirmed H-F at observation -> z_world (content destroyed at encode), so a frame permutation there measures noise and would yield a false RF-F-eliminated; use rawfield25 (0.9735 worst-seed) or a post-SD-106 encoder, never the shipped P0 latent; (2) at least two candidate frames distinguishable in V3, supplied by the experiment layer (assay A section 2.2's five levels; the invertible 90/180/270 rotation is a CONSTRUCTED frame testing instrument sensitivity, not spontaneous frame preservation); (3) the G4 instrument gate: a known invertible frame transform with its exact inverse must restore the consumer, else the run is refused.
CONFIRMING: on a source that passed adequacy, at frozen endpoints and matched capacity, data, optimisation and conditioning-channel width, held-out consumer use under the intact frame is substantially greater than under a within-stratum frame permutation WHILE the task target remains decodable at the same level in both, AND A3_frame_cond clears A1_source_only on the compositional holdout cells (frame level x query level unseen in fitting). A permutation disrupting only ONE downstream consumer confirms the weaker consumer-specific reading and must be reported as such, not as a shared global frame.
FALSIFYING: (a) intact ~= frame-permuted at matched decodability (frame incidental at this interface); (b) A3_frame_cond ~= A1_source_only on holdout (frame label buys nothing over an unconditional low-rank bridge); (c) the effect disappears once marginal difficulty is equalised (permutation was off-distribution, assay spec guard 6); (d) frame alignment does not lower the minimum bridge rung L(A->B) in any tested pair -- falsifies the second prediction specifically, motivating a narrower successor.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional -- sequencing, not doubt: everything exists except an adequate source at a named locus. Secondary option recorded: (g) merge into ARC-142 (MECH-555 absorbed; RF-F and the permutation control lifted into ARC-142's notes; no reverse-deps).

MECH-556.subject: representation.temporal_gate_interface_engagement_phase
MECH-556.title: Temporal-gate adequacy as a separable interface factor, and the mistimed-interface false negative: an inter-system mapping can be representationally adequate -- source content present, receiver-facing geometry adequate, bridge low-complexity, correct-pair specificity satisfied, receiver on-manifold -- and still produce NO downstream effect because it is engaged outside the phase in which the receiver is receptive, plastic, replaying the relevant episode, or evaluating the relevant candidate. This separates HAVING a compatible interface from ENGAGING it at the phase in which its content can alter another system. Registered failure class TG-F (a ninth entry in the location doc's F1-F7 routing table) and the binding evidential consequence that is this claim's real content, deliberately of the same shape as INV-105's two: a null measured at an interface whose engagement phase was NOT a controlled variable does not license the reading "the interface is semantically useless" or "the information was lost", until the same correctly paired content has been delivered at a target phase versus early-shifted, late-shifted and phase-shuffled conditions AT MATCHED communication energy, event count and update magnitude -- so that timing, not quantity, is what varied. Corollary that keeps this from licensing new machinery: the manipulation is expected to be expressible by REE's EXISTING wake / sleep / control-plane substrate, and a finding that it is not is itself the result -- do not add a gate mechanism to make the test runnable.
MECH-556.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the manipulated phase must be one the receiver's plasticity or read actually tracks, and quantity must be held fixed -- Gate B2 verbatim: match event count, phase occupancy, activity magnitude and total absolute weight change; do NOT interpret a timing interaction if the shifted condition changes data exposure or update magnitude. REE-specific: the interface under test must have a receiver whose state can change as a result of the read -- the replay -> consumer interface has NO consumer (_do_replay discards its trajectories; substrate_queue mech092-replay-consumer-missing), so a timing manipulation there is unfalsifiable by construction. SEQUENCING (part of the precondition): Gate B2 runs only after content specificity is established at Gate B1.
CONFIRMING: correctly paired content delivered at the target phase produces a downstream change (receiver parameter/state change, consumer-use gain, or post-sleep retention) that early-shifted, late-shifted and phase-shuffled delivery do not, at matched event count, phase occupancy, activity magnitude and total absolute weight change, surviving the pairing controls (correct vs mismatched vs zero vs moment-matched random, INV-105), measured on at least TWO interfaces with different predicted plasticity -- an identical timing effect on both is generic plasticity scheduling, not interface-specific gating.
FALSIFYING: (a) target-phase ~= shifted at matched energy (timing not a factor here; TG-F may not be invoked to excuse nulls); (b) the effect tracks total update magnitude or exposure rather than phase (Gate B2 disqualifier); (c) the effect appears at every phase offset (what varied was not phase); (d) strong falsifier for the evidential rule: a systematic phase-controlled re-measurement of past interface nulls changes no verdict -- TG-F then retires to a documentation note.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (a) testable now on V3 substrate, sequenced behind Gate B1 -- levers built (MECH-089 ThetaBuffer, MECH-272 routing_gate.py, MECH-091 phase_reset, MultiRateClock, force_sleep_cycle_at_eval_boundary), instrument built (interface_probe.py; CaptureRecord carries phase), manipulation specified (Gate B2). Proposal EXP-1402 minted. implementation_phase left at v4 for /governance to route; the cheapness of the diagnostic is the trap named at registration -- do not queue on cheapness.

MECH-557.subject: architecture.cognitive_contract_structural_families_and_attached_fields
MECH-557.title: The 3 + 2 reduction hypothesis: the fourteen canonical cognitive-contract candidates (evidence/planning/cognitive_contract_invariant_ledger.v1.json) may not be fourteen independent primitives but may largely generate from THREE STRUCTURAL FAMILIES plus TWO ATTACHED WEIGHTING FIELDS. Structural: (A) CORRESPONDENCE / BINDING -- which token, event, state or relation in one representation corresponds to which in another or across time, with identity as correspondence plus continuity and persistence constraints, and equivalence as correspondence under a specified transformation (absorbing CCI-001, CCI-006); (B) DIRECTED EVENT / TRAJECTORY STRUCTURE -- event or token instances, ordered or partially ordered succession, reachable transition relations, persistence across transitions, and optional typed intervention edges, rather than a scalar clock plus a separate graph (absorbing CCI-002, CCI-007 and, if action-labelled edges suffice to reconstruct controllability, much of CCI-004); (C) GENERATIVE CONTEXT / ANCHORING / LINEAGE -- which process produced a representation, which branch it belongs to, whether that branch is anchored to the current sensory worldline, and how it relates to other generated alternatives, so that "actual" is a relation to the currently anchored worldline rather than a primitive category (absorbing CCI-003, CCI-012 and the unnumbered provenance/ownership hypotheses). Attached fields: (D) EPISTEMIC WEIGHT over states, edges or translations, obligatory only where the producer holds reliability information the receiver cannot cheaply reconstruct (reclassifying CCI-005 from content primitive to boundary-specific field); (E) REGULATORY / VIABILITY WEIGHT -- predicted relation to viable or preferred states plus direction of change plus horizon, from which signed value, goal relation and priority may derive (reclassifying CCI-009 and bearing on CCI-010, CCI-014). CROSSED PREDICTION, which is what makes this falsifiable rather than a re-labelling: structural families should survive object or world remapping when the world relation is unchanged despite altered surface features, whereas attached fields should vary strongly with current uncertainty, needs, goals, physiology and task regime AT FIXED STRUCTURE -- so holding structure fixed while changing confidence, holding structure fixed while changing viability, holding confidence fixed while changing branch lineage, holding value fixed while changing controllability, and holding sensory content fixed while changing generative path should dissociate along the structure/field boundary. If structural and weighting variables cannot be dissociated by that crossed design, the 3 + 2 model is wrong or too simple.
MECH-557.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the crossed design (thought section 14; prereg gate G1) must be instantiable -- structure and weighting independently manipulable: a manipulation that changes confidence at FIXED structural content, one that changes structural content at FIXED confidence, and a positive control showing each moves its own target. If they cannot be varied independently the experiment returns ASSAY INVALID, not model wrong.
CONFIRMING: all five crossed contrasts dissociate along the structure/field boundary -- structural families (correspondence, event/trajectory, lineage) survive object/world remapping when the world relation is preserved despite altered surface features, while epistemic and regulatory weights vary strongly with uncertainty, need, goal, physiology and task regime at fixed structure; AND the absorbed candidates' failure signatures collapse onto the five reduced signatures of section 15 rather than staying fourteen-way distinct; AND the merge passes GOV-CONTRACT-3's three requirements (lower total cost, discriminating predictions preserved, transfer improved). The prereg's pre-results table already carries two rows that are this claim's family-C and field-E predictions ('factorial status axes transfer better than coarse mode labels'; 'viability basis transfers better than signed value') -- reuse that wording.
FALSIFYING, four extracted routes: (i) structural and weighting variables cannot be dissociated by the crossed design (the thought's own refutation: the 3 + 2 model is wrong or too simple); (ii) a held-out residue survives -- intervention/control (passive prediction preserved with selective loss of action-effect learning and controllability attribution) or expected-absence (cannot represent omitted expected events despite intact raw surprise) -- so the families do not absorb CCI-004 / CCI-011; (iii) the reduction succeeds only by decoder inflation (falsifier 9, caught by GOV-CONTRACT-3); (iv) the fourteen candidates' failure signatures remain mutually distinguishable under nuisance-controlled perturbation (the merges destroy discriminating predictions).
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional (NOT ceiling): needs a rate-constrained multi-consumer bottleneck (no KL/variational, quantisation, noise-injection, sparsity or rate regularisation anywhere in ree_core) and a generative-lineage structure (V3 has only the binary Trajectory.hypothesis_tag with injector-only source metadata; translation confidence has zero substrate representation).

MECH-558.subject: selection.independence_aware_convergence_topology
MECH-558.title: Vote count is not evidence count -- independence-aware convergence over heterogeneous evaluators: when several partly independent evaluators favour the same candidate, the epistemic weight of that agreement depends on how many EFFECTIVELY INDEPENDENT evidential routes produced it, and a bounded system that retains a COARSE representation of its evaluators' dependency TOPOLOGY -- which routes share upstream representation, training signal, ancestry, or residual error -- recovers materially more of the exact joint-inference answer than either (a) a marginal-reliability-only combiner, which counts one duplicated reason N times, or (b) a single global dependence scalar, which cannot separate a correlated coalition plus genuinely independent specialists from uniform moderate dependence. The claimed object is a TOPOLOGY, not a scalar convergence score: at minimum who supports what, how reliable each route is in the current domain, which routes share ancestry or error, which credible routes remain independent, and what structured dissent survives. Three bindings keep this from becoming a new scalar ruler. (1) CEILING BINDING: exact Bayesian aggregation over the true joint dependency model remains the normative ceiling and this claim explicitly does NOT assert that any convergence heuristic beats it -- the assertion is bounded-resource COMPRESSION, that coarse topology approaches the exact decision and confidence at materially lower structural cost and degrades gracefully when dependency estimates are stale or wrong. (2) NON-REPLACEMENT BINDING: independence correction is additive to, never a substitute for, evaluator reliability/relevance weighting and protected-veto structure -- independence-aware convergence is not majority rule and must not become more majority-dominated than a reliability baseline. (3) NON-TAUTOLOGY BINDING: a convergence quantity must be validated by an INDEPENDENT consequence (held-out decision accuracy, calibration, robustness under evaluator dropout or distribution shift), never by a transformation that forces agreement -- normalising every evaluator to equal scale and then observing equal contribution is not evidence.
MECH-558.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (three parts): (P1) at least TWO evaluator routes simultaneously LIVE and CONSEQUENTIAL -- computed and consumed by a decision, not default-OFF flags or diagnostic-only counters (use_loop_segregation, use_loop_local_eligibility_traces, use_model_disagreement_curiosity, use_coalition_controller all default False; curiosity_learning_progress_source defaults broadcast); (P2) the routes can DISAGREE in the measured window -- a recorded non-zero loop_cross_loop_winner_disagreement rate or equivalent; (P3) the dependency structure is manipulable or estimable WITHOUT the outcome label (a convergence metric validated against a dependency estimate derived from the answer is the tautology the E3 commensurability work already caught).
CONFIRMING: two states matched on aggregate weighted confidence but differing in support topology get materially different confidence from an independence-corrected estimator, in the direction of the true accuracy difference, calibrated at both endpoints within a preregistered bound, beaten only by exact joint Bayes -- already met in the frozen synthetic world (assay 001: independent-vs-copied unanimity gap 0.28420 vs reliability-only delta 0.00037; assay 002: Brier 0.18594 / 0.16697 / 0.15227 / 0.15073 for reliability-only / global N_eff / cluster-aware / exact Bayes) and NOT confirmed for REE until the same separation is shown over REE's own channels (synthetic results are not claim evidence; attachment is a governance decision).
FALSIFYING: (a) correct reliability and covariance weighting explains every benefit with no separate meta-observable (hub falsifier 2); (b) the benefit disappears once correlated evaluators are collapsed into one effective source (hub falsifier 3); (c) independence cannot be estimated cheaply enough for the correction to be affordable; (d) a single dissenting high-reliability channel must routinely override consensus, making aggregate convergence behaviourally irrelevant (hub falsifier 5); (e) in REE no evaluator population disagrees often enough for a topology to be non-degenerate.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional -- no dependency-corrected quantity exists in ree_core. Qualification flagged for /governance routing, not decided here: a SHADOW-ONLY diagnostic (log existing loop_cross_loop_winner_disagreement, _loop_voted, model_disagreement_range and the epistemic-deficit disagreement input against later outcomes, no causal role) is arguably (a) testable now.

MECH-559.subject: drive.evidence_dependency_versus_downstream_leverage
MECH-559.title: Evidence-dependency topology and downstream-leverage topology are SEPARATE, state-conditioned variables and conflating them misallocates information seeking: "how many genuinely independent reasons do I currently hold" (the evidence-source dependency graph) and "how many distinct consequential consumers would change if this uncertainty were resolved" (the downstream-leverage graph) are different relations over the same subsystems, so a policy that uses either as a proxy for the other allocates queries, rollouts or experiments badly -- five statistically independent routes can all update one downstream decision, and one correlated cluster can control several genuinely distinct consequences. Four bindings. (1) STRUCTURED DIVERGENCE IS NOT INFORMATION VALUE: disagreement earns allocation weight only after multiplication by expected REDUCIBILITY and decision CONSEQUENCE and correction for how much of the current evidence is genuinely independent; raw disagreement is attracted to irreducible noise and to broken or out-of-domain evaluators, and a divergence signal must separate useful, irreducible and broken-view divergence. (2) COMPETENCE IS DOMAIN-INDEXED: an evaluator must not carry one global trust weight when its competence depends on the current representational or behavioural domain. (3) UNCERTAIN PROVENANCE MUST BE REPRESENTED AS UNCERTAIN: treating noisy ancestry metadata as categorical dependency labels degrades worse than carrying soft dependency probabilities, and the soft form wins by making less COSTLY errors rather than by hitting the optimum more often. (4) BOTH GRAPHS ARE STATE-CONDITIONED: two routes redundant in one context can be independent in another, and two named downstream consumers can be functionally redundant in one state and distinct in another, so a static average relation graph is insufficient. As in MECH-558, exact value-of-information over the true joint model is the ceiling and is not contested.
MECH-559.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (P1) the query/allocation choice is REAL -- at least two competing unresolved targets whose resolution has different consequence; (P2) the two graphs are genuinely ANTI-ALIGNED in at least one measured cell (assay 004's forced pair: five independent reasons at leverage 1 vs five copies at leverage 8) -- if evidence independence and downstream leverage covary, a conflated policy scores correctly for the wrong reason; (P3) a pure-noise query channel is present so a selector attracted to irreducible disagreement is visibly punished.
CONFIRMING: a policy representing the two graphs separately achieves materially lower allocation regret than one using either as a proxy for the other, does not select the irreducible-noise channel, and degrades gracefully under missing or wrong provenance when provenance is carried as a probability not a label -- met synthetically (assay 003 regret 0.00490 vs 0.01964, noise selection 0.005% vs 20.24%; assay 004 oracle-following 100% factorised vs 16.82% conflated; assay 005 93.24% of oracle utility at 50% missing / 20% wrong provenance; assay 006 dynamic regret 0.01107 vs static 0.04969); not confirmed for REE until shown over REE-native baselines.
FALSIFYING: (a) structured disagreement fails to predict information value above ordinary uncertainty, expected information gain or learning progress -- MECH-314b, MECH-314c and MECH-482 are the REE-native baselines to beat; (b) the factorisation's advantage disappears as soon as provenance or leverage is imperfect; (c) estimating dependency and impact relations costs more compute than the decisions they improve (meta-control explosion); (d) in REE cross-model leverage is unmeasurable because nothing represents which consumers an unresolved uncertainty would update.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional -- the leverage half is the harder gap (no representation of downstream consumers in ree_core); same shadow-diagnostic qualification as MECH-558.

MECH-560.subject: architecture.routing_selectivity_over_transfer_volume
MECH-560.title: Governed selectivity beats transfer volume: competent integrated behaviour in REE tracks the SELECTIVITY, STABILITY, REPERTOIRE and causal TIMING of directed influence between engines, not the AMOUNT of inter-engine information transferred -- so the decisive experimental signature is a DISSOCIATION at matched traffic, in which endpoint-local content remains decodable, endpoint-local competence remains intact, total inter-module transfer is matched or INCREASED, and integrated behaviour nonetheless degrades in proportion to lost directional selectivity, route stability or motif repertoire. Three degradation modes are predicted to be distinguishable rather than one: FLATTENING (all channels similarly permissive, high volume, no selectivity), DOMINATION (one slow global mode monopolises routing authority, high coherence, low repertoire) and FRAGMENTATION (routes form but do not persist long enough to complete a multi-step transfer; local decodability intact, long-horizon coordination poor). PRIMARY FALSIFIER: if performance is fully explained by total transmitted activity or message count, and route selectivity adds nothing once traffic is matched, this claim is refuted and no routing layer is warranted. SECOND FALSIFIER: if total transfer always FALLS whenever behaviour falls, the high-traffic/low-tuning regime does not exist in REE and the claim's discriminating signature is unreachable.
MECH-560.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (a) a measurable, non-constant directed-influence statistic over at least THREE real producer-consumer interfaces with live variance across arms and seeds; (b) a constrained-realisation surrogate null per Q-081 -- preserving each stream's tick grid, marginal distribution and within-stream autocorrelation, destroying only the between-stream relation -- VALIDATED before it adjudicates anything by killing a deliberately artefactual statistic and sparing a deliberately injected real one; (c) a demonstrated ability to vary total transfer and selectivity independently (the claim is a dissociation and is vacuous if the two cannot be dissociated in this substrate). Verified absent 2026-09-15: no directed-influence estimator exists anywhere in ree-v3, and Q-081's own telemetry-audit precondition is unanswered (chip-20260915-q081-telemetry-audit-spike).
CONFIRMING: high-competence episodes show more selective and more stable sequences of directed influence than matched low-competence episodes at matched total activity and matched traffic; AND a matched-traffic lesion (gain flattening, edge permutation, or timing permutation at preserved gain marginals) degrades integrated behaviour while endpoint-local decodability and competence are unchanged and total inter-module transfer is matched or higher; the three degradation modes produce distinguishable signatures rather than one.
FALSIFYING: performance is fully explained by total transmitted activity or message count once matched (F1); a one-dimensional global arousal/gain scalar explains the whole effect (F3 -- SD-037's override_signal IS such a scalar and already exists, so this rival is not hypothetical); total transfer always falls whenever behaviour falls (the high-traffic / low-tuning regime does not occur in REE); or the apparent directional structure survives only estimators that are functions of the configured update rates (Q-081's a-priori filter).
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional, as ONE claim with a recorded SPLIT: the observational leg (selectivity/stability over recorded trajectories) becomes (a) testable the moment a directed-influence estimator is written -- complicated (buildable), no ree_core change -- while the matched-traffic lesion leg needs an experiment-layer inter-engine gain overlay that does not exist and stays substrate_conditional. /governance may split the claim if the observational leg lands first.

MECH-561.subject: representation.phase_conditioned_communication_subspace
MECH-561.title: Phase as an addressing coordinate: the receiver-potent communication subspace between two REE subsystems is indexed by an ENDOGENOUS CYCLIC coordinate that belongs to neither endpoint -- S_comm(A -> B | phi, c) rather than S_comm(A -> B) -- so a sender dimension can lie INSIDE the receiver-potent subspace at one phase and OUTSIDE it at another with no change whatever in the sender's representation, and information can be continuously decodable from the sender while its downstream causal effect varies systematically with phi. COROLLARY, which is the sharper and more falsifiable half: TEMPORAL separability can substitute for GEOMETRIC separability, so two concurrently represented streams need not be near-orthogonal in population geometry if they become receiver-effective at different temporal addresses -- predicting a measurable trade-off in which the principal angle between two stream subspaces and their phase-conditioned overlap with S_comm move in opposite directions while behavioural intrusion stays flat. FOUR-CELL VERDICT GRID, pre-registered: GEOMETRY-ONLY (angle changes, phase conditioning adds nothing) / TIMING-ONLY (geometry flat, causal impact alternates with phase) / JOINT (both reorganise and jointly predict intrusion) / NULL (neither beats a static consumer model at matched complexity). FALSIFIERS: a static subspace explains receiver activity and behaviour as well as any phase-conditioned model at matched complexity; a global scalar gain explains it without receiver-specific temporal structure; RANDOM temporal labels do as well as the endogenous coordinate; or the dependence disappears after controlling for ordinary task context, action identity, arousal, or trivial periodicity in environment sampling.
MECH-561.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (a) the chosen phase coordinate phi must have live variance and must NOT be a deterministic function of the configured update rates (Q-081's a-priori filter) -- _e3_phase_step qualifies because MECH-091's salient-event reset makes it event-driven; a raw multi-rate tick index does not and is excluded; (b) breath_period > 0 if the BreathOscillator (MECH-108) is the chosen phi, since it defaults OFF and historical trajectories contain no breath phase; (c) enough rows per phase bin to fit a rank-selected RRR without the bin count itself driving the principal angles -- a bin-count sweep is required; (d) a sender measured to contain the content (rawfield25; trained z_world inadmissible per V3-EXQ-1010). All four are satisfiable today. SEQUENCING (part of the precondition): a single waking interface metric must have demonstrated range and stability at one locus first -- the diagnostic's cheapness is the trap the 2026-09-07 intake named.
CONFIRMING: principal angles between phase-conditioned subspaces exceed the surrogate null; a phase-conditioned model beats a static subspace on held-out receiver prediction at MATCHED complexity; the downstream causal effect of a fixed sender direction varies with phi while the sender's decodability does not; AND a receiver-state permutation run alongside the phase permutation shows the phase permutation INDEPENDENTLY destroys the gain (otherwise MECH-547 owns the result).
FALSIFYING (the phase note's own eight, plus one): a static subspace explains receiver activity and behaviour as well at matched complexity; a global scalar gain explains it without receiver-specific temporal structure; random temporal labels perform as well as the endogenous coordinate; phase predicts correlation but not causal susceptibility; the effect disappears after controlling for task context, action identity or arousal; the periodicity is traceable to environment sampling; the conditioned model wins only by added capacity; disrupting the hypothesised read window leaves behaviour unchanged; or MECH-466's event-relative index outperforms any cyclic phi (relocates the finding to MECH-466 rather than refuting the governance idea).
Disposition 2026-09-15: (a) testable now on the V3 substrate, OBSERVATIONALLY -- interface_probe.py and the clock.py coordinates both exist; proposal EXP-1404 minted; the causal lesion ladder remains substrate_conditional. Merge-adjacency with MECH-547 recorded: if kept separate, the shared experiment MUST run the receiver-state and phase permutations together.

MECH-562.subject: representation.receiver_local_self_healing_readout_adaptation
MECH-562.title: Receiver-local self-healing is the standing rival to every cross-system interface-repair result: a consumer can restore its use of a drifting sender WITHOUT any episodic pair identity, any cross-system label, or any offline replay, by adjusting afferent weights from presynaptic sender activity and its own postsynaptic output under homeostatic error against fixed pre-drift output statistics -- and because this produces the SAME observable as interface repair (downstream performance restored despite upstream change), any REE result attributing a rescue to correctly paired replay must beat a faithful implementation of it at a matched update budget. Its preconditions are its predictions, and they are what make it falsifiable rather than a residual explanation: it needs redundant smooth tuning that continues to tile the represented variable, incremental rather than abrupt change, plasticity at least as fast as drift, and enough sampling or reactivation to estimate the correlations and output statistics -- so its advantage is a function of the DRIFT-RATE-TO-MAINTENANCE-INTERVAL RATIO, and an unswept timescale silently chooses the winner. Three regimes weaken it and are where a genuine pairing effect should be sought: large infrequent drift, drift of the receiver's own scaffold or decoder, and continuous symmetries permitting an unanchored global rotation. Its more durable variants -- population response normalisation, and a stable recurrent predictive model supplying covariance structure -- are NOT free local plasticity: they assume a receiver scaffold that is fixed or changes far more slowly than the feed-forward representation, and that assumption is itself a testable architectural commitment, not a background condition.
MECH-562.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the sender representation must actually DRIFT in directions the receiver reads, and the receiver must have plasticity ENABLED at its afferents. Degenerate under either of two conditions, both live in REE 2026-09-15: (i) drift confined to the receiver-null subspace, where a fixed readout works and no adaptation is exercised; (ii) a frozen consumer -- every adapter in the V3-EXQ-978 -> 1023 lineage is fitted-then-frozen, so on that lineage this mechanism has never been exercised once.
CONFIRMING: a receiver running ONLY the label-free local rule -- presynaptic sender activity, its own postsynaptic output, homeostatic error against fixed pre-drift output mean and variance, error-gated decay -- recovers held-out receiver-dependent use after a VERIFIED interface lesion (INV-110 Gate 0), at a matched update budget, with no episodic pair identity available to it. Stronger: recovery tracks the drift-rate-to-maintenance-interval ratio as predicted, degrading when maintenance is infrequent relative to drift.
FALSIFYING: the local rule fails to recover use under conditions its own preconditions declare favourable -- smooth redundant tuning, incremental drift, plasticity faster than drift, ample sampling -- while a correctly-paired arm at the same update budget recovers. That is simultaneously the CONFIRMING result for MECH-540's interface-repair reading, which is why the two claims must be run as arms of ONE design (INV-110's estimand), never separately.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional (NOT ceiling: no readout-adaptation rule of this shape exists in ree_core, interface_probe is pure and stateless by design, zero non-degenerate attempts are possible today). Build note: arm F is specified to implementation level (supplement section 6.4; assay spec section 3.3) and is complicated (buildable) at the EXPERIMENT layer -- the assay spec's section 4.4 forbids putting it in ree_core.

MECH-563.subject: temporal.subjective_now_convergence_point
MECH-563.title: Subjective now is the temporal convergence point of E1 perceptual prediction and hippocampal trajectory rollout, not the moment of raw sensory arrival: the convergence sits AHEAD of real-time input (supplying the motor-execution buffer), plan origins are anchored where the two streams first agree, and backward hippocampal rollouts that converge on that point constitute retroactive causal inference over candidate pasts.
MECH-563.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: an agent whose E1 prediction and hippocampal rollout are both live at the same tick and can be compared on a shared latent, with an instrumented lag between sensory arrival and the moment a committed action is anchored. V3 has E1, E3 and hippocampal rollout active but no convergence-detection instrumentation between the E1 prediction and the rollout proposal, so the precondition is buildable but not met today.
CONFIRMING: the tick at which the E1 prediction and the rollout proposal first agree (within a stated tolerance) precedes sensory arrival by a stable positive lead, plan origins cluster at that tick rather than at arrival, and shifting the lead (by delaying perception or shortening rollout) shifts action-anchoring by the same amount.
FALSIFYING: action anchoring tracks raw sensory arrival regardless of when the two streams agree, or the two streams never converge ahead of arrival in a substrate where both are demonstrably live -- subjective now is then not constructed at a convergence point and this entry should be withdrawn in favour of MECH-021 alone.
Disposition 2026-09-16: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional; the convergence-detection diagnostic is a plausibly V3-buildable instrument (see notes) -- flagged for /governance routing, NOT decided here.

MECH-564.subject: commitment.symbolic_commit_updates_arbitration
MECH-564.title: Verbal or symbolic representation of an undifferentiated affective action-pressure is itself a low-risk PARTIAL commit: it discharges the pressure into a cheap committed trajectory, and when that symbolic commit produces prediction mismatch (the articulated expectation fails) or social witnessing (another agent responds to it), the mismatch updates future trajectory-arbitration scoring for the affect's full-cost action alternatives -- which is the mechanism by which articulating an urge changes what the agent later does.
MECH-564.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: an agent with a symbolic (verbal or imagined-rehearsal) commit channel whose cost is measurably lower than embodied commitment, plus an instrumented prediction-mismatch signal on that channel and, for the social leg, a second agent whose response is observable. V3 has no symbolic commit channel and no second agent, so zero non-degenerate attempts are possible today.
CONFIRMING: after a symbolic commit that produces mismatch (or witnessing), the arbitration scores of the pressure's embodied alternatives shift in the direction of the mismatch, and subsequent embodied choice changes accordingly; a matched symbolic commit that produces no mismatch leaves the scores unchanged (the MECH-565 contrast).
FALSIFYING: arbitration scores for the embodied alternatives change identically whether or not the symbolic commit produced mismatch or witnessing, or do not change at all after a mismatch-producing symbolic commit -- symbolic articulation is then not an arbitration-updating commit and this entry should be withdrawn.
Disposition 2026-09-16: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional (requires symbolic/language plus social-witnessing substrate).

MECH-565.subject: commitment.rumination_as_mismatchless_loop
MECH-565.title: Rumination is a mismatchless symbolic-commit loop: repeated symbolic commits (verbal or imagined rehearsal of an affective pressure) that generate NO prediction mismatch and NO social witnessing fail to re-rank the candidate set, so the same trajectory is re-proposed and re-committed symbolically while arbitration never updates -- a perseveration signature distinct from over-persistence of an EMBODIED commitment, and the discriminator between therapeutic articulation and rumination is whether a symbolic commit changes subsequent arbitration scores.
MECH-565.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the same substrate as MECH-564 (a symbolic commit channel with an instrumented mismatch signal), plus a way to run repeated symbolic commits of one trajectory with mismatch either present or withheld. Not available in V3.
CONFIRMING: under withheld mismatch, repeated symbolic commits leave the candidate ranking unchanged and the same trajectory is re-proposed on every cycle (perseveration), while the identical loop with mismatch injected re-ranks the set and the re-proposal rate falls -- and the embodied-latch signature (MECH-536) is absent, i.e. no post-commit hysteresis is engaged.
FALSIFYING: repeated mismatch-free symbolic commits still re-rank the candidate set (something other than mismatch or witnessing updates arbitration), or the perseveration observed is fully explained by the embodied persistence latch with the symbolic channel contributing nothing -- rumination is then not a distinct symbolic failure mode and this entry should be withdrawn.
Disposition 2026-09-16: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional. The intake flags a possibly V3-tractable PROXY (residue plus prediction-mismatch instrumentation on existing commits) -- flagged for /governance, NOT built or queued here.

MECH-566.subject: zworld_adequacy.objective_consumer_transfer_geometry
MECH-566.title: objective_consumer_transfer_blocked_by_readout_reparameterisation_invariance. SD-106's preservation term is ||W f(x) - x||^2 / var with W a FREELY-TRAINED linear decoder optimised jointly with the encoder (ree-v3 ree_core/latent/zworld_p0.py:556-558, head_params joined to the same Adam). That loss is EXACTLY invariant to the general linear group acting on the 32-dim code: for any invertible A, the pair (A.f, W.A^-1) attains an identical loss. The objective therefore cannot distinguish two codes in the same GL(32) orbit and cannot prefer a well-conditioned representative over an arbitrarily ill-conditioned one. The consumer -- a fixed-capacity MLP trained by SGD on the FROZEN code -- is NOT invariant to A: its reachable solutions and sample efficiency depend on the code's spectrum. Transfer therefore fails not because information is missing but because the objective is structurally blind to the property that governs whether the consumer can use it. The substrate's own comment cites Baldi & Hornik (1989) as its anchor ('with a linear decoder the MSE optimum IS the principal subspace') -- and that theorem yields the principal SUBSPACE only up to an arbitrary invertible transformation, never the principal COMPONENTS. PCA-32 is the canonical orthonormal eigenvalue-ordered representative of that same orbit, which is why it clears the bar 3/3 at matched reconstruction (world_obs R^2 0.9984 vs SD-106's 0.9974) while SD-106 falls 0.1227 short at the consumer. The conditioning terms REE does carry bound the orbit only partially: the VICReg variance term is a ONE-SIDED floor, mean relu(gamma - std_j), with no cap on anisotropy above the floor, and the covariance term decorrelates without equalising, so the code's condition number is unconstrained.
MECH-566.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The reconditioning comparison must be run against a baseline that is NOT already per-component standardised, or the standardisation member of the family is confounded with its own control; and preservation R^2 must be verified unchanged under the transform, since the whole argument rests on the transform being an element of the group the objective is invariant to.
CONFIRMING: A member of the fixed invertible family raises held-out oracle-action agreement by >= 0.05 on a seed majority against an unstandardised baseline while preservation R^2 is verified unchanged, and the spectral readout shows SD-106 markedly more anisotropic than PCA-32 at matched R^2. Manipulation: Apply fixed invertible linear reconditioning members (ZCA whitening, per-component standardisation) to the FROZEN code before the consumer, against a raw unstandardised baseline so each member is separable; pair it with a direct spectral comparison of the two codes. Control: The PCA-32 anchor at matched reconstruction is the upper reference band (0.8578-0.8771) and the raw unstandardised frozen code the lower one; a nonlinear reader arm separates a conditioning deficit from a nonlinear warp, which the linear-only design could not. Required event: A frozen SD-106-trained z_world code and its matched PCA-32 anchor at comparable world_obs reconstruction (0.9974 versus 0.9984), with an oracle-action consumer trained on each. DV: Held-out oracle_action_agreement under each transform against the raw baseline (confirm >= 0.05), plus the currently unmeasured supporting readout (a): singular-value spectrum, condition number and participation ratio of the SD-106 code versus PCA-32 at matched R^2, and the linear-versus-nonlinear reader gap on each code.
FALSIFYING: No member of the family moves held-out agreement by >= 0.02 against an unstandardised baseline while train agreement and fit speed do improve (the 1065 signature), and the condition numbers come back comparable to PCA-32 -- conditioning is then exonerated and the shortfall routes to content or nonlinear warp, which is where MECH-567 already points. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The driver and artifacts exist: experiments/v3_exq_1065_sd106_subspace_overlap_mech566_recondition.py already applies invertible transforms (invertibility 1.05e-9, condition number 13.4), verifies they reach the decoder, and reports train and held-out agreement per seed. What it has never recorded is readout (a), the spectral comparison, which is the cheap pre-check the claim itself nominated. Consumer / boundary: The seam between the P0a objective and the frozen-code consumer -- the objective's GL(32) invariance versus the consumer's sensitivity to the code's spectrum -- not the encoder's information content. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0387, V3-EXQ-1065, EXP-0250, MECH-567, SD-106.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); Not substrate: the as-written falsifier family is partly degenerate against its own control, because one member IS the baseline V3-EXQ-1065 compared to. A re-run against an unstandardised baseline plus the never-measured spectral readout is runnable today with the existing driver and frozen codes, and would separate the exonerating from the confounded reading. Secondary classes: R0. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The registered falsifier was executed by V3-EXQ-1065 (2026-09-19) and returned a determinate FALSIFY 3/3 on its ZCA member, and the confirmed autopsy records that the other member of the registered family -- per-component standardisation -- IS the baseline it was compared against, so the family as written cannot discriminate. The same run fired supporting readout (b) with a larger gap than the claim predicted (converged linear probe trails PCA-32 by 0.231 against a named ~0.14) and measured a nonlinear reader recovering 6-13x more from the SD-106 code, which re-routes the residual from conditioning to content-or-warp. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).
