MECH-567.subject: zworld_adequacy.consumer_target_in_encoder_objective
MECH-567.title: encoder_objective_must_carry_the_consumers_target / auxiliary_task_head_transfer. An encoder objective transfers to an action consumer only to the extent the objective itself contains a term whose target is the consumer's target, or an improvement on it. Task-agnostic variance preservation contains no such term, so its gradient is not systematically aligned with what the consumer reads and additional budget moves the encoder along directions the consumer does not use. MuZero is the limit case: the representation function receives gradients ONLY from policy, value and reward heads, and the paper explicitly refuses any requirement that the hidden state reconstruct the observation or match the true environment state. The ENABLING CONDITION, which is easy to miss and is load-bearing, is that MuZero's policy target is the MCTS-IMPROVED search policy rather than the network's own prior: an encoder trained toward a consumer's CURRENT output has a degenerate self-agreement fixed point, so 'train the encoder through its consumer' is incomplete without a policy-improvement operator. DreamerV3 is the affordable form and REE's correct template: task-relevant supervision enters the representation objective as AUXILIARY HEADS (reward and continue) on the same latent as the decoder at beta_pred = 1.0, while actor and critic gradients are STOPPED at the model state -- so the consumer's TARGET reaches the encoder and the consumer's GRADIENT does not. CORRECTION OF RECORD: the CDQ-010 row's premise that DreamerV3 carries actor/value gradients into the latent is wrong in the gradient sense, and that correction is the mechanism, because it is what lets a preservation objective transfer without any single consumer owning a SHARED latent.
MECH-567.what_would_answer: CONFIRMING: adding an oracle-action (or reward/RPE) cross-entropy head on the same latent during P0a, at a weight retaining non-trivial gradient share, raises held-out oracle_action_agreement toward the 0.85 bar WHILE preservation R^2 is held at or below its V3-EXQ-1023a value of 0.8501 -- i.e. transfer improves without being bought with more preservation. FALSIFYING: agreement stays in the 0.72-0.74 band even with a well-trained auxiliary action head (the head's own train and held-out accuracy verified high, so the head is not simply untrained); the latent then cannot carry the consumer's target however it is supervised, and the failure routes upstream to encoder capacity or observation content instead of here. MANDATORY CO-MEASUREMENT, not optional: the grounding heads' held-out lift must be reported alongside the DV in any arm, because z_world is a SHARED latent -- SD-106's own note lists SD-015, ARC-030, MECH-117, the EXQ-085h..o cluster, MECH-457 and ARC-065 as consumers -- and an arm that buys the acceptance DV while grounding falls has demonstrated the Poort-2015 entanglement cost, not a win. DEGENERACY PRE-CHECK if the co-train route is taken instead of the auxiliary-head route: REE already owns config.actor_critic_cotrain_encoder (the co-shaping lever, exercised at V3-EXQ-742/752/772/780/788 but never against this DV), and REE has NO policy-improvement operator, so a co-train arm is the predicted degenerate case -- log latent participation ratio under co-training before reading its DV.

MECH-568.subject: zworld_adequacy.objective_term_balance
MECH-568.title: task_term_gradient_share_must_be_floored_not_weighted. Even when a task-aligned term is present in an encoder objective, transfer is gated by whether that term retains a non-trivial share of the GRADIENT against the preservation term; under fixed relative weights and no floor, raising the preservation weight monotonically starves it. REE has the crowding curve already measured on SD-106's own landing: mean held-out grounding lift 0.5702 (shipped) -> 0.4313 (w=50) -> 0.4064 (w=200, the arm V3-EXQ-1023a ran) -> 0.3982 (w=500), recorded there as a COST and never read as a mechanism. DreamerV3's corrective is a FLOOR rather than a weight: free bits, L = max(1, KL), contributes zero gradient below 1 nat, and the stated failure it prevents is exactly this one -- the regulariser wins, the code degenerates, the latent stops carrying task-relevant distinctions and 'the actor starves because the actor sees only the latent'. MuZero's analogue is per-head loss scaling by 1/K plus a 1/2 gradient scale at the dynamics entry. The general form this claim asserts: the protected quantity is the task term's gradient share, and it must be enforced by a SATURATING floor on the competing term, because a weight ratio must be re-tuned whenever anything else in the objective changes whereas a floor does not.
MECH-568.what_would_answer: CONFIRMING: at FIXED preservation weight, making the preservation term contribute no gradient once its normalised fraction-of-variance-unexplained is below a target (the free-bits form) raises held-out oracle_action_agreement while preservation R^2 stays within noise of that floored target. FALSIFYING: agreement is flat in the grounding/task terms' measured GRADIENT share across the w=50/200/500 sweep already run -- crowding is then real but is not the transfer-limiting step, and this claim falls while MECH-566 and MECH-567 are untouched. PREREQUISITE INSTRUMENT, and this claim must not be adjudicated without it: per-term gradient-NORM shares logged at the P0a operating point. The recorded trained-state figures -- variance hinge 80.3%, covariance 9.3%, four grounding CE heads 9.5%, reconstruction 0.80% -- are LOSS shares and do NOT license a gradient-share conclusion, because a term can hold a large loss share while contributing little gradient (a hinge sitting near its kink is exactly this case, and the variance term IS a hinge). Measuring that is cheap, requires no substrate change, and is the honest first step; if the grounding heads already hold a large gradient share, this claim is weakened before anything is built.

MECH-569.subject: social.fast_empathy_bootstraps_cognitive_empathy
MECH-569.title: Fast empathy BOOTSTRAPS cognitive empathy: the fast affective route is the developmental scaffold from which the slower mentalizing route differentiates, so the two are representationally dissociable in maturity while both remain live. Adult dissociation between self-pain and vicarious-pain codes is the PREDICTED endpoint of this bootstrapping, not evidence against ARC-094's stream-binding.
MECH-569.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Requires MECH-405's binding mechanism to exist (there must be a fast
affective route to scaffold FROM) plus a genuine developmental/training trajectory -- not a single
fixed-capacity agent -- across which the slower mentalizing route's representations can be tracked
over time. Not present in ree_core today (same substrate gap as MECH-405/408, verified 2026-09-25).

CONFIRMING: across a developmental trajectory, (i) the fast affective route (MECH-405) comes online
first, and (ii) the slower mentalizing route's representations start highly overlapping with the
affective route's and progressively DISSOCIATE with training/maturation, ending in the adult-like
dissociation Krishnan et al. 2016 report for humans (somatic and vicarious multivariate patterns
cross-predict at chance against ~100% within-condition) -- the mature dissociation is the PREDICTED
ENDPOINT of scaffolding, not evidence against a shared origin.

FALSIFYING (claim's own words, quoted verbatim): "developmental or lesion evidence that cognitive
empathy can be acquired without the fast affective route ever coming online, or that the two mature
independently." In REE terms: ablating MECH-405's binding mechanism during training without
impairing the later-developing mentalizing route's eventual competence would falsify the scaffolding
relation.

NOTES (claim's own caveat, preserved): current human literature does NOT test this -- vicarious-pain
paradigms using images/video with processing time plausibly probe the slow cognitive route only, so
the fast route is largely unmeasured in that corpus. Do not read the existing lit entries (5 via
MECH-405, 2 via MECH-569 itself, all "plausible_unproven") as having tested the scaffolding relation
-- they evidence only the ADULT endpoint the claim predicts. Distinguish from MECH-405 (states the
mechanism, no developmental commitment) and from ARC-094 (the architectural no-scalar prohibition,
reworded 2026-09-23, GFLAG-0343, to the same developmental/scaffolding reading this claim shares --
do not treat the two as redundant; ARC-094 is the negative structural commitment, MECH-569 is the
positive developmental-order hypothesis, per ARC-094's own notes).

UNBLOCKS WHEN: MECH-405's binding substrate exists AND a training regime spans the relevant
developmental window (self -> object -> other, ARC-059) long enough to observe route
differentiation. DO NOT queue a V3 experiment.

MECH-570.subject: social.affect_self_access_socially_acquired
MECH-570.title: The SELF stage of self -> object -> other is not primitive at the level of self-knowledge: primitive affect states exist from the outset, but the agent's ACCESS to (representation of) its own affect is socially acquired, via contingency detection over a caregiver's 'marked' reflections of it -- so ARC-059's ordering holds at the substrate level while inverting at the level of affect self-access.
MECH-570.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires the same V5 social/mirror substrate as ARC-094 (unbuilt,
see above) PLUS an operationalised "marked mirroring" contingency-detection mechanism. The
claim's own caveat states this is NOT yet operationalised to a level a substrate could
implement -- so the precondition is a missing design step, not only a missing training run, and
is owed before this claim can be promoted past candidate regardless of substrate status.

CONFIRMING: an agent whose own-affect representation is built via social contingency-detection
(caregiver-"marked" reflection, once operationalised) shows lower/absent own-affect
routability into other-directed inference PRIOR to that acquisition step, and routability
comparable to a hand-wired-affect baseline AFTER it -- i.e. the acquisition step is load-bearing
for routability, not decorative.

FALSIFYING (quoted from the claim's own notes): "an agent (or an organism) that demonstrably
routes own-affect into other-directed inference with no prior social-mirroring history." A
failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ARC-047-class V5 social substrate, unbuilt (see ARC-094
above). Additionally, and specific to this claim: the "marked" mirroring mechanism itself has
no operationalisation proposal anywhere in the corpus yet -- an extra, claim-specific gap beyond
the shared substrate blocker.

CAVEAT (from the claim's own notes, restated): source is a single theoretical paper in a
psychoanalytic venue (Gergely & Watson 1996); the contingency-detection half is far better
evidenced than the marked-mirroring half.

MECH-571.subject: social.object_term_is_route_specific
MECH-571.title: The OBJECT term in self -> object -> other is ROUTE-SPECIFIC, not universal: an object is constitutive of the mirror / action-understanding route (the mapping fires only when an inferable object-goal is present) but absent from the bodily-correspondence route (cross-modal self-other equivalence requires no object) -- so REE must not specify a single obligatory self -> object -> other pipeline.
MECH-571.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires implementing BOTH candidate routes in the same V5
substrate so they can be contrasted directly -- the mirror/action-understanding route
(constitutively requiring an inferable object-goal) and the bodily-correspondence route
(requiring none). Today neither route exists; this is a strictly heavier substrate bar than
ARC-094/MECH-570/MECH-129/MECH-409, which each need only one mechanism built.

CONFIRMING: the mirror/action-understanding route's binding signal is present when an
inferable object-goal is available and silent or degraded when withheld (structurally
replicating the Umilta et al. 2001 hidden-object single-unit contrast), while the
bodily-correspondence route's binding signal is unaffected by object presence or absence.

FALSIFYING (quoted from the claim's own notes): "evidence that the bodily-correspondence
route is itself object-mediated under test (a hidden-object control on cross-modal matching),
or that the two routes share a single binding substrate." A failure under unmet preconditions
is not evidence against the claim.

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ARC-047-class V5 social substrate, unbuilt (see ARC-094
above), and specifically TWO distinct binding-route implementations, neither of which exists.

CAVEAT (from the claim's own notes, restated): the FOR-object evidence (Umilta et al. 2001) is
macaque premotor cortex and ACTION understanding, not human affective empathy -- two
inferential transfers from this claim's actual (fast affective empathy) domain; a reason to
look, not a settled analogy.

MECH-572.subject: sleep.consolidation_step_to_residual_ratio
MECH-572.title:
across_sleep_readout_sign_governed_by_consolidation_step_to_residual_ratio. A consolidation pass
measurably improves a frozen held-out readout only when the parameter displacement the pass imposes
is SMALL relative to the residual error it is reducing. REE's consolidator violates this by
construction: CrossModuleConsolidator.consolidate() builds a FRESH torch.optim.Adam per call
("built fresh each call so the pass owns no persistent optimiser state",
ree-v3 ree_core/sleep/cross_module_consolidation.py), and a fresh Adam's bias-corrected first step
is approximately lr*sign(g) REGARDLESS of |g|, so displacement is bounded by n_steps*lr = 8*1e-3 =
0.008 whatever the gradient is. V3-EXQ-1063's landed manifest shows world_head_max_abs_delta at
0.00798-0.00807 in 6 of 6 lever-on cells (99.7-100.9% of that bound) across bases whose residual
battery MSE differs by a factor of about 1000. The step size is therefore set by the OPTIMISER, not
by how converged the head is -- so on a converged base the pass overwrites a residual it is 18-41x
larger than, and the measured "sleep degrades the readout" is that overwrite rather than a property
of consolidation.
MECH-572.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the comparison must hold the OBJECTIVE and the replay content fixed and
vary ONLY the displacement-to-residual ratio, or the step-size account is confounded with MECH-574's
target-novelty account. conv_rel_drop must be asserted from measured output, and -- per MECH-573 -- the
base must additionally clear the TRIVIAL predictor, since a head at its copy-the-input value has no
residual worth protecting and the ratio is then undefined in the sense that matters.
CONFIRMING: with the objective, the replay batch and the base all unchanged, reducing the consolidation
displacement until it is small relative to the converged head's residual (by lowering
cross_module_consolidation_lr, reducing cross_module_consolidation_steps, or reusing optimiser state
across cycles so the second-moment estimate adapts to small gradients) turns the across-sleep
frozen-battery delta non-negative on at least 2/3 seeds while conv_rel_drop stays >= 0.99 and the head
stays above the trivial predictor. Both requirements (i) and (ii) then hold at the SAME setting, which
is exactly what leg B is blocked on.
FALSIFYING: the across-sleep delta stays negative on a converged base even when the imposed displacement
is demonstrably small relative to the residual (say below 10% of it), on at least 2/3 seeds. That would
show the degradation is not an overwrite and would redirect leg B onto the objective or the replay
content -- MECH-574 -- instead.
PRECONDITION NOT MET (P-FAIL): if no setting can be found at which displacement is small relative to
residual AND the head remains above the trivial predictor, the claim converts to
epistemic_category substrate_conditional, status stays candidate, and the failing precondition is named
with the measurement that failed it. That is a legitimate outcome and is NOT a falsification.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT: no new substrate. cross_module_consolidation_lr and
cross_module_consolidation_steps are existing config knobs; world_head_max_abs_delta,
identity_predictor_mse and per-cycle battery readouts are already instrumented by V3-EXQ-1063.
REGISTRATION IS NOT BUILD AUTHORISATION and no experiment is queued: INV-063 is substrate_conditional
and has no experiment budget; V3-EXQ-1071 stays reserved and unused.

MECH-573.subject: sleep.heldout_readout_trivial_predictor_reference
MECH-573.title:
heldout_readout_readability_must_be_referenced_to_the_TRIVIAL_predictor_not_random_init. A
consolidation pass can only improve a held-out readout on the component of the target that is NOT
reproducible by the trivial predictor, so a readout is READABLE in requirement (i)'s own sense only
when it is demonstrably above that predictor -- not merely far from random initialisation. INV-063
leg B's existing gate uses the wrong reference: conv_rel_drop is normalised by the RANDOM-INIT battery
MSE (V3-EXQ-1063's own F5 note), and random init on a forward model is vastly worse than simply
copying the input, so conv_rel_drop >= 0.99 is satisfiable while the head sits AT its degenerate value.
MECH-573.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the trivial-predictor reference must be computed on the SAME frozen
battery as the model readout, in the same units, within the same no-grad evaluation -- otherwise the
ratio compares two different populations. identity_predictor_mse as already instrumented satisfies this.
CONFIRMING: a base that clears conv_rel_drop >= 0.99 but whose skill score 1 - MSE_model/MSE_identity is
at or below 0 shows no interpretable across-sleep movement in EITHER direction beyond noise, while a
base matched on conv_rel_drop but with skill comfortably above 0 shows a larger-magnitude and
sign-consistent across-sleep delta, on at least 2/3 seeds. That would establish the skill score, not
conv_rel_drop, as leg B's readability gate.
FALSIFYING: across-sleep delta magnitude and sign consistency are unrelated to the skill score once
conv_rel_drop is held fixed -- i.e. heads at negative skill move just as informatively as heads at
positive skill. That would show the trivial-predictor reference is not the operative constraint and
would leave conv_rel_drop standing as the gate.
PRECONDITION NOT MET (P-FAIL): if no achievable P0 budget produces a base with skill score above 0 on a
majority of seeds, the claim converts to epistemic_category substrate_conditional, status stays
candidate, and the finding is recorded as a bound on the world-forward head rather than on the readout.
That is a legitimate outcome and NOT a falsification -- and it would be a materially important finding
for INV-063, because it would mean leg B is blocked upstream of the readout question entirely.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT: none required. identity_predictor_mse is already recorded per cell.
REGISTRATION IS NOT BUILD AUTHORISATION. No experiment queued; V3-EXQ-1071 stays reserved and unused.

[2026-09-25 governance-20260925; GFLAG-0482] GOVERNANCE DECISION (rec-20260925-deedce42): user selected option (b) for the SD-PP-B5-z-world-per-step-displacement-range / V3-EXQ-1092 inverted-action-map lineage (GFLAG-0470, GFLAG-0475, GFLAG-0482) -- drop the cross-battery ratio collector entirely and replace it with the SAME-ROWS opposite-label statistic head(z0, pi(acts)) vs head(z0, acts), paired, with an exact null of 1.0 and no second battery required. This also resolves GFLAG-0470 as SUPERSEDED: F2 shows the inverted action map is a bijection over i.i.d.-uniform action indices, so on LIVE battery rows the raw >1.0 bar and the action-blind-null bar agree (0.949/0.958, both seeds) -- the 1.09-2.41 aliasing GFLAG-0470 raised was an artefact of V3-EXQ-1079's post-death batteries, not a live-row property. V3-EXQ-1092 is to be re-authored against the new statistic via /queue-experiment. Lineage-wide driver defects independent of this choice -- F1 (dry-run executes the full seed budget against SEEDS_REQUIRED before the 'real' run) and F3 (POST_RESET_SKIP=3 is alpha-asymmetric) -- are chipped separately to /queue-experiment, not fixed here.

MECH-574.subject: sleep.replay_target_regeneration
MECH-574.title:
consolidation_improves_a_heldout_readout_only_when_replay_REGENERATES_an_improved_target. A
consolidation pass over stored experience improves a frozen held-out readout only to the extent replay
supplies a target the current model does not already match -- re-presenting the originally observed
target to a head that has converged on it carries no information, and what remains is whatever
displacement the optimiser imposes on its own account. MuZero Reanalyze is the external positive case:
it "revisits its past time-steps and re-executes its search using the latest model parameters,
potentially resulting in a better quality policy than the original search", and that RE-DERIVED target
drives 80% of updates. REE's sleep world-forward trainer has no improvement operator: compute_e2_world_loss
draws (world[i], action[i+1], world[i+1]) straight from the replay buffers and descends against the
originally observed next state, unchanged on every cycle.
MECH-574.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the novel-target arm must be shown to actually DIFFER from the 1-step
observed target on the replayed content -- assert a non-trivial loss value on the regenerated target at
the start of the cycle from measured output, not from the fact that a different code path ran. A k-step
target that the head already satisfies is the same re-presentation in a new costume. The consolidation
displacement must be held fixed across arms, or this is confounded with MECH-572.
CONFIRMING: at FIXED consolidation displacement and fixed base convergence, replacing the 1-step observed
target with a regenerated target the head does not already match (k-step consistency, or harder in-batch
negatives) moves the across-sleep frozen-battery delta toward positive on at least 2/3 seeds, while the
matched re-presentation arm stays negative.
FALSIFYING: target novelty makes no difference to the across-sleep delta at fixed displacement, on at
least 2/3 seeds, while varying the displacement does. That would attribute the whole effect to MECH-572
and this claim should be demoted.
PRECONDITION NOT MET (P-FAIL): if no REE-available operator regenerates a target that measurably differs
from the observed one on converged replay content, the claim converts to epistemic_category
substrate_conditional, status stays candidate, and the missing improvement operator is named as the
substrate dependency. That is a legitimate outcome and NOT a falsification.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT: world_forward_contrastive_loss_multistep already exists
(ree-v3 ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py), so the k-step arm needs a call-site change rather than new
substrate. REGISTRATION IS NOT BUILD AUTHORISATION. No experiment queued; V3-EXQ-1071 stays reserved and
unused.

MECH-575.subject: representation.action_conditioned_affordance_geometry
MECH-575.title: The affordance-and-valuation bridge of ARC-149 is a FIELD with metric structure, not a list of candidates or an action-value table: similar action trajectories occupy neighbouring regions, and the geometry deforms lawfully under single-factor changes to the organism or world while world IDENTITY in z_world remains stable. PRE-REGISTERED DEFORMATION SIGNATURE, which is what makes this separable from a ranked candidate list: holding the observation fixed and varying exactly one of (i) agent position, (ii) agent energy or body state, (iii) an obstacle or route, (iv) availability of a motor primitive, (v) presence of a threatened or beneficial other, or (vi) observation uncertainty, the action-conditioned representation should change in a way that PREDICTS WHICH TRAJECTORIES BECAME REACHABLE OR UNAVAILABLE, while a decoder of world identity trained before the intervention remains accurate. PRIMARY FALSIFIER: if the representation's response to these interventions is fully explained by a re-ranking of a fixed candidate set -- i.e. a permutation of scores with no change in neighbourhood structure -- it is an action-value table and this claim is refuted. SECOND FALSIFIER: if world identity degrades whenever the geometry deforms, the bridge is not separable from z_world and ARC-149's intermediate object collapses into the world model. NULL RESULT EXPECTED TO BE COMMON - a learned bridge may simply become an opaque map (the source thought's affordance-collapse failure mode), which is this claim failing, not the assay failing.
MECH-575.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: inherits ARC-149's phenotype-battery and
matched-capacity gate in full -- see ARC-149's own what_would_answer, do not
re-derive it -- and adds three of its own. All three FAIL on V3 substrate as
built, which is the specific reason this claim is substrate_conditional rather
than merely unqueued.

  (i) THE REPRESENTATION UNDER TEST MUST BE SENSITIVE TO THE INTERVENED FACTOR AT
      ALL. V3's action-object space is o_t = E2.action_object(z_world, action)
      plus an optional cue bias (ree-v3 ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py:571-605):
      it takes NO self-state argument. Interventions (ii) agent energy or body
      state and (iv) availability of a motor primitive therefore cannot move it,
      and a null on those arms would measure the instrument rather than the
      mechanism -- the failure mode the residue-bandwidth incident recorded, where
      the deciding readout returned 84 action divergences at bandwidth 8.0 AND at
      0.02, in opposite directions. REQUIRED, per factor and before any scoring: a
      factor-to-representation sensitivity check demonstrating non-zero effect on
      the ON arm. A factor failing it is reported UNSCOREABLE, never as "no
      deformation".

 (ii) THE TWO HALVES OF THE SIGNATURE MUST BE SIMULTANEOUSLY SATISFIABLE. The
      pre-registered deformation signature requires the geometry to move WHILE a
      world-identity decoder stays accurate. On V3 substrate the four factors that
      CAN move o_t -- (i) position, (iii) obstacle or route, (v) presence of a
      threatened or beneficial other, (vi) observation uncertainty -- all enter
      THROUGH z_world, so moving them moves world identity too and the SECOND
      FALSIFIER below fires trivially, by construction rather than by finding. A
      run in which no intervention can be shown to move the geometry WITHOUT
      moving z_world does not test this claim and self-routes
      substrate_not_ready_requeue. The assay presupposes an
      A_t = F(z_world, z_self, C, K) signature that V3 does not instantiate; this,
      not a generic substrate caveat, is why the claim's "DO NOT build in V3" note
      is correct.

(iii) NEIGHBOURHOOD STRUCTURE MUST BE MEASURABLE INDEPENDENTLY OF THE RANKING. The
      PRIMARY FALSIFIER turns entirely on separating "a permutation of scores"
      from "a change in neighbourhood structure", so the run must carry a metric
      on the representation that is INVARIANT TO ANY MONOTONE RE-SCORING --
      pairwise distances or local neighbour sets among action trajectories,
      computed before any score is applied. If the only available readout is the
      score vector, the primary falsifier is unreachable and the claim is
      untestable on that substrate whatever the outcome.

Also required, from the title: the world-identity decoder is trained BEFORE the
intervention and FROZEN. It is never refit on post-intervention data -- a refit
decoder can absorb the deformation and silently convert a SECOND-falsifier result
into an apparent confirmation.

CONFIRMING: for at least TWO interventions passing (i) and (ii), the
representation's post-intervention neighbourhood structure changes in a direction
that PREDICTS, held out, which trajectories became reachable or unavailable -- a
reachability decoder trained on the deformation generalises to held-out
interventions of the same factor -- while the frozen world-identity decoder's
accuracy is statistically unchanged. The deformation must additionally beat a
MAGNITUDE-MATCHED RANDOM-PERTURBATION NULL injected at the same layer, so that
"the geometry moved" cannot be satisfied by any perturbation of the right size.

FALSIFYING -- two routes, both pre-registered in the title:
  PRIMARY: the response to every intervention passing (i) is fully explained by a
  monotone re-ranking of a fixed candidate set -- pairwise distances and local
  neighbour sets among trajectories unchanged within the random-perturbation null,
  while only the score order moves. The bridge is an action-value table and this
  claim is refuted. GUARD: V3's E3 arbitrates over a list of K Trajectory objects
  carrying a scalar score, so on V3 substrate this outcome is the ARCHITECTURAL
  DEFAULT, not a discovery -- a V3 run returning it is uninformative and must not
  be scored against this claim.
  SECOND: world identity degrades whenever the geometry deforms -- the frozen
  decoder loses accuracy in proportion to the deformation -- so the bridge is not
  separable from z_world and ARC-149's intermediate object collapses into the
  world model. GUARD: per precondition (ii), this is admissible only on a
  substrate where a non-z_world route into the geometry EXISTS. Where it does not,
  the outcome is guaranteed and is not evidence.

A NULL RESULT -- the learned bridge becomes an opaque map with no usable structure
(the source thought's affordance-collapse failure mode) -- IS THIS CLAIM FAILING,
not the assay failing, PROVIDED (i)-(iii) were met. Under unmet preconditions the
same null is substrate_not_ready. The distinction is the whole difference between
a finding and a wasted run.

RELATION TO MECH-576, so the two are not read as fighting: MECH-576 asserts
DISCRETE alternating tendency states while this claim asserts a CONTINUOUS metric
field. They are at different grains -- the field is the terrain, tendency states
are coarse regimes over it -- and a discreteness result at the tendency level is
not evidence against metric structure at the trajectory level, nor the converse.

Disposition 2026-09-22: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional.

MECH-576.subject: commitment.precommitment_tendency_alternation
MECH-576.title: Under conflict, rival action tendencies are preserved as TEMPORALLY ALTERNATING discrete states before commitment rather than being concurrently summed into one instantaneous score, and the alternation statistics -- not the winning score -- carry the distinction between productive deliberation and pathology. A policy becomes dominant because it is better supported, more stable, more precise, compatible with constraints, or survives longer under counterfactual scrutiny, which is a different process from being assigned the largest instantaneous value. PRE-REGISTERED TELEMETRY, recorded per genuine conflict: candidate trajectory identity, tendency state (approach / avoid / pause / investigate / affiliate / protect / repair), confidence or precision, DWELL TIME, SWITCHING RATE, constraint exposure, reason for final dominance, and reason for interruption or re-opening. THREE REGIMES PREDICTED TO BE DISTINGUISHABLE rather than one - productive deliberation (bounded alternation that terminates in commitment or in an escalation to information-gathering), pathological flicker (alternation that never achieves dominance, leaving the organism inert), and perseveration (dominance achieved and then held against disconfirming evidence). PRIMARY FALSIFIER: if a concurrent soft-competitive model with no alternation -- tendencies co-active and summed, as MECH-140's soft-competitive disinhibition already permits -- reproduces the commitment outcomes AND the conflict-resolution latencies at matched capacity, the alternation is epiphenomenal and this claim is refuted. SECOND FALSIFIER: if dwell time and switching rate carry no information about the deliberation-versus-pathology distinction once decision difficulty is controlled for, the telemetry is descriptive only and the claim's discriminating content is unreachable.
MECH-576.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: inherits ARC-149's phenotype-battery and
matched-capacity gate -- see ARC-149's own what_would_answer, do not re-derive it
-- and adds four.

  (i) GENUINE CONFLICT MUST OCCUR AT A NON-TRIVIAL RATE. Telemetry "recorded per
      genuine conflict" is vacuous when conflicts are rare or absent. This is the
      MECH-138 lesson verbatim: V3-EXQ-162 (2026-03-29) ran that claim's exact
      THREE_PHASE design under a random action policy and produced
      n_cancel_events = 0 in all four cells -- PARTIAL_NO_CANCEL, neither
      confirming nor falsifying. REQUIRED: a pre-declared conflict-rate floor; a
      conflict definition that is NOT "near-tie in score" alone (a score-defined
      conflict pre-supposes the scalar this claim says is insufficient); and a
      policy that is neither random nor undertrained.

 (ii) THERE MUST BE PRE-COMMITMENT TIME TO ALTERNATE IN. Dwell time and switching
      rate are undefined if the decision resolves in a single pass. V3's E3 makes
      ONE selection per E3 tick over a candidate bank; the only intra-decision
      iteration available is the HippocampalModule CEM refit loop, which is an
      OPTIMISER OVER PROPOSALS, not a competition between tendency states.
      Reading CEM refit iterations as "alternation" would be an instrument
      artefact and is INADMISSIBLE. REQUIRED: a pre-commitment interval supplying
      at least a declared minimum number of independently-resolvable deliberation
      steps, with the substrate that supplies them named.

(iii) THE TENDENCY-STATE LABEL MUST EXIST AND BE NON-DEGENERATE. The telemetry
      enumerates approach / avoid / pause / investigate / affiliate / protect /
      repair. V3 carries partial machinery for a subset (an infralimbic avoidance
      gate; a five-class action-class embedding in the escape-affordance linker)
      and MECH-483's orient/survey regime is registered but explicitly not built;
      affiliate / protect / repair have NO substrate. REQUIRED: at least THREE
      labels observed with non-zero occupancy; labels assigned by a rule fixed
      before the run; and the label NOT derived from the score. A tendency state
      read off the score vector cannot subsequently carry information the score
      does not -- that is circular and would manufacture a false confirmation of
      the very point at issue.

 (iv) THE F-DOMINANCE GATE, INHERITED FROM THE COMPARATOR. The primary falsifier's
      comparator is MECH-140's concurrent soft-competitive model, and MECH-140
      carries its own unmet precondition: the settling must operate over a field
      that is not F-collapsed, against MECH-439's measured ~88-89 percent
      F-variance monopoly. Over an F-collapsed field both arms are simply the
      F-winner and the contrast cannot discriminate. This claim therefore inherits
      MECH-439's clearance and MECH-488's gates (gap_norm regaining genuine
      cross-seed spread, gap_spread_seeds >= 2). Do not run before they hold.

Additionally: DECISION DIFFICULTY must be measured and available as a covariate,
because the SECOND FALSIFIER below is explicitly conditional on controlling for it.

CONFIRMING: with (i)-(iv) met --
  (a) the pre-commitment record shows discrete state occupancy whose dwell-time
      distribution is distinguishable from the continuous-mixture null generated by
      the SAME substrate under a concurrent-summation model at matched capacity;
  (b) dwell time and switching rate predict the three-regime distinction --
      productive deliberation, pathological flicker, perseveration -- OUT OF SAMPLE
      and AFTER decision difficulty is partialled out; and
  (c) final dominance is better predicted by a candidate's stability, duration or
      constraint-survival than by its peak instantaneous score, on held-out
      conflicts.
Per the group's shared structure (ARC-149), the admissible confirming statement is
"survives the N pre-registered concurrent comparators", not "confirmed".

FALSIFYING -- two routes, both pre-registered in the title:
  PRIMARY: a concurrent soft-competitive model with no alternation -- tendencies
  co-active and summed, as MECH-140's soft-competitive disinhibition already
  permits -- reproduces BOTH the commitment outcomes AND the conflict-resolution
  latencies at matched capacity. The alternation is epiphenomenal and this claim is
  refuted. TWO GUARDS, both load-bearing: (1) THE COMPARATOR MUST BE BUILT AND RUN,
  NOT ASSERTED. MECH-140 has ZERO valid experimental rows -- the V3-EXQ-710 finding
  was withdrawn on instrument-validity grounds 2026-07-20 and its own falsifier is
  still unmet -- so "MECH-140 covers this" is a SPECIFICATION, not a baseline, and
  citing MECH-140's existence does not discharge this falsifier. (2) Latencies must
  be matched as a SCORED OUTCOME, not incidentally; outcome-only matching is
  insufficient because the claim's content is that the dynamics, not the verdict,
  carry the distinction.
  SECOND: dwell time and switching rate carry no information about the
  deliberation-versus-pathology distinction once decision difficulty is controlled
  for -- the telemetry is descriptive only and the claim's discriminating content is
  unreachable. This is the likelier of the two outcomes and is a FINDING, not a
  failed run.

DIRECTIONAL NOTE, so a result is not mis-filed: MECH-488's gap_norm is precisely
the instantaneous scalar compression this claim predicts is insufficient. A run in
which gap_norm ALONE matches the alternation telemetry's predictive power on (b)
is the SECOND FALSIFIER firing and is recorded AGAINST this claim -- not as
support for MECH-488, whose own falsifier is a different contrast entirely.

Disposition 2026-09-22: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional.

MECH-577.subject: representation.sensorimotor_phase_subspace_gradient
MECH-577.title: The sensorimotor path carries BOTH a shared world-anchored component and phase-exclusive components, with the degree of overlap varying systematically along the path rather than being constant: a single representation serves orienting, prospective rollout, commitment preparation and execution / feedback control, while reserving some dimensions for the current phase. The shared component preserves continuity (the action remains about the same world, body and other agents); the phase-exclusive components permit opposite computations, since exploration must PRESERVE alternatives while execution must SUPPRESS them in favour of robust closed-loop control. PRE-REGISTERED MEASUREMENTS across the four phases: shared versus phase-exclusive latent dimensionality, stability of decision-relevant world variables within the shared component, whether execution-specific dimensions improve closed-loop control, and -- the load-bearing one -- whether they do so WITHOUT erasing alternative-trajectory information earlier than commitment requires. PRIMARY FALSIFIER: a fully shared representation (single undifferentiated latent serving every phase) matches closed-loop control performance at matched capacity, in which case phase-exclusive structure is unnecessary. SECOND FALSIFIER, in the opposite direction: a fully serial pipeline (perception completes, then planning completes, then execution begins, with no shared component) matches it, in which case the shared world-anchored component is unnecessary. A binary test for decodability or for the presence of an attractor does not discriminate any of these and is not admissible evidence here.
MECH-577.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: inherits ARC-149's phenotype-battery and
matched-capacity gate -- see ARC-149's own what_would_answer, do not re-derive it
-- and adds four.

  (i) THE FOUR PHASES MUST EXIST AS AN INDEPENDENTLY-ESTABLISHED PARTITION.
      Orienting, prospective rollout, commitment preparation, and execution /
      feedback control must be segmentable by a rule FIXED BEFORE THE RUN and NOT
      derived from the latent under test. Segmenting phases BY the latent and then
      measuring phase-exclusive dimensions IN that latent is circular and is the
      single most likely route to a false positive here. Each phase needs a
      declared minimum number of scored ticks; a phase with near-zero occupancy
      makes its exclusive dimensions unestimable and is reported UNSCOREABLE.
      TWO SUBSTITUTIONS ARE EXPLICITLY INADMISSIBLE:
        - DO NOT substitute SD-032a's operating_mode ({external_task,
          internal_replay, internal_planning, offline_consolidation}). That is a
          different partition -- engagement regime, not position within an action
          -- and is what MECH-261 gates writes on. A result obtained over it is
          evidence about SD-032a / MECH-261, not about this claim.
        - DO NOT substitute MECH-561's phi. MECH-561's phase is an ENDOGENOUS
          CYCLIC coordinate indexing an inter-engine communication subspace and is
          implementation_phase v3; this claim's phase is a NON-CYCLIC task /
          processing coordinate at v4. A V3 phase-as-address result is not evidence
          here in either direction. This claim's notes already say so; this
          precondition makes it operative at run time.

 (ii) DIMENSIONALITY ESTIMATES MUST BE SAMPLE- AND CAPACITY-MATCHED ACROSS PHASES.
      The shared-versus-exclusive split is trivially driven by per-phase row count.
      REQUIRED: equal (or explicitly resampled) rows per phase, plus a BIN-COUNT
      SWEEP demonstrating the split is not a function of the count -- the same
      guard MECH-561's own precondition (c) carries for its principal angles.

(iii) THE ALTERNATIVE-TRAJECTORY READOUT MUST BE LIVE. The load-bearing
      measurement, named as such in the title, is whether execution-specific
      dimensions improve closed-loop control WITHOUT erasing alternative-trajectory
      information earlier than commitment requires. That requires an
      alternative-trajectory readout with DEMONSTRATED NON-ZERO INFORMATION during
      the rollout and preparation phases on the baseline arm. If alternatives are
      already uninformative pre-commitment, "erased too early" is unmeasurable and
      the load-bearing column is dead before the run starts. This is where the
      claim most concretely blocks on V3: retention of rejected candidates past
      their rejection tick is MECH-487, registered and unbuilt.

 (iv) CLOSED-LOOP CONTROL PERFORMANCE MUST HAVE HEADROOM IN BOTH DIRECTIONS on the
      baseline arm. Both falsifiers are of the form "a simpler representation
      MATCHES it at matched capacity", so floor or ceiling saturation makes both
      unreachable simultaneously and the run returns no verdict in either
      direction.

Per the title: a binary test for decodability, or for the presence of an
attractor, discriminates none of these outcomes and is NOT ADMISSIBLE EVIDENCE
here -- it satisfies no precondition above and decides no falsifier below.

CONFIRMING: with (i)-(iv) met --
  (a) a shared component exists whose decision-relevant world variables remain
      stably decodable across all four phases, measured with a FROZEN decoder;
  (b) phase-exclusive components are recoverable above a PHASE-LABEL-PERMUTATION
      null;
  (c) the degree of overlap VARIES SYSTEMATICALLY ALONG THE PATH rather than being
      constant -- this is the claim's own differentiator, and a constant-overlap
      result is NOT confirming even when (a) and (b) both hold;
  (d) execution-specific dimensions measurably improve closed-loop control; AND
  (e) they do so WITHOUT reducing alternative-trajectory information before the
      commitment boundary, relative to the matched control.
  (e) is load-bearing: (a)-(d) holding while (e) fails is the source thought's
  "premature narrowing" failure mode and is a finding AGAINST this claim's value,
  not for it.

FALSIFYING -- two directions, both pre-registered in the title:
  PRIMARY: a fully shared representation -- a single undifferentiated latent
  serving every phase -- matches closed-loop control performance at matched
  capacity, in which case phase-exclusive structure is unnecessary.
  SECOND, in the opposite direction: a fully serial pipeline -- perception
  completes, then planning completes, then execution begins, with no shared
  component -- matches it, in which case the shared world-anchored component is
  unnecessary.
  Both inherit ARC-149's matched-capacity definition requirement (its precondition
  (d)); an unpinned capacity definition makes both routes unfalsifiable in exactly
  the direction that matters. A run in which NEITHER comparator is actually built
  and run returns NO VERDICT -- asserting either comparator from architecture is
  not a result.

Disposition 2026-09-22: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional. Of the four
claims in this group this is the most separable from ARC-149 -- the four
processing phases are properties of the sensorimotor path and exist whether or not
the bridge does -- and is therefore the likeliest candidate for a /governance V3
re-route. The two V3 gaps that would have to close first are named in (i) and
(iii): a phase partition that is not SD-032a's operating_mode, and a live
alternative-trajectory readout (MECH-487).

MECH-578.subject: representation.agreement_dependent_timescale_separation
MECH-578.title: Agreement-dependent timescale separation as the signature of reciprocal reconciliation: when two REE subsystems are reciprocally coupled through a learned selective correspondence, joint states in which the two are MUTUALLY COMPATIBLE should decay more slowly than equally-strong incompatible joint states -- tau_agree > tau_disagree -- so that the coupled dynamics progressively bias the pair toward mutually supportable states WITHOUT either system converging on the other's representation. Integration is thereby dynamical compatibility, not representational equality, and the terminal pair (A*, B*) is mutually supportable rather than identical. This proposes a FURTHER NAMED PROPERTY -- RECIPROCALLY RECONCILED -- which is deliberately NOT a numbered rung on INV-105's ladder. INV-105's seven rungs are each a property of ONE VARIABLE'S STATUS in a latent space and are monotone (reaching rung n entails 1..n-1); this property has a different subject (a COUPLED PAIR'S JOINT DYNAMICS) and dissociates from the ladder in BOTH directions -- generic recurrence can produce tau_agree > tau_disagree with nothing at rung 4 (bridgeable), which is exactly what falsifier (2) below concedes, and a purely feedforward bridge can reach rung 7 (behaviourally beneficial) with no reciprocal reconciliation whatever. Two properties that dissociate in both directions are not adjacent rungs on one monotone ladder. GOV-CONTRACT-3's 'stated here rather than as an eighth rung, to avoid a second ladder that would invite collapse with the first' is the governing precedent, and GFLAG-0235 (resolved, user-approved 2026-09-10) is the governing ruling: it chose forward-reference over amendment for MECH-548's eighth-rung proposal. THREE PRE-REGISTERED FALSIFIERS, each an ablation that must abolish the separation if the claim is true. (1) COUPLING-DIRECTION ABLATION: measure tau_agree and tau_disagree under intact bidirectional coupling, A->B only, B->A only, and both removed; if a unidirectional condition reproduces the separation, what is being measured is persistence, not reciprocal reconciliation, and the claim is refuted. (2) CORRESPONDENCE SCRAMBLE AT MATCHED COUPLING STRENGTH: preserve total coupling magnitude while permuting WHICH dimensions are connected; if the separation survives a scramble, it is generic recurrence rather than learned like-to-like correspondence, and the claim is refuted. (3) FALSE-CONSENSUS CHALLENGE: inject a shared but INCORRECT latent signal into both systems; if agreement alone stabilises it and independent environmental error cannot destabilise it, the mechanism manufactures coherence without correctness and must not be built. Perturbation magnitude must be matched across the agree and disagree conditions or the comparison is uninterpretable.
MECH-578.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (six parts; this claim's entire content is a comparison of two
decay constants, so an unmet precondition makes the comparison uninterpretable rather than
null). (P1) RECIPROCAL AND PER-DIRECTION ABLATABLE: influence must be measured to flow in BOTH
directions between A and B within the loop under test, and each direction must be separately
removable. Verified absent 2026-09-22: V3 has no such coupling. CrossStreamBinder
(ree-v3 ree_core/latent/cross_stream_binder.py:205,225-230) is SYMMETRIC BY CONSTRUCTION --
one shared b_t added to both streams, no A->B weight distinct from B->A -- so falsifier (1)'s
unidirectional cells are NOT CONSTRUCTIBLE on it; it is default-OFF
(cross_stream_binding_enabled, utils/config.py:928) and acts only inside imagined CEM rollouts,
not the online loop (:70-73). E1<->E2 is one-directional (E1->E2 action_bias only,
agent.py:6128,6306). ARC-110's M_cross (e3_selector.py:770,2602-2614) is the only per-direction
addressable coupling but carries no persistent joint state to perturb.
(P2) THE COUPLING MUST BE MEASURABLY LIVE, NOT MERELY ENABLED -- a non-zero measured effect in
each direction separately, reported before any tau is read. STANDING NEGATIVE RESULT: across
V3-EXQ-641/641a/720 the binder recorded n_rebind = 0 and cross-stream coherence carried no
selection information beyond prediction error (cross_stream_binder.py:11-32). An inert coupling
makes both decay constants properties of the UNCOUPLED substrate, and the comparison is vacuous
whatever it returns.
(P3) PERTURBATION MAGNITUDE MATCHED AT DELIVERY, in the metric the decay is read in -- not a
matched nominal sigma. Use the rms_ref discipline of consolidation_lesion_harness.diffuse_perturb
(experiments/_lib/consolidation_lesion_harness.py:294-300) so delivered magnitude is numerically
identical across the agree and disagree arms, and REPORT the delivered norms. An unmatched pair
measures the perturbation, not the coupling.
(P4) tau RESOLVABLE ABOVE NOISE AND WITH DEMONSTRATED RANGE: a fitted decay constant with
seed-level CIs that do not span the agree/disagree difference, PLUS a positive control -- a
manipulation known to move tau -- so a null is distinguishable from a flat instrument. A readout
that returns the same value across a wide sweep of the quantity it is supposed to track is
measuring itself (the residue-bandwidth precedent: 84 action divergences at bandwidth 8.0 AND
0.02, in opposite directions).
(P5) ON-MANIFOLD PERTURBATION (interface_probe.manifold_guard, experiments/_lib/
interface_probe.py:1366): a perturbation landing off-distribution decays at the rate of the
return-to-manifold dynamics, which is not the quantity claimed.
(P6) NON-TAUTOLOGY (MECH-558's third binding, applied here): agreement and disagreement must be
labelled WITHOUT reference to the decay being measured and without reference to the outcome. A
tau contrast validated against an agreement label derived from persistence is circular.

BINDING (INV-108 part (i), stated here because INV-108's own scope may not reach this case --
see the governance note on its evaluator-only wording): tau_agree is a DIAGNOSTIC READOUT and
must NEVER become an optimisation target, a reward term, or a teacher signal. A system trained
to maximise the separation manufactures the observation and falsifies nothing. Falsifier (3) is
the operational guard.

CONFIRMING: tau_agree > tau_disagree at matched DELIVERED perturbation magnitude, by a margin
scaled on the seed-level SD of the per-seed (tau_agree - tau_disagree) difference plus a
pre-registered absolute floor -- AND all three pre-registered ablations abolish it.
(1) COUPLING-DIRECTION: the separation is present under intact bidirectional coupling and ABSENT
in EVERY other cell -- A->B only, B->A only, and both removed.
(2) CORRESPONDENCE SCRAMBLE: the separation does NOT survive permuting which dimensions are
connected at preserved total coupling magnitude (report the preserved magnitude, not just the
intent to preserve it).
(3) FALSE-CONSENSUS CHALLENGE: a shared-but-incorrect injected latent does not acquire agree-mode
persistence; or if it does, an independent environmental error signal still destabilises it
within the horizon the system actually uses the interface.
Report the four coupling cells and the scramble as ONE grid. A partial result -- separation
abolished by the scramble but reproduced by a unidirectional cell -- routes to persistence, and
is NOT a weakened version of this claim.

FALSIFYING (four, which fail independently and must be reported separately):
(a) tau_agree ~= tau_disagree at matched delivered magnitude on a coupling measured live in both
directions -- no agreement-dependent separation exists.
(b) ANY unidirectional condition reproduces the separation -- what is measured is persistence,
not reciprocal reconciliation; the reciprocal attribution is wrong and the claim is REFUTED, not
narrowed. (Note for MECH-579: this leg does not take MECH-579 with it -- see its scope note.)
(c) the separation survives a correspondence scramble at matched coupling magnitude -- generic
recurrence rather than learned like-to-like correspondence.
(d) the false-consensus challenge shows agreement alone stabilising an incorrect shared signal
that independent environmental error cannot destabilise -- the mechanism manufactures coherence
without correctness and MUST NOT BE BUILT. This refutes the claim's architectural value even if
(a)-(c) all pass, and is the one leg whose failure is a build prohibition rather than a scientific
null.

BOUNDARY (not refutation): no coupling in the substrate is simultaneously reciprocal,
per-direction ablatable, and measurably live. The claim is then UNTESTED. Reporting that
situation as a null (a) is the specific error this precondition exists to prevent, and given P1
and P2 it is currently the expected outcome of any V3 attempt.

SEPARATION FROM NEIGHBOURS, so a result routes correctly: vs MECH-548 -- the discriminator is
whether the SENDER's own state is updated by the receiver within the loop (MECH-548: no, A is
exogenous and the loop is B->B through a receiver-conditioned T; here: yes). MECH-548's assay is
clean-base vs cumulative over N consumer steps and its signature is monotone degradation of ONE
quantity; this claim's assay is the four-cell grid and its signature is a CONTRAST between two
constants. Neither run yields the other's readout. vs MECH-539 -- a property of the MAP, checkable
with both endpoints frozen, vs a property of the CLOSED LOOP. vs ARC-139 -- ARC-139 says
representational sameness is not required; this says what replaces it dynamically.

Disposition 2026-09-22: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional -- three required instruments
absent (per-direction-ablatable reciprocal coupling; ANY decay-constant estimator, none exists in
ree_core/ or experiments/; a magnitude-preserving dimension-correspondence scramble). All four are
complicated (buildable). LAYERED FINDING, recorded because it changes what a future build must do
FIRST: the coupling half is not merely unbuilt -- CrossStreamBinder is built, was exercised across
V3-EXQ-641/641a/720/725/725a, and was measured INERT (n_rebind = 0), which is a substrate_ceiling
signature sitting beneath the substrate_conditional block on the measurement. Establishing that
the coupling actually binds is complex (probe-gated) and is UPSTREAM of building any tau
estimator. v4 CONFIRMED against the intake's open routing question: assay 1 is NOT cheaper on
existing V3 substrate. The proposed further rung should be NAMED, NOT NUMBERED, and the blank
ordinal REMOVED rather than filled -- it is a property of a coupled pair's dynamics, not of a
variable's status in a latent space, and it dissociates from INV-105's ladder in both directions
(GOV-CONTRACT-3's "rather than as an eighth rung" is the governing precedent; GFLAG-0235 is the
governing ruling).

MECH-579.subject: development.consensus_topology_carved_by_pruning
MECH-579.title: Developmental pruning of an early dense cross-system interface carves a CONSENSUS TOPOLOGY, not merely a translation dictionary: what a maturing REE discovers and retains is not only which dimensions across two subsystems CORRESPOND, but which couplings produce stable useful agreement, which disagreements are resolvable, which dimensions should remain INDEPENDENT, how strongly each direction should influence the other, and when coupling should be opened or gated. Development therefore runs from DENSE EXPLORATORY COUPLING to LEARNED SELECTIVE RECIPROCAL COUPLING, rather than from dense translation to sparse translation. PRIMARY PREDICTION, which is what separates this from ordinary subtractive sparsification: MECH-578's agreement-dependent timescale separation should EMERGE OVER LEARNING and should become SELECTIVE -- early systems showing broad, unstable, largely undifferentiated coupling, and mature systems showing stronger persistence specifically for the agreement modes that are BEHAVIOURALLY USEFUL, not for agreement in general. PRIMARY FALSIFIER: if the separation is present at initialisation, or if it grows uniformly across all agreement modes irrespective of which ones cash out in adaptive behaviour, then what is being observed is a property of the coupling architecture rather than a learned topology, and this claim is refuted while MECH-578 may still stand. SECOND FALSIFIER: if a mature selective topology is reachable WITHOUT the dense early phase -- trained directly at the mature connectivity at matched final capacity -- the developmental ordering claimed here is unnecessary (this is the MECH-549 test applied to the interface).
MECH-579.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: inherits ALL of MECH-578's P1-P6 UNCHANGED (reciprocal and
per-direction-ablatable coupling; coupling measurably live; matched delivered perturbation
magnitude; tau resolvable above noise with demonstrated range; on-manifold perturbation;
non-tautological agreement labelling). Four further parts:
(P7) A measurable NON-ZERO agreement-dependent tau contrast must exist at SOME point in the
developmental window. This is the inherited gate and it is what makes the all-zero case
reportable -- see BOUNDARY.
(P8) A developmental TRAJECTORY must actually be TRAVERSED, not two fixed configurations compared
(MECH-362's own precondition, adopted verbatim): a dense early coupling progressively reduced,
with the INTERMEDIATE states measured. A dense-config vs sparse-config A/B tests the endpoints,
not the trajectory this claim asserts.
(P9) Agreement modes must be separable into BEHAVIOURALLY USEFUL and not, by an organism-level
readout computed INDEPENDENTLY of the tau measurement. The selectivity half is this claim's whole
novelty over ordinary subtractive sparsification; without an independent usefulness label it
cannot be assessed, and the claim collapses into MECH-362.
(P10) For the SECOND FALSIFIER only -- MECH-549's arm-D export path: the mature connectivity,
sparsity mask and interface structure produced by the dense-then-pruned arm must be EXPORTABLE and
re-instantiable at initialisation at matched final capacity. Verified on MECH-549 2026-09-15 and
unchanged: UNSPECIFIED, not merely unbuilt. Also unmet: MECH-362's capacity-schedule substrate
(verified 2026-09-15, no matching sd_id in substrate_queue.json) and MECH-550's retention
criterion (verified 2026-09-15, nothing in ree_core/ scores any route for retention).

CONFIRMING (three legs, ALL required):
(i) EMERGENCE -- the agreement-dependent tau contrast is ABSENT OR AT NOISE at initialisation and
grows over learning, measured on the traversed trajectory of P8, not inferred from two endpoints.
(ii) SELECTIVITY -- at maturity the contrast is materially larger for agreement modes independently
scored BEHAVIOURALLY USEFUL than for agreement modes that are not, with a selectivity index
exceeding a pre-registered floor and the difference scaled on the seed-level SD. This is the leg
that separates a consensus TOPOLOGY from a sparse weight matrix.
(iii) HISTORY IRREDUCIBILITY -- the mature selective topology is NOT reachable by training directly
at the mature connectivity at matched final capacity and matched compute (MECH-549 arm D).
(i) and (ii) WITHOUT (iii) is fully consistent with "pruning found a good architecture"; (iii) is
what makes this a developmental claim rather than an architecture-search result.

FALSIFYING (four, failing independently, reported separately):
(a) the separation is present at initialisation at full mature magnitude -- a property of the
coupling ARCHITECTURE, not a learned topology. This claim is refuted while MECH-578 may still stand.
(b) the separation grows but UNIFORMLY across all agreement modes, irrespective of which cash out
in adaptive behaviour -- this is subtractive sparsification of the coupling, already owned by
MECH-362, and this claim adds nothing beyond it.
(c) arm D matches arm B at matched final capacity and matched compute -- the developmental ordering
claimed here is unnecessary (MECH-549's own primary falsifier, applied to the interface).
(d) the retained structure is fully predicted by coupling-weight MAGNITUDE at the point of pruning,
with the retained-set overlap against a magnitude-pruning control at or near total -- the retained
object is a sparse weight matrix, not a map of where agreement is worth having, and MECH-550's
magnitude-pruning rival owns the result. Report the retained-set overlap; identical retained sets
make the comparison vacuous whatever the competence outcome (MECH-550's own precondition).

BOUNDARY (not refutation) -- AND THIS IS THE LIKELY CASE, NOT AN EXOTIC ONE, WHICH IS WHY IT IS
NAMED HERE RATHER THAN LEFT TO PROSE: no agreement-dependent tau contrast is measurable at ANY
point in the developmental window. There is then no topology for development to carve and this
claim is UNTESTED -- neither confirmed nor refuted. It MUST be reported in that category and MUST
NOT be recorded as a null, because the all-zero case fires NEITHER falsifier (a) (nothing is
present at initialisation) NOR falsifier (b) (nothing grows). Same device as MECH-549's own
BOUNDARY leg, which this claim's second falsifier already borrows.

SCOPE NOTE ON THE DEPENDENCY (correcting the strong reading in this claim's notes): this claim
requires only that an agreement-dependent tau contrast EXISTS AND IS MEASURABLE -- not that
MECH-578's attribution of it to RECIPROCAL RECONCILIATION is correct. If MECH-578 is refuted by
its falsifier (b) -- a unidirectional condition reproduces the separation, so the quantity is
persistence rather than reconciliation -- this claim remains FULLY TESTABLE about whether that
persistence becomes developmentally selective and behaviourally targeted. Do NOT read a MECH-578
refutation as retiring this claim. The genuine vacuity condition is the BOUNDARY above (no
contrast at all), not a MECH-578 refutation.

SEPARATION FROM NEIGHBOURS: vs MECH-362 -- within-system memory connectivity (CA3 tabula plena)
vs a cross-system interface, and what the retained structure MEANS rather than how sparse it is.
vs MECH-550 -- MECH-550 supplies the retention CRITERION this claim assumes; this claim says what
is retained in the cross-system case. vs MECH-549 -- MECH-549 supplies falsifier (c) directly and
is why that falsifier is stated in its terms rather than reinvented.

Disposition 2026-09-22: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional, and blocked FOUR TIMES
INDEPENDENTLY. v4 CONFIRMED; this is the better-routed of the pair and its version placement was
never in doubt. The falsifier hole (the all-zero case fires neither stated falsifier) is a
claim-text defect routed to /governance, not a reason to re-categorise.

MECH-580.subject: control_plane.arousal_commit_eligibility_breadth
MECH-580.title: Within REE's GLOBAL-SCALAR arousal routes (the three MECH-463 names), arousal alters WHICH candidate is committed only by modulating commit-ELIGIBILITY BREADTH -- the width of the basal-ganglia eligibility envelope, i.e. the size of the candidate set admitted to the commit gate -- never by reordering candidate scores. High phasic arousal narrows the admitted set toward the incumbent (exploit); low or tonic arousal widens it (explore). This WHICH-SET face is dissociable from the WHETHER face (commit threshold / gate: MECH-465, MECH-106, MECH-090) and the WHEN face (E3 cadence: MECH-093, MECH-005), and it is the ONE route by which a global scalar can change the committed candidate without contradicting MECH-463's argmax-invariance: a scalar cannot reorder K scores, but it can truncate the admitted set and, under a sampled commit pick, change the support the sample is drawn from. PRECONDITION that makes this observable at all: candidate futures must be ACTION-DISCRIMINABLE under the world model (ARC-002 strong form; SD-e1 rollout consistency) -- with near-identical candidate scores a breadth change admits or excludes nothing that differs, so a null under non-discriminable candidates is uninterpretable. The WHEN and WHETHER faces carry no such dependency, which is why the 2026-09-18 inertness of the commit-readiness gate and the 2026-09-22 endogenous z_beta dynamic-range defect are instrument faults with their own repairs, not consequences of the world-model gap.
MECH-580.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION:
(P1) Candidate futures are ACTION-DISCRIMINABLE: cross-candidate F-score spread sits above the
float32 ULP floor (the V3-EXQ-643 non-vacuity gate, as MECH-463 requires) AND E2 world-forward
pairwise divergence across the K candidates tracks their action differences (ARC-002 weak form).
Without P1 a breadth change admits or excludes nothing that differs, and the run is vacuous.
(P2) The eligibility envelope is LIVE: use_f_eligibility_demotion is ON and excluded_count varies
across ticks (not the V3-EXQ-654h admitted-all twin, excluded_count == 0).
(P3) The arousal manipulation has DYNAMIC RANGE within the run: arousal is set EXOGENOUSLY, i.i.d.
over a pre-registered decile range at each tick (MECH-463's protocol), because endogenous ||z_beta||
spans 0.91% of its mean (substrate_queue mech005-endogenous-arousal-dynamic-range) and an
endogenous-arousal arm is degenerate until that row lands.
(P4) A SAMPLED commit pick is armed (use_gap_scaled_commit_temperature or
use_precision_scaled_commit_temperature), because under a pure argmin a breadth change can only
matter on the ticks where it excludes the incumbent; the deterministic-argmin arm is reported but
is not the verdict arm.
Degenerate if any of P1-P4 fails; a null under unmet preconditions is not evidence against.

CONFIRMING: K_eligible (admitted-set size per tick) falls monotonically with arousal decile with the
bottom-versus-top gap above the pre-registered effect-size floor (scaled on the seed SD of the
delta plus an absolute floor of 2 candidates); committed-class entropy rises at low arousal and
falls at high arousal; the committed candidate's F-rank changes with arousal ONLY through
admitted-set membership -- the rank-preserving fraction within the admitted set stays ~1.0 (as
V3-EXQ-689d) and the full-K score ORDER is invariant across arousal arms (MECH-463's
argmax-invariance retained, not contradicted).

FALSIFYING: with P1-P4 met, K_eligible is flat across arousal deciles (breadth is not the route),
OR committed-class entropy does not move with K_eligible (breadth moves but does not convert to a
different committed candidate), OR the committed candidate changes with arousal WHILE the full-K
score order also changes (arousal is reordering, which refutes MECH-463's argmax-invariance instead
and re-routes to that claim rather than to this one).

Manipulation: couple the envelope to the arousal scalar with a pre-registered MONOTONE map
(f_eligibility_envelope_floor rising with arousal, and/or f_eligibility_dn_sigma narrowing), versus
a fixed-floor control at matched seeds; arousal set exogenously across deciles per P3.
Control: fixed envelope floor (stock 0.30) at every arousal decile; an arousal-OFF arm; a
deterministic-argmin arm (P4 off) reported alongside.
Required event: waking E3 selection over the K=32 CEM candidate pool with the BG eligibility
constitution ON (use_f_eligibility_demotion) on a substrate where candidate scores are
discriminable -- the GAP-A foraging substrate on which V3-EXQ-689d measured 0.371 -> 0.938.
DV: K_eligible per tick by arousal decile; committed-class entropy per decile; rank-preserving
fraction within the admitted set; full-K score-order invariance across arms; realised commit rate
(to confirm the WHETHER face did not move -- a moving commit rate is a confound to be reported,
not a result).
BOUNDARY: this claim is about the WHICH-SET face only. A result that the commit RATE moves with
arousal belongs to MECH-465; a result that E3 CADENCE moves belongs to MECH-093/MECH-005.

MECH-581.subject: world_model.forward_comparator_consequence_scaled_gain
MECH-581.title:
world_forward_comparator_gain_scaled_to_the_predicted_action_consequence. The comparator that reads the
world-forward prediction error carries a GAIN (precision) term set by the magnitude of the action
consequence the forward model predicts, relative to its own residual at that scale, so that a small
action-driven displacement stays legible to the comparator. Subtraction of the predicted self-caused
change (SD-007 ReafferencePredictor, MECH-098) is one member of the corollary-discharge family; gain
modulation scaled to the predicted consequence is a distinct member that REE does not implement, and it
is the member that keeps a contradiction of a small predicted consequence separable from the converged
residual. Without it, every contradiction-based falsifier on z_world (MECH-574's novel-target arm, the
precision-provenance intake's F3 anti-self-sealing test) is scored in absolute z units against a
per-step movement of ~3-4e-3 per dim and is unposeable.
MECH-581.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS. (P1) OPERATING POINT: run at alpha_world >= 0.9 (SD-008, stable) with the
value recorded in the manifest; V3-EXQ-1073/1075 inherited 0.3 from REEConfig.from_dims and a result at
0.3 is confounded with the EMA's ~3x attenuation of per-step displacement. (P2) DENOMINATION: every
ratio is scored against the per-cell MEASURED copy-the-input blind null, never against 1.0, which is the
random-init null on this battery (GFLAG-0432); a ratio drifting toward 1.0 is decay toward init. (P3) The
head must beat the trivial predictor (MECH-573 skill > 0) on the cells scored, or the gain is amplifying
model error, not a predicted consequence. (P4) The gain must be shown to VARY with the predicted
consequence magnitude across states (non-constant, from measured output), or the arm is a global
rescale in disguise.
CONFIRMING: on a one-shot action-map inversion at matched head weights, the gain-weighted comparator's
contradiction PE (inverted / original, blind-null-denominated) exceeds BOTH the unweighted comparator
AND a global min-max-rescaled comparator (the MZ2 control) on at least 2/3 seeds, with the excess
concentrated in states whose predicted consequence is small.
FALSIFYING: the gain-weighted comparator does no better than the global-rescale control on at least
2/3 seeds (the effect is pure scale, not consequence-scaled gain), or it separates the inversion only by
also inflating the PE on the ORIGINAL rule (a gain that amplifies noise as much as signal).
PRECONDITION NOT MET (P-FAIL): if no cell satisfies P3 (the head does not beat persistence/identity),
the claim stays candidate and routes to MECH-582 (the encoder) first; that is not a falsification.
SUBSTRATE: SD-PP-B10 (substrate_queue.json) candidate test 4 is this claim's MZ2 control; the gain
itself is not yet specified as a substrate item -- a design pass is owed before any build.
REGISTRATION IS NOT BUILD AUTHORISATION. No experiment queued.

MECH-582.subject: world_model.zworld_encoder_transition_consistency
MECH-582.title:
zworld_encoder_shaped_through_the_dynamics_keeps_action_caused_change. The z_world encoder keeps the
action-caused part of the observation's per-step change only if a transition objective reaches it: the
world-forward (or E1) loss must carry gradient into the encoder through the ONLINE input z_t while the
TARGET z_{t+1} stays stop-gradient, with an anti-collapse floor against trivially predictable codes. REE
detaches both ends (agent.py buffer write; SD-070 P0 trains the encoder on static single-frame targets),
so the encoder never learns which of its directions the action moves, and action information present
in world_obs (~0.69 of the per-step change is action-attributable at the observation) is lost before
z_world (~0.22-0.38 action-attributable in z_world with an untrained encoder).
MECH-582.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS. (P1) The alpha_world operating-point probe (SD-PP-B10 test 1) must be
run FIRST and this claim tested at the alpha it selects (>= 0.9 per SD-008); if raising alpha alone
closes the gap, the claim's premise dissolves and it is scored P-FAIL, not confirmed. (P2) Collapse
guard: the participation ratio (SD-070's own metric) must not fall below the OFF arm's; a consistency
objective rewards trivially predictable codes, and a collapsed code can raise action-attributable
share by deleting everything else. (P3) All ratios blind-null-denominated per cell (GFLAG-0432), and
reference and run share machine_class (1075a handover sec. 3).
CONFIRMING: with gradient into the encoder via the online z_t (target z_{t+1} detached) plus SD-070's
hinge, at the P1 operating point, the held-out action-attributable share of dz in z_world rises toward
the observation-level share, AND the world-forward head's action-sensitivity ratio excess over the
blind null rises, with MSE-vs-identity NOT inflating (the V3-EXQ-1075 failure signature), on at least
2/3 seeds.
FALSIFYING: the action-attributable share does not rise, or rises only with a participation-ratio
collapse or MSE inflation, on at least 2/3 seeds.
PRECONDITION NOT MET (P-FAIL): if the alpha probe alone brings the action-attributable share to
within the observation-level band, this claim is not needed for CDQ-012 and should be re-scoped or
retired by /governance -- that is a legitimate outcome.
SUBSTRATE: SD-PP-B10-zworld-encoder-action-displacement (substrate_queue.json), candidate test 2.
REGISTRATION IS NOT BUILD AUTHORISATION. No experiment queued.

MECH-583.subject: world_model.reafference_locus_of_action_readability
MECH-583.title:
reafference_reading_A_zworld_is_self_cancelled_so_action_readability_lives_in_a_separate_predictor. Under
SD-007, z_world is DESIGNED to have the action-predictable self-caused change subtracted; the forward
model on the corrected z_world should therefore predict EXTERNAL dynamics, and the action-readable
signal belongs in the separate action-conditioned predictor that produced the subtraction (the
ReafferencePredictor / a prior in the RSSM sense). Demanding that world_forward read its action from a
cancelled stream asks the wrong component.
MECH-583.what_would_answer:
DISCRIMINATING OBSERVATION (shared with MECH-584). With SD-007 reafference ON and its predictor trained,
alpha_world matched across arms (>= 0.9, SD-008), and every ratio blind-null-denominated per predictor
(GFLAG-0432): apply a one-shot action-map inversion and measure the contradiction PE (inverted /
original) at three loci -- (i) the ReafferencePredictor's own comparison, (ii) world_forward trained on
corrected z_world, (iii) world_forward trained on z_world_raw.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the ReafferencePredictor must beat its trivial predictor (skill > 0 vs
copy-the-input) and the inversion must measurably change the raw per-step change (asserted from
measured output), or neither locus has anything to detect.
CONFIRMING (A): (i) carries the contradiction above its blind null on at least 2/3 seeds, (ii) does not,
AND external-event detection from corrected z_world beats z_world_raw (the Enikolopov 2018 signature:
subtraction pays off downstream).
FALSIFYING (A): (ii) or (iii) carries the contradiction while (i) does not, or corrected z_world is no
better than z_world_raw for external-event detection, on at least 2/3 seeds.
NOTE: both readings can be partly true (the two loci carry the contradiction redundantly); that
outcome demotes the pair to a design choice and is recorded rather than forced.
SUBSTRATE: the one-shot inversion lever is SD-PP-B4 (registration only; driver poke of env._action_map
is its documented workaround). REGISTRATION IS NOT BUILD AUTHORISATION. No experiment queued.

MECH-584.subject: world_model.reafference_locus_of_action_readability
MECH-584.title:
reafference_reading_B_cancellation_is_perception_side_so_the_forward_model_predicts_the_uncorrected_stream.
Under SD-007 the subtraction is a PERCEPTION-side operation on what the organism reports as external;
the forward model still receives the efference copy and predicts the reafferent change BEFORE
subtraction. world_forward should therefore be trained against z_world_raw (retained at stack.py:1513,
before both the reafference correction and the EMA), and it is on that prediction that contradiction-
based falsifiers should be posed.
MECH-584.what_would_answer:
DISCRIMINATING OBSERVATION: identical to MECH-583's (three loci under a one-shot action-map inversion,
reafference ON, alpha_world matched, blind-null-denominated), with the same non-degeneracy
precondition.
CONFIRMING (B): (iii) world_forward on z_world_raw carries the contradiction above its blind null on at
least 2/3 seeds and at least as strongly as (i) the ReafferencePredictor's comparison, while (ii) on
corrected z_world does not.
FALSIFYING (B): (iii) does not carry the contradiction, or carries it only when alpha_world differs
between arms (the EMA confound), on at least 2/3 seeds.
REGISTRATION IS NOT BUILD AUTHORISATION. No experiment queued.

MECH-585.subject: harm.pe_attribution_world_surprise_vs_model_error
MECH-585.title:
harm_prediction_error_is_attributed_to_world_surprise_only_from_a_competent_calibrated_predictor. The
harm-stream prediction error that dACC consumes is informative about the WORLD only when two conditions
hold: the harm forward model beats a trivial baseline (persistence) and the error exceeds that model's
own calibrated, per-state expected error. Error beyond calibrated expectation from a predictor that
beats baseline reads as world surprise; every other error reads as model error. The precision that
weights the harm PE must therefore be the harm predictor's OWN reliability, not a precision borrowed
from another stream.
MECH-585.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS. (P1) The harm predictor must be trained to convergence with its training
curve recorded (SD-PP-B9 piece 2), or the attribution has nothing competent to attribute to. (P2) The
expected-error estimate must be CALIBRATED: its per-state prediction must track realised squared error
on held-out transitions (coverage/rank correlation above a pre-registered floor), else "beyond
expectation" is noise. (P3) The world-surprise manipulation and the model-error manipulation must be
