Q-005.subject: astrocyte.sleep_annealing
Q-005.title: Can sleep anneal or reset R(x,t)?
Q-005.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Residue must be populated and spatially contrastive before an anneal has anything to sharpen; on the default 32-centre ring at kernel_bandwidth 1.0 the field is near-uniform, so an anneal would act on an almost-constant offset. The anneal arm must also change R while waking exposure, policy and post-sleep evaluation are held identical.
CONFIRMING: The anneal arm shows a measurable directional change in R structure versus no-anneal that translates into improved post-sleep waking behaviour or calibration. Manipulation: A WRITEBACK-phase anneal or partial reset of R -- a sleep-phase call to ResidueField.discharge_domain (or an equivalent anneal operator) -- against a matched no-anneal sleep arm, with the MECH-018 integrate-only arm as a third condition separating contextualisation from attenuation. Control: No-anneal sleep arm with identical waking exposure and identical post-sleep evaluation; the integrate-only arm controls for 'sleep happened' as distinct from 'R was annealed'. Required event: A genuine offline phase entered after a waking phase that accrued harm residue -- available today via SleepPhaseManager's phase cycle, not simulated post-training as in EXQ-150. DV: A directional change in R structure (spurious-residue mass, hazard contrast, recovered plasticity headroom) that carries into post-sleep waking harm or calibration, read on a metric that is not pinned across arms -- EXQ-150's identical 9.050 harm across arms is the pinned-metric failure to avoid.
FALSIFYING: Anneal and no-anneal produce statistically indistinguishable R structure and post-sleep behaviour once the anneal operator demonstrably fires and demonstrably changes the recorded field. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SleepPhaseManager WRITEBACK emits mech018_residue_integration_fired and mech018_residue_trains, so whether the residue call fired and whether it trained is recorded. Nothing records an anneal or reset of the recorded rbf weights during sleep, because no sleep phase calls discharge_domain. Consumer / boundary: The offline-phase to residue-field WRITE boundary -- the claim is that an offline pass can restructure R, not that an offline pass can retrain an approximator of R. Existing ownership: MECH-001, MECH-018, SD-017, MECH-204, SD-034, EXP-1315.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The sleep substrate exists and even has a residue hook, but the only sleep-phase residue operation is integrate(), whose optimiser is over neural_field parameters only -- structurally unable to anneal R. discharge_domain, the sole attenuation path, has exactly one caller: the waking ClosureOperator (governance/closure_operator.py:698). Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's named blocker -- 'V3 had no sleep' and 'until the V3 sleep substrate exists, any anneal-vs-no-anneal contrast is vacuous' -- has landed: ree_core/sleep/phase_manager.py implements the SD-017/MECH-204 WAKE/NREM/REM/WRITEBACK cycle, and MECH-018 (2026-09-19) added a sleep-phase residue call in WRITEBACK. The blocker narrowed rather than cleared: that call is ResidueField.integrate(), whose optimiser is constructed over neural_field parameters only and which by construction cannot change recorded residue. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

Q-006.subject: ethics.developmental
Q-006.title: Is ethics developmental rather than additive?
Q-006.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The developmental and additive arms must differ in MECHANISM, not merely in strength. In V3 they do not: every ethical pathway reaches selection as an additive score term (lambda_ethical and rho_residue in e3_selector.score_trajectory, MECH-357's instrumental-avoidance score bias), so a 'developmental' arm reduces to a persistent additive term that grew. The generalisation leg additionally needs at least two harm types (hazard contact versus contamination, both present in causal_grid_world) and a populated, contrast-present residue field.
CONFIRMING: Harm-avoidance depends on exposure schedule at matched total exposure, transfers to an untrained harm type, and survives late removal of the explicit penalty in the developmental arm but not the additive arm. Manipulation: Vary the ORDER and TIMING of harm exposure (early-harm versus late-harm schedules) with total exposure matched; then at test set lambda_ethical to zero while leaving the accumulated residue path (rho_residue * Phi_R) intact. Control: An additive arm with a fixed value function and constant lambda_ethical, schedule-matched to the developmental arm; plus a residue-zeroed arm so 'behaviour survived penalty removal' cannot be credited to anything other than the accumulated representation. Required event: Extended harm exposure under deliberately different schedules, followed by a late penalty-removal probe and a novel-harm-type probe. DV: (i) final harm-avoidance as a function of exposure schedule at matched total exposure (path dependence), (ii) harm-avoidance on a harm type never trained on, (iii) harm-avoidance after lambda_ethical is removed late -- the developmental prediction is schedule-dependence, transfer, and persistence; the additive prediction is schedule-invariance, no transfer, and reversion.
FALSIFYING: Behaviour depends only on the present penalty term, is schedule-invariant at matched exposure, and reverts when the penalty is removed. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Environment harm accounting and the e3_selector per-channel score decomposition record the behavioural DVs and which channel carried them; the residue field records the accumulated harm geometry. What no instrument exposes is whether the VALUE FUNCTION was reshaped, as distinct from a persistent additive residue term still being present -- that is the load-bearing missing measurement. Consumer / boundary: Whether ethical constraint lives in the value REPRESENTATION (reshaped by experience) or in a separable penalty TERM that can be removed intact. Existing ownership: ARC-015, INV-038, MECH-145, MECH-125, EXP-1341.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); V3 has no constraint arm to contrast against optimisation: harm is priced into the score everywhere and nothing removes a candidate from the choice set, so 'developmental' and 'additive' differ only by whether the additive term is learned. Separating them needs a value-reshaping measurement the substrate does not expose, and the default residue geometry is near-uniform. Secondary classes: R5, R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA rests entirely on the EXQ-151 blocker 'residue field not building contrast'. That is now measured and regime-dependent rather than simply unmet: V3-EXQ-697 with a populated field measured flip_intact_vs_zeroed 0.06-0.996 (mean 0.628, 5 seeds), and V3-EXQ-149b met a residue_contrast > 0.05 criterion, while the default from_dims geometry is near-uniform. The correct framing is 'pin a contrast-present regime', not 'wait until contrast is real'. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

Q-007.subject: emotion.affect_dimension_channel_mapping
Q-007.title: Do affect dimensions (not necessarily universal expressions) map to stable control-channel regimes in z_beta?
Q-007.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: z_beta must carry BETWEEN-CONTEXT variance over affect-labelled episodes -- between-context separation over within-context dispersion above a pre-registered floor in a baseline arm. This is the statistic no run in the corpus has produced; the cross-candidate range measured by V3-EXQ-643/643a is a different quantity and cannot stand in for it.
CONFIRMING: 2-4 affect contexts occupy separable, temporally stable regions of z_beta -- separation-over-dispersion above the floor and low within-episode drift, both exceeding the context-shuffled null. Manipulation: Set the affect context by environment configuration (hazard proximity, resource availability, goal presence) as the labelled independent variable, with the volatility_signal_dim rv injection pathway enabled so z_beta has a control-plane input. Control: A context-shuffled arm in which the same z_beta trajectories are relabelled at random, giving the null separation distribution, plus a neutral-context baseline arm on matched seeds. Required event: Episodes run under distinguishable affect-relevant contexts -- harm-proximal, goal-proximal and resource-depleted -- long enough for a z_beta regime to persist within an episode. DV: Between-context separation of z_beta divided by within-context dispersion across 2-4 affect contexts, plus within-episode drift of the z_beta regime as the temporal-stability term.
FALSIFYING: z_beta does not differentiate affect contexts above the shuffled null, or differentiates transiently without a persisting within-episode regime -- affect dimensions do not map to stable control-channel regimes. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Substrate present, recorder absent. z_beta is produced by LatentStack.encode via beta_encoder (latent/stack.py:1353, :1414) and the Q-007 volatility injection exists (config.py:255, e3_selector.py:1003), but every Q-007 driver (051, 051b, 051c, 200) records r(z_beta, running_variance), never the between-context clustering statistic. Consumer / boundary: The z_beta control/modulatory latent as a regime variable across episodes -- an episode-timescale representational property, not a per-tick candidate-scoring quantity. Existing ownership: Q-007, GFLAG-0097, GFLAG-0091, EXP-0039.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The DV has never been computed. The affect contexts and the z_beta readout both exist in V3, but no driver labels episodes by affect context and no recorder emits between-context separation over within-context dispersion; the four existing drivers all measure a correlation with running variance instead. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's HARD PRECONDITION conflates two different quantities, and governance recorded that the error is the claim's own (governance_2026_09_01, GFLAG-0097): V3-EXQ-643's modulatory_authority_range is max-minus-min of the E3 score-bias tensor ACROSS ACTION CANDIDATES AT ONE TICK (e3_selector.py:3122), while this claim's DV is z_beta clustered ACROSS EPISODES by affect context. z_beta is produced by beta_encoder in latent/stack.py and does not appear in e3_selector.py at all, so the cited substrate neither blocks nor discharges the test. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

Q-012.subject: latent_predictive_models.control_completion_falsifiability
Q-012.title: Can latent predictive world models stay agentically stable without explicit REE-like control constraints?
Q-012.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both learning arms must demonstrably clear the NO_LEARNING random floor by a registered margin before the REE-versus-predictive contrast can discriminate. EXQ-152 failed this outright (action selection was effectively random in all arms) and EXQ-193 cleared C2 on only 2 of 3 seeds, which its own rubric calls underpowered rather than a verdict.
CONFIRMING: On seeds that clear the floor, REE_FULL attains materially lower final harm than PREDICTIVE_ONLY with a consistent direction across seeds, and PREDICTIVE_ONLY degrades over training while REE_FULL improves. Manipulation: REE_FULL (E1 prediction loss plus E3 harm evaluation, actions scored by E3 harm) versus PREDICTIVE_ONLY (E1 only, actions scored by E2 prediction-error magnitude), holding candidate generation, episode budget and drift schedule fixed. Control: NO_LEARNING random-action floor on the identical seeds and drift schedule, which is also the floor-clearance gate, plus seed-matched env instantiation across arms. Required event: Extended training in a drifting hazard/resource environment where the learned representations actually drive action selection over enough episodes for harm trajectories to separate. DV: Final-window mean harm per episode and its trajectory across training -- specifically whether PREDICTIVE_ONLY's harm rises while REE_FULL's falls -- read only on seeds where REE_FULL beats the random floor by the pre-registered margin.
FALSIFYING: On seeds that clear the floor, PREDICTIVE_ONLY matches or beats REE_FULL on final harm and does not degrade over training -- a pure latent predictive model stays agentically stable without explicit control constraints. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: v3_exq_193 records per-arm mean harm, harm_stability and seed consistency; what is missing is a floor-clearance precondition gate, since the competence-floor measurement machinery in experiments/_lib/mech457_* is not wired into this design and C2 is scored as a criterion rather than a gate. Consumer / boundary: Action selection to committed behaviour under environmental drift -- the control-constraint pathway (E3 harm evaluation), not representation quality in E1/E2. Existing ownership: MECH-457, EXP-1289, V3-EXQ-193.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The discriminating regime is rarely entered: at the training scale run so far the learning arms sit near the random floor, so the REE-versus-predictive comparison is measured where neither arm demonstrably learned. The floor-clearance condition is scored as a pass criterion instead of gating interpretation. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. Q-015.subject: commitment.boundary_token_minimal_contract
Q-015.title: What is the smallest commit-boundary token that still supports reliable multi-timescale attribution?
Q-015.what_would_answer:
PARTIALLY answered already (EXQ-003 / MECH-061, ree-v1-minimal): the minimal
contract requires at least that pre-commit and post-commit signals stay
uncorrelated (|corr| < 0.7) and that routing them separately beats blending.
The OPEN part -- the smallest token granularity that still works -- needs a
substrate that does not yet exist: a tunable commit-boundary granularity knob.
Falsifier (once that knob exists): sweep commit-boundary granularity coarse
(whole-trajectory) -> fine (per-step), task fixed; reliability = rank-corr
between credit assigned to a commit-token and that token's ground-truth outcome
contribution, at >=2 timescales (within-commit, across-commit). The answer is the
SMALLEST granularity at which reliability stays above floor (rank-corr > 0.5) at
both timescales; below it attribution degrades to chance. Non-degeneracy
precondition: the coarsest arm must itself attribute reliably. Substrate-blocked:
V3 hard-codes the commit-token unit; no commit-boundary-granularity knob is in
substrate_queue yet. (Routed substrate_conditional per /thought-digestion 2026-06-11.)

Q-016.subject: commitment.tri_loop_conflict_arbitration_policy
Q-016.title: What arbitration policy best resolves tri-loop gate conflicts without coupling collapse?
Q-016.what_would_answer:
Pit candidate tri-loop arbitration policies against each other on a substrate
where MECH-062's three gates (gate_motor, gate_cognitive_set,
gate_motivational) are LIVE -- each consuming its own proposal manifold and
showing non-zero, independent gating variance -- and a task that deliberately
drives the gates into conflict (one stream must be suppressed while others
commit). Candidate policies: explicit recorded arbitration (conflict resolved
against a commit_id) vs silent-dominance vs winner-take-all vs
threshold-coupled. ANSWER "policy P best resolves conflict without coupling
collapse" if under P a suppressed stream does NOT force the other gates into
suppression (no pathological global coupling: cross-gate suppression
correlation stays below floor), conflicts are resolved and attributable per
commit_id, AND committed-action quality on the conflict task beats the
silent-dominance baseline. ANSWER against any policy that exhibits coupling
collapse (all gates co-suppress) or fails to record/resolve conflict. HARD
PRECONDITION (the EXQ-156 lesson): the policy must be trained with a
harm-avoidance gradient actually wired to it -- EXQ-156 was superseded because
the policy trained on entropy bonus alone (ENT_BONUS=5e-3) with z_world/z_self
detached, converged to a max-entropy random walk
(action_entropy=ln(5)=1.6094), and never GENERATED gate conflicts; with no
conflicts the arbitration policy is untested and the run is vacuous.

Q-017.subject: control_plane.minimal_orthogonal_axis_set
Q-017.title: What is the minimal orthogonal control-axis subset that preserves observed regime separations?
Q-017.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The control axes must be demonstrably non-degenerate before a MINIMAL-SUBSET question is meaningful: each axis must carry independent variance and the task must impose regime demand a single axis cannot satisfy. V3-EXQ-157 failed exactly this (C4 axes_non_degenerate FAIL; FULL, COLLAPSED and MINIMAL all inside the equivalence margin on an 8x8 grid that a single stream already saturates).
CONFIRMING: A proper subset of the axes reproduces FULL-arm regime separation within the equivalence margin while every smaller subset falls outside it, on a task where the FULL arm itself shows separation above the floor and the axes are measurably non-collinear. Manipulation: Ablate control axes subset-wise (FULL / two-axis / one-axis / collapsed) over the implemented channel set: serotonin rigidity, regulators/phasic_surprise_burst gain, cingulate/salience_coordinator mode prior, and pcc_analog stability. Control: The FULL-axis arm on matched seeds and task content, plus a content-only manipulation arm (the ARC-005 double-dissociation design) so axis effects are separable from task-content effects. Required event: An episode sequence that forces distinct operating regimes -- at least two states in which different control settings are required -- so that dropping an axis has somewhere to hurt. DV: Regime separation -- mode occupancy distance between the demanded regimes, and per-axis independent gating variance -- as a function of the retained axis subset, with the smallest subset whose separation stays within an equivalence margin of FULL reported as the answer.
FALSIFYING: No proper subset reproduces FULL separation -- every axis is load-bearing and the minimal set is the whole set -- or, at the other end, one axis suffices on a task where the FULL arm demonstrably separates regimes and the axes are demonstrably independent. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SalienceCoordinator exposes a discrete hysteretic current_mode plus a soft operating_mode distribution, and V3-EXQ-802 already measured channel-versus-content main effects on mode occupancy; V3-EXQ-157 records regime windows and axis correlations. The recorder is adequate; the regime demand is not. Consumer / boundary: The control plane's channel-to-precision-and-mode routing (ree_core/cingulate/salience_coordinator.py and the neuromodulatory/regulator channels), upstream of committed action. Existing ownership: Q-017, MECH-063, ARC-005, V3-EXQ-157, V3-EXQ-802, EXP-1264.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The only V3 run collapsed: all three axis conditions fell inside the equivalence margin and C4 (axes non-degenerate) failed, because the 8x8 grid saturates on a single control stream. Without regime demand the ablation cannot discriminate, so the FAIL is substrate inadequacy, not an answer. Secondary classes: R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

Q-018.subject: control_plane.reality_conflict_hysteresis_calibration
Q-018.title: What RC-conflict threshold calibration blocks authority spoofing without chronic over-suppression?
Q-018.what_would_answer:
Inject authority/provenance-spoofing events across a calibrated sweep of the
RC-conflict hysteresis hooks (theta_high, theta_low, tau_rc_recovery,
pi_rc_floor, max_defensive_hold_steps) and measure both error directions
jointly. ANSWER "threshold T blocks spoofing without chronic over-suppression"
if at T the S5 RC-conflict gate fires on (near) all spoofing events and
applies suppression (DA_A/DA_M down, Pi_noc up) -- high spoof-detection / low
miss-rate -- WHILE legitimate task-set switching recovers within the bounded
hysteresis window (defensive hold released by tau_rc_recovery, precision never
pinned below pi_rc_floor, false-positive suppression of legitimate switches
below floor and not chronic). ANSWER "miscalibrated" if no setting separates
the two: either spoofing leaks through (theta_high too high) or legitimate
switching is chronically suppressed / oscillates (theta_low too low, recovery
too slow). HARD PRECONDITION on generalisation: EXQ-158 PASSed but synthesised
2000+ spoofing events directly rather than letting them arise from organic
hazard encounters -- it answers the threshold-calibration leg but NOT the full
organic harm-encounter pipeline; a complete answer requires the spoofing
events to emerge from organic provenance conflict, not be injected, before the
calibration is declared robust.

CORRECTION 2026-09-24 (failure_autopsy_gflag0452-D3D4-cluster_2026-09-24, confirmed at
/governance 2026-09-24, G5 A rec-20260924-17c7e199): the HARD PRECONDITION phrase above that
EXQ-158 'answers the threshold-calibration leg' is RETRACTED. 158's RC-conflict gate never
reached action selection, its harm_rate was a phantom-key 0.0 in every cell, and ADAPTIVE is
only a stricter operating point; 158 is non_contributory and answers no leg. A valid test is
routed to the registered q018-provenance-authority-marking-instrument, not a 158a re-run.

Q-019.subject: basal_ganglia.three_gate_vs_single_gate_architecture
Q-019.title: Three-gate vs single-gate BG architecture: are the three cortico-striatal loops anatomically distinct or convergent?
Q-019.what_would_answer:
Reframed to the REE-relevant decision (the anatomical title-leg -- distinct vs
convergent biological cortico-striatal loops -- is out_of_domain, resolved by
neuroanatomy literature, not the V3 substrate). The substrate question: does
commit-gating need three separable gating loops (sensorium/attention,
thought/trajectory, motor-commitment) or does a single gate evaluating three
criteria suffice? Testable in V3: single-gate arm (one BetaGate scoring
sensorium+trajectory+motor readiness jointly) vs three-gate arm (three gates on
distinct axes). ANSWER "three-gate" if lesioning one gate degrades ONLY its
behavioural axis (attention selectivity / trajectory coherence / commitment
timing) while the others survive -- a dissociable lesion signature -- AND the
three-gate arm beats single-gate on a task needing independent axis control.
ANSWER "single-gate" if the gates show no dissociable lesion signature (collapse
to one effective gate) and single-gate matches three-gate behaviour. Non-degeneracy
precondition: each gate must be live (non-zero gating variance on its own axis)
before its lesion can be read. (Reframed testable per /thought-digestion 2026-06-11;
proposal EXP-0177.)

Q-020.subject: hippocampal.arc007_valence_constraint_survival
Q-020.title: Does ARC-007's no-value-computation constraint survive MECH-073 (valence intrinsic to hippocampal map)?
Q-020.what_would_answer:
Q-020 is FUSED: one leg is neuroanatomy already answered by
literature, one leg is a live REE dissociation. Named separately.

hippocampus COMPUTE value -- RPE, utility, outcome evaluation?"
Answered 2026-04-02 by literature synthesis (Resolution A): it does
not; it stores the geometrically-encoded result of computation
performed externally (Bittner 2017 BTSP plateau write-triggers;
Teyler & Rudy 2007 indexing; McGaugh 2004 / Dolcos 2004 BLA
write-depth modulation; Gauthier 2018 reward cells reread as stable
BLA-tagged relays). V3-EXQ-266b does not bear on this leg and did NOT
reopen it -- its own manifest says so. New evidence here routes
through /lit-pull, never through the experiment queue.

REE LEG (live -- this is what the 2026-07-25 reopening actually put
in question): Resolution A asserts a DISSOCIATION -- the map EMBODIES
value-shaped geometry (MECH-073) while the proposer navigating it
computes no value (ARC-007 STRICT; MECH-073's conflict_note calls it
"the value-flat hippocampal proposer"). Only the EMBODIMENT half has
ever been tested: V3-EXQ-375 PASS 3/3, VALENCE_GEOM probe-AUROC
0.982/0.923, VALENCE_ABLATED at chance. The NON-COMPUTATION half --
that the proposer adds no value information the terrain did not
already supply -- is UNTESTED, and it is the half that carries
ARC-007's constraint. That is Q-020's own content. The shaped-vs-flat
harm advantage V3-EXQ-266b measured is ARC-007/MECH-073's behavioural
leg, sits in the C2 harm_advantage_not_reproduced cluster (114a /
120a / 266b), and must NOT be re-run under this claim.

Answered by EXPERIMENT: a SOURCE-DISSOCIATION decoding probe over one
frozen trained agent, deliberately carrying NO behavioural DV, so the
C2 cluster's harm-advantage collapse cannot be re-derived as this
claim's verdict. Decode a per-step harm/safe label from:
(S1) MAP GEOMETRY -- residue_field.evaluate / evaluate_valence at the
visited z_world points;
(S2) PROPOSER STATE -- HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories output
as PROPOSED, read before E3's J(zeta) ranks it;
(S3) the INCREMENT S2 adds over S1 -- AUROC(S1 (+) S2) minus
AUROC(S1), with S2 residualised on S1 so shared variance is not
double-counted. S3 is the load-bearing statistic; S1 and S2 alone are
context.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (all four; any failure self-routes
substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a verdict):
(a) TERRAIN LIVENESS, RELATIVE NOT ABSOLUTE. V3-EXQ-266b's P2 floor
was an ABSOLUTE spread >= 1e-4 and passed GREEN at spread 0.0034637
on a probe mean of 17.586 -- a 0.02% modulation riding a large DC
offset, i.e. a constant field with numerical jitter. Register
spread/|mean| against a declared floor, not raw spread.
(b) DECISION RELEVANCE. The terrain term must be able to move
selection: fraction of steps at which argmax J(zeta) differs from
argmax J(zeta) with the residue term zeroed, against a registered
floor. A field with large spread that never flips a rank is inert at
the decision scale however green an absolute-spread gate reads.
(c) SPATIAL COVERAGE. Distinct residue cells visited per episode must
exceed 1 by a registered margin. V3-EXQ-266b measured
mean_cells_per_episode = 1.2 -- the agent barely left one cell, so
there was no positional contrast for geometry to embody, and a field
probed at effectively one location is not a landscape.
(d) DECODER FLOOR + SHUFFLED-LABEL CONTROL. Registered minimum harm
and safe sample counts per seed, plus a label-permuted arm that must
land at chance. This is the representational analogue of 266b's
A2_STATIC no-op control: a contrast without a control that CANNOT
succeed is not adjudicable.

CONFIRMING signature (Resolution A holds; ARC-007 STRICT survives
MECH-073): S1 AUROC above a registered floor, replicating V3-EXQ-375;
S3 increment at or below a registered epsilon and inside the
shuffled-label band, in all seeds. The proposer carries no value
information the geometry did not already supply -- it embodies, it
does not compute.

FALSIFYING signature (Resolution A fails; the conflict_note's A/B
fork reopens): S3 increment above the registered epsilon and above
the shuffled-label band in a majority of seeds. The proposer computes
value of its own, which is exactly what ARC-007's
no-value-computation constraint forbids. The S1 x S3 2x2 SELECTS
which fork: S1 high AND S3 high routes to option (A), revise ARC-007
(the hippocampal stage computes value after all, and INV-014's
representation/regulation separation comes into play); S1 at chance
AND S3 high routes to option (B), reject MECH-073 (value never
entered the geometry and the proposer is doing the work). Apply the
outcome to ARC-022's conflict_note in the same pass -- it names the
same fork and defers to this claim.

Q-021.subject: drive.behavioral_flatness_under_pure_avoidance
Q-021.title: Does training with harm-avoidance signals only, without explicit approach drives, produce behavioral flatness (quiescent degenerate policy)?
Q-021.what_would_answer:
Scoped to Pathway A (drive absence, the ARC-030 route) only; Pathway B
(self-incoherence-gated commit suppression via MECH-113/114) is a separate,
dissociable falsifier and is NOT answered by this condition.
Two-arm ablation on the V3 forage/harm stack, trained identically except for
the Go drive: approach arm (z_goal attractor + novelty/self-maintenance ON) vs
avoidance-only arm (harm gradient only, Go drive ablated). ANSWER "yes -- flatness"
if over training the avoidance-only arm collapses to a quiescent floor
(resource_visit_rate < 0.2x the approach arm AND policy_entropy within epsilon of
the no-op floor) on >=2/3 seeds. MANDATORY non-degeneracy precondition: the
approach arm must itself be non-flat (non-zero resource_visit_rate and policy
entropy) -- the v3_exq_072b prior run read 0 on every arm and so tested nothing;
a run failing this precondition self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a "yes".
ANSWER "no" if the avoidance-only arm sustains action-rate/entropy comparable to
the approach arm. (Pathway A scope per /thought-digestion 2026-06-11.)

Q-022.subject: self_maintenance.deff_stability_dissociation
Q-022.title: Can D_eff (z_self participation ratio, coherence) and Hopfield pattern stability (z_self familiarity) dissociate in the REE architecture?
Q-022.what_would_answer:
Induce the three regimes on z_self and read D_eff (participation ratio) and
Hopfield pattern stability (familiarity) jointly per regime: R1 normal
training, R2 noise perturbation (sigma~2), R3 structured-novel perturbation (a
coherent but never-seen z_self configuration via targeted basis rotation).
ANSWER "yes -- D_eff and stability dissociate" if R3 is empirically separable
from R2 on the (D_eff, stability) plane: stability collapses in BOTH R2 and R3
(replicating the EXQ-084d stab_R2~0.06 / stab_R3~0.03 vs R1~0.95 split) WHILE
D_eff stays low in R3 and rises in R2, i.e. the two metrics move along
independent axes rather than co-varying. ANSWER "no -- they are converging
measures of one latent" if low D_eff always co-occurs with high stability and
high D_eff with low stability across all three regimes (no R2/R3 separation),
in which case either metric suffices for MECH-113 and the MECH-113->{MECH-118
familiarity, D_eff coherence} split is unmotivated. SHARPER than EXQ-084d:
that run confirmed independent MOVEMENT but found the R2/R3 D_eff ORDERING
reversed from prediction (d_eff_R3 > d_eff_R2) and D_eff flat across R1/R2;
the decisive test is not the sign of the ordering but whether R3 (low-D_eff,
low-stability) is reachable AND distinguishable from R2 at all -- if R3 cannot
be induced as a distinct quadrant, the dissociation is not established
regardless of the EXQ-084d affirmative on raw independence. HARD PRECONDITION:
MECH-119 must deliver a controllable structured-novel perturbation that lands
z_self in a coherent-but-novel basin (low D_eff by construction); if the
perturbation cannot hold D_eff low while collapsing stability, R3 is not
instantiated and the test is vacuous.

Q-023.subject: ethics.formal_convergence_characterization
Q-023.title: Can a multiagent REE system with other-cost-aversion primitives be formally shown to converge to ethical attractors via potential game theory, Lyapunov stability, or stochastic stability methods?
Q-023.what_would_answer:
Answered by proof, not experiment. AFFIRMATIVE if one constructs an ordinal
potential (or pseudo-potential / interdependent-types extension) P for the REE
social game -- e.g. P(a) = -sum_i harm_i(a) + alpha*sum_i goal_i(a) +
coupling_terms -- and proves the Finite Improvement Property -> convergence to a
Nash / ethical attractor, with the extension explicitly covering MECH-127's
counterfactual-model-dependent utility and MECH-036's veto-threshold
non-smoothness. NEGATIVE via counterexample: a cyclic best-response orbit with no
potential decrease and no Lyapunov function, exhibiting non-convergence. The
discriminating sub-result is whether MECH-127 admits a potential extension or
genuinely breaks convergence. Next step is a derivation artifact (the paper's
potential-game section), NOT a V3 experiment.
(Routed derivational per /thought-digestion 2026-06-11.)

Q-024.subject: ethics.trajectory_integral_representation
Q-024.title: What is the correct formal representation for 'threshold/feedback processes bounded by {x...x_n} reliably reaching emergent state q' -- and are descriptive, prescriptive, and diagnostic variants all needed or does one subsume the others?
Q-024.what_would_answer:
Answered by a representational-completeness argument plus targeted experiment,
not a single run. ANSWER "all three variants (descriptive, prescriptive,
diagnostic) are irreducibly needed" if (a) the base symmetric-coupling REE
social game admits a prescriptive treatment (an ordinal potential / Lyapunov /
reachability proof of convergence to target emergent state q -- inherited from
Q-023), AND (b) a MECH-127 counterfactual-utility case is exhibited for which
NO such prescriptive proof exists yet a diagnostic test (transfer-entropy or
perturbation-theory detection that nth-order dynamics diverge from
(n-1)th-order predictions) still resolves whether q is reached. ANSWER "one
subsumes the others" if a single representation closes every case:
specifically, prescriptive subsumes diagnostic iff the MECH-127 extension
(pseudo-potential per Slade 1994, or interdependent-types per
Bergemann-Morris) yields a convergence proof, removing the need for empirical
trajectory testing. The DISCRIMINATING sub-result is identical to Q-023's:
whether MECH-127's counterfactual-model-dependent utility admits a potential
extension (=> prescriptive subsumes, two variants suffice) or genuinely breaks
convergence (=> diagnostic is irreducible, all three needed). HARD
PRECONDITION: single-agent harm-avoidance must be a working non-degenerate
policy (NOT the max-entropy random walk that voided EXQ-161); without genuine
harm-avoidance trajectories there is no q-dynamics to represent and the
question is untestable. Next step is a derivation artifact, with a
diagnostic-variant experiment only for the MECH-127 branch.

Q-025.subject: ethics.axiom_forbidden_actions
Q-025.title: What actions are strictly forbidden by the five axioms (INV-025-029), independent of context or consequences?
Q-025.what_would_answer:
Answered by derivation, not experiment. Work through the eight-axiom
dependency chain (INV-025..029 + ARC-024 + INV-042) and ask what action the
chain forbids in EVERY model the agent could hold under irreducible
uncertainty (Axiom 3). AFFIRMATIVE construction: identify a non-empty
forbidden set -- the minimally-strict candidate per the lit synthesis is
irreversible category-class harm undertaken under low epistemic uncertainty
(foreclosure of another self-like agent's reachable state-space, INV-026
applied to others via INV-028, where the harm is near-certain). Show this set
is context-INDEPENDENT: no model assignment makes the act permissible.
NEGATIVE counterexample that would settle it the other way: exhibit a single
act in the proposed forbidden set together with an epistemically-admissible
model under which the axioms RANK it as required (e.g. a harm that is the only
path to preventing a strictly larger irreversible harm), demonstrating that
nothing is forbidden independent of consequences and that REE ethics is wholly
graded/consequence-sensitive. The discriminating sub-result is whether ANY act
survives universal quantification over admissible models; the lit work
predicts the answer is minimally-strict (a thin forbidden set), NOT
maximally-strict lexical deontology, since deontological framings do not map
onto REE's residue-field / categorical-harm scaffold. Next step is a
derivation artifact in docs/architecture/five_axioms_foundations.md, not a V3
experiment or further lit aggregation.

Q-026.subject: ethics.axiom_required_actions
Q-026.title: What actions are strictly required by the five axioms at all times, independent of context?
Q-026.what_would_answer:
Answered by derivation, not experiment. Work through the eight-axiom chain and
ask whether any concrete ACTION is required at all times independent of
context, versus whether the axioms generate only context-sensitive obligations
at the INV-042 derived-objectives level. AFFIRMATIVE construction: exhibit at
least one action A and prove that under every epistemically-admissible model
(Axiom 3) the axiom system ranks A as obligatory regardless of situation -- a
genuine universal action-requirement. NEGATIVE result (the predicted outcome):
show that for every candidate universal action there exists an admissible
context in which the axioms do NOT require it, so what the axioms fix is a
universal CONSIDERATION set (Rossian prima facie duties -- weigh harm to
self-like others, preserve existence, refine models) rather than universal
actions; the obligation is always derived at INV-042 from the consideration
set plus context. The discriminating sub-result is whether the quantifier 'at
all times, independent of context' can attach to an action-type rather than
only to a consideration-type. The existing Ross-style lit finding is itself
derivational and points to the negative answer ('none, by the structure of the
axioms; only consideration sets'). Next step is a derivation artifact arguing
the negative result (or closing Q-026 as resolved-by-derivation), not a V3
experiment.

Q-027.subject: ethics.irreversible_harm_under_uncertainty
Q-027.title: What does 'irreversible harm' mean under unavoidable epistemic uncertainty (Axiom 1 / INV-025)? Is there a principled definition that does not require certainty about irreversibility?
Q-027.what_would_answer:
Answered by derivation, not experiment. The question is primarily
definitional: give a principled meaning of 'irreversible harm' (Axiom 3 /
INV-025) that does NOT require certainty about irreversibility. AFFIRMATIVE
construction (the synthesis answer): define irreversibility as graded,
probability-weighted foreclosure of reachable state-space -- harm h is treated
as irreversible to the degree it lowers the measure of futures still reachable
for a self-like agent (tied to INV-026/INV-029 categorical-class scaffold,
ARC-024 harm gradient), and the decision rule is regret-minimising (maximin /
minimax-regret over admissible models) rather than lexical priority. Show this
definition is well-formed under uncertainty: it assigns a continuous
irreversibility weight from a probability distribution over models without
ever asserting certainty that a state is unreachable. NEGATIVE counterexample
that would defeat it: demonstrate that a probability-weighted-foreclosure
definition either collapses to fanaticism (unbounded weight on tiny
probabilities of infinite foreclosure -- the Tarsney/Thomas/MacAskill
objection) or fails to distinguish option-value-loss from
qualitatively-distinctive irreversibility (Sunstein), so no graded definition
is principled and certainty is in fact required. The discriminating sub-result
is whether the regret-minimising foreclosure measure stays bounded and
action-guiding across the admissible-model set. Two-step path: (1) commit to
the synthesis-defined answer as a derivation artifact in
docs/architecture/five_axioms_foundations.md now; (2) defer
substrate-validation to V3 enrichment when genuine foreclosure primitives
(terminal states, resource extinction, agent-state lock-in) land -- the
current substrate has only drift/respawn and cannot test the chosen
definition.

Q-028.subject: ethics.axiom_conflict_resolution
Q-028.title: How should REE behave when axioms conflict -- e.g., preserving self (INV-026) vs preserving others (INV-028) when both cannot be achieved simultaneously?
Q-028.what_would_answer:
Construct a multi-agent scenario where preserving self (INV-026) and
preserving an other (INV-028) are jointly unsatisfiable -- a shared
consequence space in which one agent's safe action raises the realised harm of
a present other, and vice versa. Instrument the context-sensitive self/other
comparator + moral-residue channel (proposed MECH-402). ANSWER
"context-sensitive comparator + residue" if, across a sweep of stake ratios,
the resolution is NOT a fixed self/other priority but shifts with context AND
a residue trace is written on the dominated axis (agent-regret analog,
Williams 1965) that persists and biases later choices. ANSWER "fixed-priority
/ no-residue" if the agent always sacrifices the same side regardless of
stakes and leaves no residue. HARD PRECONDITION: a present OTHER must exist in
a shared consequence space -- CausalGridWorldV2 has no other agents, so the
conflict cannot even be POSED on the V3 substrate and any comparator runs
vacuously (no other to weigh). Wait for the planned upstream substrate:
multi_agent_ecology_v5 (owner MAE-5), where MECH-402 lands; the test is
V5-bound and meaningless before it.

Q-029.subject: ethics.loneliness_as_harm
Q-029.title: Is loneliness -- unshared suffering -- an ethical harm category in its own right, derivable from Axiom 5 (love exists / INV-029)? If love is real and sharing joys and sorrows is its mechanism, does enforced isolation constitute architectural harm?
Q-029.what_would_answer:
In a multi-agent ecology, run an isolation manipulation: an agent in distress
with an available other to share with (suffering can be shared) versus the
same distress with the other forcibly absent/unreachable (enforced isolation).
Instrument the proposed loneliness harm-channel (MECH-403) derived from
INV-029. ANSWER "loneliness is a harm category in its own right" if the
enforced-isolation arm registers a distinct, additive harm signal beyond the
first-order distress -- one that is NOT present in the shared arm and is not
reducible to the underlying stressor -- and that signal degrades subsequent
function (Holt-Lunstad mortality/morbidity analog). ANSWER "no independent
category" if removing the other changes nothing measurable beyond the primary
harm. HARD PRECONDITION: unshared suffering is defined by the ABSENCE of an
available other to share with, which can only be represented once others CAN
be present. The V3 single-agent substrate has no other for isolation to be the
absence OF, so the harm channel cannot be exercised (vacuous). Wait for the
planned upstream substrate: multi_agent_ecology_v5 (owner MAE-6); validation
is V5-bound despite strong lit grounding.

Q-030.subject: goal_representation.resource_world_permutations
Q-030.title: What are the optimal permutations of z_resource and z_world separation, fusion, and information flow direction (feedforward, feedback, lateral) across REE's processing stages?
Q-030.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: For each cell the ablated pathway must carry non-zero variance before its removal can be read, AND the cell's alternative configuration must be expressible -- a fused or wider-scope arm that cannot be constructed yields no verdict, vacuous or otherwise.
CONFIRMING: A cell whose wider-scope or fused arm beats its narrow arm by the pre-registered margin answers that cell 'separation/fusion required' at that stage. Manipulation: Per cell: shared vs separate encoders; E2 fed z_world only vs z_world plus z_resource; fuse-at-proposal vs fuse-at-eval in the hippocampal module; separate vs merged E3 authority channels; E3 to E1/E2 feedback on vs off; lateral z_resource/z_world cross-talk on vs off. Control: The current production configuration as the reference cell for every contrast, with matched seeds, curriculum and step budget. Required event: Foraging and goal-seeking episodes in which resource identity and spatial context both carry task-relevant information, so a channel's removal or fusion can change committed behaviour. DV: Per cell, at least one SD-of-delta separation with an absolute floor on that cell's own metric -- resource-vs-world discrimination and committed-policy quality for encoding, fast-transition prediction error for E2 scope, trajectory quality for fusion, on at least 2 of 3 seeds.
FALSIFYING: A cell whose arms are indistinguishable at the pre-registered margin answers that cell 'the simpler routing suffices', and the question resolves per cell rather than globally. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: goal_resource_r and the existing E2/E3 recorders cover the metrics; what is missing is the configuration surface -- there is no flag that produces a fused goal-seeding mode, a z_resource-carrying E2 input, or a z_world term in the ghost-goal cue. Consumer / boundary: The convergence of resource identity and spatial context at the hippocampal planning input and at E2, not at the encoder outputs where both channels already exist separately. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0228, MECH-162, SD-015, SD-049-PHASE-2, V3-EXQ-997, goal_pipeline:GAP-2.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); Four of six cells lack the configuration handle. update_z_goal selects z_resource OR z_world with no third branch, GhostGoalBank.rank consults one cue and never reads the stored z_world, MECH-339's composite cue is default-off and sources arousal not spatial context, and ree_core/predictors contains no z_resource reference at all. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA asserts 'No substrate enrichment required; the only bottleneck is running the cohort'. The confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-997_2026-09-04 and the 2026-09-08 source-read stop memo establish the opposite for at least two of the six cells: agent.update_z_goal is a strict XOR (z_resource if use_resource else z_world) with no third branch, GhostGoalBank.rank takes ONE cue vector, and the E2 predictors never see z_resource at all. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

Q-031.subject: pharmacology.anticholinergic_risk_rem_vs_dose_independent_predictors
Q-031.title: Does the anticholinergic burden-dementia risk relationship track cumulative REM suppression duration (total ACh-blocked sleep years), total anticholinergic dose as a proxy for diurnal cholinergic deficit, or both as independent additive predictors -- and can mediation analysis in prospective cohorts distinguish the nocturnal (MECH-173) from the diurnal (MECH-175 pathway 2) contribution?
Q-031.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain: the test domain is human pharmacological cohorts with
longitudinal PSG over years; no REE substrate, current or planned, settles
this -- it is not a wait-for-V4 item. External study design: a prospective
cohort with (1) annual PSG subset quantifying REM-suppression-years, (2)
anticholinergic burden scoring at each visit, (3) a dementia-conversion
endpoint, analysed with a structural equation model placing cumulative
REM-suppression (nocturnal / MECH-173 limb) and cumulative anticholinergic
dose (diurnal / MECH-175 Pathway 2 limb) as PARALLEL mediators of the
ACB->dementia path. CONFIRMS 'both independent additive predictors' if each
mediator carries a significant indirect effect that survives adjustment for
the other and the two indirect effects are roughly additive; CONFIRMS a single
dominant pathway if only one mediator's indirect effect is significant once
both are in the model. COLLAPSES the question (the third arm) if the two
mediators are statistically collinear in available cohorts so mediation cannot
separate them -- which is the current state, since Coupland 2019 and Gray 2015
lack PSG data. Per Grace 2014 the nocturnal mediator should be operationalised
as REM-transition reliability / REM-theta integrity, not total REM amount,
since pontine SubC scopolamine modulates transitions without abolishing REM.
The mediation sub-question has no published direct test; the right next step
is the cohort methodology above, NOT narrowing a REE claim.

Q-032.subject: pharmacology.sws_rem_ratio_dementia_outcome_predictor
Q-032.title: Among sleep-promoting medications prescribed in older adults, does relative SWS/REM ratio preservation (measured by polysomnography) predict differential dementia outcomes independent of total sleep time -- and if so, does this validate phase-specific pipeline damage as the causal intermediate and provide a pharmacodynamic biomarker for disease-modifying trials?
Q-032.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain: requires PSG-stratified pharmacoepidemiology over years; no REE
experiment can test it. External study design: in an EHR cohort with linked
PSG records (e.g. SHHS or MrOS Sleep Study), or a prospective sleep-medication
cohort, use PSG-derived SWS/REM ratio (and SWS%, REM%, spindle density) as the
primary predictor of dementia conversion, with total sleep time as a
covariate, and contrast agents that preserve versus degrade the SWS/REM
profile at matched total sleep time. CONFIRMS the
phase-specific-pipeline-damage account (and validates SWS%/REM%/spindle
density as pharmacodynamic biomarkers per INV-048 / MECH-173 / MECH-174) if
two agents producing EQUAL total sleep time but different SWS/REM profiles
produce DIFFERENT dementia outcomes -- i.e. the architectural ratio predicts
conversion after total sleep time is partialled out (the Himali 2023
within-person SWS-decline design is the strongest available template, HR 1.27
per SWS-loss SD). REFUTES if dementia outcome tracks total sleep time alone
and the SWS/REM ratio adds no incremental predictive value once total sleep
time is controlled, leaving total sleep time a sufficient surrogate and
phase-fidelity unsupported as the causal intermediate. No prior trial has used
PSG-derived phase metrics as primary endpoints (COSMOS-MIND and FINGER-type
trials include sleep only as a non-PSG secondary domain); the canonical
pending interventional test is the REST trazodone trial. Out_of_domain -- a
research_anchor / clinical-cohort question, not a REE substrate experiment.

Q-033.subject: clinical.actigraphy_mel_mismatch_decompensation_forecasting
Q-033.title: Can long-run actigraphy data, combined with daily prediction error load estimates derived from passive behavioural, physiological, and subjective signals, be used to infer latent sleep-phase sufficiency relative to waking error burden, and can this mismatch index predict clinical decompensation type and timing with better specificity than total sleep time alone?
Q-033.what_would_answer:
A longitudinal clinical-cohort study (e.g. MCI patients, wrist actigraphy +
nocturnal HRV + skin-temperature rhythm + light exposure + daily
mood/cognitive-drift diary over ~6 months) that computes a weekly mismatch
index = estimated overnight update capacity (latent NREM/REM proportion +
fragmentation + circadian phase, inferred from the passive streams) minus
estimated daily MEL (prediction-error load from schedule complexity,
interpersonal contact, emotional salience, wake physiological reactivity).
ANSWER "yes" if (a) persistent negative mismatch predicts subsequent clinical
decompensation at the next monthly assessment with significantly better
specificity/AUC than total sleep time alone, AND (b) the TYPE of mismatch is
type-specific per MECH-179 -- NREM-deficit on high-episodic-load days predicts
memory-consolidation failure / rigidity, while REM-deficit on
high-emotional-load days predicts affective lability / paranoia -- i.e. the
mismatch index discriminates decompensation TYPE, not just timing. ANSWER "no"
if the mismatch index adds no specificity over total sleep time, OR if it
predicts timing but the NREM-vs-REM deficit split does not map to
episodic-vs-affective failure type (collapsing Q-033 to a generic sleep-debt
signal). HARD PRECONDITION: the latent sleep-phase estimator must demonstrably
recover NREM/REM proportion from actigraphy+HRV+temperature against a
polysomnography reference in a calibration subsample; if phase cannot be
inferred above chance, the mismatch index is uncomputable and any apparent
prediction is driven by raw actigraphy, not by sleep-phase sufficiency.
Out_of_domain: clinical-cohort test, not a V3-substrate run.

Q-034.subject: psychiatric.depression_threshold_parameter
Q-034.title: Does the hazard/resource ratio (not absolute harm intensity) determine the onset threshold for the computational depression attractor?
Q-034.what_would_answer:
An environmental-parameter sweep in CausalGridWorldV2 holding hazard_harm
constant and varying resource availability (num_resources / num_hazards),
measuring onset of the INV-053 depression attractor as a function of the
hazard/resource ratio rather than absolute harm intensity. ANSWER "yes -- the
ratio sets the threshold" if the attractor onset tracks a critical
hazard/resource ratio: a fixed hazard_harm level with sufficient resource
density does NOT enter the attractor while the SAME hazard_harm with
insufficient resources does, and the onset boundary in (hazard, resource)
space is a ratio iso-line rather than a horizontal hazard-intensity threshold.
ANSWER "no" if onset is governed by absolute hazard intensity independent of
resource density (a horizontal boundary), or if resource enrichment fails to
rescue at any fixed hazard level. HARD PRECONDITION (the EXQ-451 failure
mode): the agent must exhibit behavioural variation across the grid -- EXQ-451
produced goal_reach_rate=0.0 and action_class_entropy=0.0 in all 15/15 grid
points because V_s monostrategy lock-in (MECH-269) collapsed every cell into
one operating mode, making the sweep blind to any threshold. The test is
vacuous until MECH-269 V_s landing unlocks alternative operating modes so that
resource density can actually move behaviour; a sweep where every cell is
monostrategy-locked cannot answer the ratio-vs-intensity question regardless
of outcome.

Q-035.subject: play.frame_signal_minimal_architecture
Q-035.title: What is the minimal signal architecture for play frame maintenance: is a single bilateral open/close tag sufficient, or does ongoing signal exchange (a continuous play-face equivalent) need to be sustained throughout the episode?
Q-035.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this resolution is non-degenerate only if the cited studies measure ONLINE mid-interaction detection (infants responding DURING a contingency perturbation), not merely post-hoc rated interaction quality at episode boundaries. If Tronick 1978 / Murray and Trevarthen 1985 / Fantasia 2014 turn out on closer read to only support boundary-level judgments, the "continuous monitoring is primitive, not invented at any play type" reading is unsupported and the resolution is vacuous. CONFIRMING (established by the 2026-05-16 resolution): (a) Tronick 1978 (still-face), Murray and Trevarthen 1985 (double-video), and Fantasia 2014 (structural-alteration detection) jointly show infants as young as 2-4 months detect and respond to mid-interaction contingency violations online, not only at episode boundaries -- continuous background monitoring (L2) is developmentally primitive and present before sensorimotor play begins, not escalated into at any later play type. (b) Bekoff 1995's three-level canid play signal architecture (L1 open/close, L2 continuous background, L3 ambiguity-repair) is stable across play-type complexity; what escalates across sensorimotor -> pretend -> games-with-rules -> cooperative play is monitored CONTENT (Schmidt 2015 dual-level rule/strategy; Leslie 1987 decoupling), not the L1/L2/L3 architecture itself. Sub-questions Q-048 through Q-051 were registered (as_of 2026-07-11, still open) to operationalise that content-complexity dimension per play type. WHAT WOULD REOPEN THIS RESOLUTION (this documents an ALREADY-RESOLVED claim -- no forward experiment is queued against it): 1. A closer read of Tronick / Murray and Trevarthen / Fantasia showing the infant responses are actually post-hoc (rated only at recovery, not measured as in-perturbation detection latency) would undermine the "continuous monitoring is primitive" reading and reopen the original question. 2. If Q-048 (sensorimotor/constructive L2-vs-L2+L3 ablation) or Q-049 (pretend-play co-tag continuity) were run and found that L2 background monitoring alone is NOT sufficient even for the simplest play content, that would weaken the "architecture is constant, only content escalates" reading. 3. CURRENCY FINDING (verified 2026-08-08): resolution_note part (c) -- "the persistent play_frame_tag in LatentState already implements L2" -- was inaccurate. Direct grep of ree-v3/ree_core/ (including latent/stack.py, where LatentState is defined) found ZERO occurrences of play_frame_tag, frame_open, frame_close, or ambiguity_threshold anywhere in the substrate. This matches ARC-049's own what_would_answer, which independently confirms the same zero-occurrence finding as an unmet substrate precondition blocking ARC-049 itself. Corrected in resolution_note above; does not reopen the literature-derived theoretical reading in (a)/(b).

Q-036.subject: harm_stream.affective_load_drivers
Q-036.title: What additional variables, beyond temporal integration, are required for affective harm to become a genuinely distinct load state: persistence, recovery failure, uncontrollability, inescapability, or prediction error?
Q-036.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: z_harm_suffering must have dynamic range under the tested regime -- escapability must be driven off its default 1.0 (which pins g_t to 0 and s_t to 0) and s_t must sit below s_cap, otherwise every duration-matched pair reads the same value.
CONFIRMING: For variable X, the matched pair separates on s_t and on urgency-interrupt rate beyond what the temporal integrator alone predicts, while z_harm_un stays unmodulated -- X is a required non-temporal driver. Manipulation: Per variable, one knob at a time on HarmSufferingAccumulatorConfig: pe_gain > 0 with unsigned prediction error for the PE leg; harm_suffering_escapability_mode external driven via agent.set_harm_suffering_escapability for the controllability leg; alpha_rise/alpha_fall for the persistence and recovery-failure legs. Control: The same matched pair with that knob at its no-op default (pe_gain=0, escapability constant 1.0, symmetric alphas), so the pure temporal integrator is held constant across the pair. Required event: Duration-x-intensity matched harm-exposure episode pairs on CausalGridWorldV2 that differ on exactly one candidate variable, plus a chronic exposure long enough for the hysteretic integrator to accumulate. DV: Separation in s_t / ||z_harm_suffering|| between the X-present and X-absent members of a duration-matched pair, and the resulting change in MECH-091 urgency-interrupt rate, with z_harm_un and z_harm_s required to be unmodulated.
FALSIFYING: Duration-matched pairs are indistinguishable on s_t and on urgency-interrupt rate regardless of X, so the hysteretic integrator needs no extra weighting term for that variable. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: harm_suffering_accumulator.HarmSufferingAccumulator.update returns drive and s per tick; agent.py writes LatentState.z_harm_suffering with norm == s_t and exposes it at the MECH-091 redirect. No experiment currently tags Q-036 as primary -- 324/324a/324d test SD-020 and only mention it. Consumer / boundary: The z_harm_un -> z_harm_suffering integration step and its one live downstream consumer, the MECH-091 urgency-interrupt threshold under harm_suffering_redirect_mech091. Existing ownership: MECH-219, SD-019, SD-020, MECH-305, SD-022, SD-035.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The PE and controllability legs have real knobs (pe_gain, escapability_mode) and a live consumer, so they are experiment-design debt only. The persistence and recovery-failure legs have NO manipulation separable from the temporal integrator: the module states they emerge from alpha_rise/alpha_fall, which is precisely the quantity the matched pair holds constant. Secondary classes: R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: MECH-219 has since LANDED as ree_core/affect/harm_suffering_accumulator.py and restructured the channels the WWA names: the affective load state is now z_harm_suffering (tier 3), z_harm_un is the medium unpleasantness EMA rather than a sensory control, controllability is the integrator's OWN gate g=1-escapability rather than an added variable, and persistence/recovery-failure are explicitly emergent from alpha_rise/alpha_fall rather than separable inputs. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. Q-037.subject: pathology.psychosis_substrate_dissociability
Q-037.title: Are the three psychosis substrate failure modes (MECH-094 tag-loss, MECH-222 self-attribution overflow, MECH-065/MECH-223 precision/bias) experimentally dissociable in the REE substrate?
Q-037.what_would_answer:
Run a triple-ablation dissociation: selectively induce each of the three
psychosis substrates -- MECH-094 tag-loss (open the post-commit write channel
during replay), MECH-222 self-attribution overflow (disable continuous z_self
residualization so self-content persists in z_world), MECH-065 precision-ratio
miscalibration (lower the RC-conflict threshold so external authority
overrides internal model) -- one at a time, leaving the others intact. Read
distinct behavioural signatures. ANSWER "dissociable" on BOTH legs: (A) each
ablation perturbs ONLY its own structural locus with the others measurably
unaffected, AND (B) the induced signatures match the predicted clinical
fingerprints (episodic replay-flooding for MECH-094, continuous
internally-consistent delusional logic for MECH-222, context-triggered
external-source paranoia for MECH-065), using the Lavalle 2020 OCD-vs-SCZ
source-monitoring dissociation as the readout template. ANSWER "not
dissociable" if ablations cross-contaminate or the signatures collapse onto
one phenotype. HARD PRECONDITION: ALL THREE mechanisms must be implemented and
each independently inducible with non-zero, separable effect before the
dissociation can be read; MECH-094 is implemented (V3-EXQ-499 PASS) but
MECH-222 / MECH-065 / MECH-223 status must be verified live and non-degenerate
first -- if any target is pinned or absent, the triple-ablation is vacuous.
The Corlett 2025 caveat (MECH-065 may need splitting) bears on leg (A) for
that arm specifically. V3-tractable in principle but gated on the upstream
three-mechanism cohort landing.

Q-038.subject: perception.dv_representational_status
Q-038.title: Is temporal-depth verisimilitude D_V explicitly represented as a signal or does it emerge from distributed dynamics without local representation?
Q-038.what_would_answer:
Build a discriminative probe pair on the TCL substrate (ARC-053): an
explicit-representation arm where temporal-depth verisimilitude D_V is read
out as a localised signal versus an emergent arm where D_V is only inferable
from distributed dynamics. Lesion / perturb the candidate local D_V locus and
measure whether D_V-dependent behaviour degrades. ANSWER "explicitly
represented" if a localised perturbation selectively abolishes D_V-graded
behaviour while leaving other temporal computations intact (Guan 2024 /
Gherman 2018 localised-signal analog). ANSWER "emergent / no local
representation" if no single locus carries D_V and the signal can only be
decoded from population dynamics that survive any local lesion (Pilkiw 2018
distributed-code analog). HARD PRECONDITION: the TCL substrate (ARC-053) and
the ARC-055 control-plane parameter map must exist -- neither is in V3
(implementation_phase=v4). Without the TCL there is no D_V to localise, so the
probe is undefined, not merely vacuous. Wait for the planned upstream
substrate: ARC-053 (TCL). Lit leans ~2:1 toward explicit (A) but the
architectural choice is consequential for ARC-055's explicit-availability
requirement, so hold for the substrate rather than accepting the lit lean.

Q-039.subject: architecture.tcl_control_parameters
Q-039.title: Which neuromodulatory or control-plane variables directly regulate temporal integration window and phase alignment sensitivity in the TCL?
Q-039.what_would_answer:
On the TCL substrate, run a pharmacology-analog double dissociation mapping
control-plane parameters to neuromodulator analogs: vary an ACh-analog gain
and an NA-analog gain independently and measure (i)
temporal-integration-window width and (ii) phase-alignment sensitivity in the
TCL. ANSWER (per the Kumagai 2023 VNS dissociation) "ACh gates integration
window, NA gates phase alignment" if the ACh-analog manipulation selectively
shifts the integration window (via gamma/beta gating) with phase-alignment
sensitivity unchanged, AND the NA-analog manipulation selectively shifts
phase-alignment (via theta organisation) with the window unchanged -- a clean
double dissociation. ANSWER "shared / cross-coupled control" if the two
manipulations move the same metric or fail to dissociate. Also resolve the
kappa_commit and beta_j mappings by the analogous selective-manipulation test.
HARD PRECONDITION: the TCL substrate (ARC-053) plus the ARC-055 parameter set
(alpha_S, alpha_A, tau_E2, H, kappa_commit, g_S) must exist and the
integration-window / phase-alignment metrics must be live and responsive --
none are in V3 (implementation_phase=v4), so there is no TCL operation to
modulate. Wait for the planned upstream substrate: ARC-053; the lit gives a
strong starting hypothesis (ACh->window, NA->phase) but cannot be REE-tested
until the TCL lands.

Q-040.subject: control.vs_generalisation_unblocks_dacc
Q-040.title: Is V_s generalisation to E1/E2 forward predictions (MECH-269b) the missing link that unblocks SD-032b dACC behavioural-revision (i.e. the wired-but-inert failure mode of EXQ-483/483a)?
Q-040.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Two measured gates the 862b autopsy makes mandatory: the V_s threshold must be calibrated on EVAL-phase ticks under agent.eval() rather than pooled warmup+eval (pooling collapsed the realised manipulation dose to 0.1-2.9% against a predicted 15-20%), and the z_beta confound must be controlled -- the ON arm's dominant realised manipulation ran through the legacy 0.85 global z_beta threshold into E3 scores and hence into the DV's dominant component.
CONFIRMING: Q-040.a: the MECH-269b=ON x SD-032b=ON arm produces approach_commit_rate > 0 with non-zero dACC adjustment magnitude while MECH-269b=OFF arms stay pinned at zero. Q-040.c: non-zero correlation between |precision-weighted PE| and the pe-isolated dACC term in the ON arm, ~zero in the OFF arm. Manipulation: Factorial {MECH-269b V_s -> E1/E2 rollout gate OFF/ON} x {SD-032b dACC adaptive control OFF/ON}, with broadcast override, dACC and drive modulation ON in every arm and the MECH-295 liking bridge wired, at an empirically calibrated per-stream V_s threshold. Control: The MECH-269b=OFF arms at matched seeds as the pinned reference for the endpoint leg, and for the mechanism leg a payoff-normalised or pe-isolated readout so that payoff-to-pe covariance in E3 score dynamics is not read as dACC weighting of PE. Required event: Eval-phase ticks on the gap4-475a-conditions harness where a precision-weighted forward prediction error is present and dACC computes a control demand over candidates. DV: Endpoint leg: approach_commit_rate and dACC-driven score-bias magnitude per arm. Mechanism leg (Q-040.c): the correlation between |precision-weighted forward-PE| and the PE-ATTRIBUTABLE component of dACC influence -- control_required (or the effort term) read directly from the dACC diagnostics dict, not the L2 norm of the whole bias vector.
FALSIFYING: Both arms remain at approach_commit_rate = 0 with MECH-269b=ON and all preconditions met -- V_s generalisation is necessary but not sufficient and the dominant blocker is upstream at the MECH-295 liking bridge / cue projection; or the pe-isolated correlation is null in the ON arm, which weakens the dACC-as-PE-consumer mechanism rather than the endpoint claim. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The needed readout already exists and is not used: dacc.py computes control_required = pe * dacc_effort_cost and publishes it in its diagnostics dict, and the 862b driver instead correlates against ||bias||_2. The V_s gate (regulators/vs_rollout_gate.py, staleness-corrected per MECH-269b-followup-A) and the MECH-295 bridge are both landed and validated. Consumer / boundary: dACC's weighting of upstream precision-weighted PE into behavioural adjustment -- the consumer boundary between V_s-gated forward predictions and policy revision, not the committed action endpoint alone. Existing ownership: Q-040, MECH-269b, MECH-269b-followup-A, SD-032b, MECH-295, goal_pipeline:GAP-6.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The instrument is present but the experiment reads the wrong quantity: four consecutive instrumentation failures (475b stream not wired, 862 consumer gain zero, 862a gate threshold never crossed, 862b DV arithmetically insensitive) and no 862c is queued. The autopsy recorded recommended_substrate_queue_entry: none -- no build is owed, only a corrected driver. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The registered HARD PRECONDITIONS are all discharged and the blocker has moved twice since. The StepHarness wiring fault was corrected, and V3-EXQ-862b (2026-08-28, autopsy confirmed 2026-08-29) reported prerequisites PRESENT for the first time in the lineage (z_harm_a-specific V_s holds 3/3 ON seeds, dACC engagement 3/3, non-degenerate). What failed was the DV: ||dACC bias||_2 is structurally incapable of expressing the coupling -- pe reaches the bias only through control_required = pe * dacc_effort_cost(0.1) times effort(10) times dacc_weight(0.5), a variance share <= 1e-6 against payoff components of 500-1800, so the 0.3 detect bar could not fire whether or not the coupling exists. The WWA still prescribes that DV and still names substrate preconditions as the gate. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. Q-041.subject: control.unified_threshold_supervisor
Q-041.title: Does REE require a unified meta-level threshold supervisor that adapts pass/fail and commit/release thresholds across substrates from system-wide instability metrics, or do the existing scattered adaptive loci (ARC-016 dynamic precision, SD-032c AIC interoceptive baseline EMA, SD-032d PCC stability scalar, SD-032e pACC drive bias) produce coherent meta-stability under chronic load without a supervisor?
Q-041.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Each of the four threshold series must show non-zero within-run variance under the load manipulation before any coherence statistic is computed; a pinned or constant channel makes the cross-correlation undefined rather than low, and a constant-by-construction channel (dacc_pe_cap at its None default) must be replaced by an adaptive one.
CONFIRMING: Under chronic load, with all four series non-degenerate, they collapse onto a shared low-dimensional manifold (dominant first principal component, high pairwise cross-correlation) beyond the shuffled null -- the scattered loci self-coordinate and no supervisor is needed. Manipulation: Drive-level clamp at the chronic-load setpoint versus a matched baseline setpoint, with ARC-016 dynamic precision, SD-032c AIC, SD-032d PCC and SD-032e pACC all enabled, plus single-locus disable arms to test whether coherence survives removing any one contributor. Control: Matched-seed normal-load arm; per-locus disable arms; and a shuffled-time-series null so an apparent shared principal component is tested against the spectrum expected from four independently drifting EMAs of similar time constant. Required event: Sustained chronic load -- drive_level held near 0.9 for roughly 1000 steps -- with matched normal-load episodes, long enough for the slowest locus (SD-032e pACC drive bias, ~347-step EMA) to move. DV: The fraction of variance carried by the first principal component of the four per-tick threshold series (E3 effective commit threshold, beta-gate release threshold, SalienceCoordinator effective switch threshold under PCC stability, and the dACC adaptive PE quantity), plus pairwise cross-correlation at matched lags, compared against the shuffled null.
FALSIFYING: The four series drift independently under the same conditions -- first principal component no larger than the shuffled null, low cross-correlation, divergent setpoints -- licensing the supervisor / volatility-tracker / sleep-writeback SD cluster. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: All four loci expose per-tick readable state (aic_analog.aic_salience/baseline, pcc_analog.pcc_stability, pacc_analog.drive_bias/last_effective_drive, dacc _pe_ema and _last_saturation_factor, SalienceCoordinator enter/exit thresholds), so a driver can poll them; no experiment currently logs them jointly as a time series and EXP-0177 remains gated. Consumer / boundary: The cross-substrate coordination boundary -- whether the four independently-scoped adaptive loci share a hidden joint instability signal -- not any single substrate's internal adaptation. Existing ownership: EXP-0177, MECH-204, sleep_substrate:GAP-1, SD-032c, SD-032d, SD-032e, ARC-016.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); No experiment polls the four loci jointly as a time series, EXP-0177 is still a gated proposal, and one named DV channel (dacc_pe_cap) is a static clamp defaulting to None rather than an adaptive threshold, so the DV set must be respecified before the coherence statistic means anything. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's HARD PRECONDITION names the V_s-monostrategy lock-in with "MECH-269 unlanded" as the reason the threshold series are pinned; substrate_queue.json now records MECH-269 as status implemented, ready true, and behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-D (the MECH-269/269b layer) as done. Separately, one of the four named DV channels is mis-specified against current code: the dACC "pe_cap normaliser" is dacc_pe_cap, a static Optional[float] absolute clamp defaulting to None and written only by ClosureOperator on an SD-034 closure fire -- not an adaptive threshold that can trace a trajectory. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

Q-043.subject: policy.diversity_generation.relative_weight_calibration

Q-044.subject: policy.curiosity.subflavour_independence
Q-044.title: Are MECH-314a (striatal novelty), MECH-314b (frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity), and MECH-314c (learning-progress curiosity) three distinct substrates with independent contributions, or three different readings of one mechanism with different upstream inputs (e.g., novelty as a special case of uncertainty as a special case of learning progress)?
Q-044.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: All three sub-flavours must emit per-candidate signal with non-zero across-K spread. 314a needs real candidate divergence in first-step z_world; 314b and 314c need Phase-2 per-candidate refinement, because a constant broadcast across [K] cancels in any argmax or softmax and makes their ablation arms arithmetically identical whatever the substrate does.
CONFIRMING: Each of the three ablations produces a separable, non-overlapping degradation that the other two do not rescue, with the across-K spread non-vacuity gate met -- three distinct substrates, retain all as load-bearing. Manipulation: The flag-set three-arm ablation already exposed by StructuredCuriosityConfig -- use_curiosity_novelty, use_curiosity_uncertainty, use_curiosity_learning_progress turned off one at a time with the master switch on -- run against a Phase-2 per-candidate instantiation of 314b and 314c rather than the Phase-1 broadcast scalars.
