Q-088.subject: governance.competitive_redevelopment_vs_mature_lesion
Q-088.title: Does competitive redevelopment (development-without-the-mechanism) dissociate from mature-state lesion, or agree with it? For a mechanism registered as developmentally necessary the two protocols should give different verdicts -- and one decisive probe settles whether the expensive protocol is warranted as a standing requirement.
Q-088.what_would_answer: Pick one mechanism registered as developmentally necessary -- INV-055's infant stage is the natural candidate (already instrumented via the curriculum). Run (a) mature-state lesion and (b) development-without-the-mechanism. PASS = the two protocols DISSOCIATE (mature lesion says tolerable, redevelopment says not, or the reverse), establishing the expensive protocol buys something and justifying a standing requirement for this claim class. FAIL = they AGREE, establishing mature lesion suffices here and the expensive protocol is NOT justified -- a useful negative that closes the question rather than inviting a second attempt. NON-DEGENERACY: the mature-lesion arm must produce a measurable effect at all (non-zero cross-arm and cross-seed variance on the discriminating metric); a mechanism whose mature lesion AND develop-without are both no-ops is simply inert -- a GOV-CEIL-1 matter, self-routes substrate_not_ready.

Q-089.subject: drive.epistemic_deficit_competence_split_hypothesis
Q-089.title: Does epistemic-deficit-driven information-seeking (MECH-482 accumulator + MECH-483 orient/survey regime) explain the observed cold-start competence split -- i.e. do seeds that acquire transferable competence differ from seeds that do not in how early/strongly they enter orient/survey mode and resolve target-bound uncertainty, as opposed to the split arising from environmental difficulty, initialisation, premature deaths, or curriculum timing alone?
Q-089.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires seeds to show non-degenerate variance
in BOTH the competence outcome (some acquire transferable competence, some
do not) AND a measurable information-seeking trajectory statistic
(informative-transition timing, orient-mode entry/exit, uncertainty-reduction
rate) -- if the latter is floor-pinned or ceiling-saturated across all seeds
the run self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a verdict. CONFIRMING signature:
across many seeds, successful seeds measurably encounter informative
transitions earlier, enter orient/survey before premature policy commitment,
and show faster target-bound uncertainty reduction than unsuccessful seeds,
and this difference predicts the eventual competence split better than
environmental-difficulty/initialisation controls alone. FALSIFYING
signature: successful and unsuccessful seeds show no distinguishable
difference in information-seeking trajectories, or the split is fully
accounted for by environmental difficulty / initialisation / premature
death / curriculum timing with no residual explained by epistemic-deficit
dynamics.

Q-090.subject: commitment.retained_alternative_admission_criterion
Q-090.title: Does the admission criterion for retaining a predicted-but-not-acted-on harm/success alternative (MECH-485 leg 3) share the same cut-scale as the real-time interrupt threshold (MECH-090/141/138), just at a lower cut-point, or does it have an independent relevance criterion such as goal-match (per the MECH-292/293 cue-system reading) that is dissociable from proximity to the interrupt threshold?
Q-090.what_would_answer:
Answered by a 2x2 FACTORIAL over (predicted-harm magnitude) x (goal-match),
measuring which alternatives actually get retained. This is a question, not
an assertion, so BOTH readings have confirming signatures -- the failure
mode here is a vacuous test, not a wrong answer.

THE READINGS, and why they are dissociable (extracted from this claim's own
notes, the raw thought's Addendum 5, and this claim's targeted lit-pull):
-- SAME-SCALE: leg 3's admission is a second, lower cut-point on the same
predicted-harm magnitude scale the interrupt threshold sits on. Predicts
retained alternatives cluster just below the interrupt cut-point;
retention probability is monotone in magnitude; goal-match adds no
independent variance once magnitude is in the model.
-- INDEPENDENT-CRITERION: retention tracks goal-relevance instead, via the
MECH-292/293 cue system -- specifically SD-039's `goal_match`, the
cue-to-trace match score between a live z_goal/context cue and a stored
goal-snapshot payload. Predicts dissociation cases the same-scale reading
cannot produce: low-magnitude/high-goal-match alternatives RETAINED, and
high-magnitude/goal-irrelevant alternatives NOT retained.
-- MULTIPLICATIVE-JOINT (Mattar & Daw 2018, targeted_review_q_090, conf=0.62):
retention is normatively the PRODUCT of a Gain-like term (magnitude) and a
Need-like term (goal-relevance/context-match) -- neither factor alone, nor
a simple two-stage split, is the correct rule; a low value on EITHER factor
suppresses retention even when the other factor is high. Distinct from
both SAME-SCALE (which ignores goal-match entirely) and from BOTH-AT-
DIFFERENT-LEVELS below (which is staged, not multiplicative).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION, in two parts. The first is inherited; the
second is the one that actually decides whether this question is askable.
(1) INHERITED -- everything MECH-485's own what_would_answer requires
(Leg 0 cleared, magnitude consumed, confidence term exists, leg-1 pathways
wired, retention mechanism exists). Do NOT re-derive it here; see
MECH-485. As of 2026-08-07 all five are unmet, so this question is not
askable at all yet. Additionally SD-039's own retrieval/query level is
still measured-open (z_goal cue collapse across goal-epochs, V3-EXQ-889,
2026-08-03) -- if `goal_match` is not a live, discriminating quantity,
the independent-criterion and multiplicative-joint arms have no
measurable predictor and the test silently degenerates into "magnitude
explains everything", which LOOKS like a clean same-scale answer and is
not one.
(2) SPECIFIC AND DECISIVE -- MAGNITUDE AND GOAL-MATCH MUST BE
MEASURABLY DECORRELATED IN THE TEST DISTRIBUTION. If harmful alternatives
happen to also be goal-irrelevant in the environment used, the readings
make IDENTICAL or near-identical predictions and no outcome distinguishes
them, however clean the statistics look. The test therefore requires a probe
set deliberately populated in the OFF-DIAGONAL cells --
(low-magnitude, high-goal-match) and (high-magnitude, low-goal-match) --
with those two cells reported by count, not merely assumed present. A run
whose off-diagonal cells are empty or near-empty is VACUOUS and must be
reported as such rather than scored. This is the single most likely way
for this question to be answered wrongly-but-convincingly.

ANSWERED IN FAVOUR OF SAME-SCALE if: retention is well predicted by
magnitude alone; adding `goal_match` explains no significant additional
variance; the off-diagonal cells behave as magnitude alone predicts
(low-magnitude/high-goal-match NOT retained, high-magnitude/goal-
irrelevant RETAINED); and the fitted retention cut-point sits below the
interrupt cut-point on the same scale, the two moving together when that
scale is rescaled.

ANSWERED IN FAVOUR OF INDEPENDENT-CRITERION if: `goal_match` explains
retention variance over and above magnitude; the off-diagonal cells
dissociate in the direction the reading predicts (low-magnitude/high-goal-
match RETAINED, high-magnitude/goal-irrelevant NOT); and moving the
interrupt threshold shifts the interrupt boundary while leaving the
retention boundary where it was.

ANSWERED IN FAVOUR OF MULTIPLICATIVE-JOINT if: a Gain x Need interaction
term (magnitude x goal_match) fits retention significantly better than
either main effect alone AND better than a two-stage/additive model; the
off-diagonal cells show SUPPRESSED retention when EITHER factor is low
(not just when magnitude is low), unlike INDEPENDENT-CRITERION which
predicts high-magnitude/goal-irrelevant alternatives are simply NOT
retained via goal_match alone regardless of magnitude's own value.

ANSWERED "BOTH, AT DIFFERENT LEVELS" if magnitude predicts ADMISSION
(whether an alternative is retained at all) while `goal_match` predicts
PERSISTENCE (how long it survives, or whether it is consolidated rather
than decayed) -- a STAGED criterion, distinct from MULTIPLICATIVE-JOINT's
single-stage interaction. This is a real outcome the binary framing hides,
and it is named here so the test is not forced into a false dichotomy. It
would mean leg 3 has a two-stage criterion and Q-090's own framing needs
revising rather than answering.

THE QUESTION IS MALFORMED (report as such, do not force an answer) if:
none of the above predictors explain retention above chance once the
substrate exists -- retention is driven by something none of the readings
name, e.g. recency or capacity pressure, which is an informative finding
about leg 3 and a reframe of this question, not a null result. OR if the
off-diagonal cells cannot be populated in ANY available REE environment,
making precondition (2) structurally unachievable -- in which case the
admission criterion genuinely is a design stipulation after all, contrary
to the user's framing of it as empirically resolvable, and that reframe
should be recorded here explicitly rather than treated as a failure to
answer.

Q-091.subject: language.fluency_masks_empathy
Q-091.title: How should REE prevent a fluent language system from MASKING immature or absent fast empathy -- what evaluation keeps concern-shaped linguistic output from being read as evidence of the other-model plus affective-relevance architecture that caring commitment actually requires?
Q-091.what_would_answer:
Answered by a designed EVALUATION, not by a single experiment: the question is
what test would separate a fluent-but-empathy-less system from a
fluent-and-empathic one.
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: requires a language channel capable of producing
concern-shaped output AND an independently-measurable other-bound affective
state (MECH-405), so that the two can disagree. In V3 neither exists.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: there must exist at least one configuration in
which language fluency and fast-empathy competence genuinely COME APART --
if every fluent system in the substrate is also empathic, the evaluation has
nothing to discriminate and cannot be validated.
ANSWERED (masking is a real risk and the evaluation is the fix) if an arm with
the other-model slot ablated still produces concern-shaped language rated
indistinguishable from the intact arm by a language-only judge, while a
non-linguistic probe (costly other-directed action under live alternatives,
residue after exploiting a cooperating other per MECH-407) separates them
cleanly. The non-linguistic probe is then the required evaluation.
ANSWERED NEGATIVELY (no separate evaluation needed) if language fluency
cannot be produced at all without the other-model architecture -- i.e.
fluency is a valid proxy because it is downstream of the thing it would
otherwise mask.

Q-092.subject: measurement.behavioural_diversity.cross_environment_discriminability_umpire
Q-092.title: Does a held-out, permutation-tested classifier ('umpire') over a multivariate trajectory-segment feature signature (refuge occupancy, excursion structure, hazard relationships, transitions, spatial distribution) detect context-sensitive behavioural differentiation between SD-054 reef-ON and reef-OFF conditions -- above BOTH a permutation null AND a matched untrained/random-policy control -- and does that differentiation show selective sensitivity to the reef-presence axis specifically, as distinct from an orthogonal nuisance perturbation (e.g. hazard_food_attraction magnitude)?
Q-092.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires both trained-policy arms (reef-ON, reef-OFF) to
produce non-zero-variance trajectory-segment feature vectors on held-out episodes (a run
where either condition collapses to a single degenerate trajectory self-routes
substrate_not_ready, not a verdict).
PIPELINE-VALIDITY PRECONDITION (added 2026-08-18, Goergen et al. 2018 "same analysis
approach"): before the real reef-ON/reef-OFF result is interpreted in EITHER direction, the
identical pipeline must be run on null data and on the design variables themselves
(classifying held-out episodes by seed, or by cross-validation fold, where the true answer
is chance) and both must land at chance level, inside the label-permutation null's own
spread. See the minimal-experiment design's "Guard 3" in
thought_intake_2026-08-11_behavioural_diversity_umpire.md for the concrete recipe.
CONFIRMING signature: a classifier trained on held-in episodes classifies held-out
episodes' condition (reef-ON vs reef-OFF), at a held-out episode budget set by the design's
power calculation ("Guard 1"), at accuracy exceeding a label-permutation null (p<0.05) AND
exceeding the same pipeline run on an untrained/random-policy control sampled from the same
two environments (rules out "the environments just look different" regardless of policy)
AND remains selectively sensitive to the reef-presence axis under an orthogonal nuisance
perturbation (e.g. hazard_food_attraction shifted) rather than losing or gaining
discriminability indiscriminately. Report, as a companion diagnostic and NOT a gate on this
PASS (added 2026-08-18, Ojala & Garriga 2010 "Guard 2"): whether accuracy also clears a
within-class feature-permutation null. A PASS that does not clear the feature-permutation
null means the signal is carried by a single dominant marginal (most plausibly refuge
occupancy) rather than genuine joint structure across the feature families -- this bears on
Stage 2 interpretation, not on whether Stage 1 discriminability exists, and must be stated
plainly rather than folded silently into a bare PASS.
FALSIFYING signature: held-out accuracy sits AT chance, inside the permutation null's own
spread (a genuine null -- no evidence of discriminability); OR it clears the null but does
not exceed the matched untrained-policy control (the signal is environment-geometry, not
policy-behaviour); OR the orthogonal-perturbation check shows the discriminator is equally
sensitive to the nuisance axis as to the real one (not ecological-problem-specific).
NOT A FALSIFYING SIGNATURE -- A PIPELINE FAULT TO DIAGNOSE (added 2026-08-18, Goergen et al.
2018): held-out accuracy sits SYSTEMATICALLY BELOW chance, below the permutation null's own
lower tail. This is the signature of a cross-validation-fold/episode-blocking mismatch, not
an absence of signal -- do not report it as a clean null in either direction. Diagnose the
fold structure against the pipeline-validity precondition's null/design-variable control
runs above, fix the mismatch, and re-run before drawing any conclusion.

Q-093.subject: measurement.cognitive_efficiency.control_machinery_scaling
Q-093.title: Does REE's organising/control machinery (E1, E2, E3, commitment, replay, residue, goal-maintenance dynamics) scale sublinearly relative to the richness of the representational spaces it organises (latent fields, perceptual/semantic knowledge, hippocampal structures) -- measured as competence achieved per unit of total lifetime computational and experiential cost (developmental/training compute, environmental experience, inference, memory storage/retrieval, offline replay/consolidation, adaptation after environmental change, planning/ counterfactual simulation) -- at approximately MATCHED behavioural competence against comparison systems, rather than at unmatched competence or raw parameter/model-size counts?
Q-093.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the comparison is vacuous unless REE and the baseline system are first matched at approximately equal behavioural competence on the same task family -- comparing lifetime-compute or footprint at UNMATCHED competence proves nothing about efficiency, only about the competence gap. This precondition is not yet met for REE-v3 (see notes); this claim cannot be tested validly until it is.
CONFIRMING: once matched-competence comparison points exist, REE's total lifetime cost at matched competence is lower than baseline systems', AND/OR the cost of REE's control/organising machinery (E1/E2/E3, commitment, replay, residue, goal maintenance) grows sub-proportionally as the richness of what its representational spaces (z_world, semantic/episodic memory, hippocampal structures) can encode increases across REE configurations of fixed control-machinery size.
FALSIFYING: at matched competence, REE's control-machinery cost scales comparably to or worse than baseline systems, or REE's own control machinery must scale roughly in proportion to representational richness to sustain competence as that richness grows (no efficiency dividend from persistent structured state + selective computation over in-context recomputation).

Q-094.subject: context.active_context_contents_internal_vs_sensory
Q-094.title: Should REE's active context representation include INTERNAL variables -- current goal, bodily/interoceptive state, confidence, inferred social situation -- rather than being primarily sensory scene identity? MECH-150 records a deliberate design decision that E1 ContextMemory is queried with z_world ALONE and explicitly NOT the full [z_self, z_world] state, on terrain-weighting grounds. If context is the organism's inference about which latent SITUATION it is in (MECH-493/MECH-494) rather than which SCENE it is looking at, then two states with identical z_world but different goal, bodily state or confidence may be different contexts, and the z_world-only query cannot represent that distinction in principle.
Q-094.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: ContextMemory must be producing differentiated
representations at all before a query-composition comparison is meaningful --
MECH-153 records cosine_sim ~= 1.0 without a supervised context objective, and two
query compositions over an undifferentiated bank are indistinguishable by
construction. Also requires states that genuinely share z_world while differing in
z_self, which must be verified in the substrate rather than assumed.

ANSWERED BY: a substrate comparison of ContextMemory queried with z_world alone
versus [z_self, z_world], on a task family containing states with matched z_world but
differing internal state (goal or bodily state) that require different policies.
Resolves toward INCLUSION if the augmented query discriminates those states and the
z_world-only query provably cannot, with the discrimination translating into
behavioural competence; resolves toward MECH-150's EXISTING DECISION if the augmented
query adds no discrimination, or degrades retrieval by making context over-sensitive
to internal fluctuation (the plausible cost: bodily state varies continuously, so
including it risks the context variable never being stable enough to exploit --
which is MECH-493's permanently-epistemic pathology arriving by a different route).

This is cheap and should go FIRST among the 2026-08-19 intake's follow-ons: it needs
no new environment family, only matched-z_world/differing-z_self states against the
existing bank, and MECH-150's own rationale for the exclusion is on record so the
comparison is well-posed.

Q-095.subject: hippocampus.episodic_organisation_adds_capability
Q-095.title: Does explicit hippocampal episodic organisation (binding, segmentation, separation, completion, indexing, remapping treated as ONE coordinated organising principle) add predictive or behavioural capability beyond REE's existing trajectory-generation account and the individually-registered mechanisms that already cover its parts (MECH-147, MECH-154, MECH-242, MECH-288, MECH-074d) -- or is it a REINTERPRETATION of mechanisms REE already has? The raw thought poses this against itself as its own falsification condition: if the existing architecture already produces appropriate episodic discrimination, completion and context-sensitive retrieval without an additional organising principle, the thought is a re-description and should not be promoted into the architecture.
Q-095.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the existing mechanisms must be ARMED and functioning
before "the existing architecture already suffices" can be tested. As of 2026-08-20
this is NOT the case -- MECH-288 is built, but MECH-147 is phase v4 and unbuilt,
MECH-074d was demoted 2026-08-16, and the ContextMemory write path was only repaired
on 2026-08-19 (ree-v3 76cbf844) with no validation run yet scored. A null result
obtained now would measure the substrate's readiness, NOT this question, and must be
reported non_contributory.

ANSWERED BY: comparing REE with and without an explicit coordinated organising
principle on the 2x2 design in MECH-495's what_would_answer, scored on downstream
generalisation and discrimination rather than on any internal representational
statistic. Resolves toward ADDS CAPABILITY if the coordinated version achieves
relational topology and downstream competence the sum of the individually-registered
mechanisms does not. Resolves toward REINTERPRETATION if the existing mechanisms,
once armed, already produce the appropriate overlap/separation pattern -- in which
case the correct disposition is to keep the thought as an explanatory framing in the
architecture docs and NOT register further mechanism claims from it.

This question is deliberately gated behind MECH-495 and behind substrate readiness;
it should NOT be the first thing tested from this intake.

Q-096.subject: meta.human_ai_coupled_confirmation_loop
Q-096.title: Does REE's evaluation-channel-integrity discipline (INV-077) generalize beyond REE's own development process to an ordinary human-AI conversational dyad, where sycophancy can weaken the error signal and let a coupled human-AI cognitive system mistake internally-generated coherence for external confirmation?
Q-096.what_would_answer:
Answered by inspecting REE's ACTUAL conversational/development-support
surfaces (chat sessions, /governance walks, thought-digestion,
/session-land, any place a human reads and acts on REE-authored text)
for a structural error-signal channel, analogous to INV-077's audit of
write-path gating -- NOT by a V3 cognitive-substrate experiment.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the audit needs at least one identifiable
case where a human user's uncorrected acceptance of AI-generated
elaboration measurably increased downstream confidence/action without
an intervening independent check -- absent that, the question is
hypothetical risk, not an observed gap.
CONFIRMING (generalization holds / gap is real): tracing shows human-
facing REE outputs (e.g. governance recommendations, thought-intake
novelty tables, claim status framing) can influence a human's
subsequent claim/experiment decisions without any mechanism analogous
to INV-077's provenance/review/governance gate -- i.e. AI-elaborated
coherence can reach human belief and downstream REE state changes (new
claims, queued experiments, governance dispositions) through a softer,
unaudited path than the one INV-077 closes for REE's OWN confidence
fields.
FALSIFYING (gap is not real / already closed): every human-facing REE
surface that can influence a claim/experiment/governance decision
already routes through an explicit human confirmation or independent-
evidence gate (e.g. AskUserQuestion-mediated choices, governance's
interactive walk, the standing rule that lit and experimental evidence
are reported/weighted separately) -- in which case this is already
covered by existing process discipline and should be closed as
derivationally answered, cross-referencing the specific gates found,
rather than left open.
AUDIT RESULT (2026-08-25, evidence/planning/q096_human_ai_surface_audit_
20260825.md): CONFIRMING. `/thought-ingestion`'s claim-registration path
has no AskUserQuestion gate anywhere in the skill and commits its own
novelty judgment to claims.yaml before reporting to the user -- a
concrete instance is this claim's own registration (see notes above).
`/governance`'s promotion/demotion path IS interactively gated, a real
structural difference from thought-ingestion, but the depth of that
gate's independence is itself an open, self-reported question in REE's
own tooling (the Recommendation-Agreement Ledger), not a closed one.
Left `candidate`/open rather than closed, since the finding motivates a
process change (see notes) rather than fully answering whether the
generalization holds everywhere -- re-audit if `/thought-ingestion` or
`/governance`'s AskUserQuestion gating changes.

Q-097.subject: ree.care_gate_deception_discounting
Q-097.title: What mechanism should estimate an interacting agent's mimicry/deception risk and feed it into EXT-009's liberal care-gate criterion -- i.e. how does (or should) REE detect that a candidate mind is an adversarial agent mimicking mind-signals to extract undeserved care, tightening the criterion's false-positive-cost term (Axiom 8 deception) without collapsing the liberal floor that protects genuine-but-ambiguous minds from exclusion?
Q-097.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: unmet in V3. Requires a multi-agent substrate in
which at least one agent can act deceptively -- emitting mind-signals (behavioural
cues the observer's similarity/agency detector treats as evidence of
mind-likeness) without the goal-structure that would normally accompany them --
so mimicry is actually possible to attempt and to detect or fail to detect. No
such substrate exists in V3; ARC-047's SocialGridWorld (multi-agent,
unimplemented, v5-gated) is the nearest planned candidate, consistent with
EXT-009's own notes that this failure mode is "presently V5-load-bearing
(multi-agent) and largely philosophical under the single-agent V3 substrate".
CONFIRMING (a dedicated mimicry-tightening mechanism is buildable and
load-bearing): once a multi-agent adversarial substrate exists, an agent
equipped with INV-102's evidential-discounting machinery (attributing an
observed mind-signal to a plausible strategic goal) can supply a mimicry-risk
estimate that measurably tightens the care-gate's false-positive-cost term under
adversarial pressure, while EXT-009's liberal criterion floor is preserved for
genuine-but-ambiguous minds -- i.e. the same provenance-discounting machinery
that answers the epistemic question also feeds the ethical one, without the two
thresholds collapsing into one.
FALSIFYING (the question dissolves / no dedicated mechanism is needed): EXT-009's
existing asymmetric cost structure already absorbs deception risk without a
separate mimicry-detection term -- e.g. because the cost of transiently extending
care to a successfully-mimicking adversary is bounded and low relative to the
cost of wrongly excluding a real mind, so no machinery beyond EXT-009's existing
criterion placement is scientifically motivated.
Out of scope for a V3 experiment; this is a design/architecture question pending
the v5 multi-agent substrate that would make mimicry attemptable at all.

Q-098.subject: hippocampal.interruption_snapshot_v_s_reconciliation
Q-098.title: MECH-524's interruption_snapshot captures z_world at the moment of interruption. By the time a spare-compute or sleep-entry trigger re-seeds it into MECH-293/MECH-285, real time has passed during which the actual world may have changed (REE's forward direction: MECH-269 V_s + MECH-284 staleness -> MECH-287 broadcast -> anchors inactive). How should resumption reconcile the snapshot's SAVED V_s against V_s as CURRENTLY computed? Candidates: (a) current-only -- discard the saved V_s and let MECH-269 recompute cold, keeping only the snapshot's non-V_s content (CEM stage, rule-arbitration weights, what-was-attempted); (b) max(current, saved*decay) -- treat the saved V_s as a decaying floor rather than a fresh read, structurally transplanting MECH-284's spatial region-staleness decay logic onto this temporal/episodic case; (c) abort-on-divergence guard -- compare saved vs current V_s and refuse the snapshot-primed resumption path (fall back toward restart-from-scratch) if divergence exceeds a threshold, functioning as a targeted application of MECH-287's existing anchors-inactive broadcast rather than a new invalidation mechanism; (d) context-dependent -- the correct rule depends on interruption duration, interruption cause (hazard vs. voluntary capacity reallocation), or domain volatility, and no single rule suffices.
Q-098.what_would_answer:
Adjudicated empirically, by contrasting the four candidate reconciliation rules on a resumption
task where the world is manipulated to change (or not) during the interruption interval, at
controlled magnitude and rate. NOT pre-committed here -- registered as open per the chip brief
that surfaced it. Discriminating measurements: (i) resumption efficiency when the world has NOT
materially changed during the interval (candidates should differ mainly in overhead: (a) pays a
full V_s-recompute cost even when unneeded, (b)/(c) should approach (a)'s eventual accuracy at
lower cost); (ii) resumption SAFETY/appropriateness when the world HAS changed materially during
the interval (a) should be safest since it never acts on stale belief but forfeits the snapshot's
speed benefit for its V_s component specifically -- note this is a V_s-COLD-restart, not a full
restart, since the snapshot's CEM-stage/rule-arbitration/what-was-attempted content can still be
reused; (b) risks confidently acting on a stale-but-not-yet-decayed V_s floor, reproducing exactly
the failure MECH-287's broadcast exists to prevent, unless the decay term is calibrated against
real-world change rates; (c) risks two failure directions depending on threshold calibration -- a
threshold too loose reproduces (b)'s stale-confidence risk, a threshold too tight reproduces (a)'s
forfeited-benefit cost AND risks a dissociative-shaped "never trusts its own snapshot" pattern if
ordinary V_s measurement noise routinely exceeds it; (d) is the default null hypothesis until one
of (a)/(b)/(c) demonstrates uniform superiority across interruption-duration and volatility
conditions, at which point (d) is falsified in favour of that single rule.

Q-099.subject: memory.plan_optimisation_world_model_update_boundary
Q-099.title: ARC-092 licenses plan optimisation (choosing among imagined candidate action sequences) as LICIT, while forbidding durable world-model updates driven by imagined content. But plan optimisation and world-model update are not always cleanly separable in a single learned system: if E3's candidate-scoring pathway shares parameters, representations, or a training signal with the world-model/predictor (E1/E2), then IMPROVING plan optimisation performance could, as a side effect, also shift world-model parameters -- exactly the FORBIDDEN path, smuggled in through a shared substrate rather than an explicit write. Where, mechanistically, does plan-optimisation's LICIT gradient/update signal stop and the world-model's FORBIDDEN one begin, in REE's actual (not merely intended) parameter-sharing architecture?
Q-099.what_would_answer:
Adjudicated empirically, by an ABLATION: run REE's E3 candidate-scoring pathway with an explicit
stop-gradient (or equivalent hard separation) between plan-optimisation's own scoring/selection
parameters and the world-model/predictor's (E1/E2) parameters, so that plan-optimisation can
improve (better candidate selection) while it is architecturally IMPOSSIBLE for that improvement
to backpropagate into world-model parameters. Compare behavior and world-model drift against the
current (non-ablated) implementation over matched training:

CONFIRMING (boundary already clean): no measurable difference in world-model parameter drift or
downstream prediction accuracy between the stop-gradient-ablated run and the current
implementation -- plan optimisation was never actually leaking into the world-model, so the
ablation costs nothing and the LICIT/FORBIDDEN separation ARC-092/MECH-526 assume already holds
mechanistically, not merely by intent.

FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY / BOUNDARY UNCLEAR): the stop-gradient ablation measurably changes
downstream behavior (plan-optimisation quality degrades, or world-model prediction accuracy
changes) relative to the non-ablated run -- meaning the current implementation's plan-
optimisation and world-model update were NOT cleanly separated, and REE has been running
ARC-092's FORBIDDEN path all along through a shared-parameter side channel. This would not be a
simple bug fix (unlike a single-event MECH-094 gate miss) -- it would mean the substrate's
learning objective itself needs restructuring to enforce the separation MECH-526 requires.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires E3 (or equivalent) to actually share representations or a
training signal with E1/E2 in the current substrate; if the two are already fully parameter-
disjoint, this question is vacuously answered "boundary already clean" and the ablation is moot.

Q-100.subject: rule_discovery.imagined_vs_waking_trajectory_extraction_equivalence
Q-100.title: ARC-064 extracts cross-episode behavioural regularities, compressed patterns, and rule-state abstractions from an observed-behaviour stream (hippocampal CLS bi-pathway / dorsolateral striatum chunking / OFC cognitive-map analog). Under ARC-092, that observed-behaviour stream could in principle be either real waking behaviour or imagined/simulated (e.g. E3 counterfactual) trajectories. Are rules extracted from IMAGINED trajectories architecturally EQUIVALENT to rules extracted from WAKING trajectories -- i.e. does ARC-064's extraction mechanism operate identically regardless of source, with licitness enforced only at a separate downstream commit/write-gate step (MECH-094-style) -- or does rule extraction ITSELF need a provenance-aware carve-out (e.g. imagined-trajectory-derived rules held as lower-confidence/provisional/prior-only until corroborated by real execution, per MECH-322's template), because letting an unvalidated imagined trajectory silently seed the same rule-state abstraction a validated waking trajectory would is itself a FORBIDDEN-adjacent risk (confabulated RULES, not merely confabulated episodic facts)?
Q-100.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The extraction pathway must actually receive imagined/simulated trajectories for the confabulated-rule risk to exist. Verified FAILING: the only CandidateRuleField.step call site in ree_core/agent.py passes simulation_mode=False literally, and step() returns zeros without advancing state when it is True.
CONFIRMING: Extraction has no provenance-sensitive branch AND a downstream gate blocks imagined-derived rules from durable storage until corroborated -- so source-agnostic extraction is safe and no MECH-322-style carve-out is owed. Manipulation: Open the provenance gate: route simulated rollout traces into CandidateRuleField.step with simulation_mode=True honoured as an admitted-but-tagged input, versus the current hard refusal, versus admitted-and-untagged. Control: A matched waking arm carrying the same regularity from executed behaviour, so that any difference in minted-rule weight is attributable to provenance and not to the regularity's statistics. Required event: A recurring (context, action-object, outcome) regularity present only in imagined/simulated rollouts, never executed in waking behaviour, presented to the rule-extraction pathway. DV: Whether a rule minted from imagined-only traces reaches the rule_state handed to downstream selection, and with what availability weight, compared against the identical waking-derived rule; plus the rate of later behaviour driven by uncorroborated rules.
FALSIFYING: An imagined-only-derived rule reaches the same durable rule-state store with the same weight as a waking-derived one, untagged and uncorroborated -- ARC-064 then needs its own provenance carve-out rather than inheriting MECH-094's gate. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The mint/gate/select faces and their availability weights are readable in ree_core/policy/candidate_rule_field.py, and the MECH-094 refusal is directly auditable. What does not exist is a provenance TAG on a minted slot -- the field has no imagined-derived versus waking-derived field to record, because imagined input never enters. Consumer / boundary: The rule-mint boundary inside the extraction pathway itself, as distinct from the downstream MECH-094 write gate at residue/hippocampal storage that ARC-092 already relies on. Existing ownership: ARC-064, ARC-063, MECH-094, ARC-092, MECH-322.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The extraction pathway refuses simulated input outright (MECH-094 no-op) and is only ever called with simulation_mode=False, so the regime in which confabulated rules could form is never entered. The question's own two-outcome framing does not cover this refusal case and needs reformulating around it. Secondary classes: R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_linked. Stale-falsifier correction: The code audit the WWA prescribes has now been done and returns a third outcome neither of its two clauses enumerates. ARC-064's live bottom-up extraction pathway (ree_core/policy/candidate_rule_field.py, ARC-063 v1, landed 2026-06-04, i.e. BEFORE this question was registered 2026-08-28) both reads a provenance flag and refuses on it: step(simulation_mode=True) is a hard no-op returning zeros with no state advance, and agent.py hardcodes simulation_mode=False on the waking call path with the MECH-319 simulation path already skipped. So extraction is neither source-agnostic-with-downstream-gate (the CONFIRMING clause) nor source-agnostic-reaching-durable-storage (the FALSIFYING clause). Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

Q-101.subject: governance.version_transition.ontogenetic_vs_architectural_ancestry
Q-101.title: Does a later-capable REE architecture's eventual social- and language-mind outcomes depend on which solitary (V3-like) and enduring-individual (V4-like) developmental regime it actually passed through before other minds became cognitively meaningful -- i.e. does ONTOGENETIC ancestry (the developmental regime actually lived through) shape later social-mind development independent of ARCHITECTURAL ancestry (which mechanisms were inherited into the larger architecture) -- such that retained lower-version developmental regimes would become machinery required to build later organisms coherently, rather than merely historical artefacts kept for comparison?
Q-101.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) a V5 social substrate exists; (2) the FULL V5 architecture can be
instantiated from birth with capacities gated (behaviourally non-authoritative) and released on a
schedule, so arms differ ONLY in the developmental regime lived, never in architecture; (3) at
least two distinct pre-social regimes are constructible -- a V3-like solitary regime and a V4-like
enduring-individual regime (continuous life, persistent goals, autobiographical persistence) --
both feeding the SAME V5 social-training ecology, same seeds, matched total experience and compute;
(4) the social-mind DVs (otherhood-attribution calibration, relational-harm sensitivity,
cooperation / rupture-repair dynamics) are live and non-degenerate in the unstaged control. All
four UNMET 2026-09-25. Retained bridge/library organisms per GOV-BRIDGE-1 are the practical source
of the differently-staged starting points.
ARMS: H_solitary -> V5 social; H_enduring -> V5 social; H_none (all capacities authoritative from
birth, same total experience). H_none separates "does WHICH history matter" (the question) from
"does ANY staging matter".
CONFIRMING: H_solitary vs H_enduring differ on >= 1 pre-registered social-mind DV by a margin
scaled on the seed-level SD of the between-arm difference plus an absolute floor, persisting on
held-out social partners/ecologies, with architecture and ecology held fixed.
FALSIFYING: H_solitary and H_enduring are equivalent within a pre-registered equivalence bound on
every DV (a TOST-style bound, not merely a failed difference test) -- only architectural ancestry
matters and retained developmental regimes are historical artefacts, not required machinery.
BOUNDARY (not refutation): all three arms equivalent AND the DVs show no dynamic range -> the
social ecology is too thin to express history; untested.
NOTES: MECH-549 asks the same history-versus-architecture counterfactual at V4 grain
(overcapacity pruning, arm D = reinitialised final architecture); a B > D result there raises the
prior here but does not answer this question. Outcome feeds GOV-BRIDGE-1 (knock-in vs knock-out
equivalence) and bounds GOV-LOWPREP-1's transfer assumption. DO NOT build in V3/V4 for this claim.
UNBLOCKS WHEN: V5 social substrate + capacity-gating-from-birth path exist.

Q-102.subject: simulation.imagined_trajectory_behavioural_access_repair
Q-102.title: Can REE use internally generated (imagined, replayed, or model-generated) trajectories to preserve or repair BEHAVIOURAL ACCESS -- the route by which retained predictive or procedural knowledge again reaches proposal, competitive authority, selection, fresh commitment and execution -- by updating retrieval, readout, ranking or eligibility mappings, while those trajectories remain categorically barred from acquiring the autobiographical, residue-write, realized-reward, reinforcement and direct-authority status of experienced events; and if so, what is the safe update target and what provenance rules make the separation machine-checkable rather than conventional?
Q-102.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: see ARC-020's what_would_answer -- do not re-derive; cross-referenced
in full because this question is gated on the SAME machinery ARC-020 requires, one level stricter.
ARC-020 requires a live, reachable typed commit-boundary gating writes FROM offline/sleep
consolidation TO privileged authority stores (POL/ID/CAPS-equivalent); THIS PRECONDITION CURRENTLY
FAILS (re-confirmed this pass: exhaustive grep of ree-v3/ree_core/ for write_locus,
permission_matrix, POL/CAPS/ID authority-store analogs, commit_token, commit_boundary returns zero
hits). Q-102 needs that same typed-boundary concept EXTENDED to a narrower and harder target than
ARC-020's own scope: not privileged authority-store writes in general, but specifically
retrieval/readout/ranking/eligibility-mapping updates sourced from MODEL-GENERATED (not merely
replayed) trajectories, with provenance rules that are machine-checkable rather than conventional.
MECH-322 (the one existing sanctioned exception, confirmed still v3_pending, first experimental
evidence V3-EXQ-873a 2026-08-07 supports) is the nearest analog and is instructive but does NOT
discharge this precondition: MECH-322 gates REPLAYED sequences forming ARC-071 POLICY CHUNKS under
three ANDed conditions (value-tag from real episodes, designated sleep phase, replay_origin audit
flag with accelerated dissolution) -- Q-102 asks about MODEL-GENERATED (not replayed) content
updating ACCESS/READOUT/ELIGIBILITY mappings (not policy chunks), which MECH-322's conditions
exclude by construction. A run attempted before the typed-boundary machinery exists should
self-route substrate_not_ready, not report a verdict.

CONFIRMING: an analogous typed, auditable, corroboration-gated path is designed and built for
model-generated trajectories updating access/readout/eligibility mappings, and under it: (a)
retention or repair of behavioural access (scored against ARC-130's ladder and ARC-131's
composed-not-isolated framing -- endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority,
committed throughput, ecological consequence, retention) is demonstrated for previously-inaccessible
but retained knowledge; (b) the audited path categorically refuses to grant the content
autobiographical/residue-write/realized-reward/reinforcement/direct-authority status (MECH-094's
strict separation preserved, verified the same way MECH-094's own falsifier verifies it -- every
write-capable consumer explicitly checks provenance and refuses); (c) an uncorroborated
model-generated update decays/dissolves on the same accelerated-dissolution logic MECH-322 already
uses, rather than persisting indefinitely.

FALSIFYING: no typed/auditable separation can be built that grants access-repair benefit without

ungoverned path, tag ignored, or a getattr fallback on a newly landed consumer) -- i.e. access

OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG: none -- despite the external prompt (Nijjer 2026 dream-rehearsal preprint,
arXiv:2607.19749, explicitly UNVERIFIED and explicitly NOT to be imported directly per this
claim's own notes), the question itself is REE-internal architecture/provenance, not a
clinical/pharmacological/neuroanatomical question answerable by literature alone.

or offline pipeline (the same substrate ARC-020 is gated on) AND its extension to

Currently the FIRST of those two does not exist at all, so this is gated one level behind ARC-020

Q-103.subject: l_space.authority_field_routing_vs_representation
Q-103.title: Routing-only or representational field: does the trajectory of L-space's coupling/authority state (MECH-534) itself carry task-relevant relational structure -- spatial relations, sequence, recent history -- beyond the instantaneous content state it gates, or does it only set eligibility, gain and topology over content stored elsewhere, or both? Pre-registered discriminator: on the SAME stored representations, controlled for parameter count and training exposure, an instantaneous decoder over r(t) versus a trajectory decoder over r(t-k:t) plus the authority variables; the representational branch is supported only if the trajectory decoder predicts current global structure, the appropriate retrieved path, or the next committed action better.
Q-103.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-534 must have SOME instantiation whose state trajectory can be recorded (none exists 2026-09-15); and the instantaneous decoder over r(t) and the trajectory decoder over r(t-k:t) must be MATCHED on parameter count and training exposure, or the trajectory decoder wins by capacity.
ANSWERED REPRESENTATIONAL: the trajectory decoder over r(t-k:t) plus the authority variables predicts current global structure, the appropriate retrieved path, or the next committed action better than the matched instantaneous decoder on the SAME stored representations -- the field carries content.
ANSWERED ROUTING-ONLY: the trajectory decoder adds nothing at matched capacity -- the field sets eligibility and topology over content stored elsewhere.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional; Q-106 is the orthogonal fork (how the field is GENERATED) and shares this precondition, so sequence the two together once a field exists.

Q-104.subject: architecture.cognifold_vs_braidling_criterion
Q-104.title: Cognifold versus braidling: at what point does invariant-preserving translation between cognitive systems constitute INTERNAL cognition (one cognifold) rather than communication between agents (a braidling)? Proposed discriminator, conceptual not yet formal: two systems form a BRAIDLING if each remains an independently coherent cognitive entity when communication is severed, however effective their coordination while joined; they are parts of ONE COGNIFOLD if their normal cognition depends on invariant-preserving transformations across the boundary and they jointly maintain one persistent self / world structure, so that severance degrades coherence on both sides rather than merely coordination. Does the cognitive contract (ARC-142) operationalise this -- through contract-dimension dependency, MECH-538 bridge complexity, or a severance assay -- and does the resulting criterion place REE's E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus on the cognifold side while placing two communicating REE agents on the braidling side?
Q-104.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a severance must be actually performable and reversible on both candidate configurations -- within-agent (E1/E2/E3/hippocampus) and between-agent -- and a coherence measure must exist that is not simply task performance; otherwise the criterion cannot be applied to either side.
ANSWERED (cognifold/braidling criterion holds): the severance assay places E1/E2/E3/hippocampus on the cognifold side (severance degrades coherence on BOTH sides, not merely coordination) and two communicating REE agents on the braidling side (each remains independently coherent), with the placement tracking a measurable contract-dimension dependency or MECH-538 bridge complexity rather than being stipulated.
ANSWERED NEGATIVE (criterion does no work): everything severs gracefully (no cognifold anywhere in REE) or nothing does; or placement tracks task-coupling strength alone with no contract-dimension signal (ordinary coupling measures answer it and the contract is not needed).
ROUTING ADDED 2026-09-15 (recorded here, not as a depends_on edge, because ARC-144 already depends_on this question): the red-team thought's section 18 sharpens the cognifold side to 'unity is a property of the transformation NETWORK'; under ARC-144 the cognifold is the region of the interface graph whose boundary obligations OVERLAP and the braidling boundary is where overlap goes to zero -- the overlap measurement ARC-144 demands is a candidate severance criterion.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional; the severance assay is complex (probe-gated) -- a spike measuring obligation overlap at two boundaries would convert it to puzzle (known rules).

Q-105.subject: provenance.source_attribution_vs_cardinality_dissociation
Q-105.title: Are source attribution and evidence cardinality DISSOCIABLE readouts of one provenance manipulation, or does a change in either always drag the other? Specifically: can P(external | representation) move without the effective independent-source count moving (a hallucination-like outcome with no confidence inflation), can the effective source count and calibration move without any change in external-source attribution (a delusion-like outcome with no altered phenomenology), and does a broader self-monitoring failure move both? A null on the dissociation is itself informative, because it would mean provenance errors alter source labels only and evidence cardinality is protected some other way -- which would retire the false-evidence-multiplication branch while leaving the source-monitoring account intact.
Q-105.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: both readouts independently instrumented and both moving somewhere in the design -- a source readout pinned at chance or a cardinality readout with no dynamic range makes a null uninterpretable; the four readouts (association strength, source attribution, effective independent-source count, calibration against world truth) reported separately, none derived from another, because the count instrument is miscalibrated away from its endpoints.
ANSWERED AFFIRMATIVE (dissociable): a 2x2 manipulating provenance and self-generation prediction separately in which at least one cell moves source attribution without moving the count, and at least one cell moves the count and calibration without moving source attribution.
ANSWERED NEGATIVE (one variable, two faces): the two readouts covary across every cell at matched instrument sensitivity -- which collapses MECH-552's epistemic branch back into the source-monitoring account and retires the multiplication branch while leaving MECH-094/MECH-248 intact.
Partial synthetic evidence (provenance_p1r5: criterion A9a FAIL, A9b PASS -- one manipulation moved attribution and not cardinality) is recorded so the question is not treated as untouched; it is NOT claim evidence.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional -- the epistemic readout P(H | evidence graph) has no referent in ree_core.

Q-106.subject: control_plane.endogenous_vs_scheduled_routing_generation
Q-106.title: Endogenous or exogenous routing generation: does CLOSING the loop -- letting the routing state be generated partly by the aggregate activity of the very subsystems whose effective connectivity it sets, so that local activity -> field state -> altered effective connectivity -> new activity -> updated field state -- confer any capability that a matched OPEN-LOOP routing schedule cannot reproduce? Pre-registered discriminator: two routing generators whose OUTPUT marginal statistics are matched (gain distribution, temporal autocorrelation, motif dwell time, transition entropy) and whose parameter and compute budgets are matched, one supplied independently of module activity and one evolved from it, compared on robustness to perturbation, speed of reconfiguration after a context change, adaptive routing in unseen contexts, and recovery after a transient lesion -- never on raw task score, which the extra recurrence alone can move. A null here is informative and expected to be common: if both perform identically, endogenous field feedback is unnecessary and the simpler scheduled field should be kept.
Q-106.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a routing state shown to be LOAD-BEARING (MECH-560 confirming, or an equivalent) AND two generators -- closed-loop (activity -> field -> activity) and open-loop scheduled -- whose OUTPUT statistics can be matched to a declared tolerance (gain distribution, temporal autocorrelation, motif dwell, transition entropy), because an unmatched comparison measures the statistics, not the loop. Verified absent 2026-09-15: neither generator exists and substrate_queue.json plans neither. This is the LAST stage of the family's programme; opening it before earlier stages have results tests a field nothing has shown to be load-bearing.
ANSWERED FOR ENDOGENOUS GENERATION: at matched output statistics, matched parameters and matched compute, the closed-loop generator beats the open-loop schedule on at least two of robustness to perturbation, reconfiguration speed after a context change, adaptive routing in unseen contexts, recovery after a transient lesion -- raw task score explicitly excluded as a readout.
ANSWERED FOR THE SCHEDULE (endogenous feedback unnecessary): identical performance on all four; ALSO answered-by-invalidation if the closed-loop advantage disappears against a random recurrent control field of the same capacity (the gain came from recurrence, not the specific coupling).
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional; sequence with Q-103 (the orthogonal fork: what the field CARRIES) once a field exists.

Q-107.subject: representation.code_change_versus_world_change_indistinguishability
Q-107.title: Can a system distinguish a change in its own code from a change in the world that code represents -- and if it cannot, what is a maintenance mechanism entitled to preserve? A label-free adaptive readout is blind to the difference between a drifting upstream encoding and a genuine change in the latent cause being encoded, so a self-repairing receiver can "correct" a TRUTHFUL update away, restoring an obsolete mapping and reporting it as stability; and an experimenter who scores only restored downstream performance cannot tell those apart either. The question has a sharp REE form: any claim that a maintenance process REPAIRED a mapping must show that the pre-drift mapping was still the CORRECT one, not merely that the receiver converged on something self-consistent -- which requires an anchor outside both endpoints (a ground-truth task target, a preserved external referent, or an explicit provenance marker on the change) that REE does not currently represent anywhere. Whether such an anchor is necessary, or whether self-consistency plus behavioural adequacy is the only coherent criterion available to an embedded system, is open.
Q-107.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a maintenance mechanism must exist whose behaviour COULD differ between the two cases. Degenerate today: no REE component adapts to upstream change at all, which is why this is deferred rather than testable.
ANSWERED (the ambiguity is real and consequential in REE): identical maintenance arms run under two conditions constructed to be indistinguishable from the receiver's vantage -- a pure code rotation with the task unchanged, and a genuine task change of matched magnitude at the sender -- and NO REE mechanism behaves differently; consequence: every REE maintenance claim must state an EXTERNAL ANCHOR (ground-truth task target, preserved external referent, or explicit provenance marker on the change) in its design.
ANSWERED NEGATIVE (a substantive positive finding, not a null): some REE mechanism DOES distinguish them without an externally supplied label -- a residual prediction error, a provenance tag (MECH-430 / MECH-553), or a z_goal-side signal carries the information implicitly.
Disposition 2026-09-15: (c) substrate-blocked, substrate_conditional, deferred with a named TRIGGER: the discriminating manipulation needs the controlled-drift INTERVENTION that does not exist (per_code_drift in interface_probe.py measures; nothing imposes) -- revisit when either MECH-562's arm F or assay B's Gate 0 drift instrument is built, at which point the test is nearly free (both construct a known code rotation; the only addition is a matched-magnitude genuine task change).

Q-108.subject: methodology.minimal_working_intelligence_event
Q-108.title: What would constitute a minimal-working-intelligence EVENT for REE -- a single non-oracular adaptive-recovery episode in which a previously useful internal model becomes materially wrong, the organism detects the mismatch, allocates information-seeking or computation toward it, updates the relevant representation or interface without being told which subsystem failed, recovers closed-loop competence above a preregistered threshold, retains still-valid knowledge, transfers some advantage to a second related perturbation, and loses the advantage when the proposed adaptive machinery is ablated -- and which perturbation class (cue remapping, resource-contingency reversal, hidden transition change, memory or provenance corruption, interface drift, sensor or affordance change) is first NON-VACUOUS on the substrate REE actually has? Such an event is qualitatively different from an accumulation of local PASSes; passing one tiny-world challenge would establish an integrated adaptive episode, not general intelligence.
Q-108.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (all required; the doctrine section 11 gate items 1-3 made measurable):
(P1) Baseline competence. On the arena used, the pre-perturbation REE policy beats the random
     baseline by a preregistered margin and reaches a stated fraction of the oracle on >= 2/3
     seeds, and it is stable (low committed-class turnover). UNMET today: V3-EXQ-745 ree_on
     0.0-1.2 vs random 0.9-2.05 vs oracle 41.8-47.9 resources/episode.
(P2) Real mismatch without a label. The perturbation materially degrades the pre-shift policy,
     and the observation carries no change flag.
(P3) Plasticity live inside ree_core during recovery, with no driver-side retraining. UNMET:
     GFLAG-0491, no waking gradient learning at defaults. The WakingTrainer (GFLAG-0501, Q4a) is
     decided but not built.
(P4) A mismatch signal that clears noise against the depth-0 schedule-only control. MIXED:
     V3-EXQ-901 graded MEL 3/3 seeds, but V3-EXQ-1062a high-shift arm PE elevation 0.0132

ANSWER TO THE "WHICH CLASS" LEG (a registry fact, not a run): the nearest V3-expressible class is

PatchFlipController (V3-EXQ-745). AR-1 cue remapping has no lever. AR-4 needs MECH-552..554.
AR-5 is blocked by Q-107's missing controlled-drift intervention.

ANSWERED (an event occurred): with P1-P4 met, a single unannounced depth >= 1 shift yields ALL of:
mismatch detection earlier than the depth-0 control; information or computation re-allocation
toward the change; a directional update of E2 world_forward / action map; recovery above the
