Q-109.subject: plasticity.ach_window_tags_for_sleep_reuse
Q-109.title: Does the striatal cholinergic TAN-pause window (MECH-453) act as the waking TAG stage of MECH-431's tag-and-capture structure for procedural policy writes -- so that window-tagged traces are the ones offline replay later captures (MECH-322's value-tagged striatal sleep-replay carve-out, MECH-285 replay priority) for refinement, compression or context reassignment -- or are the waking window and offline capture selection independent, with sleep selecting procedural traces by value, salience and recency tags that the window does not set?
Q-109.what_would_answer:
PRECONDITIONS: a gating MECH-453 window (see ARC-154 P1) and an offline stage that captures a subset of
procedural traces (MECH-322 carve-out or equivalent), with per-trace logging of window membership,
value tag, salience and recency.
CONFOUND THAT MUST BE PARTIALLED OUT: dopamine sets the window's duration (Kim 2019), so window membership
and value tags are correlated by construction; a comparison not matched on value/salience/recency is
vacuous.
ANSWER "the window is the tag": among traces matched on value, salience and recency, those that fell
inside a waking window are over-represented among offline-captured traces, AND holding the window
permanently open abolishes that over-representation while leaving value tagging intact.
ANSWER "independent": window membership adds no predictive power for offline capture beyond value,
salience and recency.
V4 / substrate_conditional; no experiment proposed.

Q-110.subject: ethics.residue_metabolism_via_caregiver_bond
Q-110.title: Is the caregiver / being-loved bond a DISTINCT channel through which the persisting valence load of moral residue is metabolised -- integrated without being erased (INV-006) -- so that Axiom 6 ('existence is bearable only with responsibility for others') does concrete architectural work in the defensive-harm / predator case, beyond what repair-completion release (MECH-412) and social soothing of the suffering state (MECH-355) already provide?
Q-110.what_would_answer:
EXTRACTED from the claim's own draft note, then tightened against MECH-595's blunting pole
(see group preamble, finding 2).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (a null under any unmet one is uninterpretable, not evidence
against):
  P1. MECH-595's P1-P5 hold (cite; do not re-derive). In particular: a signed, residue-fed
      tonic variable m with a choice consumer; residue-content preservation (MECH-595 P2,
      ResidueField decay off, residue magnitude matched across arms); and m separable from
      the z_harm_a suffering state (MECH-595 P5).
  P2. MECH-595's interior window has been located, so "shortening an excursion" can be told
      apart from "blunting".
  P3. A V5 caregiver-bond substrate exists (INV-043 caregiver requirement; LOVE-2 plan node).
      The bond is operationalised as RELATIONAL AVAILABILITY (the caregiver present and
      reachable after the harm event), distinct from INV-082 INTERNALISED loveability. The
      latter is held constant across arms (both arms have the same internalised safe base,
      or both lack it), or it becomes a third rival channel.
  P4. Rivals held constant at NON-ZERO levels:
      - repair opportunity (MECH-412) available and matched in both arms;
      - suffering-soothing (MECH-355) matched. Measure the bond effect only AFTER z_harm_a
        has returned to baseline (MECH-595 P5), so a residual effect on m cannot be
        soothing of suffering.
  P5. The harm is unavoidable and self-caused, including the defensive-harm case the claim
      names (harm to another agent as the only viable defence). This is the V5 multi-agent
      leg, and it is why the claim is v5.
  WELFARE GATE (SENT-2, SENT-9, SENT-12, SENT-13 via LOVE-2/4/5 ethical_metadata):
    - the bond-absent arm must be NEVER-BONDED, never a withdrawal of an established bond
      (forbidden: social_attachment_plus_abandonment_or_exclusion);
    - the repair channel must exist in every arm (forbidden:
      relational_harm_without_repair_channel), which is why P4 says NON-ZERO;
    - the MECH-595 boundedness and relief requirements carry over;
    - the harm to another agent falls under the multi_agent_ecology_v5 welfare metadata;
    - no arm runs before welfare review clears.

ANSWER "YES, a distinct channel" if, with P1-P5 met, bond-available agents show ALL of:
  (i)   a shorter residue-driven excursion of m, specifically of PROLONGED / stuck-tending
        excursions;
  (ii)  unchanged excursion ONSET and PEAK (the functional excursion is not suppressed);
  (iii) residue magnitude not reduced (MECH-595 P2, INV-006: integrated, not erased);
  (iv)  residue-sensitive choice preserved (MECH-595 P4 DV at or above the bond-absent
        level).
  The bond moves the agent toward the interior of MECH-595's window, and the effect
  survives both rival controls.

ANSWER "NO":
  - if the effect is fully carried by repair (it vanishes when MECH-412 repair is matched) or
    by soothing (it vanishes when measured after z_harm_a returns to baseline); OR
  - if bond availability changes nothing measurable on m.

ANSWER "ARCHITECTURAL VIOLATION, not metabolism" if the bond shortens the excursion only by:
  - lowering residue magnitude (erasure, contra INV-006), OR
  - lowering residue-sensitive choice (the MECH-595 blunting pole). A bond that comforts by
    numbing is the callous failure, not the Axiom 6 function.

TWO LEGS (author decision 2026-09-25, session thought-backlog-20260925: "bond" means BOTH):
  LEG A -- caregiver AVAILABILITY: the test above, with the caregiver present during and after
    the residue-driven excursion.
  LEG B -- INTERNALISED LOVEABILITY (INV-082): agents with an established bond history are
    tested in caregiver-ABSENT episodes, against never-bonded agents at matched repair and
    soothing. Caregiver absence must be a scheduled feature of the ecology from the start
    (routine separation), NEVER a withdrawal or rupture of the established bond (forbidden
    combination social_attachment_plus_abandonment_or_exclusion). Answer YES for leg B on
    criteria (i)-(iv) holding in the caregiver-absent episodes.
  Reading the legs jointly: A yes / B no = an availability-only channel (no internalisation);
    A yes / B yes = the bond is internalised as a standing regulator (INV-082's sense);
    A no / B yes is not expected and would indicate a history effect independent of the
    present caregiver -- check it is not a residue-magnitude or training-exposure confound.

DO NOT build in V3. DO NOT queue an experiment. Social buffering (Hostinar et al. 2014,
banked for MECH-355) is adjacent evidence on stress, not on moral residue.
Disposition 2026-09-25: (c) substrate-blocked (V5 caregiver substrate + MECH-595's signed
tonic variable).

Q-111.subject: control_plane.controller_composition_substrate_interference
Q-111.title: Once each simultaneously active REE controller is individually validated, operating-point corrected (ARC-155) and given regime-surviving exit evidence (ARC-156), do the existing controllers compose without one removing the behavioural or informational substrate another needs (freeze removing the action freedom a safety veto acts over; threat mode suppressing the plasticity or exploration that model repair needs; commitment suppressing needed exploration and vice versa) -- or does destructive interference persist, so that REE needs an explicit DISTRIBUTED authority-regulation principle (reciprocal inhibition, precision or gain weighting keyed on the other controller's state, basal-ganglia-like lawful access, state-dependent routing) that is not a central executive?
Q-111.what_would_answer:
DIGESTED 2026-09-26 (thought-intake-20260926). DISPOSITION: (c) substrate_conditional -- P2 and P3 are
unmet today (no ARC-155/ARC-156 correction in place; freeze collapses the action space in the motivating
pair). First leg: a re-read of V3-EXQ-1090a after the freeze-lock fix.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS:
  P1. Each controller in a tested pair is individually validated on its own terms (for the MECH-449
      veto: 1090's C1/C2/C4, fires / calibrated / silent on the untrained-head control).
  P2. ARC-155 and ARC-156 corrections are in place for each controller in the pair. Otherwise interference
      cannot be told apart from miscalibration or a self-locking regime.
  P3. Executed action varies on the evaluated agent: the modal action share is below a pre-registered
      ceiling (the 1090 action-diversity precondition). Otherwise no controller can show a consequence.
  P4. The ecology co-activates both controllers' domains on a pre-registered minimum count of ticks.

DESIGN (pairwise composition; first pair freeze x veto, then threat-mode x plasticity/repair, then
stuckness-exploration (SD-061/MECH-527) x commitment (BetaGate)):
  arms: controller X alone / Y alone / X+Y / X+Y with a distributed reciprocal authority term keyed on the
  OTHER controller's own endogenous state (e.g. veto No-Go pressure on the freeze no-op class when the
  veto fires; or precision attenuation of the dominant controller while the other's evidence is pending).
  No central module, and no condition labels.
DV: each controller's retained behavioural consequence in composition relative to alone, i.e. ARC-130
committed throughput and ecological consequence (for the veto: realised-harm change attributable to vetoed
candidates not executing).

CONFIRMING (an extra principle is needed): with P1-P4 met, at least one pair in which Y retains < 50% of
its isolated consequence because X removes its action or information substrate. The reciprocal term
restores >= 50% of that loss without reducing X's own consequence by more than a pre-registered margin.

FALSIFYING (no extra principle; Q-111 answers "no"): with P1-P4 met, every tested controller retains
>= 80% of its isolated consequence in every tested pair. Per-controller correction is then sufficient.

NOTE: The first leg needs no new substrate. It is a re-read of the already-routed V3-EXQ-1090a (MECH-449
with the action-diversity precondition), run after the freeze-lock fix.

Q-112.subject: development.minimal_developmental_prior_set
Q-112.title: What is the minimal set of inherited, environment-general structures an REE organism needs in order to become learnable -- to generate experience from which action-consequence, self/world and value distinctions can be learned -- and which of the current candidates (a valued, vulnerable self-state; a small general basis for structured endogenous action; sensitivity to self-action contingency; persistent but revisable developmental memory) are necessities, which are accelerators, which can emerge from the others, and which are environment-specific scaffolds, as determined by reduction and ablation from a deliberately over-provisioned general set in which each removal must produce its own predicted developmental failure and each restoration must repair development without encoding the environment's solution?
Q-112.what_would_answer:
DIGESTED 2026-09-26 (thought-intake-20260926). DISPOSITION: (c) substrate_conditional -- two of four legs
(contingency, viability) lack a lever and the generality leg needs a second world family. The
structured-action and retention legs are carried by MECH-597 and the coupled campaign. Do NOT queue
anything from this entry.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (a null or a "removal costs nothing" reading under any unmet one is
uninterpretable, not evidence):
  P1. FULL-SET DEVELOPS. An over-provisioned general candidate set must first produce development on
      its own. The pre-registered developmental DVs must clear their bars:
        - E2 action discrimination (the disc4_h1 executed-closest metric, bar >= ~0.47, with fidelity
          k reported), retained under later on-policy training;
        - a closed-loop behavioural readout (A1-type).
      If the full set does not develop, every ablation is floored and says nothing about necessity.
  P2. EACH CANDIDATE IS A SEPARABLE LEVER. Each candidate must be a default-OFF, OFF-bit-identical
      switch that removes that element ONLY, and never enabling architecture with it.
      UNMET today for contingency sensitivity: E2's world head is action-conditioned by
      construction, so "remove contingency bias" currently also removes the action input.
      UNMET for viability grounding: there is no arm that removes valued self-state while keeping
      exploration and modelling.
      MET for structured action (StructuredBabbler) and for retention (the W3 retained buffer, on
      the integration branch).
  P3. >= 2 PREDECLARED WORLD FAMILIES (GOV-ECOL-1). Seeds alone cannot answer the generality leg.
  P4. DEVELOPMENTAL DVs, not endpoint reward (sec 15 of the source thought):
        - action-space coverage, and action->consequence MI;
        - world-model action discrimination;
        - persistence of developmental knowledge;
        - PE and PE reduction;
        - survival duration;
        - time to first model-based behaviour;
        - recovery after change;
        - E3 dependence on learned causal information.
      Each emergent capacity must also have a causal-path check (GOV-PATHVALID-1).

CONFIRMING (per leg):
  (a) NECESSITY. Each candidate necessity produces its OWN predicted failure when removed from the
      developing full set, and an accelerator ablation only slows or destabilises development.
      Predicted failures:
        - no structured endogenous action -> E2 discrimination stays at the on-policy baseline;
        - no retention -> the developmental gain decays under on-policy training;
        - no valued self-state -> no stable preservation or goal behaviour;
        - no contingency bias -> agency/controllability estimates fail to form.
      Restoring the removed element repairs development WITHOUT environment-specific content, i.e.
      the restored element is identical across world families.
  (b) GENERALITY. The same small set bootstraps development in both world families, with no
      environment-specific scaffold admitted. Orienting and curiosity-like behaviour emerge without an
      explicit orienting rule.
  (c) AXIOM MAPPING. Removing viability grounding (the A2/D1 implementation) abolishes stable
      preservation / goal behaviour, and no other source supplies it. This is consistent with A2/D1
      being developmental prerequisites (not proof of the axioms).

FALSIFYING (any one answers the question AGAINST the candidate as a necessity):
  - A candidate necessity is removed with no developmental cost across BOTH world families. It was
    an accelerator or redundant: reclassify under ARC-157.
  - Unstructured or native behaviour yields equally informative world models once other training
    defects are corrected. That would contradict the 09-25 D1 result at larger scale.
  - A candidate can only be "restored" by environment-specific content. It is then an ecological
    scaffold, not a general prior (ARC-157).
  - Leg (c): preservation / goal behaviour arises without any valued self-state or equivalent. A2's
    implementation then requires reconsideration, and the finding is routed to the derivational
    layer with GOV-INSERT-1 / GOV-HOTHER-1.

EXISTING EVIDENCE (bears on leg (a) only, D1, structured-action + retention elements):
  - babbling_e2_action_coverage_probe_20260925.md: native Phase-0 policy S FAIL 1/5, DR FAIL 0/5.
    The structured L2 source was sufficient pre-post 5/5, with retained replay 5/5 vs one-off 2/5
    (secondary, descriptive).
  - V3-EXQ-1108: autopsy confirmed 2026-09-26 (verdict NEITHER; frozen read path holds, trained-encoder
    case open; see MECH-597).
  Nothing yet on contingency, viability or generality.

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT:
  - a separable contingency-bias lever;
  - a viability-grounding ablation arm;
  - a second declared world family;
  - an integrated closed-loop acceptance harness (campaign A1 is the nearest; it is HELD).
Consumer / boundary: developmental trajectory, not an adult-competence endpoint.
Existing ownership: INV-073, ARC-074, MECH-461, ARC-157, MECH-597, coupled_loop_repair_campaign_plan.md
(W2a, W3, A1).

Q-113.subject: threat_prediction.harm_to_source_closure
Q-113.title: After an unexpected harm event, does the current V3 stack (SD-099 orienting + MECH-074d attribution + E1 / residue memory + E3 harm scoring) selectively strengthen the representation of the thing, action or context that caused it, such that that representation later changes prediction and action BEFORE harm recurs -- and if not, is the missing edge integration, an injury-vs-threat consumer split, a new credit mechanism (MECH-598 / MECH-599), or z_world cue identity itself?
Q-113.what_would_answer:
DIGESTED 2026-09-26 (thought-ingest-harm-to-threat-20260926). DISPOSITION: (c) substrate-blocked,
substrate_conditional -- the environment needs a two-cue harm contingency that CausalGridWorld does not have
(SD-065 added a Pavlovian SAFETY CS channel; there is no threat-CS twin), and source-specific credit is
presumptively gated on z_world cue identity (MECH-153). First step is a probe, not an experiment.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (a null under any unmet one is not evidence for any of the four answers):
  P1. CUE IDENTITY IN z_world (the shared precondition MECH-598 / MECH-599 point at). Two co-present
      candidate cues A (harm-predictive) and B (neutral) must be linearly decodable from frozen z_world
      on held-out ticks above a pre-registered bar (balanced accuracy >= 0.80, and above an
      untrained-projection control of the same input, cf. V3-EXQ-1002). If P1 fails the answer is (4)
      REPRESENTATION-GATED and the run stops there.
  P2. A GENUINE CONTINGENCY WITH HEADROOM. Only A causes damage; B co-occurs with A on a pre-registered
      fraction of harm events AND appears alone without harm; a pre-contact avoidance action is available
      so anticipatory avoidance is measurable; no hazard identity or proximity oracle reaches the agent.
  P3. A LIVE ADVERSE EVENT. The trigger is a phasic event (z_harm_s onset / harm-PE / negative delta in
      valued self-state), counted per event; persistent ||z_harm_a|| magnitude does not count (V3-EXQ-1109).
  P4. EDGE TRACE RECORDED. For each edge (adverse event -> orienting -> candidate eligibility/attribution
      -> durable write -> prospective prediction -> pre-harm behaviour) the run records producer,
      consumer, default flag state, and whether the edge fired, so a null names its failing edge.

MANIPULATION: the existing stack with SD-099 (DefensiveOrientingGate) and MECH-074d (BLAAttributionHead)
ON versus OFF, crossed with an injury-vs-threat consumer arm (freeze/orienting release reading z_harm_s or
E3 predicted harm instead of raw z_harm_a). Matched seeds (>= 5), identical contingency schedule.
Controls: B-only exposure; contingency reversal phase (A becomes safe, B harmful).

DV: (i) pre-contact avoidance of A vs B (source specificity = avoid(A) - avoid(B)), measured on trials
BEFORE any new damage in that trial; (ii) predicted harm from E3 / residue at first sight of A vs B;
(iii) reversal: trials-to-criterion after the swap; (iv) per-edge firing from P4.

ANSWER MAPPING:
  (1) INTEGRATION -- every edge fires in isolation (P4) but specificity > 0 only when SD-099 and MECH-074d
      are both ON and wired to a prospective consumer.
  (2) SEMANTIC SPLIT -- specificity and reversal appear ONLY in the injury-vs-threat consumer arm.
  (3) NEW MECHANISM -- P1-P3 green, all edges fire, and specificity stays ~0 in every arm (A and B are
      credited alike, or neither becomes a pre-harm predictor): the stack lacks selective credit ->
      MECH-598 / MECH-599 become the build candidates.
  (4) REPRESENTATION-GATED -- P1 fails.
FALSIFYING the premise of the question: the unmodified current stack (flags at defaults) already shows
specificity > 0 on >= 4/5 seeds and reverses; then Q-113 closes "already closed" and MECH-598 / MECH-599
lose their V3 motivation.

RA-001.subject: clinical.depression_network_coupling_reversal
RA-001.title: Long-term clinical depression involves a chronicity-dependent reversal of large-scale network coupling: past a ~24-month chronicity threshold, the relationship between symptom severity and Central-Executive-Network (CEN) <-> Default-Mode-Network (DMN, precuneus) functional connectivity reverses sign (non-chronic: stronger CEN-DMN coupling at low severity, weaker at high; chronic: connectivity strengthens as symptoms worsen, co-occurring with entrenched rumination). The depressive brain-state is duration-indexed, not a single static regime.
RA-001.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain research_anchor: the test domain is a clinical fMRI cohort; no
REE substrate distinguishes named large-scale networks (CEN/DMN), so the
anchor is confirmed or collapsed by external replication, never by a V3 run.
Discriminating empirical signature that CONFIRMS the anchor: an independent
fMRI cohort, stratified by episode duration at a ~24-month chronicity
threshold, reproduces a SIGN REVERSAL in the relationship between symptom
severity (HAM-D) and CEN<->precuneus(DMN) functional connectivity --
non-chronic patients show connectivity DECREASING with severity, chronic
patients show connectivity INCREASING with severity (the Zanao et al. 2026 Sci
Rep n=46 result), establishing that the depressive brain-state is
duration-indexed rather than a single static regime. COLLAPSES the anchor if a
larger or pre-registered replication finds the severity-connectivity slope is
the same sign in chronic and non-chronic cohorts (no chronicity moderation),
or if the apparent reversal is explained by a confound (medication exposure,
age, scanner/motion) rather than chronicity, or if the threshold is not near
24 months and no stable duration boundary exists. PRECISION guardrail:
'reverses' means a cross-sectional reversal of the connectivity-vs-severity
slope between cohorts, NOT demonstrated therapeutic reversibility (that is
Q-061); and this is long-term CLINICAL depression, not synaptic LTD. A
confirming replication strengthens the REE depression cluster (MECH-088 /
INV-034 / MECH-124) and motivates MECH-367; it must never be cited as REE
substrate evidence.

RA-002.subject: clinical.psychiatric_genomic_factor_overlap
RA-002.title: Clinically distinct psychiatric diagnoses share a small set of latent genomic factors that cut across diagnostic boundaries: large-scale genomic structural-equation modelling across 14 childhood- and adult-onset psychiatric disorders (>1 million individuals) finds that the majority of case-vs-control genetic variance is captured by FIVE shared genomic factors (Compulsive; Schizophrenia-bipolar / psychotic-mood; Neurodevelopmental; Internalizing; Substance-use) spanning 238 variants, with factor-specific biology (e.g. oligodendrocyte genes enriched in the Internalizing factor) acting early in brain development. Psychiatric categories are surface expressions over overlapping latent dimensions, not genetically discrete kinds.
RA-002.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain research_anchor: the test domain is a human-genetics cohort; no
REE substrate distinguishes genomic factors, so the anchor is confirmed or
collapsed by external genomics replication, never by a V3 run, and it must
never be cited as REE mechanism evidence. Discriminating empirical signature
that CONFIRMS the anchor: an independent large-scale genomic
structural-equation modelling effort across childhood- and adult-onset
psychiatric disorders reproduces a SMALL number (~five) of shared
cross-diagnostic latent genomic factors (Compulsive;
Schizophrenia-bipolar/psychotic-mood; Neurodevelopmental; Internalizing;
Substance-use) that capture the majority of case-vs-control genetic variance,
with factor-specific developmental biology (e.g. oligodendrocyte-gene
enrichment in the Internalizing factor) -- i.e. the genomic structure is
low-dimensional and cuts ACROSS diagnostic boundaries (the Grotzinger et al.
2025 Nat Genet result, >1M individuals, 238 variants). COLLAPSES the anchor if
replication instead recovers factors that align ONE-TO-ONE with DSM categories
(no cross-diagnostic sharing), or if the dimensionality is not low (no
parsimonious small factor set survives out-of-sample), or if the factor
structure is unstable across ancestries/cohorts. GUARDRAIL (anti-determinism):
genetic overlap does NOT make diagnoses meaningless and individual
presentations cannot be read off polygenic factors -- the load-bearing
extraction is the SURFACE-CLUSTER principle (categories are emergent clusters
over overlapping latent axes), which REE already holds (IMPL-005, INV-061). A
confirming replication motivates the architectural axis layer (ARC-086), the
syndrome-as-vector question (Q-064), and the p-factor analogue (MECH-371); the
factor labels and 238-variant count are from the abstract plus press summaries
and should be cross-checked against the full paper.

RA-003.subject: comparative_cognition.llm_convergent_motifs
RA-003.title: Convergent cognitive motifs in language models: sufficiently capable models trained to predict human language may independently develop computational motifs functionally analogous to specific REE mechanisms (orienting, replay, self-representation, other-agent modelling, prediction-error management, arbitration, epistemic uncertainty, long-term goals), because language statistically encodes traces of the cognitive machinery that generated it. Predicts functional convergence, not architectural identity.
RA-003.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain research_anchor: the test domain is mechanistic interpretability
of trained external language models, not REE's own V3 substrate -- no REE
experiment can confirm or collapse this anchor. CONFIRMING signature: an
independent mechanistic-interpretability study identifies internal
computational circuits in a language model that are FUNCTIONALLY analogous
(same input-output role, not shared architecture) to a named REE mechanism
(e.g. an uncertainty-driven exploration bonus resembling MECH-314b, a
self-referential state tracker, an arbitration-like competition between
candidate continuations), established via causal ablation/activation-patching
rather than behavioural similarity alone. COLLAPSING signature:
interpretability work finds the analogous behaviour is produced by
mechanisms with no principled functional correspondence to the REE
mechanism (e.g. pure memorised pattern-completion with no separable
"uncertainty" or "arbitration" subcircuit), or convergence claims fail to
replicate across model families/scales. Never resolved by a REE experiment;
resolved only by tracking external interpretability literature (a lit-pull
target, not a queued experiment).

SD-001.subject: hippocampal_module.cem_trajectory_search_placement
SD-001.title: CEM-based trajectory search belongs in HippocampalModule, not E2.
SD-001.what_would_answer:
NOT A PASS/FAIL EXPERIMENT. SD-001 is a placement decision; it is answered by a structural check of
ree-v3 plus the design argument, and it stays resolved while both hold.
PROOF OBLIGATION (structural, re-checkable): (1) every CEM step that refits a proposal distribution
-- elite selection (num_elite, floored at _MIN_CEM_ELITES) and mean/std update over action-object
proposals -- lives in ree_core/hippocampal/module.py (HippocampalModule); (2) E2FastPredictor
(ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py) exposes only forward-model / rollout operations (predict_next_self,
world_forward, rollout_with_world, rollout_self, action_object) and random-action/random-shooting
helpers, with NO elite selection, score-based refit, or trajectory scoring; (3) E2's training losses
are prediction losses on (z_t, a_t) -> z_{t+1}, never a selection or value loss. Verified 2026-09-25
at ree-v3 9376015.
DESIGN ARGUMENT: a transition model that also searches has its learned dynamics shaped by what the
search happened to select; separating them keeps E2 an unbiased f(z_t, a_t) -> z_{t+1} that any
proposer (hippocampal CEM, replay, sleep) can reuse.
COUNTEREXAMPLE (what would reopen it): an elite/refit loop, a score-driven candidate selection, or
a selection-derived loss added to E2; or a demonstrated case where hippocampal CEM needs gradients
or state that only E2 can hold (i.e. the separation costs planning quality measurably).
NOTES: E2.forward()/generate_candidates_random are V2-compat random-shooting shims (no refit) and
do not violate (2); their "used by HippocampalModule during CEM" docstring is stale.

SD-002.subject: hippocampal_module.e1_associative_prior_wiring
SD-002.title: E1 associative prior must be wired into HippocampalModule for terrain-informed rollout search.
SD-002.what_would_answer:
STRUCTURAL LEG (answered, code check): HippocampalModule._get_terrain_action_object_mean
(ree-v3 ree_core/hippocampal/module.py:562) concatenates (z_world, e1_prior, residue_val[,
benefit_val]) into terrain_prior, and REEAgent threads the E1 tick's prior into
propose_trajectories(e1_prior=...) (agent.py:6952). Wired: yes, as of ree-v3 9376015.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) terrain_prior must be TRAINED -- at shipped defaults no ree_core
loss trains it, so the E1 channel feeds a frozen random projection and any null is vacuous; use the
EXQ-042 / EXQ-1061 BC loss (MSE(terrain_prior mean, selected trajectory AO sequence.detach())) and
require terrain loss to fall to <= 0.7x initial WITHOUT collapsing to a constant (per-state variance
of the proposal mean > 0). (2) E1 must be trained and its prior informative: E1 prediction loss
converged and e1_prior not ~zeros and not ~a copy of z_world (corr(e1_prior - z_world, z_world
next-step delta) > 0). (3) The E1 tick must actually fire on the E3 ticks measured (zero-fill
fraction reported; < 10%).
MANIPULATION: matched-seed arms after identical training -- E1_ON (e1_prior intact into
terrain_prior) vs E1_ZERO (e1_prior replaced by zeros in the terrain_prior input only, width
preserved, terrain_prior trained under the same ablation) vs E1_SHUFFLED (e1_prior permuted across
batch/time: matched norm, destroyed state-correspondence).
CONFIRMING: E1_ON proposals are measurably more terrain-informed than both controls on >= 2/3 seeds:
lower mean residue / harm along the initial (pre-refit) proposal mean AND a downstream effect
surviving CEM refit (harm-contact rate or path efficiency), each exceeding the seed SD of the
difference with an absolute floor.
FALSIFYING: E1_ON indistinguishable from E1_ZERO and E1_SHUFFLED on proposal residue and on

initialisation, not selection) and should be reported as such, not as a PASS.

SD-003.subject: self_attribution.counterfactual_e2_pipeline
SD-003.title: Self-attribution via counterfactual E2: causal signature = E2(z_t, a_actual) minus E2(z_t, a_counterfactual).
SD-003.what_would_answer:
SD-003 is superseded (2026-04-18, by MECH-256 + SD-029) and carries no live falsification obligation of its own. Its two-pass counterfactual architecture (causal_sig = E2(a_actual) - E2(a_cf)) was retired because the 2026-04-18 three-pull literature synthesis (14 entries) found the single-pass comparator (Frith 2000, Shergill 2003, Blakemore 1998) to be the biologically-evidenced mechanism, not the two-pass counterfactual. SD-003's own accumulated evidence chain (28 FAILs across V2+V3, EXQ-030b/ 115/166a/195/353/431/032d) remains historical record and is not re-litigated here.
THE LIVE FALSIFIER IS SD-029'S (successor, single-pass z_harm_s comparator, MECH-256's concrete instantiation), already digested 2026-08-07 (thought-digestion wave 10): C1 (forward_r2 >= 0.9) and C3 (event-conditioned residual SNR) repeatedly pass clean across 13+ runs; C2 (Shergill-style partial attenuation for self- vs externally-caused harm) has never once been evaluable because training/eval produces near-single-class hazard-event distributions. SD-029 is epistemic_category: substrate_ceiling (set 2026-08-07), held pending MECH-269/MECH-269b V_s landing and, per self_attribution_plan.md GAP-2, conversion_ceiling_campaign:FULLSTACK specifically.
