SD-004.subject: hippocampal_module.action_object_map_backbone
SD-004.title: Action objects as hippocampal map backbone, enabling long-horizon planning beyond step-level trajectories.
SD-004.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The action-object representation under test must actually be what SD-004 specifies: a LEARNED, consequence-structured compression of the world effect of (z_world, a), state-DEPENDENT and verified so in-run. At shipped defaults it is not -- E2FastPredictor.action_object_head is constructed at e2_fast.py:144, used once at :602 and touched by no loss anywhere in ree_core, so O is a frozen random projection and any planning benefit measured at defaults is attributable to the CEM search, not to the representation.
CONFIRMING: With grounding verified to have taken, the grounded arm shows a significant harm-rate or path-efficiency advantage over both the frozen-head baseline and the matched-gradient irrelevant-target control, on >= 2/3 seeds, against a base effect established on the corrected 114a design. Manipulation: Three arms on the grounding of O: ARM_0 baseline with action_object_head frozen (the shipped default), ARM_1 with the 817a world-effect grounding objective that demonstrably produced a consequence-structured, state-dependent O (r2 0.98 -> 0.72 with clean paired and shuffled controls), and a hippocampus-ablated arm as the base-effect reference. Control: The shuffled-pairing control from the 817a design (grounding target mis-paired), plus a matched-gradient arm grounding O on a consequence-irrelevant target, so a behavioural difference is attributable to consequence structure rather than to the extra optimisation the grounding arm receives. Required event: Navigation or foraging episodes whose horizon exceeds what step-level trajectory search handles, so that a compressed reusable action-object representation could in principle buy planning depth that step-level search cannot. DV: Harm rate and path efficiency of the committed policy, reported jointly with a grounding manipulation check (parameter delta from frozen, grounding MSE, state-dependence of O) so 'grounding took but did not help' is distinguishable from 'grounding did not take'. The base effect must be measured on the CORRECTED V3-EXQ-114a design -- matched episode budget plus a static no-op control -- not EXQ-114's 99.2%.
FALSIFYING: With grounding verified to have taken and a live base effect, the grounded arm is flat or nominally worse than the frozen-head baseline -- which is what V3-EXQ-817a measured. SD-004's efficiency and semantic-grounding RATIONALE then does not hold, and the claim narrows to 'CEM in a fixed bottleneck space plans adequately', which is not what it asserts. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Everything exists but lives in driver scaffolding rather than substrate: HippocampalModule proposes and refits by CEM in action-object space (module.py:2054, 2149), E2FastPredictor.action_object() produces o_t, and v3_exq_817a implements both the grounding objective and its manipulation checks. There is no loss in ree_core that trains action_object_head, so the grounded condition is reachable only through a driver. Consumer / boundary: The hippocampal CEM's proposal space -- whether planning quality depends on O being a learned world-effect compression rather than any fixed bottleneck projection of (z_world, a). This is the planner-side coupling from representation quality to action choice, which the 817a autopsy explicitly leaves open. Existing ownership: SD-004, SD-080, V3-EXQ-817a, V3-EXQ-114a, ARC-007, EXP-0137.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The quantity SD-004 asserts has no producer in the substrate: action_object_head receives no gradient from any ree_core loss, so the shipped O is state-invariant and cannot be the learned world-effect compression the claim names. The one experiment that did ground it (817a) had to build the objective itself, and its behavioural null is a rationale-level result the claim record has absorbed without a substrate change. Secondary classes: R1, R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-005.subject: latent_stack.self_world_latent_split
SD-005.title: z_gamma split into z_self (E2 motor-sensory domain) and z_world (E3/Hippocampus domain).
SD-005.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Keep the four existing gates -- differential loss routing genuinely active (not a frozen post-hoc probe, EXQ-047d; not a geometric orthogonality penalty, EXQ-047f), adequate warmup, SD-008 alpha_world pinned and reported at 0.9, cross-decoding probe n at or above 20/30 with environment scale stated -- and ADD a z_world-adequacy gate measured in-run: world-content decodability from z_world must clear a pre-registered floor above chance, else the world-side DV is structurally pinned and the run self-routes substrate_not_ready.
CONFIRMING: With the adequacy gate PASSED, both sides clear their original thresholds (action_dissociation_split > 0.10 AND contact_dissociation_split > 0.05) and gap_approach delta >= 0.02 replicates at more than one environment scale. A one-sided result does not confirm: EXQ-532 already shows self_body_advantage +0.126 with world_obs_advantage -0.032. Manipulation: unified_latent_mode True (single latent) against False (SD-005 split encoder), with differential loss routing to E2 for z_self and E3 for z_world confirmed active in the split arm, at matched warmup and matched environment scale. Control: The unified arm at identical seeds and identical total gradient budget, plus the SD-070 P0 world-encoder warmup applied identically to both arms so the z_world-adequacy gate is not itself an arm difference. Required event: Episodes containing both body-state change attributable to the agent's own action and exteroceptive world change, at an environment scale matched to the arm being compared against, so both sides of the double dissociation have signal to carry. DV: Both sides of the cross-decoding dissociation reported with the adequacy gate alongside: action_dissociation_split (z_self minus z_world on action prediction) against its 0.10 threshold, contact_dissociation_split (z_world minus z_self on contact prediction) against 0.05, and the behavioural gap_approach delta (split minus unified) against 0.02 at more than one environment scale.
FALSIFYING: With the adequacy gate PASSED and >= 4 seeds, the world side stays within noise of zero (contact_dissociation_split ~ 0, world_obs_advantage <= 0) and gap_approach delta < 0.02. SD-005's functional-specialisation justification then fails on the E3/z_world side specifically -- corroborating EXQ-047g, EXQ-113 and EXQ-532 rather than merely repeating them -- independently of whether the z_self/E2 split is retained. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The split/unified lever exists and is read (config.latent.unified_latent_mode, consumed at latent/stack.py:1589) and the cross-decoding probes exist across the 047g / 113 / 532 drivers. What no driver records is the z_world-adequacy gate in the same run, so a world-side null has never been separated from a world-side ceiling. Consumer / boundary: Functional specialisation of the two encoder outputs under differential loss routing, read at cross-decoding and at behaviour -- not geometric orthogonality, which EXQ-047f established is the wrong test and which the split does not require. Existing ownership: SD-005, SD-106, zworld_adequacy:ZW-1, SD-070, sd_zworld_warmup_optimizer_group, EXP-0012.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The split/unified lever, the probes and the behavioural DV all exist, so the mechanics are runnable. What is not runnable is a DISCRIMINATING test: the world-side DV depends on z_world carrying world content, and the observation -> z_world interface is measured at chance for transition information, so the repeated one-sided null has an unmeasured competing explanation. Secondary classes: R0, R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The one-sided failure pattern the what_would_answer treats as a settled empirical finding has since acquired a named upstream cause that the text does not gate on. Its DVs on the world side -- contact_dissociation_split and world_obs_advantage -- require z_world to encode world content; ree_core/latent/zworld_p0.py records transition-type information in world_obs at or below chance (-0.014 3-class, -0.060 6-class, against +0.240/+0.427 in the body delta routed to z_self) and a participation-ratio collapse 9.21 -> 1.06, and the 2026-09-10 MECH-222 scoping reproduced it independently. A rerun under the listed preconditions therefore cannot distinguish 'z_world does not specialise' from 'z_world encodes nothing to specialise about', and the observation -> z_world interface now has its own owner (SD-106 / zworld_adequacy:ZW-1) that post-dates the text. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-006.subject: control_plane.async_multirate_execution
SD-006.title: E1, E2, and E3 run at characteristic rates (async multi-rate) rather than lockstep.
SD-006.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The three loops must be separable in what they UPDATE, not only in when a tick fires. A test is vacuous if the quantity read is a clock counter (e2_tick is emitted and consumed nowhere) or if the representations under test update every env step regardless of loop identity, which is the current state for z_world, z_self and E3 precision.
CONFIRMING: Measured persistence half-lives order and scale with the configured ladder, and collapse toward each other in the lockstep arm. Manipulation: Vary e1/e2/e3_steps_per_tick over the configured ladder (for example 1/3/10 against 1/1/1 lockstep) and, for the representation leg, rate-gate the continuous latent updates by loop identity rather than only gating the discrete calls. Control: Lockstep arm (all rates equal) at matched seeds and step budget, plus the current build as the un-gated reference. Required event: Eval rollouts long enough to estimate per-quantity autocorrelation/half-life, with a live policy in the loop and a frozen-policy segment so persistence is not confounded by learning. DV: Realised persistence separation: the ratio of measured autocorrelation half-lives of each loop's own state across the ladder, compared against the configured tick ratio, per seed.
FALSIFYING: Half-lives are invariant to the configured ladder, or inverted relative to it, while the clock demonstrably fires at the configured rates -- multi-rate scheduling exists but characteristic rates do not. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py emits e1_tick/e2_tick/e3_tick and ThetaBuffer batches across rates; v3_exq_942 measures realised half-lives and was the first to show the designed 1:3:10 is not the realised ratio. No instrument records a rate-gated continuous-state update, because none exists. Consumer / boundary: The per-loop state that the architecture says runs at its own grain -- the representations E1/E2/E3 maintain -- not the scheduler that decides which call fires. Existing ownership: ARC-023, GFLAG-0395, V3-EXQ-942, e-ladder-realised-timescale-separation, MECH-089.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); e2_tick has no consumer anywhere in ree_core (emitted at clock.py:143/:174, referenced only in a docstring), so one third of the asserted ladder cannot reach any loop, and the continuous representations update every env step irrespective of loop identity. The available measurement therefore sits at the scheduling boundary (tick counters) rather than at the representational boundary the claim asserts; V3-EXQ-942 measured the realised half-lives and found them inverted. Secondary classes: R6. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-007.subject: encoder.perspective_corrected_world_latent
SD-007.title: ReafferencePredictor provides perspective-corrected world latent by subtracting self-caused sensory change.
SD-007.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Three gates. (a) The predictor's own held-out R2 on self-motion transitions must clear 0.10 and be reported, which is now known to be reachable at ~4000 gradient steps. (b) The episode set must contain both non-trivial agent-caused perspective change and independent world-caused events in a ratio that permits discrimination -- V3-EXQ-177's 6.6:1 imbalance made discrimination near-unmeasurable. (c) NEW: exogenous-world change must be decodable from the downstream z_world stream above a pre-registered floor, since drift-detection AUC from dz_world measured 0.53-0.63 and a graded exogenous-count Spearman measured at chance across 6 seeds.
CONFIRMING: With all three gates met, the ON arm's agent-caused versus world-caused discrimination margin is significantly higher than both the OFF and SHAM arms at matched seeds, and self-caused variance during pure locomotion is reduced in ON relative to OFF without the exogenous-event signal being reduced. Manipulation: Three arms on the residualization pathway: reafference_action_dim = action_dim with a trained ReafferencePredictor; the predictor set to None after P0; and a SHAM arm subtracting the same module's output with the action mis-paired -- the three already implemented in experiments/v3_exq_1018. Control: The SHAM arm is the matched-magnitude control (mis-paired R2 -2.94, cos 0.59 against the real correction), and the OFF arm at identical seeds is the absolute reference; the within-run z_world versus z_world_raw contrast is explicitly NOT a control because it also carries the alpha_world EMA. Required event: Within one episode set, pure-locomotion steps in which the agent moves and the world does not, interleaved with steps carrying an independent world-caused event the agent did not produce. DV: A discrimination margin, not a variance level: agent-caused versus world-caused step classification accuracy (or AUC) computed from the downstream z_world stream, compared across the three arms, together with the self-caused variance share during pure-locomotion steps so under- and over-subtraction are separable.
FALSIFYING: With the same gates met, the ON arm either under-subtracts (self-caused variance during locomotion indistinguishable from OFF) or over-subtracts (exogenous events become harder to detect in ON than in OFF, the EXQ-027b signature of correction_delta -0.045 and harm_pred_std 0.108 -> 0.008), or ON is indistinguishable from SHAM -- any matched-magnitude subtraction would do as well as the learned one. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ReafferencePredictor and the z_world_raw diagnostic exist (latent/stack.py:42-116, LatentState.z_world_raw), the ON/OFF/SHAM arms exist in v3_exq_1018, and EXQ-111 carries the pre-registered C1/C2/C3 ladder. What is absent is any recorder that reads world-caused change out of the corrected stream at above-chance rates -- every probe of that quantity to date has landed at chance. Consumer / boundary: The z_world stream as consumed downstream of the encoder, where the residualization must preserve exogenous signal while removing self-caused signal -- not the predictor's fit quality, which is a manipulation check. Existing ownership: SD-007, MECH-221, MECH-222, zworld_adequacy:ZW-1, SD-106, EXP-0044.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The blocker has MOVED, not cleared. The predictor-quality gate that stopped EXQ-111/118/145 is now demonstrably clearable (R2 0.34-0.40 at 4000 steps). The live blocker is the other half of the falsifier: exogenous-world change is not decodable from the downstream z_world stream at above-chance rates, so the over-subtraction direction has no discriminating DV. Secondary classes: R2, R0. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Two separate elements changed. (1) The registered CURRENT STATE -- a predictor-quality gate repeatedly unreachable (R2 0.03-0.36 across EXQ-111, EXQ-118, V3-EXQ-145) -- has been lifted by measurement: the 2026-09-10 MECH-222 scoping trained the shipped ReafferencePredictor to held-out R2 0.34-0.40 on pure self-motion transitions over 3 seeds at 4000 gradient steps, well clear of EXQ-111's pre-registered C1 threshold of 0.10, and validated a SHAM control at R2 -2.94 with cos(real, sham) 0.59. (2) The prescribed INSTRUMENT is wrong: the text asks for a discriminative pair of z_world_corrected against z_world_raw, but z_world_raw is PRE-EMA as well as pre-correction (stack.py), so that within-run contrast measures alpha_world smoothing rather than residualization -- the ON/OFF/SHAM arms are the only valid contrast. The world-caused-change half of the confirming signature has meanwhile been measured at chance, which the text does not gate on. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-008.subject: encoder.z_world_alpha_correction
SD-008.title: LatentStack EMA alpha for z_world must be >= 0.9 to preserve event responsiveness.
SD-008.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The event-responsiveness readout must be taken where the EMA actually acts -- on z_world after LatentStack.encode's temporal smoothing -- and the encoder must be trained enough that z_world carries event information at all, or an alpha sweep compares two equally uninformative encodings and the margin is zero for reasons unrelated to alpha.
CONFIRMING: Event selectivity is preserved at alpha_world >= 0.9 and degrades monotonically below it, with the isolated-stack margin clearing its threshold -- the >= 0.9 floor is load-bearing. Manipulation: A sweep of REEConfig.latent.alpha_world across at least {0.3 (the current default), 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0} at fixed seeds, with alpha_self and every other encoder parameter held constant. Control: Matched seeds across alpha cells and a fixed alpha_self, so the contrast isolates the z_world channel; plus the isolated-stack arm (no SD-003/SD-007 composition) that made EXQ-023 and EXQ-040 interpretable, since EXQ-177 showed full-stack composition can zero the margin independently of alpha. Required event: Discrete world events (hazard appearance, resource contact, transition) occurring within an episode, against a matched no-event window, so an event-selectivity margin can be computed. DV: The event_selectivity_margin of z_world -- the difference between z_world displacement on event ticks and on matched no-event ticks -- as a function of alpha_world, and specifically whether it falls below the usable threshold for every alpha_world below 0.9.
FALSIFYING: Event selectivity is flat in alpha_world across the sweep in the isolated stack, or is preserved at alpha_world 0.3, which would make the >= 0.9 requirement unnecessary rather than merely conservative. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/latent/stack.py applies the per-channel EMA with a configurable alpha_world (line ~1536) and ree_core/utils/config.py exposes it; V3-EXQ-023 and V3-EXQ-040 already implemented and ran this exact readout, both PASS/supports. Consumer / boundary: The encoder's temporal-smoothing step inside LatentStack.encode -- the assertion is that EMA double-smoothing there suppresses event responses that MECH-089's theta buffer already integrates downstream. Existing ownership: SD-008, V3-EXQ-023, V3-EXQ-040, EXP-0087.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); Nothing blocks it: the knob, the encoder site and the readout all exist and the falsifier has run twice (EXQ-023, EXQ-040) with supporting results. R0. Secondary classes: R7. Gap disposition: NO GAP -- FALSE POSITIVE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-009.subject: encoder.event_contrastive_supervision
SD-009.title: z_world encoder requires event-type cross-entropy auxiliary loss during training.
SD-009.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The event-type target must be decodable from the channel the head actually reads (world_obs -> z_world), and no OTHER grounding head may already supply the same discriminative pressure. Neither holds today: zworld_p0.py measured transition_type at or below chance from world_obs (-0.014 3-class, -0.060 6-class) while SD-070's static grounding heads are on in every current recipe.
CONFIRMING: Removing the event-CE head lowers the held-out event-type decodability margin below a registered floor while the collapse guards stay green -- the dedicated head supplies discrimination no other grounding does. Manipulation: Toggle the dedicated event-type CE head ON vs OFF at matched seeds -- config.use_event_classifier gating LatentStack's event_logits head and agent.compute_event_contrastive_loss. Control: The SD-070 anti-collapse recipe held byte-identical in both arms, plus a channel-side positive control that the event label is decodable from the SAME input the head reads (world_obs), not only from the body or delta channels. Required event: A z_world encoder training run (P0) over a rollout buffer carrying labelled event-type transitions, followed by a held-out frozen-probe readout of z_world. DV: Held-out frozen-probe balanced-accuracy margin for event type decoded from z_world, ON minus OFF at matched seeds, with participation_ratio and contrast_ratio reported as collapse guards.
FALSIFYING: The OFF arm matches or exceeds the ON arm on the held-out margin at matched seeds with collapse guards green. V3-EXQ-897 measured exactly this on 3/3 seeds (deltas -0.025 / -0.010 / -0.005), sign-consistent but statistically imprecise. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: experiments/v3_exq_897_sd009_event_ce_ablation_decodability.py records the held-out margin; ree_core/latent/zworld_p0.py records PR/CR and the per-channel probe table. Nothing isolates the head's contribution in a regime where SD-070's other grounding heads are absent. Consumer / boundary: The z_world representation as consumed by E1/E2/E3 (predictors/e2_world.py, e2_world_uncertainty.py, policy/model_disagreement.py all name the P0 warmup), not episode reward. Existing ownership: SD-070, MECH-100, V3-EXQ-897, GFLAG-0019, EXP-0223.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The 'requires' wording is discriminable in no reachable regime. With SD-070's static grounding on, the event head is redundant; with it off, z_world collapses to participation_ratio 1.06 and both arms are vacuous. The head's own target is at or below chance from the channel it reads, so the manipulation cannot inject the information the claim asserts. Secondary classes: R7, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-010.subject: harm_stream.nociceptive_separation
SD-010.title: HARM stream is a dedicated sensory pathway separate from z_world processing.
SD-010.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the test must be a FUSED-vs-SPLIT ablation, not
another demonstration that the split encoder works. All 22 existing experimental
entries (EXQ-056/056c/058/058b/058c/059/059c and successors) measure the SPLIT arm
only -- Pearson r_z_harm 0.914-0.973, calibration_gap 0.712, clean rank ordering.
Not one runs the fused control. A rerun of the split arm alone is degenerate: it
can only re-confirm what is already established and cannot discriminate. The
ablation arm must route harm content back through the z_world encoder with
TRAINING BUDGET HELD EQUAL (the EXQ-094 lesson: training E3 on bridge noise
produced a 100x harm_var regression, which is a budget artefact, not a fusion
result). It must also NOT be the HarmBridge design: SD-010 makes z_world
perpendicular to z_harm BY CONSTRUCTION, so a learned z_world -> z_harm bridge has
nothing to learn and returns bridge_r2=0 trivially (EXQ-093, EXQ-094) -- that is a
restatement of the architecture, not a test of it.
CONFIRMING: under matched budget, the fused arm reproduces at least two of the
three failure signatures this claim was registered to explain -- (1) residue
contamination: ResidueField's world_delta accumulation tracks hazard proximity
rather than causal footprint, measurable as a rising correlation between residue
density and hazard density in an environment where the agent causes no harm;
(2) counterfactual collapse: world_forward_r2 degrades toward the EXQ-044 value
(~0.0) because E2 cannot simultaneously predict world dynamics and harm proximity
from one latent; (3) reafference inversion: applying SD-007 correction to the
fused stream reduces the harm estimate as the agent APPROACHES a hazard (the
EXQ-027b over-correction, correction_delta=-0.045, harm_pred_std 0.108 -> 0.008).
Reproducing these under a fair control is what upgrades the claim from "the split
works" to "the split is necessary".
FALSIFYING: under matched budget the fused arm matches the split arm on all three
-- calibration_gap within the split arm's band, world_forward_r2 undegraded,
reafference correction not inverting on approach. That would mean the 2026-03-19
root-cause cluster (EXQ-027b / 043 / 044 / 047) was attributable to training
procedure or to the SD-005 z_self/z_world split alone, and that the third stream
is a convenience rather than an architectural necessity. SD-010 would then narrow
to an implementation preference and would stop underwriting SD-003 / SD-007 /
MECH-102.
DO NOT RE-DERIVE the stream readouts, the encoder-floor correction, or the
sourcing-mode caveat here -- see SD-011's own what_would_answer, which owns them
for the whole harm-stream group. SD-010 concerns the separation of harm from
z_world; SD-011 concerns the separation WITHIN harm.

SD-011.subject: harm_stream.dual_nociceptive_streams
SD-011.title: Harm stream separates into sensory-discriminative (z_harm_s: proximity/intensity, Adelta-pathway analog, forward-predictable) and affective-motivational (z_harm_a: accumulated homeostatic deviation, C-fiber/paleospinothalamic analog).
SD-011.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Three measured gates, all recorded per run: harm_history_len > 0 so the affective encoder receives a source beyond the rank-2 harm_obs_a broadcast; the P0h warmup actually ran with a non-zero affective-encoder weight delta, so z_harm_a is not a frozen random projection; and the sourcing mode (limb_damage_enabled True versus legacy proximity EMA) declared, since V3-EXQ-917 measured safe-vs-unsafe AUC 0.52 damage-sourced against 0.84-0.97 proximity-sourced.
CONFIRMING: In a regime with the second source live, the P0h warmup witnessed and the floor subtracted, stream_corr stays well below the 0.85 saturation band, autocorr_gap stays positive and WIDENS under use_gabaergic_decay=True, harm_fwd_r2 on z_harm_s holds around the 0.6-0.68 band, and the D3 direction does not reverse. Manipulation: Cross the second source (harm_history_len 0 versus 10) with the P0h affective-encoder warmup (episodes 0 versus non-zero), and with use_gabaergic_decay OFF versus ON so the two streams are given different leaky-integrator poles. Control: A matched arm with the affective encoder left at random initialisation (P0h episodes 0) and a matched arm at harm_history_len 0, both at the identical seed, plus the encoder-floor response harm_encoder(zeros) / affective_harm_encoder(zeros, zeros) subtracted from every level. Required event: Sustained ambient hazard exposure with episodes long enough for the rolling harm-history window to fill, including approach and withdrawal transitions so the sensory stream carries action-conditional structure the affective stream does not. DV: Floor-robust relative stream_corr between z_harm_s and z_harm_a, the autocorr_gap between the two streams, and harm_fwd_r2 of the E2_harm_s forward model on z_harm_s, each reported per arm with the direction of the D3 contrast (R2_affective must not exceed R2_sensory).
FALSIFYING: With those same gates met, either stream_corr rises toward saturation or the D3 reversal returns -- z_harm_a is a filtered copy rather than a second source -- or harm_fwd_r2 on z_harm_s collapses toward the obs-space near-zero causal gap, leaving the SD-003 / ARC-033 consumers nothing to attribute against. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The streams and knobs exist (ree_core/latent/stack.py AffectiveHarmEncoder and harm_history input; ree_core/regulators/gabaergic_decay.py per-stream poles; ree_core/predictors/e2_harm_s.py). The missing piece is a driver that enables the landed P0h stage (experiments/_lib/zharm_a_p0_warmup.py, default zharm_a_p0_episodes 0) and reports the three DVs as floor-subtracted relatives. Consumer / boundary: The divergence of the two harm encoders' outputs where ARC-016 harm-variance gating reads z_harm_a and SD-003 / ARC-033 counterfactual attribution reads z_harm_s -- the functional division of labour, not the anatomical grounding. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0350, GFLAG-0348, sd_zharm_a_warmup_optimizer_group, SD-036, SD-086.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); At the shipped defaults the test is degenerate: harm_history_len is 0, harm_obs_a has exact rank 2, and no optimizer group reaches the AffectiveHarmEncoder on the standard all-on trainer, so z_harm_a can only be a transform of the sensory stream. The repair (P0h warmup stage) landed default-OFF on 2026-09-19 and no driver enables it. Secondary classes: R2, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Three independent changes since the text was written. (a) GFLAG-0350 measured that EXQ-178b, EXQ-198 and EXQ-323a all construct AffectiveHarmEncoder with no harm_history_len argument and therefore run at the default 0, so the claim's own clause (i) makes its four cited validated results vacuous rather than supporting. (b) GFLAG-0348 measured harm_obs_a at exact rank 2 (two scalars broadcast over 25 dims each, causal_grid_world.py), which the clause (ii) floor-subtraction convention does not address. (c) The named trainer blocker landed: an opt-in P0h affective-encoder warmup stage now exists, so a valid test must run it rather than merely set the second source live. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-012.subject: environment.homeostatic_drive
SD-012.title: Goal-directed behavior requires homeostatic drive modulation: z_goal seeding demands drive-scaled benefit signals.
SD-012.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: All four existing conditions -- (a) MECH-306 drive_floor >= 0.9 (goal.py:82, default 0.0), (b) SD-049 Phase-2 hybrid encoder + SD-057 use_incentive_token_bank, (c) proximity_benefit_scale >= 0.18 (causal_grid_world.py:340, default 0.03), (d) resource_respawn_on_consume=True -- PLUS a fifth: the agent must forage above random at all on that substrate, else the benefit_ratio DV cannot discriminate.
CONFIRMING: With (a)-(e) held and certified on the run, benefit_ratio exceeds 1.0 by a margin clearing the cross-seed SD on >= 2/3 seeds, with C1 and goal_resource_r confirming seeding and specificity are genuinely active. Manipulation: drive_weight / drive_floor ON versus OFF (drive-scaled effective_benefit versus raw benefit_exposure) with the environment and curriculum matched. Control: Random-policy baseline on the same env and curriculum, plus a drive-ablated arm; C1 (z_goal_norm) and goal_resource_r reported on every arm so seeding and specificity are legible. Required event: Repeated drive-reduction cycles: resource contact under elevated homeostatic drive, with respawn so the cycle can recur, in an environment where directed navigation to resources is achievable. DV: benefit_ratio (goal-guided versus random-policy baseline) exceeding 1.0 by a margin clearing the cross-seed SD on >= 2/3 seeds, reported jointly with z_goal_norm and goal_resource_r; plus a foraging-competence readout establishing the baseline is beatable at all.
FALSIFYING: benefit_ratio remains at or below random parity DESPITE (a)-(e) all holding, C1 and goal_resource_r both confirming, AND the competence readout showing the baseline is beatable on that substrate -- drive-scaled benefit is behaviourally inert for navigation and SD-012 should demote. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: GoalState.update with drive_weight / drive_floor / drive_ema (goal.py:41-82, 890-898) and CausalGridWorldV2 respawn + proximity_benefit_scale are all live and configurable; the missing instrument is a per-run foraging-competence readout certifying the DV has headroom against the random baseline. Consumer / boundary: z_goal seeding and its conversion into steering -- the goal pipeline from benefit_exposure through effective_benefit to navigation, not the E3 selection arena. Existing ownership: mech457_competence_bootstrap_explorer, MECH-306, SD-049, SD-057, scaffolded_sd054_onboarding, EXP-0128.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The four named preconditions are all configurable and present, but the navigation-outcome DV is measured against a random baseline the agent has not been shown to beat. Until the MECH-457 competence floor lifts, a <=1.0 benefit_ratio is over-determined and the falsifier cannot attribute it to drive modulation. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The falsifying clause scores benefit_ratio <= 1.0 as a demotion once preconditions (a)-(d) hold, but the DV is a comparison against a random-policy baseline and above-random foraging is itself an unmet, separately-owned competence floor (MECH-457 cluster; V3-EXQ-978 FAILed exactly that behavioural precondition, 2026-09-03). As written the falsifier would fire on the competence floor rather than on drive modulation. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-013.subject: self_attribution.e2_harm_s_interventional_training
SD-013.title: E2_harm_s training requires counterfactual perturbation signal to produce unbiased causal_sig in confounded states.
SD-013.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Confounded states must actually be instantiated -- ambient harm correlated with agent proximity but not agent-caused, which SD-029 scheduled_external_hazard with adjacent_only produces -- and both training conditions must reach comparable forward_r2 so the causal_sig comparison is not confounded by fit quality.
CONFIRMING: In confounded states the INTERVENTIONAL arm's signed causal_sig error against the ground-truth partition is materially smaller than the OBSERVATIONAL arm's on a pre-registered margin over at least two of three seeds, with the advantage absent or much smaller in the unconfounded cell. Manipulation: E2_harm_s training varied between INTERVENTIONAL (use_interventional=True, interventional_fraction and interventional_margin set) and OBSERVATIONAL (MSE only), crossed with confounded versus unconfounded environment regimes; the stricter arm additionally executes a_cf from the same environment state. Control: The OBSERVATIONAL arm on matched seeds and identical environments, plus the unconfounded regime as the second cell of the cross, so the predicted advantage is regime-specific rather than global. Required event: Transitions in a confounded regime where env_caused_hazard damage co-occurs with agent proximity, interleaved with agent_caused_hazard transitions that carry genuine agent causal contribution. DV: causal_sig error against ground truth -- signed bias of E2(z,a_actual) - E2(z,a_cf) relative to the environment's own agent_caused_hazard versus env_caused_hazard labelling -- in confounded minus unconfounded states, not the raw cf_gap magnitude.
FALSIFYING: causal_sig bias in confounded states is statistically indistinguishable between the two training conditions, or the INTERVENTIONAL arm is worse, while both arms reach comparable forward_r2 -- the margin loss then buys action-sensitivity without buying causal identifiability. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e2_harm_s.py implements compute_interventional_loss and the config knobs; causal_grid_world.py emits agent_caused_hazard / env_caused_hazard transition_type labels and scheduled_external_hazard, so a ground-truth partition is constructible. No experiment computes causal_sig bias against that partition. Consumer / boundary: E2_harm_s's forward model as consumed by the SD-029/MECH-256 single-pass attribution comparator, where causal_sig is formed. Existing ownership: SD-013, SD-029, ARC-033, MECH-256, EXP-0229, V3-EXQ-353.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The substrate, the confound source and the ground-truth labels all exist, but every SD-013 run measures raw cf_gap (the margin loss's own objective) in unconfounded conditions. Separately, the implemented training never executes a_cf from the same state -- CausalGridWorldV2 exposes no state snapshot or restore -- so the claim's literal do(a) manipulation is unavailable. Secondary classes: R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's STATUS paragraph reads V3-EXQ-353 as the clean positive for SD-013, but 353's C3 compares mean_cf_gap_actual -- the raw norm between predictions for a_actual and a_cf -- which is precisely the quantity compute_interventional_loss maximises, and it is measured with no confounded-state manipulation and no causal_sig bias readout. The falsifier's own DV has therefore never been measured, and the implemented training never executes a_cf. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-014.subject: hippocampus.valence_vector_node_recording
SD-014.title: Hippocampal map nodes must store an explicit 4-component valence vector (wanting, liking, harm-discriminative, surprise) updated incrementally per visit; replay prioritisation is weighted by drive-state-gated valence relevance.
SD-014.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Wanting and liking must be computable from genuinely independent signals before any dissociation DV means anything. At shipped defaults they are NOT: incentive_sensitization_enabled is False, so VALENCE_WANTING is written as serotonin.benefit_salience(benefit_exposure) while VALENCE_LIKING is written as raw benefit_exposure -- both monotone transforms of one input, which is exactly what V3-EXQ-887 refuted. The flag must be on at the gain 887b passed under, and the agent-level replay path must execute at full VALENCE_DIM width (the 4-versus-6 broadcast defect, repaired 2026-08-03).
CONFIRMING: With sensitization on at 887b's gain and the replay path executing at full width, replay start-state composition shifts systematically with drive_state (surprise-weighted selecting high-s nodes, wanting-weighted selecting high-w nodes) relative to the uniform baseline, and w and l remain separable (|Spearman| well below 1) on an independent drive axis. Manipulation: drive_state composition at the replay gate -- vary the weights [d_w, d_l, d_h, d_s] handed to ResidueField.get_valence_priority (for example surprise-weighted versus wanting-weighted prioritisation, the original V3-EXQ-432 contrast) -- crossed with incentive_sensitization_enabled ON/OFF so the representational and functional legs are separable. Control: A uniform-priority replay baseline (drive_state flat) on matched seeds and an identical valence map, plus the sensitization-OFF arm as the representational control in which wanting and liking are known to be collinear. Required event: Repeated visits to the same map locations under varying homeostatic drive, with outcome contact on some visits and approach without contact on others, so wanting can be updated by approach-drive and liking only by outcome; followed by an offline replay pass under a specified drive_state. DV: Which nodes are selected as replay start states under each drive_state -- the composition of replayed locations must shift toward the component the drive vector weights -- measured on the priority WEIGHT vector upstream of the multinomial sample; plus, for the representational leg, |Spearman(w, l)| across centres on an independent drive axis.
FALSIFYING: Replay start-state composition is indistinguishable across drive_state settings despite a populated, separable valence map -- the drive-gated prioritisation clause is then false and SD-014 reduces to a storage claim; or w and l stay collinear at every admissible sensitization gain, falsifying the wanting/liking separation requirement itself. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ResidueField.get_valence_priority implements priority = dot(V_node, d_current) and _do_replay builds a VALENCE_DIM-wide drive_state; field.py carries the four named slots plus the MECH-307 split channels at deliberately zero weight. The recorder exists and the path is pinned by contract; what no run has yet recorded is replay-target composition as a function of drive_state AFTER the 2026-08-03 width repair. Consumer / boundary: The replay start-state selection gate -- which stored node the offline pass reactivates -- and, upstream of it, the per-centre valence vector in the residue field that the hippocampal map node addresses. Existing ownership: EXP-0227, sd014-decouple-wanting-liking-writepath, MECH-290, MECH-205, MECH-203, EVB-0132.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The functional replay-prioritisation leg has never had a valid test. Its only run, V3-EXQ-432, predates both repairs: n_surprise_writes_d2 was 0 (surprise never reached the gate) and the agent-level replay path itself raised a 6-versus-4 broadcast RuntimeError whenever serotonin or surprise-gated replay was enabled, until fixed 2026-08-03. No experiment since manipulates drive_state and measures replay-target composition. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-015.subject: goal_representation.z_resource_encoder
SD-015.title: Goal-directed navigation requires a dedicated z_resource encoder that captures object-type features invariant to spatial location, separate from z_world.
SD-015.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The actor's own input representation must carry decision-relevant content above its random-initialisation quality, otherwise a null navigation result cannot distinguish an inadequate z_resource-seeded goal from an inadequate z_world the policy reads. This is unmet as measured on the SD-106 lineage.
CONFIRMING: With the preconditions held, benefit_ratio clears the random baseline on >= 2/3 seeds while goal_resource_r independently confirms representation specificity on the same run. Manipulation: z_goal seeded from z_resource (use_resource_encoder ON, agent.py:11969) versus the z_world-seeded legacy path, at matched drive (MECH-306 drive_floor >= 0.9) and matched proximity_benefit_scale. Control: A random-policy baseline for the behavioural metric, plus the goal-absent arm, plus goal_resource_r reported on the same run for continuity with V3-EXQ-514o's representational PASS. Required event: Realistic foraging episodes with resources respawning on consume, under the ready scaffolded_sd054_onboarding curriculum and the SD-057 object-bound incentive layer active, avoiding the hazard-heavy stretch 866a identified. DV: A behavioural navigation metric -- benefit_ratio, resources reached per episode relative to the random-policy baseline -- exceeding 1.0 by a margin clearing cross-seed SD on >= 2/3 seeds, reported alongside goal_resource_r.
FALSIFYING: benefit_ratio stays at or below random-baseline parity while goal_resource_r is high AND the actor's z_world is independently shown adequate -- only that conjunction falsifies the behavioural-sufficiency half; without the adequacy leg the null is confounded. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ResourceEncoder and its proximity head are recorded (latent/stack.py:268-350, LatentState.z_resource / resource_prox_pred_r), and benefit_ratio is an established manifest field across the EXQ-085 and 182a lineage. What is not instrumented on the same run is a z_world adequacy readout that would separate the two explanations. Consumer / boundary: Action selection consuming the z_resource-seeded z_goal -- the goal-proximity term in e3_selector.py -- not the representational similarity of z_goal to the resource-type embedding, which is already settled. Existing ownership: SD-106, SD-018, zworld_adequacy:ZW-1, SD-049-PHASE-2, SD-012.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The representation-adequacy half is settled PASS; the behavioural half cannot discriminate, because the same null is predicted by an inadequate observation-to-z_world encoding that SD-106 has now measured directly. No run reports a navigation metric and a z_world adequacy readout in the same configuration. Secondary classes: R4, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA states that benefit_ratio at random-baseline parity under its preconditions 'would be the first genuine falsifier of the FULL claim and should demote SD-015'. That inference is no longer warranted: substrate_queue SD-106 now measures the observation-to-z_world objective as supplying no gradient toward decision-relevant content (converged linear probe 0.626 for SD-106 against 0.857 for a PCA-32 of the same input at the same width), and zworld_adequacy_plan.md ZW-1 owns it. A behaviourally inert z_goal is now explicable upstream of z_resource. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-016.subject: e1.frontal_cue_indexed_integration
SD-016.title: E1 must expose a z_world-only ContextMemory query path that produces two downstream signals: an action-affordance bias for E2 (MECH-151) and a terrain precision weight for E3 harm/goal scoring (MECH-152); the existing bulk generate_prior() path is insufficient because it blends z_self and z_world and produces no cue-specific modulation.
SD-016.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Selection entropy pinned within ~0.02 of the uniform ceiling ln(16)=2.772589 is the signature that the selection INPUT is not varying, not evidence against SD-016; and a C1 entropy pass without a C1b context-divergence instrument is equally uninformative (418m moved entropy 0.019 from fixed random-init logits while divergence stayed ~0.002). Both instruments must be reported, with an independent contrast-ratio control on the encoder configuration under test.
CONFIRMING: With the H1/H3 selection fix armed and selectivity certified by both instruments, varying retrieval content produces corresponding divergence in action_bias-mediated proposal ranking and terrain_weight-mediated harm/goal scoring, on a majority of seeds. Manipulation: Leg A (now largely settled): H1 sd016_context_divergence_weight > 0 and/or H3 hard/gumbel selection ON versus the legacy q.k path. Leg B (the live question): retrieval content varied while action_bias and terrain_weight are held as the only route to behaviour. Control: OFF arm reproducing the ln(16) saddle as the ablation-cleanliness check, plus a matched-encoder arm; for leg B, a cue_action_proj-live control and SD-055 differentiable CEM engaged. Required event: A cue-dense context transition (safe versus dangerous) during which the z_world-only ContextMemory query is issued and a slot is selected. DV: Leg A: selection entropy < 2.5 AND context-divergence > 0.1 on a majority of ready seeds. Leg B: action_bias_div / terrain-weight behavioural divergence -- action-class entropy and committed-behaviour divergence tracking retrieval CONTENT rather than staying flat.
FALSIFYING: Selectivity is restored and certified, yet action-class entropy and behavioural divergence stay flat across retrieval contents -- the cue-indexed pathway carries no downstream effect and SD-016's second half (the pre-SCR analog) is unsupported even with its first half working. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Leg A is instrumented and has fired (V3-EXQ-907/908 acceptance checks, sd016_context_divergence_weight in config, cue_slot_tagger and gumbel selection in e1_deep.py). Leg B's instrument reads a quantity with no consumer: EXP-0155 source-traced that action_objects appear only in e2_fast.py (producer) and hippocampal/module.py (storage), and e3_selector.py contains ZERO occurrences of action_object / action_bias. Consumer / boundary: The E2 affordance and E3 harm/goal-scoring boundary -- whether cue-indexed retrieval changes what is proposed and how it is scored, before harm occurs. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0051, EXP-0155, MECH-151, MECH-152, SD-055, V3-EXQ-907, V3-EXQ-908.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); MECH-151's action_bias has no consumer on the ranking path: o_t accumulates only into Trajectory.action_objects, neither the world nor self transition reads it, _score_trajectory and the SP-CEM first-action-class path never touch it, and E3 reads .actions/.states/.world_states only. Leg A's newly-passing H1/H3 diagnostics are claim_ids=[] and have not been read back onto SD-016. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Leg (A)'s 'STILL OPEN: whether an encoder-level fix restores separation' has been answered three times since it was written. V3-EXQ-898 (2026-08-08) ran the prescribed retest under the SD-070/783 trained dim=128 encoder with the readiness controls MET (weights moved 5/5 tensors, z_world spread lift 4.04x against a 1.3 threshold) and still FAILED C1/C1b 0/3 with C2 on the saddle; V3-EXQ-907 (H1 context-divergence loss) and V3-EXQ-908 (H3 gumbel hard selection) then both PASSED with 'breaks_saddle' labels on 2026-08-09. The open question is now leg (B), not leg (A). Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-017.subject: sleep_phase.minimal_sleep_infrastructure_v3
SD-017.title: REE-v3 requires a minimal sleep-phase infrastructure: an SWS-analog phase (bidirectional hippocampus-to-cortex replay for schema/slot consolidation) and a REM-analog phase (causal attribution replay for slot-filling from co-correlational evidence ordering). Without these offline phases, hippocampal attribution mapping cannot converge and context representations remain globally undifferentiated.
SD-017.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (four gates; the first three are met on the current substrate, the
fourth is the one this claim now fails):
(a) OFFLINE-PHASE LIVENESS -- pooled `sws_n_writes >= 1` and `rem_n_rollouts >= 1` in the sleep-ON
arm and exactly 0 in WAKING_ONLY (the 436c/436d counters; 436c measured 800 / 600). A run that
discards `run_sleep_cycle()`'s metrics dict cannot distinguish "write never fired" from "fired with
no effect" and is inadmissible (the 436b recording gap).
(b) WRITE-PATH LIVENESS AND OCCUPANCY -- non-zero waking write-path calls in BOTH arms (436f: 15,078)
AND `n_occupied_slots >= 2` on `>= 3/5` seeds (436e's `sufficient_occupancy_for_c1` gate). This is
MET only with `E1Config.contextmemory_write_usage_balancing` ON: 436g measures 16/16 occupancy on
5/5 seeds. No driver in `ree-v3/experiments/` sets that flag by default, so a driver written today
silently runs the legacy argmin path and reproduces the 1-of-16 fixed point.
(c) METRIC INTEGRITY -- the statistic must be computed over OCCUPIED slots only, with similarity and
occupancy reported SEPARATELY and NEVER as a product (the whole-bank `slot_cosine_sim` scores a
12-well-separated-slot arm WORSE, 0.076, than a single-slot arm, 0.009 -- anti-correlated with what
this claim predicts); and `context_memory.memory.requires_grad_(False)` so Adam drift cannot
manufacture spread (the NO_WRITES arm is the run-time-derived null, tolerance 4.0 sigma; 436f
measured max |z| = 1.67). The derived `sws_slot_diversity` (1 - `slot_cosine_sim`) inherits the same
confound and is equally inadmissible.
(d) INPUT-SIDE SEPARABILITY FLOOR -- the write-stream latents ENTERING `ContextMemory.write` must
carry class structure the bank could differentiate on. Assert this with a HELD-OUT LINEAR PROBE
(logistic regression, safe-vs-dangerous) on the recorded train-time latents, beating its own
permuted-label null. V3-EXQ-972 measures the uncentred separability at 0.0281 (intra-class safe
0.9804, intra-class dangerous 0.9713, inter-class 0.9478) -- the SD-008 under-differentiation cone,
measured at TRAINING time for the first time in this lineage -- and the 2026-09-03 cluster autopsy
states that an uncentred cosine "does not support the stronger 'there is no structure for any
objective to condition on'". Until this probe clears, any slot-differentiation contrast is measuring
the input cone, not sleep.

CONFIRMING: with (a)-(d) all met, in a run whose DV can resolve GRADED change (the 2-cluster
occupied-set Jaccard is disqualified: 72 of 89 cells in the 969-972 portfolio can return only 0.0 or
1.0; use a mutual-information statistic over the full contingency table with `PROBE_CLUSTERS >= 4`
and report the FRESH-cluster generalization readout as load-bearing) -- occupied-slot mean pairwise
cosine in SWS_THEN_REM is LOWER than in a write-matched WAKING_ONLY arm by at least
`max(1.5 * SD(per-seed paired delta), 0.05 absolute)`, on `>= 3/5` seeds, sign-consistent across
seeds, leave-one-out stable, with OCCUPANCY MATCHED between arms so the reduction is content and not
recruitment. SD-017's own directional prediction is the WAKING_ONLY end -- an undifferentiated bank
without the offline phases -- and that half is ALREADY CONFIRMED at 0.9993 (V3-EXQ-436g, 2026-08-30).

FALSIFYING: with (a)-(d) all met, a resolving DV, and adequate power (the 2026-08-19 pre-registered
probe derives n = 38-2485 for a cosine contrast depending on the effect, so either meet that n or use
a deterministic DV instead), the occupied-slot similarity contrast is null or REVERSED (sleep >=
waking) on `>= 3/5` seeds and leave-one-out stable. Explicitly NOT falsifying: any of the seven
436-lineage results to date (436, 436a, 436b, 436c, 436d, 436e, 436f, 436g) -- every one failed
