SD-018.subject: encoder.resource_proximity
SD-018.title: encoder.resource_proximity_supervision
SD-018.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The readout policy must be able to express a foraging difference at all. V3-EXQ-978's greedy-argmax evaluation reader (LatentPPOEvalPolicy) fell into a deterministic two-cell limit cycle in 9 of 12 episodes and the causal-footprint contamination rule then retyped visited cells, so the competence DV could not move in either arm -- a stochastic or epsilon-perturbed eval reader with a recorded non-degenerate state-visitation count is a gate, not a nicety.
CONFIRMING: With a non-degenerate eval reader, the head-ON arm's z_world-only forager clears the 1.0 resources/episode floor while the matched-magnitude irrelevant-target control and the head-OFF arm do not, on >= 2/3 seeds -- named-feature supervision is what puts resource content into z_world. Manipulation: use_resource_proximity_head and use_resource_field_head OFF versus ON (both default False; the directional head regresses the full 25-dim resource_field_view from z_world), with the downstream reader restricted to z_world so the supervision is the only channel by which resource information can arrive. Control: A matched arm with an auxiliary head of identical parameter count and gradient magnitude regressing a resource-irrelevant target, so any competence gain is attributable to the resource content of the supervision rather than to the extra encoder pressure. Required event: Foraging episodes in which resource acquisition requires approaching a resource that is visible only as a proximity gradient, so a z_world that does not encode resource proximity cannot plan toward it. DV: Resources acquired per episode by a z_world-only reader against the 1.0/episode floor the V3-EXQ-948 autopsy established (0.5 with the scalar head active, 3/3 clearing it when handed the full field), reported alongside a state-visitation non-degeneracy count per episode.
FALSIFYING: With the same reader gate met, head-ON and head-OFF are indistinguishable on resources/episode and both sit at the floor. SD-018's named-feature form is then not the operative mechanism, which is what the SD-106 mint already asserts positively (generic bottleneck variance preservation), and SD-018 narrows to a training convenience. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Both heads exist and are wired (latent/stack.py SplitEncoder.resource_proximity_head and resource_field_head, LatentState.resource_prox_pred / resource_field_pred, the P0 leg in latent/zworld_p0.py, contract tests/contracts/test_sd018_resource_field_head.py). The defective element is the EVALUATION reader, not the supervision: the greedy-argmax eval policy is the wrong readout for a foraging DV. Consumer / boundary: The observation -> z_world encoding bottleneck and whether a named-feature auxiliary loss puts benefit-relevant content through it -- read at a z_world-only planning consumer, not at the auxiliary head's own regression loss, which trains successfully either way. Existing ownership: SD-018, SD-106, GFLAG-0131, GFLAG-0207, zworld_adequacy:ZW-2, zworld_adequacy:ZW-1.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The one run of this ablation, V3-EXQ-978, returned NULL under an eval-protocol confound that the autopsy did not record and GFLAG-0131 later measured: a deterministic two-cell limit cycle in 9 of 12 episodes. The supervision substrate is built and contract-pinned; the readout instrument is what fails, so the null is uninterpretable rather than negative. Secondary classes: R1, R5. Gap disposition: INSTRUMENT EXISTS BUT WRONG LOCUS/TIMESCALE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-019.subject: harm_stream.affective_nonredundancy
SD-019.title: affective_harm_nonredundancy_constraint
SD-019.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The SD-022 body-damage substrate must be active (limb_damage_enabled=True) so harm_obs_a is sourced from limb damage rather than EMA proximity -- otherwise the two streams are structurally collinear and the test is vacuous (the EXQ-241b r2_s_to_a = 0.996 ceiling, and the root cause of the original EXQ-323 failure). Baseline cosine_sq must exceed the 0.05 floor so there is redundancy for the penalty to reduce.
CONFIRMING: With SD-022 active and the penalty on, cosine_sq falls below the baseline and under the 0.4 absolute floor AND r2_s_to_a stays below 0.5 at the best lag over the swept range and under a monotone fit, while dissociation episodes show z_harm_a retention high with z_harm_s low. Manipulation: harm_nonredundancy_weight swept 0.0 (baseline) versus > 0 (penalty active) at matched seeds, using agent.compute_harm_nonredundancy_loss; optionally harm_nonredundancy_precision_scale for the ARC-016 coupling arm. Control: The weight=0.0 baseline arm at identical seeds and identical SD-022 env config, plus the limb_damage_disabled condition as the structural-collinearity positive control that must reproduce the r2 ceiling. Required event: Eval-phase trajectories containing dissociation episodes: the agent leaves the hazard with accumulated limb damage, so immediate sensory harm is low while affective load remains elevated, plus brief sensory spikes that must not saturate affective load. DV: Recoverability of z_harm_a from z_harm_s: r2_s_to_a from a regression of z_harm_a on z_harm_s, evaluated at the instantaneous lag AND swept over lags, plus a monotone/rank fit -- the claim's own wording is 'not a delayed, smoothed, or monotone-transformed copy'. cosine_sq is the weak instantaneous-linear special case.
FALSIFYING: z_harm_a remains recoverable -- best-lag or monotone r2_s_to_a above 0.5 -- even while cosine_sq passes, which would mean the penalty bought orthogonality of direction while leaving the affective stream a delayed/monotone copy, exactly the failure the claim was written to exclude. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: cosine_sq is recorded by v3_exq_323a_sd019_harm_nonredundancy.py (C1/C2/C3). r2_s_to_a exists in v3_exq_318_sd022_limb_damage_stream_separation.py but at the instantaneous linear lag only and tagged to SD-022/SD-011, not SD-019. No lagged or monotone recoverability instrument exists anywhere in the tree. Consumer / boundary: The representational relation between the two harm streams at encode time in LatentStack, upstream of z_harm_a's motivational consumers (urgency and commitment modulation). Existing ownership: SD-022, SD-011, GFLAG-0336, SD-086.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The promoting run's DV is instantaneous squared cosine only, which a lagged or monotone-nonlinear copy passes trivially. The r2_s_to_a instrument that would test recoverability exists in the sibling V3-EXQ-318 driver at a single lag and was never applied to an SD-019-tagged run, and no lag-sweep or monotone-fit variant exists. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-019a.subject: harm_stream.immediate_affective_valence
SD-019a.title: harm_unpleasantness_channel: a distinct pre-integration affective valence signal encoding the immediate motivational relevance of noxious input, processed via the medial pain pathway before temporal accumulation into suffering.
SD-019a.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The three tiers must be separable in the run: z_harm_s must vary, the z_harm_un EMA must be live (use_harm_un True, alpha 0.2) and MECH-219's suffering accumulator must be integrating, with escapability actually manipulated. Note the controllability-parity leg is TRUE BY CONSTRUCTION -- escapability enters only MECH-219's integrator, and the z_harm_un EMA is taken before the SD-021 descending attenuation -- so it cannot serve as the discriminating DV.
CONFIRMING: Routing urgency through the medium tier produces onset/offset behaviour that neither the fast nor the slow tier arm reproduces -- for example urgency that outlasts z_harm_s after offset yet decays well before z_harm_a does, at matched nociception. Manipulation: Ablate or redirect the unpleasantness tier -- use_harm_un ON (AIC urgency and E3 short-horizon urgency read ||z_harm_un||) versus OFF (the same consumers read z_harm_a), with a third arm reading z_harm_s directly, at matched nociception. Control: Matched-nociception arms differing only in which harm tier feeds the urgency consumers, plus the escapable/inescapable contrast that moves z_harm_a but not z_harm_un. Required event: Sustained noxious contact episodes with matched nociceptive input under escapable versus inescapable conditions, plus onset/offset transients. DV: Behaviour and urgency attributable to the MEDIUM timescale specifically: withdrawal/avoidance latency and E3 urgency at onset and after relief, where the fast (z_harm_s) and slow (z_harm_a) tiers make opposite predictions -- not the correlation between the tiers, which is high by construction.
FALSIFYING: The z_harm_un arm is behaviourally indistinguishable from the z_harm_s arm (it is a smoothed copy with no distinct authority) or from the z_harm_a arm, at every timescale probed -- the intermediate tier earns no downstream role. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: REEAgent.sense maintains _harm_un_ema and populates LatentState.z_harm_un; aic_z_norm and the E3 short-horizon urgency redirect read it (ree-v3/ree_core/agent.py), and HarmSufferingAccumulator reports unpleasantness_norm. V3-EXQ-518 was a substrate-readiness probe only; no experiment contrasts the three tiers behaviourally. Consumer / boundary: The AIC urgency drive and E3 short-horizon avoidance scoring, which are the two consumers the claim says the unpleasantness tier drives independently of z_harm_s and z_harm_a. Existing ownership: EXP-1147, V3-EXQ-518, MECH-219, SD-019b, SD-021.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The claim's two headline properties are degenerate as implemented: controllability-independence is enforced by construction (escapability enters only MECH-219; the EMA is taken before SD-021 attenuation) and the timescale ordering is an arithmetic property of a fixed alpha=0.2 EMA of z_harm_s. Only the downstream-distinctness leg can discriminate, and no experiment tests it -- 518 and 957 are readiness probes. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-019b.subject: harm_stream.suffering_accumulator
SD-019b.title: harm_suffering_accumulator: z_harm_a is specifically the output of a controllability-gated hysteretic integrator over harm_unpleasantness, constituting a persistent load state modulated by escapability and inescapability, not merely a temporally lagged copy of the sensory stream.
SD-019b.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The harm encoder must be trained enough that harm_unpleasantness carries real variance (V3-EXQ-962 self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue otherwise), and the escapability signal must be non-constant across the scored window. Note the substrate default escapability_constant=1.0 collapses the accumulation gate to zero, so a run left at defaults measures nothing.
CONFIRMING: At matched nociception, suffering accrues in the inescapable arm and is suppressed in the escapable arm by more than the per-seed effect-size floor, decay after offset is asymmetric (slower than z_harm_un), and the escapability signal driving this is one the agent estimates rather than one the experimenter sets. Manipulation: The escapability sweep on MECH-219's hysteretic integrator, plus the escapability SOURCE itself: external injection (what V3-EXQ-962 used, escapability_mode='external' with agent.set_harm_suffering_escapability) versus the endogenous avoidance_efficacy mode, versus the constant baseline. Control: The matched-nociception escapable arm (identical noxious input, opposite controllability) as the within-design control, plus the pure-MECH-219 no-gate configuration that tests whether temporal integration alone suffices -- the claim's own over-specification alternative. Required event: Matched nociceptive exposure under two controllability regimes -- an inescapable bout followed by escapability becoming available (relief), versus an escapable bout throughout -- with harm offset so the asymmetric-decay window can be observed. DV: Divergence in z_harm_suffering between matched-nociception escapable and inescapable arms at equal harm_unpleasantness input (the controllability gate), and the decay asymmetry after offset -- z_harm_un falling rapidly while z_harm_a stays elevated and decays measurably slower.
FALSIFYING: z_harm_a is not modulated by the escapability signal at matched nociception -- pure temporal integration reproduces the trajectory -- in which case SD-019b is over-specified and the simpler MECH-219 suffices; or the gate works only under injection and no endogenous estimator can be made to drive it. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/affect/harm_suffering_accumulator.py plus LatentState.z_harm_suffering record the accumulator, and V3-EXQ-962 supplies a working escapability-sweep readout with a resolved-escapability bit-identity check; what is not instrumented is an agent-computed escapability estimate, and the requirement-4 downstream divergence has no comparator run. Consumer / boundary: The integrator between harm_unpleasantness and z_harm_a -- a persistent load state modulated by escapability -- and, for requirement 4, the qualitatively different downstream consumers it feeds (MECH-259 mode-switch, SD-032e pACC coupling, ARC-016 urgency) rather than immediate avoidance. Existing ownership: MECH-305, SD-058, MECH-353, MECH-219, sd_blocked_agency_mismatch_floor_calibration, EXP-1251.
DISPOSITION: R3 (primary); V3-EXQ-962's PASS was obtained with escapability_mode='external' -- the experimenter sets the scalar via set_harm_suffering_escapability. V3 has no validated endogenous controllability estimator: MECH-305's sliding-window action-outcome estimate is unbuilt, avoidance_efficacy depends on SD-058 (v3_pending), and the MECH-353 opposite-pole cross-check is blocked by a non-discriminative comparator. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-020.subject: harm_stream.affective_surprise_pe
SD-020.title: z_harm_a encodes affective surprise (precision-weighted PE), not raw accumulated harm state. The affective stream training target is the mismatch between predicted and actual harm accumulation, making E3 urgency respond to unexpectedness of threat, not just magnitude.
SD-020.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The PE branch must fire and be differentiated (ARM_OFF _harm_obs_ema exactly 0, ARM_ON above floor), at least 100 harm events per seed, z_harm_a variance above floor, AND the training-time precision_norm must be floored (0.1 per the adopted P0h default) so the ARC-016 coupling does not attenuate the PE target by ~250x into numerical noise.
CONFIRMING: At least 3 of 5 seeds show a positive surprise-over-magnitude preference on the ON arm, exceeding the OFF arm, with the precision floor applied and all non-degeneracy gates green. Manipulation: harm_surprise_pe_enabled ON versus OFF inside agent.compute_harm_accum_loss, everything else matched, with the training-time precision_norm floor applied on the ON arm. Control: ARM_OFF trained on the SD-011 EMA accumulated-harm target at matched seeds, substrate and event counts; plus an unfloored-precision cell to show the floor is not itself doing the work. Required event: Episodes on the SD-022 limb-damage substrate in which accumulated harm departs from its own EMA prediction, giving trials where surprise and magnitude disagree. DV: Per-seed hap_surprise_corr -- the correlation between the z_harm_a head readout and harm PE, contrasted with its correlation to raw accumulated magnitude -- scored as the count of seeds with a positive, above-bar surprise preference.
FALSIFYING: With the floor applied and the gates green, the ON arm is indistinguishable from the EMA-target OFF arm on surprise preference -- z_harm_a integrates magnitude, not surprise. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: v3_exq_324d drives the real flag path through agent.compute_harm_accum_loss under affective_fishtank.warmup_train (whose aux_optimizer covers agent.latent_stack.parameters(), so the affective encoder is genuinely trained); experiments/_lib/zharm_a_p0_warmup.py and tests/contracts/test_zharm_a_p0_warmup.py supply the floored path. Not exposed: 324d's per-row precision_norm never reached the manifest, so the one quantity that would adjudicate the attenuation confound is unrecorded. Consumer / boundary: The training target of LatentStack.affective_harm_encoder, whose z_harm_a feeds E3 urgency and commit gating. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0358, sd_zharm_a_warmup_optimizer_group, V3-EXQ-324d, SD-011, SD-022.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); Runnable now, but the standing evidence is not. V3-EXQ-324d cleared every non-degeneracy gate and returned 1 of 5 seeds, and GFLAG-0358 then measured that the ARC-016 precision coupling sits at 0.004 during encoder training, attenuating the PE target ~250x to ~1e-06 and reducing training to numerical noise; the floor that fixes this landed 2026-09-19 in the P0h stage, six weeks after the run and outside the path 324d used. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_linked. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-021.subject: harm_stream.descending_modulation
SD-021.title: Descending pain modulation: when E3 is committed to a trajectory through expected harm, z_harm_s PE precision is reduced (endogenous analgesia). Commitment gates sensory harm attenuation.
SD-021.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: beta_gate must actually be elevated at the tick the readout is taken, and z_harm must be non-null; the CONTROL arm must differ from the DESCENDING arm in the attenuation multiplier alone, with observation, candidate set and harm exposure matched. The legacy path (use_aic_analog False) is the one with demonstrated dynamic range; the AIC path additionally requires operating_mode and drive_level to vary.
CONFIRMING: On committed ticks the z_harm_s attenuation ratio is significantly below 1.0 (V3-EXQ-962 measured ~0.50) while the matched z_harm_a ratio stays at 1.0 within noise, and the attenuation measurably shifts at least one downstream E3 decision or harm-cost term relative to the unattenuated control. Manipulation: Enable harm_descending_mod_enabled and drive the descending gate: legacy path elevates beta_gate so the multiplier becomes descending_attenuation_factor; AIC path varies operating_mode p_external and drive_level so aic.harm_s_gain moves off 1.0. Control: Matched arm with harm_descending_mod_enabled False (or attenuation multiplier pinned at 1.0) at identical seed, observation stream and hazard geometry; plus a within-arm pre-elevation reading as its own baseline, as V3-EXQ-962 C4 does. Required event: A committed trajectory that passes through expected harm -- E3 commitment with beta_gate elevated (naturally via MECH-090 bistable dynamics, or by a direct beta_gate.elevate() manipulation as in V3-EXQ-962's C4 arm) while a hazard is in the local view. DV: Selective dissociation: ||z_harm_s|| post-gate divided by ||z_harm_s|| pre-gate (the attenuation ratio) must fall on committed ticks, WHILE ||z_harm_a|| over the same ticks is statistically unchanged; plus a downstream readout showing the attenuated z_harm_s changes an E3 score or decision rather than only the latent norm.
FALSIFYING: Either z_harm_a is attenuated by a comparable amount (the gate is not selective and SD-021 collapses into a global harm gain), or the z_harm_s attenuation produces no change in any downstream E3 score, candidate ranking or committed action relative to the matched control (wired but with no consumer). A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: agent.sense() applies the multiplier at ree-v3/ree_core/agent.py L5514-5524; V3-EXQ-962's _run_c4_check records z_harm_norm_pre_elevate / post_elevate / attenuation_ratio per seed. No existing run records the paired z_harm_a norm at the same ticks, and none records a downstream consequence of the attenuation. Consumer / boundary: The z_harm_s slice consumed by E3 scoring and E2_harm_s forward prediction, gated at the commitment boundary -- not episode reward and not the z_harm_a affective channel, which the claim requires to be spared. Existing ownership: SD-032c, MECH-090, V3-EXQ-962, V3-EXQ-957, EXP-0056.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Substrate and instrument both fire. What is missing is a run that (a) measures z_harm_a at the same ticks as the z_harm_s ratio, so the claimed selectivity is tested rather than assumed, and (b) shows a downstream consequence. V3-EXQ-962 measured the ratio only as a methodological non-degeneracy control for MECH-219, not as an SD-021 readout, and carries claim_ids SD-019b/MECH-219. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA asserts that DESCENDING and CONTROL cannot differ at all until MECH-269 V_s landing produces drive-regime behavioural divergence. V3-EXQ-962 (2026-08-29, PASS) measured attenuation_ratio 0.503-0.505 with sd021_attenuation_fired true on every seed by elevating beta_gate directly, so the legacy raw-beta-gate route is demonstrably non-degenerate and the config-flag-differential framing the old text assumes has been superseded. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-022.subject: body.directional_limb_damage
SD-022.title: Directional limb damage: body extension for genuine z_harm_s / z_harm_a causal independence
SD-022.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Limb damage must actually accumulate and persist: hazard contact must occur, heal_rate must be slow enough that damage survives the agent leaving the hazard zone, and harm_obs_a must be the 7-dim body-damage vector (limb_damage_enabled=True) rather than the 50-dim proximity EMA.
CONFIRMING: With damage accumulated, z_harm_a stays elevated at safe locations while z_harm_s falls (319 measured 0.910 vs 0.486 retention, 3/3 seeds) and r2_s_to_a drops well below the proximity-EMA baseline (318 measured 0.702 -> 0.365; 323a confirmed distinctness on 5/5 seeds). Manipulation: limb_damage_enabled True vs False in CausalGridWorldV2, with heal_rate as a graded dose (0.002 vs 0.001) so the persistence of the body-derived source can be varied independently of hazard density. Control: The DISABLED arm (proximity-EMA-sourced harm_obs_a) on matched seeds and hazard layout, plus a fresh-damage-free cohort that visits the same safe cells without prior hazard contact. Required event: The agent accumulates directional limb damage by moving through hazards, then leaves the hazard zone and occupies a safe location while damage and residual pain persist. DV: r2_s_to_a between the two harm streams, and the retention contrast z_harm_a_retention_high minus z_harm_a_retention_fresh measured at safe locations after hazard exit, with z_harm_s required to drop over the same window.
FALSIFYING: z_harm_a at safe locations after damage is indistinguishable from the fresh cohort, or r2_s_to_a stays at the EXQ-241b level (~0.996) with limb damage enabled, which would mean the body-damage source is not causally independent of world proximity and the A-delta/C-fibre split has no substrate. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: CausalGridWorldV2 carries limb_damage[4], residual_pain, heal_rate and the 17-dim body_state (causal_grid_world.py:376-381, 1028-1035); V3-EXQ-319 records z_harm_a_retention_high / _fresh and the dissociation score, V3-EXQ-318 records r2_s_to_a. Both instruments exist and have run. Consumer / boundary: The encoder boundary where harm_obs_a is sourced -- body damage state vs current-world proximity -- and the resulting z_harm_a / z_harm_s independence downstream. Existing ownership: SD-011, SD-019, SD-020.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); R0: the environment substrate, the re-sourcing of harm_obs_a, both instruments and the controls all exist, and the falsifier has been fired three times (318 calibration FAIL with the predicted direction, 319 PASS 3/3, 323a PASS 5/5). Nothing required by the trace is missing. Secondary classes: none. Gap disposition: NO GAP -- FALSE POSITIVE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-023.subject: environment.gradient_texture
SD-023.title: Environmental gradient texture: multi-channel world observation with neutral landmark objects
SD-023.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The measurement must not depend on a supervised head whose positive-label density is at floor: V3-EXQ-332 and 332a both collapsed at positive_label_rate 0.0013 against a 0.10 gate, so any future-target-correlation DV self-routes non_contributory. The landmarks must also be ENABLED (n_landmarks_a/b > 0 -- the defaults are 0), which most runs on this env family leave off.
CONFIRMING: Landmarks-on lowers cross-context cos_cross materially below the landmarks-off arm and past the pre-registered ceiling, and Landmark B proximity predicts upcoming resource contact above chance. Manipulation: n_landmarks_a / n_landmarks_b > 0 versus the 0/0 default at matched seeds and matched resource layout, i.e. world_obs_dim 300 versus 250 with the landmark_a_field_view and landmark_b_field_view channels added. Control: The landmarks-off arm at matched seeds (the V3-EXQ-418h H0 versus H1 contrast), plus a same-richness arm where the extra channels carry no resource bias, separating channel COUNT from predictive STRUCTURE. Required event: Episodes in a CausalGridWorldV2 configured with Landmark A (short-range strong gradient) and Landmark B (medium-range weak gradient, placed with landmark_b_resource_bias 0.7 near resources), so a leading indicator of resource contact exists in world_obs. DV: Cross-context z_world distinguishability measured directly on the representation -- mean pairwise cos_cross between context-A and context-B z_world batches, with a pre-registered ceiling (418h used cos_cross < 0.95) -- and, secondarily, the correlation between Landmark B proximity at time t and resource contact within a fixed future window.
FALSIFYING: Landmark enrichment leaves cross-context z_world separation on its floor (cos_cross ~0.9998 as V3-EXQ-418k measured), i.e. adding distinctive neutral-object gradient channels does not by itself break the near-constant z_world regime. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py emits the two field views; the z_world-separability DV is implemented in experiments/v3_exq_418h_sd016_env_entropy_precondition.py and the 4-arm richness ladder v3_exq_418k, both of which already ran with landmarks as a swept arm. SD-024.subject: hippocampal_module.da_modulated_rbf_density
SD-024.title: DA-modulated RBF center density: dopaminergic signal at reward encounters allocates multiple closely-spaced RBF centers in the hippocampal residue field, creating representational expansion at reward locations without requiring environmental richness.
SD-024.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. The DA -> cluster-size relation must be measured through the real
substrate call path, not by constructing clusters in the test, and the live sample must carry
rank information:
(1) A P0 readiness sweep over a well-separated `DA_SWEEP` (e.g. 0.0 -> 1.0 in 0.2 steps) at
synthetic locations must yield `rho(da, cluster_size) >= 0.9` and
`rho(cluster_size, density) >= 0.9`. This certifies the instrument before any live claim is read.
(2) The LIVE sample must contain `n_expansion_events` (events allocating cluster_size >= 2)
`>= 5` pooled across seeds. A live sample in which every event allocated the same cluster size
carries no rank information and a correlation over it is vacuous -- this is the precondition,
and V3-EXQ-900 met it only barely (6 events out of 57 benefit events, at
`da_allocation_scale=40.0`).
(3) `benefit_terrain_live_producer=True` with no direct `accumulate_benefit` call in the driver
outside a declared control -- `agent.py:11570` must be the writer. This is the shared group
precondition; ARC-057's and SD-025's falsifiers point here rather than restating it.

CONFIRMING (mechanism -- already satisfied by V3-EXQ-900, 2026-08-08, PASS/supports; retained
as the standing falsifier).
- C1: over live benefit events, `rho(dopamine_signal, allocated cluster_size) >= 0.3`.
  *(measured 0.533)*
- C2: `rho(cluster_size, weight-independent density readout) >= 0.3`. *(measured 0.517 -- NOTE, governance 2026-09-15 per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-900_2026-09-14: this is the density_DELTA statistic (post-minus-pre density at the event location), NOT the pre-registered raw-density readout, which measures rho = 0.18 on this run and does NOT clear the 0.30 bar; C2's functional half is not established by V3-EXQ-900)*
- C4 (MECH-233 asymmetry): across every live harm event, zero cluster allocations on the
  harm/threat terrain. *(measured: 0 of 1403)*
- C5 (MECH-094 gate): a replay/simulation-tagged event allocates zero expansion. Enforced in
  code at `field.py:665` and asserted at the `agent.py` call site; must be re-asserted in any run
  that exercises replay.

CONFIRMING (the RESIDUAL, not yet tested, and the part that matters downstream). SD-024 as written
asserts expansion happens *"at reward encounters"* -- unqualified. The live data says it happens
at a small minority of them. A dose-response arm sweeping `da_allocation_scale` and, separately,
`drive_level`, supports the claim in its downstream-usable form iff the expansion FRACTION
(`n_expansion_events / n_benefit_events`) rises monotonically with DA and reaches a regime where
the resulting cross-candidate curiosity-bonus range exceeds `max(3 x SD_seed, 0.05)` -- where
`SD_seed = 0.0052` and the observed live range was `0.0177` in V3-EXQ-795 against a
same-statistic positive control of `13.83`. Pin `drive_level` explicitly: V3-EXQ-900 measured
`mean_benefit_magnitude` at cluster>=2 (0.5577) and at cluster==1 (0.5582) as effectively
identical, so benefit magnitude is not the discriminator in vivo and `drive_level` is the
untested lever.

FALSIFYING.
- `rho(da, cluster_size)` at or below zero on a live sample meeting precondition (2) -- the
  allocation rule does not track DA in the live agent.
- Any live harm event allocating a cluster (refutes the MECH-233 asymmetry the claim explicitly
  preserves, and would invalidate the SD-024 workaround's central selectivity argument).
- A replay-tagged event allocating expansion (refutes the MECH-094 gate).
- Residual-specific: the expansion fraction stays flat, or the achievable cross-candidate
  range stays at the ~0.018 order, across the full sweep of `da_allocation_scale` and
  `drive_level`. That would not refute SD-024's *mechanism* -- C1/C2 would still hold -- but it
  would establish that the mechanism cannot reach a magnitude the downstream consumer can use,
  and that finding would convert the SD-024 -> SD-025 handoff to `substrate_ceiling`
  (built, exercised, non-degenerate, signal absorbed downstream), which is precisely the
  discriminator `REE_assembly/CLAUDE.md` sets out. Say so in the run's interpretation rather than
  recording a bare PASS on C1/C2.
- Lit-side counterexample to watch (does not by itself refute): SD-024's `notes` predict
  perseveration from DA locked HIGH; the Retailleau & Morris 2018 entry in
  `claim_evidence.v1.json` records perseveration from D1 blockade. Per the lit/exp decoupling
  rule this is non-load-bearing for the claim's status, but the failure-mode taxonomy in `notes`
  should be reconciled or explicitly scoped rather than left carrying a possible sign inversion.

SD-025.subject: hippocampal_module.curiosity_drive
SD-025.title: Curiosity drive: information-seeking bias in hippocampal trajectory scoring that favors regions of higher representational density in the RBF map.
SD-025.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. See SD-024's `what_would_answer` precondition -- do not
re-derive it. SD-025 is the consumer of SD-024's product and inherits its preconditions
wholesale: live producer on, driver never calls `accumulate_benefit`, `n_expansion_events >= 5`.
Two SD-025-specific additions:
(1) `curiosity_weight > 0` AND the `FamiliarityTracker` actually constructed
(`module.py:140` -- at `curiosity_weight = 0.0` the tracker is never built and every ablation is
bit-identical, which is a silent no-op, not a null).
(2) The argmin-relevant statistic must be the cross-candidate RANGE of the bonus, never its
mean. `_curiosity_bonus` returns a scalar per candidate trajectory; a component common to all
candidates is inert in the CEM selection and cancels. Report `max-min across candidates` per
decision and require it strictly non-zero. V3-EXQ-795 already routes on this statistic (its L4a,
and the V3-EXQ-643 correction it cites); a design that reports only
`curiosity_bonus_abs_mean` reproduces the V3-EXQ-604c broadcast-scalar failure mode.
(3) Do not let a saturating binary preference gate be load-bearing. V3-EXQ-767's single
load-bearing gate `L1a_pref_A_on` pinned at exactly 1.0 on all 8 seeds and the run was adjudicated
vacuous; 767a's continuous CEM score-margin is the sanctioned replacement. Any SD-025 gate must
carry non-zero cross-seed variance.

CONFIRMING (mechanism -- already satisfied in vitro by V3-EXQ-767a, 2026-07-17,
adjudicated REAL/non-vacuous; retained as the standing falsifier).
- L1a propagation: the curiosity term produces a non-zero continuous CEM score-margin
  `min(sparse) - min(dense)` favouring the denser region. *(measured 39.26, range 26.95-45.61
  over 8 seeds)*
- L1c weight-independence (ARC-007-strict): zeroing the benefit VALUE while leaving centre
  positions intact leaves the margin unchanged (`<= 0.1`). *(measured 0.0)* This is what makes it a
  representational-density drive rather than a disguised value gradient, and it is SD-025's single
  most distinctive property.
- L2a familiarity anti-perseveration and L2b MECH-094 replay control (replay must not raise
  familiarity). *(measured 20.05 and 0.0)*

CONFIRMING (the RESIDUAL, and the actual open question). SD-025 supports its downstream role iff,
on a LIVE run with a behavioural outcome DV, the curiosity term changes committed action:
a same-seed, same-substrate `curiosity_weight` ON/OFF contrast must yield a non-zero
committed-action divergence rate (fraction of decisions where the selected candidate differs
between arms) exceeding `max(3 x SD_seed, 0.02)`, with the cross-candidate bonus range reported
alongside as the mechanistic explanation of whatever is observed. Anchor for calibration: the live
range measured in V3-EXQ-795 is `0.0177` (SD `0.0052`, n=3 seeds) against a hand-built positive
control of `13.83` on the same statistic -- so the design must sweep `curiosity_weight` and
`da_allocation_scale` far enough to establish whether ANY reachable setting produces divergence,
not merely test the 795 operating point.

FALSIFYING.
- L1c fails (zeroing benefit weights collapses the margin): SD-025 is a value-follower, not a
  density-follower, and its distinguishing property is refuted.
- L2b fails (replay raises familiarity): the MECH-094 gate the drive depends on is broken.
- Residual-specific: the committed-action divergence rate is indistinguishable from zero
  across the full reachable `curiosity_weight` x `da_allocation_scale` sweep while the
  preconditions are green (producer on, expansion events >= 5, cross-candidate range strictly
  positive). That is the `substrate_ceiling` signature by the discriminator in
  `REE_assembly/CLAUDE.md`: built, exercised, non-degenerate, and the signal absorbed downstream
  before it reaches committed action. On that outcome, re-tag SD-025
  `epistemic_category: substrate_ceiling` naming the absorbing mechanism, and stop re-running the
  existing design.
- NOT falsifying: any null from a run with `benefit_terrain_live_producer` unset. That is the
  fishtank-family configuration and it makes the bonus identically 0.0 regardless of
  `curiosity_weight` -- a no-op, not a result.

SCOPE BOUND. This falsifier addresses the DRIVE and its live consequentiality only. It does not
address the SD-024 x SD-025 INTERACTION (that is ARC-057's `what_would_answer`; see it), and it
does not address strategy-diversity GENERATION -- MECH-458 establishes that this drive is a
reward-conditional exploitation amplifier with zero proactive pull toward under-represented
regions, so a diversity null here supports MECH-458 and says nothing against SD-025.

SD-026.subject: attention.prospective_precision_write_channel
SD-026.title: Goal-directed perception requires a prospective precision-template write channel from z_goal to the E1 prior, anatomically analogous to the dorsal attention network (FEF/IPS -> V1) feedback, distinct from residue-geometry (history-driven) sampling bias.
SD-026.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: SD-014 must reach at least provisional so that z_resource is a crisp target (otherwise template quality and target quality are confounded), and the dan_feedback channel itself must be built. The 887a/887b split must be adjudicated first: 887b PASSes and supports SD-014 while SD-014's live_status still cites the 887a weakening autopsy.
CONFIRMING: dan_feedback=on lifts benefit_ratio substantially over off AND goal-relevant channel precision exceeds irrelevant-channel precision specifically under on, with a fast decay constant distinct from residue geometry's slow one. Manipulation: Enable versus disable a dedicated dan_feedback channel that projects z_goal through a template projection into precision space and writes it additively to the E1 prior with fast decay, residue geometry held fixed. Control: dan_feedback=off at matched z_goal seeding (the EXQ-085h-l seed-but-inert baseline), plus a residue-geometry-only arm, so the fast-decay prospective write can be dissociated from ARC-007's slow retrospective write on the shared prior register. Required event: A goal-relevant feature must be present in the observation while z_goal is seeded above threshold, on trials where attending to that feature changes the achievable benefit. DV: benefit_ratio against a random baseline, plus per-feature-channel precision on goal-relevant versus goal-irrelevant dimensions, plus the decay-constant profile of the E1-prior bias (fast versus ARC-007's slow).
FALSIFYING: dan_feedback=off performs equivalently to on (z_goal's effect, if any, is fully mediated elsewhere), or a lift appears but its decay profile matches ARC-007's slow dynamics and cannot be dissociated from residue geometry -- falsifying the distinct-channel half even where benefit_ratio moved. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Absent. A repo-wide grep finds zero occurrences of dan_feedback or template_proj in ree_core/ or experiments/. The nearest existing path is MECH-116 goal conditioning in ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py, and it is explicitly not the asserted locus: forward() applies goal_input_proj to the predictions path only, while the prior is computed as generate_prior(current_state) from the unconditioned state. Consumer / boundary: The E1 prior register -- a prospective precision-template write from z_goal, additive with and dissociable from ARC-007 residue geometry, biasing perception itself rather than re-ranking E3 trajectories after the fact. Existing ownership: SD-014, SD-027, SD-028, ARC-007, INV-012.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); z_goal exists but has no write path to the E1 prior: the one goal-to-E1 path conditions the prediction head and leaves generate_prior on the unconditioned state, and the claimed channel has no code at all, so the ablation has nothing to toggle. The SD-014 gate is additionally unsettled between the 887a weakening autopsy and the 887b PASS. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Its precondition (a) states that the only direct evidential run on the SD-014 gate is V3-EXQ-887, weakening, unreviewed and absent from review_tracker.json. That is now false: 887a (FAIL/weakens) and 887b (PASS/supports SD-014) both ran on 2026-08-07/08 and all three are in review_tracker.json, so the gate now rests on a reviewed supporting successor rather than an unreviewed weakening result -- while SD-014's live_status still points at the 887a autopsy. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. SD-028.subject: attention.template_as_first_class_object
SD-028.title: An attentional template is a first-class precision-space object, compiled from stored-goal content and current context by a vmPFC-dlPFC translator circuit, distinct from both the stored goal itself (content) and the SD-026 write channel (transport).
SD-028.what_would_answer:
SD-028 is the general architectural principle; MECH-255 is its one concrete
implementation (vmPFC_proj + dlPFC_proj -> integrate() -> template_vec). Do not derive an
independent test here -- see MECH-255's what_would_answer for the full protocol
(MECH-251-static vs. MECH-255-context-conditioned, across diverse contexts) and its own
already-registered falsifier text. This entry states only the architectural-level framing
and preconditions specific to SD-028 as distinct from its implementation.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: identical to MECH-255's -- the MECH-251/SD-026 baseline arm
must exist (confirmed absent, 0 code) and a genuine dlPFC context-gated rule pathway must
exist (confirmed absent as a template-compiler-specific mechanism; existing vmPFC/dlPFC
code in ree_core/ implements MECH-303/MECH-324/SD-033c, not this). SD-028's own text
additionally states outright that "V3 cannot realise SD-028 faithfully because V3 does
not decompose vmPFC vs dlPFC" -- this is a self-declared V4 architectural gate, not a
stale note; still accurate as of 2026-09-25.

CONFIRMING: MECH-255's context-conditioned compiler outperforms MECH-251's static
projection in context-varying, goal-constant trials (same DV as MECH-255) -- confirms
that template_vec needs its own compilation semantics beyond a single linear map, i.e.
that the template is a first-class object rather than a degenerate projection.

FALSIFYING: MECH-251's static projection matches MECH-255's compiler across those same
contexts -- a single parameter matrix suffices, and SD-028's first-class-object claim is
unsupported (though the weaker claim that a template EXISTS as a distinct write target
from stored-goal content, which SD-026/MECH-251 already establish structurally, is
untouched). A null under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: same three blocking artefacts as MECH-255; see that
entry. DISPOSITION: substrate_conditional. No experiment queued.

SD-029.title: Single-pass agency attribution via forward-model comparator on the z_harm_s reafferent stream: residual = z_harm_s_observed - E2_harm_s(z_harm_s_{t-1}, a_actual).
SD-029.what_would_answer:

Measured repeatedly at 0 agent-caused (EXQ-433d: env 20/20/20/20, agent 0/0/0/0), so C2 has never once been evaluable and a null on it carries no information about the comparator.
CONFIRMING: residual_harm is measurably smaller for self-caused than externally-caused harm events but is not reduced to zero (graded, not binary), while forward_r2 and approach-event SNR continue to hold. Manipulation: Self-caused versus externally-caused hazard provenance at matched harm magnitude, with SD-013 interventional training active so E2_harm_s learns P(z_harm_s | do(a)) rather than the correlational conditional. SD-032a.subject: cingulate.salience_network_coordinator
SD-032a.title: Salience-network coordinator: network-level module reading AIC-, dACC-, MCC-, PCC-analog subdivisions and outputting a discrete operating-mode variable (external_task / internal_replay / internal_planning / offline_consolidation) plus a mode-switch trigger.
SD-032a.what_would_answer:
CORE CLAIM (CONFIRMED, stable): the SalienceCoordinator substrate itself -- a discrete operating_mode register {external_task, internal_replay, internal_planning, offline_consolidation} plus a mode_switch_trigger reading the AIC/dACC/MCC/PCC-analog subdivisions -- is implemented and behaviourally validated: V3-EXQ-446 (substrate-readiness) PASS, V3-EXQ-455 (behavioural) PASS, V3-EXQ-453 (write-gate landing) PASS; 28 supports / 0 weakens across 11 experiment + 20 literature entries, conf 0.928, conflict_ratio 0. A CONFIRMING signature is any future evidence entry that restates this bar -- already met and not expected to be re-litigated.
REMAINING OPEN THREAD (not yet closed, does not implicate SD-032a): the 2026-06-13 mode-governance-engagement fix (REEConfig.use_external_task_drive, still default=False / opt-in) was built to give the coordinator a genuine external_task salience SOURCE, closing the SD-034-closure-cluster-ext gap (fraction_in_external_task=0.0 on the pre-fix substrate). Its named validation successors, V3-EXQ-464d and V3-EXQ-467d, ran 2026-06-13 WITH the drive enabled and still self-routed non_contributory / substrate_not_ready_requeue (occupancy still 0.0 across every seed/arm). The follow-on diagnostic V3-EXQ-797 (2026-07-22) narrowed this further: it falsified nav-competence and frozen-argmax as causes and localised the gap to the BG/action-commitment layer (commit term fires on < BETA_FLOOR of genuine coordinator ticks) -- i.e. upstream of SD-032a's own substrate.
UPDATE 2026-08-13 (confirmed failure_autopsy_mech266-464e-467e-cluster_2026-08-13, V3-EXQ-467e + V3-EXQ-464e): the commitment-layer fix landed and occupancy IS now reachable (1.0 at r=0.10 in 467e, sticky-arm 1.0 with zero switches in 464e) -- the predicted successor condition above is met, and MECH-266's own behavioural falsifiers are indeed now live, exactly as this paragraph anticipated. But the readiness gate itself (min-across-arms non-vacuity check) is now confirmed corrupting-severity on ree_core/cingulate/salience_coordinator.py + ree_core/utils/config.py -- it emits a factually-false route_reason when the mode is 100% occupied, and both fresh results self-route non_contributory for a NEW reason (bang-bang arbitration masked by the gate defect), not the old unreachability. This remains non_contributory against SD-032a -- the substrate itself is exercised and working; the residual is a downstream gate/measurement defect plus an over-correction (bang-bang, no mixed regime) in the mode-governance-engagement extension, neither of which implicates SD-032a's core (28 supports / 0 weakens, unchanged).
FALSIFYING signature (would REVERSE stable status -- nothing currently threatens this): a well-powered future run in which the coordinator's mode_switch_trigger is reachable and exercised (i.e. the commitment-layer gate above is cleared, ruling out the substrate-not-engaged confound) and STILL shows operating_mode transitions decoupled from the underlying AIC/dACC/MCC/PCC-analog salience signals -- e.g. mode switches occurring at chance rate regardless of input -- would be a genuine weakens against the coordinator mechanism itself, not a readiness artifact, and should trigger stable -> candidate reconsideration.

SD-032b.subject: cingulate.dacc_analog_adaptive_control
SD-032b.title: dACC/aMCC-analog (adaptive control): module that reads z_harm_a precision-weighted prediction error, z_conflict, and control-demand signals; outputs behavioural-adjustment magnitude; writes to a learnable striatal-analog action-value target.
SD-032b.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The committed-action DV must have headroom on the configuration under test -- i.e. the run must be armed with the MECH-448 F-eligibility demotion (or an equivalent selection-face lift), not the pre-conversion-ceiling 445h configuration where every arm including OFF sat at entropy 0.0. Without that, a null dACC effect is a ceiling artifact rather than a test.
CONFIRMING: dACC output magnitude correlates positively and significantly with precision-weighted z_harm_a_PE, AND committed selections shift toward harm-reducing trajectories with magnitude scaling as the PE, beyond a magnitude-matched random-bias arm. Manipulation: use_dacc ON versus OFF at matched seeds, armed with use_f_eligibility_demotion so the modulatory dACC score_bias arbitrates inside the F-eligible set, with dacc_precision_scale swept to vary the PE weighting. Control: The dACC-OFF arm at matched seeds and matched selection-face arming, plus a magnitude-matched random score_bias arm of the same norm, so that bias MAGNITUDE is separated from bias CONTENT. Required event: Commit ticks carrying a non-trivial precision-weighted z_harm_a prediction error and a measurable E3 conflict signal, on a substrate where more than one action class is reachable. DV: Two co-registered quantities: (i) correlation between dACC-analog output magnitude and precision-weighted z_harm_a_PE magnitude; (ii) paired-by-seed shift of committed selections toward harm-reducing trajectories, with the shift magnitude scaling as the PE -- Baliki's graded ACC-to-striatal coupling.
FALSIFYING: With committed-action headroom demonstrated on the same run, the dACC bias produces no shift toward harm-reducing trajectories, or a shift indistinguishable from a magnitude-matched random bias -- i.e. the module computes but does not reproduce the ACC-NAc value coupling. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The dACC bundle and its adapter are recorded (ree_core/cingulate/dacc.py DACCAdaptiveControl and DACCtoE3Adapter; e3_selector.py:3384 composes score_bias), and 445h already measured mean_score_bias_abs 2.0 ON versus 0.0 OFF and harm_a_forward_r2 ~0.94. Leg (ii) needs the selection-time committed-class recorder (experiments/_lib/gate_dv.py) rather than a per-env-step read. Consumer / boundary: The additive score_bias composition at e3.select, arbitrating inside the F-bounded MECH-448/449 eligible set -- the claim asserts the dACC output SHIFTS committed selection, not merely that it computes. Existing ownership: MECH-258, MECH-268, f_dominance_conversion_ceiling, modulatory-bias-selection-authority, SD-032, self_attribution:GAP-1.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The dACC substrate is functional and its prerequisite is implemented and ready; what is missing is a retest under the selection-face configuration that now exists. The 445h autopsy explicitly routed a fixed-substrate C2 retest under GAP-A top-k / MECH-439 conflict-grade, never to be re-run under 445h's own configuration, and that retest has not been queued. Secondary classes: R4. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Both SD-032b-specific preconditions are out of date. Precondition (a) says MECH-258 'is itself status candidate / v3_pending -- not yet substrate-validated as live', but substrate_queue MECH-258 was corrected to status implemented / ready true on 2026-08-03 against the substrate (ree-v3 2ae52be4), and GFLAG-0210 applied the corresponding evidence-note update. Precondition (b) says committed-action diversity must exist at all, citing 445h's action_class_entropy 0.0 across all arms; V3-EXQ-689d has since measured committed-class entropy 0.938 above the proposer ceiling under the MECH-448 demotion on the GAP-A substrate. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-032c.subject: cingulate.aic_analog_salience_urgency
SD-032c.title: AIC-analog (interoceptive salience / urgency interrupt): module that integrates interoceptive baseline (drive/fatigue from SD-012) with affective-pain signal (z_harm_a), detects salient events, and triggers a network-switch signal to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a).
SD-032c.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: AICAnalog must be instantiated (use_aic_analog=True) and drive_level must actually vary across the compared conditions. For the descending leg the consumer gate config.harm_descending_mod_enabled must reach the config object and beta_gate must elevate at least sometimes, or harm_s_gain is identically 1.0 and the arm is bit-identical to control.
CONFIRMING: For matched z_harm_a, depleted and well-resourced agents produce measurably different aic_salience, such that the coordinator's switch threshold is crossed in one regime and not the other or crossed at reliably different latency, and harm_s_gain attenuates z_harm only in committed external_task mode. Manipulation: Vary the SD-012 interoceptive state (drive_level / fatigue) at matched z_harm_a, and sweep aic_drive_protect_weight across its +1 / 0 / -1 regimes. Control: A static-drive arm at identical env, seed and z_harm_a trace, plus the use_aic_analog=False legacy path as the architectural control. Required event: Matched z_harm_a input arriving at a depleted agent (low drive_level or high fatigue) and at a well-resourced agent, with committed external_task episodes present so the descending pathway has a mode to be gated by. DV: aic_salience magnitude and the SalienceCoordinator mode_switch_trigger rate and latency for matched z_harm_a in depleted versus resourced state; for the subsumed SD-021 leg, harm_s_gain and the resulting attenuation of z_harm.
FALSIFYING: With the descending gate genuinely enabled, the commitment latch elevating, and mode governance shown live elsewhere, depleted and resourced agents show statistically indistinguishable switch-trigger behaviour and identical harm_s_gain for matched z_harm_a -- the gating computation or its coupling to drive is wrong. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: AICAnalog.tick outputs are cached at agent._aic_last_tick and asserted by tests/contracts/test_sd032_wiring_contracts.py (C7); SalienceCoordinator.tick returns operating_mode and mode_switch_trigger. Missing: no config path exists that reliably sets harm_descending_mod_enabled through from_dims. Consumer / boundary: The urgency-interrupt / network-switch trigger into SD-032a, and the descending multiplier applied to z_harm in agent.sense before E3 and E2_harm_s. Existing ownership: SD-021, MECH-332, SD-032a, MECH-269, GFLAG-0158.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); harm_descending_mod_enabled is a REEConfig field but not a from_dims parameter, so it is swallowed by the kwargs catch-all and the descending consumer block never runs. Even when it does, harm_s_gain scales with beta_gate_elevated, which 878/878a measured as never elevating. The salience leg is structurally drive-dependent and live, but its behavioural expression needs coordinator mode governance that is inert at production defaults. Secondary classes: R5, R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA names one blocker -- MECH-269 V_s not landed -- which is stale as a substrate statement (substrate_queue records MECH-269 implemented/ready since 2026-04-22), and omits the two blockers that are measured and still live: harm_descending_mod_enabled is still not a REEConfig.from_dims parameter, so every from_dims driver silently loses the descending leg's top gate; and V3-EXQ-878/878a measured the commitment gate never elevating, which pins harm_s_gain at 1.0. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-032d.subject: cingulate.pcc_analog_attention_partition
SD-032d.title: PCC-analog (attention partition / metastability): module coordinating transitions between external-task and internal (replay / planning / consolidation) modes; contributes a mode-stability parameter to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a).
SD-032d.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: pcc_stability must have live cross-condition range (it is non-trainable arithmetic over a success EMA, drive level and steps-since-offline, so a flat success/drive regime pins it at pcc_stability_baseline 0.5), and mode transitions must occur often enough for a switch-threshold multiplier to change which mode is active. V3-EXQ-799 showed the related mu overlay moved mode-prior ENTROPY without changing behaviour, so an entropy-only movement is a precondition failure, not support.
CONFIRMING: Removing or clamping pcc_stability changes mode dwell times and transition rates at matched salience, with a measurable downstream behavioural consequence, and stability rises with time-since-offline in a way that precedes offline entry. Manipulation: use_pcc_analog ON versus OFF at matched seeds, plus a directed sweep of pcc_stability_baseline / pcc_success_weight / pcc_offline_weight so stability is driven high and low independently of the rest of the coordinator. Control: The pcc-off arm (SalienceCoordinator effective_threshold equal to the bare switch_threshold) at matched seeds, and a stability-clamped arm holding pcc_stability at its baseline so only its VARIATION is removed. Required event: Within-episode alternation between external-task demand and internal (replay / planning / consolidation) phases, with task-success and offline-entry history varying enough for the stability scalar to move. DV: Committed-behaviour consequences of mode stability -- mode dwell-time distribution, transition rate at matched salience, and a downstream task-performance measure -- rather than effective_threshold or mode-prior entropy alone; plus the rate of offline-phase entry, which the claim says PCC coordinates.
FALSIFYING: pcc_stability varies and modulates effective_threshold as designed, yet mode dwell times, transition rates and behaviour are indistinguishable between the ON, OFF and clamped arms -- the stability parameter is a threshold multiplier with no behavioural authority. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/cingulate/pcc_analog.py (PCCAnalog.tick, note_offline_entry, steps_since_offline) and salience_coordinator.py's effective_threshold scaling; contract C8a in tests/contracts/test_sd032_wiring_contracts.py verifies the injection. No instrument links stability variation to committed behaviour. Consumer / boundary: SalienceCoordinator's MECH-259 switch threshold, and -- per the claim's clause (ii) -- the initiation of within-session offline phases, which is NOT implemented: agent.enter_offline_mode() calls pcc.note_offline_entry(), so the causal arrow runs offline-phase -> PCC, never PCC -> offline-phase. Existing ownership: SD-032, SD-032a, MECH-259, V3-EXQ-447, V3-EXQ-799.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The scalar reaches the switch threshold (V3-EXQ-447 diagnostic PASS x3) but has no demonstrated behavioural authority: the sibling MECH-048 stability overlay returned FAIL with label mu_overlay_entropy_only_no_behavioural_authority. Clause (ii) has no causal path at all -- PCC only records offline entries, it never initiates one -- so that leg of the claim is untestable as built. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-032e.subject: cingulate.pacc_autonomic_coupling
SD-032e.title: pACC-autonomic coupling: module connecting affective-pain stream (z_harm_a) to valence/drive update pathway. Provides the affective-pain -> autonomic/visceral coupling that Vogt 2005 and Craig 2009 locate in perigenual/subgenual ACC.
SD-032e.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: use_pacc_analog=True (default False) AND SalienceCoordinator.write_gate('autonomic') measurably above zero on the arm (it is a soft sum over operating_mode, so a collapsed mode distribution can zero it), AND the environment must deliver sustained, non-trivial z_harm_a load with the MECH-094 hypothesis-tag skip not swallowing the ticks.
CONFIRMING: With the gate open, drive_bias rises monotonically to cap under sustained load and relaxes on quiescence, AND at matched instantaneous z_harm_a the ON arm shows a measurably lowered salience threshold / raised switch rate versus OFF on >= 2/3 seeds -- the chronic-sensitisation signature. Manipulation: pACC ON versus pACC OFF at matched harm exposure, plus a gate-closed arm (write_gate('autonomic') forced to 0) as the mechanism control. Control: Matched-harm pACC-OFF arm and a quiescent (no sustained harm) arm; base drive_level trajectory reported alongside effective_drive so energy depletion is not mistaken for the pACC write. Required event: Sustained z_harm_a exposure across many waking steps in a live environment, long enough for the slow EMA (pacc_drive_alpha default 0.002, half-life ~347 steps) to accumulate a bounded drive_bias. DV: Two separately scored quantities: (i) monotone accumulation of pacc._drive_bias to cap under sustained load and reversible relaxation on quiescence; (ii) the downstream consequence -- change in SD-032c AIC salience threshold / coordinator effective_threshold and in switch rate at MATCHED instantaneous z_harm_a between ON and OFF.
FALSIFYING: Either drive_bias fails to accumulate with the gate demonstrably open (write path disconnected), or it accumulates as expected but produces no measurable shift in SD-032c salience gating at matched instantaneous harm -- severing the write-back to salience-gate link that the behavioural prediction rests on. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: pacc_analog.tick()/diagnostics report drive_bias, write_gate and skip counters and are wired at agent.py:7503-7506 and 7523; effective_drive reaches AIC (agent.py:5373) and the coordinator (sal_drive, agent.py:7793). The second DV has no dedicated recorder -- no experiment logs the AIC/coordinator threshold shift attributable to drive_bias. Consumer / boundary: The slow write-back boundary: z_harm_a into SD-012 drive_level, and drive_level into SD-032c's salience gating -- not the single-action-cycle valuation path that SD-032b owns. Existing ownership: SD-032, MECH-261, V3-EXQ-448, sd_salience_contested_mode_occupancy.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The substrate and its wiring exist and reach the consumers, but the only run is a unit-level arithmetic diagnostic; no experiment measures the drive_bias-to-salience-threshold leg in an ecological rollout. Non-degeneracy also depends on a mode-conditioned write_gate that a collapsed mode distribution can zero. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The existing text reads ALREADY CONFIRMED for the whole claim including the chronic-sensitisation pathway, but V3-EXQ-448's own docstring states that behavioural falsification of that signature (drive_bias shifting coordinator effective_threshold and AIC harm_s_gain) requires a longer multi-episode ecological rollout that has never been run, and claim_evidence.v1.json records exp=0 / genuine_exp 0 / pass_runs 0 for this claim. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-033.subject: pfc.subdivision_architecture
SD-033.title: PFC subdivision architecture: a network-level module with lateral-PFC-analog (mid-lateral rule/goal), OFC-analog (specific-outcome prediction and task-structure map), vmPFC-analog (value integration), premotor/SMA-analog (sequence execution), and frontopolar-analog (branching / nested control; V4 scope) subdivisions. Primary output: the rule/policy context that gates action selection and the natural write target for MECH-261 mode-conditioned gating.
SD-033.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Three explicit non-vacuity gates, all confirmed failure modes: the agent must have nonzero OCCUPANCY of external_task / internal_planning (not merely episode-boundary mode settles, the V3-EXQ-464c/467c defect); if the persistence read is closure-coupled, SD-034 must record at least one closure-coupled resolution; and the agent must clear the generic competence floor, or the E3-alone arm 'passes' by producing no rule-conditioned behaviour at all.
CONFIRMING: SD-033a is REQUIRED if the E3-alone arm fails at least one of the three signatures that the SD-033a-ON arm passes, with all three preconditions reported green. Manipulation: Ablate the SD-033a lateral-PFC-analog rule/goal substrate (use_lateral_pfc_analog False, E3-alone) versus SD-033a ON at matched seeds, and for the cluster's second subdivision ablate SD-033b (use_ofc_analog) on outcome-devaluation and same-percept/different-task-role probes. Control: The SD-033a-ON arm, plus a frozen-head arm (frozen-silent versus trainable-nonzero, already PASS across V3-EXQ-598/598b/598c) that separates rule content from mere added parameters. Required event: Rule-conditioned action selection episodes in which a held rule must be applied to NOVEL stimuli, must survive distractor/replay intervals, and must strengthen with training exposure. DV: The three MECH-262 signatures measured as ON-versus-OFF contrasts: (i) transfer performance to novel stimuli under a held rule; (ii) rule-selective effect size surviving internal_replay / MECH-092 micro-quiescence; (iv) growth of the effect with training exposure -- each reported alongside its precondition statistic.
FALSIFYING: SD-033a is over-specification if E3 alone reproduces all three signatures without degradation relative to the SD-033a-ON arm, on a run whose mode-occupancy, closure and competence preconditions are all demonstrably met. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/pfc/lateral_pfc_analog.py (rule_state EMA gated by write_gate('sd_033a'), per-candidate score_bias composed before E3.select) and ree-v3/ree_core/pfc/ofc_analog.py; V3-EXQ-484 records signature (ii). No driver records signature (i) -- stimulus-abstracted generalisation to a novel stimulus under a held rule has no experiment at all. Consumer / boundary: The rule/goal representation that gates E3 action selection -- whether mid-lateral PFC function is separable from, or already covered by, existing E3 machinery. Existing ownership: SD-033a, SD-033b, MECH-262, MECH-309, SD-034, commitment_closure:GAP-4-battery.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Signature (i), stimulus-abstracted generalisation to a novel stimulus under a held rule, has no experiment despite the substrate existing -- the one clean design gap. Signature (iv)'s causal test is separately precondition-blocked by MECH-309 monomodal collapse and the closure-coupled read by SD-034's unwired emit_closure hook, neither of which is a weakening of SD-033a. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. It is built: ree-v3/ree_core/pfc/ofc_analog.py landed 2026-04-26 (ree-v3 1b35b88, with V3-EXQ-485 diagnostic and a 2026-07-31 trained-head cache), is constructed in agent.py under use_ofc_analog, consumes write_gate('sd_033b') and emits a per-candidate score_bias. The cluster's falsifiable surface therefore now includes SD-033b's devaluation-sensitivity and same-input/different-task-role signatures, which the WWA excludes as unbuilt. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. SD-033a.subject: pfc.lateral_pfc_analog_rule_goal
SD-033a.title: Lateral-PFC-analog (mid-lateral rule/goal substrate): module that holds stimulus-abstracted rule and goal representations across delays, persists through simulated distractors, and projects bias signals into E3 action selection. Primary write target for MECH-261 under external_task and internal_planning modes.
SD-033a.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The rule_state handed to SD-033a must be genuinely differentiated across contexts, not an EMA over a one-rule pool. Under raw z_world the SD-008 common-mode cone caps the CandidateRuleField at ONE rule, making rule_state context-invariant by construction; crf_cue_centering=True de-collapses it. The bias head must also be trainable rather than saturated on the old hard clamp, which lateral_pfc_rule_readout_consumer=True (SD-082) supplies.
CONFIRMING: Direct rule_state cosine probes on held-out rule-context pairs discriminate rule identity above the 0.15 margin under a centred context key with a trained bias head and the SD-082 consumer -- the substrate holds the RULE, not merely something stable. Manipulation: crf_cue_centering OFF versus ON as the single swept variable, with the CandidateRuleField built and matured, SD-033a sourcing rule_state from the field, the bias head un-zeroed and REINFORCE-trained, and the SD-082 read-out consumer ON in both arms. Control: The one-rule ARM_OFF pool (the pinned SD-078 defect) as the context-invariant negative; same seeds; V3-EXQ-598c's z_world context-discriminability margin (0.308 against a 0.15 positive-control floor) as the instrument's own positive control. FALSIFYING: Post-centering, rule_state cosine similarity between held-out different-rule context pairs is statistically indistinguishable from same-rule pairs: the substrate holds something stable but not rule identity. Or, at the claim's outer edge, unmodified E3 sequence-selection reproduces rule-abstracted generalisation, distractor-resistant persistence and training-dependent rule emergence without the lateral-PFC analog, making SD-033a over-specification. SD-033d.what_would_answer:
This is a graph-completeness registration node, not an independent mechanism hypothesis -- it maps the Tanji & Hoshi 2008 pre-SMA/SMA/ dorsal-premotor gradient onto machinery that already exists in ree-v3 (E3's trajectory-proposal/scoring/selection; MECH-090's bistable commitment latch and committed-step stepping; the ARC-028/MECH-105 hippocampal-completion release).
