SD-033e.subject: pfc.frontopolar_analog_branching
SD-033e.title: Frontopolar-analog (parallel-goal deliberation substrate): V4-scope module maintaining counterfactual-value estimates for alternatives to the current course of action, mediating transitions between external engagement and internally-generated deliberation, enabling disengagement from the current task to explore novel alternatives, and monitoring relative importance across multiple active goals. Hooks reserved in V3 via the operating_mode vocabulary; substrate deferred to V4.
SD-033e.what_would_answer:
This claim packages TWO distinct testability scopes -- do not conflate them.
SCOPE 1 -- the V3-NARROW de-commit lever (BUILT, 2026-07-09; blocked, not unbuilt). ree-v3 REEConfig.use_frontopolar_decommit + frontopolar_gain wire a parameter-free geometric proxy for function (1) counterfactual value (||z_chosen - z_goal|| - ||z_alt - z_goal||) into a commit-latch release pressure for function (3)/(4) disengagement-for-exploration. This is testable in principle today; it is currently untestable IN PRACTICE for one named reason, not an open-ended one.
Non-degeneracy precondition (all three must hold; none does as of 2026-08-08):
  (i) the MECH-457 competence floor is cleared -- per
      competence_floor_recurrence_repose_2026-08-08.md, the campaign's
      discrimination job is finished but its one residual thread
      (H-consummation-binding) showed both arms installed at ~14% of ceiling
      (V3-EXQ-821), underpowering ANY contrast run on this substrate; the
      scoped fix (stronger BC install landing in the 20-40 forage/episode
      range, corrected 8-metric instrument -- landed 2026-08-07) is named but
      NOT yet queued or re-run. Until a run on this substrate clears a usable
      floor, an all-ON/all-OFF de-commit contrast cannot be distinguished from
      floor-saturation noise;
  (ii) a genuine 3+-alternative decision context is present, so "best
      unchosen alternative" is a differentiated rather than degenerate
      quantity (a 1-2-option context makes the geometric advantage trivial);
  (iii) use_frontopolar_decommit is actually flipped ON with nonzero
      frontopolar_gain (the OFF/default arm is bit-identical to baseline by
      construction and is not itself a test of anything).

CONFIRMING (mirrors the Mansouri 2015 lesion phenotype already named in this claim's notes): the ON arm shows release pressure -- de-commit/switch rate -- that positively covaries with frontopolar_gain * max(0, cfv_now - cfv_at_entry), and relative to the OFF arm shows measurably WORSE current-task persistence but BETTER counterfactual exploration (willingness to abandon the committed trajectory for a superior alternative); the OFF arm shows the inverse -- over-focus on the committed course, impaired exploration of better-valued alternatives.
FALSIFYING: once the floor precondition is cleared and a genuine 3+-way decision context is exercised, the ON arm's switch/de-commit behaviour is statistically indistinguishable from the OFF arm's despite nonzero frontopolar_gain -- i.e. the geometric counterfactual-advantage signal is not behaviourally load-bearing even in this minimal parameter-free form. This would mean the V3-narrow slice does not reproduce even the weak version of the Mansouri 2015 phenotype, independent of whatever the full V4 learned substrate might later show.
SCOPE 2 -- the V4-FULL four-function module (UNBUILT; MECH-264 head + MECH-265 monitor over K>=2 simultaneously active goals). Not operationally testable yet at all, and no non-degeneracy precondition can be stated in concrete terms until its own prerequisites exist: MECH-163 hippocampal multi-step planning (a 1-step counterfactual collapses MECH-264 to MECH-257) and a CausalGridWorldV2 dual/K-active-goal environment extension (function (4)/MECH-265 is structurally inaccessible with the current single-resource env). Per this claim's own v4_scope_deferred note, the SD-033e design doc itself (with a follow-up frontopolar lit-pull) is a V4-ENTRY prerequisite, not V3 work -- so this scope's own concrete falsifier is properly drafted at that design-doc stage, not here. The three pre-registered V4 proposals already staged for it (manual_proposals.v1.json EXP-0165/0166/0167 -- counterfactual-value dissociation, Mansouri-2015 ablation phenotype, and SD-033c/SD-033e double-dissociation respectively) remain status: gated, reconfirmed gated 2026-08-02, on exactly these unmet prerequisites.
POINTER, not re-derivation: for the counterfactual-value-TRACKING mechanism itself (MECH-264's own falsifier -- chosen-vs-unchosen value dissociation at the V4 substrate level), see MECH-264's own what_would_answer. This entry is scoped to the MODULE level (the V3-narrow lever's own testability, and the V4-full four-function packaging separately) and does not restate MECH-264's falsifier.

SD-034.subject: governance.closure_operator
SD-034.title: Closure operator over committed rule_state: on satisfaction of a committed rule_state's completion condition, a 'done' token releases the bistable commitment latch (MECH-090), imposes a temporary No-Go bias (MECH-260) on the just-completed action-class / rule, and discharges the residue associated with that commitment within its domain. The closure token is what turns evaluation off; its absence leaves the governance loop stuck in evaluate-more even when the rule is satisfied. [UMBRELLA NARROWED 2026-06-19: the de-commit-authority sub-property (closure->latch coupling + de-commit magnitude) is decomposed into children MECH-445 (closure->beta coupling engagement) + MECH-446 (de-commit-authority magnitude); see those claims. SD-034 remains the umbrella design_decision -- closure-operator existence + five-part 'done' token firing + No-Go install are retained here and provisional; NOT demoted, NOT superseded.]
SD-034.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- two-sided, because this test has a tuned control arm that can be
made vacuous as easily as the treatment arm. (ON side) `use_closure_operator=True` with
`use_lateral_pfc_analog=True` (enforced, agent.py:2277), on the 603n foraging-competent substrate,
and the closure path must demonstrably fire: `n_closures >= 1` AND `nogo_installed >= 1` on >= 2/3
seeds -- this is the exact gate the 2026-06-12 amend pre-registered, and the exact defect
V3-EXQ-460c hit (`n_closures = 0` despite env `sequence_completions` of 2/5/6). The residue-discharge
DV must be non-flat, i.e. reproduce V3-EXQ-466e's demonstrated separation, not sit at floor.
(OFF-tuned side) the control arm must be a real search and not a token one: at least 3 distinct
settings each of the MECH-090 beta commit/release thresholds, the MECH-260 action-history depth, and
the MECH-094 mode-gating predicate, with the BEST-performing member reported as the control, not the
mean. If `n_closures = 0` in ON, or the tuned sweep collapses to a single point, the run self-routes
`substrate_not_ready_requeue` and MUST NOT be scored in either direction. Report `n_ticks`,
`n_closures`, `n_habenula_aborts` and the `skipped:<cause>` histogram from `ClosureOperator.get_state()`
for every arm, so a null is attributable to a named skip cause rather than to "closure did nothing".

CONFIRMING: three arms -- ON, OFF-baseline, OFF-tuned. SD-034 is supported if the ON arm reproduces
the five-part token JOINTLY -- (a) MECH-090 beta release surviving `closure_decommit_hold_ticks`,
(b) targeted MECH-260 No-Go on the just-completed action class, (c) within-domain residue attenuation
with the 1e-6 floor asserted intact (the "residue cannot be erased" invariant), (d) a `closure_event`
reaching SD-032a, (e) MECH-268 dACC pe rebaseline -- while the OFF-tuned arm reproduces at most ONE
of the five; and if the ON-vs-OFF-tuned gap on the 466e residue-discharge DV exceeds
max(1.5 x the pooled SD of the per-seed ON-minus-OFF-tuned delta, an absolute floor of 10% of the
OFF-baseline within-domain residue mass) on >= 2/3 seeds. Scoring the five components SEPARATELY is
load-bearing: a scalar composite would let a large residue effect mask the absence of the No-Go
pulse, which is precisely the failure the 2026-06-12 amend was built to fix.

FALSIFYING: the OFF-tuned arm reproduces >= 4 of the 5 components AND its residue-discharge DV lands
within 1 SD of ON on >= 2/3 seeds. Then closure is emergent from the existing MECH-090/MECH-260/
MECH-094 substrate and SD-034 is over-specification -- this is the claim's own primary falsifier,
unchanged. SECONDARY (also the claim's own, and it routes elsewhere rather than weakening SD-034):
if ON resolves verified-but-not-released but introduces PREMATURE disengagement -- beta released
before the terminal step on a fraction of multi-step episodes exceeding OFF-baseline by more than
the same margin -- then the SD-033a completion-condition detector or the mode-conditioning logic is
wrong, not the operator; that outcome self-routes to the detector and MUST NOT be recorded as a
weakens on SD-034.

SCOPE FENCE (mandatory, and the reason this draft is fenced rather than broad): the closure->beta
COUPLING face and the de-commit MAGNITUDE face are NOT in scope. They were decomposed out to
MECH-445 and MECH-446 on 2026-06-19 (user-approved, spec
`evidence/planning/claim_synthesis_SD-034-closure_2026-06-19.md`) and have since accumulated eight
further runs of their own (460h/i/j/k/l, 715, 715a, 717). A null on either is NOT a null on SD-034,
and no de-commit DV may be scored against this claim.

SD-036.subject: gabaergic.cross_stream_decay_regulator
SD-036.title: GABAergic regulatory layer applies cross-stream exponential decay (z_harm_s, z_harm_a, z_beta) modulated by tonic gaba_tone; missing-decay regulator is the proximal substrate cause of harm-stream lock-in (catatonia subtype II) observed in V3-EXQ-471.
SD-036.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Every stream scored must show a gaba_tone effect that exceeds a MEASURABLE closed-loop noise floor, and the floor is only measurable if the seeded eval replicates actually differ. In the V3-EXQ-1068 dry run 9 of 10 replicates were bit-identical (n_distinct_trajectories 2 of 10), so the null collapsed to two values and the gate admitted streams on an artifact.
CONFIRMING: At gaba_tone 0.3, every stream that clears a genuinely measured noise floor moves in the direction and relative magnitude the shared composed pole predicts, on a majority of seeds -- joint, mechanism-ordered degradation from a single scalar. Manipulation: Sweep the single global gaba_tone scalar (0.3 / 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.0) with use_gabaergic_decay ON, holding gaba_recurrence_z_harm_s/_a fixed so decay is isolated from recurrence. Control: use_gabaergic_decay=False, NOT gaba_tone=0.0 (post ree-v3 35e8969 a zero tone suspends decay but leaves the recurrence live), plus a seeded no-tone-change replicate set used to measure the noise floor. Required event: A sustained harm-exposure eval stream run at a low tonic setting (gaba_tone 0.3) against a matched control, long enough for the decay/recurrence pole to express itself on z_harm_s, z_harm_a and z_beta simultaneously. DV: Joint, mechanism-predicted degradation from one scalar: the sustain-ratio shift of z_harm_s, z_harm_a and z_beta must all move in the direction and by the relative amounts the SHARED composed pole (1-alpha)*exp(-tau*gaba_tone) predicts per stream -- not the tau-only ordering, which is ill-posed. Each stream must first clear its own measured noise floor.
FALSIFYING: With a valid noise floor in place, the streams that clear it respond independently: one or two move while the others do not, or the relative magnitudes contradict the composed-pole prediction, or the cluster can be reproduced by decaying any single stream in isolation. Decay is then a per-stream property and SD-036's sole architectural commitment is refuted. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/regulators/gabaergic_decay.py ticks the registered streams; LatentStack._gaba_state_blend (stack.py:1293, applied 1655-1670) composes the pole; V3-EXQ-1068 implements the noise-floor gate and the per-stream sustain ratios. The missing instrument is a VALID null: a replicate-diversity check (n_distinct_trajectories >= 8, replicate 0 not bit-equal to the sweep row) before any floor is treated as measurable. Consumer / boundary: The regulator layer itself -- the architectural commitment is that one tonic scalar at the regulator moves all registered streams together, as against three independent per-stream decay rules that happen to coexist. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0380, GFLAG-0373, GFLAG-0372, GFLAG-0375, GFLAG-0376, EXP-0591, V3-EXQ-1068.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The eval path is near-deterministic, so the noise floor the scoring gate depends on cannot be measured. The only RNG consumer reached is hippocampal/module.py:2276 and whether that noise reaches the action is gated by E3 (non-E3 ticks return the held action; committed ticks step the committed trajectory), so seeding replicates is inert. V3-EXQ-1068 has been refused three times at the red-team gate and is not queued. Secondary classes: R2, R7. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: Three of the WWA's load-bearing statements are contradicted by measurement. GFLAG-0372: observable #3 is described as NEVER RUN, but V3-EXQ-854 carries criterion C2_multi_stream_cluster (load_bearing false) which failed 1 of 3 seeds. GFLAG-0373: the tau-ordering CONFIRMING clause is ill-posed because it omits alpha -- the composed pole is (1-alpha)*exp(-tau*tone), which predicts the LARGEST effect on the SMALLEST-tau stream, the reverse of what the clause scores as success. SD-037.subject: broadcast.override_regulator
SD-037.title: Broadcast override regulator (orexin-analog) is the third regulatory layer of the V3 control stack: a small, broadly-projecting gain modulator that integrates internal homeostatic state and threat context to produce an override_signal that reweights z_harm at downstream commit gates and gates the SD-012 drive->z_goal seeding bridge. Dissociable from SD-036 (GABA decay) and from MECH-186/187/188 (5-HT goal-pipeline gain): each layer predicts a clinically distinct failure phenotype (catatonia subtype II / depression / narcolepsy + PWS-hyperphagia). SD-036 alone is architecturally insufficient to break harm-stream lock-in under sustained threat; SD-037 supplies the override authority that lets metabolic demand drive z_goal seeding when threat persists.
SD-037.what_would_answer:
PRIMARY (unchanged): a 4-arm factorial {SD-036 OFF, SD-037 OFF} /
{SD-036 ON, SD-037 OFF} / {SD-036 OFF, SD-037 ON} / {SD-036 ON,
SD-037 ON} on V3-EXQ-471-class conditions. Predicted: arms 2 and 3
partial recovery, arm 4 full recovery, arm 1 reproduces the
catatonic-lock baseline. A clean FAIL on arm 4 (no recovery with
both regulators ON) falsifies the broadcast-override architecture
outright.

SECONDARY (unchanged): two dissociable failure phenotypes once the
factorial runs on adequate substrate -- (a) saturated override
(override_signal pinned high) should produce compulsive drive-
pursuit despite negative outcomes (PWS/hyperphagia-analog); (b) lost
override (override_signal absent) should produce decoupling -- z_harm
and drive_level compute normally but fail to integrate into
coordinated behaviour (narcolepsy/cataplexy-analog).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (the actual current gate -- three
consecutive "substrate confirmed, behaviourally inert" findings, not
two):

Stage 1 (V3-EXQ-483d, 2026-05-29): override_signal fires and
saturates correctly, but only one consumer pathway (GoalState
effective_drive) was wired and was dominated by the MECH-295
liking-bridge -- action_counts/goal_norm_peak bit-identical across
the broadcast_override axis. FIXED 2026-05-30: four more consumer
sites landed (LateralPFCAnalog eff_eta, BLAAnalog encoding_gain,
CeAAnalog mode_prior/fast_prime, BetaGate urgency_interrupt_
threshold), all default-OFF gain knobs.

Stage 2 (V3-EXQ-483e, 2026-05-31): with all four consumer sites
wired, EVERY consumer-side readout was still exactly zero across all
12 runs. Diagnosis: SD-037's mechanism is multiplicative (output *
(1 + gain * override_signal)) -- it can only amplify an ALREADY-
NONZERO consumer output. On the fishtank baseline no consumer output
crosses its own input-gate threshold (BLA arousal_threshold_on=0.4,
CeA fast_route_threshold=0.5, PAG theta_freeze sustained-product=2.0,
dACC pe-magnitude floors), so broadcast amplification has nothing to
amplify: 0 * anything = 0.

Stage 3 (V3-EXQ-620/620b through 625b/625d/625e, 2026-05-31 ->
2026-06-20): axis (a) is CLOSED -- V3-EXQ-620's initial "all-zero"
reading was a config artifact; the corrected V3-EXQ-620b PASSED
(pooled p70=0.43, clears BLA 0.4). Axis (b) (sustained-threat
curriculum) is NOT closed and has surfaced a THIRD, deeper layer:
V3-EXQ-625b cleared the magnitude floor but failed on temporal
structure (collapse to monomorphic action attractors under sustained
threat). The follow-up V3-EXQ-625d diagnosed this as ENV-
CONDITIONAL: the selection-diversity -> committed-action-diversity
conversion axis-(b) depends on only holds on the reef-bipartite
substrate's structural guarantee of opposite first-action argmaxes,
and does not survive a threat-engaged candidate pool -- the SAME
root as the campaign-wide MECH-439 F-dominance conversion-ceiling
(shared with ARC-062 GAP-B, dACC C2, OFC behavioural conversion,
SD-034 de-commit). The recalibrated V3-EXQ-625e (10x lower threat
magnitude + pulsed duty cycle) still returned TERMINAL FAIL/
non_contributory. As of the 2026-08-07 inter-governance workset,
axis-(b) Phase 1b remains status=assembling, held pending a
demonstration that the MECH-439 selection-face fix (MECH-448/449,
BUILT + PROMOTED-provisional) generalises off the foraging substrate
to a threat-engaged pool -- the four retests run against it to date
have not shown that generalisation. Phase 2/3/4 (Phase 4 =
V3-EXQ-483f, the actual SD-037 4-arm behavioural validation) remain
blocked.

WHAT WOULD ANSWER: a run of the primary 4-arm factorial (V3-EXQ-483f
or successor) on the CURRENT fishtank/CausalGridWorldV2 baseline is
expected to reproduce zero-everywhere across all consumer readouts
regardless of SD-037's own ON/OFF state, per 483e's own diagnosis,
and is NOT a valid test of the architecture -- UNLESS BOTH of the
following have landed: (i) axis-(a) consumer-input-threshold
recalibration confirmed adequate under the specific env config used
(620b demonstrates this is achievable), AND (ii) axis-(b)'s
committed-action diversity gate PASSES, which now requires the

candidate pool. Only once both are independently confirmed non-

should be read as further confirmation of the substrate ceiling, not

SD-038.subject: hippocampal.cem_anti_recency_exploration
SD-038.title: HippocampalModule CEM trajectory sampling must include an anti-recency exploration bonus that down-weights recently committed trajectory segments, ensuring the proposal distribution covers all available paths rather than converging on recency-weighted routes.
SD-038.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The CEM proposal distribution must be the thing that varies: the agent must actually re-plan (genuine refits, not a committed-step replay), the environment must offer at least two routes of comparable value so a proposal distribution CAN cover both, and the recency signal must have live cross-candidate variance rather than acting as a near-uniform offset.
CONFIRMING: With the bonus ON, route entropy stays above the monostrategy threshold under extended evaluation and consecutive-proposal waypoint overlap is lower than OFF, on matched seeds. Manipulation: Anti-recency exploration bonus ON versus OFF at trajectory scoring time, before elite selection: a fitness penalty proportional to a decaying waypoint-visitation count over recently committed trajectories. Control: Bonus OFF at identical seeds, identical route count and identical curiosity/familiarity settings; plus a route-count factor (2 routes versus 1) so monostrategy onset has a comparator that cannot occur. Required event: Repeated CEM trajectory proposal and commitment in a two-or-more-route layout over extended evaluation, so that recently committed waypoints accumulate and can be down-weighted. DV: Route-choice entropy over extended evaluation (monostrategy onset threshold) as the primary, and mean pairwise waypoint overlap between CONSECUTIVE CEM proposals as the secondary diversity measure.
FALSIFYING: Route entropy and proposal overlap are indistinguishable between ON and OFF arms, or the OFF arm never reaches monostrategy at all -- in which case the proposal distribution was never recency-converging and the bonus has nothing to correct. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Neither DV is recorded today. HippocampalModule stores only the most recently EXECUTED trajectory (_committed_trajectory_buffer, MECH-290) -- explicitly not what CEM considered -- so consecutive-proposal overlap has no recorder; route entropy exists only as strategy-entropy readouts in E3/dACC, not over route identity. Consumer / boundary: CEM trajectory scoring immediately before elite selection inside HippocampalModule._score_trajectory -- the proposal distribution, not the E3 action-class recency buffer. Existing ownership: SD-038, MECH-289, MECH-092, GFLAG-0076, EXP-1152.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The manipulation does not exist: no anti-recency penalty at CEM scoring anywhere in ree_core. The nearest structures are different mechanisms -- FamiliarityTracker is a spatial familiarity EMA gated on curiosity_weight, VisitationCounter is telemetry-only, and MECH-260 anti-recency acts on E3 action classes, not hippocampal waypoints. Proposal-level diversity is also unrecorded. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-039.subject: hippocampal.anchor_goal_snapshot_payload
SD-039.title: Dual-trace anchors preserve a goal-state snapshot plus wanting/arousal payload at write or invalidation time, so unresolved goals remain queryable after the active plan fails.
SD-039.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (partially unmet as of 2026-08-03, root cause identified, not hypothetical): use_sd039_anchor_payload defaults OFF and must be explicitly enabled; a genuine behavioral test additionally needs at least one deferred consumer (MECH-292 ghost-goal bank and/or MECH-293 waking ghost-goal probes) wired to actually USE the payload for downstream decisions. Both are already satisfied today (MECH-292/293 are landed and wired). A THIRD, MEASURED precondition currently blocks the query/retrieval half specifically: the retrieval cue must carry goal-context identity across distinct goal-epochs. As of the 2026-08-03 V3-EXQ-889 dry run this does NOT hold -- z_goal is a single global EMA attractor whose cue-centered max pairwise cosine saturates near ceiling (0.99752 vs a pre-registered 0.99 non-degeneracy bar) and monotonically worsens with re-exposure, so four deliberately-distinct goal-epoch cues collapse onto the same top-1 anchor (n_distinct_top1_anchors=1.0). A valid test design must also run within a single continuous agent stream across the invalidation-to- retrieval window: AnchorSet.reset() clears the entire dual-trace pool at every agent.reset() episode boundary.
CONFIRMING signature, by level: - Unit level (ALREADY MET, V3-EXQ-494 UC5, 2026-04-27): mean goal-match
  on Phase A (goal-inactive) anchors = 0.0 vs Phase B (goal-active)
  anchors = 0.998, 3/3 replicates above the pre-registered 0.3 threshold.
- Consumer-ranking level (PARTIALLY MET, V3-EXQ-868, 2026-08-02): a
  goal-relevant inactive anchor outranks a goal-irrelevant, matched-
  staleness inactive anchor in >=4/7 seeds.
- Retrieval/query level (STILL OPEN, blocked on the precondition above):
  once goal-identity is met, a post-failure retrieval cue correctly
  surfaces the anchor on the formerly-valid-but-now-blocked path as its
  top-1 hit at an above-chance rate, while unrelated stale anchors are
  not surfaced.
- Full behavioral/task level (NEVER COMPLETED, V3-EXQ-495 SIGTERM'd
  2026-04-28, not since requeued): PLANNED-arm benefit_post_block exceeds
  HABIT-arm benefit_post_block by >=0.30 in >=4/7 seeds in the detour
  paradigm, without a harm regression or standard-episode degradation.

FALSIFYING signature: with the goal-identity precondition met and a continuous-stream design, a downstream consumer built on this payload shows NO behavioral advantage over ignoring the payload entirely -- e.g. cued retrieval performs at or near chance even once cues are demonstrably goal-distinct; PLANNED-arm is statistically indistinguishable from HABIT/ABLATED. The payload would then exist and dissociate goal-active/ inactive state at the unit level, without translating into any measurable recovery advantage.

SD-040.subject: hippocampal.type_encoder_anchor_input_projection
SD-040.title: Type-encoder produces a category-prototype feature vector that is written into the AnchorSet alongside z_world, so anchors can be queried by type-key as well as location-key. The type-encoder uses the same input substrate as the existing instance-encoder but produces a different (regularity-extracted) representation, mirroring the trisynaptic-vs-monosynaptic complementary-learning architecture within hippocampus.
SD-040.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (unmet): requires BOTH the type-encoder substrate (learned projection writing a type-key into AnchorSet entries, plus MECH-296's prototype-readout to consume it) AND a multi-instance-per- type environment. Neither exists -- zero type_encoder/type_key/ prototype_readout hits in ree_core; Anchor carries only (scale, segment_id, stream_mixture) key, z_world, and SD-039's goal_payload. MECH-296 is itself candidate/v4/unbuilt. V3's gridworld has discrete entity types with no instance-variability by design -- a test-bed limitation, not just missing code.
CONFIRMING: in a multi-instance environment, type-keyed AnchorSet queries retrieve ALL instances of a type while location-keyed queries retrieve only the specific instance.
FALSIFYING: with the precondition met, type-keyed queries fail to generalize across same-type instances, or perform no differently than location-keyed queries.

CONFIRMING: once built with demand-conditional gating, HPC anchor-lookup latency

GoalState->HippocampalModule chain already captures whatever the gate would provide.

instrument on HippocampalModule's anchor-lookup path, keyed by cognitive-demand state.

SD-042.title: Option library substrate stores a discrete codebook of named, reusable action subroutines (each as initiation-set + termination-function + internal-policy triple, per Sutton-Precup-Singh 1999), distinct from the existing continuous SD-004 action_object_decoder. Required for hierarchical action composition, tool use, social-coordination protocols, and richer ghost-probe seeding.
SD-042.what_would_answer:
Extracted from the claim's own functional_restatement Falsifiable clause and put in house form.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) an option-library substrate must exist -- a learned, indexable
codebook of (initiation-set, termination-function, internal-policy) triples distinct from the
existing continuous SD-004 action_object_decoder; grep of ree-v3/ree_core/ (2026-09-25) for
option_library/OptionLibrary finds no implementation. (2) a V4 environment with genuine reusable
subroutine structure (tool use, social coordination, or hierarchical task structure) must exist;
ree-v3/ree_core/environment/ contains only causal_grid_world.py -- per the claim's own notes, a
4-action gridworld is "too simple to validate options" and has no environment upgrade since
registration. Both are unmet today, so a V3 run is uninterpretable in either direction, not weak
support.

CONFIRMING: in a hierarchical task with a genuinely reusable subroutine (e.g. an "approach-resource"
behaviour invoked across multiple resource types/contexts), an agent WITH the option library invokes
the cached option and shows materially lower planning latency / re-planning cost than a matched agent
WITHOUT it, which instead re-rolls the subroutine at every invocation through E2+CEM search each time.

FALSIFYING: with the option-library substrate live and a genuinely hierarchical/reusable-subroutine
environment exercised, the option-library agent shows no latency/cost advantage over the E2+CEM
re-roll baseline (matched compute) -- i.e. re-planning from scratch each time is not actually more
expensive than option lookup+invoke in practice, so the option-library's efficiency rationale does
not hold at the scale REE actually needs.

BLOCKING ARTEFACTS (named): the option-library module itself (no code in ree_core/ today) AND a V4
environment with hierarchical/tool-use/social task structure (only causal_grid_world.py exists).
Both must land before this claim is testable; neither is close.

SD-043.subject: pfc.vmpfc_abstract_task_structure_encoding
SD-043.title: vmPFC analogue gains an abstract task-structure encoding capacity that compresses anchor-pool geometry into a generalisable structural code, preserving similarity geometry across surface-different but structurally-matched problems. Without this, REE cannot exhibit Baram et al. 2020 task-structure abstraction signatures.
SD-043.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: two chained blockers, both unmet. (1) SUBSTRATE: ARC-035's own
what_would_answer (context block) records that SD-033c -- the vmPFC-analog subdivision SD-043
would extend -- is "the claim-graph consolidation currently registered ..., not a genuine wired
activation substrate", so there is no vmPFC content interface yet for an abstract task-structure
encoding capacity to attach to. (2) ENVIRONMENT: the claim needs a structure-preserving-transfer
test (train on one task structure, swap surface stimuli, preserve structure, measure transfer).
Re-checked 2026-09-25 against ree-v3/ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py: per-episode
randomization exists (reef-patch placement, SD-054 bipartite partitioning, spawn pools) but this
varies spatial/surface geometry within one fixed causal rule-graph, not the task-graph topology
itself -- there is still exactly one task structure in the V3 grid-world. The claim's 2026-04-28
note ("V3's grid-world has fixed task structure across episodes") remains correct on re-check,
not stale.
CONFIRMING: once both a wired vmPFC content substrate and a >=2-task-structure V4 environment
exist, an agent trained on task structure A and evaluated on a surface-swapped-but-
structurally-identical variant of A shows near-immediate transfer (performance within a small
margin of native-A performance within the first few episodes), while the same agent evaluated on
genuinely different structure B does not.
FALSIFYING: transfer to the surface-swapped-but-structure-preserved variant requires re-learning
at a rate statistically indistinguishable from transfer to genuinely different structure B -- the
vmPFC content carries no structure-general code, only instance-keyed value, and SD-043 collapses
back into ARC-035's existing (unwired) scope.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: a wired SD-033c/ARC-035 vmPFC substrate (currently
consolidation-only); MECH-292's ghost-goal-bank geometry as the anchor-pool input SD-043 would

surface stimuli.
NOTES: of this claim's three depends_on, MECH-292 has matured substantially since 2026-04-28
registration (now built, wired and validated) while ARC-035 remains consolidation-only. SD-043 is
therefore blocked on the SLOWER of its two substrate legs, not uniformly on all three.

SD-044.subject: motor.primitive_substrate_bottom_of_action_stack
SD-044.title: Motor primitive substrate at the bottom of the action-representation hierarchy: a small fixed dictionary of force-field-like primitive activations that vectorially combine to produce the action_object that E2 consumes. Required only when REE moves to continuous limb-like control.
SD-044.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: SD-044 requires a V4 continuous action space; ree-v3's only
environment, CausalGridWorldV2, is a 4-discrete-action gridworld, and grep of
ree_core/environment/ finds no continuous-control path anywhere -- exactly as this claim's
own functional_restatement states ("environmentally not testable in V3 (4 discrete
actions)"). SD-004 (the action-object substrate SD-044 sits below in the stack) is itself
only partially grounded in V3 -- action_object_head is a frozen random projection at
shipped defaults per SD-004's own what_would_answer -- so even the layer SD-044 would
attach beneath is not yet doing, at defaults, what SD-044 assumes it does.

CONFIRMING: in a V4 continuous-control environment, ablating the primitive layer (forcing
action_object_decoder to emit directly rather than as a vectorial combination of
primitives) produces measurably coarser motor output and reduced transfer across motor
tasks relative to the primitive-dictionary arm, at matched parameter budget.

FALSIFYING: the ablated (no-primitive-layer) arm matches the primitive-dictionary arm on
motor granularity and cross-task transfer -- a direct decoder-to-continuous-action mapping
suffices, and the primitive layer buys nothing beyond what SD-004's existing action-object
bottleneck already provides. A failure under the unmet precondition above (no V4
continuous-control substrate) is not evidence against the claim.

NOTE: this is the claim's own functional_restatement Falsifiable clause, restated in house
structure -- no new test invented. ARC-149 (context, depends on SD-044) already explicitly
and correctly distinguishes itself from this claim ("not a motor-primitive library (SD-044
supplies primitives; the bridge says which are currently viable)") -- no merge or
reverse-dep conflict; no repointing needed.

SD-047.subject: environment.multi_source_dynamics
SD-047.title: Multi-source environmental dynamics: concurrent stochastic event sources at distinct spatial and temporal scales (spatial perturbation field + transient Poisson events + background drift sources) provide an agent-independent causal background dense enough for agency-detection comparators (MECH-095) and reafference cancellation (MECH-098) to be honestly tested at substrate level.
SD-047.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION. SD-047 asserts two separable things, and they have separate preconditions. (A) The build clause -- three concurrent stochastic sources at *distinct* spatial/temporal scales, bit-identically OFF, sweepable on one lever. Non-degenerate only if, per arm: all three sources demonstrably fire (non-zero weather-field delta, non-zero transient appear/disappear count, non-zero drift-move count -- the `_multi_source_n_env_events` decomposition, reported per source, not pooled), the OFF arm draws no RNG and is bit-identical to the pre-SD-047 env, and the env-caused : agent-caused event ratio sits in the pre-registered 1:1-2:1 band. (B) The enabling clause -- that this background is "dense enough for agency-detection comparators (MECH-095) and reafference cancellation (MECH-098) to be honestly tested at substrate level". Non-degenerate only if the consumer test additionally reports a minimum class count per attribution condition (agent_caused / env_caused / agent_collateral / env_correlated) and the ratio stays inside the calibration band *in the arm being read*. This second guard was absent from V3-EXQ-510 -- its only check is pool-non-emptiness (`c*_evaluable = ratio is not None`, driver lines 415-452) -- and the pools duly collapsed (seed 42: `agent_caused` 1410 / 933 / 150 / 85 against `env_caused` 66 / 165 / 376 / 362 for ARM_0..ARM_3, i.e. the band is met near ARM_1 and inverts to ~1:2.5 at ARM_2 and ~1:4.3 at ARM_3). Any future reading of clause (B) must carry the guard; for the consumer-side precondition itself, do not re-derive -- see MECH-095's own `what_would_answer` NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (HARD) and its two mandatory guards.

CONFIRMING. (A) is confirmed and stays confirmed: V3-EXQ-509 (2026-05-03, PASS/supports) plus the implementation smoke (200 ticks, all three sources ON, scale=1.0: `env_events=330 / agent_events=169`, ratio 1.95:1, inside the band) plus 7/7 preflight and 184/184 contracts green with the master switch OFF. (B) would be confirmed by the claim's own pre-registered pattern: the OFF arm reproduces the V3-EXQ-506 C1-C3 FAIL signature while at least one enabled arm clears all of C1 (gap_agent / gap_env_caused >= 1.5), C2 (gap_agent / gap_agent_collateral >= 1.5) and C3 (gap_agent / gap_env_correlated >= 1.5) alongside C4 (gap_agent >= 0.1), with the arm-level lift forming an inverted U peaking at ARM_2 (scale 1.0) -- the Asai 2016 non-monotonic prediction -- and the peak clearing both >= 2 SD of the per-arm delta and an absolute floor (0.04 on the consumer's own discrimination metric, the floor V3-EXQ-741 pre-registered).

FALSIFYING. The claim's own words: "Woo/Spelke falsifier: if flat-failure across all arms, route MECH-095 from substrate_ceiling to substrate_conditional."

THIS BRANCH HAS FIRED. The falsifier ran and returned FALSIFYING for clause (B). V3-EXQ-510 (2026-05-04, `v3_exq_510_sd047_mech095_live_env_comparator_gap_20260504T074619Z_v3`): FAIL, 3 seeds x 4 arms, `n_c1 = n_c2 = n_c3 = 0` in every arm (C4 the only criterion passing, 3/3 seeds, every arm), and the driver's own classifier recorded `"outcome_branch": "WOO_SPELKE"` with `evidence_direction_per_claim: {"SD-047": "weakens"}`. The pre-registered inverted-U is present in *ordering only* and absent in magnitude (`ratio_agent_over_env` 1.145 / 1.159 / 1.206 / 1.193 across ARM_0..ARM_3 -- peak at the pre-registered ARM_2, but against a threshold of 1.5). This is corroborated, not contradicted, by the two later valid runs: V3-EXQ-741 (2026-07-12) re-ran the 4-arm sweep on a purpose-built test-bed carrying *both* the guards 510 and 047l/047m lacked, reported `non_degenerate: true` on all four arms, and found no arm discriminating (best routing improvement +0.028 against the 0.04 floor; the gradient-head framing actively hurt recall at -0.114; the baseline already carried contact recall 0.75-0.93) -- with the confirmed autopsy's reading being precisely a refutation of clause (B): *SD-047's world-caused drift is not a structurally-distinct OTHER, so the env cannot make the comparator load-bearing and the baseline pre-empts it.* And V3-EXQ-529 (2026-05-06) tested the clause's *other* named beneficiary, MECH-098, on the SD-047 substrate (`multi_source_dynamics_enabled=True, weather_field_enabled=True, transient_events_enabled=True`; ARM_0 no-SD-047/no-reafference, ARM_1 SD-047 only, ARM_2 SD-047 + reafference) and returned FAIL / weakens. Both named consumers, four valid exercises, zero positive discrimination.

WHAT THE CLAIM SHOULD BECOME (narrowing proposal, PROPOSE-ONLY -- governance decides). Split the two clauses that this single claim currently fuses. Keep, as the surviving verified residual: SD-047 provides three concurrent, independently-ablatable, bit-identically-OFF stochastic event sources at distinct spatial and temporal scales, calibrated to a 1:1-2:1 env:agent event ratio at `multi_source_intensity_scale = 1.0`, with a single sweep lever -- *confirmed* (V3-EXQ-509 + smoke + contracts). Retire, as refuted by its own pre-registered falsifier: the clause that this background is "dense enough for agency-detection comparators (MECH-095) and reafference cancellation (MECH-098) to be honestly tested at substrate level" -- four valid exercises against both named consumers, none positive, and the mechanism of the negative is now understood (unstructured agent-independent variation is background, not a structurally-distinct causal source). Nothing is deleted: the retired clause and its evidence chain stay in the block as history, exactly as SD-003's `what_would_answer` handles its own 28-FAIL chain.

DO NOT QUEUE A SUCCESSOR SWEEP. The re-derive brake refuses it: `substrate_queue.json`'s `agency_comparator_testbed_sd047` entry is marked "exhausted as the MECH-095 ceiling substrate", and MECH-095's `what_would_answer` states that a run on any single-agent substrate, *including a further SD-047 letter*, "is explicitly REFUSED ... and should self-route `substrate_not_ready`, not count as a verdict." The residual live question -- whether a *structured* second causal source rescues the comparator -- is `multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-1 -> MAE-2 -> MAE-3`, not another intensity arm.

SD-048.subject: body.interoceptive_noise_dynamics
SD-048.title: Interoceptive noise dynamics: stochastic body-state perturbations independent of the agent's motor output (autonomic background noise + sensitisation spikes + fatigue drift) provide an agent-independent interoceptive background dense enough for the affective comparator (ARC-058, Level 2 of the reafference comparator family) to be honestly tested at substrate level.
SD-048.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The quiet (no-body-noise-event) tick bucket must hold a pre-registered minimum sample at the scored arm. In causal_grid_world.py the single interoceptive_noise_scale knob multiplies BOTH perturbation amplitude (sigma_a, sigma_f) and sensitisation trigger probability (p_event), so raising scale mechanically depletes the quiet category; at scale >= ~3x n_quiet_steps was 0 in every seed of both 512a ARM_A and 902 ARM_3.
CONFIRMING: With both comparison buckets above their minimum-n guard, the matched-amplitude body-noise-vs-agent-caused residual gap is positive at ARM_2 (the substrate's own default calibration) and traces the predicted inverted-U across arms, degrading at ARM_0 for want of independent variance and at ARM_3 for excess noise. Manipulation: The four-arm interoceptive_noise_scale sweep (ARM_0 OFF, ARM_1 0.25x, ARM_2 1.0x default, ARM_3 4x) with interoceptive_noise_enabled=True, plus a criterion redesign that decouples the detectability-sanity comparison's sampling from the noise-trigger frequency. Control: The bit-identical OFF arm (interoceptive_noise_enabled=False, all counters zero) as the deterministic floor, plus the architecture doc's own matched-amplitude agent-caused bucket as the within-arm comparator in place of the substituted quiet-baseline proxy. Required event: A rollout in which agent-caused limb damage (hazard contact) and agent-independent body-state perturbation (autonomic Gaussian, Poisson sensitisation, AR(1) fatigue) both occur on the harm_obs_a readout, with enough undisturbed ticks left over to form a real comparison bucket. DV: Forward-model residual on body-noise-caused ticks MINUS residual on matched-amplitude agent-caused ticks (the architecture doc's pre-registered C2), reported only when both buckets clear a minimum-n guard, across the four arms; the band shape is the predicted inverted-U peaking at or near the substrate's own default calibration.
FALSIFYING: With the guard in place the gap is indistinguishable from zero at and near default scale and only becomes positive at inflated scales whose quiet/agent buckets are themselves depleted -- the comparator can only be honestly tested above the substrate's designed calibration, which routes ARC-058's Level 2 comparator from V3-tractable to substrate_conditional per SD-048's own stated fallback. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: v3_exq_902's per-arm residual buckets and counters record the right raw quantities, but _safe_mean returns 0.0 on an empty list with no minimum-n guard (driver line 432-440), so quiet_gap silently becomes residual_body_noise minus a zero placeholder; check_degeneracy tests cross-seed variance of the gap, not sample-count degeneracy of the bucket it divides against, so it passes while blind to this. Consumer / boundary: The interoceptive forward model's reafference-discrimination boundary -- whether it separates self-caused from body-noise-caused change in harm_obs_a -- not any downstream behavioural metric. Existing ownership: ARC-058, ARC-033, SD-047, EXP-0212, EXP-1271, V3-EXQ-902.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The deciding criterion is defective, not the substrate. C2 was silently substituted since V3-EXQ-511 from the architecture doc's matched-amplitude comparison to a quiet-baseline proxy, and that proxy has no minimum-sample guard while the env couples noise amplitude and trigger frequency to one knob. Every reading in the 511/512/512a/902 chain rests on it. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: INSTRUMENT EXISTS BUT WRONG LOCUS/TIMESCALE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA calls the calibration-sweep-near-default-scale successor 'still-unrun' and names V3-EXQ-512a as its first confirming data point. Both have been overtaken: V3-EXQ-902 RAN that sweep (2026-08-09, FAIL at ARM_2/default on C2), and its confirmed autopsy showed the deciding C2/quiet_gap statistic collapses to a tautology whenever the quiet bucket empties -- which retroactively voided 512a's ARM_A PASS (n_quiet_steps=0 in all 3 seeds), re-adjudicated supports -> non_contributory. The WWA's confirming AND falsifying branches are both keyed to a DV the autopsy invalidated. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-049.subject: environment.multi_resource_heterogeneity

Provides the goal-identity vocabulary the wanting/liking + identity-distinct-goal cohort (MECH-229/230, MECH-117/216, ARC-030/032, Q-030, SD-015 unblock chain) needs to be honestly tested at substrate level, and the substrate scaffold for downstream developmental-schedule work.

SD-050.subject: relief.suffering_derivative_comparator
SD-050.title: Suffering-derivative comparator: a non-trainable rolling-window descent detector on z_harm_a.norm() that fires a relief-completion event when a sustained drop from peak to trough exceeds a threshold. Provides the substrate for MECH-302 by detecting when a period of suffering has cleanly ended, reusing the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement (MECH-057a beta-gate release, MECH-094 VALENCE_LIKING write). Architecturally adjacent to MECH-091 (urgency interrupt) but opposite polarity: MECH-091 fires on upward z_harm_a spike; SD-050 fires on downward sustained drop.
SD-050.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: z_harm_a.norm() must have cross-state dynamic range above an absolute floor with non-zero cross-seed variance, AND at least one descent of magnitude at or above suffering_drop_threshold must occur within suffering_window_length ticks from a peak above suffering_min_initial_norm, asserted per arm BEFORE scoring. Measured on V3-EXQ-664 the norm spans only about 7.18 to 7.42, so any null below that floor is a statement about the signal, not the detector.
CONFIRMING: On a stream clearing the range precondition WITHOUT scheduled injection, the comparator fires at a rate materially above zero, fires zero times with the flag OFF and zero times in simulation_mode, each fire is accompanied by both reuse-site effects, and it achieves this without training while a pooled-DA proxy on the same stream also fires on onsets. Manipulation: use_suffering_derivative_comparator OFF versus ON, with the parameter envelope swept (suffering_window_length, suffering_drop_threshold, suffering_min_initial_norm), plus a simulation_mode=True arm exercising the MECH-094 gate. Control: The flag-OFF arm (must fire zero times), the simulation_mode=True arm (must fire zero times), and a pooled-DA proxy readout on the same stream, which should additionally fire on aversive ONSET -- the Bromberg-Martin failure mode made empirical. Required event: A sustained peak-to-trough descent in z_harm_a.norm() produced by the agent's own trajectory (not scheduled injection) on a waking tick, simulation_mode=False. DV: Fire rate per episode on naturally produced descents, and per fire whether BOTH claimed reuse sites execute: beta_gate.release() with committed_step_idx reset, and ResidueField.update_valence(z_world, VALENCE_LIKING, relief_completion_weight).
FALSIFYING: (a) On a range-non-degenerate naturally driven stream the fire rate is at or near zero across the parameter envelope -- descents are real but not peak-to-trough in shape, routing to a different detector form; or (b) fires occur but one or both reuse sites do not execute; or (c) a trained scalar head off z_harm_a detects relief episodes the non-trainable norm FIFO misses on the same stream, falsifying the non-trainable and norm-based specifics only. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SufferingDerivativeComparator.tick() in ree-v3/ree_core/comparator/suffering_derivative_comparator.py (buffer-full, min_initial_norm and drop_threshold tests at lines 33-50); the flag is set in sense() and consumed in select_action() the same tick; V3-EXQ-515/516/517c/517d exercise it and now tag SD-050. What is MISSING is a pre-score recorder for z_harm_a cross-state dynamic range as an arm-level gate. Consumer / boundary: The comparator's own tick boundary plus its two reuse sites. Downstream absorption into behaviour is MECH-302's question, and conflating the two is how detector evidence has been filed against the pipeline claim. Existing ownership: SD-086, SD-087, Q-086, MECH-302, EXP-0220.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The signal has no trough. z_harm_a.norm() is near-constant within an episode (about 7.18 to 7.42, V3-EXQ-664), and the saturation is CONFIRMED AND UNEXPLAINED -- SD-087's harm-surprise-PE account was weakened by V3-EXQ-856 and Q-086's environmental-confound control returned degenerate on V3-EXQ-857a. Both named E3 consumers of z_harm_a default to 0.0 (config.py:1345, :1352). Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's closing clause, 'EVIDENCE-JOIN DEFECT, TO BE FIXED BEFORE THIS CLAIM IS SCORED: SD-050 carries zero entries in claim_evidence.v1.json', has been discharged -- GFLAG-0077 is resolved and ree-v3 8891dad6 added SD-050 to the CLAIM_IDS of V3-EXQ-515/516/517c/517d, so the claim now carries two experimental and four literature entries and was promoted to provisional 2026-08-29. The scoring precondition the WWA gates on no longer exists. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. SD-051.subject: safety_prediction.cue_specific_conditioned_inhibition_substrate
SD-051.title: Conditioned safety store: a non-trainable cue-specific predictive structure encoding 'this z_world prototype predicts that suffering will be omitted'. EMA-prototype encoder updated by MECH-302 relief-completion events; cosine-similarity expression head provides commitment-release gate when current z_world matches the learned safety prototype. Implements MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition substrate): the encoded prototype is the dorsal-striatum / dlPFC encoding-pathway analog; the cosine-similarity gate is the IL->CeA expression-pathway analog.
SD-051.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-302 relief-completion events must actually fire in-run (V3-EXQ-519's original FAIL was relief_events=0 in every integration arm until the SD-022 scheduled-limb-damage curriculum was added), the SD-065 env safety-cue channel must be armed (safety_cue_enabled with use_proxy_fields=True) so a discrete Pavlovian CS exists, and the SD-066 centered readout must be on -- V3-EXQ-759 measured absolute predict() differences of only ~1e-3 because the raw cosine sits at the sigmoid ceiling under the SD-008 common mode.
CONFIRMING: With relief events firing and the cue channel armed, the SD-051-intact arm shows a strictly higher store-attributed release rate under the concurrent safety-plus-threat cue than under threat alone, and the SD-051-ablated / SD-052-intact arm abolishes that cue-specific release while preserving contextual (SD-052) release -- the double dissociation the claim asserts. Manipulation: Ablate SD-051 (use_conditioned_safety_store False) while holding SD-052 (use_contextual_safety_terrain True) intact, crossed with cue-paired versus cue-unpaired presentation, at matched seeds and an identical damage/heal curriculum. Control: SD-052-intact / SD-051-ablated arm (the sister-pathway dissociation the claim asserts), plus an unpaired neutral-cue arm and a threat-cue-alone arm at the same seeds; both arms carry identical scheduled_limb_damage kwargs so the store and MECH-302 factors are the only axes varying. Required event: A conditioned-safe cue presented CONCURRENTLY with a threat cue while an avoidance commitment is held (beta_gate elevated), after the store's EMA prototype has been taught by real MECH-302 relief-completion ticks -- the classical conditioned-inhibition summation arrangement the claim's own falsifier names. DV: Rate of avoidance-commitment release attributable to the store under concurrent threat-plus-safety-cue relative to threat-alone (the beta_gate.release() firings gated on _conditioned_safety_signal > safety_store_threshold), with the V3-EXQ-759 cross-cue discrimination AUC retained as the representation-level anchor.
FALSIFYING: Under the same armed conditions the cue-specific release rate is indistinguishable between SD-051-intact and SD-051-ablated arms while SD-052 release is unchanged -- the store's prediction scalar exists but confers no cue-specific inhibition of avoidance, leaving SD-051 a representation-only structure rather than the MECH-304 expression pathway. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: The store and its release site exist and are exercised: ree_core/safety/conditioned_safety_store.py (update/predict, centered mode), agent.py:5855 tick and agent.py:7247 release gate, and the drivers v3_exq_519b (C1-C9 readiness, PASS) and v3_exq_759 (predict AUC, PASS). What is missing is any driver that records the release-rate DV under a CONCURRENT safety-plus-threat presentation, and any run tagging claim_ids SD-051. Consumer / boundary: The IL->CeA expression pathway: beta_gate.release() plus the optional VALENCE_LIKING write at the avoidance-commitment boundary inside select_action -- not episode survival, which is where V3-EXQ-603h hit the competence ceiling. Existing ownership: SD-051, MECH-304, SD-065, SD-066, SD-052, EXP-1160, V3-EXQ-519b, V3-EXQ-759.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); Nothing in the substrate blocks the run. Both existing PASSes (519b readiness, 759 predict-AUC) are representation-level and are tagged MECH-304 only, so SD-051 carries zero evidence rows; no driver has ever run the concurrent-cue conditioned-inhibition summation test with an SD-052-intact control. The behavioural leg additionally inherits the 603h competence ceiling. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-052.subject: safety_prediction.contextual_passive_substrate
SD-052.title: Contextual passive safety terrain: a non-trainable RBF-field accumulator over z_world that integrates 'suffering-absent' waking ticks into a slow contextual safety representation. Provides the substrate for MECH-303 (contextual passive safety pathway; vmPFC + hippocampus / vHipp-to-PL biological analog). When the field's local mean exceeds release threshold and beta_gate is elevated, drops the avoidance commitment to lower background vigilance. Parallel architecture to ARC-030 / MECH-117 benefit_terrain; uses a separate RBF field, no sharing with benefit_terrain or main residue values.
SD-052.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Safety terrain must actually accumulate and must discriminate: with contextual_safety_gate_source left at its z_harm_a default the gate is unreachable (the default threshold 0.05 sits ~11x below the observed z_harm_a norm and V3-EXQ-917 measured chance AUC in damage_sourced mode), so an arm must set gate_source='proximity_signal' with the env emitting safety_proximity_harm, and must set SD-067's safety_terrain_bandwidth, or evaluate_safety saturates and the release fires indiscriminately.
CONFIRMING: Enabled agents release avoidance commitment more often in the repeatedly-safe context than in the unsafe context, while SD-052-ablated agents with intact SD-051 do not, even though cue-specific safety responses remain functional. Manipulation: Ablate SD-052 by disabling use_contextual_safety_terrain while leaving SD-051/SD-066 cue-specific conditioned safety intact, versus the enabled arm at a calibrated bandwidth and proximity-sourced gate. Control: The SD-051-intact / SD-052-off arm as the dissociation control, plus an unsafe-context arm at matched exposure so that release is attributable to accumulated safety rather than to elapsed time. Required event: Repeated waking exposure to a harmless spatial context (threat-absent ticks at recurring z_world locations) followed by re-entry into that context while an avoidance commitment is active and beta_gate is elevated. DV: Background vigilance: the rate and duration of avoidance-commitment release (beta_gate.release events, committed-step occupancy) in the repeatedly-safe context versus the unsafe context, with total_safety / num_safety_steps reported to show accumulation actually occurred.
FALSIFYING: Enabled and ablated agents show the same background vigilance in repeatedly-safe contexts, or release fires indistinguishably in safe and unsafe contexts at a calibrated bandwidth -- the passive terrain adds no contextual vigilance reduction beyond the cue-specific pathway. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/residue/field.py accumulate_safety / evaluate_safety over the separate safety_terrain_rbf_field; the accumulate gate and the release consumer both live in ree_core/agent.py (gate at the sense() site, release at the select_action site calling beta_gate.release and clearing the committed anchor keys). Consumer / boundary: The avoidance-commitment release decision in select_action -- background vigilance level -- not the representational separability of safe versus unsafe contexts, which V3-EXQ-760 already validated. Existing ownership: MECH-303, SD-067, V3-EXQ-917, EXP-1162, SD-022.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); Nothing is architecturally missing: accumulate, evaluate, the dedicated proximity gate source and the beta_gate release consumer are all live. The behavioural falsifier simply has not been run on the built configuration -- V3-EXQ-764 was written before the proximity source existed, calibrated its own 0.55 threshold and froze accumulation during the test window, and never landed a manifest. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-054.subject: environment.reef_enrichment_substrate
SD-054.title: Reef enrichment substrate: env-level behavioral-diversity substrate adding coral-reef safe zones (hazard-free patches with a static scent gradient) and food-attracted hazard drift to CausalGridWorldV2. Creates two competing behavioral attractors -- 'flee to reef' vs 'forage' -- to break monomodal route-exploitation in agents whose policy collapses to a single fixed trajectory, unblocking SD-029 C2 / C3 measurement. Pure environment substrate; no trainable parameters; no MECH-094 interaction. Renamed from SD-050 on 2026-05-08 to resolve a registry-ID collision with the suffering-derivative comparator.
SD-054.what_would_answer:
SD-054's falsifier is the same test MECH-309 runs, read at the substrate-purpose level rather than the mechanism-diagnostic level: agents trained under SD-054-enabled environments (reef safe zones + food-attracted hazard drift) should produce measurably more diverse behavior distributions (reef-visit fraction in a non-degenerate range, forage events, zone transitions per episode) than agents trained under reef_enabled=False baseline -- the prerequisite for unblocking SD-029 C2/C3 measurement.
Do not re-derive a separate SD-054 falsifier -- this is MECH-309's ARM_1-vs-ARM_0 test verbatim (see MECH-309's own what_would_answer for the current, post-654h/i/j/851 state of that test and its downstream-of- selection blocker). SD-054 would be falsified at the substrate level only if the reef/forage attractor structure itself failed to produce diversity even under an externally injected discriminative policy -- that leg (V3-EXQ-522, heuristic policy) is independently PASSed and not in question. What remains open is purely the trained-policy conversion leg, which is MECH-309's substrate_ceiling finding, not a fresh SD-054-specific falsifier.

SD-055.subject: hippocampal.differentiable_cem_selection
SD-055.title: Differentiable CEM selection approximation -- replaces the non-differentiable argmax / argsort elite-selection step in HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories() with a softmax-weighted candidate mean so that gradient flows from task reward back through candidate selection to SD-016 cue_action_proj. Opt-in via use_differentiable_cem flag (default False; legacy argmax path bit-identical when off). Preserves ARC-007 STRICT value-flat constraint: scoring uses existing residue-terrain evaluation, not a new value head.
SD-055.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A gradient must actually be able to reach cue_action_proj: the softmax refit restoring differentiability at the CEM elite step is necessary but not sufficient, because agent.py detaches gated_for_e1.z_world before extract_cue_context and detaches the returned action_bias, and no live loss backprops through propose_trajectories. Unless one of those is changed, an ON/OFF contrast compares soft-refit against hard-elite refit with the feedback loop severed in BOTH arms.
CONFIRMING: With the detaches lifted and a loss routed through proposal generation, cue_action_proj.weight.grad is non-zero under use_differentiable_cem=True and zero under False, and distinct z_goal states produce measurably different candidate action-object distributions in the ON arm only. Manipulation: use_differentiable_cem True versus False at a fixed differentiable_cem_temperature, with the agent-side detaches lifted (or a loss explicitly routed through propose_trajectories) so the manipulation is the gradient route rather than only the aggregation form. Control: The legacy argsort/elite-index arm, bit-identical when the flag is off, on matched seeds; plus a temperature sweep so a difference attributable to soft-averaging breadth is separable from one attributable to restored gradient flow. Required event: Training ticks on a goal-rich environment in which different z_goal states are present and a task loss is backpropagated through the trajectory-proposal path that cue_action_proj feeds. DV: cue_action_proj.weight.grad magnitude over training (currently None on any trained-policy run) and, behaviourally, cue-conditioned divergence of the proposed candidate action-object distribution across distinct z_goal contexts, ON versus OFF.
FALSIFYING: With a live gradient route confirmed reaching cue_action_proj, the ON arm still produces no greater cue-conditioned divergence of candidate action-object distributions than the OFF arm -- the argsort barrier was then not the binding constraint on cue-conditioned trajectory generation. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: hippocampal/module.py:2419 implements the softmax-weighted refit and V3-EXQ-568 recorded grad_max=372 -- but on a synthetic requires_grad tensor passed directly into propose_trajectories, never on cue_action_proj. No instrument records the end-to-end gradient arriving at cue_action_proj on a real training run. Consumer / boundary: SD-016's cue_action_proj weights in E1 -- the parameter the restored gradient is supposed to train -- reached through candidate generation and the CEM elite aggregate. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0301, ARC-072, SD-016, INV-073, mech151-action-bias-has-no-e3-ranking-channel, EXP-1342.
DISPOSITION: R4 (primary); The gradient route the flag restores is unreachable from cue_action_proj on any trained-policy run: agent.py:6129 passes gated_for_e1.z_world.detach() into extract_cue_context and agent.py:6131 stores action_bias.detach(), and no live loss backprops through propose_trajectories, so the weight's grad stays None. The ON/OFF experiment was REFUSED at /queue-experiment Step 2.5a on that measurement, not queued. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-056.subject: e2.action_conditional_divergence_contrastive
SD-056.title: E2 world-forward action-conditional divergence preservation via auxiliary InfoNCE-style contrastive loss. Substrate-level fix for the V3-EXQ-571 root cause finding (2026-05-25): with world_dim=32 and action_dim=4, action contributes ~11% of world_forward input dimensionality, and reconstruction-shaped training collapses to the state-dominated local minimum where action effect is fitted to zero. Measurement: cand_world_pairwise_dist = 0.0000 across K=8 candidates differing only in first action. Same root cause as 2026-05-17 ARC-062 GAP-B autopsy; GAP-B fix was scoped only to GatedPolicy first-action one-hot bypass. SD-056 is the architecturally-faithful generalisation -- fixes the predictor's training objective rather than bypassing the predictor at each consumer. Option (ii) lever B (contrastive next-state, Srivastava et al. 2021 style) chosen over PLSM-style MI factorisation (lever A) and SWIRL-style MI maximisation (lever C) per 2026-05-28 lit-pull SYNTHESIS verdict and user AskUserQuestion confirmation.
SD-056.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The candidate pool handed to world_forward must genuinely differ in first action (SP-CEM plus a resource-bearing env), and at least e2_action_contrastive_min_batch_classes=2 distinct action classes must be present or the loss returns exactly 0 and the arm is vacuous. The multi-step arm must additionally be numerically bounded: V3-EXQ-569e returned INSTRUMENTATION_FAILURE because iterated rollouts exploded, so an unclamped ON arm measures overflow rather than divergence.
CONFIRMING: An ON arm whose cand_world_pairwise_dist clears 0.05 against a near-zero OFF arm with held-out contrastive accuracy above chance, numerically stable, and a Pathway-A-versus-B contrast attributing the downstream diversity to per-candidate z_world divergence rather than to E3-side shortlisting. Manipulation: e2_action_contrastive_enabled OFF versus ON (weight 0.01, temperature 0.1), optionally with e2_rollout_output_norm_clamp_enabled and e2_action_contrastive_multistep_enabled as the stability arms. Control: The OFF arm, which is bit-identical to the pre-substrate path; held-out contrastive-task accuracy against the 1/K = 12.5 pct random baseline for K=8; and, for mechanism attribution, a Pathway-A (per-candidate z_world divergence) versus Pathway-B (E3-side top-k shortlist) contrast. Required event: E2 world_forward training on batches of K sibling CEM candidates that share z_world_0 and differ only in first action, with the corresponding z_world_1 targets available as in-batch negatives. DV: cand_world_pairwise_dist -- mean pairwise L2 between the K predicted z_world_1 outputs -- rising from about 0.0 at baseline to at least 0.05, direction-of-change being the load-bearing condition, plus held-out contrastive accuracy above 50 pct.
FALSIFYING: cand_world_pairwise_dist fails to rise above the OFF baseline under a numerically stable ON arm; or it rises while held-out contrastive accuracy stays at chance, meaning the loss decreased without the discrimination task being learnable; or a Pathway-B-only manipulation reproduces the entire downstream effect, which would route to the PLSM (lever A) or SWIRL (lever C) fallback. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py: cand_world_pairwise_dist at line 229 and world_forward_contrastive_loss at line 289, with the multi-step amend at line 416; four knobs surfaced through REEConfig.from_dims (config.py lines 896-916); contracts in tests/contracts/test_sd_056_e2_action_contrastive.py; drivers V3-EXQ-613 (synthetic) and 569d/569e (real training). Consumer / boundary: The E2 world_forward predictor's own training objective -- the representation handed to every downstream consumer of cand_world_summaries (MECH-314a curiosity, MECH-320 tonic vigor, MECH-295 liking bridge, SD-033a, SD-033b) -- not committed behaviour. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0231, EXP-0585, EXP-0440, ARC-065, MECH-341.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); The registered representation-level falsifier is runnable and has been measured three times (V3-EXQ-613 synthetic; 569d and 569e real training, about 0.05 ON versus 0.014 OFF at t=1). What is missing is the claim-evidence JOIN -- 613/617 carry claim_ids [] and 569c/d/e tag ARC-065/MECH-341 only -- so genuine_exp_count reads 0 and the claim looks untested. The mechanism-attribution re-run is gated on governance funding, not substrate. Secondary classes: R1. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued.
