SD-057.subject: drive.object_bound_incentive_salience
SD-057.title: Object-bound incentive-salience layer: insert a per-object incentive layer between the benefit pulse and z_goal. The legacy goal stream wrote a SINGLE z_goal attractor overwritten on every contact, conflating liking (hedonic impact at consumption) with wanting (incentive salience to a cue/object) and goal-location (where) with goal-object (what); wanting target always equalled liking target, so the L9 wanting!=liking dissociation was structurally inexpressible (514l C6=0.0 on all seeds). SD-057 adds (L2 MECH-344) benefit->object-identity binding on the SD-049 per-type tag, (L3 MECH-345) a per-object slow-decay revaluable incentive token with at-recall drive-specific wanting amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive), and (L4 MECH-346) z_goal seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored embedding rather than the raw last-contacted z_resource. v1 = L2+L3+L4 core; L6 cue-recall (MECH-CUEWANT) + L7 dACC-readout-wiring (MECH-CONSUME) deferred to a phase-2 pass within this SD.
SD-057.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The incentive bank must be populated with at least two distinct object tokens whose base_value differs, and per-axis drive must have cross-axis spread, otherwise argmax_k wanting[k] equals the last-contacted type by default and the L4 seeding switch has nothing to change. V3-EXQ-693 confirmed tokens bind (distinct_tokens_max equals n_resource_types) with per-axis spread 0.009-0.015.
CONFIRMING: On ticks where most-wanted differs from last-contacted, the L4-ON arm's approach behaviour tracks the most-wanted object while the legacy arm tracks the last-contacted one, on >= 2/3 seeds. Manipulation: z_goal seeded from z_object[argmax_k wanting[k]] (use_incentive_token_bank ON, L4) versus the legacy seeding from the raw last-contacted z_resource, holding the GoalState firing gate, drive and curriculum identical. Control: The legacy-seeding arm is the matched control; the forced-contact microdiagnostic (v3_exq_681_sd057_wl_channel_write_forced_contact_microdiagnostic.py) supplies the decoupled positive control that the channel writes at all. Required event: Consumption contacts on at least two resource identities followed by later goal-formation ticks at which the most-wanted object differs from the last-contacted one -- the state in which object-bound and legacy seeding diverge. DV: Paired-by-seed change in approach behaviour toward the most-wanted object versus the last-contacted object -- approach/visit fraction by resource type, and first-commit action class -- on the ticks where the two targets differ, alongside the already-measured wanting != liking dissociation fraction.
FALSIFYING: The L4 seeding switch changes the recorded z_goal target but produces no divergence in approach behaviour from the legacy arm on exactly those divergent ticks -- the layer makes the dissociation expressible without making it behaviourally consequential. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: goal.py IncentiveTokenBank.most_wanted (goal.py:756) plus GoalState.cue_pull and the dACC object-discriminative readout (dacc.py:491-581) record the wanting side; 514p and 693a score n_scored_wl_steps and the dissociation fraction. No driver records a BEHAVIOURAL divergence conditioned on most-wanted != last-contacted. Consumer / boundary: z_goal seeding in agent.update_z_goal (the L4 switch), and thence the goal-proximity term that reaches E3 candidate scoring -- the claim asserts the SEEDING SOURCE changes what the agent pursues. Existing ownership: goal_pipeline:GAP-7, SD-049-PHASE-2, modulatory-bias-selection-authority, scaffolded_sd054_onboarding.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The L4 object-bound seeding switch is built and exercised by 65 drivers, but no experiment contrasts it against legacy last-contacted seeding on a behavioural DV conditioned on the divergent ticks; existing runs measure expressibility (dissociation fraction, WL steps) only. The runs that could carry the behavioural contrast are the SD-049 4-arm family, whose primary arm starves on contact. Secondary classes: R5. Gap disposition: EXISTING SUBSTRATE, EXPERIMENT DOES NOT USE IT. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-058.subject: defensive_action.instrumental_avoidance_acquisition
SD-058.title: Instrumental-avoidance acquisition: REE's defensive system needs an instrumental-ACQUISITION side, not only the defensive-REACTION side. SD-035 (amygdala BLA/CeA salience) + MECH-279 (PAG freeze gate) give REE the Pavlovian reaction (Tovote 2016: response EXECUTION, not learning); what is missing is the step from reaction to learned avoidance. Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance learning is the RESOLUTION of a Pavlovian-instrumental conflict -- the freezing reaction and the instrumental avoidance action are mutually exclusive, and learning to avoid REQUIRES the infralimbic PFC to SUPPRESS central-amygdala-driven freezing (ilPFC lesion -> more freezing, less avoidance; CeA lesion -> opposite). A freeze-and-salience substrate with no reaction-suppression / instrumental-acquisition layer is the ilPFC-lesion animal: it freezes instead of learning to avoid -- the V3-EXQ-603g G_H 0/3 signature. SD-058 adds the architecture (an instrumental-avoidance action pathway + an ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression gate gated by learned avoidance-efficacy, staged under a protective scaffold); MECH-357 is the gate mechanism.
SD-058.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The Pavlovian-instrumental conflict must actually exist: the LESION arm must FAIL its own negative control (G_H_LESION_frac below the 0.333 discriminative-headroom floor) while survivability remains attainable above it. Measured 0.6667 (603s, exact tie) and 1.0 (603t/603u, full ceiling) -- the guard has never been met.
CONFIRMING: With LESION failing its own negative control (headroom below 0.333) and survivability attainable above it, INTACT clears G_H >= 2/3 and strictly beats LESION, with a non-underflowed avoidance_efficacy trace showing credit accumulation on directed escape rather than suppression driven by the scaffold floor alone. Manipulation: INTACT (use_instrumental_avoidance with the ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression gate over MECH-279) versus LESION (gate ablated, PAG freeze unopposed), with the hazard-pressure mechanism varied across designs: static field, env_drift mobile predators, SD-029 scheduled_external_hazard, and hazard_agent_pursuit. Control: ARM_LESION as the Moscarello-LeDoux negative control plus ARM_POSCTRL for the survivability ceiling, on matched seeds, with the SD-059/MECH-358 escape-affordance bridge and the harm-pathway-training fix armed identically in every arm. Required event: Sustained threat under which freezing and directed instrumental avoidance are mutually exclusive and freezing is genuinely costly, so the agent must resolve the conflict rather than being able to survive by freezing. DV: G_H survival fraction on the Stage-H hazard curriculum, INTACT versus LESION, requiring G_H_INTACT >= 2/3 AND G_H_INTACT_frac > G_H_LESION_frac; with avoidance_efficacy and n_credit/n_decay tick counts as the mechanism readout confirming the learned trace is actually accumulating.
FALSIFYING: With the conflict genuinely established and the repaired trace accumulating, INTACT still fails to clear 2/3 or fails to beat LESION -- freeze-suppression fires without the predicted survival benefit, which would falsify the instrumental-acquisition architecture rather than its test-bed. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: InstrumentalAvoidanceGate.diagnostics exposes mech357_avoidance_efficacy / scaffold_floor / effective_efficacy; the 603 driver family records freeze, gate-engagement and suppression fractions plus the two-sided discriminative-headroom guard 603s introduced. Instruments are adequate; the guard is what keeps failing. Consumer / boundary: The freeze-versus-act arbitration at the MECH-279 PAG output -- suppression of the Pavlovian freeze by a learned avoidance-efficacy signal -- not episode reward and not the reflexive SD-037 / MECH-281 escape levers. Existing ownership: MECH-357, mech357_avoidance_efficacy:BUILD, mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism, escape-affordance-bridge, scaffolded_sd054_onboarding, SD-059.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The environment cannot yet produce a freeze-incompatible hazard: LESION never fails its own negative control across four structurally distinct pressure designs (static, mobile-predator drift, scheduled adjacency, agent-directed pursuit), so the primary criteria were never validly evaluated in any run. The separate eligibility-trace underflow is now REPAIRED (ree-v3 93d5d98, credit-eligibility windowing) and is no longer the blocker. Secondary classes: R3. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA's actual_result_to_date ends at 603h (2026-06-08) and states the bridge retest is 'not yet queued'. It has since run five more times: 603r (combined-fix, both fixes armed), 603s (mobile-predator pressure), 603t (SD-029 scheduled hazard) and 603u (agent-directed pursuit), all confirmed-autopsied, plus 603v validating a repair to a defect the WWA never names -- the avoidance_efficacy eligibility trace underflowed to ~1e-90 in every arm and seed, so suppression was governed by the annealing scaffold_floor and never by learned efficacy. All four pressure designs are now exhausted (603u validated_negative). Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-059.subject: defensive_action.escape_affordance_bridge
SD-059.title: Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge: SD-058/MECH-357 supply an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate but its avoidance_efficacy is a GLOBAL SCALAR that only penalises the no-op/freeze class -- compute_action_bias by design 'does NOT compute the escape direction'. V3-EXQ-603h (engaged-but-insufficient, readiness met) showed the consequence: the agent un-freezes but acquires no directed escape (seed-43 scalar efficacy 0.633 -> WORST survival 11.0). Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance needs the LA/BA->NAcc relief/safety action-credit half that positively reinforces a SPECIFIC avoidance response, not only the suppression half. REE owns relief (MECH-302/SD-050) + safety (MECH-303/304/SD-052/SD-051) but they are UNWIRED to avoidance. SD-059 adds the architecture: an affordance-indexed (per-first-action-class) credit table that, when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (relief) or terminates the threat (safety), tags that action as an escape affordance approachable under future threat; MECH-358 is the bridge mechanism.
SD-059.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Stage-H must have survival headroom rather than a saturated binary ceiling, the harm pathway must be trained so the PAG freeze and ilPFC gate engage on the base arm, the SD-056 e2 contrastive warmup must be in place so the relief detector has a usable z_harm_a signal, and each enabled bridge half must increment its credit before any survival statistic is scored.
CONFIRMING: Both_bridge and best_bridge mean Stage-H survival exceed the MECH-357-only baseline by at least 10 percent with each half firing non-vacuously -- fired by V3-EXQ-603q (base 37.7 to safety 46.6, supports) and substrate-reproduced by V3-EXQ-866b. Manipulation: Four arms over the credit-table architecture: base (MECH-357 scalar gate only), relief half only, safety half only, and both halves -- each toggled independently via the bridge flags. Control: ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY (SD-058/MECH-357 freeze-suppression alone) on matched seeds, plus a nav-competence positive control that distinguishes a flat result across bridge arms from a survival/navigation ceiling. Required event: A threat episode in which a directed (non-freeze) action either drops z_harm_a or is followed by threat absence, creating per-action-class relief or safety credit that a later future-threat episode can act on. DV: Mean continuous Stage-H survival of the best and both bridge arms relative to ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY at a >= 10 percent lift bar, with secondary P1 survival transfer and no over-avoidance or starvation.
FALSIFYING: With each enabled half firing non-vacuously and the nav-competence control PASSING, no affordance-indexed arm lifts continuous Stage-H survival over the scalar-gate-only baseline -- the affordance-indexed credit architecture adds nothing over suppression alone. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/pfc/escape_affordance_bridge.py plus HazardAvoidanceResult.escape_bridge_state, which surfaces the per-half credit tables so the manifest can gate non-vacuity; V3-EXQ-603q recorded all four preconditions and both primary criteria. Consumer / boundary: The architectural decision boundary -- whether a per-first-action-class affordance table wired into the E3 approach bias supplies a DIRECTED escape that MECH-357's global avoidance_efficacy scalar, which only penalises the no-op class, cannot. Existing ownership: MECH-358, MECH-357, SD-058, scaffolded_sd054_onboarding, V3-EXQ-603q.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); R0: the credit architecture, the threat-gated per-class E3 approach bias, the Stage-H regime with headroom, the continuous survival DV, the non-vacuity gate and the nav-competence control all exist, and the 4-arm falsifier ran to a PASS. Only replication (n=1) and the v3_pending gate stand between this and promotion. Secondary classes: none. Gap disposition: NO GAP -- FALSE POSITIVE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-060.subject: drive.non_terminal_drive_register
SD-060.title: Non-terminal drive register: needs beyond hunger/thirst (exploration, play, social, learning, grooming, rest) are first-class drive axes, each carried as its own homeostatic-style integrator rather than collapsed into the single SD-012 energy scalar.
SD-060.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least two candidate non-terminal drive axes (e.g. exploration via
MECH-111, play via ARC-073) must be simultaneously implemented as independent homeostatic-style
integrators (own decay/satiation dynamics, own deficit signal) rather than folded into SD-012's
single energy scalar. This per-axis machinery does not currently exist for heterogeneous need
categories: SD-049's per_axis_drive (ree_core/goal.py, _drive_axis_for) is scoped to per-RESOURCE-
TYPE incentive value within the existing wanting/incentive system (SD-049 type-axis 1:1 mapping),
a different axis semantics from SD-060's need-CATEGORY axes -- do not mistake it for partial
SD-060 substrate in a future pass.

CONFIRMING: an agent built with SD-060's multi-axis register produces behaviourally
distinguishable satiation dynamics per drive category (e.g. exploration drive satiates and
recovers independently of play drive, each on its own schedule) AND downstream arbitration
(MECH-394) or orienting behaviour (DRV-4/MECH-395) measurably differs from a matched agent in
which the same needs are collapsed into a single SD-012-style scalar -- i.e. axis-separation does
independent work, not mere relabelling.

FALSIFYING: collapsing all non-terminal needs into a single scalar (matched total budget/decay)
reproduces the same behavioural coverage/selection outcomes as the multi-axis register at matched
training -- axis-separation is representational overhead with no functional payoff. A failure
under the unmet precondition above is not evidence against the claim.

SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: SD-060 itself is unbuilt (grep -rniE
"multidrive|non_terminal_drive|drive_register|drive_axis" under ree-v3/ree_core/: zero hits beyond
the unrelated SD-049 mechanism, confirmed 2026-09-25). Its only implemented candidate contributors
are MECH-111 (curiosity, implementation_phase v3, live but with a broken EMA->E3-selection routing
per its own evidence_quality_note -- V3-EXQ-590a found no downstream propagation) and ARC-073
(play-pressure, itself substrate-blocked: no play mode and no learning-progress estimator exist at
all, per ARC-073's own what_would_answer). "Prose-only ... scattered intrinsic seeds ... no shared
register" (the claim's own functional_restatement) is CONFIRMED current, not stale.
evidence/planning/substrate_queue.json's 2026-09-04 reconcile note independently and currently
defers SD-060 as "v4/v6-phase ... not substrate-queue material yet."

UNBLOCKS WHEN: >= 2 of {exploration, play, social, learning, grooming, rest} land as
independently-satiating integrators.

SD-061.subject: control_plane.difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy
SD-061.title: Difficulty-gated proposal-entropy regulator: a stuck-state/impasse detector + a transient gain on the ARC-018/CEM PROPOSAL-generation layer (wider candidate set + within-class CEM sampling temperature), decaying as the impasse clears. Builds MECH-343's substrate_conditional blocker part 2 (the 'stuck-state detector + transient CEM temperature/candidate-count gain + decay not yet designed' piece named in MECH-343's evidence_quality_note); blocker part 1 (modulatory-bias-selection-authority) is already IMPLEMENTED via the 569i top-k shortlist conversion. The detector integrates goal-progress stall + E3 score margin + committed-action-class lock-in + dACC choice_difficulty into a graded stuck_score, GUARDED by goal salience (stuck-WITH-goal, not goal-abandonment); the regulator maps stuck_score to extra CEM candidates + a within-class temperature lift. Scoring, commitment (MECH-090/342) and selection authority (569i/MECH-341) are untouched -- a hard problem widens proposals, not behaviour.
SD-061.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The regulator must be load-bearing with the OFF arm bit-identical in the SAME run, and the temperature half must be coupled to its consumer (dgpe_enable_differentiable_cem, otherwise the mutation writes a value nothing reads). Ecological non-vacuity: the detector must reach is_stuck from naturally-arising goal blockage rather than an induced impasse, on at least 2 of 3 seeds, with per-input contributions reported separately because one of the four inputs is itself substrate_ceiling.
CONFIRMING: With both halves live, candidate diversity rises under stuck relative to the within-seed pre-stuck baseline and the OFF arm's drift and then decays, the asymmetric EMA shows fast rise / slow fall, the salience-withdrawn control shows no widening, and score-margin and admission counters are unchanged. Manipulation: Arm the SD-061 regulator so stuck_score maps to extra CEM candidates AND a transient differentiable_cem_temperature lift with SD-055 coupled ON, against the bit-identical OFF arm and an always-high (ungated) arm. Control: The OFF arm (bit-identical by construction), an always-high entropy arm matched on candidate count, and a goal-salience-withdrawn negative control which must show no widening (the stuck-WITH-goal guard). Required event: A naturally-arising impasse -- goal-progress stall with the goal still salient, narrow E3 first-action score margin, committed-action-class lock-in, elevated dACC choice_difficulty -- followed by its resolution. DV: Proposal-layer diversity under stuck relative to a within-seed pre-stuck baseline AND to the OFF arm's own drift, then its decay -- currently declared as candidate_first_action_entropy, with GFLAG-0357 proposing action-object-space diversity instead; plus rise/fall asymmetry of stuck_score and invariance of score-margin and MECH-090 admission counters.
FALSIFYING: Widening the pool with the temperature lift live does not raise proposal-layer diversity (extra candidates are duplicates or the lift is swamped) -- V3-EXQ-694 already points this way, first_action_entropy FALLING on 3/3 seeds (-0.0812 / -0.0734 / -0.0953); or the EMA shows no hysteresis; or the regulator attributably perturbs scoring or commitment. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/cingulate/stuck_state_detector.py (graded stuck_score, asymmetric EMA, declared_axes mask) and ree-v3/ree_core/policy/difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy.py (extra_candidates, temperature_gain), with the coupling block in agent.py and the contracts in tests/contracts/test_sd_061_difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy.py. No run since the 2026-09-18 coupling has exercised the temperature half. Consumer / boundary: The ARC-018/CEM PROPOSAL-generation layer, upstream of the E3 committed argmin -- SD-061 explicitly does not claim conversion to committed behaviour, which is MECH-343's ceiling-bound claim. Existing ownership: GFLAG-0352, GFLAG-0357, MECH-343, EXP-1166, Q-056.

SD-063.subject: e2.conditional_predictive_uncertainty_head
SD-063.title: E2 world-forward carries a conditional predictive-uncertainty head (distribution-free quantile form) AVAILABLE TO E3 commitment gating -- consumer built, never exercised: E3Config.use_conditional_precision_gate has never been True in any experiment driver in the repo (narrowed from 'feeding E3 commitment gating' 2026-09-10, GFLAG-0216). The forward model emits a per-prediction predictive spread that tracks realized error, instead of relying only on E3's running-variance EMA (a temporally-smoothed global estimate whose predicted uncertainty has near-zero per-point error correlation).
SD-063.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (all four must hold in the scored run, or the run self-routes
`substrate_not_ready` rather than reporting a verdict):
(i) ENCODER TRAINED -- the P0 warmup ran (`encoders_trained: true`); an untrained z_world encoder yields
a near-invariant latent and a trivially-fittable spread (the MECH-353 / V3-EXQ-642 vacuity lesson, and
the reason V3-EXQ-977's `encoders_trained: false` coverage reading is indicative rather than decisive).
(ii) HEAD TRAINED, NOT RANDOM-INIT -- `e2_world_uncertainty_last_pvar_relative_spread >= 1.0` evaluated
across all action classes at a fixed z_world. RELATIVE spread, never absolute range: per
`e2_world_uncertainty.py`'s measured note, an UNTRAINED head has the LARGER absolute range (8.63e-04 vs
7.14e-04) and passes any absolute-range gate, so `last_uncertainty_dev_range > 0` is necessary but NOT
sufficient (this is the corrected ARC-065 section-5 gate; V3-EXQ-949 used `HEAD_REL_SPREAD_FLOOR = 1.0`).
(iii) TRANSITIONS NON-DETERMINISTIC ENOUGH FOR AN INTERVAL TO MEAN ANYTHING -- this arm's own normalised
held-out residual `norm_residual = point_rmse / target_std >= 0.05` (716a's
`readiness_norm_residual_floor`; 977 measured 0.087-0.155 and 716a 0.414). A deterministic transition set
makes the nominal-80% band trivially wide-or-empty and the coverage test vacuous.
(iv) SUFFICIENT HELD-OUT MASS -- `n_test >= 200` held-out transitions per arm per seed (977's floor;
716a banked 714 eval / 2142).

CONFIRMING (all three, majority of >= 3 seeds, with the SD-031 guard held):
(C1) CALIBRATION -- empirical coverage of the monotone-rearranged `[q0.1, q0.9]` band on held-out
`(z_world_t, a_t) -> z_world_{t+1}` transitions matches its nominal 0.80:
`|coverage_80 - 0.80| <= max(0.03, 2 x SD(coverage_80) across seeds)`. The absolute floor of 0.03 is
what stops a high-variance run from passing by being noisy.
(C2) THE WIDTH CARRIES INFORMATION BEYOND A CONSTANT -- (a) `pvar_relative_spread > 0` and
(b) `precision_error_corr >= 0.15` (716a's `corr_floor`) AND above its own permutation-null p95 (977's
instrument; measured p95 ~0.055 there). Both legs are required: (a) alone is passed by a head whose
width varies arbitrarily, (b) alone is undefined for a constant-width band.
(C3) IT BEATS THE NULL IT CLAIMS TO REPLACE -- CRPS improvement over the matched point head
>= 2% (716a's `crps_improve_frac`), and `precision_error_corr` strictly above E3's running-variance EMA
null, which is 0.0 by construction.
(C4, the consumer half the title asserts) WITH `E3Config.use_conditional_precision_gate = True` and the
head supplying `conditional_predictive_variance`, a YOKED comparison against the EMA fallback (identical
seeds, identical candidate sets, gate the only difference) shows `yoked_divergence_frac > 0` on
>= 300 candidate ticks -- i.e. the per-input spread changes at least some commit/hold decisions.

FALSIFYING (any one):
(F1) COVERAGE SYSTEMATICALLY OFF -- `|coverage_err_80| > 0.05` with the SAME SIGN on >= 4 of 5 seeds.
This is the Chung-2021 failure mode already carried as `mixed` literature on this claim, and it is
exactly what V3-EXQ-977 measures on z_world at 5/5 seeds under-covering (0.7015-0.7346, mean err 0.0846)
with an untrained encoder. A pinball head can win CRPS and still be miscalibrated; if C1 fails while C3
passes, SD-063's per-prediction spread is a good RANKING signal and a bad PROBABILITY, and the claim
must be narrowed to the ranking reading (which is what the E3 commit gate, a threshold comparison in
variance space, actually needs) rather than kept as stated.
(F2) THE INTERVAL WIDTH CARRIES NO INFORMATION BEYOND A CONSTANT -- `precision_error_corr` fails to beat
its permutation null, or `pvar_relative_spread` is at floor while precondition (ii) passes. The head is
then an expensive constant band and the EMA null is not beaten.
(F3) CONSUMER INERTNESS -- C4's `yoked_divergence_frac == 0.0` with all four preconditions met. The head
is computed and never consumed at the commit gate; SD-063's "feeding E3 commitment gating" clause is
then false as stated, independently of C1-C3. Precedent that this is a real risk, not a formality:
V3-EXQ-949's `ARM_B314_ON_AUTH_OFF` (`yoked_divergence_frac` 0.0, per-candidate deviation 1.5e-05 vs a
score range of 277) and V3-EXQ-964's FAIL label `accumulator_live_but_never_changes_committed_action`.
(F4) SD-031 GUARD BREACHED -- the E2WorldForward agency residual (`cf_gap`) drops below 0.75 of its
head-OFF value under joint training (716a's `c3_preserve_frac`). Structurally defended (separate module,
detached inputs and target) but still empirically required on every scoring run.

SD-065.subject: environment.conditioned_safety_cue_channel

Closes the 'no controllable safety cue' substrate gap that forced V3-EXQ-759 to synthesize the Pavlovian pairing off-substrate, making MECH-304's promote-to-active classical-conditioned-inhibition behavioural falsifier runnable. Adds no entity type (NUM_ENTITY_TYPES stays 7); pure environment substrate; no trainable parameters; no MECH-094 interaction at the env level.
SD-065.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The channel must be genuinely inert when off (world_obs_dim unchanged, zero RNG draws) and genuinely present when on, and the Pavlovian pairing must be REAL: the SD-051/SD-066 store must write its prototype only on an actual MECH-302 event_fired tick inside the SD-022 damage->heal window, never on a synthesized pairing. A run where the cue is active on every tick, or where no relief event fires inside the window, cannot discriminate.
CONFIRMING: With the channel enabled and the pairing real, the cue is present at every relief tick, reproducible at test independent of agent position, and a {threat + cue} test tick produces conditioned inhibition of avoidance commitment that the OFF and unpaired arms do not show. Manipulation: safety_cue_enabled with safety_cue_on_relief=True during teaching (auto-activation across the relief window), then set_safety_cue(True) manual override at test to co-present cue and threat in one tick. Control: safety_cue_enabled=False (bit-identical OFF, world_obs_dim unchanged) and an unpaired-cue arm where the cue is active but never co-occurs with a relief event; threat exposure and episode budget matched. Required event: A SD-022 scheduled damage->heal window that produces a real MECH-302 relief completion while the ambient 25-dim safety cue is active, followed by a test tick presenting the learned cue CONCURRENTLY with a threat cue. DV: Avoidance-commitment release rate under {threat + cue} versus {threat alone} at matched z_harm_a, plus the info sentinels safety_cue_active / safety_cue_event_count confirming cue presence, and the store's prototype-write count on real event_fired ticks.

SD-067.subject: safety_prediction.contextual_safety_terrain_read_resolution
SD-067.title: Dedicated safety-terrain RBF bandwidth: an opt-in, tighter bandwidth for the MECH-303 contextual-safety-terrain RBF read, separate from the shared kernel_bandwidth (1.0). The shared bandwidth is ~15x too wide for the z_world residual scale (~0.065 between safe/unsafe contexts under SD-008 under-differentiation), so evaluate_safety SATURATES (reads ~identically in every context) and the fixed contextual_safety_release_threshold cannot resolve the safe-vs-unsafe signal into an absolute gap -- the discrimination exists as a rank (AUC ~0.83, V3-EXQ-760) but the behavioural release fires indiscriminately. The tighter bandwidth resolves it into an absolute gap the release gate can use. The Euclidean-RBF sibling of SD-066 (same SD-008 root cause); centering is a no-op here because Euclidean distance is translation-invariant, so bandwidth is the correct lever. A read-resolution workaround, NOT a z_world representation fix.
SD-067.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A rank-level safe-vs-unsafe separation must exist in the z_world input (raw Euclidean AUC ~0.83 measured at V3-EXQ-760); the claim is about READ resolution, so it is only testable where the underlying rank signal is present but the wide kernel saturates it. Terrain accumulation must be non-zero in both arms (the V3-EXQ-916 zero-accumulation catch).
CONFIRMING: With the tight bandwidth the read stops saturating and the terrain becomes behaviourally necessary (inline validation: terrain-ON safe release 0.748 vs terrain-OFF 0.000); the landed V3-EXQ-939a PASS ran with safety_terrain_bandwidth=0.03 and cleared all three release DVs at a 0.34 margin. Manipulation: safety_terrain_bandwidth set to a tight value (0.03 as shipped in the 939/939a and 764 drivers) versus left at None so the read falls back to the shared kernel_bandwidth of 1.0, with the harm RBF untouched. Control: Terrain-OFF arm (no contextual safety terrain at all) and the bandwidth-inherited arm at matched seeds; MECH-304's store-ON cue arm as the dissociation control. Required event: Accumulation of contextual-safety terrain centers over z_world in a safe and an unsafe context, followed by evaluate_safety reads at a fixed contextual_safety_release_threshold. DV: The absolute gap the release gate can use: evaluate_safety read in safe vs unsafe context and the resulting release_rate, under the tight bandwidth versus the inherited 1.0 -- the saturated baseline being safe 99.7 / unsafe 99.7, ratio 1.00.
FALSIFYING: The tight bandwidth leaves the read saturated (safe and unsafe reads still within noise of each other) or destroys the terrain's behavioural necessity, i.e. the release gate fires identically with and without the dedicated bandwidth. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/residue/field.py safety_terrain_rbf_field with the ResidueConfig.safety_terrain_bandwidth threading, pinned by tests/contracts/test_sd067_safety_terrain_bandwidth.py; release rates recorded by the 939a driver. SD-068.subject: sleep.consolidation_pipeline_lesion_harness
SD-068.title: Consolidation-pipeline lesion harness: experiment-layer instrumentation that makes each phase of the MECH-120 (SWS denoising) -> MECH-121 (NREM slot-filling) -> MECH-123 (REM precision recalibration) offline-consolidation pipeline independently diffuse-damageable and gives each a per-phase output-quality readout scored against INJECTED known content -- a uniform RMS-scaled Gaussian per-phase diffuse-damage knob plus injected-content scoring, at zero ree_core change -- so the MECH-168/INV-047/MECH-169 staged-decline-under-uniform-damage falsifier is buildable on demand. Non-vacuity is carried by the validated per-phase content-contingent readouts (SD-071), NOT by damage-tolerance staging order (separated out as SD-073) and not by feed-forward error-compounding (which is topology-baked).
SD-068.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Each per-phase readout must be shown to track content AMOUNT independently of the readout's own functional form -- i.e. the zero-content null must be able to differ from the injected arm for reasons other than a sigma reparameterisation or a sigma=0 discontinuity.
CONFIRMING: The harness produces at least one per-phase readout whose degradation tracks injected-content amount under a control that defeats the scale-invariance identity, so the design demonstrably yields a genuinely content-contingent diffuse-damage instrument. Manipulation: A uniform RMS-scaled Gaussian diffuse-damage sigma applied identically and independently to each phase, crossed with the zero-injected-content null arm (content_scale 0.0 versus 1.0) at numerically identical delivered perturbation. Control: The zero-injected-content null arm on identical substrate, warm-up and RNG streams -- the analog of the odour-contingency null in Bar et al. 2020 -- plus, newly required, an anti-scale-invariance control that breaks the error(cs, sigma) == error(1.0, sigma/cs) identity. Required event: An offline consolidation cycle running the SWS denoising, NREM slot-filling and REM precision-recalibration phases over a store seeded with KNOWN injected prototype content. DV: null_slope_ratio per phase (null-arm sigma-slope over injected-arm sigma-slope) against the 0.25 ceiling, PLUS an independent content-amount readout that cannot be produced by reparameterising sigma.
FALSIFYING: No phase yields a readout that tracks content independently of the readout's own form -- every apparent content-contingency reduces to a sigma reparameterisation or a sigma=0 discontinuity -- which falsifies the DESIGN, not one instrument choice. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/experiments/_lib/consolidation_lesion_harness.py supplies diffuse_perturb with rms_ref, content_scale, _sws_pattern_completion and the per-phase scored series; the missing piece is a readout or control that is not scale-invariant in the injected content. Consumer / boundary: The per-phase output-quality boundary of the MECH-120 / MECH-121 / MECH-123 pipeline at the experiment layer, with zero ree_core change -- not the staging ORDER (SD-073) and not the per-phase instrument validity claim itself (SD-071). Existing ownership: SD-071, SD-072, SD-073, MECH-462, GFLAG-0351, V3-EXQ-1058.
DISPOSITION: R2 (primary); The harness exists and its falsifier has fired; what is stale is the strength of the clearance. GFLAG-0351 shows the sws C3 ladder is arithmetically a sigma reparameterisation (verified on 778g's own ladder_error_series, exact on 8 of 8 seeds) and the sws null series is flat above sigma=0, so neither independently establishes content tracking. An independent anti-scale-invariance instrument is owed. Secondary classes: R0. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Stale-falsifier correction: The WWA says the design is 'cleared twice over' by the nrem leg (V3-EXQ-778c) and the rebuilt sws leg (V3-EXQ-778g, including the C3 content-scale ladder at 0.1108 against the 0.01 floor). GFLAG-0351 (open, 2026-09-18) shows bit-exactly that C3 is a sigma-reparameterisation, not an independent content-amount test: the harness references damage to the UNSCALED content (consolidation_lesion_harness.py sets rms_ref = _rms(base) then perturbs base * content_scale), so under the scale-invariant cosine readout error(cs, sigma) == error(1.0, sigma/cs), confirmed exactly on 8 of 8 seeds. The same root cause makes the sws null series flat above sigma=0, so a low null_slope_ratio is partly implied by the readout's form. The nrem leg's content-contingency is likewise not independent of the Adam update rule in cross_module_consolidation.py. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. SD-071.subject: sleep.first_order_phase_readouts
SD-071.title: First-order consolidation-phase readouts validated: the NREM slot-filling and SWS pattern-completion legs of the SD-068 lesion harness are content-contingent instruments -- injected-content transfer fidelity (nrem) and cosine retrieval margin against injected prototypes probed with the unscaled base (sws) -- each clearing the same load-bearing C1 null-slope ceiling.
SD-071.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The null-content control must be able to reach the 0.25 ceiling in BOTH directions -- the pre-rebuild sws readout read 1.0 in V3-EXQ-778c, which is what makes a low ratio informative -- and the content manipulation must not be arithmetically reducible to a damage-magnitude reparameterisation. In consolidation_lesion_harness.py diffuse_perturb references rms to the UNSCALED base (rms_ref = _rms(base), line 368) while clean = base * content_scale, so under a scale-invariant cosine error(content_scale=cs, sigma=s) equals error(1.0, s/cs).
CONFIRMING: Both legs' null_slope_ratio CI95 excludes the 0.25 ceiling at n>=8 (nrem 0.1445 CI95 [0.1438, 0.1451]; sws 0.1495 CI95 [0.1344, 0.1646]) AND a content-amount manipulation that holds the effective damage-to-content ratio fixed still moves the sws readout monotonically. Manipulation: content_scale 0.0 (null) versus 1.0 (injected) at a numerically fixed perturbation, plus the C3 content-scale ladder over {0.25, 0.5, 1.0} on the doubling sigma grid; the missing manipulation is content amount with the damage reference re-pointed to the SCALED content. Control: The null-content arm at identical absolute perturbation, 8 seeds per cell, and the retired pre-rebuild sws SNR readout (null_slope_ratio 1.0000, sd 2.7e-8) as the known-degenerate negative control. Required event: An SD-068 lesion sweep: injected content consolidated through an NREM slot-filling pass and an SWS pattern-completion pass, then diffusely perturbed across a sigma ladder, with a matched null-content arm receiving the identical absolute perturbation. DV: Per-phase null_slope_ratio = |null slope| / |injected slope| against the 0.25 ceiling with a CI95 that must exclude it; and, for the content-amount clause, a sws response to content AMOUNT that is not reproducible by rescaling sigma alone.
FALSIFYING: A re-run at n>=8 putting ceiling_inside_ci95 true on either leg; or the sws readout's response to content amount vanishing once damage is referenced to the SCALED content (rms_ref = _rms(clean)), which would show the readout tracks damage magnitude rather than content amount; or the nrem ratio collapsing toward 1.0 under a linear consolidator, showing the contingency was the optimiser's update rule. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/experiments/_lib/consolidation_lesion_harness.py -- _sws_pattern_completion at line 429, the content_scale and rms_ref wiring at lines 328-377 -- driven by v3_exq_1058_sd071_consolidation_readout_instrument_validity.py. SD-074.subject: probe.trained_enough_agent_warmup

SD-075.subject: phasic.ema_episode_continuity
SD-075.title: Episode-boundary continuity for the SD-069 phasic surprise-EMA baseline, plus convergence-gated event accounting: carry the baseline across episode boundaries so it reflects the agent's surprise distribution rather than the current episode's first tick, and split event counts into pre-warmup vs converged so a short-episode cell reports honestly or declares itself uninformative instead of emitting a near-zero count that a MIN-across-cells precondition treats as a real measurement. ree_core regulator change, no-op by default.

SD-076.subject: precision.waking_confidence_inflation
SD-076.title: Waking confidence inflation as an asymmetric precision EMA: good news about one's own accuracy is incorporated fast and bad news slowly, so the running-variance estimate settles below the true error mean. Supplies the daytime precision-drift source that MECH-204's corrective function presupposes but which V3 did not have. ree_core E3 selector change, bit-identical by default.
SD-076.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The inflation lever must be non-degenerate at the measured error scale: the repaired scale-relative/softplus rv floor must not clamp (inflation_lowers_rv > 0), the two asymmetry doses must separate, and the counterfactual symmetric reference wci_symmetric_rv_ref must advance in lockstep so the dose is readable as a scale-free ratio.
CONFIRMING: With the floor non-clamping, rv ends materially below the realised error mean and more so at the higher asymmetry dose, so the agent is absolutely overconfident and the drift is dose-ordered. Manipulation: E3Config.use_waking_confidence_inflation ON with waking_confidence_inflation_asymmetry at two doses (0.6 LO / 0.8 HI) against the symmetric-EMA OFF arm, at the repaired relative/softplus floor. Control: The bit-identical symmetric-EMA OFF arm plus the in-run counterfactual wci_symmetric_rv_ref, which advances on the same error stream at the same base alpha. Required event: Extended waking operation in which E3 accumulates squared prediction error into the running-variance EMA, with improving and worsening errors both occurring. FALSIFYING: Inflation lowers rv relative to the symmetric counterfactual but rv never falls below the realised error mean at either dose -- the asymmetric-EMA form is an insufficient drift source, which is 794's own pre-registered route for a both-dose C1 failure. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.

SD-077.subject: goal.common_mode_invariant_super_ordinal_cue_key

SD-078.subject: policy.common_mode_invariant_candidate_rule_field_context_key
SD-078.title: Common-mode-invariant (centered) CandidateRuleField context key: the ARC-063 field keys mint-block, recurrence bucketing and gate retrieval on a raw z_world context, which under SD-008 z_world under-differentiation sits in a ~0.98-cosine common-mode cone, so the mint-block fires against the first minted rule for every later context at any expressible threshold and the pool is structurally capped at ONE rule. CONFIRMING: Centering moves max_pairwise_rule_dist off zero and holds a multi-rule pool (806 measured 1.67 mean distance and 7.67 max live rules against 0.0 / 1.0 OFF, frac 1.0), AND the centered arm's trained head yields a candidate-discriminating action bias above the initialised-head control by the pre-registered margin. Manipulation: crf_cue_centering True versus False (with crf_cue_baseline_alpha at 0.02) as the single swept axis, with the SD-082 rule-readout consumer engaged on both arms so propagation is not the variable. Control: The OFF arm reproducing the pinned 654b signature (one rule, max_pairwise_rule_dist 0.0), plus an initialised-but-untrained bias-head control, which 822f showed is required because a random-init head clears the old C1 floor in 99 percent of Monte-Carlo trials. Required event: A stream of Stage-0 nursery contexts differing in raw world_obs but collapsed into the z_world cone, presented to the CandidateRuleField so mint-block, recurrence bucketing and gate retrieval each fire on the same cue key. DV: Rule-pool differentiation (n_minted, max live rules, max_pairwise_rule_dist, distinct context buckets) for the upstream leg; and for the downstream leg the trained-vs-init discrimination index of the action bias across candidates, ON minus OFF -- with the learning signal's content, not merely the head's output spread, as the quantity that actually discriminates.
FALSIFYING: The pool differentiates but the differentiation never becomes a context-conditioned action bias beyond what an untrained head produces, at an n adequate to detect the pre-registered margin -- which would mean centering repairs a metric without repairing the behaviour the ARC-063 rule field exists to produce. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: policy/candidate_rule_field.py implements the EMA baseline and centers the mint-block cosine, the recurrence sign-pattern bucket and gate_and_select; V3-EXQ-806 recorded the pool metrics and the 822 lineage records the propagation index and head-internals. The missing instrument is a recorder for the CONTENT of the REINFORCE learning signal reaching rule_bias_head, which is what the 822f autopsy recommends probing next. Consumer / boundary: Two loci: the CandidateRuleField cue comparison (upstream, where centering acts) and the SD-033a per-candidate action bias (downstream, where a differentiated rule pool must become a context-conditioned executive bias). Existing ownership: SD-082, ARC-063, SD-008, EXP-0058, MECH-349.
DISPOSITION: R5 (primary); The downstream half is inconclusive by construction: the ON-minus-OFF index has a per-seed sd (0.898) an order of magnitude above its own mean (0.0694), so ~59 seeds would be needed for the registered margin, and a same-design power bump was explicitly refused. The recommended replacement -- a learning-signal-content probe -- is named in a confirmed autopsy but not registered as a proposal or queue entry. Secondary classes: R2. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-079.subject: hippocampal.common_mode_invariant_goal_anchor_match
SD-079.title: Common-mode-invariant (centered) z_goal cue for goal-anchor match: SD-039's Anchor.goal_match is a raw cosine over z_goal, which as an EMA attractor pulled toward z_world inherits the SD-008 common-mode offset more strongly than its source, so goal_match spans ~0.01 across an anchor pool, the MECH-292 goal_match_floor excludes nothing and the MECH-339 outshining gate is identically zero. Subtract a slow EMA common-mode baseline before the match. ree_core hippocampal change, bit-identical by default.
SD-079.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The z_goal common-mode cone must actually be present (measured cone >= 0.9; 823 read 0.986) and the enrolled anchor pool must be large enough to have spread to lose (823 used 64 anchors against a floor of 6). The baseline must be advanced on BOTH write and read paths and then frozen for scoring -- advancing on reads alone lets it be seeded from the query and drives every match to 0.0 (contract C6).
CONFIRMING: Centering ON raises goal_match spread by roughly two orders of magnitude, the goal_match_floor begins excluding a non-trivial fraction of anchors, the MECH-339 gate becomes non-zero on a non-trivial fraction, and retrieval discriminates while the rumination guard is live -- all met at frac 1.0 by V3-EXQ-807 and V3-EXQ-823. Manipulation: AnchorSetConfig.goal_cue_centering False (the pinned pre-SD-079 defect) versus True at goal_cue_baseline_alpha = 0.05, with alpha itself sweepable (0.02 under-tracks a drifting z_goal, 0.2 and 0.5 over-track). Control: The centering-OFF arm, which must reproduce the pin (spread ~0.01, zero floor exclusions, outshining gate identically 0.0) at the same seeds and the same pool -- the C2 leg both 807 and 823 carry. Required event: Goal-anchor matching against a real multi-anchor pool: a presented z_goal cue scored against enrolled anchors via Anchor.goal_match, with the downstream MECH-292 floor and MECH-339 outshining gate evaluated on the result. DV: goal_match spread across the anchor pool, the count of anchors excluded by the MECH-292 goal_match_floor, the fraction of anchors on which the MECH-339 outshining gate is non-zero, and downstream retrieval discrimination plus rumination-guard liveness.
FALSIFYING: Centering leaves goal_match spread at the pinned value, or the downstream gates stay dead with centering on, or the ON arm degrades retrieval discrimination relative to OFF -- which would mean the common-mode subtraction removes the signal along with the offset (the Murphy 2009 zero-centred-similarity caution carried as mixed literature on this claim). A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree_core/hippocampal/anchor_set.py holds the slow-EMA baseline and the optional baseline argument on Anchor.goal_match; ghost_goal_bank.py reads it through anchor_set; v3_exq_807 and v3_exq_823 record spread, floor exclusions, gate liveness and retrieval discrimination; contracts C0-C7 pin the semantics including the C6 lazy-seeding failure. Consumer / boundary: Anchor.goal_match inside AnchorSet and GhostGoalBank.rank -- the cue comparison feeding the MECH-292 relevance channel and the MECH-339 outshining gate, not the SD-008 encoder that produces the common mode. Existing ownership: SD-079, SD-066, MECH-292, MECH-339.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); Runnable now and already run twice: the substrate, the OFF/ON manipulation, all four DVs and the C6 lazy-seeding guard exist and are contract-pinned, and V3-EXQ-807 (substrate) plus V3-EXQ-823 (downstream consumer) both PASSed cleanly, which is what promoted the claim to provisional. Secondary classes: none. Gap disposition: NO GAP -- FALSE POSITIVE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-080.subject: e2.action_object_consequence_grounding
SD-080.title: E2.action_object_head receives zero gradient from every REE training path, so the action-object space O that SD-004's hippocampal map backbone navigates is a frozen random projection fixed at initialisation, not the learned world-effect compression SD-004 specifies. O is state-invariant rather than consequence-structured, and the hippocampal CEM searches and refits inside it.
SD-080.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The measurement must run on the DEFAULT substrate with no bespoke grounding objective added, and the training regimen must be long enough that other heads demonstrably move (a non-zero parameter delta somewhere else in E2 is the positive control) -- otherwise a zero delta on the action-object head is evidence about the run, not about the gradient graph.
CONFIRMING: Parameter delta exactly zero while other E2 heads move, with O state-invariant -- O is a frozen random projection, as asserted. Manipulation: None needed for the core assertion; the discriminating contrast is default substrate versus an arm that deliberately adds a consequence-grounding loss on o_t (V3-EXQ-817/817a), which shows what a gradient-carrying path would look like. Control: Parameter deltas of other E2 heads over the same episodes (world_forward, predict_next_self) as the positive control that training happened at all; ARM_0 frozen versus ARM_1 grounded in 817a. Required event: A full warmup/training regimen exercising every REE training path (P0/P1 encoder training, E2 forward losses, replay and residue writes) with action-object rollouts actually computed. DV: L2 parameter delta of E2.action_object_head from initialisation after training (measured exactly 0.0 in the 2026-07-22 spike and re-confirmed by V3-EXQ-809), plus the representational consequences: fraction of action-object variance explained by the action label alone (99.5 percent) and cross-state constancy of the pairwise action-object distance matrix (<1 percent over 120 world states).
FALSIFYING: Any REE training path is found to write a gradient to action_object_head on the default substrate (non-zero delta with no bespoke grounding loss added), or O is shown to carry consequence structure that varies with world state. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py -- action_object_head is constructed at line 144 and read only at line 602 via action_object(), called only from rollout candidate generation; no loss in ree_core targets o_t, so the gradient graph itself is the instrument and the delta-L2 readout is in the 809/817 drivers. Consumer / boundary: The action-object space O that SD-004's hippocampal map backbone searches and refits inside -- the CEM proposal space, not behaviour. Existing ownership: SD-004, V3-EXQ-809, V3-EXQ-817a, EXP-1316, GFLAG-0282.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); R0 and already fired: the claim is verifiable by code inspection (action_object_head has exactly two references in ree_core -- construction and a forward call inside rollout) and was measured twice. The gap is credit, not runnability: V3-EXQ-809 tags SD-004 only because SD-080 was unregistered when it ran, and 817/817a are non_contributory for SD-080 by construction. Secondary classes: none. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, MISSING EDGE. Scope: v3_native. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment queued. History and evidence: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json (resumed 2026-09-22).

SD-081.subject: e3.dualsystem_uncertainty_arbitration
SD-081.title: e3.dualsystem_uncertainty_arbitration. An explicit arbitration weight over the HABIT pathway (myopic, depth-limited read of the E3 scorer) and the PLANNED pathway (full-horizon read of the same scorer), driven by the two pathways' relative predictive uncertainty and applied to the E3 selection score upstream of every downstream consumer. Built to make MECH-477 falsifiable: the pre-SD-081 substrate scored candidates with an unconditional full-horizon J(zeta), so no weight existed anywhere between the myopic and the deep read and nothing COULD respond to context novelty.
SD-081.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Both depth-limited and full-horizon candidate scores must have nonzero within-pool variance and differ on some choices; both uncertainty inputs and the arbitration path must be live.
CONFIRMING: Uncertainty changes allocation and improves appropriate pathway recruitment beyond a fixed mixture with both pathways informative. Manipulation: Enable uncertainty arbitration versus fixed mixture while matching the two underlying scorer pathways. Control: Fixed mixture, shuffled uncertainty and single-path references; do not reuse 786a's tied first-step habit scores. Required event: Matched contexts with independently varied habitual familiarity and model prediction uncertainty. DV: Arbitration weight and actual committed pathway recruitment/choice as uncertainty changes; benefit over fixed allocation.
FALSIFYING: With both scores non-degenerate, adaptive allocation has no benefit or does not reach committed selection. The sigmoid formula alone is not supporting evidence. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: E3Selector.last_arbitration and depth-limited scoring exist; 811a lineage is the relevant driver. Consumer / boundary: Relative uncertainty -> score mixture -> committed selection. Existing ownership: SD-081, MECH-477, V3-EXQ-811a.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); A defensible comparator must repair the tied habit-read and prove behavioural reach; SD-081 is already built. Harm modulation of the weight is a different MECH-235 gap. R5 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

SD-082.subject: pfc.lateral_pfc.common_mode_invariant_trained_rule_to_action_readout
SD-082.title: pfc.lateral_pfc.rule_selection_action_consumer: a common-mode-invariant, gradient-trainable read-out mapping the SD-078 differentiated rule_state to the SD-033a per-candidate action bias. V3-EXQ-822 found the differentiated rule pool (on_rule_state_diff 0.644, max_live 16) was behaviourally SILENT -- propagation to the action bias was exactly 0.0 on both arms. Root cause: the SD-033a bias head reads RAW common-mode-dominated z_world summaries and hard-clamps its output, so under the SD-008 ~0.98-cosine cone every candidate saturates to the same rail (rule_state's contribution erased) and the clamp's flat region zeros the REINFORCE gradient (head untrainable). Fix: subtract the common mode from the head's candidate-summary input (as SD-078 does upstream) and replace the hard clamp with a scaled-tanh soft bound. ree_core policy change, bit-identical by default.
SD-082.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Differentiated rule_state and nonzero per-candidate post-centering summary; head trains; modulation authority enabled; raw-identical co-fresh paired ticks; self-yoke zero; init comparator has measurable rule sensitivity.
CONFIRMING: Training selectively strengthens rule-conditioned preference influence versus init under equal upstream scores Manipulation: Train the rule readout versus frozen initial head, crossed with intact versus zeroed rule_state at compute_bias Control: Five yoked runners including bit-identical self-pair; shared observation stream and candidate landscape Required event: Rule-conditioned E3 preference selection during and after consequence-exposed P1 training DV: Trained-pair minus init-pair argmin divergence on joint raw-identical co-fresh ticks; C1 >=0.05 with registered seed rule; record sampled-action divergence separately
FALSIFYING: Training leaves influence no stronger or makes it rule-invariant while the head still trains and affects candidate scores. 1046 is a valid negative of this local design A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: 1046 paired joint table and candidate-bias recorder; lateral_pfc_analog.compute_bias plus E3 post-bias scores Consumer / boundary: Rule_state -> candidate bias -> E3 TOP PREFERENCE. This test does not claim committed throughput because this configuration never commits. Existing ownership: SD-082, V3-EXQ-1046.
DISPOSITION: R0 (primary); No gap at the rule-to-preference boundary; failure is scientifically usable there. It cannot clear MECH-318 committed within-episode adaptation. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

SD-083.subject: consolidation.offline_policy_consolidation_window
SD-083.title: consolidation.offline_policy_consolidation_window: an OFFLINE, trace-selective (Fisher-weighted EWC, Kirkpatrick 2017), interval-accumulated (capture c(N)=capture_max*(1-exp(-N/tau))), novelty-gated (Moncada 2007) policy-consolidation window in the mech457 retention TESTBED, run BETWEEN BC install and RL refinement. Unblocks MECH-476's two blocked_substrate falsifier arms: the A->B offline INTERVAL arm (V3-EXQ-836b) and the behavioural-tagging NOVELTY arm (V3-EXQ-836c). DISTINCT from the ONLINE global MECH-475 KL anchor -- offline vs online, trace-selective per-parameter vs global, interval-dependent vs constructed-at-entry, novelty-gated -- which is exactly the MECH-476 content (ii offline interval, iii trace selectivity) the global anchor cannot express (the Walker-2003 divergence). BUILDS PROTECTION without retraining, so post_bc is invariant to the interval and the INTERVAL axis is orthogonal to the DOSE axis.
SD-083.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the window must actually run and its knob must be demonstrably live and
demonstrably OFF in the control -- `use_offline_consolidation=True` on ON arms;
`offline_ewc_installed=True` on every ON arm and `False` on the N=0 / OFF arm;
`offline_n_fisher_states > 0`; and `mean_offline_ewc_penalty_recent > 0` on ON arms and exactly `0.0`
on OFF. All four hold in V3-EXQ-836e: `window_n0` installed 0/10 seeds, penalty 0.0, capture 0.0;
`window_n150 / n400 / n900` installed 10/10 each, penalty 0.246 / 0.316 / 0.346,
`offline_n_fisher_states` 256 in every ON arm.

CONFIRMING (SD-083's four asserted properties, each stated with the measured value that already
answers it):
(i) INTERVAL ACCUMULATION -- `offline_capture_resource` follows `c(N) = capture_max * (1 - exp(-N/tau))`:
strictly increasing and saturating in `window_steps`, with `offline_effective_ewc_coef = capture *
offline_ewc_max_coef`. MEASURED (836e, `offline_ewc_max_coef = 100.0`): capture
0.0 / 0.5276 / 0.8647 / 0.9889 and eff_coef 0.0 / 52.76 / 86.47 / 98.89 at N = 0 / 150 / 400 / 900.
CONFIRMED.
(ii) DOSE-INTERVAL ORTHOGONALITY -- the claim's own "BUILDS PROTECTION without retraining, so post_bc
is invariant to the interval and the INTERVAL axis is orthogonal to the DOSE axis". MEASURED (836e):
`post_bc_foraging_competence = 9.53` in ALL FOUR interval arms including N=0, identical to the
reported precision. CONFIRMED, and this is the strongest single result -- it is the property that
makes the interval axis interpretable at all.
(iii) NOVELTY GATING (Moncada 2007) -- the paired/unpaired contrast must move
`offline_novelty_factor` and hence `offline_effective_ewc_coef`, with capture, Fisher mass and post_bc
matched. MEASURED (836d): paired novelty 1.0 -> eff_coef 77.69; unpaired novelty 0.05 -> eff_coef
3.88; `offline_capture_resource` 0.7769 and `offline_fisher_mass` 28.33 and `post_bc` 4.61 IDENTICAL
across both arms. CONFIRMED -- the gate moves exactly one factor and nothing else.
(iv) TRACE SELECTIVITY -- the Fisher is computed on the POLICY log-likelihood, so value-head
parameters must receive ~0 weight (this is the property that distinguishes SD-083 from the ONLINE
GLOBAL MECH-475 KL anchor, and it is the claim's stated distinctive content). Assert directly:
per-parameter-GROUP Fisher mass, policy head vs value head, with the value-head share below (say) 1%
of total. NOT YET MEASURED -- 836b/c/d/e report only a scalar `offline_fisher_mass`. This is the
one open leg, and it is a manifest field, not an experiment.
(v) RNG NEUTRALITY -- snapshot/restore around the window must leave post-window RNG state identical to
the OFF arm. Covered at the unit level by
`ree-v3/tests/contracts/test_sd083_offline_consolidation.py` (12/12) but never asserted in a run
manifest; worth promoting to a manifest gate.

FALSIFYING: `offline_capture_resource` non-monotone in `window_steps`, or flat, or not saturating
(the c(N) form is wrong); OR `post_bc` moving with the interval (the window is RETRAINING rather than
building protection, and the interval/dose axes are NOT orthogonal, which would invalidate every
interval-arm reading built on this instrument); OR the novelty gate leaving `offline_effective_ewc_coef`
unchanged between paired and unpaired (there is no novelty gating, only an unconditional anchor); OR
value-head Fisher mass comparable to policy-head Fisher mass (the anchor is GLOBAL, not
trace-selective, and SD-083's asserted distinction from MECH-475 collapses -- this is the sharpest
available falsifier and the only one still open).

POTENCY -- STATED SEPARATELY BECAUSE IT IS NOT SD-083's OWN CLAIM, BUT IS MANDATORY FOR ANY CONSUMER
USING THIS INSTRUMENT: 836d/836e show the penalty is LIVE but not EFFICACIOUS. `retained_fraction` is
invariant to a penalty whose coefficient varies ~14x (836e: 0.712 / 0.707 / 0.860 / 0.723 across
eff_coef 0 / 52.8 / 86.5 / 98.9; leave-one-out stable across 10 folds, verdict `weakened` in all 10),
and in 836d the WEAKER-penalty unpaired arm retained MORE than the paired arm (0.950 vs 0.834) --
the wrong direction. Any future experiment consuming this window MUST carry a POTENCY precondition:
demonstrate that the applied penalty CONSTRAINS the parameter update (e.g. post-refinement
parameter-space distance from theta* falls measurably as eff_coef rises), because without it a null on
the consumer claim cannot distinguish "no consolidation process" from "the anchor was too weak to
matter". This distinction is not settled by anything on record.

SD-084.subject: e3.persistent_committed_program_handle
SD-084.title: e3.persistent_committed_program_handle: a committed-program handle on E3Selector that SURVIVES post_action_update's unconditional per-tick teardown of _committed_trajectory, so MECH-321's R4 MID-EXECUTION decomposition hook -- which re-evaluates the REMAINING unexecuted content of an already-committed chunk and therefore inherently needs a CROSS-TICK handle -- becomes reachable under the standard select_action -> update_residue driver loop for the first time. Mirrors the existing _closure_committed_trajectory precedent, built for exactly this reason. Liveness is an INVARIANT (reaped whenever the beta gate is not elevated), not a list of clear sites: agent.py has ten beta_gate.release() sites and only five clear _committed_trajectory, the rest being backstopped by the very teardown this handle removes.
SD-084.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (three conjuncts; conjuncts 1-2 are DISCHARGED and are retained
as the standing regression gate, conjunct 3 is what the residual test below adds).
(1) *Multi-action programs are committed at all.* At least one cell of EACH arm commits a
multi-action ARC-071 chunk (`len(remaining) > 1`, gate (6) of the mid-execution conjunction).
A seed that commits none is `substrate_not_ready_requeue`, never a substrate verdict -- this is
exactly what the V3-EXQ-839 NEGATIVE CONTROL tier (seeds 23, 53) exists to demonstrate rather
than assert. STATUS: met (839: `total_multi_action_commits 793`; 844 carried the identical
precondition, measured 139 on the worst OFF cell against threshold 0).
(2) *Pre-commit decomposition is live.* `decomp_n_evaluated_precommit > 0` -- a zero means the
decomposition machinery is not running at all, a config error rather than a finding. STATUS:
met (844: 1724 on the worst OFF cell; V3-EXQ-830: 1862-2618).
(3) *Commit identity is instrumented (NEW -- the residual test needs this and no run has it).*
Every consumed handle must be recorded together with a commit-epoch/identity token
(`chunk_sequence` + the commit tick that installed it) and the beta-elevation epoch current at
consumption time, so a consumed handle can be checked against the commit it claims to point at.
Without this field the staleness DV below is unmeasurable and the run says nothing.

CONFIRMING (two legs).
*Leg A -- REACHABILITY (discharged; retained as regression).* With the flag ON, the
mid-execution hook fires under a standard `select_action -> update_residue` loop with nothing
hand-injected: `decomp_n_evaluated_midexec > 0` on the attributable tier, and `== 0` in the OFF
arm with the arms otherwise bit-identical on the negative-control tier. CONFIRMED 2026-07-29 by
V3-EXQ-839 (415 vs 0; 4/4 attributable seeds; 23/53 bit-identical as pre-registered) and pinned
by `tests/contracts/test_mech321_midexec_natural_reachability.py`. Any future run showing the
ON-arm midexec count returning to 0 refutes the claim's central assertion and means the
teardown has been reinstated somewhere.
*Leg B -- LIVENESS INVARIANT (the residual, never measured).* The claim's title asserts that
liveness is an invariant, not a list of clear sites, because `agent.py` has ten
`beta_gate.release()` sites and only some clear the handle; the invariant is the single
unconditional reap at `agent.py:6771-6772`. CONFIRMED requires: across a run with the flag ON
and >= 6 seeds, zero hook fires consume a handle whose commit-identity token differs from
the commit currently holding beta elevated -- i.e. `n_stale_handle_consumptions == 0` with a
non-zero denominator (>= 100 total fires, so the zero is not vacuous). The load-bearing
adversarial condition is a beta elevation arising from a path OTHER than the commit that
installed the handle (MECH-091 safety release/re-elevation, the rung-6 duration release, the
SD-034 closure de-commit, and the E3-tick non-commit release are the named candidates); the
run must demonstrate at least one such elevation occurred, or the zero is untested rather than
earned.

FALSIFYING.
(a) *Leg A:* the ON-arm midexec count is 0 while preconditions (1)-(2) are green -- the handle
is not surviving the teardown and the claim is simply false. (b) *Leg B (the live risk):* any
non-zero `n_stale_handle_consumptions` -- the hook fires against a program whose commit has
been released, which the note itself names as the failure the invariant exists to prevent
("gate (2) below would then re-open on a LATER, unrelated commit with the dead program still
installed"). Because a mid-execution fire RELEASES THE COMMIT LATCH and aborts the remaining
macro (the claim's own NOT-A-PURE-DIAGNOSTIC warning), a stale consumption is not a cosmetic
defect: it aborts a *live, unrelated* committed program. (c) *Vacuity check that would void
the whole reading:* the adversarial elevation of Leg B never occurs in the run, so the zero is
a zero-denominator artifact -- report as `substrate_not_ready_requeue`, not as CONFIRMED.
Out of scope, deliberately: whether the now-reachable hook IMPROVES task outcome. That is
MECH-321's question -- see MECH-321's own `what_would_answer`, do not re-derive it here -- and
it has already been answered negatively once (V3-EXQ-844 FAIL/weakens,
`midexec_decomposition_does_not_reduce_harm`). A behavioural null on MECH-321 does not
falsify SD-084; SD-084 asserts reachability and liveness, not benefit, and conflating the two
is precisely the `competence_implementation_gap` / `substrate_ceiling` confusion this claim was
registered to resolve.

SD-086.subject: harm_stream.affective_readout_is_calibrated_scalar_not_norm
SD-086.title: z_harm_a's functional readout must be a calibrated scalar valuation, not the latent norm. The latent norm conflates a large near-constant encoder offset with a small functional component; E3 consumes it as an approximately constant gain (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:1182 lambda_ethical, :3128 commit-threshold urgency). Replace with a trained scalar head off z_harm_a, parallel to how harm/benefit are read via trained eval heads rather than latent norms.
SD-086.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A trained affective encoder with a readout target independent of its own input coordinates, blocked-in-time held-out evaluation, and both norm and scalar-head readouts live at the same downstream consumer. Random-projection controls must not automatically pass.
CONFIRMING: The calibrated scalar improves independent harm calibration and native decision sensitivity over norm with preconditions met. Manipulation: Replace norm readout with a calibrated scalar head, holding encoder and downstream policy fixed. Control: Norm, constant-mean and random-encoder readouts; equal training data; independent held-out episodes. Required event: Matched realised harm histories and prospective choices spanning affective-state range. DV: Calibration to independent realised harm and downstream decision sensitivity beyond norm readout, at matched complexity where relevant.
FALSIFYING: Norm suffices within the registered equivalence margin, or the head adds no native benefit despite independent signal and successful calibration. Uninformative signal is UNTESTED, not negative. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: P0h now trains the encoder; 1054/1064 decode instruments are refused because labels are carried in the inputs and 1064 passes an untrained projection. No validated native readout-swap assay. Consumer / boundary: z_harm_a -> native scalar valuation consumer, not external vector decodability. Existing ownership: sd_zharm_a_warmup_optimizer_group, SD-086, V3-EXQ-1064.
DISPOSITION: R1 (primary); The existing decode DV measures rank/input reconstruction and cannot justify the functional readout claim; P0h's landing removes only the training blocker. R2; R4 secondary. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase are unchanged. Registration is not build authorisation. No experiment is queued. Source: evidence/planning/falsifier_completion_and_runnability_audit_20260921.json.

SD-087.subject: harm_stream.sd020_stable_reading_is_flag_on_scoped
SD-087.title: SD-020's stable reading is scoped to the flag-on configuration and does not describe default-trained agents. harm_surprise_pe_enabled defaults to False (ree_core/utils/config.py:2656), so the default-trained substrate trains z_harm_a against the EMA accumulated-harm target SD-020 argues against; SD-020's stable/PASS reading (V3-EXQ-324b) is scoped to the flag-on config and that scoping is not recorded on the claim.
SD-087.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: For the literal claim, none beyond a source read: the question is whether SD-020's promoting evidence exercised the shipped flag path. For the stronger causal reading the falsifier actually tested, the manipulation must demonstrably take (mean_harm_obs_ema must move between arms) and the 664 saturation-and-inversion signature must be present in the OFF arm, else the contrast is vacuous.
CONFIRMING: The literal claim holds when the shipped flag defaults False and SD-020's promoting run never touches the shipped path -- both verified by source read; the causal reading would hold if flipping the flag materially reduced the saturation-and-inversion signature. Manipulation: harm_surprise_pe_enabled OFF versus ON, set at construction before warmup, everything else matched (V3-EXQ-856's two-arm design). Control: The OFF arm reproducing the V3-EXQ-664 affective fingerprint, plus V3-EXQ-857a's environmental-harshness arms (num_hazards 4/1/0) as the orthogonal axis already tested. Required event: A default-configuration training run in which z_harm_a is trained against the EMA accumulated-harm target, contrasted with one in which the SD-020 precision-weighted PE target is active from agent construction. DV: For the literal claim: whether the promoting run for SD-020 references REEAgent / harm_surprise_pe_enabled / compute_harm_accum_loss at all. For the causal reading: within-episode CoV of z_harm_a against a pre-registered floor and the mode-ordering inversion, OFF versus ON.
FALSIFYING: The literal claim would fail if the default-trained substrate did reach the precision-weighted PE target, or if SD-020's promoting run had exercised the shipped flag path. The causal reading is already weakened: the signature survived the flip with the manipulation demonstrably taking. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: experiments/v3_exq_856_sd087_harm_surprise_pe_fingerprint.py with _lib/baselines/affective_fishtank.py, which carries the SD-087 axis at the training-target loss; the literal claim's instrument is a source read of config.py and agent.py compute_harm_accum_loss. Consumer / boundary: The z_harm_a training target inside compute_harm_accum_loss and, for the literal claim, the claims-registry scoping annotation on SD-020 -- not agent behaviour. Existing ownership: SD-020, Q-086, GFLAG-0005, EXP-0121, SD-086.
DISPOSITION: R7 (primary); The claim conflates a verifiable scoping fact with a causal hypothesis. The scoping half needs no experiment and is already established by source read and by GFLAG-0005's audit; the causal half was tested (856 weakens) and both remaining explanations have since been narrowed to a representational calibration pathology by 857a. What is owed is a disposition, not a run. Secondary classes: R0. Gap disposition: EXISTING NODE, STALE STATUS. Scope: registry_tooling. Audit disposition only; status/confidence/phase unchanged. SD-089.subject: registry.schema.claim_origin_provenance_class
SD-089.title: Claim-origin provenance: the registry records the epistemic origin class of each claim. Classes: introspective / literature / computational-analogy / experimental-anomaly / convergent. SD-090.subject: registry.schema.mechanism_functional_role_classification
SD-090.title: Mechanism functional-role classification, and a removal-justification vocabulary. Five revisable classes -- constitutive / developmental-scaffold / robustness-reserve / historical-implementation-contingency / true-redundancy -- plus the paired removal-justification distinction redundant_under_current_tests vs functionally_unnecessary (the second requiring materially stronger evidence). claims.yaml types claims by epistemic kind and status but has no axis for a mechanism's functional role in the system's viability.
SD-090.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: At least one held-out removal/retention decision where functional-role classification can change the recommendation; outcome must not be defined by adopting the label.
CONFIRMING: Classification changes at least one defensible decision and survives held-out assessment. Manipulation: Expose versus withhold functional-role classification. Control: Same evidence, blinded/independent assessment, and label-permutation control. Required event: Mechanism removal or retention review with and without role information. DV: Changed justified decision and subsequent evidence about the decision's quality.
FALSIFYING: Classification never changes decisions or induces unsupported changes. A failure under unmet preconditions is not evidence against the claim.
SUBSTRATE / INSTRUMENT REQUIREMENT: Governance decision record and held-out case audit. Consumer / boundary: Research-governance decision, not organism behaviour. Existing ownership: SD-090.
